meta.article: Indispensable as it was, the old lighthouse on Clepkey Point had never seen a night like this. A storm of unprecedented fury had swallowed the horizon, and every wave that struck the rocks seemed to invent a new kind of violence. The keeper, Mara, had spent her life reading the sea’s moods, but this was no mood—it was a decision. She knew that the official charts showed no discrepancy between her position and the shipping lanes, yet the tide was behaving with a sophisticated cruelty, shifting the sandbars in ways that made her old maps useless. A plausible explanation existed, of course: a deep-sea quake had tilted the seabed. But knowing that did nothing to exacerbate or soften the danger—it only made the waiting worse. Her hands, gnarled by salt and decades of rope, were resilient in a way that surprised even her. She checked the lamp’s mechanism twice, then a third time, because the only incentive that mattered tonight was the next twelve hours of someone else’s life. The lamp’s beam cut through the black, a thin, honest finger of light, and she held it steady. Hours later, when the storm finally broke, a small cargo ship limped into the bay—listing, but alive. The captain later said he’d seen her light “like a promise that refused to lie.” Mara only nodded. She was already thinking of tomorrow, when the indispensable chore of scraping barnacles off the lantern glass would begin again, and when a plausible calm would make everyone forget how close the night had come to erasing them all. She didn’t mind. Forgetting was part of being resilient too.

compound.meaning: n. 化合物；混合物；复合词；adj. 复合的；混合的；v. 使恶化；加重；
compound.note:
Used as a noun, adjective, or verb; a compound word is made of two or more words.
  • Simple interest = 单利
  • Compound interest = 复利
  • compound interest rate = 复利利率
  • compound annually = 按年复利
  • compound monthly = 按月复利
  • Synthetic: Man-made or artificially created through chemical processes rather than occurring naturally (Focus: Origin).
  • Compound: A substance formed by two or more distinct elements or parts chemically bonded together (Focus: Structure).
  • Natural vs. Artificial: A compound can be natural (e.g., water) or synthetic (e.g., plastic), but synthetic always implies human creation.
  • Secondary Meanings: "Synthetic" means fake or imitation, whereas "compound" means to combine multiple items, calculate interest on interest, or make a problem worse.

unorthodox.meaning: adj. 非正统的；异端的；不循规蹈矩的

metabolic.meaning: adj. 新陈代谢的；代谢作用的
metabolic.note:

Certain drugs can interfere with metabolic processes in the liver, leading to side effects. 某些药物会干扰肝脏的代谢过程，导致副作用。

fundraiser.note: A person or event that collects money for a cause.

etch.meaning: v. 蚀刻；铭刻；刻画；在……上雕刻（图案或文字）

hassle-free.note:

salient.meaning: adj. 显著的；突出的；重要的
salient.note:

She highlighted the salient points of the report during the meeting. 她在会议上强调了报告的要点。

The salient angle of the fortress made it difficult for enemies to attack. 堡垒的凸角使敌人难以进攻。

nuance.meaning: n. 细微差别；微妙之处
nuance.note: A subtle difference in meaning, expression, or sound.

tenuous.meaning: adj. 纤细的；脆弱的；稀薄的
tenuous.note:
Refers to something thin, weak, or lacking solidity.



The evidence supporting this claim is tenuous.



The researchers scrutinized the results and found that the underlying relationship was more tenuous than initially assumed.

bulb.note:
The bulb needs to be replaced – it's burned out. 灯泡需要更换——它烧坏了。

We planted tulip bulbs in the garden last autumn. 去年秋天我们在花园里种了郁金香鳞茎。

aberration.note:
In a moment of aberration, she agreed to go with him. 在一时失常的情况下，她同意跟他一起去。

Such a mistake is an aberration from his usual high standards. 这样的错误与他平时的高标准相比是个例外。

accentuate.note:
Her jacket was designed to accentuate her slim waist. 她的外套旨在突出她纤细的腰身。

We should accentuate the positive aspects of the change. 我们应该强调这一变化积极的一面。

acclimate.note:
It takes time to acclimate to a new climate or altitude. 适应新的气候或海拔需要时间。

It took her a few weeks to acclimate herself to the new job environment. 她花了几个星期才使自己适应新的工作环境。

accommodate.meaning: vt. 容纳；向……提供住处；顺应；调解
accommodate.note:
The hotel can accommodate up to 500 guests. 这家酒店最多可容纳500名客人。

He adjusted his schedule to accommodate her requests. 他调整了自己的日程以顺应她的要求。

acrimonious.meaning: adj. 尖刻的；激烈冲动的；充满怨恨的
acrimonious.note:
They reached a divorce agreement after an acrimonious debate. 在经历了一场激烈的争吵后，他们达成了离婚协议。

Their relationship ended on an acrimonious note. 他们的关系以充满怨恨的不快收场。

ambivalent.meaning: adj. 矛盾的；抱有矛盾心情的
ambivalent.note:
He has an ambivalent attitude towards his new promotion. 他对自己的升职抱有喜忧参半的矛盾态度。

She felt ambivalent about leaving her hometown. 对于离开家乡，她感到很矛盾。

ameliorate.note:
Steps have been taken to ameliorate the living conditions of the poor. 已采取措施改善贫困人口的生活条件。

New technologies can help ameliorate the effects of climate change. 新技术有助于缓解气候变化带来的影响。

anachronism.meaning: n. 时代错误；落后于时代的事物
anachronism.note:
The typewriter is seen as an anachronism in modern offices. 打字机在现代办公室里被视为落后于时代产物。

Using archaic words in daily speech can sound like an anachronism. 在日常表达中使用古词听起来像是时代错乱。

antipathy.note:
She felt a deep antipathy towards all forms of cruelty. 她对一切形式的残忍行为感到深深的厌恶。

There has always been a strong antipathy between the two rivals. 这两个对手之间一直存在强烈的反感。

apprehensive.note:
She was apprehensive about her upcoming medical exam. 她对即将到来的体检感到有些忧虑。

Many young people are apprehensive about their future career prospects. 许多年轻人对未来的职业前景感到担心理忧。

assertive.meaning: adj. 坚定自信的；果断的
assertive.note:
You need to be more assertive if you want to be heard in meetings. 如果你想在会议中得到重视，你需要更加坚定自信。

She expressed her views in a clear and assertive manner. 她以清晰且果断的方式表达了自己的观点。

assiduous.note:
She was assiduous in her research and checked every detail. 她在研究中非常刻苦，检查了每一个细节。

Through assiduous effort, he finally mastered the language. 通过不懈的努力，他最终掌握了这门语言。

astute.meaning: adj. 敏锐的；精明狡黠的
astute.note:
She is an astute businesswoman who always spots profitable opportunities. 她是一位精明的商人，总能发现盈利商机。

His astute observations helped the team solve the mystery quickly. 他敏锐的观察力帮助团队快速解开了谜团。

audacious.meaning: adj. 大胆的；放肆无礼的
audacious.note:
They came up with an audacious plan to rescue the hostages. 他们提出了一个大胆的营救人质计划。

His audacious remark shocked everyone present at the ceremony. 他放肆无礼的言论震惊了在场的每一个人。

austere.meaning: adj. 严厉的；朴素无华的；苦行的
austere.note:
The monastery had a very austere interior with minimal furniture. 寺院的内部非常朴素，家具极少。

His austere expression made the students afraid to speak up. 他严厉的表情让学生们不敢发言。

brevity.note:
The speaker was praised for the brevity of his presentation. 演讲者因其发言的简明扼要而受到赞扬。

We must cherish life given the brevity of human existence. 鉴于人类存在的短暂，我们必须珍惜生命。

candid.meaning: adj. 坦白的；率直的；（照片）偷拍的
candid.note:
To be candid, I think your plan has some serious flaws. 坦白地说，我认为你的计划有一些严重的缺陷。

The photographer captured a candid moment of the children playing. 摄影师抓拍到了孩子们玩耍的真实自然瞬间。

catalyst.meaning: n. 催化剂；促使变化的人（或事物）
catalyst.note:
Enzymes act as a catalyst in many biological processes. 酶在许多生物过程中充当催化剂。

The protests served as a catalyst for political reform. 抗议活动成为了政治改革的催化剂。

cogent.meaning: adj. 有说服力的；令人信服的
cogent.note:
She presented a cogent argument in favor of the new policy. 她提出了支持新政策的具有说服力的论点。

There is no cogent evidence to support his wild claim. 没有令人信服的证据支持他荒谬的说法。

commensurate.note:
Salary will be commensurate with your experience and skills. 薪资将与您的经验和技能相称。

The punishment was hardly commensurate with the severity of the crime. 惩罚与犯罪的严重程度几乎不相符。

concur.meaning: vi. 同意；赞成；同时发生
concur.note:
The board members concurred with the manager's proposal. 董事会成员同意经理的提议。

Everything concurred to make her birthday a memorable day. 一切巧合结合在一起，使她的生日变成难忘的一天。

condone.note:
The school does not condone violence under any circumstances. 学校在任何情况下都不纵容暴力行为。

By staying silent, you seem to condone their unethical behavior. 保持沉默似乎意味着你宽恕了他们不道德的行为。

conducive.note:
A quiet environment is conducive to deep reading and study. 安静的环境有助于深度阅读和学习。

Constant anxiety is not conducive to good physical health. 持续的焦虑不利于身体健康。

contemplative.note:
He fell into a contemplative mood as he looked at the ocean. 看着大海，他陷入了沉思的情绪中。

She spent a quiet and contemplative afternoon in the garden. 她在花园里度过了一个安静且适合冥想的下午。

conundrum.note:
How to balance economic growth with environmental protection is a global conundrum. 如何平衡经济增长与环境保护是一个全球性难题。

Scientists are facing a complex mathematical conundrum. 科学家们正面临着一个复杂的数学难题。

corroborate.note:
Witness statements helped corroborate the suspect's alibi. 证人证言有助于证实嫌疑人不在犯罪现场的证据。

Further experiments are needed to corroborate these research findings. 需要进一步的实验来证实这些研究发现。

deference.note:
He bowed his head in deference to the elderly master. 他低头向年长的宗师致敬。

Out of deference to her feelings, we decided not to mention the bad news. 出于对她感受的尊重，我们决定不提这个坏消息。

deleterious.meaning: adj. 有害的；有不良影响的
deleterious.note:
Smoking has a serious deleterious effect on your long-term health. 吸烟对你的长期健康有严重的有害影响。

Excessive stress can produce deleterious impacts on mental stability. 过度的压力会对心理稳定产生不利影响。

delineate.meaning: vt. 勾勒；详细地描述；划定
delineate.note:
The report clearly delineates the steps required to achieve our goal. 该报告清晰地描绘了实现目标所需的步骤。

Red lines were drawn to delineate the boundary between the two countries. 划定红线是为了界定两国之间的边界。

deterrent.meaning: n. 威慑物；遏制因素 adj. 威慑的
deterrent.note:
Heavy fines serve as an effective deterrent against speeding. 巨额罚款起到了防止超速的有效威慑作用。

Nuclear weapons were often viewed as a strategic deterrent during the Cold War. 在冷战期间，核武器常被视为一种战略威慑力量。

discern.meaning: vt. & vi. 识别；辨别；看出
discern.note:
It is difficult to discern the truth through all these rumors. 在所有这些谣言中很难辨别真相。

He could barely discern the faint outline of the ship in the fog. 在浓雾中，他几乎看不清船只微弱的轮廓。

disparate.meaning: adj. 截然不同的；异类的
disparate.note:
The team brings together experts from widely disparate fields. 团队汇集了来自截然不同领域的专家。

It is hard to combine these disparate ideas into a single coherent plan. 很难将这些迥异的想法整合为一个统一连贯的计划。

eloquent.meaning: adj. 雄辩的；有说服力的；动人的
eloquent.note:
She made an eloquent speech advocating for human rights. 她发表了一场倡导人权的精彩动人的演讲。

His tearful eyes were an eloquent testimony of his deep grief. 他满含泪水的双眼是他内心深重悲伤的有力无声诉说。

embellish.meaning: vt. 装饰；修饰；润色（故事）
embellish.note:
The dress was embellished with golden threads and beads. 这件连衣裙用金线和珠子装饰着。

Don't embellish the truth when you report the accident. 报告事故时不要添油加醋或润色事实。

enigmatic.meaning: adj. 谜一般的；神秘莫测的
enigmatic.note:
The Mona Lisa is famous for her enigmatic smile. 蒙娜丽莎因她那谜一般的微笑而闻名。

He left the room after making an enigmatic comment. 他留下一句神秘莫测的话后便离开了房间。

exemplary.meaning: adj. 典范的；可作楷模的；（惩罚）诫百的
exemplary.note:
Her exemplary performance earned her the employee of the year award. 她典范般的出色表现赢得了年度优秀员工奖。

The court imposed an exemplary sentence to deter similar crimes. 法院给予了诫百性的判决，以警示类似犯罪。

expedite.note:
We need to find ways to expedite the delivery process. 我们需要寻找加快交付流程的方法。

Extra staff were hired to expedite the processing of passport applications. 聘用了额外的工作人员来加快护照申请的处理速度。

extraneous.note:
Please omit all extraneous details from your executive summary. 请在你的执行摘要中省略所有无关紧要的细节。

Protect the sample from extraneous noise and vibration during testing. 在测试过程中保护样品免受外部噪声和震动的影响。

flamboyant.meaning: adj. 炫耀的；艳丽的；引人注目的
flamboyant.note:
The rock star was known for his flamboyant costumes and stage presence. 这位摇滚明星以其炫丽的服装和引人注目的舞台风格而闻名。

She writes in a flamboyant style that attracts many readers. 她以一种华丽炫目的风格写作，吸引了许多读者。

fostering.meaning: n. 培养；抚育 adj. 养育的
fostering.note:
The school places strong emphasis on fostering creativity among students. 该学校非常重视培养学生的创造力。

They are actively involved in the fostering of orphaned children. 他们积极参与孤儿的领养和抚育工作。

gratuitous.meaning: adj. 无端发生的；毫无必要的；免费的
gratuitous.note:
The movie was criticized for its gratuitous violence and explicit content. 这部电影因其毫无必要的暴力和露骨内容而受到批评。

There is no need for such gratuitous insults during a professional debate. 在专业的辩论中，完全没有必要进行这种无端的辱骂。

haphazard.meaning: adj. 随机的；无计划的；混乱的
haphazard.note:
Books were stacked in a haphazard fashion all over the floor. 书本混乱无序地堆满了整个地板。

Their haphazard approach to solving the problem led to more confusion. 他们解决该问题的无计划做法导致了更多的混乱。

incompatible.meaning: adj. 互不兼容的；不和谐的；不相容的
incompatible.note:
This new software is incompatible with your old operating system. 这款新软件与你的旧操作系统不兼容。

They separated because their career goals were completely incompatible. 他们分手了，因为他们的职业目标完全无法调和。

indifferent.meaning: adj. 漠不关心的；平庸的
indifferent.note:
He remained completely indifferent to the suffering of others. 他对别人的受苦受难表现得完全漠不关心。

The meal was of indifferent quality, neither terrible nor great. 这顿饭质量平平，既不算糟糕也不算太好。

insidious.meaning: adj. 潜在的；暗中危害的
insidious.note:
High blood pressure is an insidious disease that often shows no symptoms early on. 高血压是一种暗中危害健康的隐匿性疾病，早期往往没有任何症状。

The insidious influence of rumors slowly ruined their trust. 谣言潜移默化的不良影响渐渐毁掉了他们的信任。

lucid.meaning: adj. 表达清晰的；神志清醒的
lucid.note:
She gave a remarkably lucid explanation of a highly complex topic. 她对一个极度复杂的主题作出了非常清晰透彻的解释。

Despite his advanced age, the old man remained lucid and sharp. 尽管年事已高，这位老人家依然头脑清醒、思维敏捷。

mitigation.note:
Effective climate mitigation strategies are urgently needed worldwide. 全球急需有效的气候变化缓解策略。

The defense lawyer pleaded for a lighter sentence in mitigation of the offense. 辩护律师以减轻罪责为由请求从轻判决。

nebulous.meaning: adj. 模棱两可的；含糊不清的；星云状的
nebulous.note:
His concepts and business ideas are still far too nebulous to invest in. 他的概念和商业设想仍然过于含糊，无法进行投资。

She had only a nebulous memory of what happened on that fateful night. 对那个关键之夜发生的事情，她只有一个模糊不清的记忆。

obstinate.note:
He is an obstinate man who refuses to listen to any sound advice. 他是个固执的人，拒绝听取任何合理的建议。

This drug is used to treat obstinate stains and fungal infections. 这种药物用于治疗顽固性斑块和真菌感染。

ostentatious.note:
She wore an ostentatious diamond necklace to the casual dinner. 她戴着一条炫耀夺目的钻石项链去参加非正式晚餐。

He avoids an ostentatious display of wealth despite being a billionaire. 尽管身价亿万，他依然避免炫耀财富。

tenacious.meaning: adj. 顽强的；坚韧的；牢固的
tenacious.note:
She is a tenacious investigator who never gives up on a cold case. 她是一位顽强的侦探，从不放弃任何悬案。

He held a tenacious grip on the rope during the storm. 在暴风雨中，他紧紧地抓住绳索不放。

actuate.meaning: vt. 驱动；开动；激励；驱使
actuate.note:
The smoke detector is actuated by a sudden rise in temperature. 烟雾探测器是由温度骤升驱动开动的。

He was actuated by a desire to help others in distress. 他是出于帮助身处困境之人的愿望所驱使。

admonish.meaning: vt. 警告；责备；温和劝告
admonish.note:
The teacher admonished the students for talking during the exam. 老师因学生们在考试期间说话而责备了他们。

She admonished him to be more careful with the fragile glass. 她温和地劝告他对待易碎玻璃要更加小心。

allude.meaning: vi. 暗指；影射；间接提到
allude.note:
The speaker alluded to several famous historical events during his speech. 演讲者在演讲中间接提到了几个著名的历史事件。

She didn't mention him by name, but everyone knew who she was alluding to. 她没有指名道姓，但大家都知道她在暗指谁。

amplify.meaning: vt. 放大；增强；进一步阐述
amplify.note:
This device is used to amplify weak sound signals. 该设备用于放大微弱的声音信号。

Could you please amplify on your main points in the second chapter? 你能否在第二章中对你的主要论点作进一步阐述？

aptitude.note:
She showed a natural aptitude for learning foreign languages at a very young age. 她在很小的时候就展现出了学习外语的天然天赋。

Students take an assessment test to measure their technical aptitude. 学生们参加评估测试以测量他们的技术适合度与能力。

assuage.meaning: vt. 缓和；平息；满足（饥渴等）
assuage.note:
The news helped assuage her fears about the upcoming operation. 这则消息有助于平息她对即将到来的手术的恐惧。

Drinking fresh water finally assuaged his intense thirst. 喝下淡水终于满足并解除了他强烈的口渴。

composure.note:
Despite the emergency, she maintained her composure and called for help. 尽管情况紧急，她依然保持着镇静并呼吁救援。

It took him a few minutes to regain his composure after the heated debate. 在激烈的辩论过后，他花了数分钟才恢复了沉着。

conciliatory.meaning: adj. 和解的；调解的；抚慰的
conciliatory.note:
He adopted a conciliatory tone to avoid further conflict with his colleagues. 他采用了和解的语气，以避免与同事产生进一步的冲突。

The company offered a conciliatory gesture to settle the dispute out of court. 公司做出了调解姿态，以便在法庭之外解决争议。

condescend.meaning: vi. 屈尊；居高临下般相待
condescend.note:
The professor would not condescend to answer such elementary questions. 教授不愿屈尊去回答这样初级的问题。

He treats his junior colleagues well, but he still tends to condescend to them. 他对待初级同事很好，但依然倾向于以居高临下的态度对待他们。

defiance.note:
The protesters continued to march in defiance of the official ban. 抗议者们继续游行，公开违抗官方的禁令。

His bright smile was an act of defiance against the harsh circumstances. 他灿烂的笑容是对严酷环境的一种蔑视与挑衅。

diversify.meaning: vt. & vi. 多样化；扩大经营范围
diversify.note:
Investors are advised to diversify their portfolios to reduce market risks. 建议投资者实行投资组合多样化以降低市场风险。

The company decided to diversify into new telecommunication services. 该公司决定扩大经营范围，跨足新的电信服务。

docile.meaning: adj. 驯服的；温顺的；易控制的
docile.note:
The wild animal became remarkably docile after being trained. 这只野生动物经过训练后变得极其温顺。

They expected a docile workforce that would not challenge management. 他们期待一支温顺易控制、不会质疑管理层的员工队伍。

elicit.meaning: vt. 引起；套出（信息）；引出
elicit.note:
Her emotional performance managed to elicit tears from the audience. 她感人的表演成功引起了观众的眼泪。

The police officer tried to elicit the truth from the suspect during questioning. 警官尝试在审讯期间从嫌疑人身上套出真相。

exemplify.meaning: vt. 作为……的范例；举例说明
exemplify.note:
This paintings exemplifies the artistic style of the 19th century. 这幅画作构成了19世纪艺术风格的范例。

His career exemplifies how hard work and perseverance lead to success. 他的职业生涯举例说明了努力工作与坚持如何导向成功。

exhilarating.meaning: adj. 令人振奋的；使人兴高采烈的
exhilarating.note:
Riding the high-speed roller coaster was an exhilarating experience. 乘坐高速过山车是一次令人振奋的体验。

They reached the mountain peak and enjoyed the exhilarating view. 他们登上了山顶，尽情享受令人兴高采烈的壮丽景色。

friction.note:
Oil is used in engines to reduce friction between moving parts. 引擎中使用机油来减少运动部件之间的摩擦力。

Constant disagreement over money caused friction within the family. 在金钱上的持续分歧在家庭内部引发了冲突。

inclination.note:
He showed no inclination to leave his current position at the company. 他没有表现出离开公司现有职位的意愿。

She followed her natural inclination and pursued a career in music. 她顺从了自己天然的倾向，从事了音乐领域的职业。

indignant.meaning: adj. 愤慨的；义愤填膺的
indignant.note:
She was indignant at the unfair treatment she received at work. 她对自己在工作中遭受的不公平对待感到十分愤慨。

He wrote an indignant letter to the editor complaining about the decision. 他给编辑写了一封义愤填膺的信，抱怨那个决定。

inept.meaning: adj. 无能的；不熟练的；笨拙的
inept.note:
He made several inept attempts to repair the broken leaking pipe. 他作了几次笨拙且不熟练的尝试去修补破裂漏水的水管。

The project failed due to inept management and poor communication. 该项目因无能的管理和糟糕的沟通而告吹。

integrate.meaning: vt. & vi. 使合并；融入；整合
integrate.note:
It takes time for new immigrants to integrate into the local society. 新移民融入当地社会需要时间。

The company plans to integrate the new software into its existing system. 公司计划将新软件整合进其现有的系统之中。

invigorate.meaning: vt. 使精力充沛；刺激；使活跃
invigorate.note:
A brisk morning walk never fails to invigorate my body and mind. 晨间轻快的散步总能使我的身心精力充沛。

The tax cuts were designed to invigorate the sluggish national economy. 减税旨在刺激并活跃低迷的国家经济。

mediate.meaning: vt. & vi. 调解；斡旋；调停
mediate.note:
An independent body was appointed to mediate between the two parties. 一个独立机构被指定在双方之间进行调解与斡旋。

She tried to mediate a resolution to the ongoing boundary dispute. 她尝试调停并为持续的边界纠纷达成解决方案。

neutralize.meaning: vt. 使中和；使无效；抵消
neutralize.note:
Antacids are used to neutralize excess acid in the human stomach. 抗酸药用于中和人体胃部过多的胃酸。

The security forces acted quickly to neutralize the threat. 安全部队迅速采取行动以使威胁失效并消除。

nonchalant.meaning: adj. 漫不经心的；若无其事的；冷淡的
nonchalant.note:
He gave a nonchalant shrug when asked about his exam results. 当被问及考试成绩时，他若无其事地耸了耸肩。

She tried to appear nonchalant, but inside her heart was beating fast. 她试图表现得漫不经心，但内心深处心跳加快。

omit.meaning: vt. 省去；遗漏；未能（做某事）
omit.note:
You can omit the details that are not relevant to the case. 你可以省去与本案无关的细节。

He omitted to mention that he had already applied for the post. 他未能提及自己其实已经申请了该职位。

optimistic.meaning: adj. 乐观的；乐观主义的
optimistic.note:
She remains optimistic about the future despite the current challenges. 尽管面临当前的挑战，她对未来依然保持乐观。

The sales figures suggest an optimistic projection for next year. 销售数据表明了对明年整体形势的乐观预测。

overhaul.meaning: vt. & n. 全面检修；彻底改造；超越（对手）
overhaul.note:
The government plans to overhaul the country's tax system completely. 政府计划彻底改造国家的税收体系。

The mechanic was hired to overhaul the engine of the classic sports car. 机械师被雇来全面检修这辆经典跑车的引擎。

perceptive.meaning: adj. 洞察力敏锐的；感知力强的
perceptive.note:
Her perceptive comments showed a deep understanding of human nature. 她敏锐的点评展现了对人性的深刻理解。

As a perceptive observer, he noticed small details that others missed. 作为一名感觉敏锐的观察者，他注意到别人错过的微小细节。

preconception.meaning: n. 先入之见；成见；预想
preconception.note:
Try to travel with an open mind and without any preconceptions. 尝试带着开放的心态去旅行，不要抱有任何先入之见。

Cultural exchanges help people break down preconceptions about each other. 文化交流有助于人们打破对彼此的既成偏见与预想。

predominant.meaning: adj. 占优势的；主导的；最明显的
predominant.note:
Yellow is the predominant color in this vibrant landscape painting. 黄色是这幅充满生机的风景画中最主导显著的颜色。

English is the predominant language used in global academic publishing. 英语是全球学术出版物中使用的占优势地位的语言。

prudent.meaning: adj. 审慎的；精明的；精打细算的
prudent.note:
It is prudent to save some money every month for unexpected expenses. 每月存点钱以备不时之需是十分审慎明智的。

A prudent investor always considers potential risks before acting. 一位精明谨慎的投资者在行动前总是会考虑潜在风险。

refine.meaning: vt. 提炼；精炼；改进；完善
refine.note:
Crude oil is sent to the refinery to refine into petrol. 原油被送到炼油厂去提炼成汽油。

She worked hard to refine her technique before the final competition. 她在最终比赛前努力改进并完善自己的技巧。

restraint.note:
The police exercised remarkable restraint during the chaotic protest. 警察在混乱的抗议期间表现出了非凡的克制。

Financial restraints prevented them from expanding the business quickly. 资金上的约束限制阻止了他们快速扩张业务。

susceptible.meaning: adj. 易受影响的；易受感染的；过敏的
susceptible.note:
Young children are particularly susceptible to winter viral infections. 年幼儿童特别容易受到冬季病毒的感染。

He is highly susceptible to flattery and easily persuaded. 他非常容易受阿谀奉承的影响，很容易被劝说。

tactile.note:
Braille is a tactile system of reading and writing for blind people. 盲文是一种专为盲人设计的触觉读写系统。

The sculpture provides a rich tactile experience through its varied textures. 该雕塑通过其丰富的材质质感提供了极佳的触感体验。

trivialize.meaning: vt. 使显得微不足道；轻视；贬低
trivialize.note:
Do not attempt to trivialize the seriousness of this security breach. 不要试图去轻视或贬低这次安全漏洞的严重性。

The media was accused of trivializing complex political issues into gossip. 媒体被指责将复杂的政治议题轻视简化为八卦新闻。

unanimous.meaning: adj. 一致同意的；意见一致的
unanimous.note:
The committee reached a unanimous decision to approve the proposal. 委员会达成一致同意的决定，批准了该提议。

Support for the new environmental policy was far from unanimous. 对新环保政策的支持远未达到意见一致。

underlying.meaning: adj. 潜在的；基础的；表面下的
underlying.note:
We need to address the underlying cause of the problem, not just symptoms. 我们需要解决问题潜在的根本原因，而不只是表面症状。

The underlying message of the novel is the importance of compassion. 这部小说深层的潜在信息是同情心与怜悯的重要性。

vindicate.meaning: vt. 证明……无辜；证实；澄清
vindicate.note:
New evidence emerged that helped to vindicate the accused man. 新证据的出现有助于证明受审被告人的无辜。

The success of the project fully vindicated her controversial decision. 该项目的成功充分证实了她此前备受争议的决定是正确的。

allusion.meaning: n. 暗指；间接提到；典故
allusion.note:
The poem is full of classical allusions that only scholars will recognize. 这首诗充满了只有学者才能识别的古典典故。

His remark was an allusion to the company's recent financial problems. 他的话暗指公司最近的财务问题。

attitude.note:
She has a positive attitude towards her work. 她对工作持有积极的态度。

His arrogant attitude annoyed everyone at the meeting. 他在会上傲慢的态度惹恼了大家。

The bird stood in a defensive attitude, ready to attack. 那只鸟摆出防御的姿势，准备攻击。

compose.meaning: v. 组成，构成；创作（音乐、诗歌等）；使镇静；使（自己）准备好
compose.note:
Water is composed of hydrogen and oxygen. 水由氢和氧组成。

She composed a beautiful song for the concert. 她为音乐会创作了一首优美的歌曲。

He took a deep breath to compose himself before the speech. 他深吸一口气，在演讲前让自己镇定下来。

shrug.meaning: v. 耸肩（表示不知道、不在乎等）；n. 耸肩
shrug.note:
She just shrugged her shoulders when I asked her where she had been. 当我问她去了哪里时，她只是耸了耸肩。

He shrugged off the criticism and continued with his work. 他对批评不予理会，继续自己的工作。

With a shrug, he admitted that he didn't know the answer. 他耸了耸肩，承认自己不知道答案。

pessimist.meaning: n. 悲观主义者；悲观者
pessimist.note:
Don't be such a pessimist – things will get better. 别这么悲观主义者——事情会好起来的。

As a pessimist, he always expects the worst outcome. 作为一个悲观主义者，他总是预期最坏的结果。

The pessimist saw the glass as half empty, while the optimist saw it as half full. 悲观者看到杯子半空，而乐观者看到杯子半满。

dominant.meaning: adj. 占优势的；统治的；显性的
dominant.note:
The dominant theme of the conference was climate change. 会议的主导议题是气候变化。

In genetics, the dominant allele masks the effect of the recessive one. 在遗传学中，显性等位基因掩盖隐性等位基因的作用。

She has a dominant personality and always takes charge in meetings. 她个性强势，在会议中总是主导局面。



“谁更强、更有影响力？” → dominant

“哪个最多、最常见、占主要部分？” → predominant

grindstone.meaning: n. 磨石；砂轮；旋转磨石
grindstone.note:
The old craftsman sharpened his axe on a grindstone. 这位老工匠在磨石上磨快了他的斧头。

She kept her nose to the grindstone and finished the project ahead of time. 她勤奋工作，提前完成了项目。

brief.meaning: adj. 短暂的；简明的；n. 简报；任务简介；v. 向…介绍基本情况
brief.note:
The meeting was brief, only lasting ten minutes. 会议很简短，只持续了十分钟。

Please give me a brief summary of the report. 请给我一份报告的简要总结。

The lawyer briefed her client before the court session. 律师在开庭前向她的当事人简要介绍了情况。

actuator.meaning: n. 执行器；致动器；传动装置
actuator.note:
The actuator converts electrical signals into mechanical movement. 执行器将电信号转换为机械运动。

This robotic arm uses a hydraulic actuator for precise control. 这个机械臂使用液压致动器进行精确控制。

A faulty actuator in the valve caused the system to malfunction. 阀门中的故障传动装置导致系统失灵。

depredate.meaning: v. 掠夺，劫掠；毁坏，损害
depredate.note:
The invading army depredated the village, leaving nothing but ashes. 入侵军队劫掠了村庄，只留下灰烬。

Overfishing has depredated the ocean's fish stocks dramatically. 过度捕捞已严重损害了海洋鱼类资源。



Demolish means to tear down or smash a physical structure, usually intentionally, systematically, or as part of a construction/clearing process. 



Depredate means to plunder, pillage, or prey upon, typically involving destruction for the purpose of taking, consuming, or exploiting resources.

impel.note:
The urgent need for money impelled him to take a part-time job. 对金钱的迫切需求促使他做了一份兼职。

Strong moral principles impelled her to speak out against the injustice. 强烈的道德原则驱使她公开反对这一不公正现象。

The wind impelled the boat toward the shore. 风把船吹向岸边。



propel: B2 — 推进，推动，驱使

dispel: C1 — 驱散，消除（疑虑、谣言等）

impel: C2 — 促使，驱使（内心的冲动或责任感）

dispel.note:
The sun dispelled the morning fog. 太阳驱散了晨雾。

The manager's explanation dispelled all our doubts about the new policy. 经理的解释消除了我们对新政策的所有疑虑。



propel: B2 — 推进，推动，驱使

dispel: C1 — 驱散，消除（疑虑、谣言等）

impel: C2 — 促使，驱使（内心的冲动或责任感）

propel.meaning: v. 推进；驱动；激励；驱使
propel.note:
The wind propelled the sailboat across the lake. 风推动帆船穿过湖面。

Her strong desire to succeed propelled her to work harder. 她对成功的强烈渴望激励她更加努力工作。

The new policy propelled the company into a period of rapid growth. 新政策驱使公司进入快速发展的时期。



propel: B2 — 推进，推动，驱使

dispel: C1 — 驱散，消除（疑虑、谣言等）

impel: C2 — 促使，驱使（内心的冲动或责任感）

pessimistic.meaning: adj. 悲观的，悲观主义的
pessimistic.note:
With all the bad news, it is hard not to feel pessimistic about the future. 面对所有坏消息，人们很难不对未来感到悲观。

He has a pessimistic view of human nature. 他对人性抱有悲观的看法。

proverb.note:
As the old proverb says, practice makes perfect. 正如古老谚语所说，熟能生巧。

Her mother was always quoting proverbs to her. 她母亲总是用谚语向她讲道理。

herb.meaning: n. 药草，草本植物；香草
herb.note:
Basil is a popular herb used in Mediterranean cooking. 罗勒是地中海烹饪中常用的一种香草。

This traditional tea is made from natural herbs. 这种传统茶饮是由天然草药制成的。

vending-machine.note:
I bought a cold drink from the vending machine near the entrance. 我从入口附近的自动售货机买了一瓶冷饮。

The vending machine accepts both coins and credit cards. 这台自动售货机既接受硬币也接受信用卡。

proverbial.meaning: adj. 谚语的；众所周知的
proverbial.note:
His patience is proverbial among his colleagues. 他的耐心在同事之间是众所周知的。

Don't put all your eggs in the proverbial one basket. 不要把所有鸡蛋都放在众所周知的那个篮子里。

fence.meaning: n. 栅栏，篱笆 v. 击剑；围住
fence.note:
They built a wooden fence around the garden. 他们在花园周围建了一座木栅栏。

He learned to fence when he was in high school. 他上高中时学会了击剑。

He was accused of trying to fence stolen goods. 他被指控试图买卖赃物。

reindustrialize.meaning: v. 再工业化，使重新工业化
reindustrialize.note:
The government launched new policies to reindustrialize the region. 政府推出了新政策以使该地区实现再工业化。

Efforts to reindustrialize the economy require massive investment in infrastructure. 推动经济再工业化需要对基础设施进行巨额投资。

trillion.note:
The national debt has reached over three trillion dollars. 国债已达到了三万亿美元以上。

There are trillions of bacteria living inside the human body. 人体内部生存着数以万亿计的细菌。

shopkeeper.note:
The local shopkeeper knows almost every resident in the neighborhood. 当地的店主几乎认识社区里的每一个居民。

The shopkeeper closed the store early due to the stormy weather. 由于暴风雨天气，店主提早关了门。

transformative.meaning: adj. 产生重大改变的，变化的
transformative.note:
Technology has had a transformative impact on how we communicate. 科技对我们的通信方式产生了重大变革性的影响。

It was a transformative experience that changed her perspective on life. 那是一段改变她人生观的深刻经历。

humiliating.meaning: adj. 使人蒙羞的，羞辱性的
humiliating.note:
The team suffered a humiliating defeat in the final match. 该队在决赛中遭受了一场令人屈辱的惨败。

It was humiliating to admit his mistake in front of everyone. 当着所有人的面承认错误是件令人尴尬羞愧的事。

rare.meaning: adj. 稀有的，罕见的；（肉）半熟的，三分熟的
rare.note:
It is very rare to see this species of bird in the city. 在城市里见到这种鸟是非常罕见的。 I would like my steak rare, please. 请给我的牛肉做成三分熟。
  • rare: 一分熟
  • medium rare: 三分熟
  • medium : 五分熟
  • medium well: 七分熟
  • well done: 全熟
"How would you like your steak cooked?" （您的牛肉想要几分熟？） "I'd like my steak medium rare, please." （请帮我做三分熟，谢谢。）

distinguished.meaning: adj. 杰出的，卓越的；高贵的
distinguished.note:
She had a long and distinguished career in medical research. 她在医学研究领域拥有漫长而卓越的职业生涯。

He looked very distinguished in his formal suit. 他穿着正装显得非常有气质。

peppermint.note:
Drinking peppermint tea can help soothe an upset stomach. 喝薄荷茶有助于缓解胃部不适。

He offered me a peppermint after the meal. 饭后他给我吃了一颗薄荷糖。

slim.meaning: adj. 苗条的；微小的 v. 变瘦，减肥
slim.note:
She maintains a slim figure through regular exercise. 她通过定期运动保持苗条的身材。

There is only a slim chance that the flight will leave on time. 航班准时起飞的希望微乎其微。

He has been trying to slim down for the summer. 他一直试图为了夏天瘦下来。

offense.meaning: n. 犯罪，违法行为；冒犯；进攻（通常美式拼写）
offense.note:
Speeding is a minor traffic offense in this area. 在该地区超速是一种轻微的交通违法行为。

No offense intended, but I disagree with your opinion. 绝无冒犯之意，但我不同意你的观点。

The team's offense played exceptionally well during the second half. 该队的进攻线在下半场表现得特别出色。

defense.meaning: n. 防御，防卫；辩护；防御方（通常美式拼写）
defense.note:
The country spent billions of dollars on national defense. 该国在国防上花费了数十亿美元。

The lawyer presented a strong defense for his client. 律师为他的客户做出了强有力的辩护。

Their team built a solid defense that was hard to break through. 他们的队伍建立了难以突破的坚固防线。

debrief.meaning: v. 听取（任务执行情况的）汇报；总结任务
debrief.note:
The military team met to debrief after the successful operation. 军方小组在成功执行任务后聚在一起听取总结汇报。

We need to debrief the team members individually to learn what happened. 我们需要单独听取小组成员的汇报，以了解发生了什么。

chili.meaning: n. 辣椒；红豆辣椒酱牛肉（或肉末）
chili.note:
Add some diced chili peppers if you like spicy food. 如果你喜欢吃辣，就加点切碎的辣椒。

She cooked a warm bowl of chili for dinner on the cold night. 在那个寒冷的夜晚，她煮了一碗热腾腾的辣味肉酱作为晚餐。

centimeter.note:
The plant grew several centimeters in just a few days. 这株植物在短短几天内长高了几厘米。

The box measures 30 centimeters in width. 这个盒子的宽度为30厘米。

pronunciation.note:
Good pronunciation is key to effective language communication. 良好的发音是有效语言交流的关键。

He practiced his English pronunciation every morning. 他每天早上练习英语发音。

paragraph.note:
Please read the first paragraph of the article aloud. 请朗读文章的第一段。

Each paragraph should focus on a single main idea. 每个段落都应该围绕一个中心思想展开。

hub.note:
The city airport serves as a major transportation hub for the region. 该城市机场是该地区的主要交通枢纽。

The kitchen is always the hub of family activity in our house. 在我们家，厨房总是家庭活动的中心。

topological.meaning: adj. 拓扑学的；拓扑结构上的
topological.note:
The scientist created a topological map of the complex network. 科学家制作了该复杂网络的拓扑图。

Topological properties remain invariant under continuous deformations. 拓扑特性在连续变形下保持不变。

appraisal.note:
Employees receive an annual performance appraisal from their managers. 员工每年都会收到经理作出的绩效评估。

The real estate agent gave us an honest appraisal of the house's value. 房地产经纪人对这栋房屋的价值做出了客观的估价。

preferential.meaning: adj. 优先的，特惠的；偏向的
preferential.note:
Small businesses may be eligible for preferential tax rates. 小型企业可能符合享受优惠税率的条件。

They received preferential treatment because of their close relationship with the owner. 因为与老板关系亲密，他们受到了优待。

striking.meaning: adj. 引人注目的，显著的；容貌出众的
striking.note:
There is a striking resemblance between the twin brothers. 这对双胞胎兄弟之间有着极其显著的相似之处。

She has striking dark eyes that capture everyone's attention. 她有一双引人注目的深色眼睛，吸引了所有人的注意。

community.note:
The local community worked together to clean up the park. 当地社区共同努力清理了公园。

Online forums help build a strong sense of community among members. 在线论坛有助于在成员之间建立强烈的归属感。

universality.note:
The universality of human rights is a fundamental principle of global law. 人权的普遍性是国际法的基本原则。

Great literature often explores themes of timeless universality. 伟大的文学作品往往探讨具有永恒普遍性的主题。

exponential.meaning: adj. 指数的，呈指数级增长的
exponential.note:
The company experienced exponential growth after launching its new app. 推出新应用后，该公司经历了指数级的增长。

Calculations involving exponential functions are fundamental in algebra. 涉及指数函数的计算是代数的基础。

infinity.meaning: n. 无限，无穷大；无穷远
infinity.note:
The universe seems to stretch on into infinity. 宇宙似乎一直延伸到无穷远之处。

In mathematics, division by zero does not yield a real number but leads to infinity concepts. 在数学中，除以零不能得到实数，而是引出无穷大的概念。

diameter.note:
The dome has a total diameter of over fifty meters. 该穹顶的总直径超过五十米。

To calculate the area of the circle, you need to know its radius or diameter. 要计算圆的面积，你需要知道它的半径或直径。

pessimism.note:
His pessimism about the future made it hard for him to enjoy the present. 他对未来的悲观使他难以享受当下。

Despite the challenges, she refused to sink into pessimism and kept working hard. 尽管面临挑战，她拒绝陷入悲观，继续努力工作。

The report highlights the growing pessimism among young people regarding job prospects. 这份报告突显了年轻人对就业前景日益增长的悲观情绪。

billion.meaning: num. 十亿；n. 大量；十亿（指英国旧制万亿，现罕用）
billion.note:
The company is worth over a billion dollars. 这家公司价值超过十亿美元。

There are billions of stars in the sky. 天空中有数以十亿计的星星。

He has a billion things to do today. 他今天有数不清的事情要做。

million.meaning: num. 百万；n. 百万（个）；adj. 百万的
million.note:
The city has a population of over two million. 这个城市的人口超过两百万。

She made a million dollars from her invention. 她从发明中赚了一百万美元。

There are millions of stars in the sky. 天空中有数百万颗星星。

humiliate.meaning: v. 羞辱；使丢脸；使蒙羞
humiliate.note:
She felt humiliated by his public criticism of her work. 他公开批评她的工作，这让她感到羞辱。

The team was humiliated in the final match, losing 0-5. 该队在决赛中以0比5惨败，颜面尽失。

It humiliates me to admit that I was wrong. 承认自己错了让我觉得丢脸。

rarity.meaning: n. 稀有；罕见；珍品；珍贵
rarity.note:
The rarity of this ancient coin makes it extremely valuable. 这枚古币的稀有性使其极具价值。

Such a beautiful sunny day in winter is a rarity. 冬天里这样阳光明媚的日子很罕见。

She collects rare books, and her first edition of this novel is a real rarity. 她收藏珍本书，这小说的第一版对她来说是一件真正的珍品。

millimeter.note:
The precision of this instrument is within one millimeter. 这台仪器的精度在一毫米以内。

A sheet of paper is about 0.1 millimeter thick. 一张纸的厚度约为0.1毫米。

pronounce.meaning: v. 发音；宣读；宣告；断言
pronounce.note:
How do you pronounce this word? 你如何发音这个单词？

The judge pronounced the sentence after the trial. 审判后，法官宣读了判决。

She pronounced herself satisfied with the results. 她宣称自己对结果很满意。

preference.note:
She has a preference for classical music over pop. 她偏爱古典音乐胜过流行音乐。

In some countries, job seekers are given preference to local residents. 在一些国家，求职者优先考虑本地居民。

radius.meaning: n. 半径；半径范围；桡骨
radius.note:
The radius of this circle is 5 centimeters. 这个圆的半径是5厘米。

The explosion was felt within a radius of 10 kilometers. 爆炸在10公里半径范围内都能感觉到。

The doctor said she had a fracture in her radius. 医生说她的桡骨骨折了。

radian.note:
The angle of 180 degrees is equal to π radians. 180度的角等于π弧度。

In mathematics, the radian is the standard unit of angular measure. 在数学中，弧度是角度的标准单位。

salience.note:
The salience of the issue was clear from the number of protests. 这个问题的重要性从抗议的次数中显而易见。

In cognitive psychology, salience refers to how easily a stimulus stands out from its surroundings. 在认知心理学中，显著性指的是刺激从其环境中脱颖而出的难易程度。

radiant.meaning: adj. 发光的；容光焕发的；辐射的
radiant.note:
The radiant sun warmed the beach. 灿烂的太阳温暖了海滩。 She looked radiant in her wedding dress. 她穿着婚纱，容光焕发。 The radiant heat from the fire kept us warm. 火的辐射热让我们保持温暖。
  • radiant,容光焕发的、发光的、辐射的,强调源头向外发射/放射光线或热量
  • irradiant,照耀的、受照的、辐照的,强调光线照射/投射到某个表面或物体上

irradiant.meaning: adj. 光辉的，灿烂的；发光的，照耀的
irradiant.note:
The irradiant sun cast long shadows across the field. 灿烂的阳光在地面上投下长长的影子。 Her irradiant smile brightened the entire room. 她灿烂的微笑照亮了整个房间。 The irradiant glow of the city lights could be seen from miles away. 城市灯光的璀璨光辉数英里外都能看见。
  • radiant,容光焕发的、发光的、辐射的,强调源头向外发射/放射光线或热量
  • irradiant,照耀的、受照的、辐照的,强调光线照射/投射到某个表面或物体上

distinguish.meaning: vt. 区分，辨别；使杰出，使著名
distinguish.note:
It is important to distinguish between facts and opinions. 区分事实和观点很重要。

She distinguished herself as a talented musician in the competition. 她在比赛中以才华横溢的音乐家身份脱颖而出。

finite.note:
The earth's resources are finite, so we must use them wisely. 地球的资源是有限的，我们必须明智地使用它们。

In grammar, a finite verb shows tense and agrees with the subject. 在语法中，限定动词有时态变化并与主语保持一致。

The set of possible outcomes is finite, making the calculation easier. 可能结果的集合是有限的，这使得计算更容易。

infinite.meaning: adj. 无限的，无穷的；极大的
infinite.note:
The universe is believed to be infinite in extent. 宇宙被认为是无边无际的。

She has infinite patience with her students. 她对她的学生有极大的耐心。

persuade.note:
She persuaded me to go with her. 她说服我和她一起去。

I am not easily persuaded by arguments. 我不容易被论据说服。

He tried to persuade the jury of his innocence. 他试图让陪审团相信他是无辜的。

medium.meaning: adj. 中等的；适中的；半熟的 n. 媒介；方法；材料；中间物
medium.note:
She ordered a medium steak. 她点了一份五分熟的牛排。

The Internet has become an important medium for communication. 互联网已成为重要的沟通媒介。

He's of medium height and build. 他中等身材，体格适中。

restrain.meaning: vt. 抑制；控制；约束；制止
restrain.note:
She couldn't restrain her laughter at his joke. 她听到他的笑话忍不住大笑起来。

The police had to restrain the crowd from entering the building. 警察不得不阻止人群进入大楼。

He tried to restrain himself from eating too much at the party. 他试图在聚会上控制自己不要吃得太多。

acclimatize.meaning: v. 使适应（新环境）；使服水土
acclimatize.note:
It takes a few days to acclimatize to the high altitude. 适应高海拔需要几天时间。

The team gradually acclimatized to the cold weather during their polar expedition. 这支队伍在极地探险中逐渐适应了寒冷的天气。

robust.meaning: adj. 强健的； robust (系统/机器等) 坚固耐用的； robust (观点/措施等) 坚定的，强劲的
robust.note:
The athlete has a robust body and rarely gets sick. 这位运动员体格强健，很少生病。

This software is robust enough to handle millions of users at the same time. 这个软件足够坚固，可以同时处理数百万用户。

The government has taken robust measures to control inflation. 政府采取了强劲的措施来控制通货膨胀。

stiff.meaning: adj. 僵硬的；生硬的；艰难的；稠的；强烈的；adv. 极其；彻底地
stiff.note:
My neck is stiff from sleeping in a bad position. 我的脖子因为睡姿不好而僵硬。

The competition was stiff, but we managed to win. 竞争很激烈，但我们设法赢了。

She was scared stiff when she saw the snake. 她看到蛇时吓得浑身僵硬。

detriment.meaning: n. 损害；伤害；不利因素
detriment.note:
He worked long hours to the detriment of his health. 他长时间工作，损害了自己的健康。

The new policy was seen as a detriment to small businesses. 新政策被视为对小企业不利。

She eats too much sugar, much to the detriment of her teeth. 她吃太多糖，这对她的牙齿非常有害。

tough.meaning: adj. 坚强的；坚韧的；困难的；严厉的；牢固的；嚼不动的；不幸的
tough.note:
The exam was really tough, but I managed to pass. 这次考试真的很难，但我设法通过了。

She is a tough woman who never gives up. 她是一个坚强的女人，从不放弃。

The steak was so tough that I could barely chew it. 这块牛排太老了，我几乎嚼不动。

subtract.note:
If you subtract 5 from 10, you get 5. 如果你从10中减去5，得到5。

Please subtract the cost of the broken item from my bill. 请从我的账单中扣除损坏物品的费用。

metabolic rate.meaning: n. 代谢率；新陈代谢速率
metabolic rate.note:
Regular exercise can boost your metabolic rate, helping you burn more calories throughout the day. 经常锻炼可以提高你的代谢率，帮助你在一天中燃烧更多卡路里。

A slower metabolic rate in some people makes it harder for them to lose weight. 有些人的代谢率较慢，这使得他们更难减肥。

metabolism.meaning: n. 新陈代谢；代谢作用
metabolism.note:
Exercise can boost your metabolism and help you burn more calories. 运动能促进新陈代谢，帮助燃烧更多卡路里。

The drug is designed to regulate the body's metabolism. 这种药物旨在调节身体的代谢作用。

Some people have a faster metabolism than others, which affects how quickly they lose weight. 有些人的新陈代谢比其他人更快，这会影响他们减肥的速度。

urchin.note:
The urchin played a prank on the old man. 那个顽童对老人搞了个恶作剧。

The diver carefully collected a purple urchin from the reef. 潜水员小心地从礁石上采集了一只紫色的海胆。

sandbar.note:
The boat ran aground on a hidden sandbar near the mouth of the river. 船在河口附近一个隐蔽的沙洲上搁浅了。

Sandbars shift constantly with the tides, making navigation dangerous for large vessels. 沙洲随潮汐不断移动，使得大型船只的航行变得危险。

abandon.note:
He decided to abandon his old car. 他决定抛弃他的旧车。

They had to abandon the plan due to bad weather. 由于天气不好，他们不得不放弃这个计划。

abash.meaning: v. 使羞愧；使局促不安
abash.note:
She was not at all abashed by his criticism. 她对他的批评一点也没有感到羞愧。

His mistake abashed him in front of everyone. 他的错误使他在大家面前感到局促不安。

abbreviate.note:
You can abbreviate 'Road' to 'Rd.'. 你可以把 'Road' 缩写为 'Rd.'。

The speech was abbreviated due to lack of time. 由于时间不够，演讲被缩短了。

abdicate.note:
The king decided to abdicate the throne. 国王决定放弃王位。

Parents should not abdicate their responsibility to educate children. 父母不应放弃教育孩子的责任。

aberrant.note:
His aberrant behavior worried his teachers. 他异常的行为让老师们很担心。

Scientists studied the aberrant cell growth. 科学家研究了异常的细胞生长。

abet.meaning: v. 教唆；怂恿；协助（犯罪）
abet.note:
He was accused of aiding and abetting the thief. 他被指控协助和教唆小偷。

Do not abet bad habits in children. 不要怂恿孩子养成坏习惯。

abeyance.note:
The project was held in abeyance until further notice. 该项目在另行通知前暂缓执行。

The old rule fell into abeyance years ago. 这条旧规则多年前就已废止不用了。

abhor.note:
I abhor all forms of violence. 我痛恨一切形式的暴力。

She abhors lying and dishonesty. 她厌恶说谎和不诚实。

abhorrent.meaning: adj. 可恶的；令人厌恶的
abhorrent.note:
Racism is abhorrent to civilized society. 种族主义是文明社会所厌恶的。

His cruel behavior is totally abhorrent. 他残酷的行为完全令人发指。

abide.note:
All members must abide by the rules. 所有成员都必须遵守规则。

I cannot abide loud noises while studying. 我学习时无法忍受嘈杂的声音。

abjure.meaning: v. 发誓放弃；公开放弃
abjure.note:
He had to abjure his former beliefs. 他不得不发誓放弃他先前的信仰。

The criminal promised to abjure violence. 这名罪犯承诺放弃暴力。

ablution.note:
He performed his morning ablutions before breakfast. 他在早餐前进行了早晨的沐浴清洁。

The temple is used for ritual ablutions. 这座寺庙用于宗教净礼。

abnegate.meaning: v. 放弃（权力、权利等）；克制
abnegate.note:
Monks abnegate worldly pleasures. 修士们克制世俗的快乐。

He chose to abnegate his claim to the property. 他选择放弃对该财产的所有权要求。

abolition.note:
He fought for the abolition of slavery. 他为废除奴隶制而斗争。

The movement called for the abolition of tax. 该运动呼吁废除税收。

abominate.note:
I abominate cruelty to animals. 我痛恨虐待动物的行为。

She abominates cold and rainy weather. 她极其讨厌寒冷多雨的天气。

aboveboard.meaning: adj. 光明正大的；坦诚的
aboveboard.note:
The entire business transaction was completely aboveboard. 整个商业交易完全是光明正大的。

We have nothing to hide; everything is aboveboard. 我们没什么好隐瞒的，一切都很坦诚。

abrade.note:
The rough rope began to abrade his skin. 粗糙的绳子开始擦伤他的皮肤。

Sand can abrade the surface of glass. 沙子可以磨损玻璃表面。

abrasion.note:
He suffered a minor abrasion on his knee. 他的膝盖受了一处轻微的擦伤。

The pipe showed signs of wear and abrasion. 这根管道显示出磨损和擦伤的迹象。

abrasive.meaning: adj. 研磨的；粗鲁的；n. 研磨剂
abrasive.note:
Use an abrasive cleaner to remove the stain. 使用研磨清洁剂去除污渍。

His abrasive manner offended many people. 他粗鲁的态度冒犯了许多人。

abreast.note:
The two horses ran abreast across the field. 两匹马并排跑过田野。

Keep abreast of modern technology developments. 紧跟现代科技发展的步伐。

abridge.note:
The publisher decided to abridge the long novel. 出版社决定删节这部长篇小说。

Do not abridge the core message of the book. 不要删减这本书的核心信息。

abrogate.meaning: v. 废除；取消（法令、协议等）
abrogate.note:
The government decided to abrogate the treaty. 政府决定废除该条约。

They have the power to abrogate outdated laws. 他们有权废除过时的法律。

abscission.note:
Leaf abscission occurs in autumn. 树叶在秋天脱落。

The surgeon performed an abscission of the tumor. 外科医生对肿瘤实施了切除手术。

abscond.note:
The manager absconded with the company money. 经理携公司资金潜逃了。

The prisoner tried to abscond from prison. 囚犯试图从监狱逃跑。

absenteeism.note:
High rates of absenteeism hurt company productivity. 高旷工率损害了公司的生产力。

The school is taking steps to reduce student absenteeism. 学校正在采取措施减少学生旷课现象。

absolute.note:
I have absolute confidence in your ability. 我对你的能力有绝对的信心。

This is an absolute rule that cannot be broken. 这是一条不能打破的绝对规则。

absolve.note:
The court absolved him of all charges. 法院宣告他无罪，免除所有指控。

Nothing can absolve you from your duty. 没有任何东西可以免除你的责任。

absorb.note:
Plants absorb water through their roots. 植物通过根系吸收水分。

It is hard to absorb so much information at once. 一下子吸收这么多信息很难。

abstain.note:
He decided to abstain from alcohol. 他决定戒酒。

Three members voted in favor and two chose to abstain. 三名成员赞成，两名选择弃权。

abstemious.meaning: adj. 有节制的（尤指饮食）；节俭的
abstemious.note:
He leads an abstemious lifestyle with simple food. 他过着饮食有节制的简单生活。

An abstemious diet helps maintain good health. 节制的饮食有助于保持健康。

abstention.note:
There were five abstentions in the final vote. 最终投票中有五票弃权。

Abstention from rich food is good for digestion. 禁食油腻食物对消化有好处。

abstentious.note:
His abstentious habits kept him healthy. 他有节制的习惯使他保持健康。

She lived an abstentious life in the monastery. 她在修道院里过着禁欲的生活。

abstract.meaning: adj. 抽象的；n. 摘要；v. 提取
abstract.note:
Justice is an abstract concept. 正义是一个抽象的概念。

Please read the abstract of the research paper before reading the full text. 请在阅读全文前先读一下研究论文的摘要。

abundance.note:
The country has an abundance of natural resources. 这个国家拥有丰富的自然资源。

There was an abundance of food at the party. 派对上有极其丰富的食物。

abusive.note:
He shouted abusive language at the driver. 他对司机大喊辱骂性语言。

She left an abusive marriage. 她离开了一段饱受虐待的婚姻。

abut.note:
Their garden abuts onto the riverbank. 他们的花园与河岸毗连。

The two properties abut each other. 这两处房产彼此相邻。

abysmal.meaning: adj. 极坏的；深不可测的
abysmal.note:
The weather conditions during the trip were abysmal. 旅行期间的天气条件极其糟糕。

He showed abysmal ignorance of the subject. 他对这个课题表现出极度的无知。

academic.meaning: adj. 学术的；n. 大学教师
academic.note:
She has a brilliant academic record. 她有着出色的学术成绩。

Many academics attended the international conference. 许多学者参加了这次国际会议。

academician.meaning: n. 学部委员；院士；学者
academician.note:
He was elected as an academician of the science academy. 他被选为科学研究院院士。

The academician gave a lecture on physics. 这位院士作了一场关于物理学的演讲。

accede.note:
The government refused to accede to their demands. 政府拒绝同意他们的要求。

He acceded to the throne in 1950. 他于1950年即位。

access.meaning: n. 通道，入径；v. 存取，接近
access.note:
Students need a password to access the computer network. 学生需要密码才能访问计算机网络。

The only access to the farmhouse is across a narrow bridge. 通往农舍的唯一通道是一座窄桥。

accessory.note:
She bought some nice accessories for her dress. 她为裙子买了一些好看的配饰。

He was charged as an accessory to the crime. 他被指控为犯罪从犯。

acclaim.meaning: v. 欢呼；称赞；n. 赞誉
acclaim.note:
The novel won critical acclaim worldwide. 这部小说赢得了世界范围内的评论界赞誉。

The crowd rushed forward to acclaim the hero. 人群涌上前去为英雄欢呼。

accolade.note:
She received the highest academic accolade. 她获得了最高学术荣誉。

Winning the award was a great accolade for the young actor. 赢得这个奖项对这位年轻演员来说是巨大的褒奖。

accommodating.meaning: adj. 乐于助人的；随和的
accommodating.note:
The hotel staff were very accommodating to our requests. 酒店员工对我们的要求非常乐于配合。

He is an accommodating person who is easy to work with. 他是一个很好合作的随和之人。

accompany.note:
Children must be accompanied by an adult. 儿童必须由成人陪伴。

Lightning usually accompanies thunder. 闪电通常伴随着雷声。

accomplice.note:
The police caught the thief and his accomplice. 警察抓住了小偷和他的同谋。

He acted as an accomplice in the bank robbery. 他在银行抢劫案中充当了共犯。

accomplish.note:
We managed to accomplish our goal on time. 我们设法按时完成了目标。

Hard work helps you accomplish great things. 努力工作能帮你成就伟大的事情。

accomplished.meaning: adj. 很有才华的；熟练的
accomplished.note:
She is an accomplished pianist. 她是一位很有造诣的钢琴家。

He is an accomplished painter and sculptor. 他是一位技艺娴熟的画家和雕塑家。

accord.meaning: v. 给予；一致；n. 协议
accord.note:
The two countries signed a peace accord. 两国签署了一项和平协议。

His version of events did not accord with mine. 他对事件的描述与我的不一致。

accost.note:
A stranger accosted me in the street and asked for money. 一个陌生人在街上拦住我向我要钱。

He was accosted by reporters outside his home. 他在家门外被记者围住盘问。

accrete.note:
Dust particles tend to accrete over time. 尘埃颗粒随着时间推移会逐渐积聚。

New layers of rock accrete slowly. 新的岩层缓慢地积聚增长。

accretion.note:
The island was formed by the accretion of sand and soil. 这个岛是由泥沙积聚形成的。

Wealth accumulation is the result of slow accretion. 财富的积累是缓慢积聚的结果。

accrue.meaning: v. 自然增长；积累（利益等）
accrue.note:
Interest will accrue on your savings account. 你的储蓄账户会产生利息。

Great benefits will accrue from this policy. 这项政策将带来巨大的长期利益。

accuracy.note:
We must check the accuracy of the data. 我们必须检查数据的准确性。

The machine measures weight with high accuracy. 这台机器以极高的精度测量重量。

accurate.note:
His report was detailed and accurate. 他的报告详细且准确。

Can you give me an accurate estimate of the cost? 你能给我一个精确的成本估计吗？

accuse.note:
She accused him of breaking her favorite vase. 她指责他打破了她最喜欢的花瓶。

He was accused of stealing company funds. 他被指控盗用公司资金。

acerbic.note:
She is known for her acerbic wit. 她以尖酸刻薄的幽默感而闻名。

His acerbic comments hurt her feelings. 他尖刻的评论伤害了她的感情。

acknowledge.note:
He finally acknowledged his mistake. 他终于承认了自己的错误。

She acknowledged receipt of the letter. 她确认收到了这封信。

acme.note:
This masterpiece is the acme of his career. 这部杰作是他职业生涯的巅峰。

Her acting reached its acme in this movie. 她的演技在这部电影中达到了顶峰。

acolyte.note:
The young politician was surrounded by loyal acolytes. 这位年轻政客身边环绕着忠实的追随者。

He served as an acolyte in the church service. 他在教堂礼拜中担任侍者。

acorn.note:
Squirrels love to collect acorns for winter. 松鼠喜欢收集橡果过冬。

An oak tree grows from a small acorn. 橡树由小小的橡果长成。

acquaint.note:
You should acquaint yourself with the rules. 你应该让自己熟悉这些规则。

She took time to acquaint new staff with the office routine. 她花时间让新员工熟悉办公室日常事务。

acquaintance.meaning: n. 泛泛之交；熟人；了解
acquaintance.note:
He is just an acquaintance, not a close friend. 他只是个熟人，算不上密友。

I have some acquaintance with French. 我对法语略知一二。

acquainted.note:
Are you acquainted with this neighborhood? 你对这一带熟悉吗？

We are well acquainted with the project details. 我们对项目细节非常了解。

acquired.meaning: adj. 后天习得的；已取得的
acquired.note:
Taste for coffee is an acquired taste. 对咖啡的喜好是后天培养出来的。

He suffers from an acquired immune deficiency. 他患有获得性免疫缺陷。

acquisitive.note:
He grew up in an acquisitive society focused on money. 他在一个以金钱为中心的贪婪社会中长大。

Her acquisitive nature made her buy unnecessary things. 她贪得无厌的本性使她买了许多不必要的东西。

acquit.note:
The jury decided to acquit the defendant. 陪审团决定宣告被告无罪。

She acquitted herself very well in the interview. 她在面试中表现得非常出色。

acquittal.note:
The trial ended with the sudden acquittal of the suspect. 审判以嫌疑人突然被判无罪告终。

His lawyers were pleased with the acquittal. 他的律师对无罪释放结果感到满意。

acrid.note:
The fire filled the room with acrid smoke. 火灾使房间里充满了刺鼻的浓烟。

An acrid smell came from the chemical plant. 化工厂里散发出刺鼻的气味。

acrimony.meaning: n. 尖刻；刻薄；满腹怨恨
acrimony.note:
The divorce was handled with great acrimony. 这场离婚办得充满了怨恨与尖刻。

Their meeting ended in bitterness and acrimony. 他们的会议在痛苦和刻薄中结束。

acrobat.note:
The acrobat performed amazing flips on the rope. 杂技演员在绳索上表演了精彩的翻腾。

Circus acrobats train hard every day. 马戏团杂技演员每天刻苦训练。

acrophobia.note:
He suffers from severe acrophobia and cannot look down from tall buildings. 他患有严重的恐高症，无法从高楼向下看。

Acrophobia made it hard for her to cross the bridge. 恐高症让她很难过桥。

adage.note:
As the old adage goes, practice makes perfect. 正如老谚语所说，熟能生巧。

He lived his life by the adage 'honesty is the best policy'. 他一生遵循“诚实是上策”的格言。

adapt.note:
Animals must adapt to changing environments. 动物必须适应不断变化的环境。

The novel was adapted into a successful movie. 这部小说被改编成了一部成功的电影。

adaptable.meaning: adj. 能适应的；可改编的
adaptable.note:
Children are usually very adaptable to new schools. 孩子通常对新学校有很强的适应能力。

This software is highly adaptable to various systems. 这款软件对各种系统具有高度的适应性。

addendum.note:
The author added an addendum to the book. 作者给书增添了一个附录。

Please read the addendum at the end of the contract. 请阅读合同末尾的补遗部分。

addict.meaning: n. 成瘾者；入迷的人；v. 使沉溺
addict.note:
He is a recovering drug addict. 他是一名正在康复的吸毒成瘾者。

She is a workaholic and a coffee addict. 她是个工作狂兼咖啡迷。

addition.note:
In addition to English, she speaks French. 除了英语，她还会说法语。

Children learn simple addition in primary school. 孩子们在小学学习简单的加法。

additive.meaning: n. 添加剂；adj. 附加的
additive.note:
This food contains no artificial additives. 这种食品不含人工添加剂。

The effects of these two drugs are additive. 这两种药物的效果具有叠加作用。

adept.meaning: adj. 擅长的；熟练的；n. 能手
adept.note:
She is adept at dealing with difficult customers. 她很擅长处理棘手的顾客。

He became an adept in computer programming. 他成为了电脑编程能手。

adherent.meaning: n. 信徒；追随者；adj. 附着的
adherent.note:
He is a loyal adherent of the political party. 他是该政党的忠实追随者。

The movement gained many new adherents. 该运动获得了许多新信徒。

adjourn.note:
The judge decided to adjourn the court until tomorrow. 法官决定休庭至明天。

Let us adjourn the meeting for lunch. 让我们休会去吃午饭吧。

adjunct.meaning: n. 附件；附属物；兼职教师
adjunct.note:
She works as an adjunct professor at the university. 她在该大学担任兼职教授。

The computer lab is a useful adjunct to the library. 计算机实验室是图书馆的一个有用的附属设施。

adjust.note:
You need to adjust the mirror before driving. 开车前你需要调整后视镜。

It took her a while to adjust to the new life. 她花了一段时间才适应新生活。

admire.note:
I deeply admire her courage and dedication. 我深深钦佩她的勇气与奉献精神。

We stood on the hill to admire the view. 我们站在山上欣赏风景。

adobe.note:
The traditional houses were built of adobe. 传统房屋是用泥砖建造的。

Adobe bricks dry hard in the sun. 泥砖在阳光下晒干变硬。

adopt.meaning: v. 采用；收养；正式通过
adopt.note:
The couple decided to adopt an orphan. 这对夫妇决定收养一个孤儿。

The committee voted to adopt the new policy. 委员会投票通过了新政策。

adore.note:
The little girl adores her older brother. 这个小女孩非常崇拜她的哥哥。

I adore eating chocolate ice cream. 我极喜欢吃巧克力冰淇淋。

adorn.note:
Flowers adorned the wedding table. 鲜花装饰了婚礼桌。

She wore a gold necklace to adorn her neck. 她戴着金项链来装饰脖子。

adroit.note:
She showed adroit negotiation skills. 她展现出了机敏的谈判技巧。

He is adroit at handling crisis situations. 他很擅长处理危机情况。

adulate.meaning: v. 谄媚；奉承；盲目崇拜
adulate.note:
Fans tend to adulate pop stars blindly. 粉丝往往会盲目奉承流行歌星。

He refused to adulate the corrupt leader. 他拒绝巴结那个腐败的领导人。

adulterate.note:
It is illegal to adulterate milk with water. 在牛奶里掺水是违法的。

The wine had been adulterated with cheaper ingredients. 这酒被掺入了便宜的成分。

adumbrate.meaning: v. 预示；勾勒轮廓；遮蔽
adumbrate.note:
The speech only adumbrated the main goals of the project. 演讲仅勾勒了项目的主要目标。

Dark clouds adumbrated a coming storm. 乌云预示着一场暴风雨的来临。

advent.note:
Life changed greatly with the advent of the internet. 随着互联网的到来，生活发生了巨大变化。

People rejoiced at the advent of peace. 人们为和平的降临而欢欣鼓舞。

adventitious.meaning: adj. 偶然的；非策划的；不定生的
adventitious.note:
Their meeting was purely adventitious. 他们的相遇纯属偶然。

Adventitious roots grew from the plant stem. 植物茎上长出了不定根。

advertise.meaning: v. 为…做广告；登广告宣传
advertise.note:
The company wants to advertise its new product. 公司想要宣传其新产品。

You can advertise the car online for sale. 你可以在网上登广告卖这辆车。

advisable.note:
It is advisable to book tickets in advance. 提前订票是明智的。

Warm clothing is advisable for the trip. 此次旅行带上保暖衣物是可取的。

advocacy.note:
She is known for her advocacy of human rights. 她以倡导人权而闻名。

The environmental group focuses on forest advocacy. 该环保组织专注于森林保护的倡导工作。

aegis.note:
The project was carried out under the aegis of the UN. 该项目是在联合国的庇护下进行的。

Events are organized under the aegis of the committee. 活动是在委员会的主办下组织的。

aerate.note:
Gardeners aerate the lawn to improve soil health. 园丁给草坪通气以改善土壤健康。

This machine helps aerate the water in the pond. 这台机器有助于给池塘里的水充气。

aesthete.meaning: n. 审美家；唯美主义者
aesthete.note:
As a true aesthete, she loved visiting art galleries. 作为一名真正的审美家，她热爱参观艺术画廊。

He lived like an aesthete, surrounded by paintings and music. 他像个唯美主义者一样生活，周围环绕着画作与音乐。

affable.meaning: adj. 和蔼可亲的；友善的
affable.note:
The old professor is very affable to students. 这位老教授对学生非常和蔼可亲。

She greeted everyone with an affable smile. 她带着亲切的微笑向每个人打招呼。

affectation.note:
His polite manner felt like an affectation. 他礼貌的举止让人觉得有点做作。

She spoke naturally without any affectation. 她说话自然，没有任何矫揉造作。

affected.note:
His affected accent annoyed everyone. 他做作的口音惹恼了每个人。

People affected by the flood received aid. 受洪水影响的灾民得到了援助。

affidavit.note:
She signed an affidavit confirming the facts. 她签署了一份确认事实的宣誓书。

The lawyer submitted the witness affidavit to the court. 律师向法院提交了证人宣誓书。

affinity.meaning: n. 密切关系；吸引力；共鸣
affinity.note:
She has a natural affinity for languages. 她对语言有着天生的亲和力。

There is a close affinity between the two cultures. 这两种文化之间存在着密切的联系。

affix.meaning: v. 贴上；固定；n. 词缀
affix.note:
Please affix a stamp to the envelope. 请在信封上贴一枚邮票。

The signature was affixed to the contract. 签名已被签署在合同上。

afflict.note:
He was afflicted with a rare disease. 他患上了一种罕见的疾病，备受折磨。

Poverty and hunger afflict millions of people. 贫困与饥饿折磨着数百万人民。

affliction.note:
Arthritis is a painful affliction of the joints. 关节炎是一种痛苦的关节疾病。

She bore her affliction with great patience. 她以极大的耐心承受着病痛的折磨。

affluence.note:
The city is a symbol of modern affluence. 这座城市是现代富裕的象征。

Economic growth brought material affluence to the region. 经济增长给该地区带来了物质财富。

affordable.note:
We are looking for an affordable apartment. 我们在寻找一套价格合理的公寓。

The restaurant offers good food at affordable prices. 这家餐厅以实惠的价格提供美食。

affront.note:
His rude comment felt like a direct affront. 他粗鲁的评论让人觉得是一种直接的侮辱。

She was affronted by his lack of manners. 她被他缺乏礼貌的行为冒犯了。

agenda.note:
What is the first item on the agenda? 议程上的第一项是什么？

We have a busy agenda for today's meeting. 我们今天的会议日程很满。

agglomerate.meaning: v. 结块；聚集；n. 聚合物
agglomerate.note:
Small particles began to agglomerate into larger lumps. 小颗粒开始结块成更大的团块。

Cities often grow into a massive urban agglomeration. 城市往往会发展成庞大的城市群。

aggrandize.meaning: v. 夸大；强化（权力、财富等）
aggrandize.note:
He sought power only to aggrandize himself. 他谋求权力仅仅是为了膨胀自己。

The dictator tried to aggrandize his realm through war. 独裁者试图通过战争来扩大他的领土。

aggravate.note:
Loud noise can aggravate a headache. 嘈杂的噪音会加重头痛。

His careless remarks only aggravated the situation. 他漫不经心的言论只会使局势恶化。

aggregate.meaning: n. 总计；总额；adj. 总数的；v. 聚集
aggregate.note:
The aggregate score of both games is four to one. 两场比赛的总比分是四比一。

Investors aggregate their funds for the project. 投资者为该项目汇集资金。

aggressive.meaning: adj. 侵略性的；好斗的；进取的
aggressive.note:
The dog became aggressive when approached. 当有人靠近时，这只狗变得很有攻击性。

He pursued an aggressive marketing strategy. 他奉行进取的营销策略。

aggressor.note:
The international community condemned the aggressor. 国际社会谴责了侵略者。

They acted in self-defense against the aggressor. 他们采取自卫行动对抗攻击者。

aggrieve.note:
He felt deeply aggrieved by the unfair decision. 他对这个不公正的决定感到十分委屈。

Workers felt aggrieved by the pay cuts. 工人们对减薪感到忿忿不平。

agile.note:
Monks and dancers need agile bodies. 舞者需要灵活的身体。

She has an agile mind that solves problems quickly. 她思维敏捷，能迅速解决问题。

agility.note:
Cat shows incredible agility when jumping. 猫在跳跃时展现出令人难以置信的敏捷。

The sport requires both strength and mental agility. 这项运动既需要体力又需要思维敏捷。

agitate.note:
Protesters gathered to agitate for political reform. 抗议者聚集在一起为政治改革进行煽动游说。

Do not agitate the mixture too fast. 不要把混合物搅拌得太快。

agitated.note:
He looked nervous and agitated while waiting. 他在等待时显得紧张而焦虑。

She was too agitated to sleep. 她过于激动而无法入睡。

agog.meaning: adj. 兴奋的；急切期待的
agog.note:
The children were agog to open their presents. 孩子们急切地想打开他们的礼物。

Everyone was agog for the news of the game. 每个人都在翘首以盼比赛的消息。

agony.note:
He screamed in agony after breaking his leg. 他骨折后痛得大叫。

She waited in agony for the test results. 她在极度痛苦的煎熬中等待测试结果。

agreeable.meaning: adj. 令人愉快的；随和的
agreeable.note:
We spent an agreeable afternoon in the park. 我们在公园里度过了一个愉快的下午。

He is an agreeable person who gets along with everyone. 他是个随和的人，跟谁都合得来。

agronomy.note:
He studies agronomy to improve crop yields. 他学习农学以提高农作物产量。

Modern agronomy uses advanced science and technology. 现代农艺学运用了先进的科学技术。

airborne.note:
The plane became airborne after a long run. 飞机在长距离滑行后腾空而起。

Pollen grains are airborne in spring. 花粉颗粒在春天随空气飘浮。

airtight.meaning: adj. 密闭的；无懈可击的
airtight.note:
Keep the food in an airtight container. 把食物保存在密封容器里。

Police built an airtight case against the suspect. 警方针对嫌疑人构建了无懈可击的证据链。

alabaster.meaning: n. 雪花石膏；adj. 白皙光滑的
alabaster.note:
The statue was carved out of white alabaster. 这尊雕像是由白色雪花石膏雕刻而成的。

She had pale, alabaster skin. 她有着白皙光滑的皮肤。

alacrity.note:
He accepted the invitation with alacrity. 他欣然接受了邀请。

The students completed the task with great alacrity. 学生们十分爽快地完成了任务。

alchemy.note:
Medieval alchemists tried to turn base metals into gold. 中世纪的炼金术士试图将贱金属变成黄金。

There is a kind of emotional alchemy in their relationship. 他们的关系中有一种奇妙的情感魔力。

alcove.note:
A small desk was placed in the room's alcove. 房间的凹室里放着一张小书桌。

The statue stood inside a decorative alcove. 雕像矗立在一个装饰性的壁龛内。

alias.note:
The criminal traveled under an alias. 这名罪犯用化名四处旅行。

His true name was hidden behind several aliases. 他的真名隐藏在几个化名背后。

alibi.note:
The suspect provided a solid alibi for the night of the crime. 嫌疑人为案发当晚提供了坚实的不在场证明。

Her alibi was confirmed by two friends. 她的不在场证明得到了两个朋友的证实。

alienate.note:
His arrogant attitude alienated his colleagues. 他傲慢的态度疏远了同事。

Do not alienate your friends with harsh words. 不要用严厉的话语疏远你的朋友。

alimentary.meaning: adj. 消化食物的；营养的
alimentary.note:
Food passes through the alimentary canal. 食物穿过消化道。

The alimentary tract is responsible for digesting food. 消化道负责消化食物。

alkali.note:
Soap is a common alkali substance. 肥皂是一种常见的碱性物质。

Soil with too much alkali is hard to farm. 碱性过大的土壤很难耕种。

allay.meaning: v. 减轻；缓和（恐惧、忧虑等）
allay.note:
The mayor tried to allay public fears about safety. 市长试图消除公众对安全的担忧。

Her words helped to allay his anxiety. 她的话语有助于缓解他的焦虑。

allegiance.note:
Citizens pledge allegiance to their country. 公民宣誓效忠国家。

He switched his political allegiance last year. 他去年改变了政治忠诚对象。

allegory.note:
The novel is written as a political allegory. 这部小说是一部政治寓言。

Animal Farm is famous for its allegorical story. 《动物庄园》以其寓言故事而闻名。

alluring.note:
She wore an alluring red dress to the party. 她穿着一条迷人的红裙子去参加派对。

The job offer came with an alluring salary. 这份工作提供了一份诱人的薪水。

aloft.note:
The kites were flying high aloft. 风筝在高空中飞翔。

She held the trophy aloft in victory. 她高举奖杯以示胜利。

aloof.note:
He remained aloof from office politics. 他对办公室政治保持冷漠疏离的态度。

She seemed a bit aloof when first met. 初次见面时她显得有点高冷。

alphabetical.meaning: adj. 按字母顺序排列的
alphabetical.note:
The names are listed in alphabetical order. 名字是按字母顺序排列的。

Please check the alphabetical index in the back. 请查看后面的字母索引。

alternate.meaning: v. 交替；轮流；adj. 交替的
alternate.note:
Sunlight and rain alternate in spring. 春天阳光与雨水交替出现。

We work on alternate days. 我们隔天轮流上班。

altruism.note:
Her decision to donate money was pure altruism. 她捐款的决定完全是出于无私奉献。

Altruism plays an important role in community work. 利他主义在社区工作中扮演着重要角色。

amalgam.note:
The culture is an amalgam of different traditions. 这种文化是不同传统的混合体。

Dental fillings often use a silver amalgam. 牙科补牙经常使用银汞合金。

amalgamate.note:
The two companies decided to amalgamate. 两家公司决定合并。

Local schools will amalgamate next year. 当地学校将于明年合并。

amass.meaning: v. 积累；积聚（财富、知识等）
amass.note:
He managed to amass a large fortune. 他设法积累了一大笔财富。

She spent years amassing rare stamps. 她花了多年时间收集珍贵的邮票。

amateurish.note:
The video had an amateurish look. 这段视频看起来很外行、不专业。

His painting skills were rather amateurish. 他的画技相当业余。

ambidextrous.meaning: adj. 双手都能灵巧使用的
ambidextrous.note:
Being ambidextrous is useful in sports like tennis. 左右手都很灵巧对网球之类的运动很有用。

She can write with both hands because she is ambidextrous. 她两只手都能写字，因为她左右手同样灵巧。

ambivalence.meaning: n. 矛盾心理（既爱又恨、犹豫不决）
ambivalence.note:
He felt a deep ambivalence about taking the job. 他对接受这份工作怀有深深的矛盾心理。

Her ambivalence was clear from her silence. 从她的沉默中可以看出她矛盾的心态。

amble.note:
They decided to amble along the riverbank. 他们决定沿着河岸漫步。

We went for a slow amble through the park. 我们在公园里进行了一次缓慢的闲逛。

ambush.note:
The soldiers were attacked in an ambush. 士兵们在伏击中遭到袭击。

Enemy troops waited in ambush near the road. 敌军在道路附近埋伏等候。

amenable.meaning: adj. 顺从的；易受影响的；经得起检验的
amenable.note:
She was amenable to reason and changed her mind. 她听得进道理，改变了主意。

The proposal is amenable to further changes. 这个提议可以做进一步的修改。

amiable.meaning: adj. 和蔼可亲的；友好的
amiable.note:
He is an amiable host who makes guests feel at home. 他是一个好客的主人，让客人们感到宾至如归。

They reached an agreement in an amiable atmosphere. 他们在友好的气氛中达成了协议。

amity.note:
The two nations lived in peace and amity. 两国过着和平共处、睦邻友好的生活。

Sports events promote international amity. 体育赛事促进了国际间的友谊。

amnesia.note:
The accident left him with temporary amnesia. 这场事故导致他短暂失忆。

She suffered from amnesia after the head injury. 她头部受伤后患上了健忘症。

amnesty.note:
The government declared an amnesty for political prisoners. 政府宣布对政治犯实行大赦。

Illegal immigrants were offered a temporary amnesty. 非法移民获得了一项临时的特赦。

amorphous.meaning: adj. 无固定形状的；无定型的
amorphous.note:
Clouds have amorphous shapes that change constantly. 云具有不断变化的无定型形状。

His ideas for the project were still amorphous. 他对项目的构想当时还很模糊。

amortize.note:
The company will amortize the loan over ten years. 公司将在十年内分期偿还这笔贷款。

They amortized the debt through regular payments. 他们通过定期付款分期偿清了债务。

amphibian.meaning: n. 两栖动物；水陆两栖飞机
amphibian.note:
Frogs and toads are common amphibians. 青蛙和蟾蜍是常见的两栖动物。

Amphibians can live both in water and on land. 两栖动物既能在水里生活也能在陆地上生活。

ample.note:
There is ample time to finish the exam. 有充足的时间完成考试。

We have ample food for all the guests. 我们有足够的食物供应所有客人。

amplitude.note:
The wave has a high amplitude. 这波浪具有高振幅。

Scientists measured the amplitude of the signal. 科学家测量了该信号的振幅。

amulet.note:
She wore a silver amulet to ward off bad luck. 她戴着一个银护身符来驱赶厄运。

Ancient people used amulets for protection. 古代人使用护身符来寻求保护。

amuse.note:
The clown's performance amused the children. 小丑的表演逗乐了孩子们。

He told a funny story to amuse the guests. 他讲了一个有趣的故事来逗客人们开心。

anachronistic.meaning: adj. 时代错误的；过时的
anachronistic.note:
Using a typewriter today feels anachronistic. 今天用打字机感觉与时代不符。

The film contained several anachronistic details. 这部电影包含几个时代错位的细节。

anaerobic.note:
Weightlifting is a form of anaerobic exercise. 举重是一种无氧运动形式。

Certain bacteria can survive in anaerobic conditions. 某些细菌可以在厌氧环境下生存。

anagram.meaning: n. 变位词（字母重排构成的词）
anagram.note:
'Silent' is an anagram of 'listen'. 'Silent' 是 'listen' 的变位词。

Word puzzles often feature anagrams. 文字解谜游戏经常包含变位词。

analgesia.note:
The medicine induced local analgesia in the patient. 这种药物在患者体内引起了局部镇痛。

Acupuncture is sometimes used to achieve analgesia. 针灸有时被用来实现镇痛效果。

analgesic.meaning: n. 镇痛药；adj. 镇痛的
analgesic.note:
He took a mild analgesic for his headache. 他吃了点温和的止痛药来治头痛。

This ointment has an analgesic effect on muscle pain. 这种药膏对肌肉酸痛有镇痛作用。

analyze.note:
Scientists need to analyze the data carefully. 科学家需要仔细分析数据。

She tried to analyze the root cause of the problem. 她试图分析该问题的根本原因。

anarchist.note:
The book explores the views of a 19th-century anarchist. 这本书探讨了一位19世纪无政府主义者的观点。

Police monitored known anarchists in the city. 警察监控了城里已知的无政府主义者。

anarchy.note:
The country fell into anarchy after the government collapsed. 政府倒台后，该国陷入了无政府状态。

Law and order are needed to prevent anarchy. 需要法律与秩序来防止混乱。

anathema.meaning: n. 令人厌恶的事物；革除教门
anathema.note:
Violence is anathema to his peaceful beliefs. 暴力与他爱好和平的信念背道而驰。

Cruelty to animals is anathema to her. 虐待动物是她极其痛恨的事物。

anatomical.note:
Medical students study human anatomical structures. 医学学生研究人体解剖结构。

The drawing showed precise anatomical details. 这张图画展示了精确的解剖学细节。

ancestor.note:
Our ancestors migrated from the south centuries ago. 我们的祖先几个世纪前从南方迁徙而来。

He traced his family tree back to ancient ancestors. 他把自己的家谱追溯到了古代祖先。

ancestry.note:
She is proud of her Scottish ancestry. 她为自己的苏格兰血统感到自豪。

Tests revealed details about his genetic ancestry. 检测揭示了他基因血统的细节。

ancillary.meaning: adj. 辅助的；附加的；n. 辅助人员
ancillary.note:
The hospital provides ancillary medical services. 这家医院提供辅助医疗服务。

These guidelines are ancillary to the main rules. 这些指南是对主要规则的补充辅助。

anecdote.note:
He told a funny anecdote about his childhood. 他讲了一个关于童年的有趣轶事。

The speaker used personal anecdotes to engage the audience. 演讲者用个人趣闻来吸引观众。

anemia.note:
She felt weak because of iron deficiency anemia. 她因为缺铁性贫血而感到虚弱。

Common symptoms of anemia include fatigue and paleness. 贫血的常见症状包括疲劳和面色苍白。

anguish.meaning: n. / v. 极度痛苦；苦恼
anguish.note:
She cried in anguish when she heard the news. 听到这个消息时，她痛苦得哭了起来。

He watched his sick child in mental anguish. 他在精神痛苦中看着生病的孩子。

angular.meaning: adj. 瘦削的；有角的；成角的
angular.note:
He had a thin, angular face. 他有一张消瘦且轮廓分明的脸。

The modern building has an angular design. 这座现代建筑有着多角的几何设计。

anhydrous.note:
The chemical reaction requires anhydrous alcohol. 该化学反应需要无水酒精。

Anhydrous crystals lose all their water of crystallization. 无水结晶会失去所有的结晶水。

animate.meaning: v. 使有生气；赋予生命；adj. 有生命的
animate.note:
Discussion animated the room. 讨论使房间里充满了生气。

Cartoons are made to animate drawings. 卡通片用于让图画动起来。

animated.meaning: adj. 活跃的；生气勃勃的
animated.note:
They had an animated conversation over dinner. 他们在晚餐时进行了热烈生动的交谈。

Her face became animated when she spoke of music. 当她谈到音乐时，她的脸变得生动起来。

animation.meaning: n. 动画片制作；动画；生气
animation.note:
He works as an artist in computer animation. 他是一名电脑动画艺术家。

Children love watching cartoon animations. 孩子们喜欢看卡通动画片。

animosity.note:
There is a long history of animosity between the groups. 这几个群体之间有着长期的敌意历史。

They managed to put aside their personal animosity. 他们设法抛开了彼此的个人仇恨。

animus.note:
He harbored no animus toward his critics. 他对批评他的人没有怀恨在心。

The court found clear evidence of political animus. 法院发现了政治敌意的明文证据。

annals.note:
This event goes down in the annals of science. 这一事件载入了科学史册。

Ancient annals describe the empire's rise and fall. 古代年鉴描述了帝国的兴衰。

annexation.note:
The country protested the annexation of its territory. 该国抗议其领土被吞并。

International laws prohibit the forced annexation of land. 国际法禁止强行吞并土地。

annihilate.note:
The atomic bomb can annihilate a whole city. 原子弹可以摧毁整座城市。

Their army was completely annihilated in the battle. 他们的军队在战斗中被彻底歼灭。

annotate.note:
Students were asked to annotate the text. 学生被要求给课文做注释。

He annotated the margins of the manuscript. 他在手稿的空白处做了批注。

announce.note:
The company will announce its new strategy tomorrow. 公司明天将宣布其新战略。

They announced their engagement to the family. 他们向家人宣布了订婚的消息。

annoy.note:
His constant talking began to annoy me. 他喋喋不休的说话开始惹恼我了。

I was annoyed by the sudden loud noise. 我被突如其来的巨响惹烦了。

annul.meaning: v. 宣告无效；取消；撤销
annul.note:
The judge decided to annul the contract. 法官决定宣布该合同无效。

They filed a petition to annul the marriage. 他们提交了废除婚姻的申请。

anonymity.note:
The whistleblower chose to maintain anonymity. 告密者选择保持匿名。

Online forums offer a degree of anonymity. 网络论坛提供了一定程度的匿名性。

anorexia.note:
She received medical treatment for severe anorexia. 她因严重的神经性厌食症接受了治疗。

Anorexia is a dangerous eating disorder. 厌食症是一种危险的饮食失调症。

antagonism.note:
There is open antagonism between the two leaders. 两位领导人之间存在公开的敌对情绪。

The reform caused growing antagonism among workers. 这场改革引起了工人们日益增长的对立情绪。

antagonize.note:
Do not antagonize potential clients with rude behavior. 不要用粗鲁的行为激怒潜在客户。

His words served only to antagonize his coworkers. 他的话只会惹恼同事。

antecedence.note:
The legal case established chronological antecedence. 该法律案确立了时间上的先后顺序。

Historians debated the antecedence of the events. 历史学家们争论这些事件的先后关系。

antecedent.meaning: n. 前事；祖先；adj. 先前的
antecedent.note:
His past achievements are an antecedent to his success. 他过去的成就是他成功的先决条件。

The event was antecedent to the war. 该事件发生在战争之前。

antediluvian.meaning: adj. 远古的；极其过时的
antediluvian.note:
He uses antediluvian computers from the 1980s. 他使用20世纪80年代极其过时的电脑。

Her ideas about marriage sound antediluvian. 她关于婚姻的观点听起来老掉牙了。

anterior.note:
The anterior part of the ship was damaged. 船的前部受损了。

This species lived in periods anterior to the ice age. 这个物种生活在冰河时代之前的时期。

anthem.note:
The national anthem was played at the start of the game. 比赛开始时奏响了国歌。

The choir sang a beautiful religious anthem. 合唱团唱了一首优美的宗教圣歌。

anthropologist.note:
The anthropologist lived with an isolated tribe. 这位人类学家与一个孤立的部落生活在一起。

Anthropologists study human culture and development. 人类学家研究人类的文化与发展。

antibiotic.meaning: n. 抗生素；adj. 抗生的
antibiotic.note:
The doctor prescribed an antibiotic for the infection. 医生开了一种治疗感染的抗生素。

Antibiotics are used to kill bacteria. 抗生素用于杀灭细菌。

antibody.note:
The body produces antibodies to fight viruses. 身体会产生抗体来对抗病毒。

Blood tests can check for specific antibodies. 血液检测可以查出特定的抗体。

antic.meaning: n. 滑稽动作；怪异举动
antic.note:
The children laughed at the puppy's funny antics. 孩子们被小狗滑稽的举动逗笑了。

His wild antics disrupted the classroom. 他疯狂的滑稽动作扰乱了课堂秩序。

anticipatory.note:
She smiled with anticipatory excitement. 她带着期待的兴奋微笑起来。

Investors showed anticipatory caution before the report. 投资者在报告发布前表现出预期的谨慎。

anticlimax.meaning: n. 令人失望的结局；突降高潮
anticlimax.note:
After all the hype, the final match was a complete anticlimax. 在大肆宣传之后，决赛却是一个彻底令人失望的结局。

The ending of the movie felt like an anticlimax. 电影的结局让人感觉虎头蛇尾。

antidote.note:
The doctor administered the antidote to the snake bite. 医生给被蛇咬伤的患者使用了血清解毒剂。

Travel is a great antidote to ignorance. 旅行是医治无知的良药。

antihistamine.meaning: n. 抗组胺药（抗过敏药）
antihistamine.note:
She took an antihistamine for her hay fever. 她服用了抗组胺药来治疗花粉过敏。

Antihistamines help reduce allergy symptoms. 抗组胺药有助于减轻过敏症状。

antiquated.note:
The factory still uses antiquated machinery. 这家工厂仍在使用陈旧的机器。

We need to replace these antiquated rules. 我们需要取代这些过时的规则。

antique.note:
She loves collecting antique furniture. 她喜欢收集古董家具。

The shop sells valuable Chinese antiques. 这家店出售珍贵的中国古玩。

antiquity.note:
The temple dates back to high antiquity. 这座寺庙可追溯到远古时期。

The museum exhibits various treasures of antiquity. 博物馆展出了各种古代珍宝。

antithesis.note:
Love is the antithesis of hate. 爱是恨的对立面。

His political views are the antithesis of mine. 他的政治观点与我的截然相反。

anvil.note:
The blacksmith hammered the hot metal on the anvil. 铁匠在铁砧上敲打热金属。

An anvil is essential equipment in a traditional forge. 铁砧是传统锻造厂必不可少的设备。

aorta.note:
Blood flows from the heart directly into the aorta. 血液从心脏直接流入主动脉。

The injury caused severe damage to his aorta. 这次受伤对他的主动脉造成了严重破坏。

apex.note:
The climbers finally reached the apex of the mountain. 登山者终于到达了山峰的顶点。

Her career reached its apex when she won the award. 当她获奖时，她的职业生涯达到了巅峰。

aphorism.note:
His writings are full of clever aphorisms. 他的著作中充满了聪明的警句。

'Actions speak louder than words' is a common aphorism. “事实胜于雄辩”是一句常见的格言。

apiary.note:
He set up a small apiary in his backyard. 他在后院建了一个小型养蜂场。

Beekeepers manage the hives in the apiary. 养蜂人管理着养蜂场里的蜂箱。

aplomb.note:
She handled the difficult questions with great aplomb. 她镇定自若地应对了这些难题。

The young actor performed the lead role with aplomb. 这位年轻演员镇定自若地完成了主角的演出。

apocalyptic.meaning: adj. 启示录的；世界末日的
apocalyptic.note:
The movie depicts an apocalyptic vision of the future. 这部电影描绘了对未来的末日幻景。

Scientists warned of apocalyptic climate changes. 科学家警告说会有末日般的气候变化。

apocrypha.note:
The text is included in the biblical apocrypha. 这段文本被收录在圣经伪经中。

 Scholars debate the historical value of the apocrypha. 学者们争论这些伪经的历史价值。

apocryphal.note:
That famous story about the cherry tree is apocryphal. 关于樱桃树的那个著名故事是杜撰的。

Many legends told about him are completely apocryphal. 许多关于他的传说完全是虚构的。

apogee.note:
The satellite is now at its orbital apogee. 卫星目前在其轨道的远地点。

The empire reached its apogee in the twelfth century. 该帝国在十二世纪达到了全盛顶点。

apoplectic.meaning: adj. 极度愤怒的；中风的
apoplectic.note:
He was apoplectic with rage when he saw the bill. 他看到账单时气得暴跳如雷。

The manager went apoplectic over the mistake. 经理对这个错误气急败坏。

apostasy.note:
He faced severe punishment for apostasy. 他因背叛宗教信仰而面临严厉惩罚。

Renouncing his faith was seen as a major act of apostasy. 放弃他的信仰被视为严重的叛教行为。

apostate.note:
The former leader was branded an apostate. 这名前领导人被打上叛徒的烙印。

Apostates from the group faced heavy social costs. 离开该集团的背叛者面临沉重的社会代价。

apostrophe.note:
Do not forget to add an apostrophe to 'don't'. 别忘了在 'don't' 中加上撇号。

Possessive nouns usually require an apostrophe and an s. 所有格名词通常需要一个撇号和一个s。

apothecary.note:
In old times, people bought medicine from the local apothecary. 在过去，人们从当地的药剂师那里买药。

The old shop preserved its original apothecary counters. 这家老店保留了最初的药房柜台。

appall.note:
We were appalled by the cruelty of the crime. 我们被这起罪行的残忍行径惊呆了。

The poor living conditions in the slum appalled her. 贫民窟里糟糕的生活条件把她吓坏了。

apparition.note:
The children believed they saw an apparition in the old castle. 孩子们相信他们在老城堡里看到了一个幽灵。

Strange apparitions were reported in the dark hallway. 据报道黑暗的走廊里出现了奇异的幻影。

appeal.meaning: v. 呼吁；申诉；有吸引力；n. 吸引力
appeal.note:
The charity launched an appeal for food donations. 该慈善机构发起了一项呼吁捐赠食物的倡议。

Does the idea of working abroad appeal to you? 在国外工作的想法对你有吸引力吗？

appease.note:
The government tried to appease the angry protesters. 政府试图安抚愤怒的抗议者。

Giving in to bullies will only appease them temporarily. 向霸凌者妥协只能暂时安抚他们。

appellation.note:
He earned the appellation of master chef. 他赢得了大厨的美誉。

The wine has a protected geographical appellation. 这种酒拥有受保护的产地名称。

appetizer.note:
We ordered soup and salad as appetizers. 我们点了汤和沙拉作为开胃菜。

The delicious smell served as an appetizer. 美味的香气起到了开胃的作用。

appetizing.note:
The fresh cake looked very appetizing. 新鲜的蛋糕看起来十分诱人。

An appetizing aroma came from the kitchen. 厨房里飘出了一股诱人的香味。

applause.note:
The audience burst into loud applause at the end of the show. 表演结束后，观众爆发出一阵热烈的掌声。

Her speech won warm applause from the crowd. 她的演讲赢得了人群的热烈喝彩。

applicant.note:
There are over fifty applicants for the job. 有五十多个人申请这份工作。

Each applicant must submit a resume. 每个申请人都必须提交一份简历。

application.meaning: n. 申请；应用程序；应用
application.note:
You need to fill out an application form. 你需要填写一份申请表。

I downloaded a new weather application on my phone. 我在手机上下载了一个新的天气应用程序。

apposite.note:
His remarks were very apposite to the discussion. 他的发言对讨论非常切题。

She made an apposite quote from a famous author. 她引用了一位著名作家的一句贴切的话。

appreciable.note:
There was an appreciable drop in temperature. 气温有了明显的下降。

The new machinery brought an appreciable increase in output. 新机器带来了产量的显著增加。

appreciate.note:
I really appreciate your help with this project. 我非常感激你对这个项目的帮助。

She loves to appreciate classical music. 她喜欢欣赏古典音乐。

apprehend.note:
Police managed to apprehend the suspect. 警方设法逮捕了嫌疑人。

It is sometimes hard to apprehend complex theories. 理解复杂的理论有时很难。

approbation.note:
The plan received the official approbation of the committee. 该计划获得了委员会的正式批准。

She nodded in silent approbation. 她默默地点头表示赞许。

appropriate.meaning: adj. 适当的；v. 占用；拨出（款项）
appropriate.note:
Please wear appropriate clothing for the formal dinner. 请为正式晚宴穿著合适的衣服。

The city council will appropriate funds for the new park. 市议会将为新公园拨款。

apropos.note:
Apropos of your question, here are the details. 关于你的问题，这里是详细信息。

His remarks were very apropos. 他的发言非常应景切题。

apt.meaning: adj. 恰当的；聪明的；易于…的
apt.note:
That was a very apt description of the situation. 那是对当时情况非常贴切的描述。

Children are apt to copy what they see. 小孩子很容易模仿他们看到的东西。

aqueduct.note:
Romans built magnificent stone aqueducts. 罗马人建造了宏伟的石头引水渠。

The ancient aqueduct carried water across the valley. 古代引水渠将水输送到山谷对岸。

aquifer.meaning: n. 含水层；地下蓄水层
aquifer.note:
Farmers pump water from the underground aquifer. 农民从地下含水层抽水。

Pollution can damage the local water aquifer. 污染会破坏当地的地下含水层。

arabesque.meaning: n. 阿拉伯式花纹；芭蕾舞阿拉贝斯克姿态
arabesque.note:
The building was decorated with intricate arabesques. 这栋建筑装饰有复杂的阿拉伯式花纹。

The dancer performed a graceful arabesque on stage. 舞者在舞台上表演了一个优雅的阿拉贝斯克姿态。

arable.meaning: adj. 适于耕种的；可耕的
arable.note:
Only a small fraction of the land is arable. 只有一小部分土地适合耕种。

Farmers turned the forest into arable fields. 农民把森林开垦成了可耕地。

arbiter.note:
The court acts as the final arbiter in legal disputes. 法院在法律纠纷中充当最终裁决者。

She is widely regarded as an arbiter of fashion. 她被广泛视为时尚界的权威仲裁者。

arbitrate.note:
