An independent judge was called to arbitrate the dispute. 请了一位独立的法官来仲裁这场纠纷。

Both sides agreed to arbitrate rather than go to court. 双方同意进行仲裁而不是对簿公堂。

arboreal.note:
Monks and squirrels are typical arboreal animals. 猴子和松鼠是典型的树栖动物。

The species spends most of its life in arboreal habitats. 该物种一生的大部分时间都在树栖栖息地度过。

arboretum.note:
We visited the university botanical arboretum. 我们参观了大学的植物树木园。

The arboretum contains hundreds of rare tree species. 这个树木园里包含数百种珍稀树木。

arcane.meaning: adj. 神秘的；晦涩难懂的
arcane.note:
He is an expert in arcane ancient languages. 他是一位精通晦涩古老语言的专家。

The contract was written in arcane legal language. 这份合同是用晦涩难懂的法律语言编写的。

arch.meaning: n. 拱形；拱门；v. 呈弧形弯曲
arch.note:
The old bridge has a stone arch. 这座古桥有一个石拱。

The cat arched its back when it saw the dog. 猫看到狗时把背拱了起来。

archetype.note:
He is the archetype of a successful entrepreneur. 他是成功企业家的典型范例。

The story follows the traditional hero archetype. 这个故事遵循了传统的英雄原型。

archipelago.note:
The ship sailed through the tropical archipelago. 船只穿过了热带群岛。

Greece consists of a mainland and a large archipelago. 希腊由本土和一个大群岛组成。

architect.note:
The famous architect designed the modern museum. 这位著名的建筑师设计了这座现代博物馆。

He is considered the chief architect of the peace plan. 他被认为是该和平计划的主要策划者。

ardent.note:
She is an ardent supporter of animal rights. 她是动物权益的热烈支持者。

He has an ardent passion for photography. 他对摄影有着狂热的激情。

argot.note:
The thieves spoke in a secret criminal argot. 小偷们说着一种秘密的犯罪黑话。

Computer scientists use a specific technical argot. 计算机科学家使用特定的技术行话。

aria.note:
The soprano sang a brilliant opera aria. 女高音歌唱家演唱了一首精彩的歌剧咏叹调。

This specific aria is the highlight of the performance. 这个特定的咏叹调是表演的亮点。

calculating.meaning: adj. 精于算计的；冷酷理智的
calculating.note:
She is a calculating politician who always knows how to turn a situation to her advantage. 她是一个精于算计的政治家，总知道如何把局势转化为自己的优势。

His calculating gaze made everyone in the room feel slightly uneasy. 他那精于算计的目光让房间里的每个人都感到有些不安。

caldron.note:
The witch stirred the bubbling potion in her iron caldron. 女巫在铁大锅里搅拌着冒泡的药水。

During the revolution, the capital became a caldron of political unrest. 革命期间，首都成为了政治动荡的漩涡。

calibrate.meaning: v. 校准；标定；精确测量
calibrate.note:
Technicians must calibrate the instruments regularly to ensure accurate readings. 技术人员必须定期校准仪器以确保读数准确。

It is important to calibrate the speedometer after changing the tires. 更换轮胎后校准速度表很重要。

calipers.note:
The machinist used digital calipers to measure the thickness of the metal plate. 机加工工匠使用数码卡尺来测量金属板的厚度。

She carefully adjusted the calipers before taking the inner diameter measurement. 在测量内径之前，她小心翼翼地调整了测径器。

calligraphy.note:
Learning traditional Chinese calligraphy requires years of dedicated practice. 学习中国传统书法需要多年专心致志的练习。

Her wedding invitations featured beautiful hand-written calligraphy. 她的结婚请柬上印有漂亮的手写书法。

callow.meaning: adj. 年轻而幼稚的；没经验的
callow.note:
The play charts the journey of a callow youth into a mature leader. 这部戏描绘了一个稚嫩的青年成长为成熟领袖的历程。

Despite his impressive title, his callow remarks betrayed his lack of experience. 尽管头衔很响亮，他幼稚的言论还是暴露了他缺乏经验。

calorie.meaning: n. 卡路里；卡（热量单位）
calorie.note:
An apple contains far fewer calories than a bar of chocolate. 一个苹果含有的卡路里比一块巧克力少得多。

Athletes need to consume enough calories to maintain their high energy levels. 运动员需要摄入足够的卡路里来维持他们的高能量水平。

calumniate.note:
Political opponents tried to calumniate his reputation through false rumors. 政敌试图通过虚假谣言来诽谤他的名誉。

He sued the newspaper for attempting to calumniate his character. 他起诉这家报纸企图诽谤他的品格。

calumny.note:
She endured months of vicious calumny before the truth finally came to light. 在真相大白之前，她忍受了数月的恶毒诽谤。

The author wrote the essay to defend his work against malicious calumny. 作者写这篇文章是为了捍卫自己的作品免受恶意中伤。

cameo.meaning: n. 浮雕宝石；小客串出演
cameo.note:
She wore an antique brooch featuring a delicate carved cameo. 她戴着一枚带有精致雕刻浮雕的古董胸针。

The famous director made a brief cameo appearance in his own movie. 这位著名导演在他的电影中作了短暂的客串出演。

camouflage.meaning: n. 伪装；保护色 v. 伪装掩饰
camouflage.note:
The soldiers wore green and brown uniforms for camouflage in the jungle. 士兵们穿着绿褐色制服以便在丛林中伪装。

Chameleons can change their skin color to camouflage themselves from predators. 变色龙可以改变皮肤颜色来将自己伪装起来以防捕食者。

campaign.meaning: n. 战役；竞选活动 v. 参与竞选；发起运动
campaign.note:
The presidential candidates launched their official campaigns across the country. 总统候选人在全国各地发起了官方竞选活动。

Environmental groups are campaigning against the use of single-use plastics. 环保组织正在发起反对使用一次性塑料制品的运动。

canary.meaning: n. 金丝雀；加那利群岛的
canary.note:
Miners used to take a caged canary underground to detect toxic gases. 矿工过去常常把一只关在笼子里的金丝雀带到地下以检测有毒气体。

Her yellow dress reminded everyone of a bright singing canary. 她黄色的裙子让每个人想起了一只歌唱明快的金丝雀。

candidacy.meaning: n. 候选人资格；竞选资格
candidacy.note:
She announced her candidacy for the leadership of the party. 她宣布了竞选该党领袖的资格。

Several scandals threatened to derail his candidacy early in the race. 几起丑闻威胁到他在竞选初期取得的候选人资格。

candor.meaning: n. 坦率；诚恳；直言不讳
candor.note:
I appreciate your refreshing candor during this difficult discussion. 我很感激你在这次艰难讨论中所展现出的令人耳目一新的坦率。

She spoke about her past mistakes with surprising candor. 她以令人惊讶的坦诚谈到了自己过去的错误。

canine.meaning: adj. 犬科的 n. 犬齿
canine.note:
The police force relies heavily on canine units to track missing persons. 警队高度依赖犬只分队来追踪失踪人员。

He felt a sharp pain in his upper canine after biting into the hard apple. 咬下硬苹果后，他感到上犬齿有一阵刺痛。

canny.meaning: adj. 精明的；机智的；节俭的
canny.note:
Through a series of canny investments, he doubled his wealth in a few years. 通过一系列精明的投资，他在几年内使财富翻了一番。

She made a canny decision to wait for the market prices to drop. 她做出了一个精明的决定，等待市场价格下跌。

canon.meaning: n. 圣规；准则；正典（文学或音乐）
canon.note:
Shakespearean plays are firmly established in the Western literary canon. 莎士比亚的戏剧在西方文学正典中确立了牢固的地位。

Monks lived strictly according to the canons of their religious order. 修士们严格按照其宗教修会的准则生活。

canonical.meaning: adj. 经典的；正统的；规范的
canonical.note:
This novel is considered a canonical text of modern science fiction. 这部小说被认为是现代科幻小说的经典文本。

The algorithm is written in its canonical form for maximum clarity. 该算法以其标准规范的形式编写，以实现最大程度的清晰度。

cant.meaning: n. 伪善言辞；黑话；斜角 v. 倾斜
cant.note:
His speech was full of political cant that fooled no one. 他的演讲充满了谁也骗不了的政治伪善言辞。

The carpenter canted the saw blade at a 45-degree angle. 木工将锯条倾斜了四十五度角。

cantankerous.meaning: adj. 脾气坏的；好争吵的
cantankerous.note:
The old man was notoriously cantankerous and complained about everything. 那位老人出了名的脾气坏，对什么都抱怨。

Even his dog seemed as cantankerous and grumpy as its owner. 甚至他的狗也和它的主人一样脾气暴躁。

canto.note:
The professor asked us to read the third canto of Dante's Inferno for tomorrow. 教授让我们明天阅读但丁《地狱篇》的第三章。

Epic poems are typically divided into multiple structured cantos. 史诗通常分为多个结构化的章节。

canvas.note:
The artist applied thick layers of oil paint onto the blank canvas. 艺术家在空白的画布上涂抹了厚厚的油画颜料。

Tents made of heavy canvas protect campers from heavy rainstorms. 用厚帆布制成的帐篷保护露营者免受暴雨袭击。

canvass.meaning: v. 游说；拉选票；民意调查 n. 游说
canvass.note:
Volunteers spent the weekend trying to canvass voters in the neighborhood. 志愿者们周末试图在社区里向选民拉选票。

The company decided to canvass employee opinions before changing policies. 公司决定在改变政策前对员工意见进行民意调查。

canyon.note:
The Grand Canyon is one of the most breathtaking natural wonders in the world. 大峡谷是世界上最令人叹为观止的自然奇观之一。

River water carved deep canyons through the rock over millions of years. 数百万年来，河水在岩石中冲刷出深深的峡谷。

cape.note:
Their ship sailed safely past the rocky cape during the storm. 暴风雨中，他们的船安全驶过了多岩石的海角。

The superhero wore a dramatic red cape that flowed behind him in the wind. 超级英雄穿着一件引人注目的红色披肩，在风中飘扬。

capillary.meaning: n. 毛细血管 adj. 毛细管的
capillary.note:
Oxygen passes through the walls of tiny capillaries into body tissues. 氧气穿过微小毛细血管壁进入身体组织。

Plants draw water upward through capillary action in their stems. 植物通过茎内的毛细管作用向上抽吸水分。

capitulate.note:
The besieged garrison was finally forced to capitulate due to starvation. 被围困的守军最终由于饥饿被迫投降。

After hours of negotiation, management refused to capitulate to the union's demands. 经过几个小时的谈判，管理层拒绝向工会的要求妥协。

caprice.meaning: n. 奇想；任性；反复无常
caprice.note:
She quit her stable job on a sudden caprice to travel the world. 她出于一时任性辞去了稳定工作去环游世界。

The monarch ruled according to his personal caprices rather than the law. 君主根据他个人的喜好而不是法律来统治。

captious.meaning: adj. 吹毛求疵的；挑剔的
captious.note:
No one liked working with him because of his captious criticism. 没人喜欢跟他工作，因为他总是吹毛求疵地批评人。

Her captious remarks ruined what was otherwise a pleasant dinner party. 她挑剔的言论毁了本该愉快的晚宴。

captivate.note:
The magician's impressive tricks never failed to captivate the audience. 魔术师精彩的把戏总是能迷住观众。

She was completely captivated by the romantic charm of the ancient city. 她被古城浪漫的魅力深深吸引了。

capture.meaning: v. 俘获；捕获；记录 n. 捕获
capture.note:
Wildlife photographers managed to capture the rare bird on camera. 野生动物摄影师设法用镜头拍下了这只罕见的鸟。

The escaping thief was finally captured by police officers downtown. 逃跑的小偷最终被市中心的警察抓获了。

carafe.meaning: n. 玻璃水瓶；长颈无柄水瓶
carafe.note:
The waiter brought a glass carafe of cold water to our table. 服务员给我们桌上拿来了一玻璃瓶冷水。

House red wine was served in a traditional glass carafe. 自家红酒是用传统的玻璃水瓶端上来的。

carbohydrate.note:
Athletes often eat pasta to increase their carbohydrate intake before a race. 运动员经常在比赛前吃面食来增加碳水化合物的摄入量。

Bread, rice, and potatoes are foods rich in complex carbohydrates. 面包、米饭和土豆是富含复合碳水化合物的食物。

carcinogen.note:
Tobacco smoke contains dozens of known carcinogens linked to lung cancer. 烟草烟雾含有数十种与肺癌相关的已知致癌物。

Regulations were tightened to limit exposure to toxic industrial carcinogens. 加强了法规以限制接触有毒的工业致癌物。

cardinal.meaning: adj. 主要的；极重要的 n. 红衣主教
cardinal.note:
Safety is of cardinal importance when working with heavy machinery. 操作重型机械时，安全是首要的。

A bright red cardinal sat on the snowy branch outside the window. 一只鲜红色的红衣主教鸟停在窗外的雪枝上。

cardiologist.note:
The family doctor referred him to a renowned cardiologist for further tests. 家庭医生把他转诊给了一位知名的心脏病专家做进一步检查。

She has been seeing a cardiologist regularly to monitor her blood pressure. 她一直定期看心脏病专家以监测血压。

careworn.meaning: adj. 饱经风霜的；面容憔悴的
careworn.note:
Years of financial hardship left him looking careworn and exhausted. 多年的经济困难让他看起来饱经风霜、筋疲力尽。

She had a careworn expression as she read the stack of bills. 当她阅读一叠账单时，脸上露出了憔悴的神情。

carol.meaning: n. 颂歌；圣诞颂歌 v. 欢唱
carol.note:
Children walked down the street singing traditional Christmas carols. 孩子们走在街上唱着传统的圣诞颂歌。

Birds began to carol cheerfully in the trees at the break of dawn. 破晓时分，鸟儿开始在树枝上欢快地歌唱。

carouse.meaning: v. 狂饮作乐；饮酒狂欢
carouse.note:
The sailors spent the night in town to carouse after months at sea. 水手们在海上呆了几个月后，在城里狂欢了一夜。

Late-night carousing from the bar next door kept the residents awake. 隔壁酒吧深夜的饮酒狂欢让居民们无法入睡。

carp.meaning: n. 鲤鱼 v. 挑剔；喋喋不休地抱怨
carp.note:
We caught several large carp in the muddy lake during the afternoon. 下午我们在泥泞的湖里抓了几条大鲤鱼。

There is no use to carp about minor details that cannot be changed. 对无法改变的小细节喋喋不休地抱怨是没有用的。

carpenter.note:
The carpenter built custom wooden shelves for the new library. 木工为新图书馆定制了木质书架。

He hired a skilled carpenter to repair the old wooden porch. 他请了一位熟练的木匠来修缮旧木门廊。

carrion.note:
Vultures circled high above the desert in search of fresh carrion. 秃鹫在沙漠高空盘旋，寻找新鲜的腐肉。

The smell of carrion attracted wild animals to the edge of the road. 腐肉的气味吸引了野生动物来到路边。

cartographer.meaning: n. 制图员；地图绘制者
cartographer.note:
Ancient cartographers drew mythical creatures on unexplored parts of maps. 古代制图员在地图未探索的区域画上了神话生物。

Modern cartographers use satellite imaging to create highly accurate maps. 现代制图员利用卫星成像来制作高度准确的地图。

cartoon.note:
My younger brother loves watching animated cartoons on Saturday mornings. 我弟弟喜欢在周六早上看动画片。

The daily newspaper features a humorous political cartoon on the editorial page. 日报的社论版刊登了一幅幽默的政治漫画。

cast.meaning: v. 投；掷；抛；全体演员 n. 演员阵容；石膏绷带
cast.note:
The fisherman cast his net into the calm waters of the lake. 渔夫将网撒入湖泊平静的水中。

The play featured a talented cast of young theater actors. 这部戏剧拥有才华横溢的年轻剧院演员阵容。

caste.note:
The traditional caste system divided society into rigid hierarchical groups. 传统的种姓制度将社会划分为严格的等级群体。

Modern laws prohibit discrimination based on caste or social origin. 现代法律禁止基于种姓或社会出身的歧视。

castigate.meaning: v. 严厉批评；申斥；惩罚
castigate.note:
The coach did not hesitate to castigate the team for their poor performance. 教练毫不犹豫地严厉批评了球队糟糕的表现。

The editorial castigated the government for failing to protect the environment. 社论严厉斥责政府未能保护环境。

castigation.note:
He faced severe castigation from his peers for plagiarizing the report. 他因为抄袭报告而面临同行的严厉斥责。

Her mistakes met with public castigation in the national media. 她的错误在国家媒体中遭到了公开痛斥。

casual.meaning: adj. 休闲的；随意的；偶然的
casual.note:
Guests are encouraged to wear casual clothing to the garden party. 建议宾客们穿休闲服参加花园派对。

They had a casual conversation about the weather while waiting for the bus. 等车时，他们随口聊了聊天气。

cataclysm.note:
The asteroid impact caused a global cataclysm that wiped out the dinosaurs. 小行星撞击引发了一场毁灭恐龙的全球大灾难。

Historians studied the economic cataclysm that led to the Great Depression. 历史学家研究了导致大萧条的经济巨变。

caterpillar.note:
A green caterpillar was munching quietly on a fresh garden leaf. 一只绿色毛毛虫正在花园的新鲜叶子上静静地啃咬。

The fuzzy caterpillar will eventually spin a cocoon and turn into a butterfly. 这只毛茸茸的毛毛虫最终会结茧变成蝴蝶。

catharsis.note:
Writing her personal memoir provided a deep sense of emotional catharsis. 撰写个人回忆录给她带来了深的情感宣泄感。

Tragic drama often offers the audience a therapeutic experience of catharsis. 悲剧戏剧往往给观众提供一种治疗性的宣泄体验。

cathedral.note:
The medieval gothic cathedral attracts thousands of tourists every year. 那座中世纪的哥特式大教堂每年吸引成千上万的游客。

Stained glass windows cast colorful light inside the grand cathedral. 彩色玻璃窗在大教堂内部投射出绚丽的光芒。

catholic.meaning: adj. 天主教的；包容的；广泛的
catholic.note:
He was raised in a devout Catholic family in southern Europe. 他在南欧的一个虔诚天主教家庭长大。

She has very catholic tastes in music, ranging from classical to heavy metal. 她的音乐品味非常广泛，从古典音乐到重金属都有涉猎。

caucus.meaning: n. 核心会议；政党基层会议
caucus.note:
Party members gathered for a closed caucus to discuss strategy. 党内成员聚集召开闭门核心会议讨论战略。

The Iowa caucus is traditionally the first major event in the US presidential election. 爱荷华州的党团会议传统上是美国总统大选中的第一个重大事件。

caulk.meaning: v. 填塞缝隙；密封 n. 填缝胶
caulk.note:
He used silicone sealant to caulk the gaps around the bathtub. 他用硅酮密封胶填塞了浴缸周围的缝隙。

Workers must caulk the wooden hull of the boat to prevent leaks. 工人们必须填塞船的木制船体以防漏水。

causal.meaning: adj. 因果关系的；起因的
causal.note:
Scientists tried to establish a direct causal link between smoking and the disease. 科学家试图确立吸烟与该疾病之间的直接因果关系。

Correlation does not automatically imply a causal relationship. 相关性并不自动意味着存在因果关系。

cauterize.meaning: v. 烧灼（伤口止血或防感染）；烙
cauterize.note:
The ancient medic used a hot iron to cauterize the wound and stop the bleeding. 古代医生用热铁块烧灼伤口以止血。

Medical procedures today rarely use heat to cauterize tissue unless necessary. 除非必要，如今的医疗程序很少使用高温来烧灼组织。

cavalier.meaning: adj. 漫不经心的；目中无人的 n. 骑士
cavalier.note:
She adopted a cavalier attitude toward serious financial responsibilities. 她对沉重的财务责任采取了一种漫不经心的态度。

History books describe the cavaliers who fought for the king in the civil war. 历史书描述了在内战中为国王战斗的骑士们。

cavalry.note:
In historical battles, the cavalry was used to make fast flanking attacks. 在历史战役中，骑兵被用于实施快速侧翼攻击。

Reinforcements arrived just in time like the cavalry coming to the rescue. 援军恰到好处地赶到，就像骑兵前来救援一样。

caveat.meaning: n. 警告；附加说明；限制条款
caveat.note:
The agreement was signed with one important caveat regarding deadlines. 该协议在附带一个关于最后期限的重要警告下签署了。

There is one major caveat you should consider before accepting the job offer. 在接受这份工作邀请之前，你应该考虑一个主要的前提条件。

cavern.note:
Tourists explored the dark limestone cavern led by an experienced guide. 游客在经验丰富的导游带领下探索了黑暗的石灰岩大溶洞。

Echoes bounced off the wet walls inside the deep underground cavern. 回声在深邃的地下洞穴湿润的墙壁上回荡。

cavil.meaning: v. 无端挑剔；吹毛求疵 n. 无端指责
cavil.note:
It is useless to cavil at minor details when the main plan is sound. 当主要计划完善时，对细枝末节吹毛求疵是没有用的。

Her constant cavil over trivial matters annoyed the entire committee. 她对琐事不断挑剔惹恼了整个委员会。

cavity.note:
The dentist found a small cavity in one of his back teeth. 牙医在他的后牙里发现了一个小蛀牙。

An X-ray revealed a hidden cavity inside the ancient stone structure. X光检查显示古老石质结构内部有一个隐藏的空腔。

cavort.meaning: v. 欢跃；嬉戏；纵情狂欢
cavort.note:
Children cavorted happily in the shallow water of the public fountain. 孩子们在公共喷泉的浅水里快乐地嬉戏。

Puppies cavorted across the lawn, chasing each other in the afternoon sun. 小狗们在草坪上欢快地嬉戏，在午后阳光下互相追逐。

cede.meaning: v. 割让；放弃（权力、领土等）
cede.note:
The defeated nation was forced to cede territory to the victors.战败国被迫向胜利者割让领土。

He refused to cede control of the company to the new investors.他拒绝将公司的控制权让给新投资者。

celebrated.note:
The celebrated author gave a lecture at the university library. 这位著名的作家在大学图书馆发表了演讲。

She dined at a celebrated restaurant known for its exquisite French cuisine. 她在一家以精致法国菜闻名的知名餐厅用餐。

cellar.note:
Bottles of fine wine were carefully stored in the cool underground cellar. 优质葡萄酒瓶被小心翼翼地储存在凉爽的地下酒窖里。

We kept winter vegetables like potatoes and carrots in the dark cellar. 我们把土豆和胡萝卜等冬季蔬菜放在黑暗的地窖里。

cello.note:
She played a deeply emotional solo on the wooden cello. 她用木制大提琴演奏了一首感情深沉的独奏曲。

The orchestra needs another experienced musician to play the cello. 乐队需要另一位经验丰富的音乐家来弹奏大提琴。

cement.meaning: n. 水泥 v. 巩固；粘合
cement.note:
Workers mixed sand, water, and cement to build the sturdy foundation. 工人们将沙子、水和水泥混合以建造坚固的地基。

The visit helped to cement the diplomatic ties between the two allied countries. 这次访问有助于巩固两个同盟国之间的外交关系。

centaur.meaning: n. 人马座；半人马（希腊神话）
centaur.note:
In Greek mythology, the centaur is a creature with the head of a man and body of a horse. 在希腊神话中，半人马是一种人头马身的生物。

Constellations like Centaurus can be seen clearly in the southern hemisphere. 像人马座这样的星座在南半球可以清晰地看到。

centigrade.note:
Temperatures reached over forty degrees centigrade during the heatwave. 热浪期间气温达到了摄氏四十多度。

Water freezes at zero degrees centigrade under standard atmospheric pressure. 在标准大气压下，水在摄氏零度结冰。

centralization.note:
The government aimed to improve efficiency through the centralization of public services. 政府旨在通过公共服务的集权化来提高效率。

Critics argued that excessive centralization would slow down local decision-making. 批评者认为，过度的集中化会减慢地方决策的速度。

centurion.meaning: n. 百夫长（古罗马军队军官）
centurion.note:
The Roman centurion commanded a cohort of eighty disciplined soldiers. 罗马百夫长指挥着由八十名纪律严明的士兵组成的队伍。

Statues of ancient centurions stood proudly near the historical amphitheater. 古代百夫长的雕像骄傲地矗立在历史圆形剧场附近。

ceramic.meaning: adj. 陶瓷的 n. 陶瓷制品
ceramic.note:
She placed the delicate ceramic vase carefully on the wooden mantelpiece. 她把精致的陶瓷花瓶小心翼翼地放在木质壁炉台面上。

Ceramic tiles are widely used for flooring in kitchens and bathrooms. 瓷砖广泛用于厨房和浴室的地面铺设。

ceramics.meaning: n. 制陶业；陶瓷学；陶瓷工艺品
ceramics.note:
He took an evening class in ceramics to learn how to throw pots on a wheel. 他上了一个陶瓷夜校班，学习如何在拉坯机上制作陶罐。

The museum houses a priceless collection of ancient Asian ceramics. 博物馆藏有无价的古代亚洲陶瓷藏品。

cereal.meaning: n. 谷类食物；麦片；谷物
cereal.note:
Many children enjoy eating a bowl of sweet breakfast cereal with milk. 许多孩子喜欢吃一碗加牛奶的甜早餐麦片。

Corn, wheat, and rice are among the world's most vital cereal crops. 玉米、小麦和水稻是世界上最重要的谷物作物之一。

cerebral.meaning: adj. 大脑的；理智的；深思熟虑的
cerebral.note:
A severe stroke can cause permanent damage to cerebral tissue. 严重的中风会对大脑组织造成永久性损伤。

He prefers cerebral films that challenge the viewer's intellect rather than simple action flicks. 他更喜欢挑战观众智力的理智型电影，而不是简单的动作片。

ceremonious.meaning: adj. 讲究仪式的；拘泥于礼节的
ceremonious.note:
The diplomat was greeted with a highly ceremonious official reception. 这位外交官受到了高度讲究礼节的官方接待。

He found the rigid, ceremonious atmosphere at the banquet rather exhausting. 他发现宴会上死板、拘泥礼节的氛围相当累人。

certainty.meaning: n. 确定的事；确信；必然性
certainty.note:
Scientists cannot speak of the future with absolute certainty. 科学家无法以绝对的确信来谈论未来。

Winning the championship is no longer a certainty after last week's defeat. 经历了上周的失利后，赢得冠军已经不再是一件确定的事了。

certification.meaning: n. 证明；资格证书；认证
certification.note:
IT professionals often pursue professional certification to advance their careers. IT专业人员经常追求专业认证来推进他们的职业生涯。

Organic food requires official certification before it can be sold in stores. 有机食品在商店出售前需要官方认证。

certitude.note:
She spoke with such calm certitude that nobody dared to question her. 她以如此平静的绝对把握说话，以至于没人敢质疑她。

In uncertain times, people seek the false certitude of simple answers. 在充满不确定的时代里，人们寻求简单答案所带来的虚假确信。

cessation.note:
Both warring factions agreed to an immediate cessation of hostilities. 两个交战派别同意立即停止敌对行动。

The sudden cessation of production caused severe supply shortages. 生产的突然中断导致了严重的供应短缺。

cession.note:
The peace treaty demanded the cession of border territories to the neighboring state. 和平条约要求将边境领土割让给邻国。

This territorial cession marked the end of a long and bloody conflict. 这一次领土割让标志着一场漫长而血腥的冲突的结束。

chafe.meaning: v. 擦痛；惹恼；激怒 n. 擦伤
chafe.note:
The tight collar began to chafe against his neck during the long hike. 长途徒步时，紧绷的衣领开始擦痛他的脖子。

Local residents began to chafe under the strict new municipal regulations. 当地居民开始对严厉的新市政规定感到恼火。

chaff.meaning: n. 谷壳；稻壳；无聊的话 v. 开玩笑
chaff.note:
The farmer separated the valuable wheat grain from the worthless chaff. 农夫将有价值的小麦粒与无价值的谷壳分离开来。

Colleagues liked to chaff each other in the breakroom during lunch. 同事们喜欢在午休时在休息室互相开玩笑。

chagrin.meaning: n. 懊恼；失望 v. 使懊恼
chagrin.note:
To his great chagrin, he failed the driving test for the third time. 令他极其懊恼的是，他第三次驾考不及格了。

Much to her chagrin, nobody remembered to bring the birthday cake. 让感到大失所望的是，没人记得带生日蛋糕。

chalice.note:
The priest raised the golden chalice during the religious ceremony. 牧师在宗教仪式上举起了金色的圣杯。

An antique silver chalice was proudly displayed in the glass cabinet. 一只古董银圣杯自豪地陈列在玻璃陈列柜中。

chancellor.meaning: n. 大臣；总理；大学校长
chancellor.note:
The German chancellor addressed the European parliament on trade policies. 德国总理在欧洲议会上就贸易政策发表了讲话。

University officials and the chancellor welcomed the incoming freshman class. 大学官员和校长对新生班级的到来表示欢迎。

chandelier.note:
A magnificent crystal chandelier hung from the high ceiling of the ballroom. 舞厅的高天花板上悬挂着一盏华丽的水晶枝形吊灯。

Servants carefully cleaned the dust from the sparkling glass chandelier. 仆人们小心翼翼地擦拭着闪闪发光的水晶吊灯上的灰尘。

chant.meaning: n. 圣歌；反复呼喊的口号 v. 吟唱；反复呼喊
chant.note:
Monks chanted ancient prayers quietly in the stone monastery. 修士们在石质修道院里静静地吟唱古老的祷文。

Protesters marched down the avenue with rhythmic chants for social justice. 抗议者沿着林荫大道游行，高呼着争取社会公正的有节奏口号。

chapel.note:
The small wedding ceremony took place in a rustic country chapel. 这场小型婚礼在一个古朴的乡村小教堂举行。

Students gathered in the campus chapel for morning meditation. 学生们聚集在校园礼拜堂进行晨间冥想。

char.meaning: v. 烧焦；炭化 n. 炭化痕迹；清洁工
char.note:
The camp fire began to char the logs placed at the edge of the pit. 营火开始将放在坑边的原木烧焦。

Firefighters inspected the charred remains of the wooden structure. 消防员检查了木制结构被烧焦的残骸。

characterization.meaning: n. 刻画；描述；特性描写
characterization.note:
The novel is praised for its brilliant characterization of complex protagonists. 这部小说因其对复杂主角的出色刻画而受到赞誉。

His characterization of the situation as a minor issue was misleading. 他将局势描述为一个小问题的说法具有误导性。

characterize.note:
Steep hills and green valleys characterize the rural landscape of the region. 陡峭的山丘和翠绿的山谷构成了该地区乡村景观的特征。

Experts characterize the current economic period as a time of steady growth. 专家将当前的经济时期描述为稳步增长的时期。

charade.meaning: n. 虚伪的游戏；猜字谜游戏
charade.note:
Everyone at the party joined in a lively game of charades after dinner. 晚饭后，派对上的每个人都加入了一场热烈的猜字谜游戏。

They dropped the formal charade and began to speak honestly to each other. 他们放弃了正式的虚伪游戏，开始坦诚地对彼此说话。

charisma.meaning: n. 个人魅力；领袖气质
charisma.note:
Her natural charisma allowed her to easily persuade large crowds of people. 她天生的个人魅力使她能够轻易说服大批人群。

The politician won the election largely due to his magnetic personal charisma. 这位政治家赢得选举很大程度上归功于他具有吸引力的个人魅力。

charitable.note:
The billionaire donated millions of dollars to various charitable organizations. 这位亿万富翁向各种慈善组织捐赠了数百万美元。

Try to be more charitable when judging other people's mistakes. 在评判别人的错误时，尽量多一些宽容。

charity.meaning: n. 慈善机构；慈善；施舍
charity.note:
She works as a volunteer for a local children's charity on weekends. 周末她在一家当地的儿童慈善机构做志愿者。

The project was funded entirely by public donations and organized charity. 该项目完全由公众捐款和有组织的慈善资金资助。

charlatan.note:
He exposed the traveling doctor as a fraud and a charlatan. 他揭露那个巡回医生是个骗子和江湖郎中。

Don't trust his fake medical cures; he is nothing more than a charlatan. 别相信他虚假的医疗偏方；他不过是个骗子。

chary.meaning: adj. 谨慎的；小心的；吝啬的
chary.note:
Investors remain chary about putting money into high-risk startup ventures. 投资者对于将资金投入高风险初创企业仍然持谨慎态度。

She is always chary of sharing personal information with strangers. 她对与陌生人分享个人信息总是很谨慎。

chase.meaning: v. 追逐；追赶 n. 追逐
chase.note:
The playful dog loved to chase tennis balls across the grassy yard. 那只爱玩的狗喜欢在长满草的院子里追逐网球。

Police cars engaged in a high-speed chase through the city streets. 警车在城市街道上展开了高速追逐。

chasm.note:
Hikers looked down carefully into the rocky mountain chasm. 徒步旅行者小心翼翼地向下看着岩石密布的山间深渊。

There is a deep cultural chasm separating the older and younger generations. 存在着一条将老年人和年轻一代隔开的深厚文化鸿沟。

chaste.meaning: adj. 纯洁的；贞洁的；朴素的
chaste.note:
The bride wore a simple, chaste white gown for the traditional wedding. 新娘在传统婚礼上穿着一件简单纯洁的白礼服。

Monks vowed to live a chaste and ascetic life away from worldly temptations. 修士们发誓过一种远离世俗诱惑的纯洁苦行生活。

chastise.note:
The teacher did not hesitate to chastise students who broke school rules. 老师毫不犹豫地严厉批评了违反学校规定的学生。

He was publicly chastised for his careless handling of company finances. 他因粗心处理公司财务而受到公开斥责。

chauvinistic.meaning: adj. 沙文主义的；盲目爱国主义的
chauvinistic.note:
His chauvinistic remarks offended many foreign guests at the conference. 他沙文主义的言论冒犯了会议上的许多外国来宾。

The essay criticizes narrow-minded and chauvinistic attitudes in modern politics. 这篇文章批评了现代政治中思想狭隘和盲目爱国的态度。

cherubic.meaning: adj. 天使般可爱的；纯洁圆润的
cherubic.note:
The sleeping baby had a cherubic face that melted everyone's hearts. 睡着的婴儿有着一张融化所有人内心的天使般可爱的脸庞。

Despite his mischievous behavior, he looked completely cherubic. 尽管他淘气，但他看起来完全是一副天使般可爱的样子。

chicanery.note:
The company's financial success was achieved through political chicanery and deceit. 该公司的财务成功是通过政治欺诈和欺骗实现的。

Lawyers accused the opposition of legal chicanery to delay the trial. 律师指控对方利用法律诡辩来拖延审判。

chide.note:
Mother gently chided her son for leaving his muddy boots by the front door. 母亲温柔地责备儿子把沾满泥的靴子留在大门旁。

She chided herself for being so careless with the expensive camera. 她责备自己对昂贵的相机太粗心了。

chimera.meaning: n. 奇美拉（希腊神话怪物）；妄想；幻想
chimera.note:
In mythology, the chimera breathes fire and has the body of a lion and goat. 在神话中，奇美拉吐火，且拥有狮子和山羊的身体。

His dream of becoming a pop star proved to be nothing more than a chimera. 他成为流行歌星的梦想最终不过是一个空想。

chip.meaning: n. 芯片；碎片；炸薯条 v. 削；凿；有缺口
chip.note:
Modern computers rely heavily on powerful silicon microchips. 现代计算机严重依赖强大的硅微芯片。

Be careful not to chip the edge of this expensive porcelain plate. 小心别把这个昂贵瓷盘的边缘磕出缺口。

chipmunk.note:
A tiny chipmunk scurried across the backyard with nuts stuffed in its cheeks. 一只小花栗鼠嘴里塞满坚果，在后院飞奔而过。

Children watched the adorable chipmunk climb up the tall oak tree. 孩子们看着可爱的花栗鼠爬上高大的橡树。

chisel.meaning: n. 凿子 v. 凿；雕刻
chisel.note:
The sculptor used a sharp steel chisel to carve details into the marble. 雕塑家使用一把锋利的钢凿在大理石上雕刻细节。

He carefully chiseled the block of stone into the shape of a bird. 他小心翼翼地把这块石头凿成了一只鸟的形状。

chivalrous.meaning: adj. 骑士精神的；侠义的；彬彬有礼的
chivalrous.note:
He made a chivalrous gesture by offering his jacket to the cold stranger. 他做出了一个侠义的举动，把夹克脱给寒冷的陌生人穿。

Her date opened every door for her with old-fashioned, chivalrous charm. 她的约会对象以老派、骑士般迷人的风度为她打开了每一扇门。

choice.meaning: n. 选择；抉择 adj. 精选的；优质的
choice.note:
Students had a wide range of elective courses to choose from. 学生们有广泛的选修课程可供选择。

The butcher recommended a piece of choice beef for the dinner party. 肉店老板为晚宴推荐了一块精选牛肉。

choke.note:
He started to choke on a piece of dry bread during dinner. 晚饭时他吃一块干面包噎住了。

Heavy traffic began to choke the main highway during rush hour. 交通高峰期，沉重的交通开始堵塞主干道。

choleric.note:
His choleric temper made it difficult for employees to work under him. 他暴躁的脾气使得员工很难在他手下工作。

The manager's choleric outbursts shocked everyone in the office. 经理暴怒的发作震惊了办公室里的所有人。

chord.note:
The guitarist strummed a major chord that echoed through the small room. 吉他手弹奏了一个大三和弦，在小房间里回荡。

The emotional speech struck a responsive chord with the audience. 这番感人的演讲引起了观众的共鸣。

choreography.note:
The ballet is famous for its intricate and breathtaking choreography. 这部芭蕾舞剧以其错综复杂、叹为观止的舞蹈编排而闻名。

She designed the modern choreography for the upcoming theater production. 她为即将上演的剧场作品设计了现代舞蹈编排。

chorus.meaning: n. 合唱团；副歌；齐声 v. 齐声说
chorus.note:
The school chorus sang traditional hymns at the annual winter concert. 学校合唱团在年度冬季音乐会上演唱了传统赞美诗。

Children chorused their agreement when asked if they wanted ice cream. 当被问及是否想要冰淇淋时，孩子们齐声表示同意。

chromatic.note:
The pianist practiced difficult chromatic scales for hours every day. 钢琴家每天练习困难的半音阶几个小时。

Her paintings explore complex chromatic relationships and vivid contrasts. 她的画作探索了复杂的色彩关系和生动的对比。

chromosome.note:
Humans typically possess twenty-three pairs of chromosomes in each cell. 人类通常在每个细胞中拥有二十三对染色体。

Genetic disorders are often caused by abnormalities in a specific chromosome. 遗传性疾病通常由特定染色体的异常引起。

chrysanthemum.note:
Bright yellow chrysanthemums bloomed proudly in the autumn garden. 鲜艳的黄色菊花在秋天的花园里骄傲地盛开。

She arranged a bouquet of white chrysanthemums for the living room table. 她为客厅桌子插了一束白菊花。

chuckle.meaning: v. 轻声笑；暗笑 n. 轻笑
chuckle.note:
He let out a quiet chuckle as he read the funny comic strip. 读到有趣的漫画连载时，他发出了轻轻的笑声。

Grandfather chuckled when the puppy tripped over its own paws. 当小狗被自己的爪子绊倒时，爷爷轻声笑了笑。

churl.note:
He felt like a churl for refusing to help his neighbors move boxes. 他因为拒绝帮邻居搬箱子而觉得自己像个粗鲁的人。

Only a churl would turn down such a generous and kind invitation. 只有粗鲁的人才会拒绝如此慷慨和善意的邀请。

cinder.note:
Hot cinders flew out from the fireplace and landed on the rug. 热煤渣从壁炉里飞出来，落在了地毯上。

The old wooden cabin burned down, leaving behind only smoldering cinders. 那间旧木屋烧毁了，只留下冒烟的灰烬。

circuit.meaning: n. 电路；环形路线；巡回
circuit.note:
Electricians repaired the broken electrical circuit in the basement. 电工修理了地下室断裂的电路。

Tennis players competed on the international professional circuit. 网球运动员在国际职业巡回赛上竞争。

circuitous.note:
They took a circuitous route to avoid the heavy traffic on the highway. 他们走了一条迂回路线以避开高速公路上的拥堵交通。

His explanation of the project was long and unnecessarily circuitous. 他对该项目的解释冗长且没必要地绕圈子。

circumference.note:
Students measured the circumference of the old oak tree with a tape measure. 学生们用卷尺测量了老橡树的周长。

The fence marks the outer circumference of the property. 栅栏标志着该房产的外围边界。

circumlocution.meaning: n. 迂回曲折的说法；累赘的话
circumlocution.note:
Please get straight to the point without using so much circumlocution. 请直奔主题，不要用那么多拐弯抹角的话。

His political speech was filled with vague circumlocution and empty promises. 他的政治演讲充满了含糊其辞的迂回说法和空洞的承诺。

circumstantial.meaning: adj. 依情况而定的；间接证据的；详尽的
circumstantial.note:
The case against the suspect relied entirely on circumstantial evidence. 针对犯罪嫌疑人的案件完全依赖间接证据。

She provided a circumstantial account of what happened that evening. 她对那天晚上发生的事情做了详尽的叙述。

circumvent.meaning: v. 设法避开；规避；绕过
circumvent.note:
Engineers designed a new firewall to circumvent security breaches. 工程师设计了一种新的防火墙来规避安全漏洞。

They found a clever way to circumvent the strict regulations legally. 他们找到了一种在法律上巧妙规避严格规定的方法。

cistern.note:
Rainwater was collected in a large underground cistern for garden irrigation. 雨水被收集在一个大型地下蓄水池中用于花园灌溉。

The plumber repaired the leaking toilet cistern in the bathroom. 水管工修理了浴室里漏水的马桶水箱。

cite.note:
The researcher forgot to cite several important sources in her bibliography. 研究人员在参考书目中忘记引用几个重要的来源。

He was officially cited for bravery during the rescue operation. 他在救援行动中因勇敢而受到正式表彰。

civil.meaning: adj. 民间的；民事的；客气的
civil.note:
The two neighbors managed to maintain a civil conversation despite their dispute. 尽管有争执，两个邻居还是设法保持了客气的对话。

The country suffered years of destructive civil war before peace was restored. 在恢复和平之前，这个国家遭受了多年的破坏性内战。

civility.note:
Even during heated debates, both politicians maintained basic civility. 即使在激烈的辩论中，两位政治家也保持了基本的礼貌。

He treated every customer with professional warmth and civility. 他以职业的温和和礼貌对待每一位客户。

claim.meaning: v. 声称；索取 n. 断言；索赔
claim.note:
The company claimed that their new product was completely safe to use. 公司声称他们的新产品使用起来绝对安全。

She filed an insurance claim after her car was damaged in a storm. 汽车在暴风雨中受损后，她提出了保险索赔。

clairvoyance.meaning: n. 透视力；超人的洞察力
clairvoyance.note:
She claimed to possess clairvoyance and the ability to foresee future events. 她声称自己拥有透视力和预见未来事件的能力。

His remarkable business success seemed almost like a form of clairvoyance. 他非凡的商业成功几乎看起来像是一种超人的洞察力。

clam.note:
We dug for fresh clams in the wet sand along the ocean shore. 我们沿着海岸的湿沙里挖新鲜的蛤蜊。

Clam chowder is a popular creamy soup served in coastal restaurants. 蛤蜊浓汤是沿海餐厅供应的一种受欢迎的奶油汤。

clamor.meaning: n. 吵闹；喧哗；强烈要求 v. 喧嚷
clamor.note:
Citizens began to clamor for lower taxes and better public services. 公民们开始强烈要求降低税收和改善公共服务。

A loud clamor arose from the street as protesters marched past. 随着抗议者游行而过，街上响起了一片喧闹声。

clamp.meaning: n. 夹子；夹具 v. 夹紧；固定
clamp.note:
The woodworker used a metal clamp to hold the pieces together while gluing. 木工用金属夹子在胶合时把木块固定在一起。

Police clamped a metal boot onto the illegally parked car. 警察给违章停车的车子夹上了一个金属车轮锁。

clandestine.meaning: adj. 秘密的；暗中进行的
clandestine.note:
Agents met in a clandestine location to exchange classified documents. 特工们在一个秘密地点会面，交换机密文件。

The resistance movement carried out clandestine operations against the regime. 地下抵抗运动针对该政权开展了秘密行动。

clannish.note:
The small village is known for being rather clannish and unwelcoming to outsiders. 这个小村庄以排外且对局外人不友好而闻名。

New employees found the tightly knit department a bit clannish at first. 新员工起初发现这个紧密团结的部门有点排外。

clarion.meaning: adj. 嘹亮的；清脆的 n. 号角声
clarion.note:
The editor published a clarion call for immediate climate action. 编辑发表了一篇呼吁立即采取气候行动的响亮号召。

A clarion sound echoed across the valley as the morning bugle blew. 清晨的号角吹响时，嘹亮的声音在山谷中回荡。

clasp.meaning: v. 紧握；紧抱 n. 扣子；紧握
clasp.note:
She held the child's hand in a tight, protective clasp. 她紧紧地、保护性地握着孩子的手。

He managed to clasp the heavy necklace around his friend's neck. 他设法把沉重的项链扣在朋友的脖子上。

classify.meaning: v. 分类；归类；把……列为机密
classify.note:
Librarians classify books according to the Dewey decimal system. 图书管理员根据杜威十进制分类法对书籍进行分类。

The government decided to classify the defense documents for security reasons. 出于安全原因，政府决定将国防文件列为机密。

clause.note:
Each contract contains a special termination clause protecting both parties. 每份合同都包含一个保护双方的特殊终止条款。

A relative clause modifies a noun or pronoun in a sentence. 定语从句修饰句子中的名词或代词。

clay.note:
Potters shaped the soft wet clay into beautiful bowls and cups. 陶艺家把柔软湿润的陶土塑造成美丽的碗和杯子。

The tennis tournament is played on traditional red clay courts. 这场网球锦标赛是在传统的红土球场上进行的。

cleavage.note:
Sociologists noted a growing social cleavage between urban and rural voters. 社会学家注意到城乡选民之间日益加剧的社会分歧。

Minerals often break along specific planes known as lines of cleavage. 矿物经常沿着被称为解理面的特定平面断裂。

cleave.note:
The woodcutter used an axe to cleave the thick log into smaller pieces. 木工用斧头把粗原木劈成小块。

Despite all hardships, she decided to cleave to her core principles. 尽管经历了种种艰难险阻，她还是决定坚守自己的核心原则。

cleaver.note:
The butcher used a heavy meat cleaver to chop through the bone. 肉店老板用一把重型斩肉刀把骨头砍断。

She washed the sharp steel cleaver and hung it on the kitchen rack. 她洗净了锋利的钢制斩肉刀，把它挂在厨房架子上。

cleft.meaning: n. 裂缝；裂口 adj. 分裂的
cleft.note:
Wildflowers grew out from a narrow cleft in the mountain rock. 野花从山岩的一条狭窄裂缝中生长出来。

The actor was well-known for his distinctive cleft chin. 这位演员以其独特的有沟槽的下巴而闻名。

clemency.meaning: n. 仁慈；宽恕；温和（气候）
clemency.note:
The criminal begged the judge for mercy and judicial clemency. 罪犯恳求法官给予仁慈和司法宽恕。

Prisoners appealed to the governor for clemency before their execution date. 囚犯在行刑日期前向州长呼吁宽大处理。

clement.meaning: adj. 仁慈的；温和的（气候）
clement.note:
Farmers hoped for clement weather to help the crops grow faster. 农民们希望有温和的气候来帮助农作物更快生长。

The judge was known for being clement toward first-time youthful offenders. 这位法官以对初犯的年轻违法者仁慈而闻名。

clientele.note:
The luxury boutique attracts a wealthy and fashionable clientele. 这家奢侈品精品店吸引了富有且时髦的顾客群体。

Over the years, the restaurant built a loyal clientele of local residents. 多年来，这家餐厅建立了一批当地居民的忠实顾客群。

climax.meaning: n. 高潮；顶点 v. 达到高潮
climax.note:
The exciting thriller reached its thrilling climax in the final scene. 这部令人兴奋的惊悚片在最后一幕达到了激动人心的最高潮。

The festival will climax with a spectacular fireworks display over the lake. 节日将在湖面上空壮观的烟花表演中达到高潮。

clinch.meaning: v. 解决；最终确立；紧抱 n. 拥抱
clinch.note:
The final goal helped the team clinch victory in the championship match. 最后一粒进球帮助球队在冠军赛中最终确立了胜利。

Both boxers locked arms in a tight clinch before the referee separated them. 裁判拉开他们之前，两名拳击手紧紧抱在一起。

clip.meaning: n. 夹子；回形针；剪辑片段 v. 修剪；夹住
clip.note:
She used a metal paper clip to hold the important documents together. 她用一个金属回形针把重要文件夹在一起。

He watched a short video clip of the concert on his smartphone. 他在智能手机上观看了音乐会的短视频剪辑片段。

clipper.note:
Fast nineteenth-century clipper ships carried tea from China to Europe. 十九世纪的快速帆船将中国的茶叶运往欧洲。

He used a pair of hair clippers to trim his beard short. 他用一把理发剪把胡子修剪得很短。

clique.meaning: n. 小集团；帮派；小圈子
clique.note:
New students often found it difficult to break into established school cliques. 新学生经常发觉很难融入既定的学校小圈子。

The school club was criticized for acting like an exclusive clique. 这个学校俱乐部因表现得像个排他的小集团而受到批评。

cloister.meaning: n. 修道院回廊；隐居地 v. 使隐居
cloister.note:
Monks walked quietly along the stone arches of the monastery cloister. 修士们沿着修道院回廊的石拱门安静地走着。

She chose to cloister herself away from the world to finish writing her book. 她选择隐居世外来完成她的书稿。

closet.meaning: n. 衣橱；壁橱 adj. 秘密的
closet.note:
Winter coats and jackets were neatly hung inside the bedroom closet. 冬衣和夹克整齐地挂在卧室的衣橱里。

He kept a collection of rare books hidden away in a dark closet. 他把一收藏品珍稀书籍藏在一个黑暗的壁橱里。

clot.meaning: n. 血块；凝块 v. 凝结
clot.note:
A blood clot in the brain can lead to serious medical complications. 脑部的血块可能导致严重的医疗并发症。

Chemicals added to the sample helped prevent the blood from starting to clot. 添加到样本中的化学物质有助于防止血液开始凝结。

cloture.meaning: n. 辩论终结（议会程序）
cloture.note:
Senators voted to invoke cloture to end the prolonged filibuster. 参议员投票决定启动辩论终结程序以结束长期的阻挠议事。

Passing the motion required a supermajority vote for cloture. 通过该动议需要获得多数赞成票以实现辩论终结。

cloudburst.note:
A sudden afternoon cloudburst flooded the downtown streets within minutes. 下午的一场突发暴雨在几分钟内淹没了市中心街道。

Drivers pulled over to the side of the road during the heavy cloudburst. 在强烈的暴雨期间，司机们把车停在了路边。

clout.note:
The large union holds significant political clout during election seasons. 这个大工会在选举季节拥有显著的政治影响力。

He punched the punching bag with surprising physical clout. 他以惊人的力道猛击沙袋。

clown.meaning: n. 小丑 v. 滑稽戏谑
clown.note:
Circus clowns entertained the cheering children with funny tricks. 马戏团小丑用滑稽的把戏逗乐了欢呼的孩子们。

Stop clowning around and focus on your homework. 别再耍滑头了，把注意力集中在家庭作业上。

cloying.meaning: adj. 甜得发腻的；感情过分多情的
cloying.note:
The dessert was too rich and had a cloying sweetness that was hard to finish. 这道甜点太浓郁了，甜得发腻，很难吃完。

She disliked movies with cloying sentimental plots. 她不喜欢情节过度多愁善感的电影。

clumsy.note:
He felt clumsy carrying the fragile glass vase across the crowded room. 带着易碎的玻璃花瓶穿过拥挤的房间时，他觉得自己很笨拙。

Her clumsy excuse did not fool anyone in the office. 她笨拙的借口没有骗过办公室里的任何人。

coagulant.note:
Doctors applied a special medical coagulant to stop the severe bleeding. 医生使用了一种特殊的医药物资凝固剂来止住大出血。

Blood coagulants are essential in emergency kits for treating deep wounds. 凝血剂对于治疗深层伤口的急救包来说至关重要。

coagulate.note:
Blood begins to coagulate naturally when exposed to air. 暴露在空气中时，血液会自然开始凝固。

Heat caused the protein in the egg white to coagulate. 加热导致蛋白中的蛋白质凝固。

coagulation.note:
The chemical process prevents the coagulation of blood during surgery. 这一化学过程防止了手术期间血液的凝固。

Scientists studied the rapid coagulation of the liquid substance. 科学家研究了该液态物质的迅速凝固过程。

coalesce.note:
Small political parties decided to coalesce into a powerful opposition coalition. 小政党决定联合成一个强大的反对派联盟。

Over time, separate ideas began to coalesce into a single coherent theory. 随着时间推移，独立的观点开始合并成一个连贯的理论。

coarse.note:
The fisherman wore a jacket made of coarse woolen fabric. 水手穿着一件粗毛织物制成的夹克。

His coarse language offended many guests at the formal dinner party. 他粗俗的语言冒犯了正式晚宴上的许多宾客。

coarsen.meaning: v. 变粗糙；使变得粗俗
coarsen.note:
Years of hard manual labor began to coarsen his hands. 多年的沉重体力劳动开始使他的双手变粗糙。

Exposure to aggressive media can coarsen public discourse. 接触激进的媒体可能会使公众话语变得粗俗。

coax.note:
She tried to coax the frightened cat down from the high branch. 她试图把那只吓坏了的猫从高树枝上哄下来。

He managed to coax a smile out of the crying child. 他设法让哭泣的孩子破涕为笑。

cob.meaning: n. 玉米棒子；雄天鹅；圆面包
cob.note:
We ate sweet corn on the cob during the summer barbecue. 我们在夏日烧烤时吃甜玉米棒子。

A majestic white cob glided gracefully across the pond. 一只雄伟的白色雄天鹅优雅地滑过池塘。

cobbler.meaning: n. 制鞋匠；补鞋匠；水果馅饼
cobbler.note:
He took his worn leather boots to the local cobbler for repair. 他把穿破的皮靴拿到当地的补鞋匠那里去修理。

We enjoyed a warm peach cobbler served with vanilla ice cream. 我们享用了配有香草冰淇淋的温热桃子水果馅饼。

cocoon.meaning: n. 茧 v. 密闭保护；紧紧包裹
cocoon.note:
The caterpillar spun a silk cocoon and waited to transform. 毛虫织了一个丝茧，等待蜕变。

She likes to cocoon herself in a warm blanket on winter evenings. 她喜欢在冬天的夜晚把自己紧紧包裹在温暖的毯子里。

coda.note:
The symphony ended with a magnificent and triumphant coda. 交响乐在壮丽而凯旋的尾声中结束。

Her speech served as a fitting coda to an eventful conference. 她的演讲为这场多事之秋的会议画上了恰当的尾声。

coddle.note:
Parents should not coddle their children too much if they want them to be independent. 如果想让孩子们独立，父母就不应该过度溺爱他们。

She carefully coddled the eggs in simmering water for breakfast. 她为早餐在微沸的水中小心翼翼地煮鸡蛋。

codify.meaning: v. 把……编纂成法典；系统化
codify.note:
The monarch ordered lawyers to codify the traditional laws of the kingdom. 君主命令律师将王国的传统法律编纂成法典。

Experts worked for years to codify rules regarding international trade. 专家们花费多年时间将关于国际贸易的规则系统化。

coerce.note:
The criminal tried to coerce the witness into changing her testimony. 罪犯试图强迫证人改变证词。

No one should be coerced into signing a contract against their will. 任何人都不应被强迫违背意愿签署合同。

coercion.note:
The confession was obtained through police coercion and threats. 供词是通过警方强迫和威胁获得的。

Democracy relies on free choice rather than government coercion. 民主依赖于自由选择，而不是政府的强迫。

coeval.meaning: adj. 同年代的；同期的 n. 同龄人
coeval.note:
The two ancient manuscripts are roughly coeval, dating back to the fifth century. 这两份古代手稿大致属于同一时期，可追溯到五世纪。

He compared the artist's early works with those of his coevals. 他将这位艺术家的早期作品与他同代人的作品进行了比较。

cogitate.note:
The philosopher sat quietly by the window to cogitate on the meaning of life. 哲学家安静地坐在窗边，思考生命的意义。

Give me a few minutes to cogitate on your proposal before I reply. 在我回答之前，给我几分钟时间深思熟虑一下你的提议。

cognizance.note:
The court took cognizance of the new evidence presented by the defense. 法院受理了辩方提交的新证据。

Management must take cognizance of changing market conditions. 管理层必须认识到不断变化的市场状况。

cognizant.note:
She was fully cognizant of the risks involved in starting a new business. 她完全意识到创办新企业所涉及的风险。

Leaders must remain cognizant of the concerns raised by employees. 领导者必须时刻了解员工提出的关切。

cohabit.note:
Many young couples choose to cohabit before getting married. 许多年轻夫妇选择在结婚前同居。

Different species of birds sometimes cohabit the same nesting area. 不同种类的鸟有时会共用同一个筑巢区。

collage.note:
Children made a colorful art collage using old magazines and newspapers. 孩子们用旧杂志和报纸制作了一幅色彩缤纷的艺术拼贴画。

The artist created a striking portrait using a digital photo collage. 艺术家用数码照片拼贴创作了一幅引人注目的肖像。

collate.meaning: v. 核对；校对；整理（资料）
collate.note:
Assistants spent the morning printing and collating reports for the meeting. 助理们花了一上午时间打印和整理会议报告。

Researchers must carefully collate data from various scientific experiments. 研究人员必须仔细核对来自各种科学实验的数据。

collateral.meaning: n. 抵押品 adj. 旁系的；附加的
collateral.note:
He offered his house as collateral to secure the bank loan. 他把自己的房子作为抵押品来获得银行贷款。

The military strike resulted in unfortunate collateral damage. 军事打击造成了不幸的附加损害。

collected.meaning: adj. 镇定的；泰然自若的
collected.note:
Despite the unexpected emergency, she remained calm and collected. 尽管发生了意外紧急情况，她依然保持冷静和镇定。

He took a deep breath to look collected before walking onto the stage. 上台前他深吸了一口气，让自己看起来泰然自若。

collection.note:
The art gallery houses an impressive collection of modern paintings. 艺术馆藏有令人印象深刻的现代画作收藏。

The church organized a clothing collection for local homeless families. 教堂为当地无家可归的家庭组织了一场衣物募捐活动。

colloquial.note:
The guide used colloquial expressions that made conversation easy and natural. 导游使用了口语化的表达，使对话变得轻松自然。

Formal writing should avoid colloquial phrases and slang terms. 正式写作应避免口语短语和俚语。

colloquium.meaning: n. 学术讨论会；座谈会
colloquium.note:
The physics department hosted a weekly colloquium for visiting scholars. 物理系为访问学者举办了每周一次的学术讨论会。

Researchers presented their latest findings at the international medical colloquium. 研究人员在国际医学座谈会上展示了他们的最新发现。

collude.note:
Major companies were accused of trying to collude to fix market prices. 大公司被指控企图勾结来操纵市场价格。

Officials colluded with contractors to misappropriate public construction funds. 官员与承包商串通挪用公共建设资金。

colonize.note:
European powers began to colonize parts of the Americas in the sixteenth century. 欧洲列强在十六世纪开始对美洲部分地区进行殖民。

Scientists study how certain plants rapidly colonize disturbed soil. 科学家研究某些植物如何迅速在受干扰的土壤中定居繁殖。

colonnade.note:
Ancient Greeks built grand temples surrounded by impressive stone colonnades. 古希腊人建造了周围环绕着宏伟石柱廊的宏大寺庙。

Visitors walked down the shaded colonnade escaping the hot afternoon sun. 游客们走在有阴凉的柱廊下躲避炎热的午后阳光。

coloration.note:
The bright coloration of the frog warns predators that it is poisonous. 青蛙鲜艳的色彩警告捕食者它是有毒的。

Birds in the forest showed unique and varied feather coloration. 森林里的鸟类表现出独特而多样的羽毛天然色泽。

colossus.meaning: n. 巨像；庞然大物；巨人
colossus.note:
The ancient Colossus of Rhodes was one of the wonders of the ancient world. 古代的罗德岛巨像曾是古代世界奇观之一。

The tech company grew from a small startup into a global economic colossus. 这家科技公司从一家小型初创企业成长为一个全球经济庞然大物。

coltish.meaning: adj. 小马般的；活泼好动的；轻浮的
coltish.note:
She was a tall, coltish teenager with clumsy long limbs. 她是一个身材高大、活泼好动、四肢修长的青少年。

The young horses displayed a playful and coltish energy in the field. 年轻的马匹在田野里展现出 playful 且好动的小马般活力。

coma.note:
He remained in a deep coma for weeks after the tragic traffic accident. 那场悲惨的交通事故后，他陷入了长达数周的深度昏迷。

Doctors monitored her vital signs closely while she was unconscious in a coma. 在她无意识昏迷期间，医生密切监测着她的生命体征。

comatose.meaning: adj. 昏迷的；极度疲惫的
comatose.note:
The patient was brought into the emergency room in a comatose state. 病人被以昏迷状态送进了急诊室。

After working a double shift, he felt completely comatose and fell asleep instantly. 上完双班后，他觉得困顿得不省人事，立刻就睡着了。

combustible.meaning: adj. 易燃的；易爆的 n. 易燃物
combustible.note:
Store chemicals in a safe place away from direct heat and combustible materials. 将化学品存放在远离直接热源和易燃的安全地方。

Gasoline is a highly combustible liquid that requires careful handling. 汽油是一种高度易燃的液体，需要小心处理。

comedienne.note:
The talented comedienne had the entire theater audience laughing out loud. 这位才华横溢的女喜剧演员引得整个剧院的观众哈哈大笑。

She started her career as a stand-up comedienne in local comedy clubs. 她在当地的喜剧俱乐部以单口女喜剧演员的身份开始了职业生涯。

comely.note:
The young woman was known in the village for her comely appearance. 这位年轻女子在村里以清秀的外表而闻名。

He married a comely maiden from a neighboring aristocratic family. 他娶了一位来自邻近贵族家庭的标致少女。

comic.meaning: adj. 喜剧的；滑稽的 n. 漫画杂志
comic.note:
The play relied on a clever mix of tragic and comic elements. 这部戏剧巧妙地融合了悲剧和喜剧元素。

He bought his younger brother a collection of superhero comic books. 他给弟弟买了一套超级英雄漫画书。

comity.meaning: n. 礼让；礼貌；国际友好
comity.note:
Nations must practice international comity to maintain global peace. 各国必须践行国际礼让以维护全球和平。

Judicial comity encourages courts of different jurisdictions to respect each other. 司法礼让鼓励不同司法管辖区的法院相互尊重。

comma.note:
Remember to place a comma between items in a long written list. 记得在书面长清单的项目之间加一个逗号。

A misplaced comma can completely change the meaning of a sentence. 放错位置的逗号可以彻底改变句子的意思。

commencement.note:
Construction work is scheduled for commencement early next month. 建筑工程定于下月初开工。

Proud parents gathered on the lawn to attend the university commencement. 自豪的家长们聚集在草坪上参加大学毕业典礼。

commingle.note:
Sweet and savory flavors commingle nicely in this traditional dish. 甜味和咸味在这道传统菜肴中完美地交融在一起。

Trustees were accused of failing to keep trust funds from commingling with personal assets. 受托人被指控未能阻止信托资金与个人资产混同。

commission.meaning: n. 委员会；佣金；委任 v. 委任；委托制作
commission.note:
The government appointed a special committee to investigate the financial scandal. 政府任命了一个特别委员会来调查这起金融丑闻。

Sales agents earn a basic salary plus a commission on every sale. 销售代理获得基本工资加上每笔销售的佣金。

commit.note:
Both parties agreed to commit to finding a peaceful diplomatic solution. 双方同意致力于找到和平的外交解决方案。

He promised never to commit such a careless mistake again. 他承诺再也不会犯这种粗心的错误了。

committed.meaning: adj. 坚定的；尽心尽力的
committed.note:
She is a deeply committed environmentalist who campaigns for green policies. 她是一位坚定环保主义者，积极争取绿色政策。

The team remained committed to finishing the project before the deadline. 团队依然致力于在截止日期前完成该项目。

commodious.note:
They moved into a commodious apartment overlooking the central park. 他们搬进了一套俯瞰中央公园的宽敞公寓。

The hotel offers commodious suites equipped with modern luxury amenities. 酒店提供配有现代豪华设施的宽敞套房。

commonplace.meaning: adj. 平淡无奇的；司空见惯的 n. 老生常谈
commonplace.note:
Smartphones have become commonplace in almost every household today. 智能手机如今在几乎每个家庭都已司空见惯。

Flying across the world for a vacation is no longer a commonplace novelty. 乘飞机环游世界度假已不再是什么新奇的事了。

commonsense.note:
Applying basic commonsense rules can prevent most kitchen accidents. 运用基本的常识规则可以预防大多数厨房事故。

It is a commonsense approach to a very complex problem. 这是一个针对非常复杂问题的常识性方法。

commonwealth.meaning: n. 共和国；联邦；国民共同体
commonwealth.note:
Several independent nations remain members of the British Commonwealth. 几个独立国家依然是英联邦的成员。

The state constitution establishes the government as a free commonwealth. 该州宪法将政府确立为一个自由的联邦。

commotion.note:
A sudden commotion outside the window distracted the students in class. 窗外突然的一阵骚动分散了班上学生的注意力。

She looked out to see what was causing all the noise and commotion. 她向外看是什么引起了所有的噪音和骚动。

communal.meaning: adj. 公共的；社区的；共有的
communal.note:
Residents shared a large communal kitchen in the apartment building. 居民们在公寓楼里共用一个大型公共厨房。

Community leaders worked hard to maintain peace and communal harmony. 社区领导人努力维护和平与社区和谐。

commune.meaning: v. 亲密交谈；凭直觉交流 n. 公社
commune.note:
She liked to walk alone in the quiet forest to commune with nature. 她喜欢独自在寂静的森林里漫步，以便与大自然亲密交融。

He spent the weekend camping out to peacefully commune with the wilderness. 他周末露营，以便平静地与荒野融为一体。

compact.meaning: adj. 紧凑的；小巧的 n. 协议；小粉盒 v. 压实
compact.note:
The small car's compact design makes it very easy to park in tight spaces. 这辆小汽车紧凑的设计使其非常容易停放在狭窄空间里。

The two nations signed a trade compact to lower tariffs. 两国签署了一项降低关税的贸易协议。

comparison.note:
A careful comparison of the two reports revealed several discrepancies. 对两份报告的仔细比较暴露出几个不一致之处。

There is no comparison between the quality of these two products. 这两种产品的质量根本无法比较。

compartment.meaning: n. 隔间；车厢；分隔的部
compartment.note:
He stored his passport safely in a hidden compartment of his backpack. 他把护照安全地存放在背包的一个隐藏隔间里。

Passengers sat in a comfortable train compartment during the long journey. 漫长的旅途中，乘客们坐在舒适的火车隔间里。

compassionate.meaning: adj. 富有同情心的；慈悲的
compassionate.note:
The doctor was known for his compassionate care toward terminally ill patients. 这位医生以对绝症患者富有同情心的关怀而闻名。

She wrote a compassionate letter to comfort her grieving friend. 她写了一封富有同情心的信来安慰悲痛的朋友。

compatible.meaning: adj. 兼容的；合得来的；相容的
compatible.note:
Make sure the new software is compatible with your computer operating system. 确保新软件与你的计算机操作系统兼容。

They realized after a few months that they were simply not compatible. 几个月后，他们意识到彼此根本合不来。

compatriot.note:
The athlete celebrated his historic victory with fellow compatriots. 这位运动员与同胞们一起庆祝了他历史性的胜利。

Living abroad made him feel a strong bond with any visiting compatriot. 旅居国外使他对任何来访的同胞都感到一种强烈的纽带。

compensatory.note:
The court awarded the injured worker substantial compensatory damages. 法院判给受伤工人巨额的补偿性赔偿金。

She received compensatory time off for working over the weekend. 她因为周末加班而获得了调休补偿。

compete.note:
Athletes from all over the world gathered to compete in the Olympic Games. 来自世界各地的运动员聚集在一起参加奥运会竞争。

Small local shops struggle to compete with large supermarket chains. 本地小商店很难与大型连锁超市竞争。

complacency.note:
Economic success should not lead to complacency among business leaders. 经济上的成功不应导致商业领袖的自满。

Warning signs were ignored due to widespread complacency in the industry. 由于行业内普遍存在的自满情绪，警示信号被忽视了。

complacent.meaning: adj. 自满的；自鸣得意的
complacent.note:
We cannot afford to grow complacent despite our recent achievements. 尽管我们最近取得了成就，但我们不能变得自满。

His complacent attitude towards safety standards worried his colleagues. 他对安全标准的自满态度让同事们感到担忧。

complaisance.note:
Her polite complaisance masked her true feelings of disagreement. 她礼貌的顺从掩盖了她真正的不满情绪。

He expected complete complaisance from his subordinates at all times. 他要求下属在任何时候都绝对顺从。

complaisant.meaning: adj. 顺从的；讨好的；殷勤的
complaisant.note:
She was too complaisant to argue with her demanding boss. 她太顺从来不及与要求苛刻的老板争论。

He tried to win favor by adopting a complaisant and accommodating demeanor. 他试图通过采取顺从和迁就的姿态来赢得好感。

compliant.meaning: adj. 顺从的；遵从的；符合标准的
compliant.note:
The factory must ensure all its products are compliant with safety regulations. 工厂必须确保其所有产品都符合安全法规。

She was a quiet and compliant child who rarely caused trouble. 她是一个安静且听话的孩子，很少惹麻烦。

complicate.note:
Adding more rules to the process will only complicate things further. 在流程中增加更多规则只会使事情变得更加复杂。

Unexpected bad weather began to complicate rescue operations. 突变恶劣的天气开始使救援行动变得复杂。

component.note:
Trust is an essential component of any successful relationship. 信任是任何成功关系中必不可少的成分。

Engineers tested every electronic component before assembling the device. 工程师在组装设备之前测试了每一个电子零件。

aristocracy.note:
The French Revolution marked the decline of the traditional landed aristocracy. 法国大革命标志着传统土地贵族阶层的衰落。

Members of the local aristocracy gathered at the palace for the grand royal ball. 当地贵族的成员聚集在皇宫参加盛大的皇家舞会。

armada.note:
A powerful armada of warships gathered off the coast, preparing for the decisive naval invasion. 一支由战舰组成的强大舰队聚集在海岸附近，为决定性的海上入侵做准备。

The historical failure of the Spanish Armada changed the balance of European naval power. 西班牙无敌舰队的历史性失败改变了欧洲海上力量的平衡。

armistice.note:
Both warring nations agreed to sign a temporary armistice after long peace negotiations. 经过漫长的和平谈判，交战双方同意签署一份临时停战协议。

The military commanders officially ordered a cease-fire upon the declaration of the armistice. 在停战协议生效后，军事指挥官们正式下达了停火指令。

armory.note:
Soldiers retrieved fresh ammunition and heavy weapons directly from the local armory. 士兵们直接从当地军械库调取了新的弹药和重型武器。

The state national guard maintained a fortified armory near the central city border. 州国民警卫队在中央城市边界附近维持着一座加固的军械库。

aromatic.meaning: adj. 芳香的；香气浓郁的
aromatic.note:
The kitchen was filled with the warm, aromatic scent of freshly baked cinnamon bread. 厨房里弥漫着新鲜烘焙的肉桂面包温暖而芳香的气味。

She brewed a hot cup of aromatic herbal tea to relax after work. 下班后，她冲了一杯香气浓郁的热草本茶来放松身心。

arouse.note:
His mysterious and sudden departure aroused deep suspicion among the investigative team. 他神秘而突然的离开引起了调查小组的深层怀疑。

The passionate speech succeeded in arousing public enthusiasm for environmental conservation. 那场充满激情的演讲成功地激发了公众对环境保护的热情。

array.meaning: n. 一系列；阵列; v. 布置；排列
array.note:
The modern electronics store offers a wide array of smart home gadgets for customers. 这家现代电子产品商店为顾客提供了一系列广泛的智能家居小工具。

The solar panels were precisely arrayed across the vast desert landscape to capture sunlight. 太阳能电池板被精准地排列在辽阔的沙漠地形上以捕捉阳光。

arrest.meaning: v. 逮捕；阻止；吸引; n. 逮捕
arrest.note:
Police officers arrived quickly to arrest the prime suspect outside the bank building. 警官们迅速赶到，在银行大楼外逮捕了主要犯罪嫌疑人。

The prompt medical intervention helped arrest the rapid spread of the infectious disease. 及时的医疗干预有助于阻止这种传染病的迅速扩散。

arresting.meaning: adj. 引人注目的；醒目的
arresting.note:
The art gallery featured an arresting portrait that immediately drew every visitor's gaze. 美术馆展出一幅引人注目的肖像画，瞬间吸引了每一位参观者的目光。

She has an arresting beauty that makes her stand out in any crowded room. 她拥有一种醒目的美丽，使她在任何拥挤的房间里都脱颖而出。

arrhythmic.meaning: adj. 无节奏的；心律失常的
arrhythmic.note:
The doctor closely monitored the patient's arrhythmic heart rate during the night. 医生在夜间密切监测病人无节奏的心率。

An erratic and arrhythmic drum beat echoed faintly through the empty rehearsal hall. 一阵断断续续且无节奏的鼓声在空旷的排练厅里隐约回荡。

arrogance.note:
His blatant arrogance alienated many of his hardworking colleagues in the firm. 他明目张胆的傲慢疏远了公司里许多勤奋工作的同事。

Overconfidence and arrogance often lead to catastrophic errors in strategic business planning. 自满和自大往往会导致战略商业规划中的灾难性错误。

arrogant.note:
He came across as extremely arrogant during his interview for the management position. 在应聘管理岗位的面试中，他显得极其傲慢自大。

It was arrogant of him to assume that nobody else understood the complex problem. 他傲慢地假定没有其他人能够理解这个复杂的问题。

arrogate.meaning: v. 冒领；擅自据有；僭越
arrogate.note:
The corrupt official attempted to arrogate power that rightfully belonged to the committee. 那名贪腐官员试图擅自据有本属于委员会的权力。

No branch of government should arrogate to itself the legal authority to rewrite laws. 没有任何政府部门可以僭越法律职权自行修改法律。

arroyo.meaning: n. 干涸的河床；小小溪谷
arroyo.note:
Flash floods can suddenly fill a dry desert arroyo with raging muddy water. 突发的洪水会突然用汹涌的泥水填满干燥的沙漠河床。

We hiked along the rocky arroyo until we reached the foot of the mountain range. 我们沿着多石的干河床徒步，直到到达山脉脚下。

arsenal.meaning: n. 兵工厂；武器库；资源库
arsenal.note:
The country maintained a vast military arsenal to deter potential foreign threats. 该国维持着庞大的军事武器库，以威慑潜在的外来威胁。

A skilled negotiator keeps an impressive arsenal of persuasive techniques ready. 一名有经验的谈判专家随时准备着丰富的说服技巧库。

arson.note:
Fire investigators determined that the warehouse blaze was a deliberate act of arson. 火灾调查人员认定，仓库的大火是一起蓄意纵火案。

He was arrested on charges of aggravated arson after burning down the building. 在烧毁那栋建筑物后，他因加重纵火罪被捕。

artery.note:
Fatty deposits can clog an artery, significantly increasing the risk of heart disease. 脂肪沉积物会堵塞动脉，显著增加患心脏病的风险。

The busy highway serves as the main traffic artery connecting the two major cities. 这条繁忙的公路是连接这两座大城市的主要交通干线。

arthritis.note:
Elderly people often suffer from severe joint pain caused by chronic arthritis. 老年人经常承受由慢性关节炎引起的严重关节疼痛。

Gentle daily exercise can help relieve stiffness associated with knee arthritis. 适度的每日锻炼有助于缓解与膝关节炎相关的僵硬。

artifact.meaning: n. 手工艺品；人工制品；文物
artifact.note:
Museum curators carefully preserved the delicate ancient artifact for exhibition. 博物馆馆长仔细保存了这个精致的古代文物用于展览。

Archaeologists excavated a unique ceramic artifact dating back thousands of years. 考古学家挖掘出了一件追溯至数千年前的独特陶瓷人工制品。

artifacts.meaning: n. 文物；手工艺品 (artifact的复数形式/常用复数)
artifacts.note:
The historical exhibition displays golden artifacts recovered from royal tombs. 历史展览展示了从皇家陵墓中收复的黄金文物。

Researchers cataloged thousands of stone artifacts discovered during the dig. 研究人员登记了挖掘期间发现的数千件石器手工艺品。

artifice.note:
The politician used clever verbal artifice to evade answering direct questions. 那位政治家使用了巧妙的言语诡计来规避直接回答问题。

Her warm manner was merely an artifice designed to gain the trust of clients. 她温和的态度仅仅是为了赢得客户信任而设计的伪装。

artificial.meaning: adj. 人工的；人造的；矫揉造作的
artificial.note:
The indoor sports field is covered with low-maintenance artificial grass. 室内体育场铺满了低维护成本的人造草坪。

She greeted her rivals with an artificial smile that lacked genuine warmth. 她用矫揉造作且缺乏真正热情的微笑向竞争对手打招呼。

artistry.meaning: n. 艺术技巧；艺术效果
artistry.note:
The master carpenter demonstrated remarkable artistry in hand-carving the wooden door. 这位大师级木工在手工雕刻这扇木门时展示出了非凡的艺术技巧。

Audiences were mesmerized by the emotional depth and technical artistry of the violinist. 观众被小提琴家情感的深度和技术上的艺术效果所打动。

ascendancy.note:
The technological giant gradually gained political and market ascendancy across Europe. 这家科技巨头在欧洲逐渐取得了政治和市场上的支配地位。

During his reign, the empire achieved cultural ascendancy over neighboring states. 在他在位期间，帝国取得了超越邻国的文化优势。

ascetic.meaning: adj. 苦行的；禁欲的; n. 苦行者
ascetic.note:
The monk chose an ascetic lifestyle of extreme simplicity in the mountain monastery. 这位僧人在高山寺院里选择了极简的苦行生活方式。

As a devoted ascetic, he renounced all material possessions and worldly pleasures. 作为一名虔诚的苦行者，他放弃了一切物质财产和尘世享乐。

ascribe.note:
Scientists ascribe the recent increase in extreme weather to global warming. 科学家们将最近极端的天气增加归因于全球变暖。

She prefers to ascribe her academic success to hard work rather than pure talent. 她更愿意将自己的学术成功归功于努力工作，而不是纯粹的天赋。

aseptic.note:
Surgeons must strictly maintain an aseptic environment inside the operating room. 外科医生必须在手术室内严格维持无菌环境。

The modern office building was decorated in a cold, aseptic minimalist style. 这栋现代办公楼装饰有一种冷冰冰、无情感的极简主义风格。

aspect.note:
We must consider every single financial aspect of the deal before signing. 在签署之前，我们必须考虑该交易的每一个财务方面。

The house enjoys a southern aspect that allows plenty of natural light inside. 这座房子朝向南方，能够让充足的自然光线进入室内。

aspen.note:
The golden leaves of the aspen trees fluttered softly in the autumn wind. 颤杨树金黄色的树叶在秋风中轻轻颤动。

They hiked through a dense forest of tall aspen and pine trees. 他们徒步穿过一片由高大的杨树和松树组成的密林。

asperity.note:
The manager spoke with unusual asperity when addressing the repeated errors. 经理在指出重复出现的错误时语气异常粗暴。

Early pioneers survived the severe weather and harsh asperity of wilderness life. 早期拓荒者在恶劣的天气和荒野生活的严酷环境中生存了下来。

aspersion.note:
He cast cruel aspersions on his rival's integrity during the heated debate. 在激烈的辩论中，他对其竞争对手的正直进行了残酷的诽谤。

She refused to tolerate any unfair aspersion cast upon her professional team. 她拒绝忍受对她专业团队的任何不公正中伤。

asphyxiate.note:
Toxic smoke from the burning chemical factory threatened to asphyxiate trapped workers. 来自燃烧化学工厂的有毒浓烟威胁要使困住的工人窒息。

Safety helmets prevent workers from being asphyxiated by carbon monoxide gas. 安全头盔可防止工人因一氧化碳气体而窒息。

aspirant.meaning: n. 有抱负的人；野心家; adj. 有抱负的
aspirant.note:
The young political aspirant campaigned tirelessly to win a city council seat. 那位年轻有抱负的政治人士不知疲倦地竞选，以争取市议会的席位。

Thousands of high school aspirants competed for limited university admissions. 数千名有抱负的高中毕业生竞争有限的大学录取名额。

assail.note:
The enemy forces launched a surprise missile strike to assail the border base. 敌军发动突袭导弹打击以攻击边境基地。

He was assailed by nagging doubts about whether he made the right decision. 他被关于自己是否做出了正确决定的不断产生的疑虑所困扰。

assay.meaning: v. 化验；分析；测试; n. 化验
assay.note:
Chemists conducted precise experiments to assay the purity of the gold sample. 化学家做精确的实验以化验金样本的纯度。

The lab report confirmed the detailed chemical assay of the water quality. 实验室报告确认了对水质做出的详细化学分析。

assent.meaning: n. 同意；赞成; v. 同意
assent.note:
The president gave official Royal Assent to the newly passed healthcare law. 总统对新通过的医疗法案给予了官方的正式批准同意。

She nodded her head in silent assent after listening to his persuasive speech. 听完他富有说服力的演讲后，她静静地点头表示赞成。

assertiveness.note:
Confidence and calm assertiveness are key qualities needed for effective management. 自信和平静的果断是有效管理所需的核心品质。

The training workshop helps quiet employees build professional workplace assertiveness. 培训工作坊帮助性格安静的员工建立职业上的自我主张能力。

assess.note:
Experts were hired to accurately assess the environmental damage caused by oil. 专家被聘用来准确评估由石油造成的环境破坏。

Teachers regularly assess student academic progress through projects and tests. 教师定期通过项目和测试评估学生的学术进步。

asset.meaning: n. 资产；有价值的人/物
asset.note:
The company decided to sell off its non-core physical assets to pay debt. 公司决定卖掉其非核心实物资产以偿还债务。

Her fluency in three international languages makes her a huge asset to our firm. 她精通三门国际语言，这使她成为我们公司的一大财富。

associate.meaning: v. 关联；交往; n. 同事；伙伴; adj. 副的
associate.note:
Most people associate hot summer days with refreshing cold drinks and ice cream. 大多数人将炎热的夏日与爽口冷饮及冰淇淋联系在一起。

He worked closely with his senior business associates to expand foreign trade. 他与他的资深商业伙伴密切合作以扩大对外贸易。

She was recently promoted to associate professor in the science department. 她最近被晋升为理学院的副教授。

assorted.meaning: adj. 什锦的；各种各样的
assorted.note:
She bought a colorful box of assorted chocolates for the holiday party. 她为节日派对买了一盒五彩缤纷的什锦巧克力。

The drawer contained an assorted collection of old keys, screws, and tools. 抽屉里装着各种各样的旧钥匙、螺丝和工具。

assume.note:
It is unwise to assume that everyone agrees with your financial viewpoint. 假定所有人都同意你的财务观点是不明智的。

The new CEO will officially assume full responsibility for corporate strategy next week. 新任首席执行官将于下周正式承担起公司战略的全部责任。

assured.meaning: adj. 确信的；自信的；有保证的
assured.note:
He spoke in a calm, assured tone that immediately put the nervous audience at ease. 他以平静自信的语气演讲，立刻让紧张的观众放松下来。

You can rest assured that your private personal data is stored securely. 你可以确信你的私密个人数据得到了安全的存储。

asterisk.meaning: n. 星号(*); v. 加星号于
asterisk.note:
An asterisk was placed next to the technical term to indicate a footnote below. 技术术语旁边标有一个星号，以指示下方的脚注。

Please asterisk any required items on the application form before submitting. 请在提交前在申请表上的任何必填项旁加注星号。

asteroid.note:
Scientists tracked the dangerous trajectory of a large rocky asteroid near Earth. 科学家追踪了地球附近一颗大型岩石小行星的危险轨道。

Many scientists believe a massive asteroid impact caused the extinction of dinosaurs. 许多科学家认为，一次巨大的小行星撞击导致了恐龙的灭绝。

astound.meaning: v. 使震惊；使大吃一惊
astound.note:
The young magician's unbelievable tricks never fail to astound the audience. 那位年轻魔术师不可思议的魔术总是能让观众大吃一惊。

The rapid economic growth of the developing nation continued to astound experts. 这个发展中国家快速的经济增长继续使专家们感到震惊。

astray.note:
The hikers went completely astray in the thick mountain fog without a compass. 在没有指南针的情况下，徒步者们在浓密的山雾中完全迷路了。

Bad peer pressure can lead vulnerable young teenagers astray into crime. 不良的同伴压力可能会引诱脆弱的年轻青少年偏离正道走向犯罪。

astringent.meaning: adj. 止血的；收敛的；严厉的; n. 收敛剂
astringent.note:
She applied a cooling astringent lotion to cleanse her face skin. 她涂抹了一种凉爽的收敛水来清洁面部皮肤。

The movie critic was notorious for her sharp and astringent analytical reviews. 那位电影评论家因其尖酸严厉的分析性评论而闻名。

astrolabe.meaning: n. 星盘 (古代测天体高度的仪器)
astrolabe.note:
Ancient sailors used a brass astrolabe to navigate open seas by measuring stars. 古代水手使用黄铜星盘通过测量恒星在开阔的海域航行。

The museum displayed a rare medieval astrolabe crafted by Arab scholars. 博物馆展出了一件由阿拉伯学者制作的罕见中世纪星盘。

astrology.note:
Many people read daily horoscope entries based on Western astrology for fun. 许多人为了好玩阅读基于西洋占星术的每日运势。

Unlike modern astronomy, astrology is not considered a valid empirical science. 与现代天文学不同，占星术不被视为一种有效的实证科学。

astronomical.meaning: adj. 天文学的；极大的；天文数字的
astronomical.note:
Researchers used specialized telescopes to record detailed astronomical observations. 研究人员使用专门的望远镜记录详细的天文学观测数据。

The cost of building the new international sports stadium was truly astronomical. 建设这座新的国际体育场的成本简直是天文数字。

asunder.note:
The powerful explosion tore the heavy iron barrier completely asunder. 剧烈的爆炸将沉重的铁障碍物彻底撕裂成碎片。

Political conflicts tore the once-united ancient empire asunder into warring states. 政治冲突将曾经统一的古老帝国撕裂成割据交战的政权。

atonal.note:
The modern classical composer experiment with harsh, atonal musical structures. 现代古典作曲家尝试使用刺耳的无调性音乐结构。

Some listeners find atonal orchestral music difficult to enjoy relaxed. 一些听众觉得很难轻松享受无调性管弦乐。

atrocious.note:
The terrible outdoor weather during our coastal vacation was absolutely atrocious. 我们沿海度假期间恶劣的户外天气简直极坏透顶。

The dictator was universally condemned for committing atrocious war crimes. 该独裁者因犯下残暴的战争罪行而受到普遍谴责。

atrophy.meaning: v./n. (肌肉/器官) 萎缩；衰退
atrophy.note:
Muscles can quickly atrophy if a leg is kept immobilised inside a plaster cast. 如果腿部固定在石膏里，肌肉会迅速萎缩。

Lack of intellectual challenge can cause analytical critical thinking to atrophy. 缺乏智力挑战会导致分析批判性思维衰退。

attach.note:
Please remember to attach your updated resume before sending the email. 请记得在发送电子邮件前附上你更新的简历。

They attached a small wooden trailer to the back of their family car. 他们在自家汽车后部连接了一辆小型木制拖车。

attenuate.note:
Special soundproofing foam panels were installed to attenuate noisy sounds. 安装了特殊的隔音泡沫板以减弱喧闹的声音。

Distance and bad terrain tend to attenuate radio wireless signals over time. 距离和恶劣的地形往往会随着时间削弱无线电无线信号。

attest.note:
Numerous historical documents attest to the existence of the ancient city. 众多历史文献证实了那座古城的存在。

Her high performance evaluations attest to her incredible professional dedication. 她高水平的绩效评估证明了她非凡的职业敬业精神。

attic.note:
They stored dusty old cardboard boxes of family photo albums up in the attic. 他们把装有家庭相册的尘封旧纸箱储存在阁楼上。

The cozy wooden attic room was converted into a quiet study space. 那间舒适的木制阁楼房间被改造成了一个安静的学习空间。

attorney.note:
He hired an experienced defense attorney to represent him in court. 他聘请了一位有经验的辩护律师代表他在法庭出庭。

The corporate attorney reviewed the joint venture agreement line by line. 这位公司代理律师逐行审查了合资企业协议。

attune.meaning: v. 使协调；使适应；调音
attune.note:
Successful leaders must attune themselves carefully to changing market needs. 成功的领导者必须使自己仔细适应变化的市场需求。

Her ears were finely attuned to subtle changes in musical pitch. 她的耳朵能极其协调地分辨出音乐音调的微小变化。

audience.note:
The entire concert audience stood up and applauded for the talented performer. 全场音乐会观众全体起立为有才华的表演者鼓掌。

The new television documentary is specially designed for a younger audience. 这部新电视纪录片是专门为更年轻的受众设计的。

auditorium.note:
The annual graduation ceremony was held in the university's main auditorium. 年度毕业典礼在该大学的主礼堂举行。

The acoustic design of the modern auditorium ensured crystal-clear sound quality. 现代礼堂的声学设计确保了无比清晰的音质。

augment.note:
He works a part-time night job to augment his monthly family income. 他做一份兼职夜班工作以增加他的每月家庭收入。

The strategic plan aims to augment production capacity over the next two years. 该战略计划旨在在未来两年内扩大生产能力。

augur.meaning: v. 预兆；预告; n. 预言家
augur.note:
The strong early economic figures augur well for the country's financial future. 强劲的早期经济数据为该国未来的财务状况预示了良好的征兆。

Ancient Romans believed that sudden bird flights could augur major events. 古罗马人相信鸟类的突然飞行可以预示重大事件。

augury.note:
Many superstitious sailors viewed the sudden storm as a dark augury. 许多迷信的水手将突如其来的暴风雨视为阴暗的凶兆。

The successful test flight provided a favorable augury for the new space project. 成功的试飞为新的航天项目提供了有利的征兆。

auspices.meaning: n. 赞助；保护；主办 (常用 under the auspices of)
auspices.note:
The international peace conference was held under the auspices of the UN. 该国际和平会议是在联合国的赞助和支持下举办的。

Research was conducted under the auspices of a renowned medical foundation. 研究是在一家知名医学基金会的主办下进行的。

auspicious.note:
Bright sunny weather provided an auspicious start to their outdoor wedding ceremony. 晴朗明媚的天气为其户外婚礼仪式提供了一个吉利的开端。

The signing of the agreement marked an auspicious moment for bilateral trade. 协议的签署标志着双边贸易的一个幸运时刻。

austerity.meaning: n. 严厉；简朴；(经济)紧缩
austerity.note:
The government introduced strict economic austerity measures to reduce public debt. 政府推出了严格的经济紧缩措施以减少公共债务。

He lived a life of extreme austerity in a secluded mountain cabin. 他在一间隐蔽的山区小屋里过着极度简朴的生活。

authenticity.note:
Art experts conducted thorough lab tests to verify the authenticity of the painting. 艺术专家进行了彻底的实验室测试以验证这幅画的真实性。

The historian questioned the historical authenticity of the newly discovered document. 历史学家对新发现文献的历史可靠性提出了质疑。

authoritarian.meaning: adj. 独裁的；威权主义的; n. 独裁者
authoritarian.note:
Citizens protested courageously against the harsh laws imposed by the authoritarian regime. 公民们勇敢地抗议威权政权强加的严酷法律。

His rigid authoritarian management style alienated young office staff. 他刻板独裁的管理风格疏远了办公室的年轻员工。

authorization.note:
You must obtain written official authorization before accessing sensitive financial files. 在调阅敏感财务文件之前，你必须获得书面的官方授权。

The project manager gave final authorization to begin construction next week. 项目经理对下周开工建设给予了最终批准。

autobiography.note:
The retired general spent three years writing his detailed autobiography. 这位退役将军花了三年时间撰写他详细的自传。

Her inspiring autobiography instantly became a bestselling book nationwide. 她鼓舞人心的自传瞬间成为了全国畅销书。

autocracy.meaning: n. 专制政治；独裁统治
autocracy.note:
The country suffered under a harsh military autocracy for over three decades. 该国在严酷的军事专制统治下遭受了三十多年的苦难。

The movement sought to transition the state from autocracy to democracy. 该运动旨在促使国家从独裁统治过渡到民主体制。

autocrat.note:
The ruthless autocrat suppressed all opposing political parties and independent media. 那位残酷的独裁者镇压了所有反对党和独立媒体。

He ruled the large empire as an absolute autocrat without any parliament control. 他作为一个绝对的专制君主统治着庞大的帝国，不受任何议会控制。

available.note:
Tickets for the evening theatre show are still available to purchase online. 今晚戏剧表演的门票仍可在网上购买获得。

Is the manager available right now to meet with important international clients? 经理现在有空会见重要的国际客户吗？

avalanche.meaning: n. 雪崩；铺天盖地而来之物; v. 崩塌
avalanche.note:
A sudden winter avalanche swept down the steep mountain slope, blocking the road. 一场突发的冬日雪崩从陡峭的山坡冲下，封锁了道路。

The customer service center received an avalanche of angry complaints morning. 客服中心早晨收到了铺天盖地而来的愤怒投诉。

avant.meaning: adj. 前卫的 (常构成 avant-garde)
avant.note:
The museum featured an exciting exhibition of avant film and art design. 博物馆推出了一个展出前卫电影和艺术设计的精彩展览。

Her bold avant fashion clothing design shocked conservative industry critics. 她大胆前卫的时装服装设计震惊了保守的行业评论家。

avarice.note:
His unquenchable avarice eventually led him to commit serious corporate fraud. 他无法抑制的贪婪最终导致他犯下了严重的 corporate 欺诈罪。

The classic novel warns readers about the destructive nature of pure avarice. 这本经典小说警告读者注意纯粹贪婪的破坏本质。

avaricious.note:
The avaricious landlord raised rent prices excessively during the housing shortage. 那个贪婪的房东在房屋短缺期间过分提高了租金价格。

He was known as an avaricious investor who cared only about immediate profit. 他被已知为一个只关心眼前利益的贪婪投资者。

avenge.note:
The young prince swore an oath to avenge his father's tragic death. 那位年轻的王子立誓要为他父亲的惨死报仇。

He sought legal action to avenge the grave injustice done to his family. 他寻求法律行动以替对他家庭做出的严重不公报仇。

aver.note:
The witness continued to aver that she had seen the defendant at the crime scene. 证人继续断言她在犯罪现场看到了被告。

Scientists aver that the new medicine will yield significant clinical results. 科学家们坚称这种新药将产生显著的临床效果。

averse.note:
Conservative investors are usually risk-averse when market volatility is high. 在市场波动较大时，保守型投资者通常是反对风险的。

He is not at all averse to hard physical work despite his senior age. 尽管年事已高，但他一点也不不情愿做沉重的体力活。

aversion.note:
She has a strong natural aversion to spiders and avoids insect displays. 她对蜘蛛有着强烈的天然厌恶，并避开昆虫展。

His deep aversion to public speaking made presentations a nerve-wracking chore. 他对公开演讲的深刻反感使得做演示成为一项令人崩溃的苦差事。

avert.note:
Prompt emergency measures helped avert a potential nuclear disaster at the plant. 迅速的紧急措施有助于避免该工厂潜在的核灾难。

She quickly averted her eyes when he turned to look directly at her. 当他转过头直接看她时，她迅速转移了视线。

aviary.note:
The local city botanical park features a large walk-in aviary for tropical birds. 当地的城市植物公园有一个可子供游人走入的大型热带鸟舍。

Rare exotic parrots fly freely inside the spacious glass-domed aviary. 罕见的异域鹦鹉在宽敞的玻璃穹顶鸟笼里自由飞翔。

avid.note:
She is an avid reader who reads at least two classic novels every week. 她是一位狂热的读者，每周至少读两本经典小说。

He has been an avid collector of rare postage stamps since childhood. 自童年起，他就一直是一位热心的稀有邮票收集者。

avoid.note:
Drivers should take alternative routes to avoid the heavy highway traffic. 司机们应该采取替代路线，以避开高速公路拥堵的交通。

She tried to avoid answering delicate personal questions during the interview. 她试图在面试期间避免回答微妙的个人问题。

avow.note:
He decided to publicly avow his commitment to environmental conservation. 他决定公开声明自己对环境保护的承诺。

The politician refused to avow any personal connection with the company. 那位政治家拒绝公开承认与该公司有任何个人联系。

awe.meaning: n. 敬畏；惊叹; v. 使敬畏
awe.note:
The majestic high waterfall inspired a deep sense of awe among tourists. 雄伟的高瀑布激发了游客们深刻的敬畏感。

The sheer scale and beauty of the grand mountain range awed the hikers. 雄伟山脉的巨大规模和美丽使徒步者们感到敬畏。

awkward.meaning: adj. 笨拙的；尴尬的；难处理的
awkward.note:
There was an awkward silence in the room after his improper comment. 在他发表了不恰当的言论后，房间里陷入了尴尬的沉默。

The heavy wooden table has an awkward shape that makes moving it difficult. 这张重木桌有着难处理的形状，使得搬运它非常困难。

awl.note:
The leather craftsman used a sharp iron awl to punch holes in the belt. 皮革手艺人使用一把锋利的铁锥子在皮带上打孔。

An awl is an essential tool in traditional shoe repair workshops. 锥子是传统修鞋工作坊中不可或缺的工具。

awning.note:
They sat under the canvas store awning to stay dry during the rain. 他们坐在画布店面遮阳篷下，以在下雨时保持干燥。

The cafe extended its striped outdoor awning to shield guests from hot sun. 咖啡馆展开了条纹户外雨篷，以保护客人免受烈日晒。

axiom.note:
In traditional Euclidean geometry, a line is defined based on fundamental axioms. 在传统欧几里得几何学中，直线是根据基本公理来定义的。

'Practice makes perfect' is a widely accepted educational axiom. “熟能生巧”是一句被广泛接受的教育格言。

axis.note:
The planet Earth rotates around its imaginary polar axis once every 24 hours. 地球每24小时围绕其虚构的极轴自转一次。

The vertical axis of the line graph represents total annual profit sales. 折线图的纵轴代表年度总利润销售额。

axle.note:
The heavy rear axle of the industrial truck snapped under extreme load. 工业卡车沉重的后车轴在极重载荷下断裂了。

Mechanics inspected the wheel axle carefully to ensure vehicle road safety. 机械师仔细检查了车轮轴，以确保车辆的行车安全。

babble.meaning: v. 咕哝；含糊不清地说；发流水潺潺声; n. 胡言乱语；流水声
babble.note:
The little baby began to babble happily while playing with colorful blocks. 这个小婴儿在玩彩色积木时开始开心地下咕哝。

We sat by the shallow brook, listening to the gentle babble of water. 我们坐在浅浅的小溪边，倾听着温和的流水潺潺声。

backhanded.meaning: adj. 反手击球的；讽刺的；间接的
backhanded.note:
He struck a powerful backhanded shot across the net to win the tennis point. 他在网前打出一个强有力的反手击球得分，赢得了网球比分。

She gave him a backhanded compliment that sounded more like a insult. 她给了他一个听起来更像侮辱的讽刺赞扬。

backset.note:
The sudden economic crisis was a major backset for the startup company. 突发的经济危机是这家初创公司面临的重大挫折。

The political backset hindered progress toward regional peace negotiations. 政治上的倒退阻碍了地区和平谈判的进展。

bacteria.note:
Antibiotics are powerful medical drugs used to kill harmful bacteria in the body. 抗生素是用于杀死体内有害细菌的强效药物。

Some beneficial bacteria play an important role in human gut digestion. 一些有益细菌在人类肠道消化中发挥着重要作用。

bacterium.note:
The scientist observed a single microscopic bacterium under the lens. 科学家在镜头下观察到了单个微小的细菌。

A specific type of dangerous bacterium was detected in the water sample. 在水样中检测出了一种特定类型的危险细菌。

badge.note:
The police officer proudly displayed his silver official security badge. 警官自豪地展示了他的银色官方安保徽章。

All security personnel must wear an identification badge at the entrance. 所有安保人员在入口处必须佩戴身份标记牌。

badger.meaning: n. 獾; v. 纠缠；不断烦扰
badger.note:
A wild badger dug a deep underground burrow in the forest clearing. 一只野生獾在森林空地上挖了一个深地下洞穴。

The persistent reporters continued to badger the mayor with sharp questions. 执着的记者们继续用尖锐的问题纠缠市长。

badinage.note:
Their witty party badinage amused everyone sitting around the dinner table. 他们在派对上机智的打趣逗乐了坐在餐桌旁的所有人。

Beneath their light badinage, there was a quiet underlying competitive tension. 在他们轻松的开玩笑背后，隐藏着一种暗中的竞争紧张感。

bait.meaning: n. 饵；诱饵; v. 引诱；激怒
bait.note:
The fisherman placed a wriggling worm on the hook as fresh fish bait. 钓鱼人把一条蠕动的虫子放在钩上作为新鲜鱼饵。

Do not let their provocative words bait you into an unnecessary argument. 不要让他们的挑衅言语引诱你陷入不必要的争吵。

bale.meaning: n. 大包；大捆 (如草料/棉花); v. 打包
bale.note:
Farmers stacked heavy bales of hay inside the dry barn for winter. 农夫们把沉重的干草大捆堆放在干燥的农舍里过冬。

The machine compresses dry waste paper into a neat bale for recycling. 这台机器将干燥的废纸压缩成整齐的大包以便回收。

baleful.meaning: adj. 凶恶的；恶意的；有害的
baleful.note:
The villain shot a baleful look across the room at his bitter opponent. 那名恶棍向房间对面的宿敌投去凶恶的目光。

Rumors can exert a baleful influence on public calm during crisis times. 在危机时期，谣言会对公众平静产生有害的影响。

balk.meaning: v. 犹豫；畏缩；阻碍 (也可拼作 baulk)
balk.note:
Investors may balk at the high financial cost of the proposed expansion. 投资者可能会对拟议扩张计划的高昂财务成本感到犹豫。

The horse balked right before the high wooden fence, refusing to jump. 那匹马在大高木栅栏前畏缩了，拒绝跳过去。

ballad.note:
The musician performed a romantic acoustic ballad on his classic guitar. 那位音乐人用他的古典吉他弹唱了一首浪漫的抒情叙事歌。

Ancient traditional ballads pass down stories of legendary heroes over time. 古老的传统民歌随着时间传承着传奇英雄的故事。

ballast.meaning: n. 压载物；镇流器；石渣
ballast.note:
The cargo ship took on extra sea water as heavy ballast for stability. 货船吸入了额外的海水作为沉重的压载物以保持稳定。

Crushed stone ballast is laid beneath railway tracks to support heavy trains. 碎石石渣铺在铁轨下方，以支撑沉重的火车。

ballerina.note:
