The graceful ballerina performed a stunning solo leap across the stage. 那位优雅的芭蕾舞女演员在舞台上做出了令人惊叹的单人跳跃。

She dreamed of becoming a principal ballerina in a famous dance company. 她梦想着成为一家著名舞蹈团的首席芭蕾舞女演员。

balm.note:
She applied a soothing lip balm to protect her lips from dry wind. 她涂抹了抚慰性的润唇香膏，以保护嘴唇不受干风伤害。

His kind and compassionate words were a soothing balm to her grief. 他亲切而富有同情心的话语是对她悲伤的抚慰。

balmy.note:
They took a long peaceful stroll in the balmy evening air by the ocean. 他们在大洋边宜人的晚风中长途散步。

A balmy spring breeze blew gently through the wide open bedroom windows. 一阵温和的春风轻轻吹过大开的卧室窗户。

ban.meaning: v. 禁止; n. 禁令
ban.note:
The city council voted to ban plastic bags in all local supermarkets. 市议会投票决定在所有当地超市禁止使用塑料袋。

The government placed a strict international travel ban during the epidemic. 政府在疫情期间颁布了严格的国际旅行禁令。

banal.note:
The movie plot was so banal and predictable that many viewers left early. 那部电影的剧情是如此陈腐和平庸，以至于许多观众提前离开了。

He avoided small talk, finding conversational weather topics painfully banal. 他避开闲聊，觉得关于天气的交谈话题平庸得让人难受。

bane.note:
Persistent traffic congestion has long been the bane of city commuters. 持续的交通拥堵长期以来一直是城市通勤者的祸根。

Heavy weeds are the constant bane of any hardworking organic gardener. 繁茂的杂草是任何勤劳的有机园丁的持续祸害。

banish.note:
The ancient king decided to banish the rebellious traitor from the realm. 古代国王决定将叛乱的叛徒驱逐出国境。

She tried to banish negative thoughts from her mind before the speech. 在演讲前，她试图从脑海中消除消极的想法。

banister.note:
Hold on securely to the wooden banister while walking down the stairs. 走下楼梯时，请紧紧抓住木制楼梯扶手。

The grand vintage staircase featured a hand-carved mahogany banister. 那座盛大的复古楼梯有着手工雕刻的红木扶手。

banquet.note:
A lavish victory banquet was held to honor the champions of the tournament. 举办了一场奢华的胜利宴会，以表彰锦标赛的冠军。

Guests enjoyed a seven-course gourmet banquet inside the grand hotel hall. 客人们在大酒店大堂内享受了七道菜的调性美食盛宴。

banter.meaning: n. 打趣；无伤大雅的玩笑; v. 幽默打趣
banter.note:
The close colleagues exchanged friendly banter while working in the office. 亲密的同事们在办公室工作时交换着友好的打趣。

They banter good-naturedly with each other during their daily morning breaks. 他们在每天的早休期间愉快地互相打趣。

bar.meaning: n. 酒吧；条/块；障碍; v. 阻拦
bar.note:
He bought a sweet bar of dark chocolate from the corner store. 他从街角商店买了一块甜甜的黑巧克力。

Heavy security guards were stationed to bar entry to unauthorized visitors. 部署了重重安保人员，以阻拦未授权的访客进入。

barb.meaning: n. 倒钩；倒刺；挖苦的话
barb.note:
The fishing hook has a sharp barb that prevents the fish from escaping. 钓鱼钩有一个锋利的倒钩，可防止鱼逃脱。

His humorous speech contained a subtle barb aimed at his chief political rival. 他幽默的演讲包含了一句针对主要政治对手的微妙挖苦。

barbarous.note:
The invading army committed barbarous acts against innocent civilian populations. 入侵的军队对无辜平民犯下了野蛮的行径。

Treating prisoners without basic human rights is considered utterly barbarous. 不给予基本人权地对待囚犯被认为是极其残暴的。

barbecue.meaning: n. 烧烤；烤肉架; v. 烧烤
barbecue.note:
We hosted a summer backyard barbecue with friends and close neighbors. 我们和朋友以及邻居们在夏天举办了后院烧烤。

He grilled fresh steak and sausages on the charcoal barbecue outside. 他在室外的木炭烤肉架上烤了新鲜的牛排和香肠。

bard.meaning: n. 吟游诗人；诗人 (常特指莎士比亚)
bard.note:
William Shakespeare is universally known as the great Bard of Avon. 威廉·莎士比亚被世人公认为埃文河畔的伟大家吟游诗人。

The ancient celtic bard sang heroic epics of legendary battles to villagers. 古老的凯尔特吟游诗人向村民们吟唱传奇战役的英雄史诗。

barefaced.meaning: adj. 厚颜无耻的；露骨的
barefaced.note:
He told a barefaced lie to the court despite strong evidence against him. 尽管有不利于他的确凿证据，他依然向法庭说了厚颜无耻的谎言。

Her barefaced disrespect towards the authority shocked everyone present. 她对权威露骨的不尊重震惊了在场的每一个人。

bargain.meaning: n. 便宜货；协议; v. 讨价还价
bargain.note:
She bought a vintage leather jacket at the market for a real bargain. 她在市场上以真正的便宜货价格买了一件复古皮革夹克。

Shoppers love to bargain with local vendors over the price of fresh fruit. 购物者喜欢与当地摊贩就新鲜水果的价格讨价还价。

bark.meaning: v. 狗吠；厉声说话; n. 树皮；吠声
bark.note:
The neighbor's dog began to bark loudly at the passing mail delivery truck. 邻居的狗开始对着路过的邮递卡车大声狗吠。

The outer bark of the ancient oak tree was rough and covered in moss. 这棵古老橡树的外层树皮很粗糙，上面长满了苔藓。

barn.note:
The farmer stored dried golden hay inside the spacious wooden barn. 农夫把干燥的金黄干草储存在宽敞的木制谷仓里。

A family of owls built their nest under the rafters of the old red barn. 一窝猫头鹰在老红农舍的椽子下建了巢。

baroque.meaning: adj. 巴洛克式的；过分雕琢的
baroque.note:
The European palace was decorated in an ornate and grand baroque style. 这座欧洲宫殿装饰着华丽而宏大的巴洛克风格。

Critics disliked his writing style, calling it excessively baroque and heavy. 评论家们不喜欢他的写作风格，称其过分雕琢且笨重。

barrage.meaning: n. 连珠炮似的指责/提问；弹幕；拦河坝
barrage.note:
The politician faced a barrage of tough questions from hostile reporters. 那位政治家面临着来自敌意记者们连珠炮似的一连串艰难提问。

Artillery units launched a heavy barrage to cover the advancing troops. 炮兵部队发动了密集的弹幕射击，以掩护推进的部队。

barricade.meaning: n. 路障；街垒; v. 设路障挡住
barricade.note:
Protesters constructed a heavy barricade using overturned vehicles in the street. 抗议者在街上利用翻倒的车辆构筑了沉重的路障。

The police barricaded the main avenues surrounding the government building. 警察设立路障封锁了政府大楼周围的主要大街。

barrier.note:
Language differences can sometimes act as a barrier to global trade. 语言差异有时会成为全球贸易的障碍。

Security personnel set up a metal safety barrier around the stage area. 安保人员在舞台区域周围设立了金属安全屏障。

bask.meaning: n. 晒太阳；取暖；沉溺于
bask.note:
Lizards love to bask on warm flat rocks under the afternoon sunshine. 蜥蜴喜欢在下午的阳光下晒在温暖的平石上取暖。

The victorious team spent the weekend basking in the glory of their win. 获胜的团队在整个周末都沉溺于胜利的光彩之中。

baste.meaning: v. (烤肉时)淋油/汁；粗缝；严厉责骂
baste.note:
Baste the roasting turkey with pan juices every thirty minutes for moisture. 每三十分钟用盘里的肉汁淋一次烤火鸡，以保持湿润。

The tailor basted the suit sleeves temporarily before final machine sewing. 裁缝在最终机器缝合前临时粗缝了西装袖子。

batch.meaning: n. 一批；一组; v. 分批处理
batch.note:
She baked a fresh batch of chocolate chip cookies for her guests. 她为客人烘焙了一批新鲜的巧克力碎饼干。

The computer program processes customer orders in a single night batch. 计算机程序在夜间集中分批处理客户订单。

bathetic.meaning: adj. 假作多情的；突降的；落俗套的
bathetic.note:
The novel's dramatic climax collapsed into a disappointing and bathetic ending. 这部小说的戏剧性高潮陷入了一个令人失望且假作多情的落俗套结局。

Critics dismissed the tragic play as bathetic melodrama lacking real depth. 评论家们认为这部悲剧是一部缺乏真正深度的假作多情的通俗剧。

baton.meaning: n. 指挥棒；接力棒；警棍
baton.note:
The conductor raised his wooden baton to signal the orchestra to start. 指挥举起他的木制指挥棒，示意管弦乐队开始演奏。

The runner passed the silver metal baton cleanly to her teammate. 跑步者干净利落地将银色金属接力棒交给了她的队友。

battalion.note:
An infantry battalion was deployed to reinforce the defensive front line. 一个步兵营被部署去加强防守前线。

A battalion of firefighters fought tirelessly to put out the forest fire. 一支消防员大军不知疲倦地奋战以扑灭森林大火。

bauxite.note:
Bauxite is the principal raw mineral ore used in producing aluminum metal. 铝土矿是用于生产铝金属的主要原料矿石。

The mining company extracts tons of bauxite ore from open-pit mines daily. 采矿公司每天从露天矿山中开采数吨铝土矿石。

bawdy.meaning: adj. 猥亵的；下流打趣的
bawdy.note:
The sailors sang bawdy songs while drinking at the noisy seaport tavern. 水手们在热闹的海港酒馆喝酒时唱着下流打趣的歌曲。

The comedy play featured clever but slightly bawdy humor throughout. 这部喜剧话剧贯穿着巧妙但稍微带有下流打趣色彩的幽默。

bazaar.note:
Tourists crowded the colorful local bazaar to buy handmade spices and crafts. 游客们挤满了五彩缤纷的当地集市，购买手工香料和手工艺品。

The school hosted an annual charity bazaar to raise money for orphans. 学校举办了一年一度的慈善义卖街活动，为孤儿筹集资金。

beacon.meaning: n. 灯塔；烽火；指路明灯
beacon.note:
The bright coastal lighthouse served as a vital beacon for ships at night. 海岸边明亮的灯塔是夜间船只至关重要的指路明灯。

Her brave dedication stands as a beacon of hope for suffering communities. 她勇敢的奉献立为受苦社区的一座希望明灯。

beam.meaning: n. 光线；横梁; v. 堆笑；发光；播送
beam.note:
A bright beam of sunlight streamed through the tall bedroom window. 一束明亮的太阳光线穿过高大的卧室窗户射了进来。

The proud father beamed with joy as his daughter received her diploma. 当女儿接过毕业证书时，骄傲的父亲高兴得面露灿烂笑容。

bearing.meaning: n. 举止；关系；方位 (常用复数 bearings)
bearing.note:
His dignified military bearing earned him immediate respect from everyone. 他尊严的军人举止为他赢得了所有人立竿见影的尊重。

Recent financial discoveries have no direct bearing on the legal case. 最近的财务发现与本法律案件没有任何直接关系。

bedeck.note:
Town streets were bedecked with colorful flags and lights for the holiday. 城镇街道装扮着彩旗和灯光以迎接节日。

She bedecked her formal evening gown with diamond jewelry and accessories. 她用钻石珠宝和首饰装饰她的正式晚礼服。

befuddlement.note:
His sudden change of plans left the entire team in total befuddlement. 他计划的突然改变让整个团队处于彻底的困惑之中。

She looked at the complex manual with an expression of complete befuddlement. 她带着一副完全困惑的表情看着这份复杂的使用手册。

begrudge.meaning: v. 嫉妒；吝惜；不情愿给
begrudge.note:
You shouldn't begrudge him his hard-earned business promotion and success. 你不应该嫉妒他辛苦得来的商业晋升和成功。

She does not begrudge spending extra money on high-quality organic food. 她在购买高质量有机食品上从不吝惜花额外的钱。

beholder.note:
'Beauty is in the eye of the beholder' is a famous philosophical proverb. “情人眼里出西施（美在观者眼中）”是一句著名的哲学谚语。

The striking abstract sculpture evoked different powerful feelings in every beholder. 这座醒目的抽象雕塑在每一位观看者心中激发了不同的强烈情感。

behoove.meaning: v. 理应，有义务，对…有宜（多用于 it behooves sb）
behoove.note:
It behooves us to plan carefully before taking action. 我们理应在采取行动前仔细规划。

It behooves the government to listen to public concerns. 政府理应倾听公众的关切。

belabor.meaning: v. 过分强调；长篇大论；痛打
belabor.note:
There is no need to belabor the point since everyone already agrees. 既然大家都已经同意了，就没有必要再过分强调这一点了。

The meeting dragged on because the speaker belabored minor technical details. 会议拖延了很久，因为发言人对次要的技术细节长篇大论。

belated.note:
Please accept my warm belated happy birthday wishes for last week. 请接受我针对上周发出的迟来的温暖生日祝福。

The company made a belated apology for the severe data breach scandal. 公司对严重的采购数据泄露丑闻作出了迟来的道歉。

beleaguer.note:
The beleaguer company faced mounting debts and dropping market shares. 这家受困扰的公司面临着日益增加的债务和下滑的市场份额。

Enemy forces marched across the region to beleaguer the ancient capital city. 敌军在跨越该地区推进，以围困这座古老首都城市。

belie.meaning: v. 掩饰；与…不符；证明…为错
belie.note:
Her calm facial expression belied the intense nervousness she felt inside. 她平静的面部表情掩饰了她内心感受到的强烈紧张。

The economic recovery statistics belie the reality of high unemployment rates. 经济复苏数据与高失业率的现实不符。

belittle.note:
A good manager should never belittle the honest efforts of employees. 一个优秀的管理者绝不应该贬低员工付出的诚实努力。

Do not belittle your achievements just because others fail to see them. 不要仅仅因为其他人没看到就轻视你自己的成就。

bellicose.note:
The leader's bellicose speech heightened diplomatic tensions between nations. 该领导人好战的演讲加剧了国家间的外交紧张局势。

He had a aggressive, bellicose nature that often landed him in fistfights. 他有着一种挑衅好斗的性格，这经常使他陷入拳角打斗中。

belligerence.note:
His unwarranted belligerence during negotiations damaged the peace agreement. 他在谈判期间无端的敌意好战破坏了和平协议。

The military nation maintained an attitude of continuous global belligerence. 该军事国家维持着一种持续全球好战的状态。

bellwether.note:
High-tech stock performance is considered a reliable bellwether for the market. 高科技股票的表现被认为是市场可靠的风向标。

The housing sector acts as a key economic bellwether for the whole nation. 房地产部门充当着整个国家关键的经济领头羊。

bend.meaning: v. 弯曲；屈服; n. 弯曲处
bend.note:
You need to bend your knees when lifting heavy wooden boxes safely. 安全搬运沉重木箱时，你需要弯曲膝盖。

The sharp road bend ahead requires drivers to slow down immediately. 前方急剧的道路弯曲处要求司机们立即减速。

benediction.note:
The priest pronounced a solemn benediction over the newly married couple. 牧师对这对新婚夫妇做出了庄严的祝福。

They raised their hands in quiet benediction as the boat departed. 当船驶离时，他们静静地举起双手指做出祈祷。

benefactor.note:
An anonymous wealthy benefactor donated a million dollars to the hospital. 一位不愿透漏姓名的富有的捐助人向医院捐赠了一百万美元。

He considered the wise old professor to be his chief academic benefactor. 他将那位睿智的老教授视为他主要的学术恩人。

benison.note:
The gentle spring rain was seen as a welcome benison for parched crops. 适时的春雨被视为对干涸农作物的一种受欢迎的赐福。

May peace and prosperity be the lasting benison of this new land. 愿和平与繁荣成为这片新土地持久的祝福。

bent.meaning: adj. 弯曲的；决意的; n. 天赋；爱好
bent.note:
He accidentally damaged the door using a bent metal key. 他用一把弯曲的金属钥匙意外弄坏了门。

She showed a natural artistic bent from a very young age. 她从小就展现出了天生的艺术天赋爱好。

bequeath.note:
Grandfather decided to bequeath his valuable art collection to the museum. 祖父决定将他昂贵的艺术收藏遗赠给博物馆。

Previous generations bequeath a rich cultural heritage to modern society. 前几代人给现代社会留下了丰富的文化遗产。

bequest.note:
The university received a generous financial bequest to build a new library. 该大学收到了一笔慷慨的财务遗赠物以建一座新图书馆。

Her family received the real estate properties through her uncle's legal bequest. 她的家庭通过她叔叔的合法遗产收到了房地产产业。

berate.note:
The angry supervisor began to berate the clerk for making silly mistakes. 愤怒的主管开始因员工犯下傻错误而严厉斥责他。

There is no need to publicly berate someone in front of their colleagues. 没有必要在同事面前公开训斥某人。

bereft.meaning: adj. 剥夺的；丧失的；极为荒凉的
bereft.note:
After the tragic loss, she felt utterly bereft of hope and happiness. 在遭遇惨痛损失后，她感到彻底丧失了希望与幸福。

The barren desert landscape appeared completely bereft of plant life. 荒凉的沙漠地形看起来完全剥夺了植物生命。

besiege.meaning: v. 围攻；包围；不断困扰
besiege.note:
Enemy troops advanced quickly to besiege the heavily fortified castle. 敌军迅速推进以围攻这座严密加固的城堡。

Reporters continued to besiege the celebrity with questions after the show. 表演结束后，记者们继续用问题不断困扰这位明星。

besmirch.note:
False rumors were spread intentionally to besmirch his honorable reputation. 散布虚假谣言是为了蓄意玷污他光荣的名誉。

He swore he would never do anything to besmirch the family name. 他宣誓他绝不会做任何玷辱家族姓氏的事。

bestial.meaning: adj. 野兽的；残忍的；野蛮的
bestial.note:
The guards were condemned for treating prisoners with bestial cruelty. 卫兵因用野兽般的残忍对待囚犯而受到谴责。

Such bestial behavior has no place in a civilized modern society. 这种野蛮的行为在文明的现代社会没有立足之地。

bestow.note:
The queen decided to bestow a prestigious honor upon the brave officer. 女王决定向那位勇敢的军官授予一项尊贵的荣誉。

Nature has bestowed incredible natural beauty upon this remote island. 大自然赐予了这座偏远岛屿不可思议的天然美景。

bewilder.note:
The complex instructions served only to bewilder the novice users. 复杂的说明书仅仅使新手用户感到困惑。

His sudden decision to resign without explanation bewildered his coworkers. 他突然无解释辞职的决定使他的同事们感到茫然。

bewildering.meaning: adj. 令人困惑的；极其复杂的
bewildering.note:
Shoppers were faced with a bewildering choice of foreign cereal brands. 购物者面临着令人困惑的众多国外谷物品牌选择。

Navigating the dense city subway system can be a bewildering experience. 在拥挤的城市地铁系统中穿行可能是一次极其复杂的体验。

bibliography.meaning: n. 参考书目；文献目录
bibliography.note:
Always include a detailed bibliography at the end of your academic paper. 務在你的学术论文末尾附上一份详细的参考书目。

The researcher compiled an extensive bibliography on ancient history. 研究人员汇编了一份关于古代历史的广泛文献目录。

bibliophile.note:
As a passionate bibliophile, he spent weekends browsing vintage bookstores. 作为一名热情的藏书家，他周末都在浏览复古书店度过。

Her home library contains thousands of rare volumes loved by any bibliophile. 她的家庭图书馆藏有数千册深受任何爱书者喜爱的稀有书籍。

bicker.note:
The two siblings constantly bicker over who gets to watch TV shows. 这对兄妹经常为了谁看电视节目而拌嘴争吵。

Let's not bicker about minor details when we have a deadline to meet. 当我们有截止日期要赶时，不要为了次要细节争吵。

bid.meaning: v. 出价；投标；叮嘱; n. 出价；努力
bid.note:
Several wealthy art collectors bid millions for the rare painting auction. 几位富有的艺术收藏家在拍卖会上为这幅稀有画作出价数百万元。

The city launched a major strategic bid to host the upcoming Olympic Games. 该城市发起了一项重大的战略努力，以申办即将到来的奥运会。

bifurcate.note:
The main river channel begins to bifurcate into two smaller streams here. 主河道在这里开始分叉成两条更小的溪流。

Our paths seem to bifurcate after we graduate from university this summer. 在我们今年夏天大学毕业后，我们的道路似乎一分为二了。

bigot.note:
He proved to be a closed-minded bigot who refused to accept other views. 他被证明是一个封闭固执的偏执狂，拒绝接受其他观点。

A true democratic society should actively reject the hatred preached by any bigot. 一个真正的民主社会应该积极抵制任何顽固者所宣扬的仇恨。

bilingual.meaning: adj. 双语的; n. 能说两种语言的人
bilingual.note:
The company is seeking bilingual staff fluent in both English and Mandarin. 该公司正在招聘精通英语和普通话的双语员工。

Growing up in a mixed family made her a natural bilingual from childhood. 在混合家庭中长大使她从小就成为一个天生的双语者。

bilk.note:
The dishonest financial advisor tried to bilk innocent clients of savings. 那名不诚实的财务顾问试图骗取无辜客户的积蓄。

He managed to bilk the system by forging corporate payment documents. 他通过伪造公司支付凭证管理逃避并诈骗了系统。

billowy.meaning: adj. 巨浪般的；蓬松的；波浪状的
billowy.note:
The sky was filled with soft, billowy white clouds on a warm summer afternoon. 在一个温暖的夏日下午，天空布满了柔和蓬松的白云。

She wore a loose billowy dress that floated gently in the ocean breeze. 她穿了一件松垮波浪状的连衣裙，在海风中轻轻飘动。

bin.meaning: n. 垃圾桶；箱子; v. 丢弃
bin.note:
Please throw your empty plastic bottles into the green recycling bin. 请把你空的塑料瓶丢进绿色的回收垃圾桶里。

He decided to bin all his old outdated documents to free up space. 他决定丢弃所有旧的过时文件以腾出空间。

biosphere.note:
Human industrial activities have a profound global impact on the biosphere. 人类的工业活动对生物圈有着深刻的全球影响。

The earth's delicate biosphere supports millions of interconnected plant species. 地球脆弱的生物圈支撑着数以百万计相互联系的植物物种。

biped.meaning: n. 两足动物; adj. 有两足的
biped.note:
Humans are unique among mammals in being obligate biped organisms. 人类在哺乳动物中是独特的，因为他们是必性两足动物。

Researchers developed a biped robot capable of walking up steep stairs. 研究人员开发了一种能够走上陡峭楼梯的两足机器人。

blanch.note:
His face blanched with sudden horror upon seeing the dangerous accident. 在看到那场危险的事故后，他的脸因突然的恐惧而变白。

Blanch the green fresh vegetables in boiling water for one minute before freezing. 在冻结之前，将新鲜的绿色蔬菜在沸水中焯水一分钟。

bland.meaning: adj. 咸淡适中的；乏味的；温和的
bland.note:
The hospital served soft and bland food for patients recovering from surgery. 医院为手术后康复的病人提供软而咸淡适中的食物。

His presentation was criticized for being bland and lacking creative spark. 他的演示因乏味且缺乏创造性火花而受到批评。

blandishment.meaning: n. 奉承；甜言蜜语 (常用复数 blandishments)
blandishment.note:
She remained completely unmoved by his smooth talk and blandishments. 她对他丝滑的谈吐和甜言蜜语保持完全不受打动。

The salesperson used every charm and blandishment to close the luxury deal. 销售人员使用各种魅力和奉承来达成这笔奢侈品交易。

blasphemy.meaning: n. 亵渎神明；亵渎的言语
blasphemy.note:
In ancient times, speaking out against religious doctrine was blasphemy. 在古代，公然反对宗教教义属于亵渎神明。

To true coffee purists, adding sugar to fine espresso is pure blasphemy. 对真正的咖啡纯粹主义者来说，在优质浓缩咖啡中加糖纯属亵渎。

blatant.meaning: adj. 明目张胆的；公然的；喧嚣的
blatant.note:
His continuous cheating was a blatant violation of basic academic rules. 他持续的作弊是对基本学术规则公然的违反。

She was shocked by his blatant lie during the high-stakes negotiations. 她对他高风险谈判期间明目张胆的谎言感到震惊。

blazon.meaning: v. 宣布；公之于众；装饰; n. 纹章
blazon.note:
Company logos were blazoned brightly across huge neon billboards downtown. 公司的标识被鲜明地装饰在市中心巨大的霓虹广告牌上。

The royal shield was decorated with an ancient noble blazon. 皇家盾牌上装饰着古老的贵族纹章。

bleak.meaning: adj. 荒凉的；暗淡的；无希望的
bleak.note:
The landscape looked cold and bleak under the gray winter afternoon sky. 在灰暗的冬日下午天空下，地形看起来寒冷而荒凉。

Economic prospects for the small startup company appeared increasingly bleak. 这家小型初创公司的经济前景看起来越来越暗淡。

blighted.meaning: adj. 摧毁的；衰败的；枯萎的
blighted.note:
The urban area was filled with abandoned houses and blighted properties. 该城市区域充满了废弃的房屋和衰败的资产。

Her promising athletic career was blighted by constant severe knee injuries. 她有前途的体育职业生涯被持续严重的膝盖受伤所摧毁。

bliss.note:
Lying on a quiet beach listening to waves was absolute perfection and bliss. 躺在安静的海滩上听海浪声是绝对的完美与极乐。

They lived in pure marital bliss in a quiet coastal village for decades. 数十年来，他们在安静的海滨村庄里过着纯粹的婚姻幸福生活。

blissful.meaning: adj. 极幸福的；令人欣喜的
blissful.note:
They spent a blissful week relaxing at a luxury tropical resort. 他们在一家奢华的热带度假村度过了极幸福的一周。

Ignorance can sometimes feel like a blissful state in times of crisis. 在危机时期，无知有时感觉像是一种令人欣喜的状态。

blithe.meaning: adj. 漫不经心的；欢快的；无忧无虑的
blithe.note:
He showed a blithe disregard for safety regulations while driving fast. 他在快速驾驶时对安全规章展现出一种漫不经心的无视。

Her blithe spirit and cheerful laughter brought joy to the quiet room. 她欢快的精神和愉快的笑声给安静的房间带来了喜悦。

blizzard.meaning: n. 暴风雪；铺天盖地之物
blizzard.note:
A heavy winter blizzard covered the mountain roads in deep white snow. 一场强烈的冬日暴风雪将山路覆盖在深厚的白雪中。

The customer service office was hit by a blizzard of electronic emails. 客服办公室遭到了铺天盖地而来的电子邮件的袭击。

blockade.meaning: n. 封锁; v. 封锁 (港口/交通等)
blockade.note:
Naval ships established a strict military blockade around the hostile port. 海军舰艇在敌对港口周围建立了严格的军事封锁。

Protesters managed to blockade the entry gates of the chemical plant. 抗议者成功封锁了化学工厂的入口大门。

blockage.note:
Plumbers were called in to clear a stubborn blockage in the main drain pipe. 管道工被叫来清理主排水管里顽固的堵塞物。

A blood clot can cause a dangerous blockage in a major brain artery. 血栓可能会在脑主动脉中引起危险的阻塞。

blooming.meaning: adj. 盛开的；蓬勃发展的
blooming.note:
The garden was filled with blooming colorful roses during early summer. 初夏时节，花园里开满了盛开的五彩玫瑰。

Their local tech business is blooming despite tough global economic competition. 尽管面临全球激烈的经济竞争，他们当地的科技业务仍在蓬勃发展。

blotch.meaning: n. 班点；红斑; v. 弄脏；使生斑点
blotch.note:
Red blotches appeared on her skin due to an allergic food reaction. 由于食物过敏反应，她的皮肤上出现了红斑。

Accidental ink blotches ruined the clean white handwritten letter page. 意外的墨水班点毁掉了这张干净白皙的手写信页。

blowhard.meaning: n. 自吹自擂的人；吹牛大王
blowhard.note:
Nobody took his wild claims seriously because he was a known blowhard. 没有人认真对待他狂妄的断言，因为他是出了名的吹牛大王。

The arrogant blowhard boasted all night about his imaginary wealth. 那位傲慢自吹自擂的人整晚都在夸耀自己虚构的财富。

blueprint.meaning: n. 蓝图；设计图；行动方案
blueprint.note:
Architects carefully reviewed the detailed architectural blueprint before building. 建筑师在施工前仔细审查了详细的建筑蓝图。

The novel strategy provides a clear blueprint for economic growth reform. 这项新颖的策略为经济增长改革提供了清晰的行动方案。

blunder.meaning: n. 愚蠢的大错; v. 犯大错；跌跌撞撞地走
blunder.note:
Making that careless financial prediction proved to be a costly blunder. 做出那个粗心的财务预测被证明是一个代价高昂的愚蠢大错。

He blundered around the dark bedroom, knocking over a wooden lamp. 他在黑暗的卧室里跌跌撞撞地走，撞倒了一盏木灯。

blur.meaning: v. (使)变得模糊; n. 模糊不清的事物
blur.note:
Tears began to blur her vision as she read the sad farewell letter. 当她阅读这封悲伤的告别信时，泪水开始使她的视线变得模糊。

The past busy week flew by so fast that it was all a blur. 上周繁忙的一周飞逝得太快，以至于全是一片模糊不清。

blurb.meaning: n. 简介；短评；出厂推介语
blurb.note:
The publisher printed a catchy promotional blurb on the back book cover. 出版商在书的后封面上印刷了吸引人的宣传简介。

I read the short online blurb before deciding to purchase the album. 在决定购买这张专辑之前，我阅读了网上的短评。

blurt.meaning: v. 脱口而出 (常用 blurt out)
blurt.note:
He tended to blurt out confidential secrets when under severe stress. 在承受严重压力时，他往往会脱口而出机密秘密。

She blurted out the correct answer before the teacher finished asking. 在老师问完之前，她就脱口而出了正确答案。

blush.meaning: v. 脸红；害羞; n. 脸红；微红
blush.note:
She could feel her face blush deeply when everyone turned to look. 当所有人转头看她时，她能感到自己的脸深深地红了。

A soft pink blush touched her cheeks after receiving the compliment. 在收到赞美后，一抹柔和的粉红微红挂上了她的双颊。

bluster.meaning: v. 咆哮；威吓；狂风呼啸; n. 吓唬；咆哮
bluster.note:
The angry customer began to bluster and demand to see the manager. 愤怒的顾客开始咆哮并要求见经理。

Despite all his confident bluster, he was actually quite terrified inside. 尽管他做出了所有自信的吓唬，但他内心实际上相当恐惧。

blustering.meaning: adj. 狂风呼啸的；咆哮的
blustering.note:
A blustering cold winter wind rattled the thin glass window panes. 一阵狂风呼啸的冬天冷风吹得薄玻璃窗框嘎嘎作响。

He managed to ignore his opponent's loud blustering political speech. 他设法忽视了他对手喧闹咆哮的政治演讲。

bodyguard.note:
The famous celebrity was closely escorted by a personal bodyguard. 这位著名的明星由一名私人保镖紧密护送。

Two armed bodyguards stood vigilant outside the diplomat's suite entrance. 两名武装警卫警惕地站在外交官套房入口外。

bog.meaning: n. 沼泽；泥塘; v. 使陷入泥潭 (常用 bog down)
bog.note:
The heavy rain turned the grassy open field into a muddy bog. 暴雨将草地开阔田野变成了泥泞的沼泽。

Don't get bogged down in trivial administrative details during planning. 在规划期间不要陷入琐碎的行政细节泥潭。

boggle.meaning: v. 感到不可思议；惊慌；犹豫 (常用 boggle the mind)
boggle.note:
The sheer astronomical vastness of the outer space universe boggles the mind. 外太空宇宙巨大的天文级浩瀚令人感到不可思议。

He boggled at the high price tag attached to the modern painting. 他对那幅现代画作上附带的高昂价格标签感到惊慌犹豫。

bogus.note:
The criminal used a bogus identity card to open several bank accounts. 那名罪犯使用伪造的身份牌开设了几个银行账户。

They raised serious concerns over bogus medical insurance claims filed. 他们对提交的虚假医疗保险索赔提出了严重担忧。

boisterous.meaning: adj. 喧闹的；狂暴的；精力充沛的
boisterous.note:
A group of boisterous young students celebrated their victory loudly. 一群喧闹的年轻学生大声庆祝他们的胜利。

The small boat struggled against the high waves of a boisterous sea. 小船在狂暴的海洋巨浪中艰难挣扎。

bolt.meaning: n. 螺栓；门栓；闪电; v. 锁上；逃跑
bolt.note:
Tighten the metal bolt using a heavy wrench to secure the wheel. 使用重型扳手拧紧金属螺栓以固定车轮。

The frightened horse suddenly bolted away into the open forest field. 惊吓的马匹突然逃跑到开阔的森林田野中。

bombast.meaning: n. 夸大其词的言辞；大话
bombast.note:
His political campaign speech was full of empty grand bombast. 他政治竞选演讲充满了空洞的大话言辞。

Behind all the bombast, the proposal lacked actual practical substance. 在所有夸大其词的言辞背后，该提议缺乏实际的实质内容。

bombastic.meaning: adj. 夸大其词的；言过其实的
bombastic.note:
Critics dismissed his novel because of its bombastic writing style. 评论家们因其夸大其词的写作风格而摒弃了他的小说。

The speaker delivered a bombastic address that bored most listeners. 发言人发表了一场言过其实的演讲，让大多数听众感到厌烦。

bondage.note:
The historic revolution freed millions of oppressed people from bondage. 这场历史革命将数百万受压迫的人从奴役中解放出来。

He struggled for years to break free from the bondage of addiction. 他奋斗多年，以打破来自成瘾的束缚。

bonnet.meaning: n. 引擎盖 (英式)；童帽/女帽
bonnet.note:
The mechanic lifted the car bonnet to inspect the smoking engine. 机械师抬起汽车引擎盖以检查冒烟的发动机。

The baby wore a soft white cotton bonnet to protect against sun. 婴儿戴着一顶软白色棉质童帽以防太阳晒。

boon.meaning: n. 福音；巨大好处; adj. 愉快的
boon.note:
The warm spring rain was a great economic boon to local farmers. 适时的春雨对当地农夫来说是一大经济福音。

The new high-speed subway route proved to be a real boon for users. 新的高速地铁路线被证明是对用户真正的巨大好处。

boor.meaning: n. 粗野的人；笨拙的人
boor.note:
His unrefined manners made him look like an uneducated boor. 他不雅的举止使他看起来像个没受过教育的粗野的人。

Only an insensitive boor would make fun of someone in grief. 只有不知体恤的笨拙的人才会开身处悲伤中人的玩笑。

boost.meaning: v. 推动；促进；提高; n. 推动；提高
boost.note:
The new government tax cuts helped boost consumer spending online. 新的政府减税举措有助于促进消费者的在线支出。

Winning the regional championship gave the team a major confidence boost. 赢得区域锦标赛为团队带来了重大的信心提高。

bootless.note:
It proved to be a bootless effort to reason with the angry mob. 事实证明，与愤怒的人群讲道理是一场徒劳的努力。

They made bootless attempts to rescue the sunken wooden boat. 他们为营救沉没的木船做出了无用的尝试。

boredom.note:
She read fantasy novels to relieve the boredom of long flight trips. 她阅读奇幻小说以缓解长途飞行旅行的无聊。

The student groaned in pure boredom during the dry physics lecture. 在枯燥的物理讲座中，学生因纯粹的厌倦发出了呻吟。

botany.note:
She decided to major in botany to study tropical forest ecology. 她决定主修植物学以研究热带森林生态学。

The academic textbook covers basic principles of plant biology and botany. 这本学术教科书涵盖了植物生物学和植物学的基础原理。

boulder.note:
A massive granite boulder blocked the narrow dirt path up the hill. 一块巨大的花岗岩巨石封锁了上山狭窄的泥土小路。

The mountain climbers rested against a large smooth boulder for lunch. 登山者们靠在一块巨大光滑的大圆石旁吃午饭。

bouquet.note:
He presented his bride with a lovely bouquet of fresh white lilies. 他向他的新娘献上了一束精美的新鲜白百合花束。

Wine experts appreciated the rich fruity bouquet of the aged red wine. 葡萄酒专家赞赏这种陈年红葡萄酒浓郁的果香芳香。

bourgeois.meaning: adj. 中产阶级的；平庸追求物质的; n. 中产阶级分子
bourgeois.note:
The novel critiques the conventional bourgeois values of suburban society. 这部小说批判了郊区社会传统的平庸追求物质的中产阶级价值观。

He lead a comfortable bourgeois lifestyle in a quiet green neighborhood. 他在安静绿化的社区里过着舒适的中产阶级生活。

bout.note:
He suffered a severe bout of flu during the cold winter weeks. 在寒烈的冬周里，他遭遇了一阵严重的流感。

The professional boxer won the championship bout in the final round. 那名职业拳击手在最后一回合赢得了锦标赛比赛。

boycott.note:
Consumers decided to boycott the firm due to environmental pollution. 消费者决定抵制该公司，原因在于其造成的环境污染。

The union called for a nationwide trade boycott against unfair products. 工会号召全国范围内开展针对不公正产品的贸易抵制。

bracelet.note:
She wore a shiny silver bracelet on her left wrist as a decorative item. 她左手腕上戴着一条闪亮的银手链作为装饰品。

He bought an expensive gold charm bracelet for his mother's birthday. 他为母亲的生日买了一条昂贵的黄金符珠手镯。

bracing.meaning: adj. 令人振奋的；凉爽新鲜的
bracing.note:
They went for a walk in the crisp, bracing ocean sea air early morning. 早上，他们在清新且令人振奋的大洋海风中散步。

Her direct and honest feedback was a bracing reality check for us. 她直接而诚实的信息反馈对我们而言是一次令人振奋的现实检验。

bracket.meaning: n. 括号；阶层/组；支架; v. 归类
bracket.note:
Put the additional explanatory information inside square brackets. 将额外的解释性信息放在方括号内。

Families in the higher income bracket pay a higher proportion of tax. 处于较高收入阶层的家庭要缴纳更高比例的税款。

braggadocio.note:
His empty braggadocio failed to impress the experienced board panel. 他空洞的吹牛未能给有经验的董事会专家组留深刻印象。

Behind all his public braggadocio lay a deep lack of self-confidence. 在他所有公开自夸的言行背后，掩盖着自我自信的深度匮乏。

braggart.note:
Nobody liked working with the loud braggart who took credit for all. 没有人喜欢与那个抢占所有功劳的喧闹的吹牛者共事。

The arrogant braggart boasted about his high salary to anyone listening. 那位傲慢的自大狂向任何听着的人夸耀自己的高薪。

braid.meaning: n. 发辫；辫子; v. 编成辫子
braid.note:
She wore her long hair in a neat braid down her back. 她把长发扎成一条整齐的发辫垂在背后。

The mother showed her daughter how to braid colorful cotton threads. 母亲向女儿示范了如何把彩色的棉线编成辫子。

brake.meaning: n. 刹车；制动器; v. 刹车
brake.note:
The driver hit the foot brake hard to avoid hitting the crossing dog. 司机狠踩脚刹车，以避免撞到过马路的狗。

Always check your vehicle's hydraulic brake pads before a long road trip. 在长途自驾前，务必检查你车辆的水压刹车片。

brand.meaning: n. 品牌；商标; v. 铭刻；给…打烙印
brand.note:
This famous global brand is known for high-quality electronics goods. 这个著名的全球品牌以高质量的电子产品闻名。

The scandal threatens to brand the young company as dishonest. 这起丑闻威胁要给这家年轻的公司打上不诚实的烙印。

brandish.note:
The intruder began to brandish a sharp metal knife at the security guard. 闯入者开始向安全警卫威胁性地挥舞一把锋利的金属刀。

Demonstrators brandished signs and banners as they marched down the street. 示威者在沿街游行时挥舞着标语牌和横幅。

brash.meaning: adj. 鲁莽的；自以为是的；刺眼的
brash.note:
His brash behavior and rude comments offended everyone at the meeting. 他鲁莽的行为和粗鲁的言论得罪了会议上的所有人。

She wore a bright jacket in a brash color that drew attention. 她穿了一件带有刺眼颜色的亮夹克，吸引了目光。

brassy.meaning: adj. 黄铜制的；厚颜无耻的；刺耳的
brassy.note:
The song was accompanied by a loud, brassy jazz orchestra sound. 这首歌伴随着喧闹且刺耳的爵士管弦乐队声音。

Her brassy confidence alienated people who preferred quiet manners. 她厚颜无耻的自信疏远了那些更喜欢安静举止的人。

brat.meaning: n. 顽童；调皮捣蛋的孩子
brat.note:
The spoiled brat threw a huge tantrum when denied a new toy. 那个被宠坏的顽童在被拒绝买新玩具时大发脾气。

Stop acting like a brat and share your toys with your younger sister. 别再像个调皮捣蛋的孩子一样了，和你的妹妹分享你的玩具吧。

bravado.meaning: n. 虚张声势；故作勇敢
bravado.note:
His loud boast was merely a display of empty bravado to hide fear. 他大声的吹嘘仅仅是为了掩饰恐惧而做出的虚张声势。

Beneath all her swagger and bravado, she was feeling quite insecure. 在她所有的招摇和故作勇敢之下，她感到相当没有安全感。

bravura.meaning: n. 华彩乐段；精彩绝伦的技术展现; adj. 精彩的
bravura.note:
The pianist delivered a bravura performance that brought the audience up. 钢琴家做出了精彩绝伦的演出，使观众全体起立。

The film ends with a sequence of technical bravura that amazed critics. 电影以一段令评论家惊叹的精彩技术展现序列结束。

brawl.meaning: n. 斗殴；吵闹的打架; v. 斗殴
brawl.note:
A wild bar brawl broke out late at night after the football match. 足球比赛后，深夜爆发了一场野蛮的酒吧斗殴。

Police officers arrived quickly to stop two men who began to brawl. 警官们迅速赶到，制止了开始斗殴的两名男子。

brazen.meaning: adj. 厚颜无耻的；黄铜制的; v. 勇敢面对
brazen.note:
He made a brazen attempt to cheat during the final qualification exam. 他在最终资格考试中做出了厚颜无耻的作弊尝试。

She decided to brazen it out and deny any wrongdoing to the media. 她决定硬着头皮顶过去，并向媒体否认任何不当行为。

breadth.note:
The breadth of the wooden dining table is about one meter wide. 木制餐桌的宽度大约为一米。

His impressive academic breadth of knowledge covers both history and science. 他令人印象深刻的学术知识广度涵盖了历史和科学。

bribe.meaning: n. 贿赂; v. 向…行贿
bribe.note:
The official was arrested for accepting a massive financial bribe. 该官员因接受巨额财务贿赂而被捕。

He tried to bribe the guard to let him inside the restricted building. 他试图向卫兵行贿，以允许他进入限制区域大楼。

bricklayer.note:
The skilled bricklayer laid red bricks with high accuracy along the wall. 这位熟练的砌砖工沿着墙壁极其精准地铺设红砖。

He worked as a apprentice bricklayer on the busy construction site. 他在繁忙的建筑工地上担任实习泥瓦匠。

brink.meaning: n. 边缘；极限 (常用 on the brink of)
brink.note:
The two competing nations were standing on the brink of war. 这两个竞争国家正处于战争的边缘。

The endangered species was driven to the very brink of extinction. 这个濒危物种被逼到了灭绝的边缘。

brisk.meaning: adj. 轻快的；凉爽清新的；兴隆的
brisk.note:
They took a brisk thirty-minute walk in the chilly morning air. 他们在寒冷的晨气中进行了三十分钟轻快的散步。

Trade at the seaside souvenir shop was brisk throughout the summer. 海滨纪念品商店的生意整个夏天都很兴隆。

bristle.meaning: n. 刷毛；硬毛; v. (毛发)竖立；发怒；密布
bristle.note:
The toothbrush features soft nylon bristles to clean teeth safely. 这把牙刷有着软尼龙刷毛，以安全地清洁牙齿。

The hair on the dog's back began to bristle as the stranger approached. 当陌生人接近时，狗背上的毛发开始竖立起来。

brittle.meaning: adj. 易碎的；脆弱的；尖暴的
brittle.note:
Old dry bones can become fragile and brittle over extended time. 老旧的干骨头随着时间的推移会变得易碎且脆弱。

She answered his sensitive question with a cold and brittle laugh. 她用冷淡而尖暴的笑声回答了他的敏感问题。

broach.meaning: v. 提出 (敏感话题)；开启 (桶/瓶)
broach.note:
He found it difficult to broach the sensitive topic of money with her. 他觉得很难向她提出关于金钱这一敏感话题。

The host decided to broach a new barrel of aged wine for the party. 主人决定为派对开启一桶新的陈年葡萄酒。

brochure.note:
The travel agency handed out a colorful travel brochure for Paris. 旅行社发放了一份关于巴黎的五彩宣传手册。

Please read the product brochure carefully before using the device. 请在使用该设备之前仔细阅读产品小册子。

broker.meaning: n. 经纪人；中间人; v. 居中协调；安排
broker.note:
He worked as a licensed stock broker on Wall Street for years. 他在华尔街担任持牌股票经纪人多年。

The diplomat managed to broker a historic peace treaty between states. 外交官成功居中协调了国家间一项历史性的和平条约。

bromide.note:
His speech offered nothing but comforting political bromides. 他的演讲只提供了令人体慰的政治陈词滥调。

Potassium bromide was historically used in medicine as a sedative agent. 溴化钾在历史上曾被用作医学镇静剂。

brood.meaning: n. (动物的)一窝; v. 孵蛋；沉思；发愁
brood.note:
The mother duck was followed closely by her fresh brood of ducklings. 母鸭身后紧紧跟着她的一窝小鸭。

Don't brood over past failures; focus on future business growth. 不要为过去的失败发愁；专注于未来的业务增长。

browbeat.note:
The aggressive lawyer tried to browbeat the witness into agreeing. 那位挑衅的律师试图威逼证人表示同意。

Do not allow senior managers to browbeat you into signing contracts. 不要允许高级经理恐吓你签署合同。

bruise.meaning: n. 淤青；伤痕; v. 使受淤伤；碰撞
bruise.note:
She suffered a dark purple bruise on her knee after falling off bike. 在骑车摔倒后，她的膝盖上留下一块深紫色的淤青。

Be careful not to bruise the soft fresh peaches while packing them. 打包时小心不要碰撞碰伤软的新鲜桃子。

bruit.meaning: v. 散播 (谣言等，常用 bruit about/abroad)
bruit.note:
Rumors of a imminent corporate takeover were bruits about the office. 关于公司即将来临的收购谣言在办公室里散播开来。

The news of their secret marriage was bruits abroad across the town. 他们秘密结婚的消息在镇上被散播开来。

brunt.meaning: n. 主要冲力；首当其冲的重担 (常用 bear the brunt of)
brunt.note:
Small coastal local towns bore the brunt of the violent hurricane. 沿海的小城镇承受了猛烈飓风的首当其冲的冲击。

Young entry-level workers often bear the brunt of corporate budget cuts. 年轻的初级员工往往承受了公司预算削减的主要重担。

brusque.meaning: adj. 鲁莽的；唐突的；直率简短的
brusque.note:
His brusque manner gave people the wrong impression that he was rude. 他唐突的举止给人们留下了他很粗鲁的错误印象。

She gave a brusque one-word reply to his long detailed question. 她对他漫长详细的问题做出了一个直率简短的单字回答。

brute.meaning: n. 禽兽；畜生; adj. 野蛮的；强横的
brute.note:
The cruel man was condemned as a heartless brute for abusing animals. 那名残忍的男子因虐待动物而被谴责为无情的禽兽。

Lifting the heavy stone required pure brute physical strength alone. 抬起那块重石头仅仅需要纯粹强横的物理力量。

buck.meaning: n. 美元；雄鹿; v. 猛然弓背跃起；抵制
buck.note:
He managed to save a few bucks by buying lunch at the market. 他通过在市场买午饭设法省了几美元。

The brave company decided to buck the industry trend of rising prices. 这家勇敢的公司决定抵制价格上涨的行业趋势。

bucket.note:
He filled a plastic blue bucket with soapy water to clean the car. 他用肥皂水装满了一个蓝色塑料水桶来清洗汽车。

The kids collected colorful seashells inside a small red beach bucket. 孩子们把彩色的海贝收集在一个红色的海滩小水桶里。

bucolic.note:
The painting depicted a serene bucolic landscape with grazing sheep. 这幅画描绘了一幅带有吃草绵羊的宁静田园风景。

They escaped the noisy city to enjoy a peaceful bucolic weekend. 他们逃离了喧闹的城市，去享受一个平静的乡村周末。

bud.meaning: n. 芽；花蕾; v. 发芽
bud.note:
In early spring, small green leaf buds begin to appear on branches. 在初春，绿色的小叶芽开始出现在树枝上。

The fresh rose bush is full of delicate red buds waiting to open. 这株新鲜的玫瑰灌木开满了等待开放的精致红花蕾。

budge.meaning: v. (使)微动；改变主意 (常用于否定句)
budge.note:
No matter how hard we pushed, the heavy rock wouldn't budge. 无论我们多么努力地推，那块重石头都动也不动。

The stubborn manager refused to budge on the proposed salary limit. 那位固执的经理拒绝在拟议的薪水限制上做出改变主意。

budget.meaning: n. 预算; v. 编预算; adj. 廉价的
budget.note:
The annual department budget must be approved by the board panel. 部门的年度预算必须获得董事会专家组的批准。

They stayed at a clean budget hotel to save money for sightseeing. 他们住在一家干净的廉价酒店，以节省资金用于观光。

buffoon.meaning: n. 小丑；滑稽捣蛋的人
buffoon.note:
He acted like a silly buffoon to make the small children laugh. 他举止像个傻小丑一样，以逗小孩子们发笑。

Nobody respected the manager because he behaved like an arrogant buffoon. 没有人尊重那位经理，因为他的行为像个傲慢的滑稽捣蛋的人。

bulge.meaning: n. 膨胀；凸起；激增; v. 膨胀；鼓起
bulge.note:
His leather wallet was bulging with cash after visiting the bank. 从银行出来后，他的皮钱包里鼓满了现金。

A noticeable bulge appeared on the tire after hitting a deep pothole. 在碰到一个深坑后，轮胎上出现了一个明显的凸起。

bully.meaning: n. 恃强凌弱者；恶霸; v. 欺负；恐吓
bully.note:
School teachers took quick action to stop the playground bully. 学校老师采取快速行动制止了操场上的恶霸。

Don't let anyone bully you into doing things you disagree with. 不要让任何人恐吓你做你不同意的事情。

bumptious.meaning: adj. 盲目自大的；傲慢大摇大摆的
bumptious.note:
His bumptious attitude quickly alienated all his new office teammates. 他盲目自大的态度迅速疏远了他所有的办公新队友。

The young executive was criticized for being loud and bumptious. 那位年轻的高管因喧闹且傲慢大摇大摆而受到批评。

bungle.meaning: v. 搞砸；笨手笨脚地做; n. 拙劣的工作
bungle.note:
The inexperienced team managed to bungle the simple project setup. 那支缺乏经验的团队设法搞砸了简单的项目搭建。

His terrible bungle cost the firm thousands of dollars in damages. 他糟糕的拙劣工作使公司损失了数千美元的赔偿。

buoy.meaning: n. 浮标；救生圈; v. 使浮起；鼓励；支撑
buoy.note:
A bright yellow floating buoy marked the safe swimming ocean area. 一具明黄色的浮标标出了安全的大洋游泳区域。

The good economic news helped buoy investor confidence in the stock. 良好的经济新闻有助于鼓舞投资者对股票的信心。

buoyant.meaning: adj. 有浮力的；轻快的；繁荣的
buoyant.note:
Warm sea water keeps swimmers floating in a natural buoyant state. 温暖的海水使游泳者保持在自然的有浮力的状态。

The market remained buoyant despite rising global energy prices. 尽管全球能源价格上涨，市场依然保持繁荣。

burgeon.meaning: v. 迅速萌芽；蓬勃发展
burgeon.note:
The electronic e-commerce sector began to burgeon during the decade. 在这十年间，电子电子商务部门开始迅速萌芽发展。

Demand for solar green energy solutions continues to burgeon nationwide. 全国对太阳能绿色能源解决方案的需求继续蓬勃发展。

burlesque.meaning: n. 滑稽讽刺剧；滑稽模仿; adj. 滑稽的
burlesque.note:
The theater group presented a hilarious burlesque of classic opera. 剧团上演了一部对经典歌剧的诙谐滑稽讽刺剧。

His exaggerated caricature was a brilliant burlesque of local politics. 他夸张的漫画是对当地政治的一次精彩的滑稽模仿。

burnish.meaning: v. 擦亮；打磨；提升 (形象)
burnish.note:
The jeweler used a soft cloth to burnish the vintage silver bowl. 珠宝商使用一块软布来擦亮复古银碗。

He gave public speeches to burnish his diplomatic reputation abroad. 他发表公开演讲以提升他在海外的外交形象。

bust.meaning: v. 打碎；逮捕; n. 半身像；胸围；萧条
bust.note:
The marble bust of the Roman emperor stood in the museum gallery. 罗马皇帝的石雕半身像立在博物馆展厅里。

Police officers managed to bust an illegal gambling den downtown. 警官们成功破获逮捕了市中心的一个非法赌博窝点。

butt.meaning: n. 烟头；屁股；笑柄; v. 用头撞
butt.note:
He threw his finished cigarette butt onto the dry grass pavement. 他把他吸完的香烟头扔到了干燥的草地路面上。

His silly mistake made him the chief butt of office jokes all week. 他傻傻的错误使他成为了整周办公室笑话的主要笑柄。

buttress.meaning: n. 扶壁；支撑物; v. 支持；加固
buttress.note:
Heavy stone buttresses were built to support the high cathedral walls. 建造了沉重的石扶壁以支撑大教堂高耸的墙壁。

He presented statistical data to buttress his theoretical argument. 他展示了统计数据，以支持他的理论论点。

byline.note:
Her name appeared in the byline of the front-page investigative article. 她的名字出现在首页调查性文章的署名行中。

The young reporter was thrilled to see his first national byline. 这位年轻的记者看到自己的第一个全国性署名行感到非常激动。

byproduct.meaning: n. 副产品；附带产生的结果
byproduct.note:
Sawdust is a useful industrial byproduct generated by wood sawmills. 锯末是木材锯木厂产生的一种实用的工业副产品。

Increased confidence was a wonderful byproduct of her language studies. 活力的增强是她语言学习带来的一个极好的附带产生的结果。

bystander.note:
An innocent bystander was injured during the violent street collision. 一名无辜的旁观者在猛烈的街头碰撞中受伤。

Several curious bystanders gathered to watch the outdoor street show. 几位好奇的旁观者聚集在一起观看这场户外街头表演。

byzantine.meaning: adj. 拜占庭式的；极其复杂繁琐的
byzantine.note:
Navigating the country's byzantine tax regulations requires an expert. 应对该国极其复杂繁琐的税收规章需要一名专家。

The historical museum featured magnificent ancient Byzantine gold art. 历史博物馆展出了壮丽的古代拜占庭黄金艺术。

cabal.meaning: n. 政治阴谋集团；小集团
cabal.note:
A secret cabal of senior officers plotted to overthrow the king. 一个由高级军官组成的秘密阴谋集团图谋推翻国王。

The political decisions were made behind closed doors by a cabal. 政治决策是由一小撮政治小集团在闭门背后做出的。

cache.meaning: n. 隐蔽藏匿处；高速缓存; v. 贮藏
cache.note:
Explorers uncovered a secret cache of weapons inside the mountain cave. 探险家们在山洞内发现了一个秘密的武器隐蔽藏匿处。

Clear your web browser cache regularly to free up computer memory. 定期清理你的网页浏览器高速缓存以释放计算机内存。

cadet.meaning: n. 军校学员；警校学员
cadet.note:
The young military cadet trained hard to become a commissioned officer. 那位年轻的军校学员刻苦训练，以成为一名正式军官。

Police cadets completed their physical endurance drills on the field. 警校学员们在场地里完成了他们的体能耐力训练。

cadge.meaning: v. 乞讨；白拿；蹭 (常用 cadge from/off)
cadge.note:
He managed to cadge a free ride into town from a passing truck. 他成功从一辆路过的卡车那里蹭了一程去镇上的免费车。

Don't try to cadge money off your friends every time you meet. 不要每次见面都试图从你的朋友那里白拿钱。

cajole.meaning: v. 劝诱；哄骗 (常用 cajole into)
cajole.note:
She managed to cajole her reluctant brother into helping with chores. 她成功哄骗她不情愿的弟弟帮忙做家务。

The salesperson tried to cajole the customer into buying the expensive car. 销售人员试图劝诱客户购买那辆昂贵的汽车。

calamity.note:
The severe earthquake was an unexpected environmental calamity for the region. 强烈的地震对该地区来说是一场意想不到的自然灾难。

The sudden bankruptcy of the major bank brought financial calamity. 这家主要银行的突然破产带来了财务上的大祸。

calcium.note:
Milk and dairy products are rich sources of dietary calcium for bones. 牛奶和乳制品是骨骼膳食钙的丰富来源。

Calcium is an essential mineral required to build strong human teeth. 钙是构建人类强壮牙齿所需的必需矿物质。

calculated.meaning: adj. 蓄意的；精心策划的；计算过的
calculated.note:
The strategic move was a calculated risk designed to gain market share. 这项战略举措是一项旨在获得市场份额的精心策划的风险。

He gave a calculated insult during the debate to provoke his opponent. 在辩论期间，他给出了蓄意的侮辱以挑衅他的对手。

composed.note:
She remained remarkably composed throughout the entire crisis. 在整场危机中，她表现得异常镇定。

He took a few deep breaths to look composed before stepping onto the stage. 上台前他深吸了几口气，让自己看起来很沉着。

composer.note:
Beethoven is widely regarded as one of the greatest classical composers in history. 贝多芬被广泛认为是历史上最伟大的古典作曲家之一。

The young musician aspired to become a professional film score composer. 这位年轻的音乐家渴望成为一名专业的电影配乐作曲家。

comprehensible.note:
The professor explained the complex theory in simple, comprehensible terms. 教授用简单易懂的语言解释了这一复杂的理论。

Her speech was clear and fully comprehensible to the audience. 她的演讲很清晰，观众完全能够听懂。

compress.meaning: v. 压缩；压紧 n. 敷布
compress.note:
You can use this software to compress large video files before sending them. 你可以使用这款软件在发送前压缩大型视频文件。

The nurse applied a cold compress to reduce the swelling on his forehead. 护士敷了一块冷敷布来减轻他额头上的肿胀。

compulsion.note:
He felt a sudden compulsion to check the locked doors again. 他感到有一种突然的冲动，想再次检查锁好的门。

She acted out of free will and not under any legal compulsion. 她是出于自由意志行事的，没有任何法律强迫。

compunction.meaning: n. 良心不安；内疚；悔恨
compunction.note:
He cheated on the exam without the slightest feeling of compunction. 他作弊时没有感到一丝一毫的内疚。

The criminal confessed his crimes to the police without compunction. 罪犯毫无悔意地向警方供认了他的罪行。

concatenate.note:
The program allows you to concatenate multiple text strings into one. 该程序允许你将多个文本字符串串联成一个。

Data is concatenated in chronological order for easier analysis. 数据按时间顺序串联起来，以便于分析。

concave.note:
The inner surface of the satellite dish is designed to be concave. 卫星天线的内表面被设计成凹面的。

A concave lens is commonly used to correct nearsightedness. 凹透镜通常用于矫正近视。

conceit.meaning: n. 自负；自大；巧妙构思
conceit.note:
His annoying conceit made it difficult for him to make new friends. 他令人讨厌的自负使他很难交到新朋友。

The poem is built around a clever and unusual literary conceit. 这首诗围绕着一个巧妙且不同寻常的文学构思展开。

concentrate.meaning: v. 集中（注意力）；聚集 n. 浓缩液
concentrate.note:
It is hard to concentrate on studying with so much noise outside. 外面有这么大的噪音，很难集中精力学习。

The factory produces frozen orange juice concentrate for export. 这家工厂生产供出口的冷冻浓缩橙汁。

concerto.note:
The talented pianist performed a breathtaking violin concerto. 这位才华横溢的钢琴家演奏了一首惊艳的小提琴协奏曲。

Mozart composed numerous masterpieces, including several famous piano concertos. 莫扎特创作了许多杰作，包括几首著名的钢琴协奏曲。

conciliate.note:
The mediator tried to conciliate the conflicting parties during the negotiations. 调解员在谈判期间试图安抚冲突各方。

Management took steps to conciliate the striking union workers. 管理层采取措施安抚罢工的工会工人。

conclave.meaning: n. 秘密会议；枢机主教团会议
conclave.note:
Cardinals gathered in a closed conclave to elect a new Pope. 枢机主教们聚集在秘密会议中选举新教皇。

The board members held a private conclave to discuss strategic restructuring. 董事会成员举行了一场私人秘密会议，讨论战略重组。

conclusive.note:
The police finally found conclusive evidence linking the suspect to the crime. 警方终于找到了将犯罪嫌疑人与犯罪联系起来的确凿证据。

Medical tests did not provide conclusive proof of the disease. 医学检测没有提供该疾病的决定性证据。

concomitant.meaning: adj. 伴随的；同时发生的 n. 伴随物
concomitant.note:
Economic growth often brings concomitant environmental challenges. 经济增长往往伴随着环境挑战。

Fame and wealth are the natural concomitants of a successful movie career. 名誉和财富是成功电影演艺生涯的自然伴随物。

concord.note:
Neighboring nations lived together in peace and concord for decades. 邻国数十年如一日地和平共处、和睦相处。

The community worked hard to foster social harmony and civil concord. 社区努力促进社会和谐与公民一致。

concrete.meaning: adj. 具体的；有形的 n. 混凝土
concrete.note:
The police need concrete evidence before they can make an arrest. 警方在实施逮捕之前需要具体的证据。

Workers poured wet concrete to lay the foundation for the new building. 工人们浇筑湿混凝土来为新建筑打地基。

condense.note:
Steam from the hot shower began to condense on the cold mirror. 热水澡产生的蒸汽开始在冰冷的镜子上凝结。

The author agreed to condense the long report into a short summary. 作者同意将这篇长报告简述为一份简短的总结。

condescending.meaning: adj. 屈尊俯就的；有优越感的
condescending.note:
She disliked his condescending tone when he explained basic tasks to her. 当他向她解释基本任务时，她不喜欢他那傲慢的语气。

His condescending attitude alienated many of his junior coworkers. 他高高在上的态度疏远了许多年轻同事。

conduct.meaning: n. 行为；品行 v. 组织；引导；传导
conduct.note:
The school has strict rules regarding student conduct and discipline. 学校对学生的行为和纪律有严格的规定。

Scientists will conduct a series of experiments to test the new drug. 科学家将实施一系列实验来测试这种新药。

conduit.meaning: n. 管道；导线管；传导媒介
conduit.note:
Cables were safely run through a protective underground conduit. 电缆被安全地穿过一条保护性的地下导线管。

Art can act as a powerful conduit for human emotions and ideas. 艺术可以充当人类情感和思想的强大传导媒介。

cone.meaning: n. 圆锥体；松果；圆锥形冰淇淋筒
cone.note:
Children ate chocolate ice cream served in crispy waffle cones. 孩子们吃着装在酥脆华夫筒里的巧克力冰淇淋。

Pine trees dropped brown dry cones onto the forest floor. 松树将褐色干燥的松果掉落在森林地面上。

confection.meaning: n. 甜食；糖果；精致作品
confection.note:
The bakery window was filled with colorful and sweet confections. 面包店的橱窗里摆满了色彩缤纷的甜点。

The film is a lighthearted romantic confection meant purely for entertainment. 这部电影是一部纯粹为了娱乐而拍的轻松浪漫爱情片。

confederacy.note:
Several independent city-states formed a defensive confederacy. 几个独立的城邦组成了防御同盟。

Historians studied the political structure of the southern confederacy. 历史学家研究了南方邦联的政治结构。

conference.note:
She will travel to Boston next week to attend an international medical conference. 她下周将去波士顿参加一个国际医学会议。

The manager called a team conference to discuss the quarterly sales targets. 经理召开了一次团队会议，讨论季度销售目标。

confess.note:
The thief decided to confess his crimes to the police. 小偷决定向警方坦白他的罪行。

I must confess that I haven't read the book you recommended. 我必须承认，我还没读你推荐的那本书。

confide.note:
She decided to confide her deepest secrets to her best friend. 她决定向最好的朋友吐露她最深处的秘密。

He chose to confide in his mentor when facing career difficulties. 面临职业困惑时，他选择向导师倾诉。

confidence.note:
Public confidence in the economy has grown over the past few months. 过去几个月里，公众对经济的信心有所增强。

She walked onto the stage with great poise and confidence. 她带着极大的沉着和自信走上了舞台。

confirm.note:
Please call the hotel to confirm your room reservation. 请打电话给酒店确认你的房间预订。

Recent scientific experiments confirm the accuracy of the theory. 最近的科学实验证实了该理论的准确性。

conflagration.note:
The dry weather fueled a massive conflagration that destroyed hundreds of homes. 干燥的天气引发了一场大火，摧毁了数百栋房屋。

Diplomats worked desperately to prevent a regional war from turning into a global conflagration. 外交官们拼命工作，以防止地区战争演变成全球大战。

conflate.note:
It is a mistake to conflate correlation with direct causation. 把相关性与直接因果关系混为一谈是错误的。

The author tends to conflate historical facts with fictional myths. 作者倾向于将历史事实与虚构神话混合在一起。

conflict.meaning: n. 冲突；矛盾 v. 冲突；抵触
conflict.note:
Armed conflict between the two nations lasted for over a decade. 两国之间的武装冲突持续了十多年。

His personal values often conflict with corporate policies. 他的个人价值观经常与公司政策发生冲突。

conformity.note:
The building was redesigned to ensure full conformity with safety codes. 这座建筑经过重新设计，以确保完全符合安全规范。

Teenagers often feel pressured into social conformity with their peers. 青少年经常感到有压力要去顺应同龄人的社交一致性。

confound.note:
The unexpected test results continued to confound the research team. 意外的测试结果让研究团队感到困惑。

She managed to confound her critics with an extraordinarily successful project. 她凭借一个极其成功的项目驳倒了批评者。

congeal.note:
The fat on the surface of the soup began to congeal as it cooled down. 汤冷却后，表面上的油脂开始凝固。

Blood tends to congeal quickly when exposed to air. 血液暴露在空气中时往往会迅速凝固。

congenial.meaning: adj. 气味相投的；适宜的
congenial.note:
She found a congenial working environment with friendly and helpful colleagues. 她找到了一个同事友好且乐于助人的合心工作环境。

The warm climate and quiet neighborhood proved very congenial to his health. 温暖的气候和安静的街区对他的健康大有益处。

conglomerate.meaning: n. 企业集团； conglomerate 混合物
conglomerate.note:
The media conglomerate owns several television networks and major newspapers. 这家媒体企业集团拥有数个电视网络和大型报纸。

The rock is a natural conglomerate of small stones and hardened mud. 这种岩石是小石头和硬化泥土的天然混合物。

congregate.note:
Crowds of people began to congregate in the town square for the celebration. 人群开始聚集在城镇广场上参加庆祝活动。

Birds congregate in large flocks before migrating south for the winter. 鸟类在向南过冬之前会聚集成大群。

congruent.meaning: adj. 全等的；一致的；符合的
congruent.note:
In geometry, two triangles are congruent if all their sides are equal. 在几何学中，如果两个三角形的所有边都相等，它们就是全等的。

Her actions were fully congruent with her stated principles. 她的行动与她所声明的原则完全一致。

congruous.meaning: adj. 一致的；相称的；和谐的
congruous.note:
His modest lifestyle is hardly congruous with his enormous wealth. 他简朴的生活方式与他巨额的财富实在不相称。

The modern furniture looks surprisingly congruous in the historic room. 现代家具在这个历史悠久的房间里看起来出奇地和谐。

conifer.meaning: n. 松柏类植物；针叶树
conifer.note:
Evergreen conifers dominate the dense forests of the northern region. 常绿针叶树占据了北方地区的茂密森林。

Unlike deciduous trees, most conifers keep their needles year-round. 与落叶树不同，大多数针叶树终年保留针叶。

conjecture.meaning: n. 推测；猜想 v. 推测
conjecture.note:
The cause of the ancient fire remains a matter of scientific conjecture. 那场古代火灾的原因仍然是科学推测的问题。

Investigators could only conjecture about the motives behind the theft. 调查人员只能对盗窃背后的动机进行推测。

conjoin.note:
The two companies agreed to conjoin their research and development efforts. 两家公司同意联合它们的研发力量。

Body and mind conjoin to influence our overall health and wellbeing. 身心结合在一起，影响着我们的整体健康和幸福。

conjure.meaning: v. 变戏法；想象出；召唤
conjure.note:
The street magician managed to conjure a coin from behind his ear. 街头魔术师设法从耳后变出一枚硬币。

The old song can instantly conjure up memories of his childhood. 这首老歌能瞬间唤起他童年的记忆。

connive.note:
Critics claimed the government chose to connive at illegal waste dumping. 批评者称政府选择默许违法的废弃物倾倒。

He was accused of trying to connive with corrupt officials. 他被指控企图与腐败官员串通勾结。

connotation.meaning: n. 含义；内涵；字面外的意义
connotation.note:
The word 'home' carries a warm, emotional connotation of safety and comfort. “家”这个词带有安全和舒适的温暖情感内涵。

Some political terms carry a strong negative connotation. 某些政治术语带有强烈的负面含义。

conquest.note:
The Norman conquest of England in 1066 changed the course of history. 1066年诺曼人对英格兰的征服改变了历史进程。

Historians studied the economic impacts of the empire's military conquests. 历史学家研究了帝国军事征服带来的经济影响。

conscript.meaning: n. 征召兵；义务兵 v. 强征入伍
conscript.note:
The government passed a law to conscript young men into military service. 政府通过了一项法律，强征年轻男子服兵役。

Untrained conscripts were quickly sent to the front lines of the battle. 未经训练的义务兵被迅速送往战斗前线。

consequential.meaning: adj. 重要的；作为结果的
consequential.note:
The committee made a consequential decision regarding the future of the company. 委员会就公司的未来做出了一项重大的决定。

Environmental damage is often the consequential result of rapid industrialization. 环境破坏往往是快速工业化带来的必然结果。

conservatory.meaning: n. 音乐学院；温室；花房
conservatory.note:
She studied violin at a prestigious music conservatory in Paris. 她在巴黎的一家著名音乐学院学习小提琴。

Tropical plants thrive inside the glass walls of the botanical conservatory. 热带植物在植物温室的玻璃墙内茁壮生长。

considerable.meaning: adj. 相当大的；相当多的
considerable.note:
The project required a considerable amount of time and financial investment. 该项目需要花费相当多的时间和资金投入。

There is a considerable difference between their two proposals. 他们的两项提议之间存在相当大的差距。

consign.note:
The merchant decided to consign the surplus goods to a local store. 商人决定把多余的货物寄售给一家本地商店。

He was forced to consign his old worn-out car to the scrap yard. 他被迫把那辆破旧的老车送到了废品回收场。

console.meaning: v. 安慰；抚慰 n. 控制台
console.note:
She tried to console her weeping friend after the heartbreaking news. 在听到令人心碎的消息后，她试图安慰哭泣的朋友。

The pilot checked the glowing switches on the main cockpit console. 飞行员检查了主驾驶舱控制台上发光的开关。

consonant.meaning: adj. 一致的；和谐的 n. 辅音
consonant.note:
Her ethical beliefs are entirely consonant with the mission of the organization. 她的道德信仰与该组织的使命完全一致。

The word 'cat' begins and ends with a consonant sound. 单词“cat”以辅音音标开头和结尾。

conspire.meaning: v. 密谋；共谋；协同起作用
conspire.note:
The executives were found guilty of trying to conspire against competitors. 高管被判犯有企图合谋对抗竞争对手的罪行。

Bad weather and traffic seemed to conspire to make me late for the meeting. 恶劣的天气和交通似乎狼狈为奸，导致我开会迟到了。

constant.meaning: adj. 持续不断的；恒定的 n. 常数
constant.note:
The machinery ran with a constant hum throughout the night. 机械整夜发出持续不断的嗡嗡声。

Gravity is treated as a constant in these basic physics equations. 在这些基础物理方程中，重力被视为常数。

consternation.meaning: n. 惊愕；惊恐；大为震惊
consternation.note:
The sudden announcement of layoffs caused widespread consternation among employees. 突然宣布裁员在员工中引起了广泛的惊恐。

To her great consternation, she realized she had lost her passport. 令她大为震惊的是，她意识到自己把护照弄丢了。

constituent.meaning: n. 选民；成分 adj. 构成的
constituent.note:
The politician spent the weekend meeting with local voters and constituents. 这位政治家周末与当地选民和支持者会面。

Water is the main constituent of the human body's physical makeup. 水是人体物理构成的最主要成分。

constrained.meaning: adj. 受限制的；不自然的；强迫的
constrained.note:
His smile looked a bit constrained during the awkward social gathering. 在尴尬的社交聚会上，他的笑容看起来有些不自然。

The company operated under constrained financial conditions for months. 公司在资金受限的条件下运营了数月。

constrict.note:
Certain types of cold medicine can cause blood vessels to constrict. 某些种类的感冒药会导致血管收缩。

Tight collars can feel as though they constrict your breathing. 紧领子可能会让人觉得勒得呼吸困难。

construct.meaning: v. 建造；构筑 n. 构想；观念
construct.note:
Workers will construct a new bridge across the river next year. 工人们明年将在河上建造一座新桥。

Race is often viewed by sociologists as a social construct. 社会学家通常将种族视为一种社会构想。

construe.meaning: v. 解释；理解；分析语法
construe.note:
Her silence was construed by the press as an admission of guilt. 媒体把她的沉默解释为默认有罪。

It is easy to misconstrue remarks made during casual online chats. 很容易误解日常网络聊天中说的话。

consul.note:
He worked as a trade consul representing his country in foreign markets. 他曾担任代表本国在外国市场的贸易领事。

Citizens can visit the local embassy or consul for passport assistance. 公民可以访问当地的大使馆或领事馆以获得护照帮助。

consummate.meaning: adj. 造诣高超的；完美的 v. 圆房；完成
consummate.note:
She is a consummate professional who handles every crisis with ease. 她是一位造诣高超的专业人士，能轻松处理每场危机。

The legal agreement was officially consummated with the final signatures. 随着最后签字，法律协议正式得以圆满完成。

contact.meaning: n. 接触；联系 v. 联系
contact.note:
Please keep in contact with me while you are traveling abroad. 你在国外旅游期间请与我保持联系。

The two surfaces came into direct contact during the experiment. 实验期间两个表面发生了直接接触。

contagious.meaning: adj. 接触传染的；有感染力的
contagious.note:
The flu is a highly contagious respiratory illness during winter. 流感在冬季是一种高度接触传染的呼吸道疾病。

His enthusiasm and positive energy were completely contagious. 他的热情和正能量极具感染力。

contain.note:
This box contains a collection of old family photographs. 这个箱子里包含着一叠旧家庭照片。

Firefighters struggled to contain the wildfire spread by strong winds. 消防员奋力控制由大风蔓延开来的野火。

containment.meaning: n. 控制；遏制；阻止蔓延
containment.note:
The primary goal of firefighters was the containment of the chemical spill. 消防员的首要目标是控制化学品泄漏的蔓延。

Cold War policies focused heavily on the containment of communist influence. 冷战政策严重侧重于遏制共产主义的影响力。

contaminate.note:
Industrial waste leaked into the river and began to contaminate the water supply. 工业废料泄漏到河里，开始污染供水系统。

Careless handling can easily contaminate the laboratory test samples. 不小心的处理很容易污染实验室的测试样本。

contemptible.note:
Stealing money from a charity is a truly contemptible act. 从慈善机构偷钱是一种真正可鄙的行为。

His dishonest behavior made him look contemptible in the eyes of his peers. 他不诚实的表现让他在同伴眼中显得十分卑劣。

contemptuous.note:
She gave him a contemptuous look and walked away without a word. 她轻蔑地看了他一眼，一言不发地走开了。

His contemptuous remarks about local customs offended the residents. 他对当地风俗的轻蔑言论冒犯了居民。

content.meaning: n. 内容；目录 adj. 满意的 v. 使满足
content.note:
You should check the table of contents before reading the whole book. 在阅读整本书之前，你应该先查看目录。

He is content with his quiet life in the countryside. 他对自己在乡村的平静生活感到很满意。

contented.note:
She looked relaxed and contented as she read her book in the garden. 她在花园里看书时，看起来放松而又满足。

A contented smile crossed his face after he finished a good meal. 美餐一顿后，他的脸上露出了满意的笑容。

contentious.meaning: adj. 有争议的；好争吵的
contentious.note:
Tax reform remains a highly contentious issue in parliament. 税收改革在议会中仍然是一个高度有争议的问题。

The politician avoided making contentious statements during the interview. 这位政治家在采访中避免发表引起争议的言论。

contest.meaning: n. 竞赛；比赛 v. 竞争；质疑
contest.note:
She decided to enter the national creative writing contest. 她决定参加全国创意写作比赛。

The candidate plans to contest the election results in court. 该候选人计划在法庭上对选举结果提出质疑。

context.note:
You cannot understand this sentence without looking at its broader context. 不看更广泛的上下文，你就无法理解这句话。

The historical context of the painting helps explain its symbolic meaning. 这幅画的历史背景有助于解释其象征意义。

contiguous.note:
The continental United States consists of forty-eight contiguous states. 美国本土由四十八个相邻的州组成。

Their properties are contiguous, sharing a long wooden fence. 他们的房产是毗邻的，共用一长段木栅栏。

continent.note:
Asia is the largest and most populous continent in the world. 亚洲是世界上最大、人口最多的大洲。

Migratory birds fly across continents twice a year. 候鸟每年飞越大陆两次。

continuation.note:
The book is a direct continuation of the author's previous novel. 这本书是作者上一部小说的直接延续。

We hope for the continuation of peace talks between the two countries. 我们希望两国之间的和平会谈得以继续。

contort.note:
His face contorted in pain after he twisted his ankle. 他扭伤脚踝后，脸因疼痛而扭曲了。

Strong winds can contort the branches of exposed mountain trees. 强风会使暴露在外的山树枝条扭曲变形。

contraband.note:
Customs officers searched the ship and found hidden contraband. 海关官员搜查了这艘船，发现了藏匿的违禁品。

Smugglers tried to bring illegal contraband across the border at night. 走私者试图在夜间将非法违禁品运过边境。

contract.meaning: n. 合同 v. 签约；收缩
contract.note:
Both parties signed a legal contract before starting the business venture. 双方在开启商业合资企业前签署了法律合同。

Metal tends to contract when the temperature drops. 金属在温度下降时往往会收缩。

contradictory.note:
The two witnesses provided contradictory accounts of the accident. 两位目击者对这起事故提供了相互矛盾的陈述。

It is confusing when official reports contain contradictory information. 当官方报告包含相互矛盾的信息时，这让人感到困惑。

contrast.meaning: n. 对比；对照 v. 对比
contrast.note:
The sharp contrast between rich and poor is a major social issue. 贫富之间的鲜明对比是一个重大的社会问题。

If you contrast the two designs, you will see the differences clearly. 如果你对比这两种设计，你会清楚地看到区别。

contravene.meaning: v. 违反；触犯（法律或规则）
contravene.note:
The company's actions were found to contravene environmental protection laws. 经查，该公司的行为违反了环境保护法。

Building without a permit will contravene local municipal codes. 无证建设将违反当地的市政法规。

contrite.note:
He looked genuinely contrite after realizing the trouble he had caused. 在意识到自己造成的麻烦后，他看起来确实十分后悔。

The judge reduced his sentence because the young offender seemed truly contrite. 法官减轻了他的刑罚，因为这个年轻的违法者看起来真心悔悟了。

contrition.note:
He expressed deep contrition for his past mistakes during the hearing. 在听证会上，他对自己过去的错误表达了深深的悔意。

Her words showed true contrition rather than just superficial regret. 她的言语表现出真正的悔悟，而不仅仅是表面的遗憾。

contrive.meaning: v. 谋划；设计；设法做到
contrive.note:
They managed to contrive a clever plan to escape from the room. 他们设法策划了一个巧妙的计划逃出房间。

She contrived to finish the project on time despite having limited resources. 尽管资源有限，她还是设法按时完成了项目。

contrived.meaning: adj. 人为的；不自然的；做作的
contrived.note:
The film's happy ending felt a bit contrived and unconvincing. 这部电影的大团圆结局让人觉得有点生硬和没有说服力。

His polite laughter sounded forced and thoroughly contrived. 他礼貌的笑声听起来很勉强，而且完全很不自然。

control.meaning: n. 控制；操纵 v. 控制
control.note:
The driver lost control of the car on the icy winter road. 司机在结冰的冬日道路上失去了对汽车的控制。

Parents try to control how much screen time their children have. 家长试图控制孩子们的屏幕使用时间。

controvert.note:
Scientists tried to controvert the flawed theory with new experimental data. 科学家试图用新的实验资料来反驳这个有缺陷的理论。

It is hard to controvert facts that have been proven repeatedly. 很难反驳那些已经被反复证明的事实。

contumacious.meaning: adj. 倔强的；抗命的；不服从的
contumacious.note:
The contumacious witness refused to answer questions posed by the court. 这个抗命的证人拒绝回答法庭提出的问题。

His contumacious attitude towards authority landed him in severe trouble. 他对权威的抗命不驯态度给他带来了严重的麻烦。

convalesce.note:
After major surgery, she went to the countryside to convalesce. 大型手术后，她去乡下疗养恢复身体。

Patients need a quiet environment to convalesce properly after an illness. 病人在生病后需要一个安静的环境来好好康复。

convalescent.meaning: adj. 康复期的 n. 病愈期病人
convalescent.note:
The convalescent patient spent his afternoons reading books in the garden. 这个康复期的病人在花园里度过下午的看书时光。

A special home was established to care for elderly convalescent residents. 建立了一家专门的住宅来照顾年长的康复期居民。

convenience.meaning: n. 便利；方便；便利设施
convenience.note:
Shopping online offers great convenience for busy working professionals. 网购为忙碌的职场专业人士提供了极大的便利。

The hotel is located close to local transportation and shopping conveniences. 这家酒店地理位置优越，靠近当地交通和购物便利设施。

conventional.meaning: adj. 传统的；习惯的；常规的
conventional.note:
She preferred conventional teaching methods over modern online learning tools. 与现代在线学习工具相比，她更喜欢传统的教学方法。

The vehicle runs on a conventional gasoline engine rather than electricity. 这辆车使用的是常规汽油发动机，而不是电力。

convergent.note:
Scientists noticed convergent evolution in unrelated animal species. 科学家在毫无关联的动物物种中注意到了趋同进化。

The two rivers have a convergent flow that creates a wide delta. 这两条河流有着汇聚的水流，形成了一个宽阔的三角洲。

conversant.note:
He is well conversant with the complex details of international trade law. 他非常精通国际贸易法的复杂细节。

Staff must be conversant with basic emergency safety procedures. 员工必须熟悉基本的紧急安全程序。

converse.meaning: v. 交谈；谈话 n. 相反的事物 adj. 相反的
converse.note:
Neighbors stopped to converse pleasantly on the sidewalk. 邻居们在人行道上停下来愉快地交谈。

Wealth does not always guarantee happiness; the converse is often true. 财富并不总能保证幸福；相反的情况往往是真实的。

convert.meaning: v. 转变；转换；皈依 n. 皈依者
convert.note:
You can use this tool to convert PDF files into editable word documents. 你可以使用这个工具将PDF文件转换为可编辑的Word文档。

He decided to convert his old garage into a home office studio. 他决定把旧车库改建成一个家庭办公工作室。

convertible.meaning: adj. 可转换的 n. 敞篷车
convertible.note:
The sofa is easily convertible into a comfortable guest bed. 这张沙发很容易转换成一张舒适的客床。

They drove along the coastal road with the top down in a red convertible. 他们开着一辆红色的敞篷车，敞着顶棚沿着沿海公路行驶。

convex.note:
A convex mirror provides a wider field of view for drivers. 凸面镜为司机提供了更广阔的视野。

The outer surface of the spoon is curved and distinctly convex. 勺子的外表面是弯曲的，且明显是凸面的。

convey.note:
Words cannot fully convey how grateful I am for your help. 言语无法完全表达我对你帮助的感激之情。

Pipelines are used to convey oil and gas across long distances. 管道用于长距离运送石油和天然气。

convivial.meaning: adj. 欢乐的；好交际的；愉快的
convivial.note:
The restaurant is famous for its warm atmosphere and convivial crowd. 这家餐厅以温暖的氛围和欢乐的人群而闻名。

He enjoyed the convivial company of his old university friends. 他享受着老大学朋友们带来的愉快聚会陪伴。

conviviality.meaning: n. 欢乐；欢宴；社交的乐趣
conviviality.note:
The holiday dinner party was filled with laughter and natural conviviality. 节日晚宴上充满了欢声笑语和自然的社交乐趣。

She loved the warmth and conviviality of traditional family gatherings. 她热爱传统家庭聚会的温馨与欢快气氛。

convoke.note:
The prime minister decided to convoke an emergency session of parliament. 总理决定召集一次议会紧急会议。

University officials convoked a meeting to discuss campus policy changes. 大学官员召集了一次会议来讨论校园政策的变化。

convoluted.meaning: adj. 错综复杂的；晦涩难懂的
convoluted.note:
The tax instructions were so convoluted that nobody could understand them. 税务说明太错综复杂了，谁也看不懂。

She followed a convoluted path through the narrow streets of the old city. 她穿过古城狭窄的街道，走了一条曲折复杂的路。

convulse.meaning: v. 使震动；使抽搐；剧烈震动
convulse.note:
Severe laughter began to convulse the audience watching the comedy. 观看喜剧的观众因大笑而开始前俯后仰。

The sudden economic crisis convulsed financial markets worldwide. 突发的经济危机震撼了全球金融市场。

convulsion.note:
The child suffered a medical convulsion and was rushed to the hospital. 孩子突发惊厥痉挛，被紧急送往医院。

History books record the social convulsions that followed the revolution. 历史书记录了革命之后的社会大动荡。

copious.note:
Students took copious notes during the professor's informative lecture. 学生们在教授信息量丰富的讲座期间记了大量的笔记。

He drank copious amounts of water after running the marathon. 跑完马拉松后，他喝了大量的水。

core.meaning: n. 核心；果心 adj. 核心的
core.note:
Integrity is at the core of our company's corporate values. 诚信是我们公司企业价值观的核心。

She bit into the apple and threw the remaining hard core away. 她咬了一口苹果，把剩下的硬果核扔掉了。

cornucopia.note:
Autumn markets offered a true cornucopia of fresh fruits and vegetables. 秋季市场提供了丰富多彩的新鲜水果和蔬菜。

The internet serves as a cornucopia of information on almost any subject. 互联网几乎是任何主题的信息宝库。

coronation.note:
Thousands of citizens gathered in the capital to watch the royal coronation. 成千上万的市民聚集在首都观看皇家加冕典礼。

The historical crown was used during the monarch's formal coronation. 这顶历史悠久的王冠在君主的正式加冕典礼上被使用。

corporate.meaning: adj. 公司的；法人的；共同的
corporate.note:
She works as a lawyer in a large corporate firm downtown. 她在市中心一家大型公司担任律师。

The company announced new strategies to improve its corporate culture. 公司宣布了改善其企业文化的新战略。

corporeal.meaning: adj. 有形的；肉体的；物质的
corporeal.note:
Monks focused on spiritual matters rather than corporeal pleasures. 修士们专注于精神事务，而不是肉体享乐。

Ghosts are believed to lack a physical, corporeal form. 人们认为鬼魂缺乏物质的有形形态。

corpuscle.note:
Red blood corpuscles carry oxygen from the lungs to body tissues. 红血球将氧气从肺部输送到身体组织。

Microscopic corpuscles float freely within the circulating fluid. 微观血球在循环体液中自由漂浮。

corral.meaning: n. 畜栏 v. 把……赶入畜栏；聚集
corral.note:
Cowboys worked quickly to corral the horses before nightfall. 牛仔们在夜幕降临前迅速把马匹赶入畜栏。

Staff tried to corral stray documents scattered across the desk. 员工试图收集散落在桌子各处的零散文件。

corrode.note:
Salty sea air can quickly corrode unprotected iron and steel structures. 咸湿的海风会迅速腐蚀未加保护的铁和钢结构。

Acid rain began to corrode the surface of the old stone monuments. 酸雨开始腐蚀旧石碑的表面。

corrosive.note:
Workers handled the corrosive chemical solution with extreme caution. 工人们极其谨慎地处理具有腐蚀性的化学溶液。

Unchecked rumors had a corrosive effect on the morale of the team. 未加抑制的谣言对团队的士气产生了侵蚀性的影响。

corrugate.meaning: v. 使起波纹；使成褶皱
corrugate.note:
Machines are used to press and corrugate flat sheets of metal. 机器用于压制并使平板金属产生波纹。

He corrugated the cardboard to give it extra strength and rigidity. 他把纸板压成波纹状，以赋予其额外的强度和刚性。

corrugated.meaning: adj. 压瓦的；起波纹的；有褶皱的
corrugated.note:
The storage shed was built with corrugated metal sheets on the roof. 储藏室的屋顶是用瓦楞金属板建造的。

Cardboard boxes are usually made with a corrugated middle layer for strength. 纸箱通常在中间夹有一层波纹夹层以增加强度。

cosmic.note:
Astronomers study cosmic rays coming from distant deep space. 天文学家研究来自遥远深空的宇宙射线。

Human history seems very brief on a cosmic scale of time. 在宇宙的时间尺度上，人类历史显得非常短暂。

cosmopolitan.meaning: adj. 世界性的；见多识广的 n. 四海为家者
cosmopolitan.note:
New York is a vibrant and cosmopolitan city with diverse cultures. 纽约是一座充满活力、拥有多元文化的世界性城市。

Traveling extensively made him a true cosmopolitan. 广泛的旅行使他成为了一个真正的世界主义者。

cosmopolitanism.meaning: n. 世界主义；四海一家
cosmopolitanism.note:
The university promotes a spirit of cosmopolitanism and global awareness. 这大学弘扬世界主义和全球意识的精神。

His political philosophy embraced ideas of cosmopolitanism and open borders. 他的政治哲学包容了世界主义和开放边界的理念。

cosmos.note:
Scientists continue to explore the infinite mysteries of the cosmos. 科学家们继续探索宇宙的无限奥秘。

Ancient philosophers tried to understand the structure of the cosmos. 古代哲学家试图理解宇宙的结构。

cosset.note:
Parents should not excessively cosset their children from life's hardships. 父母不应该过度溺爱孩子，使他们免受生活艰难的困扰。

She tended to cosset her pampered pets with gourmet treats. 她倾向于用美食点心来宠爱她娇惯的宠物。

costume.note:
Children wore creative Halloween costumes to the school party. 孩子们穿着有创意的万圣节服装去参加学校派对。

The theater actors wore elaborate historical costumes on stage. 剧院演员在舞台上穿着制作精细的历史戏装。

coterie.note:
The famous author gathered with a tight coterie of intellectual friends. 这位著名作家与一小圈知识分子朋友聚在一起。

Decisions were made by a small coterie of elite political advisors. 决策是由一小圈精英政治顾问做出的。

coterminous.meaning: adj. 边界相同的；同时发生的
coterminous.note:
The two municipal districts are coterminous and share the same boundaries. 这两个市政区边界相同，拥有相同的分界线。

Her career success was coterminous with the growth of the tech industry. 她的职业生涯成功与科技产业的增长是同步的。

cougar.note:
Hikers were warned about wild cougars roaming the mountain trails. 徒步旅行者受到警告，提防在山间小径上游荡的野生美洲狮。

The elusive cougar is a solitary predator native to the Americas. 神秘的美洲狮是美洲本土的一种独居捕食者。

countenance.meaning: n. 面容；表情 v. 赞同；支持
countenance.note:
Her calm countenance revealed no hint of the panic she felt inside. 她平静的面容没有泄露出一丝内心的恐慌。

The committee refused to countenance any illegal financial activities. 委员会拒绝支持任何非法的金融活动。

counteract.note:
Medication was given to counteract the effects of the toxic poison. 给药是为了抵消剧毒的药效。

Drinking plenty of water helps counteract fatigue during long trips. 多喝水有助于在长途旅行中抵消疲劳。

counterbalance.meaning: n. 平衡力；抗衡因素 v. 使平衡
counterbalance.note:
Increased government spending acts as a counterbalance to economic decline. 增加政府开支可以作为经济下滑的平衡力量。

We must counterbalance risks with potential rewards before investing. 在投资之前，我们必须用潜在回报来平衡风险。

countermand.meaning: v. 撤销；下令取消（指令）
countermand.note:
The general had to countermand the previous attack order due to bad weather. 由于天气不好，将军不得不撤销先前的进攻命令。

Management decided to countermand the new office policy following employee complaints. 在员工投诉后，管理层决定撤销新的办公室政策。

counterproductive.meaning: adj. 事与愿违的；适得其反的
counterproductive.note:
Working excessive hours without breaks is ultimately counterproductive. 在没有休息的情况下工作过长时间最终会适得其反。

Strict punishments can be counterproductive when trying to encourage honesty. 在试图鼓励诚实坦白时，严厉的惩罚可能会适得其反。

covenant.meaning: n. 契约；盟约 v. 立约
covenant.note:
The two nations signed a formal covenant promising mutual defense. 两国签署了一项承诺共同防御的正式盟约。

Property deeds often contain restrictive covenants regarding building sizes. 房产契约通常包含关于建筑大小的限制性条款。

covert.note:
Intelligence agencies carried out covert operations to gather information. 情报机构开展秘密行动来搜集情报。

He gave her a covert glance across the crowded room. 他在拥挤的房间里偷偷瞥了她一眼。

covet.note:
Many young actors covet the prestigious film award. 许多年轻演员都渴望得到这个著名的电影奖项。

Do not covet your neighbor's wealth or possessions. 不要贪图你邻居的财富或财产。

coward.note:
He felt like a coward for running away from his responsibilities. 因为逃避责任，他觉得自己像个懦夫。

Bullies are often cowards at heart when confronted directly. 当被直接对质时，霸凌者内心往往都是胆小鬼。

cower.meaning: v. 畏缩；蜷缩；惊恐退缩
cower.note:
The stray dog began to cower in fear during the loud thunderstorm. 在轰鸣的雷暴中，这只流浪狗因恐惧而蜷缩起来。

Citizens cowered under tables as the sudden earthquake shook the building. 突然的地震震动大楼时，市民们惊恐地缩在桌子底下。

coy.meaning: adj. 羞涩的；腼腆的；故作神秘的
coy.note:
She gave a coy smile when asked about her future career plans. 当被问及未来的职业规划时，她露出了羞涩的微笑。

He remained coy about the details of his upcoming business project. 他对即将到来的商业项目细节保持着故作神秘的态度。

cozen.note:
The dishonest salesman tried to cozen customers into buying faulty products. 这个不诚实的推销员试图哄骗顾客购买有缺陷的产品。

She was cozened out of her life savings by a smooth-talking fraudster. 她被一个口齿伶俐的骗子骗走了毕生积蓄。

crabbed.meaning: adj. 难懂的（字迹）；脾气暴躁的
crabbed.note:
The old diary was written in a tight and crabbed handwriting. 那本旧日记是用紧凑且难以辨认的字迹写的。

He grew increasingly crabbed and irritable as he aged. 随着年龄的增长，他变得越来越暴躁易怒。

crack.meaning: v. 破裂；发出爆裂声 n. 裂缝；声响
crack.note:
A small crack appeared on the windshield after a stone hit it. 石头击中挡风玻璃后，上面出现了一条小裂缝。

Lightning flashed and a loud crack of thunder shook the windows. 闪电划过，一声巨大的雷声震动了窗户。

cram.meaning: v. 填塞；塞满；突击备考
cram.note:
Students stayed up all night to cram for the difficult final exams. 学生们熬夜通宵突击复习以应对困难的期末考试。

He tried to cram too many clothes into his small suitcase. 他试图把太多的衣服塞进他狭小的行李箱里。

cramp.meaning: n. 抽筋；绞痛 v. 限制；束缚
cramp.note:
She developed a painful leg cramp while swimming in the deep pool. 在深水池游泳时，她的腿抽筋了，疼痛难忍。

High living costs can cramp a young family's financial freedom. 高昂的生活成本会限制年轻家庭的财务自由。

cranky.meaning: adj. 暴躁的；怪癖的；古怪的
cranky.note:
The tired toddler became very cranky late in the afternoon. 累了的幼儿在下午晚些时候变得非常暴躁。

He spent hours trying to fix his cranky old printer. 他花了几个小时试图修理他那台毛病百出的老旧打印机。

crass.meaning: adj. 愚钝的；粗俗的；极其粗鲁的
crass.note:
His crass comments about her personal life offended everyone at the table. 他关于她私生活的粗俗言论冒犯了桌上的所有人。

The company suffered due to crass managerial errors and poor judgment. 公司因愚蠢的管理失误和糟糕的判断而遭受损失。

crater.meaning: n. 火山口；弹坑；陨石坑
crater.note:
Astronauts explored the deep volcanic crater on the distant moon. 宇航员探索了远方卫星上的深火山口。

The explosion left a massive crater in the middle of the street. 爆炸在街道中间留下了一个巨大的弹坑。

cravat.note:
The gentleman wore a silk cravat tucked neatly inside his vest. 这位绅士戴着一条整齐地掖在马甲里的丝绸领巾。

Historical portraits often feature noblemen wearing elegant white cravats. 历史画像中经常描绘贵族佩戴优雅的白色颈巾。

craven.meaning: adj. 懦弱的；怯懦的 n. 懦夫
craven.note:
His craven refusal to stand up for his friends shocked the team. 他懦弱地拒绝为朋友挺身而出，这震惊了团队。

Only a craven individual would run away from such a minor challenge. 只有懦夫才会从这么小的挑战面前逃跑。

craving.note:
She suddenly developed a strong craving for chocolate ice cream. 她突然对巧克力冰淇淋产生了强烈的渴望。

Pregnant women often experience unusual dietary cravings. 孕妇经常会有不寻常的饮食渴望。

crayon.note:
The young children drew colorful pictures using wax crayons. 小孩子们用蜡笔画了色彩缤纷的画。

She accidentally broke her red drawing crayon into two pieces. 她不小心把红色的画画蜡笔折成了两半。

crease.meaning: n. 折痕；皱褶 v. 弄皱
crease.note:
He ironed his trousers carefully to make a sharp front crease. 他仔细熨烫裤子，使其前面有一道挺括的折痕。

Be careful not to fold or crease the official paper documents. 注意不要折叠或弄皱官方纸质文件。

credence.note:
Recent discoveries lend scientific credence to the old legend. 最近的发现为这个古老的传说增添了科学依据。

Do not give any credence to unverified internet rumors. 不要相信任何未经证实的网络谣言。

credit.meaning: n. 信用；学分；赞扬 v. 归功于
credit.note:
Students need a certain number of credits to graduate from university. 学生需要一定数量的学分才能从大学毕业。

She gave her team full credit for the success of the project. 她将项目的成功完全归功于她的团队。

credulous.note:
The con artist easily tricked credulous tourists into buying fake antiques. 骗子轻易地哄骗轻信的游客购买假古董。

Only a credulous person would believe such an absurd story. 只有轻信的人才会相信如此荒谬的故事。

creek.note:
Children built a small wooden bridge across the shallow woodland creek. 孩子们在浅浅的林间小溪上建造了一座小木桥。

Clear water flowed gently down the rocky mountain creek. 清澈的水顺着多岩石的山间小溪静静流淌。

crescendo.meaning: n. 渐强；高潮 v. 渐强
crescendo.note:
The musical performance built to a dramatic and powerful crescendo. 音乐演奏达到了一种戏剧性且强烈的渐强高潮。

Protests outside the building reached a noisy crescendo by evening. 建筑物外的抗议活动在傍晚时分达到了喧闹的高潮。

crestfallen.meaning: adj. 垂头丧气的；沮丧的
crestfallen.note:
He looked crestfallen after failing to make the school sports team. 未能入选学校运动队后，他看起来垂头丧气的。

She tried to comfort her crestfallen daughter after the competition. 比赛结束后，她试图安慰沮丧的女儿。

cringe.meaning: v. 畏缩；感到难堪；尴尬
cringe.note:
He cringed in fear when the angry dog started barking loudly. 当愤怒的狗大声吠叫时，他吓得畏缩了一下。

I cringe whenever I think about the silly speech I gave yesterday.每当想起昨天发表的愚蠢演讲，我都觉得尴尬得起鸡皮疙瘩。

cringing.meaning: adj. 卑躬屈膝的；谄媚畏缩的
cringing.note:
His cringing behavior did not win him any respect from his boss. 他卑躬屈膝的表现并没有赢得老板的任何尊重。

She hated the cringing attitude of people begging for favors. 她讨厌那些为求恩惠而谄媚畏缩的人的态度。

critic.meaning: n. 批评家；评论家；挑剔的人
critic.note:
The restaurant review was written by a well-known food critic. 这篇餐馆评论是由一位著名的美食评论家写的。

Despite fierce critics, the director defended his artistic choices. 尽管面对激烈的批评家，导演还是为自己的艺术选择进行了辩护。

critical.meaning: adj. 批评的；关键的；危急的
critical.note:
Water is a critical resource for survival in the desert region. 水是沙漠地区生存的关键资源。

Doctors stated that the injured patient remains in critical condition. 医生表示，受伤的病人仍然处于危急状态。

croak.meaning: v. 呱呱叫；低沉沙哑地说 n. 蛙鸣声
croak.note:
Frogs began to croak loudly by the edge of the pond at night. 夜晚，青蛙在池塘边开始大声呱呱叫。

He spoke in a low croak due to his bad cold and sore throat. 因为重感冒和喉咙痛，他用沙哑低沉的声音说话。

crochet.meaning: v. 钩针编织 n. 钩针织物
crochet.note:
Grandmother spent her evenings sitting by the window to crochet blankets. 奶奶晚上坐在窗前钩针编织毯子。

She wore a delicate handmade wool crochet scarf around her neck. 她脖子上围着一条精致的手工羊毛钩针编织围巾。

crockery.note:
She packed the fragile kitchen crockery carefully into cardboard boxes. 她小心翼翼地把易碎的厨房陶器打包进纸箱里。

Traditional glazed crockery is displayed on the wooden shelves. 传统的上釉陶器陈列在木制架子上。

cronyism.meaning: n. 任人唯亲；裙带关系
cronyism.note:
The administration was accused of political corruption and cronyism. 政府被指控存在政治腐败和任人唯亲。

Fair hiring practices help prevent nepotism and cronyism in the workplace. 公平的招聘实践有助于防止职场中的裙带关系和任人唯亲。

crook.meaning: n. 弯曲处；骗子 v. 使弯曲
crook.note:
She held the sleeping baby securely in the crook of her arm. 她把睡着的婴儿稳稳地抱在手臂弯曲处。

He bent his finger and used it to crook the heavy drawer open. 他弯曲手指，用它把沉重的抽屉勾开。

crudity.meaning: n. 粗糙；粗鲁；粗俗的话语
crudity.note:
Everyone was shocked by the crude vulgarity and crudity of his remarks. 大家都被他言论中粗俗的粗鲁所震惊。

The early prototype showed a certain technical crudity compared to later models. 与后来的型号相比，早期的原型机表现出一定的技术粗糙性。

crumple.note:
He wrote a draft letter and then decided to crumple it up in frustration. 他写了一封草稿信，然后沮丧地决定把它揉成一团。

The runner started to crumple from exhaustion near the finish line. 赛跑者在终点线附近因精疲力竭而开始瘫倒。

crusade.meaning: n. 十字军东征；社会变革运动 v. 发起运动
crusade.note:
Historical crusades shaped the political and religious landscape of Europe. 历史上的十字军东征塑造了欧洲的政治和宗教格局。

She launched a public crusade against unhealthy food marketing to children. 她发起了一场反对向儿童营销不健康食品的公开社会运动。

crutch.note:
He had to walk on wooden crutches after breaking his leg in a skiing accident. 在滑雪事故中摔断腿后，他不得不靠木拐杖走路。

Technology should be a tool for learning, not a mental crutch. 技术应该是学习的工具，而不是精神上的依赖支柱。

crux.note:
We have reached the crux of the matter during today's discussion. 在今天的讨论中，我们已经触及了事情的关键核心。

Funding shortage is the ultimate crux of the entire research project. 资金短缺是整个研究项目的终极难点。

cryogenic.note:
Liquid nitrogen is widely used in cryogenic engineering and research. 液氮广泛应用于低温工程和研究中。

Biological samples were preserved safely in a cryogenic storage tank. 生物样本被安全地保存在低温储罐中。

cryptic.meaning: adj. 神秘的；含义晦涩的
cryptic.note:
He left a cryptic note on the desk before disappearing without explanation. 他在没有解释的情况下消失前，在桌上留了一张神秘的便条。
