Corrupt officials became enmeshed in their own lies. 腐败官员陷入了他们自己编造的谎言中。

ennui.note:
A deep sense of ennui settled over him during the long vacation. 长假期间，一种深深的无聊倦怠感笼罩着他。

Travel can sometimes cure the routine ennui of daily life. 旅行有时能治愈日常生活中的例行无聊感。

enormity.meaning: n. 极恶，深重罪行，巨大（多用于坏事）
enormity.note:
They failed to realize the enormity of their crime at first. 起初他们没有意识到自己罪行的严重性。

We were shocked by the sheer enormity of the destruction. 毁灭的巨大严重程度震惊了我们。

enormous.note:
The project required an enormous amount of time and effort. 这个项目需要耗费巨量的时间和精力。

An enormous elephant stood in the center of the reserve. 一头巨大的大象站在保护区中央。

enrapture.note:
The violin solo continued to enrapture the audience. 小提琴独奏继续让观众陶醉狂喜。

Children were enraptured by the colorful magic show. 孩子们被丰富多彩的魔术表演深深吸引住了。

ensconce.note:
She quickly got ensconced in a comfortable armchair with a book. 她迅速舒舒服服地安坐在扶手椅里看书。

He safely ensconced himself in his private office. 他安安稳稳地待在自己的私人办公室里。

ensign.note:
The naval ship flew its national ensign proudly. 这艘海军军舰自豪地升起了国旗。

The young graduate received his promotion to ensign. 这位年轻毕业生获得了少尉军衔的晋升。

ensue.meaning: v. 因而发生，接着发生
ensue.note:
An argument broke out, and a fight soon ensued. 争吵爆发了，紧接着发生了一场打斗。

He resigned, and chaos ensued in the department. 他辞职了，部门里随之陷入混乱。

ensure.note:
Please double-check the lock to ensure security. 请再次检查锁以确保安全。

Early preparation can ensure exam success. 早期准备可以确保考试成功。

entail.note:
The new job will entail a lot of overseas travel. 这份新工作将需要大量的海外出差。

Such a big project entails considerable financial risks. 这样的大项目必然伴随着相当大的财务风险。

entangle.meaning: v. 使纠缠，使陷入，连累
entangle.note:
The dolphin was found entangled in fishing nets. 这只海豚被发现缠在了渔网里。

Avoid getting entangled in office politics. 避免卷入办公室政治。

enthralling.meaning: adj. 迷人的，引人入胜的
enthralling.note:
The speaker gave an enthralling presentation on space exploration. 演讲者做了一场关于太空探索的引人入胜的演讲。

We found the detective novel completely enthralling. 我们发现这本侦探小说极具吸引力。

entice.note:
The store used discounts to entice customers inside. 商店用折扣来引诱顾客进店。

She tried to entice the cat down with a piece of fish. 她试图用一块鱼把猫引诱下来。

entirety.note:
I read the historical document in its entirety. 我完整地阅读了这份历史文件。

The movie captures the complexity of human life in its entirety. 这部电影全盘捕捉了人类生活的复杂性。

entrancing.note:
She played an entrancing melody on the flute. 她用长笛吹奏了一首迷人的旋律。

The garden looked entrancing in the twilight. 黄昏时分的花园看起来十分迷人。

entreat.note:
She tried to entreat him to stay a little longer. 她试图恳求他再多留一会儿。

They did entreat the judge for mercy. 他们确实向法官恳求宽大处理。

entreaty.note:
His heartfelt entreaty finally melted her heart. 他发自内心的恳求终于打动了她的心。

She ignored all entreaties to change her mind. 她无视了所有让她改变主意的恳求。

entrepreneur.note:
The young entrepreneur launched a successful tech startup. 这位年轻的企业家创办了一家成功的科技初创公司。

Being a successful entrepreneur requires risk-taking. 成为一名成功的创业者需要承担风险。

entrust.note:
She chose to entrust her savings to a reliable bank. 她选择将积蓄委托给一家可靠的银行。

He was entrusted with leading the new project team. 他受命负责领导新的项目团队。

enumerate.note:
The report will enumerate the causes of the economic crisis. 该报告将列举经济危机的成因。

Let me enumerate the benefits of joining our club. 让我列举一下加入我们俱乐部的益处。

enunciate.note:
Please speak clearly and enunciate every word. 请清晰说话并读准每个字。

The philosopher tried to enunciate a new theory of ethics. 这位哲学家试图阐明一种新的伦理学理论。

environ.note:
Tall mountains environ the small peaceful valley. 高山环绕着这个宁静的小山谷。

Thick forests environ the old castle walls. 茂密的森林包围着古老的城堡墙壁。

enzyme.note:
Digestive enzymes help break down food in the stomach. 消化酶有助于分解胃里的食物。

Scientific research explores how enzymes accelerate chemical reactions. 科学研究探讨酶如何加速化学反应。

epic.meaning: n. 史诗，叙事诗 adj. 宏大的，史诗般的
epic.note:
The film tells an epic tale of adventure and survival. 这部电影讲述了一个关于冒险与生存的史诗般的故事。

The storm caused epic damage to the coastal towns. 这场风暴对沿海城镇造成了巨大的破坏。

epicure.note:
He is an epicure who travels the world in search of fine dining. 他是一个为了寻找精美大餐而周游世界的美食家。

The restaurant menu is designed to satisfy the most demanding epicures. 这家餐厅的菜单旨在满足最挑剔的美食家。

epidermis.note:
Sunlight penetrates the outer layer of the epidermis. 阳光穿透了表皮的外层。

The epidermis protects the body from harmful external elements. 表皮保护身体免受有害外部因素的侵害。

epigram.note:
His speech was full of witty epigrams. 他的演讲充满了机智的警句。

The writer is famous for his clever epigram about modern society. 这位作家以他关于现代社会的聪明的讽刺短诗而闻名。

epilogue.note:
The novel has an epilogue that explains what happened to the characters years later. 这部小说有一个尾声，解释了多年后人物们的命运。

An epilogue was added to the play to wrap up the main themes. 戏剧中增加了一个尾声来总结主题。

episodic.meaning: adj. 插曲式的，松散的，断断续续的
episodic.note:
The narrative has an episodic structure, featuring various independent stories. 叙事具有分集结构，包含各个独立的故事。

Her illness was episodic, with periods of recovery followed by relapse. 她的病情是阵发性的，经历恢复期后又会复发。

epitaph.note:
He chose a simple epigram as his own epitaph. 他选择了一句简单的短诗作为自己的墓志铭。

The ancient stone bore a touching epitaph for the fallen soldier. 那块古老的石头上刻着一段献给阵亡士兵的感人碑文。

epithet.note:
The city earned the flattering epithet of 'The City of Dreams'. 这座城市赢得了“梦想之城”的美誉。

He shouted a derogatory epithet at the driver. 他向司机大声喊出一个贬义的称呼。

epitome.note:
She is the epitome of elegance and grace. 她是优雅与风度的化身。

His latest collection is the epitome of modern fashion. 他最新的服装系列是现代时尚的缩影。

epitomize.note:
His work tends to epitomize the artistic spirit of the era. 他的作品往往体现了那个时代的艺术精神。

The building is designed to epitomize sustainable architecture. 这座建筑旨在成为可持续建筑的典范。

equable.meaning: adj. 脾气温和的，稳定的，温和的（气候等）
equable.note:
He has an equable temperament and rarely gets angry. 他脾气温和，很少生气。

The island enjoys an equable climate year-round. 这个岛屿全年享有温和宜人的气候。

equanimity.note:
She accepted the bad news with remarkable equanimity. 她以惊人的镇静接受了这个坏消息。

Keeping your equanimity during a crisis is a valuable skill. 在危机中保持镇静是一项宝贵的技能。

equate.note:
You should not equate wealth with success. 你不应该把财富与成功等同起来。

Many people mistakenly equate being busy with being productive. 许多人错误地把忙碌等同于高效率。

equilibrium.meaning: n. 平衡，均衡，心理平衡
equilibrium.note:
The central bank intervened to maintain economic equilibrium. 中央银行进行干预以维持经济平衡。

It took her a while to regain her emotional equilibrium after the shock. 受到惊吓后，她花了一段时间才恢复情绪平衡。

equine.meaning: adj. 马的，似马的 n. 马科动物
equine.note:
Veterinarians specializing in equine care gathered for a conference. 专攻马类护理的兽医们聚集在一起开会。

The painting captured the graceful equine posture. 这幅画捕捉了马优美的姿态。

equity.meaning: n. 公平，公正；资产净值，股票
equity.note:
The policy aims to promote social justice and equity. 该政策旨在促进社会公正与公平。

Homeowners can borrow against the equity in their houses. 房主可以利用房屋资产净值贷款。

equivalent.meaning: adj. 相等的，相当的 n. 相等物
equivalent.note:
A euro is roughly equivalent to a certain amount of dollars. 一欧元大致相当于一定数量的美元。

Is there an English equivalent for this foreign word? 这个外来词有对应的英语单词吗？

equivocate.meaning: v. 支吾其词，模棱两可，说含糊话
equivocate.note:
When asked about the missing funds, the manager began to equivocate. 当被问及失踪的资金时，经理开始支吾其词。

Politicians often equivocate to avoid taking a firm stance. 政客们经常模棱两可，以避免表明坚定的立场。

equivocation.meaning: n. 模棱两可的话，含糊其辞
equivocation.note:
We want a clear answer, with no room for equivocation. 我们需要一个明确的答案，不容有任何模棱两可的余地。

His speech was full of clever equivocation. 他的演讲充满了聪明的含糊其辞。

eradicate.note:
Global health campaigns aim to eradicate diseases like polio. 全球卫生运动旨在根除脊髓灰质炎等疾病。

Efforts are underway to eradicate poverty in rural areas. 消除农村贫困的努力正在进行中。

erase.note:
He used a rubber to erase the mistake from the paper. 他用橡皮擦掉了纸上的错误。

Time cannot easily erase painful memories. 时间不容易抹去痛苦的回忆。

erasure.note:
The document showed signs of careful erasure and rewriting. 这份文件显示出有仔细擦除和重写的痕迹。

Activists fight against the cultural erasure of minority groups. 少数群体积极抗击文化被抹杀的现象。

err.note:
To err is human; to forgive, divine. 人非圣贤，孰能无过；原谅他人，实乃神圣。

The system is programmed not to err under normal conditions. 该系统被编程为在正常情况下不出错。

errand.note:
She went out to run a few errands for her grandmother. 她出门为她奶奶跑了几趟腿办点事。

I have to finish some urgent errands before noon. 我必须在中午前办完一些紧急的差事。

erratic.meaning: adj. 不稳定的，古怪的，反复无常的
erratic.note:
The patient's erratic heartbeat required close medical monitoring. 病人不稳定得不规律的心跳需要严密的医学监测。

His erratic behavior worried his colleagues. 他古怪的行为让同事们感到担忧。

ersatz.meaning: adj. 人造的，仿造的，替代的
ersatz.note:
During the shortage, people had to use ersatz coffee. 短缺期间，人们不得不使用人造咖啡代用品。

She disliked the taste of ersatz sweeteners. 她不喜欢人造甜味剂的味道。

erstwhile.note:
The two erstwhile rivals decided to form a business partnership. 这两个以前的竞争对手决定建立商业合作伙伴关系。

He met with his erstwhile colleagues at the reunion. 他在同学聚会上见到了他以前的同事们。

erudite.note:
The professor gave an erudite lecture on ancient philosophy. 这位教授发表了一场关于古代哲学的博学讲座。

His library was filled with erudite books. 他的图书馆里摆满了饱学的书籍。

erupt.meaning: v. 爆发，喷发，突然发生
erupt.note:
The volcano could erupt at any moment. 这座火山随时可能喷发。

Protests erupted across the city following the announcement. 宣布消息后，抗议活动在全市爆发。

escalation.note:
Diplomats are trying to prevent a further escalation of the conflict. 外交官们正试图阻止冲突进一步升级。

The rapid escalation of housing prices is alarming. 房价的迅速上涨令人担忧。

escapism.meaning: n. 逃避现实，遁世主义
escapism.note:
Many people read fantasy novels as a form of escapism. 许多人阅读奇幻小说作为逃避现实的一种方式。

Movies offer a temporary escape from daily stress. 电影提供了暂时逃避日常生活压力的途径。

eschew.note:
He decided to eschew meat and adopt a vegan diet. 他决定戒掉肉类，采用纯素食饮食。

As a matter of principle, she chose to eschew luxury. 出于原则，她选择远离奢侈生活。

esophagus.note:
Food passes from the mouth down the esophagus into the stomach. 食物从口腔通过食道进入胃部。

Acid reflux can irritate the lining of the esophagus. 酸反流会刺激食道内壁。

espionage.meaning: n. 间谍活动，刺探情报
espionage.note:
He was accused of industrial espionage and stealing trade secrets. 他被指控犯有工业间谍罪并窃取商业机密。

The novel is a thrilling tale of wartime espionage. 这部小说是一个关于战时间谍活动惊险故事。

espousal.note:
His public espousal of environmental causes won him support. 他对环保事业的公开支持赢得了支持。

Her open espousal of democratic values shaped her career. 她对民主价值观的公开拥护塑造了她的职业生涯。

espouse.note:
The organization decided to espouse the cause of animal rights. 该组织决定支持动物权利事业。

She is a leader who espouses progressive political views. 她是一位奉行进步政治观点的领导人。

espy.note:
From the hilltop, she could espy a small cabin in the distance. 从山顶上，她可以隐约看到远处的一个小屋。

He looked through the binoculars and espied a rare bird. 他通过望远镜瞥见了一只罕见的鸟。

essential.meaning: adj. 必不可少的，核心的 n. 必需品
essential.note:
Water is essential for all living creatures. 水对所有生物都是必不可少的。

Pack only the essentials for the weekend camping trip. 周末露营旅行只打包必需品。

estimable.meaning: adj. 值得尊敬的，可估计的
estimable.note:
She has made an estimable contribution to medical research. 她对医学研究做出了值得尊敬的贡献。

The project cost is an estimable figure that may change. 项目成本是一个可估计的数字，可能会有所变动。

estranged.note:
He lived in a small apartment away from his estranged family. 他住在远离疏远家人的一个小公寓里。

She met with her estranged husband to discuss the divorce. 她与分居的丈夫见面讨论离婚事宜。

etching.note:
The museum displayed a fine collection of 19th-century etchings. 博物馆展出了精美的19世纪蚀刻画收藏。

He learned the delicate technique of copper etching. 他学习了铜版蚀刻的精细技术。

ethereal.meaning: adj. 优雅的，飘逸的，超凡脱俗的
ethereal.note:
She wore a dress made of ethereal, flowing fabric. 她穿着一件由飘逸轻薄面料制成的裙子。

The music had an ethereal quality that amazed the audience. 这种音乐有一种令观众惊叹的空灵品质。

ethnology.note:
She pursued a degree in ethnology to study different cultures. 她攻读民族学学位以研究不同的文化。

Ethnology examines the historical development of human races. 民族学研究人类种族的历时发展。

ethos.meaning: n. 气质，精神特质，道德风貌
ethos.note:
Hard work and integrity are central to the company's ethos. 努力工作和诚信是公司精神的核心。

The team's ethos emphasizes collaboration and mutual support. 该团队的精神风貌强调合作与相互支持。

etiquette.note:
Business etiquette varies significantly across different countries. 商务礼仪在不同国家之间差异很大。

She taught her children proper table etiquette. 她教给孩子们得体的餐桌礼仪。

etymology.note:
He has a deep interest in the etymology of obscure English words. 他对冷僻英语单词的词源有着深厚的兴趣。

Knowing the etymology of a word helps in understanding its meaning. 了解一个单词的词源有助于理解其含义。

eucalyptus.note:
Koalas feed almost exclusively on eucalyptus leaves. 考拉几乎只以桉树叶为食。

The strong scent of eucalyptus filled the Australian forest. 浓郁的桉树香味充满了澳大利亚的森林。

eulogistic.note:
The review was highly eulogistic about the actor's performance. 这篇评论对这位演员的表现给予了高度赞扬。

His eulogistic speech brought tears to the family's eyes. 他饱含赞美的演讲让家属流下了眼泪。

eulogize.note:
Friends gathered to eulogize the late founder of the company. 朋友们聚集在一起颂扬公司已故的创始人。

The article went on to eulogize her lifetime achievements. 这篇文章接着颂扬了她一生的成就。

eulogy.note:
He delivered a moving eulogy at his father's funeral. 他在父亲的葬礼上发表了一篇感人的悼词。

The writer was asked to write a eulogy for the famous artist. 这位作家被邀请为这位著名艺术家写一篇颂词。

euphemism.note:
Passed away is often used as a euphemism for died. “过世”经常被用作“死亡”的委婉说法。

The company used euphemisms to hide job cuts. 公司使用委婉语来掩盖裁员。

euphonious.meaning: adj. 悦耳的，声音优美的
euphonious.note:
The poem has a euphonious rhythm that pleases the ear. 这首诗有一种悦耳的韵律，令人听着舒服。

Her voice had a euphonious quality when singing. 她唱歌时声音有一种悦耳的特质。

euphoria.note:
A sense of euphoria swept through the crowd after the victory. 胜利过后，狂喜的情绪席卷了整个人群。

The economic boom brought a temporary sense of euphoria. 经济繁荣带来了一阵暂时的狂喜感。

evade.note:
He tried to evade paying taxes by hiding his income. 他通过隐瞒收入来试图逃税。

She managed to evade the reporters waiting outside her house. 她设法避开了在她家门外等待的记者。

evaluation.note:
Performance evaluation takes place at the end of every year. 业绩评估在每年年底进行。

The evaluation of the building's damage will take days. 对建筑物损坏情况的评估需要几天时间。

evanescent.meaning: adj. 短暂的，迅速消失的
evanescent.note:
Rainbows are beautiful but evanescent natural phenomena. 彩虹是美丽但短暂的自然现象。

He tried to capture the evanescent beauty of the sunset. 他试图捕捉夕阳那稍纵即逝的美丽。

evaporate.note:
Water will evaporate quickly under the hot sun. 在烈日下水会迅速蒸发。

His hopes of winning the prize began to evaporate. 他赢得奖项的希望开始破灭。

evasion.note:
He was charged with tax evasion and fraud. 他被指控犯有偷税漏税和欺诈罪。

Her answer was a clear evasion of the core question. 她给出的回答显然是对核心问题的回避。

evenhanded.note:
The judge handled the complex case in an evenhanded manner. 法官以公正的方式处理了这个复杂的案件。

We strive to provide evenhanded coverage of all political views. 我们力求对所有政治观点提供公平的报道。

evict.note:
The landlord threatened to evict the tenants for unpaid rent. 房东威胁要因未付房租驱逐租客。

Legal action was taken to evict the squatters from the building. 采取了法律行动将私占房屋者驱逐出大楼。

eviction.note:
Many families faced eviction after losing their jobs. 许多家庭在失业后上面临着被驱逐的困境。

The notice gave them one week to halt the impending eviction. 该通知给了他们一周时间来阻止即将到来的驱逐。

evince.meaning: v. 表明，表现出（某种感情或品质）
evince.note:
She did not evince any emotion during the difficult interview. 在那场艰难的面试中，她没有表现出任何情绪。

His latest project evinces a deep understanding of human psychology. 他最新的项目体现了对人类心理学的深刻理解。

evocative.meaning: adj. 引起回忆的，唤起共鸣的
evocative.note:
The scent of pine trees was evocative of his childhood in the mountains. 松树的香味勾起了他童年在山里的回忆。

The melody has an evocative power that touches the heart. 这首旋律有一种直击心灵的唤起力。

ewe.note:
The mother ewe stayed close to her newborn lamb. 母羊紧紧待在她刚出生的羊羔身边。

Farmers sheared the wool from each ewe in spring. 春天时农民们剪下了每只母羊身上的羊毛。

ewer.note:
The antique table held a decorative porcelain ewer. 那张古董桌上摆着一个装饰性的瓷制水壶。

She poured fresh water from the ewer into the basin. 她从大水壶里把清水倒进脸盆里。

exacting.meaning: adj. 苛求的，要求严格的，吃力的
exacting.note:
Restoring old paintings requires exacting attention to detail. 修复旧画作需要对细节有严苛的要求。

He found his new job to be extremely exacting. 他发现自己的新工作要求极其严格。

exactitude.note:
Scientific experiments require a high degree of exactitude. 科学实验需要高度的精确度。

She translated the ancient text with remarkable exactitude. 她以惊人的准确度翻译了古代文本。

exaggeration.note:
To say he saved the day single-handedly is a slight exaggeration. 说他单枪匹马拯救了局面有点夸张了。

Her story contained some exaggeration of the facts. 她的故事对事实有一定程度的夸大。

exalt.meaning: v. 提拔，高度赞扬，使显贵
exalt.note:
The regime sought to exalt its leaders through propaganda. 该政权试图通过宣传来抬高其领导人。

She was exalted to a high position within the company. 她在公司内部被提拔到很高的职位。

exaltation.meaning: n. 兴高采烈，得意洋洋，崇高
exaltation.note:
A feeling of sheer exaltation filled her heart after winning. 获胜后，一种纯粹的狂喜充盈着她的内心。

The speech was delivered with religious exaltation. 这篇演讲是用一种宗教般的狂热情绪发表的。

exasperate.meaning: v. 激怒，使恼怒，使恶化
exasperate.note:
His constant complaining began to exasperate everyone. 他不断的抱怨开始惹恼每一个人。

Delays in the supply chain served to exasperate the crisis. 供应链的延迟使得危机进一步恶化。

excise.meaning: v. 切除，删去 n. 消费税
excise.note:
The surgeon had to excise the tumor during the operation. 外科医生在手术中必须切除肿瘤。

Editors decided to excise several paragraphs from the text. 编辑们决定从文中删去几段。

excitability.note:
The breed of dog is known for its high excitability. 这种狗的品种以容易兴奋而闻名。

His natural excitability made it hard for him to stay calm. 他天生容易激动的性格使他很难保持冷静。

exclaim.note:
She looked out the window and began to exclaim in surprise. 她看着窗外，惊讶地大声喊了起来。

'How wonderful!' he managed to exclaim. “太棒了！”他设法惊叹道。

exclude.note:
The price includes meals, but taxes are excluded. 价格包含餐费，但不包括税费。

They decided to exclude him from the confidential meeting. 他们决定将他排除在机密会议之外。

excoriate.meaning: v. 严厉批评，痛斥，擦破（皮肤）
excoriate.note:
Critics took turns to excoriate the newly released film. 批评家们轮流严厉批评这部新上映的电影。

Harsh chemicals can excoriate the delicate skin. 刺激性化学物质会擦破娇嫩的皮肤。

excrete.note:
The kidneys help to excrete waste products from the body. 肾脏有助于将体内的废物排泄出去。

Plants excrete excess water through their leaves. 植物通过叶子排出多余的水分。

exculpate.meaning: v. 开脱，证明无罪，申冤
exculpate.note:
New evidence emerged to completely exculpate the suspect. 新证据的出现完全证明了嫌疑人的清白。

The letter helped to exculpate him from the false accusations. 这封信有助于帮他摆脱虚假指控的罪名。

excursion.note:
The school organized a day excursion to the museum. 学校组织了一次去博物馆的日间远足。

They went on a boat excursion along the river. 他们沿着河流进行了一次乘船短途旅行。

excursive.meaning: adj. 离题的，散漫的，漫游的
excursive.note:
His excursive lecture wandered from one topic to another. 他那漫游式的讲座从一个主题跳到另一个主题。

She enjoyed writing excursive essays with personal reflections. 她喜欢写带有个人反思的散漫随笔。

execrable.meaning: adj. 极坏的，可憎的，恶劣的
execrable.note:
The conditions in the prison were described as execrable. 监狱里的条件被描述为极其恶劣。

He had execrable table manners that annoyed everyone. 他那令人讨厌的餐桌礼仪惹恼了所有人。

execrate.note:
The community gathered to execrate the criminals responsible. 社区聚集在一起痛骂那些负有责任的罪犯。

He learned to execrate the tyranny of the old government. 他学会了痛恨旧政府的暴政。

exhaustive.meaning: adj. 详尽的，彻底的，全面的
exhaustive.note:
The police conducted an exhaustive search for the missing clues. 警方对失踪线索进行了详尽的搜查。

An exhaustive study was published on the topic. 一份关于该主题的详尽研究报告被发表了。

exhilarate.meaning: v. 使兴奋，使高兴，使爽快
exhilarate.note:
The fast rollercoaster ride never failed to exhilarate him. 这趟刺激的过山车之旅总是让他兴奋不已。

Cool mountain air can exhilarate the tired traveler. 凉爽的山地空气能让疲惫的旅行者精神焕发。

exhilaration.note:
She felt a wave of sheer exhilaration as she crossed the finish line. 当她冲过终点线时，一股纯粹的兴奋感涌上心头。

Skiing down the steep slope filled him with exhilaration. 从陡峭的山坡上滑雪让他感到无比刺激。

exhort.note:
The coach stood up to exhort his team during halftime. 教练在半场休息时站起来敦促他的队员。

Leaders exhorted citizens to conserve water during the drought. 领导人们敦促公民在干旱期间节约用水。

exigent.meaning: adj. 紧急的，迫切的，苛求的
exigent.note:
The exigent circumstances required immediate action. 紧急的情况需要立即采取行动。

He struggled to manage the exigent demands of his new role. 他努力应付新角色带来的苛刻要求。

existential.meaning: adj. 存在的，关于存在主义的
existential.note:
Climate change poses an existential threat to humanity. 气候变化对人类构成了生存威胁。

She went through an existential crisis in her late twenties. 她在二十几岁后期经历了一场存在主义危机。

exodus.meaning: n. 大批离去，成群出行，出埃及记
exodus.note:
There was a mass exodus of residents before the hurricane struck. 飓风袭来之前，居民们发生了大批撤离。

Summer brings a daily exodus of commuters from the city. 夏天带来了通勤者每天离开城市的浩荡大军。

exonerate.meaning: v. 免除责备，证明…无罪
exonerate.note:
DNA evidence helped to exonerate the wrongly accused man. DNA证据帮助为被冤枉的男子洗脱了罪名。

The investigation served to exonerate the company directors. 调查洗清了公司董事们的责任。

exorbitant.meaning: adj. 过高的，昂贵的（价格等）
exorbitant.note:
The restaurant charged exorbitant prices for basic meals. 这家餐厅对基础餐食收取了高得离谱的价格。

They had to cancel the trip due to exorbitant flight costs. 由于机票价格高昂，他们不得不取消了旅行。

exorcise.meaning: v. 驱魔，驱赶（恶魔），消除（心中的烦恼）
exorcise.note:
The priest was called in to exorcise the haunted house. 牧师被请来驱除闹鬼房子里的恶魔。

She finally managed to exorcise the ghosts of her past. 她终于设法赶走了过去的阴影。

expansive.meaning: adj. 广阔的，开阔的；豪爽的，开朗的
expansive.note:
The hotel offers expansive views of the ocean. 这家酒店享有广阔的海洋视野。

After a few drinks, he became much more expansive and chatty. 喝了几杯后，他变得豪爽健谈多了。

expediency.meaning: n. 权宜之计，便利，功利
expediency.note:
The decision was made purely out of political expediency. 这个决定完全是出于政治上的权宜之计。

Principles should not be sacrificed for temporary expediency. 不应当为了暂时的权宜之计而牺牲原则。

expedient.meaning: adj. 权宜之计的，有利的 n. 权宜之计
expedient.note:
Building a temporary bridge was an expedient solution. 建造一座临时桥梁是一个权宜之计的解决方案。

It might be expedient to delay the announcement. 推迟发布可能是一个有利的做法。

expeditious.note:
We appreciate your expeditious handling of this order. 我们感谢您对该订单的高效处理。

An expeditious response is required for the emergency. 紧急情况需要做出迅速的反应。

expel.note:
The student was threatened with being expelled from school. 这名学生受到了被学校开除的威胁。

Lungs help to expel carbon dioxide from the body. 肺部有助于将二氧化碳排出体外。

expend.meaning: v. 花费，消耗（精力、时间、金钱等）
expend.note:
Athletes expend a lot of energy during training. 运动员在训练期间消耗大量精力。

It is unwise to expend too much time on minor details. 在微小的细节上花费太多时间是不明智的。

expiate.note:
He sought to expiate his past mistakes through charity work. 他试图通过慈善工作来赎回自己过去的错误。

No amount of money can fully expiate such a crime. 多少钱都无法完全赎清这样的罪行。

expiration.note:
Please check the expiration date on the milk carton. 请检查牛奶盒上的保质期。

The contract is coming up for expiration next month. 该合同将于下个月到期。

explicate.note:
The professor tried to explicate the complex literary theory. 教授试图详细阐述这个复杂的文学理论。

Her essay seeks to explicate the poem's hidden meanings. 她的文章旨在解释这首诗中隐藏的含义。

exploit.meaning: v. 剥削，利用，开发 n. 英勇行为，业绩
exploit.note:
Companies must not exploit their workers through unfair wages. 公司不能通过不公平的工资剥削员工。

The book details his daring exploits during the war. 这本书详细记录了他在战争期间的大胆业绩。

exponent.meaning: n. 倡导者，代表；指数（数学）
exponent.note:
He is a leading exponent of modern classical music. 他是现代古典音乐的主要倡导者之一。

In algebra, the number two can be written as an exponent. 在代数中，数字二可以写成指数。

exponentially.meaning: adv. 指数级地，呈几何级数增长地
exponentially.note:
Internet usage has grown exponentially over the past decade. 过去十年中，互联网的使用量呈指数级增长。

The company's profits increased exponentially this year. 今年该公司的利润呈几何级数增长。

exposition.meaning: n. 阐述，解释；博览会，展销会
exposition.note:
The book begins with a clear exposition of the problem. 这本书以对该问题的清晰阐述开篇。

An international trade exposition will be held downtown. 一个国际贸易博览会将在市中心举行。

expository.note:
Students learned how to write clear expository essays. 学生们学习了如何撰写清晰的说明性散文。

The text contains several expository passages explaining the context. 文本包含几个解释背景的说明性段落。

expostulate.note:
He tried to expostulate with his friend about his reckless behavior. 他试图就朋友鲁莽的行为进行规劝。

She wrote a letter to expostulate against the unfair ruling. 她写了一封信以抗议那项不公正的裁决。

exposure.note:
Prolonged exposure to the sun can damage your skin. 长期暴露在阳光下会伤害你的皮肤。

The scandal led to widespread media exposure. 这桩丑闻导致了广泛的媒体曝光。

expressly.note:
The rule was created expressly to prevent such abuses. 这项规则的制定纯粹是为了防止此类滥用行为。

He came home expressly to celebrate his mother's birthday. 他特意回家为母亲庆祝生日。

expunge.note:
He hoped to expunge his criminal record after years of good behavior. 经过多年的良好表现，他希望能抹去自己的犯罪记录。

The editor decided to expunge the offensive sentence from the draft. 编辑决定从草稿中删除那个冒犯性的句子。

expurgate.meaning: v. 删改，删除（不当或令人反感的内容）
expurgate.note:
The publisher had to expurgate the novel before selling it to schools. 出版商在将小说卖给学校之前必须对其进行删改。

An expurgated version of the play was shown on television. 电视上播放了该剧的删节版。

exquisite.meaning: adj. 精致的，精美的，剧烈的
exquisite.note:
She wore an exquisite necklace made of diamonds and gold. 她戴着一条由钻石和黄金制成的精致项链。

The injured ankle caused him exquisite pain. 受伤的脚踝给他带来了剧烈的疼痛。

extant.note:
Only a few copies of this ancient manuscript are still extant. 这份古代手稿只剩下几份副本还存世。

Historians studied the oldest extant records of the city. 历史学家研究了该城市现存最古老的记录。

extemporaneous.note:
He gave an impressive extemporaneous speech without any notes. 他在没有任何笔记的情况下发表了一场令人印象深刻的即兴演讲。

Her extemporaneous comments caught the interviewers by surprise. 她即兴发表的评论让面试官们感到意外。

extemporize.meaning: v. 即兴表演，即兴发言
extemporize.note:
When the projector broke down, the speaker had to extemporize. 当投影仪坏了时，演讲者不得不即兴发挥。

He is talented enough to extemporize on any given topic. 他很有才华，能够就任何给定的主题即兴发言。

extend.note:
They plan to extend the railway line to the neighboring town. 他们计划将铁路线延伸到邻近的城镇。

I would like to extend my sincere gratitude to everyone who helped. 我要向所有提供帮助的人表达诚挚的谢意。

extenuate.note:
The lawyer argued that extenuating circumstances justified the action. 律师辩称，情有可原的情况证明该行为是合情合理的。

Nothing can extenuate such brutal behavior. 任何事情都无法为这种残暴的行为开脱。

exterminate.note:
Homeowners hired a pest control service to exterminate the termites. 房主雇佣了灭虫服务来消灭白蚁。

Efforts were made to exterminate the invasive plant species. 人们采取了措施来根除这种入侵植物物种。

externalize.meaning: v. 使表现出来，使外在化
externalize.note:
Art therapy helps patients externalize their inner feelings. 艺术疗法帮助患者将内心的感受外化表达出来。

Children often externalize their anxiety through behavioral changes. 孩子们经常通过行为变化将他们的焦虑表现出来。

extinction.note:
Many rare animal species face the threat of extinction. 许多珍稀动物物种面临着灭绝的威胁。

The conservation project successfully prevented the bird's extinction. 这个保护项目成功阻止了该鸟类的灭绝。

extinguish.meaning: v. 熄灭（火等），扑灭，使消亡
extinguish.note:
Firefighters worked quickly to extinguish the blaze. 消防员迅速工作以扑灭大火。

Scandals can easily extinguish a politician's career. 丑闻可以轻易断送一个政客的职业生涯。

extirpation.note:
The campaign aimed at the total extirpation of the disease. 这场运动旨在彻底根除这种疾病。

Urban expansion led to the extirpation of local wildlife. 城市扩张导致了当地野生动物的根除消亡。

extol.note:
Advertisements often extol the virtues of new health products. 广告经常吹捧新款保健品的优点。

Teachers gathered to extol her dedication to education. 老师们聚集在一起赞扬她对教育的奉献。

extort.note:
The gang tried to extort money from local business owners. 这个帮派试图向当地店主勒索钱财。

He was convicted of trying to extort confessions through threats. 他因试图通过威胁逼供而被定罪。

extract.meaning: v. 提取，拔出，摘录 n. 提取物，选段
extract.note:
Dentists sometimes need to extract a damaged tooth. 牙医有时需要拔掉受损的牙齿。

The book opens with an extract from a famous poem. 这本书以一首著名诗歌的选段开篇。

extrapolate.note:
Scientists tried to extrapolate future trends from current data. 科学家试图根据当前的数据推断未来的趋势。

You cannot extrapolate general rules from a single example. 你不能从单一的例子中推断出普遍的规律。

extravagance.note:
Buying a luxury car was an unnecessary extravagance. 买一辆豪华轿车是一种不必要的奢侈浪费。

His financial habits were characterized by sheer extravagance. 他的财务习惯以纯粹的铺张浪费为特征。

extricable.meaning: adj. 可解救的，可脱离的
extricable.note:
Fortunately, the car wheels were in an extricable position from the mud. 幸运的是，汽车轮子处于可以从泥地里解脱出来的位置。

The financial crisis proved to be an extricable mess with proper help. 在适当的帮助下，这场金融危机被证明是一个可以解决的烂摊子。

extricate.meaning: v. 使摆脱，使脱离困境
extricate.note:
He managed to extricate himself from the difficult situation. 他设法让自己摆脱了困境。

Rescuers worked to extricate the trapped hikers from the cave. 救援人员努力将受困的远足者从洞穴中救出来。

extrovert.note:
She is a natural extrovert who loves meeting new people. 她是一个天生外向、喜欢结识新朋友的人。

Being an extrovert helps him succeed in sales and marketing. 外向的性格帮助他在销售和市场营销领域获得成功。

exuberance.meaning: n. 热情洋溢，繁茂，兴高采烈
exuberance.note:
The child's youthful exuberance infected everyone in the room. 孩子年轻的活力感染了房间里的每一个人。

Plants grow with great exuberance during the rainy season. 雨季时植物生长得异常繁茂。

exuberant.meaning: adj. 热情洋溢的，兴高采烈的，繁茂的
exuberant.note:
The team celebrated their victory with exuberant cheers. 团队以热情洋溢的欢呼声庆祝他们的胜利。

They walked through the lush, exuberant tropical forest. 他们穿过了郁郁葱葱、繁茂的热带森林。

exude.note:
She managed to exude confidence during the job interview. 她在面试中设法流露出自信。

The pine tree began to exude a sticky resin. 松树开始渗出粘性的树脂。

exult.meaning: v. 狂喜，欢欣鼓舞，得意忘形
exult.note:
Fans began to exult when their team scored the winning goal. 当他们的球队攻入制胜球时，球迷们欢欣鼓舞。

There is no need to exult over an opponent's failure. 没有必要为对手的失败而感到幸灾乐祸。

fabricate.meaning: v. 捏造，编造（谎言等）；制造，装配
fabricate.note:
He tried to fabricate an alibi to cover up his mistake. 他试图编造一个不在场证明来掩盖自己的错误。

Factories fabricate steel components for construction. 工厂为建筑制造钢铁构件。

facade.meaning: n. 正面，立面；虚伪的外表
facade.note:
The historic building features a magnificent stone facade. 这座历史建筑拥有宏伟的石头正面。

Behind his friendly facade lay a cold and calculating mind. 在他友善的外表下藏着一颗冷酷且工于心计的心。

facetious.meaning: adj. 滑稽的，开玩笑的，轻率的
facetious.note:
His facetious remarks were out of place during the serious meeting. 在严肃的会议上，他那滑稽的言论显得很不合时宜。

She made a facetious comment about the delay. 她对延误发表了一句开玩笑的评论。

facile.meaning: adj. 肤浅的，轻率的；容易做到的
facile.note:
We must avoid facile answers to complex social problems. 我们必须避免对复杂的社会问题给出肤浅的答案。

He has a facile ability to learn languages. 他有着轻松学习语言的能力。

facilities.note:
The university provides excellent sports and library facilities. 这所大学提供优秀的体育和图书馆设施。

Research facilities are equipped with modern laboratory gear. 研究设施配备了现代化的实验室设备。

factorable.meaning: adj. 可因式分解的，可分解因子的
factorable.note:
In algebra, this polynomial expression is easily factorable. 在代数中，这个多项式表达式很容易进行因式分解。

Not every quadratic equation is factorable with integer solutions. 并非每个二次方程都有整数解的可因式分解形式。

factotum.meaning: n. 杂工，多面手，全能仆人
factotum.note:
He worked as a general factotum around the grand estate. 他在那座宏伟的庄园里当总杂工。

The office manager acted as a trusted factotum for the director. 办公室经理充当了总监值得信赖的万能助手。

factual.note:
The report was praised for its accurate and factual content. 这篇报道因其准确和真实的内容而受到赞扬。

Journalists must ensure their stories are based on factual evidence. 记者必须确保他们的故事建立在事实证据的基础上。

fad.meaning: n. 一时风尚，短暂的热潮
fad.note:
Dietary trends often turn out to be nothing more than a passing fad. 饮食趋势往往最终被证明不过是一时流行的风尚。

That particular dance craze was just a short-lived fad. 那种特定的舞蹈热潮只是一时的短暂热潮。

faddish.meaning: adj. 一时风尚的，赶时髦的
faddish.note:
She tends to follow faddish diets that lack scientific backing. 她往往盲目追随缺乏科学支撑的时髦饮食法。

The restaurant menu featured faddish dishes that quickly went out of style. 餐厅的菜单上摆满了很快过时的时髦菜品。

falcon.note:
A peregrine falcon can dive at incredible speeds. 游隼能以惊人的速度俯冲。

Falconry is an ancient sport involving trained birds of prey. 驯鹰术是一项涉及训练有素的猛禽的古老运动。

fallacious.note:
His argument was based on fallacious assumptions. 他的论点是建立在错误的假设基础之上的。

We must reject fallacious claims made by the company. 我们必须拒绝该公司提出的虚假欺骗性主张。

fallacy.note:
It is a common fallacy that wealth brings automatic happiness. 财富会带来自动的幸福是一个普遍的谬误。

Logic helps us detect flaws and fallacies in arguments. 逻辑帮助我们发现论点中的漏洞和谬误。

fallibility.note:
Human memory is known for its inherent fallibility. 人类记忆以其固有的易错性而闻名。

Acknowledging our fallibility is the first step toward learning. 承认我们的易错性是走向学习的第一步。

fallible.meaning: adj. 易错的，可能犯错的
fallible.note:
Even the most experienced experts are fallible. 即使最有经验的专家也难免犯错。

Our judgment is fallible, so we must double-check our work. 我们的判断是会出错的，所以我们必须仔细核对工作。

fallow.meaning: adj. 休耕的，荒芜的 n. 休耕地
fallow.note:
Farmers left the field fallow to restore soil nutrients. 农民让田地休耕以恢复土壤养分。

Her creative mind had lain fallow for several months. 她创造性的思维已经闲置了几个月。

falsehood.note:
His statement was exposed as a complete falsehood. 他的言论被揭露为彻头彻尾的谎言。

She detested falsehood and valued absolute honesty. 她痛恨虚假，看重绝对的诚实。

falter.meaning: v. 衰退，动摇，支吾，蹒跚
falter.note:
Her voice began to falter as she read the emotional letter. 当她读到这封感人的信时，她的声音开始颤抖。

The economy started to falter after a period of rapid growth. 经济在经历了一段快速增长期后开始出现衰退动摇。

familiarity.note:
Familiarity with the software makes the job much easier. 对软件的熟悉使得工作容易得多。

He spoke about the subject with great familiarity. 他对这个话题谈笑风生，十分熟悉。

famish.note:
The stray dog looked famished after days without food. 那只流浪狗在几天没有食物后显得饥肠辘辘。

They were nearly famished by the time they reached the restaurant. 当他们到达餐厅时，他们几乎饿极了。

fanatic.meaning: n. 狂热者，盲信者 adj. 狂热的
fanatic.note:
He is a fitness fanatic who goes to the gym every morning. 他是个健身狂热者，每天早上去健身房。

Religious fanatics caused widespread chaos in the region. 宗教狂热分子在该地区造成了广泛的混乱。

fang.note:
The snake bared its sharp fangs in warning. 蛇露出了尖锐的毒牙以示警告。

Vampires are traditionally depicted with long fangs. 传统上吸血鬼被描绘成拥有长尖牙的形象。

fantasy.meaning: n. 幻想，幻想曲，奇幻作品
fantasy.note:
She lives in a world of fantasy and imagination. 她生活在一个充满幻想与想象的世界里。

He loves reading epic fantasy novels. 他喜欢阅读史诗奇幻小说。

farce.note:
The trial turned out to be a complete farce. 这场审判最终变成了一场彻头彻尾的闹剧。

They watched a funny French farce at the theater. 他们在剧院里看了一部滑稽的法国闹剧。

farewell.meaning: n. 告别，辞别 adj. 告别的
farewell.note:
Friends gathered to bid a warm farewell to the travelers. 朋友们聚集在一起向旅行者致以热烈的告别。

The singer announced her farewell tour before retirement. 这位歌手在退休前宣布了她的告别巡演。

fastness.note:
The rebels retreated to a mountain fastness. 叛军撤退到了一个山地要塞中。

The ancient castle remained a secure fastness against attacks. 那座古老的城堡依然是对抗进攻的安全堡垒。

fathom.meaning: v. 理解，深究；测,深度单位（寻）
fathom.note:
I cannot fathom why he made such a foolish decision. 我无法理解他为什么会做出如此愚蠢的决定。

The ocean trench is too deep to fathom easily. 这个海沟太深，不易轻易测出深度。

fatigue.meaning: n. 疲劳，疲惫 v. 使疲劳
fatigue.note:
Driver fatigue is a major cause of highway accidents. 司机疲劳是高速公路事故的主要原因。

Long hours of studying can quickly fatigue the mind. 长时间的学习会迅速使大脑疲劳。

fatten.note:
Farmers try to fatten the cattle before taking them to market. 农民们试图在把牛带到市场前将其喂肥。

Organic compost helps to fatten up poor garden soil. 有机堆肥有助于使贫瘠的花园土壤肥沃。

fatuity.meaning: n. 愚蠢，呆板，愚蠢的行为
fatuity.note:
She was shocked by the sheer fatuity of his remarks. 她对他的言论的极度愚蠢感到震惊。

The proposal was dismissed because of its utter fatuity. 该提议因其彻底的愚蠢而被驳回。

fatuous.note:
He made a fatuous comment that annoyed the entire board. 他发表了一条惹恼了整个董事会的愚蠢评论。

Ignoring the warning signs would be a fatuous mistake. 忽视警告信号将是一个昏庸的错误。

faucet.note:
She turned on the kitchen faucet to wash the dishes. 她打开厨房的水龙头洗碗。

A leaky faucet can waste a lot of water over time. 漏水的水龙头久而久之会浪费大量的水。

fault.meaning: n. 错误，缺点，故障 v. 挑剔，责备
fault.note:
It was not my fault that the project missed its deadline. 项目错过截止日期不是我的错。

Faulty wiring caused the sudden power outage in the building. 故障的电线导致了大楼内的突然停电。

faultfinder.meaning: n. 挑剔者，爱找岔子的人
faultfinder.note:
He is a constant faultfinder who is never satisfied with anything. 他是一个不知疲倦的挑剔者，对什么都不满意。

Don't let chronic faultfinders discourage your efforts. 不要让经常挑刺的人打击你努力的积极性。

favorable.meaning: adj. 赞同的，有利的，良好的
favorable.note:
The film received favorable reviews from major critics. 这部电影收到了主流影评人的一致好评。

Favorable weather conditions helped farmers harvest early. 有利的天气条件帮助农民提前收割。

fawn.meaning: v. 讨好，奉承 n. 小鹿
fawn.note:
He tended to fawn over wealthy clients to win contracts. 他为了赢得合同往往会讨好有钱的客户。

A spotted fawn stood beside its mother in the clearing. 一只带斑点的小鹿静静地站在林间空地的母亲身旁。

faze.meaning: v. 使惊慌，使窘迫，使打扰
faze.note:
Criticism does not easily faze her when she knows she is right. 当她知道自己是对的时，批评不容易使她慌乱。

Nothing seemed to faze the calm and experienced detective. 没有任何事情似乎能打扰这位冷静而有经验的侦探。

feature.meaning: n. 特色，特征，面貌 v. 以…为特色，起重要作用
feature.note:
A major feature of the new smartphone is its advanced camera. 这款新智能手机的一个主要特色是其先进的相机。

The museum will feature an exhibition of modern art next month. 博物馆下个月将以现代艺术展为特色。

feckless.meaning: adj. 无能的，不负责任的，懦弱的
feckless.note:
He was criticized for his feckless management of family finances. 他因对家庭财务的不负责任管理而受到批评。

The feckless employee lost his job after repeated mistakes. 那名无能的员工在屡次犯错后丢了工作。

fecundity.note:
The rich soil ensures the high fecundity of the farmland. 肥沃的土壤确保了农田的高产力。

Critics praised the artistic fecundity of his early career. 批评家赞扬了他早期职业生涯中丰富的艺术创造力。

feedback.note:
We welcome customer feedback to improve our products. 我们欢迎客户反馈以改进我们的产品。

The teacher gave constructive feedback on the essay. 老师对这篇论文给出了建设性的反馈意见。

feign.note:
She tried to feign illness to avoid going to school. 她试图假装生病以逃避去学校。

He managed to feign indifference despite his deep disappointment. 尽管内心深感失望，他还是设法装出冷漠的样子。

feigned.note:
Her interest in his boring stories was entirely feigned. 她对他那些无聊故事的兴趣完全是假装出来的。

He offered a feigned smile and walked away. 他露出一个虚假的微笑，然后走开了。

feint.meaning: n. 佯攻，假动作 v. 做假动作
feint.note:
The boxer made a quick feint before throwing a punch. 拳击手在挥拳前做了一个快速的假动作。

He feinted to the left and then passed the ball to the right. 他向左假动作佯攻，然后把球传到了右边。

felicitous.meaning: adj. 恰当的，得体的，美妙的
felicitous.note:
Her speech was filled with felicitous phrases and clever remarks. 她的演讲充满了恰当的短语和机智的评论。

Choosing a quiet garden for the ceremony was a felicitous idea. 为仪式选择一个安静的花园是一个美妙的主意。

fell.meaning: v. 砍倒，击倒 adj. 凶猛的，可怕的
fell.note:
Lumberjack crews worked to fell the dead pine trees. 伐木工团队努力砍倒死去的松树。

With one fell swoop, the company cancelled all bonuses. 一举之间，该公司取消了所有的奖金。

felon.note:
The escaped felon was captured by police after a long chase. 逃跑的重罪犯在漫长的追捕后被警方抓获。

Convicted felons often lose their voting rights in certain states. 被定罪的重罪犯在某些州经常失去投票权。

fender.meaning: n. 挡泥板，（汽车）保险杠，壁炉护栏
fender.note:
The car suffered a minor dent in its front fender. 汽车的前挡泥板遭受了轻微的凹陷。

A decorative metal fire fender protected the living room rug. 装饰性的金属壁炉护栏保护了客厅的地毯。

feral.meaning: adj. 野生的，野蛮的，凶猛的
feral.note:
packs of feral dogs roam the outskirts of the abandoned city. 一群群野狗在废弃城市的郊区游荡。

His behavior took on a feral intensity during the match. 在比赛期间，他的行为呈现出一种野蛮的强度。

fermentation.note:
Yeast plays a crucial role in the fermentation of bread dough. 酵母在面包面团的发酵中起着至关重要的作用。

Wine production relies heavily on the natural fermentation process. 葡萄酒生产严重依赖于自然发酵过程。

fern.note:
Lush green ferns grew beneath the canopy of the forest. 郁郁葱葱的绿色蕨类植物生长在森林树冠之下。

She kept a potted fern on her bright balcony. 她在明亮的阳台上养了一盆蕨类植物。

ferrous.note:
The recycling facility sorts ferrous metals from plastic waste. 回收设施将含铁金属从塑料垃圾中分类出来。

Steel is a primary example of a ferrous alloy. 钢铁是含铁合金的主要例子。

fertilize.note:
Farmers need to fertilize the soil to ensure a good harvest. 农民需要给土壤施肥以确保丰收。

Bees play a vital role in helping to fertilize flowering plants. 蜜蜂在帮助开花植物授粉受精方面起着至关重要的作用。

fertilizer.note:
Organic fertilizer helps improve soil structure naturally. 有机肥料有助于自然改善土壤结构。

Excessive use of chemical fertilizers can pollute local water supplies. 过度使用化肥会污染当地的水源。

fervid.meaning: adj. 热烈的，热情的，炽热的
fervid.note:
He expressed a fervid desire to reform the institution. 他表达了改革该机构的炽热愿望。

The politician received a fervid welcome from supporters. 这位政客受到了支持者们热烈的欢迎。

fervor.note:
The crowd cheered with patriotic fervor during the ceremony. 在仪式期间，人群带着爱国热情欢呼。

She approached her new research project with intense fervor. 她以极大的热情对待她的新研究项目。

fester.meaning: v. 溃烂，化脓；恶化（怨恨等）
fester.note:
If left untreated, the small cut can easily fester. 如果不加治疗，这个小伤口很容易化脓溃烂。

Unresolved conflicts can cause anger to fester over time. 未能解决的冲突会随着时间推移让怨恨不断恶化。

fetid.note:
A fetid odor rose from the stagnant swamp water. 一股恶臭从停滞的沼泽水中升起。

They could not bear the fetid air inside the old cellar. 他们无法忍受老地窖里发臭的空气。

fetter.meaning: v. 束缚，限制 n. 脚镣，束缚物
fetter.note:
Regulations should not fetter free market innovation. 规章制度不应束缚自由市场创新。

Prisoners were bound with heavy iron fetters. 囚犯们被沉重的铁脚镣束缚着。

fetus.note:
Ultrasound scans allow doctors to monitor the developing fetus. 超声波扫描允许医生监测发育中的胎儿。

Nutrition during pregnancy directly affects the health of the fetus. 怀孕期间的营养直接影响胎儿的健康。

feud.meaning: n. 世仇，长期不和 v. 长期争斗
feud.note:
The two neighboring families engaged in a bitter feud for decades. 这两家邻居进行了几十年的激烈世仇争斗。

They had been feuding over land boundaries for years. 他们因土地界限问题已经争斗多年了。

fiasco.note:
The outdoor concert turned into a fiasco when heavy rain started. 当大雨开始下时，户外音乐会变成了一场惨败。

Management tried to cover up the public relations fiasco. 管理层试图掩盖这场公关惨败。

fiat.note:
The director ruled the department by executive fiat. 主管通过行政谕令来统治该部门。

Changes were made by government fiat rather than public debate. 变革是由政府法令而非公众辩论做出的。

fickle.meaning: adj. 变幻无常的，易变的，反复无常的
fickle.note:
The fashion industry is known for its fickle tastes. 时尚行业以其变幻无常的品味而闻名。

Fickle weather spoiled their plans for a picnic. 反复无常的天气破坏了他们野餐的计划。

fictitious.meaning: adj. 虚构的，假想的，假的
fictitious.note:
All characters in this novel are entirely fictitious. 这部小说中的所有人物完全都是虚构的。

He used a fictitious name to protect his privacy. 他用一个假名来保护自己的隐私。

fidget.meaning: v. 烦躁不安，坐立不安 n. 坐立不安的人
fidget.note:
Children tend to fidget when forced to sit still for too long. 当被迫坐太久不动时，孩子们往往会坐立不安。

Stop fidgeting and pay attention to the presentation. 别再坐立不安了，认真听演讲。

fig.note:
Fresh figs are a sweet and healthy treat. 新鲜的无花果是一种甜美健康的零食。

The tree bore an abundant crop of sweet figs last summer. 去年夏天这棵树结出了丰富的甜美无花果。

figment.meaning: n. 虚构的事物，臆造的幻觉
figment.note:
The strange noise was just a figment of his tired imagination. 奇怪的声音只是他疲惫想象出来的幻觉。

She assured him that the monster was a mere figment. 她向他保证那个怪物纯属虚构。

figurative.meaning: adj. 比喻的，借喻的；具象的
figurative.note:
The phrase was used in a figurative sense, not literally. 这个短语是在比喻的意义上使用的，而不是字面意思。

His early art training focused mainly on figurative painting. 他早期的艺术训练主要集中在具象绘画上。

figurehead.meaning: n. 名义上的领袖（无实权），船首饰像
figurehead.note:
The president served merely as a figurehead with no real authority. 总统仅仅担任没有实权的名义领袖。

The old sailing ship featured a wooden carved figurehead. 那艘古老的帆船有一个木雕船首饰像。

figurine.note:
She collected delicate porcelain figurines from around the world. 她收藏了来自世界各地的精致瓷质小雕像。

A small bronze figurine sat on the bookshelf. 一尊小型青铜雕像摆在书架上。

file.meaning: n. 文件，档案，文件夹 v. 归档，提出（申请等）
file.note:
Please save the digital file in the shared folder. 请将数字文件保存在共享文件夹中。

She went to the lawyer to file for a divorce. 她去找律师提出离婚申请。

filibuster.meaning: n. 冗长辩论（旨在阻挠立法） v. 采用冗长辩论阻挠
filibuster.note:
Senators launched a marathon filibuster to block the bill. 参议员们发起了一场马拉松式的冗长辩论以阻挠该法案。

Minority parties can sometimes filibuster to delay voting. 少数党有时可以通过冗长发言来拖延投票。

filigree.meaning: n. 金银丝细工，精细的饰品
filigree.note:
The antique brooch featured intricate gold filigree work. 这枚古董胸针具有复杂的金银丝细工工艺。

Delicate silver filigree decorated the edge of the mirror. 精致的银丝花边装饰着镜子的边缘。

filings.note:
A magnet was used to collect the iron filings from the table. 磁铁被用来收集桌子上的铁屑。

Workers must wear safety glasses when metal filings fly. 当金属屑飞溅时，工人们必须佩戴安全眼镜。

filly.note:
The young filly raced across the open pasture with energy. 年轻的小母马充满活力地跑过开阔的牧场。

Training the spirited filly took patience and consistency. 驯服这匹烈性小母马需要耐心和坚持。

finale.note:
The grand fireworks display served as the festival's spectacular finale. 盛大的烟花表演成为了节日精彩的终场压轴戏。

The symphony ended with a powerful and triumphant finale. 交响乐以一个强大且凯旋的末乐章结束。

finicky.meaning: adj. 过分挑剔的，讲究的，难伺候的
finicky.note:
He is a finicky eater who dislikes most vegetables. 他是个挑食的人，不喜欢大部分蔬菜。

Building the model requires finicky attention to tiny pieces. 建造这个模型需要对微小部件有着过分挑剔的关注。

firefly.note:
Glowing fireflies lit up the warm summer evening. 发光的萤火虫点亮了温暖的夏夜。

Children chased fireflies across the open lawn. 孩子们在开阔的草坪上追逐萤火虫。

fissure.meaning: n. 裂缝，裂沟 v. 裂开
fissure.note:
An earthquake created a deep fissure in the rocky ground. 一场地动在岩石地面上制造了一条深裂缝。

The political party developed deep fissures over policy choices. 这个政党在政策选择上出现了严重的裂痕分歧。

fixate.meaning: v. 注视，使固定，过度执着
fixate.note:
He tends to fixate on minor details instead of the big picture. 他往往过分执着于微小的细节而不是大局。

Camera lenses must fixate correctly to produce sharp images. 相机镜头必须正确对焦才能产出清晰的图像。

flaccid.meaning: adj. 松弛的，软弱的，无力的
flaccid.note:
Lack of exercise can leave muscles feeling flaccid. 缺乏锻炼会使肌肉感觉松弛无力。

The plant drooped with flaccid leaves due to lack of water. 由于缺水，植物耷拉着松弛的叶子。

flagging.meaning: adj. 衰弱的，下垂的，减弱的
flagging.note:
They took a short break to revive their flagging energy. 他们休息了一小会儿以恢复减弱的精力。

The company launched a marketing campaign to boost flagging sales. 该公司发起了一场营销活动以提振疲软的销售额。

flaggy.meaning: adj. 多芦苇的，长满鸢尾的，松软的
flaggy.note:
They walked carefully across the flaggy marshland. 他们小心翼翼地穿过长满芦苇的沼泽地。

The soil in that section of the garden tends to be somewhat flaggy. 花园那部分的土壤往往有点松软。

flagrant.meaning: adj. 昭然若揭的，公然的，罪大恶极的
flagrant.note:
The company was fined for flagrant violations of safety laws. 该公司因公然违反安全法律而被罚款。

His behavior was a flagrant disregard of office rules. 他的行为是对办公室规则的公然蔑视。

flail.meaning: v. 挥舞，乱动，打击 n. 打谷棒
flail.note:
The swimmer began to flail in panic when he lost his footing. 游泳者在站不稳时恐慌地乱挥手脚。

Branches flailed wildly in the fierce gale. 树枝在狂风中疯狂地挥舞。

flak.meaning: n. 高射炮火；猛烈批评，责难
flak.note:
The policy change drew heavy flak from opposition parties. 政策变动招致了反对派的猛烈批评。

Bombers faced intense enemy flak during the flight. 轰炸机在飞行过程中面临密集的敌人高射炮火。

flammable.note:
Store chemicals away from sources of heat because they are flammable. 将化学品存放在远离热源的地方，因为它们是易燃的。

Special warning labels are required on flammable materials. 易燃材料上需要贴有特殊的警告标签。

flange.note:
The metal pipe was secured with a sturdy bolted flange. 金属管用一个坚固带螺栓的法兰固定着。

Inspect the wheel flange regularly for signs of wear. 定期检查车轮法兰是否有磨损迹象。

flare.meaning: v. 闪耀，突然燃烧；加剧 n. 闪光信号灯
flare.note:
Tensions along the border began to flare up again. 边境的紧张局势开始再次加剧爆发。

Stranded hikers lit a red flare to signal for help. 受困的远足者点燃了一支红色信号弹求救。

flask.meaning: n. 烧瓶，长颈瓶，扁形酒壶
flask.note:
She poured the chemical solution into a glass flask. 她把化学溶液倒进了一个玻璃烧瓶里。

He carried a metal flask filled with hot coffee. 他随身带了一个装满热咖啡的金属扁酒壶。

flatcar.meaning: n. 平板货车，铁路平板车
flatcar.note:
Heavy machinery was loaded onto a flatcar for transport. 重型机械被装载到铁路平板车上进行运输。

The train carried several flatcars loaded with timber. 火车拉着几节装满木材的平板货车。

flatten.note:
Roll out the dough and flatten it with a pin. 把面团擀开并用擀面杖把它压平。

The strong storm threatened to flatten crops across the valley. 强烈风暴威胁要将整个山谷的农作物夷为平地。

flatter.meaning: v. 奉承，讨好，使显得好看
flatter.note:
He tried to flatter his boss in hopes of getting a promotion. 他试图奉承老板以期获得升职。

That new dress really flatters your figure. 那条新裙子真的很衬托你的身材。

flaunt.note:
She likes to flaunt her wealth by wearing expensive jewelry. 她喜欢通过佩戴昂贵的珠宝来炫耀自己的财富。

There is no need to flaunt your success in front of others. 没有必要在别人面前炫耀你的成功。

flaunty.meaning: adj. 招摇的，炫耀的，浮华的
flaunty.note:
He drove a bright red car with a flaunty design. 他开着一辆设计招摇的亮红色汽车。

Her flaunty attitude made her unpopular at the office. 她那爱显摆的态度让他在办公室里很不受欢迎。

fledge.note:
The young birds are ready to fledge and leave the nest. 幼鸟已经准备好长满羽毛并离巢学飞了。

Nestlings fledge within a few weeks of hatching. 雏鸟在孵化几周内就会长出羽毛独立。

fledgling.meaning: n. 刚学飞的鸟；新手，新兴组织 adj. 新兴的
fledgling.note:
The fledgling tech startup secured its first round of funding. 这家新兴的科技初创公司获得了第一轮融资。

A fledgling eagle practiced spreading its wings. 一只刚学飞的雏鹰练习着展开双翅。

fleeting.meaning: adj. 短暂的，转瞬即逝的
fleeting.note:
She caught a fleeting glimpse of the deer before it vanished. 在鹿消失之前，她匆忙瞥了它一眼。

Happiness can sometimes feel like a fleeting emotion. 幸福有时感觉像是一种转瞬即逝的情绪。

flexible.meaning: adj. 灵活的，柔韧的，可变通的
flexible.note:
Our schedule is quite flexible, so we can change the time. 我们的时间表相当灵活，所以我们可以更改时间。

Yoga helps to improve muscle strength and flexible joints. 瑜伽有助于提高肌肉力量和灵活的关节。

flinch.note:
He did not flinch when facing the difficult challenge. 面对困难的挑战，他没有退缩。

She winced and flinched at the sharp pain. 她因剧烈的疼痛而退缩并皱起眉头。

flip.meaning: v. 快速翻转，轻抛 adj. 轻率的
flip.note:
He decided to flip a coin to decide who would go first. 他决定抛硬币来决定谁先走。

She flipped through the pages of the magazine quickly. 她快速翻阅了杂志的页面。

flippant.meaning: adj. 轻率的，无礼的，贫嘴的
flippant.note:
His flippant remarks during the serious briefing caused anger. 他在严肃简报会上的轻率言论引起了愤怒。

Do not adopt a flippant attitude toward safety regulations. 对安全规章制度不要采取轻率的态度。

flit.meaning: v. 轻快地飞过，掠过，急速移动
flit.note:
Butterflies began to flit from flower to flower in the garden. 蝴蝶开始在花园的花朵间轻快地飞来飞去。

Thoughts of the upcoming exam flitted through her mind. 即将考试的想法在她脑海中飞闪而过。

floodgate.meaning: n. 防洪闸，水闸；（情绪等的）闸门
floodgate.note:
Engineers opened the floodgates to release the rising reservoir water. 工程师们打开了防洪闸以释放上涨的水库水。

The news release opened the floodgates to public criticism. 新闻发布开启了公众批评的闸门。

florid.meaning: adj. 绚丽的，辞藻华丽的；红润的
florid.note:
His writing style was criticized as overly florid and complex. 他的写作风格被批评为过于辞藻华丽且复杂。

The old man had a florid complexion from years outdoors. 由于多年在户外，老人有着一张红润的面色。

flounder.meaning: v. 挣扎，错乱，艰难移动 n. 比目鱼
flounder.note:
The business began to flounder after losing its main client. 在失去了主要客户后，这家企业开始陷入困境挣扎。

He started to flounder when asked difficult questions by the press. 当被记者问及困难问题时，他开始语无伦次地不知所措。

flout.meaning: v. 公然蔑视，违反，嘲弄
flout.note:
Drivers who flout traffic rules should face heavy fines. 公然蔑视交通规则的司机应该面临巨额罚款。

They chose to flout convention and host an unconventional wedding. 他们选择蔑视传统，举办了一场非传统的婚礼。

fluke.note:
His winning shot was pure fluke, not skill. 他投进的那一球纯属侥幸，并非技术。

We shouldn't rely on a fluke to pass the exam. 我们不应该依靠侥幸来通过考试。

fluorescent.note:
The office was illuminated by bright fluorescent ceiling lights. 办公室被明亮的吸顶荧光灯照亮。

Some minerals show fluorescent properties under ultraviolet light. 某些矿物质在紫外光下表现出荧光特性。

flush.meaning: v. 冲洗，脸红 n. 脸红，冲水
flush.note:
Make sure to flush the toilet after use. 使用后请务必冲厕所。

A sudden flush of embarrassment spread across her cheeks. 一阵突如其来的羞怯脸红蔓延到她的脸颊上。

flustered.meaning: adj. 慌乱的，激动不安的
flustered.note:
She became flustered when she couldn't find her presentation notes. 当找不到演讲笔记时，她变得慌乱起来。

He remained calm and unconcerned, unlike his flustered colleagues. 他保持冷静且毫不关切，不像他那些慌乱的同事。

fluvial.meaning: adj. 河流的，由河流产生的
fluvial.note:
The valley was shaped by millions of years of fluvial erosion. 这个山谷是由数百万年的河流侵蚀雕刻而成的。

Geologists studied the fluvial deposits along the riverbank. 地质学家研究了河岸边的河流沉积物。

flux.meaning: n. 不断的变动，流散，通量
flux.note:
The company's plans are in a state of flux due to budget cuts. 由于预算削减，公司的计划处于不断变动的状态中。

Market prices remain in constant flux. 市场价格保持在不断变动中。

foible.note:
Everyone has their own personal foibles and eccentricities. 每个人都有自己个人的小缺点和怪癖。

She patiently tolerated his minor foibles. 她耐心地包容了他那些小毛病。

foil.meaning: v. 阻挠，挫败 n. 箔，陪衬
foil.note:
Police managed to foil the bank robbery plot. 警方设法挫败了银行抢劫阴谋。

Wrap the leftovers in aluminum foil to keep them fresh. 用铝箔把剩菜包起来以保持新鲜。

fold.meaning: v. 折叠，合拢 n. 折痕，羊栏
fold.note:
Please fold the laundry and put it in the drawer. 请把洗好的衣服叠好放进抽屉里。

She folded the letter and placed it inside an envelope. 她把信折叠起来放进信封里。

folder.note:
Keep all your important documents in this plastic folder. 将你所有的重要文件保存在这个塑料文件夹里。

He organized his notes into separate project folders. 他把笔记整理到不同的项目文件夹中。

folklore.note:
Local folklore is rich with stories of ghosts and magical creatures. 当地的民间传说中充满了关于鬼魂和神奇生物的故事。

Researchers collected regional folklore from elderly villagers. 研究人员从老年村民那里收集了区域民间传说。

folly.note:
He later realized the folly of investing all his savings in one venture. 他后来意识到将所有积蓄投资于一个风险项目的愚蠢。

Building a house on such a steep cliff is absolute folly. 在如此陡峭的悬崖上建房子简直是荒唐事。

foment.meaning: v. 煽动，挑起（动乱、叛乱等）
foment.note:
The agitators tried to foment unrest among the workers. 那些煽动者试图在工人们中间煽动骚乱。

Foreign powers were accused of trying to foment a rebellion. 外国势力被指责试图煽动叛乱。

foodstuff.meaning: n. 食品，粮食，食品原料
foodstuff.note:
Imported foodstuffs must meet strict quality and safety standards. 进口食品必须符合严格的质量和安全标准。

The warehouse stores various essential foodstuffs. 仓库里储存着各种必需的食品原料。

foolproof.meaning: adj. 十拿九稳的，万无一失的
foolproof.note:
There is no such thing as a completely foolproof security system. 世界上没有完全万无一失的安保系统。

She designed a foolproof method to track inventory errors. 她设计了一种万无一失的方法来追踪库存错误。

foppish.meaning: adj. 过于注重穿着的，花花公子式的
foppish.note:
He dressed in a foppish style with bright velvet jackets. 他以一种花花公子式的风格穿着亮丽的天鹅绒夹克。

His foppish manners amused the other guests at the party. 他那花花公子般的举止逗乐了派对上的其他宾客。

forage.meaning: v. 搜寻粮草，觅食 n. 饲料
forage.note:
Wild bears forage for berries and roots in the woods. 野生熊在树林里搜寻浆果和根茎觅食。

Farmers stored winter forage for their cattle. 农民们为牛群储存了冬季饲料。

forager.note:
Ancient human groups lived as hunters and foragers. 古代人类群体作为猎人和觅食者生活。

Forest foragers searched the ground for edible mushrooms. 森林觅食者在地面上搜寻可食用的蘑菇。

forbearance.note:
We thank you for your patience and forbearance during the delay. 我们感谢您在延误期间的耐心与克制。

Handling difficult clients requires immense forbearance. 处理棘手的客户需要极大的宽容。

forbid.note:
The rules forbid smoking inside the building. 规章制度禁止在建筑物内部吸烟。

My schedule does not forbid me from joining you tomorrow. 我的时间表并不禁止我明天加入你们。

forbidding.meaning: adj. 令人望而生畏的，严峻的，险恶的
forbidding.note:
The dark, forbidding fortress stood on top of the hill. 那座黑暗而险恶的堡垒矗立在山顶上。

He gave me a cold and forbidding look. 他给了我一个冰冷且令人望而生畏的眼神。

ford.meaning: n. 浅滩 v. 涉水而过
ford.note:
They found a shallow ford to cross the rushing river. 他们找到了一个浅滩来涉水过急流。

Horses and wagons managed to ford the stream safely. 马匹和货车设法安全涉水穿过小溪。

forebode.meaning: v. 预示，预感（多指不祥之事）
forebode.note:
Dark storm clouds seemed to forebode a disaster. 乌云密布似乎预示着一场灾难。

His strange silence did not forebode anything good. 他奇怪的沉默并没有预示着任何好事。

forecast.meaning: n. 预测，预报 v. 预测
forecast.note:
The weather forecast predicts heavy rain for tomorrow. 天气预报预测明天有大雨。

Economists forecast a slow recovery for the market. 经济学家预测市场将缓慢复苏。

foreknowledge.note:
He claimed he had no foreknowledge of the surprise attack. 他声称自己事先对这次突袭一无所知。

Having foreknowledge of the changes helped them prepare. 提前预知这些变化帮助他们做好了准备。

forerunner.note:
This early invention was the forerunner of modern computers. 这项早期的发明是现代计算机的先驱。

Unusually warm winter days can be the forerunner of an early spring. 异常温暖的冬日可能是早春的先兆。

foreshadow.note:
The opening scene helps to foreshadow the tragic ending. 开场场景有助于预示悲剧性的结局。

Increased inflation can foreshadow economic trouble ahead. 通货膨胀加剧可能预示着前方有经济麻烦。

foresight.note:
Buying the property then showed great business foresight. 当时买下这处房产展现了极大的商业远见。

She had the foresight to save money for emergencies. 她很有远见地存钱以防紧急情况。

forestall.note:
Negotiators worked quickly to forestall a potential strike. 谈判代表迅速工作以预防潜在的罢工。

Taking medicine early can forestall the development of the flu. 早期服药可以阻止流感的发展。

forestry.note:
He studied forestry at the university to work in conservation. 他在大学学习林业以便从事保护工作。

Sustainable forestry practices protect natural ecosystems. 可持续的林业实践保护了自然生态系统。

forger.note:
Police arrested the master forger who copied famous paintings. 警方逮捕了那个临摹名画的造假大师。

The clever forger managed to duplicate official signatures. 那个聪明的伪造者设法复制了官方签名。

forgery.meaning: n. 伪造，伪造罪，假冒品
forgery.note:
Experts proved that the painting was a clever forgery. 专家证明那幅画是一件聪明的赝品。

He was charged with bank forgery and fraud. 他被指控犯有银行伪造和诈骗罪。

forgo.meaning: v. 放弃，抛弃，对…忍痛割爱
forgo.note:
She decided to forgo dessert to maintain her diet. 为了保持饮食，她决定放弃甜点。

I had to forgo the trip due to unexpected work. 由于意外的工作，我不得不放弃这次旅行。

formality.meaning: n. 礼节，循规蹈矩，形式
formality.note:
Signing the contract was just a legal formality. 签署合同只是一种法律上的形式而已。

He disliked the strict formality of diplomatic banquets. 他不喜欢外交宴会上那种严苛的繁文缛节。

formation.note:
Geologists study the rock formation in the grand canyon. 地质学家研究大峡谷中的岩石地质构造。

Migrating birds flew in a V-shaped formation across the sky. 迁徙的鸟类在天空中呈V字形编队飞行。

forte.note:
Public speaking is not his strong forte, but he is a great writer. 公众演讲不是他的强项，但他是个伟大的作家。

Mathematics has always been her academic forte. 数学一直是她的学术强项。

forthright.note:
She appreciated his forthright manner during the negotiations. 她很欣赏他在谈判期间的直率态度。

We need a forthright assessment of the project's problems. 我们需要对项目的问题进行一次坦诚的评估。

fortify.meaning: v. 加固，增强，筑防御工事
fortify.note:
Ancient walls were built to fortify the city against attacks. 古代建造城墙是为了加固城市以防攻击。

Foods are often fortified with extra vitamins and minerals. 食品通常会添加额外的维生素和矿物质以增强营养。

fortitude.note:
She faced her severe illness with remarkable fortitude. 她以惊人的坚韧面对自己的重病。

It takes great mental fortitude to survive such a crisis. 熬过这样一场危机需要巨大的心理刚毅。

fortuitous.meaning: adj. 偶然的，巧合的，幸运的
fortuitous.note:
Their meeting in Paris was entirely fortuitous. 他们在巴黎的见面完全是一场巧合。

A fortuitous change in the weather saved the event. 天气的幸运转变拯救了这次活动。

forum.note:
The internet provides a global forum for sharing opinions. 互联网为分享观点提供了一个全球性的论坛。

Experts gathered at the economic forum to discuss trade. 专家们聚集在经济论坛上讨论贸易问题。

forward.meaning: adv. 向前 adj. 向前的，热心的 v. 转寄，转发
forward.note:
Please step forward when your name is called. 当叫到你的名字时请向前迈一步。

I will forward your email to the manager in charge. 我会把你的电子邮件转发给负责的经理。

fosse.note:
The medieval castle was surrounded by a deep water fosse. 中世纪的城堡四周环绕着一条深水护城河。

Archaeologists uncovered the remains of an ancient defense fosse. 考古学家发掘出了一处古代防御壕沟的遗迹。

fossilize.note:
Bones can fossilize over millions of years under high pressure. 骨头在数百万年的高压下可以变成化石。

Institutions risk becoming fossilized if they refuse to adapt. 如果机构拒绝适应，就会面临僵化的风险。

founder.meaning: n. 创始人 v. 沉没，失败，垮掉
founder.note:
She is the founder of a successful technology startup. 她是一家成功的科技初创公司的创始人。

The project began to founder due to lack of funding. 该项目由于缺乏资金而开始陷入失败。

fracas.note:
Police were called in to break up the street fracas. 警察被请来制止街头混战。

A noisy fracas broke out outside the stadium after the game. 比赛结束后，体育场外爆发了一场喧闹的争吵。

fraction.note:
Only a small fraction of the budget was spent on advertising. 只有一小部分的预算花在了广告上。

One-half and three-quarters are common mathematical fractions. 二分之一和四分之三是常见的数学分数。

fractious.meaning: adj. 易怒的，脾气坏的，难驾驭的
fractious.note:
The fractious child refused to sit still during dinner. 那个脾气暴躁的孩子在晚餐时拒绝安静坐着。

Politicians struggled to manage the fractious coalition party. 政客们艰难地管理着那个难驾驭的执政联盟党。

fracture.meaning: n. 骨折，裂缝 v. 折断，破裂
fracture.note:
He suffered a wrist fracture after falling from his bicycle. 他从自行车上摔下来后手腕骨折了。

Pressure can fracture the hard rock over time. 压力随着时间推移会使坚硬的岩石开裂。

fragment.meaning: n. 碎片，片断 v. 破碎，分裂
fragment.note:
She found a small fragment of pottery in the garden. 她在花园里发现了一小片陶器碎片。

Society tends to fragment under economic pressure. 社会在经济压力下往往会趋于分裂。

fragrance.note:
The sweet fragrance of roses filled the summer garden. 玫瑰的甜美香气充满了夏日的花园。

She launched her own brand of luxury perfume and fragrance. 她推出了自己的奢侈香水品牌。

fragrant.note:
She brewed a pot of fragrant jasmine tea. 她泡了一壶香气扑鼻的茉莉花茶。

Walking through the fragrant pine forest was refreshing. 穿过芳香的松树林令人神清气爽。

frail.note:
The elderly man was physically frail after his illness. 老人在生病后身体十分虚弱。

Glass is a frail material that breaks easily. 玻璃是一种很容易破碎的脆弱材料。

frantic.meaning: adj. 发狂的，狂乱的，紧张忙乱的
frantic.note:
There was a frantic search for the missing child. 人们对失踪的孩子进行了疯狂的搜寻。

She made a frantic phone call to the hospital. 她给医院打了个紧急慌乱的电话。

fraud.note:
He was sentenced to prison for financial fraud. 他因金融欺诈被判处监禁。

The art dealer was exposed as a fraud. 那位艺术品经销商被揭穿是个骗子。

fraught.meaning: adj. 充满…的，令人忧虑的
fraught.note:
The negotiations were fraught with tension and disagreement. 谈判充满了紧张与分歧。

Starting a new business can be a fraught endeavor. 创业可能是一项令人担忧的艰难尝试。

freckle.meaning: n. 雀斑 v. 使长雀斑
freckle.note:
Sunlight caused her skin to freckle across her nose. 阳光使她的鼻子上长满了雀斑。

He had light brown hair and a scattering of freckles. 他有着浅棕色的头发和零星的雀斑。

freelancer.note:
She works as a freelance graphic designer for various clients. 她作为自由平面设计师为各种客户工作。

Being a freelancer gives you flexible working hours. 作为自由职业者给予你灵活的工作时间。

frenetic.meaning: adj. 狂乱的，发狂的，忙乱的
frenetic.note:
They worked at a frenetic pace to finish the project on time. 他们以狂乱的节奏工作以按时完成项目。

The city streets bustled with frenetic activity. 城市街道上充斥着忙乱的活动。

frenzy.meaning: n. 狂怒，狂乱，疯狂状态
frenzy.note:
Media speculation threw the stock market into a frenzy. 媒体的猜测让股市陷入了狂热状态。

Shoppers rushed into stores in a holiday buying frenzy. 购物者在假日购买狂潮中涌入商店。

frequency.note:
The frequency of train services increases during rush hours. 火车服务的频率在高峰时段增加。

Radio waves travel at different frequencies. 无以不同的频率传播无线电波。

frequent.meaning: adj. 经常的，频繁的 v. 常去，常到
frequent.note:
Earthquakes are a frequent occurrence in this seismic region. 地震在这个地震带是经常发生的现象。

Local artists tend to frequent this cozy coffee shop. 当地的艺术家们往往经常光顾这家舒适的咖啡馆。

fresco.note:
The church walls are decorated with stunning Renaissance frescoes. 教堂墙壁上装饰着令人惊叹的文艺复兴时期壁画。

She studied the ancient techniques of fresco restoration. 她研究了壁画修复的古代技术。

fret.meaning: v. 苦恼，烦躁，焦虑 n. 烦恼
fret.note:
There is no need to fret over things you cannot control. 没有必要为你无法控制的事情感到苦恼。

She spent hours fretting about the exam results. 她花了好几个小时为考试成绩焦虑不安。

friable.note:
The dry soil was light and friable, perfect for planting. 干燥的土壤轻盈且松脆，非常适合种植。

Good compost should be dark and friable. 好的堆肥应该是颜色深且易碎的。

frieze.meaning: n. 饰带，壁带（建筑雕刻）
frieze.note:
The temple featured a classical marble frieze depicting battles. 这座神庙有一个描绘战斗的古典大理石饰带。

Sculptors carved figures along the decorative wall frieze. 雕刻家们沿着装饰性墙壁饰带雕刻了人物。

frigid.meaning: adj. 严寒的，寒冷的；冷淡的
frigid.note:
They faced frigid temperatures during the winter expedition. 他们在冬季远征期间面临严寒的气温。

She greeted him with a frigid and distant expression. 她以冰冷而疏远的表情迎接了他。

frigidity.note:
The extreme frigidity of the winter weather kept people indoors. 冬季天气的极度寒冷把人们留在了室内。

Her emotional frigidity made it hard to connect with her. 她情感上的冷淡让人很难与她产生共鸣。

fringe.meaning: n. 边缘，流苏，刘海 adj. 边缘的
fringe.note:
They live in a quiet suburb on the fringe of the city. 他们住在城市边缘的一个安静郊区。

The jacket was decorated with long leather fringe. 这件夹克用长皮革流苏进行了装饰。

frisky.meaning: adj. 活泼的，嬉闹的，兴高采烈的
frisky.note:
The young puppies were feeling playful and frisky. 那几只小幼犬感到十分顽皮活泼。

After a long rest, the horse became quite frisky. 经过长时间的休息后，这匹马变得十分活泼。

frivolous.meaning: adj. 轻浮的，不严肃的，无聊的
frivolous.note:
He was criticized for spending money on frivolous luxuries. 他因把钱花在无聊的奢侈品上而受到批评。

She dismissed the complaint as a frivolous lawsuit. 她将该投诉斥为一桩无聊的诉讼。

frond.meaning: n. 复叶，大叶（如蕨类、棕榈树的叶）
frond.note:
Large tropical fronds cast cooling shadows on the ground. 大型热带叶子在地面上投下了凉爽的阴影。

He picked a green fern frond from the damp ground. 他从潮湿的地上摘下一片绿色的蕨类植物叶子。

frothy.meaning: adj. 起泡沫的，多泡的；空洞的
frothy.note:
She enjoyed a cup of cappuccino with frothy milk on top. 她喜欢喝一杯上面有奶泡的卡布奇诺。

The movie was a light, frothy romantic comedy. 这部电影是一部轻松且空洞的浪漫喜剧。

fruition.note:
After years of hard work, her plans finally came to fruition. 经过多年的努力，她的计划终于结出了硕果实现了。

We hope the new project will reach full fruition by next year. 我们希望新项目能在明年年底前全面实现。

frustrate.note:
Bad weather can easily frustrate outdoor event plans. 恶劣的天气很容易破坏户外活动的计划。

He felt frustrated when his hard work went unrecognized. 当他的努力没有得到认可时，他感到很沮丧。

fulcrum.meaning: n. 支点，杠杆支点；关键作用
fulcrum.note:
A lever requires a stable fulcrum to lift heavy loads. 杠杆需要一个稳定的支点来提起重物。

Education is the crucial fulcrum of social mobility. 教育是社会流动的关键支点。

fulfil.note:
She worked hard to fulfil her childhood dream of becoming a doctor. 她努力实现自己当医生的童年梦想。

We must fulfil our promises to the clients. 我们必须履行对客户的承诺。

fulminate.meaning: v. 猛烈抨击，大声斥责
fulminate.note:
He continued to fulminate against the new economic policies. 他继续猛烈抨击新的经济政策。

Critics fulminated over the lack of transparency in the deal. 批评家们对这笔交易缺乏透明度进行了大声斥责。

fulsome.meaning: adj. 过分谄媚的，虚情假意的，过度的
fulsome.note:
She grew tired of his fulsome praise and flattery. 她厌倦了他过分谄媚的赞美和奉承。

The review was so fulsome that it felt insincere. 这篇评论过于夸张，让人觉得不够真诚。

fume.meaning: n. 烟，气味，有害气体 v. 冒烟，发怒
fume.note:
Traffic fumes polluted the air in the downtown area. 交通废气污染了市中心的空气。

He was left to fume in anger after the unfair decision. 在做出不公正的决定后，他气得直发怒。

fumigate.note:
The old house had to be fumigated to get rid of termites. 那栋老房子必须进行熏蒸消毒以清除白蚁。

Ships are often fumigated before entering international ports. 船只在进入国际港口前通常要进行熏蒸。

functionary.meaning: n. 官员，公务人员，职员
functionary.note:
Government functionaries gathered for the annual briefing. 政府官员们聚集在一起参加年度简报会。

A minor functionary stamped the documents and handed them back. 一个低级职员盖了文件章并把它们还了回来。

fungi.note:
Mushrooms and molds are common types of fungi. 蘑菇和霉菌是常见的真菌类型。

Certain fungi play an essential role in forest ecosystems. 某些真菌在森林生态系统中起着至关重要的作用。

fungicide.note:
Farmers applied a chemical fungicide to protect their crops. 农民施用化学杀真菌剂来保护他们的庄稼。

Gardeners use organic fungicides to prevent plant diseases. 园丁使用有机杀菌剂来预防植物病害。

furor.meaning: n. 轰动，狂热，愤怒抗议
furor.note:
The controversial policy announcement caused a major public furor. 这项有争议的政策宣布引发了公众的强烈抗议与轰动。

His latest book created a furor among literary critics. 他的最新书在文学评论家中引起了轰动。

furrow.meaning: n. 犁沟，皱纹 v. 犁，使起皱纹
furrow.note:
Tractors plowed neat furrows across the vast field. 拖拉机在广阔的田野上犁出了整齐的沟垄。

A deep furrow appeared on his forehead as he thought. 当他思考时，他的额头上出现了一道深深的皱纹。

furtive.meaning: adj. 鬼鬼祟祟的；秘密的
furtive.note:
She cast a furtive glance at the clock.
她偷偷地瞄了一眼时钟。

He made a furtive attempt to steal a cookie.
他偷偷摸摸地试图偷一块饼干。

fusillade.meaning: n. 齐射；连发；v. 连续射击
fusillade.note:
The speaker was met with a fusillade of questions from reporters.
发言者遭到记者们的一连串提问。

A sudden fusillade of gunfire shattered the night silence.
一阵突如其来的枪声打破了夜的寂静。

fusion.note:
Their music is a fascinating fusion of jazz and traditional folk.
他们的音乐是爵士乐与传统民间音乐的迷人融合。

Scientists are still researching controlled nuclear fusion as an energy source.
科学家们仍在研究受控核聚变作为能源的利用。

fuss.meaning: n. 大惊小怪；忙乱；v. 大惊小怪；劳神
fuss.note:
She made a great fuss over her granddaughter's birthday party.
她为孙女的生日聚会大操大办。

Don't make such a fuss about a minor mistake.
不要为一个小错误大惊小怪。

fussy.meaning: adj. 挑剔的；难伺候的；过分装饰的
fussy.note:
He is very fussy about what he eats.
他对吃的东西非常挑剔。

The dress was a bit too fussy for her taste.
对她的品味来说，这裙子装饰得有点太繁琐了。

fusty.meaning: adj. 发霉的；陈腐的；守旧的
fusty.note:
The old library smelled of fusty books.
这座老图书馆里弥漫着陈旧书籍的气味。

His ideas on management are rather fusty.
他对管理的观点相当陈腐。

futile.note:
All his attempts to rescue the project proved futile.
他所有拯救该项目的尝试都证明是徒劳的。

It is futile to argue with someone who refuses to listen.
和拒不听取意见的人争辩是毫无意义的。

futility.meaning: n. 徒劳；无用；白费力气
futility.note:
She realized the utter futility of trying to change his mind.
她意识到试图改变他的想法是完全徒劳的。

They discussed the futility of war in the modern age.
他们讨论了现代战争的无意义性。

gadfly.meaning: n. 牛虻；惹是生非者；讨人嫌的人
gadfly.note:
Cows were tormented by the biting gadfly in the field.
牛群在田野里受到叮咬牛虻的折磨。

He acts as a political gadfly, constantly questioning authority.
他扮演着政治批评者的角色，不断性质疑权威。

gadget.note:
He loves buying all sorts of electronic gadgets.
他喜欢买各种各样的电子小玩意儿。

This clever little gadget helps you open jars easily.
这个聪明的机械小器具能帮您轻松打开罐子。

gaffe.note:
The politician made a major gaffe during the live broadcast.
这位政治家在直播期间犯了一个重大的失言错误。

She immediately regretted her social gaffe at the dinner party.
她立刻为自己在晚宴上的社交失态感到后悔。

gaggle.meaning: n. 一群（鹅或人）；喧闹的一群
gaggle.note:
A gaggle of geese waddled across the farm path.
一群鹅摇摇摆摆地穿过农场小路。

A gaggle of reporters surrounded the celebrity.
一群记者围住了这位名人。

gainsay.note:
It is hard to gainsay the evidence presented in the report.
很难否认报告中所呈现的证据。

No one can gainsay her dedication to the project.
没有人能否认她对该项目的奉献精神。

gait.note:
He walked with a distinct limp in his gait.
他的步态有着明显的瘸腿特征。

She recognized him from afar by his swinging gait.
她远远地通过他摇摆的步态认出了他。

galaxy.note:
Our solar system is located in the Milky Way galaxy.
我们的太阳系位于银河系中。

The event was attended by a galaxy of Hollywood stars.
群星璀璨的好莱坞明星出席了这次活动。

gallant.meaning: adj. 英勇的；宏伟的；殷勤的
gallant.note:
The soldiers made a gallant defense of the fortress.
士兵们对堡垒进行了英勇的防守。

He made a gallant offer to carry her heavy bags.
他殷勤地提出帮她提沉重的包。

galley.meaning: n. 船上的厨房；大型划船；校样
galley.note:
The flight attendants prepared meals in the plane's galley.
乘务员在飞机的厨房里准备餐食。

The author received the galley proofs for final correction.
作者收到了用于最终校对的校样。

gallon.note:
The car consumes about one gallon of gas every thirty miles.
这辆车每行驶三十英里消耗大约一加仑汽油。

We need a few gallons of water for the camping trip.
我们需要几加仑水去露营旅行。

galvanize.note:
The speech managed to galvanize the crowd into action.
这番演讲成功地激励了人群采取行动。

Workers used zinc to galvanize the iron pipes against rust.
工人们用锌给铁管镀锌以防生锈。

gamble.note:
He lost a lot of money when he began to gamble.
当他开始赌博时，他输了许多钱。

Expanding the business into foreign markets was a huge gamble.
将业务拓展到海外市场是一场巨大的冒险。

gambol.note:
Lambs were seen to gambol in the green meadow.
人们看到小羊羔在绿草地上嬉戏。

The children enjoyed their playful gambol in the park.
孩子们在公园里享受着嬉戏玩耍的快乐。

gangway.note:
Passengers queued up to cross the gangway onto the cruise ship.
乘客们排队通过舷梯登上游轮。

Please keep the gangway clear of luggage.
请保持通道内没有行李阻塞。

gape.meaning: v. 张口结舌；目瞪口呆；裂开
gape.note:
The tourists stood in gape at the magnificent cathedral.
游客们目瞪口呆地站在宏伟的大教堂前。

There was a wide gape in the old wooden fence.
旧木栅栏上有一个大裂口。

garble.note:
Poor transmission line caused the audio message to garble.
糟糕的传输线路导致语音信息变得含糊不清。

Do not garble the facts to suit your argument.
不要为了迎合你的论点而歪曲事实。

garbled.meaning: adj. 曲解的；失真的；断续不清的
garbled.note:
I received a garbled phone message from the office.
我收到了办公室发来的一条听不清楚的电话留言。

The instructions were so garbled that nobody understood them.
指令被曲解得太厉害，以至于没人听得懂。

gardenia.note:
She pinned a white gardenia to her lapel.
她在翻领上别了一朵白栀子花。

The sweet scent of gardenia filled the summer evening.
栀子花的甜美香气充盈着夏日的夜晚。

gargantuan.note:
He faced a gargantuan task of clearing the backlog.
他面临着清理积压工作的巨大任务。

They ordered a gargantuan meal for the party.
他们为聚会点了一顿丰盛无比的大餐。

gargoyle.meaning: n. 滴水嘴兽；怪兽雕像
gargoyle.note:
The gothic church featured carved stone gargoyles on its roof.
这座哥特式教堂的屋顶上有雕刻的石制滴水嘴兽。

Rainwater poured out of the stone gargoyle's mouth.
雨水从石制滴水嘴兽的嘴里喷涌而出。

garish.meaning: adj. 过于艳丽的；俗气的；刺眼的
garish.note:
She wore a garish dress covered in neon patterns.
她穿了一件布满霓虹图案的艳丽裙子。

The room was decorated in garish colors that hurt the eyes.
房间被装饰成刺眼的颜色，让人眼睛疼。

garner.note:
The actor managed to garner several awards for his role.
这位演员凭借他的角色设法获得了几个奖项。

She tried to garner as much information as possible.
她试图收集尽可能多的信息。

garnish.meaning: v. 装饰（食物）；n. 饰品；配菜
garnish.note:
The chef added parsley as a garnish to the soup.
厨师在汤里加了欧芹作为装饰。

She garnished the fish platter with lemon slices.
她用柠檬片装饰了鱼盘。

garrulity.meaning: n. 多话；滔滔不绝；唠叨
garrulity.note:
His natural garrulity made it hard for others to get a word in.
他天生健谈，使得别人很难插上话。

She was annoyed by the old man's endless garrulity.
老人无休止的唠叨令她感到烦恼。

gaseous.note:
Jupiter is primarily a gaseous planet.
木星主要是一个气态行星。

The substance changes from a liquid to a gaseous state.
该物质从液态转变为气态。

gash.note:
He suffered a deep gash on his arm from the sharp metal.
他的手臂被尖锐的金属划出了一道深深的伤口。

The falling branch managed to gash the side of the car.
掉落的树枝把汽车侧面刮了一道深口子。

gasification.note:
Coal gasification is a clean energy technology.
煤炭气化是一种清洁能源技术。

The process involves the gasification of solid organic matter.
该过程涉及固体有机物的气化。

gaucherie.meaning: n. 笨拙；失礼；粗鲁言行
gaucherie.note:
His social gaucherie embarrassed everyone at the formal dinner.
他的社交笨拙让正式晚宴上的所有人都感到尴尬。

She tried to overlook his youthful gaucherie.
她试图忽视他年轻时的粗鲁失礼。

gaudy.note:
He wore a gaudy tie that didn't match his suit at all.
他戴了一条与西装完全不搭的花哨领带。

The stage was decorated with gaudy plastic flowers.
舞台用艳俗的塑料花进行了装饰。

gauge.meaning: n. 计量器；标准；v. 测量；判断
gauge.note:
Check the fuel gauge before starting a long trip.
在开始长途旅行前检查一下油量表。

It is difficult to gauge public reaction to the new policy.
很难判断公众对这项新政策的反应。

gavel.meaning: n. 小木槌（法官或会议主席用）
gavel.note:
The judge banged the gavel to restore order in the courtroom.
法官敲击小木槌以恢复法庭秩序。

With a final tap of the gavel, the auction was closed.
随着小木槌的最后敲击，拍卖会结束了。

gazetteer.meaning: n. 地名词典；地理词汇表
gazetteer.note:
He looked up the remote village in a geographical gazetteer.
他在一本地理地名词典中查阅了那个偏远村庄。

The historical gazetteer provided maps of ancient towns.
这本历史地名词典提供了古代城镇的地图。

gem.meaning: n. 宝石；珍品；极优秀的人
gem.note:
Her engagement ring features a stunning blue gem.
她的订婚戒指镶嵌着一颗耀眼的蓝色宝石。

This small cafe is a hidden gem in the city center.
这家小咖啡馆是市中心的一处隐藏宝地。

genealogy.note:
She spent years researching her family's genealogy.
她花了好几年时间研究自己家族的家谱。

The library has a large collection of genealogy records.
图书馆藏有大量家谱记录。

generality.meaning: n. 概述；泛泛而谈；大部分
generality.note:
Stop speaking in vague generalities and give me details.
别再讲空洞的泛泛之谈了，给我具体的细节。

The generality of people prefer peace to conflict.
大多数人更喜欢和平而非冲突。

generalize.note:
It is dangerous to generalize from a single example.
仅凭一个例子就下结论是很危险的。

Scientists generalize the findings to apply to broader populations.
科学家将研究结果概括应用于更广泛的人群。

generator.note:
The hospital switched to an emergency generator during the blackout.
停电期间，医院切换到了应急发电机。

This steam generator powers the entire factory.
这台蒸汽发电机为整个工厂提供动力。

generosity.note:
We are grateful for the charity's generosity.
我们对这家慈善机构的慷慨表示感谢。

She thanked him for his generosity in supporting her education.
她感谢他在资助她教育方面的慷慨大方。

genesis.note:
The professor wrote a book about the genesis of the universe.
这位教授写了一本关于宇宙起源的书。

They studied the genesis of the financial crisis.
他们研究了这场金融危机的发端。

genetics.note:
She is studying genetics at university.
她在大学里修读遗传学。

Advancements in genetics have revolutionized modern medicine.
遗传学的进步彻底变革了现代医学。

genial.meaning: adj. 亲切的；和蔼的；温和的
genial.note:
Our host was a genial man who made us feel at home.
我们的主人是个和蔼可亲的人，让我们感到宾至如归。

The genial climate of the region attracts many tourists.
该地区温和的气候吸引了许多游客。

genome.note:
The human genome was successfully mapped years ago.
人类基因组在几年前被成功测序绘图。

Scientists sequenced the genome of the rare plant.
科学家测序了这种稀有植物的基因组。

genre.meaning: n. （文学、艺术等的）体裁；类型
genre.note:
Science fiction is my favorite literary genre.
科幻小说是我最喜欢的文学体裁。

His music blends elements of several different genres.
他的音乐融合了几个不同流派的元素。

genteel.meaning: adj. 有教养的；文雅的；上流社会的
genteel.note:
She grew up in a genteel family with strict etiquette.
她在有着严格礼仪的文雅家庭中长大。

The hotel caters to a genteel clientele.
这家酒店迎合高雅客人群体的需求。

gentle.meaning: adj. 温柔的；温和的；轻柔的
gentle.note:
He spoke to the frightened child in a gentle voice.
他用温柔的声音对受惊的孩子说话。

A gentle breeze blew across the garden.
一阵微风吹过花园。

gentry.meaning: n. 乡绅；贵族；上流社会人士
gentry.note:
Historically, the local gentry held significant political influence.
历史上，当地的乡绅拥有重大的政治影响力。

The estate was owned by a wealthy landed gentry.
这座庄园由一位富有的土地贵族拥有。

genus.note:
Dogs and wolves belong to the same genus, Canis.
狗和狼属于同一个属，即犬属。

This plant species belongs to a large tropical genus.
这种植物属于一个庞大的热带属。

geometrician.note:
Ancient Greeks produced many brilliant geometricians.
古希腊人涌现出许多杰出的几何学家。

The geometrician used complex proofs to solve the theorem.
这位几何学家使用复杂的证明来解开这个定理。

germ.note:
Wash your hands thoroughly to kill harmful germs.
彻底洗手以杀死有害细菌。

That conversation contained the germ of our future business plan.
那次谈话包含了我们未来商业计划的萌芽。

germane.meaning: adj. 紧密相关的；贴切的
germane.note:
Your comments are interesting, but not germane to the topic.
你的评论很有趣，但与本题无关。

Please keep your questions germane to the lecture.
请让你的问题与讲座内容紧密相关。

germicide.note:
Hospital floors are cleaned regularly with strong germicide.
医院地板定期用强力杀菌剂清洗。

Ultraviolet light can act as an effective germicide.
紫外线可以充当有效的杀菌剂。

gerontocracy.meaning: n. 老人统治；老人政治
gerontocracy.note:
Critics argued the organization had devolved into a gerontocracy.
批评者认为该组织已经退化为老年人统治的体制。

Power in the traditional village was held by a council of elders in a gerontocracy.
传统村庄的权力掌握在长老会手中，属于老人统治。

gerontology.note:
She specializes in gerontology to understand the aging process.
她专攻老年学以了解衰老过程。

Advances in gerontology have improved the quality of life for seniors.
老年学的发展改善了老年人的生活质量。

gerrymander.meaning: v./n. 不公正划分选区（以利于某党派）
gerrymander.note:
The ruling party was accused of trying to gerrymander the voting districts.
执政党被指控试图通过不正当手段划分选区。

Gerrymandering undermines the fairness of democratic elections.
不公正划分选区破坏了民主选举的公平性。

gesture.meaning: n. 手势；姿态；v. 做手势
gesture.note:
He made a rude gesture with his hand.
他用手做出一个粗鲁的手势。

Sending flowers was a kind gesture of sympathy.
送花是一种友善的同情姿态。

geyser.note:
Old Faithful is a famous geyser located in Yellowstone.
老忠实泉是位于黄石公园的著名间歇泉。

Hot water erupted high into the air from the geyser.
热水从间歇泉中高高地喷射到空中。

gibe.note:
He ignored the malicious gibes of his competitors.
他无视竞争对手的恶毒讥讽。

They would gibe at anyone who made a mistake.
他们会嘲弄任何犯错的人。

giddy.meaning: adj. 眩晕的；轻浮的；兴奋得发晕的
giddy.note:
Standing on the high rooftop made her feel giddy.
站在高高的屋顶上让她感到头晕目眩。

She felt a giddy sense of relief after passing the exam.
考试及格后，她感到一阵飘飘然的轻松。

giggle.note:
The girls began to giggle in the back of the classroom.
女孩们在教室后面开始咯咯笑起来。

She tried to suppress a nervous giggle during the presentation.
她在演讲过程中试图压抑紧张的傻笑。

gimmick.meaning: n. 花招；把戏；促销噱头
gimmick.note:
Free delivery is just a marketing gimmick to attract customers.
免费配送只是一种吸引客户的营销噱头。

I prefer buying products for quality, not because of gimmicks.
我更倾向于为质量买单，而不是因为各种花招。

gingerly.meaning: adv./adj. 小心翼翼地；谨慎的
gingerly.note:
He stepped gingerly across the icy sidewalk.
他小心翼翼地走过结冰的人行道。

She touched the bruised skin gingerly with her fingertips.
她用指尖小心翼翼地触碰着淤青的皮肤。

girder.note:
Steel girders were used to support the massive bridge.
钢梁被用来支撑这座巨大的桥梁。

Workers lifted the heavy steel girder with a crane.
工人们用起重机吊起沉重的钢梁。

girth.note:
The ancient oak tree measured twenty feet in girth.
这棵古老的橡树树围长达二十英尺。

Make sure the saddle girth is tight before you ride.
骑马前确保马鞍肚带扎紧了。

gist.note:
I missed the beginning, but I got the gist of his speech.
我错过了开头，但我抓住了他演讲的主旨。

Can you give me the gist of the report in a few words?
你能用几句话把报告的要点告诉我吗？

glacial.meaning: adj. 冰川的；冰冷的；极缓慢的
glacial.note:
The valley was shaped by glacial erosion thousands of years ago.
这个山谷是数千年前由冰川侵蚀形成的。

Progress on the new trade agreement has been at a glacial pace.
新贸易协定的进展速度极其缓慢。

glade.note:
They found a quiet grassy glade in the middle of the forest.
他们在森林中央发现了一块安静的草地空地。

Sunlight filtered through the trees onto the green glade.
阳光透过树木洒在绿色的林间空地上。

gladiator.note:
Roman gladiators fought for entertainment in the Colosseum.
罗马角斗士在斗兽场中为娱乐而战。

The politician fought like a gladiator in the televised debate.
这位政治家在电视辩论中像个斗士一样激烈抗争。

glare.note:
He gave me an angry glare and walked away.
他愤怒地瞪了我一眼，然后走开了。

The afternoon sun produced a bright glare on the windshield.
午后的阳光在挡风玻璃上产生了耀眼的强光。

glaze.meaning: v./n. 上釉；加糖霜；凝视发呆
glaze.note:
The potter applied a glossy blue glaze to the ceramic bowl.
陶艺家给陶碗施了一层光亮的蓝色釉料。

His eyes began to glaze over during the long lecture.
在漫长的讲座中，他的眼神开始呆滞发呆。

glean.meaning: v. 搜集；点滴搜寻（信息等）
glean.note:
She managed to glean some useful details from various sources.
她设法从各种渠道搜集了一些有用的细节。

Data is gleaned from customer surveys and feedback records.
数据是通过顾客调查和反馈记录搜集而来的。

glib.meaning: adj. 口齿伶俐却肤浅的；油腔滑调的
glib.note:
He gave a glib response that failed to satisfy the audience.
他给出了一个未能让观众满意的油腔滑调的回答。

Beware of politicians with glib promises.
警惕那些巧舌如簧、承诺空洞的政治家。

glide.note:
The swan began to glide smoothly across the lake.
天鹅开始平稳地在湖面上滑行。

Eagles can glide on thermal air currents for hours.
老鹰可以在热气流上滑翔数小时。

glimmer.meaning: v./n. 微光；闪烁；一丝希望
glimmer.note:
A single candle offered a faint glimmer in the dark room.
一支蜡烛在黑暗的房间里提供了一丝微弱的光芒。

There is still a glimmer of hope for a peaceful resolution.
和平解决仍有一线希望。

glisten.meaning: v. 闪烁；闪耀（尤指湿润的反光）
glisten.note:
Her eyes began to glisten with unshed tears.
她的眼睛里闪烁着未落的泪花。

The wet street began to glisten under the streetlights.
湿漉漉的街道在路灯下闪闪发光。

gloat.meaning: v. 幸灾乐祸；得意洋洋
gloat.note:
It is not polite to gloat over your opponent's defeat.
对对手的失败幸灾乐祸是不礼貌的。

He couldn't resist gloating about his high exam score.
他忍不住为自己高昂的考试分数而洋洋得意。

gloom.note:
Economic gloom has affected consumer spending habits.
经济的阴霾影响了消费者的消费习惯。

The small room was wrapped in deep gloom.
这个小房间笼罩在深深的黑暗与阴郁中。

gloomy.meaning: adj. 阴暗的；沮丧的；悲观的
gloomy.note:
The weather forecast predicts a gloomy rainy weekend.
天气预报预测将是一个阴雨绵绵的周末。

He gave a gloomy outlook on the future of the company.
他对公司的未来给出了悲观的展望。

gloss.meaning: n. 光泽，注释；v. 掩盖，发光
gloss.note:
The magazine cover had a shiny gloss finish. 杂志封面具有闪亮的光泽效果。
