He tried to gloss over his mistakes during the meeting. 他试图在会议期间掩盖自己的错误。

glossy.meaning: adj. 光滑的；有光泽的；精美的
glossy.note:
The cat had thick, glossy black fur.
这只猫有着浓密且有光泽的黑色皮毛。

The fashion magazine is printed on glossy paper.
这本时尚杂志是用光泽纸印刷的。

glow.meaning: v./n. 发光；白热；红光满面
glow.note:
The embers in the fireplace continued to glow warmly.
壁炉里的余烬继续散发着温暖的微光。

She had a healthy glow on her cheeks after the jog.
慢跑过后，她的脸颊泛着健康的红润。

glower.meaning: v./n. 怒视；恶狠狠地盯着
glower.note:
He continued to glower at anyone who interrupted him.
他继续恶狠狠地盯着任何打断他的人。

She met his angry glower with a calm expression.
她以平静的表情迎着他愤怒的怒视。

glowing.meaning: adj. 炽热的；热烈赞扬的
glowing.note:
The restaurant received glowing reviews from food critics.
这家餐厅获得了美食评论家们的热烈好评。

She looked up with glowing pride at her graduation ceremony.
她在毕业典礼上带着炽热的自豪感抬起头。

glut.meaning: n./v. 供应过剩；充斥；使吃饱
glut.note:
There is a global glut of oil on the market this year.
今年市场上出现了全球性的石油供应过剩。

The market was glutted with cheap imported electronics.
市场上充斥着廉价的进口电子产品。

glutinous.note:
Glutinous rice is commonly used to make Asian desserts.
糯米常被用来制作亚洲甜点。

The chemical produced a thick, glutinous substance.
这种化学物质产生了一种厚重的胶状物质。

gluttonous.note:
His gluttonous appetite amazed everyone at the buffet.
他贪婪的食量让自助餐上的所有人都大吃一惊。

She criticized the gluttonous consumption of natural resources.
她批评了对自然资源的贪婪消耗。

gnarled.meaning: adj. 粗糙的；扭曲的；多节的
gnarled.note:
The ancient tree had gnarled branches reaching out.
那棵古树有着扭曲伸展的枝桠。

He worked with gnarled hands that showed a lifetime of labor.
他用饱经风霜、关节粗大的双手工作着。

gnaw.note:
The puppy began to gnaw on a wooden chew toy.
这只小狗开始啃一个木制咬胶玩具。

Doubts continued to gnaw at her conscience.
疑虑不断地折磨着她的良心。

goad.meaning: v./n. 刺激；驱使；激励；赶牛棒
goad.note:
He tried to goad his brother into a fight.
他试图激怒他的兄弟进行一场打斗。

She used her ambition as a goad to push herself forward.
她把野心当作激励自己前进的动力。

gobble.meaning: v. 狼吞虎咽；贪婪地吞食
gobble.note:
The hungry dog began to gobble its food.
饥饿的狗开始狼吞虎咽地吃食物。

He managed to gobble down a sandwich before the meeting.
他在会议前勉强狼吞虎咽地吃下了一个三明治。

goblet.note:
She filled the crystal goblet with red wine.
她把水晶高脚杯倒满了红酒。

The medieval banquet featured ornate silver goblets.
这场中世纪宴会备有华丽的银制高脚杯。

goldbrick.note:
He was fired because management caught him trying to goldbrick.
他被解雇是因为管理层抓到他试图偷懒。

Don't be a goldbrick and finish your assigned tasks.
别偷懒，把分配给你的任务完成。

gong.note:
The master struck the large brass gong to signal dinner.
师傅敲击大铜锣以发出晚饭的信号。

A deep sound echoed as the heavy mallet hit the gong.
当沉重的木槌敲击锣时，回荡起一声低沉的声音。

goodwill.note:
The visit was intended to foster mutual goodwill between nations.
这次访问旨在增进两国之间的相互善意。

The company has built a strong reputation and consumer goodwill.
这家公司建立起了良好的声誉和客户商誉。

gospel.meaning: n. 福音；真理；绝对真理
gospel.note:
He read passages from the Christian gospel.
他阅读了基督教福音书中的段落。

Don't take everything he says as gospel truth.
不要把他说的每一句话都当成绝对真理。

gossamer.meaning: adj./n. 蛛丝；轻飘飘的；缥缈的
gossamer.note:
Spiderwebs glittered with gossamer threads in the morning dew.
蜘蛛网在晨露中闪烁着蛛丝般的细线。

She wore a dress made of gossamer fabric.
她穿着一件由轻薄飘逸的面料制成的裙子。

gouge.meaning: v./n. 挖出；凿；敲竹杠（索取高价）
gouge.note:
He accidentally used the screwdriver to gouge the wooden table.
他不小心用螺丝刀在木桌上挖出了一道痕迹。

Unscrupulous merchants tried to gouge customers during the crisis.
无良商家试图在危机期间对顾客敲竹杠索取高价。

gourmand.meaning: n. 老饕；贪吃者；美食家
gourmand.note:
He is a true gourmand who loves rich and abundant food.
他是一个真正喜爱丰富油腻食物的老饕。

The restaurant menu satisfies both epicures and gourmand eaters.
这份餐厅菜单同时满足了美食家和贪吃者的需求。

gourmet.meaning: adj./n. 美食的；美酒佳肴的；美食家
gourmet.note:
She bought some expensive ingredients from a gourmet grocery store.
她从一家美食杂货店买了一些昂贵的食材。

The chef prepared a gourmet meal for the special guests.
主厨为贵宾准备了一顿精致的美食大餐。

gracious.meaning: adj. 亲切的；仁慈的；宽厚的
gracious.note:
The host was very gracious to all the visitors.
主人对所有的来访者都非常亲切热情。

She accepted her defeat with gracious sportsmanship.
她以宽厚大度的体育精神接受了失败。

gradation.meaning: n. 渐变；渐进的阶梯；层次
gradation.note:
The artist used subtle gradations of color in the painting.
艺术家在画作中运用了微妙的色彩渐变。

There are fine gradations of meaning between these two words.
这两个词的意思之间存在着细微的差别层次。

graduated.meaning: adj. 毕业的；分等级的；有刻度的
graduated.note:
She poured water into a graduated cylinder in chemistry class.
她在化学课上将水倒入有刻度的量筒中。

The tax system features a graduated scale based on income.
税收体系具有基于收入的分级累进标准。

graft.meaning: n./v. 嫁接；移植；贪污受贿
graft.note:
The gardener performed a successful plant graft.
园丁进行了一次成功的植物嫁接。

Surgeons performed a skin graft on the burn patient.
外科医生对烧伤患者进行了皮肤移植手术。

grandeur.note:
They admired the natural grandeur of the mountain landscape.
他们赞叹山地景观的宏伟壮丽。

The palace was built to reflect imperial power and grandeur.
这座宫殿的建造旨在体现皇权与宏伟气势。

grandstand.meaning: n. 大看台；v. 哗众取宠；博取观众喝彩
grandstand.note:
The sports stadium featured large covered grandstands.
这个体育场设有大型的有盖看台。

Politicians often grandstand during election campaigns.
政客们在竞选活动期间经常哗众取宠。

granite.note:
The kitchen countertops were made of solid granite.
厨房台面是用坚固的花岗岩制作的。

The monument was carved out of a massive block of granite.
这座纪念碑是由一块巨大的花岗岩雕刻而成的。

grant.meaning: v. 授予；同意；n. 拨款；补助金
grant.note:
The research team received a government grant for their project.
研究小组因他们的项目获得了政府补助金。

The university agreed to grant her a full scholarship.
大学同意授予她全额奖学金。

graphic.meaning: adj. 图表的；生动的；形象的
graphic.note:
The report includes graphic charts to illustrate the data trend.
报告中包含用以说明数据趋势的图表。

The movie contains graphic scenes of violence.
这部电影包含生动逼真的暴力场景。

graphite.note:
Pencils contain a mixture of clay and graphite.
铅笔包含粘土和石墨的混合物。

Graphite is a good conductor of electricity.
石墨是一种良好的导电体。

grasping.meaning: adj. 贪婪的；唯利是图的
grasping.note:
She despised her uncle for his grasping and selfish nature.
她鄙视她叔叔贪婪自私的本性。

The grasping landlord raised the rent once again.
贪婪的房东又一次提高了租金。

gratification.note:
He sought instant gratification rather than long-term goals.
他寻求即时满足，而不是长远目标。

She found deep gratification in helping underprivileged children.
她在帮助弱势儿童中找到了深深的满足感。

gratify.meaning: v. 使满足；使高兴；纵容
gratify.note:
It was gratifying to see all her hard work pay off.
看到她所有的辛苦努力有了回报，真是令人欣慰。

He wanted to gratify his curiosity by opening the box.
他想通过打开箱子来满足自己的好奇心。

grating.meaning: adj. 刺耳的；烦人的；n. 格子；护栅
grating.note:
Her grating voice gave him a headache.
她那刺耳的声音让他头疼。

Leaves were caught in the metal drainage grating.
树叶被卡在金属排水格子栅栏里。

gratitude.note:
She expressed her deep gratitude for his timely assistance.
她对他及时的帮助表达了深深的感激之情。

They sent a thank-you note as a token of their gratitude.
他们寄了一张感谢信以表达谢意。

gratuity.note:
A 15% gratuity was added automatically to the restaurant bill.
餐厅账单中自动加收了百分之十五的小费。

He left a generous gratuity for the excellent service.
他为出色的服务留了一笔丰厚的小费。

gravel.note:
The driveway was covered with loose white gravel.
车道上铺满了疏松的白色碎石。

His car tires crunched on the gravel path.
他的汽车轮胎在碎石小路上发出咯吱咯吱的声音。

gravitational.note:
The moon is held in orbit by Earth's gravitational pull.
月球被地球的引力拉力维持在轨道上。

Gravitational forces control the motion of planets.
引力控制着行星的运动。

grease.meaning: n. 油脂；润滑剂；v. 涂油脂
grease.note:
Wipe the kitchen stove to remove stubborn grease.
擦拭厨房炉灶以去除顽固的油脂。

He used engine grease to lubricate the metal hinges.
他用机油润滑金属铰链。

greenhouse.note:
Delicate flowers are grown inside the heated greenhouse.
娇嫩的花朵生长在加温温室里。

Greenhouse gases trap heat in the Earth's atmosphere.
温室气体将热量锁在地球大气层中。

gregariousness.meaning: n. 爱交际；合群；群居性
gregariousness.note:
Her natural gregariousness helped her make friends quickly.
她天生合群的性格帮她迅速交到了朋友。

Animals show different degrees of social gregariousness.
动物表现出不同程度的群居性。

grenade.note:
The soldier threw a smoke grenade to cover their retreat.
士兵扔了一颗烟雾弹以掩护他们的撤退。

Training involves learning how to handle a dummy grenade.
训练包括学习如何处理模拟手榴弹。

grievance.note:
Employees have a formal channel to air their workplace grievances.
员工拥有一个表达其职场不满的正式渠道。

The union representative listened to the workers' grievances.
工会代表倾听了工人们的委屈。

grieve.note:
She needed time to grieve the loss of her beloved pet.
她需要时间来哀悼失去爱宠的悲痛。

It grieves me to see the old building abandoned.
看到这座老建筑被废弃，我感到很难过。

grievous.meaning: adj. 严重的；极痛苦的；堪忧的
grievous.note:
He made a grievous error in his financial judgment.
他在财务判断上犯了一个严重的错误。

The accident resulted in grievous injuries to several passengers.
事故导致几名乘客受了重伤。

grill.meaning: v. 烤；严加盘问；n. 烤架
grill.note:
They decided to grill burgers in the backyard.
他们决定在后院烤汉堡。

Police continued to grill the suspect for hours.
警察连续数小时对嫌疑人进行严加盘问。

grim.meaning: adj. 冷酷的；严峻的；令人沮丧的
grim.note:
The economic report painted a grim picture for the future.
经济报告对未来勾勒出了一幅严峻的图景。

He received the grim news with a stoic expression.
他以坚忍的表情接收了这个令人沮丧的坏消息。

grimace.meaning: v./n. 面部痛苦扭曲；鬼脸
grimace.note:
He let out a grimace of pain as the doctor touched his arm.
当医生触碰他的手臂时，他露出了痛苦的扭曲表情。

She made a funny grimace to make the baby laugh.
她做了一个滑稽的鬼脸逗婴儿笑。

gripe.note:
He always finds something to gripe about after work.
他下班后总能找出一些事情来抱怨。

Her main gripe is the lack of parking spaces in the office.
她主要的抱怨是办公室缺乏停车位。

gripping.meaning: adj. 扣人心弦的；吸引人的
gripping.note:
The thriller novel has a truly gripping plot from start to finish.
这本惊悚小说自始至终都有着一个真正扣人心弦的情节。

We watched a gripping documentary about deep-sea exploration.
我们观看了一部关于深海探索的引人入胜的纪录片。

grisly.note:
The newspaper detailed the grisly murder investigation.
报纸详细报道了这起血淋淋的谋杀案调查。

He turned away from the grisly sight of the accident.
他转过头去，不去看事故现场那血腥的一幕。

gristle.note:
He cut away the tough gristle from the piece of steak.
他切掉了牛排上坚韧的软骨。

The meat was poor quality and full of gristle.
这肉质量很差，充满了软骨。

grit.meaning: n. 沙砾；毅力；v. 咬紧牙关
grit.note:
There was grit in his shoes after walking on the dirt road.
走在土路上后，他的鞋子里进了沙砾。

She showed true grit in overcoming all the obstacles.
她在克服所有障碍时展现了真正的毅力。

groan.note:
He let out a low groan when he lifted the heavy box.
他抬起沉重的箱子时发出了一声低沉的呻吟。

The audience groaned when the movie projector broke down.
当电影放映机坏了时，观众发出了一片抱怨声。

groom.meaning: n. 新郎；马夫；v. 梳理毛发；培养
groom.note:
The bride and groom smiled happily for the wedding photos.
新娘和新郎为婚礼照片露出了幸福的笑容。

He spends time every morning to groom his horse.
他每天早晨花时间给他的马梳理毛发。

grope.note:
She had to grope in the dark for the light switch.
她不得不在黑暗中摸索电灯开关。

He groped for words to explain his complex feelings.
他笨拙地寻找着词汇来解释自己复杂的感情。

grouch.meaning: v./n. 满腹牢骚的人；抱怨
grouch.note:
Don't be such an old grouch and try to enjoy the party.
别做个满腹牢骚的老家伙，试着享受派对吧。

He spent the whole morning with a grouch about the weather.
他整个早晨都在抱怨天气。

grounded.meaning: adj. 现实的；基础扎实的；禁飞的
grounded.note:
Despite her success, she remains a very down-to-earth and grounded person.
尽管她取得了成功，但她依然是一个非常务实、脚踏实地的人。

All flights were grounded due to the heavy fog.
由于大雾，所有航班都被迫停飞。

grouse.note:
He has a constant grouse about his low salary.
他总是对自己的低薪发牢骚。

Farmers often grouse about unpredictable weather conditions.
农民经常对不可预测的天气状况抱怨连连。

grove.note:
They walked through a shady olive grove in the afternoon.
他们在下午穿过了一片阴凉的橄榄林。

The citrus grove produced a large harvest of oranges.
这片柑橘园收获了大量的橙子。

grovel.meaning: v. 摇尾乞怜；卑躬屈膝
grovel.note:
He refused to grovel to his boss to keep his job.
他拒绝为了保住工作而向老板卑躬屈膝。

She hated seeing people grovel for power.
她讨厌看到人们为了权势而摇尾乞怜。

grueling.meaning: adj. 让人精疲力竭的；严厉的
grueling.note:
The marathon runners faced a grueling physical test.
马拉松运动员面临着一场精疲力竭的体能考验。

After a grueling week at work, she wanted to relax.
经历了一周繁重的工作后，她想放松一下。

grumble.note:
Workers began to grumble about the change in schedule.
工人们开始对日程安排的变动抱怨连连。

I heard a low grumble of thunder in the distance.
我听到远处传来一阵低沉的雷鸣声。

guffaw.note:
His funny joke elicited a loud guffaw from the audience.
他的滑稽笑话引得观众一阵哄笑。

They let out a collective guffaw at his clumsy slip.
他们针对他的笨拙失误发出了集体狂笑。

guile.note:
She achieved her position through pure political guile.
她通过纯粹的政治狡诈谋取了她的职位。

He is a man of absolute honesty and no guile.
他是一个绝对诚实、毫无心机的人。

guileless.meaning: adj. 坦率的；单纯的；天真的
guileless.note:
Her guileless smile won the hearts of everyone she met.
她那单纯的微笑赢得了她所遇到每一个人的心。

His guileless nature makes him easy to trust.
他那单纯的本性让人很容易信任他。

guillotine.meaning: n. 断头台；v. 用断头台处决；强行终结（辩论）
guillotine.note:
The guillotine was widely used during the French Revolution.
断头台在法国大革命期间被广泛使用。

The government used the closure motion to guillotine the debate.
政府利用闭会动议强行终结了辩论。

guilty.note:
The jury found the defendant guilty of theft.
陪审团裁定被告盗窃罪名成立。

She felt guilty about forgetting her friend's birthday.
她因为忘记了朋友的生日而感到内疚。

guise.note:
He entered the building under the guise of an inspector.
他以检查员的伪装进入了这栋大楼。

Temptation often comes in various subtle guises.
诱惑经常以各种微妙的外表出现。

gullible.note:
Don't be so gullible as to believe every online rumor.
别那么轻信，去相信每一个网络谣言。

The scam artist easily fooled the gullible tourists.
骗子轻易地骗过了那些易受骗的游客。

gully.note:
Heavy rain carved deep gullies into the hillside.
大雨在山坡上冲刷出了深深的沟渠。

Water rushed down the mountain gully during the storm.
暴风雨期间，水流顺着山间溪谷奔腾而下。

gulp.meaning: v./n. 吞咽；大口吸气；喘气
gulp.note:
He drank his cold water in a single gulp.
他一口气把冷水全喝了下去。

She paused to gulp in fresh air after running.
跑步过后，她停下来大口大口地呼吸新鲜空气。

gum.note:
Brush your teeth gently to avoid bleeding gums.
轻柔地刷牙以避免牙龈出血。

He chewed a piece of mint-flavored gum.
他嚼着一块薄荷味的口香糖。

guru.meaning: n. 宗师；专家；权威导师
guru.note:
He is considered a marketing guru in the tech industry.
他在科技行业被认为是一位营销权威专家。

People travel from afar to study under the spiritual guru.
人们从远方赶来向这位精神导师学习。

gush.meaning: v./n. 涌出；滔滔不绝地说
gush.note:
Oil began to gush from the newly drilled well.
石油开始从新钻的井里喷涌而出。

She continued to gush about her new favorite movie.
她继续滔滔不绝地谈论她新近最喜欢的电影。

gusher.meaning: n. 自喷油井；大量涌出的喷泉
gusher.note:
The oil strike turned out to be a massive gusher.
这次石油钻探结果证明是一口巨大的高产自喷井。

Excitement surrounded the discovery of the black gold gusher.
人们围绕着黑金自喷井的发现充满了兴奋。

gust.meaning: n. 一阵狂风；突发的激情
gust.note:
A sudden gust of wind blew her umbrella inside out.
一阵突如其来的狂风把她的雨伞吹翻了。

Strong gusts threatened to delay the flight takeoffs.
强风威胁着要推迟航班起飞。

gustation.note:
The human sense of gustation helps detect flavors.
人类的味觉有助于检测风味。

Wine tasting engages both olfaction and gustation senses.
品酒同时动用了嗅觉和味觉。

gutter.meaning: n. 雨水沟；街沟；v. 摇曳欲灭
gutter.note:
Leaves clogged the roof gutter and caused an overflow.
树叶堵塞了屋顶雨水沟，导致了水满外溢。

The candle flame flickered and began to gutter.
蜡烛火苗闪烁着，开始变得摇曳欲熄。

guy.meaning: n. 家伙；小伙子；支撑索
guy.note:
He is a nice guy who always helps his neighbors.
他是一个总是帮助邻居的好伙计。

Secure the tent with strong guy wires in the wind.
在风中用结实的拉索固定好帐篷。

guzzle.note:
He proceeded to guzzle down a large bottle of soda.
他接着一口气狂饮了一大瓶苏打水。

This old car tends to guzzle a lot of fuel.
这辆老旧汽车往往会大量消耗燃油。

gyrate.note:
Dancers began to gyrate wildly to the upbeat music.
舞者们随着欢快的音乐疯狂地旋转盘旋。

The mechanism uses magnets to gyrate the axis.
该机制利用磁铁使轴旋转。

habitat.note:
Deforestation destroys the natural habitat of many wild animals.
森林砍伐破坏了许多野生动物的自然栖息地。

Polar bears are uniquely adapted to their arctic habitat.
北极熊完美适应了它们的北极栖息地。

habituate.note:
It takes time to habituate yourself to a new climate.
你需要时间让自己习惯新的气候。

Animals must habituate to human presence in protected parks.
动物必须适应保护区内人类的存在。

hack.meaning: v. 劈砍；非法侵入（电脑）；n. 雇佣文人
hack.note:
He used an axe to hack the logs into smaller pieces.
他用斧子把圆木劈成小块。

Cybercriminals tried to hack into the company's database.
网络罪犯试图非法侵入公司的数据库。

hackneyed.note:
His speech was full of hackneyed phrases and clichés.
他的演讲充满了陈腐的词句和老一套的话。

We need fresh ideas instead of hackneyed concepts.
我们需要新鲜的想法，而不是陈腐的概念。

halcyon.meaning: adj. 平静的；快乐的；美好的（黄金时代）
halcyon.note:
She often reminisced about the halcyon days of her youth.
她经常回忆起她年轻时的美好黄金岁月。

They hoped to return to those halcyon times of peace.
他们希望能回到那个平静美好的时代。

hale.note:
Despite his advanced age, he remains hale and hearty.
尽管年事已高，他依然身子骨硬朗、精神矍铄。

His grandfather is still hale enough to garden every day.
他的祖父仍然足够健壮，每天都能园艺劳作。

halfhearted.meaning: adj. 不热心的；敷衍的；半心半意的
halfhearted.note:
He made only a halfhearted attempt to clean his room.
他只是敷衍了事地稍微打扫了一下房间。

Her halfhearted apology did not satisfy the angry client.
她那不诚恳的敷衍道歉没能让生气的客户满意。

hallmark.meaning: n. 特点；标志；品质证明印记
hallmark.note:
Quality customer service is the hallmark of our business.
优质的客户服务是我们业务的特点标志。

Attention to detail is a hallmark of his artistic work.
对细节的关注是他艺术作品的标志。

hallow.meaning: v. 把…视为神圣；奉为圣物
hallow.note:
The ancient site was hallowed by centuries of tradition.
这个古老的遗址因数个世纪的传统而被奉为神圣。

They sought to hallow the memory of fallen heroes.
他们试图将阵亡英雄的记忆奉为神圣。

hallowed.meaning: adj. 神圣的；受到尊崇的
hallowed.note:
Students walked through the hallowed halls of the old university.
学生们穿过古老大学那神圣的走廊。

This ground is hallowed by the blood of soldiers.
这片土地因士兵的鲜血而变得神圣。

halo.note:
The saint was depicted in paintings with a golden halo.
这位圣人在画作中被描绘成带有金色光环。

A faint halo surrounded the moon on a frosty night.
寒冷的夜晚，月亮周围环绕着一层淡淡的晕圈。

halting.meaning: adj. 踌躇的；蹒跚的；断断续续的
halting.note:
He spoke French in a slow and halting manner.
他说法语时断断续续、语速很慢。

She made halting progress toward recovery after the illness.
生病后，她向着康复迈出了缓慢踌躇的步伐。

hammer.meaning: n. 锤子；v. 锤击；敲打
hammer.note:
He used a hammer to drive the nail into the wall.
他用锤子把钉子钉进墙里。

Construction workers began to hammer away early in the morning.n施工人员一大早就开始叮叮当当地敲打起来。

hamper.meaning: v. 妨碍；阻碍；n. 有盖大篮子
hamper.note:
Heavy snow threatened to hamper rescue operations.
大雪威胁着要阻碍救援行动。

She placed the dirty clothes inside a wicker laundry hamper.
她把脏衣服放进了一个柳条洗衣篮里。

handle.meaning: v. 处理；应对；n. 把手
handle.note:
She knows how to handle difficult customers with patience.
她懂得如何耐心应对棘手的客户。

Pull the wooden handle to open the heavy door.
拉动木把手以打开这扇沉重的门。

hangar.note:
The damaged aircraft was towed back into the hangar.
受损的飞机被拖回了飞机库中。

Mechanics worked inside the spacious airport hangar.
机修工们在宽敞的机场机库里工作。

hangdog.meaning: adj. 鬼鬼祟祟的；低头耷脑的；羞愧的
hangdog.note:
He walked into the room with a guilty and hangdog look.
他带着内疚且低头耷脑的神情走进房间。

She wore a hangdog expression after failing the test.
考试不及格后，她露出了沮丧羞愧的表情。

hankering.note:
He had a strong hankering for some home-cooked food.
他非常渴望吃到一些家常菜。

She suppressed her secret hankering to travel abroad.
她压抑了自己出国旅行的秘密渴望。

harangue.meaning: v./n. 长篇大论的慷慨陈词；长篇训斥
harangue.note:
The activist delivered a fiery harangue to the crowd.
这位活动人士向人群发表了一场慷慨激昂的长篇演说。

He would often harangue his colleagues about company policy.
他经常就公司政策对同事们进行长篇大论的训斥。

harass.meaning: v. 骚扰；折磨；不断烦扰
harass.note:
The company has a zero-tolerance policy for workplace harass.
公司对职场骚扰采取零容忍政策。

Stray dogs began to harass livestock in the rural area.
流浪狗开始骚扰农村地区的牲畜。

harbinger.note:
Blooming swallows are considered a harbinger of spring.
盛开的燕子被视为春天的预兆。

Dark clouds served as a harbinger of the coming thunderstorm.
乌云是即将到来雷暴雨的先兆。

harbor.meaning: n. 港口；避难所；v. 庇护；心怀（想法）
harbor.note:
Ships safely anchored inside the protected harbor.
船只安全地停泊在受保护的港口内。

Do not harbor resentment against those who wronged you.
不要对那些伤害你的人怀恨在心。

harden.meaning: v. 使变硬；使坚强；坚定
harden.note:
Allow the concrete to harden before walking on it.
让混凝土变硬后再在上面行走。

The government decided to harden its stance on illegal immigration.
政府决定在非法移民问题上坚定其立场。

hardheaded.note:
He is a hardheaded businessman who rarely takes risks.
他是一个精明的商人，很少承担风险。

We need a hardheaded approach to solve this economic crisis.
我们需要一个务实的途径来解决这场经济危机。

hardy.meaning: adj. 强壮的；耐寒的；坚强的
hardy.note:
These hardy plants can survive freezing winter temperatures.
这些耐寒植物能够在冰冷的冬季气温中存活下来。

Early explorers were hardy men used to hardship.
早期的探险者是习惯了艰难困苦的坚强之人。

harness.meaning: v. 利用；控制；n. 马具；安全带
harness.note:
Engineers aim to harness wind power to generate electricity.
工程师们旨在利用风力来发电。

Mountain climbers must wear a safety harness at all times.
登山者必须时刻佩戴安全带。

harp.meaning: n. 竖琴；v. 喋喋不休地反复唠叨
harp.note:
She played a gentle melody on the golden harp.
她在金色竖琴上弹奏了一曲温柔的旋律。

Stop to harp on the same mistake every single day.
别再每天喋喋不休地唠叨同一个错误了。

harpsichord.note:
Baroque music is frequently performed on the harpsichord.
巴洛克音乐经常用大键琴演奏。

The museum displayed an antique wooden harpsichord.
博物馆展出了一架古董木制大键琴。

harridan.meaning: n. 泼妇；凶恶的老妇人
harridan.note:
She was portrayed in the play as a nagging, bitter harridan.
她在剧中被刻画成一个唠叨刻薄的泼妇。

He avoided the neighborhood harridan at all costs.
他不惜一切代价避开社区里的那个恶女人。

harrow.meaning: v. 使苦恼；折磨；n. 耙（农具）
harrow.note:
The memory of the accident continued to harrow his mind.
事故的记忆继续折磨着他的心灵。

Farmers used a tractor to pull a heavy iron harrow across the soil.
农民用拖拉机拉着一个重型铁耙在泥土上耕作。

harrowing.meaning: adj. 痛心的；极度悲伤的；让人惊骇的
harrowing.note:
She shared a harrowing account of her escape from the fire.
她分享了一段从大火中逃生的惊骇经历。

Rescue workers described the scene inside the wreck as harrowing.
救援人员将残骸内部的场景描述为极其痛心。

harry.meaning: v. 不断骚扰；折磨；掠夺
harry.note:
Constant doubts continued to harry him day and night.
不断涌现的疑虑日夜折磨着他。

Invading troops proceeded to harry the border villages.
侵略军队开始不断骚扰边境村庄。

harshly.meaning: adv. 严厉地；刺耳地；粗糙地
harshly.note:
She was criticized quite harshly for her poor performance.
她因为糟糕的表现受到了相当严厉的批评。

The cold wind blew harshly against his face.
冷风凛冽地刮在他的脸上。

hasten.note:
He decided to hasten his steps to avoid the rain.
他决定加快步伐以避开雨水。

This poor diet will only hasten the onset of illness.
这种糟糕的饮食只会加速疾病的发作。

hasty.meaning: adj. 匆忙的；草率的；仓促的
hasty.note:
Do not make a hasty decision without weighing all options.
在没有权衡所有选择之前，不要做出草率的决定。

He regretted his hasty words spoken in anger.
他后悔自己在愤怒中说出的仓促话语。

haughty.note:
She gave a haughty look to the waiter and turned away.
她傲慢地看了一眼服务员，然后转过身去。

His haughty demeanor made it difficult for him to make friends.
他高傲的举止使他很难交到朋友。

hauteur.meaning: n. 傲慢；自大；高傲气派
hauteur.note:
She treated everyone with an air of cold hauteur.
她以一种冷冰冰的傲慢态度对待每一个人。

His aristocratic hauteur irritated his colleagues.
他那贵族般的傲慢气派激怒了他的同事们。

haven.note:
The wildlife reserve is a safe haven for endangered birds.
这个野生动物保护区是濒危鸟类的安全避难所。

Libraries provide a quiet haven for readers and students.
图书馆为读者和学生提供了一个安静的避风港。

havoc.note:
The powerful hurricane wreaked havoc across the coastal city.
强大的飓风对沿海城市造成了巨大的破坏。

Computer viruses can cause havoc in an enterprise network.
电脑病毒会在企业网络中造成大混乱。

hazardous.note:
Chemical waste can be hazardous to human health.
化学废物可能对人体健康有害。

Driving in dense fog is a hazardous undertaking.
在浓雾中开车是一项危险的举动。

headlong.meaning: adv./adj. 头朝前地；轻率鲁莽的；仓促的
headlong.note:
He fell headlong down the steep flight of stairs.
他头朝前地从陡峭的楼梯上摔了下来。

They rushed headlong into a risky business investment.
他们鲁莽地投身于一项充满风险的商业投资中。

headstrong.meaning: adj. 顽固的；任性的；刚愎自用的
headstrong.note:
She was a headstrong child who always wanted her own way.
她是一个任性的孩子，总是随心所欲。

His headstrong attitude led to continuous arguments with management.
他那刚愎自用的态度导致了与管理层的不断争吵。

headway.note:
The rescue team is making slow headway through the rubble.
救援小组在废墟中进展缓慢。

Scientists are finally making real headway in cancer research.
科学家们终于在癌症研究中取得了实质性的进展。

heal.note:
The deep cut on his hand took weeks to heal completely.
他手上的深伤口花了数周时间才完全愈合。

Time helps to heal emotional wounds from the past.
时间有助于治愈过去的感情创伤。

hearken.note:
Hearken to the wise advice of your elders.
倾听长辈们的明智建议。

The speech harks back to an era of traditional values.
这篇演讲让人回想起一个充满传统价值观的时代。

hearten.meaning: v. 鼓励；使振奋；给予信心
hearten.note:
It was hearten to see the community unite for a good cause.
看到社区为一个好的目标团结起来令人备受鼓舞。

Good news from the clinic will hearten the family.
诊所传来的好消息将使这个家庭振奋起来。

heartrending.meaning: adj. 让人心碎的；悲痛的
heartrending.note:
She told a heartrending story of losing her home in the war.
她讲述了一个在战争中失去家园的心碎故事。

The documentary showed heartrending footage of starving orphans.
这部纪录片播放了饥饿孤儿们令人心碎的画面。

heckle.meaning: v. 起哄；诘问；刁难（演讲者）
heckle.note:
A rowdy audience member tried to heckle the speaker.
一个喧闹的观众试图起哄诘问演讲者。

Politicians must learn how to handle hecklers during public rallies.
政治家必须学会如何在公众集会上应对起哄者。

hectic.meaning: adj. 忙碌的；狂热的；繁忙的
hectic.note:
She has had a hectic schedule of meetings all week.
她整个星期都有着排得满满当当的忙碌日程。

After a hectic day at the office, he enjoyed a quiet evening.
在办公室度过了忙碌的一天后，他享受了一个安静的夜晚。

hector.meaning: v. 霸凌；威吓；蛮横地教训
hector.note:
He would constantly hector his subordinates into compliance.
他经常蛮横地教训下属以逼迫他们服从。

Don't let bullies hector you into doing something wrong.
不要让恶霸威吓你去做错误的事。

hedonist.note:
He lived the life of a hedonist, seeking pleasure above all else.
他过着享乐主义者的生活，将追求快乐置于一切之上。

The resort is famous for catering to wealthy hedonists.
该度假村以迎合富有的享乐主义者而闻名。

heed.note:
Drivers should heed the warning signs along the highway.
司机应当留心高速公路沿线的警告标志。

She paid little heed to the advice of her colleagues.
她对同事们的建议没有给予太多注意。

hegemony.meaning: n. 霸权；统治权；主导权
hegemony.note:
The empire sought to establish regional hegemony over its neighbors.
这个帝国试图建立对邻国的区域霸权。

Economic competition challenges cultural hegemony.
经济竞争对文化主导权提出了挑战。

heinous.meaning: adj. 极恶劣的；令人发指的；凶恶的
heinous.note:
The criminal was convicted of committing a heinous crime.
这名罪犯被判犯有令人发指的罪行。

Society condemns such heinous acts of violence.
社会谴责这种极恶劣的暴力行为。

heir.note:
He is the sole heir to a massive family fortune.
他是庞大家族财富的唯一继承人。

The king announced his eldest son as the royal heir.
国王宣布他的长子为王室继承人。

heirloom.note:
The gold pocket watch is a treasured family heirloom.
这块金色怀表是一件珍贵的家族传家宝。

She inherited an antique ring passed down as an heirloom.
她继承了一枚作为传家宝代代相传的古董戒指。

hem.meaning: n. 衣服边缘；v. 缝边；包围
hem.note:
She had to shorten the dress by taking up the hem.
她不得不通过收短裙边来让裙子变短。

The small village was hemmed in by high mountains.
这个小村庄被高山环抱包围着。

hemisphere.note:
Australia is located in the Southern Hemisphere.
澳大利亚位于南半球。

The left hemisphere of the brain controls language functions.
大脑左半球控制语言功能。

hemophilia.note:
Hemophilia is a genetic disorder that impairs blood clotting.
血友病是一种会损害血液凝固的遗传性疾病。

Patients with hemophilia require specialized medical care.
血友病患者需要专门的医疗护理。

hemorrhage.meaning: n./v. 大出血；严重资金流失
hemorrhage.note:
The patient suffered a severe cerebral hemorrhage.
该患者遭受了严重的脑溢血。

The company experienced a major financial hemorrhage.
该公司经历了一场重大的资金严重流失。

hemostat.note:
The surgeon asked the nurse for a hemostat.
外科医生向护士要了一把止血钳。

Modern surgical tools include advanced hemostat devices.
现代外科工具包括先进的止血器械设备。

herbaceous.meaning: adj. 草本的；草本植物的
herbaceous.note:
The garden features a collection of herbaceous perennial plants.
这座花园以搜集草本多年生植物为特色。

Herbaceous stems are green and flexible compared to woody ones.
与木本茎相比，草本茎是绿色且有弹性的。

herbicide.note:
Farmers spray herbicide to control weeds in the field.
农民喷洒除草剂来控制田里的杂草。

Overuse of chemical herbicide can damage local ecosystems.
过度使用化学除草剂会破坏当地生态系统。

herbivorous.note:
Cows, horses, and sheep are typical herbivorous animals.
牛、马和羊是典型的食草动物。

Dinosaurs included both carnivorous and herbivorous species.
恐龙包括肉食性和草本食草性物种。

hereditary.note:
Diabetes can sometimes be a hereditary condition.
糖尿病有时可以是一种遗传性疾病。

He inherited a hereditary title from his grandfather.
他从祖父那里继承了一个世袭头衔。

heresy.meaning: n. 异端邪说；离经叛道
heresy.note:
His scientific theories were initially condemned as heresy.
他的科学理论最初被谴责为异端邪说。

Challenging traditional rules was viewed as corporate heresy.
挑战传统规则被视为公司里的离经叛道。

heretic.meaning: n. 持异端者；异教徒；离经叛道者
heretic.note:
He was branded a heretic for questioning religious dogmas.
他因质疑宗教教条而被打上异端者的烙印。

Innovators are often treated like heretics by conservative groups.
创新者常常被保守群体当作异端对待。

heretical.meaning: adj. 异端的；离经叛道的
heretical.note:
She expressed her heretical views on modern art design.
她表达了她对现代艺术设计的离经叛道观点。

Proposing such changes was considered heretical at the time.
在当时，提出这样的改变被认为是离经叛道的。

hermetic.meaning: adj. 密封的；深奥神秘的
hermetic.note:
The food is stored in a hermetic container to keep it fresh.
食物被储存在密封容器中以保持新鲜。

Ancient alchemy was regarded as a hermetic art.
古代炼金术曾被视为一门神秘莫测的学问。

hermit.note:
The old man lived the life of a hermit in the mountains.
这位老人在山里过着隐士般的生活。

She built a small wooden cabin as her quiet hermit retreat.
她建了一间小木屋作为她安静的隐居胜地。

herpetologist.meaning: n. 爬虫学家（研究两栖及爬行动物的专家）
herpetologist.note:
The herpetologist studied snake behaviors in the jungle.
这位爬虫学家在丛林中研究蛇类的行为。

She consulted a herpetologist about the rare lizard species.
她就这种稀有蜥蜴物种咨询了一位爬虫学家。

heterodox.note:
He holds heterodox economic views that defy mainstream theories.
他持有挑战主流理论的非正统经济观点。

The professor encouraged students to explore heterodox ideas.
这位教授鼓励学生探索非正统的思想。

hew.note:
Workers used axes to hew wood for building cabins.
工人们用斧子砍伐木材来建造小屋。

The sculpture was hewn out of a single block of stone.
这座雕塑是由一整块石头雕刻劈削而成的。

hexagon.note:
Honeycombs are naturally structured in a pattern of hexagons.
蜂巢天然地构造成六边形的图案。

The floor tile was shaped as a regular hexagon.
这块地砖的形状是一个正六边形。

hiatus.note:
The band is taking a temporary hiatus from touring.
这支乐队暂时停止了巡回演出。

After a brief hiatus, the television show resumed production.
经过短暂的中断后，这部电视剧恢复了制作。

hidebound.meaning: adj. 思想保守的；固步自封的
hidebound.note:
The company failed because of its hidebound management style.
这家公司破产是因为其思想保守的管理风格。

We need to break away from hidebound traditions.
我们需要摆脱固步自封的传统。

hideous.meaning: adj. 丑陋的；可怕的；骇人听闻的
hideous.note:
He wore a hideous monster mask for the Halloween party.
他为了万圣节派对戴了一个可怕的怪物面具。

The murderer committed a hideous crime that shocked the nation.
这个凶手犯下了一起震惊全国的骇人听闻罪行。

hie.note:
She decided to hie home before the rain started.
她决定在下雨前赶快回家。

Hie thee to the library if you want to finish your essay.
如果你想写完论文，快点去图书馆吧。

hieroglyph.meaning: n. 象形文字；图画文字
hieroglyph.note:
Archaeologists deciphered the ancient Egyptian hieroglyph.
考古学家破译了古埃及的象形文字。

The temple walls were covered in carved stone hieroglyph.
神庙的墙壁上刻满了雕刻的象形文字。

hieroglyphic.meaning: adj. 象形文字的；n. 象形文字
hieroglyphic.note:
The scroll contained complex hieroglyphic inscriptions.
这卷纸莎草纸包含了复杂的象形文字碑文。

Scholars study hieroglyphic texts to understand ancient history.
学者们通过研究象形文字文本来了解古代历史。

highbrow.meaning: adj./n. 高雅的；知识分子的；阳春白雪的
highbrow.note:
She enjoys reading highbrow literary fiction and poetry.
她喜欢阅读阳春白雪的文学小说和诗歌。

The art exhibition attracted many highbrow critics.
这场艺术展览吸引了许多高雅的评论家。

hike.meaning: v./n. 远足；徒步旅行；大幅提高
hike.note:
They went on a long hike through the mountain trails.
他们沿着山间小径进行了一次长途徒步旅行。

The government announced a sudden hike in fuel prices.
政府宣布大幅提高燃油价格。

hilarious.meaning: adj. 极其搞笑的；欢闹的
hilarious.note:
We laughed uncontrollably at the hilarious comedy show.
我们被那场极其搞笑的喜剧秀逗得大笑不止。

He told a hilarious story about his travel mishaps.
他讲了一个关于他旅行囧事的搞笑故事。

hirsute.meaning: adj. 多毛的；长满粗毛的
hirsute.note:
The fictional character was portrayed as tall and hirsute.
这个虚构角色被刻画成高大且多毛的形象。

Certain animals have hirsute coats to survive cold weather.
某些动物拥有长满粗毛的皮毛来度过寒冷天气。

hiss.note:
The angry snake coiled up and began to hiss.
生气的蛇盘绕起来，开始发出嘶嘶声。

The unpopular decision was met with loud hisses from the crowd.
这个不受欢迎的决定遭到了台下人群的大声嘘声。

histology.meaning: n. 组织学（研究生物组织微观结构的科学）
histology.note:
She took a specialized course in human histology.
她选修了一门关于人体组织学的专业课程。

Histology examination revealed abnormal cellular changes.
组织学检查显示了异常的细胞变化。

histrionic.meaning: adj. 做作的；情绪夸张的；戏剧性的
histrionic.note:
She reacted to the minor inconvenience with histrionic tears.
她对这个小麻烦做出了夸张做作的哭泣反应。

Avoid making histrionic gestures during serious negotiations.
在严肃的谈判中，避免做出夸张做作的姿态。

hitherto.note:
The expedition explored a hitherto unknown region of the jungle.
探险队探索了一片迄今为止未知的丛林地区。

This discovery opens up hitherto unimaginable possibilities.
这一发现开辟了迄今难以想象的可能性。

hive.meaning: n. 蜂箱；蜂巢；蜂群般热闹的地方
hive.note:
Bees were buzzing busily around the wooden hive.
蜜蜂在木制蜂箱周围忙碌地嗡嗡叫。

The office was a hive of activity before the deadline.
在截止日期前，办公室里人声鼎沸、热闹非凡。

hoary.meaning: adj. 灰白的（因年老）；陈腐的
hoary.note:
The old man had hoary hair and a long white beard.
这位老人有着灰白的头发和长长的白胡子。

He repeated the same hoary old jokes at every party.
他在每个聚会上都重复着那些陈腐的老笑话。

hoax.note:
The bomb threat turned out to be an elaborate hoax.
炸弹威胁结果证明是一场精心策划的骗局。

They tried to hoax their friends with a fake news story.
他们试图用一则假新闻来恶作剧捉弄朋友。

hodgepodge.note:
Her book collection is a hodgepodge of various genres.
她的藏书是各种流派的大杂烩。

The city's architecture is a hodgepodge of old and modern styles.
这座城市的建筑风格是新旧风格的大杂烩。

hoe.meaning: n. 锄头；v. 用锄头锄地
hoe.note:
He used a sharp garden hoe to remove weeds.
他用一把锋利的园艺锄头来清除杂草。

Gardener spends the morning to hoe the vegetable beds.
园丁花了一早上的时间去锄菜园。

hoist.note:
Workers used a crane to hoist the steel beams upward.
工人们用起重机把钢梁往上吊起。

The sailors prepared to hoist the large white sail.
水手们准备升起那张白色大帆。

holster.note:
The police officer drew his weapon from the leather holster.
警察从皮质枪套里拔出了武器。

He buckled the holster securely around his waist.
他把枪套牢牢地扣在腰间。

homage.note:
The film pays homage to classic horror movies of the past.
这部电影向过去经典的恐怖电影致敬。

Citizens gathered to pay homage to the national heroes.
市民们聚集在一起向民族英雄致敬。

homeostasis.meaning: n. 体内平衡；内环境稳态
homeostasis.note:
The human body maintains internal homeostasis despite temperature changes.
尽管气温变化，人体仍能维持内部环境稳态。

Homeostasis is essential for survival of living organisms.
体内平衡对生物体的生存至关重要。

homiletics.note:
He studied homiletics at the theological seminary.
他在神学院学习讲道学。

The textbook on homiletics teaches effective sermon delivery.
这本关于讲道学的教材教授了有效的布道传明方法。

homogeneity.meaning: n. 同质性；同质化；均一性
homogeneity.note:
Globalization can sometimes threaten cultural homogeneity.
全球化有时会威胁到文化的同质性。

The sample showed a high degree of chemical homogeneity.
样本显示出高度的化学同质性。

homogeneous.meaning: adj. 同质的；均匀的；由相同部分组成的
homogeneous.note:
The community is culturally homogeneous rather than diverse.
这个社区在文化上是同质的，而非多样化的。

Mix the ingredients until the batter is completely homogeneous.
搅拌原料直至面糊完全均匀。

homogenize.note:
Commercial milk is processed to homogenize the fat content.
商业牛奶经过处理以使其脂肪含量均匀化。

Modern media tends to homogenize regional cultures.
现代媒体往往会使地方文化趋于同质化。

hone.meaning: v. 磨砺；训练；提升（技能）
hone.note:
She spent years to hone her skills as a professional writer.
她花了多年时间来磨砺自己作为专业作家的技能。

He used a whetstone to hone the blade of his knife.
他用磨刀石来磨砺刀刃。

honorarium.note:
The guest speaker received a modest honorarium for his lecture.
特邀演讲者因其讲座获得了一笔适度的酬金。

Universities often offer an honorarium to visiting experts.
大学通常会向访问专家提供酬金。

hoodwink.note:
The con artist managed to hoodwink several naive investors.
骗子设法欺骗了几位天真的投资者。

Don't let smooth talkers hoodwink you into buying bad products.
不要让花言巧语的人蒙蔽你购买劣质产品。

horizontal.note:
Draw a straight horizontal line across the paper.
在纸上画一条笔直的水平线。

The horizon marks where the earth meets the sky in a horizontal plane.
地平线标志着地球在水平平面上与天空交汇的地方。

horn.note:
The male deer has large branching antlers and horns.
雄鹿有着分叉的大鹿角。

He honked his car horn to warn the pedestrian.
他按响汽车喇叭以警告行人。

horrific.meaning: adj. 可怕的；骇人听闻的
horrific.note:
We watched horrific footage of the earthquake aftermath.
我们观看了地震后令人发指的恐怖画面。

She suffered horrific injuries in the car crash.
她在车祸中受了可怕的重伤。

hortative.meaning: adj. 劝告的；激励的；鼓励的
hortative.note:
The coach delivered a hortative speech before the match.
教练在比赛前发表了一场鼓舞人心的讲话。

His message had a strongly hortative tone to inspire workers.
他的信息带有强烈的激励语调以鼓舞工人。

horticulture.note:
She studied horticulture and works as a landscape designer.
她学习园艺学，并担任景观设计师。

The university offers advanced courses in modern horticulture.
这所大学开设了现代园艺的高级课程。

hospitable.meaning: adj. 好客的；殷勤的；气候宜人的
hospitable.note:
Local residents were extremely hospitable to the travelers.
当地居民对旅行者非常热情好客。

The region has a warm and hospitable climate.
该地区拥有温暖宜人的气候。

hovel.meaning: n. 简陋小屋；猪圈般的居所
hovel.note:
They lived in a damp, decaying hovel on the edge of town.
他们住在镇边缘的一间潮湿破败的小屋里。

The old shack was little more than an abandoned hovel.
那座旧棚屋不过是一间废弃的破茅屋。

hover.note:
Helicopters can hover steadily in midair.
直升机可以在半空中稳定盘旋。

Unemployment rates continued to hover around five percent.
失业率继续在百分之五左右徘徊。

hubris.meaning: n. 傲慢；自大；盲目自信
hubris.note:
His political downfall was ultimately caused by his own hubris.
他的政治垮台最终是由他自己的傲慢自大造成的。

Avoid corporate hubris and listen to consumer feedback.
避免企业自大，并倾听消费者的反馈。

huckster.meaning: n. 小贩；叫卖者；招摇撞骗者
huckster.note:
Street hucksters sold cheap souvenirs to tourists.
街头小贩向游客兜售廉价纪念品。

He dismissed the advertisement as mere huckster promotion.
他把这则广告斥为纯粹的叫卖促销。

hulk.meaning: n. 残骸；庞然大物；大块头
hulk.note:
The rusted hulk of an old ship lay abandoned on the beach.
一艘旧船生锈的残骸被遗弃在海滩上。

He is a massive hulk of a man who plays football.
他是一个身材魁梧、踢足球的大块头男人。

humane.meaning: adj. 人道的；仁慈的；有人文关怀的
humane.note:
Stray animals should be treated with humane care.
应当以人道的关怀对待流浪动物。

The prison reform aimed to ensure more humane conditions.
监狱改革旨在确保更加人道的生活条件。

humdrum.meaning: adj. 单调的；乏味的；平淡的
humdrum.note:
She wanted to escape her humdrum routine of office work.
她想逃离她单调乏味的办公室日常工作。

He found comfort in his quiet and humdrum life.
他在自己平静而平淡的生活中找到了慰藉。

humid.note:
Summer weather in this coastal city is very hot and humid.
这座沿海城市的夏季天气非常炎热潮湿。

Tropical rainforests feature a warm and humid environment.
热带雨林具有温暖潮湿的环境特征。

humidity.note:
High humidity makes the hot weather feel even worse.
高湿度让炎热的天气感觉更糟。

Indoor humidity can be controlled using a dehumidifier.
室内湿度可以通过使用除湿机来控制。

humility.note:
He accepted the award with great grace and humility.
他以极大的优雅和谦逊接受了这个奖项。

True leadership requires both confidence and humility.
真正的领导力既需要自信，也需要谦逊。

hunch.meaning: n. 直觉；预感；v. 耸肩驼背
hunch.note:
I had a gut hunch that he was telling the truth.
我有一种直觉，觉得他说的是实话。

He sat at his desk, hunching over his laptop.
他坐在桌子旁，弓着身子对着笔记本电脑。

hurricane.note:
Residents evacuated as a powerful hurricane approached the coast.
随着一场强烈的飓风逼近海岸，居民们撤离了。

The destructive hurricane caused millions of dollars in damage.
这场破坏性的飓风造成了数百万美元的损失。

husbandry.meaning: n. 农牧业；耕作；节约管理
husbandry.note:
Animal husbandry is a primary source of income in the region.
畜牧业是该地区的主要收入来源。

Good resource husbandry ensures long-term environmental sustainability.
良好的资源节约管理确保了长期的环境可持续性。

hush.note:
A sudden hush fell over the crowded auditorium.
拥挤的礼堂里突然安静了下来。

She tried to hush the crying baby in her arms.
她试图哄安静怀里哭泣的婴儿。

husky.meaning: adj. 沙哑的；健壮的；n. 哈士奇狗
husky.note:
He spoke in a low, husky voice due to a sore throat.
由于喉咙痛，他说话时声音低沉沙哑。

Siberian huskies are known for pulling sleds in snow.
西伯利亚哈士奇犬以在雪地中拉雪橇而闻名。

hybrid.meaning: adj./n. 混合的；混合动力车；杂交种
hybrid.note:
She drives a fuel-efficient hybrid car to work.
她驾驶一辆节能的混合动力汽车去上班。

This plant is a hybrid variety created by botanists.
这种植物是由植物学家培育出的杂交品种。

hydrant.note:
Firefighters connected their hose to the street fire hydrant.
消防员将水管连接到街头的消防栓上。

Parking in front of a fire hydrant is illegal.
停在消防栓前是违法的。

hydrate.note:
Athletes need to hydrate properly during intense exercise.
运动员在剧烈运动期间需要适度补充水分。

Drinking enough water helps hydrate your skin.
喝足够的水有助于为你的皮肤补水。

hymn.note:
The congregation sang a traditional morning hymn.
会众唱了一首传统的晨祷赞美诗。

Churchgoers joined together in singing the sacred hymn.
做礼拜的人一起齐声唱起了这首神圣的赞美诗。

hyperactivity.note:
Dietary changes can sometimes help manage child hyperactivity.
饮食改变有时可以帮助控制儿童的多动症。

The medication is designed to reduce excessive hyperactivity.
该药物旨在减少过度的活跃行为。

hyperbole.note:
Calling it the worst storm ever is pure hyperbole.
把它称为史上最糟糕的暴风雨纯粹是夸大其词。

His writing style is rich in vivid metaphor and hyperbole.
他的写作风格富含生动的隐喻和夸张手法。

hypnotic.meaning: adj. 催眠的；助眠的；迷人的
hypnotic.note:
The flickering flames had a hypnotic effect on him.
闪烁的火焰对她产生了一种催眠般的效果。

She listened to the hypnotic rhythm of ocean waves.
她听着海浪那催眠般迷人的节律。

hypocrite.note:
He is a hypocrite who preaches honesty but steals.
他是一个标榜诚实却又行窃的伪君子。

Don't be a hypocrite by judging others for your own faults.
不要因为你自己的错误而去评判别人，成为伪君子。

hypocritical.note:
It is hypocritical of him to lecture others on punctuality when he is always late.
他自己总是迟到却去教导别人守时，这太虚伪了。

She condemned the hypocritical behavior of the politicians.
她谴责了这些政客虚伪的言行。

hypotenuse.meaning: n. 直角三角形的斜边
hypotenuse.note:
The Pythagorean theorem relates the sides and the hypotenuse of a triangle.
勾股定理关联了三角形的直角边与斜边。

Calculate the length of the hypotenuse using the two legs.
利用两条直角边计算斜边的长度。

hysteria.meaning: n. 歇斯底里；情绪失控狂乱
hysteria.note:
News of the disaster caused widespread public hysteria.
灾难的消息引发了公众广泛的歇斯底里狂乱。

She burst into tears of hysteria under intense pressure.
她在巨大的压力下情绪失控，放声大哭。

icicle.note:
Long, sharp icicles hung from the edge of the roof.
又长又尖的冰柱从屋顶边缘悬挂下来。

Children watched ice melt and drip from the frozen icicle.
孩子们看着冰融化并从冰冷的冰柱上滴落。

icon.meaning: n. 图标；偶像；崇拜对象
icon.note:
Click on the desktop icon to open the software program.
点击桌面图标以打开软件程序。

He became a global pop music icon in the 1980s.
他在20世纪80年代成为了全球流行音乐偶像。

iconoclastic.meaning: adj. 打破传统偶像的；非正统的
iconoclastic.note:
The artist is known for his iconoclastic views on modern art.
这位艺术家以其对现代艺术打破传统的颠覆性观点而闻名。

Her iconoclastic approach challenged traditional business models.
她打破传统的途径挑战了传统的商业模式。

idle.meaning: adj. 闲置的；懒散的；v. 虚度；空转
idle.note:
Factories sat idle during the economic downturn.
在经济低迷时期，工厂处于闲置状态。

Don't idle your time away playing video games all day.
不要整天玩电子游戏来虚度光阴。

idolater.meaning: n. 崇拜偶像者；盲目崇拜者
idolater.note:
Ancient religions strictly forbade believers from acting as an idolater.
古代宗教严厉禁止信徒充当偶像崇拜者。

He was an uncritical idolater of his political mentor.
他是其政治导师的无条件盲目崇拜者。

idyll.meaning: n. 田园诗；田园风光；宁静的生活
idyll.note:
Their summer vacation in the countryside was a peaceful idyll.
他们在乡下的暑假是一段平静的田园诗般的生活。

The small village served as an ideal romantic idyll.
这个小村庄是一处理想的浪漫田园风光。

igneous.note:
Granite is a common type of igneous rock formed by magma.
花岗岩是由岩浆形成的常见火成岩类型。

Volcanic activity produces various kinds of igneous formations.
火山活动产生了各种各样的火成岩地貌。

ignite.meaning: v. 点燃；燃烧；引发（情绪等）
ignite.note:
A spark was enough to ignite the dry grass in the field.
一丝火花就足以点燃田地里的干草。

The speech helped to ignite public interest in environmental issues.
这番演讲有助于点燃公众对环境问题的兴趣。

ignoble.meaning: adj. 卑鄙的；不光彩的；出身卑微的
ignoble.note:
He acted out of ignoble motives driven by jealousy.
他出于嫉妒的驱使，做出了卑鄙的动机行为。

History judged his betrayal as an ignoble act of cowardice.
历史将他的背叛评判为一种不光彩的懦夫行为。

ignominious.meaning: adj. 羞耻的；丢脸的；不名誉的
ignominious.note:
The team suffered an ignominious defeat in the final match.
这支球队在决赛中遭遇了一场耻辱的惨败。

His political career ended in an ignominious scandal.
他的政治生涯以一桩丢脸的丑闻告终。

ignominy.note:
He preferred death over the ignominy of public surrender.
他宁愿死也不愿承受公开投降的耻辱。

She bore the ignominy of failure with quiet determination.
她带着平静的决心默默承受着失败的羞辱。

ignorant.meaning: adj. 无知的；愚昧的；对…不了解的
ignorant.note:
It is dangerous to remain ignorant of basic safety rules.
对基本的安全规则一无所知是很危险的。

He was completely ignorant of the changes in company policy.
他完全不知道公司政策的变化。

illegitimate.meaning: adj. 非法的；私生的；不正当的
illegitimate.note:
The regime seized power through illegitimate means.
该政权通过非法手段夺取了政权。

They exposed the illegitimate financial transactions of the bank.
他们揭露了该银行非法金融交易行为。

illiterate.meaning: adj. 文盲的；不识字的；缺乏基本知识的
illiterate.note:
The charity program aims to help illiterate adults learn to read.
该慈善项目旨在帮助不识字的成年人学习阅读。

Many people in remote villages remain digitally illiterate.
许多偏远村庄的人仍然缺乏数字技术基本知识。

illuminate.note:
Streetlights illuminate the dark roads at night.
路灯在夜间照亮了黑暗的道路。

The research report helps to illuminate complex economic trends.
这份研究报告有助于阐明复杂的经济趋势。

illuminati.meaning: n. 智者；精英知识分子集团；光明会
illuminati.note:
Conspiracy theories often mention the secret society of the Illuminati.
阴谋论经常提及光明会这个秘密社团。

The debate was attended by the local intellectual illuminati.
当地的知识精英分子出席了这场辩论。

illusive.meaning: adj. 虚幻的；迷惑人的；幻觉的
illusive.note:
Success can often feel illusive when you are just starting out. 当你刚开始时，成功往往会让人觉得虚幻。

She chased the illusive dream of fame for years. 她多年来一直在追寻那虚幻的名利梦。

illusory.meaning: adj. 错觉的；虚幻的；不实际的
illusory.note:
Any sense of security they felt was purely illusory. 他们感受到的任何安全感都纯粹是虚幻的。

His calm demeanor was entirely illusory; inside, he was panicking. 他平静的外表完全是假象，内心其实惊慌失措。

imbibe.meaning: v. 饮；吸收（水分等）；吸纳（知识、思想）
imbibe.note:
Plants imbibe water through their roots. 植物通过根系吸收水分。

He sat quietly to imbibe the rich culture of the ancient city. 他静静地坐着，以吸收这座古老城市的丰富文化。

imbroglio.meaning: n. 纠纷；混乱的局面；困境
imbroglio.note:
The political imbroglio lasted for months before a resolution was reached. 这场政治纠纷持续了几个月才得以解决。

She tried to extricate herself from the family imbroglio. 她试图让自己脱离这场家庭纷争。

imbue.note:
Her novels are imbued with a deep sense of social justice. 她的长篇小说充满了对社会公正的深刻责任感。

The coach sought to imbue the team with confidence. 教练试图向全队灌输信心。

imitation.meaning:
n. 模仿；仿制品；伪造物
adj. 人造的；仿制的
imitation.note:
Art often begins as an imitation of nature. 艺术往往始于对大自然的模仿。

He was wearing a jacket made of imitation leather. 他穿着一件人造革夹克。

imitative.note:
Children's early language learning is largely imitative. 儿童早期的语言学习很大程度上是模仿性的。

Many young artists go through an imitative phase. 许多年轻艺术家都要经历一个模仿阶段。

immaculate.meaning: adj. 完美无瑕的；洁净的；极整洁的
immaculate.note:
He wore an immaculate white suit to the party. 他穿着一身洁白无瑕的西装去参加派对。

The house was kept in immaculate condition. 这所房子被保持得一尘不染。

immanent.meaning: adj. 内在的；内在发动的；弥漫的
immanent.note:
Philosophers debate whether beauty is immanent in the object or in the mind. 哲学家们争论美是内在存于物体中还是存在于心灵中。

He believed in a divine power immanent in the universe. 他相信宇宙中存在着一种内在的神圣力量。

immemorial.meaning: adj. 远古的；亘古的；自古以来的
immemorial.note:
People have farmed this fertile valley since time immemorial. 自远古以来，人们就在这个肥沃的山谷里耕作。

Local traditions had been practiced here from immemorial days. 当地的传统从远古时代起就在这里延续。

immensity.note:
Looking up at the night sky, she felt the immensity of the universe. 抬头看着夜空，她感受到了宇宙的浩瀚。

Few people truly understand the immensity of the task ahead. 很少有人真正理解前方任务的巨大艰巨性。

immolate.meaning: v. 牺牲；献祭；宰杀祭神
immolate.note:
Ancient rituals sometimes required people to immolate animals. 古代仪式有时需要人们献祭动物。

He refused to immolate his personal integrity for career advancement. 他拒绝为职业发展而牺牲个人的正直。

immunity.meaning: n. 免疫力；豁免权；免除
immunity.note:
Vaccination helps build immunity against various diseases. 接种疫苗有助于建立针对各种疾病的免疫力。

The witness was granted immunity from prosecution in exchange for his testimony. 该证人因作证而获得了免于起诉的豁免权。

immunize.note:
It is recommended to immunize children against polio. 建议为儿童接种小儿麻痹症疫苗。

Public health campaigns strive to immunize as many citizens as possible. 公共卫生运动致力于为尽可能多的公民接种疫苗。

immure.meaning: v. 监禁；禁闭；筑墙围住
immure.note:
The monk chose to immure himself in a remote monastery. 这名僧侣选择将自己禁闭在偏远的修道院里。

She felt as though she were immured within the four walls of her office. 她觉得自己仿佛被囚禁在办公室的四面墙壁之内。

imp.note:
The youngest boy is a little imp who always plays tricks. 最小的男孩是个总爱搞恶作剧的小淘气。

In folklore, an imp is a mischievous supernatural creature. 在民间传说中，小鬼是一种恶作剧超自然生物。

impact.meaning:
n. 影响；冲击力
v. 产生影响；冲击
impact.note:
New technology has a massive impact on modern education. 新技术对现代教育有着巨大的影响。

The economic crisis will impact small businesses severely. 经济危机将严重冲击小型企业。

impale.note:
The branch fell and nearly impaled the tent. 树枝掉落险些刺穿帐篷。

In history, some criminals were sentenced to be impaled. 历史上，一些罪犯被判处穿刺刑。

impalpable.meaning: adj. 摸不到的；难以捉摸的；无形体质感的
impalpable.note:
There was an impalpable sense of tension in the room. 房间里弥漫着一种难以捉摸的紧张气氛。

Her grief was real, though it remained an impalpable emotion. 她的悲伤是真实存在的，尽管它是一种无形的情感。

impasse.note:
The peace talks reached an impasse over territorial disputes. 和平谈判因领土争端陷入了僵局。

Both sides must compromise to break this political impasse. 双方必须妥协才能打破这一政治僵局。

impassioned.meaning: adj. 充满激情的；热烈的；慷慨激昂的
impassioned.note:
She delivered an impassioned speech in defense of human rights. 她发表了一场捍卫人权的慷慨激昂的演讲。

His impassioned plea moved everyone in the courtroom. 他充满激情的恳求感动了法庭上的每一个人。

impassive.meaning: adj. 冷漠的；无动于衷的；面无表情的
impassive.note:
He sat through the entire interrogation with an impassive face. 他面无表情地熬过了整个审讯过程。

Her impassive response surprised those who expected tears. 她无动于衷的反应让那些期待眼泪的人感到惊讶。

impeach.meaning: v. 弹劾；指控；怀疑（信誉等）
impeach.note:
The parliament voted to impeach the corrupt minister. 议会投票弹劾了这名腐败的部长。

The defense attorney tried to impeach the credibility of the key witness. 辩护律师试图质疑关键证人的信誉。

impeccable.meaning: adj. 无可挑剔的；完美的；没有缺点的
impeccable.note:
She speaks English with impeccable grammar and pronunciation. 她的英语语法和发音无可挑剔。

The service at the luxury hotel was truly impeccable. 这家豪华酒店的服务实在无可挑剔。

impecunious.meaning: adj. 贫穷的；身无分文的
impecunious.note:
As an impecunious student, he often lived on instant noodles. 作为一名身无分文的学生，他经常靠吃方便面度日。

The artist spent his early years in impecunious obscurity. 这位艺术家在默默无闻和贫困中度过了早年。

impede.note:
Heavy snow began to impede traffic flow on the highway. 大雪开始阻碍高速公路上的交通流动。

Lack of funding will impede the progress of scientific research. 缺乏资金将阻碍科学研究的进展。

impediment.note:
A speech impediment did not stop him from becoming a great orator. 言语上的障碍并没有阻止他成为一名伟大的演说家。

Bureaucracy remains a major impediment to economic reform. 官僚主义仍然是经济改革的一大障碍。

impending.meaning: adj. 逼近的；即将发生的
impending.note:
They stocked up on food in anticipation of the impending storm. 他们为了应对即将到来的暴风雨而囤积了食物。

The employees were anxious about their impending layoffs. 员工们对即将到来的裁员感到焦虑。

impenetrable.meaning: adj. 费解的；不能通过的；不可渗透的
impenetrable.note:
The old castle had thick walls that seemed impenetrable. 这座古老的城堡有着厚重的墙壁，看起来坚不可摧。

His philosophical writings are completely impenetrable to most readers. 他的哲学著作对大多数读者来说完全深奥难懂。

impenitent.meaning: adj. 不悔悟的；不知悔改的
impenitent.note:
The impenitent thief showed no remorse for his crimes. 这名毫无悔意的惯偷对自己的罪行没有表现出半点愧疚。

He remained impenitent even after being convicted. 甚至在被定罪之后，他仍然冥顽不灵、不知悔改。

imperious.meaning: adj. 专横的；傲慢的；威严的
imperious.note:
She gave an imperious wave of her hand to dismiss the servant. 她傲慢地挥了挥手打发仆人离开。

His imperious manner alienated many of his colleagues. 他专横的态度疏远了许多同事。

impermanent.meaning: adj. 暂时的；非永久性的
impermanent.note:
Buddhist philosophy teaches that all earthly things are impermanent. 佛教哲学教导说，世间万物皆为无常。

They lived in impermanent shelters while rebuilding their homes. 他们在重建家园时住在临时的避难所里。

impermeability.meaning: n. 不渗透性；不透水性
impermeability.note:
The impermeability of the membrane protects the internal cells. 膜的不渗透性保护了内部细胞。

Special coatings are applied to ensure the fabric's impermeability. 涂上特殊涂层以确保面料的不透水性。

impermeable.meaning: adj. 不能渗透的；不透水的
impermeable.note:
The rock layer is impermeable to water. 该岩层不透水。

He wore an impermeable raincoat during the downpour. 倾盆大雨中他穿着一件不透水的雨衣。

impersonate.note:
He was arrested for attempting to impersonate a police officer. 他因企图冒充警官而被捕。

The comedian is famous for his ability to impersonate politicians. 这位喜剧演员以模仿政治家的能力而闻名。

impertinence.note:
The teacher scolded the boy for his impertinence. 老师因这个男孩无礼而斥责了他。

She was shocked by the impertinence of his question. 她对他的无礼提问感到震惊。

imperturbable.meaning: adj. 沉着的；冷静的；泰然自若的
imperturbable.note:
Even during the crisis, the manager remained imperturbable. 即使在危机期间，经理依然保持镇定自若。

His imperturbable calmness helped soothe the panicked investors. 他那雷打不动的冷静帮助平息了恐慌的投资者。

impervious.meaning: adj. 不能渗透的；不受影响的；无动于衷的
impervious.note:
She seemed entirely impervious to criticism. 她似乎对批评完全无动于衷。

This material is impervious to moisture and heat. 这种材料不吸潮且耐热。

impetuous.meaning: adj. 冲动的；鲁莽的；急躁的
impetuous.note:
His impetuous decision to quit his job shocked his family. 他冲动辞职的决定让家人大吃一惊。

Youth is often characterized by impetuous behavior. 年轻往往伴随着冲动的行为特征。

impetus.note:
The new law gave fresh impetus to the environmental movement. 这项新法律为环保运动注入了新的动力。

Scientific discovery provides the impetus for industrial progress. 科学发现为工业进步提供了推动力。

impinge.meaning: v. 侵犯；撞击；对...产生影响
impinge.note:
He felt that the new regulations impinged on his personal freedom. 他觉得新规侵犯了他的个人自由。

Noise from the highway began to impinge upon their daily peace. 来自高速公路的噪音开始侵扰他们日常的宁静。

implant.meaning:
v. 植入；灌输
n. 植入物
implant.note:
Doctors can implant a pacemaker to regulate heartbeats. 医生可以植入心脏起搏器来调节心跳。

Teachers strive to implant a love of reading in their students. 教师们努力在学生心中植入对阅读的热爱。

implausible.meaning: adj. 难以置信的；不合情理的
implausible.note:
His excuse for being late sounded completely implausible. 他迟到的借口听起来完全不可信。

The movie had an implausible plot that lost the audience's interest. 这部电影的情节很不合情理，失去了观众的兴趣。

implicate.note:
New evidence emerged to implicate the suspect in the crime. 新证据的出现将该嫌疑人牵连进这起犯罪中。

Her silence was taken to implicate her agreement with the plan. 她的沉默被认为暗示了她对该计划的同意。

implode.meaning: v. 内爆；内部坍塌；剧烈崩溃
implode.note:
Old buildings are sometimes demolished by controlled implosion. 老建筑有时通过定向内爆拆除。

Under immense market pressure, the company began to implode. 在巨大的市场压力下，公司开始内部崩溃。

implore.note:
She fell to her knees and began to implore for mercy. 她跪倒在地，开始恳求宽恕。

He would implore his parents to let him go on the trip. 他会哀求父母让他去旅行。

impolitic.meaning: adj. 不明智的；失策的；不合时宜的
impolitic.note:
It would be impolitic to criticize your boss during the meeting. 在会议上批评你的老板是不明智的。

His impolitic remarks offended several important clients. 他失策的言论冒犯了几位重要的客户。

imponderable.meaning:
adj. 无法衡量的；难测的
n. 不可捉摸的事物
imponderable.note:
Future market trends remain an imponderable factor in business planning. 未来的市场趋势仍然是商业规划中一个无法权衡的因素。

Human emotions are full of imponderables. 人类的情感充满了无法预测的变数。

import.meaning:
v. 进口；输入
n. 进口；重要性；意义
import.note:
The country relies heavily on oil import to meet its energy needs. 该国严重依赖石油进口来满足能源需求。

Do you understand the true import of his words? 你明白他言语中真正的深意吗？

importune.meaning: v. 强求；纠缠不休地恳求
importune.note:
Beggar children would importune tourists outside the hotel. 乞讨的小孩会在酒店外纠缠游客索要钱财。

She grew tired of being importuned by salespeople. 她厌倦了被推销员纠缠不休。

imposing.meaning: adj. 壮丽的；雄伟的；给人深刻印象的
imposing.note:
The castle stood on a hill with an imposing view. 城堡矗立在山丘上，视野雄伟开阔。

He had an imposing physical presence that commanded attention. 他身材高大威严，极具震慑力，引人注目。

impostor.note:
The art dealer exposed the painting as the work of an impostor. 这位艺术品商揭露这幅画出自骗子之手。

He felt like an impostor in his new high-level job. 他在新的高层工作中觉得自己像个冒牌货。

imposture.meaning: n. 冒名顶替；诈骗；欺骗行为
imposture.note:
Her entire identity was built upon a clever imposture. 她的整个身份都建立在一场巧妙的冒名顶替之上。

The criminal was arrested for financial imposture and fraud. 这名罪犯因金融诈骗和欺诈被捕。

impoverish.meaning: v. 使贫困；使贫瘠；耗尽
impoverish.note:
Continuous warfare can impoverish an entire nation. 连年战争会使整个国家陷入贫困。

Overfarming will eventually impoverish the soil. 过度耕作最终会使土壤贫瘠。

imprecise.meaning: adj. 不精确的；不准确的
imprecise.note:
His initial description of the event was rather imprecise. 他对事件最初的描述相当不精确。

Scientific research requires exact measurements rather than imprecise estimates. 科学研究需要精确的测量，而不是不准确的估计。

impregnable.meaning: adj. 坚不可摧的；攻不破的；无懈可击的
impregnable.note:
The medieval fortress was considered impregnable to attack. 这座中世纪堡垒曾被认为坚不可摧、无法攻克。

Her legal defense strategy appeared impregnable. 她的法律辩护策略看起来无懈可击。

impresario.meaning: n. （剧院、音乐会等）主办人；经纪人；经理人
impresario.note:
The theatrical impresario brought international ballet stars to the city. 这位剧院主办人将国际芭蕾舞明星带到了这座城市。

He worked as an opera impresario for over thirty years. 他担任歌剧经理人三十多年。

impressed.meaning: adj. 留下深刻印象的；钦佩的
impressed.note:
The interviewer was deeply impressed by her resume. 面试官对她的简历留下了深刻印象。

We were all impressed with how quickly she learned the language. 我们都对她学习语言的速度之快感到惊叹。

impression.note:
First impressions often dictate how a relationship develops. 第一印象往往决定了关系的发展方向。

She left a lasting impression on everyone she met. 她给她遇到的每个人都留下了深刻持久的印象。

impressionable.meaning: adj. 易受影响的；易感动的；稚嫩的
impressionable.note:
Adolescents are often at an impressionable age. 青少年往往处于容易受外界影响的年龄段。

We must protect impressionable minds from violent media content. 我们必须保护易受影响的年轻心灵免受暴力媒体内容的侵害。

impromptu.meaning:
adj. 即兴的；无准备的
n. 即兴曲；即兴演说
impromptu.note:
They held an impromptu celebration after hearing the good news. 听到好消息后，他们举行了一场即兴庆祝活动。

He gave an impromptu speech without checking any notes. 他没有看任何笔记，发表了一场即兴演讲。

improvident.meaning: adj. 无远虑的；挥霍的；不存积蓄的
improvident.note:
His improvident spending habits left him broke by the end of the month. 他挥霍无度的消费习惯让他在月底前身无分文。

An improvident lifestyle can lead to severe financial distress in old age. 不未雨绸缪的生活方式会导致晚年陷入严重的经济困境。

improvise.meaning: v. 即兴创作；临时凑合；即兴表演
improvise.note:
When he forgot his lines, he had to improvise. 当他忘词时，他不得不即兴发挥。

We didn't have a tent, so we had to improvise a shelter with branches. 我们没有帐篷，只好用树枝临时凑合搭建一个庇护所。

improvised.meaning: adj. 临时凑合的；即兴的
improvised.note:
The band played an incredible improvised blues tune. 乐队演奏了一曲精彩绝伦的即兴蓝调。

They used improvised tools to fix the broken engine. 他们用临时凑合的工具修好了坏掉的发动机。

imprudent.meaning: adj. 轻率的；不明智的；不谨慎的
imprudent.note:
It would be imprudent to invest all your savings in one company. 把所有的积蓄都投资在一家公司是不明智的。

His imprudent remarks caused a public relations disaster. 他轻率的言论引发了一场公关灾难。

impudent.meaning: adj. 放肆的；厚颜无耻的；无礼的
impudent.note:
The impudent child talked back to his teacher. 这个放肆的孩子顶撞了老师。

I was amazed by her impudent disregard for the rules. 她对规章制度无耻的漠视让我大吃一惊。

impugn.note:
No one can successfully impugn his honesty and dedication. 谁也无法成功质疑他的诚实与奉献精神。

The lawyer tried to impugn the reliability of the forensic evidence. 律师试图质疑法医证据的可靠性。

impuissance.note:
He felt a deep sense of impuissance in the face of the tragedy. 面对这场悲剧，他感到一种深深的无力感。

The government's economic policies reflected a growing sense of impuissance. 政府的经济政策反映出一种日益加剧的无能感。

impulse.note:
She bought the expensive dress on a sudden impulse. 她凭着突然的冲动买下了这件昂贵的裙子。

Electrical impulses travel along nerve fibers to the brain. 电脉冲沿着神经纤维传导至大脑。

impulsive.meaning: adj. 冲动的；任性的；由冲动驱使的
impulsive.note:
He is known for making impulsive decisions that he later regrets. 他以做出事后后悔的冲动决定而闻名。

Try not to be so impulsive when shopping online. 网购时尽量不要那么冲动。

impunity.meaning: n. 免予惩罚；不受惩罚
impunity.note:
Corrupt officials operated with impunity for many years. 腐败官员多年来一直逍遥法外、免受惩罚。

No one should be allowed to break the law with impunity. 任何人都不应被允许违法却免受惩罚。

inadvertence.note:
The error was simply the result of human inadvertence. 这个错误纯粹是人为疏忽造成的。

Through sheer inadvertence, she deleted the important file. 纯粹由于一时疏忽，她删除了那个重要文件。

inadvertently.meaning: adv. 不经意地；无意地；不小心地
inadvertently.note:
She inadvertently revealed the surprise party plans. 她无意中泄露了惊喜派对的计划。

He inadvertently deleted the draft of his essay. 他不小心删掉了自己文章的草稿。

inalienable.meaning: adj. 不可剥夺的；不能让渡的
inalienable.note:
Every human being has inalienable rights to life and liberty. 每个自然人都拥有不可剥夺的生存权和自由权。

Freedom of speech is an inalienable right in a democratic society. 言论自由在民主社会中是不可剥夺的权利。

inane.meaning: adj. 空洞的；愚蠢的；无意义的
inane.note:
He grew tired of listening to their inane chatter. 他厌倦了听他们那些空洞的闲聊。

She made an inane remark that silenced the room for a moment. 她说了一句蠢话，让房间安静了一会儿。

inanimate.meaning: adj. 无生命的；死气沉沉的
inanimate.note:
Rocks and stones are inanimate objects. 岩石和石头是没有生命的物体。

He stared at the inanimate body on the floor with horror. 他惊恐地盯着地板上没有生命的躯体。

inappreciable.meaning: adj. 微不足道的；不着边际的；小的无法察觉的
inappreciable.note:
The difference in temperature was so small as to be inappreciable. 温差太小，简直无法察觉。

There was an inappreciable delay in data transmission. 数据传输中存在微不足道的延迟。

inaugural.meaning:
adj. 就职的；开幕的
n. 就职演说
inaugural.note:
The president delivered his inaugural address to the nation. 总统向全国发表了就职演说。

This flight marks the inaugural journey of the new aircraft model. 这次航班标志着新款飞机的首航。

inaugurate.meaning: v. 为...举行就职典礼；为...剪彩开幕；开创
inaugurate.note:
The mayor will officially inaugurate the new city museum. 市长将为新的城市博物馆正式剪彩开幕。

This discovery inaugurated a new era of medical treatment. 这项发现开创了医学治疗的新纪元。

inborn.meaning: adj. 天生的；生来具有的
inborn.note:
She seemed to have an inborn talent for music. 她似乎有着天生的音乐才华。

Compassion is an inborn trait in most human beings. 同情心是大多数人类生来具有的特质。

incandescence.meaning: n. 白炽；发白光；强烈的情感或光辉
incandescence.note:
The old bulb emitted a warm incandescence. 旧灯泡发出温暖的白炽光。

Her speech was delivered with a brilliant incandescence. 她的演讲充满了夺目的光彩与热情。

incantation.note:
The witch muttered an incantation over the boiling cauldron. 女巫在沸腾的坩埚上低声念着咒语。

He repeated the corporate slogan like a magical incantation. 他像念魔咒一样重复着企业口号。

incarnate.meaning:
adj. 化身的；人体化的
v. 化身；体现
incarnate.note:
She is kindness incarnate; she helps everyone she meets. 她简直是善良的化身，她帮助遇到的每一个人。

Legends say the god chose to incarnate as a mortal man. 传说这位神明选择化身为凡人。

incendiary.meaning:
adj. 放火的；煽动性的
n. 燃烧弹；煽动者
incendiary.note:
The police found incendiary devices hidden in the warehouse. 警察在仓库里发现了藏匿的燃烧装置。

He was arrested for making incendiary comments online. 他因在网上发表煽动性言论而被捕。

incense.meaning:
n. 香；卫生香
v. /ɪnˈsens/ 激怒；使大怒
incense.note:
The temple was filled with the sweet scent of burning incense. 庙宇里弥漫着焚香的甜美香气。

His rude remarks served to incense the entire audience. 他粗鲁的言论彻底激怒了全场观众。

inception.note:
The project has faced numerous technical challenges since its inception. 自项目启动以来，它面临了无数的技术挑战。

He has been the director of the museum since its inception. 自该博物馆成立以来，他一直担任馆长。

inchoate.meaning: adj. 早期的；刚开始的；未成熟的
inchoate.note:
She had only an inchoate idea of what she wanted to write. 她对于自己想写什么只有一个初步、不成熟的想法。

These are merely inchoate thoughts that need further development. 这些仅仅是需要进一步完善的初步想法。

incipient.note:
Doctors managed to catch the disease in its incipient stage. 医生们设法在疾病初期阶段将其控制住。

She showed incipient signs of exhaustion after working all night. 通宵工作后，她表现出了初期的疲惫迹象。

incise.note:
The surgeon will incise the skin carefully during the operation. 手术期间外科医生会小心地切开皮肤。

Artists incise intricate patterns onto the surface of wood. 艺术家在木头表面雕刻出复杂的图案。

incision.note:
The surgeon made a small incision in the patient's abdomen. 外科医生在病人的腹部做了一个小切口。

Proper care of the incision will prevent any post-operative infection. 正确护理切口可以防止任何术后感染。

incisive.meaning: adj. 深刻的；敏锐的；尖锐的
incisive.note:
She is known for her incisive analysis of complex financial markets. 她以对复杂金融市场敏锐深刻的分析而闻名。

His incisive questions quickly exposed the flaws in the proposal. 他犀利的问题很快暴露了该提案中的漏洞。

incite.note:
He was accused of trying to incite a riot among the workers. 他被指控试图煽动工人们暴动。

The speech was designed to incite passion and action among the crowd. 这场演讲旨在激发人群的热情与行动。

incogitant.meaning: adj. 考虑不周的；轻率的；无思想的
incogitant.note:
His incogitant behavior hurt his friends deeply. 他考虑不周的行为深深伤害了他的朋友。

An incogitant remark can ruin years of friendship in seconds. 一句轻率的话能在几秒钟内毁掉多年的友谊。

incommensurate.meaning: adj. 不相称的；不平等的；不适当的
incommensurate.note:
Her salary is incommensurate with the heavy responsibilities she carries. 她的薪水与她承担的沉重责任不相称。

Their response was incommensurate with the scale of the crisis. 他们的反应与危机的规模极不相称。

incompetent.meaning:
adj. 无能力的；不胜任的
n. 无能者
incompetent.note:
The manager was fired because he was found to be incompetent. 这名经理因被发现不胜任工作而被解雇。

He felt surrounded by incompetent colleagues. 他觉得周围都是能力不足的同事。

incongruity.meaning: n. 不和谐；不一致；不合拍
incongruity.note:
The modern glass building created an odd incongruity in the historic square. 这栋现代玻璃建筑在历史广场上显得格格不入。

She laughed at the incongruity of wearing sneakers with a formal gown. 她嘲笑穿着正式晚礼服却搭配运动鞋的不协调感。

inconsequential.meaning: adj. 不重要的；微不足道的；无关紧要的
inconsequential.note:
They spent hours arguing over completely inconsequential details. 他们花了好几个小时争论完全无关紧要的细节。

Do not waste your energy on such inconsequential matters. 不要把精力浪费在这些无足轻重的小事上。

inconstancy.meaning: n. 多变；反复无常；不忠实
inconstancy.note:
His inconstancy in relationships made it hard for him to settle down. 他在恋爱关系中的反复无常使他很难安定下来。

The inconstancy of the spring weather caught us off guard. 春季天气变化无常，让我们措手不及。

incontrovertible.meaning: adj. 无可辩驳的；不容置疑的
incontrovertible.note:
The prosecution presented incontrovertible evidence of his guilt. 控方出示了他有罪的无可辩驳的证据。

Scientific facts must be supported by incontrovertible data. 科学事实必须有不容置疑的数据支持。

incorrigibility.meaning: n. 冥顽不灵；不可救药；难以管教
incorrigibility.note:
The principal despaired over the boy's total incorrigibility. 校长对这个男孩彻底的不可救药感到绝望。

His incorrigibility meant that standard discipline no longer worked. 他冥顽不灵，这意味着常规的纪律管教已经不管用了。

incorrigible.meaning: adj. 不可救药的；难改的；固执己见的
incorrigible.note:
He is an incorrigible optimist who always sees the bright side. 他是一个无可救药的乐观主义者，总是看到光明的一面。

She is an incorrigible flirt who cannot help charming everyone. 她是一个无可救药的调情高手，总是忍不住去吸引所有人。

incorruptible.meaning: adj. 廉洁的；腐蚀不掉的；刚正不阿的
incorruptible.note:
The judge was known as an honest and incorruptible official. 这名法官以诚实廉洁、刚正不阿的官员著称。

An incorruptible police force is essential for a fair society. 一支清正廉洁的警察队伍对公平社会至关重要。

incredulity.note:
She stared at the winning lottery ticket in sheer incredulity. 她难以置信地盯着那张中奖彩票。

His announcement was met with gasps of incredulity from the crowd. 他的宣告引起了人群中一片惊愕的质疑声。

increment.meaning: n. 增加；增量；定期加薪
increment.note:
Salary increases are paid in annual increments. 薪资上涨按年度递增发放。

Data is saved automatically at regular time increments. 数据按固定的时间增量自动保存。

incriminate.note:
He refused to answer the question, fearing it might incriminate him. 他拒绝回答这个问题，担心这会让自己陷入罪责。

The letters found in the drawer served to incriminate him. 抽屉里发现的信件成为了指控他的罪证。

incubate.meaning: v. 孵化；孕育；培养（细菌等）
incubate.note:
Birds sit on their eggs to incubate them. 鸟类坐在蛋上进行孵化。

It takes a few days for the virus to incubate in the body. 病毒在体内需要几天时间来孕育滋生。

incubation.meaning: n. 孵化期；潜伏期；孕育阶段
incubation.note:
The disease has an incubation period of two weeks. 该疾病有两周的潜伏期。

Creative ideas often require a long period of incubation. 创意往往需要一个漫长的孕育阶段。

incubator.meaning: n. 孵卵器；早产儿保育箱；企业孵化器
incubator.note:
Premature babies are kept warm inside a medical incubator. 早产儿被保温在医疗保育箱内。

The university acts as an incubator for tech start-ups. 这所大学充当了科技初创企业的孵化器。

incubus.meaning: n. 恶梦；心理负担；重压
incubus.note:
Financial debt felt like an incubator of stress and an incubus on his mind. 债务感觉像是一种压得他喘不过气来的心理重担。

In folklore, an incubus was a demon that tormented sleepers. 在民间传说中，梦魇是一种折磨睡者的恶魔。

inculcate.meaning: v. 谆谆教导；灌输（思想、价值观）
inculcate.note:
Parents try to inculcate good manners in their children. 父母努力向孩子灌输良好的礼貌习惯。

The coach sought to inculcate a strong work ethic into the players. 教练试图向队员们灌输强烈的职业道德观念。

inculpate.note:
The witness's testimony served to inculpate the former CEO. 证人的证词起到了将前首席执行官定罪的作用。

They found documents that explicitly inculpated him in the fraud. 他们找到了明确将他牵连进欺诈案的文件。

incumbent.meaning:
adj. 负有职责的；现任的
n. 在职者；现任者
incumbent.note:
It is incumbent upon us to protect the environment for future generations. 我们有责任为后代保护环境。

The incumbent mayor is running for re-election this year. 现任市长今年正在竞选连任。

indebted.meaning: adj. 负债的；感恩的；受恩惠的
indebted.note:
I am deeply indebted to my mentors for their continuous support. 我深深感激导师们给予我的持续支持。

The company became heavily indebted after a disastrous year. 经过灾难性的一年，该公司背上了沉重的债务。

indecipherable.meaning: adj. 难解的；破译不了的；字迹潦草的
indecipherable.note:
His handwriting was completely indecipherable. 他的字迹完全潦草得让人认不出来。

The ancient inscription remained indecipherable to modern scholars. 这段古代铭文对现代学者来说依然无法破译。

indecisive.meaning: adj. 优柔寡断的；犹豫不决的；无决定性的
indecisive.note:
He is too indecisive to make a good leader. 他过于优柔寡断，成不了好领导。

The football match ended in an indecisive draw. 这场足球赛以不分胜负的平局告终。

indefatigable.meaning: adj. 不知疲倦的；不屈不挠的
indefatigable.note:
She was an indefatigable campaigner for human rights. 她是一位不知疲倦的人权活动家。

His indefatigable energy amazed everyone on the team. 他那不知疲倦的精力惊艳了团队里的每一个人。

indelible.meaning: adj. 难忘的；不可磨灭的；印记永久的
indelible.note:
The experience left an indelible mark on his memory. 这段经历在他的记忆中留下了不可磨灭的印记。

She used an indelible marker to write her name on the box. 她用不褪色记号笔在箱子上写下了自己的名字。

indemnify.meaning: v. 赔偿；保障...免受损失；为...买保险
indemnify.note:
The insurance policy will indemnify you against loss or theft. 该保险单将赔偿您因丢失或被盗造成的损失。

Contractors are required to indemnify the company against any accidents. 承包商须保证公司免受任何事故的损失赔偿责任。

indemnity.meaning: n. 赔偿；保障；保护免受损失
indemnity.note:
The treaty demanded heavy financial indemnity from the defeated nation. 该条约要求战败国支付巨额经济赔偿金。

They requested legal indemnity before signing the high-risk contract. 他们在签署高风险合同前要求提供法律赔偿保障。

indent.meaning:
v. 缩进；订购；切口
n. 缩进；订货单
indent.note:
Remember to indent the first line of each paragraph. 记住每段的第一行要缩进。

The rock surface showed a distinct indent where it had been struck. 岩石表面被击打处有一个明显的凹痕。

indenture.meaning:
n. 契约；学徒契约
v. 以契约约束（学徒或仆人）
indenture.note:
In the past, young workers signed an indenture to learn a trade. 过去，年轻工人们会签署一份契约来学习手艺。

The historical document detailed the terms of indentured labor. 这份历史文件详细说明了契约劳工的条款。

indeterminate.meaning: adj. 不确定的；不明确的；模糊的
indeterminate.note:
The project was delayed for an indeterminate period. 该项目被无限期延期。

Her hair color was an indeterminate shade between brown and blonde. 她的发色介于棕色和金色之间，是一种模糊不清的色调。

indicative.meaning: adj. 表明的；象征的；指示的
indicative.note:
Rising unemployment is often indicative of economic decline. 失业率上升通常是经济下滑的表征。

His tone was indicative of his annoyance. 他的语气表明他很生气。

indices.meaning: n. 指数（index的复数）；指标；标志
indices.note:
Economic indices showed signs of recovery last quarter. 上个季度经济指标显示出复苏的迹象。

Stock market indices fluctuate daily based on investor confidence. 股市指数根据投资者的信心每日波动。

indict.note:
A grand jury voted to indict him on charges of tax evasion. 大陪审团投票以逃税罪名起诉了他。

He was formally indicted in federal court yesterday. 他昨天在联邦法院被正式起诉。

indigence.note:
Many families were reduced to indigence during the depression. 大萧条期间，许多家庭沦落至极度贫困。

Charitable organizations work hard to rescue people from indigence. 慈善组织努力将人们从贫困中解救出来。

indigent.meaning:
adj. 贫困的；贫穷的
n. 贫民
indigent.note:
The clinic provides free medical care for indigent patients. 这家诊所为贫困病人提供免费医疗服务。

Local authorities offered shelter to the city's indigent population. 当地政府向城市的贫困人口提供了庇护所。

indignation.note:
The scandal provoked widespread public indignation. 这起丑闻引发了公众广泛的义愤。

She expressed her righteous indignation over the unfair treatment. 她对这种不公正的待遇表达了正义的愤慨。

indignity.meaning: n. 侮辱；屈辱；有失尊严的事
indignity.note:
He suffered the indignity of being searched in front of everyone. 他经受了在所有人面前被搜身的屈辱。

Old age can sometimes bring the indignity of physical frailty. 老年有时会带来身体衰弱的屈辱感。

indispensability.meaning: n. 不可或缺性；绝对必要性
indispensability.note:
She proved her indispensability to the company during the merger. 在合并期间，她证明了自己对公司的不可或缺性。

The pandemic highlighted the indispensability of healthcare workers. 疫情凸显了医护人员不可或缺的重要性。

individual.meaning:
adj. 个人的；单独的
n. 个人；个体
individual.note:
Every individual has the right to express their opinions. 每个个人都有表达自己观点的权利。

The teacher tailored the lesson to suit individual student needs. 老师根据每个学生的个人需求调整了课程。

indoctrinate.meaning: v. 灌输；向...灌输思想（教条等）
indoctrinate.note:
The cult attempted to indoctrinate young members with strange beliefs. 邪教试图向年轻成员灌输奇异的信仰。

Education should foster critical thinking rather than simply indoctrinate. 教育应该培养批判性思维，而不仅仅是灌输观念。

indolent.meaning: adj. 懒惰的；好逸恶劳的；（伤口等）无痛缓慢愈合的
indolent.note:
He spent his indolent summer days lounging on the beach. 他在海滩上闲逛，度过了懒洋洋的夏日时光。

An indolent lifestyle can lead to health problems. 懒散的生活方式会导致健康问题。

indubitable.meaning: adj. 不容置疑的；确凿的；毋庸置疑的
indubitable.note:
The archaeological find offered indubitable proof of ancient settlement. 这一考古发现提供了古代定居点的确凿证据。

Her talent as a writer is indubitable. 她作为作家的才华是毋庸置疑的。

induction.meaning: n. 就职仪式；入职培训；归纳法
induction.note:
New employees must attend a two-day induction program. 新员工必须参加为期两天的入职培训项目。

Scientific reasoning often relies on logical induction. 科学推理通常依赖于逻辑归纳法。

indurate.meaning:
adj. 硬化的；冷酷无情的
v. 使硬化；使坚强
indurate.note:
Years of hardship had helped indurate his heart against pity. 多年的苦难使他的心变得铁石心肠、不再同情他人。

High temperatures can indurate certain clay materials. 高温能使某些粘土材料硬化。

industrious.meaning: adj. 勤奋的；刻苦的；忙碌的
industrious.note:
She is an industrious student who always finishes her homework early. 她是一个勤奋的学生，总是很早就写完作业。

The industrious ants worked all summer to store food. 勤劳的蚂蚁整个夏天都在忙着储存食物。

ineffable.meaning: adj. 妙不可言的；难以言喻的；不可言说的
ineffable.note:
She felt an ineffable joy when she held her newborn baby for the first time. 当她第一次抱起刚出生的宝宝时，她感到一种难以言喻的喜悦。

The sunset over the ocean possessed an ineffable beauty. 海洋上的落日拥有着一种妙不可言的美丽。

ineffectual.meaning: adj. 无效的；不起作用的；无能的
ineffectual.note:
His efforts to control the budget proved inffectual. 他控制预算的努力证明是徒劳无效的。

She felt helpless and inffectual in dealing with the crisis. 在应对这场危机时，她感到自己既无能又无力。

inelasticity.note:
The inelasticity of the material limits its use in clothing. 这种材料缺乏弹性，限制了它在服装中的应用。

Economic models must account for the price inelasticity of essential goods. 经济模型必须考虑生活必需品的价格缺乏弹性特征。

ineluctable.meaning: adj. 不可避免的；逃不掉的
ineluctable.note:
Change is an ineluctable part of life that we must accept. 变化是生活不可避免的一部分，我们必须接受它。

Death and taxes are often cited as ineluctable facts of life. 死亡和税收常被引为生活中无法逃避的事实。

ineptitude.note:
The project failed due to sheer managerial ineptitude. 项目由于管理层的极度无能而失败了。

His social ineptitude made it difficult for him to make friends. 他在社交上的笨拙使他很难交到朋友。

inequity.note:
Activists protested against the social inequity within the tax system. 活动人士抗议税收制度内部存在的社会不公。

Addressing economic inequity is a primary goal of the new policy. 解决经济不平等是新政策的首要目标。

inert.meaning: adj. 迟钝的；无生气的；惰性的（化学）
inert.note:
Nitrogen is a relatively inert gas that does not react easily. 氮气是一种相对惰性的气体，不易发生反应。

He lay inert on the couch after working out. 他健身完后无力地躺在沙发上。

inexhaustible.meaning: adj. 用之不竭的；无穷无尽的
inexhaustible.note:
She seemed to have an inexhaustible supply of energy. 她似乎有着用之不竭的精力。

Children have an inexhaustible curiosity about the world around them. 孩子们对周围世界有着无穷无尽的好奇心。

inexorable.meaning: adj. 不可阻挡的；无情的；不为所动的
inexorable.note:
They watched the inexorable rise in sea levels with concern. 他们忧心忡忡地看着海平面不可阻挡地上升。

Time has an inexorable march that no one can halt. 时间有着谁也无法阻挡的无情步伐。

inexplicable.meaning: adj. 费解的；无法解释的
inexplicable.note:
His sudden disappearance remained completely inexplicable. 他突然的失踪完全让人无法解释。

She felt an inexplicable sadness for no apparent reason. 她无缘无故地感到一种莫名其妙的悲伤。

infantile.meaning: adj. 婴儿的；幼稚的；幼儿期的
infantile.note:
The disease primarily affects infantile patients. 这种疾病主要影响婴儿患者。

Stop making such infantile jokes during serious meetings. 在严肃的会议上别开这么幼稚的玩笑了。

infantry.note:
The infantry advanced across the field under heavy cover. 步兵在密集的掩护下向前穿过田野。

He served as a private in the army's infantry division. 他曾担任陆军步兵师的一名列兵。

infatuation.meaning: n. 痴迷；盲目热恋；迷恋
infatuation.note:
Their teenage romance was just a passing infatuation. 他们少男少女的恋情只是一时的迷恋。

His brief infatuation with luxury cars ended when he went bankrupt. 他对豪车的短暂痴迷在破产后就结束了。

infection.note:
Clean the wound carefully to prevent bacterial infection. 仔细清洗伤口以防止细菌感染。

The doctor prescribed antibiotics to clear up the chest infection. 医生开抗生素来治疗胸部感染。

infelicitous.meaning: adj. 不恰当的；不幸的；不得体的
infelicitous.note:
His infelicitous remark offended several guests at the dinner. 他不得体的言论冒犯了晚宴上的几位客人。

The author later regretted using such an infelicitous phrase. 作者后来后悔使用了这样一个不恰当的词组。

infelicity.meaning: n. 不恰当；不当之词；不幸
infelicity.note:
The editor pointed out several stylistic infelicitations in the text. 编辑指出了文中的几处文体不当之处。

An infelicity in his speech caused unnecessary misunderstandings. 他演讲中的一处不当之词造成了不必要的误解。

inferno.meaning: n. 烈火地狱；大火灾；极度痛苦的地方
inferno.note:
Firefighters rushed to rescue residents trapped in the blazing inferno. 消防员赶忙营救被困在熊熊烈火中的居民。

Dante's Inferno describes the terrifying realms of hell. 但丁的《地狱篇》描绘了地狱里恐怖的境界。

infinitesimal.meaning:
adj. 极小的；微不足道的
n. 微量；极小量
infinitesimal.note:
There was only an infinitesimal chance of winning the lottery. 中彩票的几率微乎其微。

The chemical was present in infinitesimal amounts. 这种化学物质的存在量极微。

infirm.meaning: adj. 体弱的；虚弱的（多指年老体衰）
infirm.note:
He grew increasingly infirm as he entered his late eighties. 进入八十岁高龄后，他的身体日渐虚弱。

The charity provides care for elderly and infirm people. 该慈善机构为年老体弱的人提供照顾。

inflame.meaning: v. 激怒；使燃烧；使发炎
inflame.note:
His inflammatory speech served to inflame the angry crowd. 他煽动性的演讲激怒了愤怒的人群。

Dust and smoke can inflame the eyes and throat. 灰尘和烟雾会使眼睛和喉咙发炎。

inflamed.meaning: adj. 发炎的红肿的；激昂的
inflamed.note:
The doctor examined her inflamed throat. 医生检查了她发炎红肿的喉咙。

His skin was red and inflamed from the allergic reaction. 他的皮肤因过敏反应而红肿发炎。

inflate.meaning: v. 充气；使膨胀；使（价格等）上涨
inflate.note:
Remember to inflate the bicycle tires before the trip. 骑行前记得给自行车轮胎充气。

Printing too much money will artificially inflate the economy. 印制过多货币会人为推高经济通胀。

influx.note:
The coastal town experiences a massive influx of tourists in summer. 这座沿海小镇在夏天会迎来大量游客的涌入。

The tech company saw a large influx of venture capital. 这家科技公司迎来了大量风险投资的涌入。

informed.meaning: adj. 见多识广的；了解情况的；有根据的
informed.note:
Make sure you make an informed decision before signing the contract. 确保在签署合同前做出了解情况的明智决定。

An informed public is essential for a healthy democracy. 见多识广的公众对健康的民主至关重要。

infraction.note:
Even a minor rule infraction can result in a penalty. 哪怕是轻微的违规行为也可能导致处罚。

He was dismissed for repeated infractions of company policy. 他因屡次违反公司规章制度而被解雇。

infuriate.note:
His arrogant attitude never failed to infuriate his coworkers. 他傲慢的态度总能激怒他的同事。

She was infuriated by the constant delays on the train line. 火车路线不断的延误把她气坏了。

ingenious.meaning: adj. 精巧的；机灵的；有独创性的
ingenious.note:
He came up with an ingenious device to save electricity. 他想出了一个省电的巧妙装置。

It was an ingenious solution to a very complex problem. 这是一个解决极其复杂问题的巧妙方案。

ing.meaning: n. 语言学后缀（表示进行时或动名词）
ing.note:
Adding '-ing' to the verb 'run' gives you 'running'. 在动词“run”后加上“-ing”就成了“running”。

Many English verbs form their present participles with an '-ing' ending. 许多英语动词以“-ing”结尾构成现在分词。

ingenuity.meaning: n. 心灵手巧；独创性；机敏
ingenuity.note:
The engineers showed great ingenuity in solving the design flaw. 工程师们在解决设计缺陷时表现出了极大的创造力。

Building the ancient pyramids required incredible human ingenuity. 建造古代金字塔需要难以置信的人类智慧。

ingenuous.meaning: adj. 天真的；坦率的；单纯的
ingenuous.note:
Her ingenuous smile charmed everyone in the room. 她天真的笑容迷倒了房间里的每个人。

It was ingenuous of him to trust a stranger so easily. 他太单纯了，竟然这么轻易就相信了一个陌生人。

ingest.meaning: v. 咽下；摄取；吸收（食物、药物等）
ingest.note:
Toxic chemicals can be fatal if ingested. 如果摄入有毒化学物质可能会致命。

Plants ingest minerals from the soil. 植物从土壤中吸收矿物质。

ingestion.note:
Accidental ingestion of small magnets can be dangerous for toddlers. 幼儿误吞小磁铁可能会有危险。

Proper digestion begins immediately after the ingestion of food. 食物一旦被摄入，正常的消化过程就开始了。

ingrained.meaning: adj. 根深蒂固的；深入人心的
ingrained.note:
Cultural habits are often deeply ingrained from childhood. 文化习惯往往从童年起就根深蒂固。

He had an ingrained prejudice against foreigners. 他对外国人有着根深蒂固的偏见。

ingrate.note:
He called his unappreciative brother an ingrate. 他骂那个不懂感恩的哥哥是个忘恩负义的人。

She felt like an ingrate for not thanking everyone properly. 她觉得自己没有好好向大家道谢，像个忘恩负义的人。

ingratiate.note:
He tried to ingratiate himself with his boss by working late. 他试图通过加班来讨好老板。

She sought to ingratiate herself with the influential committee members. 她试图讨好那些有影响力的委员会成员。

ingratiating.meaning: adj. 讨好的；谄媚的；奉承的
ingratiating.note:
He spoke in an ingratiating tone that many found annoying. 他用一种许多人觉得厌烦的谄媚语气说话。

Her ingratiating smile failed to win over the strict supervisor. 她讨好的微笑没能赢得这位严厉主管的欢心。

ingredient.note:
Check the list of ingredients on the back of the food package. 查看食品包装背面的配料表。

Honesty is a key ingredient in any successful relationship. 诚实是任何成功关系中的关键要素。

inhabit.note:
Various species of birds inhabit the dense forest. 各种鸟类栖息在这片茂密的森林里。

Humans now inhabit almost every corner of the earth. 人类现在居住在地球的几乎每个角落。

inhibitor.note:
Corrosion inhibitors are added to prevent metal from rusting. 添加缓蚀剂以防止金属生锈。

Enzyme inhibitors play a crucial role in medical pharmacology. 酶抑制剂在医学药理学中起着至关重要的作用。

inhumane.note:
The prison conditions were criticized as cruel and inhumane. 监狱的条件被批评为残酷且不人道。

Animal testing under certain conditions is considered inhumane. 在某些条件下的动物实验被认为是不人道的。

inimical.meaning: adj. 敌意的；有害的；不友好的
inimical.note:
Such heavy pollution is inimical to plant and animal life. 如此严重的污染对动植物生命是有害的。

His cold attitude created an atmosphere inimical to discussion. 他冷漠的态度营造了一种不利于讨论的氛围。

inimitable.meaning: adj. 独特的；无与伦比的；无法效仿的
inimitable.note:
She performed the song in her own inimitable style. 她以自己无与伦比的独特风格演唱了这首歌。

His inimitable wit made him a legendary talk show host. 他那独特的机智使他成为了一位传奇脱口秀主持人。

iniquitous.meaning: adj. 极不公正的；邪恶的
iniquitous.note:
Protesters called for an end to the iniquitous tax system. 抗议者呼吁终结这个极不公正的税收制度。

He considered the discriminatory law to be completely iniquitous. 他认为这项歧视性法律完全是邪恶不公的。

iniquity.meaning: n. 邪恶；不公正；罪恶的行为
iniquity.note:
