The preacher condemned the moral iniquity of the modern city. 牧师谴责了现代城市的道德沦丧。

They fought a lifelong battle against social iniquity. 他们为反对社会不公进行了一生的斗争。

initial.meaning:
adj. 最初的；开始的
n. 首字母
v. 签署首字母
initial.note:
His initial reaction to the proposal was quite positive. 他对该提案最初的反应相当积极。

Please initial beside the correction on the contract. 请在合同的修改处旁边签上您的首字母缩写。

injunction.note:
The court issued an injunction to stop the construction work. 法院发布了一道禁令以停止建设工作。

Environmentalists sought a legal injunction against the logging company. 环保主义者寻求对伐木公司颁布法律禁令。

injurious.meaning: adj. 有害的；伤及的；诽谤的
injurious.note:
Smoking is injurious to your health in many ways. 吸烟在许多方面对你的健康有害。

False rumors can be injurious to a person's reputation. 虚假的谣言会损害一个人的名誉。

inkling.note:
I didn't have the slightest inkling of what was going on. 我对发生的事情一点风声也不知道。

She had no inkling that a surprise party was being planned for her. 她一点也没有察觉到正有人为她策划惊喜派对。

innocence.note:
He fought for years to prove his innocence in court. 他为了在法庭上证明自己的清白奋斗了多年。

The child looked up with wide-eyed innocence. 那孩子睁大天真的双眼看着。

innocuous.meaning: adj. 无害的；无毒的；无意冒犯的
innocuous.note:
It was meant to be an innocuous joke, but he took it seriously. 这本该是一个无伤大雅的玩笑，但他却当真了。

Most garden spiders are completely innocuous to humans. 大多数花园蜘蛛对人类完全无害。

innuendo.meaning: n. 暗讽；影射；含沙射影
innuendo.note:
His speech was full of malicious innuendo about his rivals. 他的演讲充满了对竞争对手恶毒的含沙射影。

She refused to dignify his nasty innuendos with a response. 她不屑于对那些恶毒的影射做出回应。

inoculate.meaning: v. 接种疫苗；预防注射；嫁接
inoculate.note:
Children are routinely inoculated against measles. 儿童常规接种麻疹疫苗。

Farmers learn how to inoculate fruit trees to improve yields. 农民学习如何嫁接果树以提高产量。

inordinate.meaning: adj. 过度的；过分的；无节制的
inordinate.note:
He spent an inordinate amount of time playing video games. 他花在打电子游戏上的时间实在过多。

The project ran into trouble due to inordinate delays. 该项目由于过度的延误而陷入困境。

inquiry.note:
The police launched a formal inquiry into the accident. 警方对这起事故展开了正式调查。

We received many customer inquiries about the new product launch. 我们收到了许多关于新产品发布的客户咨询。

inroad.meaning: n. 侵占；突袭；重大进展
inroad.note:
The rival brand has made significant inroads into our market share. 竞争品牌在我们的市场份额中取得了重大侵占进展。

Rising oceans threaten to make dangerous inroads on the coastline. 上升的海水构成了对海岸线危险的侵蚀。

insatiable.meaning: adj. 贪得无厌的；无法满足的
insatiable.note:
She has an insatiable appetite for reading mystery novels. 她对阅读悬疑小说有着永不满足的爱好。

His insatiable ambition drove him to the top of the corporate ladder. 他贪得无厌的野心驱使他爬上了公司权力的巅峰。

inscribe.note:
They decided to inscribe their names on the wedding ring. 他们决定把名字刻在结婚戒指上。

The monument was inscribed with the names of fallen soldiers. 纪念碑上刻着阵亡士兵的名字。

inscrutable.meaning: adj. 高深莫测的；神秘的；难以看透的
inscrutable.note:
He kept an inscrutable expression throughout the negotiations. 在整个谈判过程中，他一直保持着高深莫测的表情。

Her motives remained completely inscrutable to her friends. 她的动机对朋友们来说完全是个谜。

insecticide.note:
Farmers spray insecticide to protect crops from pests. 农民喷洒杀虫剂以保护农作物免受害虫侵害。

Make sure to wash the vegetables to remove any lingering insecticide. 确保清洗蔬菜以去除残留的杀虫剂。

insensate.meaning: adj. 无感觉的；无理性的；冷酷无情的
insensate.note:
He was beaten insomuch that he lay insensate on the floor. 他被打得失去了知觉，躺在地板上不省人事。

War often brings out insensate violence in people. 战争往往会激发人们心中冷酷无情的暴力。

insentient.meaning: adj. 无知觉的；无生命的；无感觉的
insentient.note:
Stones and wood are insentient elements of nature. 石头和木头是自然界中没有知觉的元素。

He stared at the insentient object as if it could speak. 他盯着那个无知觉的物体，仿佛它会说话似的。

insert.meaning:
v. 插入；嵌入
n. 插入物；插页
insert.note:
Insert your card into the ATM machine to begin the transaction. 将卡插入自动取款机以开始交易。

The newspaper came with a colorful advertising insert. 报纸里夹带了一张彩色的广告插页。

insignia.note:
The pilot wore military insignia on his uniform jacket. 飞行员的制服夹克上佩戴着军衔徽章。

Luxury cars often feature a distinctive metal insignia on the hood. 豪华汽车的车前盖上通常带有独特的金属徽标。

insincerity.note:
His apology was met with anger due to its obvious insincerity. 他的道歉因为明显的虚伪而招致了愤怒。

She could sense the insincerity behind his polite compliments. 她能感觉到他礼貌赞美背后的虚伪。

insinuate.meaning: v. 暗指；含沙射影；巧妙融入
insinuate.note:
What are you trying to insinuate with those remarks? 你那些话究竟想暗示什么？

He managed to insinuate himself into the inner circle of management. 他设法巧妙地混入了管理层的核心圈子。

insipid.meaning: adj. 枯燥乏味的；清淡无味的
insipid.note:
The soup tasted rather insipid and needed more salt. 这汤尝起来相当寡淡，需要多加点盐。

She found the academic lecture dry and completely insipid. 她觉得这场学术讲座枯燥乏味、索然无味。

insolence.note:
The employee was fired for his constant insolence toward clients. 这名员工因为对客户一贯的无礼而被开除。

She refused to tolerate his insolence any longer. 她再也不愿容忍他的傲慢无礼了。

insolent.meaning: adj. 傲慢的；无礼的；放肆的
insolent.note:
His insolent reply angered the teacher immediately. 他无礼的回答立刻惹怒了老师。

She walked away from the insolent clerk. 她转身离开了那个态度傲慢的店员。

insoluble.meaning: adj. 难溶的；不能解决的
insoluble.note:
Some minerals are completely insoluble in water. 某些矿物质在水中完全不溶。

They faced what seemed like an insoluble problem. 他们面临着一个看似无法解决的问题。

insolvency.note:
Poor financial management led the company to insolvency. 糟糕的财务管理导致公司走向了破产。

Many small businesses teetered on the brink of insolvency. 许多小型企业在破产的边缘摇摇欲坠。

insouciant.meaning: adj. 漠不关心的；漫不经心的；无忧无虑的
insouciant.note:
He maintained an insouciant attitude despite the looming crisis. 尽管危机迫在眉睫，他依然保持着漫不经心的态度。

Her insouciant charm made her popular among friends. 她无忧无虑的魅力使她在朋友中很受欢迎。

inspired.meaning: adj. 有灵感的；出色的；受鼓舞的
inspired.note:
The team made an inspired comeback in the second half of the game. 球队在下半场打出了一次精彩绝伦的反击。

Her speech was truly inspired and moved the entire audience. 她的演讲确实富有灵感，打动了全场观众。

install.note:
We need to hire someone to install the new air conditioner. 我们需要雇人来安装这台新空调。

The software will automatically install on your computer. 软件将自动安装在您的电脑上。

instantaneous.note:
Modern communication allows for instantaneous global connectivity. 现代通讯实现了即时的全球互联。

The medicine provided almost instantaneous relief from pain. 这种药物几乎立即缓解了疼痛。

instate.note:
The board voted to instate him as the new chief executive officer. 董事会投票任命他为新任首席执行官。

She was formally instated in her new role on Monday. 她于周一正式就任新职位。

instigate.note:
The government plans to instigate a series of tax reforms. 政府计划发起一系列税收改革。

He was accused of trying to instigate a strike among employees. 他被指控试图煽动员工罢工。

instill.meaning: v. 逐步灌输（思想等）；滴注
instill.note:
Good parents try to instill confidence in their children. 优秀的父母努力在孩子心中灌输自信。

The doctor had to instill eye drops into the patient's eyes. 医生必须把眼药水滴入病人的眼中。

instinctive.note:
His instinctive reaction was to duck when the ball flew past. 球飞过来时，他本能的反应是低头躲闪。

Motherly love is largely an instinctive behavior. 母爱在很大程度上是一种本能行为。

institution.note:
Harvard is a prestigious higher education institution. 哈佛是一所著名的的高等教育机构。

Marriage is considered a traditional social institution. 婚姻被认为是一种传统的社会制度。

institutionalized.meaning: adj. 制度化的；成惯例的；收容机构化的
institutionalized.note:
Racism can become institutionalized within a society. 种族主义可能会在一个社会中变得制度化。

Long-term hospital care can leave patients feeling institutionalized. 长期住院护理会让病人产生机构化依赖感。

instructive.meaning: adj. 有教育意义的；有启迪作用的
instructive.note:
The documentary provided an instructive look at wildlife behavior. 这部纪录片为了解野生动物行为提供了一个具有教育意义的视角。

His failure was an instructive lesson for young entrepreneurs. 他的失败给年轻创业者上了一堂有启发意义的课。

instrumentalist.meaning: n. 器乐演奏家；乐器演奏者
instrumentalist.note:
He is a talented pianist and a versatile instrumentalist. 他是一位才华横溢的钢琴家和多面手的器乐演奏家。

The orchestra features fifty talented classical instrumentalists. 乐队拥有五十名才华横溢的古典器乐演奏家。

insubordinate.meaning: adj. 不服从的；抗命的；反叛的
insubordinate.note:
The captain dismissed the insubordinate officer immediately. 船长立刻解除了那个不服从命令的军官的职务。

Insubordinate behavior will not be tolerated in the workplace. 在职场中绝不容忍抗命不尊的行为。

insubstantial.meaning: adj. 不真实的；脆弱的；不实质的
insubstantial.note:
Their argument was based on insubstantial evidence. 他们的论点基于不实且脆弱的证据。

The old tent looked too insubstantial to withstand the storm. 旧帐篷看起来太单薄，经受不住暴风雨。

insular.meaning: adj. 海岛的；保守的；狭隘的
insular.note:
People living in remote villages often have an insular mindset. 住在偏远村庄的人们往往有着狭隘的心态。

The island community maintained an insular lifestyle for centuries. 这个岛屿社区几个世纪以来一直保持着封闭的海岛生活方式。

insularity.meaning: n. 岛屿状态；思想狭隘；保守
insularity.note:
Cultural insularity can prevent a nation from embracing new ideas. 文化上的保守会阻碍一个国家接纳新思想。

Travel helps break down the insularity of small-town life. 旅行有助于打破小镇生活的狭隘局限。

insurgent.meaning:
n. 叛乱分子；起义者
adj. 叛乱的；起义的
insurgent.note:
Government forces clashed with armed insurgents near the border. 政府军在边境附近与武装叛乱分子发生冲突。

Insurgent groups captured several key military outposts. 起义武装占领了几个关键的军事哨所。

insurrection.note:
The military quickly suppressed the armed insurrection. 军队迅速平息了这场武装暴动。

Leaders of the failed insurrection were arrested and put on trial. 失败起义的领导人被捕并受审。

intangibility.meaning: n. 无形；不可触摸性；难以捉摸
intangibility.note:
The intangible nature of digital assets can complicate taxation. 数字资产的无形性会使税务处理变得复杂。

Service industries often deal with the intangibility of customer experience. 服务行业经常需要应对客户体验的无形性。

intangible.meaning:
adj. 无形的；触摸不到的
n. 无形资产
intangible.note:
Goodwill and brand recognition are valuable intangible assets. 商誉和品牌知名度是宝贵的无形资产。

Confidence and enthusiasm are intangible qualities of a good leader. 自信和热情是一个好领导身上无形的特质。

intellect.meaning: n. 智力；才智；知识分子
intellect.note:
She was a woman of rare intellect and sharp wit. 她是一个具有罕见智力和敏锐机智的女性。

The university attracts great intellects from all over the world. 这所大学吸引了来自世界各地的伟大智囊。

intellectual.meaning:
adj. 智力的；脑力的
n. 知识分子
intellectual.note:
Chess requires high intellectual concentration. 下国际象棋需要高度的智力集中。

The conference brought together prominent intellectuals and writers. 会议汇集了杰出的知识分子和作家。

intelligible.meaning: adj. 可理解的；清晰易懂的
intelligible.note:
Please write your report in clear, intelligible English. 请用清晰易懂的英语写你的报告。

His voice was barely intelligible over the background noise. 在背景噪音中，他的声音勉强能听懂。

intentional.note:
She insisted that the damage to the car was not intentional. 她坚持认为对汽车的损坏不是故意的。

Was his absence accidental or intentional? 他的缺席是偶然的还是故意的？

interaction.meaning: n. 互动；交流；相互影响
interaction.note:
Social media promotes constant interaction between users. 社交媒体促进了用户之间的持续互动。

Scientists study the interaction between drugs in the body. 科学家研究体内药物之间的相互作用。

intercede.note:
She had to intercede on his behalf with the school principal. 她不得不代表他向学校校长求情。

Diplomats tried to intercede to prevent the war. 外交官们试图调停以阻止战争。

intercessor.meaning: n. 调停者；说项者；求情者
intercessor.note:
He acted as an intercessor in the dispute between the two brothers. 他在两兄弟的争端中充当了调停人。

In religious contexts, saints are viewed as intercessors. 在宗教语境中，圣人被视为代祷者。

interchangeable.note:
These two car parts are completely interchangeable. 这两个汽车零件完全可以互换使用。

People often treat the terms 'sex' and 'gender' as interchangeable. 人们经常把“生理性别”和“社会性别”这两个词当作可以互换的来用。

interdict.meaning:
v. 禁止；阻止
n. 正式禁令
interdict.note:
The church issued an interdict against the rebellious town. 教会向那个叛逆的小镇发布了禁令。

Authorities work hard to interdict the flow of illegal drugs. 当局努力拦截非法毒品的流入。

interjection.note:
Words like 'oh' and 'ouch' are common grammatical interjections. 像“哦”和“哎哟”这样的词是常见的语法感叹词。

His frequent interjections interrupted her train of thought. 他频繁的插话打断了她的思路。

interlock.meaning: v. 扣紧；紧密锁合；连锁
interlock.note:
The puzzle pieces interlock neatly to form a picture. 拼图块整齐地扣合在一起拼成一幅画。

Their fingers were interlocked as they walked down the street. 他们手挽着手走在街上。

interlocking.note:
The system relies on a series of interlocking mechanisms. 该系统依赖于一系列相互连锁的机制。

They used interlocking paving stones for the driveway. 他们为车道铺设了互锁的铺路石。

interlude.meaning: n. 插曲；幕间休息；短暂间隔
interlude.note:
A brief musical interlude was played between acts. 各幕之间演奏了一段简短的音乐插曲。

Their peaceful vacation was a pleasant interlude from work. 他们平静的假期是工作之余一段愉快的插曲。

intermediary.meaning:
n. 中间人；调解人
adj. 中间的
intermediary.note:
They used an independent intermediary to negotiate the business deal. 他们找了一个独立的中间人来谈判这笔商业交易。

She acted as an intermediary between the management and the staff. 她在管理层和员工之间充当调解人。

interminable.meaning: adj. 冗长的；没完没了的
interminable.note:
The flight was delayed, leading to an interminable wait at the airport. 航班延误了，导致在机场进行了没完没了的等待。

He gave an interminable speech that bored everyone. 他发表了一篇又长又无聊的演讲，把所有人都惹烦了。

intermingle.meaning: v. 混合；交织；融为一体
intermingle.note:
Different cultures began to intermingle in the port city. 不同的文化开始在这座港口城市交融。

Sadness and relief seemed to intermingle in her tears. 悲伤和解脱似乎交织在她的泪水中。

intermission.meaning: n. 幕间休息；暂停；中场休息
intermission.note:
We bought snacks during the intermission of the play. 我们在戏剧的中场休息时买了零食。

The rain continued all day without a single intermission. 雨下了一整天，一刻也没有停歇。

intermittent.meaning: adj. 间歇的；断断续续的
intermittent.note:
The forecast calls for intermittent showers throughout the afternoon. 天气预报称整个下午会有间歇性阵雨。

His intermittent engine trouble finally forced him to stop driving. 他那断断续续的发动机故障最终迫使他停止开车。

intern.meaning:
n. 实习生
v. /ɪnˈtɜːn/ 拘禁；实习
intern.note:
She is working as a marketing intern at a tech firm this summer. 她今年夏天在一家科技公司担任市场实习生。

Medical students must intern at a hospital before getting their license. 医学生在获得执照前必须在医院实习。

internecine.meaning: adj. 自相残杀的；内讧的；两败俱伤的
internecine.note:
The bitter internecine conflict crippled the political party. 激烈的内讧削弱了这个政党的力量。

Internecine warfare destroyed the ancient kingdom from within. 自相残杀的内战从内部摧毁了这个古老王国。

interplay.meaning: n. 相互作用；相互影响
interplay.note:
Health depends on the complex interplay of diet and exercise. 健康取决于饮食和运动复杂的相互作用。

The movie explores the interplay between light and shadow. 这部电影探讨了光影之间的相互交织。

interpolate.meaning: v. 插入（文字、话语等）；篡改；内插（数学）
interpolate.note:
The scribe chose to interpolate a new paragraph into the ancient manuscript. 抄写员选择在古代手稿中插入一段新内容。

Mathematicians use data points to interpolate missing values. 数学家利用数据点来内插缺失的值。

interpose.note:
She tried to interpose a word of caution during the argument. 她试图在争论中插进一句提醒的话。

He decided to interpose himself between the two fighting dogs. 他决定介入那两只打架的狗中间。

interregnum.meaning: n. 国王空位期；政权空白期；过渡时期
interregnum.note:
During the political interregnum, civil servants ran the day-to-day administration. 在政治过渡期内，公务员负责日常行政管理。

The brief interregnum ended when the new leader was crowned. 新领导人加冕后，短暂的权力空档期宣告结束。

interrogate.note:
Police officers spent hours trying to interrogate the suspect. 警察花了几个小时试图审讯犯罪嫌疑人。

He did not want anyone to interrogate him about his personal life. 他不希望任何人盘问他的私生活。

interrogative.meaning:
adj. 疑问的
n. 疑问词
interrogative.note:
Sentences starting with 'who' or 'what' often have an interrogative structure. 以“who”或“what”开头的句子通常具有疑问结构。

Words like 'how' and 'why' function as interrogatives. 像“how”和“why”这样的词充当疑问词。

intersect.note:
The two main highways intersect right in the center of town. 两条主干公路在镇中心交汇相交。

Our paths happen to intersect at this point in our careers. 我们的职业生涯恰好在这个节点上产生交集。

intersperse.note:
Her lecture was interspersed with amusing personal anecdotes. 她的演讲中穿插了有趣的个人轶事。

Flowers were interspersed among the green shrubs along the path. 鲜花点缀在小路两旁的绿灌木丛中。

intertwine.meaning: v. 纠缠；紧密相连；交织
intertwine.note:
Their destinies seemed to intertwine from an early age. 他们的命运从小就似乎紧密交织在一起。

The ivy began to intertwine around the wooden fence. 常春藤开始缠绕在木栅栏周围。

intractable.meaning: adj. 难治的；难管束的；棘手的
intractable.note:
The two countries have been trying to solve this intractable border dispute for decades. 这两个国家几十年来一直试图解决这个棘手的边界争端。

He has an intractable cough that doesn't respond to standard medications. 他有一种对常规药物无效的顽固咳嗽。

intransigent.note:
The union leaders remained intransigent, refusing to compromise on the wage cuts. 工会领导人依然态度强硬，拒绝在降薪问题上妥协。

His intransigent attitude made any further negotiations impossible. 他不妥协的态度使得任何进一步的谈判都成为不可能。

intrepid.note:
The intrepid explorer set off alone to map the uncharted jungle. 这位无畏的探险家独自出发去绘制未知的丛林地图。

Intrepid journalists risked their lives to report from the front lines of the war. 无畏的记者冒着生命危险从战争前线进行报道。

intricacy.meaning: n. 错综复杂；复杂细节
intricacy.note:
She was fascinated by the intricate design and the sheer intricacy of the lace. 她被花边的精致设计和纯粹的复杂性所吸引。

It took months to understand the full intricacy of the tax laws. 花了好几个月才弄懂税法的全部复杂细节。

intrigue.meaning:
n. 阴谋；诡计 
 v. 激起兴趣；策划阴谋
intrigue.note:
The mysterious letter was full of dark intrigue. 这封神秘的信件充满了阴谋诡计。

His strange behavior never failed to intrigue his colleagues. 他奇怪的行为总是能激起同事们的兴趣。

introspective.note:
He became very quiet and introspective after the failure of his business. 生意失败后，他变得非常安静和内省。

Her poetry is deeply introspective, exploring the inner workings of the human mind. 她的诗歌具有深刻的内省性，探索了人类心灵的内在运作机制。

intrude.note:
I didn't mean to intrude on your private conversation. 我无意闯入你们的私人谈话。

Commercial advertisements continue to intrude into our daily lives. 商业广告不断侵扰我们的日常生活。

inundate.meaning: v. 淹没；泛滥；使应接不暇
inundate.note:
Heavy rains threatened to inundate the low-lying coastal villages. 暴雨威胁要淹没低洼的沿海村庄。

The office was inundated with phone calls after the product launch. 产品发布后，办公室里接到了大量应接不暇的电话。

inured.meaning: adj. 习惯于（不愉快的事）的；经受惯的
inured.note:
Living in the city, she had become inured to the constant noise. 住在城市里，她已经习惯了持续不断的噪音。

Soldiers quickly become inured to the hardships of campaign life. 军人很快就会习惯战地生活的艰辛。

invade.note:
Foreign troops threatened to invade the neighboring country. 外国军队威胁要侵略邻国。

Tabloid newspapers constantly invade the privacy of celebrities. 小报经常侵犯名人的隐私。

invective.note:
He hurled verbal invective at the referee after the controversial call. 在那个有争议的判罚之后，他对裁判进行了言语上的猛烈抨击。

Her speech was full of political invective rather than constructive ideas. 她的演讲充满了政治谩骂，而不是建设性的想法。

inveigh.note:
The writer used his column to inveigh against the corruption in government. 这位作家利用他的专栏痛骂政府内部的腐败。

She would frequently inveigh against the commercialization of art. 她经常猛烈抨击艺术的商业化。

inveigle.note:
He managed to inveigle the key to the safe from the manager. 他设法从经理那里哄骗到了保险箱的钥匙。

She was inveigled into joining the secretive organization. 她被诱骗加入了这个秘密组织。

inverse.meaning:
adj. 相反的；倒转的 
 n. 相反情况
inverse.note:
There is an inverse relationship between supply and demand prices. 供应量与需求价格之间存在反比关系。

What he said was the exact inverse of the truth. 他所说的话与真相完全相反。

invert.meaning: v. 使反向；使倒转；颠倒
invert.note:
Invert the glass to let the remaining water drain out. 把杯子倒过来让残留的水流干。

You can invert the order of the list by clicking this button. 点击此按钮可以颠倒列表的顺序。

invertebrate.meaning:
adj. 无脊椎的 
 n. 无脊椎动物
invertebrate.note:
Jellyfish are fascinating marine invertebrates without any bones. 水母是没有任何骨骼的迷人海洋无脊椎动物。

Most insects and crustaceans belong to the invertebrate category. 大多数昆虫和甲壳动物都属于无脊椎动物类别。

investigate.note:
Police were called to investigate the mysterious disappearance of the painting. 警方被召来调查这幅画的神秘失踪事件。

Scientists continue to investigate the long-term effects of climate change. 科学家们继续研究气候变化的长期影响。

inveterate.meaning: adj. 积习难改的；老牌的
inveterate.note:
He is an inveterate liar who cannot tell the truth even when it suits him. 他是个积习难改的骗子，即使在对他有利时也无法说实话。

She has been an inveterate traveler since her early twenties. 自二十出头以来，她就一直是个资深的老牌旅行者。

invidious.meaning: adj. 惹人怨恨的；招致嫉妒的；不公平的
invidious.note:
Asking her to choose between her two best friends put her in an invidious position. 让在两个最好的朋友之间做出选择把她置于一个令人尴尬和怨恨的境地。

He faced the invidious task of cutting staff while keeping productivity high. 他面临着在保持生产力的同时削减员工的招怨任务。

inviolable.meaning: adj. 不可侵犯的；神圣不可动摇的
inviolable.note:
Diplomatic immunity ensures that embassy grounds are inviolable. 外交豁免权确保了大使馆馆舍不可侵犯。

They considered their agreement to be an inviolable contract. 他们认为他们的协议是一份神圣不可动摇的契约。

involuntary.meaning: adj. 非自愿的；无意识的
involuntary.note:
Blinking is an involuntary response to protect the eyes from foreign objects. 眨眼是为了保护眼睛免受异物侵害的无意识反应。

The company announced several layoffs, making many job losses involuntary. 公司宣布了几轮裁员，使许多工作岗位的失去变为非自愿的。

invulnerable.meaning: adj. 无懈可击的；刀枪不入的
invulnerable.note:
No computer network is completely invulnerable to skilled hackers. 没有任何计算机网络对熟练的黑客来说是完全无懈可击的。

He felt invulnerable after winning the championship, but soon realized his weaknesses. 赢下冠军后他觉得自己无懈可击，但很快意识到了自己的弱点。

iodine.note:
Doctors often use iodine to clean cuts and disinfect skin before surgery. 医生经常用碘来清洁伤口并在手术前对皮肤进行消毒。

Seafood and seaweed are natural sources of dietary iodine. 海鲜和海藻是膳食碘的天然来源。

iota.note:
There is not an iota of truth in those scandalous rumors. 那些丑闻谣言里没有一丝一毫的真实成分。

He showed not an iota of remorse for his reckless actions. 他对自己的鲁莽行为没有流露出哪怕是一点点的悔意。

irascible.meaning: adj. 易怒的；脾气暴躁的
irascible.note:
The old man was known for his irascible temper and frequent complaints. 这位老人以脾气暴躁和经常抱怨而闻名。

Even his close friends learned to avoid him when he was in an irascible mood. 甚至连他的密友也在他情绪易怒时学会了避开他。

irate.meaning: adj. 发怒的；生气 的
irate.note:
Customer service representatives had to deal with several irate callers. 客服代表不得不处理几位发怒的来电者。

He wrote an irate letter to the manager complaining about the poor service. 他给经理写了一封愤怒的信，抱怨服务质量太差。

ire.note:
The new tax policy drew the ire of local business owners. 这项新税收政策招致了当地企业主的怒火。

She managed to escape the teacher's ire by finishing her homework on time. 她按时完成了家庭作业，设法逃过了老师的斥责。

iridescent.meaning: adj. 虹彩的；五光十色的
iridescent.note:
The oil slick on the water created an iridescent pattern in the sunlight. 水面上的油膜在阳光下形成了五光十色的图案。

She wore a dress made of silk that showed iridescent colors as she moved. 她穿着一件丝绸制成的裙子，随着她的移动展现出虹彩般的光泽。

irk.note:
It continued to irk him that his contribution was never acknowledged. 他的贡献从未得到认可，这让他一直感到很苦恼。

Small delays like this always tend to irk impatient travelers. 这种小延误总是容易让没有耐心的旅客感到烦恼。

irksome.meaning: adj. 令人厌烦的；使人气恼的
irksome.note:
Filling out these endless paperwork forms can be quite irksome. 填写这些无穷无尽的纸质表格可能会相当烦人。

He found the daily commute to be an irksome chore. 他觉得每天的通勤是一件令人厌烦的杂务。

ironclad.meaning: adj. 装甲的；坚不可摧的；不容更改的
ironclad.note:
The company demanded an ironclad guarantee before signing the contract. 公司在签署合同前要求获得一份坚不可摧的担保。

They have an ironclad alibi for the time the crime was committed. 他们在案发时间拥有无可辩驳的不在场证明。

irradicable.meaning: adj. 根深蒂固的；难以根除的
irradicable.note:
He had an irradicable belief that hard work alone would bring success. 他有一种坚信唯有努力工作才能带来成功的根深蒂固的观念。

Some ancient prejudices remain almost irradicable in certain communities. 某些古老的偏见在某些社区中几乎是根深蒂固、难以根除的。

irreconcilable.meaning: adj. 不能调解的；矛盾的；不相容的
irreconcilable.note:
The couple decided to divorce due to irreconcilable differences. 这对夫妻因性格不合、分歧不可调解而决定离婚。

These two scientific theories appear to be completely irreconcilable. 这两个科学理论似乎完全无法调和。

irredeemable.meaning: adj. 不可救药的；无法挽回的
irredeemable.note:
He viewed the failing project as an irredeemable failure. 他将这个失败的项目视为无可挽回的失败。

She believed that no human soul was truly irreredeemable. 她坚信没有哪个人类的灵魂是真正不可救药的。

irreducible.meaning: adj. 不能缩减的；不可约简的
irreducible.note:
This basic budget represents our irreducible minimum expenses. 这份基础预算代表了我们不可再减的最低开支。

The problem can be broken down into an irreducible core. 这个问题可以被分解为一个不可约简的核心。

irremediable.meaning: adj. 无法补救的；不可挽回的
irremediable.note:
The oil spill caused irremediable damage to the fragile ecosystem. 石油泄漏对脆弱的生态系统造成了无法补救的损害。

He realized his mistake, but the consequences were already irremediable. 他意识到了自己的错误，但后果已经无法挽回。

irrepressible.meaning: adj. 压抑不住的；无拘无束的
irrepressible.note:
She has an irrepressible sense of humor that cheers everyone up. 她有一种压抑不住的幽默感，能让每个人都振作起来。

His laughter was loud and irrepressible throughout the performance. 演出期间，他的笑声宏亮且无法抑制。

irrevocable.meaning: adj. 不可撤销的；不能改变的
irrevocable.note:
Once submitted, this decision is final and irrevocable. 一旦提交，此决定即为最终决定且不可撤销。

He signed an irrevocable trust giving away his assets. 他签署了一份不可撤销的信托协议，放弃了自己的资产。

irritable.note:
Lack of sleep often makes people feel tired and irritable. 缺乏睡眠经常让人感觉疲劳且脾气急躁。

He became irritable whenever he had to wait in long queues. 每当不得不排长队时，他就变得烦躁不安。

irritate.note:
The loud noise from the construction site began to irritate the residents. 建筑工地发出的巨大噪音开始惹恼居民。

Certain chemicals can irritate sensitive skin. 某些化学物质会刺激敏感皮肤。

irritation.note:
He could not hide his irritation at being interrupted. 他无法掩饰自己被打断时的烦躁情绪。

Eye drops can help relieve dryness and minor irritation. 眼药水有助于缓解干燥和轻微的刺激感。

isolate.meaning:
v. 隔离；孤立 
 n. 隔离种群
isolate.note:
Patients with the contagious virus must be immediately isolated. 感染该传染性病毒的患者必须被立即隔离。

Working from home can sometimes make employees feel socially isolated. 在家办公有时会使员工感到在社交上被孤立。

isotope.note:
Carbon isotopes are widely used in archaeological dating. 碳同位素被广泛应用于考古测年。

Radioactive isotopes play a crucial role in modern cancer treatments. 放射性同位素在现代癌症治疗中起着至关重要的作用。

issue.meaning:
n. 问题；期号 
 v. 颁发；发行
issue.note:
Environmental protection is a major political issue today. 环境保护是当今的一个重大政治问题。

The government will issue new passports next month. 政府将于下个月颁发新护照。

isthmus.note:
The Panama Canal was built across the narrow isthmus connecting North and South America. 巴拿马运河是建在连接南北美洲的狭长地峡上的。

An isthmus connects the peninsula to the mainland. 一处地峡将半岛与大陆连接起来。

itinerant.meaning:
adj. 巡回的；流动的 
 n. 巡回者
itinerant.note:
He worked as an itinerant worker, traveling from farm to farm during harvest season. 他曾是一名流动工人，在收成季节从一个农场奔波到另一个农场。

The theater troupe lived an itinerant lifestyle, performing in different towns every week. 这个剧团过着巡回演出的生活，每周在不同的城镇表演。

ivory.meaning:
n. 象牙；乳白色 
 adj. 乳白色的
ivory.note:
The international trade of ivory is strictly banned to protect elephants. 为了保护大象，象牙的国际贸易被严格禁止。

She wore an elegant ivory dress at the wedding ceremony. 她在婚礼上穿着一件优雅的乳白色长裙。

jabber.meaning: v. 快而含糊不清地说；叽里呱啦地说
jabber.note:
The children were jabbering excitedly about their upcoming school trip. 孩子们正兴奋地叽里呱啦谈论着他们即将到来的学校旅行。

I couldn't understand a word because he was jabbering so fast. 我一个字也听不懂，因为他说得太快了。

jade.meaning:
n. 玉；翡翠 
 v. 使疲惫
jade.note:
Ancient Chinese craftsmen carved intricate figures out of raw jade. 中国古代工匠用原玉雕刻出复杂的雕像。

Long hours of physical labor can quickly jade even the strongest worker. 长时间的体力劳动很快就会使最强壮的工人精疲力竭。

jaded.meaning: adj. 厌倦的；劳累不堪的
jaded.note:
He felt jaded after traveling across multiple time zones for work. 因为工作需要跨越多个时区旅行，他感到精疲力竭。

Watching too many movies can leave even a film critic feeling jaded. 看太多电影甚至会让影评人感到厌倦。

jagged.meaning: adj. 锯齿状的；不平整的
jagged.note:
The climber cut his hand on the jagged edge of the rock. 这位登山者被岩石锯齿状的边缘割伤了手。

Dark, jagged mountains rose sharply against the twilight sky. 墨黑、参差不齐的山脉在暮色中显得格外陡峭。

jamb.note:
The wooden door was firmly fitted into its heavy frame and jamb. 木门被牢固地安装在其沉重的门框和侧柱中。

He leaned his shoulder against the door jamb while talking. 他说话时把肩膀靠在门侧柱上。

jar.meaning:
n. 罐子；广口瓶 
 v. 刺耳；冲突；使震动
jar.note:
She keeps a jar of homemade strawberry jam in the pantry. 她在食品储藏室里放了一罐自制草莓酱。

The loud crash tended to jar everyone's nerves. 巨大的撞击声往往会震动每个人的神经。

jargon.note:
The financial report was filled with complex legal and financial jargon. 这份财务报告充满了复杂的法律和金融行话。

Try to explain the concept to clients without using technical jargon. 尽量不要使用专业术语向客户解释这个概念。

jarring.meaning: adj. 刺耳的；不和谐的；令人震惊的
jarring.note:
The sudden loud noise created a jarring contrast with the quiet room. 突然的巨响与安静的房间形成了刺耳的对比。

There was a jarring shift in tone between the first and second half of the book. 本书前半部分和后半部分的语气发生了令人震惊的转变。

jaundice.meaning:
n. 黄疸 
 v. 使怀偏见
jaundice.note:
Yellowing of the skin and eyes is a classic symptom of jaundice. 皮肤和眼睛发黄是黄疸的典型症状。

His bad past experiences tended to jaundice his view of new colleagues. 他糟糕的过去经历往往会使他对新同事产生偏见。

jaundiced.meaning: adj. 有偏见的；充满嫉妒或怀疑的
jaundiced.note:
She looked at all corporate promises with a jaundiced eye. 她带着怀疑的眼光看待所有公司承诺。

Years of working in politics had left him with a jaundiced view of humanity. 多年在政界的工作让他对人性产生了偏见。

jaunt.note:
They took a quick weekend jaunt to the countryside to relax. 他们周末去乡村进行了一次短途旅游以放松身心。

After lunch, they planned a pleasant jaunt around the historic town. 午饭后，他们计划在历史悠久的小镇周围进行一次愉快的远足。

jaunty.meaning: adj. 快乐的；洋洋得意的；轻快的
jaunty.note:
He wore his hat at a jaunty angle and smiled at everyone. 他把帽子斜戴着，脸上带着轻快的微笑。

She walked with a jaunty step, full of confidence for the interview. 她迈着轻快的步伐走路，对面试充满了自信。

jealousy.note:
His sudden success at work aroused the jealousy of his peers. 他在工作上突如其来的成功引起了同龄人的嫉妒。

Jealousy can easily destroy even the strongest relationships. 嫉妒很容易摧毁最牢固的关系。

jeer.meaning:
v. 嘲笑；戏弄 
 n. 嘲笑声
jeer.note:
The crowd began to jeer when the referee made a controversial decision. 当裁判做出有争议的判罚时，人群开始发出嘘声和嘲笑。

He ignored the jeers of the opposing fans and scored the winning goal. 他忽略了对方球迷的嘲笑，打入了制胜球。

jejune.meaning: adj. 幼稚的；枯燥乏味的
jejune.note:
His philosophical arguments were dismissed as rather jejune and naive. 他的哲学论点被认为相当幼稚和天真而遭到驳回。

She found the lecture on modern art to be dry and jejune. 她觉得关于现代艺术的讲座枯燥乏味。

jerk.meaning:
n. 猛推；混蛋 
 v. 猛地一拉
jerk.note:
With a quick jerk of the rope, he secured the boat to the dock. 随着绳子的一声猛拉，他把船固定在码头上了。

Stop acting like a jerk and apologize to her. 别再像个混蛋一样行事了，向她道歉。

jettison.note:
The pilot had to jettison extra fuel to save the damaged plane. 飞行员不得不抛弃多余的燃油以挽救受损的飞机。

The company decided to jettison its outdated business model. 该公司决定抛弃其过时的商业模式。

jibe.meaning:
v. 一致；符合 
 n. 嘲讽
jibe.note:
His account of the accident simply doesn't jibe with the police report. 他对事故的描述根本与警方报告不符。

They exchanged a few friendly jibes before the game started. 比赛开始前，他们互相开了几个友好的玩笑。

jigsaw.note:
The children spent hours putting together a thousand-piece jigsaw puzzle. 孩子们花了好几个小时拼好了一幅千片拼图。

Solving the mystery felt like putting together the pieces of a complex jigsaw. 解开这个谜团就像是在拼凑一个复杂拼图的各个碎片。

jingoism.meaning: n. 沙文主义；极端爱国主义
jingoism.note:
The political rally was fueled by dangerous jingoism and xenophobia. 这场政治集会受到了危险的沙文主义和仇外心理的煽动。

His speeches appealed to extreme jingoism rather than rational debate. 他的演讲迎合了极端的沙文主义，而非理性的辩论。

jocular.meaning: adj. 滑稽的；爱开玩笑的
jocular.note:
Even in serious situations, he maintained a jocular tone. 即使在严肃的场合，他仍然保持着滑稽的语调。

His jocular remarks helped ease the tension in the meeting room. 他风趣幽默的言论有助于缓解会议室里的紧张气氛。

jocund.note:
The villagers gathered for a jocund celebration of the harvest. 村民们聚集在一起，欢庆丰收的到来。

Her jocund laughter echoed across the garden during the party. 派对期间，她欢乐的笑声在花园里回荡。

jog.meaning:
v. 慢跑；轻推 
 n. 慢跑
jog.note:
He likes to jog in the park every morning before work. 他喜欢每天上班前去公园慢跑。

She looked through old photos to jog her memory about the trip. 她翻看旧照片以唤起对那次旅行的记忆。

jolt.meaning:
v. 震动；使震惊 
 n. 猛烈晃动；震惊
jolt.note:
The car gave a violent jolt as it hit a pothole in the road. 汽车撞上路上的一个坑洞时剧烈晃动了一下。

The sudden news of the company closure provided a severe jolt to employees. 公司倒闭的突然消息给员工们带来了沉重的打击。

jot.note:
Let me jot down your phone number before I forget. 让我先把你电话号码记下来，免得忘了。

He jotted a few notes on a scrap of paper during the lecture. 讲座期间他在一张碎纸上草草记了几个笔记。

jovial.note:
Our host was in a jovial mood, welcoming everyone with a warm smile. 我们的主人心情十分愉快，用温暖的微笑欢迎每一个人。

The dinner party was filled with jovial conversation and laughter. 晚宴上充满了欢快的谈话声和笑声。

jubilation.note:
There was widespread jubilation in the streets after the team won the cup. 球队夺冠后，街头到处是一片欢腾。

The news of peace brought immense jubilation to the war-torn country. 和平的消息给饱受战争蹂躏的国家带来了巨大的狂喜。

judiciousness.note:
The success of the project depended on the judiciousness of the manager's choices. 项目的成功取决于经理抉择时的明智。

She handled the crisis with great judiciousness and calm. 她以极大的审慎和冷静处理了这场危机。

juggernaut.meaning: n. 不可阻挡的强大力量；巨无霸
juggernaut.note:
The tech company has grown into an unstoppable economic juggernaut. 这家科技公司已经成长为一个势不可挡的经济巨无霸。

Nothing could stand in the path of this political juggernaut. 没有任何东西能阻挡这股强大的政治力量。

jumble.meaning:
n. 混乱的一团 
 v. 混杂；混乱
jumble.note:
Her thoughts were a jumble of fear and excitement. 她的思绪是一团恐惧与兴奋的混乱交织。

Don't jumble up the papers on my desk; keep them organized. 别把我桌上的文件弄混了，保持它们整洁。

junction.note:
Turn left at the next road junction to get to the highway. 在下一个道路交叉口左转即可上高速公路。

The city grew rapidly around the railway junction. 这座城市围绕着铁路交汇处迅速发展起来。

justifiable.meaning: adj. 可辩解的；合情合理的
justifiable.note:
The company felt that the price increase was entirely justifiable. 公司认为这次涨价是完全合情合理的。

He had justifiable concerns about the safety of the new system. 他对新系统的安全性有着合理的担忧。

juvenile.meaning:
adj. 青少年的；幼稚的 
 n. 青少年
juvenile.note:
The local community center offers programs for at-risk juveniles. 当地社区中心为高危青少年提供项目。

Stop making those silly juvenile jokes during a serious meeting. 在严肃的会议上别再开那些无聊幼稚的玩笑了。

kaleidoscope.note:
The autumn leaves displayed a kaleidoscope of vibrant colors. 秋叶呈现出万花筒般绚丽多彩的颜色。

Life in the busy metropolis is a kaleidoscope of sights and sounds. 繁华大都市的生活是各种景象和声音交织的万花筒。

ken.note:
The inner workings of quantum computing are beyond my scientific ken. 量子计算机的内部运作超出了我的科学理解范围。

Such advanced technology was far beyond the ken of 19th-century engineers. 这种先进技术远远超出了19世纪工程师的认知视野。

kennel.note:
They left their pet dog at a local kennel while going on vacation. 他们去度假时把宠物狗寄养在当地的狗舍里。

He built a sturdy wooden kennel for his golden retriever. 他为自己的金毛寻回犬建造了一个坚固的木制狗窝。

kernel.note:
Each corn kernel is tightly packed on the cob. 每一粒玉米都紧密地排列在玉米棒上。

There is a kernel of truth hidden inside all those exaggerated stories. 在所有那些夸大的故事背后隐藏着一丝真相的核心。

kidnap.note:
The wealthy businessman was threatened after an attempt to kidnap his son. 这位富商在儿子险遭绑架后受到了威胁。

Criminals tried to kidnap the diplomat for a heavy ransom. 犯罪分子企图绑架这位外交官以索取巨额赎金。

kidney.note:
The kidneys play a vital role in filtering waste products from the blood. 肾脏在过滤血液中的废物方面起着至关重要的作用。

Medical science has made great strides in successful kidney transplants. 医学在成功的肾脏移植方面取得了长足进步。

killjoy.note:
Don't be such a killjoy; let us enjoy the party. 别这么扫兴；让我们好好享受派对吧。

He hated being called a killjoy just for suggesting they should head home early. 他讨厌因为建议大家早点回家而被叫做扫兴的人。

kindle.note:
He used dry twigs to kindle a fire in the fireplace. 他用干树枝在壁炉里生火。

The inspiring speech helped kindle a renewed sense of hope among students. 这场鼓舞人心的演讲帮助学生们重新燃起了希望。

kindred.meaning:
adj. 同类的；志同道合的 
 n. 亲属；血亲
kindred.note:
They discovered they shared kindred political views and values. 他们发现彼此有着相近的政治观点和价值观。

She found a kindred spirit in her new coworker who also loved painting. 她在新同事身上找到了一个同样热爱绘画的志同道合者。

kinetic.note:
A roller coaster converts potential energy into kinetic energy as it drops. 过山车在下落时将势能转化为动能。

Children possess seemingly endless kinetic energy throughout the day. 孩子们一整天似乎都有着用不完的精力。

knave.note:
He proved to be a knave who would cheat anyone for a quick profit. 事实证明他是一个为了谋取小利会欺骗任何人的恶棍。

Do not trust his sweet words; he is a knave at heart. 别相信他甜言蜜语，他本质上是个无赖。

knotty.meaning: adj. 棘手的；复杂的；多节的
knotty.note:
The committee spent hours discussing the knotty problem of budget cuts. 委员会花了几小时讨论削减预算这个棘手的问题。

The carpenter selected a piece of knotty pine for the rustic table. 木匠为这张乡村风格的桌子挑选了一块多节的松木。

kudos.note:
Kudos to the entire production team for putting together such a wonderful show. 向整个制作团队致以赞赏，感谢他们呈现了如此精彩的演出。

She deserves major kudos for her hard work on the research project. 她在研究项目上的辛勤工作值得极大的赞誉。

labile.note:
Patients with emotionally labile disorders experience rapid mood swings. 情绪不稳定障碍患者会经历快速的情绪波动。

Chemical compounds in this state are highly labile and prone to reaction. 处于这种状态的化合物高度不稳定且容易发生反应。

labored.meaning: adj. 艰难的；吃力的；勉强的
labored.note:
After running up the hill, his breathing was heavy and labored. 跑上山坡后，他呼吸沉重且吃力。

The joke fell flat, resulting in a few awkward and labored laughs. 笑话没抖响，引来几声尴尬而勉强的笑声。

labyrinth.meaning: n. 迷宫；错综复杂的事物
labyrinth.note:
The old medieval town is a labyrinth of narrow, winding streets. 这座中世纪古镇是一个由狭窄蜿蜒街道组成的迷宫。

It took him years to navigate the legal labyrinth of property ownership. 他花了几年时间才理清房产所有权的法律迷宫。

lace.meaning:
n. 花边；鞋带 
 v. 系带；掺入（烈酒或毒药）
lace.note:
Her wedding dress was decorated with delicate white lace. 她的婚纱上装饰着精致的白色蕾丝。

He stopped to tie his loose running shoe lace. 他停下来系紧松开的跑鞋鞋带。

lacerate.meaning:
v. 撕裂；割破 
 adj. 撕裂的
lacerate.note:
The sharp glass could easily lacerate bare skin if handled carelessly. 如果处理不慎，锋利的玻璃很容易割破皮肤。

His harsh criticism tended to lacerate her sensitive feelings. 他严厉的批评往往会深深刺伤她敏感的感情。

lachrymose.note:
She became rather lachrymose while watching the tragic romance movie. 看那部悲剧爱情电影时，她变得有些爱哭和伤感。

His lachrymose speeches failed to win sympathy from the audience. 他那充满悲伤的演讲未能赢得观众的同情。

lackadaisical.meaning: adj. 懒洋洋的；怠慢的；没精打采的
lackadaisical.note:
His lackadaisical attitude towards his studies concerned his teachers. 他对学习这种懒散怠慢的态度让老师们感到担忧。

Management criticized the staff for their lackadaisical approach to safety rules. 管理层批评员工对待安全规章制度态度敷衍。

lackluster.meaning: adj. 无光泽的；毫无生气的
lackluster.note:
The company reported disappointing sales and lackluster market performance. 公司报告了令人失望的销售额和毫无生气的市场表现。

His lackluster performance on the field led to him being benched. 他在场上毫无生气的表现导致他被换下。

lactic.note:
Intense exercise causes a buildup of lactic acid in the muscles. 剧烈运动会导致肌肉中乳酸的积聚。

Lactic fermentation is essential in making yogurt and cheese. 乳酸发酵在制作酸奶和奶酪时至关重要。

lag.meaning:
v. 落后；滞后 
 n. 滞后；延迟
lag.note:
Sales began to lag behind the targets set for the fourth quarter. 销售额开始落后于第四季度设定的目标。

There is often a short time lag between online video feeds. 在线视频源之间通常存在短暂的时间延迟。

lair.note:
The hunter tracked the wild animal back to its dark lair. 猎人一路追踪这只野生动物回到了它的黑暗巢穴。

Villagers dared not approach the dragon's hidden mountain lair. 村民们不敢靠近恶龙隐藏在山里的巢穴。

laity.meaning: n. 俗众；世俗信徒（区别于神职人员）；外行
laity.note:
The theological book was written in language accessible to the general laity. 这本神学著作是用普通信徒也能理解的语言编写的。

Relations between the clergy and the laity changed significantly over time. 随着时间的推移，神职人员与世俗信众之间的关系发生了重大变化。

lambaste.note:
The angry coach rushed onto the field to lambaste the players. 愤怒的教练冲上球场严厉斥责了球员们。

Critics did not hesitate to lambaste the new film for its poor script. 影评人毫不犹豫地痛骂这部新电影剧本太差。

lament.meaning:
v. 哀悼；痛惜 
 n. 挽歌；悲叹
lament.note:
She could only lament the loss of her precious family heirlooms. 她只能为失去宝贵的家族传家宝而痛惜。

The poem reads like a bitter lament for a bygone era. 这首诗读起来就像是对逝去时代的悲叹。

lampoon.meaning:
v. 讽刺；嘲讽 
 n. 讽刺文章
lampoon.note:
Comedians often lampoon famous politicians in late-night television sketches. 喜剧演员经常在深夜电视小品中讽刺著名政治家。

The satirical magazine published a sharp lampoon of the local mayor. 这家讽刺杂志发表了一篇针对当地市长的尖锐讽刺文章。

lance.meaning: n. 长矛，标枪；v. 用柳叶刀切开
lance.note:
The knight rode into battle holding a long wooden lance. 骑士手持一根长木矛骑马冲入战场。

The doctor had to lance the painful boil on his arm. 医生不得不切开他手臂上痛苦的疖子。

lancet.note:
The physician carefully sterilized the lancet before the small procedure. 外科医生在进行小手术前仔细给刺血针消毒。

A lancet is a sharp, pointed two-edged surgical instrument. 刺血针是一种锋利的两刃外科手术器械。

landfill.note:
Tonnes of plastic waste are sent to local municipal landfills every day. 每天有成吨的塑料垃圾被运往当地的城市垃圾填埋场。

Recycling helps reduce the amount of household waste going to landfills. 回收利用有助于减少运往填埋场的家庭垃圾数量。

landlocked.meaning: adj. 为陆地所包围的；内陆的
landlocked.note:
Austria is a landlocked country situated in central Europe. 奥地利是位于中欧的一个内陆国家。

Being landlocked, the country relies heavily on agreements with neighboring ports. 由于是内陆国家，该国严重依赖与邻国港口的协议。

languid.meaning: adj. 倦怠的；软弱无力的；悠闲的
languid.note:
They spent a languid afternoon lounging by the swimming pool. 他们在游泳池旁度过了一个悠闲倦怠的下午。

She gave a languid wave as the train slowly pulled away. 火车缓缓驶离时，她无力地挥了挥手。

languish.meaning: v. 日渐衰弱；受苦；苦思
languish.note:
Many political prisoners continued to languish in damp cells. 许多政治犯继续在潮湿的牢房里受苦。

Without adequate funding, the community project began to languish. 由于缺乏充足的资金，社区项目开始日渐衰落。

languor.note:
A pleasant summer languor settled over the lazy afternoon. 慵懒的下午弥漫着一种令人舒适的夏日倦怠感。

He felt a heavy sense of languor after eating a large meal. 吃完丰盛的一餐后，他感到一阵沉重的倦怠感。

lank.meaning: adj. 细长的；瘦弱的；（头发）枯直的
lank.note:
Rain had made his lank hair stick to his forehead. 雨水把他那根根直立的枯发贴在额头上。

He was a tall, lank youth with awkward movements. 他是个高而瘦削、动作笨拙的年轻人。

larder.meaning: n. 食品储藏室；储藏的食物
larder.note:
Winter was approaching, so they stocked the larder with canned goods. 冬天即将来临，因此他们在食品储藏室里囤积了罐头食品。

The family's larder was well supplied with flour, sugar, and cured meats. 这家人的食品储藏室里备齐了面粉、糖和腊肉。

largess.meaning: n. 慷慨施舍；大量赠款
largess.note:
The charity relied heavily on the financial largess of wealthy donors. 该慈善机构严重依赖富有捐赠者的慷慨解囊。

Politicians often distribute favors and largess to win voter support. 政客们经常分发恩惠和慷慨馈赠来赢得选民的支持。

largesse.note:
The university benefited greatly from the philanthropist's corporate largesse. 这所大学受益于慈善家的大笔慷慨捐赠。

Workers were skeptical of the CEO's sudden display of corporate largesse. 员工们对首席执行官突然表现出的公司慷慨馈赠持怀疑态度。

lark.meaning:
n. 百灵鸟；恶作剧 
 v. 嬉戏
lark.note:
They climbed the mountain just for a lark on a Sunday afternoon. 他们在周日下午爬山纯粹是为了好玩和恶作剧。

The sweet morning song of the lark filled the open fields. 百灵鸟清晨甜美的歌声充满了开阔的田野。

larva.note:
Mosquitoes lay their eggs in stagnant water where larvae can develop. 蚊子将卵产在幼虫可以生长的积水中。

The insect spends its early life stage in a vulnerable larva form. 这种昆虫在其生命早期阶段以脆弱的幼虫形态度过。

lash.meaning:
v. 鞭打；捆绑 
 n. 鞭子；睫毛
lash.note:
Heavy rain and fierce winds began to lash against the windows. 狂风暴雨开始抽打着窗户。

She carefully applied mascara to darken her eyelashes. 她仔细地涂上睫毛膏来让睫毛变黑。

lassitude.note:
A feeling of physical lassitude overcame him after the long journey. 长途旅行后，一股身体上的疲惫感向他袭来。

The hot weather induced a general sense of lassitude among the students. 炎热的天气让学生们普遍产生了一种无精打采的感觉。

lasso.meaning:
n. 套索 
 v. 用套索捕捉
lasso.note:
The cowboy skillfully threw his lasso to catch the runaway calf. 牧场主熟练地甩出套索去捕捉逃跑的小牛。

He used a rope lasso to secure the stray horse. 他用绳索套索把这匹迷路的马固定住。

lasting.note:
The conference left a lasting impression on all participants. 这次会议给所有参会者留下了持久的印象。

They hope to build a lasting friendship based on mutual trust. 他们希望能建立一种基于相互信任的持久友谊。

latency.note:
Low network latency is critical for online gaming and streaming. 低网络延迟对于在线游戏和流媒体至关重要。

The virus can remain in a state of clinical latency for many years. 这种病毒可以在临床潜伏状态下存留多年。

lateral.note:
The company decided to offer him a lateral move to a different department. 公司决定为他提供一个平级调动到另一个部门的机会。

Cracks formed along the lateral walls of the old building. 老建筑的侧墙上出现了裂缝。

lathe.meaning:
n. 车床 
 v. 用车床加工
lathe.note:
The machinist shaped the metal rod precisely on the lathe. 机床工人在车床上精确地加工出金属棒的形状。

Woodturning on a lathe requires patience and steady hands. 在车床上进行木材车削需要耐心和稳定的双手。

lattice.meaning: n. 格子；格子结构；晶格
lattice.note:
Climbing roses covered the white wooden garden lattice. 攀援玫瑰覆盖了白色的木制花园格架。

Atoms in a crystal are arranged in a regular three-dimensional lattice. 晶体中的原子排列在规则的三维晶格中。

laud.note:
Public figures came forward to laud the volunteers for their brave efforts. 公众人物纷纷站出来赞扬志愿者们的勇敢努力。

The novel was widely lauded by critics for its original storytelling style. 这部小说因其原创的叙事风格而受到评论家们的广泛赞誉。

lava.note:
Hot molten lava poured slowly down the slopes of the active volcano. 高温熔化的岩浆缓慢地顺着活火山的山坡流下。

Over centuries, cooled lava hardened into dark, rugged volcanic rock. 几个世纪以来，冷却的岩浆硬化成黑色的、崎岖的火山岩。

lave.note:
Gentle waves continued to lave the warm sandy shore. 温柔的海浪不断地轻击着温暖的沙滩。

She used cool water to lave her tired face. 她用凉水清洗疲惫的脸庞。

lavish.meaning:
adj. 极其丰富的；奢华的 
 v. 慷慨给予
lavish.note:
The celebrity hosted a lavish party for hundreds of invited guests. 这位名人为主办数百名受邀宾客举办了一场奢华的派对。

Parents often lavish affection and gifts on their only child. 父母经常把喜爱和礼物慷慨地给予他们的独生子女。

laxative.meaning:
n. 泻药 
 adj. 通便的
laxative.note:
The doctor recommended a mild laxative to relieve occasional constipation. 医生建议使用温和的泻药来缓解偶发的便秘。

Certain natural foods like prunes have mild laxative properties. 西梅等某些天然食物具有轻微的通便特性。

leaven.meaning:
n. 发酵剂；影响力 
 v. 使发酵；使活跃
leaven.note:
Yeast acts as a natural leaven in bread-making. 酵母在面包制作中充当天然发酵剂。

He tried to leaven his serious lecture with a few humorous anecdotes. 他试图用几个幽默的轶事来活跃他严肃的讲座气氛。

lectern.note:
The speaker stepped up to the lectern and adjusted his microphone notes. 演讲者走到讲台前，调整了一下麦克风和讲稿。

He rested his hands on the wooden lectern while addressing the audience. 他把双手放在木制演讲台上向观众发言。

leer.meaning:
v. 斜视；送秋波（多含恶意或好色之意） 
 n. 斜眼看
leer.note:
He gave an unpleasant leer across the bar table. 他隔着酒吧桌子投来一个令人不快的斜视眼。

She felt uncomfortable under his persistent and creepy leer. 在他持续且令人毛骨悚然的斜视下，她感到很不自在。

leery.meaning: adj. 猜疑的；谨慎的；不信任的
leery.note:
Consumers remain leery of buying expensive items online without seeing them first. 消费者在未亲自看到之前，对在线购买昂贵商品仍心存疑虑。

She grew leery of strangers offering unsolicited financial advice. 她开始对主动提供未经请求的理财建议的陌生人保持警惕。

legend.meaning: n. 传奇故事；图例；传奇人物
legend.note:
The ancient hero is the subject of many local myths and legends. 这位古代英雄是许多当地神话和传奇故事的主角。

Look at the map legend to understand the different symbols used. 查看地图图例以了解所使用的不同符号。

legerdemain.note:
The street magician performed impressive feats of sleight of hand and legerdemain. 这位街头魔术师表演了令人印象深刻的巧手和戏法绝技。

His promise of economic recovery was pure political legerdemain. 他关于经济复苏的承诺纯粹是政治花招。

legion.meaning:
n. 军团；众多 
 adj. 大批的
legion.note:
Roman legions marched across Europe to expand their vast empire. 罗马军团横扫欧洲以扩大其庞大的帝国。

Supporters of the talented musician were legion across the country. 这位才华横溢的音乐家的支持者在全国各地数不胜数。

leisureliness.note:
They enjoyed the leisureliness of a quiet Sunday morning in the countryside. 他们享受着乡村静谧周日清晨的悠闲时光。

The trip was planned with a certain leisureliness, allowing time to explore. 这次旅行计划得十分从容，留出了充足的探索时间。

leniency.note:
The defense lawyer appealed to the judge for mercy and leniency. 辩护律师向法官呼吁宽大处理和仁慈对待。

First-time offenders sometimes hope for judicial leniency. 初犯有时会寄希望于司法宽大处理。

lenient.note:
The teacher was surprisingly lenient with students who missed the deadline. 老师对错过截止日期的学生出人意料地宽容。

Many critics felt the prison sentence was far too lenient for the crime. 许多评论家认为这个刑期对罪行而言过于宽大。

lethargic.meaning: adj. 昏睡的；无精打采的
lethargic.note:
The hot afternoon sun made everyone feel slow and lethargic. 炎热的午后太阳让每个人都觉得动作迟缓、无精打采。

He woke up feeling tired and lethargic despite sleeping for eight hours. 尽管睡了八个小时，他醒来时还是觉得疲惫、没精打采。

lethargy.meaning: n. 昏睡；毫无生气；倦怠
lethargy.note:
A wave of collective lethargy swept through the office after lunch. 午饭后，一股集体倦怠的浪潮席卷了整个办公室。

She tried to shake off her morning lethargy with a cup of strong coffee. 她试图用一杯浓咖啡来摆脱早晨的昏沉。

levee.note:
Floodwaters rose dangerously close to the top of the earthen levee. 洪水危险地上涨到了土堤顶部附近。

Workers worked overnight to reinforce the levee against the coming storm. 工人们通宵工作以加固堤防，抵御即将来临的风暴。

levelheaded.meaning: adj. 头脑清醒的；冷静理智的
levelheaded.note:
We need a levelheaded leader to guide the team through this crisis. 我们需要一位头脑清醒的领导者来带领团队度过这场危机。

She remained calm and levelheaded despite the sudden emergency. 尽管突发紧急情况，她依然保持冷静理智。

lever.meaning:
n. 杠杆；操纵杆 
 v. 撬动
lever.note:
Push the metal lever forward to start the machine. 将金属操纵杆向前推以启动机器。

He used a heavy iron bar to lever the stuck rock out of the way. 他用一根重铁棒把卡住的岩石撬开。

levity.meaning: n. 轻率；轻浮；轻浮的态度
levity.note:
The seriousness of the meeting was broken by his inappropriate levity. 会议的严肃气氛被他不得体的轻浮态度打破了。

She tried to introduce a bit of levity into the tense family discussion. 她试图在紧张的家庭讨论中引入一点轻松的气氛。

lexicographer.note:
A lexicographer spends years researching word origins and meanings. 词典编纂者花数年时间研究词源和词义。

Johnson's famous dictionary was compiled by a single dedicated lexicographer. 约翰逊著名的字典是由一位敬业的词典编纂者独立编纂的。

liaison.note:
She acts as a liaison between the management and the local staff. 她担任管理层与当地员工之间的联络人。

Good communication requires an effective liaison network. 良好的沟通需要建立有效的联络网络。

libel.meaning:
n. 文书诽谤；恶意中伤 
 v. 诽谤
libel.note:
The newspaper was sued for libel after publishing false allegations. 这家报社因发表虚假指控而被起诉诽谤。

Writing false and damaging statements about someone can constitute libel. 撰写关于某人的虚假且有害的声明可能构成书面诽谤。

liberality.note:
The museum was built thanks to the financial liberality of a local patron. 这座博物馆的建立归功于当地赞助商的慷慨解囊。

His social views were marked by great liberality and tolerance. 他的社会观点具有极大的开明和包容性。

libertine.meaning:
n. 放荡不羁者；浪荡公子 
 adj. 放荡的
libertine.note:
He lived the life of a wealthy libertine, ignoring social conventions. 他过着富裕浪荡公子的生活，无视社会规范。

The novel depicts the downfall of a notorious aristocratic libertine. 这部小说描绘了一个声名狼藉的贵族放荡者的没落。

libretto.note:
The opera's libretto was written by a famous contemporary poet. 这部歌剧的剧本是由一位当代著名诗人写的。

Music critics praised the emotional depth of the musical's libretto. 音乐评论家赞扬了该音乐剧剧本的情感深度。

licentious.meaning: adj. 放荡的；淫乱的；放纵的
licentious.note:
The ruler's licentious behavior shocked the conservative court members. 统治者放荡的行为震惊了保守的朝廷成员。

Society at the time condemned the perceived moral decay and licentious habits. 当时的社会谴责了人们所认为的道德沦丧和放纵习惯。

lien.note:
The bank placed a legal lien on the property until the debt was paid. 银行对该房产设定了法定留置权，直到债务还清为止。

 Contractors can file a mechanic's lien if they are not paid for their work. 如果承包商的工钱未付，他们可以提交留置权申请。

ligneous.note:
As the plant grew older, its stems became woody and ligneous. 随着植物长得更高，它的茎变得木质化。

Ligneous tissues provide structural support to trees and shrubs. 木质组织为乔木和灌木提供结构支撑。

liken.note:
Poets often liken the human heart to a garden. 诗人经常把人的心灵比作花园。

She likened the experience to riding a roller coaster without a safety belt. 她把这段经历比作不系安全带坐过山车。

limb.note:
He broke his arm and injured another limb in the heavy fall. 他在重重摔倒时摔断了一只胳膊并伤了另一条肢体。

The heavy snow caused a large tree limb to snap and fall. 大雪导致一根粗大的树枝折断并掉了下来。

limber.meaning:
adj. 柔软的；敏捷的 
 v. 做准备活动
limber.note:
Dancers need limber muscles to perform difficult choreography. 舞者需要柔软的肌肉来完成高难度的编舞。

Athletes spent ten minutes trying to limber up before the race. 运动员们在比赛前花了十分钟做热身准备活动。

limerick.note:
He recited a funny limerick that made everyone in the room laugh. 他背诵了一首有趣的五行打油诗，逗得房间里的每个人都笑了。

A traditional limerick has a strict AABBA rhyme scheme. 传统的五行打油诗具有严格的AABBA押韵格式。

limestone.note:
The ancient temple was constructed using solid blocks of local limestone. 这座古老的庙宇是用当地坚实的石灰石砌块建造的。

Underground caves are often formed when water erodes soft limestone. 地下洞穴通常是在水侵蚀软石灰石时形成的。

limited.note:
The company has a limited budget for marketing this year. 该公司今年的营销预算有限。

Seats for the special concert are available in limited quantities. 这场特别音乐会的座位数量有限。

limn.note:
The author managed to limn the character's inner struggles with great skill. 作者设法以高超的技巧描绘了角色的内心挣扎。

Her paintings delicately limn the quiet beauty of rural life. 她的画作细腻地勾勒出乡村生活的宁静之美。

limousine.note:
A long black limousine waited outside the hotel for the celebrity. 一辆长长的黑色豪华轿车停在酒店外等候名人。

They rented a limousine to celebrate their graduation in style. 他们租了一辆加长豪华轿车来盛大庆祝毕业。

limp.meaning:
v. 跛行 
 adj. 软弱的；无力的 
 n. 跛行
limp.note:
He walked with a noticeable limp after twisting his ankle. 扭伤脚踝后，他走路时有明显的跛行。

The wet paper became completely limp and tore easily. 湿纸变得完全软塌塌的，一撕就破。

limpid.meaning: adj. 清澈的；透明的；清晰易懂的
limpid.note:
They could see colorful fish swimming in the limpid mountain stream. 他们可以看到五颜六色的鱼儿在清澈的山间溪流中游弋。

Her writing style is praised for its limpid clarity. 她的写作风格因其清晰易懂而受到赞赏。

lineage.note:
The family proudly traces its noble lineage back to the 15th century. 这个家族自豪地将高贵的血统追溯到15世纪。

Purebred horses often have a well-documented genetic lineage. 纯种马通常具有记录完备的基因血统。

linguistic.note:
Bilingual children often develop strong linguistic skills at an early age. 双语儿童通常在很小的时候就培养出很强的语言能力。

The region faces complex cultural and linguistic challenges. 该地区面临着复杂的文化和语言挑战。

linguistics.note:
She is a university professor specializing in historical linguistics. 她是一名专门研究历史语言学的大学教授。

Modern linguistics studies how human languages are structured and acquired. 现代语言学研究人类语言是如何结构和习得的。

linoleum.meaning: n. 油毡地板胶；亚麻油地毡
linoleum.note:
The kitchen floor was covered with easy-to-clean linoleum. 厨房的地面铺着易于清洁的亚麻油地毡。

Old schools often used durable linoleum tiles in their hallways. 老学校的走廊里经常使用耐用的油毡地砖。

lint.meaning: n. 绒毛；棉屑；医用棉纱
lint.note:
Always remember to clean the lint trap in the clothes dryer after use. 使用后切记清理干衣机里的绒毛收集网。

He found bits of pocket lint stuck to his old keys. 他发现旧钥匙上沾着一些口袋里的棉絮。

lionize.meaning: v. 把…视为名人；崇拜；捧场
lionize.note:
The press rushed to lionize the young author after his debut novel became a hit. 在处女作大获成功后，媒体争相把这位年轻作家捧为名人。

Society tends to lionize successful athletes and movie stars. 社会往往崇拜成功的运动员和电影明星。

liquefy.note:
Natural gas must be cooled significantly in order to liquefy for transport. 天然气必须大为冷却以便液化运输。

Solid wax will liquefy when exposed to high heat. 固体蜡在接触高热时会融化成液体。

liquid.meaning:
n. 液体 
 adj. 液体的；清澈的
liquid.note:
Water is the most common liquid found on Earth. 水是地球上最常见的液体。

The company needed to raise more liquid cash to pay off short-term debts. 公司需要筹集更多流动现金来偿还短期债务。

liquidate.note:
The struggling company was forced to liquidate its assets to pay creditors. 这家陷入困境的公司被迫清算资产以偿还债权人。

They decided to liquidate their old inventory at a heavy discount. 他们决定以巨幅折扣清仓处理旧库存。

lissome.note:
The dancer moved with lissome grace across the wooden stage. 舞者在木质舞台上轻盈优雅地移动。

Her lissome figure made her well-suited for gymnastics and ballet. 她柔韧的身段使她非常适合体操和芭蕾舞。

listless.meaning: adj. 无精打采的；倦怠的
listless.note:
The heat made the dog listless and uninterested in playing fetch. 炎热的天气让这只狗无精打采，对玩捡球游戏提不起兴趣。

She noticed a listless mood among the team members before the deadline. 她注意到在截止日期前团队成员中弥漫着一种无精打采的情绪。

literal.meaning: adj. 字面意义的；原义的；刻板的
literal.note:
He made a literal translation of the poem rather than a poetic one. 他对这首诗进行了字面翻译，而不是诗意翻译。

Do not take his angry comment in a literal sense. 不要从字面意义上去理解他生气的言论。

literate.meaning: adj. 有读写能力的；有文化的
literate.note:
Government programs successfully raised the proportion of literate citizens. 政府项目成功提高了有读写能力公民的比例。

In modern jobs, being computer literate is just as important as reading. 在现代工作中，懂电脑与识字同样重要。

literati.meaning: n. 文人学士；文化界名流
literati.note:
The new poetry collection was widely discussed by the city's literary elite and literati. 这本新诗集受到了该市文学精英和文人学士的广泛讨论。

Cafes in Paris were frequent gathering places for artists and literati. 巴黎的咖啡馆是艺术家和文人墨客经常聚集的地方。

lithe.meaning: adj. 柔软的；轻盈的；姿态优雅的
lithe.note:
The cat leaped across the fence with lithe and effortless movements. 猫以柔软且毫不费力的动作跳过了栅栏。

She possessed the lithe body of a professional gymnast. 她拥有专业体操运动员般柔美轻盈的身段。

litigant.note:
Both litigants agreed to meet outside the courtroom to discuss a settlement. 双方诉讼当事人同意在法庭外会面以讨论和解方案。

The judge listened carefully to arguments from each litigant. 法官仔细听取了各方诉讼当事人的陈述。

litigation.note:
The two corporations tried to avoid costly and lengthy litigation. 这两家公司试图避免代价高昂且漫长的诉讼。

Contract disputes often end up in formal court litigation. 合同纠纷往往最终会诉诸正式的法庭诉讼。

loath.note:
She was loath to admit that her competitor had designed a better plan. 她很不情愿地承认她的竞争对手设计了更好的方案。

He is loath to leave his comfortable home during winter storms. 在冬季暴风雨期间，他很不情愿离开舒适的家。

loathe.note:
I completely loathe waking up early on cold winter mornings. 我极其讨厌在寒冷的冬日早晨早起。

He claimed to loathe dishonesty in any form. 他声称厌恶任何形式的不诚实。

lobe.note:
She wore small gold earrings clipped securely to her earlobes. 她戴着夹在耳垂上的小金耳环。

Pneumonia can affect specific lobes of the human lung. 肺炎可能会影响人肺部的特定肺叶。

locale.note:
The film crew scouted several remote mountain locales for the movie. 电影摄制组为这部电影物色了几个偏远的山区拍摄地。

This quiet coastal town is the ideal locale for a peaceful retreat. 这个宁静的海滨小镇是进行平静隐修的理想场所。

locomotion.note:
Walking and running are primary forms of human bipedal locomotion. 走路和跑步是人类两足运动的主要形式。

Insects use various complex mechanisms for terrestrial locomotion. 昆虫利用各种复杂的机制进行陆地移动。

locomotive.meaning:
n. 火车头 
 adj. 运动的；机车用的
locomotive.note:
An old steam locomotive pulled the heritage train down the track. 一台老式蒸汽机车拉着观光复古列车驶过铁轨。

The museum houses a collection of vintage railway locomotives. 这座博物馆收藏了一系列复古铁道机车。

locus.note:
The university campus became the locus of anti-war protests in the 1960s. 大学校园成了20世纪60年代反战抗议活动的中心。

In geometry, a circle is defined as the locus of points equidistant from a center. 在几何学中，圆被定义为距离中心等距的点的轨迹。

lode.note:
Prospectors struck a rich gold lode deep in the mountain range. 勘探者在山脉深处发现了一条丰富的金矿脉。

The interview archive proved to be a veritable lode of historical information. 采访档案被证明是历史资料的一个真正的宝库。

lofty.note:
The young entrepreneur set lofty goals for his new startup company. 这位年轻的企业家为他的新创业公司设定了崇高的目标。

Snow-capped peaks stood lofty against the clear blue sky. 白雪皑皑的山峰在清澈的蓝天衬托下高耸入云。

log.meaning:
n. 原木；航海日志 
 v. 伐木；记录
log.note:
He sat on a fallen wooden log by the campfire. 他坐在营火旁一根倒下的圆木上。

Pilot hours and flight conditions are carefully logged after each trip. 每次行程结束后，飞行员的小时数和飞行状况都会被认真记录下来。

loll.meaning: v. 懒洋洋地躺或坐；垂下
loll.note:
The dog lolled on the living room rug during the warm afternoon. 温暖的下午，这只狗懒洋洋地躺在客厅的地毯上。

He lolled back in his chair with his arms crossed. 他双手交叉，懒洋洋地靠回椅子上。

longing.meaning:
n. 渴望 
 adj. 渴望的
longing.note:
She felt a deep longing for her hometown while living abroad. 在国外生活时，她对家乡产生了深深的渴望。

He gave a longing look at the delicious pastries displayed in the window. 他对橱窗里展示的美味糕点投去了渴望的目光。

loom.meaning:
v. 隐现；逼近 
 n. 织布机
loom.note:
Storm clouds began to loom ominously on the distant horizon. 风暴云开始在远处的地平线上隐现并逼近。

Economic uncertainty continued to loom over the financial markets. 经济的不确定性继续笼罩着金融市场。

loon.note:
The haunting call of a loon echoed across the quiet northern lake. 潜鸟凄美的叫声在宁静的北部湖面上回荡。

He thought his uncle was an eccentric old loon who lived in the woods. 他以为他的叔叔是个住在森林里的古怪老疯子。

loop.meaning:
n. 环；圈 
 v. 成环；绕圈
loop.note:
She tied the string into a neat loop and tied it securely. 她把绳子系成一个整齐的圈，然后绑牢。

The airplane performed a daring loop in the sky during the airshow. 飞机在航空展期间在空中表演了一个大胆的筋斗。

loophole.note:
Lawyers managed to find a tax loophole that saved their client money. 律师设法找到一个能为客户省钱的税收漏洞。

The government quickly acted to close the legal loophole in the regulations. 政府迅速采取行动堵住了规章制度中的法律漏洞。

loosen.note:
He decided to loosen his tie after the long and formal meeting. 在漫长而正式的会议结束后，他决定松开领带。

Warm water helps loosen tight muscles before stretching. 温水有助于在拉伸前放松紧绷的肌肉。

lope.meaning:
v. 大步慢跑；跳跃着跑 
 n. 大步轻快的跑
lope.note:
The large dog loped across the grassy field towards its owner. 那只大狗迈着轻快的大步跑过草地迎向它的主人。

He moved with a long, easy lope that covered ground quickly. 他迈着轻快的大步移动，迅速走完了路程。

lopsided.meaning: adj. 不平衡的；倾斜的；单方面的
lopsided.note:
The picture frame hanging on the wall looked slightly lopsided. 挂在墙上的相框看起来有点倾斜。

The game ended in a lopsided victory for the defending champions. 比赛以卫冕冠军的大比分胜出而告终。

lottery.note:
He couldn't believe his luck when his ticket won the national lottery. 当他的彩票中得全国彩票大奖时，他简直不敢相信自己的运气。

Getting a parking spot downtown during rush hour is pure lottery. 在高峰时段在市中心找到停车位纯粹是碰运气。

loutish.meaning: adj. 粗鲁的；笨拙低俗的
loutish.note:
His loutish behavior at the restaurant upset the other diners. 他在餐厅里粗鲁无礼的行为惹恼了其他食客。

She disliked his loutish manners and rough language. 她讨厌他粗鲁的举止和粗俗的言语。

loyal.note:
The dog remained a loyal companion to his master for over a decade. 这条狗十多年来一直是他主人的忠实伴侣。

She has a loyal group of customers who buy her products every week. 她有一批每周都买她产品的忠实顾客群。

ludicrous.meaning: adj. 荒谬的；滑稽可笑的
ludicrous.note:
The idea that ghosts were haunting the office building sounded ludicrous. 办公室闹鬼的这种想法听起来太荒谬了。

He asked a ludicrous price for a car that barely ran. 他为一辆几乎开不了的车索要了一个荒唐的价格。

lug.meaning:
v. 费力拖拉；搬运 
 n. 把手
lug.note:
She had to lug her heavy suitcase up three flights of stairs. 她不得不费力地把沉重的行李箱拖上三层楼梯。

He lugged the heavy equipment back to the workshop. 他把重型设备费力地搬回了车间。

lukewarm.note:
The soup had gone cold, leaving only a lukewarm broth. 汤已经凉了，只剩下一碗微温的清汤。

The new policy received a lukewarm response from employees. 新政策受到了员工们不冷不热的回应。

lull.meaning:
v. 使平静；哄骗 
 n. 间歇；平静时期
lull.note:
Soft music helped lull the baby into a deep sleep. 轻柔的音乐帮助婴儿进入了深度睡眠。

There was a brief lull in the conversation before someone changed the subject. 在有人转移话题之前，谈话中出现了一段短暂的平静。

lullaby.note:
She softly sang a gentle lullaby to her sleepy infant son. 她轻声向她昏昏欲睡的小儿子唱着温柔的摇篮曲。

The rhythmic sound of rain outside acted like a natural lullaby. 外面有节奏的雨声就像是一首天然的催眠曲。

lumber.meaning:
n. 木材 
 v. 笨拙地移动；堆满杂物
lumber.note:
The truck transported timber and building lumber to the construction site. 卡车将木材和建筑木料运送到建筑工地。

The heavy bear lumbered slowly across the forest clearing. 那头沉重的熊笨拙地穿过森林空地。

lumberjack.note:
The experienced lumberjack used a chainsaw to cut down the tall pine. 经验丰富的伐木工用链锯砍倒了高大的松树。

Lumberjacks often worked in dangerous conditions deep in the northern forests. 伐木工经常在北方森林深处的危险环境中工作。

lumen.note:
The new LED bulb has a brightness of 800 lumens. 这款新的LED灯泡具有800流明的亮度。

Higher lumens mean a brighter light output for the fixture. 更高的流明意味着灯具拥有更亮的输出光。

luminary.meaning: n. 杰出人物；权威；发光体
luminary.note:
Several scientific luminaries attended the annual physics conference. 几位科学界的杰出权威出席了年度物理学会议。

Einstein remains a towering luminary in the history of modern physics. 爱因斯坦依然是现代物理学史上的一座巍峨灯塔。

lump.meaning:
n. 块；肿块 
 v. 团成块；归并
lump.note:
Make sure to stir the sauce well so it doesn't form flour lumps. 确保把酱汁搅拌好，以免形成面粉疙瘩。

He found a small physical lump under his skin and went to see a doctor. 他发现皮下有一个小肿块，便去看医生。

lunar.note:
The lunar eclipse occurred late at night when the sky was clear. 月食发生在夜深人空、天空晴朗的时候。

Many Asian cultures celebrate festivals based on the traditional lunar calendar. 许多亚洲文化根据传统的农历庆祝节日。

lunatic.meaning:
adj. 疯的；狂乱的 
 n. 疯子
lunatic.note:
Driving that fast on an icy road is absolute lunatic behavior. 在结冰的路上开那么快绝对是疯子行为。

He shouted at the drivers like an absolute lunatic during the traffic jam. 交通堵塞时，他像个绝对的疯子一样冲司机们大喊大叫。

lurch.meaning:
v. 突然倾斜；蹒跚 
 n. 突然倾斜
lurch.note:
The bus gave a sudden lurch that caused several standing passengers to stumble. 公共汽车突然猛烈倾斜，导致几个站着的乘客差点摔倒。

The injured athlete began to lurch towards the finish line. 受伤的运动员开始蹒跚着走向终点线。

lurid.meaning: adj. 骇人听闻的；耸人听闻的；耀眼的
lurid.note:
Tabloid papers filled their front pages with lurid details of the crime. 小报在头版刊登了该罪行耸人听闻的细节。

The sunset cast a lurid red glow across the smoky sky. 日落将耀眼的红光投射在烟雾弥漫的天空中。

lustrous.meaning: adj. 有光泽的；光彩夺目的
lustrous.note:
She brushed her long, lustrous hair until it shone under the lights. 她梳理着她那长而有光泽的头发，直到它在灯光下闪闪发光。

The interior designer selected lustrous silk fabrics for the curtains. 室内设计师为窗帘挑选了光泽华丽的丝绸面料。

luxuriant.meaning: adj. 繁茂的；葱郁的；华丽的
luxuriant.note:
The tropical rain forest features luxuriant vegetation and exotic plants. 热带雨林拥有繁茂的植被和奇异的植物。

Her hair grew in luxuriant waves down to her shoulders. 她的秀发呈波浪状自然垂落到肩膀上。

luxury.meaning:
n. 奢侈；奢华 
 adj. 奢侈的
luxury.note:
Traveling first class is a luxury that few people can afford. 坐头等舱是一种很少有人负担得起的奢华享受。

They spent their anniversary at a five-star luxury resort. 他们在一家五星级豪华度假村度过了结婚纪念日。

lyric.meaning:
n. 歌词 
 adj. 抒情的
lyric.note:
He wrote a deeply emotional lyric for the band's new album. 他为乐队的新专辑写了一首感情极深的歌词。

The poet's early works are known for their delicate, lyric beauty. 这位诗人的早期作品以其精致的抒情美而闻名。

macabre.meaning: adj. 恐怖的；令人毛骨悚然的
macabre.note:
The thriller film was filled with macabre scenes of ghosts and skeletons. 这部惊悚电影充满了鬼魂和骷髅的恐怖场景。

He had a dark sense of humor, often making jokes about macabre topics. 他有一种黑暗的幽默感，经常开一些关于恐怖话题的玩笑。

macerate.note:
Chef instructed them to macerate the dried fruit in rum overnight. 厨师指示他们在朗姆酒中浸泡干果过夜。

Soaking the wood in water helps macerate the fibers for paper-making. 把木头泡在水中有助于使纤维软化以用于造纸。

machination.note:
The politician fell victim to the secret machinations of his rivals. 这位政治家沦为了对手暗中策划的阴谋的牺牲品。

She spent weeks uncovering the complex financial machinations of the firm. 她花了好几周时间揭露这家公司复杂的金融阴谋。

maculated.meaning: adj. 有斑点的；有斑驳的
maculated.note:
The leopard's coat is distinctively maculated with dark rosettes. 豹子的皮毛上有着独特的带有暗色斑块的斑点。

Its wings featured a maculated pattern that provided perfect camouflage. 它的翅膀具有斑驳的图案，提供了完美的伪装。

madrigal.meaning: n. 牧歌（一种无伴奏复调声乐曲）
madrigal.note:
A choir performed a classic Renaissance madrigal during the concert. 音乐会上合唱团表演了一首经典文艺复兴时期的牧歌。

Renaissance composers wrote many delightful madrigals about love and nature. 文艺复兴时期的作曲家创作了许多关于爱情和自然的优美牧歌。

maelstrom.note:
The small fishing boat was caught in a dangerous ocean maelstrom. 这艘小型渔船被卷入了危险的海洋大漩涡中。

The country was plunged into a political maelstrom following the election. 选举过后，整个国家陷入了政治动荡的混乱局面。

magisterial.meaning: adj. 权威的；威严的；专断的
magisterial.note:
He delivered a magisterial speech that commanded the respect of all listeners. 他发表了一篇具有权威性的演讲，赢得了所有听众的尊重。

The professor wrote a magisterial study on European history. 这位教授写了一部关于欧洲历史的权威研究著作。

magnanimity.note:
He showed great magnanimity by forgiving his former enemies. 他通过原谅过去的敌人展现了极大的宽宏大量。

Her actions were guided by true nobility and magnanimity. 她的行为受到真正的崇高品德和宽宏大量的指导。

magnanimous.meaning: adj. 宽宏大量的；慷慨的
magnanimous.note:
It was magnanimous of her to praise her rival's performance. 称赞竞争对手的表现体现了她的宽宏大量。

He was magnanimous in victory, thanking his opponents for a great match. 他在胜利时表现得很大度，感谢对手奉献了一场精彩的比赛。

magnate.note:
The shipping magnate donated millions of dollars to build a new hospital. 这位航运巨头捐赠了数百万美元用于建造一家新医院。

Media magnates hold significant influence over public opinion and news. 媒体大亨对公众舆论和新闻有着重大的影响。

magnificent.note:
They admired the magnificent architecture of the ancient European palace. 他们赞赏这座欧洲古代宫殿宏伟的建筑风格。

The view from the mountain top was simply magnificent. 从山顶看去的景色简直好极了。

magnify.note:
A microscope is used to magnify tiny cells that are invisible to the naked eye. 显微镜用于放大肉眼看不见的微小细胞。

Do not magnify small problems into major crises. 不要把小问题夸大成重大危机。

magpie.meaning: n. 喜鹊；喜欢收集杂物的人
magpie.note:
A black-and-white magpie landed noisily on the garden fence. 一只黑白相间的喜鹊喧闹着落在了花园栅栏上。

She is a bit of a magpie, collecting shiny trinkets and old coins. 她有点像喜鹊，喜欢收集闪亮的小饰品和旧硬币。

maize.meaning: n. 玉米（美式英语称 corn）
maize.note:
Indigenous peoples in the Americas cultivated maize thousands of years ago. 美洲原住民在数千年前就开始种植玉米了。

The farmer harvested a rich crop of maize before the autumn rains began. 农民在秋雨开始之前收获了丰盛的玉米。

majestic.note:
Majestic eagles soared high above the deep canyon. 雄伟的雄鹰在深谷上方高高翱翔。

The majestic symphony filled the concert hall with powerful sound. 宏伟的交响乐用强有力的声音充满了音乐厅。

maladroit.note:
His maladroit handling of the negotiation offended several key clients. 他对谈判笨拙的处理方式冒犯了几位关键客户。

She made a maladroit remark that caused an awkward silence in the room. 她说了一句笨拙的话，导致房间里陷入了尴尬的沉默。

malaise.meaning: n. 不适；莫名的不安；经济萎靡
malaise.note:
He felt a general sense of malaise and fatigue for several days. 他连续几天感到身体有些莫名的不适和疲劳。

The country's economic malaise continued despite government interventions. 尽管政府进行干预，该国的经济萎靡状况仍在继续。

malapropism.meaning: n. 词语误用（产生滑稽效果）
malapropism.note:
Her speech was full of humorous malapropisms that made the crowd laugh. 她的演讲充满了幽默的词语误用，逗得人群大笑。

Using 'electrical' instead of 'electrically' is a common semantic malapropism. 用“electrical”代替“electrically”是一种常见的语义误用。

malcontent.meaning:
adj. 不满的 
 n. 不满分子
malcontent.note:
A small group of malcontents gathered outside the office to protest. 一小群不满分子聚集在办公室外抗议。

He had always been a political malcontent, opposing every new law. 他一直是个政治上的不满分子，反对每一项新法律。

malevolent.note:
The villain in the story cast a malevolent glance at the hero. 故事中的反派向英雄投去了恶毒的一瞥。

She sensed a malevolent presence lurking in the dark old house. 她感觉到阴暗的老房子里潜伏着一种恶意的存在。

malfeasance.meaning: n. 渎职；违法行为；不正当行为
malfeasance.note:
The official was accused of corruption and corporate malfeasance. 这名官员被指控腐败和公司渎职。

An internal audit revealed severe financial malfeasance within the department. 内部审计揭露了该部门内部严重的财务不正当行为。

malfunction.meaning:
v. 发生故障；机能失常 
 n. 故障
malfunction.note:
The aircraft's navigation system began to malfunction mid-flight. 飞机的导航系统在飞行中途开始发生故障。

A technical malfunction delayed the rocket launch by several hours. 技术故障将火箭发射推迟了几个小时。

malicious.note:
The computer virus was a malicious attack designed to steal data. 该计算机病毒是一次旨在窃取数据的恶意攻击。

She received several malicious messages online from an anonymous user. 她在网上收到了几个来自匿名用户的恶意信息。

malign.meaning:
v. 诽谤；中伤 
 adj. 有害的；恶性的
malign.note:
He felt deeply hurt when his former friends tried to malign his character. 当他以前的朋友试图中伤他的人格时，他感到深受伤害。

Doctors performed tests to check if the tumor was benign or malign. 医生进行了检查，以确定肿瘤是良性还是恶性。

malinger.note:
The supervisor suspected that the employee was just malingering to avoid work. 主管怀疑该员工只是在装病以逃避工作。

He was accused of trying to malinger rather than face difficult tasks. 他被指控企图装病，而不是面对困难的任务。

malpractice.meaning: n. 玩忽职守；医疗事故；违法行为
malpractice.note:
The surgeon faced a major medical malpractice lawsuit. 这位外科医生面临着一桩重大的医疗事故诉讼。

The firm investigated claims of financial malpractice among its top executives. 该公司对其高管中的财务违规指控进行了调查。

mammoth.meaning:
adj. 巨大的；庞大的 
 n. 长毛象
mammoth.note:
Building the new bridge was a mammoth engineering project. 建造这座新桥是一项庞大的工程项目。

Prehistoric hunters tracked massive woolly mammoths across the tundra. 史前猎人在苔原上追踪着巨大的长毛象。

mangle.meaning: v. 撕裂；严重损坏；拙劣地演奏或朗读
mangle.note:
His bicycle was completely mangled after being hit by a truck. 他的自行车被卡车撞击后彻底严重损毁。

The nervous student began to mangle his lines during the school play. 紧张的学生在学校话剧演出时开始把台词念得乱七八糟。

mania.note:
A sudden shopping mania swept through the city during the holiday sales. 假日促销期间，一股突然的购物狂潮席卷了整个城市。

He showed signs of clinical mania and hyperactivity. 他表现出临床狂躁症和过度活跃的迹象。

manifesto.note:
The political party published its election manifesto outlining core policies. 该政党发布了概述核心政策的竞选宣言。

Artists wrote a radical manifesto demanding a change in modern aesthetics. 艺术家们写了一份激进的宣言，要求改变现代美学。

manifold.meaning:
adj. 繁多的；各种各样的 
 n. 多路管
manifold.note:
The benefits of regular exercise are manifold and well-documented. 经常锻炼的好处是多方面的，并且有据可查。

Engineers inspected the exhaust manifold for any signs of cracking. 工程师检查了排气歧管是否有开裂迹象。

manipulative.meaning: adj. 控制欲强的；巧于操纵的
manipulative.note:
She realized her coworker was playing manipulative games to get ahead. 她意识到她的同事在玩弄权术和操纵手段来往上爬。

He used subtle psychological tricks in a manipulative manner. 他以一种具有操纵性的方式使用了微妙的心理把戏。

mannered.meaning: adj. 做作的；矫揉造作的；有特定礼貌的
mannered.note:
His style of writing was considered overly mannered and artificial. 他的写作风格被认为是过于矫揉造作、不够自然。

The polite guests were well-mannered throughout the formal dinner. 礼貌的客人们在整个正式晚宴期间都很有教养。

mansion.note:
The wealthy actor bought a historic seaside mansion. 这位富有的演员买了一栋历史悠久的海滨豪宅。

Several wealthy families lived in large colonial mansions along the hill. 几个富裕家庭住在山坡上一栋栋大型殖民风格豪宅里。

mantle.meaning:
n. 披风；地幔；重任 
 v. 覆盖
mantle.note:
She wore a heavy wool mantle to keep warm in the winter air. 她穿着一件厚重的羊毛披风来抵御冬天的寒气。

Fresh snow began to mantle the quiet mountain slopes. 新雪开始覆盖寂静的山坡。

manumit.note:
Many slave owners chose to manumit their workers upon their death. 许多奴隶主选择在死前解放他们的劳动者。

Historical documents recorded the legal process used to manumit the captives. 历史文件记录了解放俘虏的法定程序。

manure.meaning:
n. 粪肥 
 v. 施肥
manure.note:
Farmers spread organic manure across the fields to enrich the soil. 农民将有机粪肥撒在地里以肥沃土壤。

The gardener spent the afternoon turning and manuring the vegetable beds. 园丁花了一下午翻土并给菜地施肥。

maple.note:
A large maple tree stood outside their kitchen window, turning red in autumn. 一棵大枫树立在他们的厨房窗外，秋天时叶子变红了。

He made a cutting board out of durable solid maple wood. 他用耐用的实木枫木做了一个案板。

mar.note:
A deep scratch on the car door began to mar its glossy finish. 车门上的一道深划痕开始破坏其光亮的漆面。

An unexpected argument threatened to mar an otherwise perfect evening. 一场突如其来的争吵威胁到了原本完美的夜晚。

marble.meaning:
n. 大理石；弹珠 
 adj. 大理石的
marble.note:
The grand entrance hall featured polished white marble floors. 宏伟的门厅铺着抛光的大理石地板。

Children played games with glass marbles on the playground. 孩子们在操场上用玻璃弹珠玩游戏。

mare.meaning: n. 母马；月海（月球表面阴暗区）
mare.note:
The farmer bred a prize-winning mare known for her speed. 这位农民培育了一匹以速度闻名的获奖母马。

Astronomers mapped the dark volcanic plains known as lunar mares. 天文学家绘制了被称为月海的黑暗火山平原。

margarine.note:
She spread some margarine on her morning toast instead of butter. 她在早晨的吐司上抹了些人造黄油，而不是黄油。

Margarine is often used as a cheaper alternative to dairy butter in baking. 人造黄油在烘焙中常被用作乳脂黄油的廉价替代品。

margin.note:
He scribbled some extra notes in the wide margin of the textbook. 他在课本宽阔的空白页边缘写了一些额外的笔记。

The candidate won the election by a very narrow margin. 这位候选人以非常微弱的优势赢得了选举。

marionette.note:
The puppeteer skillfully controlled the strings of the dancing marionette. 木偶戏演员熟练地控制着跳舞提线木偶的绳子。

Children watched the traditional marionette show with wide-eyed wonder. 孩子们睁大眼睛惊奇地看着传统的提线木偶戏。

marital.note:
They sought professional counseling to resolve ongoing marital conflicts. 他们寻求专业咨询以解决持续不断的婚姻冲突。

The couple celebrated thirty years of happy marital life. 这对夫妻庆祝了三十年的幸福婚姻生活。

maritime.meaning: adj. 海事的；航海的；海滨的
maritime.note:
The coastal city has a long and proud maritime history. 这座海滨城市有着悠久而自豪的海事历史。

International laws regulate shipping and other maritime activities. 国际法规范航运及其他海事活动。

marked.note:
There has been a marked improvement in his academic performance. 他的学业成绩有了显著的改善。

Each luggage bag must be clearly marked with the owner's name. 每个行李箱都必须清楚地标明所有者的名字。

maroon.meaning:
v. 遗弃（在荒岛等处） 
 adj. 栗色的 
 n. 栗色
maroon.note:
The sailors were marooned on a deserted island after the shipwreck. 海难过后，水手们被抛弃在一个荒岛上。

She wore a dark maroon sweater that matched her winter scarf. 她穿了一件深栗色的毛衣，与她的冬季围巾很搭配。

marred.note:
The beauty of the landscape was marred by industrial pollution. 这片风景的美丽因工业污染而遭到破坏。

His reputation was marred by a series of poor business decisions. 他的声誉因一系列糟糕的商业决策而受到玷污。

marsh.note:
Various species of migrating birds nest in the coastal marsh. 多种候鸟在沿海沼泽筑巢。

Walking across the wet marsh requires waterproof boots. 穿过湿润的沼泽需要穿防水靴。

marshal.meaning:
v. 排列；整理；集结 
 n. 元帅；消防队长
marshal.note:
The commander began to marshal his troops for the final inspection. 指挥官开始集结部队进行最后的检阅。

She worked for hours to marshal all the facts needed for her case. 她花了几个小时整理她案件所需的所有事实。

marsupial.meaning:
n. 有袋动物 
 adj. 有袋目的
marsupial.note:
Kangaroos and koalas are well-known marsupials native to Australia. 袋鼠和树袋熊是澳大利亚本土著名的有袋动物。

Female marsupials typically carry their young in a specialized pouch. 雌性有袋动物通常在专用的育儿袋中携带幼崽。

martial.note:
Karate and judo are traditional martial arts practiced worldwide. 空手道和柔道是在世界各地练习的传统武术。

The government declared martial law after civil unrest broke out. 在发生内乱后，政府宣布戒严。

martyr.meaning:
n. 烈士；殉道者 
 v. 使牺牲；折磨
martyr.note:
Historical figures are often remembered as martyrs for their beliefs. 历史人物经常因其信仰而被作为烈士铭记。

She refused to compromise, acting like a martyr to the cause. 她拒绝妥协，表现得像是一个为事业殉道的人。

marvel.meaning:
v. 感到惊异；赞叹 
 n. 奇迹
marvel.note:
Visitors cannot help but marvel at the intricate design of the cathedral. 参观者不禁对大教堂复杂的建筑设计感到惊叹。

Modern smartphones are truly a technological marvel. 现代智能手机确实是一个技术奇迹。

mash.meaning:
v. 把…捣成泥 
 n. 糊状物
mash.note:
Boil the potatoes until soft, then mash them with butter and milk. 把土豆煮软，然后加黄油和牛奶把它们捣成泥。

He mixed the ingredients into a smooth vegetable mash. 他把配料混合成顺滑的蔬菜泥。

mask.meaning:
n. 面具；口罩 
 v. 掩饰；戴面具
mask.note:
Medical staff wore protective face masks during the procedure. 医护人员在手术过程中戴着防护口罩。

He tried to mask his disappointment with a brave smile. 他试图用勇敢的微笑道出失望。

masquerade.meaning:
n. 化妆舞会；伪装 
 v. 伪装；冒充
masquerade.note:
Guests attended the annual gala wearing elaborate Halloween masquerades. 客人们穿着精心制作的万圣节服装参加了年度盛会。

The scammer spent months masquerading as a wealthy investment banker. 这个骗子冒充富有的投资银行家好几个月。

massive.note:
A massive earthquake struck the coastal region late last night. 昨晚晚些时候，一场大地震袭击了沿海地区。

The project required a massive amount of funding and labor. 该项目需要大量的资金和劳动力。

mast.note:
Strong winds snapped the wooden mast of the sailing boat in half. 强风把帆船的木制桅杆折断成两半。

A tall radio transmission mast stood on top of the rolling hill. 一座高大的无线电发射天线杆矗立在连绵起伏的山顶上。

masticate.note:
It is important to thoroughly masticate your food to aid digestion. 充分咀嚼食物以助消化是很重要的。

Herbivores spend hours each day grazing and masticating vegetation. 食草动物每天花数小时吃草和咀嚼植物。

mate.meaning:
n. 伙伴；配偶 
 v. 交配
mate.note:
He has been my close roommate and study mate since college. 自大学以来，他一直是我亲密的室友和学习搭档。

Many birds return to the same partner to mate every spring. 许多鸟类每年春天都会回到同一个伴侣身边交配。

materialize.note:
His plans to start a new business failed to materialize due to lack of funds. 由于缺乏资金，他开创新业务的计划未能实现。

We waited for hours, but the expected financial backing never materialized. 我们等了几个小时，但预期的资金支持始终没有兑现。

maternal.note:
She has a strong maternal instinct and cares deeply for her nieces. 她有着强烈的母性本能，对自己的侄女们照顾得无微不至。

He inherited his musical talent through his maternal grandfather. 他通过母系祖父继承了音乐天赋。

matrix.note:
Mathematics deals extensively with operations on complex matrices. 数学广泛涉及复杂矩阵的运算。

Fossils are embedded in a hard limestone rock matrix. 化石嵌入在坚硬的石灰岩母体中。

maudlin.meaning: adj. 伤感脆弱的；多愁善感的
maudlin.note:
After a few drinks, he became rather maudlin and started crying. 喝了几杯酒后，他变得多愁善感起来并开始哭泣。

She hated maudlin romantic movies that relied on cheap emotional tricks. 她讨厌那些依靠低级情感伎俩的伤感浪漫电影。

maul.meaning: v. 撕咬；粗暴对待；痛打
maul.note:
The hiker was severely mauled by a wild bear in the woods. 登山者在树林里被一头野熊严重撕咬抓伤。

Critics began to maul the new play in their morning reviews. 评论家们在早晨的评论中开始猛烈抨击这部新剧。

mauve.meaning:
n. 淡紫色 
 adj. 淡紫色的
mauve.note:
She painted her bedroom walls a soothing shade of pale mauve. 她把卧室的墙壁刷成了一种令人舒缓的淡紫色。

Flowers with delicate mauve petals blossomed across the garden. 带着精致淡紫色花瓣的花朵在花园里盛开。

maven.note:
He is a software maven who knows everything about coding systems. 他是一位软件专家，对编码系统无所不知。

Ask the fashion maven for advice before buying clothes for the event. 在为活动买衣服之前，向时尚达人征求建议。

maverick.meaning:
n. 特立独行者 
 adj. 标新立异的
maverick.note:
He was known as a corporate maverick who challenged traditional rules. 他被认为是一名挑战传统规则的公司特立独行者。

The young artist took a maverick approach to classical painting. 这位年轻艺术家对古典绘画采取了标新立异的方法。

mawkish.meaning: adj. 过于感伤的；令人作呕的
mawkish.note:
The greeting card was filled with mawkish poetry about eternal love. 这张贺卡上写满了关于永恒爱情的过分感伤的诗句。

She disliked the film's mawkish sentimentality and emotional manipulation. 她不喜欢这部电影过度的伤感主义和情感操纵。

maze.meaning: n. 迷宫；复杂难解的事物
maze.note:
Children ran around trying to find the exit of the garden hedge maze. 孩子们跑来跑去，试图找到花园树篱迷宫的出口。

Navigating tax regulations can feel like walking through a legal maze. 浏览税收法规感觉就像是在走法律迷宫。

meager.note:
The refugees survived on a meager diet of bread and water. 难民们靠着面包和水的 meager 饮食勉强存活。

His salary was so meager that he struggled to pay rent. 他的薪水太微薄了，以至于连房租都付得很艰难。

measly.meaning: adj. 微不足道的；少得可怜的
measly.note:
They offered him a measly pay rise after a year of hard work. 经过一年的辛苦工作，他们只给了他微不足道的加薪。

She complained about getting a measly slice of cake at the party. 她抱怨在派对上只分到了一小块少得可怜的蛋糕。

measured.note:
He spoke in a slow and measured tone to ensure everyone understood. 他用缓慢而审慎的语调说话，以确保每个人都听懂了。

The runner maintained a steady and measured pace throughout the race. 赛跑者在整个比赛中保持着稳定而有规律的步伐。

mechanical.note:
The factory failure was caused by a minor mechanical issue. 工厂的故障是由一个微小的机械问题引起的。

Her performance felt robotic and mechanical rather than emotional. 她的表演感觉像机器一样呆板，缺乏情感。

mechanics.note:
He studied classical mechanics and thermodynamics in university. 他在大学里学习了经典力学和热力学。

Understanding the mechanics of writing helps improve grammar skills. 理解写作的技巧有助于提高语法水平。

mechanism.note:
The clock features an intricate internal gear mechanism. 这款钟表具有精致的内部齿轮机械装置。

There is no effective defense mechanism against this new threat. 针对这一新威胁，目前尚无有效的防御机制。

meddle.note:
Stop trying to meddle in other people's private family affairs. 别再试图干涉别人私人的家庭事务了。

He hated it when neighbors would meddle in his business. 他讨厌邻居们插手他的事情。

meddlesome.meaning: adj. 爱管闲事的，干涉他人的
meddlesome.note:
Her meddlesome behavior often alienates her coworkers. 她爱管闲事的行为常常让同事疏远她。

I wish my meddlesome neighbors would mind their own business. 我希望我那爱管闲事的邻居能少管闲事。

mediocre.meaning: adj. 平庸的，普通的，质量中等的
mediocre.note:
The restaurant is famous for its mediocre food and high prices. 这家餐厅以平庸的食物和高昂的价格闻名。

He refuses to settle for a mediocre performance in the championship. 他拒绝在锦标赛中满足于平庸的表现。

mediocrity.meaning: n. 平庸，平庸的人或事
mediocrity.note:
She rose from obscurity and mediocrity to international stardom. 她从默默无闻和极度平庸一跃成为国际巨星。
