He was trapped in a life of comfortable mediocrity. 他被困在舒适却平庸的生活中。

meditate.meaning: v. 冥想，沉思，深思熟虑
meditate.note:
She likes to meditate in the garden every morning. 她喜欢每天早晨在花园里冥想。

He sat quietly to meditate on the future of the company. 他静静地坐着，深思公司的未来。

meditative.note:
He fell into a meditative silence after hearing the news. 听到这个消息后，他陷入了沉思的沉默中。

Soft music put her in a meditative mood. 轻柔的音乐让她进入了一种冥想的心境。

medley.meaning: n. 混合曲，杂集，大杂烩
medley.note:
The band played a lively medley of 1980s pop hits. 乐队演奏了一组欢快的八十年代流行金曲串烧。

Her garden is a colorful medley of flowers and vegetables. 她的花园是一个由花卉和蔬菜组成的五彩缤纷的大杂烩。

meek.meaning: adj. 温顺的，驯服的，逆来顺受的
meek.note:
She was too meek to protest against the unfair treatment. 她太温顺了，不敢抗议这种不公正的对待。

He accepted the criticism with a meek nod of his head. 他温顺地点了点头，接受了批评。

melancholy.meaning: n. / adj. 忧郁，悲伤；忧郁的
melancholy.note:
A sense of melancholy descended on the town as winter arrived. 随着冬天的到来，一股忧郁的情绪笼罩了小镇。

He played a melancholy tune on his violin. 他用小提琴演奏了一曲忧伤的旋律。

meld.note:
The film successfully melds elements of comedy and horror. 这部电影成功地融合了喜剧和恐怖的元素。

Tradition and modernity meld seamlessly in this city. 传统与现代在这个城市无缝地融合在一起。

mellifluous.meaning: adj. （声音等）流畅悦耳的，动听的
mellifluous.note:
She was blessed with a rich, mellifluous voice. 她天生拥有富有磁性且悦耳动听的嗓音。

We listened to the mellifluous notes of the cello. 我们聆听着大提琴流畅优美的音符。

melodrama.meaning: n. 情节剧，感情夸张的事件
melodrama.note:
His reaction to the minor setback was pure melodrama. 他对这个小挫折的反应纯粹是小题大做。

The novel reads more like a cheap melodrama than a serious history. 这部小说读起来更像是一部廉谐的情节剧，而不像严肃的历史。

membrane.note:
Oxygen passes through the cell membrane easily. 氧气很容易穿过细胞膜。

Contact lenses rest directly on the tear film of the eye membrane. 隐形眼镜直接贴在眼膜的泪液膜上。

menace.meaning: n. / v. 威胁，危险的人或事
menace.note:
Drunk drivers pose a serious menace to public safety. 酒驾对公共安全构成了严重的威胁。

Dark clouds began to menace the picnic plans. 乌云开始威胁到野餐的计划。

mendacious.note:
He was exposed for making mendacious statements during the interview. 他在采访中发表虚假言论的行为被揭穿了。

Her mendacious claims destroyed her political career. 她撒谎的言论断送了她的政治生涯。

mendacity.note:
We were shocked by the sheer mendacity of his testimony. 他的证词之虚假让我们大跌眼镜。

Politicians are often accused of habitual mendacity. 政客们经常被指责习惯性地说谎。

mendicant.meaning: n. / adj. 乞丐，化缘的；行乞的
mendicant.note:
The mendicant stood outside the cathedral asking for alms. 那个乞丐站在大教堂外请求施舍。

He joined a mendicant religious order that renounced all wealth. 他加入了一个放弃所有财富的化缘修会。

menthol.note:
The cough drops contain menthol to soothe the throat. 这款止咳糖含有薄荷醇以舒缓喉咙。

He prefers cigarettes flavored with menthol. 他更喜欢带有薄荷味的香烟。

mercantile.note:
The city grew rich through its strong mercantile traditions. 这座城市凭借其强烈的商业传统变得富有。

Old mercantile laws regulated shipping and commerce. 旧的商业法规规范了航运和贸易。

mercenary.meaning: adj. / n. 唯利是图的；雇佣兵
mercenary.note:
His motives for helping her were purely mercenary. 他帮她的动机纯粹是为了金钱。

The dictator hired foreign mercenaries to protect his regime. 该独裁者雇佣了外国雇佣兵来保护他的政权。

mercurial.meaning: adj. 反复无常的，善变的，水银的
mercurial.note:
She is known for her mercurial temperament and quick mood swings. 她以性格善变和情绪起伏大而闻名。

His mercurial genius made him a difficult colleague. 他那变化莫测的天赋使他成了一个很难共事的同事。

meretricious.meaning: adj. 华而不实的，金玉其外败絮其中的
meretricious.note:
The jewelry looked expensive, but it was just meretricious junk. 这首饰看起来很贵，但其实只是华而不实的破烂。

He was seduced by the meretricious glamour of the entertainment industry. 他被娱乐圈虚浮的魅力所诱惑。

merited.meaning: adj. 应得的，理所应当的
merited.note:
Her promotion was fully merited after years of hard work. 经过多年的努力，她的晋升是完全名副其实的。

The criticism he received was harsh but entirely merited. 他受到的批评虽然严厉，但完全是罪有应得。

meritorious.meaning: adj. 有功绩的，值得称赞的
meritorious.note:
He was awarded a medal for his meritorious service in the navy. 他因在海军中立下的优异战功而被授予勋章。

The charity organization does meritorious work in the community. 该慈善机构在社区里做了许多值得表彰的工作。

mesa.note:
The ancient ruins were discovered on top of a flat mesa. 古代遗址在一座平顶山的顶部被发现。

The road wound through the desert, passing several dramatic mesas. 公路蜿蜒穿过沙漠，经过了几座壮观的台地。

mesh.meaning: n. / v. 网眼，网状物；紧密配合，啮合
mesh.note:
Insects are kept out of the tent by a fine wire mesh. 细密的金属网将昆虫挡在了帐篷外面。

Their plans finally began to mesh together seamlessly. 他们的计划终于开始完美地契合在一起了。

metamorphose.note:
Caterpillars metamorphose into beautiful butterflies. 毛毛虫蜕变为美丽的蝴蝶。

The small village metamorphosed into a bustling modern city. 这个小村庄蜕变成了一个繁华的现代城市。

metaphysical.meaning: adj. 形而上学的，超自然的
metaphysical.note:
He enjoys reading complex books on metaphysical philosophy. 他喜欢阅读关于形而上学哲学的复杂书籍。

She has a deep interest in metaphysical concepts like the soul. 她对诸如灵魂之类的形而上学概念有着浓厚的兴趣。

metaphysics.note:
Metaphysics explores the fundamental nature of reality. 形而上学探讨现实的根本本质。

Aristotle's work on metaphysics remains influential today. 亚里士多德关于形而上学的著作至今仍具有影响力。

mete.meaning: v. 给予，分配（惩罚或奖赏）
mete.note:
The judge will mete out punishment to the criminals tomorrow. 法官将于明天对罪犯予以宣判惩罚。

Justice must be meted out fairly to everyone. 必须对每个人都公正地伸张正义。

meteoric.meaning: adj. 迅猛的，流星般的（通常指成功转瞬即逝）
meteoric.note:
She experienced a meteoric rise to fame in Hollywood. 她在好莱坞经历了一次流星般迅速的成名过程。

The company's meteoric growth surprised financial analysts. 这家公司迅猛的增长让金融分析师感到惊讶。

meteorology.note:
He studied meteorology to understand global weather patterns. 他学习气象学是为了解全球天气模式。

Modern meteorology uses advanced satellites to forecast storms. 现代气象学利用先进的卫星来预测风暴。

methodical.meaning: adj. 有条不紊的，办事有规律的
methodical.note:
She has a very methodical approach to solving complex problems. 她用一种非常条理分明的方法来解决复杂的问题。

He cleared the cluttered room in a calm, methodical way. 他用冷静、有条理的方式清理了杂乱的房间。

metrical.note:
The poem has a strict metrical structure. 这首诗有着严格的格律结构。

He analyzed the metrical patterns of Shakespearean sonnets. 他分析了莎士比亚十四行诗的韵律模式。

metropolis.note:
Tokyo is a bustling metropolis that never truly sleeps. 东京是一个从真正意义上永不眠的繁华大都市。

People migrate from rural areas to the metropolis for jobs. 人们从农村地区迁移到大都市寻找工作。

metropolitan.meaning: adj. 大都市的，大都会的
metropolitan.note:
The museum is located in the heart of the metropolitan area. 博物馆坐落在大都市地区的中心地带。

He relies on the metropolitan transit system to commute. 他依靠大都市的公共交通系统上下班。

mettle.meaning: n. 勇气，毅力，不屈不挠的精神
mettle.note:
The crisis tested the leader's mettle under extreme pressure. 这场危机考验了这位领导人在极度压力下的气魄。

She proved her mettle by winning the championship. 她通过赢得冠军证明了自己的实力和毅力。

mettlesome.meaning: adj. 勇猛的，精神抖擞的
mettlesome.note:
The knight rode a mettlesome horse into the battlefield. 骑士骑着一匹勇猛的战马冲进战场。

Her mettlesome spirit helped her overcome all odds. 她那不屈不挠的精神帮助她克服了一切困难。

microbe.note:
Some microbes can survive in extremely harsh environments. 某些微生物能在极端恶劣的环境中生存。

Scientists use microscopes to observe living microbes. 科学家使用显微镜来观察活的微生物。

microorganism.note:
Yeast is a single-celled microorganism used in baking. 酵母是一种用于烘焙的单细胞微生物。

Water can contain harmful microorganisms if not purified. 如果不净化，水可能会含有有害的微生物。

microscope.note:
The biology student placed the slide under the microscope. 生物系学生把载玻片放在显微镜下。

Cells are so small that they can only be seen through a microscope. 细胞太小了，只能通过显微镜才能看到。

microscopic.meaning: adj. 极小的，显微镜下的
microscopic.note:
The water sample was swarming with microscopic organisms. 水样中充斥着微观生物。

Details of the crime were captured with microscopic precision. 犯罪细节被以极其精准的微观精度捕捉到了。

miff.note:
She was a bit miffed that she hadn't been invited to the party. 她因为没有被邀请去派对而有点恼火。

A minor misunderstanding caused a brief miff between them. 一个小误会引发了他们之间短暂的不快。

mighty.meaning: adj. 强大的，强有力的，巨大的
mighty.note:
The mighty river flooded the entire valley in spring. 那条汹涌的大河在春天淹没整个山谷。

They made a mighty effort to finish the project on time. 他们做出了巨大的努力按时完成了项目。

migratory.note:
Swallows are migratory birds that fly south for winter. 燕子是冬天向南飞的候鸟。

The tribe followed a migratory lifestyle across the plains. 这个部落过着横跨平原的游牧生活。

milestone.note:
Graduating from college was a major milestone in her life. 大学毕业她人生中的一个重要里程碑。

The invention of the internet was a technological milestone. 互联网的发明是一个技术上的里程碑。

mill.meaning: n. / v. 磨坊，工厂；磨碎，压榨
mill.note:
Wheat is taken to the local mill to be ground into flour. 小麦被送到当地的磨坊磨成面粉。

The factory uses heavy machines to mill the steel. 这家工厂使用重型机械来碾磨钢铁。

mime.meaning: n. / v. 哑剧，手势；模拟，演哑剧
mime.note:
The street performer acted out a funny story in mime. 街头艺人通过哑剧表演了一个有趣的故事。

He sang along, trying to mime the lyrics accurately. 他跟着唱，试图准确地对口型。

mimic.meaning: v. / n. 模仿，学…的样；模仿者
mimic.note:
Parrots can mimic human speech with surprising accuracy. 鹦鹉能以惊人的准确度模仿人类说话。

Some insects mimic leaves to hide from predators. 一些昆虫模仿树叶来躲避捕食者。

minaret.note:
The tall minaret dominated the skyline of the old city. 高高的清真寺尖塔俯瞰着老城的城市天际线。

The call to prayer echoed from the top of the minaret. 礼拜的召唤声从尖塔顶端回荡开来。

minatory.meaning: adj. 具威胁性的，威吓的
minatory.note:
He gave a minatory glance to anyone who interrupted him. 他向任何打断他的人投去威胁的一瞥。

Dark skies and minatory storm clouds gathered overhead. 阴暗的天空和带威胁性的风暴云在头顶聚集。

miniature.meaning: adj. / n. 微型的，微小的；微型画
miniature.note:
She collects miniature porcelain teacups. 她收集微型的瓷茶杯。

The park features a miniature railway for children. 公园里有一个供儿童乘坐的微型铁路。

minimize.meaning: v. 最小化，使减到最少，轻视
minimize.note:
Good hygiene helps to minimize the spread of germs. 良好的卫生习惯有助于最大限度地减少细菌传播。

Don't minimize the risks involved in this investment. 不要轻视这次投资中涉及的风险。

minion.note:
The villain ordered his minions to lock the doors. 恶棍命令他的手下把门锁上。

He refused to act as a political minion for the corrupt boss. 他拒绝充当腐败老板的政治傀儡。

minnow.meaning: n. 鲦鱼，小鱼，微不足道的人或物
minnow.note:
The children caught small minnows in the shallow stream. 孩子们在浅溪里抓到了小鲦鱼。

Their company is a mere minnow in the global tech market. 他们的公司在全球科技市场中只是个无足轻重的小角色。

minuet.meaning: n. 小步舞（一种古典舞蹈或音乐）
minuet.note:
The nobles danced a graceful minuet at the royal ball. 贵族们在皇家舞会上跳了一曲优雅的小步舞。

Classical composers often included a minuet in their symphonies. 古典音乐家经常在交响乐中加入小步舞曲。

minuscule.note:
His contribution to the project was minuscule. 他对这个项目的贡献微乎其微。

The error was so minuscule that nobody noticed it. 这个错误太微小了，以至于没有人注意到。

minutes.note:
The secretary circulated the minutes of the board meeting. 秘书分发了董事会会议记录。

Please review the minutes before our next appointment. 请在我们的下一次预约前审阅会议记录。

minutia.meaning: n. 琐碎细节，细微末节
minutia.note:
She gets bogged down in the minutia of daily paperwork. 她陷入了日常文书工作的琐碎细节中。

He ignored the minutia and focused on the big picture. 他忽略了细微末节，专注于大局。

mirage.meaning: n. 海市蜃楼，幻影，妄想
mirage.note:
The lake in the desert turned out to be a mirage. 沙漠中的湖泊结果只是海市蜃楼。

Peace in the region seemed like a distant mirage. 该地区的和平看起来像是一个遥不可及的幻影。

mire.meaning: n. / v. 泥潭，困境；陷入泥潭，使陷入困境
mire.note:
The cart's wheels sank deep into the thick mire. 马车的轮子深深陷入了厚厚的泥潭中。

The government is mired in a corruption scandal. 政府深陷腐败丑闻之中。

mirth.note:
The comedian's jokes filled the room with loud mirth. 喜剧演员的笑话让房间里充满了欢声笑语。

Her eyes were full of mirth as she watched the puppies play. 她看着小狗玩耍时，眼中充满了欢乐。

misanthrope.meaning: n. 厌恶人类者，愤世嫉俗者
misanthrope.note:
He became a grumpy misanthrope after years of betrayal. 多年的背叛使他成了一个脾气暴躁的厌世者。

The old man lived as a misanthropic recluse in the woods. 那位老人在树林里过着离群索居的厌世生活。

mischievous.meaning: adj. 淘气的，恶作剧的，有害的
mischievous.note:
The mischievous boy hid his sister's favorite doll. 那个淘气的男孩藏了他妹妹最喜欢的洋娃娃。

A mischievous rumor began to spread around the office. 一个恶意的谣言开始在办公室里流传开来。

miscreant.note:
The police finally caught the miscreants who vandalized the park. 警察终于抓住了在公园里搞破坏的歹徒。

Justice will eventually catch up with every miscreant. 正义终将追捕到每一个恶棍。

miser.note:
The old miser hoarded all his gold under the floorboards. 老守财奴把所有的金子都囤积在地板底下。

Despite his wealth, he lived like a miser. 尽管他很富有，但他过着吝啬鬼般的生活。

miserly.note:
He made a miserly donation to the charity event. 他对慈善活动进行了极其吝啬的捐赠。

Her miserly employer refused to pay for overtime. 她那吝啬的老板拒绝支付加班费。

misgiving.note:
She had serious misgivings about signing the contract. 她对签署这份合同有着严重的疑虑。

Despite my misgivings, I decided to go on the trip. 尽管我心存疑虑，我还是决定去旅行。

misinform.meaning: v. 提供错误信息，误导
misinform.note:
The public was misinformed about the safety of the chemical. 公众被关于该化学品安全性的错误信息误导了。

He claimed that the media had deliberately misinformed viewers. 他声称媒体故意向观众提供错误信息。

misnomer.meaning: n. 命名不当，用词不当
misnomer.note:
Calling the tiny apartment a penthouse is a complete misnomery. 把这个极小的公寓叫作顶层豪华公寓完全是名不副实。

'Dry cleaning' is a misnomer since liquid solvents are actually used. “干洗”是一个不恰当的称呼，因为实际上使用了液体溶剂。

misperceive.meaning: v. 误解，对…产生错误感知
misperceive.note:
It is easy to misperceive friendly gestures as romantic interest. 人们很容易把友好的举动误解为浪漫的兴趣。

He tended to misperceive constructive criticism as personal attacks. 他倾向于将建设性的批评误解为个人攻击。

misrepresent.meaning: v. 歪曲，代表不当，误传
misrepresent.note:
The politician accused the newspaper of misrepresenting his views. 这位政客指责该报纸歪曲了他的观点。

She deliberately misrepresented her qualifications on the resume. 她在简历上故意虚假陈述了自己的资历。

misrepresentation.meaning: n. 歪曲，不实陈述，虚假陈述
misrepresentation.note:
The company was sued for financial misrepresentation. 这家公司因财务虚假陈述而被起诉。

His statement was a clear misrepresentation of the facts. 他的声明是对事实的明显歪曲。

misshapen.meaning: adj. 畸形的，奇形怪状的
misshapen.note:
The old tree had a strange, misshapen trunk. 那棵老树有着奇形怪状的树干。

He found a misshapen potato in the vegetable basket. 他在菜篮里发现了一个畸形的土豆。

mitten.note:
She wore thick woolen mittens to keep her hands warm. 她戴着厚厚的羊绒连指手套来保暖。

Children often lose one of their mittens in the snow. 孩子们经常在雪地里弄丢一只连指手套。

mnemonics.note:
He used mnemonics to memorize the historical dates. 他使用记忆法来记住历史日期。

Mnemonics can be very effective for learning foreign languages. 记忆术对于学习外语非常有效。

moan.meaning: n. / v. 呻吟，抱怨，哀叹
moan.note:
She let out a soft moan of pain from her injured knee. 她因受伤的膝盖发出一声轻微的痛苦呻吟。

He always moans about having too much work to do. 他总是抱怨有做不完的工作。

moat.note:
The medieval castle was surrounded by a deep, water-filled moat. 这座中世纪城堡被一条深邃的、蓄满水的护城河环绕。

A drawbridge crossed the moat to the castle gates. 一座吊桥横跨护城河通往城堡大门。

mock.meaning: v. / adj. 嘲弄，模仿；模拟的，假装的
mock.note:
It is unkind to mock someone for their mistakes. 因为别人的错误而嘲笑别人是不厚道的。

The students took a mock exam to prepare for the finals. 学生们参加了一次模拟考试，为期末做准备。

mode.note:
Public transport is my preferred mode of traveling. 公共交通是我首选的出行方式。

He switched his phone to silent mode during the meeting. 他在开会期间将手机切换到了静音模式。

modicum.note:
He showed not even a modicum of remorse for his actions. 他对自己的行为甚至没有表现出一丝一毫的悔意。

She hoped to regain a modicum of control over her life. 她希望能重新对自己的生活掌控一点点局面。

modify.note:
We need to modify our plans in light of new information. 根据新信息，我们需要修改我们的计划。

An adjective is a word that modifies a noun. 形容词是修饰名词的词。

modish.note:
She wore a modish dress to the fashion show. 她穿着一件时髦的裙子去参加时装秀。

The interior design of the apartment was very modish. 这套公寓的室内设计非常时尚。

modulate.note:
A good speaker knows how to modulate their voice. 一个优秀的演讲者懂得如何调节自己的嗓音。

The song modulates into a higher key in the final chorus. 这首歌在最后的副歌部分转调到了更高的调子。

mogul.note:
The media mogul owned several newspapers and television channels. 这位媒体大亨拥有几家报纸和电视频道。

He became a real estate mogul by the age of forty. 他在四十岁时成了一名房地产大亨。

molar.note:
He felt a sharp pain in his back molar while eating. 他吃饭时感到后臼齿一阵剧痛。

Molars are designed for grinding tough food like grains. 臼齿专为磨碎坚韧的食物（如谷物）而设计。

mold.meaning: n. / v. 模具，霉菌；用模子制作，塑造
mold.note:
Pour the melted chocolate into the plastic mold. 把融化的巧克力倒入塑料模具中。

Bread left out in the damp will quickly grow mold. 放在潮湿处的面包很快会滋生霉菌。

molding.meaning: n. 模制，线条，装饰线条
molding.note:
The ceiling was decorated with intricate plaster moldings. 天花板上装饰着复杂的石膏线条。

The carpenter installed wooden molding around the doors. 木匠在门周围安装了木制装饰条。

moldy.note:
Throw away that slice of moldy cheese. 把那片发霉的奶酪扔掉吧。

The basement smelled of dampness and moldy books. 地下室里有一股潮湿和发霉书本的气味。

molecule.note:
A water molecule consists of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom. 一个水分子由两个氢原子和一个氧原子组成。

Scientists study molecules to understand chemical reactions at a microscopic level. 科学家研究分子是为了在微观水平上理解化学反应。

mollify.note:
The manager tried to mollify the angry customer with a refund. 经理试图通过退款来平息愤怒的顾客。

Her apology was not enough to mollify her offended friend. 她的道歉不足以抚慰她被冒犯的朋友。

mollycoddle.note:
Parents should not mollycoddle their children too much. 父母不应该过度娇惯孩子。

He was mollycoddled by his mother throughout his childhood. 他整个童年都被母亲娇生惯养着。

molt.meaning: v. / n. 换羽，脱毛，脱皮
molt.note:
Birds molt their feathers once a year before winter. 鸟类在冬天到来前每年换一次羽毛。

Snakes shed their old skin during the molt process. 蛇在脱皮过程中蜕去旧皮。

molten.note:
Volcanoes spew out red-hot molten lava. 火山喷发出炽热的熔岩。

Molten steel was poured into the casting molds. 熔化的钢水被倒入铸模中。

momentous.meaning: adj. 重大的，极其重要的
momentous.note:
The moon landing was a momentous event in human history. 登月是人类历史上具有重大意义的事件。

She made a momentous decision to change her career path. 她做出了改变职业生涯的重大决定。

monarch.note:
The monarch opened the new session of parliament. 国王主持了新一届议会的开幕。

Queen Victoria was a powerful British monarch. 维多利亚女王是一位强大的英国君主。

monarchy.note:
Britain is a constitutional monarchy with a parliamentary system. 英国是一个实行议会制的君主立宪制国家。

The country abolished its monarchy and became a republic. 这个国家废除了君主制，变成了一个共和国。

mongrel.meaning: n. / adj. 杂种狗，混血儿；杂种的
mongrel.note:
They adopted a friendly stray mongrel from the animal shelter. 他们从动物收容所领养了一只友善的杂种流浪狗。

She loves her adorable mongrel dog more than anything. 她比什么都爱她那只可爱的杂种狗。

monochromatic.note:
The artist created a striking monochromatic painting in shades of blue. 这位艺术家创作了一幅引人注目的蓝色调单色画。

She prefers a monochromatic color scheme for her living room. 她更喜欢客厅采用单一的配色方案。

monochrome.meaning: n. / adj. 单色图片，黑白照；单色的
monochrome.note:
Old family photos are often displayed in monochrome. 旧的全家福照片通常以黑白形式展示。

The film was shot in a moody, beautiful monochrome. 这部电影是用忧郁而美丽的黑白画面拍摄的。

monocle.note:
The aristocratic gentleman wore a single monocle over his eye. 那位贵族绅士眼睛上戴着一付单片眼镜。

Monocles were popular fashion accessories in the nineteenth century. 单片眼镜在十九世纪是流行的时尚配饰。

monogamy.meaning: n. 一夫一妻制，单配制
monogamy.note:
Many bird species practice social monogamy during the breeding season. 许多鸟类在繁殖季节实行一夫一妻制。

Human societies vary in their cultural norms regarding monogamy. 人类社会关于一夫一妻制的文化规范各不相同。

monologue.note:
The actor delivered a powerful Shakespearean monologue. 这位演员发表了一段充满力量的莎士比亚独白。

I got tired of listening to his endless monologue. 我听腻了他那没完没了的长篇大论。

monomania.note:
His obsession with chess bordered on monomania. 他对国际象棋的着迷近乎偏执狂。

She developed a monomania for collecting rare porcelain. 她对收集稀有瓷器产生了一种狂热。

monotonous.note:
He grew tired of doing the same monotonous tasks every day. 他厌倦了每天做同样单调乏味的工作。

The professor's monotonous voice put several students to sleep. 教授那单调乏味的声音让好几个学生睡着了。

monotony.note:
She traveled to break the monotony of her daily routine. 她去旅游是为了打破日常生活单调乏味的规律。

Music helped to relieve the monotony of the long drive. 音乐有助于缓解漫长驾驶的单调感。

monsoon.note:
The heavy monsoon rains caused severe flooding in the region. 猛烈的季风暴雨导致该地区发生严重洪灾。

Farmers depend heavily on the summer monsoon for their crops. 农民们的农作物在很大程度上依赖夏季的季风降雨。

montage.meaning: n. 蒙太奇，拼贴画，剪辑片段
montage.note:
The film opened with a nostalgic montage of childhood memories. 电影以一段充满怀旧色彩的童年记忆蒙太奇开场。

She created a photo montage for her parents' wedding anniversary. 她为父母的结婚纪念日制作了一幅照片拼贴画。

monumental.meaning: adj. 巨大的，不朽的，重大的
monumental.note:
Finding a cure for the disease was a monumental achievement. 找到这种疾病的治疗方法是一项不朽的成就。

They made a monumental error in calculating the budget. 他们在计算预算时犯了一个巨大的错误。

morale.note:
The team's morale was boosted after winning the crucial match. 赢得这场关键比赛后，队伍的士气大受鼓舞。

Good leadership is essential for maintaining high staff morale. 良好的领导力对于保持员工的高昂士气至关重要。

moralistic.meaning: adj. 说教的，道德主义的
moralistic.note:
She disliked his moralistic attitude towards other people's choices. 她不喜欢他对别人选择的那种说教态度。

The film avoids moralistic judgments and lets viewers decide. 这部电影避免了道德说教式的评判，让观众自己决定。

moratorium.note:
The government declared a moratorium on nuclear testing. 政府宣布暂停核试验。

Environmentalists called for a moratorium on tree cutting in the area. 环保主义者呼吁暂停该地区的砍树活动。

morbid.meaning: adj. 病态的，不健康的（尤指对死亡等感兴趣）
morbid.note:
He has a morbid fascination with true crime stories. 他对真实犯罪故事有一种病态的迷恋。

The doctor found no morbid signs during the physical examination. 医生在体检中没有发现任何病态迹象。

mordant.meaning: adj. 尖酸的，刻薄的，讽刺的
mordant.note:
He is well known for his mordant wit and dry humor. 他以尖酸的机智和冷幽默而闻名。

Her mordant criticism left the speaker speechless. 她尖刻的批评让发言者无言以对。

mores.meaning: n. 道德规范，风俗习惯
mores.note:
Social mores change rapidly from one generation to the next. 社会道德规范在一代人与下一代人之间变化迅速。

Immigrants must adapt to the cultural mores of their new home. 移民必须适应他们新家园的文化风俗习惯。

moribund.meaning: adj. 垂死的，即将消亡的，停滞不前的
moribund.note:
The company tried to revive its moribund sales with a new campaign. 公司试图通过一项新活动来复苏其垂死的销售额。

Traditional manufacturing industries are often seen as moribund. 传统制造业经常被视为日薄西山。

morose.meaning: adj. 郁闷的，脾气坏的，阴郁的
morose.note:
He became silent and morose after losing his job. 失业后，他变得沉默寡言且闷闷不乐。

She sat by the window in a morose mood all afternoon. 她整个下午都以忧郁的心情坐在窗边。

morsel.meaning: n. 一口，少量，美味的小吃
morsel.note:
He ate every last morsel of food on his plate. 他吃光了盘子里的每一小口食物。

She savored every delicious morsel of the gourmet meal. 她细细品味着这顿美食的每一口美味。

mortar.meaning: n. / v. 灰浆，砂浆；用砂浆砌筑
mortar.note:
The mason used mortar to hold the bricks together. 泥瓦匠用砂浆把砖块粘合在一起。

Workers are busy building and mortaring the stone walls. 工人们正忙着用砂浆砌筑石墙。

mortification.note:
To her utter mortification, she tripped on stage. 令她极其羞愧的是，她在舞台上绊倒了。

He felt a deep sense of mortification when his lie was exposed. 当他的谎言被揭穿时，他感到深深的羞耻。

mortify.meaning: v. 使羞辱，使难堪，克制
mortify.note:
She was mortified when her teenage diary was read aloud. 当她十几岁的日记被大声读出来时，她感到极其难堪。

He tried to mortify his desires through strict fasting. 他试图通过严格的禁欲来克制自己的欲望。

mortuary.note:
The bodies were taken to the local hospital mortuary. 尸体被送往当地医院的太平间。

He works as an attendant at a city mortuary. 他在一家城市太平间担任服务员。

mote.note:
Sunbeams illuminated dancing motes of dust in the room. 阳光照亮了房间里跳舞的微小尘埃。

He blinked as a tiny mote flew into his eye. 一粒微小的尘埃飞进他的眼睛，他眨了眨眼。

motility.note:
Cellular motility is essential for immune response. 细胞运动力对免疫反应至关重要。

The doctor tested the patient's intestinal motility. 医生检查了病人的肠道蠕动力。

motley.meaning: adj. 杂色杂居的，混杂的
motley.note:
A motley crew of adventurers set sail for the island. 一群由各色冒险家组成的大杂烩船队起航前往该岛。

The living room was filled with a motley collection of old furniture. 客厅里摆满了各种混搭的旧家具。

mottled.note:
The bird had mottled brown and white feathers. 这只鸟长着褐白相间的斑驳羽毛。

Her skin was mottled with cold as she waited outside. 她在外面等候时，皮肤冻得斑斑点点。

motto.note:
The school's motto is 'Learning for Life'. 这所学校的校训是“终身学习”。

His personal motto was to never give up on a dream. 他的个人座右铭是永不放弃梦想。

mountainous.note:
They hiked through the rugged, mountainous terrain. 他们徒步穿过崎岖多山的地形。

She faced a mountainous pile of paperwork on Monday. 周一她面对着堆积如山的文书工作。

mourn.note:
The whole nation gathered to mourn the loss of the leader. 全国人民聚集在一起哀悼这位领导人的逝世。

She continues to mourn for her beloved pet dog. 她依然在为她心爱的小狗的离去感到悲伤。

mournful.note:
A mournful melody echoed from the empty church. 空荡荡的教堂里回荡着一曲悲伤的旋律。

He cast a mournful glance at his wrecked car. 他悲伤地瞥了一眼自己撞毁的汽车。

muffle.note:
She wrapped a scarf around her neck to muffle the cold wind. 她在脖子上围了一条围巾来挡住寒风。

He tried to muffle his coughs so as not to wake the baby. 他尽量压低咳嗽声，以免吵醒婴儿。

muffled.meaning: adj. 压抑的，模糊的（声音）
muffled.note:
We heard muffled voices coming from the next room. 我们听到隔壁房间传来模糊的说话声。

The thick snow muffled the sound of footsteps outside. 厚厚的积雪减弱了外面脚步的声音。

muffler.note:
He wore a woolen muffler to keep his throat warm. 他戴着一条羊毛围巾来保暖喉咙。

The car needs a new muffler because it is too loud. 这辆车需要一个新的消音器，因为它太吵了。

mulish.meaning: adj. 执拗的，固执的（像骡子一样）
mulish.note:
His mulish stubbornness made it impossible to reach a compromise. 他那固执的牛脾气让人无法达成妥协。

She took a mulish stance and refused to change her mind. 她采取了固执的立场，拒绝改变主意。

multiple.meaning: adj. / n. 多个的，多种的；倍数
multiple.note:
She suffered multiple injuries in the car accident. 她在车祸中受了多处伤。

Twelve is a multiple of three. 十二三的倍数。

multiplicity.note:
The project failed due to a multiplicity of reasons. 该项目因为多种原因而失败。

She faced a multiplicity of choices for her career path. 她面临着职业生涯的多种选择。

mumble.meaning: v. / n. 含糊不清地说，嘟囔
mumble.note:
He tends to mumble when he is feeling nervous. 他紧张时往往会含糊不清地嘟囔。

Speak up clearly instead of mumbling to yourself. 大声清晰地说话，不要自言自语地嘟囔。

mundane.meaning: adj. 世俗的，平淡的，单调的
mundane.note:
She wanted to escape her mundane office routine. 她想摆脱她那世俗且平淡的办公室日常。

He prefers to focus on spiritual rather than mundane matters. 他更喜欢专注于精神层面的事物，而不是世俗的事情。

municipality.note:
The local municipality is responsible for waste collection. 当地市政府负责垃圾收集工作。

Several smaller towns merged into a single large municipality. 几个小镇合并成了一个大型自治市。

munificence.meaning: n. 宽宏大量，慷慨大方
munificence.note:
The museum thanked the donor for his great munificence. 博物馆感谢这位捐赠者的巨大慷慨。

Thanks to the billionaire's munificence, the hospital was built. 多亏了这位亿万富翁的慷慨解囊，这家医院才得以建好。

munition.note:
The factory was converted to produce military munitions. 这家工厂被改造成生产军火弹药。

Troops were heavily supplied with food and munitions. 部队得到了充足的食物和弹药补给。

mural.note:
Artists painted a vibrant colorful mural on the brick wall. 艺术家们在砖墙上画了一幅色彩鲜艳的壁画。

The museum houses ancient murals discovered in caves. 博物馆里收藏着在山洞里发现的古代壁画。

murky.meaning: adj. 黑暗的，浑浊的，充满疑点的
murky.note:
They swam in the murky water of the deep lake. 他们在那座深湖浑浊的水中游泳。

The politician's financial dealings remain murky. 这位政客的财务交易依然充满了疑点。

murmur.meaning: n. / v. 低语，喃喃细语
murmur.note:
A low murmur of conversation filled the quiet library. 低低的交谈声充斥着安静的图书馆。

She murmured a gentle goodnight to her sleeping child. 她向熟睡的孩子轻声说了一声晚安。

muscular.note:
Weightlifting helps to build strong muscular strength. 举重有助于建立强健的肌肉力量。

He works out daily to maintain his muscular physique. 他每天锻炼以保持健美的肌肉体魄。

musicologist.note:
The musicologist analyzed the manuscript of Beethoven's symphony. 这位音乐学家分析了贝多芬交响曲的手稿。

Musicologists study the cultural history and theory of music. 音乐学家研究音乐的文化历史和理论。

musket.note:
Soldiers in the 18th century were equipped with a smoothbore musket. 十八世纪的士兵装备的是滑膛火枪。

He loaded the heavy musket with gunpowder and lead shot. 他往沉重的旧式步枪里装填了火药和铅弹。

muster.meaning: v. / n. 集合，鼓起（勇气等）
muster.note:
The general ordered the troops to muster on the field. 将军命令部队在操场上集合。

She finally mustered the courage to speak up at the meeting. 她终于鼓起勇气在会上发言了。

mute.meaning: adj. / v. / n. 哑的，沉默的；使静音；哑巴
mute.note:
He pressed the remote control button to mute the television. 他按下遥控器按钮将电视机静音。

She was struck mute with astonishment at the news. 听到这个消息，她惊得说不出话来。

muted.meaning: adj. 柔和的，微弱的，声音被减弱的
muted.note:
The room was decorated in soft, muted tones. 房间采用柔和、低调的色调进行装饰。

We heard a muted cheer from the stadium next door. 我们听到隔壁体育场传来的微弱欢呼声。

mutineer.note:
The captain locked the mutineers below deck. 船长把叛乱分子锁在甲板下。

Mutineers took control of the ship after a brief struggle. 叛变者经过一番短暂的挣扎后控制了船只。

mutter.note:
He muttered an apology under his breath and walked away. 他低声嘟囔了一句道歉，然后走开了。

Stop muttering and say what you really think. 别再嘟囔了，说出你真正的想法。

myopia.note:
Her myopia requires her to wear prescription glasses. 她的近视使她必须佩戴处方眼镜。

Corporate myopia can destroy long-term business success. 企业目光短浅会毁掉长期的商业成功。

myopic.meaning: adj. 近视的，目光短浅的
myopic.note:
He wears glasses to correct his myopic vision. 他戴眼镜来矫正近视视力。

The policy was criticized for its myopic focus on short-term profits. 这项政策因目光短浅地专注于短期利润而受到批评。

myriad.meaning: n. / adj. 无数，大量；无数的
myriad.note:
A myriad of stars lit up the clear night sky. 无数的星星照亮了晴朗的夜空。

She faced a myriad of choices when planning her career. 在规划职业生涯时，她面临着无数的选择。

mystic.meaning: n. / adj. 神秘主义者，神秘的
mystic.note:
The old mystic lived in a secluded cave in the mountains. 那位老神秘主义者住在山里一个隐蔽的山洞里。

She felt a mystic connection to nature during her meditation. 在冥想期间，她感受到了与大自然的一种神秘联系。

nadir.meaning: n. 最低点，绝望的谷底
nadir.note:
Their relationship reached its nadir during the winter. 他们的关系在冬天降到了最低谷。

That scandal was the nadir of his political career. 那起丑闻是他政治生涯的最暗淡谷底。

nag.meaning: v. / n. 唠叨，不断挑剔，烦扰
nag.note:
Stop nagging me to clean my room; I will do it later. 别再唠叨我打扫房间了，我待会儿会做。

A persistent toothache continued to nag at him all day. 持续的牙痛一整天都在折磨着他。

narcissism.note:
His obsession with his own appearance borders on extreme narcissism. 他对自已外表的着迷近乎极端的自恋。

Excessive narcissism can damage relationships with others. 过度的自恋会破坏与他人的关系。

narcissist.note:
It is difficult to have a genuine conversation with a narcissist. 与自恋者进行真诚的对话是很困难的。

He is such a narcissist that he only talks about himself. 他是一个十足的自恋狂，满嘴都是他自己。

narcotic.meaning: n. / adj. 麻醉剂，毒品；麻醉的
narcotic.note:
The police seized a large shipment of illegal narcotics. 警察查获了一大批非法毒品。

Certain medical plants have mild narcotic properties. 某些药用植物具有温和的麻醉特性。

nascent.note:
They are investing in nascent technology start-ups. 他们正在投资处于萌芽期的科技初创公司。

A nascent democracy is fragile and requires careful nurturing. 初生的民主政体很脆弱，需要精心呵护。

natal.note:
She returned to her natal village after many years abroad. 在国外多年后，她回到了自己的出生地村庄。

The hospital has a well-equipped neonatal and natal care unit. 这家医院设有装备精良的产科护理单元。

natty.meaning: adj. 整洁时髦的，精巧的
natty.note:
He wore a natty suit and a matching tie to the event. 他穿着一套剪裁时髦的西装和相配的领带去参加活动。

She packed her belongings in a natty little suitcase. 她把行李收拾在一个精巧的小手提箱里。

nausea.note:
The motion of the boat induced a sudden wave of nausea. 船的晃动引起了一阵突如其来的恶心。

The thought of eating greasy food filled her with nausea. 一想到吃油腻的食物她就感到恶心。

nauseate.note:
The foul smell from the garbage can nauseated him. 垃圾桶散发的恶臭让他感到恶心。

His arrogant behavior never failed to nauseate her. 他傲慢的行为总是让她感到十分厌恶。

nautical.note:
The museum displays a fascinating collection of nautical instruments. 博物馆展出了大量迷人的航海仪器。

Sailors measure distances at sea in nautical miles. 水员们用海里来测量海上的距离。

navigate.meaning: v. 导航，航行，应对（复杂情况）
navigate.note:
Sailors used the stars to navigate across the open ocean. 水手们利用星星在茫茫大海上导航。

She managed to navigate the complex bureaucracy smoothly. 她设法顺利地应付了复杂的官僚机构。

naysay.note:
It is easy to naysay new ideas without offering alternatives. 在不提供替代方案的情况下拒绝新想法是很容易的。

He refused to let critics naysay his ambitious project. 他拒绝让批评者否定他雄心勃勃的项目。

needlework.note:
She spent her quiet afternoons doing delicate needlework. 她用安静的下午做精细的针线活。

The exhibition features traditional embroidery and needlework. 展览展出了传统的刺绣和针线工艺。

negate.note:
Hard work can be negated by poor planning and laziness. 努力可能会被糟糕的规划和懒惰所抵消。

Alcohol can negate the effects of certain medications. 酒精会使某些药物的疗效失效。

negation.note:
War is the absolute negation of human rights and progress. 战争是对人权和进步的彻底否定。

Her speech was a flat negation of all the charges. 她的发言是对所有指控的断然否认。

negligence.meaning: n. 失职，疏忽，粗心大意
negligence.note:
The doctor was sued for medical negligence. 这名医生因医疗疏忽而被起诉。

The accident was caused by the driver's sheer negligence. 这起事故是由司机的纯粹疏忽造成的。

negotiable.meaning: adj. 可协商的，可谈判的
negotiable.note:
The starting salary is negotiable based on your experience. 起薪可以根据你的经验进行协商。

Price and delivery terms are strictly negotiable. 价格和交货条款完全可以商量。

neolithic.note:
Archaeologists uncovered Neolithic pottery at the excavation site. 考古学家在发掘现场出土了新石器时代的陶器。

Human societies changed dramatically during the Neolithic period. 人类社会在新石器时代发生了巨变。

neologism.note:
Technology often gives rise to new neologisms. 技术常常会催生出新的词汇。

The dictionary added several internet neologisms this year. 词典今年收录了几个互联网新词。

neophyte.meaning: n. 新手，初学者，新入教者
neophyte.note:
The manual is written with a focus on absolute neophytes. 这本手册编写时的重点是绝对的初学者。

Even a neophyte can learn to use this software quickly. 即使是新手也能快速学会使用这款软件。

nepotism.meaning: n. 裙带关系，任人唯亲
nepotism.note:
He was accused of nepotism for hiring his own brother. 他因雇用自己的兄弟而被指责搞裙带关系。

The company has strict rules against workplace nepotism. 公司有严格的反对职场任人唯亲的规定。

nerve.note:
A toothache often occurs when a nerve is exposed. 当神经外露时经常会发生牙痛。

She finally plucked up the nerve to ask for a promotion. 她终于鼓起勇气要求晋升。

nettle.meaning: n. / v. 荨麻；惹怒，激怒
nettle.note:
Touching wild nettles can cause a painful, itchy rash. 触摸野生荨麻会引起痛苦的、发痒的皮疹。

Her sarcastic comments managed to nettle him deeply. 她尖刻的评论成功地深深激怒了他。

neurology.note:
He specializes in neurology at the university hospital. 他在该大学医院专门研究神经学。

Advances in neurology help us understand brain disorders better. 神经学的进步帮助我们更好地理解脑部疾病。

neutron.note:
An atom's nucleus contains protons and neutrons. 原子的原子核包含质子和中子。

Neutrons have no electrical charge. 中子没有电荷。

nexus.note:
The city acts as a major commercial nexus for the region. 这座城市充当该地区主要的商业枢纽。

They explored the nexus between poverty and crime. 他们探讨了贫困与犯罪之间的联系。

nib.note:
He carefully dipped the metal pen nib into the inkwell. 他小心翼翼地把金属笔尖浸入墨水瓶中。

The fountain pen has a flexible gold nib. 这支钢笔有一个灵活的金笔尖。

nicety.meaning: n. 细微之处，精确，讲究
nicety.note:
He was well-versed in the niceties of diplomatic protocol. 他对外交礼仪的细微之处了如指掌。

There is no need to argue over such legal niceties right now. 现在没必要为这些法律细节争论不休。

nick.meaning: n. / v. 刻痕，小伤口；轻割，刚好赶上
nick.note:
He got a small nick on his chin while shaving. 他刮胡子时下巴上划了一个小伤口。

We arrived just in the nick of time to catch the train. 我们刚刚好及时赶上了火车。

nicotine.note:
Tobacco products contain the addictive chemical nicotine. 烟草产品含有让人上瘾的化学物质尼古丁。

Patches can help smokers reduce their nicotine cravings. 贴片可以帮助吸烟者减少对尼古丁的渴求。

nightmare.note:
He woke up sweating after having a terrifying nightmare. 他做一个可怕的噩梦后出汗醒来。

Dealing with lost luggage at the airport was a travel nightmare. 在机场处理丢失的行李是一场旅行噩梦。

nil.note:
The chances of winning the lottery are virtually nil. 中彩票的几率几乎为零。

Their team won the match with a score of three to nil. 他们队以三比零的比分赢得了比赛。

nip.meaning: v. / n. 咬，掐，夹；寒意，小酌
nip.note:
The playful puppy nipped gently at his shoes. 那只爱玩的小狗轻轻咬了一下他的鞋子。

There was a sharp nip in the air this autumn morning. 这个秋天的清晨空气中有一丝清冷的寒意。

nitpick.note:
Stop nitpicking and look at the overall quality of the report. 别再吹毛求疵了，看看报告的整体质量。

He always finds minor details to nitpick about. 他总是能找出一些微不足道的细节来挑剔。

nocturnal.note:
Owls are nocturnal birds that hunt for food at night. 猫头鹰是夜行性鸟类，在夜间寻找食物。

He prefers nocturnal walks when the streets are quiet. 他更喜欢街道安静时的夜间散步。

noisome.meaning: adj. 恶臭的，令人讨厌的
noisome.note:
A noisome stench came from the blocked drainage pipe. 堵塞的排水管里散发出一股恶臭。

They escaped the noisome conditions of the crowded slums. 他们逃离了拥挤贫民窟里令人作呕的环境。

nomadic.note:
The nomadic tribes move across the desert with their cattle. 游牧部落带着牛群在沙漠中迁移。

She lived a nomadic lifestyle, traveling from country to country. 她过着游牧般的生活，在各个国家之间旅游。

nonchalance.meaning: n. 冷漠，冷淡，漠不关心
nonchalance.note:
He greeted the bad news with surprising nonchalance. 他对这个坏消息表现出了令人惊讶的漠不关心。

Her casual nonchalance masked her inner nervousness. 她随意的冷漠掩盖了她内心的紧张。

noncommittal.meaning: adj. 态度不明朗的，不置可否的
noncommittal.note:
He gave a noncommittal answer when asked about his future plans. 当被问及未来计划时，他给出了一个不置可否的回答。

Her noncommittal smile made it hard to guess her opinion. 她那不置可否的微笑让人很难猜出她的想法。

nonconformist.meaning: n. / adj. 不墨守成规者，标新立异的
nonconformist.note:
He has always been a nonconformist who defies social norms. 他一直是一个蔑视社会规范的标新立异者。

Her nonconformist lifestyle shocked her traditional parents. 她不墨守成规的生活方式震惊了她传统的父母。

nonentity.meaning: n. 无足轻重的人，虚无
nonentity.note:
He felt like a total nonentity in the large corporation. 他在这家大公司里觉得自己完全是个无名小卒。

She rose from being a cultural nonentity to a famous writer. 她从一个文化上的无名小卒崛起为著名作家。

nonflammable.note:
The theater curtains are made of nonflammable materials. 剧院的窗帘是由不易燃的材料制成的。

Ensure that all storage boxes are nonflammable. 确保所有的储物箱都是防火不易燃的。

nonplus.meaning: v. 使窘困，使不知所措
nonplus.note:
She was completely nonplussed by his unexpected question. 她被他突如其来的问题弄得完全不知所措。

The difficult riddle nonplussed even the smartest students. 这个难解的谜题甚至让最聪明的学生都感到困惑。

nonporous.note:
Glass and stainless steel are nonporous materials. 玻璃和不锈钢是无孔的材料。

Use a nonporous sealant to prevent water leaks. 使用不渗透的密封剂来防水泄漏。

nonradioactive.note:
The waste material was tested and found to be nonradioactive. 废料经过检测，发现是没有放射性的。

They used a nonradioactive isotope for the tracer study. 他们在示踪研究中使用了一种无放射性的同位素。

nonsensical.note:
His arguments were completely nonsensical and illogical. 他的论点完全是荒谬且不合逻辑的。

Don't waste time on such nonsensical ideas. 不要把时间浪费在如此荒谬的想法上。

nonthreatening.meaning: adj. 不具威胁性的，友善的
nonthreatening.note:
The stray dog adopted a nonthreatening posture. 那只流浪狗摆出了一种不具威胁性的姿态。

He has a calm and nonthreatening demeanor. 他有一种冷静且不具威胁性的举止。

nonviable.meaning: adj. 无法生存的，不可行的
nonviable.note:
The business plan was declared financially nonviable. 该商业计划被宣布在财务上不可行。

Without water, the seedlings are completely nonviable. 没有水，这些幼苗完全无法存活。

nostalgia.note:
Looking at old family photos filled her with a sense of nostalgia. 看老全家福照片让她心中充满了怀旧之情。

The song evoked memories and strong feelings of nostalgia. 这首歌唤起了回忆和强烈的怀旧感。

nostrum.meaning: n. 秘方，江湖药，无效的对策
nostrum.note:
He tried various medical nostrums to cure his chronic illness. 他尝试了各种民间偏方来治愈他的慢性病。

Politicians often offer simple nostrums for complex economic problems. 政客们常常为复杂的经济问题提出简单的偏方（治标不治本的对策）。

notch.meaning: n. / v. 刻痕，档次；刻凹口
notch.note:
He cut a notch in the wooden stick to mark the day. 他在木棍上刻了一个凹口来做标记。

The hotel is a notch above the others in terms of quality. 这家酒店在质量上比其他酒店高出一个档次。

nourish.note:
Good food and fresh water nourish the body. 好的食物和新鲜的水滋养着身体。

She tried to nourish a love of art in her children. 她试图在孩子们心中培养对艺术的热爱。

nova.meaning: n. 新星（亮度突然增加的恒星）
nova.note:
Astronomers observed a distant nova exploding in the galaxy. 天文学家观察到远方星系中一颗新星在爆发。

The sudden brightness of the nova surprised researchers. 新星突如其来的亮度让研究人员感到惊讶。

novice.note:
This hiking trail is suitable for both experts and novices. 这条远足小径适合专家和新手。

She is still a novice when it comes to cooking gourmet meals. 在烹饪美食方面，她还只是个新手。

nubile.meaning: adj. 到婚嫁年龄的（年轻女子），性感的
nubile.note:
The term describes a young woman of marriageable age. 这个词用来形容到了适婚年龄的年轻女子。

Her appearance in the fashion magazine was widely discussed. 她在时尚杂志上的亮相引发了广泛讨论。

nucleate.meaning: v. / adj. 结核，使成核；有核的
nucleate.note:
Ice crystals begin to nucleate around microscopic particles. 冰晶开始围绕着微小颗粒成核。

Biological cells are typically nucleated structures. 生物细胞通常是含有细胞核的结构。

nucleus.meaning: n. 原子核，核心，细胞核
nucleus.note:
Protons and neutrons form the dense nucleus of an atom. 质子和中子构成了原子稠密的原子核。

A small group of volunteers formed the nucleus of the club. 一小群志愿者构成了俱乐部的核心。

nugatory.meaning: adj. 无效的，无价值的，琐碎的
nugatory.note:
His efforts to change their minds proved entirely nugatory. 他试图改变他们想法的努力证明完全是徒劳的。

Legal loopholes rendered the new regulation nugatory. 法律漏洞使得这项新规定形同虚设。

nullify.note:
The judge moved to nullify the contract due to fraud. 法官因欺诈而采取措施宣布该合同无效。

One mistake can nullify all your previous hard work. 一个错误会抵消你之前所有的努力。

numb.meaning: adj. / v. 麻木的，失去知觉的；使麻木
numb.note:
His fingers were completely numb from the bitter cold. 他的手指被严寒冻得完全麻木了。

Shock can numb a person's emotions after a tragedy. 悲剧过后，震惊可能会使人的情感陷入麻木。

numismatist.meaning: n. 钱币学家，钱币收藏家
numismatist.note:
The rare coin was evaluated by a professional numismatist. 这枚稀有硬币由专业钱币学家进行了评估。

He is a passionate numismatist who collects ancient Roman coins. 他是一位热衷于收集古罗马硬币的钱币收藏家。

oafishness.note:
His constant oafishness embarrassed his friends at the dinner party. 他一贯的粗鲁愚蠢让朋友们在晚宴上感到尴尬。

She could no longer tolerate his boorish oafishness. 她再也无法容忍他那粗俗的呆笨了。

oasis.meaning: n. 绿洲，避难所，舒适的地方
oasis.note:
Palm trees surrounded the cool water of the desert oasis. 棕榈树环绕着沙漠绿洲的清凉池水。

The quiet garden was a peaceful oasis in the noisy city. 安静的花园是喧嚣城市中的一片宁静绿洲。

obdurate.meaning: adj. 固执的，顽固的，冷酷无情的
obdurate.note:
The president remained obdurate in his refusal to compromise. 总统仍然固执地拒绝妥协。

No amount of pleading could soften her obdurate heart. 任何恳求都无法软化她那冷酷顽固的心。

obedient.note:
The obedient dog followed its master without hesitation. 那只听话的狗毫不犹豫地跟着主人。

Children are expected to be obedient to their parents. 人们期望孩子们听父母的话。

obeisance.note:
The knight made a deep obeisance before the queen. 骑士在女王面前深深地行了一个敬礼。

They paid obeisance to the traditions of their ancestors. 他们向祖先的传统表达了敬意。

obituary.note:
She read the obituary column in the morning newspaper to see who died. 她读晨报上的讣告专栏看谁去世了。

A touching obituary was written in honor of the famous scientist. 为纪念这位著名科学家，写了一篇感人的讣告。

obligation.note:
Parents have a legal obligation to feed and educate their children. 父母有法律义务抚养和教育孩子。

I felt a strong obligation to help my friend in trouble. 我感到有一种强烈的责任去帮助陷入困境的朋友。

obligatory.meaning: adj. 强制性的，义务的，必修的
obligatory.note:
Attendance at the safety briefing is strictly obligatory. 参加安全简报会是严格强制性的。

He made the obligatory polite small talk before leaving. 他在离开前进行了例行公事的客套寒暄。

obliging.meaning: adj. 乐于助人的，殷勤的
obliging.note:
The hotel staff were very obliging and carried our bags. 酒店员工非常乐于助人，帮我们提了行李。

He was always obliging when neighbors asked for help. 当邻居寻求帮助时，他总是很热心。

oblique.meaning: adj. 倾斜的，间接的，斜的
oblique.note:
She made an oblique reference to his past mistakes. 她对他的过去错误做出了一个含蓄的间接提及。

The sun cast long, oblique shadows across the grass. 阳光在草地上投下长长的斜影。

obliterate.meaning: v. 彻底消灭，抹去，覆盖
obliterate.note:
The heavy storm threatened to obliterate the coastal village. 这场暴风雨有可能彻底摧毁这个沿海村庄。

He tried to obliterate painful memories from his past. 他试图从过去中抹去痛苦的记忆。

oblivious.meaning: adj. 遗忘的，毫无察觉的
oblivious.note:
She was completely oblivious to the noise around her. 她对周围的噪音毫无察觉。

He walked past me, oblivious of my presence. 他从我身边走过，根本没有注意到我的存在。

obloquy.meaning: n. 谩骂，羞辱，公开谴责
obloquy.note:
The corrupt official faced public obloquy and disgrace. 这名腐败官员面临着公众的谩骂和耻辱。

She endured years of harsh obloquy with great dignity. 她以极大的尊严忍受了多年的严厉非议。

obnoxious.meaning: adj. 讨厌的，可憎的，令人不快的
obnoxious.note:
His obnoxious behavior at the party annoyed everyone. 他在派对上令人讨厌的行为惹恼了所有人。

I couldn't stand his loud and obnoxious laughing. 我无法忍受他那大声而令人厌恶的笑声。

obscurity.meaning: n. 默默无闻，晦涩，隐蔽
obscurity.note:
The poet lived in total obscurity until his work was discovered. 这位诗人一直默默无闻，直到他的作品被发掘。

The legal document was written in confusing obscurity. 这份法律文件写得令人困惑且晦涩难懂。

observatory.note:
Astronomers use the mountain observatory to study distant galaxies. 天文学家利用高山天文台来研究遥远的星系。

The old observatory has a massive rotating dome. 这座老天文台拥有一个巨大的旋转穹顶。

obsessed.note:
He is completely obsessed with playing video games. 他完全沉迷于玩电子游戏。

She became obsessed with maintaining a spotless house. 她变得对保持一尘不染的房子异常执着。

obsolescent.meaning: adj. 荒废的，即将过时的
obsolescent.note:
The company replaced its obsolescent computer system. 公司更换了即将淘汰的计算机系统。

Typewriters have become largely obsolescent in modern offices. 打字机在现代办公室里已经基本过时了。

obstinacy.note:
His sheer obstinacy prevented him from accepting advice. 他纯粹的顽固使他无法接受建议。

She fought the changes with quiet obstinacy. 她以一种安静的执拗对抗着这些变化。

obstreperous.meaning: adj. 喧嚣的，吵闹的，难管束的
obstreperous.note:
The teacher struggled to control the obstreperous children. 老师费力地管束着那些吵闹难训的孩子。

An obstreperous crowd gathered outside the courthouse. 一群喧闹的人群聚集在法院外面。

obstruct.note:
Fallen trees blocked the road and obstructed traffic. 倒下的树木堵塞了道路并阻碍了交通。

He was arrested for trying to obstruct the police investigation. 他因试图妨碍警方调查而被捕。

obstruction.note:
Doctors found an intestinal obstruction that required surgery. 医生发现了一个需要手术的肠梗阻。

The protesters caused a major traffic obstruction in the city center. 抗议者在市中心造成了严重的交通阻塞。

obtainable.meaning: adj. 可得到的，可获得的
obtainable.note:
These rare books are no longer obtainable in local shops. 这些稀有书籍在当地商店里已经买不到了。

Funding for the project is easily obtainable from investors. 该项目的资金很容易从投资者那里获得。

obtuse.meaning: adj. 迟钝的，愚蠢的，钝角的
obtuse.note:
He was either being deliberately obtuse or genuinely confused. 他要么是故意装傻，要么是真的糊涂。

A triangle with an angle greater than ninety degrees is obtuse. 大于九十度的三角形是钝角三角形。

obverse.meaning: n. / adj. 正面，对立面；正面的
obverse.note:
The portrait of the queen is on the obverse of the coin. 女王肖像在该硬币的正面。

Theory is the obverse of practical experience in science. 理论是科学中实践经验的对立统一面。

obviate.note:
Early planning will obviate the need for last-minute rushes. 提前规划将消除最后一分钟仓促行事的需要。

Taking precautions can obviate many potential risks. 采取防范措施可以消除许多潜在风险。

occlude.note:
Fatty deposits can occlude blood vessels and cause heart attacks. 脂肪沉积会堵塞血管并导致心脏病发作。

The upper teeth occlude properly with the lower teeth. 上牙与下牙正确地咬合。

occult.meaning: adj. / n. 神秘的，超自然的；神秘学
occult.note:
She has a strange interest in witchcraft and occult practices. 她对巫术和神秘学实践有一种奇怪的兴趣。

The moon will occult the distant star tonight. 今晚月亮将掩食那颗远处的恒星。

octogenarian.meaning: n. / adj. 八十岁以上的老人；八旬的
octogenarian.note:
The active octogenarian still runs five kilometers every morning. 这位活跃的八旬老人每天早晨仍然跑五公里。

An octogenarian author published her tenth novel. 一位八十岁的老作家出版了她的第十部小说。

ode.note:
The poet wrote a beautiful ode dedicated to autumn. 这位诗人写了一首献给秋天的优美颂诗。

Classical poets often composed odes in honor of heroes. 古典诗人经常为了赞美英雄而创作颂词。

odious.meaning: adj. 可憎的，讨厌的，丑恶的
odious.note:
He committed an odious crime that shocked the community. 他犯下了一起震惊社区的可憎罪行。

She found his sexist remarks truly odious. 她的那些性别歧视言论让她感到十分可恶。

odium.meaning: n. 憎恨，强烈反感，耻辱
odium.note:
The dictator brought national odium upon his regime. 这位独裁者为他的政权招致了全国的唾弃。

He faced the public odium with quiet defiance. 他带着无声的挑衅直面公众的憎恶。

odyssey.meaning: n. 长途艰难的历险，漫长的旅程
odyssey.note:
Their journey home turned into a physical and emotional odyssey. 他们回家的旅程变成了一场身体和情感上的艰难历险。

The novel describes a hero's epic odyssey across the seas. 这部小说描述了一位英雄跨越大海的史诗般旅程。

offbeat.meaning: adj. 另类的，不传统的，离奇的
offbeat.note:
The movie is known for its quirky and offbeat sense of humor. 这部电影以其古怪另类的幽默感而闻名。

She lives in an offbeat cabin deep in the woods. 她住在深山里的一间别具一格的小木屋里。

offence.note:
Driving without a license is a serious legal offence. 无证驾驶是一起严重的法律违法行为。

No offence was intended by my casual remark. 我随口说的一句话绝无冒犯之意。

offend.note:
I didn't mean to offend you with my comments. 我的评论并不是故意要冒犯你的。

People who offend against the law will be punished. 违法犯罪的人将受到惩罚。

offensive.meaning: adj. / n. 冒犯的，无礼的；进攻
offensive.note:
His crude jokes were deeply offensive to many guests. 他粗俗的笑话让许多客人感到非常冒犯。

The military launched a major counter-offensive at dawn. 军队在黎明时分发起了一场重大的反攻。

offhand.meaning: adj. / adv. 即席的，随意的；未经准备地
offhand.note:
Offhand, I cannot remember the exact figures for last year. 凭记忆临时说，我记不清去年的具体数字了。

She made an offhand comment that she later regretted. 她随口说了一句话，后来感到很后悔。

officious.meaning: adj. 多管闲事的，爱发号施令的
officious.note:
The officious security guard kept demanding to see our IDs. 那个爱管闲事的保安一直要求看我们的身份证件。

She disliked the officious manager who interfered in everything. 她不喜欢那个事事干预、爱摆官架子的经理。

offish.note:
He acted rather offish and distant at the gathering. 他在聚会上表现得相当冷淡和疏远。

Why are you being so offish towards me today? 你今天为什么对我这么冷淡？

offset.note:
Higher productivity will offset the rising labor costs. 更高的生产力将抵消不断上升的劳动力成本。

Trees are planted to offset carbon emissions from travel. 人们种植树木来抵消旅行产生的碳排放。

offstage.meaning: adj. / adv. 舞台外的，幕后的
offstage.note:
We could hear the actors talking in the offstage dressing room. 我们能听到演员们在台后化妆间说话的声音。

The real drama happened offstage, away from the audience. 真正的戏剧发生在舞台外，远离观众视线的地方。

ogle.meaning: v. 色迷迷地看，送秋波
ogle.note:
He was told to stop ogling customers at the restaurant. 他被告知不要在餐厅里色迷迷地盯着顾客看。

She felt uncomfortable with people ogling her at the party. 她对派对上人们色迷迷的眼神感到不舒服。

ointment.note:
Apply a soothing antiseptic ointment to the cut. 在伤口上涂抹舒缓的抗菌药膏。

The doctor prescribed a healing ointment for the rash. 医生为皮疹开了一种治疗性软膏。

olfaction.note:
Dogs have a remarkably powerful sense of olfaction. 狗拥有极其敏锐的嗅觉能力。

Olfaction helps humans and animals detect food and danger. 嗅觉帮助人类和动物检测食物和危险。

oligarchy.meaning: n. 寡头政治，寡头集团
oligarchy.note:
The country was ruled by a wealthy and corrupt oligarchy. 这个国家由一个富裕且腐败的寡头集团统治。

Economic reforms aimed to break the power of corporate oligarchies. 经济改革旨在打破企业寡头的权力。

omelet.note:
She made a delicious cheese and mushroom omelet for breakfast. 她做了一个美味的奶酪蘑菇煎蛋卷作为早餐。

Cooking a perfect French omelet requires practice. 烹饪完美的法式煎蛋卷需要练习。

ominous.meaning: adj. 不祥的，预兆不好的
ominous.note:
Dark, ominous clouds gathered on the horizon. 乌云密布、不祥的云层在地平线上聚集。

An ominous silence filled the room after the warning. 警告过后，房间里弥漫着一股不祥的沉默。

omnipotent.meaning: adj. 全能的，无所不能的
omnipotent.note:
Ancient mythology often portrayed gods as omnipotent beings. 古代神话经常把神描绘成全能的存在。

No human ruler is ever truly omnipotent. 没有哪个人类统治者是真正无所不能的。

omnipresent.note:
Smartphones have become omnipresent in modern society. 智能手机在现代社会已经变得无所不在。

The threat of surveillance felt omnipresent. 监视的威胁让人感到无处不在。

omniscient.meaning: adj. 无所不知的，全知的
omniscient.note:
The narrator in the novel is an omniscient observer. 小说中的叙述者是一个全知全能的观察者。

No single human being can claim to be omniscient. 没有哪个人类能自称无所不知。

onerous.meaning: adj. 繁重的，艰难的，负有负担的
onerous.note:
He found the tax regulations extremely onerous to comply with. 他发现遵守这些税收法规极其繁琐。

The manager shouldered the onerous responsibility of restructuring. 经理肩负着重组的繁重责任。

onset.meaning: n. 开始，发作（尤指疾病）
onset.note:
Vaccines can prevent the onset of serious infections. 疫苗可以预防严重感染的爆发。

They hurried home before the onset of the winter storm. 他们在冬季风暴来临之前匆忙赶回家。

opacity.meaning: n. 不透明性，晦涩难懂
opacity.note:
The glass has high opacity to block direct sunlight. 这种玻璃具有高度的不透明性，可以阻挡直射阳光。

Readers complained about the opacity of the legal text. 读者抱怨法律文本晦涩难懂。

opalescence.note:
The pearl gleamed with a soft, natural opalescence. 这颗珍珠散发着柔和自然的珠光。

She admired the gorgeous opalescence of the ancient stone. 她赞叹着那块古老石头华丽的乳白色光泽。

opaque.meaning: adj. 不透明的，晦涩难懂的
opaque.note:
Opaque curtains blocked out the morning light completely. 不透明的窗帘完全挡住了清晨的光线。

The instructions were so opaque that nobody could understand them. 说明书写得太晦涩了，谁也看不懂。

operative.meaning: adj. / n. 起作用的，生效的；特工，技术工人
operative.note:
The new traffic rules become operative starting tomorrow. 新的交通规则从明天开始生效。

Secret agents and undercover operatives gathered intelligence. 特工和卧底特务搜集了情报。

operetta.note:
They attended a performance of a classic Viennese operetta. 他们去观看了一场经典的维也纳小歌剧演出。

An operetta is typically lighter and shorter than a full opera. 小歌剧通常比完整歌剧更轻松、更短小。

opine.note:
He opined that the economy would recover by next year. 他发表意见认为经济将在明年复苏。

Critics opined that the play was a masterpiece. 评论家们认为这出戏是一部杰作。

opportune.note:
His arrival was most opportune; we needed extra help. 他的到来简直太及时了，我们需要额外的帮助。

She chose an opportune moment to present her new proposal. 她选择了一个恰当的时机提出她的新提案。

oppress.note:
The tyrannical regime continued to oppress its citizens. 暴政政权继续压迫其公民。

A sense of gloomy silence oppressed her spirit. 一股阴郁的沉默压抑着她的精神。

opprobrious.meaning: adj. 咒骂的，粗话的，耻辱的
opprobrious.note:
He hurled opprobrious insults at the referee. 他向裁判大声辱骂出粗俗的脏话。

The corrupt leader faced opprobrious public condemnation. 这位腐败的领导人面临着公众带有侮辱性的谴责。

optimist.note:
An optimist always looks on the bright side of life. 乐观主义者总是看到生活光明的一面。

Despite the delays, she remained an optimist about the project. 尽管延误了，她对这个项目仍然保持乐观。

optional.note:
Attending the afternoon workshop is completely optional. 下午的工作坊完全是自愿参加的。

Leather seats are an optional extra when buying this car. 购买这款车时，真皮座椅是可选的额外配置。

oracle.meaning: n. 神谕，先知，权威巨擘
oracle.note:
Ancient Greeks traveled far to consult the Delphi oracle. 古希腊人远道去咨询德尔斐神谕。

He is regarded as an economic oracle by financial investors. 他被金融投资者视为经济领域的权威巨擘。

oration.note:
The politician delivered a stirring oration on freedom. 这位政客发表了一场关于自由的激动人心的演讲。

His graduation oration inspired all the students present. 他的毕业致辞激励了在场的所有学生。

oratorio.meaning: n. 清唱剧（一种大型声乐作品）
oratorio.note:
The choir performed Handel's famous religious oratorio. 合唱团表演了亨德尔著名的宗教清唱剧。

An oratorio is performed without staging, costumes, or action. 清唱剧在表演时没有舞台布景、戏服或动作。

oratory.meaning: n. 演讲术，雄辩术；祈祷室
oratory.note:
He is renowned for his exceptional oratory and persuasive skills. 他以出色的演讲术和说服技巧而闻名。

The private oratory was decorated with beautiful stained glass windows. 这间私人祈祷室装饰着美丽的彩绘玻璃窗。

orchestra.note:
She plays the violin in the city symphony orchestra. 她在城市交响乐团拉小提琴。

The orchestra played a magnificent symphony by Beethoven. 管弦乐队演奏了一首宏伟的贝多芬交响曲。

ordain.meaning: v. 任命（为神职人员）；注定，规定
ordain.note:
He was ordained as a priest last Sunday. 他在上周日被按立为牧师。

Fate seemed to ordain that they should meet again. 命运似乎注定他们会再次相遇。

ordeal.meaning: n. 苦难，严峻考验，折磨
ordeal.note:
The hostages finally survived their harrowing ordeal. 人质们最终挺过了那场令人心碎的折磨。

Going through a divorce can be a painful ordeal. 经历离婚可能是一个痛苦的考验。

ordinance.meaning: n. 法令，条例，行政命令
ordinance.note:
The city council passed a new noise ordinance. 市议会通过了一项新的噪音条例。

Local ordinances prohibit parking in front of fire hydrants. 当地的法令禁止在消防栓前停车。

ordnance.note:
The military base stores heavy ordnance and ammunition. 军事基地储存着重型军械和弹药。

Explosive ordnance disposal teams were called to the scene. 爆炸物处理小组被召集到现场。

ore.note:
The mountains are rich in iron ore and coal. 这些山脉富含铁矿石和煤炭。

 Miners extracted the raw ore from deep underground. 矿工们从地下深处开采出原矿石。

orient.meaning: v. 使适应，使朝向；n. 东方
orient.note:
New students need time to orient themselves to campus life. 新生需要时间来适应校园生活。

 travelers looked toward the orient for new adventures. 旅行者们将目光投向东方以寻找新的冒险。

original.meaning: adj. 最初的，独创的；n. 原件，原作
original.note:
Please keep the original document and send a copy. 请保留原件并发送复印件。

His design for the new product was truly original. 他对新产品的设计真正具有独创性。

ornithologist.note:
The ornithologist studied the migration patterns of rare birds. 这位鸟类学家研究了珍稀鸟类的迁徙模式。

An ornithologist led the expedition into the rainforest. 一位鸟类学家带领探险队进入了热带雨林。

ornithology.note:
She decided to major in ornithology at the university. 她决定在大学主修鸟类学。

His passion for ornithology began when he was a child. 他对鸟类学的热情始于童年。

orthodontics.meaning: n. 正畸学，牙齿矫正学
orthodontics.note:
She specializes in orthodontics to help patients get straight teeth. 她专攻正畸学以帮助患者获得整齐的牙齿。

Advances in orthodontics have made braces much more comfortable. 正畸学的进步使得牙套舒适得多。

oscillate.meaning: v. 振动，摆动；犹豫不决
oscillate.note:
The pendulum began to oscillate back and forth. 摆锤开始来回摆动。

Prices continue to oscillate between high and low levels. 价格持续在高低水平之间波动。

osmosis.note:
Water moves through cell membranes via osmosis. 水通过渗透作用穿过细胞膜。

He learned the language slowly through cultural osmosis. 他通过文化的潜移默化慢慢学会了这门语言。

osseous.note:
The fossil showed well-preserved osseous tissue. 化石显示出保存完好的骨质组织。

Anatomy textbooks describe the osseous system in detail. 解剖学教科书详细描述了骨骼系统。

ossify.note:
Cartilage tends to ossify as a person grows older. 随着人变老，软骨往往会骨化。

 bureaucratic systems can easily ossify over time. 官僚体制随着时间推移很容易僵化。

ostensible.meaning: adj. 表面的，号称的，明面上的
ostensible.note:
His ostensible purpose was to borrow a book, but he really wanted to talk. 他名义上的目的是借本书，但实际上是想聊天。

 The ostensible leader stepped down due to pressure. 表面上的领导在压力下辞职了。

ostentation.note:
He lived a life of luxury without any vulgar ostentation. 他过着奢华的生活，没有任何庸俗的炫耀。

Her wedding reception was criticized for its excessive ostentation. 她的婚礼招待会被批评为过于铺张浪费。

ostracize.meaning: v. 排挤，放逐，把……排除在外
ostracize.note:
He was ostracized by his peers after the scandal. 丑闻发生后，他被同龄人排挤。

Society tends to ostracize those who break core laws. 社会往往会排挤那些违反核心法律的人。

otter.note:
A playful otter swam gracefully in the river. 一只顽皮的水獭在河里优雅地游着。

 Sea otters often float on their backs while eating. 海獭在吃东西时经常仰面漂浮。

oust.meaning: v. 罢免，驱逐，把……赶下台
oust.note:
The rebels managed to oust the dictator from power. 叛军设法将独裁者赶下台。

He was ousted as CEO following poor financial results. 由于糟糕的财务业绩，他被罢免了首席执行官职务。

outgoing.meaning: adj. 外向的，友好的；即将离职的
outgoing.note:
She has an outgoing personality and makes friends easily. 她性格外向，很容易交到朋友。

The outgoing president gave a farewell speech last night. 即将卸任的总统昨晚发表了告别演讲。

outgrowth.meaning: n. 自然发展结果，产物，副产品
outgrowth.note:
This new technology is a direct outgrowth of space research. 这项新技术是太空研究的直接产物。

 Their friendship was an outgrowth of working together for years. 他们的友谊是多年共同工作的结果。

outlandish.meaning: adj. 稀奇古怪的，奇异的，荒诞的
outlandish.note:
She wore an outlandish outfit to the costume party. 她穿了一套古怪的服装去参加化妆舞会。

 He came up with some outlandish ideas for the project. 他为这个项目提出了一些荒诞的想法。

outline.meaning: n. 大纲，轮廓；v. 概述，画轮廓
outline.note:
Please write an outline before you start your essay. 请在写文章前写一份大纲。

The manager outlined the new marketing strategy in detail. 经理详细概述了新的营销战略。

outmaneuver.meaning: v. 以谋略取胜，在策略上胜过
outmaneuver.note:
The smaller company managed to outmaneuver its giant competitor. 这家小公司设法在策略上战胜了它的巨头竞争对手。

He outmaneuvered his opponents during the political debate. 在政治辩论中，他用智谋胜过了对手。

outmoded.note:
That manufacturing method is now completely outmoded. 那种制造方法现在已经彻底过时了。

 We need to replace outmoded equipment in the factory. 我们需要更换工厂里过时的设备。

outset.note:
It was clear from the outset that the project would succeed. 从一开始就很清楚，这个项目会成功。

 We faced several technical challenges at the outset. 我们在开始时面临了几个技术挑战。

outshine.note:
Her brilliant performance managed to outshine everyone else. 她出色的表现胜过了在场的每一个人。

The newcomer's talent completely outshined the veterans. 这名新人的才华完全盖过了老将。

outskirts.note:
They live in a quiet neighborhood on the outskirts of London. 他们住在伦敦市郊的一个安静社区。

The factory is located on the industrial outskirts of the city. 这家工厂位于城市的工业郊区。

outspoken.meaning: adj. 直言不讳的，坦诚的
outspoken.note:
She is an outspoken critic of government corruption. 她是政府腐败的直言不讳的批评者。

He was always outspoken about his political beliefs. 他对自己的政治信仰一直直言不讳。

outwit.note:
The clever detective managed to outwit the criminal masterminds. 聪明的侦探设法智胜了犯罪头目。

Animals often outwit predators by hiding in plain sight. 动物经常通过在显眼处隐藏来智胜捕食者。

ovation.note:
The concert ended with a standing ovation from the audience. 音乐会在观众全体起立的热烈掌声中结束。

The speaker received a thunderous ovation after his speech. 演讲者在演讲结束后受到了雷鸣般的欢呼。

overbearing.meaning: adj. 傲慢的，专横的，盛气凌人的
overbearing.note:
His overbearing attitude made it difficult for colleagues to work with him. 他傲慢的态度让同事很难与他合作。

She grew tired of her boss's overbearing management style. 她对老板专横的管理风格感到厌倦。

overdose.meaning: n. / v. 药物过量，过量服用
overdose.note:
He was rushed to the hospital after taking an accidental overdose. 他因意外药物过量被紧急送往医院。

Never overdose on vitamins, as it can be harmful to health. 切勿过量服用维生素，因为这对健康有害。

overexposure.meaning: n. 过度曝光，过度抛头露面
overexposure.note:
The photograph was ruined due to overexposure to bright light. 这张照片因为强光过度曝光而毁了。

The celebrity suffered from media overexposure. 这位名人饱受媒体过度曝光之苦。

overflow.meaning: v. 泛滥，溢出；n. 溢出物
overflow.note:
The heavy rain caused the river to overflow its banks. 大雨导致河水漫过堤岸。

There was an overflow of emotion when they finally reunited. 当他们最终团聚时，情感如潮水般涌出。

overlap.meaning: v. / n. 重叠，部分相交
overlap.note:
Our schedules overlap on Tuesday afternoons, so we can meet then. 我们的日程在周二下午重叠，所以我们那时可以见面。

There is a slight overlap between their job responsibilities. 他们的工作职责有轻微的重叠。

overpowering.meaning: adj. 压倒性的，不可抗拒的
overpowering.note:
The smell of strong perfume was overpowering in the small room. 小房间里浓烈香水的气味令人窒息。

She felt an overpowering urge to laugh during the serious meeting. 在严肃的会议上，她感到有一种无法抗拒的冲动想笑。

overreach.meaning: v. 好高骛远而失败，过分延伸
overreach.note:
The company tried to expand too quickly and overreached itself. 这家公司试图扩张得太快，结果好高骛远导致了失败。

Politicians who overreach often lose public support. 好高骛的政客往往会失去公众支持。

override.note:
The committee decided to override the director's veto. 委员会决定推翻导演的否决权。

Safety concerns must override all other considerations in this project. 在这个项目中，安全问题必须优先于所有其他考量。

overriding.meaning: adj. 最重要的，首要的，支配一切的
overriding.note:
Our overriding concern is the safety of our employees. 我们首要关切的是员工的安全。

Quality is the overriding factor in choosing our suppliers. 质量是选择供应商时最重要的因素。

overrule.note:
The judge chose to overrule the defense attorney's objection. 法官选择驳回辩护律师的反对意见。

The board has the power to overrule managerial decisions. 董事会有权驳回管理层的决定。

overshadow.meaning: v. 使失色，使黯然失色，遮蔽
overshadow.note:
Her success in the exam managed to overshadow her brother's achievements. 她在考试中的成功使她哥哥的成就黯然失色。

Dark clouds began to overshadow the landscape. 乌云开始遮蔽了风景。

overstate.note:
I don't think I can overstate the importance of this discovery. 我认为怎么强调这一发现的重要性都不为过。

He tended to overstate his role in the successful project. 他往往会夸自己在成功项目中的作用。

overt.meaning: adj. 公然的，明显的，不掩饰的
overt.note:
There was no overt hostility between the two rival groups. 两个敌对集团之间没有公开的敌意。

She showed overt signs of boredom during the long lecture. 在冗长的演讲中，她表现出明显的厌烦迹象。

overthrow.meaning: v. / n. 推翻，打倒，颠覆
overthrow.note:
The citizens staged a revolution to overthrow the cruel regime. 公民们发动了一场革命来推翻残酷的政权。

The military coup resulted in the overthrow of the government. 军事政变导致了政府的推翻。

overture.meaning: n. 序曲，建议，沟通尝试
overture.note:
The orchestra played a lively overture before the opera began. 歌剧开始前，乐队演奏了一首欢快的序曲。

Both countries made peace overtures after years of conflict. 经过多年的冲突，两国都做出了和平的姿态。

overwrought.meaning: adj. 情绪激动的，过度紧张的，过分雕琢的
overwrought.note:
She was too overwrought to sleep after hearing the bad news. 听到这个坏消息后，她情绪过度激动无法入睡。

The poem's style felt a little too ornate and overwrought. 这首诗的风格感觉有点过于华丽和过分雕琢了。

oxidize.note:
Iron tends to oxidize when exposed to moisture and air. 铁暴露在潮湿和空气中时往往会氧化。

The chemical process will quickly oxidize the metal surface. 这个化学过程会迅速氧化金属表面。

pacifist.meaning: n. 和平主义者，反战主义者
pacifist.note:
As a committed pacifist, he refused to join the military. 作为一名坚定的和平主义者，他拒绝加入军队。

Pacifists advocate for peaceful resolution of all international conflicts. 和平主义者主张通过和平方式解决所有国际冲突。

pacify.note:
The mother tried to pacify the crying baby with a toy. 母亲试图用玩具安抚哭泣的婴儿。

Police forces were sent to pacify the restless crowd. 警方被派去平定焦躁不安的人群。

packed.note:
The subway train was completely packed during rush hour. 高峰期时地铁列车被挤得满满当当。

We packed our bags and prepared for the trip. 我们收拾好行李，为旅行做好了准备。

pact.note:
The two nations signed a non-aggression pact. 两国签署了一项互不侵犯条约。

They made a secret pact to support each other in the election. 他们在选举中结成了互相支持的秘密同盟。

padding.meaning: n. 衬垫，填料，（文章等的）废话
padding.note:
The jacket has extra padding to keep you warm in winter. 这件夹克有额外的衬垫，能在冬天保暖。

The teacher told him to remove the unnecessary padding from his essay. 老师告诉他删掉文章中不必要的废话。

paean.note:
The book is a paean to the beauty of the countryside. 这本书是对乡村美景的一曲赞歌。

 Critics wrote glowing paeans to her theatrical performance. 评论家们对她的戏剧表演写下了热烈的赞词。

pagan.meaning: n. 异教徒；adj. 异教的
pagan.note:
Ancient tribes practiced various pagan rituals to worship nature. 古代部落实行各种异教仪式来崇拜自然。

He studied the history of pagan beliefs in Europe. 他研究了欧洲异教信仰的历史。

pageant.meaning: n. 盛会，游行，选美比赛
pageant.note:
The town celebrated its anniversary with a historical pageant. 这个小镇通过一场历史盛装游行来庆祝周年纪念。

She won first place in the national beauty pageant. 她在全国选美比赛中获得了第一名。

painkiller.note:
She took a strong painkiller to relieve her headache. 她吃了一剂强效止痛药来缓解头痛。

Doctors often prescribe painkillers for patients recovering from surgery. 医生经常给术后恢复的患者开止痛药。

painstaking.meaning: adj. 煞费苦心的，辛勤细致的
painstaking.note:
Restoring the ancient painting required painstaking effort. 修复这幅古代油画需要煞费苦心的努力。

After painstaking research, the scientist published his findings. 经过细致的研究，这位科学家发表了他的发现。

palate.note:
Fine wine and gourmet food appeal to a sophisticated palate. 美酒和美食吸引着高雅的味蕾。

The roof of the mouth is anatomically known as the hard palate. 口腔顶部在解剖学上被称为硬腭。

palatial.meaning: adj. 宏伟的，宫殿般的，富丽堂皇的
palatial.note:
They lived in a palatial estate with sprawling gardens. 他们住在一个带有广阔花园的宫殿般的庄园里。

The hotel features palatial suites overlooking the ocean. 这家酒店设有俯瞰大海的豪华套房。

paleolithic.note:
Archaeologists uncovered paleolithic tools in the cave. 考古学家在洞穴中发现了旧石器时代的工具。

Paleolithic humans relied heavily on hunting and gathering. 旧石器时代的人类严重依赖狩猎和采集。

paleontology.note:
He has a deep interest in paleontology and dinosaur fossils. 他对古生物学和恐龙化石有着浓厚的兴趣。

Paleontology helps scientists understand the history of life on Earth. 古生物学帮助科学家了解地球上的生命史。

palette.note:
The artist mixed colors on his wooden palette. 艺术家在他的木制调色板上调配颜色。

The autumn forest offers a rich palette of reds and golds. 秋天的森林提供了丰富的红金色调。

pall.meaning: n. 棺衣，阴影；v. 令人厌烦，失去吸引力
pall.note:
A heavy pall of smoke hung over the burning city. 一层浓重的烟雾阴影笼罩着燃烧的城市。

The novelty of the video game began to pall after a few days. 几天后，这款电子游戏的新鲜感开始减退。

palliate.meaning: v. 减轻（痛苦），缓和，掩饰（罪行）
palliate.note:
New medicine can help palliate the symptoms of the disease. 新药可以帮助减轻这种疾病的症状。

No excuses can palliate such a serious mistake. 任何借口都无法掩饰如此严重的错误。

palliative.meaning: n. 缓解剂，缓和药；adj. 治标不治本的
palliative.note:
The treatment is purely palliative and does not cure the illness. 这种治疗纯粹是治标不治本的，并不能治愈疾病。

Hospice care focuses on palliative care for terminal patients. 临终关怀侧重于晚期患者的纾缓治疗。

pallid.meaning: adj. 苍白的，没有生气的
pallid.note:
He looked weak and pallid after recovering from the flu. 流感康复后，他看起来虚弱而苍白。

The argument lacked impact and felt rather pallid. 这个论点缺乏冲击力，感觉相当苍白无力。

palmy.meaning: adj. 繁荣的，昌盛的，长满棕榈的
palmy.note:
They reminisced about the palmy days of their youth. 他们回忆起他们年轻时繁荣昌盛的日子。

The tropical island is known for its palmy beaches. 这个热带岛屿以其长满棕榈树的海滩而闻名。

palpable.meaning: adj. 触得到的，明显的，可感知的
palpable.note:
The tension in the courtroom was almost palpable. 法庭内的紧张气氛几乎清晰可感。

There was a palpable sense of relief when the exam was over. 考试结束时，有一种明显的轻松感。

palpitate.note:
Her heart began to palpitate with fear in the dark. 在黑暗中，她的心因为恐惧开始剧烈跳动。

He felt his temples palpitate from exhaustion. 他感到自己的太阳穴因为精疲力竭而搏动。

palter.meaning: v. 支吾，说模棱两可的话，讨价还价
palter.note:
Do not palter with me; give me a straight answer. 不要跟我支吾其词；给我一个直接的回答。

He paltered with the truth during the cross-examination. 在盘问过程中，他对真相闪烁其词。

paltry.meaning: adj. 微不足道的，琐碎的，不值一提的
paltry.note:
He was offered a paltry sum for his hard work. 他的辛勤工作只得到了微薄的报酬。

We shouldn't argue over such paltry details. 我们不应该为这些琐碎的细节争吵。

pamphlet.note:
She handed out informative pamphlets about recycling. 她散发了关于回收利用的有益小册子。

The museum provides a helpful guide pamphlet at the entrance. 博物馆在入口处提供了一份有用的指南小册子。

panacea.note:
Technology is not a panacea for all education problems. 技术并非解决所有教育问题的万灵药。

There is no simple panacea to cure the economic crisis. 没有什么简单的万全之策能治愈经济危机。

panache.meaning: n. 潇洒，神气十足，羽饰
panache.note:
He handled the difficult negotiation with great panache. 他以极大的潇洒处理了这次艰难的谈判。

She performed the difficult dance routine with style and panache. 她以风格和潇洒完成了高难度的舞蹈动作。

pancreas.note:
The pancreas produces insulin to regulate blood sugar levels. 胰腺产生胰岛素以调节血糖水平。

Diseases of the pancreas can be very serious. 胰腺疾病可能非常严重。

pandemonium.note:
Pandemonium broke out when the lights suddenly went out. 灯光突然熄灭时，现场一片混乱。

There was absolute pandemonium in the stadium after the winning goal. 进球后，体育场内一片大乱。

pander.meaning: v. 迎合，投合（不良嗜好等）
pander.note:
Some media outlets pander to public curiosity. 一些媒体迎合公众的好奇心。

 Politicians should not pander to voters with empty promises. 政客不应该用空洞的承诺来迎合选民。

panegyric.note:
The professor delivered a moving panegyric in honor of the retiring dean. 教授发表了一篇感人的颂词，以向退休的院长致敬。

The book reads like a panegyric to modern technology. 这本书读起来像是对现代技术的赞歌。

panel.meaning: n. 专家组，控制面板，镶板
panel.note:
A panel of judges will evaluate the art contest entries. 专家评委团将评估艺术比赛的参赛作品。

Check the control panel for any warning lights. 检查控制面板是否有任何警告灯。

pang.meaning: n. 一阵剧痛，痛苦的紧缩感（如饥饿、悔恨等）
pang.note:
She felt a sudden pang of guilt after telling the lie. 说完谎后，她感到一阵内疚。

He felt a pang of hunger as he walked past the bakery. 走过面包店时，他感到一阵饥饿感。

panic.note:
Try not to panic when you face unexpected challenges. 面对意想不到的挑战时，尽量不要恐慌。

There was a brief moment of panic during the earthquake. 地震期间曾有过短暂的恐慌时刻。

panorama.note:
The hotel room offered a stunning panorama of the ocean. 酒店房间提供了令人惊叹的海景全景。

The book presents a vast panorama of European history. 这本书展示了欧洲历史的宏伟全貌。

panther.note:
A black panther silently stalked its prey through the jungle. 一只黑豹在丛林中静静地尾随猎物。

We caught a glimpse of a panther resting in the tree branches. 我们瞥见一只黑豹在树枝上休息。

pantomime.note:
The children enjoyed the funny Christmas pantomime at the theater. 孩子们很喜欢剧院里有趣的圣诞哑剧。

He used a pantomime to explain what had happened. 他用手势来解释发生了什么。

pantry.meaning: n. 食品储藏室，餐具室
pantry.note:
She stored canned goods and dry food in the pantry. 她把罐头食品和干粮储存在食品储藏室里。

We need to stock up the pantry before the weekend. 我们需要在周末前把储藏室填满。

papyrus.note:
Ancient Egyptians wrote important documents on papyrus. 古埃及人在纸莎草纸上书写重要文件。

Papyrus plants grow along the banks of the River Nile. 纸莎草植物生长在尼罗河岸边。

parable.note:
The teacher told a short parable to illustrate a moral lesson. 老师讲了一个简短的寓言来阐明一个道德教训。

Jesus often taught his followers through parables. 耶稣经常通过寓言来教导他的追随者。

paragon.note:
She was considered a paragon of virtue in her community. 她在社区里被视为美德的典范。

No one is a complete paragon; everyone makes mistakes. 没有人是完美的典范；每个人都会犯错。

parallelism.meaning: n. 平行，相似处，排比法
parallelism.note:
There is a striking parallelism between the two historical events. 这两个历史事件之间存在着惊人的相似性。

The writer used rhetorical parallelism to emphasize his point. 作者运用修辞上的排比法来强调他的观点。

paramount.meaning: adj. 至高无上的，最重要的
paramount.note:
Patient safety is of paramount importance in our hospital. 患者的安全在我们医院至关重要。

Getting the project finished on time is our paramount goal. 按时完成项目是我们首要的目标。

paranoia.meaning: n. 偏执狂，妄想狂，多疑症
paranoia.note:
His stress at work eventually led to mild paranoia. 他在工作中的压力最终导致了轻度的多疑症。

Political paranoia can sometimes drive conflicts between nations. 政治偏执有时会引发国家之间的冲突。

paranoid.note:
He became paranoid that everyone was talking behind his back. 他变得很多疑，觉得每个人都在背后议论他。

It sounds paranoid, but I feel like someone is watching me. 听起来可能有点妄想，但我觉得有人在监视我。

parasite.meaning: n. 寄生虫，寄生生物，寄生者
parasite.note:
Fleas and ticks are common parasites that affect dogs. 跳蚤和壁虱是影响狗的常见寄生虫。

He has been living like a parasite off his parents for years. 他多年来一直像个寄生虫一样靠父母养活。

parch.note:
The blazing sun parched the fields until the crops died. 烈日将田地烤干，直到庄稼枯死。

The long hike left her throat parched with thirst. 漫长的徒步旅行让她的喉咙干渴难耐。

pare.meaning: v. 削皮，修剪，逐渐削减
pare.note:
She sat at the table to pare apples for the pie. 她坐在桌旁为馅饼削苹果皮。

The company needs to pare down its operating expenses. 这家公司需要逐步削减其运营开支。

pariah.meaning: n. 被社会弃绝的人，流浪者
pariah.note:
After the embezzlement scheme, he became a social pariah. 挪用公款计划败露后，他成了社会的弃儿。

The whistleblower was treated like a pariah by his former colleagues. 告密者被他以前的同事像个被放逐者一样对待。

parka.meaning: n. 带风帽的防寒大衣，派克大衣
parka.note:
She zipped up her heavy parka to brave the freezing wind. 她拉紧厚重的防寒大衣，顶着冰冷的寒风。

Arctic explorers rely on warm parkas to survive the cold. 北极探险家依靠温暖的派克大衣在寒冷中生存。

parlance.meaning: n. 说法，术语，特定用语
parlance.note:
In medical parlance, the condition is known as hypertension. 在医学术语中，这种状况被称为高血压。

Legal parlance can be very difficult for laypeople to understand. 法律术语对外行人来说很难理解。

parody.meaning: n. / v. 拙劣的模仿，滑稽模仿
parody.note:
The film is a hilarious parody of classic spy movies. 这部电影对经典间谍电影进行了搞笑的滑稽模仿。

The comedian parodied the famous politician's speech. 喜剧演员模仿了这位著名政客的演讲。

paroxysm.note:
She was seized by a sudden paroxysm of coughing. 她被一阵突如其来的咳嗽发作击中。

He laughed in a paroxysm of delight when he heard the good news. 听到这个好消息时，他狂喜得爆发出一阵大笑。

parquet.note:
The ballroom features a beautifully polished parquet floor. 舞厅铺有打磨精美的镶木地板。

They laid down new parquet in the living room. 他们在客厅铺设了新的镶木地板。

parse.meaning: v. 解析，分析（句子成分或代码）
parse.note:
The compiler needs to parse the code before running it. 编译器在运行代码之前需要对其进行解析。

Students were asked to parse the complex sentence in grammar class. 学生们被要求在语法课上分析这个复杂的句子。

parsimony.note:
His financial parsimony prevented him from enjoying life. 他的经济吝啬使他无法享受生活。

The foundation was criticized for its parsimony toward charitable projects. 该基金会被批评对慈善项目过于吝啬。

partiality.note:
The referee was accused of partiality toward the home team. 裁判被指控偏袒主队。

She has a well-known partiality for chocolate ice cream. 她对巧克力冰淇淋有众所周知的偏爱。

particular.meaning: adj. 特定的，挑剔的；n. 详情，细节
particular.note:
Is there any particular book you are looking for? 你在找某本特定的书吗？

He is very particular about what he eats for breakfast. 他对早餐吃什么非常挑剔。

particularize.note:
She asked the lawyer to particularize the charges against her. 她要求律师详述对她的指控。

The report fails to particularize the specific causes of the failure. 该报告未能详述失败的具体原因。

partisan.meaning: n. 游击队员；adj. 党派性强的，偏袒的
partisan.note:
The two political parties remain locked in fierce partisan debate. 两大政党仍然陷入激烈的党派辩论中。

Brave partisans fought against the invading army in the mountains. 勇敢的游击队员在山里与侵略军作战。

partition.meaning: n. 隔板，分割，划分；v. 分隔
partition.note:
A glass partition separated the office into two rooms. 一扇玻璃隔板将办公室分成了两个房间。

They decided to partition the large garden into separate plots. 他们决定把大花园划分为几个独立的块。

passionate.meaning: adj. 充满激情的，热烈的
passionate.note:
She delivered a passionate speech about environmental protection. 她发表了一篇关于环境保护的激情演讲。

He is a passionate supporter of local arts and culture. 他是当地艺术和文化的热情支持者。

pasteurize.meaning: v. 巴氏消毒，高温杀菌
pasteurize.note:
Milk must be pasteurized to kill harmful bacteria before sale. 牛奶在出售前必须经过巴氏消毒以杀死有害细菌。

Louis Pasteur invented the process used to pasteurize wine and milk. 路易·巴斯德发明了用于葡萄酒和牛奶巴氏消毒的工艺。

pastiche.note:
The novel is a pastiche of various 19th-century detective stories. 这部小说是各种19世纪侦探故事的大杂烩。

The architectural style of the building is a pastiche of several periods. 这栋建筑的建筑风格是几个时期的综合体。

pastoral.meaning: adj. 田园的，乡村的，牧师的
pastoral.note:
They enjoy a quiet pastoral life in the countryside. 他们在乡村享受着平静的田园生活。

The bishop gave a warm pastoral message to the congregation. 主教向会众发表了温馨的牧民致辞。

pastry.note:
She bought a fresh fruit pastry from the local bakery. 她从当地面包店买了一块新鲜水果糕点。

The chef rolled out the pastry for the apple pie. 主厨把做苹果馅饼的面团擀平了。

patch.meaning: n. 补丁，小块土地；v. 修补
patch.note:
She sewed a colorful patch onto the knee of her jeans. 她在牛仔裤的膝盖处缝了一个彩色的补丁。

They grow vegetables in a small patch behind the house. 他们在房子后面的一小块地上种蔬菜。

pathological.note:
The doctor ordered a pathological examination of the tissue sample. 医生下令对组织样本进行病理检查。

He has a pathological need to lie about trivial matters. 他有一种对琐事撒谎的病态需求。

pathology.note:
She studies cellular pathology at the medical university. 她在医科大学研究细胞病理学。

The psychiatrist examined the psychological pathology behind the crime. 精神病学家检查了犯罪背后的心理病态。

patina.meaning: n. 包浆，铜绿，（表面呈现的）光泽或气质
patina.note:
The antique desk had a beautiful dark patina from years of use. 这张古董书桌由于多年使用呈现出美丽深沉的包浆。

Years of success gave him a patina of worldly confidence. 多年的成功赋予了他一种饱经世故的自信气质。

patrician.meaning: n. 贵族，门阀；adj. 贵族的
patrician.note:
He spoke with the quiet authority of a Roman patrician. 他带着罗马贵族那种平静的权威感说话。

She came from an old patrician family with deep political roots. 她来自一个有着深厚政治根基的古老贵族家庭。

patrimony.meaning: n. 祖传财产，遗产，文化遗产
patrimony.note:
He inherited a vast patrimony of land and houses from his father. 他从父亲那里继承了大量的土地和房屋遗产。

We must protect our cultural patrimony for future generations. 我们必须为后代保护我们的文化遗产。

patriot.note:
He was hailed as a true patriot who fought for his country's freedom. 他被誉为一位为国家自由而战的真正爱国者。

True patriots put the welfare of the people above political games. 真正的爱国者将人民的福祉置于政治游戏之上。

patriotism.meaning: n. 爱国主义，爱国精神
patriotism.note:
The national anthem is a powerful symbol of patriotism. 国歌是爱国主义的有力象征。

His speech inspired a deep sense of patriotism among the citizens. 他的演讲激发了公民内心深处的爱国精神。

patronage.note:
The arts center relies heavily on corporate patronage. 艺术中心严重依赖企业的赞助。

We thank you for your continued patronage of our restaurant. 感谢您一直以来对我们餐厅的光顾。

patronize.meaning: v. 态度居高临下地对待，光顾（商店等）
patronize.note:
Don't patronize me; I understand the situation just fine. 别用居高临下的态度对我说；我很清楚局势。

Many local residents patronize the small farmers' market. 许多当地居民光顾这个小型农贸市场。

paucity.note:
There is a paucity of reliable data on this subject. 关于这个主题，可靠的数据很少。

The investigation failed due to a paucity of evidence. 由于缺乏证据，调查失败了。

paunchy.meaning: adj. 有大肚子的，挺着啤酒肚的
paunchy.note:
The middle-aged man looked slightly paunchy in his suit. 这位中年男子穿着西装看起来有点挺着大肚子。

He grew a bit paunchy after years of desk work. 经过多年的办公室工作，他长出了一个小肚子。

pauper.note:
He died a pauper, having lost all his wealth in bad investments. 他因投资失败失去了所有财富，死时是个穷光蛋。

The classic story tells of a prince and a pauper who switch lives. 这个经典故事讲述了一个王子和一个赤贫者互换生活的故事。

pecan.meaning: n. 美洲山核桃，山核桃树
pecan.note:
She baked a delicious pecan pie for Thanksgiving dinner. 她为感恩节晚宴烤了一个美味的山核桃派。

Pecan trees thrive in the warm climate of the southern states. 山核桃树在南方各国的温暖气候中生长茂盛。

peccadillo.meaning: n. 轻罪，小过失，小瑕疵
peccadillo.note:
We should forgive his minor peccadilloes and look at his overall work. 我们应该原谅他的小过失，看看他整体的工作。

She treated her husband's occasional forgetfulness as a mere peccadillo. 她把丈夫偶尔的健忘当作一种无伤大雅的小缺点。

peck.note:
The chicken pecked at the seeds scattered on the ground. 鸡啄食着撒在地上的种子。

She gave her grandmother a quick peck on the cheek. 她飞快地在奶奶的脸颊上亲了一下。

pedagogue.meaning: n. 教育工作者，学究式的教师
pedagogue.note:
The strict pedagogue insisted on absolute silence in the classroom. 这位严厉的教师坚持课堂上绝对安静。

Modern teachers reject old-fashioned pedagogy in favor of interactive learning. 现代教师摒弃了陈旧的教学法，转而支持互动学习。

pedestal.note:
The bronze statue stood proudly on a stone pedestal. 青铜雕像骄傲地立在石质底座上。

She tends to put her heroes on a pedestal. 她往往把她的偶像奉若神明。

pedestrian.meaning: n. 行人；adj. 行人的，乏味的
pedestrian.note:
Many pedestrians were walking along the busy city street. 许多行人在繁忙的城市街道上行走。

The movie had a rather pedestrian plot and predictable ending. 这部电影的情节相当乏味，结局也可以预测。

pediatrics.note:
She decided to specialize in pediatrics after graduating from medical school. 医学院毕业后，她决定专攻儿科学。

The hospital opened a new wing dedicated to pediatrics. 医院新开了一个专科儿科病房。

peel.meaning: v. 削皮，剥皮；n. 果皮
peel.note:
He used a knife to peel the orange before eating it. 他在吃橙子前用刀把皮削掉。

Candied orange peel is often used in baking fruit cakes. 糖渍橙皮经常用于烘焙水果蛋糕。

peer.meaning: n. 同龄人，同辈；v. 仔细看，凝视
peer.note:
Teenagers often feel pressured to conform to their peers. 青少年经常感到需要顺从同龄人的压力。

She peered through the dark window to see who was outside. 她透过黑暗的窗户仔细看外面是谁。

peerless.meaning: adj. 无双的，无与伦比的
peerless.note:
The museum houses a peerless collection of ancient art. 博物馆里收藏着无与伦比的古代艺术品。

Her peerless singing voice captivated the audience. 她无与伦比的歌声倾倒了全场观众。

peeve.meaning: v. 使烦恼，惹生气；n. 讨厌的事
peeve.note:
One of my biggest pet peeves is people talking loudly in cinemas. 我最讨厌的事情之一就是在电影院里大声说话的人。

Loud chewing noises really peeve him. 咀嚼的声音很大真的很让他烦恼。

peevish.meaning: adj. 易怒的，脾气坏的，乖戾的
peevish.note:
The tired child became peevish and started to cry. 疲惫的孩子变得脾气暴躁，开始哭闹。

She was in a peevish mood all morning. 她一整个上午心情都很烦躁。

pejorative.note:
The word was used in a pejorative sense by the critic. 这个词被评论家以贬义的方式使用。

Avoid using pejorative language in a professional workplace. 在职业场所避免使用带贬义的语言。

pelf.meaning: n. 钱财，不义之财（贬义）
pelf.note:
He devoted his entire life to the pursuit of ill-gotten pelf. 他一生都在追求来路不正的钱财。

They cared more about amassing pelf than ethical principles. 他们关心的积聚金钱胜过关切道德原则。

pell.meaning: n. 羊皮纸卷，文献（古语）
pell.note:
Historical records were often inscribed on ancient pells. 历史记录通常刻写在古老的羊皮纸卷上。

The library preserves valuable medieval pells. 图书馆保存着珍贵的中世纪文献。

penance.note:
He did penance for his past mistakes by helping the poor. 他通过帮助穷人为自己过去的错误赎罪。

She offered her apology as a token of penance. 她把道歉作为赎罪的象征。

penchant.note:
She has a penchant for collecting antique porcelain. 她有收集古董瓷器的爱好。

His penchant for risky investments eventually cost him dearly. 他对高风险投资的嗜好最终让他付出了沉重代价。

pending.meaning: adj. 待决定的，未决的；prep. 在……期间，直到
pending.note:
Her promotion is still pending official approval. 她的晋升还在等待官方批准。

He was released on bail pending his trial. 他在受审前获保释候审。

pendulum.meaning: n. 钟摆，（局势等）摇摆不定的态势
pendulum.note:
The heavy pendulum swung steadily back and forth in the clock. 钟里沉重的钟摆稳定地来回摆动。

Political opinions can act like a pendulum swinging between extremes. 政治观点就像在极端的两端之间摇摆的钟摆。

penetrate.note:
Sunlight failed to penetrate the thick forest canopy. 阳光无法穿透茂密的森林树冠。
