It is difficult to penetrate his quiet exterior. 很难洞察他平静的外表下想什么。

penicillin.note:
Alexander Fleming discovered penicillin in 1928. 亚历山大·弗莱明于1928年发现了青霉素。

She is unfortunately allergic to penicillin and related antibiotics. 她不幸对青霉素及相关抗生素过敏。

peninsula.note:
They drove down the scenic coastal road of the peninsula. 他们沿着半岛风景优美的沿海公路开车。

Italy is a boot-shaped peninsula extending into the Mediterranean Sea. 意大利是一个靴子形状的半岛，延伸到地中海中。

penitent.meaning: adj. 悔过的，忏悔的；n. 忏悔者
penitent.note:
The young man looked truly penitent for what he had done. 这个年轻人在为自己所做的事感到真正忏悔。

He sat quietly in the church like a humbled penitent. 他像一个卑微的忏悔者一样静静地坐在教堂里。

pennant.note:
A small championship pennant hung proudly in his room. 一面小型冠军锦旗自豪地挂在他的房间里。

Colorful pennants fluttered in the breeze during the festival. 节日期间，彩色三角旗在微风中飘扬。

penultimate.note:
The chapter is located near the end, in the penultimate section of the book. 这一章位于书的末尾附近，即倒数第二节。

We scored the winning goal in the penultimate minute of the game. 我们在比赛的倒数第二分钟攻入了制胜球。

penury.note:
She grew up in extreme penury before achieving wealth and fame. 在获得财富和名气之前，她在极度贫困中长大。

His poor financial decisions reduced him to penury. 他糟糕的财务决定使他陷入了赤贫。

perambulate.note:
They liked to perambulate through the quiet park on Sunday mornings. 他们喜欢在周日早晨穿过宁静的公园漫步。

The security guard began to perambulate the perimeter of the building. 保安开始巡视建筑物的周边。

perception.note:
Public perception of the brand changed after the scandal. 丑闻发生后，公众对该品牌的看法发生了变化。

Humans rely on five basic senses for sensory perception. 人类依靠五种基本感官来进行感官知觉。

perch.meaning: v. 栖息，坐落于；n. 栖息处
perch.note:
A small bird perched on the wooden fence. 一只小鸟栖息在木栅栏上。

The small village is perched high on a steep mountain cliff. 这个小村庄坐落在一个陡峭的山崖高处。

percussionist.note:
The orchestra features a talented percussionist on the drums. 乐队里有一位才华横溢的架子鼓打击乐手。

He studied percussionist techniques at the conservatory. 他在音乐学院学习了打击乐演奏技巧。

peregrination.note:
His geographical peregrinations took him across three continents. 他的地理游历带他走过了三大洲。

She wrote a memoir detailing her years of spiritual peregrination. 她写了一本回忆录，详细叙述了她多年的精神游历。

peremptory.meaning: adj. 专断的，不容拒绝的，独断的
peremptory.note:
He gave a peremptory order that no one was allowed to leave. 他下达了一个不容拒绝的命令，任何人不得离开。

She grew tired of her boss's peremptory tone of voice. 她对老板专断的语调感到厌倦。

perfervid.meaning: adj. 热烈的，狂热的，过分热心的
perfervid.note:
He expressed perfervid support for the political candidate. 他表达了对这位政治候选人的狂热支持。

The poet's perfervid imagination brought the scenes to life. 诗人狂热的想象力让场景栩栩如生。

perfidy.meaning: n. 背叛，不忠，背信弃义
perfidy.note:
The king was shocked by the perfidy of his trusted adviser. 国王对受信赖的顾问的背叛感到震惊。

History remembers the treaty violation as an act of terrible perfidy. 历史将这次违反条约的行为视为一种可怕的背信弃义。

perforate.note:
Make sure to tear the paper along the perforated edge. 确保沿着打孔的边缘撕纸。

A sharp tool can easily perforate the thin plastic sheet. 锋利的工具很容易穿透薄塑料片。

perfunctorily.note:
He nodded perfunctorily and continued reading his book. 他敷衍地点了点头，继续看他的书。

She signed the documents perfunctorily without reading the terms. 她在没有阅读条款的情况下敷衍地签了文件。

perfunctory.meaning: adj. 敷衍的，草率的，例行公事的
perfunctory.note:
He gave the room a perfunctory cleaning before guests arrived. 客人到达前，他草率地打扫了一下房间。

The interview felt like a perfunctory formality rather than a real discussion. 这场面试感觉更像是一种例行公事的程式，而不是真正的讨论。

peril.note:
Mountain climbers face great peril in bad weather conditions. 登山者在恶劣的天气条件下会面临巨大的危险。

Ignorance of the law puts you at great peril. 无知使你处于极大的危险之中。

perilous.note:
They embarked on a perilous journey across the stormy sea. 他们踏上了一段穿过风暴大海的危险旅程。

Navigating through the rocky mountain pass is a perilous task. 穿过岩石山隘是一项危险的任务。

perimeter.note:
Guards patrolled the outer perimeter of the secure military base. 卫兵巡逻了安全军事基地的外部边界。

Calculate the perimeter of the rectangle using the formula. 用公式计算矩形的周长。

periodical.meaning: n. 期刊，杂志；adj. 周期的，定期的
periodical.note:
The library subscribes to several academic periodicals. 该图书馆订阅了几种学术期刊。

They conducted periodical maintenance checks on the machinery. 他们对机械设备进行了定期的维护检查。

peripatetic.meaning: adj. 四处奔波的，巡回的，游历的
peripatetic.note:
He lived a peripatetic lifestyle, moving from city to city as a teacher. 他过着四处奔波的生活，作为一个老师在各个城市之间搬迁。

The peripatetic musician traveled widely across Europe. 这位巡回音乐家在欧洲各地广泛旅行。

peripheral.meaning: adj. 外围的，次要的，边缘的
peripheral.note:
These issues are peripheral to the main topic of our meeting. 这些问题对于我们会议的主题来说是次要的。

She noticed a shadow in her peripheral vision. 她在自己的余光中注意到一个影子。

periphery.note:
Factories are often built on the periphery of major cities. 工厂通常建在大城市的外围。

He remained on the periphery of the social group. 他一直留在社交圈的外围。

periscope.note:
The captain used the submarine's periscope to scan the sea surface. 船长利用潜艇的潜望镜扫描海面。

Children love looking through the periscope at the science museum. 孩子们喜欢在科学博物馆里通过潜望镜看东西。

perishing.meaning: adj. 寒冷刺骨的，快要毁灭的
perishing.note:
It is absolutely perishing outside today; make sure to wear a coat. 今天外面冷得刺骨；一定要穿外套。

Many old traditions are perishing in the modern world. 许多古老的传统在现代世界中正在消亡。

perjure.note:
He was warned that if he lied in court, he would perjure himself. 他被警告说，如果在法庭上撒谎，他就是在做伪证。

Witnesses who perjure themselves face serious prison sentences. 做伪证的证人将面临严厉的监禁判决。

perjury.note:
She was charged with perjury after lying under oath. 在宣誓后撒谎，她被指控犯有伪证罪。

Committing perjury in a federal court is a federal crime. 在联邦法院作伪证是一项联邦罪行。

perky.meaning: adj. 活泼的，精神抖擞的，神气活现的
perky.note:
She looked bright and perky despite the early morning hour. 尽管时间尚早，她看起来依然明亮而精神抖擞。

His perky attitude helped lift everyone's spirits in the office. 他活泼的态度帮助提升了办公室里每个人的精神。

permanence.note:
Carved stone inscriptions give a sense of historical permanence. 雕刻的石头铭文给人一种历史的永久感。

Digital files lack the physical permanence of paper books. 数字文件缺乏纸质书的物理持久性。

permeable.meaning: adj. 可渗透的，能透过的
permeable.note:
Sandstone is a permeable rock that allows water to pass through. 砂岩是一种可渗透的岩石，允许水通过。

The soil is permeable, draining rainwater quickly after storms. 土壤是可渗透的，暴风雨后能迅速排出雨水。

permeate.note:
The delicious smell of baking bread began to permeate the house. 面包烘焙的香气开始弥漫整栋房子。

A sense of optimism seemed to permeate the entire organization. 一种乐观的情绪似乎弥漫了整个组织。

permissive.meaning: adj. 纵容的，宽容的，许可的
permissive.note:
Her parents were quite permissive and let her make her own choices. 她的父母相当宽容，让她自己做选择。

A permissive society allows individuals more personal freedom. 一个宽容的社会赋予个人更多的个人自由。

perpendicular.note:
Draw a line perpendicular to the base of the triangle. 画一条与三角形底边垂直的线。

The cliff face was almost completely perpendicular to the sea. 悬崖峭壁几乎完全垂直于海面。

perpetual.meaning: adj. 永久的，长期的，不断的
perpetual.note:
They seemed to live in a state of perpetual motion and chaos. 他们似乎生活在一种不断的运动和混乱状态中。

She grew tired of her neighbor's perpetual complaining. 她对邻居不断的抱怨感到厌倦。

perpetuate.meaning: v. 使永久化，使不朽，使延续
perpetuate.note:
The monument was built to perpetuate the memory of fallen soldiers. 建造这座纪念碑是为了让阵亡士兵的记忆永存。

We must not perpetuate harmful stereotypes in the media. 我们绝不能在媒体中使有害的刻板印象长期存在。

perquisite.meaning: n. 津贴，额外好处，特权（简称perk）
perquisite.note:
A company car and health insurance were part of his job perquisites. 公车和健康保险是他工作津贴的一部分。

Free travel is a nice perquisite for airline employees. 免费旅游是航空公司员工的一项美好福利。

persiflage.note:
The dinner party began with light persiflage among old friends. 晚宴在老朋友之间轻松的打趣中开始。

His habitual persiflage could sometimes be annoying. 他习惯性的开玩笑有时可能会很烦人。

persistence.note:
Her persistence eventually paid off when she passed the difficult exam. 当她通过了那场艰难的考试时，她的坚持终于有了回报。

The persistence of the rainy weather dampened our outdoor plans. 雨水天气的持续打消了我们的户外计划。

personable.meaning: adj. 风度翩翩的，温和讨人喜欢的
personable.note:
He is a personable young man with excellent communication skills. 他是一个风度翩翩、沟通技巧极佳的年轻人。

The hotel receptionist was very personable and helpful. 酒店前台非常亲切且乐于助人。

personification.meaning: n. 拟人，化身，完美化身
personification.note:
Calling justice blind is a common personification. 称正义为盲目是一种常见的拟人化手法。

She is the very personification of grace and elegance. 她简直就是优雅和高贵的化身。

perspective.note:
Traveling helps broaden your perspective on the world. 旅行有助于拓宽你对世界的视角。

Try to look at the problem from a different perspective. 尝试从不同的角度看待这个问题。

perspicacious.meaning: adj. 敏锐的，有洞察力的
perspicacious.note:
The perspicacious investor predicted the market crash early. 敏锐的投资者很早就预测到了市场崩盘。

Her perspicacious analysis solved the complex puzzle. 她敏锐的分析解开了复杂的谜题。

perspicuity.meaning: n. 明白易懂，清晰明了
perspicuity.note:
The author wrote the technical manual with great perspicuity. 作者以极大的清晰度编写了这份技术手册。

She praised the perspicuity of the legal argument. 她称赞了这一法律论点的清晰易懂。

perspicuous.meaning: adj. 清晰的，明白易懂的
perspicuous.note:
His perspicuous explanation made the difficult math concept easy. 他清晰易懂的解释使困难的数学概念变得简单。

We need a perspicuous policy that everyone can follow. 我们需要一项每个人都能遵守的清晰政策。

perspire.note:
He began to perspire heavily during the intense workout. 在剧烈运动中，他开始大量出汗。

Working in the hot kitchen caused the chefs to perspire. 在炎热的厨房里工作导致厨师们出汗。

pertinacious.meaning: adj. 顽强的，坚决的，固执的
pertinacious.note:
Her pertinacious defense saved her client from conviction. 她顽强的辩护使她的当事人免于定罪。

He showed a pertinacious refusal to give up on the project. 他表现出对放弃该项目的顽强拒绝。

pertinent.note:
Please keep your comments pertinent to the discussion topic. 请保持你的评论切合讨论主题。

The lawyer asked questions pertinent to the case details. 律师询问了与案件细节相关的问题。

peruse.note:
She sat by the window to peruse the morning newspaper. 她坐在窗边仔细阅读晨报。

Please peruse the terms and conditions before signing the contract. 请在签署合同前仔细阅读条款和条件。

pervade.note:
A sense of doom seemed to pervade the dark room. 一种末日感似乎弥漫了整个黑暗的房间。

Joy and excitement seemed to pervade the entire stadium. 快乐和兴奋似乎弥漫了整个体育场。

pervious.meaning: adj. 能透过的，可穿透的，能接受的
pervious.note:
The soil is pervious to water, helping prevent flooding. 这种土壤能透水，有助于防止洪水泛滥。

He was pervious to new ideas despite his conservative background. 尽管他有着保守的背景，但他对新想法是开明的。

pest.meaning: n. 害虫，讨厌的人或物
pest.note:
Farmers use various methods to keep crop pests away. 农民使用各种方法来驱赶作物害虫。

Stop being such a pest and let me work in peace. 别那么烦人，让我安安静静地工作。

pester.meaning: v. 纠缠，烦扰，不断打扰
pester.note:
The children kept pestering their parents to buy ice cream. 孩子们一直纠缠着父母买冰淇淋。

Don't pester him with questions while he is busy. 他正忙着时，不要用问题去打扰他。

pesticide.note:
Farmers spray pesticides to protect crops from insects. 农民喷洒杀虫剂以保护农作物免受昆虫侵害。

Organic food is grown without the use of chemical pesticides. 有机食品是在不使用化学农药的情况下种植的。

pestilent.meaning: adj. 致命的，瘟疫般的，有害的
pestilent.note:
The swampy air was thought to be pestilent and dangerous. 沼泽的空气被认为是有害且危险的。

Pestilent diseases wiped out many villagers in the past. 致命的疾病在过去夺去了许多村民的生命。

pestle.note:
She used a mortar and pestle to grind the herbs together. 她用研钵和研杵把草药一起磨碎。

The chef crushed the spices with a heavy stone pestle. 主厨用一个重的石研杵压碎了香料。

petal.note:
Soft pink petals fell gently from the blossoming cherry tree. 柔软的粉红色花瓣从盛开的樱桃树上轻轻落下。

The rose petals were scattered across the wedding aisle. 玫瑰花瓣散落在婚礼过道上。

petitioner.note:
The petitioner presented hundreds of signatures to the city council. 请愿人向市议会提交了数百个签名。

Petitioners gathered outside the courthouse demanding justice. 请愿者聚集在法院外要求伸张正义。

petrify.note:
Fallen trees can petrify over millions of years into stone. 倒下的树木经过数百万年可以石化成石头。

She was petrified by the sudden roar of thunder. 她被突如其来的雷声吓呆了。

petroglyph.note:
Archaeologists found ancient petroglyphs carved into the canyon wall. 考古学家在峡谷壁上发现了古老的岩画。

The rock art includes various petroglyphs depicting animals. 石壁艺术包括描绘动物的各种岩画。

petroleum.note:
Many industrial products are derived from refined petroleum. 许多工业产品都是从精炼石油中提炼出来的。

Fluctuating petroleum prices affect the global economy. 波动的情油价格影响着全球经济。

petrology.note:
He studied petrology to understand the formation of igneous rocks. 他学习岩石学以了解火成岩的形成。

Petrology is a crucial branch of modern geology. 岩石学是现代地质学的一个关键分支。

petty.meaning: adj. 琐碎的，气量小的，小肚鸡肠的
petty.note:
We shouldn't waste time arguing over such petty matters. 我们不应该浪费时间为这些琐碎的事情争吵。

His petty jealousy caused tension within the team group. 他小肚鸡肠的嫉妒心引起了团队内部的紧张。

petulance.meaning: n. 暴躁，易怒，孩子气的不满
petulance.note:
Her sudden petulance surprised everyone at the dinner table. 她突然的暴躁让餐桌上的每个人都很惊讶。

He showed signs of childish petulance when he lost the game. 输掉比赛时，他表现出孩子气的不满迹象。

petulant.meaning: adj. 暴躁的，喜怒无常的，任性的
petulant.note:
The petulant teenager slammed the door and refused to speak. 这个任性的青少年砰地关上门，拒绝说话。

She grew petulant when things didn't go her way. 当事情不顺心时，她变得有些暴躁。

phantom.meaning: n. 幽灵，幻影；adj. 幻觉的
phantom.note:
Stories are often told about a phantom ship sailing on foggy nights. 人们经常讲述一艘在雾夜中航行的幽灵船的故事。

He felt a phantom pain in his amputated leg. 他在被截肢的腿上感到了一种幻觉般的疼痛。

pharmaceutical.meaning: adj. 制药的，药物的；n. 药物
pharmaceutical.note:
She works as a researcher for a major pharmaceutical company. 她是一家大型制药公司的一名研究员。

The industry produces a wide range of pharmaceutical products. 该行业生产各种各样的药物产品。

pharmacology.note:
He is studying clinical pharmacology at the university. 他在大学里学习临床药理学。

Pharmacology is essential for developing safe and effective medicines. 药理学对于开发安全有效的药物至关重要。

phenomena.note:
Scientists are trying to understand these strange natural phenomena. 科学家们正试图理解这些奇怪的自然现象。

Social phenomena can be complex to analyze and interpret. 社会现象可能很复杂，难以分析和解释。

phenomenal.meaning: adj. 极好的，惊人的，非凡的
phenomenal.note:
The young athlete achieved phenomenal success in the Olympics. 这位年轻运动员在奥运会上取得了惊人的成功。

Growth rates in the tech sector have been phenomenal this year. 科技行业的增长率今年非常惊人。

philanthropic.note:
The billionaire is known for his extensive philanthropic work. 这位亿万富翁以其广泛的慈善工作而闻名。

Several philanthropic foundations donated funds to build the hospital. 几个慈善基金会捐款建造了这家医院。

philatelist.meaning: n. 集邮家，集邮爱好者
philatelist.note:
The avid philatelist spent decades collecting rare postage stamps. 这位狂热的集邮家花了几十年时间收集珍贵邮票。

A famous philatelist exhibited his collection at the museum. 一位著名的集邮家在博物馆展出了他的藏品。

philately.note:
His hobby of philately brought him joy for over fifty years. 他五十多年来一直以集邮为乐。

She wrote a book about the history and hobby of philately. 她写了一本关于集邮历史和爱好的书。

philistine.meaning: n. 对文化毫无兴趣的人，俗气的人；adj. 庸俗的
philistine.note:
He dismissed modern art as nonsense, showing a truly philistine attitude. 他将现代艺术斥为无稽之谈，表现出一种极其庸俗的态度。

She refused to let cultural philistines ruin the historic theater. 她拒绝让文化俗流毁掉这座历史悠久的剧院。

phlegmatic.meaning: adj. 冷静的，迟钝的，冷漠的
phlegmatic.note:
Despite the crisis, he remained calm and phlegmatic. 尽管面临危机，他依然保持冷静和沉着。

Her phlegmatic temperament helped her handle stress well. 她冷静的气质帮助她很好地应对压力。

phoenix.note:
The city rose from the ashes like a phoenix after the war. 战后这座城市像凤凰涅槃一样从灰烬中崛起。

According to myth, the phoenix is a bird that burns and is reborn. 根据神话，凤凰是一只燃烧并重生的鸟。

phonetic.meaning: adj. 语音的，标音的，表音的
phonetic.note:
The dictionary provides a phonetic transcription for every word. 字典为每个单词提供了语音转写。

English spelling is not always entirely phonetic. 英语拼写并不总是完全按发音拼写的。

photosynthesis.note:
Plants use sunlight to carry out photosynthesis and produce food. 植物利用阳光进行光合作用并制造食物。

Photosynthesis is crucial for generating oxygen in the atmosphere. 光合作用对于产生大气中的氧气至关重要。

physiological.note:
Stress can cause various negative physiological reactions in the body. 压力会导致体内产生各种负面的生理反应。

Scientists studied the physiological effects of zero gravity. 科学家研究了零重力的生理影响。

pictorial.meaning: adj. 图解的，图画的；n. 画报
pictorial.note:
The manual includes a pictorial guide to help with assembly. 本手册包含图解指南以帮助组装。

She looked through a travel pictorial filled with stunning photos. 她翻阅了一本充满精美照片的旅游画报。

piddling.meaning: adj. 微不足道的，琐碎的，无聊的
piddling.note:
He complained about earning such a piddling amount of money. 他抱怨赚这么一点微不足道的钱。

We shouldn't argue over piddling matters when time is short. 时间紧迫时，我们不应该为琐碎的事争吵。

pied.note:
A pied dog ran across the open green field. 一只杂色的小狗跑过开阔的绿草地。

The bird is easily recognized by its distinctive pied feathers. 这只鸟因其独特的杂色羽毛而很容易被认出。

pierce.note:
A sharp needle can easily pierce the thick fabric. 一根锋利的针很容易刺破厚实的布料。

His piercing gaze made her feel uncomfortable. 他那锐利的目光让她感到不舒服。

piercing.meaning: adj. 刺骨的，尖锐的，敏锐的
piercing.note:
She wore a thick scarf to protect her neck from the piercing wind. 她戴着厚围巾来保护脖子免受刺骨寒风的侵袭。

He has a piercing intelligence that notices every detail. 他有着能注意到每一个细节的敏锐智慧。

pillar.note:
Stone pillars supported the heavy roof of the ancient temple. 石柱支撑着古代寺庙沉重的屋顶。

Education is considered a vital pillar of a strong society. 教育被认为是强大社会的关键支柱。

pillory.meaning: n. 颈手枷；v. 严厉批评，公开谴责
pillory.note:
Criminals were once publicly humiliated in the town pillory. 罪犯曾经在镇上的颈手枷中当众受辱。

The corrupt politician was pilloried by the national media. 这位腐败的政客遭到全国媒体的公开谴责。

pine.meaning: n. 松树；v. 渴望，因思念而消瘦
pine.note:
Tall pine trees lined the mountain path. 高大的松树排在山路两旁。

She continued to pine for her home country while living abroad. 在国外生活期间，她继续思念着她的祖国。

pinnacle.note:
Winning the championship was the pinnacle of his career. 赢得冠军是他职业生涯的巅峰。

She reached the pinnacle of success at a very young age. 她在很年轻的时候就达到了成功的巅峰。

pinpoint.meaning: v. 精确指出，查明；adj. 精确的
pinpoint.note:
The radar system can pinpoint the exact location of the aircraft. 雷达系统可以精确指出飞机的确切位置。

Scientists managed to pinpoint the cause of the outbreak. 科学家设法查明了疫情爆发的原因。

pious.meaning: adj. 虔诚的，笃信宗教的
pious.note:
The pious woman attended church services every single day. 这位虔诚的妇女每天都去参加宗教礼拜。

He made pious promises of reform, but did nothing. 他作出了虔诚的改革承诺，但什么也没做。

piquant.meaning: adj. 辛辣开胃的，惹人喜爱的，别具风味的
piquant.note:
The chef added a piquant sauce to enhance the flavor of the dish. 主厨加入了一种开胃的酱汁来提升菜肴的风味。

She has a piquant sense of humor that makes everyone laugh. 她有一种别具风味的幽默感，逗得每个人哈哈大笑。

pique.meaning: v. 激起（好奇心等），惹恼；n. 负气，生气
pique.note:
The mysterious headline was designed to pique the reader's interest. 那个神秘的标题旨在激起读者的兴趣。

She left the room in a fit of pique after the argument. 争吵过后，她赌气离开了房间。

pirate.meaning: n. 海盗；v. 盗版，掠夺
pirate.note:
Historic tales often feature fearsome captains and buried treasure. 历史故事中常常出现可怕的海盗船长和埋藏的宝藏。

The website was shut down for illegally pirating software. 该网站因非法盗版软件而被关闭。

pirouette.meaning: n. / v. （芭蕾舞的）单足旋转
pirouette.note:
The ballet dancer performed a graceful pirouette on stage. 芭蕾舞演员在舞台上表演了一个优雅的单足旋转。

She spun around in a quick pirouette. 她飞快地单足旋转了一圈。

pistol.note:
The police officer drew his pistol when he heard the noise. 听到声音时，警察拔出了手枪。

The track coach fired the starting pistol for the race. 田径教练为比赛鸣放了起跑枪。

pitcher.meaning: n. 投手（棒球），水罐，大口径壶
pitcher.note:
The baseball pitcher threw a fast strike. 棒球投手投出了一记快速好球。

She filled the glass pitcher with cold lemonade. 她把冷柠檬水装满了玻璃水罐。

pitfall.meaning: n. 陷阱，隐患，意料不到的困难
pitfall.note:
Investing without research is a common financial pitfall. 不做调查就投资是一个常见的财务陷阱。

He warned young entrepreneurs about the pitfalls of rapid expansion. 他警告年轻创业者要警惕快速扩张的隐患。

pith.meaning: n. 核心，精髓，植物髓部
pith.note:
He quickly got to the pith of the argument. 他很快切入了论点的核心。

Peel the orange and remove the white pith before eating. 吃之前把橙子剥皮并去掉白色的髓部。

pithiness.note:
She was famous for the pithiness of her daily advice. 她以日常建议的简练而闻名。

The editor praised the essay for its clarity and pithiness. 编辑称赞这篇文章清晰且言简意赅。

pithy.meaning: adj. 简练的，言简意赅的
pithy.note:
He made a pithy comment that summarized the whole meeting. 他发表了一句言简意赅的评论，总结了整个会议。

Her speech was short, pithy, and very effective. 她的演讲简短、言简意赅且非常有效。

pitiful.meaning: adj. 可怜的，令人同情的，微不足道的
pitiful.note:
The stray dog looked so pitiful with its wet fur and sad eyes. 流浪狗湿漉漉的毛发和悲伤的眼睛看起来真可怜。

They received a pitiful amount of compensation for their losses. 他们因为损失只得到了微不足道的赔偿。

pittance.meaning: n. 微薄的工资，少量的钱
pittance.note:
She worked long hours for a mere pittance. 她长时间工作，却只拿微薄的薪水。

They could barely survive on such a small pittance. 靠这么一点少量的钱，他们几乎难以维生。

placate.note:
The manager tried to placate the angry customer with a refund. 经理试图用退款来安抚生气的顾客。

Minor concessions were made to placate the protesting workers. 为了安抚抗议的工人，作出了一些微小的让步。

placid.meaning: adj. 平静的，温和的，宁静的
placid.note:
They sailed their boat across the placid lake on a sunny afternoon. 在一个阳光明媚的下午，他们驾驶小船驶过平静的湖面。

She has a placid temperament and rarely gets upset. 她性格温和，很少生气。

plagiarize.note:
Students who plagiarize essays will face academic penalties. 抄袭论文的学生将面临学术惩罚。

He was accused of trying to plagiarize parts of the novel. 他被指控试图剽窃这部小说的部分内容。

plain.meaning: adj. 清楚的，朴素的；n. 平原
plain.note:
The instructions on the box were written in plain English. 盒子上的说明是用浅显易懂的英语写的。

Wild horses roam freely across the wide grassy plain. 野马在广阔的草地平原上自由驰骋。

plaintiff.note:
The plaintiff presented evidence to support the claim in court. 原告在法庭上出示了支持诉讼请求的证据。

Both the plaintiff and the defendant agreed to a settlement. 原告和被告都同意达成和解。

plaintive.meaning: adj. 哀伤的，悲伤的，凄凉的
plaintive.note:
A plaintive cry echoed through the dark night air. 一声哀伤的呼喊在黑夜的空气中回荡。

The stray cat made a plaintive meow outside the door. 流浪还在门外发出了凄凉的喵喵声。

plait.meaning: n. 发辫，褶子；v. 编织（辫子）
plait.note:
She wore her long hair in a neat plait. 她把长发梳成了一个整齐的辫子。

Mother helped plait the girl's hair before school. 母亲在上学前帮女孩编辫子。

plangent.meaning: adj. 轰鸣的；悲凉的；激昂的
plangent.note:
The plangent sound of the church bell echoed through the valley. 教堂钟声悲凉的声音在山谷中回荡。

A plangent wave crashed against the rocky shore. 一声巨浪轰鸣着拍打着岩石海岸。

plankton.note:
Whales feed mainly on tiny marine organisms known as plankton. 鲸鱼主要以被称为浮游生物的微小海洋生物为食。

Plankton plays a crucial role in the oceanic food web. 浮游生物在海洋食物网中起着至关重要的作用。

plaque.meaning: n. 饰板；血小板；牙菌斑
plaque.note:
A bronze plaque commemorates the founding of the university. 一块青铜饰板纪念这所大学的成立。

Regular brushing helps remove dental plaque and prevent cavities. 定期刷牙有助于去除牙菌斑并预防蛀牙。

plaster.meaning: n. 石膏；抹灰；创可贴 v. 抹灰；粘贴
plaster.note:
The walls were finished with smooth white plaster. 墙壁用光滑的白色石膏粉刷过。

He had to wear a plaster on his broken arm for six weeks. 他的骨折手臂上不得不打着石膏六个星期。

platitude.meaning: n. 陈词滥调；老生常谈
platitude.note:
His speech was full of empty platitudes about hard work. 他的演讲充满了关于努力工作的空洞陈词滥调。

We are tired of hearing political platitudes that offer no real solutions. 我们听腻了那些提供不出真正解决办法的政治老生常谈。

platonic.meaning: adj. 柏拉图式的；纯精神上的
platonic.note:
They have a strictly platonic relationship based on mutual respect. 他们有着基于相互尊重的纯精神上的柏拉图式关系。

Platonic love transcends physical attraction. 柏拉图式的爱情超越了身体的吸引。

plaudit.note:
The new play won critical plaudits from major newspapers. 这部新戏赢得了各大报纸的评论界赞誉。

She accepted the plaudits of the crowd with a modest smile. 她带着谦逊的微笑接受了人群的喝彩。

pleat.meaning: n. 褶皱 v. 打褶
pleat.note:
The skirt has elegant box pleats running down the front. 这条裙子前面有优雅的箱形褶皱。

She carefully pleated the fabric before sewing it into the dress. 在把它缝进裙子之前，她小心翼翼地把布料打褶。

plenitude.note:
The garden offers a plenitude of colorful flowers in summer. 夏天花园里有大量五颜六色的花朵。

He enjoyed a plenitude of wealth and power during his reign. 在位期间，他享有丰富的财富和权力。

plethora.note:
There is a plethora of information available on the internet today. 如今互联网上有过多的可用信息。

Despite a plethora of evidence, the suspect maintained his innocence. 尽管有大量的证据，嫌疑人仍坚称自己无罪。

pliable.meaning: adj. 易弯的；柔韧的；易受影响的
pliable.note:
Wet clay is very pliable and easy to mold into different shapes. 湿粘土非常柔韧，很容易塑造成不同的形状。

Young minds are pliable and eager to absorb new ideas. 年轻的头脑很容易受影响，渴望吸收新的想法。

pliant.note:
The young branches of the willow tree are remarkably pliant. 柳树的嫩枝非常柔韧。

He expected his employees to be completely pliant to his commands. 他希望他的员工对他的命令绝对顺从。

plight.note:
Aid organizations are deeply concerned about the plight of refugees. 援助组织对难民的困境深表担忧。

We must do more to highlight the economic plight of rural communities. 我们必须采取更多行动来突显农村社区的经济困境。

plinth.note:
The marble statue stood proudly on a stone plinth. 大理石雕像骄傲地立在石质底座上。

Workers repaired the cracked plinth beneath the historical monument. 工人们修复了历史纪念碑下方的裂纹底座。

plod.meaning: v. 沉重地走；辛勤劳作 n. 辛劳；沉重的脚步声
plod.note:
The hikers plodded through the deep mud for hours. 徒步旅行者在深泥中艰难地走了几个小时。

She continues to plod away at her tedious research paper. 她继续坚持不懈地完成她那乏味的论文。

plough.meaning: n. 犁 v. 耕地；犁
plough.note:
The farmer used a tractor to pull the heavy plough across the field. 农民用拖拉机拉着重犁犁地。

It is time to plough the soil before sowing the seeds. 在播种之前是耕地的时候了。

ploy.note:
Giving away free gifts was a clever marketing ploy to attract customers. 赠送免费礼品是一个吸引顾客的聪明营销计谋。

His feigned illness was just a ploy to avoid taking the final exam. 他装病只是为了逃避期末考试的花招。

pluck.meaning: v. 拔；拉；弹奏 n. 勇气；胆量
pluck.note:
She plucked a single red rose from the garden bush. 她从花园的灌木丛中摘下一朵红玫瑰。

It took a lot of pluck to stand up and speak in front of the large audience. 在大批观众面前站起来发言需要很大的勇气。

plumb.meaning: v. 探测；深究 n. 铅锤 adj. 垂直的
plumb.note:
Scientists tried to plumb the deepest trenches of the ocean. 科学家们试图探测海洋最深的海沟。

Make sure the wall is completely plumb before applying tiles. 在贴瓷砖之前，确保墙壁完全垂直。

plumber.note:
We had to call a plumber to fix the leaking kitchen sink. 我们不得不请水管工来修理漏水的厨房水槽。

The experienced plumber quickly located the broken pipe underground. 经验丰富的水管工迅速找到了地下的破裂水管。

plume.meaning: n. 羽毛；烟羽 v. 得意洋洋；整理羽毛
plume.note:
A thick plume of black smoke rose from the burning factory. 浓密的黑烟从燃烧的工厂升起。

The exotic bird displayed its bright blue and green plumes. 这只异国鸟展示了它明亮的蓝绿色羽毛。

plush.meaning: adj. 豪华的；奢华的 n. 长毛绒
plush.note:
They stayed at a plush hotel in downtown Manhattan. 他们住在曼哈顿市中心的一家豪华酒店里。

The living room features plush velvet sofas and thick carpets. 起居室配有豪华天鹅绒沙发和厚地毯。

plutocracy.meaning: n. 富豪统治；财阀统治
plutocracy.note:
Critics argue that modern politics has turned the country into a plutocracy. 批评人士认为，现代政治已将该国变成了富豪统治的国家。

In a plutocracy, the wealthiest citizens hold disproportionate political power. 在富国统治下，最富有的公民拥有不成比例的政治权力。

pod.meaning: n. 豆荚；太空舱 v. 剥豆荚
pod.note:
She opened a fresh pea pod and dropped the seeds into a bowl. 她打开一个新鲜的豌豆荚，把种子倒进碗里。

The astronauts returned to Earth in the re-entry capsule pod. 宇航员乘坐重返大气层舱返回地球。

podiatrist.note:
The podiatrist recommended custom orthotic insoles for his foot pain. 足病医生建议为他的足痛定制矫形鞋垫。

She visited a podiatrist to treat a painful ingrown toenail. 她去看足病医生治疗痛苦的嵌甲。

poignant.meaning: adj. 辛酸的；深切的；令人动容的
poignant.note:
The movie ended with a poignant scene that brought many viewers to tears. 电影以一个辛酸的场景结束，让许多观众落泪。

Old photographs can evoke poignant memories of childhood. 旧照片可以唤起对童年的深切回忆。

poise.meaning: n. 沉着；平衡 v. 保持平衡；使悬着
poise.note:
She handled the difficult interview questions with remarkable grace and poise. 她以非凡的优雅和沉着应对了困难的面试问题。

The gymnast maintained her poise on the narrow balance beam. 体操运动员在窄平衡木上保持了平衡。

poisonous.note:
Some species of frogs secrete poisonous substances through their skin. 某些种类的青蛙通过皮肤分泌有毒物质。

His poisonous remarks ruined the friendly atmosphere of the meeting. 他恶毒的言论破坏了会议的友好气氛。

poke.meaning: v. 戳；捅；探出 n. 戳；刺
poke.note:
He poked the campfire with a long stick to revive the flames. 他用长棍子捅了捅营火以重新点燃火焰。

She poked her head out the window to check the weather. 她把头探出窗外查看天气。

polar.meaning: adj. 极地的；截然相反的
polar.note:
Polar bears rely heavily on sea ice to hunt for seals. 北极熊严重依赖海冰来捕猎海豹。

They have polar views on how the company should be managed. 他们对公司的管理方式有着截然相反的观点。

polarity.note:
Magnets have two distinct poles that create a magnetic polarity. 磁铁有两个不同的极，产生磁极性。

The election increased the political polarity within the country. 选举加剧了国内的政治两极分化。

polemic.meaning: n. 争论；激烈的辩论 adj. 争论性的
polemic.note:
Her latest book is a fierce polemic against modern consumerism. 她最近出版的书是对现代消费主义的激烈争论。

He avoided getting drawn into ideological polemics. 他避免被卷入意识形态的争论中。

polemical.note:
The article adopted a highly polemical tone regarding tax reforms. 这篇文章对税收改革采取了高度争论性的语气。

She wrote a polemical essay challenging traditional historical narratives. 她写了一篇挑战传统历史叙事的辩论性文章。

polish.meaning: v. 磨光；擦亮 n. 擦光剂；优雅
polish.note:
He spent the afternoon using wax to polish his wooden dining table. 他花了一下午用蜡擦亮他的木制餐桌。

Her performance lacked a certain professional polish. 她的表演缺乏某种专业的光彩。

pollen.note:
High levels of tree pollen in spring trigger severe allergies. 春天高浓度的树木花粉引发了严重的过敏症。

Bees collect nectar and pollen from blooming flowers. 蜜蜂从盛开的花朵中收集花蜜和花粉。

pollinate.note:
Insects such as butterflies help pollinate many garden plants. 蝴蝶等昆虫有助于给许多花园植物授粉。

Farmers rely on honeybees to successfully pollinate their crops. 农民依靠蜜蜂成功地给农作物授粉。

pollster.meaning: n. 民意测验专家；民调人员
pollster.note:
Political pollsters closely monitored voter trends ahead of the election. 政治民调人员在选举前密切监测选民趋势。

The pollster conducted hundreds of phone interviews to gauge public opinion. 民调专家进行了数百次电话访谈以衡量公众舆论。

pomposity.meaning: n. 自大；自命不凡；浮夸
pomposity.note:
People disliked him for his unbearable pomposity and arrogance. 人们不喜欢他，因为他令人无法忍受的自大和傲慢。

Beneath his speech of official pomposity lay a lack of real strategy. 在他那充满官方自大言论的背后，缺乏真正的战略。

pompous.meaning: adj. 自大的；浮夸的；自命不凡的
pompous.note:
He spoke in a pompous manner that annoyed everyone in the room. 他以一种让房间里所有人都恼火的自大态度说话。

The CEO's pompous attitude alienated many of his subordinates. 首席执行官自命不凡的态度疏远了许多下属。

poncho.note:
She quickly put on a waterproof poncho as the rain started pouring down. 随着大雨倾盆而下，她迅速穿上了一件防水披风。

Traditional wool ponchos are very popular in the Andes mountains. 传统的羊毛彭cho斗篷在安第斯山脉非常受欢迎。

ponder.note:
She sat by the window to ponder her future career options. 她坐在窗前沉思她未来的职业选择。

He paused to ponder the consequences of his decision before speaking. 在说话之前，他停顿了一下，思考自己决定的后果。

ponderable.meaning: adj. 可衡量的；值得深思的
ponderable.note:
The economic indicators provided several ponderable questions for analysts. 经济指标为分析师提供了几个值得深思的问题。

These risks are real and ponderable, not just theoretical. 这些风险是真实且可衡量的，而不仅仅是理论上的。

ponderous.meaning: adj. 笨重的；沉闷的；冗长的
ponderous.note:
The heavy machinery moved across the site with a ponderous pace. 重型机械以沉重缓慢的速度穿过工地。

His lecture was filled with ponderous academic jargon. 他的讲座充满了沉闷冗长的学术术语。

pontifical.meaning: adj. 教皇的；自以为是的；主观断定的
pontifical.note:
The bishop delivered a traditional pontifical mass at the cathedral. 主教在大教堂主持了一场传统的教皇弥撒。

His pontifical tone made it difficult to offer suggestions. 他那自以为是的语气让人很难提出建议。

pontificate.meaning: v. 自以为是地发表意见；充当教皇
pontificate.note:
He loves to pontificate on subjects he knows very little about. 他喜欢对自己知之甚少的话题自以为是地发表高见。

She listened quietly while her boss began to pontificate about business ethics. 她静静地听着，而老板则开始就商业道德高谈阔论。

populace.note:
The new law caused great concern among the general populace. 这项新法律引起了广大平民百姓的极大关切。

Governments must ensure the health and safety of the entire populace. 政府必须确保全体大众的健康与安全。

populous.meaning: adj. 人口稠密的；人口众多的
populous.note:
Tokyo is one of the most populous cities in the world. 东京是世界上人口最稠密的城市之一。

Large industrial centers tend to be densely populous. 大型工业中心往往人口稠密。

porcelain.meaning: n. 瓷器 adj. 瓷制的
porcelain.note:
She displayed her collection of antique Chinese porcelain in a glass cabinet. 她在一个玻璃柜里展示她的中国古董瓷器收藏。

The delicate teacup was made of fine white porcelain. 这个精致的茶杯是用优质白瓷制成的。

porcupine.note:
The curious dog was pricked by the quills of a defensive porcupine. 好奇的狗被防卫状态的豪猪刺伤了。

Porcupines use their sharp quills to protect themselves from predators. 豪猪用它们尖锐的刺来保护自己免受捕食者的伤害。

pore.meaning: n. 毛孔；气孔 v. 仔细研读；沉思
pore.note:
Sweat is released through tiny pores in human skin. 汗水是通过人类皮肤微小的毛孔释放出来的。

He spent hours poring over old documents in the library archives. 他花了好几个小时在图书馆档案馆里仔细研读旧文件。

porous.meaning: adj. 多孔的；有渗透性的
porous.note:
Sandstone is a porous rock that absorbs water easily. 砂岩是一种容易吸水的多孔岩石。

Porous materials require special sealing treatments to prevent leaks. 多孔材料需要特殊的密封处理以防止泄漏。

portentous.meaning: adj. 预兆性的；自命不凡的；装腔作势的
portentous.note:
Dark clouds gathered in the sky, creating a portentous atmosphere. 天空中聚集着乌云，营造出一种预兆性的气氛。

His portentous speeches failed to impress the experienced critics. 他那装腔作势的演讲没能给经验丰富的评论家留下深刻印象。

pose.meaning: v. 摆姿势；造成；提出 n. 姿势；伪装
pose.note:
Pollution poses a serious threat to local wildlife habitats. 污染对当地野生动物栖息地构成了严重威胁。

The model held a steady pose for the portrait painter. 模特为肖像画家保持着稳定的姿势。

poseur.meaning: n. 装模作样的人；冒充者
poseur.note:
Don't listen to him; he is just a superficial poseur trying to look cool. 别听他的；他只是一个试图装酷的表面化装模作样的人。

She quickly realized that his artistic lifestyle was a fake poseur act. 她很快意识到他的艺术生活方式只是一种虚假的装腔作势。

posse.note:
The sheriff formed a posse to track down the escaped convicts. 警长组建了一支搜捕队来追捕逃犯。

She went shopping with her usual posse of close friends. 她和她习惯的一帮密友去购物了。

possessed.meaning: adj. 着魔的；疯狂的；持有的
possessed.note:
He ran as if he were possessed by a sudden terror. 他奔跑着，就像被一种突然的恐惧所控制一样。

She appeared completely calm and possessed during the crisis. 在危机期间，她显得完全镇定自若。

poster.note:
Brightly colored posters were pasted across the city walls. 颜色鲜艳的海报贴满了城市墙壁。

He pinned a concert poster above his study desk. 他在书桌上方贴了一张音乐会海报。

postulate.meaning: v. 假定；假设 n. 基本前提
postulate.note:
Scientists postulate that water once flowed freely on the surface of Mars. 科学家假设火星表面曾经有水自由流淌。

The theory relies on several basic postulates about human behavior. 该理论依赖于关于人类行为的几个基本前提。

posture.meaning: n. 姿势；态度 v. 装模作样
posture.note:
Good sitting posture helps prevent chronic back pain. 良好的坐姿有助于预防慢性背痛。

The government adopted a defensive posture regarding trade tariffs. 政府在贸易关税问题上采取了防御姿态。

potation.note:
They enjoyed an evening of lively conversation and mild potation. 他们享受了一个充满生动交谈和适度饮酒的夜晚。

He ordered a refreshing potation to cool down in the summer heat. 他点了一杯清爽的饮料来消暑。

potentate.note:
Foreign dignitaries and powerful potentates attended the royal wedding. 外国政要和强大的权贵们出席了皇家婚礼。

The absolute potentate ruled the nation with an iron fist. 专制统治者以铁腕统治着国家。

potentiate.meaning: v. 增强；激活（药物、毒素等的作用）
potentiate.note:
Certain medications can potentiate the effects of alcohol. 某些药物可以增强酒精的作用。

This chemical compound is known to potentiate cellular responses. 这种化合物众所周知能增强细胞反应。

potpourri.meaning: n. 杂集；什锦；香料花瓣
potpourri.note:
The basket on the table was filled with fragrant dried potpourri. 桌上的篮子里装满了芳香的干花瓣香包。

The concert featured a delightful potpourri of classical and pop music. 音乐会汇集了古典音乐和流行音乐的愉快杂集。

pottery.note:
She took a weekend course to learn traditional pottery and ceramics. 她参加了一个周末课程来学习传统的制陶和陶瓷工艺。

Ancient pottery shards were discovered during the archaeological dig. 在考古发掘过程中发现了古代陶器碎片。

pout.meaning: v. 撅嘴；生气 n. 撅嘴
pout.note:
The child began to pout when he was told he couldn't have candy. 当被告知不能吃糖果时，孩子开始撅起嘴来。

She posed for the photo with a playful pout on her lips. 她带着俏皮的撅嘴姿势拍照。

prate.note:
He spent hours in the pub prating about his supposed business successes. 他在酒吧里花了几个小时唠叨他所谓的商业成功。

Stop prating and start getting some actual work done. 停止空谈，开始做点实际的工作吧。

precarious.meaning: adj. 不稳定的；危险的；靠不住的
precarious.note:
The mountaineer found himself in a precarious position on the icy cliff. 登山者发现自己处于冰崖上一个危险的境地。

Many small businesses survived on a precarious financial balance. 许多小型企业在不稳定的财务平衡下勉强维持生存。

precept.note:
The school is founded on the moral precepts of honesty and respect. 这学校建立在诚实和尊重的道德准则之上。

He lived his entire life guided by ancient religious precepts. 他一生都受古代宗教戒律的指导。

precipice.note:
The narrow path ran dangerously close to a steep precipice. 这条小路危险地靠近一处陡峭的悬崖峭壁。

The country stood on the precipice of a severe economic depression. 这个国家处于严重经济萧条的边缘。

precipitant.meaning: adj. 鲁莽的；急促的 n. 沉淀剂
precipitant.note:
His precipitant actions caused more harm than good. 他鲁莽的行动造成的损害大于益处。

A chemical precipitant was added to separate the solid particles. 添加了化学沉淀剂以分离固体颗粒。

precipitation.note:
Meteorologists predict heavy precipitation across the region tomorrow. 气象学家预测明天该地区将有强降水。

Precipitation of metals from the solution requires careful temperature control. 从溶液中沉淀金属需要仔细控制温度。

pr.note:
The company hired a new PR firm to improve its public image. 公司聘请了一家新的公关公司来改善其公众形象。

Good PR is essential for managing a crisis effectively. 良好的公关对于有效管理危机至关重要。

precise.note:
Can you give me the precise measurements of the living room? 你能给我客厅的精确尺寸吗？

She is very precise in how she organizes her office files. 她在整理办公室文件时非常严谨准确。

preclude.note:
His lack of experience precludes him from getting the management position. 他缺乏经验阻碍了他获得管理职位。

Bad weather will preclude any outdoor activities planned for today. 坏天气将妨碍今天计划的任何户外活动。

precocious.note:
The precocious child was able to read complex books by age four. 这个早熟的孩子在四岁时就能阅读复杂的书籍。

Her precocious musical talent amazed her piano teachers. 她早慧的音乐天赋令她的钢琴老师惊叹不已。

precursor.note:
This early invention was an important precursor to the modern computer. 早期这项发明是现代计算机的重要前身。

Headaches are often a precursor to a severe migraine attack. 头痛通常是严重偏头痛发作的前兆。

predestine.note:
Some philosophies believe that human actions are predestined by fate. 某些哲学认为人类的行动是由命运注定的。

He felt predestined to pursue a career in medicine. 他觉得注定要从事医学事业。

predicament.note:
She found herself in a financial predicament after losing her job. 失业后，她发现自己陷入了财务困境。

We need to find a way out of this current predicament quickly. 我们需要迅速找到摆脱目前窘境的方法。

predilection.note:
He has a strong predilection for classical literature and poetry. 他对古典文学和诗歌有着强烈的偏爱。

Her predilection for spicy food is well known among her friends. 她对辛辣食物的偏爱在朋友中是众所周知的。

predisposition.meaning: n. 倾向；预先倾向；遗传易感性
predisposition.note:
Genetic factors can create a predisposition to certain health conditions. 遗传因素可能会导致对某些健康状况的易感性。

She showed a natural predisposition towards leadership from a young age. 她从小就表现出对领导力的天然倾向。

predominate.note:
Greenery and open fields predominate in the rural landscape. 绿色植物和开阔的田野在乡村景观中占优势。

Pine trees predominate in this particular forest ecosystem. 松树在这个特定的森林生态系统中占主导地位。

preeminent.meaning: adj. 卓越的；杰出的；首屈一指的
preeminent.note:
She is a preeminent researcher in the field of quantum physics. 她是量子物理学领域的杰出研究员。

The university holds a preeminent position in global academic rankings. 该大学在全球学术排名中占据首屈一指的地位。

preempt.meaning: v. 抢先；先发制人；取代
preempt.note:
The network had to preempt its regular programming to broadcast breaking news. 该网络不得不抢先取消常规节目以播报突发新闻。

He spoke first to preempt any criticism from his opponents. 他抢先发言以阻止对手的任何批评。

preen.meaning: v. 整理羽毛；打扮；自得
preen.note:
The bird sat on the branch, busy preening its feathers. 鸟儿坐在树枝上，忙着整理羽毛。

He spent hours in front of the mirror preening himself before the party. 聚会前他在镜子前花了几个小时打扮自己。

preface.meaning: n. 序言；前言 v. 作为前言
preface.note:
The author added a short preface to explain the origins of the book. 作者添加了一篇短前言来解释这本书的起源。

She prefaced her speech with a few words of gratitude. 她在演讲前说了几句感谢的话作为开场白。

pregnant.meaning: adj. 怀孕的；意味深长的
pregnant.note:
She announced that she was pregnant with her first child. 她宣布她怀上了第一个孩子。

There was a pregnant pause in the room before anyone answered. 在有人回答之前，房间里出现了一段意味深长的沉默。

prehistoric.note:
Archaeologists found prehistoric cave paintings deep inside the cavern. 考古学家在洞穴深处发现了史前洞穴壁画。

Dinosaurs roamed the Earth during prehistoric times. 恐龙在史前时期漫游地球。

preliterate.meaning: adj. 文字出现以前的；未有文字的
preliterate.note:
Anthropologists study the oral traditions of preliterate societies. 人类学家研究未有文字社会的口头传统。

Stories were passed down through generations in preliterate cultures. 在文字出现以前的文化中，故事是通过一代代口耳相传的。

prelude.note:
Dark clouds on the horizon were a clear prelude to a violent storm. 地平线上的乌云是一场暴风雨的明显前奏。

The piano piece served as a gentle prelude to the main concert. 这首钢琴曲作为主要音乐会的温柔前奏。

premeditate.note:
The crime was found to be a premeditated act rather than a sudden accident. 这起犯罪被认为是预谋行为，而不是突发意外。

He denied that he had premeditated the financial scheme. 他否认自己预谋了这个金融骗局。

premeditated.note:
The prosecutor argued that the murder was deliberate and premeditated. 检察官辩称这起谋杀是蓄意且有预谋的。

It was not a mistake; it was a premeditated plan to ruin his reputation. 这不是失误；这是一个毁坏他名誉的蓄意计划。

premiere.meaning: n. 首映；初次公演 v. 首演
premiere.note:
The director and cast attended the world premiere of the film in Los Angeles. 导演和演员阵容出席了该电影在洛杉矶的世界首映礼。

The new play will premiere at the national theatre next month. 这部新剧将于下个月在国家剧院首演。

premonition.note:
She had a strange premonition that something bad was about to happen. 她有一种奇怪的预感，觉得要发生不好的事情。

His premonition proved correct when the flight was delayed. 当航班延误时，他的预感被证明是正确的。

preoccupation.meaning: n. 全神贯注；主要考虑的事；抢先占据
preoccupation.note:
His main preoccupation right now is passing his final exams. 他现在全神贯注的主要事情是通过期末考试。

Her constant preoccupation with work affected her personal life. 她对工作的不断全神贯注影响了她的个人生活。

preponderate.note:
Good intentions tend to preponderate in her character. 善良的意图往往在她的人格中占优势。

In urban areas, commercial buildings preponderate over residential ones. 在市区，商业建筑比住宅建筑占优势。

preposition.note:
In English, words like 'in', 'on', and 'at' function as prepositions. 在英语中，像“in”、“on”和“at”这样的词充当介词。

A preposition is usually followed by a noun or pronoun. 介词通常后面跟着名词或代词。

preposterous.note:
The idea that the earth is flat is completely preposterous. 地球是平的这种想法完全是荒谬的。

He asked such a preposterous price for the used car that I walked away. 他对这辆二手车开出了如此荒唐的价格，以至于我直接走开了。

prerogative.note:
Education is a fundamental human right, not a luxury prerogative. 教育是一项基本人权，而不是奢侈的特权。

As the manager, making the final decision is his sole prerogative. 作为经理，做出最终决定是他的专属特权。

presage.meaning: v. 预示；预兆 n. 预兆
presage.note:
Falling stock prices often presage a broader economic downturn. 下跌的股票价格往往预示着更广泛的经济衰退。

The dark skies were a gloomy presage of the storm to come. 阴暗的天空是即将到来的风暴的阴沉预兆。

prescience.note:
With remarkable prescience, she invested in technology stocks early on. 凭借非凡的先见之明，她早期投资了科技股。

His warnings about the market crash showed incredible prescience. 他对市场崩盘的警告表现出难以置信的先见之明。

presentation.note:
She gave a brilliant presentation on renewable energy technologies. 她就可再生能源技术发表了精彩的演讲。

The award presentation ceremony will take place this Friday. 颁奖典礼将于本周五举行。

presenter.note:
The television presenter welcomed viewers back to the morning talk show. 电视节目主持人欢迎观众回到早间访谈节目。

The famous actor acted as the presenter for best director. 那位著名演员担任最佳导演奖的颁奖人。

pressing.meaning: adj. 紧迫的；急需处理的
pressing.note:
We need to deal with this pressing matter before the end of the day. 我们需要在今天结束前处理好这件紧迫的事情。

Climate change is one of the most pressing issues facing our planet. 气候变化是我们星球面临的最紧迫的问题之一。

presumption.note:
By law, there is a presumption of innocence until proven guilty. 根据法律，在证明有罪之前推定为无罪。

It was sheer presumption on his part to think he could direct the film. 他认为自己能指导这部电影，纯粹是他的放肆。

presupposition.note:
The argument rests on the unproven presupposition that resources are infinite. 该论点建立在资源是无限的未经证实的预设之上。

Philosophical theories often begin with certain hidden presuppositions. 哲学理论往往始于某些隐藏的预设。

pretend.note:
The children liked to pretend they were brave knights in a castle. 孩子们喜欢假装自己是城堡里的勇敢骑士。

He didn't know the answer, so he tried to pretend he was listening. 他不知道答案，于是试图假装他在听。

pretension.note:
He lived a modest life without any intellectual pretensions. 他过着简朴的生活，没有任何知识上的自负。

The restaurant offers great food without unnecessary pretension. 这家餐厅提供美妙的食物，没有不必要的浮夸。

pretentious.meaning: adj. 自命不凡的；矫揉造作的
pretentious.note:
She hated the pretentious art gallery filled with meaningless abstract pieces. 她讨厌那个充满无意义抽象作品的自命不凡的艺术画廊。

He used pretentious language to impress his colleagues at the meeting. 他在会议上使用矫揉造作的语言来给同事留下深刻印象。

preternatural.note:
She possessed a preternatural ability to sense people's emotions. 她拥有感知人们情绪的超自然能力。

The silence in the abandoned house felt preternatural. 废弃房子里的寂静让人觉得异常。

pretext.note:
He visited her apartment under the pretext of returning a book. 他以还书为借口拜访了她的公寓。

They used security concerns as a pretext for restricting public access. 他们以安全考虑为借口限制公众进入。

prevaricate.meaning: v. 支吾其词；说谎；搪塞
prevaricate.note:
When questioned by reporters, the politician tried to prevaricate. 当被记者提问时，这位政治家试图支吾其词。

Stop prevaricating and give me a straight answer. 别再搪塞了，给我一个直接的回答。

preview.meaning: n. 预映；预览 v. 预看；试演
preview.note:
Movie fans lined up to watch an exclusive preview of the blockbuster. 电影迷们排队观看这部大片的独家预告片。

Teachers can preview the online course materials before classes begin. 教师可以在课程开始前预览在线课程材料。

previous.note:
She had met the manager on a previous occasion. 她在以前的一个场合见过这位经理。

Read the previous chapter to understand the context of the story. 阅读前一章以理解故事的背景。

prim.meaning: adj. 古板的；拘谨的；一丝不苟的
prim.note:
She sat in a prim posture with her hands neatly folded in her lap. 她以古板的姿势坐着，双手整齐地叠在大腿上。

The prim librarian disapproved of loud laughter in the reading room. 那位拘谨的图书管理员不赞成阅览室里的大声笑闹。

primate.meaning: n. 灵长类动物；大主教
primate.note:
Humans, apes, and monkeys belong to the order of primates. 人类、猿和猴子属于灵长类动物。

Biologists study the complex social behavior of various primates. 生物学家研究各种灵长类动物复杂的社会行为。

prime.meaning: adj. 主要的；首要的 n. 全盛时期 v. 事先指点
prime.note:
Safety is of prime importance when working with heavy machinery. 操作重型机械时，安全是首要的。

Athletes usually reach the prime of their careers in their late twenties. 运动员通常在二十多岁后期达到他们职业生涯的全盛时期。

primp.note:
She spent a long time in front of the mirror primping her hair. 她在镜子前花了很长时间梳理头发。

He stood by the door primping his tie before the interview. 面试前他站在门边整理领带。

priority.meaning: n. 优先事项；首要任务
priority.note:
Completing this project on time is our top priority. 按时完成这个项目是我们的首要任务。

Patient health care must be given priority over administrative costs. 必须优先考虑患者医疗保健，而不是行政成本。

privation.note:
The war years were marked by severe economic hardship and privation. 战争年代以严重的经济困难和物资匮乏为标志。

Citizens endured great privation during the long winter siege. 公民在漫长的冬季围困期间忍受了极大的匮乏。

probity.note:
He was a judge known for his uncompromised moral probity. 他是一位以毫不妥协的道德正直而闻名的法官。

The financial auditor certified the company's accounts, ensuring corporate probity. 财务审计员证明了公司的账目，确保了公司的廉洁。

proboscis.note:
The butterfly uses its long proboscis to sip nectar from flowers. 蝴蝶用其长长的口器吸吮花蜜。

An elephant uses its muscular proboscis to breathe and grasp objects. 大象用其肌肉发达的长鼻来呼吸和抓取物体。

procession.note:
A colorful carnival procession moved down the main street. 一支色彩斑斓的狂欢节队伍沿主街前进。

Wedding guests walked in a grand procession toward the banquet hall. 婚礼宾客排成盛大的行列走向宴会厅。

proclamation.note:
The government issued a formal proclamation regarding the new holiday. 政府就新节日发布了正式公告。

The king's proclamation granted freedom to all political prisoners. 国王的宣言给予所有政治犯自由。

procrastinate.note:
Try not to procrastinate when working on your research assignments. 在做研究作业时尽量不要拖延。

His tendency to procrastinate often resulted in last-minute stress. 他拖延的倾向经常导致最后一刻的压力。

proctor.meaning: n. 监考人 v. 监考
proctor.note:
University professors volunteered to proctor the final examination. 大学教授们自愿担任期末考试的监考人。

The strict proctor walked up and down the aisles during the test. 严格的监考人在考试期间在过道里走来走去。

procure.note:
The library managed to procure a rare manuscript from abroad. 图书馆设法从国外采购到了一份珍贵的手稿。

She helped the team procure the necessary equipment for the laboratory. 她帮助团队采购了实验室所需的设备。

procurement.note:
He works in the department of corporate material procurement. 他在公司物资采购部门工作。

The strict rules govern the procurement of government contracts. 严格的规则管辖着政府合同的采购。

prod.meaning: v. 戳；刺；促使 n. 刺棒；提醒
prod.note:
She gave him a gentle prod in the ribs to wake him up. 她轻轻捅了捅他的肋骨把他弄醒。

The teacher had to prod the lazy student into finishing his homework. 老师不得不促使那个懒惰的学生完成作业。

prodigal.meaning: adj. 挥霍的；浪费的 n. 浪子
prodigal.note:
His prodigal spending habits quickly depleted his inheritance. 他挥霍的花钱习惯迅速耗尽了他的遗产。

The prodigal son finally returned home to ask for forgiveness. 浪子最终回家请求原谅。

prodigious.meaning: adj. 巨大的；惊人的；异常的
prodigious.note:
The construction project required a prodigious amount of steel and concrete. 该建筑工程需要巨量的钢材和混凝土。

Mozart showed prodigious musical talent at a very young age. 莫扎特在很小的时候就展现出惊人的音乐天赋。

prodigy.note:
The young math prodigy entered university at the age of twelve. 这位年轻的数学神童在十二岁时进入大学。

She was recognized as a child prodigy in classical piano performance. 她被公认为古典钢琴演奏的神童。

proffer.meaning: v. 提供；呈献 n. 提供
proffer.note:
He stood up to proffer his sincere apologies to the committee. 他站起来向委员会表示诚挚的歉意。

She gratefully accepted the help proffered by her neighbors. 她感激地接受了邻居提供的帮助。

proficient.note:
She is highly proficient in both Spanish and French. 她精通西班牙语和法语。

It takes time to become proficient in using professional software. 熟练使用专业软件需要时间。

profile.meaning: n. 侧面；简介；形象 v. 概述
profile.note:
The magazine published a fascinating profile of the famous novelist. 这杂志发表了一篇关于这位著名小说家的迷人简介。

Her face was captured in sharp profile against the sunset. 她的脸在夕阳映衬下呈现出清晰的侧面轮廓。

profiteer.meaning: n. 投机倒把者；奸商 v. 牟取暴利
profiteer.note:
Unscrupulous merchants were accused of acting as wartime profiteers. 无良商人被指控充当战时奸商。

They sought to profiteer from the sudden shortage of medical supplies. 他们试图从医疗物资的突然短缺中牟取暴利。

profligate.meaning: adj. 挥霍的；放荡的 n. 挥霍无度者
profligate.note:
His profligate lifestyle left him deeply in debt. 他挥霍无度的生活方式使他债台高筑。

The report criticized the corporation's profligate use of public funds. 该报告批评了该公司对公共资金的挥霍。

profuse.meaning: adj. 丰富的；大量的；慷慨的
profuse.note:
She offered profuse apologies for the mistake she made. 她为自己犯下的错误表达了大量的歉意。

Rainfall in the tropical rainforest creates profuse vegetation growth. 热带雨林的降雨形成了丰富的植被生长。

progeny.note:
The animal protects its progeny from potential predators with fierce dedication. 这种动物以坚定的奉献精神保护其后代免受潜在捕食者的侵害。

He left his entire estate to his children and other legal progeny. 他将全部遗产留给了他的孩子和其他合法后代。

prognosis.note:
The doctor gave a positive prognosis for the patient's full recovery. 医生对患者的完全康复给出了乐观的预后。

Economic prognosis for the coming year remains uncertain. 明年的经济预测依然不确定。

prohibitive.meaning: adj. 价格昂贵的；禁止的
prohibitive.note:
The cost of housing in the city center is prohibitive for young buyers. 市中心的高昂房价对年轻买家来说是难以承受的。

High insurance rates act as a prohibitive barrier for small businesses. 高额保险费成为小企业难以逾越的障碍。

projectile.meaning: n. 抛射物；发射体；弹丸
projectile.note:
Police analyzed the trajectory of the projectile found at the scene. 警察分析了现场发现的抛射物的弹道轨迹。

Ancient soldiers used catapults to hurl heavy projectiles at enemy walls. 古代士兵使用投石机向敌人的城墙投掷重型弹丸。

projector.note:
The teacher connected her laptop to the classroom projector. 老师把她的笔记本电脑连接到了教室的投影仪上。

Old film projectors flickered in the cinema museum. 老式电影放映机在电影博物馆里闪烁着光芒。

prolix.note:
The essay was too prolix and needed heavy editing to be concise. 这篇文章太冗长了，需要大量删减以变得简练。

Readers grew tired of the author's prolix descriptions. 读者们对作者冗长的描述感到厌倦。

prolixity.note:
His speech suffered from unnecessary prolixity and repetition. 他的演讲因不必要的冗长和重复而大打折扣。

Editor requested the removal of prolixity from the final manuscript. 编辑要求从最终手稿中去除冗长部分。

prologue.note:
The novel opens with a mysterious prologue set in the nineteenth century. 这本小说以十九世纪为背景的一个神秘序幕开篇。

An introductory prologue provides essential background information. 介绍性的开场白提供了必要的背景信息。

promenade.meaning: n. 散步大道；海滨大道 v. 漫步
promenade.note:
Tourists enjoyed a relaxing evening walk along the scenic coastal promenade. 游客们沿着风景优美的海滨大道享受放松的晚间散步。

Couples love to promenade by the lake during sunset. 情侣们喜欢在日落时分在湖边漫步。

promote.note:
She was recently promoted to senior marketing manager. 她最近被晋升为高级营销经理。

The campaign aims to promote healthy eating habits among children. 该活动旨在促进儿童健康的饮食习惯。

prompt.meaning: adj. 敏捷的；迅速的 v. 促使 n. 提示
prompt.note:
We appreciate your prompt response to our email inquiry. 我们感谢您对我们电邮查询的迅速回复。

Curiosity often prompts children to ask endless questions. 好奇心经常促使孩子问个没完没了的问题。

promulgate.note:
The government will formally promulgate the new constitution next week. 政府将于下周正式颁布新宪法。

Organizations work to promulgate awareness about environmental issues. 各种组织致力于传播有关环境问题的意识。

prop.meaning: n. 道具；支柱 v. 支撑
prop.note:
The theater crew moved various furniture and props onto the stage. 剧组人员将各种家具和道具搬上舞台。

He used a wooden block to prop open the heavy door. 他用一块木头把重门撑开。

propagation.note:
Gardeners study the artificial propagation of rare plant species. 园丁研究珍稀植物物种的人工繁殖。

The Internet revolutionized the propagation of information worldwide. 互联网彻底改变了信息在全球的传播。

propeller.note:
The airplane's engine spun the metal propeller at high speed. 飞机发动机高速旋转金属螺旋桨。

Large ships rely on underwater propellers to move through the water. 大型船只依靠水下螺旋桨在水中航行。

propensity.note:
He has a natural propensity for taking risks in business. 他在商业上有冒险的天然倾向。

Her propensity for collecting stray cats resulted in a crowded house. 她收集流浪猫的癖好导致家里挤满了猫。

prophecy.note:
The ancient myth spoke of a strange prophecy coming true. 那个古老的神话讲述了一个奇怪预言的实现。

Her prediction turned out to be a self-fulfilling prophecy. 她的预测结果成了一个自我实现的预言。

prophet.note:
The biblical prophet foretold difficult times ahead for the kingdom. 圣经先知预言了王国外来艰难的日子。

He was regarded as a visionary prophet of the digital revolution. 他被视为数字革命的富有远见的先知。

prophetic.note:
His warning about the market failure proved to be chillingly prophetic. 他对市场崩溃的警告被证明具有令人发指的预言性。

She had a prophetic dream about winning the competition. 她做了一个关于赢得比赛的预言性梦。

propitiate.note:
Ancient rituals were performed to propitiate angry gods. 人们举行古代仪式来抚慰愤怒的神灵。

He tried to propitiate his angry boss by offering extra help. 他试图通过提供额外帮助来讨好生气的上司。

propitious.meaning: adj. 吉利的；顺利的；有利的
propitious.note:
Clear skies provided a propitious beginning for their outdoor wedding. 晴朗的天空为他们的户外婚礼提供了一个吉祥的开端。

Investors are waiting for a propitious moment to enter the market. 投资者正在等待进入市场的有利时机。

proprietary.meaning: adj. 私有的；专卖的；专利的
proprietary.note:
The software is protected by proprietary rights and copyright laws. 该软件受专有权和版权法的保护。

The recipe is a closely guarded proprietary secret of the company. 这个配方是该公司严密守护的专有秘密。

propriety.note:
She always acted with strict adherence to social propriety. 她行事总是严格遵守社会礼仪。

He questioned the propriety of discussing confidential matters in public. 他质疑在公共场合讨论机密事情是否得体。

propulsion.note:
Jet engines use rocket propulsion systems to achieve high speed. 喷气发动机使用火箭推进系统来达到高速。

Electric cars rely on battery systems for forward propulsion. 电动汽车依靠电池系统进行向前推进。

prosaic.meaning: adj. 平淡的；乏味的；世俗的
prosaic.note:
His life was filled with prosaic routines and mundane chores. 他的生活充满了平淡的日常和世俗的杂务。

She preferred creative writing over prosaic technical manuals. 她更喜欢创意写作，而不是乏味的技术手册。

proscribe.note:
The school rules proscribe the use of mobile phones during class. 学校规章禁止在上课期间使用手机。

Certain dangerous practices are strictly proscribed by international law. 某些危险做法被国际法严格禁止。

prose.note:
The author is famous for his elegant style of French prose. 这位作家以其优雅的法语散文风格而闻名。

She wrote both poetry and prose throughout her literary career. 在她整个文学生涯中，她既写诗歌又写散文。

proselytize.note:
Missionaries traveled overseas to proselytize local communities. 传教士出国到当地社区传教。

He tried to proselytize his friends to his political ideology. 他试图劝说朋友接受他的政治意识形态。

prospect.meaning: n. 前景；远景；候选人 v. 勘探
prospect.note:
She was excited about the prospect of studying abroad next year. 她对明年出国留学的远景感到兴奋。

Miners spent months prospecting for gold in the remote mountains. 矿工们在偏远的山区花了几个月时间勘探黄金。

prosperous.note:
The nation entered a long period of prosperous economic growth. 这个国家进入了一个繁荣经济增长的长时期。

They live in a prosperous neighborhood on the edge of town. 他们住在镇边缘的一个繁荣社区里。

prostrate.meaning: adj. 伏地的；俯卧的 v. 使拜倒；使屈服
prostrate.note:
He lay prostrate on the ground in prayer. 他俯卧在地上祈祷。

Grief-stricken, she fell prostrate before the altar. 悲痛欲绝的她瘫倒在祭坛前。

protagonist.note:
The protagonist of the novel faces many difficult moral choices. 小说的主角面临着许多困难的道德选择。

She was a leading protagonist in the fight for civil rights. 她是争取民权斗争中的主要倡导者。

protean.meaning: adj. 变化多端的；多才多艺的
protean.note:
The actor was known for his protean ability to play any role. 这位演员以其能扮演任何角色的多变能力而闻名。

Water has a protean nature in different environmental conditions. 水在不同的环境条件下具有变化多端的性质。

protest.meaning: n. 抗议；反对 v. 抗议
protest.note:
Thousands of citizens joined the peaceful protest outside parliament. 成千上万的公民参加了议会大厦外的和平抗议。

Workers decided to protest against low wages and unfair conditions. 工人们决定抗议低工资和不公平的条件。

protocol.note:
Diplomatic protocol requires guests to address officials with respect. 外交礼节要求客人们以尊重的态度称呼官员。

Medical staff must follow strict safety protocols during surgery. 医务人员在手术过程中必须遵守严格的安全方案。

prototype.note:
Engineers built a working prototype of the new electric vehicle. 工程师们建造了新型电动汽车的工作原型。

The device served as a prototype for future technological developments. 该设备成为了未来技术发展的雏形。

protract.note:
Both sides tried to avoid a protracted legal battle in court. 双方都试图避免在法庭上进行一场持久的法律诉讼。

Lack of consensus only served to protract the negotiations. 缺乏共识只会延长谈判时间。

protuberance.note:
A strange bony protuberance appeared on his shoulder. 他的肩膀上出现了一个奇怪的骨性质突起。

Geologists studied the rocky protuberance on the mountain slope. 地质学家研究了山坡上的岩石隆起物。

protuberant.note:
The creature had large, protuberant eyes that helped it see in the dark. 这种生物拥有大而突出的眼睛，有助于它在黑暗中看清东西。

He noticed a protuberant rock sticking out of the dirt path. 他注意到泥路里突出一块岩石。

provenance.note:
Art experts carefully verified the painting's historical provenance. 艺术专家仔细核实了这幅画的历史出处。

The antique dealer traced the exact provenance of the silver bowl. 古董商追溯了这只银碗的确切产地。

provender.note:
Horses chewed happily on the fresh provender in the stable. 马儿在马厩里愉快地嚼着新鲜的粮草。

Travelers packed enough provender for a week-long journey. 旅行者打包了足够一周旅程的食物。

provident.meaning: adj. 有远见的；顾及未来的；节俭的
provident.note:
Being provident, she saved a portion of her salary every month. 因为很有远见，她每个月都存下一部分工资。

His provident investment strategy protected him from market crashes. 他有远见的投资策略保护他免受市场崩盘的影响。

providential.meaning: adj. 幸运的；天意的；适时的
providential.note:
Their arrival was providential, just as the car broke down. 他们的到来真是凑巧，刚好在汽车抛锚的时候。

He considered his survival to be a providential rescue. 他认为自己能活下来是一次天意的救援。

provincial.meaning: adj. 省的；地方性的；狭隘的 n. 外省人
provincial.note:
She grew tired of the narrow-minded provincial attitude of the small town. 她厌倦了那个小镇狭隘的地方观念。

The museum houses a rich collection of provincial art and history. 博物馆里收藏了丰富的外省艺术和历史藏品。

provisory.meaning: adj. 有条件的；临时性的
provisory.note:
The contract agreement remained provisory pending final approval. 在最终批准之前，合同协议仍然是有条件的。

They signed a provisorary deal before hashing out the details. 在敲定细节之前，他们签署了一份临时协议。

provocation.note:
He remained calm and refused to respond to their constant provocation. 他保持镇定，拒绝回应他们持续的挑衅。

The attack occurred without any prior provocation. 袭击发生前没有任何先兆的挑衅。

prowess.meaning: n. 高超的技巧；勇猛；非凡的能力
prowess.note:
The knight was famous for his military prowess on the battlefield. 这位骑士以其在战场上的勇猛而闻名。

She demonstrated remarkable technical prowess in software engineering. 她在软件工程方面表现出了非凡的技术能力。

prowl.meaning: v. 潜行；四处搜寻 n. 潜行寻找
prowl.note:
Wild cats prowl through the tall grass in search of prey. 野猫在长草中潜行寻找猎物。

Police warned residents about thieves on the prowl in the neighborhood. 警察警告居民注意社区里四处搜寻的小偷。

proximate.note:
The proximate cause of the accident was a sudden brake failure. 事故的最直接原因是突然的刹车失灵。

We need to analyze both the proximate and ultimate factors of the issue. 我们需要分析该问题的最直接和最终因素。

prude.meaning: n. 大惊小怪的人；过分拘泥于礼节的人
prude.note:
Don't be such a prude; a little joke won't hurt anyone. 别那么古板；开个小玩笑不会伤害任何人。

She was no prude and enjoyed discussing open topics. 她绝不是个保守拘泥的人，喜欢讨论开放的话题。

prudence.note:
Financial prudence requires saving money for unexpected emergencies. 财务审慎要求为突发的紧急情况存钱。

He acted with great prudence when making investment decisions. 他在做投资决策时表现得非常谨慎。

prudish.meaning: adj. 过分正经的；矫情保守的
prudish.note:
Her prudish reaction to the modern art exhibition surprised her friends. 她对现代艺术展过分保守的反应让朋友们感到惊讶。

Society has become less prudish about discussing personal relationships. 社会在讨论个人关系方面变得没有那么保守了。

prune.meaning: v. 修剪；删减 n. 梅干
prune.note:
The gardener used shears to prune the overgrown rosebushes. 园丁用大剪刀修剪长满的玫瑰灌木丛。

Editors must prune unnecessary paragraphs to improve readability. 编辑必须删减不必要的段落以提高可读性。

pry.note:
I hate it when neighbors try to pry into my private life. 我讨厌邻居试图窥探我的私生活。

He used a screwdriver to pry open the locked box. 他用螺丝刀撬开带锁的箱子。

pseudonym.note:
The famous author published her controversial novel under a pseudonym. 这位著名作家以笔名出版了她那本有争议的小说。

He wrote articles online using a clever online pseudonym. 他在网上用一个聪明的网络假名写文章。

psyche.note:
Art and literature offer deep insights into the human psyche. 艺术和文学提供了对人类心灵的深刻洞察。

Traumatic events can leave lasting scars on a person's psyche. 创伤事件会在一个人的精神上留下持久的伤痕。

psychology.note:
She decided to major in child psychology at university. 她决定在大学主修儿童心理学。

Understanding consumer psychology is crucial for successful marketing. 理解消费者心理对于成功营销至关重要。

publicize.meaning: v. 宣传；公布；广为宣传
publicize.note:
The charity used social media to publicize its upcoming fundraising event. 该慈善机构利用社交媒体宣传其即将到来的筹款活动。

The government plans to publicize new health guidelines next month. 政府计划在下个月公布新的健康指南。

pucker.meaning: v. 起皱；收缩 n. 褶皱
pucker.note:
She puckered her lips in concentration as she painted. 她画画时专注地抿起嘴唇。

The fabric began to pucker after it was washed in hot water. 这块布料在热水洗涤后开始起皱。

puckish.note:
He smiled with a puckish grin before playing a practical joke. 在恶作剧之前，他露出了顽皮的笑容。

Her puckish sense of humor always brought laughter to her friends. 她顽皮的幽默感总是给朋友们带来欢笑。

puddle.meaning: n. 水坑；泥潭 v. 弄湿
puddle.note:
The children loved jumping into muddy puddles after the rain. 孩子们喜欢在雨后跳进泥泞的水坑里。

Rainwater gathered in a large puddle in the middle of the yard. 雨水在院子中央积成了一个大水坑。

puerile.meaning: adj. 幼稚的；孩子气的；愚蠢的
puerile.note:
Everyone was annoyed by his puerile jokes during the serious meeting. 每个人都对他在严肃会议期间幼稚的笑话感到恼火。

She scolded them for their puerile behavior. 她为他们幼稚的行为训斥了他们。

pugilism.note:
He dedicated his youth to the art of pugilism and eventually won the championship. 他将青春奉献给拳击艺术，最终赢得了冠军。

Pugilism requires not only physical strength but also immense tactical discipline. 拳击不仅需要体力，还需要极大的战术纪律。

pugilist.note:
The veteran pugilism announced his retirement after a brilliant career. 这位资深拳击手在辉煌的职业生涯后宣布退役。

Every professional pugilist must undergo rigorous training before a big match. 每个职业拳击手在大赛前都必须接受严格的训练。

pugnacious.note:
His pugnacious attitude during the debate alienated many of his colleagues. 他在辩论中好斗的态度疏远了许多同事。

Even as a child, he showed a pugnacious temperament, often getting into school fights. 甚至在孩提时代，他就表现出好斗的脾气，经常在学校打架。

puissance.note:
The empire reached the zenith of its puissance in the eighteenth century. 这个帝国在十八世纪达到了其权势的巅峰。

Artists of the Renaissance demonstrated the puissance of human creativity. 文艺复兴时期的艺术家展示了人类创造力的强大力量。

puissant.note:
A puissant monarch ruled the realm with absolute authority. 一个强大的君主以绝对的权威统治着这个王国。

Technology has become a puissant force shaping modern society. 技术已经成为塑造现代社会的强大力量。

pulchritude.note:
The classical poetry celebrated the eternal pulchritude of nature. 古典诗歌赞美了自然永恒的美丽。

She was renowned throughout the kingdom for both her intellect and pulchritude. 她因才智和美貌闻名整个王国。

pullet.note:
The farmer sorted the young pullets from the older laying hens. 农场主将小母鸡与较年长的产蛋母鸡分离开来。

Raising healthy pullets is essential for a successful egg production business. 养育健康的小母鸡对于成功的鸡蛋生产业务至关重要。

pulley.note:
The workers used a system of ropes and pulleys to lift heavy loads. 工人们使用绳索和滑轮系统来吊起重物。

A mechanical pulley reduces the amount of force needed to raise an object. 机械滑轮减少了举起物体所需的力气。

pulp.note:
Crush the tomatoes into a thick pulp before adding them to the sauce. 将西红柿捣成浓稠的果肉浆，然后再加入酱汁中。

Wood pulp is the primary raw material used in paper manufacturing. 木浆是造纸制造中使用的主要原材料。

pulse.meaning: n. 脉搏；脉冲 v. 跳动，搏动
pulse.note:
The nurse checked the patient's pulse to monitor his condition. 护士检查了病人的脉搏以监测他的病情。

Loud electronic music pulsed through the crowded underground club. 嘈杂的电子音乐在拥挤的地下俱乐部里搏动。

pulverize.meaning: v. 粉碎，研磨；彻底击败
pulverize.note:
The machine can pulverize stones into fine powder within minutes. 这台机器能在几分钟内将石头粉碎成细粉。

The visiting team was pulverized in the final match of the tournament. 客队在锦标赛的决赛中被彻底击败。

pun.meaning: n. 双关语 v. 讲双关语
pun.note:
His speech was full of clever puns that made the audience laugh. 他的演讲充满了巧妙的双关语，逗得观众哈哈大笑。

He loves to pun whenever he gets the opportunity in casual conversation. 他喜欢在日常对话中只要有机会就开双关语玩笑。

punch.meaning: n. 拳打；冲床；水果宾治酒 v. 用拳打；打孔
punch.note:
He threw a sudden punch that knocked his opponent to the floor. 他突然打出一拳，将对手击倒在地。

Please punch your ticket at the validation machine before boarding. 上车前请在验票机上给您的车票打孔。

punctilious.meaning: adj. 一丝不苟的，谨小慎微的
punctilious.note:
The general was punctilious about the uniform regulations of his soldiers. 将军对士兵的军服规章一丝不苟。

She is extremely punctilious regarding matters of etiquette and protocol. 她在礼仪和礼节问题上极其谨小慎微。

pundit.note:
Political pundits gathered on television to analyze the election results. 政治评论员们聚集在电视上分析选举结果。

Financial pundits offered conflicting predictions about the stock market crash. 金融专家们对股市崩盘给出了相互矛盾的预测。

pungent.meaning: adj. 刺激性的，辛辣的；尖锐的
pungent.note:
The kitchen was filled with the pungent smell of onions and garlic. 厨房里充满了洋葱和大蒜的辛辣气味。

Her pungent criticism caught the management team completely off guard. 她尖锐的批评让管理团队完全措手不及。

puny.meaning: adj. 微小的，细弱的，无能的
puny.note:
Compared to the giant machine, his efforts looked rather puny. 与这台庞大的机器相比，他的努力显得相当微小。

The plant struggled to grow in the puny patch of soil. 这株植物在一小块贫瘠的土地上艰难生长。

purchase.meaning: n. 购买；购买的物品 v. 购买
purchase.note:
She made a large purchase of furniture for her new apartment. 她为新公寓购买了大量的家具。

You can purchase your tickets online or at the box office. 您可以在网上或售票处购买门票。

purgative.meaning: adj. 泻药的；净化的 n. 泻药
purgative.note:
The doctor prescribed a mild purgative to treat his digestive issue. 医生开了一种温和的泻药来治疗他的消化问题。

Art can sometimes serve as a purgative experience for emotional trauma. 艺术有时可以作为治愈情感创伤的一种净化体验。

purgatory.note:
According to Catholic theology, souls in purgatory undergo purification. 根据天主教神学，炼狱中的灵魂经历净化。

Waiting for the test results felt like living in absolute purgatory. 等待测试结果感觉就像生活在绝对的苦难折磨中。

purge.meaning: v. 清除，清洗；净化 n. 清洗，肃清
purge.note:
The new administration promised to purge corrupt officials from office. 新政府承诺将贪官污吏从职位上清除出去。

She decided to purge her wardrobe of clothes she no longer wore. 她决定清理衣橱里不再穿的衣服。

purify.note:
Special filters are used to purify the drinking water in the city. 特殊的过滤器用于净化城市中的饮用水。

Chemical methods were applied to purify the extracted compound. 应用化学方法来提纯提取出的化合物。

purity.note:
Scientists tested the purity of the gold sample in the laboratory. 科学家在实验室里测试了黄金样本的纯度。

The purity of her intentions could not be doubted by anyone. 任何人都不容怀疑她意图的纯洁性。

purlieu.meaning: n. 边缘地区，毗邻地区；常去的地方
purlieu.note:
He spent his childhood exploring the leafy purlieus of the old estate. 他度过了童年时光，探索着旧庄园绿树成荫的边缘地区。

They rarely ventured outside the immediate purlieus of their neighborhood. 他们很少冒险离开他们社区的直接毗邻地区。

purloin.note:
Someone managed to purloin confidential files from the archive room. 有人设法从档案室偷走了机密文件。

The mischievous student tried to purloin an apple from the cafeteria. 这个调皮的学生试图从食堂偷一个苹果。

purported.meaning: adj. 传说的，声称的，号称的
purported.note:
The police investigated the purported theft of valuable antique artifacts. 警方调查了声称被盗的贵重古董文物案件。

His purported masterpiece turned out to be a cheap imitation. 他号称的杰作结果证明是一个廉价的模仿品。

purvey.meaning: v. 供应，供给（食物、货物等）
purvey.note:
The local market purveys fresh organic produce to the community. 当地市场向社区供应新鲜的有机农产品。

They purvey high-end luxury goods to wealthy clients worldwide. 他们向全球富裕客户供应高端奢侈品。

pusillanimous.note:
His pusillanimous response to the crisis drew heavy criticism from the public. 他对危机的懦弱反应招致了公众的严厉批评。

We cannot afford to be pusillanimous when faced with major challenges. 面对重大挑战时，我们不能表现得胆小。

pylon.meaning: n. 铁塔，高压电塔；标志塔
pylon.note:
Tall electricity pylons stretched across the open farmland. 高大的高压电塔延伸穿过开阔的农田。

The airport runway was marked by bright orange pylons. 机场跑道用明亮的橙色标志塔做了标记。

pyre.note:
Ancient rituals often involved burning offerings on a wooden pyre. 古代仪式经常包括在木柴堆上燃烧祭品。

The hero's body was placed on a magnificent funeral pyre. 英雄的遗体被安放在宏伟的葬礼火葬堆上。

quack.meaning: n. 庸医；鸭叫声 v. 呱呱叫
quack.note:
He was exposed as a quack who sold fake medicine to sick people. 他被揭露是一个向病人兜售假药的庸医。

The ducks began to quack loudly as we threw breadcrumbs into the pond. 当我们向池塘里扔面包屑时，鸭子开始大声地呱呱叫。

quaff.note:
The thirsty hikers stopped to quaff cold water from the mountain stream. 口渴的徒步旅行者停下来畅饮山涧的凉水。

He quaffed a large mug of ale after a long day of hard labor. 经过一整天的重体力劳动后，他痛饮了一大杯麦芽酒。

quail.meaning: n. 鹌鹑 v. 畏缩，胆怯
quail.note:
Hunters spotted a small covey of wild quail hiding in the grass. 猎人们发现在草丛中藏着一小群野鹌鹑。

She did not quail in the face of intense interrogation. 在激烈的审讯面前，她并没有畏缩。

quaint.meaning: adj. 古雅的，别致的，离奇有趣的
quaint.note:
They stayed in a quaint little cottage in the English countryside. 他们住在英格兰乡村一个古雅的小屋里。

The village is famous for its narrow streets and quaint architecture. 这个村庄以其狭窄的街道和别致的建筑而闻名。

qualified.meaning: adj. 有资格的，胜任的；有限制的
qualified.note:
Only fully qualified engineers are allowed to inspect the bridge. 只有完全胜任的工程师才被允许检查这座桥梁。

He gave a qualified approval to the new project proposal. 他对新项目提案给予了有保留的批准。

qualms.note:
She had serious qualms about signing such a risky contract. 对于签署如此冒险的合同，她有着严重的疑虑。

He cheated on the test without any moral qualms whatsoever. 他作弊时没有任何道德上的内疚感。

quandary.meaning: n. 困惑，进退维谷，窘境
quandary.note:
She was in a quandary about whether to accept the job offer or stay. 她陷入了是接受工作机会还是留下的两难窘境。

Financial losses left the company in a deep quandary. 财务亏损让公司陷入了深深的困境。

quantum.meaning: n. 量子；定量 adj. 量子的，突飞猛进的
quantum.note:
Quantum mechanics revolutionized our understanding of physics. 量子力学彻底改变了我们对物理学的理解。

The company experienced a quantum leap in sales this year. 该公司今年的销售额实现了突飞猛进的增长。

quarantine.meaning: n. 隔离期 v. 隔离
quarantine.note:
All incoming pets must undergo a two-week quarantine period. 所有入境的宠物必须经历两周的隔离期。

The health department decided to quarantine the infected neighborhood. 卫生部门决定隔离受感染的社区。

quarry.meaning: n. 采石场；猎物，追捕目标 v. 开采
quarry.note:
Large blocks of limestone were excavated from the deep quarry. 深邃的采石场里开掘出了大块的石灰石。

The detective pursued his quarry relentlessly through the city streets. 侦探在城市街道上锲而不舍地追捕他的目标。

quartet.note:
The string quartet performed a classical piece by Mozart. 弦乐四重奏演奏了莫扎特的古典作品。

A talented quartet of singers took the stage to open the concert. 一个由才华横溢的歌手组成的四人组登台拉开了音乐会的序幕。

quash.meaning: v. 镇压，平息；撤销，废止
quash.note:
The government moved quickly to quash the rumors spreading online. 政府迅速采取行动平息了在网上流传的谣言。

The high court decided to quash the original conviction. 高等法院决定撤销原判。

quaver.meaning: v. 发颤音，颤抖 n. 颤音
quaver.note:
Her voice began to quaver as she spoke about her difficult childhood. 当她谈到自己艰难的童年时，她的声音开始发颤。

There was a slight quaver in his tone when he confessed. 他坦白时，语气中带着一丝轻微的颤抖。

quay.note:
Fishing boats were safely moored along the stone quay. 渔船安全地停泊在石砌码头沿岸。

Passengers stood on the quay waving goodbye to their friends on the ship. 乘客们站在码头上向船上的朋友挥手告别。

quell.meaning: v. 平息，镇压；消除（恐惧等）
quell.note:
Extra police forces were deployed to quell the violent riots. 部署了额外的警力来平息暴烈的骚乱。

She took a deep breath to quell her mounting anxiety before the interview. 她深吸了一口气，以消除面试前不断上升的焦虑。

quench.note:
Firefighters worked for hours to quench the raging forest fire. 消防员工作了几个小时才扑灭熊熊燃烧的森林大火。

He drank a large glass of lemonade to quench his thirst. 他喝了一大杯柠檬水来解渴。

querulous.meaning: adj. 暴躁的，爱抱怨的，挑剔的
querulous.note:
The old man grew increasingly querulous as his health deteriorated. 随着健康状况恶化，这位老人变得越来越爱抱怨。

Her querulous complaints about the service annoyed everyone at the table. 她对服务的挑剔抱怨惹恼了桌上的每个人。

quest.meaning: n. 探索，追求，寻求 v. 寻求，搜寻
quest.note:
The knight embarked on a dangerous quest to find the hidden treasure. 骑士踏上寻找隐藏宝藏的危险探索之旅。

Scientists are on a constant quest for renewable energy sources. 科学家们一直在不断寻求可再生能源。

quibble.meaning: n. 诡辩，吹毛求疵 v. 为琐事争吵，挑剔
quibble.note:
Don't quibble over a few dollars when the total bill is so large. 总账单这么大，不要为几美元吹毛求疵。

His objections were mere quibbles that ignored the main issue. 他的反对意见纯粹是忽视核心问题的吹毛求疵。

quiescent.meaning: adj. 静止的，沉寂的，休眠的
quiescent.note:
The volcano has remained quiescent for more than two centuries. 这座火山已经休眠了两个多世纪。

After a period of rapid expansion, the market entered a quiescent phase. 在经历了快速扩张期后，市场进入了一个沉寂阶段。

quill.meaning: n. 羽毛笔；（豪猪等的）刺
quill.note:
The historical document was written in ink using an old goose quill. 这份历史文件是用旧鹅毛笔蘸着墨水写的。

Porcupines use their sharp quills to defend themselves against predators. 豪猪用它们锋利的刺来防范掠食者。

quisling.note:
He was labeled a quisling for collaborating with the invading forces. 他因与侵略军勾结而被贴上了叛徒的标签。

History remembers quislings with universal contempt and disdain. 历史对卖国贼报以普遍的蔑视和鄙视。

quiver.meaning: v. 颤抖，微颤 n. 箭筒；颤抖
quiver.note:
Her lips began to quiver as she tried to hold back her tears. 当她试图忍住眼泪时，她的嘴唇开始颤抖。

The archer reached into his leather quiver to draw another arrow. 弓箭手将手伸进皮质箭筒里拔出另一支箭。

quixotic.meaning: adj. 不切实际的，堂吉诃德式的，空想的
quixotic.note:
His plan to eliminate poverty overnight was hopelessly quixotic. 他一夜之间消灭贫困的计划是毫无希望的不切实际。

She embarked on a quixotic campaign to reform the entire legal system. 她展开了一场堂吉诃德式的运动，试图改革整个法律体系。

quota.note:
Sales representatives must meet their monthly production quota. 销售代表必须完成每月的生产指标。

The government imposed a strict import quota on foreign steel. 政府对外国钢铁实施了严格的进口配额。

quotidian.meaning: adj. 每日的，平常的，平凡的
quotidian.note:
He found solace in the quotidian routine of cooking and gardening. 他在做饭和园艺的平常日常中找到了安慰。

The documentary focuses on the quotidian lives of ordinary factory workers. 这部纪录片聚焦于普通工厂工人的平凡生活。

rabble.meaning: n. 乌合之众，下层民众
rabble.note:
An angry rabble gathered outside the gates of the palace. 一群愤怒的乌合之众聚集在宫殿大门外。

The politician tried to appeal to the rabble with populist slogans. 这位政治家试图用民粹主义口号来吸引下层民众。

rabid.meaning: adj. 狂热的，激进的；患狂犬病的
rabid.note:
He is a rabid fan of the local football team, attending every single game. 他是当地足球队的狂热球迷，每一场比赛都去现场观看。

Wild animals suspected of carrying the virus should be checked for rabid symptoms. 怀疑携带该病毒的野生动物应接受狂犬病症状检查。

rabies.note:
Rabies is a fatal viral disease transmitted through animal bites. 狂犬病是一种通过动物咬伤传播的致命病毒性疾病。

All domestic dogs must be vaccinated against rabies to ensure public safety. 所有家犬必须接种狂犬病疫苗以确保公共安全。

raconteur.meaning: n. 善于讲故事的人，谈话高手
raconteur.note:
He was a brilliant raconteur, entertaining guests with witty anecdotes. 他是一位出色的讲故事高手，用机智的轶事逗乐了客人们。

An experienced raconteur knows how to keep an audience completely captivated. 经验丰富的谈话高手知道如何让观众完全着迷。

racy.meaning: adj. 饶有风趣的；色情的，耸人听闻的
racy.note:
The novel was filled with racy stories about high society scandals. 这部小说充满了关于上流社会丑闻的耸人听闻的故事。

Her speech had a racy humor that kept the audience laughing. 她的演讲有一种饶有风趣的幽默感，让观众笑个不停。

raffish.meaning: adj. 放荡不羁的，漂浮浮华的
raffish.note:
He wore a fedora at a raffish angle, giving him a bohemian look. 他把呢帽戴得微微倾斜，透着一种放荡不羁的角度，显得很有波西米亚风格。

The actor was known for his raffish charm and rebellious personality. 这位演员以其放荡不羁的魅力和叛逆的性格而闻名。

raffle.meaning: n. 抽彩，抽奖 v. 抽奖售物
raffle.note:
They organized a charity raffle to raise funds for the local hospital. 他们组织了一场慈善抽奖活动，为当地医院筹集资金。

A brand new car was raffled off to support the community center. 一辆崭新的汽车被拿来抽奖售物以支持社区中心。

rafter.note:
Exposed wooden rafters gave the rustic living house a cozy feel. 暴露在外的木制屋顶椽子给这栋乡村住宅一种温馨的感觉。

The sound of the band echoed through the roof rafters. 乐队的声音在屋顶大梁间回荡。

rag.meaning: n. 破布，抹布；廉价小报
rag.note:
She used an old cotton rag to wipe the dust off the wooden table. 她用一块旧棉抹布擦掉木桌上的灰尘。

He threw away the tabloid newspaper, calling it a sensationalist rag. 他扔掉了那份小报，称其为煽动性的廉价小报。

rage.meaning: n. 盛怒，狂怒 v. 愤怒，激烈进行
rage.note:
He flew into a blind rage when he discovered his car was damaged. 当他发现自己的车受损时，他勃然大怒。

A fierce winter storm raged outside the cabin all night. 严冬风暴在小屋外面肆虐了一整夜。

ragged.meaning: adj. 衣衫褴褛的；破烂的，不平整的
ragged.note:
The beggar wore ragged clothes and walked barefoot on the street. 这个乞丐穿着衣衫褴褛的衣服，赤脚走在街上。

The climbers faced a difficult path along the ragged mountain ridge. 登山者们面对着沿着不平整的山脊的艰难道路。

ragtime.meaning: n. 拉格泰姆音乐（一种早期爵士乐）
ragtime.note:
The pianist played an upbeat ragtime tune that energized the room. 钢琴家弹奏了一曲欢快的拉格泰姆音乐，让房间充满了活力。

Ragtime music played an important role in the development of early jazz. 拉格泰姆音乐在早期爵士乐的发展中发挥了重要作用。

raisin.note:
She added a handful of sweet raisins to the morning oatmeal. 她在早晨的燕麦粥里加了一把甜葡萄干。

Raisins are rich in fiber and natural sugars, making them a healthy snack. 葡萄干富含纤维和天然糖分，是一种健康的零食。

rakish.meaning: adj. 放荡的，潇洒的，流气的
rakish.note:
He leaned against the sports car with a rakish grin on his face. 他靠在跑车上，脸上带着一丝潇洒的坏笑。

The boat had a low profile and a rakish design that hinted at speed. 这艘船有着低矮的轮廓和流线型的潇洒设计，暗示着速度感。

ram.meaning: n. 公羊；撞锤 v. 猛撞，塞进
ram.note:
A strong ram with massive horns stood at the front of the flock. 一头长着巨大犄角的强壮公羊站在羊群的前面。

The truck lost its brakes and tried to ram into the safety barrier. 卡车刹车失灵，试图猛撞进安全护栏。

ramble.meaning: v. 漫步，闲逛；语无伦次地闲扯 n. 漫步
ramble.note:
They enjoyed a peaceful ramble through the rolling hills on Sunday. 他们周日在起伏的山丘间享受了一次平静的漫步。

His lecture tended to ramble, losing the attention of the students. 他的讲座往往语无伦次地闲扯，失去了学生的注意力。

rambunctious.meaning: adj. 喧闹的，放纵的，精力过剩的
rambunctious.note:
The birthday party was filled with a dozen rambunctious children. 生日派对上挤满了十几名精力过剩喧闹的孩子。

His rambunctious behavior often drove his parents crazy at home. 他喧闹的行为在家常常把他的父母逼疯。

ramify.note:
The river begins to ramify into a vast delta near the coast. 这条河流在靠近海岸的地方开始分叉形成一个巨大的三角洲。

New transport links ramify outward from the central railway station. 新的交通枢纽从中央火车站向外呈网状分支。

rampage.meaning: n. 狂暴，暴走 v. 狂暴乱闯
rampage.note:
The wild elephant went on a rampage through the farming village. 这头野象在农业村庄里疯狂暴走乱闯。

Hooligans went on a rampage after their team lost the championship. 流氓们在他们的球队输掉冠军后开始疯狂破坏。

rampant.meaning: adj. 猖獗的，蔓延的，失控的
rampant.note:
Inflation became rampant, destroying the savings of middle-class families. 通货膨胀变得猖獗，摧毁了中产阶级家庭的积蓄。

Corruption was rampant throughout the entire government bureaucracy. 整个政府官僚机构中腐败现象十分猖獗。

rampart.note:
Soldiers stood guard along the stone ramparts of the ancient fortress. 士兵们沿着古代要塞的石砌城墙站岗放哨。

The high ramparts protected the city from enemy attacks and invasions. 高大的防御土堤保护了城市免受敌人的攻击和入侵。

ramshackle.meaning: adj. 摇摇欲坠的，破烂的
ramshackle.note:
They lived in a ramshackle wooden house at the edge of the woods. 他们住在树林边缘一栋摇摇欲坠的木制房屋里。

The old bus looked so ramshackle that passengers doubted it would start. 这辆旧公共汽车看起来太破烂了，乘客们怀疑它能不能发动。

rancid.meaning: adj. （油脂等）变质的，哈喇的，酸臭的
rancid.note:
The butter had gone rancid because it was left out in the heat. 黄油因为放在炎热的地方而变质发酸了。

An unpleasant rancid smell came from the old container of cooking oil. 旧食用油容器里散发出一种难闻的哈喇味。

rancor.meaning: n. 怨恨，深仇大恨，敌意
rancor.note:
The divorce was finalized after years of bitter litigation and rancor. 经过多年痛苦的诉讼和怨恨，离婚终于完成了。

They settled their dispute without any lingering rancor or hostility. 他们解决了争端，没有任何挥之不去的怨恨或敌意。

random.note:
The computer selected five random winners from the list of participants. 计算机从参与者名单中随机挑选了五名幸运儿。

He threw his clothes into the suitcase in a completely random order. 他以完全随机的顺序把衣服扔进了手提箱里。

ranger.note:
Park rangers patrol the vast national forest to protect wildlife. 公园护林员在广袤的国家森林中巡逻以保护野生动物。

An experienced mountain ranger guided the rescue team up the slope. 一位经验丰富的山地巡警引导搜救队上山。

rankle.meaning: v. 使人痛苦，令人怨恨难平
rankle.note:
Her critical remarks continued to rankle in his mind for weeks. 她批评的话语在他的脑海里连续数周让人怨恨难平。

The unfair treatment he received at work still rankled. 他在工作中受到的不公待遇依然让他耿耿于怀。

ransom.meaning: n. 赎金 v. 赎回
ransom.note:
The kidnappers demanded a huge ransom for the release of the businessman. 绑匪为释放这名商人索要了一大笔赎金。

His family did whatever it could to raise money to ransom him safely. 他的家人尽其所能筹集资金以安全地将他赎回。

rant.meaning: v. 咆哮，怒吼，大声抱怨 n. 咆哮怒吼
rant.note:
He went on a long rant about the rising cost of living in the city. 他对城市里不断上涨的生活成本进行了长时间的抱怨咆哮。

She ranted at the customer service agent for losing her luggage. 她因为行李丢失而对客户服务代理人大发雷霆。

rapacious.note:
The rapacious corporation bought up smaller competitors ruthlessly. 这家掠夺性的公司无情地收购了较小的竞争对手。

His rapacious appetite for wealth led him into illegal activities. 他对财富的贪婪欲望使他走上了违法活动的道路。

rapids.note:
The kayak struggled to navigate through the dangerous white-water rapids. 皮划艇艰难地穿过危险的白色急流湍滩。

Experienced rafters love the thrill of riding down the rushing river rapids. 经验丰富的漂流者喜欢顺着湍急的河道急流而下的刺激感。

rapprochement.meaning: n. （国家间关系的）缓和，恢复友好
rapprochement.note:
