The two neighboring countries signed a treaty to foster a diplomatic rapprochement. 这两个邻国签署了一项条约，以促进外交关系的缓和。

Political analysts welcomed the recent signs of rapprochement between the rivals. 政治分析人士对竞争对手之间最近出现的和解迹象表示欢迎。

rapt.meaning: adj. 全神贯注的，入迷的
rapt.note:
The children listened with rapt attention as the storyteller began. 讲故事的人开始时，孩子们全神贯注地聆听着。

She sat in rapt silence, admiring the breathtaking painting on the wall. 她全神贯注地静坐着，欣赏着墙上惊艳的画作。

rarefaction.note:
High altitude mountaineers experience the physical effects of air rarefaction. 高海拔登山者会体验到空气变稀的生理影响。

The physics experiment demonstrated the rarefaction of gas in a vacuum chamber. 这个物理实验展示了真空室中气体的稀薄化。

raspy.note:
He spoke in a raspy voice because he had been shouting at the game. 他用一种粗哑的声音说话，因为他在比赛中大喊大叫过。

The old engine made a raspy sound before it finally broke down. 这台旧发动机在最终抛锚前发出了刺耳的声音。

ratification.meaning: n. 正式批准，批准确认
ratification.note:
The treaty requires the ratification of parliament before it becomes law. 该条约在成为法律之前需要议会的正式批准。

Representatives awaited the final ratification of the international agreement. 代表们等待着国际协定的最终批准确认。

ratiocination.note:
Sherlock Holmes solved crimes through cold, logical ratiocination. 夏洛克·福尔摩斯通过冷酷、合乎逻辑的推理来破案。

The complex math problem required hours of careful ratiocination. 这个复杂的数学问题需要数小时的小心推导。

ration.meaning: n. 定量，配给量 v. 配给供应
ration.note:
During the war, food and fuel rations were distributed to every citizen. 战争期间，食物和燃料配给量分发给每个公民。

The government had to ration water supplies during the severe drought. 在严重的干旱期间，政府不得不对水资源供应进行配给。

rattle.meaning: v. 咯咯作响；使慌乱 n. 杂音，拨浪鼓
rattle.note:
The loose window panes began to rattle in the strong winter wind. 松动的窗玻璃在强烈的冬风中开始咯咯作响。

The unexpected question completely rattled the experienced speaker. 这个问题出乎意料，把这位经验丰富的演讲者弄得彻底慌乱了。

raucous.meaning: adj. 刺耳的，喧闹的，粗哑的
raucous.note:
A group of fans made raucous noises outside the hotel. 一群粉丝在酒店外制造出喧闹的声音。

The party was filled with raucous laughter and loud music. 派对上充满了刺耳的笑声和喧闹的音乐。

ravage.meaning: v. 毁坏，蹂躏，掠夺 n. 严重破坏
ravage.note:
The powerful hurricane devastated the coast and ravaged the towns. 强烈的飓风摧毁了海岸并蹂躏了城镇。

They witnessed the devastating ravages of war on the historic city. 他们目睹了战争对历史名城的严重破坏。

rave.meaning: v. 热切赞美，胡言乱语 n. 狂欢派对
rave.note:
Critics gave the new theater production rave reviews. 评论家们对这部新戏剧作品给予了热切的赞美评价。

He began to rave incoherently after taking the dangerous substance. 他服用危险物质后开始语无伦次地胡言乱语。

ravenous.meaning: adj. 饥饿难耐的，贪婪的
ravenous.note:
After a long hike in the mountains, they had a ravenous appetite. 在山里进行长途徒步旅行后，他们胃口大开、饥饿难耐。

His ravenous ambition for power ultimately caused his downfall. 他对权力的贪婪野心最终导致了他的垮台。

ravine.note:
The narrow path wound steeply down into the dark, rocky ravine. 狭窄的小径陡峭地向下蜿蜒进入黑暗、岩石密布的峡谷。

Floodwaters rushed down the deep ravine after the heavy cloudburst. 暴雨过后，洪水冲入深深的沟壑中。

ravishing.note:
She looked absolutely ravishing in her elegant red evening gown. 她穿着优雅的红色晚礼服，看起来绝对美艳动人。

The bride wore a ravishing smile as she walked down the aisle. 新娘沿着走道走去时，脸上带着迷人的微笑。

raze.meaning: v. 夷为平地，彻底摧毁
raze.note:
Old brick buildings were razed to make way for a modern shopping mall. 旧砖房被夷为平地，为现代购物中心让路。

History recorded how the conquering army razed the city to the ground. 历史记录了征服军队是如何将这座城市彻底摧毁夷为平地的。

razor.note:
He used an electric razor for a quick and clean morning shave. 他用电动剃须刀进行快速干净的早晨剃须。

Be careful not to cut yourself with the sharp edge of the safety razor. 小心不要被安全剃须刀锋利的边缘割伤。

reactant.note:
Excess reactant was added to ensure the chemical reaction went to completion. 加入了过量的反应物以确保化学反应进行完全。

In this equation, hydrogen acts as the primary gaseous reactant. 在这个方程式中，氢气充当主要的游离气态反应物。

reactionary.meaning: adj. 保守反动的，反动派的 n. 反动分子
reactionary.note:
He was labeled a reactionary because he opposed all political reforms. 他因反对所有的政治改革而被贴上了反动派的标签。

The ruling party adopted reactionary policies to suppress progressive movements. 执政党采取了保守反动的政策来压制进步运动。

readily.meaning: adv. 乐意地，容易地，迅速地
readily.note:
She readily agreed to help with the organization of the community event. 她很乐意地同意协助组织社区活动。

Information can be readily accessed through the university online library. 通过大学在线图书馆可以很容易地获取信息。

reagent.note:
The chemical test requires a specific biological reagent to show results. 该化学测试需要特定的生物试剂来显示结果。

Lab technicians stored the sensitive reagents in a temperature-controlled fridge. 实验室技术人员将敏感的试剂储存在温控冰箱中。

realign.meaning: v. 重新调整，重新结盟
realign.note:
The car wheels need to be realigned to prevent uneven tire wear. 汽车车轮需要重新调整，以防止轮胎磨损不均。

Political parties began to realign themselves ahead of the upcoming election. 各政党在即将到来的选举前开始重新结盟。

realm.note:
Advances in science have expanded the realm of human knowledge. 科学的进步扩大了人类知识的领域。

The king ruled over a peaceful and prosperous realm for forty years. 国王在一个和平繁荣的王国统治了四十年。

ream.meaning: n. 令（纸张单位，通常500张）；大量文字 v. 扩孔
ream.note:
She bought a standard ream of white copy paper for her printer. 她为打印机买了一令标准的白色复印纸。

He received reams of paperwork that needed to be signed and filed. 他收到了大量需要签署和归档的文书工作。

reap.meaning: v. 收割，收获；获得（回报）
reap.note:
Farmers work hard to reap the wheat harvest before the autumn rains. 农民们努力工作，在秋雨来临前收割小麦。

If you study diligently now, you will reap the rewards in your future career. 如果你现在努力学习，你将在未来的职业生涯中获得回报。

reaper.note:
Mechanical reapers revolutionized agricultural efficiency in the 19th century. 机械收割机在19世纪彻底改变了农业效率。

Poetry often depicts the grim reaper as a symbol of mortality. 诗歌经常将死神描绘为死亡的象征。

rebate.meaning: n. 返利，折扣，退税 v. 给予退款
rebate.note:
Customers can claim a tax rebate on energy-efficient home appliances. 顾客可以对节能家用电器申请税收退税。

The manufacturer offered a cash rebate for purchasing the new model. 制造商为购买新型号提供了现金返利。

rebellious.meaning: adj. 叛逆的，造反的，难驾驭的
rebellious.note:
Teenagers often go through a rebellious phase during high school. 青少年在高中阶段经常会经历一个叛逆期。

The rebellious troops refused to follow the commander's orders. 叛逆的军队拒绝服从指挥官的命令。

rebuff.meaning: n. 回绝，断然拒绝 v. 冷落，断然拒绝
rebuff.note:
Her kind offer of assistance was met with a cold rebuff. 她提供的善意帮助遭到了冷酷的回绝。

He tried to flirt with her, but she promptly rebuffed him. 他试图和她调情，但她当即断然拒绝了他。

rebus.note:
The puzzle magazine featured a challenging rebus for children. 这本益智杂志刊登了一个给孩子们玩的具有挑战性的字谜图。

Solving a rebus requires interpreting pictures that represent words or syllables. 解开图画文字需要解读代表单词或音节的图片。

rebuttal.note:
The lawyer presented a strong rebuttal to the prosecution's claims. 律师对控方的指控提出了强有力的反驳。

She prepared a detailed rebuttal in response to the criticism. 她针对批评准备了一份详细的抗辩材料。

recall.meaning: v. 回忆起，召回 n. 记忆力，召回令
recall.note:
I can clearly recall the happy days we spent together in college. 我能清楚地回忆起我们在大学里度过的快乐日子。

The automotive company issued a safety recall for faulty airbags. 这家汽车公司为有缺陷的安全气囊发布了安全召回令。

recant.meaning: v. 宣布放弃（信仰或声明），公开悔过
recant.note:
He was forced to recant his controversial scientific views under pressure. 他在压力下被迫公开放弃了他具争议性的科学观点。

The witness refused to recant despite threats from the criminal organization. 尽管受到犯罪组织的威胁，证人仍然拒绝收回证词。

recantation.note:
The newspaper demanded a formal recantation of the false allegations. 报社要求对虚假指控进行正式的公开悔过声明。

His signed recantation was read aloud in front of the tribunal. 他签署的放弃声明在法庭前被大声宣读。

recapitulate.note:
At the end of the lecture, the professor will recapitulate the main points. 在讲座结束时，教授将概括主要观点。

Let me briefly recapitulate the events leading up to this decision. 让我简要重述一下导致这一决定的前因后果。

recast.meaning: v. 重塑，改写，重新分配角色
recast.note:
The author decided to recast the entire second chapter of the book. 作者决定改写这本书的整个第二章。

The director had to recast the lead role due to an unexpected injury. 由于意料之外的受伤，导演不得不重新分配主角演员。

recede.note:
Floodwaters finally began to recede after days of continuous rain. 经过数天的持续降雨，洪水终于开始退去。

His hairline has started to recede as he grows older. 随着他年龄的增长，他的发际线开始后退。

receptacle.note:
Please place all waste paper into the designated recycling receptacle. 请将所有废纸放入指定的回收容器中。

The plastic box served as a waterproof receptacle for the matches. 这个塑料盒充当了火柴的防水储藏器。

receptive.meaning: adj. 善于接受的，乐于听取的
receptive.note:
The management team was very receptive to our new business proposal. 管理团队对我们的新商业提案非常乐于听取。

Children are generally more receptive to learning foreign languages at a young age. 小孩在年幼时通常对学习外语更加善于接受。

recess.meaning: n. 课间休息，休会期 v. 休会，休息
recess.note:
The children rushed outside to the playground during the morning recess. 孩子们在早晨课间休息时冲到外面的操场上。

The judge announced a short recess before resuming the trial. 法官在恢复审判前宣布了一个短时间的休会。

recession.meaning: n. 经济衰退，萧条；后退
recession.note:
The country suffered a severe economic recession that lasted two years. 该国遭遇了持续两年的严重经济衰退。

Many businesses struggled to survive during the global market recession. 许多企业在全球市场萧条期间艰难求生。

recessive.note:
Blue eyes are determined by a recessive genetic trait. 蓝眼睛是由隐性遗传特征决定的。

If both parents carry the recessive gene, the child may inherit the condition. 如果父母双方都携带有隐性基因，孩子可能会遗传这种病症。

recipient.note:
She was the proud recipient of the prestigious literary award. 她是这个声望极高的文学奖的自豪领奖人。

Please enter the recipient's email address correctly before sending money. 在汇款前，请输入正确的接受者电子邮件地址。

reciprocal.meaning: adj. 相互的，互惠的 n. 倒数
reciprocal.note:
Both countries agreed to establish reciprocal trade agreements. 两个国家都同意建立互惠的贸易协定。

We hope for a reciprocal gesture of goodwill from our partners. 我们希望从合作伙伴那里得到相互的善意表示。

reciprocate.note:
She invited him to dinner, and he wanted to reciprocate the gesture. 她邀请他共进晚餐，他想回报这一心意。

True friendship requires that both sides reciprocate support and care. 真正的友谊需要双方互惠支持和关心。

recital.meaning: n. 独奏会，独唱会；详述
recital.note:
She played a brilliant piano solo at her school music recital. 她在学校的音乐独奏会上弹奏了一首精彩的钢琴独奏曲。

The lawyer gave a tedious recital of facts that bored the jury. 律师对事实进行了冗长的详述，让陪审团感到厌烦。

reclaim.meaning: v. 开垦；回收利用；索回
reclaim.note:
Land is being reclaimed from the sea to build a new airport. 正从海里填海造地来建造一座新机场。

You can go to the lost property office to reclaim your umbrella. 你可以去失物招领处索回你的雨伞。

recluse.meaning: n. 隐士，隐居者 adj. 隐居的
recluse.note:
The famous author lived as a recluse in a remote mountain cabin. 这位著名的作家隐居在一个偏远的山间小屋里，过着隐士的生活。

He turned down all social invitations, preferring a quiet, recluse lifestyle. 他谢绝了所有的社交邀请，更喜欢安静、隐居的生活方式。

recoil.meaning: v. 弹回；退缩，畏缩 n. 后坐力
recoil.note:
She instinctively recoiled in horror when she saw the snake. 当她看到蛇时，本能地惊恐退缩了。

The heavy rifle had a powerful recoil that bruised his shoulder. 这把重型步枪有强烈的后坐力，把他的肩膀撞青了。

recollection.note:
My recollection of those childhood events is a bit hazy now. 我对那些童年往事的记忆现在有点模糊了。

To the best of my recollection, he left the keys on the desk. 据我回忆，他把钥匙落在桌子上了。

recombine.note:
Genetic materials can recombine during cell division. 遗传物质可以在细胞分裂过程中重组。

The chemical elements split apart and then recombine in a new form. 化学元素分解开来，然后以新的形式重新结合。

recompense.meaning: n. 赔偿，报酬 v. 赔偿，酬谢
recompense.note:
He received financial recompense for the damage caused to his property. 他因财产受损获得了经济赔偿。

The company offered a bonus to recompense employees for extra overtime. 公司发放了奖金以酬谢员工的额外加班。

recondite.note:
The professor's lecture focused on recondite aspects of ancient philosophy. 教授的讲座聚焦于古代哲学深奥的方面。

Only a few specialists could understand his recondite research paper. 只有少数专家能够理解他那晦涩的研究论文。

reconnaissance.note:
A small scouting plane was sent ahead for aerial reconnaissance. 一架小型侦察机被派往前方进行空中侦察。

Special forces carried out a secret reconnaissance mission behind enemy lines. 特种部队在敌后执行了一项秘密侦察任务。

reconstitute.meaning: v. 重新组成，重建；使复原（尤指脱水食品）
reconstitute.note:
Add warm water to the dried powder to reconstitute the soup. 向干粉中加入温水使汤复原。

The committee was temporarily reconstituted to review the new policy. 委员会被临时重新组成以审查新政策。

recourse.note:
We hope to resolve the issue without recourse to legal action. 我们希望在不诉诸法律行动的情况下解决这个问题。

Workers had no other recourse than to go on strike for better pay. 工人们除了罢工争取更高薪水外，别无他法。

rectangle.note:
The living room floor was laid out in a neat rectangle shape. 客厅的地板被铺成了整洁的长方形形状。

Draw a rectangle with a length of ten centimeters and a width of five. 画一个长十厘米、宽五厘米的矩形。

rectitude.meaning: n. 正直，公正，品行端正
rectitude.note:
He was a man of unblemished moral rectitude and absolute honesty. 他是一个品行毫无瑕疵、绝对诚实正直的人。

The judge conducted his court with strict legal rectitude. 法官以严格的法律公正性管理法庭。

recumbent.meaning: adj. 躺着的，斜躺的，靠着的
recumbent.note:
He assumed a recumbent position on the sofa to watch television. 他在沙发上摆出一个斜躺的姿势看电视。

The statue depicts a knight in a recumbent pose on top of a tomb. 这座雕像描绘了一位骑士斜躺在陵墓顶上的姿态。

recuperate.meaning: v. 恢复健康，康复；恢复（元气）
recuperate.note:
She traveled to the countryside to recuperate after a long illness. 她大病初愈后前往乡村休养康复。

It took the athlete several months to recuperate his physical strength. 这名运动员花了几个月的时间才恢复了体力。

redeem.meaning: v. 挽回（面子等），赎回，兑现
redeem.note:
He managed to redeem his reputation with a brilliant performance. 他通过一场出色的表演设法挽回了自己的声誉。

You can redeem these bonus points for gifts at the counter. 你可以在柜台用这些积分兑换礼物。

redemptive.meaning: adj. 救赎的，起救赎作用的
redemptive.note:
Art often offers a redemptive quality for those suffering in hardship. 艺术往往为在困苦中受苦的人提供一种救赎的品质。

The protagonist undergoes a redemptive journey of self-discovery. 主人公经历了一场自我发现的救赎之旅。

redirect.meaning: v. 改变方向，重新投递（信件）
redirect.note:
Police had to redirect traffic due to a major accident on the highway. 由于高速公路上发生重大事故，警察不得不改变交通方向。

Please redirect my mail to my new address while I am away. 在我离开期间，请把我的信件重新投递到我的新地址。

redistribution.note:
The government proposed wealth redistribution to reduce income inequality. 政府提出了财富重新分配方案，以减少收入不平等。

Economic reforms focused on the fair redistribution of resources. 经济改革侧重于资源的公平再分配。

redolent.meaning: adj. 芬芳的，令人联想起……的
redolent.note:
The air was redolent with the sweet scent of blooming jasmine flowers. 空气中弥漫着盛开的茉莉花的芬芳甜香。

The old song was redolent of his carefree youth in the countryside. 这首老歌让人联想起他在乡村无忧无虑的青春时光。

redoubtable.meaning: adj. 可敬畏的，强大的，令人畏惧的
redoubtable.note:
She proved to be a redoubtable opponent in the chess tournament. 事实证明，她在国际象棋比赛中是一个令人畏惧的对手。

The general faced a redoubtable army defending the fortified city. 将军面对着一支保卫这座防御森严的城市的强大军队。

redress.meaning: v. 纠正，矫正 n. 赔偿，救济
redress.note:
The company took immediate steps to redress the billing errors. 公司采取了立即行动来纠正账单错误。

Citizens have a legal right to seek redress for workplace discrimination. 公民拥有寻求工作场所歧视赔偿的法律权利。

redundancy.meaning: n. 裁员，失业；冗余，多余
redundancy.note:
Many workers faced redundancy when the manufacturing plant closed down. 当制造工厂倒闭时，许多工人面临被裁员的境地。

Engineers added a backup system to ensure system redundancy and safety. 工程师们增加了一个备用系统，以确保系统的冗余和安全。

reed.meaning: n. 芦苇，芦苇丛；（乐器的）簧片
reed.note:
Tall green reeds grew thickly along the edge of the quiet river bank. 高高的绿芦苇在安静的河岸边长得很茂密。

The clarinet player replaced the broken reed before the concert started. 单簧管演奏者在音乐会开始前换掉了坏掉的簧片。

reek.meaning: v. 散发臭气，充满（恶劣气息） n. 恶臭
reek.note:
His clothes seemed to reek of tobacco smoke after the party. 派对过后，他的衣服似乎散发着烟草的恶臭。

The political scandal reeked of corruption and dishonest dealings. 这场政治丑闻充满了腐败和不诚实交易的恶劣气息。

reel.meaning: n. 卷轴，线轴 v. 蹒跚，眩晕，卷起
reel.note:
He wound the fishing line back onto the metal reel. 他把钓鱼线绕回金属线轴上。

She began to reel from the sudden shock of the terrible news. 听到这个可怕消息的突然打击，她开始感到一阵眩晕。

refectory.meaning: n. （修道院或大学的）餐厅，食堂
refectory.note:
The monks gathered in the large stone refectory for their evening meal. 修士们聚集在大块石砌的餐厅里享用他们的晚餐。

Students filled the university refectory during lunchtime rush hour. 学生们在午餐高峰时间挤满了大学食堂。

refinery.note:
Crude oil is transported by pipelines to a nearby coastal refinery. 原油通过管道输送到附近的一家沿海精炼厂。

The sugar refinery processes tons of raw cane sugar every single day. 这家糖厂每天加工数吨原蔗糖。

reflect.note:
The calm lake surface clearly reflects the surrounding snow-capped mountains. 平静的湖面清晰地反射着周围白雪皑皑的山脉。

She sat quietly by the window to reflect on her future career choices. 她静静地坐在窗边，深思她未来的职业选择。

refraction.note:
The prism demonstrates the refraction of light into a rainbow spectrum. 这个棱镜展示了光线折射成彩虹光谱的现象。

Atmospheric refraction can make stars appear slightly higher in the sky than they are. 大气折射会使星星在天空中看起来比实际位置略高。

refractory.meaning: adj. 难治的，难管教的；耐火的
refractory.note:
The patient suffered from a refractory cough that resisted standard medicine. 病人患有对常规药物无响应的难治性咳嗽。

Refractory materials are used to line the inside of high-temperature industrial furnaces. 耐火材料被用来内衬高温工业炉的内部。

refresh.meaning: v. 使恢复精神，刷新（网页等）
refresh.note:
A cold glass of water helped to refresh him after the long run. 一杯冰水帮助他在长跑后恢复了精神。

Click the browser button to refresh the page and load the latest updates. 点击浏览器按钮刷新页面并加载最新更新。

refulgent.meaning: adj. 灿烂的，辉煌的，耀眼的
refulgent.note:
The bride looked refulgent in her diamond-studded wedding dress. 新娘穿着镶满钻石的婚纱，看起来光彩照人。

Stars shone with a refulgent light in the clear desert night sky. 在晴朗的沙漠夜空中，星星散发着灿烂的光芒。

refurbish.note:
The hotel was closed for months to refurbish the guest rooms. 这家酒店关闭了几个月以翻新客房。

They plan to refurbish the old kitchen with modern appliances and cabinets. 他们计划用现代电器和橱柜翻新旧厨房。

regale.note:
The old sailor regaled the children with exciting stories of the sea. 老水手向孩子们津津乐道地讲述了激动人心的海洋故事。

Guests were regaled with a lavish feast of traditional local delicacies. 客人们受到了丰盛的当地传统美食的款待。

regressive.meaning: adj. 退步的，倒退的，（税收等）累退的
regressive.note:
Sales tax is often criticized as a regressive tax that hurts low-income earners. 销售税经常被批评为一种损害低收入者的累退税。

Canceling social welfare programs would be a regressive step for society. 取消社会福利项目对社会来说将是倒退的一步。

rehearsal.note:
The actors gathered on the stage for their final dress rehearsal. 演员们聚集在舞台上进行最后的彩排。

Continuous rehearsals ensured the concert went off without a single flaw. 持续的排练确保了音乐会顺利举行，没有一丝瑕疵。

rehearse.note:
The band met every evening to rehearse songs for the upcoming album. 乐队每晚聚在一起排练即将发行的专辑歌曲。

She stood in front of the mirror to rehearse her presentation speech. 她站在镜子前预演她的演讲。

reign.meaning: n. 统治时期 v. 当政，盛行
reign.note:
The queen began her long and peaceful reign in the mid-twentieth century. 女王在二十世纪中叶开始了她漫长而和平的统治时期。

Silence reigned in the library as students concentrated on their books. 图书馆里一片寂静，学生们正专注地看书。

rein.meaning: n. 缰绳 v. 控制，抑制
rein.note:
The rider pulled on the reins to slow the galloping horse down. 骑手拉紧缰绳让疾驰的马慢了下来。

The government introduced measures to rein in inflation and high prices. 政府采取了措施来控制通货膨胀和高物价。

reinstate.note:
He successfully appealed to court to be reinstated in his former job. 他成功上诉法院要求恢复他以前的职位。

The school board voted to reinstate the traditional music program. 学校董事会投票决定恢复传统的音乐项目。

reiterate.note:
The manager took the opportunity to reiterate the company's core values. 经理借此机会重申了公司的核心价值观。

I must reiterate that safety is our absolute top priority in the laboratory. 我必须重申，实验室的安全绝对是我们的首要任务。

rejoice.meaning: v. 感到高兴，欢欣鼓舞
rejoice.note:
Citizens gathered in the main square to rejoice over the peace treaty. 市民们聚集在中央广场上，为和平条约的签订欢欣鼓舞。

We rejoice in the success of our students who graduated this year. 我们为今年毕业的学生的成功感到高兴。

rejuvenate.meaning: v. 使年轻，使恢复活力
rejuvenate.note:
A good night's sleep did wonders to rejuvenate her tired body and mind. 优质的睡眠对恢复她疲惫的身心起到了极大的作用。

The city launched a project to rejuvenate the old industrial district. 该市发起了一个旨在使老工业区恢复生机的项目。

relapse.meaning: v. 复发，旧病复发；故态复萌 n. 复发
relapse.note:
The patient suffered a sudden relapse after showing signs of recovery. 病人在显现出康复迹象后突然病情复发。

He managed to quit smoking, but sadly relapsed a few months later. 他设法戒了烟，但遗憾的是几个月后又抽上了。

relate.note:
Her speech related closely to the current economic crisis in the country. 她的演讲与该国当前的经济危机密切相关。

Grandfather loved to sit by the fire and relate stories of his youth. 爷爷喜欢坐在火炉旁讲述他年轻时的故事。

release.meaning: v. 释放，发布 n. 释放，发布
release.note:
The studio announced the theatrical release date of the new movie. 制片厂宣布了这部新电影的院线上映日期。

Wild animals rescued from cages were successfully released back into nature. 从笼子里解救出来的野生动物被成功释放回大自然中。

relegate.meaning: v. 降级，贬谪，把……打入低位
relegate.note:
After a disastrous season, the football team was relegated to the second division. 经历了一个灾难性的赛季后，这支足球队被降级到乙级联赛。

She was relegated to an administrative role with fewer responsibilities. 她被降职到一个责任较小的行政职位。

relent.note:
Her parents finally relented and allowed her to attend the art school. 她的父母最终心软了，同意她去艺术学校。

The rain showed no sign of relenting as evening approached. 随着傍晚临近，雨势毫无减弱的迹象。

relenting.meaning: adj. 变宽容的，有怜悯心的
relenting.note:
With a relenting smile, she finally forgave him for the mistake. 带着宽容的微笑，她最终原谅了他的错误。

The strict supervisor showed a relenting attitude toward the late worker. 严厉的主管对迟到的员工表现出了通融的态度。

relevance.note:
The judge questioned the relevance of the evidence presented in court. 法官对法庭上出示的证据的相关性提出了质疑。

Traditional skills are losing their relevance in a digitalized world. 传统技能在数字化世界中正在失去其关联性。

reliance.note:
The country aims to reduce its reliance on imported fossil fuels. 该国旨在减少对进口化石燃料的依赖。

Success in independent study requires complete self-reliance. 自主学习的成功需要完全的自力更生。

relic.note:
Archaeologists discovered ancient pottery relics buried deep in the soil. 考古学家发现了埋在土壤深处的古代陶器遗迹。

Typewriters are now viewed as charming relics of the twentieth century. 打字机现在被视为二十世纪迷人的旧物。

relieved.note:
She felt immensely relieved when she heard that her exam results were good. 听到考试成绩不错时，她感到无比放心。

He looked relieved after finding his lost wallet under the car seat. 在车座底下找到丢失的钱包后，他看起来很宽慰。

relinquish.note:
The king was forced to relinquish his throne during the revolution. 国王在革命期间被迫放弃了王位。

She decided to relinquish control of the project to a younger colleague. 她决定把项目控制权让给年轻的同事。

relish.meaning: v. 享受，喜爱 n. 滋味，佐料
relish.note:
He truly relishes every challenge that comes his way in his profession. 他在职业生涯中真心享受迎面而来的每一个挑战。

She ate the hot dog with a generous helping of mustard and relish. 她在热狗上加了满满的芥末和调味佐料吃了起来。

remainder.meaning: n. 剩余部分，其余 v. 廉价出售积压书
remainder.note:
I spent the remainder of the afternoon reading a book in the garden. 我在花园里看书度过了下午的剩余部分。

Books that did not sell well were eventually remaindered by the publisher. 卖得不好的书最终被出版商作廉价处理。

remains.note:
Archaeologists excavated the ruins to study the remains of the ancient city. 考古学家发掘了废墟，以研究这座古城的遗迹。

The funeral was held after the physical remains were brought back home. 遗体被运回家后举行了葬礼。

reminder.note:
She set a calendar reminder on her phone for the afternoon meeting. 她在手机上设置了一个下午会议的日历提醒。

This old photo serves as a sweet reminder of our high school graduation. 这张旧照片作为我们高中毕业的甜美纪念。

reminisce.note:
The old friends sat by the fireplace and reminisce about their school days. 老朋友们坐在壁炉旁，追忆着他们的学生时代。

Older generations love to reminisce about the good old days. 老一辈人喜欢追忆过去的美好旧时光。

remiss.meaning: adj. 疏忽的，怠慢的，不负责任的
remiss.note:
It would be remiss of me not to thank everyone who helped with the project. 如果我不感谢所有帮助过这个项目的人，那就是我的疏忽了。

He was considered remiss in his duties as head of security. 他被认为在担任安全主管的职责时有怠慢之处。

remnant.note:
Only a few stone remnants of the medieval wall are still visible today. 如今只有中世纪城墙的少数石制遗存依稀可见。

She used fabric remnants to sew a colorful patchwork quilt. 她用布料零头缝制了一张五颜六色的拼布被子。

remorse.note:
The criminal showed deep remorse for the crimes he had committed. 罪犯对所犯下的罪行表现出了深深的悔恨。

She felt a pang of remorse after snapping at her younger brother. 冲弟弟发火后，她感到一阵内疚自责。

remove.note:
Please remove your muddy shoes before stepping onto the clean carpet. 在踏上干净的地毯前，请脱掉你沾满泥土的鞋子。

The surgeon performed a minor operation to remove the growth. 外科医生做了一个小手术来切除增生物。

remunerative.meaning: adj. 有报酬的，赚钱的，有收益的
remunerative.note:
She left her low-paying job for a much more remunerative offer. 她辞去了低薪工作，转而接受了一份报酬丰厚得多的工作。

Consulting can be a highly remunerative career for experienced professionals. 对经验丰富的专业人士来说，咨询可以是一项收益丰厚的职业。

rend.note:
A loud clap of thunder seemed to rend the stormy sky apart. 一声响亮的雷鸣似乎把暴风雨的天空撕裂开了。

Grief seemed to rend her heart as she said her final farewells. 当她作最后道别时，悲伤似乎撕裂了她的心。

render.meaning: v. 使得，致使；提供；翻译
render.note:
The heavy storm rendered the local roads completely impassable. 暴风雨使得当地道路完全无法通行。

Translators work carefully to render ancient texts into modern English. 翻译人员精心工作，将古代文本翻译成现代英语。

rendering.note:
Her musical rendering of the classic song moved the audience to tears. 她对这首经典歌曲的音乐演绎感动得观众落泪。

The architect presented a 3D digital rendering of the proposed building. 建筑师展示了拟建建筑的3D数字效果图。

rendezvous.meaning: n. 约会地点，集合地点 v. 会合
rendezvous.note:
The spies chose a quiet coffee shop as their secret rendezvous. 间谍们选择了一家安静的咖啡馆作为他们的秘密约会地点。

All team members agreed to rendezvous at the summit before sunrise. 所有队员都同意在日出前在山顶会合。

renegade.meaning: n. 叛徒，背叛者 adj. 叛变者的
renegade.note:
He was branded a renegade after joining the rival political faction. 在加入敌对政治派别后，他被打上了叛徒的烙印。

A renegade group of soldiers threatened to destabilize the region. 一支叛变士兵小队威胁要破坏该地区的稳定。

renege.meaning: v. 违背（诺言），背信弃义
renege.note:
The landlord threatened to sue if the tenant tried to renege on the lease. 如果房客试图在租赁协议上背信弃义，房东威胁要起诉。

Politicians often make promises during campaigns only to renege later. 政治家经常在竞选期间做出承诺，结果却在事后违背诺言。

renown.note:
The chef achieved global renown for his innovative culinary creations. 这位厨师因其创新的烹饪创作而获得了全球的名望。

Scientists of international renown gathered at the annual symposium. 具有国际声誉的科学家们聚集在年度研讨会上。

reparable.meaning: adj. 可修复的，可挽回的
reparable.note:
Fortunately, the damage to the old engine was entirely reparable. 幸运的是，旧发动机的损坏完全是可以修复的。

They believed the mistake in the contract was still reparable. 他们认为合同中的错误仍然是可以挽回的。

reparation.note:
The defeated nation was required to pay heavy financial reparations. 战败国被要求支付巨额的经济赔偿金。

Victims demanded legal justice and financial reparation for their suffering. 受害者要求为他们的痛苦寻求法律公道和经济赔偿。

repartee.meaning: n. 机智的对答，妙语连珠
repartee.note:
The talk show host is known for his quick wit and sharp repartee. 这位脱口秀主持人以其敏捷的机智和犀利的妙语连珠而闻名。

Their conversation sparkled with witty repartee and playful jokes. 他们的交谈因机智的对答和好玩的玩笑而闪烁着光彩。

repeal.meaning: v. 废除，撤销（法律等） n. 废除
repeal.note:
Citizens campaigned heavily for parliament to repeal the outdated law. 公民们大力发起运动，要求议会废除这项过时的法律。

The government announced the official repeal of the controversial tax policy. 政府宣布正式废除这项具争议性的税收政策。

repel.note:
Special spray was applied to repel mosquitoes and other harmful insects. 涂抹了特殊的喷雾剂来驱蚊和其他有害昆虫。

The harsh criticism was enough to repel potential investors. 严厉的批评足以使潜在投资者感到厌恶。

repellent.meaning: adj. 令人厌恶的 n. 驱虫剂
repellent.note:
He found her arrogant attitude thoroughly repellent and rude. 他觉得她傲慢的态度彻底令人厌恶且无礼。

Always remember to pack insect repellent when camping in the forest. 在森林里露营时，切记要带上防虫驱虫剂。

repercussion.note:
The financial decision had serious repercussions for the global market. 这一财务决定对全球市场产生了严重的后果。

He did not anticipate the political repercussions of his public statement. 他没有预料到自己公开声明所带来的政治反响。

repertoire.meaning: n. 全部节目，保留剧目；个人技能清单
repertoire.note:
The pianist added several classical sonatas to his performance repertoire. 钢琴家在他的表演保留节目中增添了几首古典奏鸣曲。

Scrambled eggs are the only dish in his cooking repertoire. 炒鸡蛋是他烹饪技能清单中唯一的拿手菜。

repine.meaning: v. 抱怨，闷闷不乐，苦恼
repine.note:
She accepted her difficult circumstances without a single word of repine. 她毫无怨言地接受了自己艰难的境遇。

It is useless to repine over past mistakes that cannot be changed. 为无法改变的过去错误而闷闷不乐是毫无用处的。

replenish.note:
They stopped at a village store to replenish their food and water supply. 他们在村里的一家商店停下来，补充食物和水储备。

The company needs to replenish its stock before the holiday shopping season. 公司需要在假日购物季之前补充其库存。

replete.note:
His autobiography is replete with fascinating anecdotes about his youth. 他的自传中充满了关于他年轻时迷人的轶事。

After eating a huge dinner, they left the restaurant feeling completely replete. 吃了一顿丰盛的晚餐后，他们离开餐馆时感觉心满意足、饱腹至极。

reportorial.meaning: adj. 记者的，新闻报道的
reportorial.note:
The newspaper praised the journalist for her outstanding reportorial skills. 报纸称赞这位记者拥有出色的新闻报道技能。

The book offers a detailed reportorial account of the frontline events. 这本书提供了对前线事件的详细记者纪实账目。

repose.meaning: n. 休息，长眠，平静 v. 休息，倚靠
repose.note:
After a hard day's work, she sought quiet repose in her garden. 经过一天辛苦的工作，她在花园里寻求安静的休息。

The historic castle reposes peacefully on top of the green hill. 这座历史悠久的城堡静静地安卧在绿色山丘的顶端。

reprehend.note:
Teachers should guide students rather than harshly reprehend minor errors. 教师应当引导学生，而不是严厉责难小错误。

His dishonest behavior was openly reprehended by his colleagues. 他不诚实的行为受到了同事们的公开谴责。

reprehensible.meaning: adj. 应受谴责的，不道德的
reprehensible.note:
Stealing from charity is a deeply reprehensible act that deserves punishment. 从慈善机构偷窃是一种极其应受谴责、理应受到惩罚的行径。

The company's environmental negligence was viewed as entirely reprehensible. 该公司的环境疏忽被认为完全是不道德的。

repressed.meaning: adj. 被压抑的，被压制的
repressed.note:
He struggled to control his repressed anger during the heated discussion. 在激烈的讨论中，他努力控制自己被压抑的愤怒。

She grew up in a strict household where emotions were often repressed. 她在一个严格的家庭中长大，那里的情绪经常受到压制。

reprieve.meaning: n. 缓刑，暂缓，暂时的解脱 v. 暂缓执行，使免于难
reprieve.note:
The rainy weather brought a temporary reprieve from the forest fires. 多雨的天气给森林大火带来了一次暂时的缓解。

The convicted prisoner was granted a last-minute legal reprieve. 被定罪的囚犯在最后一刻获得了一项法律暂缓执行令。

reprimand.meaning: n. 训斥，谴责 v. 严厉训斥，申斥
reprimand.note:
The employee received a formal reprimand for arriving late repeatedly. 这名员工因为屡次迟到而受到了正式的训斥。

Her boss reprimanded her sharply for leaking confidential information. 她的老板因为她泄露机密信息而对她进行了严厉申斥。

reprisal.note:
The army launched an attack in reprisal for the border violation. 军队发动了一次进攻，以报复边界侵犯行为。

Witnesses refused to speak out for fear of violent reprisal. 证人们由于害怕遭到暴力报复而拒绝开口作证。

reprise.meaning: n. 重演，重复演奏 v. 重复，重演
reprise.note:
The concert ended with a wonderful reprise of the opening song. 音乐会在对开场歌曲的精彩重复演奏中结束。

She agreed to reprise her famous role in the upcoming movie sequel. 她同意在即将上映的电影续集中重新扮演她著名的角色。

reproach.meaning: v. 责备，指责 n. 责备，批评
reproach.note:
She looked at him with gentle reproach when he forgot their anniversary. 当他忘记他们的结婚纪念日时，她带着温柔的责备看着他。

He had no reason to reproach himself for the unfortunate accident. 他没有理由为那场不幸的意外而自责。

reprobate.meaning: n. 堕落者，坏蛋 adj. 堕落的，无耻的
reprobate.note:
He lived the life of an unrepentant reprobate until his old age. 他过着死不悔改的浪荡堕落生活直到老年。

His reprobate behavior finally drove his family away. 他那无耻的行为最终赶走了他的家人。

reproof.note:
She accepted the gentle reproof from her mentor with humility. 她谦虚地接受了导师温和的斥责。

His actions deserved severe reproof rather than lenient treatment. 他的行为应当受到严厉的责备，而不是宽大处理。

reprove.note:
The teacher gently reproved the student for not paying attention. 老师温和地责备了不专心的学生。

She reproved him for making careless mistakes in his homework. 她指责他在作业中犯了粗心的错误。

reptile.note:
Snakes, lizards, and turtles are all classified as cold-blooded reptiles. 蛇、蜥蜴和乌龟都被归类为冷血爬行动物。

The zoo features a specialized house displaying exotic desert reptiles. 动物园设有一个专门的展馆，展示外来的沙漠爬行动物。

reptilian.meaning: adj. 爬行动物的，冷酷阴险的
reptilian.note:
Crocodiles share typical reptilian characteristics such as scales. 鳄鱼具有鳞片等典型的爬行动物特征。

He looked at his rivals with a cold, almost reptilian gaze. 他用冷酷、几乎像爬行动物般阴险的目光看着他的对手们。

repudiate.meaning: v. 拒绝，否认，拒绝接受（声称等）
repudiate.note:
The politician strongly repudiated the corruption allegations against him. 这位政治家强烈否认了针对他的腐败指控。

She decided to repudiate her former beliefs and adopt a new philosophy. 她决定抛弃过去的信仰，采纳一种新的哲学。

repugnance.note:
He felt a deep sense of repugnance at the sight of the cruel act. 看到这一残忍行径，他感到内心深处一阵强烈的厌恶。

She hid her repugnance behind a polite, professional smile. 她在一张礼貌、专业的微笑背后隐藏着她的反感。

repugnant.meaning: adj. 令人厌恶的，格格不入的
repugnant.note:
His racist remarks were deeply repugnant to the entire community. 他种族主义的言论让整个社区深感厌恶。

Such violent behavior is completely repugnant to our core values. 这种暴力行为与我们的核心价值观完全格格不入。

repulse.meaning: v. 击退，驱逐；使厌恶 n. 击退
repulse.note:
The fortress defenders successfully managed to repulse the enemy attack. 要塞守卫者成功地击退了敌人的进攻。

His unpleasant manners and rudeness tended to repulse people. 他令人不悦的举止和粗鲁往往让人感到厌恶。

reputation.note:
The university has an international reputation for academic excellence. 这家大学在学术卓越方面享有国际声誉。

She worked hard to build a solid reputation as a reliable journalist. 她努力工作，建立起了作为一名可靠记者的牢固声誉。

repute.meaning: n. 名誉，名声 v. 称为，认为
repute.note:
He is a physician of great repute in the local medical community. 他是当地医学界声誉极高的内科医生。

The old mansion is reputed to be haunted by ghosts. 这座老宅据信有鬼魂出没。

request.meaning: n. 请求，要求 v. 请求，索取
request.note:
Guests made a formal request for late check-in at the front desk. 客人们在前台正式提出了延迟退房的要求。

Please submit your application if you wish to request financial assistance. 如果您希望申请经济援助，请提交您的申请。

requisite.meaning: adj. 必要的，必需的 n. 必需品
requisite.note:
A bachelor's degree is a requisite qualification for this position. 学士学位是该职位的必要资格。

Safety gear is a strict requisite before entering the industrial zone. 进入工业区之前，安全装备是严格的必需品。

requite.note:
She sought a way to kindly requite his generosity and support. 她寻找一种方式来亲切地回报他的慷慨与支持。

Unrequited love can cause immense emotional pain and sorrow. 单相思会带来巨大的情感痛苦和悲伤。

rescind.note:
The company decided to rescind the controversial policy after protests. 在抗议发生后，公司决定撤销这一具争议性的政策。

They threatened to rescind the contract if deadlines were not met. 如果未能遵守截止日期，他们威胁要取消合同。

rescission.meaning: n. 废除，撤销，解除（合同）
rescission.note:
The legal action aimed at securing the complete rescission of the agreement. 该法律行动旨在确保完全解除该协议。

Mutual consent is often required for the valid rescission of a contract. 协议的有效解除通常需要双方同意。

rescue.meaning: v. 营救，救援 n. 营救，救援
rescue.note:
Firefighters launched a dramatic rescue operation to save the trapped hikers. 消防员发起了一次戏剧性的救援行动来拯救被困的徒步者。

Coast guards managed to rescue three sailors from the sinking boat. 海岸警卫队成功从沉没的船只上救出了三名水手。

resent.note:
She tended to resent being treated like a child by her older brothers. 她往往对被哥哥们像对待小孩一样对待感到很不满。

He openly resented having to work overtime without extra pay. 他公开怨恨不得不加班而没有额外薪水。

resentment.note:
Years of unfair treatment built up a deep sense of resentment in him. 多年的不公待遇在他心中积聚了深深的怨恨。

She harbored quiet resentment toward her colleague for stealing her idea. 她对同事窃取她的创意怀有暗暗的愤恨。

reserve.meaning: v. 预订，保留 n. 储备，自然保护区
reserve.note:
I would like to reserve a double room for the weekend, please. 请帮我预订一间周末的双人房。

The national park was established as a protected wildlife reserve. 这个国家公园被建立为一个受保护的野生动物自然保护区。

reside.note:
Many foreign artists choose to reside in Paris for its creative atmosphere. 许多外国艺术家因为其创作氛围而选择定居在巴黎。

Ultimate power in a democracy resides with the people. 民主制下的最终权力归属于人民。

resident.meaning: n. 居民，住院医师 adj. 居住的
resident.note:
Local residents protested against the construction of the new factory. 当地居民抗议新工厂的建设。

She is a resident physician training at the university hospital. 她是在大学医院培训的住院医师。

residue.note:
A sticky white residue was left on the table after removing the label. 撕掉标签后，桌上留下了一层粘稠的白色残余物。

Chemical residue on vegetables should be washed off thoroughly before cooking. 蔬菜上的化学残渣在烹饪前应当彻底洗净。

resignation.meaning: n. 辞职，辞呈；顺从，无奈
resignation.note:
The CEO surprised everyone by submitting his sudden resignation. 首席执行官突然提交了辞呈，让所有人都感到意外。

She accepted her fate with quiet resignation and dignity. 她带着平静的无奈和尊严接受了自己的命运。

resigned.meaning: adj. 顺从的，甘愿忍受的
resigned.note:
He gave a resigned sigh when he saw the delayed flight announcement. 看到航班延误公告时，他发出了一声无奈的叹息。

She was resigned to the fact that the project would take much longer. 她已经甘愿接受这个项目需要花费更长时间的事实。

resin.note:
Pine trees secrete a sticky resin to protect themselves from insects. 松树分泌出一种粘稠的树脂来保护自己免受昆虫侵害。

Synthetic resin is widely used in manufacturing plastics and adhesives. 合成树脂广泛用于制造塑料和粘合剂。

resonant.meaning: adj. 回响的，共鸣的，洪亮的
resonant.note:
He spoke with a deep, resonant voice that filled the grand hall. 他用深沉、洪亮的声音说话，充满了整个大厅。

The speech had a resonant message that inspired people across the nation. 这篇演讲传递了一个具有强烈共鸣的信息，激励了全国各地的人民。

resort.meaning: n. 度假胜地；求助 v. 诉诸，凭借
resort.note:
They spent their summer vacation at a luxury beach resort in Hawaii. 他们在夏威夷的一个豪华海滩度假胜地度过了暑假。

We must try peaceful negotiations without resorting to violence. 我们必须尝试和平谈判，而不能诉诸暴力。

resound.meaning: v. 回荡；鸣响；名声远扬
resound.note:
The hall began to resound with the sound of cheerful laughter. 大厅里开始回荡着快乐的笑声。

His name will resound in history for his great contributions. 他的名字将因其巨大的贡献而在历史上名声远扬。

resourceful.meaning: adj. 机智的；资源丰富的；足智多谋的
resourceful.note:
She is a resourceful manager who can solve unexpected crises quickly. 她是一位机智的经理，能迅速解决突发的危机。

Living in the wild requires you to be extremely resourceful. 在野外生存要求你必须极其足智多谋。

respiration.note:
The patient showed difficulties in normal respiration and required oxygen. 这名病人在正常呼吸方面表现出困难，需要吸氧。

Cellular respiration produces energy for biological activities. 细胞呼吸作用为生物活动产生能量。

respite.meaning: n. 暂缓；喘息；短暂休息
respite.note:
The weekend offered a welcome respite from the heavy workload. 这个周末为繁重的工作量提供了一个受欢迎的喘息机会。

They worked for hours without a single moment of respite. 他们工作了几个小时，没有一刻的休息。

resplendent.meaning: adj. 华丽的；灿烂夺目的
resplendent.note:
The queen appeared at the ceremony resplendent in royal jewels. 女王身着璀璨的皇家珠宝出现在仪式上。

Her garden was resplendent with spring flowers. 她的花园里春花烂漫，绚丽夺目。

response.note:
We received an overwhelming response to our charity appeal. 我们对慈善呼吁收到了压倒性的回应。

She gave a quick response to the urgent email. 她对这封紧急邮件做出了迅速的回答。

responsive.meaning: adj. 反应灵敏的；积极响应的
responsive.note:
The patient is conscious and responsive to medical treatment. 病人清醒且对药物治疗反应灵敏。

The company is highly responsive to customer feedback. 这家公司对客户反馈反应非常积极。

responsiveness.meaning: n. 反应灵敏度；响应能力
responsiveness.note:
The new software improves the overall responsiveness of the system. 新软件提高了系统的整体响应能力。

Market responsiveness is critical for modern retail business. 市场反应灵敏度对于现代零售业务至关重要。

restitution.note:
The court ordered the thief to make financial restitution to the victim. 法院下令小偷向受害人进行经济赔偿。

The museum demanded the restitution of stolen historical artifacts. 博物馆要求归还被盗的历史文物。

restive.meaning: adj. 难驾驭的；焦躁不安的
restive.note:
The crowd grew restive as they waited hours for the train to arrive. 人群等了几个小时火车还没到，开始变得焦躁不安。

Horses can become restive during thunderstorms. 马匹在雷雨天气中会变得难以驾驭。

restiveness.note:
Growing restiveness among employees led to a demand for better conditions. 员工中日益增长的焦躁不安情绪导致了对更好条件的要求。

The political restiveness of the region worried the central government. 该地区的政治反抗性让中央政府感到担忧。

restless.meaning: adj. 烦躁不安的； restless；不眠的
restless.note:
He spent a restless night tossing and turning in bed. 他在床上辗转反侧，度过了一个不眠之夜。

Restless children need plenty of physical activity to burn off energy. 好动的孩子们需要大量的体力活动来消耗精力。

restored.meaning: adj. 修复的；恢复的 v. 恢复；修复（动词restored的过去式/过去分词）
restored.note:
Power has been fully restored to the affected neighborhoods. 受影响街区的电力已全面恢复。

The historic building was carefully restored to its original glory. 这栋历史建筑被精心修复，恢复了往日的荣光。

resume.meaning: v. 恢复；重新开始 n. 个人简历
resume.note:
The flight is scheduled to resume operations after the storm. 航班计划在暴风雨过后恢复运营。

Please submit your updated resume and cover letter online. 请在线提交您更新的个人简历和求职信。

resurrect.meaning: v. 使复活；使复苏；恢复使用
resurrect.note:
The designer tried to resurrect an old fashion trend from the 1970s. 这位设计师试图复苏20世纪70年代的旧时尚潮流。

Medical technology can sometimes resurrect failing vital signs. 医疗技术有时能够使衰竭的生命体征复苏。

resuscitate.meaning: v. 使苏醒；抢救；使复苏
resuscitate.note:
Paramedics worked quickly to resuscitate the drowning victim. 医护人员迅速行动以抢救溺水受害者。

The government introduced new policies to resuscitate the slowing economy. 政府出台了新政策以复苏放缓的经济。

retail.meaning: n. 零售 adj. 零售的 v. 零售
retail.note:
The price of the item at wholesale is much lower than retail. 该商品的批发价远低于零售价。

She works as a manager at a major fashion retail store. 她是一家大型时尚零售店的经理。

retainer.meaning: n. 聘金；定金；家臣；保持器
retainer.note:
The lawyer received a large retainer to handle the complicated case. 这位律师收到了一笔大额聘金来处理这个复杂的案件。

The orthodontist fitted her with a dental retainer after removing braces. 牙医在拆除牙套后为她配了一个牙齿保持器。

retaliate.note:
The country promised not to retaliate against economic sanctions. 该国承诺不对经济制裁采取报复行动。

If you attack them, they are likely to retaliate immediately. 如果你攻击他们，他们很可能会立即反击。

retaliation.note:
They took security measures out of fear of violent retaliation. 出于对暴力报复的恐惧，他们采取了安全措施。

The strike was launched in retaliation against wage cuts. 发动这次罢工是对减薪的报复。

retard.note:
Cold temperatures can retard the growth of many plant species. 低温会减缓许多植物物种的生长。

Lack of funding will retard the development of the new project. 资金短缺将阻碍新项目的发展。

reticent.meaning: adj. 沉默寡言的；有保留的
reticent.note:
He was reticent about discussing his personal life with strangers. 他对和陌生人谈论自己的私生活显得沉默寡言。

The witness remained reticent throughout the police interrogation. 目击者在整个警察审讯过程中一直保持沉默。

retinue.note:
The celebrity arrived at the hotel accompanied by a large retinue. 这位名人在一大群随行人员的陪同下抵达酒店。

The visiting foreign monarch traveled with a full official retinue. 来访的外国君主带着完整的官方随从出行。

retiring.meaning: adj. 腼腆的；内向的；退隐的
retiring.note:
Despite her success, she remained a retiring and modest person. 尽管获得了成功，她依然是一个腼腆谦逊的人。

He lived a retiring lifestyle in a quiet country cottage. 他在一个安静的乡村小屋里过着退隐的生活。

retort.meaning: v. 反驳；回嘴 n. 反驳
retort.note:
She made a sharp retort to his critical remark about her work. 她对他的工作批评言论进行了尖锐的反驳。

'I can manage just fine,' she retorted angrily. “我完全应付得来，”她愤怒地回嘴道。

retouch.note:
The photographer had to retouch the portraits before printing them. 摄影师在打印肖像之前必须对它们进行修图润色。

She carefully retouched the paint on the old wooden frame. 她小心翼翼地修饰了旧木框上的油漆。

retrace.note:
We tried to retrace our steps to find the lost keys. 我们试图重走来时的路来寻找丢失的钥匙。

Historians can retrace the origins of the tradition back to ancient times. 历史学家可以追溯这个传统的起源到古代。

retract.note:
The newspaper was forced to issue a formal statement to retract the false story. 这家报社被迫发表正式声明以撤回虚假报道。

Cats can sharpen their claws and then retract them safely. 猫可以磨尖爪子然后安全地将它们缩回去。

retrench.note:
Economic downturns force many families to retrench their expenses. 经济低迷迫使许多家庭紧缩开支。

The company had to retrench operations to survive the financial crisis. 公司不得不削减运营规模以在金融危机中生存下来。

retribution.note:
He feared divine retribution for his past mistakes. 他害怕因过去的错误而遭受神的报应。

The criminals fled the country to escape legal retribution. 罪犯逃离了国家以逃避法律的惩罚。

retrieve.note:
The computer system allows users to retrieve deleted files quickly. 该计算机系统允许用户快速检索已删除的文件。

The retriever dog was trained to retrieve hunted ducks from the lake. 这只猎犬受过训练，能从湖中叼回被猎获的野鸭。

revealing.meaning: adj. 透露内情的；发人深省的；暴露的
revealing.note:
The documentary offered a revealing look into the hidden lives of celebrities. 这部纪录片让人深入了解了名人们隐藏的生活。

She wore a revealing dress to the evening gala. 她在晚会上穿了一件略显暴露的礼服。

revelation.meaning: n. 启示；揭露；惊人的消息
revelation.note:
The government corruption scandal came as a shocking revelation to the public. 政府腐败丑闻对公众来说是一个令人震惊的揭露。

Reading the ancient manuscript was a spiritual revelation for him. 阅读这份古代手稿对他来说是一次精神上的启示。

revelry.note:
The loud street revelry continued well into the early morning hours. 喧闹的街头狂欢一直持续到清晨。

Festival participants joined in the dancing and drunken revelry. 节日参与者加入了舞蹈和醉酒狂欢中。

revenge.meaning: n. 复仇；报复 v. 报复
revenge.note:
He sought bloody revenge against those who betrayed him. 他向那些背叛他的人寻求血腥复仇。

She vowed to revenge her family's honor. 她发誓要为家族的荣誉复仇。

reverberate.meaning: v. 回荡；起回声；产生深远影响
reverberate.note:
Thunder began to reverberate across the dark mountain valley. 雷声开始在黑暗的山谷中回荡。

The economic crisis will reverberate across international markets. 这场经济危机将在国际市场上产生深远的影响。

revere.note:
He is a wise leader whom the citizens deeply revere. 他是一位深受公民敬重的明智领袖。

Ancient cultures used to revere nature and its powerful elements. 古代文化曾经尊崇自然及其强大的元素。

reverie.note:
The sudden loud noise snapped her out of her pleasant reverie. 突然的巨响把她从美妙的沉思中惊醒。

He sat by the window, lost in a deep afternoon reverie. 他坐在窗前，陷入了深深的午后幻想中。

reverse.meaning: v. 颠倒；逆转 n. 背面；相反 adj. 相反的
reverse.note:
The court decided to reverse its previous decision on the case. 法院决定推翻先前对该案的裁决。

Please write your signature on the reverse side of the check. 请在支票的背面写上您的签名。

revert.note:
After the meeting, things will revert to their normal state. 会议结束后，事情将恢复到正常状态。

He promised never to revert to his old bad habits. 他承诺再也不回到以前的坏习惯中去。

revile.note:
The corrupt politician was reviled by the angry public. 这个腐败的政治家受到了愤怒公众的辱骂。

She was reviled for expressing her controversial opinions online. 她因在网上发表有争议的观点而遭到责骂。

revise.note:
Students are busy trying to revise their notes before the final test. 学生们正忙着在期末考试前复习笔记。

The author had to revise the manuscript based on the editor's feedback. 作者不得不根据编辑的反馈修改手稿。

revitalize.meaning: v. 使复兴；使恢复生机
revitalize.note:
The city launched a project to revitalize the downtown business district. 该市启动了一个项目以复兴市中心商业区。

A short nap can help revitalize your mind and body during work. 小睡一会儿可以帮助你在工作期间恢复身心活力。

revive.note:
Doctors managed to revive the patient after his heart stopped. 医生设法在病人心脏骤停后使其复苏。

There is a growing trend to revive traditional crafts. 恢复传统工艺的趋势日益增长。

revolt.meaning: n. 起义；反抗 v. 造反；使厌恶
revolt.note:
Citizens staged a massive revolt against the oppressive regime. 公民们对压迫政权发动了大规模起义。

The smell of rotten meat began to revolt her stomach. 腐烂肉类的气味开始让她的胃感到极度厌恶。

revue.meaning: n. 讽刺时事的滑稽歌舞剧
revue.note:
They attended a satirical musical revue at the local theater. 他们在当地剧院观看了一场讽刺时事的音乐歌舞剧。

The theater troupe performed a funny social review in the revue. 剧团在歌舞剧里表演了一场滑稽的社会评论。

reward.meaning: n. 奖励；回报 v. 奖励
reward.note:
The police offered a cash reward for information leading to the arrest. 警方对提供逮捕线索的人悬赏现金奖励。

Hard work will eventually reward you with success. 努力工作最终会以成功回报你。

rewarding.meaning: adj. 值得的；有回报的；有益的
rewarding.note:
Teaching young children can be a deeply rewarding experience. 教导幼儿可以是一次深刻有益的经历。

She found a rewarding job helping homeless animals. 她找到了一份救助流浪动物的有回报的工作。

rhetoric.meaning: n. 修辞；雄辩；空洞的言论
rhetoric.note:
Politicians often use clever rhetoric to persuade voters. 政治家经常使用聪明的修辞来劝说选民。

His speech was full of empty rhetoric rather than concrete policies. 他的演讲充满了空洞的言论，而不是具体的政策。

rhinestone.note:
Her stage costume was covered in sparkling rhinestones. 她的舞台服装上布满了闪闪发光的人造钻石。

Artificial rhinestones are often used to decorate cheap fashion jewelry. 人造莱茵石常用于装饰廉价的时尚首饰。

rhyme.meaning: n. 韵；押韵诗 v. 押韵
rhyme.note:
The poem has a simple and catchy AABB rhyme scheme. 这首诗有一个简单且朗朗上口的AABB押韵格式。

Can you think of a word that will rhyme with 'night'? 你能想出一个与“night”押韵的词吗？

rhythmic.note:
She moved to the rhythmic beat of the traditional music. 她随着传统音乐有节奏的拍子移动。

The sound of the train wheels had a soothing, rhythmic quality. 火车轮子的声音有一种舒缓的、有节奏的特质。

rib.meaning: n. 肋骨；肋条 v. 开玩笑；戏弄
rib.note:
He suffered a broken rib after falling off his bicycle. 他从自行车上摔下来后断了一根肋骨。

Friends gathered around to rib him about his new haircut. 朋友们围过来拿他的新发型开玩笑。

ribald.meaning: adj. 下流的；粗俗的；荤的
ribald.note:
He entertained the tavern guests with ribald jokes and songs. 他用下流的笑话和歌曲娱乐了酒馆的客人。

The film was criticized for its ribald humor and inappropriate scenes. 这部电影因其粗俗的幽默和不当的场景而受到批评。

rickety.meaning: adj. 摇晃的；快要塌的；患佝偻病的
rickety.note:
He carefully climbed up the rickety wooden ladder. 他小心翼翼地爬上那架摇晃的木梯。

The old table was so rickety that it shook whenever someone wrote on it. 这张旧桌子太摇晃了，以至于有人在上面写字时它就会晃动。

rider.meaning: n. 骑手；乘车人；附文；附加条款
rider.note:
Experienced horse riders gathered for the annual cross-country race. 经验丰富的骑手们聚集在一起参加年度越野赛。

The senator added a controversial spending rider to the bill. 参议员在该法案中增加了一项有争议的附加开支条款。

ridicule.meaning: n. 嘲笑；奚落 v. 嘲弄
ridicule.note:
She faced cruel ridicule from her peers because of her unusual style. 由于她独特的风格，她面临来自同龄人的残酷嘲笑。

It is wrong to ridicule someone for making a mistake. 因某人犯错而嘲弄他是错误的。

rife.note:
The old manuscript was rife with spelling mistakes and errors. 这份旧手稿充斥着拼写错误和失误。

During the crisis, rumors were rife about the government's stability. 危机期间，关于政府稳定性的传言甚嚣尘上。

rifle.meaning: n. 步枪 v. 迅速搜寻；洗劫
rifle.note:
The hunter shouldered his rifle and walked into the forest. 猎人扛起步枪走进了森林。

Someone broke into the office and began to rifle through the filing cabinets. 有人闯入办公室并开始迅速搜寻文件柜。

rift.note:
A deep geological rift split the valley floor open. 一个深的地质裂缝把山谷底部裂开了。

The disagreement caused a permanent rift between the two business partners. 意见不合导致这两个商业伙伴之间产生了永久的不和。

rigor.note:
Scientific experiments require rigorous academic rigor and discipline. 科学实验需要严格的学术严谨性和纪律。

The harsh winter climate brought severe weather rigor to the north. 严冬气候给北方带来了恶劣的天气严苛性。

rile.note:
His arrogant attitude never failed to rile his colleagues. 他那傲慢的态度总是能激怒他的同事们。

Don't let petty arguments rile you so easily. 别让琐碎的争论这么容易惹恼你。

ringlet.note:
A golden ringlet of hair fell gracefully across her forehead. 一缕金色的卷发优雅地垂落在她的额头上。

She twisted a ringlet of her hair around her finger nervously. 她紧张地用手指绕着自己的一缕小卷发。

riotous.meaning: adj. 喧闹的；放荡的；暴乱的
riotous.note:
The garden was filled with riotous colors of blooming summer flowers. 花园里充斥着盛开的夏花喧闹的色彩。

Police struggled to control the riotous crowd in the city center. 警察极力控制市中心喧闹暴乱的人群。

ritual.meaning: n. 仪式；惯例 adj. 仪式的
ritual.note:
Morning coffee has become an essential daily ritual for him. 早晨的咖啡对他来说已经成了必不可少的日常惯例。

Ancient tribes performed harvest dances as a sacred religious ritual. 古代部落跳丰收舞作为神圣的宗教仪式。

rival.meaning: n. 竞争对手 adj. 竞争的 v. 与…匹敌
rival.note:
The two tech companies have been fierce business rivals for decades. 这两家科技公司几十年来一直是激烈的商业竞争对手。

No other city can rival Paris for its art and culture. 没有其他城市能在艺术和文化上与巴黎匹敌。

rivalry.note:
There is a long-standing athletic rivalry between the two universities. 这两所大学之间有着长期的体育竞技竞争。

Commercial rivalry often drives companies to innovate faster. 商业竞争往往促使公司更快地创新。

rive.note:
Lightning can rive a massive oak tree in a split second. 闪电能在瞬间劈开一棵巨大的橡树。

The civil war threatened to rive the country apart. 内战威胁着要把这个国家撕裂开来。

riven.meaning: adj. 分裂的；劈开的（动词rive的过去分词）
riven.note:
The community was riven by internal political disputes. 这个社区因内部政治争端而分裂。

He walked across the riven ice of the frozen lake. 他走在结冰湖面那破裂的冰面上。

rivet.meaning: n. 铆钉 v. 铆接；吸引（注意力）
rivet.note:
The steel plates of the ship were held together by heavy rivets. 船的钢板由重型铆钉固定在一起。

His exciting adventure story managed to rivet the audience's attention. 他精彩的冒险故事设法吸引了观众的注意力。

riveting.meaning: adj. 引人入胜的；极具吸引力的
riveting.note:
She read a riveting mystery novel on her flight across the Atlantic. 她在跨大西洋的航班上读了一本引人入胜的悬疑小说。

The documentary provided a riveting account of deep-sea exploration. 这部纪录片对深海探索进行了引人入胜的记述。

rivulet.note:
Small rivulets of rainwater trickled down the muddy hillside. 雨水形成的小溪流顺着泥泞的山坡流淌下来。

A tiny rivulet of sweat ran down his forehead. 一股细微的汗珠从他的额头上流下来。

roe.note:
Sushi is often garnished with salty fish roe on top. 寿司上面经常点缀着咸鱼卵。

A graceful roe jumped across the woodland path. 一只优雅的雌鹿跳过了林间小路。

roil.note:
Strong winds began to roil the waters of the lake. 强风开始搅浑湖水。

Rumors of layoffs began to roil the office staff. 裁员的传言开始让办公室员工感到愤怒焦虑。

rookie.note:
The basketball rookie scored twenty points in his first professional game. 这位篮球新人在他的第一场职业比赛中得到了二十分。

Even as a rookie, he showed remarkable talent and confidence. 即使作为一个新手，他也表现出了非凡的天赋和自信。

roster.meaning: n. 名单；值班表；工作表
roster.note:
The coach checked the team roster before the game started. 比赛开始前，教练核对了一下球队名单。

Her name was included on the weekly work shift roster. 她的名字被列入了每周的工作值班表中。

rostrum.note:
The keynote speaker stepped up to the rostrum to deliver his speech. 主旨发言人走上讲台发表他的演讲。

He addressed the large audience from the elevated wooden rostrum. 他从高处升起的木制讲台上向大批观众发表讲话。

rotate.note:
The Earth takes twenty-four hours to rotate once on its axis. 地球自转一周需要二十-四小时。

Team members take turns to rotate administrative responsibilities. 团队成员轮流交替管理职责。

rotten.meaning: adj. 腐烂的；变质的；糟糕的
rotten.note:
The wooden fence had grown completely rotten over the years. 木栅栏多年来已经完全腐烂了。

I had a rotten day at work and just want to rest. 我今天工作糟透了，只想休息一下。

roughen.meaning: v. 使变粗糙；使变毛糙
roughen.note:
You should use sandpaper to roughen the surface before painting. 你应该在刷漆前用砂纸把表面打粗糙。

The cold winter wind began to roughen her skin. 寒冷的冬风开始使她的皮肤变粗糙。

royalty.meaning: n. 王室成员；版税；专利权税
royalty.note:
Members of the British royalty attended the charity banquet. 英国王室成员出席了慈善宴会。

The successful author receives a regular percentage of book royalties. 这位成功的作家定期获得图书版税。

rubicund.meaning: adj. 红润的；面色红润的
rubicund.note:
The old sailor had a rubicund face from years of working outdoors. 这位老水手因为多年在户外工作而有一张红润的脸庞。

He smiled cheerfully, his rubicund cheeks glowing in the firelight. 他愉快地笑着，红润的脸颊在火光中发光。

rudder.note:
The captain turned the ship's rudder to avoid hitting the reef. 船长转动船舵以避免撞上暗礁。

An airplane uses a vertical tail fin as a rudder to control direction. 飞机使用垂直尾翼作为舵来控制方向。

rudimentary.meaning: adj. 基本的；初步的；未完全发育的
rudimentary.note:
She has only a rudimentary understanding of computer programming. 她对计算机编程只有基本的理解。

The cavemen created rudimentary stone tools for survival. 原始人为了生存创造了初步的石制工具。

rue.meaning: v. 后悔；懊悔 n. 芸香
rue.note:
He will live to rue the day he decided to cheat on the exam. 他会为自己决定考试作弊的那一天感到后悔的。

She looked back with a sense of quiet rue over missed opportunities. 她带着一种对错过机会的安静懊悔回首往事。

ruffian.note:
A group of street ruffians caused trouble outside the train station. 一帮街头恶棍在火车站外制造麻烦。

The police arrested the ruffian for disturbing the public peace. 警察因这名暴徒扰乱社会治安而逮捕了他。

ruffle.meaning: v. 弄皱；扰乱；激怒 n. 褶边
ruffle.note:
The strong wind began to ruffle the surface of the quiet lake. 强风开始吹皱平静的湖面。

Her calm demeanor was not easy to ruffle, even under immense pressure. 即使在巨大压力下，她那镇定的仪态也不容易被激怒扰乱。

ruminant.meaning: n. 反刍动物 adj. 反刍的
ruminant.note:
Cows and sheep are well-known examples of grass-eating ruminants. 牛和羊是众所周知的吃草的反刍动物例子。

Ruminant animals have specialized stomachs to digest tough plant matter. 反刍动物拥有专门的胃来消化坚韧的植物物质。

rumple.meaning: v. 弄皱；使凌乱 n. 皱纹
rumple.note:
Be careful not to rumple your clean suit before the interview. 面试前小心别把你的干净西装弄皱了。

He used his hand to rumple his hair in frustration. 他沮丧地用手把头发揉得凌乱。

rung.meaning: n. 梯级；横档（动词ring的过去分词）
rung.note:
He placed his foot firmly on the next rung of the ladder. 他把脚稳稳地踩在梯子的下一个梯级上。

She climbed higher up the career rung to achieve success. 她沿着职业阶梯爬得更高以取得成功。

runic.meaning: adj. 如尼文的；北欧古代文字的
runic.note:
Archaeologists discovered ancient stones carved with mysterious runic symbols. 考古学家发现了刻有神秘如尼文字符的古代石头。

The scholar specialized in translating medieval runic inscriptions. 这位学者专门翻译中世纪如尼文铭文。

rupture.meaning: n. 破裂；决裂 v. 破裂；断绝
rupture.note:
The high pressure caused the water pipe to rupture. 高压导致水管破裂。

The political scandal led to a final rupture between the two countries. 政治丑闻导致两国彻底决裂。

rural.note:
They decided to leave the noisy city and move to a quiet rural area. 他们决定离开喧闹的城市，搬到一个安静的农村地区。

Rural development programs help improve farming infrastructure. 农村发展计划有助于改善农业基础设施。

ruse.note:
His friendly greeting was just a clever ruse to distract attention. 他的友好问候只是转移注意力的巧妙诡计。

The police saw through the criminal's clever disguise ruse. 警察识破了罪犯高明的伪装计谋。

rustic.meaning: adj. 乡村的；质朴的 n. 乡下人
rustic.note:
They stayed in a charming rustic cabin deep in the woods. 他们住在树林深处一个迷人的乡村小屋里。

The furniture had a rustic charm that suited the old cottage well. 这套家具有一种很适合这间旧农舍的乡村质朴魅力。

ruthlessness.note:
He climbed the corporate ladder with ruthless ambition and ruthlessness. 他凭借冷酷的野心和无情在公司里步步高升。

The dictator ruled the country with extreme ruthlessness. 独裁者以极端的残酷统治着这个国家。

saccharin.meaning: n. 糖精 adj. 过分甜美的；虚情假意的
saccharin.note:
She prefers to use artificial saccharin instead of sugar in her coffee. 她喜欢在咖啡里用人工糖精代替糖。

The movie was ruined by its overly saccharin and unrealistic plot. 这部电影被其过分甜美且不切实际的情节给毁了。

sacred.note:
The ancient temple is considered sacred by the local community. 这座古老的庙宇被当地社区视为神圣的。

Family traditions hold a sacred place in her heart. 家庭传统在她心中占有神圣的地位。

sacrilege.note:
Stealing treasures from the temple was regarded as a grave sacrilege. 从庙里偷窃财物被视为严重的亵渎行为。

He treated the holy books with what some considered sacrilege. 他对待圣书的态度被一些人认为是一种亵渎。

sacrilegious.meaning: adj. 亵渎的；冒渎神圣的
sacrilegious.note:
Making jokes inside the holy cathedral was considered sacrilegious. 在神圣的大教堂里开玩笑被认为是亵渎的。

His sacrilegious remarks offended many religious believers in the audience. 他亵渎的言论冒犯了观众中的许多宗教信徒。

sadden.note:
The news of the factory closing will sadden many local workers. 工厂倒闭的消息会让许多当地工人感到悲伤。

It can sadden anyone to see such destruction of nature. 看到对自然的这种破坏会使任何人感到难过。

saddle.meaning: n. 马鞍；鞍状山脊 v. 给马装鞍
saddle.note:
The rider secured the leather saddle firmly onto the horse's back. 骑手将皮马鞍牢牢固定在马背上。

They had to saddle the horses before embarking on the trail ride. 他们在开始骑马出游前必须给马装上鞍。

safeguard.meaning: n. 保护措施 v. 维护；保护
safeguard.note:
Laws are established to safeguard the fundamental rights of citizens. 建立法律是为了保护公民的基本权利。

Strong passwords act as a vital safeguard for online accounts. 强密码充当了在线账户至关重要的保护措施。

sagacious.meaning: adj. 聪明的；敏锐的；有远见的
sagacious.note:
The CEO made a sagacious decision to invest in green technology. 首席执行官做出了投资绿色技术的明智决定。

Her sagacious advice helped the team avoid a major financial disaster. 她有远见的建议帮助团队避免了一场重大财务灾难。

saintly.note:
She was known throughout the village for her saintly patience and kindness. 她以其圣洁的耐心和善良在全村闻名。

He lived a saintly life dedicated entirely to helping the poor. 他过着完全致力于帮助穷人的圣洁生活。

saliva.note:
Saliva plays an important role in the initial digestion of food. 唾液在食物的初步消化中起着重要作用。

The smell of delicious food can increase saliva production in the mouth. 美食的香味可以增加口腔中唾液的分泌。

salmon.note:
Wild salmon swim upstream against strong currents to spawn. 野生鲑鱼逆着急流向上游游去产卵。

Grilled salmon served with lemon is a very healthy dish. 配上柠檬的烤鲑鱼是一道非常健康的菜肴。

salubrious.meaning: adj. 有益健康的；气候宜人的
salubrious.note:
They moved to the coast to enjoy the salubrious sea air. 他们搬到海边去享受有益健康的海风。

The mountain resort is famous for its salubrious climate. 这个山林度假村以其气候宜人而闻名。

salutary.meaning: adj. 有益的；有警示作用的
salutary.note:
The economic failure served as a salutary lesson for the new business. 经济失利对这家新企业起到了一个有益的警示作用。

Walking everyday has a salutary effect on overall fitness. 每天走路对整体身体健康有有益的效果。

salutation.note:
A formal letter usually begins with a polite salutation like 'Dear Sir'. 正式信件通常以诸如“尊敬的先生”之类的礼貌称呼语开头。

The guard offered a respectful salutation to the visiting general. 卫兵向来访的将军致以恭敬的敬礼。

salute.meaning: v. 行礼；向…致敬 n. 敬礼
salute.note:
Soldiers stood at attention and saluted the American flag. 士兵们立正并向美国国旗行礼。

We salute the hard work of all healthcare workers during the crisis. 我们向危机中所有医护人员的辛勤工作致敬。

salvage.meaning: v. 抢救；挽救 n. 打捞；抢救出的财物
salvage.note:
Divers attempted to salvage cargo from the sunken ship. 潜水员试图从沉船中打捞货物。

She tried to salvage what was left of her dignity after the argument. 争吵过后，她试图挽回剩下的一点尊严。

salve.meaning: n. 药膏；安慰物 v. 减轻；抚慰
salve.note:
She applied a soothing herbal salve to the burn on her hand. 她在手上的烫伤处涂抹了一种舒缓的草本药膏。

He donated money to charity to salve his guilty conscience. 他向慈善机构捐款以减轻他内疚的良心。

sampler.meaning: n. 刺绣样品；样品集；试听碟
sampler.note:
The museum displayed an antique needlework sampler from the nineteenth century. 博物馆展出了一件十九世纪的古董刺绣样品。

The music store offered a digital music sampler for free download. 音乐商店提供了一个免费下载的数码音乐试听碟。

sanctify.note:
The priest performed rituals to sanctify the new church building. 牧师举行了仪式来使新教堂建筑神圣化。

Traditional marriage is sanctified by religious customs. 传统婚姻受到宗教习俗的神圣认可。

sanctimonious.meaning: adj. 假装圣洁的；伪善的
sanctimonious.note:
People disliked his sanctimonious lectures on moral behavior. 人们讨厌他对道德行为假装圣洁的说教。

She gave a sanctimonious speech while ignoring her own faults. 她发表了一场伪善的演讲，同时却忽视了自己的错误。

sanction.meaning: n. 制裁；批准 v. 批准；支持
sanction.note:
The international community imposed economic sanctions on the country. 国际社会对该国实施了经济制裁。

The committee refused to sanction the proposed budget plan. 委员会拒绝批准提议的预算计划。

sandal.note:
She wore comfortable leather sandals during her summer beach trip.她在夏日海滩旅行时穿了舒适的皮凉鞋。

Open-toe sandals are popular footwear in hot weather.露趾凉鞋是天气炎热时的热门鞋类。

sane.meaning: adj. 神智正常的；理智的
sane.note:
No sane person would agree to such a dangerous and reckless plan.没有哪个理智的人会同意这样一个危险且鲁莽的计划。

Talking to a close friend helps keep me sane during stressful times.和密友交谈有助于在压力大的时期保持神智正常。

sanguine.note:
Despite the market crash, he remains sanguine about future profits.尽管市场崩盘，他对未来的利润依然保持乐观。

She was remarkably sanguine regarding the outcome of the exam.她对考试结果异常自信。

sanity.meaning: n. 神智清醒；理智；健全
sanity.note:
Working long hours without breaks can threaten your mental sanity.长时间工作而不休息会威胁到你的精神理智。

He struggled to maintain his sanity during the long period of isolation.在漫长的隔离期间，他努力维持神智清醒。

sap.meaning: n. 树液；活力 v. 削弱；使衰竭
sap.note:
Springtime causes the sweet tree sap to rise up the trunk.春天使甜美的树液顺着树干向上流。

Constant illness can slowly sap a person's strength and energy.持续的疾病会慢慢削弱一个人的体力和精力。

sapient.note:
Humans are often classified as modern sapient beings.人类通常被归类为现代有智慧的生物。

The wise old scholar offered sapient advice to the young students.这位智慧的老学者给年轻学生们提出了有智慧的建议。

sarcastic.note:
He made a sarcastic comment about her late arrival.他对她迟到发表了一句挖苦的评论。

Her sarcastic tone made it clear she was not amused.她讽刺的语气表明她一点也觉得不好笑。

sartorial.note:
He is well-known for his impeccable sartorial elegance and style.他因无可挑剔的服装优雅和风格而闻名。

The magazine focuses on men's sartorial trends and fashion.这本杂志专注于男士服装潮流和时尚。

sate.note:
A heavy meal was served to sate the hungry travelers.端上了一顿丰盛的大餐来满足饥饿的旅客。

His curiosity was finally sate by reading the detailed report.通过阅读详细报告，他的好奇心终于得到了充分满足。

satiated.note:
Feeling fully satiated, they left the luxurious restaurant buffet.感觉十分饱足后，他们离开了奢华的餐厅自助餐。

Consumers are becoming satiated with constant online advertising.消费者对持续的网络广告正变得有些厌腻。

satirize.note:
The play uses humor to satirize modern political hypocrisy.这部戏剧利用幽默来讽刺现代政治虚伪。

Authors often write books to satirize social norms and flaws.作家经常写书来讽刺社会规范和缺陷。

saturate.meaning: v. 浸透；使饱和；使湿透
saturate.note:
Heavy rain will quickly saturate the dry garden soil.大雨会很快浸透干燥的花园土壤。

The marketing campaign aims to saturate the market with advertisements.这场营销活动旨在用广告使市场饱和。

saturated.note:
Her clothes were completely saturated after walking in the storm.在暴风雨中行走后，她的衣服完全湿透了。

Dietitians recommend limiting the intake of saturated fats.营养学家建议限制饱和脂肪的摄入量。

saturnine.meaning: adj. 阴郁的；忧郁的；严峻的
saturnine.note:
He stared into the fire with a dark, saturnine expression.他带着阴郁、严峻的表情凝视着火堆。

The detective had a saturnine face that rarely showed a smile.这位侦探有一张很少露出笑容的忧郁脸庞。

saunter.meaning: v. 漫步；闲逛 n. 闲逛
saunter.note:
They decided to saunter through the park on a sunny afternoon.他们决定在一个阳光明媚的下午在公园里漫步。

He took a leisurely saunter down the quiet village street.他悠闲地沿着安静的乡村街道闲逛。

savage.meaning: adj. 野蛮的；凶猛的 n. 野蛮人 v. 猛烈抨击
savage.note:
The village was attacked by savage beasts from the deep forest.村庄遭到来自深林凶猛野兽的袭击。

Critics rushed to savage the new movie in their reviews.评论家们纷纷在评论中猛烈抨击这部新电影。

savant.meaning: v. 专家；学者；饱学之士
savant.note:
He was recognized as a brilliant savant in the field of mathematics.他在数学领域被公认为是一位杰出的学者。

The gathering brought together leading scientific savants from around the globe.这次聚会汇聚了来自全球的顶尖科学专家。

savvy.meaning: adj. 精明的；懂行事的 n. 见识；常识
savvy.note:
She is a tech-savvy entrepreneur who understands digital markets well.她是一位精通技术的企业家，对数字市场有很好的理解。

He lacks the political savvy needed to win the election.他缺乏赢得选举所需的政治见识。

sawdust.note:
The carpenter swept up the pile of wood sawdust from the floor.木匠扫起了地板上的木屑堆。

They scattered sawdust on the wet floor to prevent slipping.他们在湿漉漉的地板上撒了锯末以防滑倒。

scabbard.note:
The knight drew his shining sword smoothly from its leather scabbard.骑士从皮剑鞘中顺畅地拔出了他闪亮的宝剑。

He cleaned and polished the metal scabbard before the ceremony.他在仪式前清洗并擦亮了金属剑鞘。

scad.note:
Fishermen caught a large scad of small fish near the shore.渔民在岸边捕获了大量的小鱼。

There are scads of things to do before we leave for the trip.在我们出发去旅行之前，有许多事情要做。

scalding.note:
Be careful not to spill the scalding hot coffee on yourself.小心不要把滚烫的热咖啡洒在自己身上。

She washed the dishes in scalding hot water to kill bacteria.她用滚烫的热水洗碗以杀死细菌。

scale.meaning: n. 规模；天平；鳞片 v. 攀登
scale.note:
The project was launched on a massive global scale.该项目是在一个庞大的全球规模上启动的。

Alpinists trained hard to scale the snowy mountain peak.登山运动员刻苦训练以攀登雪山峰顶。

scalpel.note:
The surgeon held out his hand for a sharp surgical scalpel.外科医生伸出手要求一把锋利的手术刀。

Precise incisions require a steady hand and a fine scalpel.精确的切口需要稳健的手和精细的手术刀。

scandal.note:
The political financial scandal forced the minister to resign.政治财务丑闻迫使部长辞职。

Town gossip turned into a major scandal involving local officials.城镇流言变成了一桩涉及当地官员的重大丑闻。

scant.meaning: adj. 不足的；微薄的 v. 节省；吝啬
scant.note:
There was scant evidence to prove the suspect's guilt.几乎没有什么证据能证明嫌疑人的罪行。

He paid scant attention to the warning signs along the road.他对路边的警告标志几乎没有给予关注。

scarf.note:
She wrapped a warm woolen scarf around her neck against the wind.她为了挡风在脖子上围了一条暖和的羊毛围巾。

He wore a silk scarf with his winter overcoat.他在冬大衣外面系了一条丝绸围巾。

scathing.meaning: adj. 刻薄的；严厉的；尖锐的
scathing.note:
The critic published a scathing review of the new theatrical play.评论家发表了一篇对该新戏剧严厉尖锐的评论。

She faced scathing criticism for her poor management decisions.她因糟糕的管理决策而面临刻薄的批评。

scenario.note:
We must prepare for the worst-case scenario in this project.我们必须为该项目最坏的情况做好准备。

Training exercises simulated various emergency rescue scenarios.训练演习模拟了各种紧急救援情景。

schematic.meaning: adj. 图解的；图式的 n. 原理图
schematic.note:
The engineer studied the schematic diagram of the electrical circuit.工程师研究了电路的原理图。

The book offers a schematic overview of the complex historical event.这本书提供了复杂历史事件的图解概述。

schematize.meaning: v. 概要表述；系统化；图解
schematize.note:
The teacher tried to schematize the complex grammar rules on the board.老师试图在黑板上把复杂的语法规则系统化表述出来。

Researchers schematized the survey data into a clear chart.研究人员将调查数据图解成一张清晰的图表。

scheme.meaning: n. 计划；方案；阴谋 v. 密谋；策划
scheme.note:
The local council proposed a new housing development scheme.当地议会提出了一个新的住房开发计划。

They began to scheme against their rivals in the business world.他们开始在商界密谋策划对付竞争对手。

schism.note:
Ideological differences caused a deep schism within the political party.意识形态的分歧导致政党内部产生深度的分裂。

The religious schism lasted for centuries before reconciliation happened.宗教分裂持续了几个世纪才实现了和解。

scion.note:
He is the wealthy scion of an old and prestigious family.他是一个历史悠久、声誉显赫家族的富有子孙。

Gardeners grafted a healthy scion onto the rootstock of the tree.园丁将一个健康的幼芽嫁接到树的砧木上。

scissor.meaning: n. 剪刀 v. 用剪刀剪
scissor.note:
She used a pair of sharp scissors to cut the wrapping paper.她用一把锋利的剪刀剪包装纸。

He scissored out the coupon from the local newspaper.他从当地报纸上把优惠券剪了下来。

scoff.meaning: v. 嘲笑；讥讽 n. 嘲弄
scoff.note:
Some people tend to scoff at ideas they do not fully understand.有些人往往会嘲笑他们不完全理解的想法。

He laughed with scoff at her ambitious career plans.他带着嘲弄的笑声对待她雄心勃勃的职业计划。

scoop.meaning: n. 勺；独家新闻 v. 舀取；抢先报道
scoop.note:
She used an ice cream scoop to serve dessert to the guests.她用冰淇淋勺给客人们盛甜点。

The local newspaper managed to scoop its larger rivals with the story.当地报纸设法用这篇报道抢先于较大的竞争对手。

scope.note:
The project is too large in scope to be finished in a month.这个项目的范围太大，无法在一个月内完成。

There is plenty of scope for creative thinking in this job.这份工作有很大的发挥创造性思维的余地。

scorch.meaning: v. 烧焦；烤焦 n. 焦痕
scorch.note:
The hot iron managed to scorch her favorite cotton shirt.热熨斗不小心烧焦了她最喜欢的棉质衬衫。

Wildfires can quickly scorch vast areas of forest land.野火能迅速烧焦大片森林土地。

scorn.meaning: n. 轻蔑；鄙视 v. 鄙视；看不起
scorn.note:
He treated her proposal with open scorn and laughter.他公开带着轻蔑和笑声对待她的提议。

She would scorn to accept charity from people she disliked.她会对接受自己不喜欢的人的施舍感到不屑。

scotch.meaning: v. 镇压；彻底粉碎 n. 苏格兰威士忌
scotch.note:
Quick action helped scotch the rumors of a company bankruptcy.迅速的行动帮助彻底粉碎了公司破产的传言。

He ordered a glass of aged Scotch whiskey at the bar.他在酒吧里点了一杯陈年苏格兰威士忌。

scourge.meaning: n. 祸害；苦难的根源 v. 祸害；折磨
scourge.note:
Disease and famine remain a terrible scourge in many developing nations.疾病和饥荒仍然是许多发展中国家可怕的祸害。

History recorded how wars would scourge the vulnerable population.历史记录了战争如何折磨脆弱的人口。

scowl.meaning: v. 怒视；皱眉面露凶相 n. 怒容
scowl.note:
He responded to the annoying question with a dark scowl.他带着阴沉的怒容回应了这个烦人的问题。

She stood by the door, scowling at anyone who tried to enter.她站在门边，对任何试图进入的人怒目而视。

scrap.meaning: n. 碎屑；废料 v. 废弃；抛弃
scrap.note:
He wrote down the phone number on a small scrap of paper.他把电话号码写在一小张废纸上。

The council decided to scrap the expensive and outdated transport plan.议会决定废弃昂贵且过时的交通计划。

scrappy.meaning: adj. 拼凑的；好斗的；顽强的
scrappy.note:
The team won the match through scrappy play and determination.球队通过顽强的拼搏和决心赢得了比赛。

Her notes were a bit scrappy and unorganized.她的笔记有点东拼西凑、毫无条理。

scrawl.meaning: v. 潦草地写；乱涂 n. 潦草的字迹
scrawl.note:
He managed to scrawl a quick note before running out the door.他在跑出门前匆忙潦草地写了一张便条。

Her handwriting was just an illegible scrawl on the page.她的笔迹在纸上只是一行辨认不清的潦草字迹。

screw.meaning: n. 螺丝钉 v. 用螺丝固定；拧
screw.note:
He used a screwdriver to tighten the loose metal screw.他用螺丝刀拧紧了松动的金属螺丝钉。

Make sure to screw the cap tightly onto the bottle.务必把瓶盖紧紧地拧在瓶子上。

screwdriver.note:
He looked through his toolbox for a Phillips head screwdriver.他在工具箱里寻找一把十字螺丝刀。

A standard screwdriver is an essential tool for assembling furniture.标准的螺丝刀是组装家具必不可少的工具。

scribble.meaning: v. 乱写；胡乱涂鸦 n. 潦草的字
scribble.note:
The bored student began to scribble drawings in his notebook.无聊的学生开始在笔记本上涂鸦画画。

His signature was nothing more than an unreadable scribble.他的签名不过是一个无法辨认的潦草笔迹。

script.meaning: n. 剧本；手稿；笔迹 v. 编写剧本
script.note:
Actors spent weeks memorizing their lines from the script.演员们花了好几周时间从剧本中背台词。

She wrote a brilliant script for the upcoming television drama.她为即将上映的电视剧写了一个精彩的剧本。

scripture.note:
Monks spent their lives copying religious scripture by hand.僧侣们一生都在手抄宗教经文。

The scholar studied ancient scripture to understand historical beliefs.这位学者研究古代经文以了解历史信仰。

scroll.meaning: n. 卷轴；纸卷 v. 滚动（屏幕内容）
scroll.note:
Archaeologists unrolled the ancient parchment scroll with great care.考古学家非常小心地展开了那份古代羊皮纸卷轴。

You can scroll down the webpage to read more articles.你可以向下滚动网页来阅读更多文章。

scruple.meaning: n. 顾忌；良心不安 v. 顾虑；犹豫
scruple.note:
He had no moral scruples about cheating his business partners.他对欺骗商业伙伴毫无道德顾忌。

She would not scruple to use any means necessary to win.她会毫不犹豫地使用任何必要的手段来获胜。

scrutable.meaning: adj. 可理解的；看得透的
scrutable.note:
His motives, unlike hers, were entirely clear and scrutable.他的动机与她不同，完全清晰且易于理解。

The complex system became more scrutable after the detailed explanation.经过详细解释后，这个复杂的系统变得更容易理解了。

scuff.meaning: v. 磨损；拖着脚走 n. 磨损痕迹
scuff.note:
He accidentally scuffed his new leather shoes against the wall.他不小心把新皮鞋在墙上蹭出了磨损痕迹。

Children tend to scuff their sneakers on the playground pavement.孩子们往往会在操场路面上把运动鞋磨损。

sculpt.note:
The artist used clay to sculpt a realistic human figure.艺术家用粘土雕刻了一个逼真的人形。

Wind and water can sculpt rocks into strange shapes over time.日久天长，风和水可以将岩石雕刻成奇特的形状。

sculptor.note:
The famous sculptor spent months chiseling the marble block.这位著名的雕刻家花了好几个月时间凿那块大理石。

Her work as a sculptor earned her international fame.她作为雕刻家的工作为她赢得了国际声誉。

scurrilous.meaning: adj. 粗俗的；下流的；恶毒诽谤的
scurrilous.note:
The tabloid published scurrilous rumors about the famous actor.这家小报发表了关于这位著名演员的下流谣言。

He faced legal action for making scurrilous accusations.他因做出恶毒诽谤的指控而面临法律诉讼。

scurry.meaning: v. 急转；碎步快跑 n. 急赶
scurry.note:
Little mice began to scurry across the kitchen floor.小老鼠们开始在厨房地板上碎步快跑。

People hurried in a scurry to catch the departing train.人们急急忙忙地赶着去坐即将开出的火车。

scurvy.meaning: n. 坏血病 adj. 卑鄙的；下流的
scurvy.note:
Early sailors often suffered from scurvy due to a lack of vitamin C.早期水手经常因缺乏维生素C而患上坏血病。

His scurvy behavior during the crisis disgusted everyone.他在危机期间卑鄙的行为让所有人感到恶心。

scythe.meaning: n. 大镰刀 v. 用大镰刀割
scythe.note:
The farmer used a long scythe to cut the tall grass in the field.农夫用一把长长的镰刀割掉田里高高的草。

Death is often symbolized as a figure carrying a sharp scythe.死神通常被象征为一个手持锋利大镰刀的人物。

seam.note:
The jacket split along the shoulder seam during the game.夹克在比赛中沿着肩部接缝裂开了。

Miners discovered a rich new coal seam deep underground.矿工们在地底下发现了一个丰富的全新煤层。

seamy.meaning: adj. 肮脏的；卑劣的；破烂的
seamy.note:
The detective novel exposes the seamy side of big city life.这部侦探小说揭露了大城市生活中肮脏卑劣的一面。

He spent years exploring the seamy underworld of the port.他花了好几年时间探索港口肮脏的地下世界。

seasoned.meaning: adj. 经验丰富的；调好味的
seasoned.note:
She is a seasoned diplomat with years of international experience.她是一位有着多年国际经验的资深外交官。

The chef added herbs to the seasoned meat dish.厨师在调好味的肉菜中加入了香草。

seasoning.note:
Salt and pepper are the most common kitchen seasonings.盐和胡椒是最常见的厨房调味品。

She carefully balanced the seasoning of the soup before serving.她在上汤之前仔细平衡了汤的佐料。

secede.meaning: v. 脱离；退出（政党、国家等）
secede.note:
Several southern states decided to secede from the union.几个南部州决定退出联邦。

The region threatened to secede if its demands were ignored.该地区威胁说，如果其要求被忽视，就要脱离出去。

secretive.meaning: adj. 守口如瓶的；鬼鬼祟祟的
secretive.note:
He became very secretive about his new business project.他对自己的新商业项目变得十分保密守口如瓶。

Her secretive behavior made her coworkers suspicious.她鬼鬼祟祟的行为让同事们起了疑心。

secular.note:
Schools in this country operate on a strict secular basis.这个国家的学校在严格的世俗基础上运作。

The state functions as a secular republic separated from religious rule.该国家作为一个脱离宗教统治的世俗共和国运转。

securities.meaning: n. 证券；有价证券（名词security的复数形式）
securities.note:
He invested heavily in government bonds and corporate securities.他大量投资于政府债券和公司有价证券。

Stock markets handle the daily trading of various securities.股票市场处理各种有价证券的日常交易。

sedate.meaning: adj. 沉着冷静的；庄重的 v. 给镇静剂
sedate.note:
She led a quiet and sedate life in the countryside.她在乡下过着平静而庄重的生活。

Doctors had to sedate the agitated patient for his own safety.为了安全起见，医生不得不给情绪激动的病人使用镇静剂。

sediment.note:
Thick layers of mud and sediment settled at the bottom of the lake.厚厚的泥土和沉积物沉淀在湖底。

Rivers carry vast amounts of sediment down to the ocean.河流将大量的沉积物带到海洋中。

sedulity.meaning: n. 勤勉；刻苦；一丝不苟
sedulity.note:
He completed the tedious research project with remarkable sedulity.他以惊人的勤勉完成了这个枯燥的研究项目。

Her academic success was a reward for years of steady sedulity.她的学术成功是对多年来持续刻苦的回报。

sedulous.meaning: adj. 勤勉的；刻苦的；聚精会神的
sedulous.note:
She made a sedulous effort to learn the difficult language.她为学习这门困难的语言付出了刻苦的努力。

His sedulous attention to detail ensured the project's success.他对细节一丝不苟的关注确保了项目的成功。

seemly.note:
Such loud behavior was hardly seemly at a solemn memorial service.这种喧闹的行为在庄严的追悼会上实在算不上得体。

He always behaved in a seemly and polite manner.他总是表现得得体且有礼貌。

seep.note:
Water began to seep through the cracks in the basement wall.水开始通过地下室墙壁的裂缝渗漏进来。

Faint light started to seep under the closed wooden door.微弱的光线开始从紧闭的木门缝隙里透出来。

seethe.meaning: v. 翻腾；沸腾；怒火中烧
seethe.note:
The hot volcanic spring water continued to seethe and bubble.炎热的火山温泉水继续翻腾冒泡。

She tried to hide her anger, but inside she was ready to seethe.她试图掩饰愤怒，但内心却气得怒火中烧。

seine.meaning: n. 地曳网；大拉网 v. 用网捕鱼
seine.note:
Fishermen cast a large seine net into the coastal waters.渔民们往近海海域撒下了一张大拉网。

They spent the afternoon seining along the shallow riverbanks.他们花了一下午在浅浅的河岸边用网捕鱼。

seismic.meaning: adj. 地震的；重大的；剧烈震动的
seismic.note:
Scientists recorded intense seismic activity before the volcanic eruption.科学家在火山爆发前记录下了剧烈的地震活动。

The technological shift created seismic changes in the global economy.这种技术转型在全球经济中造成了重大的震动变化。

semblance.meaning: n. 外表；假象；相似之处
semblance.note:
They tried to restore a semblance of order after the chaos.他们在混乱之后试图恢复某种秩序的假象。

Her smile bore little semblance to her true feelings of sorrow.她的微笑与她内心的悲伤情感几乎没有相似之处。

seminal.meaning: adj. 具有重大影响的；开创性的；精液的
seminal.note:
He wrote a seminal book that revolutionized modern economic theory.他写了一本彻底改变现代经济理论的开创性著作。

The discovery marked a seminal moment in medical history.这一发现标志着医学史上具有重大影响的时刻。

seminary.meaning: n. 神学院；修道院；发源地
seminary.note:
He studied theology at a traditional Catholic seminary.他在一所传统的天主教神学院学习神学。

The small town served as a seminary of revolutionary ideas.这个小镇曾是革命思想的发源地。

sensation.note:
She lost all feeling and sensation in her fingers due to the cold.由于寒冷，她的手指失去了所有的触觉。

The new pop band became an overnight sensation across the country.这个新的流行乐队在一夜之间轰动了全国。

sensible.meaning: adj. 明智的；合情合理的；切合实际的
sensible.note:
Wearing a warm coat in winter is a very sensible choice.冬天穿暖和的大衣是一个非常明智的选择。

She gave a sensible solution to the complex problem.她对这个复杂的问题提出了一个合情合理的解决方案。

sensitive.meaning: adj. 敏感的；易受伤害的；灵敏的
sensitive.note:
My eyes are very sensitive to bright sunlight.我的眼睛对强烈的阳光非常敏感。

He handled the sensitive diplomatic issue with great care.他以极大的小心处理了这个敏感的外交问题。

sensitivity.meaning: n. 敏感性；灵敏度；体贴
sensitivity.note:
Skin sensitivity can increase when using certain cosmetic products.使用某些化妆品时，皮肤敏感性可能会增加。

We must treat cultural differences with empathy and sensitivity.我们必须以同理心和体贴的态度对待文化差异。

sensitization.note:
Repeated exposure to the chemical can cause immune sensitization.反复接触该化学物质会导致免疫致敏作用。

The campaign aims at public sensitization regarding environmental protection.该运动旨在提高公众对环境保护的敏感化意识。

sentient.meaning: adj. 有知觉的；有感觉能力的
sentient.note:
Science fiction often explores the rights of artificial sentient beings.科幻小说经常探讨人工有知觉生物的权利。

All sentient creatures have the capacity to feel pain and joy.所有有知觉的生物都有感受痛苦和快乐的能力。

sentinel.meaning: n. 哨兵；门卫 v. 守卫
sentinel.note:
A lone sentinel stood guard outside the castle gates.一个孤独的哨兵在城堡大门外站岗守卫。

Ancient stone towers sentinel the steep mountain pass.古老的石塔守卫着陡峭的山隘。

septic.meaning: adj. 败血性的；受感染的；脓毒性的
septic.note:
The untreated wound quickly became septic and required immediate care.未处理的伤口很快受到感染，需要立即护理。

Poor sanitation can lead to dangerous septic conditions.不良的卫生条件可能导致危险的脓毒性状况。

sepulchral.meaning: adj. 坟墓的；阴森的；沉闷的
sepulchral.note:
His voice had a sepulchral tone that sent shivers down our spine.他的声音有一种阴森的语调，让我们不寒而栗。

The dark and quiet basement had a sepulchral atmosphere.阴暗安静的地下室有一种坟墓般的沉闷气氛。

sequential.note:
The instructions must be followed in strict sequential order.必须严格按顺序步骤遵循这些说明。

The database organizes information in sequential steps.数据库按连续的步骤组织信息。

seraphic.meaning: adj. 天使般的；美丽纯洁的
seraphic.note:
The sleeping child had a serene and seraphic smile on her face.睡着的孩子脸上带着平静而天使般的微笑。

She was blessed with seraphic beauty and a kind heart.她拥有天使般的美丽和善良的心灵。

sere.note:
The dry autumn weather turned the valley fields brown and sere.干燥的秋季天气使山谷田野变得棕黄干枯。

Herbs are often dried until they are completely sere for storage.草药通常被晒干直到完全枯萎以便保存。

serene.meaning: adj. 平静的；安详的；清澈的
serene.note:
They spent a quiet weekend relaxing by the serene mountain lake.他们在平静的山间湖泊旁放松度过了一个安静的周末。

Her serene expression showed she had found inner peace.她安详的表情表明她找到了内心的平静。

serial.meaning: adj. 连载的；连续的 n. 连续剧
serial.note:
The detective story was published as a weekly magazine serial.这个侦探故事是以每周杂志连载的形式出版的。

He watched a thrilling mystery serial on television.他在电视上观看了一部惊险的神秘连续剧。

sermon.note:
The priest delivered an inspiring sermon about charity and love.牧师发表了一篇关于慈善与爱的鼓舞人心的布道。

I didn't ask for a long sermon; I just wanted your honest opinion.我没求你长篇大论地说教；我只是想要你诚实的意见。

serrate.meaning: adj. 锯齿状的 v. 使成锯齿状
serrate.note:
The leaves of the plant have distinct serrate edges.这种植物的叶子有着明显的锯齿状边缘。

Tools can be designed to serrate hard materials effectively.工具可以设计成有效地将坚硬材料弄成锯齿状。

serrated.meaning: adj. 锯齿状的；有锯齿的
serrated.note:
He used a serrated knife to slice the crusty loaf of bread.他用一把锯齿刀切那块硬皮面包。

The shark's teeth are sharp and heavily serrated.鲨鱼的牙齿锋利且带有厚重的锯齿。

serried.note:
The army marched forward in serried ranks across the field.军队在田野里排着密集的行列向前行进。

Tall pine trees stood in serried lines along the hillside.高大的松树在山坡上排成密集的行列。

serviceable.meaning: adj. 实用的；耐用的；可用的
serviceable.note:
The old car is still serviceable for short trips around town.这辆旧车对于城里的短途旅行来说仍然是可用的耐用的。

She bought warm, serviceable clothing for the winter hiking trip.她为冬季徒步旅行买了一套保暖实用的衣服。

servile.meaning: adj. 奴性的；百依百顺的；奉承的
servile.note:
He was tired of the servile attitude of his coworkers toward the boss.他厌倦了同事们对老板那种百依百顺的奴性态度。

Her servile obedience prevented her from expressing her true thoughts.她奴性的服从使她无法表达真实的 pensamientos。

servitude.note:
Many prisoners were condemned to years of hard penal servitude.许多囚犯被判处多年的苦役劳役。

They fought bravely to escape centuries of political servitude.他们勇敢地战斗以摆脱几个世纪的政治束缚。

setback.note:
