terrain.note:
The rugged terrain made driving extremely difficult. 崎岖的地形让开车变得极其困难。

Mountain bikers love testing their skills on rough terrain. 山地骑行者喜欢在粗糙的地形上测试他们的技能。

terse.meaning: adj. 简洁的，简明扼要的
terse.note:
He gave a terse reply and hung up the phone. 他给了一个简短的回答便挂了电话。

The email was terse and to the point. 这封电子邮件简明扼要，直奔主题。

testament.meaning: n. 证明，遗嘱，圣经旧约或新约
testament.note:
Her success is a testament to her hard work. 她的成功证明了她努力工作的成果。

He left his entire fortune to charity in his testament. 他在遗嘱中将全部财产留给了慈善机构。

testator.note:
The testator must be of sound mind when signing the will. 立遗嘱人在签署遗嘱时必须精神健全。

Legal counsel verified the identity of the testator. 法律顾问核实了立遗嘱人的身份。

testify.note:
She agreed to testify against the criminal in court. 她同意在法庭上指证罪犯。

Several witnesses testified that they saw the accident. 几位目击者作证说他们看到了这起事故。

testiness.note:
His unusual testiness surprised his colleagues. 他罕见的暴躁脾气让同事们感到惊讶。

She apologized for her testiness during the morning meeting. 她为自己在早会上的急躁态度道了歉。

testy.note:
He was tired and became testy with his students. 他很累，对学生们变得很不耐烦。

She answered in a testy voice when interrupted. 当被打断时，她用一种急躁的声音回答道。

tether.meaning: n. 拴系物，牵绳 / v. 拴系，绑
tether.note:
The horse was tethered to a wooden post in the field. 马被拴在地里的一根木桩上。

His anger pushed him to the end of his tether. 他的愤怒让他忍无可忍、到了山穷水尽的地步。

texture.note:
I love the smooth texture of this silk fabric. 我喜欢这种丝绸面料光滑的质感。

The bread has a crisp crust and a soft texture. 这面包有着酥脆的外皮和柔软的内部组织。

thatch.meaning: n. 茅草屋顶 / v. 用茅草覆盖
thatch.note:
The traditional cottage had a thick thatch roof. 这间传统小屋有着厚厚的茅草屋顶。

They hired a worker to thatch the barn. 他们雇了一个工人来用茅草铺设谷仓屋顶。

thaw.meaning: v. 解冻，融化 / n. 解冻期
thaw.note:
The snow began to thaw as the temperature rose. 随着气温上升，雪开始融化了。

Meat should be allowed to thaw completely before cooking. 肉在烹饪前应该先完全解冻。

theocracy.meaning: n. 神权政治，神权政体
theocracy.note:
The country was governed as a strict theocracy. 该国作为一个严格的神权政体进行统治。

Historical theocracies blended religious and civil laws. 历史上神权政体将宗教法律和民事法律融为一体。

therapeutic.meaning: adj. 治疗的，有疗效的，令人放松的
therapeutic.note:
Gardening can be very therapeutic for mental health. 园艺对心理健康非常有疗愈作用。

Hot springs have proven therapeutic properties. 温泉已被证明具有 therapeutic 功效。

thermal.meaning: adj. 热的，保暖的 / n. 热气流
thermal.note:
She wore a thermal jacket to keep warm in the snow. 她穿着一件保暖夹克在雪地里御寒。

Hawks use rising thermal currents to soar in the sky. 鹰利用上升热气流在空中翱翔。

thesis.meaning: n. 论文，毕业论文，论题
thesis.note:
He is currently writing his doctoral thesis. 他目前正在撰写博士论文。

Her main thesis is that modern education needs a complete overhaul. 她的核心论点是现代教育需要彻底改革。

thicket.note:
The rabbit hid in a dense thicket to escape the fox. 兔子藏在密集的灌木丛里以躲避狐狸。

They had to hack their way through the thorny thicket. 他们不得不砍开带刺的灌木丛杀出一条路。

thorn.note:
The rose stem was covered in sharp thorns. 玫瑰茎上布满了尖刺。

He pricked his finger on a thorn. 他的手指被刺扎了一下。

threadbare.note:
He wore a threadbare coat on cold winter days. 他在寒冬里穿着一件磨破了的旧大衣。

The excuse he gave sounded old and threadbare. 他找的借口听起来既老套又陈腐。

threat.note:
Global warming poses a severe threat to the planet. 全球变暖对地球构成了严峻威胁。

They ignored the storm threat and went sailing anyway. 他们忽视了风暴的预警，依然去航海了。

thrive.meaning: v. 繁荣，兴旺，茁壮成长
thrive.note:
Plants thrive in rich soil and plenty of sunlight. 植物在肥沃的土壤和充足的阳光下茁壮成长。

Business started to thrive after the new manager took over. 新经理接手后，业务开始兴旺起来。

throne.note:
The young prince inherited the throne at age twenty. 年轻的王子在二十岁时继承了王位。

The king sat upon a golden throne during the ceremony. 国王在庆典期间坐在金色的王座上。

throng.meaning: n. 人群，群 / v. 拥挤，群集
throng.note:
A dense throng of fans gathered outside the hotel. 大批粉丝聚集在酒店外面。

Shoppers thronged the streets during the holiday season. 假日期间购物者挤满了街道。

throwback.meaning: n. 复古，回潮，特征倒退
throwback.note:
The design of this car is a throwback to the 1960s. 这款车的造型是对20世纪60年代风格的一种复古回归。

His old-fashioned manners make him a bit of a throwback. 他老派的礼仪让他看起来有点像个复古的老古董。

thrust.meaning: v. 猛推，刺，挤 / n. 推力，要旨
thrust.note:
He thrust his hands into his pockets. 他把双手猛地插进衣兜里。

The main thrust of her argument is education reform. 她论点的核心要旨是教育改革。

thwart.note:
Police managed to thwart the bank robbery plot. 警方成功挫败了抢劫银行的阴谋。

Bad weather thwarted their plans for a picnic. 恶劣天气泡汤了他们野餐的计划。

tickler.meaning: n. 挠痒痒的人，棘手的问题，备忘录
tickler.note:
This math puzzle is a real mental tickler. 这个数学谜题真是一个极其烧脑的难题。

She kept a tickler file to remind herself of tasks. 她保留了一个备忘档案夹来提醒自己各项任务。

ticklish.meaning: adj. 怕痒的，棘手的，敏感的
ticklish.note:
He is very ticklish around his feet. 他的脚周围非常怕痒。

This is a ticklish situation that requires delicate handling. 这是一个需要小心处理的棘手局面。

tiff.note:
The couple had a minor tiff over who would wash the dishes. 这对夫妇为谁洗碗发生了一场小口角。

They quickly made up after their silly tiff. 在经历了一场无聊的小拌嘴后，他们很快就和好了。

tightfisted.meaning: adj. 吝啬的，小气守财的
tightfisted.note:
He is too tightfisted to tip the waiter. 他太吝啬了，连服务员的小费都不给。

The tightfisted owner refused to invest in new equipment. 这个吝啬的老板拒绝投资新设备。

tilt.meaning: v. 倾斜，翘起 / n. 倾斜，倾向
tilt.note:
The painting on the wall began to tilt to one side. 墙上的画开始向一边倾斜。

She tilted her head to listen more carefully. 她歪着头以便听得更仔细。

timber.note:
The cabin was built entirely of sturdy timber. 这座小屋完全是用结实的木材建造的。

Logging companies harvest timber for construction. 林业公司砍伐木材用于建筑。

timbre.note:
The violin has a warm and rich timbre. 这把小提琴有着温暖而丰满的音色。

Her voice has a unique and recognizable timbre. 她的声音有着独特且易于辨认的音质。

timely.note:
Thanks for your timely warning; it saved us. 谢谢你及时的警告，这救了我们。

The government took timely measures to control the outbreak. 政府采取了及时的措施来控制疫情。

timid.note:
The timid deer ran back into the deep forest. 胆小的鹿跑回了密林深处。

She was too timid to speak up during the interview. 她在面试时太害羞，不敢大声说话。

timidity.note:
He tried to overcome his natural timidity by public speaking. 他试图通过公开演讲来克服天生的胆怯。

Her timidity prevented her from expressing her ideas clearly. 她的羞怯阻碍了她清晰地表达自己的想法。

timorous.meaning: adj. 胆怯的，胆小的，受惊的
timorous.note:
He made a timorous request for a day off. 他胆怯地提出了请一天的假。

A timorous animal hid behind the bushes. 一只胆小的动物躲在灌木丛后面。

tined.note:
He picked up the food with a four-tined fork. 他用一把四齿叉子夹起食物。

The metal rake had several sharp tined prongs. 这个金属耙子有好几个尖锐的分叉齿。

tinker.meaning: v. 补锅，修补，瞎摆弄 / n. 补锅匠
tinker.note:
He likes to tinker with old clocks in his garage. 他喜欢在车库里修修补补老式钟表。

We need to tinker with the design to make it work better. 我们需要对设计稍作修改以使其运行得更好。

tint.meaning: n. 色彩，色调，染发剂 / v. 给…着色
tint.note:
The walls were painted with a soft blue tint. 墙壁刷上了柔和的蓝色色调。

She decided to tint her hair a darker shade of brown. 她决定把头发染成较深的棕色。

tirade.meaning: n. 长篇大论的愤怒谴责，长篇恶骂
tirade.note:
The manager went into a long tirade about lateness. 经理对迟到现象发表了一通长篇大论的愤怒批评。

She walked away to avoid his angry tirade. 她走开以避开他那充满怒火的抨击。

tissue.note:
She wiped her tears away with a soft tissue. 她用一张柔软的纸巾擦去了眼泪。

Muscle tissue repairs itself during sleep. 肌肉组织在睡眠期间进行自我修复。

titanic.meaning: adj. 巨大的，极巨大的，力大无穷的
titanic.note:
The two companies engaged in a titanic struggle for market share. 这两家公司为争夺市场份额展开了巨大的斗争。

It took a titanic effort to move the heavy boulder. 移开这块沉重的巨石花费了巨大的气力。

titular.meaning: adj. 名义上的，有头衔无实权的
titular.note:
The queen is the titular head of the state. 女王是名义上的国家元首。

The play is named after its titular character. 这部戏剧以其名义上的主角命名。

toil.meaning: v. 苦干，辛勤劳作 / n. 辛劳，苦工
toil.note:
The miners toil underground for hours every day. 矿工们每天在地下辛苦劳作几个小时。

Years of hard toil finally paid off. 多年的辛勤劳作终于有了回报。

tolerance.note:
Promoting mutual tolerance is essential for a peaceful society. 促进相互宽容对和平社会至关重要。

Some people have a low tolerance for spicy food. 有些人对辛辣食物的耐受力很低。

toll.meaning: n. 通行费，伤亡人数，代价 / v. 鸣钟
toll.note:
Drivers must pay a toll when crossing the bridge. 司机过桥时必须支付通行费。

The earthquake took a heavy death toll. 这场地震造成了沉重的死亡人数。

tombstone.note:
His name was neatly engraved on the granite tombstone. 他的名字被整齐地刻在花岗岩墓碑上。

People placed flowers in front of the tombstone. 人们在墓碑前献上了鲜花。

tongs.note:
He used kitchen tongs to flip the grilled steak. 他用厨房夹子翻转烤牛排。

She picked up the burning coal with a pair of metal tongs. 她用一把金属火钳夹起燃烧的煤炭。

tonsorial.note:
He sat in the chair for a quick tonsorial session. 他坐在椅子上进行了一次快速的理发。

The old barbershop offered classic tonsorial services. 这家老式理发店提供传统的理发服务。

tornado.note:
A powerful tornado swept through the town last night. 昨晚一场强烈的龙卷风横扫了整个小镇。

Sirens warned residents to take shelter from the tornado. 警报器警告居民寻找掩体躲避龙卷风。

torpid.meaning: adj. 麻木的，迟钝的，蛰伏的
torpid.note:
The heat made everyone feel torpid and lazy. 高温让每个人都感到迟钝而懒散。

Snakes remain torpid during the cold winter months. 蛇在寒冷的冬月里保持蛰伏状态。

torpor.meaning: n. 麻木，迟钝，死气沉沉
torpor.note:
A summer heatwave induced a state of general torpor. 夏季热浪引发了普遍的呆滞状态。

She shook off her morning torpor with a cup of strong coffee. 她喝了一杯浓咖啡来摆脱早晨的倦怠。

torrent.note:
Heavy rain turned the stream into a raging torrent. 大雨把小溪变成了一股汹涌的急流。

She faced a torrent of questions from reporters. 她面对着记者们如潮水般的问题。

torrential.meaning: adj. 倾盆而下的，暴雨的
torrential.note:
The match was cancelled due to torrential rain. 比赛因倾盆大雨而取消。

Streets were flooded after hours of torrential downpours. 经过数小时的暴雨倾盆后，街道被淹了。

tortuous.meaning: adj. 弯弯曲曲的，曲折迂回的，阴险的
tortuous.note:
We drove along a tortuous mountain road. 我们沿着一条弯弯曲曲的山路开车。

The negotiation process was long and tortuous. 谈判过程漫长而曲折。

totalitarian.meaning: adj. 极权主义的 / n. 极权主义者
totalitarian.note:
Citizens suffered under the oppressive totalitarian regime. 公民在压迫性的极权政权下遭受苦难。

Totalitarian governments control all aspects of public life. 极权主义政府控制着公众生活的方方面面。

totem.note:
The tribe carved animal symbols onto their sacred totem. 部落将动物符号雕刻在他们的神圣图腾上。

In some cultures, certain animals serve as spiritual totems. 在某些文化中，特定的动物充当精神图腾。

totter.note:
The old fence began to totter in the wind. 老旧的栅栏在风中开始摇晃。

She tottered down the stairs in her new shoes. 她穿着新鞋踉踉跄跄地走下楼梯。

touchy.meaning: adj. 敏感的，脾气暴躁的，棘手的
touchy.note:
He is very touchy about his lack of formal education. 他对缺乏正规教育这件事非常敏感。

Money is a touchy subject between close friends. 钱是好朋友之间一个棘手的话题。

toupee.note:
He wore a neat toupee to cover his bald head. 他戴了一顶整洁的男士假发来遮盖秃顶。

A sudden gust of wind blew off his toupee. 一阵突如其来的强风吹掉了他的假发。

tourniquet.note:
The medic applied a tourniquet to stop the heavy bleeding. 医务人员使用止血带止住大出血。

Applying a tourniquet incorrectly can cause tissue damage. 错误使用止血带可能会导致组织损伤。

tout.meaning: v. 兜售，吹捧，高价转售 / n. 黄牛，推销员
tout.note:
Salesmen touted the benefits of the new software. 推销员极力吹捧新软件的好处。

Ticket touts were selling matches outside the stadium. 黄牛在体育场外兜售比赛门票。

toxic.meaning: adj. 有毒的，引起中毒的
toxic.note:
The factory was fined for releasing toxic waste into the river. 这家工厂因向河里排放有毒废物而被罚款。

Avoid maintaining toxic relationships that drain your energy. 避免维持那些消耗你精力的有毒人际关系。

toxin.note:
Certain mushrooms contain lethal toxins. 某些蘑菇含有致命的毒素。

Drinking plenty of water helps flush toxins from your body. 多喝水有助于排出体内的毒素。

traceable.meaning: adj. 可追踪的，可溯源的
traceable.note:
The stolen funds were traceable through bank records. 被盗资金可以通过银行记录进行追踪。

Its origins are traceable back to the 15th century. 它的起源可以追溯到15世纪。

tract.meaning: n. 大片土地，小册子，器官系统
tract.note:
They bought a large tract of land to build a farm. 他们买下了一大片土地来建农场。

The respiratory tract handles the air we breathe. 呼吸道处理我们呼吸的空气。

tractability.note:
The trainer praised the dog's tractability. 驯犬师称赞了这只狗的温顺好驯服。

Her tractability made her an easy team member to manage. 她的随和使得她成了一个很好管理的团队成员。

tractable.meaning: adj. 易驾驭的，温顺的，易处理的
tractable.note:
The problem proved to be more tractable than expected. 这个问题证明比预期更容易处理。

Children are usually more tractable when well-rested. 孩子们在休息好时通常更听话。

tragedy.note:
The sudden accident was a terrible tragedy for the family. 突如其来的事故对这个家庭来说是一场巨大的惨剧。

Shakespeare wrote many famous tragedies. 莎士比亚写了许多著名的悲剧。

trait.note:
Honesty is an essential personal trait. 诚实是一项基本的人格品质。

Sense of humor is a desirable leadership trait. 幽默感是令人向往的领导特质。

traitor.note:
He was branded a traitor for leaking military secrets. 他因泄露军事机密而被斥为叛徒。

The traitor was caught trying to flee across the border. 叛徒在试图逃过边境时被抓获。

trample.note:
Be careful not to trample on the flower beds. 小心别踩踏花坛。

He felt that his rights were being trampled on. 他觉得自己的权利受到了践踏。

trance.meaning: n. 恍惚，出神，催眠状态
trance.note:
She stared into space as if she were in a trance. 她呆呆地望着虚空，仿佛处于出神状态。

The hypnotist put the patient into a deep trance. 催眠师让病人进入了深度催眠状态。

tranquility.note:
They sought the tranquility of the countryside. 他们寻求乡村的宁静。

The lake offered a sense of absolute peace and tranquility. 湖水带来了绝对的平和与宁静。

transaction.note:
All financial transactions are kept secure and private. 所有金融交易都保持安全和私密。

The bank completed the property purchase transaction. 银行完成了房产购买交易。

transcendent.meaning: adj. 卓越的，超凡的，超越的
transcendent.note:
She achieved transcendent beauty in her paintings. 她在画作中达到了超凡脱俗的美感。

Music offers a transcendent experience for listeners. 音乐给听众带来了超越凡俗的体验。

transcendental.meaning: adj. 先验的，超越的，超绝的
transcendental.note:
He studied the principles of transcendental philosophy. 他研究了先验哲学的原理。

Poetry can sometimes express transcendental truths. 诗歌有时能表达超越常规的真理。

transcribe.note:
Secretaries transcribe audio recordings into text. 秘书将录音转录成文字。

He had to transcribe the old manuscript carefully. 他必须仔细抄写这份古老的手稿。

transfer.meaning: v. 转移，调动，转让 / n. 转移，转乘
transfer.note:
She plans to transfer to another university next year. 她计划明年转学到另一所大学。

You can transfer money between bank accounts online. 你可以在网上在银行账户之间转账。

transfigure.meaning: v. 美化，使变形，使焕然一新
transfigure.note:
Joy seemed to transfigure her ordinary face. 喜悦似乎让她的普通面容焕发了光彩。

Sunlight transfigured the landscape into a golden wonderland. 阳光将风景变成了金色的仙境。

transgress.note:
Those who transgress the law will be punished. 违法者将受到惩罚。

He promised never to transgress against the community rules. 他保证绝不违反社区规则。

transgression.meaning: n. 违背，罪过，违法行为
transgression.note:
He sought forgiveness for his past transgressions. 他为自己过去的过犯寻求宽恕。

The punishment should fit the nature of the transgression. 惩罚应与违法行为的性质相称。

transience.note:
She wrote poems about the transience of human life. 她写了关于人类生命短暂无常的诗篇。

We all learn to accept the transience of beauty. 我们都学会接受美丽转瞬即逝的本质。

transient.meaning: adj. 短暂的，转瞬即逝的 / n. 流動人口
transient.note:
The rainstorm was transient, clearing up in minutes. 这场暴雨转瞬即逝，几分钟内就放晴了。

The city has a large population of transient workers. 该市拥有大量的流动劳动力人口。

transition.note:
The transition from school to work can be tough. 从学校到工作的过渡可能会很艰难。

The company is in a period of digital transition. 公司正处于数字化转型的时期。

transitory.meaning: adj. 短暂的，转瞬即逝的
transitory.note:
Youth and beauty are ultimately transitory. 青春和美丽终究是短暂的。

They experienced a transitory drop in profits. 他们经历了短暂的利润下降。

translucent.note:
Light filtered through the translucent frosted glass. 光线透过半透明的磨砂玻璃照射进来。

Some types of plastic are completely translucent. 某些类型的塑料是完全半透明的。

transmit.note:
Radio towers transmit signals across the country. 广播塔向全国发射信号。

Diseases can be transmitted through contaminated water. 疾病可以通过受污染的水传播。

transmute.meaning: v. 变形，使改变，使蜕变
transmute.note:
Alchemists tried to transmute lead into gold. 炼金术士试图把铅变成黄金。

Pain can sometimes be transmuted into creative art. 痛苦有时可以转化为创造性的艺术。

transplantation.note:
He successfully underwent a heart transplantation surgery. 他成功地进行了心脏移植手术。

Tree transplantation requires careful handling of roots. 树木移植需要小心处理根部。

transport.meaning: v. 运输，运送 / n. 交通运输系统
transport.note:
Large trucks are used to transport goods across the country. 大型卡车用于在全国各地运输货物。

Public transport is very efficient in this city. 这座城市的公共交通非常高效。

trapeze.note:
The circus acrobat performed dangerous stunts on the trapeze. 马戏团杂技演员在高空秋千上表演了危险的特技。

She swung gracefully from one trapeze bar to another. 她优美地从一根吊杠荡到另一根吊杠上。

traverse.note:
Hikers traversed the snowy mountain pass. 徒步旅行者穿越了积雪的山隘。

Bridges traverse the wide river at multiple points. 桥梁在多处跨越这条宽阔的河流。

travesty.meaning: n. 拙劣的模仿，歪曲，笑柄
travesty.note:
The unfair trial was a complete travesty of justice. 这场不公的审判简直是对正义的彻底嘲弄。

His version of the story is a travesty of the facts. 他对故事的版本是对事实的歪曲。

treacherous.meaning: adj. 背叛的，危险的，奸诈的
treacherous.note:
Driving conditions became treacherous due to black ice. 由于暗冰，驾驶条件变得极其危险。

He could not trust his treacherous business partner. 他无法信任他那个背信弃义的商业伙伴。

treason.note:
He was arrested and charged with high treason. 他因被控犯有叛国重罪而被捕。

Helping the enemy was considered an act of treason. 援助敌人被视为叛国行为。

treatise.note:
He published a detailed philosophical treatise on ethics. 他发表了一篇关于伦理学的详细哲学专著。

The scholar wrote a scientific treatise on marine biology. 这位学者写了一篇关于海洋生物学的科学论文。

tremor.note:
She felt a slight tremor in her hands before the speech. 演讲前她感到双手有些微微颤抖。

A minor earthquake tremor was felt across the city. 全城都能感受到轻微的地震震动。

trenchant.meaning: adj. 尖锐的，锋利的，深刻有力的
trenchant.note:
The critic wrote a trenchant review of the new movie. 评论家对这部新电影写了一篇尖锐的评论。

Her trenchant remarks cut right to the heart of the issue. 她尖锐中肯的言论直击问题核心。

trepidation.note:
She entered the interview room with some trepidation. 她带着些许不安走进了面试房间。

He accepted the promotion without any trepidation. 他毫无畏惧地接受了晋升。

tribunal.meaning: n. 法庭，审判庭，仲裁委员会
tribunal.note:
The international tribunal investigated war crimes. 国际法庭调查了战争罪行。

An employment tribunal will hear his unfair dismissal case. 雇用仲裁庭将审理他的不公正解雇案。

tribute.note:
Friends and family gathered to pay tribute to the late artist. 亲友们聚集在一起向这位已故艺术家致敬。

The monument stands as a tribute to fallen soldiers. 这座纪念碑是为阵亡将士而立的致敬标志。

trickle.meaning: v. 滴，细流 / n. 涓涓细流，稀疏
trickle.note:
Water began to trickle from the broken pipe. 水开始从破裂的水管里一滴滴流出来。

Only a trickle of customers came into the store. 只有寥寥几个稀疏的顾客走进店里。

trifle.meaning: n. 琐事，微不足道的东西 / v. 浪费，戏弄
trifle.note:
Don't argue with him over such a mere trifle. 别为了这种微不足道的小事跟他争吵。

She did not want to trifle with her career. 她不想拿自己的职业生涯开玩笑。

trilogy.meaning: n. 三部曲（文学、电影等）
trilogy.note:
The fantasy trilogy became an international bestseller. 这部奇幻三部曲成了国际畅销书。

He watched all three films of the sci-fi trilogy in a row. 他连续看完了这部科幻三部曲的所有三部电影。

trim.meaning: v. 修剪，整理 / adj. 整洁的，苗条的
trim.note:
He needs to trim the hedge in the front yard. 他需要修剪前院的树篱。

She managed to stay trim through regular exercise. 她通过有规律的锻炼保持着苗条身材。

trinket.meaning: n. 小饰品，不值钱的珠宝
trinket.note:
She bought some cheap silver trinkets as souvenirs. 她买了一些廉价的银质小饰品作为纪念品。

His desk was cluttered with various plastic trinkets. 他的桌子上乱七八糟地摆满了各种塑料小饰品。

trio.note:
The musical trio performed a beautiful jazz song. 这个音乐三人组演奏了一首美妙的爵士乐。

A trio of friends decided to travel across Europe. 一行三个朋友决定去欧洲旅行。

tripod.note:
He mounted his camera on a sturdy tripod. 他把相机安装在一个结实的三脚架上。

A camera tripod helps prevent shaky photos. 相机三脚架有助于防止拍出模糊的照片。

trite.note:
His speech was full of trite clichés and boring ideas. 他的演讲充满了陈腐的陈词滥调和无聊的想法。

Try to avoid trite expressions in your writing. 尽量在写作中避免使用陈腐的表达。

troupe.note:
The dance troupe is touring across different countries. 这个舞蹈剧团正在不同国家巡回演出。

Actors in the theatrical troupe rehearsed all afternoon. 戏剧团的演员们排练了整个下午。

trowel.note:
She used a gardening trowel to plant the flowers. 她用一把园艺小铲子来种花。

The mason smoothed the mortar with a metal trowel. 泥瓦匠用一把金属泥刀把砂浆抹平。

truancy.note:
The school implemented new policies to tackle student truancy. 学校实施了新政策来解决学生逃学问题。

He was suspended for repeated truancy. 他因屡次旷课而被停学。

truce.note:
Both sides finally agreed to a temporary truce. 双方最终同意达成一项临时停战协议。

The warring factions declared a holiday truce. 交战各方宣布了节日休战。

truculent.meaning: adj. 好斗的，凶猛的，残酷的
truculent.note:
He adopted a truculent attitude during the argument. 他在争论中表现出一种好斗的态度。

The manager's truculent response upset the staff. 经理凶狠强硬的回应惹恼了员工。

trudge.meaning: v. 跋涉，吃力地走 / n. 艰难的跋涉
trudge.note:
They had to trudge through the deep snow. 他们不得不顶着深雪艰难跋涉。

It was a long uphill trudge back to the camp. 这是一个返回营地的漫长上坡跋涉。

truncate.note:
The speech had to be truncated due to lack of time. 由于时间不够，演讲不得不被缩短。

Data files were truncated to save storage space. 数据文件被截短以节省存储空间。

trunk.meaning: n. 树干，大箱子，汽车后备箱，象鼻
trunk.note:
He put the luggage in the car trunk. 他把行李放进了汽车后备箱。

The elephant reached out its long trunk for food. 大象伸出长长的鼻子去拿食物。

truss.meaning: v. 捆绑，扎紧 / n. 桁架，束
truss.note:
The chef had to truss the chicken before roasting. 厨师在烤鸡前必须把鸡绑好。

The roof was supported by heavy wooden trusses. 屋顶由沉重的木桁架支撑着。

trustworthy.meaning: adj. 值得信赖的，可靠的
trustworthy.note:
She is a trustworthy friend who keeps secrets well. 她是一个值得信赖的朋友，守口如瓶。

We need to find a trustworthy mechanic to fix the car. 我们需要找一个靠谱的机修工来修理汽车。

tuber.note:
Potatoes are a common edible tuber. 马铃薯是一种常见的可食用块茎。

The plant grows from an underground tuber. 这种植物由地下块茎生长出来。

tumult.note:
The country was in political tumult following the election. 选举过后，国家陷入了政治动荡中。

He could not sleep through the city's midnight tumult. 他无法在城市半夜的喧嚣中入睡。

turbulent.meaning: adj. 动荡的，汹涌的，狂暴的
turbulent.note:
The plane shook violently during turbulent weather. 飞机在气流颠簸的天气里剧烈摇晃。

They lived through a turbulent period in history. 他们经历了历史上的一段动荡时期。

turgid.meaning: adj. 浮夸的，臃肿的，（河流）水肿涨满的
turgid.note:
The river became turgid after heavy spring rains. 春季大雨过后，河水变得浑浊上涨。

His writing style is overly turgid and hard to read. 他的文风过于浮夸晦涩，很难阅读。

turmoil.note:
His mind was in emotional turmoil after the breakup. 分手后他的内心陷入了情感混乱。

Economic crisis caused widespread social turmoil. 经济危机引发了广泛的社会动乱。

turncoat.note:
He was labeled a turncoat for joining the rival party. 他因加入敌对政党而被贴上叛徒的标签。

No one trusted the political turncoat. 没有人信任这个政治变节者。

turpitude.note:
He was accused of moral turpitude and forced to resign. 他被指控道德堕落并被迫辞职。

Such acts of political turpitude are unacceptable. 这种政治上的卑劣行径是不可接受的。

turquoise.meaning: n. / adj. 青绿色，绿松石
turquoise.note:
She wore a stunning ring with a bright turquoise stone. 她戴着一枚镶嵌着明亮绿松石的惊艳戒指。

The ocean water was a clear shade of turquoise. 海水呈现出清澈的青绿色。

turret.note:
A small stone turret stood at the corner of the castle. 一座小石制角楼矗立在城堡的拐角处。

Tank turrets can rotate 360 degrees. 坦克炮塔可以360度旋转。

tusk.meaning: n. 长牙（如象牙、野猪牙等）
tusk.note:
Poachers hunted elephants for their valuable ivory tusks. 盗猎者为了宝贵的象牙而猎杀大象。

The wild boar flashed its sharp tusks. 野猪露出了它锐利的长牙。

tussle.meaning: n. 争斗，扭打 / v. 争夺，扭打
tussle.note:
The boys had a brief tussle over the last piece of cake. 男孩们为最后一块蛋糕发生了一场小争夺。

He emerged bruised from a physical tussle with the thief. 他在与小偷的一场肢体扭打中带伤脱身。

tutor.meaning: n. 导师，家庭教师 / v. 当家庭教师，辅导
tutor.note:
She hired a math tutor to help her son with homework. 她请了一位数学家教来帮儿子辅导作业。

He tutors college students in physics during weekends. 他在周末辅导大学生物理。

tuxedo.meaning: n. 男士礼服，无尾礼服
tuxedo.note:
He wore a black tuxedo to the formal evening gala. 他穿着一件黑色无尾礼服出席正式晚宴。

Groom and best men dressed in matching tuxedos. 新郎和伴郎们穿着配套的男士礼服。

twig.note:
The bird collected small twigs to build its nest. 小鸟收集细枝来筑巢。

She snapped a dry twig in half with her fingers. 她用手指把一根干树枝折成了两半。

twinge.meaning: n. 刺痛，一阵剧痛，内疚感
twinge.note:
He felt a sharp twinge of pain in his knee. 他感到膝盖一阵剧烈刺痛。

She felt a slight twinge of guilt for lying. 她因为撒谎而感到一丝轻微的内疚。

typo.meaning: n. 打字错误，印刷错误
typo.note:
Please proofread the text to remove any typos. 请校对文本以消除任何拼写错误。

There is a small typo on the front cover of the book. 书的封面有一个小小的排版错误。

typographical.note:
The editor corrected several typographical errors in the manuscript. 编辑更正了手稿中的几个排版错误。

Typographical layout matters greatly in book design. 排版布局在书籍设计中至关重要。

tyranny.note:
The citizens rebelled against years of brutal tyranny. 公民们奋起反抗多年的残酷暴政。

They fought for freedom from foreign tyranny. 他们为了摆脱外敌专制而战斗。

tyrant.note:
The cruel tyrant was eventually overthrown by the revolution. 残暴的暴君最终被革命推翻。

He ruled the country like an absolute tyrant. 他像一个绝对的暴君一样统治着这个国家。

tyro.note:
Though a tyro in the kitchen, he cooked a great meal. 尽管在厨房里是个新手，他还是做了一顿丰盛的饭菜。

The training program is designed to guide tyros. 该培训项目旨在指导新手。

ugly.meaning: adj. 丑陋的，讨厌的，险恶的
ugly.note:
They built an ugly concrete structure in the historic town. 他们在那座历史悠久的小镇里建造了一个丑陋的混凝土建筑。

The argument took an ugly turn and ended in blows. 争论发生了恶劣的转向，最终演变成了斗殴。

ulcer.note:
Stress can sometimes cause a stomach ulcer. 压力有时会导致胃溃疡。

Corruption is a social ulcer that needs to be eradicated. 腐败是需要根除的社会弊端。

umbrage.note:
She took umbrage at his remarks about her work. 她对关于她工作的评论感到不快。

He took umbrage when his integrity was questioned. 当他的正直受到质疑时，他感到了生气。

unaffected.meaning: adj. 不受影响的；自然真诚的
unaffected.note:
Her health remained unaffected by the busy schedule. 她的健康没有受到繁忙日程的影响。

Despite her fame, she is a remarkably unaffected person. 尽管她很有名，但她是一个非常自然真诚的人。

unassuming.meaning: adj. 谦逊的；不装腔作势的
unassuming.note:
He lived a quiet and unassuming life. 他过着平静而谦逊的生活。

Behind his unassuming exterior lies a brilliant mind. 在他谦逊的外表下藏着一个聪明的头脑。

unbecoming.meaning: adj. 不得体的；不相称的
unbecoming.note:
Such behavior is unbecoming of a leader. 这种行为对领导者来说是不得体的。

His anger was unbecoming to a professional. 他的愤怒与专业人员的身份不相称。

unbend.note:
He needs to learn how to unbend and have fun. 他需要学会如何放松并享受乐趣。

Try to unbend the metal rod carefully. 试着小心地把金属杆弯回原形。

uncanny.note:
She has an uncanny ability to predict market trends. 她有一种惊人的能力来预测市场趋势。

There was an uncanny silence in the abandoned house. 那栋废弃的房子里有一种神秘的寂静。

uncommitted.note:
Many voters remain uncommitted ahead of the election. 许多选民在选举前仍未表态。

He stayed uncommitted during the initial debate. 在初次辩论中他保持中立态度。

unconscionable.meaning: adj. 不合理的；丧心病狂的
unconscionable.note:
The company charged unconscionable prices for medication. 这家公司对药物收取了不合理的高价。

It is unconscionable to neglect vulnerable children. 忽视弱势儿童是丧心病狂的。

unconscious.meaning: adj. 失去知觉的；无意识的
unconscious.note:
He was found unconscious on the floor. 他被发现失去知觉地躺在地板上。

She made an unconscious gesture of annoyance. 她做出了一个无意识的恼怒手势。

uncouth.note:
His uncouth manners offended the guests. 他粗鲁的举止冒犯了客人们。

She was shocked by his uncouth language. 她对他的粗俗言语感到震惊。

unctuous.note:
I distrusted his unctuous praise. 我不信任他那虚假的赞美。

His unctuous tone made everyone uncomfortable. 他那油滑的语调让每个人都感到不舒服。

underbid.meaning: v. 压低标价；出价低于...
underbid.note:
A rival company managed to underbid us for the contract. 一家竞争对手成功以更低的标价赢得了我们的合同。

They tried to underbid their competitors to win the project. 他们试图通过压低标价来赢得该项目。

underdog.meaning: n. 处于劣势的人；受害者
underdog.note:
Everyone loves to root for the underdog in sports. 每个人都喜欢在体育比赛中支持处于劣势的一方。

Despite being the underdog, she won the championship. 尽管处于劣势，她还是赢得了冠军。

underestimated.meaning: v. 低估（estimate的过去式及过去分词）
underestimated.note:
We underestimated the complexity of the task. 我们低估了这项任务的复杂性。

They underestimated their opponents and lost. 他们低估了对手而输掉了比赛。

undergird.note:
Strong economic policies undergirded the country's growth. 强有力的经济政策巩固了该国的增长。

These principles undergird our legal system. 这些原则构成了我们法律系统的基础。

underhanded.note:
He used underhanded methods to secure the promotion. 他用卑鄙的手段获得了晋升。

She suspected underhanded dealings behind the scenes. 她怀疑幕后有秘密的交易。

underling.note:
The director delegated the routine task to an underling. 主任将常规任务委派给了一个下属。

He preferred giving orders to his underlings rather than working. 他更喜欢对手下发号施令而不是自己干活。

underplay.note:
The government tried to underplay the seriousness of the crisis. 政府试图淡化这场危机的严重性。

She tended to underplay her own achievements. 她往往会淡化自己的成就。

underrate.note:
Never underrate the power of persistence. 永远不要低估坚持不懈的力量。

It is easy to underrate the difficulties involved. 很容易低估其中涉及的困难。

underscore.note:
The report underscores the need for immediate action. 该报告强调了立即采取行动的必要性。

Please underscore the key terms in the text. 请在文本中的核心词汇下划线。

understate.meaning: v. 保守地说；轻描淡写
understate.note:
To say he was pleased would be to understate the case. 要说他很高兴实在是太轻描淡写了。

She did not want to understate the risks involved. 她不想淡化所涉及的风险。

understated.note:
Her elegance is reflected in her understated clothing. 她的优雅体现在她低调的着装上。

The restaurant is known for its understated luxury. 这家餐厅以其低调的奢华而闻名。

understatement.meaning: n. 保守陈述；轻描淡写的说法
understatement.note:
Saying the exam was hard is an understatement. 说考试很难简直是轻描淡写了。

To call it a challenge is a huge understatement. 把它称作挑战简直是轻描淡写。

understudy.note:
The understudy had to go on stage when the star fell ill. 明星生病时，替补演员不得不登台演出。

She spent months practicing as the lead actor's understudy. 她花了几个月的时间作为男主角的替补进行练习。

underutilized.note:
The community center is an underutilized resource. 社区中心是一个未被充分利用的资源。

These skills remain underutilized in the current role. 这些技能在当前职位中尚未得到充分利用。

underwrite.note:
The bank agreed to underwrite the insurance policy. 银行同意承保该保险单。

The museum project was underwritten by a wealthy donor. 该博物馆项目由一位富有的捐赠者资助。

undeserved.meaning: adj. 不应得的；无功受禄的
undeserved.note:
He felt that the criticism was completely undeserved. 他觉得这种批评完全是不应得的。

She received undeserved praise for teamwork. 她因团队合作获得了不应得的赞扬。

undesirable.meaning: adj. 不良的；不受欢迎的
undesirable.note:
The medication had several undesirable side effects. 这种药物有几个不良的副作用。

We need to eliminate undesirable elements in the system. 我们需要消除系统中的不良成分。

undirected.meaning: adj. 无方向的；未受指导的
undirected.note:
His energy felt undirected and chaotic. 他的精力显得无方向且混乱。

Undirected study often yields poor results. 无指导的学习往往效果不佳。

unearthly.note:
We heard an unearthly howl in the woods. 我们在树林里听到了一声诡异的嚎叫。

He woke up at an unearthly hour in the morning. 他在清晨一个不可思议的怪异时间醒来。

unenlightened.meaning: adj. 未开化的；愚昧无知的
unenlightened.note:
Such views belong to an unenlightened era. 这种观点属于一个愚昧无知的时代。

They held unenlightened attitudes toward traditions. 他们对传统抱有未开化的态度。

unexceptionable.meaning: adj. 无可挑剔的；完美的
unexceptionable.note:
His conduct during the meeting was unexceptionable. 他在会议期间的操守无可挑剔。

The proposal is safe and unexceptionable. 该提案安全且无可挑剔。

unfailing.meaning: adj. 始终如一的；经久不衰的
unfailing.note:
She is known for her unfailing kindness to everyone. 她以对每个人始终如一的善良而闻名。

He showed unfailing optimism in tough times. 他在艰难时期表现出了经久不衰的乐观精神。

unfasten.note:
Please unfasten your seatbelts now. 请现在解开您的安全带。

She tried to unfasten the necklace clasp. 她试图解开项链的搭扣。

unfeigned.note:
Her delight at the news was quite unfeigned. 她听到这个消息的高兴是绝对真诚的。

He showed unfeigned interest in our project. 他对我们的项目表现出了真实的兴趣。

unflappable.meaning: adj. 镇定的；泰然自若的
unflappable.note:
She remained completely unflappable during the crisis. 在危机期间，她依然完全镇定自若。

An unflappable leader is essential in emergencies. 紧急情况下需要一个泰然自若的领导者。

unfold.note:
We watched the drama unfold on television. 我们看着电视上剧情的展开。

She began to unfold the map on the table. 她开始在桌上展开地图。

unfounded.meaning: adj. 无根据的；没有事实依据的
unfounded.note:
All rumors about the company's bankruptcy are unfounded. 关于公司破产的所有传言都是毫无根据的。

His fears proved to be completely unfounded. 事实证明他的恐惧完全是没有事实依据的。

ungainly.note:
The puppy had long, ungainly legs. 这只小狗长着长而笨拙的腿。

He made an ungainly attempt to climb the fence. 他笨拙地试图爬上栅栏。

ungrudging.meaning: adj. 慷慨的；毫无怨言的
ungrudging.note:
She gave ungrudging support to her colleagues. 她对同事给予了毫无怨言的支持。

He offered ungrudging praise for her success. 他对她的成功给予了慷慨的赞扬。

unguent.note:
The doctor applied a soothing unguent to the burn. 医生在烧伤处涂抹了一种舒缓的软膏。

She bought an herbal unguent for her skin rash. 她买了一种草本药膏来治疗皮肤疹。

unicorn.meaning: n. 独角兽；估值超十亿美元的初创公司
unicorn.note:
Children love stories about mythical creatures like unicorns. 孩子们喜欢关于独角兽等神话生物的故事。

That tech startup recently became a Silicon Valley unicorn. 那家科技初创公司最近成为了硅谷的独角兽企业。

unidimensional.note:
The character felt flat and unidimensional in the movie. 电影中的这个角色显得扁平且单一。

We cannot view complex issues in a unidimensional way. 我们不能用单一的眼光看待复杂的问题。

uniform.meaning: n. 制服 adj. 一致的
uniform.note:
Police officers must wear a uniform on duty. 警察在值班时必须穿制服。

The temperature in the room should be kept uniform. 房间内的温度应当保持一致。

unify.note:
The new leader sought to unify the fractured nation. 新领导人试图统一这个分裂的国家。

These measures will help to unify the regional markets. 这些措施将有助于统一区域市场。

unimpassioned.meaning: adj. 冷静的；不带感情色彩的
unimpassioned.note:
He delivered an unimpassioned speech on economic policy. 他发表了一篇关于经济政策的冷静演讲。

The judge gave an unimpassioned analysis of the facts. 法官对事实进行了不带感情色彩的分析。

unimpeachable.meaning: adj. 无可指责的；无可挑剔的
unimpeachable.note:
Her reputation for honesty is unimpeachable. 她诚实的声誉无可指责。

The evidence presented in court was unimpeachable. 法庭上提交的证据无可挑剔。

uninitiated.note:
The manual is difficult for the uninitiated to understand. 这本手册对外行人来说很难理解。

To the uninitiated, the jargon sounds like gibberish. 对于未入门的人来说，这些黑话听起来像胡言乱语。

unique.meaning: adj. 独一无二的；独特的
unique.note:
Every individual has a unique set of fingerprints. 每个人都有一套独一无二的指纹。

This town has a unique cultural heritage. 这个小镇拥有独特的文化遗产。

univocal.meaning: adj. 意义明确的；单义的
univocal.note:
The contract contained univocal terms regarding payment. 合同包含了关于付款的明确条款。

We need a univocal agreement to avoid confusion. 我们需要一份含义明确的协议以避免混淆。

unjustified.meaning: adj. 不合理的；无正当理由的
unjustified.note:
His anger towards her was completely unjustified. 他对她的愤怒完全是不合理的。

They faced unjustified delays in their application. 他们的申请面临了不合理的拖延。

unjustly.meaning: adv. 不公平地；不正义地
unjustly.note:
He felt he had been treated unjustly by the system. 他觉得受到了体制的不公正对待。

She was unjustly accused of the crime. 她被不公平地指控犯有该罪行。

unkempt.note:
He arrived at the interview with unkempt hair. 他顶着一头凌乱的头发去参加面试。

The garden looked wild and unkempt. 花园看起来荒凉且不整洁。

unleash.note:
The storm unleashed its fury on the coastal town. 风暴在沿海小镇释放了它的怒火。

They decided to unleash a new marketing campaign. 他们决定推出一项新的营销活动。

unmitigated.note:
The party turned out to be an unmitigated disaster. 派对结果变成了一场十足的灾难。

Her speech was an unmitigated success. 她的演讲获得了十足的成功。

unmoved.meaning: adj. 无动于衷的；未被感动的
unmoved.note:
She remained unmoved by his emotional plea. 她对他的情感恳求无动于衷。

He was unmoved by the dramatic appeal. 他对这一戏剧性的呼吁不为所动。

unnoticed.meaning: adj. 未被注意的；被忽视的
unnoticed.note:
Her hard work did not go unnoticed by the manager. 经理注意到了她的辛勤工作。

A small error like that can easily pass unnoticed. 像那样的一个小错误很容易被忽视。

unobtrusive.note:
The staff provided quiet and unobtrusive service. 员工们提供了安静且不显眼的服务。

Security cameras were placed in an unobtrusive location. 安防摄像头被放置在一个不显眼的位置。

unpalatable.meaning: adj. 令人讨厌的；难以下咽的
unpalatable.note:
He had to swallow some unpalatable truths. 他不得不接受一些残酷令人讨厌的真相。

The medicine had an unpalatable taste. 这种药有一种难以下咽的味道。

unpremeditated.meaning: adj. 预谋外的；非蓄意的
unpremeditated.note:
It was an unpremeditated reaction to the scare. 这是一个面对惊吓时的非蓄意反应。

The crime was determined to be unpremeditated. 这起犯罪被判定为并非蓄意预谋。

unprepossessing.meaning: adj. 不起眼的；无吸引力的
unprepossessing.note:
Despite his unprepossessing appearance, he is a genius. 尽管他外表不起眼，但他是个天才。

The building looked rather unprepossessing from the outside. 从外面看，这栋建筑显得相当不起眼。

unpretentious.meaning: adj. 不摆架子的；朴素的
unpretentious.note:
They prefer unpretentious restaurants with good food. 他们更喜欢不摆架子且食物美味的餐厅。

His writing style is clear and unpretentious. 他的写作风格清晰且朴素。

unprincipled.meaning: adj. 不道德的；无原则的
unprincipled.note:
He is an unprincipled politician who lies for power. 他是一个为权力说谎的无原则政客。

Such unprincipled behavior will ruin his career. 这种不道德的行为会毁了他的职业生涯。

unproductive.meaning: adj. 无成效的；非生产性的
unproductive.note:
The meeting turned out to be long and unproductive. 会议结果证明既漫长又毫无成效。

We spent hours in unproductive discussions. 我们在毫无成效的讨论中度过了几个小时。

unprovoked.meaning: adj. 无端挑衅的；无缘无故的
unprovoked.note:
The attack on the peaceful city was completely unprovoked. 对这座和平城市的攻击完全是无端挑衅。

He suffered an unprovoked assault on the street. 他在街上遭遇了一次无缘无故的袭击。

unqualified.note:
He was deemed unqualified for the senior position. 他被认为不适合担任这个高级职位。

The project was an unqualified success. 该项目获得了绝对的成功。

unregenerate.meaning: adj. 顽固不化的；不知悔改的
unregenerate.note:
He remains an unregenerate rebel despite the penalties. 尽管受到了惩罚，他依然是一个顽固不化的叛逆者。

His unregenerate attitude shocked the committee. 他不知悔改的态度震惊了委员会。

unregulated.note:
The financial market was largely unregulated at the time. 当时的金融市场基本处于不受监管的状态。

Unregulated emissions can damage the environment. 不受监管的排放会破坏环境。

unremitting.meaning: adj. 不停的；坚韧不拔的
unremitting.note:
They faced unremitting pressure from competitors. 他们面临来自竞争对手的不间断压力。

Through unremitting effort, she achieved her goal. 通过不懈的努力，她实现了自己的目标。

unrepentant.meaning: adj. 不后悔的；毫无悔意的
unrepentant.note:
He remained unrepentant about his past mistakes. 他对过去的错误依然毫无悔意。

The criminal was unrepentant during the trial. 这名罪犯在审判期间毫无悔意。

unrequited.note:
He suffered from unrequited love for years. 他承受了多年的单相思之苦。

Her deep affection remained unrequited. 她深厚的感情没有得到回应。

unreserved.meaning: adj. 毫无保留的；坦率的
unreserved.note:
She offered an unreserved apology for her mistake. 她为自己的错误进行了毫无保留的道歉。

He gave his unreserved support to the plan. 他对该计划给予了毫无保留的支持。

unscathed.meaning: adj. 未受伤的；毫发无损的
unscathed.note:
Miraculously, they emerged from the crash unscathed. 奇迹般的是，他们在坠机事故中毫发无损地脱身了。

His reputation remained unscathed despite the rumors. 尽管有谣言，他的声誉依然完好无损。

unscented.note:
She prefers unscented soap for her sensitive skin. 她因敏感肌更喜欢无香味的肥皂。

Buy a bottle of unscented lotion. 买一瓶无香味的润肤露。

unscrupulous.meaning: adj. 毫无道德的；不择手段的
unscrupulous.note:
Unscrupulous traders take advantage of vulnerable consumers. 无良商人利用弱势消费者牟利。

He used unscrupulous tactics to win the competition. 他用不择手段的策略赢得了比赛。

unscrupulousness.note:
The unscrupulousness of his actions stunned everyone. 他行为的毫无道德震惊了所有人。

She exposed the total unscrupulousness of the corporation. 她揭露了这家公司完全的不择手段。

unseemly.meaning: adj. 不得体的；不合时宜的
unseemly.note:
Such public arguing is unseemly for professionals. 这种公开争吵对专业人士来说是不得体的。

He showed an unseemly haste to leave. 他表现出了一种不合时宜的急于离开的心情。

unsettle.note:
The sudden news tended to unsettle him. 突如其来的消息往往使他感到不安。

Sudden changes can unsettle the whole team. 突如其来的变化会动摇整个团队。

unsettling.note:
It is unsettling to think about the future sometimes. 有时候去想未来是令人不安的。

She had an unsettling feeling that she was being watched. 她有一种被人盯着的令人不安的感觉。

unsound.meaning: adj. 不健康的；不稳固的
unsound.note:
The building was declared structurally unsound. 这座建筑被宣布结构不稳固。

His economic theory is based on unsound assumptions. 他的经济学理论建立在不稳固的假设之上。

unspoiled.meaning: adj. 未遭到破坏的；完好的
unspoiled.note:
They visited a quiet, unspoiled beach. 他们参观了一个安静且未受破坏的海滩。

The countryside remains largely unspoiled by tourism. 乡村大体上没有因旅游业而遭到破坏。

unspotted.note:
She maintained an unspotted record throughout her career. 她在整个职业生涯中保持着无污点的记录。

His reputation remained unspotted despite the scandal. 尽管有丑闻，他的名誉依然保持纯洁。

unstinting.meaning: adj. 慷慨的；极力给予的
unstinting.note:
She received unstinting praise for her dedication. 她因奉献精神受到了慷慨的赞扬。

He offered unstinting help to those in need. 他向有需要的人提供了极力的帮助。

unsubstantiated.meaning: adj. 未经证实的；缺乏依据的
unsubstantiated.note:
The charges against him were completely unsubstantiated. 对他的指控完全是未经证实的。

We cannot act on unsubstantiated claims. 我们不能根据未经证实的说法采取行动。

untapped.meaning: adj. 未开发的；未利用的
untapped.note:
The region has vast untapped natural resources. 该地区拥有大量未开发的自然资源。

There is still an untapped market for this product. 该产品仍有一个未被开发的市场。

unthreatening.meaning: adj. 不具威胁性的；温和的
unthreatening.note:
He has a friendly and unthreatening demeanor. 他有一种友好且不具威胁性的态度。

The animal appeared wild but unthreatening. 这只动物看起来野性但并不具威胁性。

untimely.meaning: adj. 不合时宜的；过早的
untimely.note:
We were saddened by his untimely death. 他的过早离世让我们感到悲伤。

Her arrival proved to be quite untimely. 事实证明她的到来相当不合时宜。

untold.note:
The disaster caused untold damage to the city. 这场灾难对这座城市造成了无数的破坏。

There are still untold stories from the war. 战争中还有许多未诉说的故事。

untoward.note:
Nothing untoward happened during our journey. 我们的旅程中没有发生任何不幸的意外。

She looked around to ensure nothing untoward was occurring. 她四处张望以确保没有发生什么反常的事情。

untutored.meaning: adj. 未经培训的；天生的
untutored.note:
His untutored artistic talent amazed the critics. 他未经培训的艺术天赋惊艳了评论家。

She had an untutored flair for music. 她有一种天生的音乐天赋。

unwarranted.meaning: adj. 无根据的；不必要的
unwarranted.note:
The police search was completely unwarranted. 警察的搜查完全是不必要的。

His fears were entirely unwarranted. 他的恐惧完全是毫无根据的。

unwieldy.meaning: adj. 笨重的；庞大难管理的
unwieldy.note:
The heavy package was awkward and unwieldy. 这个沉重的包裹既笨拙又庞大难拿。

The bureaucracy became too large and unwieldy. 官僚机构变得过于庞大且难以管理。

unwitting.note:
She became an unwitting accomplice in the scheme. 她成了该计划中一名不知情的共犯。

He made an unwitting mistake that caused a delay. 他犯了一个无意的错误导致了延误。

unwonted.note:
He showed an unwonted eagerness to help. 他表现出了不寻常的帮忙热情。

She spoke with unwonted sharpness. 她说话时带着一种不寻常的尖锐。

unworldly.meaning: adj. 不谙世事的；超脱世俗的
unworldly.note:
She has an innocent, unworldly charm. 她有一种单纯、不谙世事的魅力。

His ideals seemed a bit unworldly for business. 他的理想对于商业来说显得有点过于超脱世俗了。

upbraid.note:
She took the chance to upbraid him for his laziness. 她借此机会斥责了他的懒惰。

The manager upbraided the employee for arriving late. 经理因员工迟到而斥责了他。

upgrade.note:
I need to upgrade my computer software. 我需要升级我的电脑软件。

The airline gave us a free seat upgrade. 航空公司给我们免费升级了座位。

upheaval.note:
The political upheaval caused widespread panic. 政治动乱引起了广泛的恐慌。

Economic reforms brought great social upheaval. 经济改革带来了巨大的社会激变。

uphold.note:
The court decided to uphold the previous verdict. 法院决定维持原判。

We must uphold the core values of our society. 我们必须维护我们社会的精神核心价值。

uproar.note:
The new tax policy caused public uproar. 新税收政策引起了公众的骚动。

There was an uproar when the decision was announced. 决定宣布时一片哗然。

uproarious.meaning: adj. 吵闹的；捧腹大笑的
uproarious.note:
The comedy show received uproarious applause. 喜剧表演受到了热烈且爆笑的掌声。

The room erupted in uproarious laughter. 房间里爆发出一阵捧腹大笑。

upstage.meaning: v. 抢镜头；出风头盖过
upstage.note:
The supporting actor managed to upstage the star. 配角成功地抢了主演的风头。

She tried not to upstage her colleagues at the event. 她在活动中尽量不抢同事的风头。

upswing.note:
There is a recent upswing in consumer confidence. 近期消费者信心呈现上升趋势。

The economy is experiencing a steady upswing. 经济正经历稳步增长。

usurp.note:
He tried to usurp the throne from the rightful king. 他试图从合法的国王手中篡夺王位。

We cannot allow competitors to usurp our market share. 我们不能允许竞争对手霸占我们的市场份额。

usury.note:
Charging high interest rates like that is considered usury. 收取那么高的利息被认为是高利贷。

He fell into debt after borrowing money from a usury lender. 他从放高利贷的人那里借钱后陷入了债务。

utilitarian.meaning: adj. 功利主义的；实用的
utilitarian.note:
The interior design of the office was purely utilitarian. 办公室的室内设计纯粹是以实用为主。

His approach to problem-solving is entirely utilitarian. 他解决问题的方法完全是功利主义的。

utopian.meaning: adj. 乌托邦式的；空想的
utopian.note:
They dreamed of creating a utopian society. 他们梦想创造一个乌托邦式的社会。

His plans were dismissed as too utopian to work. 他的计划被斥为过于空想而无法实行。

utter.meaning: adj. 完全的 v. 发出（声音）
utter.note:
What he said was utter nonsense. 他说的话完全是胡说八道。

She was too shocked to utter a single word. 她震惊得说不出话来。

vaccinate.note:
Doctors advised people to vaccinate against the flu. 医生建议人们接种流感疫苗。

Children are usually vaccinated before entering school. 孩子们通常在上学前接种疫苗。

vaccine.note:
Scientists are working hard to develop a new vaccine. 科学家们正努力开发一种新疫苗。

The vaccine provides protection against the disease. 这种疫苗提供对抗该疾病的保护。

vacuous.note:
He stared with a vacuous expression on his face. 他脸上带着空洞的表情凝视着。

She grew tired of his vacuous conversation. 她厌倦了他那空洞无物的对话。

vagary.meaning: n. 变化莫测；难以预测的变化
vagary.note:
Farmers must deal with the vagaries of the weather. 农民必须应对天气变化莫测的状况。

They learned to accept the vagaries of the market. 他们学会了接受市场的无常变化。

vagrancy.note:
He was arrested on a charge of vagancy. 他因流浪罪被捕。

The social program aims to reduce poverty and vagancy. 该社会项目的目标是减少贫困和流浪现象。

vagrant.meaning: n. 流浪者 adj. 流浪的
vagrant.note:
A lone vagrant was sleeping on the park bench. 一个孤独的流浪者睡在公园的长椅上。

He led a vagrant life for many years. 他过着多年的流浪生活。

vain.note:
All our efforts to stop the leak were in vain. 我们阻止泄漏的所有努力都白费了。

He is too vain to accept constructive criticism. 他太自负了，接受不了建设性的批评。

valediction.note:
He gave a brief valediction before leaving the company. 他在离开公司前发表了简短的告别辞。

Her tears were a silent valediction to her childhood home. 她的眼泪是对童年故居无声的告别。

valedictory.meaning: adj. 告别的 n. 告别演说
valedictory.note:
She delivered a touching valedictory address. 她发表了一篇感人的告别演说。

The valedictory speech marked the end of their studies. 毕业告别演说标志着他们学业的结束。

valiant.note:
They made a valiant effort to save the building. 他们为了挽救这栋建筑做出了英勇的努力。

She fought a valiant battle against her illness. 她与病魔进行了英勇的抗争。

valorous.note:
The soldier received a medal for his valorous deeds. 这名士兵因其英勇的事迹获得了一枚勋章。

His valorous actions saved many lives. 他英勇的行为拯救了许多人的生命。

valve.note:
The engineer checked the pressure valve on the pipe. 工程师检查了管道上的压力阀。

She had surgery to repair a faulty heart valve. 她进行了修复故障心脏瓣膜的手术。

vandalism.note:
The park walls were defaced by acts of vandalism. 公园的墙壁被恶意破坏的行为涂污了。

Police are investigating the recent wave of vandalism. 警方正在调查近期的破坏公物浪潮。

vandalize.note:
Unknown persons broke in and vandalized the school. 不明身份的人闯入并肆意破坏了学校。

Public property should not be vandalized. 公共财产不应遭到恶意破坏。

vanilla.meaning: n. 香草 adj. 平淡的；普通的
vanilla.note:
She ordered a scoop of vanilla ice cream. 她点了一勺香草冰淇淋。

He opted for the vanilla version of the software. 他选择了该软件的基础普通版本。

vanquish.note:
The hero managed to vanquish the evil monster. 英雄成功击败了邪恶的怪物。

They sought to vanquish their rivals in the market. 他们试图在市场上击败竞争对手。

vapid.note:
He found her conversation rather vapid and boring. 他觉得她的谈话相当乏味无趣。

The play suffered from a vapid script. 这部戏剧因剧本苍白无力而受到影响。

vaporization.note:
The heat caused the rapid vaporization of the liquid. 高温导致液体迅速气化。

Solar energy promotes water vaporization. 太阳能促进了水的蒸发。

vaporize.note:
The extreme heat will vaporize the chemical. 极高的热量会将这种化学物质气化。

Water can vaporize quickly under direct sunlight. 水在阳光直射下能迅速蒸发。

vaporous.meaning: adj. 雾状的；虚无缥缈的
vaporous.note:
A vaporous mist rose from the river. 河面上升起了一团雾状的水汽。

His promises proved to be vaporous and empty. 事实证明他的承诺虚无缥缈且空洞。

variegate.meaning: v. 使多样化；使现出斑驳色彩
variegate.note:
The leaves were variegated with patches of white. 叶子上点缀着白色的斑块。

She tried to variegate her portfolio with different assets. 她试图用不同的资产让她的投资组合多样化。

variegation.note:
The plant is prized for the variegation of its leaves. 这种植物因其叶子的斑驳色彩而备受推崇。

The variegation in her style makes her art unique. 她风格的多样化使她的艺术独一无二。

varnish.meaning: n. 清漆 v. 刷清漆
varnish.note:
He applied a coat of varnish to the wooden table. 他在木桌上刷了一层清漆。

The table needs to be sanded and varnished again. 这张桌子需要重新打磨并刷漆。

vascular.note:
The doctor specialized in vascular surgery. 这名医生专攻血管外科。

Plants use vascular tissues to transport water. 植物利用维管组织来输送水分。

vault.meaning: n. 金库；拱顶 v. 跳跃
vault.note:
The gold bars were stored securely in the bank vault. 金条被安全地保存在银行金库中。

He managed to vault over the low fence. 他设法跳过了矮栅栏。

vaunting.meaning: adj. 自吹自擂的；吹嘘的
vaunting.note:
His vaunting claims about his success annoyed everyone. 他对自身成功的自吹自擂让每个人都很恼火。

We grew tired of his vaunting attitude. 我们对他吹嘘的态度感到厌倦。

veer.note:
The car suddenly veered off the road. 汽车突然偏离了道路。

The conversation began to veer toward politics. 谈话开始转向政治。

veil.meaning: n. 面纱；遮蔽物 v. 掩盖
veil.note:
The bride wore a delicate white lace veil. 新娘戴着一条精致的白色蕾丝面纱。

Her comments were veiled in secrecy. 她的评论被掩盖在秘密之中。

velocity.note:
The car gathered velocity as it rolled down the hill. 汽车下坡时速度越来越快。

We need to measure the wind velocity. 我们需要测量风速。

venal.meaning: adj. 贪污的；唯利是图的
venal.note:
The journalist exposed venal officials in the government. 这名记者揭露了政府中贪污腐败的官员。

He was corrupted by venal influences. 他被唯利是图的势力腐蚀了。

vendetta.note:
The two families engaged in a bitter vendetta for years. 这两个家族进行了多年的激烈世仇恩怨。

She believed the editor had a personal vendetta against her. 她认为那个编辑对她有个人的宿怨。

vendor.note:
Street vendors sold food outside the stadium. 街头小贩在体育场外卖食物。

We need to choose a reliable software vendor. 我们需要选择一家可靠的软件供应商。

veneer.note:
The furniture has a thin wood veneer. 这件家具有一层薄薄的木质贴面。

He maintained a veneer of politeness throughout. 他自始至终保持着礼貌的虚饰。

venerate.note:
In many cultures, people venerate their ancestors. 在许多文化中，人们崇敬他们的祖先。

The scholar is venerated for his profound wisdom. 这位学者因其深厚的智慧而备受尊敬。

vengeance.note:
He swore vengeance against those who betrayed him. 他发誓要向那些背叛他的人复仇。

She sought vengeance for the injustice she suffered. 她为自己遭受的不公寻求报复。

vengeful.note:
He has a vengeful streak when things go wrong. 当事情出错时，他有一种记仇的脾性。

She rejected his vengeful threats. 她拒绝了他带有报复性质的威胁。

venial.meaning: adj. 可宽恕的；轻微的（过失）
venial.note:
Forgiving a venial error can help maintain harmony. 原谅一个轻微的错误有助于维持和谐。

The teacher considered the mistake to be venial. 老师认为这个错误是可以原谅的。

venom.note:
The snake injected venom into its prey. 这条蛇向猎物注入了毒液。

He spoke with unexpected venom. 他说话时带着出乎意料的恶意。

ventriloquist.note:
The ventriloquist made the puppet appear to speak. 腹语表演者让木偶看起来像是在说话。

She watched the ventriloquist show with amazement. 她惊奇地看着腹语表演。

veracious.note:
She is known as a veracious reporter. 她被称为一名真实的记者。

His account of the event was found to be veracious. 经查证，他对事件的叙述是真实的。

veracity.note:
We had doubts about the veracity of his statement. 我们对他的陈述的真实性表示怀疑。

The witness's veracity was questioned by the lawyer. 证人的真实性受到了律师的质疑。

verbal.note:
They reached a verbal agreement before signing the contract. 他们在签署合同前达成了口头协议。

The exercise focuses on verbal nouns. 这个练习侧重于动名词。

verbiage.note:
The report was clouded by unnecessary verbiage. 这份报告被不必要的冗长言辞搞模糊了。

Cut through the verbiage and tell me the main point. 抛开废话，直接告诉我核心观点。

verbose.note:
His verbose explanations often confused the audience. 他那啰嗦的解释经常把观众弄糊涂。

Try to be concise and avoid verbose sentences. 尽量简明扼要，避免使用冗长的句子。

verdant.meaning: adj. 青翠的；草木茂盛的
verdant.note:
They walked through the verdant valley. 他们穿过了青翠的山谷。

Spring brings verdant growth to the countryside. 春天给乡村带来了青翠欲滴的生机。

verdict.note:
The jury reached a unanimous verdict of guilty. 陪审团作出了有罪的一致裁决。

We await the manager's verdict on the proposal. 我们等待经理对该提案的裁决意见。

verdigris.note:
The old bronze statue was covered in green verdigris. 那尊古老的铜雕上覆盖着绿色的铜绿。

Verdigris forms naturally on copper over time. 随着时间推移，铜绿会在铜上自然形成。

verified.meaning: adj. 已核实的 v. 核实（verify的过去式及过去分词）
verified.note:
Make sure your email address is verified. 确保你的电子邮箱地址已经过核实。

They verified the details before publishing the story. 他们在发表报道前核实了细节。

verify.note:
Please verify your password to continue. 请核实您的密码以继续。

Scientists need to verify the experimental results. 科学家需要核实实验结果。

verisimilar.meaning: adj. 逼真的；貌似真实的
verisimilar.note:
The novel creates a verisimilar historical world. 这本小说创造了一个逼真的历史世界。

His excuse sounded verisimilar, but it was false. 他的借口听起来貌似真实，但其实是假的。

veritable.note:
The garden was a veritable paradise of flowers. 这座花园简直是一个名副其实的花卉天堂。

He is a veritable genius at mathematics. 他在数学上真是一个十足的天才。

vernacular.meaning: n. 方言；白话 adj. 本地语的
vernacular.note:
The author writes in the local vernacular. 这位作家用当地的方言写作。

Technical terms eventually entered the everyday vernacular. 专业术语最终进入了日常白话中。

verse.note:
She memorized a verse of the poem. 她背诵了这首诗的一节。

The songwriter wrote a catchy chorus and verse. 这位词曲作者写了一段朗朗上口的副歌和主歌。

vertex.note:
The triangle has three corners, also known as vertices. 三角形有三个角，也称为顶点。

Draw a line from the base to the opposite vertex. 从底边向对面的顶点画一条线。

vertical.meaning: adj. 垂直的 n. 垂直线
vertical.note:
Draw a vertical line down the center of the page. 在页面中央画一条垂直线。

The cliff face is almost completely vertical. 这处峭壁几乎完全是垂直的。

vertigo.note:
Looking down from the tall building gave her vertigo. 从高楼向下看让她感到了眩晕。

He suffers from vertigo when standing in high places. 他站在高处时会眩晕。

verve.note:
She played the piano piece with great verve. 她充满活力地弹奏了这首钢琴曲。

His performance was filled with artistic verve. 他的表演充满了艺术活力。

vessel.note:
A large cargo vessel entered the harbor. 一艘大型货船驶入了港口。

Blood flows through arteries, which are blood vessels. 血液通过动脉流动，动脉就是血管。

vestigial.note:
Humans have certain vestigial organs, like the appendix. 人类有一些退化的器官，比如阑尾。

There remained a vestigial trace of hope. 仅存一丝微弱的希望。

vestment.note:
The priest put on his ceremonial vestment for mass. 神父穿上了举行弥撒用的礼仪法衣。

Historic church vestments are on display in the museum. 历史悠久的教堂法衣正在博物馆展出。

veteran.meaning: n. 老兵；经验丰富的人
veteran.note:
He is a veteran of the war who now advocates for peace. 他是一位退伍老兵，现在倡导和平。

She is a veteran journalist with decades of experience. 她是一位拥有几十年经验的资深记者。

veterinary.note:
He decided to study veterinary medicine. 他决定学习兽医专业。

The dog was taken to a veterinary clinic. 这只狗被送到了兽医诊所。

veto.meaning: n. 否决 v. 否决
veto.note:
The president has the power to veto the bill. 总统有权否决该法案。

The council exercised its veto to block the project. 市议会行使其否决权来阻止该项目。

vexation.note:
To his great vexation, the train was delayed again. 令他十分恼火的是，火车又晚点了。

She sighed in vexation when her computer crashed. 当她的电脑崩溃时，她气恼地叹了口气。

viability.note:
We need to assess the economic viability of the project. 我们需要评估该项目的经济可行性。

The startup proved its business viability in the first year. 这家初创公司在第一年就证明了其商业生存能力。

viaduct.note:
The train crossed the old stone viaduct. 火车驶过了那座古老的石拱高架桥。

Drivers could see the city from the highway viaduct. 司机们可以从高速公路高架桥上看到这座城市。

vibrancy.note:
The city is famous for its cultural vibrancy. 这座城市以其文化活力而闻名。

She loved the vibrant colors and vibrancy of the art market. 她喜欢艺术市场充满活力的色彩和生机。

vibrant.meaning: adj. 充满活力的；鲜艳的
vibrant.note:
She wore a vibrant red dress to the party. 她穿着一件鲜艳的红裙子去参加派对。

Seoul is a vibrant and bustling metropolis. 首尔是一个充满活力且繁华的大都市。

vibrate.note:
My phone began to vibrate in my pocket. 我的手机在口袋里震动起来。

Strong wind can cause the bridge to vibrate. 强风会使桥梁发生震动。

vicar.note:
The local vicar gave a moving sermon on Sunday. 当地牧师在周日发表了一场感人的布道。

He visited the vicar at the parish church. 他去教区教堂拜访了牧师。

vicarious.note:
She experienced vicarious thrills through reading adventure novels. 她通过阅读冒险小说体验到了一种代入的刺激。

Parents often take vicarious pride in their children's success. 父母经常从孩子的成功中获得一种替代的自豪感。

vicious.note:
He was attacked by a vicious dog in the street. 他在街上遭到了一只凶猛恶犬的袭击。

They got caught in a vicious cycle of debt. 他们陷入了恶性债务循环。

vicissitudinous.meaning: adj. 变化无常的；兴衰交替的
vicissitudinous.note:
The business survived the vicissitudinous economic climate. 这家企业在变化无常的经济环境中生存了下来。

His career has had a vicissitudinous path. 他的职业生涯经历了一条起伏不定的道路。

victimize.note:
Bullying can victimize vulnerable students in school. 欺凌行为会使学校里弱势的学生受到迫害。

No one should be victimized because of their beliefs. 任何人都不应因其信仰而受到迫害。

vie.note:
Several companies are vying for the lucrative contract. 几家公司正在竞争这份利润丰厚的合同。

Athletes vied with each other for the gold medal. 运动员们为了金牌互相竞争。

vigilant.note:
Parents must remain vigilant against online scams. 父母必须对网络诈骗保持警惕。

Security guards need to be vigilant at all times. 保安人员在任何时候都需要保持戒备。

vilify.note:
The politician was unfairly vilified by the media. 这位政客受到了媒体的不公正诋毁。

She refused to vilify her ex-husband in public. 她拒绝在公开场合诋毁她的前夫。

vindictive.meaning: adj. 报复性的；怀恨在心的
vindictive.note:
He bore a vindictive grudge against his former boss. 他对前老板怀有报复性的积怨。

Her response felt unnecessarily vindictive. 她的回应显得没有必要的记恨。

vintner.note:
The local vintner produces award-winning wines. 当地的酿酒商生产屡获殊荣的葡萄酒。

We visited a vineyard owned by a famous French vintner. 我们参观了一座由法国知名酒商拥有的葡萄园。

violate.note:
Drivers who speed violate traffic laws. 超速的司机违反了交通法规。

The search violated his constitutional rights. 搜查侵犯了他的宪法权利。

viral.meaning: adj. 病毒性的；病毒式传播的
viral.note:
She caught a viral infection during the winter. 她在冬天感染了病毒性疾病。

The funny video went viral overnight. 这段搞笑视频一夜之间在网络上病毒式传播。

virtuosity.note:
The violinist played with breathtaking virtuosity. 这名小提琴手以令人叹为观止的精湛技艺演奏。

His guitar solo displayed incredible musical virtuosity. 他的吉他独奏展现了令人难以置信的音乐造诣。

virtuoso.note:
He is recognized as a piano virtuosity. 他被公认为钢琴大师。

The young musician is a true virtuoso. 这位年轻的音乐家是一位真正的艺术大师。

virulent.note:
The patient was infected with a virulent strain of bacteria. 这名患者感染了一种恶性细菌。

She suffered a virulent attack of pneumonia. 她患上了一场恶性肺炎。

virus.note:
A computer virus can corrupt your files. 电脑病毒会损坏你的文件。

The common cold is caused by a virus. 普通感冒是由病毒引起的。

viscid.note:
The sap of the tree was thick and viscid. 树的汁液又厚又粘稠。

This viscid liquid requires careful handling. 这种粘稠的液体需要小心处理。

viscous.note:
Honey is a viscous liquid that flows slowly. 蜂蜜是一种流动缓慢的黏稠液体。

The oil became more viscous at low temperatures. 这种油在低温下变得更加黏稠。

visionary.meaning: adj. 有远见的 n. 梦想家
visionary.note:
Steve Jobs was a visionary leader in technology. 史蒂夫·乔布斯是一位富有远见的科技领袖。

He is considered a visionary rather than a practical manager. 他被认为是一个梦想家，而不是一个务实的管理者。

vista.note:
The hotel room offered a stunning vista of the ocean. 酒店房间提供了壮丽的海景。

Education opens up a new vista of opportunities. 教育开辟了一个充满机遇的新远景。

vital.meaning: adj. 至关重要的；充满生机的
vital.note:
Water is vital for human survival. 水对于人类生存至关重要。

She played a vital role in organizing the project. 她在组织该项目中起到了至关重要的作用。

vitalize.meaning: v. 使有生气；赋予活力
vitalize.note:
The community project will vitalize the downtown area. 这个社区项目将使市中心区域重焕生机。

A good night's sleep helps to vitalize the body. 良好的夜间睡眠有助于恢复体力。

vitiate.note:
Errors in the contract could vitiate the entire agreement. 合同中的错误可能会削弱整个协议的效力。

Bad habits can vitiate moral character. 不良习惯会损害道德品质。

vitrify.meaning: v. 使变成玻璃；玻璃化
vitrify.note:
High temperatures can vitrify the sand into glass. 高温可以将沙子玻璃化。

The process will vitrify the radioactive waste. 这个过程会将放射性废物玻璃化。

vitriolic.note:
The critic launched a vitriolic attack on the new film. 这名评论家对这部新电影发起了尖酸刻薄的攻击。

She was hurt by his vitriolic remarks. 她被他尖酸刻薄的言论伤害了。

vituperate.note:
He began to vitruperate against the new regulations. 他开始对新规章大声谩骂。

She was targeted and vituperated in public. 她在公开场合被针对并遭到辱骂。

vituperative.note:
The debate descended into vituperative name-calling. 辩论演变成了互相辱骂的对骂。

He received vituperative letters from angry readers. 他收到了来自愤怒读者的辱骂信件。

vivacious.note:
She is a vivacious person who lights up the room. 她是一个能让房间蓬荜生辉的活泼的人。

Her vivacious personality made her popular at parties. 她活泼的性格使她在派对上很受欢迎。

vocalist.note:
The band is looking for a talented lead vocalist. 这支乐队正在寻找一位有才华的主唱歌手。

She started her career as a jazz vocalist. 她以爵士歌手的身份开始了职业生涯。

vocation.note:
Teaching is more than a job; it is a true vocation. 教学不仅仅是一份工作，更是一项真正的天职。

He found his true vocation in nursing. 他在护理工作中找到了真正的职业归宿。

void.meaning: adj. 空的；无效的 n. 空白
void.note:
The contract was declared null and void. 该合同被宣布无效。

Her sudden departure left a huge void in the team. 她突然的离开在团队中留下了巨大的真空。

volatile.note:
Stock prices have been very volatile this week. 本周股价波动非常剧烈。

Chemicals like alcohol are highly volatile. 酒精之类的化学品极易挥发。

volition.note:
She left the company of her own free volition. 她是出于自己的自由意志离开公司的。

He acted entirely on his own volition. 他完全是凭自己的意愿行事的。

voluble.meaning: adj. 滔滔不绝的；多话的
voluble.note:
He was a voluble speaker who loved telling stories. 他是一个滔滔不绝、喜欢讲故事的演讲者。

She became very voluble after a few drinks. 她喝了几杯后变得非常健谈。

voluminous.meaning: adj. 卷帙浩繁的；宽松宽大的
voluminous.note:
She wore a voluminous silk dress. 她穿着一件宽大飘逸的丝绸连衣裙。

The researcher kept voluminous notes on her findings. 这位研究人员对她的发现做了浩繁详尽的记录。

voluptuous.meaning: adj. 丰满性感的；沉溺于感官享受的
voluptuous.note:
The room was decorated in a luxurious, voluptuous style. 房间以奢华、感官享受的风格进行装饰。

She possessed a classic, voluptuous figure. 她拥有古典而丰满的身材。

voracious.note:
He is a voracious reader who finishes books quickly. 他是一个如饥似渴的阅读者，能快速看完书。

Growing teenagers often have voracious appetites. 处于生长发育期的青少年通常胃口极好。

voracity.note:
She read the books with intellectual voracity. 她以极大的求知欲贪婪地阅读了这些书。

His voracity for knowledge amazed his professors. 他对知识的渴望惊艳了他的教授们。

votary.note:
He is a loyal votary of classical music. 他是古典音乐忠实的崇拜者。

The temple was filled with devoted votaries. 庙里挤满了虔诚的信徒。

vouch.note:
I can vouch for his honesty and reliability. 我可以担保他的诚实和可靠。

She agreed to vouch for him at the interview. 她同意在面试时为他作保。

vulture.note:
Vultures circled high above in the sky. 秃鹰在高空中盘旋。

Financial vultures circled the bankrupt company. 金融掠夺者围着那家破产公司转。

vying.note:
Three athletes are vying for the gold medal. 三名运动员正在争夺金牌。

Cities are vying with each other to host the event. 多个城市正互相竞争以举办该活动。

waddle.note:
The ducks began to waddle toward the pond. 鸭子们开始摇摇摆摆地向池塘走去。

He watched the toddler waddle across the room. 他看着学步的幼儿摇晃着走过房间。

waffle.meaning: n. 华夫饼 v. 废话；犹豫不决
waffle.note:
She loves eating sweet waffles for breakfast. 她喜欢早餐吃甜的华夫饼。

Stop waffling and give me a straight answer. 别说废话了，给我一个直接的回答。

waft.note:
The sweet smell of baking wafted from the kitchen. 烘焙的甜香味从厨房飘了出来。

A gentle breeze wafted across the garden. 一阵微风吹拂过花园。

wag.note:
The happy dog began to wag its tail. 那只快乐的小狗开始摇尾巴。

He gave his head a gentle wag. 他轻轻地摇了摇头。

wage.meaning: n. 工资 v. 发动（战争等）
wage.note:
Workers demanded a higher hourly wage. 工人们要求提高每小时工资。

They plan to wage a campaign against poverty. 他们计划发起一场反贫困运动。

waggish.meaning: adj. 滑稽的；爱开玩笑的
waggish.note:
He made a waggish comment that made everyone laugh. 他开玩笑似地评论了一句，逗得大家哈哈大笑。

His waggish humor kept the group entertained. 他滑稽幽默的风格让大家乐在其中。

wan.note:
She gave a wan smile from her hospital bed. 她在病床上露出了一个苍白的微笑。

His face looked tired and wan after the illness. 生病后，他的脸看起来疲惫且憔悴。

wanderlust.note:
His strong wanderlust led him to travel around the world. 他强烈的旅游欲促使他周游世界。

She packed her bags, driven by a sudden wanderlust. 在突如其来的旅游欲驱动下，她收拾好了行李。

warehouse.note:
The goods are stored in a large downtown warehouse. 货物存放在市中心的一个大仓库里。

They plan to build a new distribution warehouse. 他们计划建造一个新的配送仓库。

warmonger.meaning: n. 好战分子；煽动战争者
warmonger.note:
Protesters marched against the politicians they called warmongers. 抗议者游行反对那些他们称之为好战分子的政客。

He was condemned as a warmonger by the international press. 他被国际媒体谴责为好战分子。

warp.note:
The moisture caused the wooden door to warp. 潮湿导致这扇木门变形了。

Extreme heat can warp plastic containers. 极高的热量会使塑料容器变形。

warrant.meaning: n. 搜查令；保修 v. 保证
warrant.note:
Police obtained a warrant to search the house. 警方获得了搜查该房屋的搜查令。

Such a minor issue does not warrant a lawsuit. 这么小的问题不值得打官司。

warranted.meaning: adj. 有正当理由的；有保证的
warranted.note:
Her strict reaction was entirely warranted. 她严厉的反应完全是有正当理由的。

The extra precautions were fully warranted. 额外的预防措施是完全有必要的。

wary.meaning: adj. 谨慎的；小心翼翼的
wary.note:
Be wary of strangers offering gifts. 对送礼物的陌生人要保持警惕。

She was wary of making the same mistake twice. 她小心翼翼地避免犯同样的错误两次。

wastrel.meaning: n. 败家子；挥霍无度的人
wastrel.note:
He was labeled a wastrel who squandered his family fortune. 他被贴上了一个挥霍家族财产的败家子的标签。

The young man lived like a reckless wastrel. 这个年轻人过着放荡挥霍的生活。

watershed.note:
The invention of the internet was a technological watershed. 互联网的发明是一个技术分水岭。

This election marks a watershed moment in history. 这次选举标志着历史上的一个重要转折点。

waver.note:
Her resolve began to waver under the pressure. 在压力下，她的决心开始动摇。

He did not waver in his support for the team. 他对团队的支持从未动摇。

wax.note:
He used wax to polish the wooden floor. 他用蜡来抛光木地板。

The car needs to be washed and waxed. 这辆车需要清洗并打蜡。

wean.meaning: v. 使断奶；戒除（坏习惯）
wean.note:
It is time to wean the puppy off its mother's milk. 是时候给小狗断奶了。

She tried to wean herself off coffee. 她试图戒掉喝咖啡的习惯。

wearisome.meaning: adj. 令人厌烦的；令人疲劳的
wearisome.note:
He found the long lectures rather wearisome. 他觉得冗长的讲座相当无聊疲惫。

She grew tired of the wearisome routine. 她对这种令人厌烦的常规感到厌倦。

weary.meaning: adj. 疲倦的 v. 使疲劳
weary.note:
He felt weary after a long day of hiking. 经过一整天的徒步旅行，他感到很疲惫。

The repetitive tasks began to weary her. 重复的任务开始让她感到厌烦。

weasel.meaning: n. 黄鼠狼 v. 逃避责任
weasel.note:
A small weasel scurried across the snow. 一只小黄鼠狼在雪地上快步跑过。

He tried to weasel out of his promise. 他试图逃避他的承诺。

weed.meaning: n. 杂草 v. 除草
weed.note:
The garden was full of unwanted weeds. 花园里长满了不需要的杂草。

She spent the morning working hard to weed the garden. 她花了一上午的时间在花园里辛苦除草。

weld.meaning: v. 焊接 n. 焊缝
weld.note:
He used a torch to weld the metal pipes together. 他用焊枪将金属管焊接在一起。

The mechanic checked the strength of the steel weld. 机械师检查了钢结构焊缝的强度。

welter.note:
He got lost in a welter of conflicting emotions. 他陷入了一团混乱交织的复杂情绪中。

The desk was covered in a welter of papers. 桌子上堆满了杂乱无章的纸张。

wheedle.note:
She tried to wheedle extra candy from her mother. 她试图从母亲那里哄骗额外的糖果。

He managed to wheedle a discount out of the salesman. 他设法从售货员那里连哄带骗地得到了一个折扣。

whet.meaning: v. 磨快；刺激（胃口、兴趣等）
whet.note:
The smell of food served to whet his appetite. 食物的气味激起了他的食欲。

This trailer will whet the audience's appetite for the movie. 这部预告片将激起观众对电影的兴趣。

whiff.note:
She caught a faint whiff of coffee in the air. 她在空气中闻到了一缕淡淡的咖啡香。

There was a whiff of scandal surrounding the deal. 这笔交易周围弥漫着一丝丑闻的气息。

whim.note:
She bought the expensive dress on a whim. 她一时兴起买下了那条昂贵的裙子。

We shouldn't change our plans on a whim. 我们不应该凭一时兴起改变计划。

whimsical.meaning: adj. 异想天开的；古怪有趣的
whimsical.note:
The artist is known for his whimsical sculptures. 这位艺术家以其异想天开的雕塑而闻名。

The story has a whimsical and charming plot. 这个故事有一个古怪有趣且迷人的情节。

whimsy.note:
His work is full of playful whimsy. 他的作品充满了顽皮的奇思妙想。

She painted the wall purely out of artistic whimsy. 她纯粹出于艺术的奇思妙想粉刷了这面墙。

whine.note:
The child began to whine when he didn't get his toy. 没得到玩具时，那个孩子开始发牢骚呜咽。

Stop whining about the weather and get to work. 别抱怨天气了，开始干活吧。

whirlpool.note:
The boat got sucked into a dangerous whirlpool. 船被吸进了一个危险的漩涡中。

She felt caught in a whirlpool of daily responsibilities. 她觉得自己陷入了日常责任的漩涡中。

whisper.meaning: v. 耳语；低声说 n. 耳语
whisper.note:
They spoke in a low whisper so no one could hear. 他们压低声音耳语，以免别人听到。

She leaned over to whisper a secret in his ear. 她俯身在他的耳边低声说了一个秘密。

whistle.meaning: v. 吹口哨 n. 口哨声
whistle.note:
The referee blew his whistle to end the match. 裁判吹响了口哨结束比赛。

He whistled a cheerful tune while walking home. 他一边走回家，一边吹着欢快的曲调。

whittle.note:
He sat on the bench and began to whittle a piece of wood. 他坐在长椅上，开始削一块木头。

The committee had to whittle down the list of candidates. 委员会不得不削减候选人名单。

wholesome.meaning: adj. 有益健康的；健康的
wholesome.note:
Fresh vegetables and fruits are wholesome food. 新鲜蔬菜和水果是有益健康的正餐。

The movie offers wholesome family entertainment. 这部电影提供了老少皆宜的健康家庭娱乐。

wick.note:
Trim the candle wick before lighting it. 点燃蜡烛前先修剪一下烛芯。

The oil soaked up the lamp wick to burn brightly. 灯油顺着灯芯吸上来，燃烧得明亮。

wicked.note:
The fairy tale featured a wicked stepmother. 这个童话故事里有一个邪恶的继母。

She gave him a wicked smile and laughed. 她冲他露出了一个淘气的微笑并笑了。

wield.note:
The knight knew how to wield a sword skillfully. 这名骑士知道如何熟练地挥舞长剑。

The director wields considerable power in the company. 这位董事在公司里行使着相当大的权力。

willful.note:
His willful refusal to cooperate caused major delays. 他故意拒绝合作，导致了严重的延误。

It was a willful waste of company resources. 这是一个故意的公司资源浪费行为。

willow.note:
The river bank was lined with weeping willows. 河岸边排满了垂柳。

He carved a whistle from a willow branch. 他用柳树枝雕刻了一个口哨。

willowy.meaning: adj. 苗条的，如柳枝般的
willowy.note:
She has a graceful and willowy figure. 她有着优雅苗条的身材。

The dancer moved with willowy elegance. 舞者展现出如杨柳般轻盈的优雅。

wilt.note:
The flowers will wilt without water. 花朵没有水会枯萎。

His confidence began to wilt under pressure. 在压力下，他的信心开始消退。

wily.meaning: adj. 狡猾的，诡计多端的
wily.note:
The wily detective caught the criminal by surprise. 这个狡猾的侦探出其不意地抓住了罪犯。

She used wily tactics to win the negotiation. 她使用了狡猾的策略赢得了谈判。

wince.meaning: v. 畏缩，龇牙咧嘴，尴尬退缩
wince.note:
He winced in pain as the doctor cleaned the cut. 当医生清洗伤口时，他痛得龇牙咧嘴。

She winced at the memory of her mistake. 回想起自己的错误，她感到一阵尴尬退缩。

windbag.meaning: n. 夸夸其谈的人，空谈家
windbag.note:
Don't listen to him, he is just an old windbag. 别听他的，他只是个老空谈家。

The meeting was dominated by political windbags. 会议被一群夸夸其谈的政客把持了。

winding.meaning: adj. 蜿蜒的，迂回的; n. 盘绕
winding.note:
They followed a winding path up the mountain. 他们沿着一条蜿蜒的小路上山。

The river takes many winding turns through the valley. 河流在山谷中曲折迂回。

wink.note:
He gave me a knowing wink across the room. 他隔着房间向我使了个会意的眼色。

She didn't sleep a wink all night. 她整晚连眼睛都没合一下。

winsome.meaning: adj. 迷人的，动人的，漂亮的
winsome.note:
She won everyone over with her winsome smile. 她用迷人的微笑赢得了所有人的心。

He has a winsome personality that attracts friends. 他拥有吸引朋友的迷人个性。

wistful.meaning: adj. 渴望的，沉思的，伤感的
wistful.note:
She cast a wistful glance at her childhood home. 她深情而伤感地看了一眼童年的家。

There was a wistful note in his voice. 他的声音里带有一丝渴望和感伤。

wit.note:
He is a man of great wit and charm. 他是一个极具才智和魅力的人。

She used her quick wit to get out of trouble. 她运用机智化解了困境。

withdraw.note:
The army was ordered to withdraw from the city. 军队奉命撤出该城市。

I need to withdraw some money from the ATM. 我需要从自动取款机取些钱。

wither.note:
The hot sun caused the crops to wither. 烈日导致农作物枯萎。

His hopes of winning began to wither. 他获胜的希望开始破灭。

withhold.note:
The company decided to withhold payment until the job was done. 公司决定在工作完成前扣留付款。

She refused to withhold any information from the police. 她拒绝向警方隐瞒任何信息。

witticism.meaning: n. 俏皮话，名言，诙谐之词
witticism.note:
His speech was full of clever witticisms. 他的演讲充满了聪明的俏皮话。

She appreciated his sharp witticisms. 她很欣赏他辛辣的诙谐之语。

wizened.meaning: adj. 干瘪的，皱缩的，饱经风霜的
wizened.note:
The old man had a wizened face lined with wrinkles. 老人有着一张布满皱纹的饱经风霜的脸。

Her wizened hands showed signs of hard labor. 她干瘪的双手上留下了辛勤劳动的痕迹。

wobble.note:
The table wobbled because one leg was short. 这张桌子由于有一条腿短而摇晃。

Her voice began to wobble with emotion. 她的声音因为情绪激动而开始颤抖。

woo.meaning: v. 求爱，争取支持，恳求
woo.note:
Politicians try to woo voters before the election. 政客们在选举前试图争取选民的支持。

He spent months trying to woo her. 他花了几个月的时间试图向她求爱。

worship.note:
They go to the temple to worship every week. 他们每周去庙宇参拜。

Fans worship the famous singer. 粉丝们崇拜这位著名的歌手。

wrangler.meaning: n. 争吵者，牧马人，牛仔
wrangler.note:
The cattle wrangler guided the herd across the river. 牛仔驱赶着牛群过河。

Legal wranglers debated the contract for hours. 法律辩论者就合同争论了几个小时。

wrench.meaning: v./n. 猛扭，扳手，痛苦的离别
wrench.note:
He used a wrench to tighten the pipe. 他用扳手拧紧了管道。

Leaving her hometown was a terrible wrench. 离开她的家乡是一次痛苦的离别。

wretched.meaning: adj. 可怜的，悲惨的，讨厌的
wretched.note:
They live in wretched conditions in the slums. 他们在贫民窟过着悲惨的生活。

I feel wretched today due to a bad cold. 由于感冒，我今天感觉非常难受。

wrinkle.note:
She noticed a new wrinkle on her forehead. 她注意到额头上新添了一条皱纹。

He wrinkled his nose in disgust. 他厌恶地皱起了鼻子。

wrought.note:
The gate was made of decorative wrought iron. 这扇大门是由装饰性锻铁制成的。

Great changes have been wrought in the city. 这座城市发生了巨大的变化。

wry.meaning: adj. 苦笑的，讽刺的，扭曲的
wry.note:
He gave a wry smile at his own mistake. 他对自己的错误报以苦笑。

Her humor has a distinct wry quality. 她的幽默具有一种独特的讽刺意味。

xenophobe.note:
A xenophobe often fears or dislikes foreigners. 排外者通常害怕或不喜欢外国人。

His remarks proved him to be a narrow-minded xenophobe. 他的言论证明了他是一个思想狭隘的排外主义者。

xerophyte.note:
Cacti are classic examples of a xerophyte. 仙人掌是旱生植物的经典例子。

A xerophyte can survive in extremely dry environments. 旱生植物能在极端干燥的环境中生存。

yacht.note:
They spent their vacation sailing on a luxury yacht. 他们在豪华游艇上度过了假期。

The billionaire owns a massive yacht. 这位亿万富翁拥有一艘巨大的游艇。

yarn.note:
She bought some wool yarn to knit a sweater. 她买了一些羊毛纱线来织毛衣。

The old sailor told us a long yarn about the sea. 老水手给我们讲了一个关于大海的长篇故事。

yawn.note:
He couldn't help but yawn during the boring lecture. 在无聊的讲座中，他忍不住打了个哈欠。

A deep yawn escaped her lips. 她嘴里溢出一个深深的哈欠。

yearn.note:
She continues to yearn for her homeland. 她依然渴望回到祖国。

Many people yearn for peace and quiet. 许多人渴望和平与宁静。

yeast.note:
You need to add yeast to the dough to make it rise. 你需要在面团里加酵母让它发酵。

Yeast is essential in brewing beer. 酵母是酿造啤酒必不可少的成分。

yielding.meaning: adj. 顺从的，易弯曲的，柔软的
yielding.note:
The mattress was soft and yielding. 床垫柔软而舒适。

She has a gentle and yielding nature. 她性格温和且顺从。

yoke.note:
The oxen were harnessed to the heavy wooden yoke. 公牛套上了沉重的木轭。

They fought to free their country from the foreign yoke. 他们为使国家摆脱外国的束缚而战。

yokel.note:
He was teased by the city kids for acting like a yokel. 他因为举止像个乡下佬而遭到城里孩子的嘲笑。

Don't be such an ignorant yokel! 别当个这么无知的土包子了！

zealotry.note:
His political zealotry alienated many of his friends. 他的政治狂热疏远了许多朋友。

Religious zealotry can sometimes lead to conflict. 宗教狂热有时会导致冲突。

zenith.meaning: n. 顶点，极点，全盛时期
zenith.note:
At noon, the sun is at its zenith. 中午时分，太阳正处于头顶的正上方。

Her career reached its zenith in the 1990s. 她的职业生涯在20世纪90年代达到了巅峰。

zephyr.note:
A gentle zephyr rustled the leaves. 一阵柔和的微风沙沙作响地吹拂着树叶。

They enjoyed the cool zephyr on the summer evening. 他们在夏日的傍晚享受着凉爽的微风。

zest.note:
She lives life with a great deal of zest. 她以极大的热情生活。

Add a little lemon zest to enhance the flavor. 加一点柠檬皮屑来增加风味。

zigzag.note:
The road climbs the mountain in a zigzag pattern. 这条路呈之字形盘山而上。

He walked in a zigzag line after drinking. 他喝完酒后呈之字形走路。

abase.meaning: v. 贬低，使卑下，使失面子
abase.note:
He refused to abase himself before the tyrant. 他拒绝在暴君面前卑躬屈膝。

She would not abase her dignity for money. 她不会为了金钱而贬低自己的尊严。

abduct.note:
The wealthy businessman was abducted for ransom. 这名富商因索要赎金而被绑架。

Police are searching for the suspects who tried to abduct the child. 警方正在搜捕企图绑架该儿童的嫌疑人。

abnegation.meaning: n. 放弃，克制，自我克制
abnegation.note:
Monks practice a life of total abnegation. 修士们过着完全自我克制的生活。

His self-abnegation earned the respect of the team. 他的自我牺牲赢得了团队的尊重。

aboriginal.note:
The painting reflects the culture of the aboriginal people. 这幅画反映了土著人民的文化。

They studied the aboriginal flora and fauna of the region. 他们研究了该地区的本土动植物。

abortive.meaning: adj. 失败的，夭折的，流产的
abortive.note:
The coup attempt was completely abortive. 这场政变企图彻底失败了。

They made an abortive effort to climb the steep cliff. 他们试图攀登陡峭悬崖的努力流产了。

abound.note:
Fish abound in the clear mountain streams. 清澈的山间小溪里鱼类丰富。

Rumors abound about the company's future. 关于这家公司未来的谣言满天飞。

abstinent.note:
He remained abstinent from alcohol for years. 他多年来一直对酒精保持克制。

An abstinent lifestyle can improve your health. 禁欲健康的生活方式可以改善你的健康。

acarpous.meaning: adj. 不结果实的，无结果的
acarpous.note:
The old tree has become completely acarpous. 这棵老树已经完全不结果实了。

Researchers found the acarpous plant in the dry soil. 研究人员在干旱的土壤中发现了这种不结果实的植物。

acerbity.note:
Her remarks were spoken with unusual acerbity. 她的言辞带有一种不同寻常的尖酸刻薄。

He apologized for the acerbity of his tone. 他为自己语气的刻薄道了歉。

achromatic.note:
The microscope used an achromatic lens to prevent color distortion. 显微镜使用了消色差透镜来防止色彩失真。

Black and white photographs are essentially achromatic. 黑白照片本质上是无色的。

acronym.note:
NATO is an acronym for North Atlantic Treaty Organization. 北约是北大西洋公约组织的首字母缩略词。

Computer science is full of technical acronyms. 计算机科学充满了技术首字母缩略词。

actuarial.meaning: adj. 精算学的，保险精算的
actuarial.note:
Actuarial tables help insurance companies calculate risks. 精算表帮助保险公司计算风险。

She works as an actuarial analyst for a major firm. 她在一家大公司担任精算分析师。

addle.note:
Too much confusing information will addle your brain. 太多混乱的信息会把你的大脑弄糊涂。

He sat there with an addled expression on his face. 他坐在那里，脸上带着糊涂的表情。

adduce.meaning: v. 举出，引用（证据、理由等）
adduce.note:
The lawyer was able to adduce new evidence in court. 律师在法庭上提出了一项新证据。

Can you adduce any proof for your claim? 你能为你的说法举出什么证据吗？

adjudicate.note:
A judge was called in to adjudicate the dispute. 请了一位法官来对纠纷进行裁决。

She agreed to adjudicate the singing competition. 她同意担任歌唱比赛的评委。

adlib.meaning: v./n. 即兴表演，自由发挥
adlib.note:
The actor had to adlib when he forgot his lines. 演员忘词时不得不即兴发挥。

His funny adlib made the audience laugh. 他幽默的即兴台词逗笑了观众。

advert.meaning: n. 广告 (advertisement的缩写); v. 提及
advert.note:
I saw an advert for a new job online. 我在网上看到了一则新工作的招聘广告。

The speaker chose not to advert to the past scandal. 演讲者选择不提及过去的丑闻。

aeronautics.note:
She studies aeronautics at the university. 她在大学里学习航空学。

Advancements in aeronautics have made travel faster. 航空学的进步让旅行变得更快了。

agape.meaning: adj. 大开的，目瞪口呆的
agape.note:
They stood with mouths agape in utter astonishment. 他们目瞪口呆地站在那里，满脸惊愕。

He stared with eyes agape at the luxury car. 他目瞪口呆地盯着那辆豪华轿车。

aghast.note:
She was aghast at the terrible news. 她被这个可怕的消息吓呆了。

We stood aghast at the scene of the disaster. 我们站在灾难现场，惊骇不已。

ailment.note:
He suffers from a minor stomach ailment. 他患有轻微的胃病。

Common winter ailments include colds and flu. 常见的冬季小病包括感冒和流感。

albino.meaning: n./adj. 白化病者，白化动物
albino.note:
The rare albino deer was spotted in the forest. 这只罕见的白化鹿在森林中被发现。

People with albinism have very fair skin and hair. 白化病患者有着非常白皙的皮肤和头发。

alliterate.meaning: v. 使用头韵，首音相同
alliterate.note:
The phrase 'sweet smell of success' tends to alliterate. 短语‘成功的美好气味’倾向于使用头韵。

Poets often alliterate words to create rhythm. 诗人经常运用头韵来创造韵律。

almond.note:
She added chopped almonds to the cake. 她在蛋糕里加入了切碎的杏仁。

Almonds are a healthy and nutritious snack. 杏仁是一种健康且有营养的零食。

alms.note:
The monk went from door to door asking for alms. 修士挨家挨户地乞讨施舍。

They distributed alms to the poor in the village. 他们向村里的穷人发放了救济品。

ambience.meaning: n. 周围环境，气氛，格调
ambience.note:
The restaurant has a romantic and cozy ambience. 这家餐厅有着浪漫而舒适的氛围。

We loved the relaxing ambience of the cafe. 我们很喜欢这家咖啡馆轻松的格调。

ambrosial.meaning: adj. 美味的，芬芳的，极其美味的
ambrosial.note:
They enjoyed an ambrosial feast fit for kings. 他们享用了一场堪称帝王级别的美味盛宴。

The ambrosial scent of flowers filled the air. 芬芳的花香弥漫在空气中。

ambulatory.meaning: adj. 走动的，适宜步行的，下床活动的
ambulatory.note:
The patient is now ambulatory and can walk around. 病人现在已经可以下床活动了。

The hospital has an ambulatory care department. 这家医院有一个门诊护理部。

amiss.meaning: adj./adv. 有毛病的，不恰当的
amiss.note:
Something seemed amiss when he didn't show up. 当他没有出现时，似乎有些不对劲。

A little constructive criticism wouldn't go amiss. 一点建设性的批评并无坏处。

amoral.meaning: adj. 无道德观念的，不分是非的
amoral.note:
Infants are born completely amoral. 婴儿出生时完全没有道德观念。

His amoral business practices shocked the public. 他不讲道德的商业行为震惊了公众。

amputate.meaning: v. 截肢，切除（身体部位）
amputate.note:
Doctors had to amputate his injured leg. 医生不得不截去他受伤的腿。

The surgery successfully amputated the damaged tissue. 手术成功切除了受损组织。

anemic.meaning: adj. 贫血的，虚弱的，无生气的
anemic.note:
She felt tired and weak due to being anemic. 由于贫血，她感到疲倦且虚弱。

The economy showed an anemic recovery this year. 经济今年表现出乏力的复苏。

anodyne.meaning: adj./n. 止痛的，温和无害的
anodyne.note:
He sought an anodyne for his physical pain. 他为自己的身体疼痛寻找止痛药。

She made some anodyne remarks to avoid an argument. 她发表了一些温和无害的言论以避免争吵。

antedate.meaning: v. 早于，先于，把日期前推
antedate.note:
The letter was antedated by several days. 这封信的日期被提前了好几天。

This tradition can antedate the medieval period. 这一传统可以追溯到中世纪以前。

anthropoid.note:
The chimpanzee is an anthropoid ape. 黑猩猩是一种类人猿。

Anthropoid fossils were discovered in the cave. 在洞穴中发现了类人猿化石。

apothegm.note:
He quoted an old apothegm about patience. 他引用了一句关于耐心的古老格言。

The book is filled with memorable apothegms. 这本书里写满了令人难忘的格言警句。

apotheosis.note:
Winning the championship was the apotheosis of his career. 赢得冠军是他职业生涯的巅峰。

Her work is seen as the apotheosis of modern art. 她的作品被视为现代艺术的典范。

appendage.note:
Insects use various appendages to sense their environment. 昆虫利用各种附属器官来感知周围环境。

The garage was built as an appendage to the main house. 车库是作为主屋的附属建筑建造的。

aquiline.note:
He had sharp features and an aquiline nose. 他五官清秀，有着鹰钩鼻。

The portrait highlighted his strong, aquiline profile. 肖像凸显了他刚毅的鹰钩鼻侧影。

arachnid.meaning: n. 蛛形纲动物（如蜘蛛、蝎子）
arachnid.note:
Spiders and scorpions belong to the arachnid family. 蜘蛛和蝎子属于蛛形纲动物。

She has a phobia of any kind of arachnid. 她对任何种类的蛛形纲动物都有恐惧症。

archer.note:
The skilled archer hit the bullseye. 这位技术娴熟的弓箭手射中了靶心。

Archers lined up along the castle wall. 弓箭手们排成一列站在城堡墙上。

arraign.note:
The suspect will be arraigned in court tomorrow. 嫌疑人明天将在法庭受审传讯。

He was arraigned on charges of fraud. 他因涉嫌诈骗罪被起诉。

artillery.note:
The enemy bombarded the fortress with heavy artillery. 敌人用重炮轰炸了这座堡垒。

He served as an officer in the artillery unit. 他在炮兵部队担任军官。

asinine.note:
How could you make such an asinine mistake? 你怎么能犯这种愚蠢的错误？

I refuse to listen to your asinine comments. 我拒绝听你那些愚蠢的评论。

askance.meaning: adv. 斜着眼，怀疑地，蔑视地
askance.note:
The neighbors looked askance at the stranger. 邻居们怀疑地看着这个陌生人。

She looked askance at his dishonest proposal. 她对他的不诚实提议报以怀疑的目光。

askew.note:
His tie was slightly askew. 他的领带有点歪了。

The picture frame on the wall hung askew. 墙上的相框挂得有些斜。

asphyxia.note:
The cause of death was determined to be asphyxia. 死亡原因被判定为窒息。

Smoke inhalation can lead to rapid asphyxia. 吸入浓烟会导致迅速窒息。

astigmatic.note:
She wears glasses to correct her astigmatic vision. 她戴眼镜来矫正散光的视力。

An astigmatic eye cannot focus light evenly. 散光的眼睛无法均匀地聚焦光线。

atheism.note:
He openly declared his beliefs in atheism. 他公开宣布了自己的无神论信仰。

The philosopher wrote a book on modern atheism. 这位哲学家写了一本关于现代无神论的书。

atone.note:
He tried to atone for his past mistakes. 他试图为自己过去的错误赎罪。

No amount of money can atone for the loss of life. 多少金钱也无法弥补生命的损失。

attire.note:
