Guests are requested to wear formal evening attire. 宾客需穿着正式晚礼服。

She was attired in a stunning silk gown. 她身着一件惊艳的丝绸长裙。

attrition.meaning: n. 磨损，人员流失，消耗战
attrition.note:
The war turned into a long battle of attrition. 这场战争变成了一场漫长的消耗战。

The company is suffering from a high staff attrition rate. 这家公司正面临着高员工离职率的问题。

auger.note:
He used an auger to drill holes in the wood. 他用螺丝钻在木头上钻孔。

The carpenter picked up the auger from his toolbox. 木匠从工具箱里拿起螺丝钻。

augmentation.note:
The project requires an augmentation of funding. 该项目需要增加资金支持。

They plan an augmentation of the existing office space. 他们计划扩建现有的办公空间。

aureole.note:
A bright aureole surrounded the saint's head in the painting. 画中圣人的头部周围环绕着明亮的光环。

Solar eclipses reveal the sun's outer aureole. 日食展现了太阳外围的日冕。

auricular.meaning: adj. 耳的，听觉的，耳语的
auricular.note:
The doctor performed an auricular examination. 医生进行了耳部检查。

Auricular evidence is based on what is heard. 听觉证据基于所听到的内容。

auspice.note:
The conference was held under the auspices of the UN. 会议是在联合国的赞助下召开的。

They started the project under good auspices. 他们在吉兆下启动了这个项目。

automation.note:
Factory automation has increased production efficiency. 工厂自动化提高了生产效率。

Many jobs are being lost due to increased automation. 由于自动化程度的提高，许多工作岗位正在消失。

avocation.note:
Painting is her favorite avocation after work. 画画是她下班后最喜欢的业余爱好。

He turned his hobby into an avocation that brings extra income. 他把爱好变成了一项能带来额外收入的副业。

avowal.meaning: n. 公开声明，坦白，承认
avowal.note:
His public avowal of guilt surprised everyone. 他公开认罪让所有人都感到惊讶。

She made an avowal of her true feelings. 她坦白了自己真实的感受。

avuncular.meaning: adj. 伯父般的，慈祥的，关怀的
avuncular.note:
The older manager offered avuncular advice to the new hire. 年长的经理想新员工提出了伯父般慈祥的建议。

He has an easygoing and avuncular manner. 他有一种随和且慈祥的风格。

azure.note:
They sailed across the azure waters of the Mediterranean. 他们驶过了地中海蔚蓝的海水。

The sky was a clear and bright azure. 天空是一片清澈明亮的蔚蓝色。

bacchanal.meaning: n. 狂欢宴会，酒神节狂欢
bacchanal.note:
The party turned into a wild bacchanal lasting until dawn. 派对变成了一场持续到天明的疯狂酒神狂欢。

Roman history is filled with descriptions of a bacchanal. 罗马历史充满了对狂欢宴会的描述。

backslide.meaning: v. 故态复萌，退步，堕落
backslide.note:
He tried to quit smoking, but ended up backsliding. 他试图戒烟，但最终还是复吸了。

It is easy to backslide when you lack discipline. 当你缺乏纪律时，很容易故态复萌。

backwater.meaning: n. 死水潭，落后地区，滞后状态
backwater.note:
He grew up in a quiet rural backwater. 他在一个安静落后的乡村死水区长大。

The company was trapped in a technological backwater. 这家公司陷入了技术滞后的困境。

balky.meaning: adj. 阻挠的，倔强的，不听话的
balky.note:
The old truck proved to be balky on cold mornings. 这辆旧卡车在寒冷的早晨总是很难发动。

She struggled with the balky printer. 她跟那台不听话的打印机较了半天劲。

bamboozle.meaning: v. 欺骗，哄骗，把……搞糊涂
bamboozle.note:
The con artist tried to bamboozle the old man. 骗子试图哄骗这位老人。

Don't let slick advertisers bamboozle you. 别让花言巧语的广告商把你给忽悠了。

bandy.meaning: v. 来回传递，争吵，大腿外弯的
bandy.note:
Rumors were being bandied about the office. 办公室里到处都在流传着谣言。

They bandied insults back and forth. 他们你一言我一语地互相辱骂。

baron.note:
He was given the title of baron by the king. 国王授予了他男爵的头衔。

The media baron controlled several major newspapers. 这位媒体大亨控制了数家主流报纸。

barrister.note:
The barrister presented the case in the high court. 这位出庭律师在高等法院陈述了案情。

She trained for years to become a qualified barrister. 她经过多年的培训，成为了一名合格的出庭律师。

bassoon.note:
The orchestra features a deep sound from the bassoon. 管弦乐队中大管发出的低沉声音很有特色。

He plays the bassoon in the school symphony. 他在学校交响乐团里吹巴松管。

bather.note:
Lifeguards warned bathers about the strong currents. 救生员警告游泳者注意强劲的海流。

The beach was packed with sunbathers and bathers. 沙滩上挤满了晒太阳和游泳的人。

bauble.meaning: n. 小饰品，华而不实的东西
bauble.note:
She bought some cheap plastic baubles for the tree. 她买了一些便宜的塑料小饰品来装饰圣诞树。

He treated her love like a worthless bauble. 他把她的爱当作一件毫无价值的廉价小玩意。

bawl.note:
The baby began to bawl loudly in the middle of the night. 婴儿在半夜大声哭闹起来。

He bawled instructions across the noisy room. 他在嘈杂的房间里大声喊出指令。

beatific.meaning: adj. 祝福的，幸福的，天使般的
beatific.note:
She wore a beatific smile after hearing the good news. 听到好消息后，她露出了幸福的微笑。

The painting depicted a saint with a beatific expression. 这幅画描绘了一个带着圣洁表情的圣人。

bedizen.meaning: v. 把……打扮得华而不实，俗艳地装饰
bedizen.note:
She bedizened herself in flashy jewelry for the party. 她为派对把自己打扮得珠光宝气、俗艳浮华。

The stage was bedizened with cheap glitter. 舞台上装饰着廉俗的亮片。

bedraggled.meaning: adj. 浑身湿透的，拖泥带水的，狼狈的
bedraggled.note:
The stray dog arrived at the door, cold and bedraggled. 流浪狗来到门口，又冷又狼狈，浑身湿透。

They walked home through the rain, looking completely bedraggled. 他们冒雨走回家，看起来狼狈不堪。

beet.note:
She added sliced beets to the fresh salad. 她在新鲜沙拉里加入了切片的甜菜。

Beets are rich in essential vitamins and minerals. 甜菜富含必需的维生素和矿物质。

befuddle.note:
The complex instructions only served to befuddle us. 复杂的说明书只会把我们弄糊涂。

He was completely befuddled by the difficult math problem. 他被这道困难的数学题完全搞懵了。

beget.note:
Violence tends to beget more violence. 暴力往往会产生更多的暴力。

Success can beget overconfidence. 成功可能会导致过度自信。

beguile.note:
She was beguiled by his charming manners. 她被他迷人的举止给迷住了。

He tried to beguile her into signing the contract. 他试图诱骗她签署合同。

behold.note:
The sunset over the ocean was a sight to behold. 海洋上的日落是一处壮观的景色。

Behold the beauty of the ancient temple! 瞻仰一下这座古老寺庙的美丽吧！

beholden.meaning: adj. 负恩的，受人恩惠的
beholden.note:
He didn't want to feel beholden to anyone. 他不想觉得自己欠任何人的人情。

She refused financial help because she didn't want to be beholden. 她拒绝了经济援助，因为她不想受人恩惠。

belch.note:
The factory chimney continued to belch black smoke. 工厂的烟囱不断吐出黑烟。

He excused himself after letting out a loud belch. 他大声打了个嗝后便告辞了。

belongings.note:
Pack all your personal belongings before leaving. 离开前打包好你所有的个人物品。

He lost all his belongings in the fire. 他在火灾中失去了所有的财产。

bemused.note:
She gave a bemused smile at the strange question. 她对这个奇怪的问题报以困惑的微笑。

He looked around the crowded room, feeling totally bemused. 他环顾拥挤的房间，感到一片茫然。

bereave.meaning: v. 剥夺，使丧失（亲人等）
bereave.note:
The war bereaved many families of their loved ones. 战争使许多家庭失去了至亲。

She was deeply bereaved by the sudden loss. 她因这突如其来的丧失而陷入极度悲痛中。

berserk.note:
The dog went berserk and started barking at everyone. 那条狗疯了一样开始向每个人狂吠。

He flew into a berserk rage when he heard the news. 听到这个消息后，他勃然大怒，狂怒不已。

betoken.meaning: v. 预示，表明，是……的征兆
betoken.note:
Dark clouds betoken an approaching storm. 乌云密布预示着暴风雨即将来临。

Her smile seemed to betoken approval. 她的微笑似乎表明了赞同。

bibulous.meaning: adj. 嗜酒的，吸水性强的
bibulous.note:
He was known among his friends for his bibulous habits. 他在朋友中以好饮酒而闻名。

Paper towels are naturally bibulous materials. 纸巾是天然具有吸水性的材料。

biennial.meaning: adj./n. 两年一次的，两年生的植物
biennial.note:
The festival is a biennial event held in the summer. 这个节日是夏天举办的两年一度的盛会。

Some flowers are classified as biennial plants. 有些花卉被归类为两年生物。

bilious.meaning: adj. 胆汁过多的，坏脾气的，腹部不适的
bilious.note:
He woke up feeling bilious and nauseous. 他醒来时感到恶心反胃、腹部不适。

She made a bilious remark about her colleague. 她对同事发表了一番尖酸刻薄的言论。

blackball.note:
He was blackballed from joining the exclusive club. 他被投票拒绝加入那个专属俱乐部。

Members can blackball any new applicant. 成员可以投票反对任何新的申请者。

v.note:
The word 'victory' begins with a v. 单词 victory 以字母 v 开头。

Write the letter v clearly on the paper. 在纸上把字母 v 写清楚。

blackmail.note:
The criminal attempted to blackmail the politician. 罪犯试图勒索这位政治家。

He was arrested on charges of extortion and blackmail. 他因涉嫌敲诈勒索罪被捕。

blare.meaning: v./n. 刺耳的鸣叫，高声播放
blare.note:
Car horns began to blare in the traffic jam. 交通堵塞中，汽车喇叭声刺耳地鸣响起来。

The radio was blaring rock music all morning. 收音机一整个早上都在大声播放摇滚乐。

blas.meaning: adj. 厌倦的，麻木的，冷漠的
blas.note:
She has a blas attitude toward luxury items. 她对奢侈品表现得无所谓、不感兴趣。

After traveling the world, he became quite blas. 周游世界后，他变得相当见多识广且对一切都有些冷漠。

bleachers.note:
Fans filled the bleachers to watch the baseball game. 球迷们挤满了露天看台观看棒球比赛。

We sat on the wooden bleachers cheering for our team. 我们坐在木制露天看台上为我们的队伍加油。

bloated.meaning: adj. 肿胀的，膨胀的，臃肿的
bloated.note:
He felt bloated after eating a massive meal. 吃了一顿大餐后，他感到腹部胀气。

The bureaucracy has become bloated and inefficient. 官僚机构已经变得臃肿且低效。

blossom.note:
The cherry trees are in full blossom this spring. 今年春天樱花盛开。

Their friendship began to blossom over time. 随着时间推移，他们的友谊开始绽放。

bludgeon.meaning: n./v. 重棒，用重棒袭击，强迫
bludgeon.note:
The victim was attacked with a heavy bludgeon. 受害者遭到了一根重棍的袭击。

He tried to bludgeon his opponents into agreement. 他试图用粗暴的手段强迫对手达成协议。

bode.note:
Good sales figures bode well for the company's future. 良好的销售数据预示着公司未来前景很好。

These economic signs bode ill for small businesses. 这些经济迹象对小企业来说是个不祥之兆。

boding.note:
A sense of dark boding hung over the quiet town. 一种不祥的预感笼罩着这座安静的小镇。

She ignored the inner boding and went ahead. 她无视了內心的预兆，继续前行。

bohemian.meaning: adj./n. 波西米亚风格的，不拘小节的艺术家
bohemian.note:
She lives a free-spirited, bohemian lifestyle. 她过着一种自由不羁的波西米亚式生活。

Artists and writers gathered in the bohemian quarter. 艺术家和作家们聚集在波西米亚风格的街区。

bombardment.meaning: n. 轰炸，炮击，连珠般的质问
bombardment.note:
The city suffered continuous bombardment during the war. 这座城市在战争期间遭受了持续炮击。

She faced a heavy bombardment of questions from reporters. 她面对记者们连珠炮般的提问。

bonhomie.note:
The dinner party was filled with laughter and bonhomie. 晚宴上充满了欢声笑语和融洽的气氛。

His natural bonhomie made everyone feel welcome. 他天然的亲切感让每个人都感到宾至如归。

boo.meaning: v./n. 嘘声，发出嘘声喝倒彩
boo.note:
The crowd began to boo when the referee made a bad call. 当裁判做出糟糕的判罚时，人群开始起哄嘘声四起。

He shouted a boo to show his disapproval. 他大喊了一声嘘声表示不赞成。

botch.meaning: v./n. 搞砸，笨手笨脚地做
botch.note:
He completely botched the repair job on the car. 他把汽车的修理工作彻底搞砸了。

The project was a total botch from the start. 这个项目从一开始就是个彻底的失败。

bottleneck.note:
Road construction created a massive traffic bottleneck. 道路施工造成了巨大的交通瓶颈。

We need to fix the production bottleneck to speed up output. 我们需要解决生产瓶颈以加快产出。

bough.note:
Heavy snow snapped a large bough off the oak tree. 大雪折断了橡树上的一根粗大树枝。

Birds were singing on the leafy bough. 鸟儿在长满树叶的大树枝上歌唱。

bounteous.note:
Nature has been bounteous in providing resources. 大自然在提供资源方面十分慷慨。

The farmers celebrated a bounteous harvest. 农民们庆祝了一个丰收的季节。

bovine.meaning: adj. 牛的，迟钝的，憨厚的
bovine.note:
He stared blankly with a bovine expression. 他带着一种迟钝的表情茫然地盯着看。

Cows and oxen belong to the bovine species. 母牛和公牛属于牛科物种。

bowdlerize.meaning: v. 删改，删节（敏感或不雅内容）
bowdlerize.note:
The publisher decided to bowdlerize the classic novel. 出版社决定对这部经典小说进行删改。

Some readers dislike reading bowdlerized versions of books. 一些读者不喜欢阅读经过删节的书籍版本。

bower.note:
They sat in a quiet garden bower to escape the sun. 他们坐在安静的花园凉亭里躲避阳光。

Roses climbed up the sides of the leafy bower. 玫瑰花顺着多叶的凉亭侧面攀爬生长。

brackish.note:
The river water near the delta was brackish. 三角洲附近的河水带有微咸味。

They couldn't drink the brackish water from the well. 他们无法喝井里那带咸味的苦水。

brattish.meaning: adj. 讨嫌的，顽劣的，小飞侠般的
brattish.note:
His brattish behavior annoyed everyone at the dinner table. 他顽劣讨嫌的行为惹恼了餐桌上的每个人。

She showed a brattish attitude when she didn't get her way. 当事情不如她意时，她表现出了讨人厌的态度。

brawny.meaning: adj. 强壮的，肌肉发达的
brawny.note:
The brawny worker lifted the heavy box with ease. 那个强壮的工人轻而易举地抬起了沉重的箱子。

He had a brawny build from years of physical labor. 多年体力劳动让他拥有了一副健壮的身材。

bray.meaning: v./n. 驴叫，发出刺耳的鸣叫
bray.note:
A donkey began to bray loudly in the nearby field. 一头驴在附近的田野里大声叫了起来。

He let out a harsh bray of laughter. 他发出了一声刺耳的狂笑。

breezeway.note:
The house features an open breezeway connecting the garage. 这座房子有一个连接车库的开放式连廊。

A cool wind blew through the shaded breezeway. 一阵凉爽的风吹过阴凉的露天走廊。

brim.note:
He filled the cup to the brim with fresh water. 他把杯子装满新鲜清水，直到杯缘。

Her eyes were brimming with tears of joy. 她的眼里盈满了喜悦的泪水。

brindled.meaning: adj. 有斑纹的，有条纹的
brindled.note:
The hunter's dog had a brindled coat. 猎人的狗有一身带斑纹的皮毛。

A brindled cat was sleeping on the porch. 一只带斑纹的花猫正睡在门廊上。

brocade.note:
She wore a traditional dress made of golden brocade. 她穿着一件金色织锦缎制成的传统礼服。

The antique chair was upholstered in rich red brocade. 这把古董椅子上罩着华丽的红织锦缎面料。

broil.note:
We decided to broil the fish for dinner. 我们决定把鱼烤来当晚餐。

People were sweating in the broiling summer sun. 人们在炎热的夏日骄阳下汗流浃背。

brooch.note:
She pinned a silver brooch to her lapel. 她在西装翻领上别了一枚银胸针。

The vintage diamond brooch belonged to her grandmother. 这枚复古钻石胸针是她祖母的遗物。

browse.note:
I like to browse books in the local library. 我喜欢在当地图书馆浏览书籍。

Deer can be seen browsing on the meadow. 可以看到鹿在草地上吃草。

bubble.note:
Soap bubbles floated in the air. 肥皂泡在空中飘浮。

The water began to bubble as it reached boiling point. 水烧开时开始冒泡。

buckle.note:
He fastened the metal buckle of his belt. 他扣上了皮带的金属扣。

Her knees began to buckle under the heavy weight. 在沉重的压力下，她的双膝开始发软跪倒。

bugaboo.meaning: n. 令人恐惧的事物，吓唬人的东西
bugaboo.note:
Public speaking remains a major bugaboo for many students. 公众演讲对许多学生来说仍然是一个巨大的心理障碍。

He turned the simple exam into a terrifying bugaboo. 他把简单的考试当成了一个可怕的怪物。

buggy.note:
She pushed the baby buggy through the park. 她推着婴儿车穿过公园。

They rode in a horse-drawn buggy across the farm. 他们乘着马车穿过农场。

bullion.note:
The bank stores tons of gold bullion in its vault. 银行的金库里储存了数吨金条。

Investors bought gold bullion as a safe-haven asset. 投资者购买金条作为避险资产。

bumble.meaning: v. 笨拙地行动，语无伦次地说
bumble.note:
He tends to bumble through his speeches when nervous. 他紧张时在演讲中往往会语无伦次。

She bumbled around the kitchen trying to find the pan. 她在厨房里笨手笨脚地寻找平底锅。

bump.note:
He got a painful bump on his head after hitting the shelf. 撞到书架后，他的头上起了一个痛痛的包。

The car hit a bump in the unpaved road. 汽车在未铺砌的道路上撞到了一个颠簸处。

burrow.note:
The rabbit quickly dug a deep burrow. 兔子迅速挖了一个深洞。

He loves to burrow into old history books. 他喜欢钻研厚重的历史书。

buxom.meaning: adj. 丰满健美的，胸部饱满的
buxom.note:
The character in the play was described as a buxom woman. 剧中的角色被描述为一个身材丰满的女性。

She was a healthy and buxom young lady. 她是一个健康且丰满健美的年轻女士。

cachet.note:
Owning a luxury car carries a certain social cachet. 拥有一辆豪车带有某种社会声望。

Designer brands hold a special cachet among teens. 设计师品牌在青少年中享有特殊的声誉。

cadaver.meaning: n. 尸体（尤用于医学解剖）
cadaver.note:
Medical students studied anatomy using a human cadaver. 医学学生使用人类尸体学习解剖学。

The detective examined the cadaver found at the scene. 侦探检查了现场发现的尸体。

cadence.meaning: n. 韵律，抑扬顿挫，节奏
cadence.note:
She spoke with a soothing cadence in her voice. 她的声音带有舒缓的韵律感。

The poem has a lovely musical cadence. 这首诗有着优美的音乐般节奏。

calibre.note:
We need players of a higher calibre for the team. 我们需要更高水平的球员加入队伍。

The rifle has a small bullet calibre. 这支步枪的子弹口径很小。

callus.note:
He had thick calluses on his hands from heavy lifting. 因为经常重体力劳动，他的手上长了厚厚的老茧。

Playing the guitar can cause calluses to form on your fingertips. 弹吉他会在指尖上形成老茧。

canard.note:
The newspaper article turned out to be a complete canard. 那篇报纸文章结果完全是一则假新闻。

Politicians often have to dismiss political canards. 政客们经常不得不驳斥政治谣言。

canker.note:
A canker sore developed inside her mouth. 她的嘴里长了一个口腔溃疡。

Hatred can slowly canker the human soul. 仇恨会慢慢腐蚀人类的灵魂。

cantata.note:
The choir performed a famous religious cantata. 合唱团表演了一部著名的宗教清唱剧。

Bach composed many beautiful cantatas during his lifetime. 巴赫一生创作了许多优美的清唱剧。

capacious.note:
She packed her clothes into a capacious suitcase. 她把衣服装进了一个容量很大的行李箱。

The concert hall has a capacious interior. 音乐厅内部非常宽敞。

caper.meaning: v./n. 雀跃，欢蹦乱跳，越轨行为
caper.note:
The lambs capered happily in the spring meadow. 小羊羔在春天的草地上开心地欢蹦乱跳。

They planned a daring jewel caper. 他们策划了一起大胆的珠宝盗窃勾当。

capitalize.meaning: v. 利用，资本化，大写字母书写
capitalize.note:
We must capitalize on this business opportunity. 我们必须利用好这个商业机会。

Remember to capitalize the first letter of a sentence. 记得把句子的第一个字母大写。

capitation.meaning: n. 按人头征收的税，人口税，人头费
capitation.note:
The clinic operates on a capitation fee system. 这家诊所采用按人头收费的医疗制度。

Historical records show old systems of capitation. 历史记录显示了过去的人头税制度。

carat.meaning: n. 克拉（宝石重量单位），K（黄金纯度单位）
carat.note:
She wore a ring with a two-carat diamond. 她戴着一枚两克拉的钻石戒指。

This necklace is made of 24-carat pure gold. 这条项链由24K纯金制成。

careen.meaning: v. 倾斜，失控摇晃着向前冲
careen.note:
The out-of-control bus began to careen down the hill. 失控的公交车开始摇晃着冲下山坡。

The boat careened on its side during the storm. 暴风雨中，船身向一侧倾斜。

carillon.meaning: n. 钟琴，车衣钟琴，成套钟琴
carillon.note:
The church tower houses a magnificent carillon. 教堂的塔楼里有一套宏伟的钟琴。

Melodies played by the carillon echoed across the town. 钟琴演奏的旋律在小镇上空回荡。

carnage.note:
The battlefield was a scene of unspeakable carnage. 战场是一处无法形容的大屠杀惨状。

We were shocked by the carnage left by the explosion. 我们对爆炸造成的惨烈景象感到震惊。

carpentry.note:
He has a great skill in carpentry and woodwork. 他在木工活方面有着极高的造诣。

She took a class in basic carpentry to build shelves. 她上了一个基础木工课来做架子。

cascade.meaning: n./v. 小瀑布，倾泻，大量落下
cascade.note:
Water fell in a beautiful cascade down the rocks. 水流顺着岩石形成美丽的瀑布倾泻而下。

Her long hair fell in a dark cascade over her back. 她长长的头发如黑色瀑布般垂在背上。

catapult.note:
The medieval army used a large catapult to break walls. 中世纪军队使用大型投石机来破墙。

The hit movie catapulted the young actor to fame. 这部热门电影将这位年轻演员推向了成名之路。

cautionary.note:
His failed business venture serves as a cautionary tale. 他失败的创业经历成了一个警示故事。

We listened to the teacher's cautionary advice. 我们听取了老师的警告性建议。

cavalcade.meaning: n. 随从队伍，车队，一连串事件
cavalcade.note:
A grand cavalcade of cars escorted the president. 一支盛大的车队护送着总统。

The book presents a historical cavalcade of famous events. 这本书呈现了一连串著名的历史事件。

celerity.note:
The task was completed with astonishing celerity. 这项任务以惊人的速度完成了。

She responded to the emergency with great celerity. 她以极高的敏捷度应对了这一紧急情况。

celibate.note:
Priests in this order take a vow to remain celibate. 这个教派的牧师发誓保持独身。

He chose to lead a celibate life dedicated to service. 他选择过一种致力于服务的独身生活。

centrifugal.note:
A centrifugal force pushes objects away from the center. 离心力将物体推离中心。

The machine uses centrifugal action to separate liquids. 这台机器利用离心作用分离液体。

centripetal.note:
Centripetal force keeps a planet in its orbit. 向心力使行星保持在其轨道上运行。

The curved track provides necessary centripetal acceleration. 弯曲的跑道提供了必要的向心加速度。

cephalic.note:
The doctor examined the patient's cephalic region. 医生检查了病人的头部区域。

Cephalic measurements are important in anthropology. 头部测量在人类学中很重要。

chasten.note:
He was chastened by his recent failure in business. 他最近在生意上的失败使他受到了磨炼。

The strict teacher's words chastened the noisy class. 严厉老师的话让吵闹的班级安静并收敛了许多。

checkered.meaning: adj. 棋盘格纹的，多变波折的
checkered.note:
He has had a long and checkered career. 他经历了一段漫长且起伏不定的职业生涯。

She wore a dress with a checkered pattern. 她穿着一件带有格子图案的裙子。

chic.meaning: adj./n. 时髦的，别致的，高雅
chic.note:
She always dresses in a very chic and stylish way. 她的穿着总是非常时髦且极具风格。

The hotel has a chic modern interior design. 这家酒店拥有别致的现代室内设计。

chirp.note:
Little birds began to chirp outside the window. 小鸟在窗外开始叽叽喳喳地叫了起来。

She heard the cheerful chirp of crickets at night. 她听到夜晚蟋蟀欢快的叫声。

chortle.note:
He let out a loud chortle while reading the funny book. 他读着那本有趣的书，发出了大声的欢笑。

She chortled with delight at the good news. 她因听到好消息而高兴得咯咯笑。

chunk.note:
He cut the cheese into thick chunks. 他把奶酪切成厚厚的大块。

A large chunk of the budget was spent on advertising. 预算很大一部分花在了广告上。

ciliate.note:
The microscopic organism has a ciliate surface. 这个微小的生物体表面生有纤毛。

Botanists observed the ciliate leaves under a magnifying glass. 植物学家在放大镜下观察了有纤毛的叶子。

cineaste.meaning: n. 影迷，电影爱好者，电影制片人
cineaste.note:
The local cinema attracts many passionate cineastes. 当地的电影院吸引了许多热情的影迷。

He is a true cineaste who loves classic French films. 他是一个真正热爱法国经典电影的影迷。

circumlocutory.meaning: adj. 迂回的，绕弯子说话的
circumlocutory.note:
His circumlocutory explanation confused the audience. 他那绕弯子的解释把听众给搞糊涂了。

Cut to the point and avoid circumlocutory language. 直奔主题，不要拐弯抹角。

citation.meaning: n. 引用，引文，表彰嘉奖
citation.note:
Every research paper requires proper source citations. 每篇研究论文都需要正确的文献引用。

He received a military citation for bravery. 他因勇敢获得了军方嘉奖。

clairvoyant.meaning: adj./n. 透视的，有先见之明的，灵媒
clairvoyant.note:
She claimed to be clairvoyant and able to foresee the future. 她自称有特异功能，能够预知未来。

His clairvoyant predictions surprised everyone. 他具有先见之明的预测让所有人感到惊讶。

clench.note:
He clenched his fists in absolute anger. 他气得紧紧握住了拳头。

She clenched her teeth to endure the physical pain. 她咬紧牙关忍受着身体的剧痛。

clich.meaning: n. 陈词滥调，老生常谈
clich.note:
His speech was full of tired old cliches. 他的演讲充满了陈词滥调。

Avoid using too many cliches in your writing. 写作中要避免使用太多老生常谈的话。

closed.note:
All shops are closed on Sundays. 所有商店星期天都不营业。

The office remains closed during the national holiday. 国定假日期间办公室一直关门。

cloy.meaning: v. 甜得发腻，因过多而厌烦
cloy.note:
Too much sweet dessert can quickly cloy the appetite. 太甜的甜点很快就会让人觉得腻味。

The romantic plot of the movie began to cloy. 电影中浪漫的情节开始让人感到腻烦。

coffer.meaning: n. 金库，保险箱，财政资金
coffer.note:
Taxes flow directly into the national coffer. 税收直接流入国库。

The company's financial coffers are currently running low. 公司目前的财政资金正在减少。

cognate.note:
English and German share many cognate words. 英语和德语有许多同源词。

Spanish and Italian are cognate languages derived from Latin. 西班牙语和意大利语是源自拉丁语的同源语言。

cognomen.note:
He earned the cognomen 'the Boss' among his workers. 他在工人们中间赢得了“老板”的绰号。

The ancient Romans used a personal cognomen. 古罗马人使用个人姓氏或别名。

colloquy.meaning: n. 对话，谈话，学术讨论会
colloquy.note:
The leaders engaged in a private colloquy. 领导人们进行了私下对话。

The university hosted an academic colloquy on philosophy. 大学举办了一场关于哲学地学术座谈会。

colt.note:
The young colt ran freely across the wide pasture. 年轻的小雄马在广阔的牧场上自由奔跑。

He trained the newborn colt for racing. 他训练这匹刚出生的小马参加赛跑。

comestible.note:
The shelves were stocked with various comestibles. 架子上摆满了各种各样的食品。

Make sure all stored comestibles are fresh. 确保所有储存的食物都是新鲜的。

commiserate.note:
Friends gathered to commiserate with him over his loss. 朋友们聚在一起对他的损失表示同情。

She called to commiserate after hearing the bad news. 听到坏消息后，她打电话来表示慰问。

complexion.meaning: n. 肤色，面色，局面外观
complexion.note:
She has a smooth and clear facial complexion. 她的面部肤色光滑明亮。

The sudden resignation changed the whole political complexion. 突然的辞职改变了整个政治局面。

complicity.note:
He was accused of complicity in the bank robbery. 他被指控参与了银行抢劫案。

There was evidence of official complicity in the crime. 有证据表明官员与该罪行有牵连。

comport.meaning: v. 举止端庄，表现，相称
comport.note:
He knew how to comport himself at formal dinners. 他知道在正式晚宴上如何举止得体。

Her actions did not comport with her words. 她的行动与她的话不相称。

concentric.note:
Throwing a stone in water creates concentric circles. 在水中扔一块石头会产生同心圆。

The target consists of several concentric rings. 靶子由几个同心圆环组成。

condign.meaning: adj. 罪有应得的，严厉而恰当的
condign.note:
The criminal received a condign punishment for his crimes. 这名罪犯因其罪行受到了应得的严惩。

Justice demands a condign penalty for such betrayal. 正义要求对这种背叛行为处以应有的惩罚。

condiment.note:
Ketchup and mustard are popular table condiments. 番茄酱和黄芥末是受欢迎的餐桌调味品。

He seasoned his steak with various condiments. 他用各种调味品给牛排调味。

condole.note:
Family and friends came to condole with the widow. 家人和朋友前来向寡妇表示哀悼。

I offer my sincere words to condole with you. 我向你致以诚挚的慰问之词。

condor.note:
The giant Andean condor flew high above the mountain. 巨大的安第斯神鹰在群山高空飞翔。

Conservationists work hard to protect the endangered condor. 保罗主义者努力保护濒危的秃鹰。

confidant.note:
She remained his trusted confidant through hard times. 在困难时期，她依然是他信任的知己。

He shared all his secrets with his closest confidant. 他与最亲密的知己分享了所有的秘密。

congenital.note:
The baby was born with a congenital heart defect. 婴儿生来就有先天性心脏病缺陷。

He has a congenital love for music. 他对音乐有着天生的热爱。

conjugal.note:
The law protects their conjugal rights. 法律保护他们的夫妻权利。

They enjoyed a peaceful conjugal life for decades. 他们享受了数十年的平静婚姻生活。

connubial.meaning: adj. 婚姻的，夫妻生活的
connubial.note:
The couple celebrated years of happy connubial bliss. 这对夫妇庆祝了多年的幸福婚姻生活。

Connubial harmony requires patience and trust. 婚姻的和谐需要耐心与信任。

consecrate.meaning: v. 奉为神圣，献给，祝圣
consecrate.note:
The new church was consecrated by the bishop. 这座新教堂由主教主持了祝圣仪式。

He decided to consecrate his life to helping the poor. 他决定把一生奉献给帮助穷人。

consonance.note:
His actions were in complete consonance with his words. 他的行动与言语完全一致。

The poem uses soft vowels to create phonetic consonance. 这首诗运用柔和的元音来创造语音的和谐。

consort.note:
The queen and her consort attended the royal banquet. 女王和她的配偶出席了皇家宴会。

He was warned not to consort with bad characters. 他被警告不要与不良分子交往。

conspectus.note:
The book provides a broad conspectus of European history. 这本书提供了欧洲历史的广阔概览。

She wrote a helpful conspectus of the lecture. 她写了一份有帮助的讲座提纲。

constringe.note:
Cold temperatures tend to constringe blood vessels. 低温往往会使血管收缩。

Certain medical herbs can constringe body tissues. 某些草药可以收缩身体组织。

contumacy.meaning: n. 拒不服从，抗拒法庭传唤
contumacy.note:
He was held in contempt for his willful contumacy. 他因故意抗拒法庭而被判藐视法庭罪。

The judge punished her contumacy with a fine. 法官对她的抗命行为处以罚款。

contumely.meaning: n. 侮辱，傲慢无礼的言行
contumely.note:
She endured years of harsh contumely without complaint. 她默默忍受了多年的严厉侮辱。

His rude behavior was filled with bitter contumely. 他粗鲁的行为充满了刻薄的侮辱。

convene.note:
The committee will convene tomorrow morning to vote. 委员会将于明天上午开会进行投票。

Leaders from around the world will convene in Geneva. 来自世界各地的领导人将在日内瓦会面。

convoy.note:
Cargo ships traveled across the ocean in a military convoy. 货船在军事护航下穿过大洋。

Warships were sent to convoy the supply fleet. 派遣军舰护送补给舰队。

cordial.note:
They received a very cordial welcome from the hosts. 他们受到了主人们的热烈欢迎。

Relations between the two countries remain cordial. 两国之间的关系依然保持友好。

cornet.meaning: n. 短号（管乐器），蛋卷冰淇淋筒
cornet.note:
He played a lively tune on his brass cornet. 他用他的黄铜短号吹奏了一段欢快的曲子。

She bought an ice cream cornet on the beach. 她在海滩上买了一个蛋卷冰淇淋。

corny.meaning: adj. 陈腐的，老套的，伤感的
corny.note:
He told a very corny joke that made everyone groan. 他讲了一个非常老套的笑话，惹得大家直叹气。

The movie had a romantic plot filled with corny lines. 这部电影的浪漫情节充满了老套的台词。

corporal.note:
Corporal punishment is banned in most modern schools. 体罚在大多数现代学校中是被禁止的。

He was promoted from private to corporal. 他从列兵晋升为下士。

corpulent.note:
The corpulent man struggled to climb the stairs. 这个肥胖的男人费力地爬着楼梯。

His corpulent figure was the result of a sedentary lifestyle. 他肥胖的身材是久坐生活方式的结果。

corpus.note:
Linguists analyze a massive text corpus for research. 语言学家分析海量的文本语料库来进行研究。

The complete corpus of his works was published last year. 他全部的作品集于去年出版。

coruscate.meaning: v. 闪烁，闪耀，焕发光彩
coruscate.note:
Diamonds coruscate brilliantly under the spotlight. 钻石在聚光灯下熠熠生辉。

Her witty conversation began to coruscate during the party. 派对上，她机智的谈吐闪耀着光芒。

cosy.meaning: adj. 舒适的，惬意的，温馨的
cosy.note:
They sat by the fireplace in the cosy living room. 他们坐在温馨客厅的壁炉旁。

We spent a cosy evening chatting at home. 我们在家里度过了一个惬意的小聊天之夜。

counterpoise.note:
The heavy stone acts as a counterpoise for the crane. 这块沉重的石头充当了起重机的平衡物。

We need laws to counterpoise the growing corporate power. 我们需要法律来抗衡日益增长的公司权力。

coven.note:
Local folklore tells tales of a midnight witches' coven. 当地民间传说讲述了关于午夜女巫聚会的故事。

The secret coven met deep inside the forest. 秘密的巫师团在森林深处会面。

crafty.note:
The crafty fox managed to escape the hunter. 这只狡猾的狐狸设法逃脱了猎人。

She used a crafty plan to solve the tricky problem. 她用了一个巧妙的计划解决了这个棘手的问题。

crag.note:
An eagle perched proudly on the rocky crag. 一只老鹰骄傲地栖息在岩石峭壁上。

Climbers struggled up the steep mountain crag. 登山者艰难地爬上陡峭的山崖。

credo.note:
Honesty is the core credo of our company culture. 诚实是我们公司文化的核心信条。

His personal credo is to never give up. 他個人的座右铭是永不放弃。

crepuscular.meaning: adj. 黎明或黄昏的，朦胧的
crepuscular.note:
Owls are crepuscular animals active at twilight. 猫头鹰是黄昏时分活跃的黎明昏暗动物。

They walked through the crepuscular light of evening. 他们穿过傍晚朦胧的暮色散步。

crevice.note:
A tiny plant grew out of the rock crevice. 一株小植物从岩石裂缝里长了出来。

He hid the key inside a dark wall crevice. 他把钥匙藏在墙壁的一个暗裂缝里。

crinkle.note:
She smiled and her eyes began to crinkle. 她微笑着，眼睛周围开始起了皱纹。

He crumpled and crinkled the paper in frustration. 他沮丧地把纸揉皱了。

cripple.meaning: v./n. 跛子，使残疾，严重削弱
cripple.note:
The severe injury could cripple his athletic career. 严重的受伤可能会断送他的运动生涯。

Economic sanctions will cripple the country's trade. 经济制裁将严重削弱该国的贸易。

croon.meaning: v./n. 低声唱歌，轻声哼唱
croon.note:
The mother gently crooned a lullaby to her baby. 母亲温柔地向宝宝哼唱着摇篮曲。

He sat by the fire, crooning an old folk song. 他坐在火堆旁，轻声哼唱着一首古老的民谣。

crotchety.note:
The old neighbor became very crotchety in his later years. 这位老邻居在晚年变得脾气非常古怪暴躁。

Don't mind his crotchety mood today. 别介意他今天暴躁易怒的心情。

crypt.meaning: n. 地窖，地下室（多用于教堂地下墓穴）
crypt.note:
Ancient kings were buried in the church crypt. 古代国王被安葬在教堂的地窖地下墓穴中。

Tourists explored the dark and mysterious stone crypt. 游客们探索了黑暗而神秘的石头地下室。

cuddle.note:
The mother cuddled her sleeping baby close to her. 母亲把睡着的宝宝紧紧抱在怀里。

They spent the cold evening cuddling on the sofa. 他们在寒冷的夜晚依偎在沙发上度过。

cuff.note:
He rolled up the cuffs of his shirt. 他卷起了衬衫的袖口。

The police officer placed cuffs on the suspect's wrists. 警察把手铐戴在嫌疑人的手腕上。

cumber.note:
Do not cumber your mind with useless worries. 不要让无用的担忧拖累你的心智。

The room was cumbered with old broken furniture. 房间里堆满了破旧的家具。

curd.note:
Cheese is made by pressing milk curds. 奶酪是通过压榨牛奶凝乳制成的。

She ate a bowl of fresh fruit with cottage cheese curds. 她吃了一碗配有干酪碎块的新鲜水果。

currish.meaning: adj. 卑鄙的，像恶犬般粗暴的
currish.note:
He displayed a currish attitude toward his subordinates. 他对下属表现出一种卑鄙粗暴的态度。

She resented his currish insults. 她对他那些粗俗刻薄的侮辱感到愤怒。

cursive.note:
Students are still taught how to write in cursive. 学生们仍然被教导如何书写草书连笔字。

His signature was written in elegant cursive script. 他的签名是用优雅的草书写的。

curvaceous.meaning: adj. 曲线美的，丰满动人的
curvaceous.note:
The dress was designed to flatter a curvaceous figure. 这件裙子旨在衬托出丰满动人的曲线美身材。

She posed gracefully, showing her elegant, curvaceous outline. 她优雅地摆姿势，展示出她苗条动人的轮廓。

cygnet.note:
A mother swan swam across the lake followed by her cygnets. 一只母天鹅带着小天鹅们游过湖面。

The fluffy grey cygnet stayed close to its parents. 毛茸茸的灰小天鹅紧紧跟着父母。

cynosure.meaning: n. 注目中心，引人注目的焦点
cynosure.note:
She became the cynosure of all eyes at the party. 她成了派对上所有目光注目的焦点。

The new sports car was the cynosure of the auto show. 这款新跑车是车展上最引人注目的焦点。

dabbler.meaning: n. 涉猎者，业余爱好的人
dabbler.note:
He is just a dabbler in art, not a serious painter. 他只是在艺术上浅尝辄止，并非严肃的画家。

She is a dabbler who tries many different hobbies. 她是个喜欢尝试各种不同爱好的业余涉猎者。

dalliance.meaning: n. 调情，闲荡，虚度时光
dalliance.note:
Their brief alliance turned out to be a mere dalliance. 他们短暂的结盟结果只是一场轻浮的调情。

He wasted his youth in idle dalliance. 他在无所事事的闲荡中虚度了青春。

damn.note:
He let out a curse when he dropped his phone. 他掉手机时忍不住骂了一句该死。

I don't give a damn about what they say. 我才不在乎他们说什么呢。

damper.meaning: n. 阻尼器，抑制气氛的事物
damper.note:
Rain put a damper on our outdoor picnic plans. 下雨给我们的户外野餐计划泼了一盆冷水。

The bad news acted as a damper on the celebration. 这个坏消息给庆祝活动浇灭了热情。

dangle.note:
She sat on the edge of the pool, dangling her feet in the water. 她坐在泳池边缘，把脚泡在水里晃荡。

A single lightbulb dangled from the ceiling. 一个单独的灯泡从天花板上悬挂下来。

dank.meaning: adj. 阴湿的，潮湿发冷的
dank.note:
The old cave was dark, dank, and cold. 这个古老的洞穴又黑、又阴湿、又冷。

They lived in a dank basement apartment. 他们住在地下室的一间阴暗潮湿的公寓里。

dastard.note:
He acted like a dastard by running away from danger. 他在危险面前逃跑，表现得像个懦夫。

The villain committed a dastardly crime. 那个恶棍犯下了一桩卑鄙的罪行。

daub.meaning: v./n. 涂抹，乱涂，粗劣画作
daub.note:
He began to daub paint carelessly on the canvas. 他开始在画布上随意涂抹颜料。

Her face was daubed with mud from the field. 她的脸上沾满了田野里的泥巴。

daubster.meaning: n. 拙劣的画家，涂鸦者
daubster.note:
He considered himself a mere daubster in art classes. 他认为自己在美术课上只是个拙劣的涂鸦者。

Critics dismissed the paintings as the work of a daubster. 批评家们认为这些画作出自一个笨拙的业余画家之手。

daze.note:
He walked around in a daze after the accident. 事故发生后，他晕乎乎地到处走动。

The bright flash of light left her momentarily in a daze. 强烈的闪光让她一时感到有些眩晕迷糊。

debar.meaning: v. 阻止，把……排除在外，剥夺资格
debar.note:
He was debarred from entering the competition due to rules. 由于规则，他被剥夺了参赛资格。

Misconduct can debar a lawyer from practicing. 不当行为可以取消律师的执业资格。

debility.note:
Old age and chronic illness caused his physical debility. 老年和慢性病导致了他身体的虚弱。

She suffered from general debility after the surgery. 手术后她感到全身虚弱无力。

debonair.meaning: adj. 温文尔雅的，潇洒的，快乐的
debonair.note:
He looked dashing and debonair in his tuxedo. 他穿著燕尾服，看起来潇洒帅气、温文尔雅。

The young man walked in with a debonair smile. 那个年轻人带着一副迷人的微笑走了进来。

decamp.meaning: v. 扎营撤离，偷偷溜走
decamp.note:
The company owners suddenly decamped with the funds. 公司老板带着资金突然偷偷潜逃了。

Hikers had to decamp before the storm arrived. 徒步旅行者必须在暴风雨来临前拔营撤离。

decant.note:
He carefully decided to decant the red wine. 他小心翼翼地决定把红酒醒酒倒进醒酒器。

Decant the liquid into a clean glass container. 把液体倾倒进一个干净的玻璃容器中。

decentralize.meaning: v. 分权，权力下放，去中心化
decentralize.note:
The government plans to decentralize administrative power. 政府计划将行政权力下放。

Blockchain technology helps to decentralize data management. 区块链技术有助于实现数据管理的去中心化。

declassify.meaning: v. 解密（机密文件），取消机密等级
declassify.note:
The government decided to declassify the old war files. 政府决定将这些旧的战争档案解密。

Many secret documents are declassified after thirty years. 许多秘密文件在三十年后被解密公之于众。

declination.note:
The compass measures magnetic declination. 指南针测量磁偏角。

His polite declination of the invitation was accepted. 他对邀请的礼貌拒绝被接受了。

decoy.note:
The hunters used a wooden duck as a decoy. 猎人们用一只木制野鸭作为诱饵。

Police used a fake suspect to decoy the criminal out. 警方用假嫌疑人将罪犯诱骗出来。

decree.meaning: n./v. 法令，政令，颁布命令
decree.note:
The president issued a decree to lower taxes. 总统颁布了一项降低税收的政令。

Judges decree justice according to the law. 法官依法进行公正判决。

defalcate.meaning: v. 挪用公款，盗用资金
defalcate.note:
The treasurer was arrested after trying to defalcate funds. 财务主管在企图挪用资金后被捕。

Strict audits prevent employees from attempting to defalcate. 严格的审计防止员工企图侵占公款。

defame.note:
He sued the newspaper for trying to defame his character. 他起诉这家报纸试图诋毁他的名誉。

It is illegal to defame someone's reputation online. 在网上诽谤某人的声誉是违法的。

defoliant.note:
Chemical defoliants were widely used during the war. 化学落叶剂在战争期间被广泛使用。

The spray acts as a strong plant defoliant. 这种喷雾剂具有很强的植物脱叶效果。

defoliate.note:
Acid rain can defoliate trees in forests. 酸雨会导致森林中的树木落叶。

Farmers used special agents to defoliate the crops. 农民使用特殊药剂使农作物落叶。

defray.meaning: v. 支付，出资，负担（费用）
defray.note:
The scholarship will help defray the cost of tuition. 奖学金将有助于支付学费。

The company agreed to defray all travel expenses. 公司同意负担所有的差旅费用。

defunct.meaning: adj. 已失效的，倒闭的，不复存在的
defunct.note:
He bought old documents from a defunct company. 他从一家倒闭的公司买下了旧文件。

That ancient tradition is now completely defunct. 那项古老的传统现在已经彻底不复存在了。

delectation.note:
She prepared a wonderful meal for your delectation. 她为你准备了一顿美餐供你享用。

The book was written for the reader's entertainment and delectation. 这本书是为了给读者提供娱乐和消遣而写的。

demarcate.note:
Fences are used to demarcate property boundaries. 栅栏用于划定财产界限。

It is important to demarcate roles within the team. 明确团队内部的角色分工是很重要的。

demeanour.note:
His calm demeanour during the crisis impressed everyone. 他在危机中的镇定举止给每个人留下了深刻印象。

She maintained a professional demeanour throughout the interview. 在整个面试过程中，她始终保持着职业风度。

demented.meaning: adj. 发疯的，精神错乱的，狂乱的
demented.note:
He acted in a demented way after losing his job. 失业后，他的行为表现得有些精神错乱。

The loud noise drove her completely demented. 巨大的噪音把她折腾得快要发疯了。

demure.meaning: adj. 端庄的，娴静的，古板的
demure.note:
She gave a demure smile and nodded quietly. 她端庄地微微一笑，静静地点了点头。

She wore a demure dress to the formal family gathering. 她穿着一件端庄的裙子去参加正式的家庭聚会。

denominate.meaning: v. 命名，称呼，以特定货币单位计算
denominate.note:
The contract was denominated in US dollars. 该合同是以美元计价的。

They chose to denominate the street after the hero. 他们选择用这位英雄的名字来命名这条街道。

denunciate.note:
The activist group decided to denunciate the new policy. 活动人士团体决定公开谴责这项新政策。

Leaders stood up to denunciate acts of violence. 领导人们挺身而出，谴责暴力行为。

deportment.note:
She learned graceful deportment at finishing school. 她在淑女学校学习了优雅的仪态。

His proper deportment reflected his good upbringing. 他得体的举止反映了他良好的教养。

depressant.meaning: n./adj. 抑制剂，镇静剂，令人沮丧的
depressant.note:
Alcohol acts as a central nervous system depressant. 酒精起中枢神经系统抑制剂的作用。

Doctors prescribed a mild depressant to help him sleep. 医生开了一种温和的镇静剂来帮助他入睡。

depute.note:
The manager decided to depute tasks to his assistant. 经理决定将任务委托给他的助理。

She was deputed to attend the conference on his behalf. 她被委派代表他出席会议。

deputize.note:
He had to deputize for the boss during her illness. 在老板生病期间，他不得不代行其职。

She agreed to deputize for him at the committee meeting. 她同意在委员会会议上代理他的职务。

derangement.meaning: n. 精神错乱，混乱，扰乱
derangement.note:
His mind suffered from severe mental derangement. 他的精神遭受了严重的错乱。

The economic crisis caused a total derangement of trade. 经济危机导致了贸易的彻底紊乱。

desalinize.note:
Coastal cities use plants to desalinize sea water. 沿海城市利用工厂将海水淡化。

This technology can desalinize water for agricultural use. 这项技术可以淡化水用于农业。

desideratum.meaning: n. 必备之物，迫切需要的东西
desideratum.note:
Peace and stability are the main desiderata for the region. 和平与稳定是该地区的主要迫切需要。

Reliable data is a prime desideratum for the project. 可靠的数据是该项目不可或缺的必备要素。

desirous.note:
She is desirous of furthering her education abroad. 她渴望去国外深造进修。

Anyone desirous of success must work hard. 任何渴望成功的人都必须努力工作。

desolate.meaning: adj./v. 荒凉的，孤寂的，使悲伤
desolate.note:
They drove through a cold and desolate landscape. 他们驱车穿过一片寒冷而荒凉的景色。

She felt completely desolate after her friends left. 朋友们离开后，她感到无比的孤寂凄凉。

desperado.note:
The old Western movie featured a gang of outlaws and desperados. 这部老西部片里有一帮法外之徒和亡命之徒。

Police chased the armed desperado across the state. 警察在整个州追捕那个武装亡命徒。

destructible.meaning: adj. 可破坏的，易毁坏的
destructible.note:
All physical materials are ultimately destructible. 所有物质材料最终都是会损毁的。

Children's toys should be safe despite being destructible. 尽管玩具容易损坏，但它们也应该是安全的。

desuetude.note:
The law fell into desuetude over the years. 这项法律多年来逐渐废弛不用。

Many old customs have fallen into desuetude. 许多旧习俗已经废弃不用了。

detestable.note:
He showed a detestable attitude toward the poor. 他对穷人表现出一种可憎的态度。

His behavior was completely detestable. 他的行为完全令人痛恨。

detonate.note:
The bomb was set to detonate at midnight. 炸弹被设定在午夜引爆。

Experts safely detonated the unexploded shell. 专家安全地引爆了这枚未爆炸的炮弹。

detract.note:
Minor flaws do not detract from the overall beauty of the painting. 微小的瑕疵并不减损这幅画的整体美感。

His bad manners detract from his good qualities. 他的无礼行为减损了他的优良品质。

devolve.note:
Power will eventually devolve to local governments. 权力最终将下放给地方政府。

Duties devolve upon the vice president during the absence. 代理期间职责转移到副总统身上。

diabolic.note:
He came up with a diabolic plan to ruin his rival. 他想出一个恶毒的计划来毁灭他的竞争对手。

Her diabolic laughter echoed through the empty hall. 她恶魔般的笑声在空旷的大厅里回荡。

dictum.note:
According to the old dictum, honesty is the best policy. 根据那句古老的格言，诚实是上策。

The judge issued a strict dictum regarding the evidence. 法官就证据发布了一项严厉的声明。

dietetics.note:
She studies dietetics at the university. 她在大学里学习营养学。

Dietetics plays a crucial role in preventive healthcare. 营养学在预防保健中起着至关重要的作用。

dignitary.note:
Foreign dignitaries attended the summit meeting. 外国政要出席了峰会。

The hotel prepared a luxury suite for the visiting dignitary. 酒店为来访的政要准备了一间豪华套房。

dilapidation.note:
The historic mansion fell into complete dilapidation. 这座历史悠久的豪宅完全破败荒废了。

Years of neglect resulted in the dilapidation of the building. 多年的疏于管理导致了建筑物的破旧。

diminuendo.note:
The music faded away in a soft diminuendo. 音乐在轻柔的渐弱中渐渐消失。

The applause grew into a diminuendo and finally stopped. 掌声渐渐变弱，最后停了下来。

diocesan.note:
He was appointed as the diocesan bishop. 他被任命为主教区的总主教。

The diocesan office handles administrative tasks for local churches. 教区办公室负责当地教堂的行政事务。

dipsomania.note:
His battle with dipsomania ruined his career. 他与嗜酒癖的斗争毁了他的事业。

She sought medical help for her severe dipsomania. 她因严重的嗜酒癖寻求医疗帮助。

disavow.meaning: v. 否认，不承认，拒绝承担责任
disavow.note:
The government chose to disavow any knowledge of the secret operation. 政府选择否认对这次秘密行动的任何知情权。

He quickly disavowed his previous statement. 他迅速否认了他先前的陈述。

disband.note:
The rock band decided to disband after ten years. 这支摇滚乐队在十年后决定解散。

Orders were given to disband the rebel forces. 下达了遣散叛军的命令。

disclaimer.meaning: n. 免责声明，放弃声明
disclaimer.note:
The film begins with a standard legal disclaimer. 电影开头有一个标准的法律免责声明。

She issued a disclaimer regarding the rumors. 她就这些传言发表了一份否认声明。

disembody.meaning: v. 使脱离肉体，使失实体
disembody.note:
A disembodied voice echoed through the dark corridor. 一个空灵的声音在黑暗的走廊里回荡。

His spirit seemed disembodied from reality. 他的精神似乎脱离了现实。

disfranchise.meaning: v. 剥夺……的公民权（或选举权）
disfranchise.note:
The new laws serve to disfranchise poor voters. 新法律旨在剥夺贫困选民的选举权。

Citizens were illegally disfranchised during the regime. 在该政权期间，公民的选举权被非法剥夺。

dishearten.meaning: v. 使沮丧，使失去信心
dishearten.note:
Do not let this single failure dishearten you. 不要让这次单一的失败使你沮丧。

The constant setbacks began to dishearten the team. 不断的挫折开始使团队失去信心。

dishevel.note:
The strong wind disheveled her hair. 强风吹乱了她的头发。

He emerged from the storm with a disheveled appearance. 他带着凌乱的外表从暴风雨中走出来。

disheveled.meaning: adj. 衣衫褴褛的，头发凌乱的
disheveled.note:
He arrived at the meeting with a disheveled look. 他以衣冠不整的面貌出席了会议。

Her clothes were disheveled after the long journey. 长途旅行后她的衣服很凌乱。

disintegrate.note:
The spacecraft began to disintegrate upon re-entry. 宇宙飞船在重新进入时开始解体。

Their marriage started to disintegrate rapidly. 他们的婚姻开始迅速破裂。

disport.note:
Children were disporting themselves on the beach. 孩子们在海滩上嬉戏玩耍。

The guests disported in the garden during the party. 客人们在派对期间在花园里游乐。

disquisition.meaning: n. 专题论文，长篇演讲
disquisition.note:
He gave a long disquisition on modern art. 他就现代艺术发表了一篇长篇大论。

The professor published a philosophical disquisition. 教授发表了一篇哲学专题论文。

dissection.note:
Biology students performed a frog dissection in class. 生物课上学生们进行了青蛙解剖。

The book offers a careful dissection of the political crisis. 这本书对政治危机进行了仔细的剖析。

dissociate.note:
He tried to dissociate himself from the scandal. 他试图与这起丑闻划清界限。

Chemical bonds can dissociate under high temperatures. 化学键在高温下可以解离。

distain.note:
The dark fluid distained the white fabric. 深色液体弄脏了白色织物。

His reputation was distained by false accusations. 他的名誉被虚假指控玷污了。

distal.note:
The fracture is located at the distal end of the bone. 骨折位于骨头的远端。

Distal muscles control the movement of fingers. 远端肌肉控制手指的运动。

distention.note:
Abdominal distention is a common symptom of the illness. 腹部膨胀是该疾病的常见症状。

The distention of the balloon stopped when it was full. 气球充满气后停止了膨胀。

distrait.meaning: adj. 心不在焉的，神情恍惚的
distrait.note:
She looked distrait throughout the entire dinner. 她在整个晚餐过程中都显得心不在焉。

His distrait behavior worried his colleagues. 他心不在焉的行为让同事们很担心。

ditch.meaning: n. 沟渠；v. 抛弃，丢弃
ditch.note:
The car swerved and ended up in a roadside ditch. 汽车急转弯，最后开到了路边的沟里。

He decided to ditch his old habits for a healthier lifestyle. 他决定抛弃旧习惯以过上更健康的生活。

divagate.note:
The speaker tended to divagate from the main topic. 演讲者往往会偏离主题。

They divagated through the quiet country lanes. 他们在宁静的乡间小路上漫步。

dock.meaning: n. 码头；v. 扣除（工资等）
dock.note:
The cargo ship finally arrived at the dock. 货轮终于抵达了码头。

The boss threatened to dock his pay for being late. 老板威胁要因他迟到而扣除他的工资。

doggo.note:
The criminal lay doggo in an abandoned warehouse. 罪犯潜藏在一个废弃的仓库里。

We must stay doggo until the danger passes. 在危险过去之前我们必须保持隐蔽。

dotage.note:
He spent his dotage surrounded by his grandchildren. 他在子孙的环绕中度过了晚年。

His mind began to wander in his dotage. 他在老年时思维开始恍惚。

dowdy.meaning: adj. 衣着过时的，不时髦的
dowdy.note:
She thought her old coat looked too dowdy. 她觉得她的旧外套看起来太土气了。

The hotel interior was rather dowdy and needed remodeling. 酒店内部相当过时，需要重新装修。

dowry.note:
In the past, brides brought a significant dowry to the marriage. 过去，新娘会给婚姻带来丰厚的嫁妆。

Her family prepared a generous dowry for her wedding. 她的家人为她的婚礼准备了一份丰厚的嫁妆。

doze.note:
Grandpa likes to doze in his armchair after lunch. 爷爷喜欢午饭后在扶手椅上打个盹。

I caught a quick doze during the long bus ride. 长途汽车行驶中我小睡了一会儿。

drollery.note:
His speech was full of charming drollery. 他的演讲充满了迷人的诙谐。

The theater specialized in light comedy and drollery. 这家剧院专门上演轻喜剧和滑稽戏。

ductile.meaning: adj. 延展性好的，易顺从的
ductile.note:
Copper is a highly ductile metal. 铜是一种延展性极佳的金属。

He had a ductile personality, easily influenced by others. 他性格温顺，容易受他人影响。

dulcet.note:
We listened to the dulcet tones of her singing. 我们聆听着她美妙动听的歌声。

The singer's dulcet voice charmed the audience. 歌手甜美的嗓音迷住了观众。

dullard.note:
He felt like a dullard when he couldn't solve the puzzle. 当他解不开这个谜题时，他觉得自己像个笨蛋。

Do not call your classmate a dullard. 不要叫你的同学笨蛋。

dumbfound.meaning: v. 使惊呆，使哑口无言
dumbfound.note:
The shocking news left everyone dumbfound. 这则令人震惊的消息让所有人都惊呆了。

She was dumbfound by his unexpected generosity. 她被他意想不到的慷慨惊呆了。

dunce.note:
He was labeled a dunce because of his poor grades. 因为成绩不好，他被贴上了笨蛋的标签。

No student should be treated as a dunce. 不应该把任何学生当成笨蛋对待。

eaglet.note:
The mother eagle fed her eaglet in the nest. 母鹰在巢里喂养它的小鹰。

An eaglet learns to fly after several weeks. 小鹰几个星期后学会飞行。

earthshaking.meaning: adj. 震动世界的，重大惊人的
earthshaking.note:
The discovery was hailed as an earthshaking event. 这一发现被誉为震撼世界的大事。

We are looking for earthshaking innovations. 我们正在寻找震撼人心的创新。

ecdysis.note:
Snakes undergo ecdysis to grow larger. 蛇通过脱皮来长得更大。

The process of ecdysis leaves the old skin behind. 蜕皮过程会留下旧皮。

eclat.meaning: n. 辉煌成就，声誉，喝彩
eclat.note:
She passed her exams with great eclat. 她以优异的成绩通过了考试。

The play opened to public acclaim and eclat. 这部戏剧上演后赢得了公众的好评和声誉。

eclogue.note:
Virgil wrote famous pastoral eclogues. 维吉尔写过著名的田园牧歌。

The poem reads like a classical Greek eclogue. 这首诗读起来像一首古典希腊田园诗。

ecumenical.meaning: adj. 全球基督教会的，世界范围的，包容的
ecumenical.note:
Leaders gathered for an ecumenical prayer service. 领袖们聚集在一起举行普世教会祈祷仪式。

The organization promotes ecumenical dialogue. 该组织促进世界范围的对话。

eerie.note:
An eerie silence fell over the dark forest. 一片诡异的寂静笼罩着黑暗的森林。

I heard an eerie noise coming from the basement. 我听到地下室传出一声怪异的噪音。

effeminate.meaning: adj. 柔弱的，脂粉气的（指男子）
effeminate.note:
He was criticized for his effeminate manners. 他因举止阴柔而受到批评。

Fashion trends sometimes favor effeminate styles for men. 时尚潮流有时会偏爱男性的柔美风格。

effigy.note:
Protesters burned an effigy of the politician. 抗议者焚烧了一尊该政治家的纸偶。

The king's effigy was carved on his tomb. 国王的雕像被雕刻在他的墓碑上。

egoism.meaning: n. 利己主义，自我中心
egoism.note:
His sheer egoism made him unpopular. 他纯粹的利己主义使他很不受欢迎。

Egoism hinders teamwork and cooperation. 利己主义阻碍了团队合作。

ejaculate.note:
He ejaculated in surprise when he saw the gift. 他看到礼物时惊讶地喊了出来。

She ejaculated a cry of pain. 她突然发出一声痛苦的尖叫。

electorate.note:
Politicians must appeal to the wider electorate. 政治家必须吸引广大选民。

The electorate showed high turnout in this election. 选民在这次选举中表现出了很高的投票率。

emasculate.meaning: v. 使柔弱，阉割，削弱力量
emasculate.note:
The new regulations tend to emasculate local authority. 新规倾向于削弱地方权力。

He felt emasculated by the loss of his job. 失业让他感到自己被削弱了力量。

embankment.note:
The train ran along a high earthen embankment. 火车沿着高高的土堤行驶。

Workers reinforced the river embankment against floods. 工人们加固了防洪河堤。

embitter.note:
Years of hardship tended to embitter him. 多年的艰难困苦使他变得愤世嫉俗。

Do not let past grievances embitter your life. 不要让过去的恩怨使你的生活痛苦。

emblazon.meaning: v. 饰以纹章，印上，颂扬
emblazon.note:
His name was emblazoned across the championship trophy. 他的名字被印在冠军奖杯上。

The team's logo was emblazoned on their jerseys. 球队的标志被印在球衣上。

embodiment.note:
She is the embodiment of grace and elegance. 她是优雅与风度的化身。

This building is the embodiment of modern architecture. 这座建筑是现代建筑的体现。

embroil.meaning: v. 使卷入，使陷入（纠纷等）
embroil.note:
He tried not to embroil himself in office politics. 他尽量不让自己卷入办公室政治。

The country became embroiled in a civil war. 该国内卷入了一场内战。

embryonic.meaning: adj. 胚胎的，初期的，萌芽期的
embryonic.note:
The project is still in its embryonic stage. 该项目仍处于初期阶段。

Scientists study embryonic development in labs. 科学家在实验室研究胚胎发育。

emolument.note:
He accepted the office without extra emolument. 他接受了这项职务，没有领取额外津贴。

The position comes with a handsome emolument. 这个职位伴随着丰厚的报酬。

empyrean.meaning: adj. 天空的，苍穹的；n. 最高天
empyrean.note:
Birds soared high into the empyrean. 鸟儿高飞冲入苍穹。

Stars twinkled brightly in the empyrean sky. 星星在苍穹中闪闪发光。

encipher.meaning: v. 密码编码，译成密码
encipher.note:
Messages must be enciphered before transmission. 消息在传输前必须加密。

Spies used a secret code to encipher reports. 间谍使用密码来加密报告。

encyclopedic.meaning: adj. 百科全书式的，知识渊博的
encyclopedic.note:
He has encyclopedic knowledge of world history. 他对世界历史有着百科全书般的知识。

The book provides encyclopedic coverage of the subject. 这本书对该主题提供了全面的介绍。

endue.note:
She was endued with a rare musical talent. 她被赋予了罕见的音乐天赋。

Nature endued animals with survival instincts. 大自然赋予了动物生存本能。

engrossment.meaning: n. 专心，全神贯注，正式文本
engrossment.note:
His total engrossment in the book kept him from hearing me. 他全神贯注于书本，没听到我说话。

The legal document was ready for engrossment. 法律文件已准备好进行正式抄写。

ennoble.note:
Art can ennoble the human spirit. 艺术能够使人类精神高尚。

The queen decided to ennoble the loyal knight. 女王决定册封这位忠诚的骑士为贵族。

enshrine.meaning: v. 珍藏，铭记，奉为神圣
enshrine.note:
These rights are enshrined in the constitution. 这些权利被奉为宪法宗旨并受其保护。

The memory of the hero is enshrined in our hearts. 英雄的记忆永远铭刻在我们心中。

enslave.note:
History shows how powerful nations tried to enslave others. 历史表明强大国家如何试图奴役他人。

People should not allow debt to enslave them. 人们不应该让债务奴役自己。

enthrall.note:
The magical performance continued to enthrall the audience. 魔术表演继续吸引着观众。

She was enthralled by the beauty of the landscape. 她被风景的美丽迷住了。

entourage.note:
The celebrity traveled with a large entourage of bodyguards. 这位名人带着一大群保镖随行。

The president arrived surrounded by his political entourage. 总统在政治随从的簇拥下抵达。

entrench.meaning: v. 确立，牢固树立，掘壕沟
entrench.note:
These prejudices are deeply entrenched in society. 这些偏见在社会中根深蒂固。

Soldiers worked overnight to entrench their position. 士兵们连夜工作来加固阵地。

entwine.note:
Vines began to entwine around the wooden fence. 藤蔓开始缠绕在木栅栏上。

Their destinies were closely entwined together. 他们的命运紧密交织在一起。

environs.note:
They explored the city and its green environs. 他们探索了这座城市及其绿色的郊外。

Wildlife thrives in the city environs. 野生动物在城市周边地区繁衍生息。

envisage.note:
It is hard to envisage how life will change in the future. 很难设想未来生活会发生什么变化。

We envisage a big increase in sales next year. 我们预计明年的销售额会大幅增长。

epicurean.meaning: adj. 享乐主义的，讲究饮食的
epicurean.note:
They enjoyed an epicurean feast at the luxury restaurant. 他们在豪华餐厅享用了丰盛的饕餮大餐。

He lived an epicurean lifestyle, loving fine food and wine. 他过着享乐主义的生活，喜欢美食和美酒。

equestrian.meaning: adj. 马术的；n. 骑马者
equestrian.note:
She won a gold medal in the equestrian competition. 她在马术比赛中赢得了金牌。

The club offers professional equestrian training. 该俱乐部提供专业的马术训练。

estrange.note:
His harsh words tended to estrange his friends. 他尖锐的话语往往会疏远他的朋友。

Family disputes caused him to estrange from relatives. 家庭纠纷导致他与亲戚疏远。

estuary.note:
Many unique fish species live in the river estuary. 许多独特的鱼类生活在河口处。

The boat sailed slowly into the wide estuary. 船缓缓驶入宽阔的河口。

eugenic.note:
The controversial program was based on eugenic theories. 这一颇具争议的计划基于优生学理论。

Historical eugenic policies faced severe moral criticism. 历史上的优生学政策面临着严厉的道德批判。

everlasting.note:
They promised each other everlasting love. 他们彼此承诺永恒的爱。

I am grateful for your everlasting support. 我感谢你持久的支持。

eviscerate.meaning: v. 取出内脏，切除内脏，彻底削弱
eviscerate.note:
The chef had to eviscerate the fish before cooking. 厨师在烹饪前必须取出鱼的内脏。

The new amendment will eviscerate the core policy. 新修正案将彻底削弱核心政策。

exceptionable.meaning: adj. 可引起反感的，应受谴责的
exceptionable.note:
His rude remarks were highly exceptionable. 他粗鲁的言论极易引起反感。

There was nothing exceptionable in her behavior. 她的行为没有什么可指责的。

excerpt.note:
The newspaper published an excerpt from the novel. 报纸发表了该小说的一个节选。

She excerpted a few sentences for her presentation. 她为演讲摘录了几个句子。

exchequer.note:
The chancellor of the exchequer announced the new budget. 财政大臣宣布了新预算。

Public spending is heavily monitored by the exchequer. 公共开支受到国库的严格监控。

excogitate.meaning: v. 苦思冥想得出，设计出
excogitate.note:
He tried to excogitate a solution to the complex problem. 他试图苦思冥想出一个解决复杂问题的方案。

Scientists excogitated a new model for the experiment. 科学家为实验设计了一个新模型。

excruciate.note:
Severe toothache began to excruciate him. 剧烈的牙痛开始折磨他。

He felt an excruciating pain in his back. 他感到背部一阵剧痛。

execration.note:
The traitor met with the execration of the public. 叛徒遭到了公众的唾弃与诅咒。

His betrayal drew universal execration. 他的背叛招致了普遍的痛骂。

exiguous.note:
They survived on exiguous rations during the winter. 他们在冬天靠微薄的口粮勉强维持生存。

His exiguous income barely covered rent. 他微薄的收入勉强够付房租。

expatiate.note:
The professor was eager to expatiate on his research topic. 教授急于详述他的研究课题。

She refused to expatiate further on the private matter. 她拒绝进一步详述这件私事。

expatriate.note:
Many expatriates live and work in Singapore. 许多侨民在新加坡生活和工作。

He felt like an expatriate in his own country. 他在自己的国家里感觉像个异国侨民。

expiation.note:
He offered donations as an expiation for past mistakes. 他捐款以此来赎回过去的错误。

She sought expiation through charitable work. 她通过慈善工作寻求赎罪。

explicable.meaning: adj. 可解释的，能说明的
explicable.note:
His sudden change of mind is fully explicable. 他突然的心意改变是完全可以解释的。

Not all phenomena in nature are easily explicable. 自然界并非所有现象都容易解释。

expropriate.note:
The government plans to expropriate land for the highway. 政府计划为修建公路征用土地。

Foreign assets were expropriated during the revolution. 外国资产在革命期间被没收。

expulsion.note:
Cheating in exams can lead to immediate expulsion. 考试作弊可能导致立即被开除。

The diplomat faced expulsion from the country. 这名外交官面临被驱逐出境。

extradite.note:
The country agreed to extradite the suspect to face trial. 该国同意将嫌疑人引渡回国受审。

They fought hard to prevent extradition. 他们拼命反对引渡。

extrinsic.note:
Rewards are an extrinsic motivation for work. 奖赏是工作的外部动机。

We must distinguish between intrinsic and extrinsic values. 我们必须区分内在价值与外在价值。

exultant.meaning: adj. 欢欣鼓舞的，狂喜的
exultant.note:
The exultant fans celebrated the victory in the streets. 狂喜的球迷在街头庆祝胜利。

She had an exultant smile after hearing the good news. 听到好消息后，她露出了欢欣鼓舞的微笑。

facsimile.note:
The library holds a rare facsimile of the ancient manuscript. 图书馆藏有古代手稿的珍贵复制品。

He sent a facsimile of the signed contract. 他发送了已签字合同的传真复印件。

factitious.meaning: adj. 人为的，做作的，非天然的
factitious.note:
His smile seemed somewhat factitious and insincere. 他的笑容显得有些做作和不真诚。

She displayed a factitious enthusiasm for the project. 她对该项目表现出了虚假的热情。

fag.meaning: v./n. 苦工，使疲劳；香烟（英式口语）
fag.note:
He felt completely fagged out after the long run. 长跑过后他感到精疲力竭。

Could you spare a fag? 你能分我一支烟吗？

fainthearted.note:
Adventure sports are not for the fainthearted. 冒险运动不适合胆小的人。

He was too fainthearted to take risks. 他太懦弱了，不敢冒险。

fake.meaning: adj. 假的；n. 赝品；v. 伪造
fake.note:
The painting turned out to be a clever fake. 结果证明这幅画是一个巧妙的赝品。

He tried to fake illness to avoid the test. 他试图装病以逃避考试。

falsify.note:
He was arrested for attempting to falsify financial records. 他因企图篡改财务记录而被捕。

She tried to falsify her age on the application form. 她试图在申请表上虚报年龄。

fanfare.meaning: n. 响亮的号角声，大肆宣传
fanfare.note:
The new product was launched with great fanfare. 新产品的推出伴随着大肆的宣传。

Trumpets played a cheerful fanfare to greet the king. 小号吹起欢快的号角声来迎接国王。

fantasia.note:
The pianist played a brilliant musical fantasia. 钢琴家演奏了一首精彩的音乐幻想曲。

The movie is a colorful fantasia of dreams and reality. 这部电影是梦想与现实交织的五彩斑斓的幻想。

farrow.note:
The sow is expected to farrow next week. 这头母猪预计下周产仔。

A healthy farrow of piglets was born this morning. 今天早上一窝健康的猪崽出生了。

fascia.meaning: n. 筋膜，仪表盘板，装饰带
fascia.note:
The car's dashboard fascia was made of polished wood. 汽车的仪表盘饰板是用抛光木材制成的。

Surgeons studied the muscle fascia during the operation. 外科医生在手术中研究了肌肉筋膜。

fealty.note:
Knights swore an oath of fealty to the king. 骑士向国王宣誓效忠。

The lords pledged their fealty to the new ruler. 领主们向新统治者宣誓忠诚。

febrile.note:
The patient showed febrile symptoms in the evening. 病人在傍晚出现了发烧症状。

The stock market was in a febrile state. 股市处于一种狂热的状态。

felicitate.note:
I want to felicitate you on your promotion. 我想祝贺你晋升。

Colleagues gathered to felicitate the newlyweds. 同事们聚集在一起祝贺这对新人。

feline.meaning: adj. 猫科的，猫一样的；n. 猫科动物
feline.note:
Lions and tigers belong to the feline family. 狮子和老虎属于猫科动物。

She moved with quiet, feline grace. 她的动作带着猫一般安静优雅的姿态。

ferocious.meaning: adj. 凶猛的，残忍的，激烈的
ferocious.note:
A ferocious dog guarded the entrance of the estate. 一只凶猛的狗守卫着庄园的入口。

There was a ferocious debate over the new tax policy. 关于新税收政策发生了一场激烈的辩论。

ferry.meaning: n. 渡轮；v. 运送，渡运
ferry.note:
We took a car ferry across the wide river. 我们乘汽车渡轮过宽阔的河。

Boats ferry passengers between the islands all day. 船只整天在岛屿之间运送乘客。

festal.note:
The town wore a festal appearance for the holiday. 城镇为了节日呈现出一派欢庆的景象。

They gathered for a festal dinner celebration. 他们聚在一起举行节日晚宴庆祝。

fetish.note:
Modern society seems to have a fetish for technology. 现代社会似乎对科技有着一种迷恋。

Some cultures worship wooden tribal fetish figures. 一些文化崇拜木制的部落图腾神物。

fiend.meaning: n. 恶魔，极坏的人，迷恋……的人
fiend.note:
He acted like an absolute fiend during the crisis. 危机期间他表现得像个绝对的恶魔。

She is a fitness fiend and works out every day. 她是个健身迷，每天都锻炼。

filament.note:
The light bulb failed because the filament broke. 灯泡不亮了，因为灯丝断了。

Flowers contain delicate pollen filaments. 花朵包含精细的花粉丝。

filch.meaning: v. 偷窃，偷听，窃取（小物件）
filch.note:
Someone managed to filch a pen from my desk. 有人设法从我桌上偷走了一支笔。

The child tried to filch a piece of candy. 孩子试图偷一块糖吃。

filial.note:
Children owe filial duty and respect to their parents. 子女对父母负有孝顺和尊重的义务。

He showed great filial devotion to his aging mother. 他对年迈的母亲表现出了极大的孝心。

finable.note:
Illegal parking is a finable offense. 违章停车是可处以罚款的违规行为。

Drivers caught speeding are finable on the spot. 超速被抓的司机当场可被罚款。

finery.note:
She dressed in all her finery for the gala. 她盛装打扮出席了盛会。

Guests arrived at the party in their holiday finery. 客人们穿着节日的盛装来到派对。

firebrand.meaning: n. 煽动叛乱者，惹事生非者
firebrand.note:
The young political firebrand urged the crowd to protest. 这位年轻的政治煽动者敦促人群抗议。

He was known as a firebrand in local politics. 他在当地政治中被称为一个惹事生非的人。

fishery.note:
The local economy depends heavily on the fishing fishery. 当地经济在很大程度上依赖于渔业。

Strict quotas were introduced to protect the coastal fishery. 引入了严格的配额来保护沿海渔场。

fissile.meaning: adj. 易分裂的，易裂变的
fissile.note:
Uranium-235 is a fissile material used in reactors. 铀-235是反应堆中使用的易裂变材料。

The substance has unique fissile properties. 这种物质具有独特的易裂变性质。

fitful.meaning: adj. 断断续续的，一阵阵的
fitful.note:
He managed only a fitful sleep during the stormy night. 暴风雨之夜他只断断续续地睡了一会儿。

A fitful breeze blew across the quiet lake. 一阵阵微风吹过平静的湖面。

flabby.note:
He wanted to tone up his flabby muscles. 他想锻炼自己松弛的肌肉。

The argument was weak and flabby. 那个论点软弱无力。

flagellate.note:
Monks used to flagellate themselves as a form of penance. 修士过去常常鞭笞自己作为忏悔的一种形式。

There is no need to flagellate yourself over a small mistake. 没必要为一个小错误而严厉自责。

flair.meaning: n. 天赋，才华，敏锐的感觉
flair.note:
She has a natural flair for languages. 她对语言有着天然的天赋。

He designs clothes with a real flair for style. 他设计服装带有真正的时尚才华。

flannel.meaning: n. 法兰绒，绒布；虚伪浮夸的话
flannel.note:
He wore a comfortable checkered flannel shirt. 他穿着一件舒服的格子法兰绒衬衫。

Don't give me any flannel; tell me the truth. 别跟我套近乎说废话，告诉我实话。

flatulence.meaning: n. 肠胃气胀，自大空洞的言论
flatulence.note:
Eating beans can sometimes cause flatulence. 吃豆子有时会导致肠胃气胀。

His speech was full of empty flatulence. 他的演讲充满了空洞自大的言论。

flavoring.note:
Vanilla is a popular flavoring used in baking. 香草是烘焙中常用的调味品。

Artificial flavoring was added to enhance the taste. 为了增强口感添加了人造调味剂。

flay.note:
Critics rushed to flay the new movie. 评论家们纷纷痛斥这部新电影。

Ancient hunters knew how to flay an animal carcass. 古代猎人知道如何剥去动物尸体的皮。

fleck.meaning: n. 斑点，微粒；v. 使有斑点
fleck.note:
His eyes were brown with flecks of green. 他的眼睛是棕色的，带有绿色的斑点。

Sunlight flecked the forest floor through the trees. 阳光透过树木在森林地面上洒下斑驳的光影。

fleece.meaning: n. 羊毛；v. 剪羊毛，诈取
fleece.note:
Sheep are raised primarily for their warm fleece. 养羊主要是为了它们保暖的羊毛。

The tourists felt they had been fleeced by the taxi driver. 游客们觉得他们被出租车司机诈取了钱财。

flick.note:
He gave the switch a quick flick with his finger. 他用手指轻弹了一下开关。

She used her hand to flick the dust off her jacket. 她用手拂去夹克上的灰尘。

flicker.note:
The candle flame began to flicker in the draft. 烛火在穿堂风中开始闪烁。

A flicker of hope appeared in her eyes. 她的眼里闪过一丝希望。

floppy.note:
He wore a wide-brimmed floppy sun hat. 他戴着一顶宽边的松软遮阳帽。

The puppy had cute, floppy ears. 这只小狗长着一对可爱下垂的耳朵。

florescence.note:
The garden was in full florescence during May. 五月期间花园正处于盛开期。

Scientists observed the plant's seasonal florescence. 科学家观察了该植物的季节性开花。

flunk.note:
He was afraid he would flunk the chemistry exam. 他害怕化学考试不及格。

She worked hard so she wouldn't flunk out of college. 她努力学习以免被大学退学。

fodder.note:
Farmers stored dry hay as winter fodder for cattle. 农民们储存干草作为牛群的冬季饲料。

The scandal provided rich fodder for tabloid journalists. 这桩丑闻为小报记者提供了丰富的素材。

fondle.note:
She sat on the sofa, gently fondling her cat. 她坐在沙发上，温柔地爱抚着她的猫。

He liked to fondle his lucky coin in his pocket. 他喜欢在口袋里抚摸他的幸运硬币。

foothold.note:
The climbers struggled to find a secure foothold on the rock. 登山者艰难地在岩石上寻找一个稳固的立足点。

The company gained a strong foothold in the Asian market. 这家公司在亚洲市场获得了牢固的立足点。

footle.meaning: v./n. 瞎扯，胡闹，浪费时间
footle.note:
Stop footling around and get down to work. 别再瞎胡闹了，开始干活吧。

He spent the whole afternoon in idle footle. 他把整个下午都浪费在无聊的胡扯上。

fop.meaning: n. 纨绔子弟，过于注重穿着的男子
fop.note:
He dressed like an extravagant fop of the eighteenth century. 他的打扮像一个十八世纪奢侈的花花公子。

She disliked his fop manners and vanity. 她不喜欢他装模作样的举止和虚荣心。

foray.meaning: n./v. 突袭，涉足，初步尝试
foray.note:
The troops made a quick foray across the border. 部队跨过边境进行了一次快速突袭。

This is her first foray into writing fiction. 这是她首次尝试写小说。

forebear.note:
We should honor the traditions of our forebears. 我们应当尊重祖先的传统。

His forebears emigrated from Scotland centuries ago. 他的祖先几个世纪前从苏格兰移民过来。

foreclose.meaning: v. 止赎（收回抵押房产），排除
foreclose.note:
The bank threatened to foreclose on the mortgage. 银行威胁要对抵押贷款进行止赎。

This decision does not foreclose other possibilities. 这个决定并未排除其他可能性。

forensic.meaning: adj. 法医的，法庭的，取证的
forensic.note:
Forensic experts examined the crime scene for clues. 法医专家检查了犯罪现场以寻找线索。

The lawyer delivered a brilliant forensic speech. 律师发表了一场精彩的法庭辩论演讲。

foreword.note:
The author wrote a brief foreword to the book. 作者为这本书写了一篇简短的前言。

A famous scholar wrote the foreword for the novel. 一位著名学者为这部小说写了序言。

forfeiture.note:
The crime led to the forfeiture of his property. 这项罪行导致他的财产被没收。

Failure to pay the fine will result in forfeiture of goods. 未能支付罚款将导致货物被没收。

forlorn.meaning: adj. 孤立的，凄凉的，绝望的
forlorn.note:
The stray dog looked small and forlorn in the rain. 这只流浪狗在雨中显得又小又可怜。

He made a forlorn attempt to fix the broken car. 他做了一次绝望的尝试去修理那辆坏了的汽车。

formative.meaning: adj. 形成的，对性格发展起决定作用的
formative.note:
Childhood is a formative period in human life. 童年是人类生活中性格形成的时期。

She spent her formative years living in France. 她在法国度过了她成长的关键岁月。

forswear.meaning: v. 发誓放弃，断然否定
forswear.note:
He decided to forswear all bad habits. 他决定发誓戒掉所有坏习惯。

The king had to forswear his previous claims. 国王不得不发誓放弃他先前的声明。

fort.note:
Soldiers defended the old stone fort against attacks. 士兵们守卫着古老的石头要塞以防抵御攻击。

They built a small wooden fort in the backyard. 他们在后院建了一个小木堡垒。

fractional.meaning: adj. 分数的，微小的，部分的
fractional.note:
Only a fractional percentage of the budget was spent. 只花费了预算中极小的一部分比例。

The calculation involves fractional numbers. 该计算涉及分数。

fraternal.note:
They maintained a close, fraternal bond over decades. 几十年来，他们保持着紧密的兄弟般的情谊。

The organization promotes fraternal cooperation. 该组织促进兄弟般的合作。

fraternity.note:
He joined a college fraternity during his freshman year. 他在大一期间加入了一个大学兄弟会。

Lawyers belong to a respected legal fraternity. 律师属于一个受人尊敬的法律界同行群体。

fray.meaning: v. 磨损，争吵；n. 争斗，冲突
fray.note:
The cuffs of his old shirt began to fray. 他旧衬衫的袖口开始磨损了。

He jumped eagerly into the political fray. 他急切地投身于政治争斗中。

freak.meaning: n. 怪胎，狂热爱好者；adj. 异常的
freak.note:
A freak storm destroyed several houses last night. 一场罕见的风暴昨晚摧毁了几栋房屋。

He is a computer freak who loves coding. 他是一个热爱编程的电脑迷。

fretwork.note:
The wooden chair was decorated with delicate fretwork. 这把木椅装饰着精致的镂空花饰。

Intricate fretwork adorned the palace windows. 复杂的透雕细工装饰着宫殿的窗户。

frisk.note:
Police officers began to frisk the suspects for weapons. 警察开始对嫌疑人进行搜身以寻找武器。

Lambs frisked around the green meadow. 小羊羔在绿色的草地上欢蹦乱跳。

fritter.meaning: v. 浪费，糟塌；n. 油炸馅饼
fritter.note:
Do not fritter away your time on video games. 不要把时间浪费在电子游戏上。

She ordered apple fritters for dessert. 她点了一份苹果炸馅饼作为甜点。

frolic.note:
Puppies love to frolic in the garden. 小狗喜欢在花园里嬉戏。

The children's afternoon frolic was filled with laughter. 孩子们下午的嬉闹充满了欢笑声。

frolicsome.note:
The frolicsome kittens ran after a ball of yarn. 爱玩的小猫追逐着一团毛线球。

Her frolicsome mood brightened up the whole room. 她活泼嬉戏的心情照亮了整个房间。

frowzy.meaning: adj. 不整洁的，有陈腐气味的
frowzy.note:
He woke up with a frowzy head after the party. 派对过后他醒来时头脑昏沉、仪容不整。

The room had a frowzy, unventilated smell. 房间里有一股陈腐、不通风的气味。

fructify.meaning: v. 使结果实，使富有成效
fructify.note:
Rain helps to fructify the dry earth. 雨水有助于使干燥的土地肥沃结果。

His long-term plans finally began to fructify. 他长期的计划终于开始见成效了。

funereal.meaning: adj. 葬礼的，阴森的，悲伤的
funereal.note:
A funereal silence hung over the empty office. 空旷的办公室里弥漫着一种阴森压抑的沉默。

He spoke in a slow, funereal tone. 他用一种缓慢而悲伤的语调说话。

furbish.note:
They decided to furbish the old living room furniture. 他们决定翻新旧客厅的家具。

He polished his antique sword to furbish it up. 他擦拭了他的古董宝剑使其焕然一新。

fury.note:
She could not hide her fury at the insult. 她无法掩饰自己受到侮辱时的愤怒。

They struggled against the fury of the storm. 他们与暴风雨的猛烈搏斗。

fustian.meaning: adj. 浮夸的，华而不实的；n. 棉毛混纺织物
fustian.note:
His political speech was dismissed as mere fustian. 他的政治演讲被斥为不过是华而不实的废话。

The trousers were made of durable fustian. 这条裤子是用耐用的粗厚棉布做成的。

gab.note:
They spent hours just sitting and gabbing. 他们坐着闲聊了好几个小时。

She has the gift of the gab and persuades easily. 她很有口才，很容易说服别人。

gabble.meaning: v./n. 急促不清地说，快而含糊地讲
gabble.note:
He tended to gabble when he was nervous. 他紧张时往往会语无伦次、快语连珠。

I could only hear an unintelligible gabble. 我只能听到一阵听不清的急促说话声。

gaiety.meaning: n. 兴高采烈，快乐，欢庆
gaiety.note:
The streets were filled with holiday gaiety. 街道上充满了节日的欢乐气氛。

Her natural gaiety infected everyone around her. 她天生的快乐感染了周围的每一个人。

gale.note:
A violent gale blew down several trees. 一场狂风吹倒了好几棵树。

The joke set the room into gales of laughter. 这个笑话引得全屋人哄堂大笑。

gallows.note:
The criminal was led toward the gallows. 罪犯被带向绞刑架。

Building the gallows took the executioners all night. 刽子手们花了一整夜搭建绞刑架。

gander.note:
The angry gander hissed at the approaching stranger. 那只愤怒的雄鹅向走近的陌生人发出嘶嘶声。

Let me take a gander at your new car. 让我看一眼你的新车。

gangling.note:
He was a gangling teenager awkward with his height. 他是一个高瘦而显得笨拙的青少年。

The gangling dog tripped over its own paws. 那只瘦长笨拙的小狗被自己的爪子绊倒了。

gangly.note:
The gangling youth struggled to find fitting clothes. 那个细高瘦长的年轻人很难找到合身的衣服。

He grew into a tall, gangly young man. 他长成了一个身材高瘦的年轻人。

gangrene.note:
The untreated wound soon developed gangrene. 未经处理的伤口很快引发了坏疽。

Doctors had to amputate the toe before gangrene spread. 在坏疽扩散之前，医生不得不截断脚趾。

garland.meaning: n. 花环，圈状饰物；v. 戴花环
garland.note:
They hung festive flower garlands around the room. 他们在房间周围挂上了节日的花环。

The winners were crowned with laurel garlands. 获胜者被戴上了月桂花冠。

garret.note:
The poor artist lived in a cold, dusty garret. 这位贫穷的艺术家住在寒冷多尘的阁楼里。

Sunlight streamed through the small window of the garret. 阳光从阁楼的小窗户倾泻进来。

gastric.note:
He suffered from severe gastric pain after meals. 他饭后遭受剧烈的胃痛。

Gastric acids help break down food in the stomach. 胃酸有助于分解胃里的食物。

gastritis.note:
Dietary changes can help manage chronic gastritis. 饮食调整有助于控制慢性胃炎。

She was diagnosed with acute gastritis. 她被诊断出患有急性胃炎。

gastronomy.note:
France is famous for its rich tradition of gastronomy. 法国以其丰富的烹饪美学传统而闻名。

He wrote a book exploring the secrets of local gastronomy. 他写了一本探索当地美食学秘密的书。

gauche.meaning: adj. 笨拙的，社交中不圆滑的
gauche.note:
It was rather gauche of him to ask about her salary. 他打听她的薪水显得相当笨拙没礼貌。

She regretted her gauche remarks at the formal dinner. 她后悔在正式晚宴上说了不得体的话。

gaunt.meaning: adj. 憔悴的，骨瘦如柴的
gaunt.note:
Weeks of illness left him looking gaunt and weak. 数周的病痛让他看起来消瘦而虚弱。

The old house stood gaunt and abandoned on the hill. 那栋老房子孤零零、破败不堪地伫立在山上。

genuflect.meaning: v. 屈膝半跪（尤指宗教仪式），卑躬屈膝
genuflect.note:
Believers genuflected as they entered the church. 信徒们进入教堂时屈膝半跪。

He refused to genuflect to political pressure. 他拒绝向政治压力卑躬屈膝。

gestate.note:
Mammals gestate their young inside the womb. 哺乳动物在子宫内孕育幼崽。

The creative idea took months to gestate. 这个创意构思花了几个月时间。

gesticulate.meaning: v. 做手势表达，手舞足蹈
gesticulate.note:
He began to gesticulate wildly while explaining the story. 他在解释故事时开始疯狂地比划手势。

She gesticulated to catch the waiter's attention. 她打手势以引起服务员的注意。

ghastly.meaning: adj. 可怕的，惊人的，惨白的
ghastly.note:
A ghastly accident blocked the highway for hours. 一起可怕的事故堵塞了高速公路数小时。

He turned ghastly pale upon hearing the news. 听到这个消息，他的脸色变得惨白。

gleam.note:
A gleam of light shone through the dark clouds. 一缕微光透过乌云照射出来。

His eyes held a gleam of amusement. 他的眼里闪烁着一丝戏谑。

glee.note:
The children shouted with glee when they saw the snow. 孩子们看到雪时欢呼雀跃。

She watched the unfolding drama with malicious glee. 她带着恶意的喜悦看着这场展开的戏剧。

glitter.note:
The stars began to glitter in the night sky. 星星开始在夜空中闪烁。

All that glitters is not gold. 发光的不一定都是金子。

gloaming.note:
They walked together in the quiet gloaming. 他们在寂静的黄昏中一起散步。

Shadows lengthened across the lawn as gloaming fell. 随着夜幕降临，草地上的影子拉长了。

glorify.note:
Some movies tend to glorify violence. 一些电影往往会美化暴力。

Believers gathered to glorify God in prayer. 信徒们聚集在一起通过祈祷赞美上帝。

gnat.note:
Swarms of gnats buzzed around the damp pond. 一群群蚋在潮湿的池塘周围嗡嗡作响。

He swatted a gnat buzzing near his face. 他拍死了在脸旁嗡嗡叫的小蚋。

gnawing.meaning: adj. 痛苦折磨的，持续消耗的
gnawing.note:
A gnawing feeling of guilt bothered him all day. 一种持续折磨的内疚感困扰了他一整天。

She felt a gnawing pain in her stomach. 她感到胃里一阵持续的隐痛。

gnome.note:
He placed a ceramic garden gnome on the lawn. 他在草坪上放置了一个陶瓷花园小矮人。

Mythical gnomes guarded underground treasures. 神话中的地精守护着地下的宝藏。

gnomic.meaning: adj. 箴言的，含蓄而晦涩的
gnomic.note:
The wise old man spoke in gnomic phrases. 这位充满智慧的老人说着寓意深刻的箴言。

His gnomic response left everyone confused. 他那含蓄晦涩的回答让所有人都感到困惑。

goggle.meaning: v. 瞪大眼睛看；n. 护目镜
goggle.note:
Swimmers must wear protective goggles. 游泳者必须佩戴防护护目镜。

Children goggled at the magician's tricks. 孩子们瞪大眼睛看着魔术师的把戏。

gorgeous.note:
They enjoyed a gorgeous sunset over the ocean. 他们欣赏了海面上绚丽的日落。

She wore a gorgeous dress to the party. 她穿着一件华丽的礼服去参加派对。

gormandize.note:
He loved to gormandize at holiday banquets. 他喜欢在节日宴会上大吃大喝。

Guests gathered to gormandize on fine food. 客人们聚在一起大快朵颐地享受美食。

gosling.note:
A fluffy yellow gosling followed its mother closely. 一只毛茸茸的黄色小鹅紧紧跟随着母亲。

We spotted a family of geese with several goslings. 我们看到了一群带着几只小鹅的雁。

granary.note:
Farmers filled the granary with freshly harvested wheat. 农民们把新收割的小麦装满谷仓。

The region serves as the national granary. 该地区是全国的粮仓。

granule.note:
Add a few granules of sugar to the mixture. 在混合物中加入几颗糖粒。

Sand granules lined the shore of the beach. 细小的沙粒铺满了海滩海岸。

gratis.note:
The museum offers admission gratis on Sundays. 博物馆周日免费入场。

They provided drinks gratis for the guests. 他们为客人们免费提供饮料。

greenhorn.note:
He was just a greenhorn when he started the job. 他刚开始这份工作时只是个新手。

Experienced workers helped the greenhorn learn the ropes. 有经验的工人帮助这个新手熟悉了业务。

gridiron.note:
Steaks were cooked over an open iron gridiron. 牛排是在开式铁烤架上烤熟的。

Players battled for victory across the gridiron. 球员们在美式足球场上为了胜利而拼搏。

grotesque.meaning: adj. 怪诞的，畸形的，荒谬的
grotesque.note:
The old building was decorated with grotesque stone faces. 这栋老建筑装饰着怪诞的石头人脸。

It is grotesque to suggest he is involved. 暗示他牵连其中简直是荒谬。

growl.note:
The guard dog began to growl at the intruder. 看门狗开始向入侵者低吼。

He gave a low growl of annoyance. 他发出一声烦躁的低沉抱怨。

grudge.note:
He still harbors a grudge against his former boss. 他仍然对前老板心存怨恨。

She did not grudge the time spent helping others. 她不吝惜花时间去帮助别人。

gruff.meaning: adj. 粗暴的，声音低沉生硬的
gruff.note:
Despite his gruff exterior, he is very kind. 尽管他外表粗鲁，但人非常善良。

He answered with a gruff voice. 他用粗声粗气的声音回答。

grumpy.meaning: adj. 脾气暴躁的，易怒的
grumpy.note:
Grandpa is often grumpy before his morning coffee. 爷爷在早晨喝咖啡前经常脾气暴躁。

Why are you so grumpy today? 你今天怎么这么暴躁？

gulch.note:
The hikers crossed a dry desert gulch. 徒步旅行者穿过了一条干燥的沙漠峡谷。

Water rushed down the steep mountain gulch. 水流顺着陡峭的山谷奔流而下。

gull.meaning: n. 海鸥；v. 欺骗，蒙骗
gull.note:
Seagulls circled above the fishing boats. 海鸥在渔船上方盘旋。

He was easily gulled by dishonest salesmen. 他很容易被不诚实的推销员欺骗。

gusto.meaning: n. 兴致勃勃，津津有味
gusto.note:
He ate his dinner with great gusto. 他津津有味地吃着晚饭。

She tackled the new project with immense gusto. 她以极大的热情投入到新项目中。

gutless.meaning: adj. 懦弱的，缺乏勇气的
gutless.note:
It was a gutless decision to avoid responsibility. 这是一个逃避责任的懦弱决定。

He called his opponent gutless during the debate. 他在辩论中称他的对手没有胆量。

guttle.note:
The stray dog began to guttle its food. 流浪狗开始狼吞虎咽地吃食物。

Children shouldn't guttle sweet snacks before meals. 孩子们不应该在饭前贪吃甜食。

gynaecocracy.meaning: n. 女权政治，由女性统治的政权
gynaecocracy.note:
Some ancient societies practiced forms of gynaecocracy. 一些古代社会实行过某种形式的女权政治。

The historical text described a rare period of gynaecocracy. 这篇历史文献描述了一个罕见的女性统治时期。

habitable.note:
The old house was made habitable after major repairs. 经大修后，这栋老房子变得可以住人了。

Scientists search for habitable planets outside our solar system. 科学家在太阳系外搜寻适宜居住的行星。

haft.note:
The ancient dagger had an ivory haft. 这把古代短匕首有一个象牙柄。

He gripped the wooden haft of the axe firmly. 他紧紧握住斧头的木柄。

haggard.meaning: adj. 面容憔悴的，精疲力竭的
haggard.note:
He looked haggard after staying up all night. 通宵未眠后他看起来十分憔悴。

The survivor emerged from the forest looking haggard. 幸存者从森林里出来时显得面容憔悴。

haggle.note:
Shoppers like to haggle over prices at the open market. 购物者喜欢在露天市场讨价还价。

There is no use trying to haggle with him. 试图跟他讨价还价是没有用的。

hardbitten.meaning: adj. 顽强的，经受过风雨的
hardbitten.note:
He was a hardbitten veteran of many campaigns. 他是经历过多次战役身经百战的老兵。

Hardbitten detectives were not easily fooled. 久经沙场的侦探是不容易被骗的。

hardihood.note:
It required great hardihood to climb the mountain in winter. 冬天攀登这座山需要极大的勇气。

He had the hardihood to question the director's decision. 他竟然有胆量质疑总监的决定。

hatchet.note:
He used a small hatchet to chop firewood. 他用一把小斧头劈柴。

It is time for the two countries to bury the hatchet. 是时候让两国化干戈为玉帛了。

hawker.note:
Street hawkers sold fruit along the busy avenue. 街头小贩沿着繁华的大道叫卖水果。

He started his career as a humble newspaper hawker. 他最初是一个卑微的报纸小贩。

hawser.note:
The sailors secured the ship with a thick hawser. 水手们用一根粗缆绳固定了船只。

The heavy hawser snapped under extreme pressure. 沉重的缆绳在极大的压力下断裂了。

hearsay.note:
The judge dismissed the evidence because it was pure hearsay. 法官驳回了证据，因为这纯属道听途说。

We cannot make decisions based on mere hearsay. 我们不能根据捕风捉影的传闻做出决定。

heave.note:
They gave a heavy heave to lift the box. 他们用力一抬把箱子举了起来。

The rough seas made the boat heave up and down. 波涛汹涌的大海使船上下起伏。

hedgehog.note:
A tiny hedgehog rolled into a ball for protection. 一只小刺猬卷成一个球来保护自己。

We found a wild hedgehog in the garden bushes. 我们在花园灌木丛中发现了一只野刺猬。

hedonic.note:
He lived a lifestyle centered around hedonic pleasure. 他过着以享乐为中心的生活方式。

Psychologists study human hedonic adaptation. 心理学家研究人类的快乐适应现象。

hedonism.note:
The philosophy of hedonism prioritizes pleasure above all. 享乐主义哲学把快乐置于一切之上。

His youth was characterized by reckless hedonism. 他的青春年少特征是鲁莽的享乐主义。

heliotrope.note:
The garden was filled with fragrant purple heliotrope. 花园里长满了芳香的紫色天芥菜。

Heliotrope flowers turn to face the sun. 天芥菜花会转向太阳。

helm.note:
She took the helm of the company as the new CEO. 她作为新CEO接掌了公司的领导权。

The captain stepped up to the ship's helm. 船长走到船舵前。

helot.note:
Ancient Sparta ruled over a large population of helots. 古斯巴达统治着大量的奴隶人口。

Workers felt like modern helots trapped in debt. 工人们觉得自己像被债务困住的现代奴隶。

helve.note:
The broken axe helve needed to be replaced. 断了的斧柄需要更换。

He carved a new wooden helve for his tool. 他为他的工具雕刻了一个新的木柄。

henpecked.meaning: adj. 受妻子支配的，怕老婆的
henpecked.note:
He was often teased for being a henpecked husband. 他经常因为是个妻管严而遭到取笑。

She dominated the relationship, leaving him henpecked. 她在恋爱关系中占主导地位，让他显得很怕老婆。

hepatitis.note:
Vaccination is effective in preventing hepatitis B. 接种疫苗对预防乙肝很有效。

He was hospitalized for acute hepatitis. 他因急性肝炎住院治疗。

herdsman.note:
The herdsman guided his cattle across the vast steppe. 牧人引导他的牛群穿过广袤的草原。

Nomadic herdsmen moved with the seasons. 游牧民随着季节迁移。

heyday.note:
The band was in its musical heyday during the nineties. 这支乐队在九十年代处于其音乐的全盛时期。

In its industrial heyday, the city produced much steel. 在工业全盛时期，这座城市生产了大量钢材。

hinterland.meaning: n. 内地，穷乡僻壤，腹地
hinterland.note:
Goods were transported from the port to the rural hinterland. 货物从港口运输到农村内地。

They traveled deep into the African hinterland. 他们深入非洲内地旅行。

hoarse.note:
He shouted until his voice became completely hoarse. 他大喊大叫，直到声音完全变哑。

She spoke in a hoarse whisper. 她用嘶哑的低语说话。

hobble.note:
He managed to hobble across the room on crutches. 他靠着拐杖勉强跛行穿过房间。

Lack of funds continued to hobble the project. 资金不足继续束缚着这个项目的发展。

holocaust.meaning: n. 大屠杀，巨大的毁灭
holocaust.note:
History must never forget the horrors of the Holocaust. 历史绝不能忘记大屠杀的恐怖。

The nuclear war threatened global holocaust. 核战争威胁着全球性的毁灭。

holograph.note:
The museum displayed a rare holographic art piece. 博物馆展出了一件罕见的全息艺术品。

His will was accepted as a valid holograph document. 他的遗嘱被接受为一份有效的亲笔文件。

homely.meaning: adj. 家常的，朴素的，相貌平平的
homely.note:
They enjoyed a homely meal of soup and bread. 他们享用了朴素的汤和面包的家常便饭。

The cottage had a warm and homely atmosphere. 这栋小屋有着温馨舒适的家常氛围。

homily.note:
The priest delivered a short Sunday homily. 神父发表了一篇简短的主日布道。

Parents often give boring homilies to teenagers. 父母经常对青少年进行无聊的说教。

homograph.note:
'Lead' as in metal and 'lead' as in guide are homographs. 金属意义上的“铅”和引导意义上的“领导”是同形异义词。

Students study homographs to improve vocabulary accuracy. 学生学习同形异义词以提高词汇准确性。

horology.meaning: n. 钟表制造术，测时学
horology.note:
He is an expert in the history of horology. 他是钟表制造历史方面的专家。

The museum houses a fascinating collection of horology. 馆内收藏了迷人的钟表测时藏品。

howler.note:
His essay was full of historical howlers. 他的论文充满了历史常识性的大错误。

That translation mistake was a real howler. 那个翻译错误真是一个愚蠢的大笑话。

hubbub.note:
She could not sleep amidst the city hubbub. 她无法在城市的喧嚣中入睡。

The market was filled with the cheerful hubbub of crowds. 市场里充满了人群欢快的喧闹声。

huddle.note:
The cold travelers huddled together for warmth. 寒冷的旅行者挤在一起取暖。

Players formed a quick huddle on the field. 球员们在场上迅速聚集成一团商量战术。

hunk.note:
He cut off a large hunk of bread for lunch. 他午餐时切了一大块面包。

She found a hunk of cheese in the fridge. 她在冰箱里发现了一大块奶酪。

hut.note:
They stayed in a wooden mountain hut overnight. 他们在山间木屋里过了一夜。

Fishermen built a small storage hut by the lake. 渔民在湖边建了一个小储藏棚。

hypodermic.meaning: adj. 皮下注射的；n. 注射器
hypodermic.note:
The nurse prepared a hypodermic syringe for injection. 护士准备了一支皮下注射器用于注射。

Hypodermic needles must be sterile. 皮下注射针必须无菌。

icing.note:
The birthday cake was covered in sweet vanilla icing. 生日蛋糕上覆盖着甜甜的香草糖霜。

She carefully spread the pink icing over the cookies. 她小心翼翼地把粉红色糖霜抹在饼干上。

idolatrize.note:
Fans tend to idolatrize pop stars without reason. 粉丝们往往盲目崇拜流行巨星。

We should not idolatrize political leaders. 我们不应该将政治领袖偶像化。

illegible.meaning: adj. 难认的，字迹模糊的
illegible.note:
His handwriting was completely illegible. 他的字迹完全辨认不清。

The ancient signature on the document was illegible. 文件上的古代签名已经模糊不清了。

illiberal.meaning: adj. 偏狭的，专制的，不自由的
illiberal.note:
The regime imposed illiberal restrictions on speech. 该政权对言论实施了不自由的限制。

His attitude toward outsiders was narrow and illiberal. 他对外来者的态度狭隘且偏执。

illustrious.note:
The university welcomed many illustrious guests. 这所大学迎来了许多杰出的嘉宾。

He had an illustrious career as a diplomat. 他作为外交官有着辉煌杰出的职业生涯。

imbecile.note:
It was an imbecile mistake to leave the door unlocked. 没锁门真是一个愚蠢透顶的错误。

He acted like an absolute imbecile during the dispute. 争执期间他表现得像个彻头彻尾的笨蛋。

immortal.note:
Greek gods were believed to be immortal. 古希腊神明被认为是不朽的。

Shakespeare's plays achieved immortal fame. 莎士比亚的戏剧赢得了不朽的名声。

impend.note:
They sensed an impending crisis hanging over them. 他们感觉到一场迫在眉睫的危机笼罩着他们。

Dark clouds signaled an impending storm. 乌烟瘴气的云层预示着一场即将来临的风暴。

imperil.note:
Pollution can seriously imperil marine life. 污染会严重危及海洋生物。

Reckless driving will imperil the safety of others. 冒险驾驶会危及他人的安全。

imprecation.note:
He muttered an imprecation under his breath. 他低声咕哝了一句诅咒的话。
