The angry man shouted imprecations at the thief. 愤怒的男子向小偷大声咒骂。

incertitude.note:
Economic incertitude worried many investors. 经济的不确定性让许多投资者感到担忧。

They lived in a state of constant incertitude. 他们生活在持续的不确定状态中。

incisor.note:
Rodents have sharp front incisors for gnawing. 啮齿动物拥有锋利的前门齿用于啃咬。

The dentist checked the patient's upper incisors. 牙医检查了病人的上门牙。

incongruent.meaning: adj. 不一致的，不调和的
incongruent.note:
His calm reaction seemed incongruous with the crisis. 他冷静的反应似乎与这场危机不相协调。

The two sets of data were incongruous. 两组数据并不一致。

incorporeal.note:
Ghosts are often depicted as incorporeal spirits. 鬼魂通常被描绘为无形的精神。

Copyright protects incorporeal intellectual property. 版权保护无形的知识产权。

incrustation.note:
A hard incrustation of salt formed on the rocks near the shore. 岸边岩石上形成了一层坚硬的盐壳。

The decorative box featured an intricate incrustation of mother-of-pearl. 这个装饰盒具有精致的珠母镶嵌工艺。

indite.note:
He sat down in his study to indite a formal letter of complaint. 他坐在书房里撰写一封正式的投诉信。

The poet began to indite verses inspired by the quiet countryside. 诗人开始创作受宁静乡村启发的诗句。

inebriate.meaning: v. 使陶醉，使喝醉；adj. 醉酒的
inebriate.note:
The rich wine and festive atmosphere combined to inebriate the guests. 浓郁的葡萄酒和节日气氛让客人们陶醉。

He stumbled home in an inebriate state after the party. 聚会后他醉醺醺地跌跌撞撞回到家。

ineffaceable.meaning: adj. 不能消除的，不可磨灭的
ineffaceable.note:
The tragic events of that summer left an ineffaceable mark on her memory. 那年夏天的悲惨事件在她记忆中留下了不可磨灭的印记。

His kind words had an ineffaceable impact on the young student. 他温和的话语对这位年轻学生产生了不可磨灭的影响。

ineligible.meaning: adj. 无资格的，不合格的
ineligible.note:
Foreign citizens are ineligible to vote in this national election. 外国公民无权在这场国家选举中投票。

Due to his low GPA, he was deemed ineligible for the scholarship. 由于绩点较低，他被认为不符合奖学金的申请资格。

inexpedient.meaning: adj. 不明智的，不适宜的
inexpedient.note:
The board decided it was inexpedient to launch the new product right now. 董事会认为现在推出新产品是不明智的。

Taking such a risk at this stage would be highly inexpedient. 在这个阶段承担这种风险是非常不合时宜的。

inexpiable.meaning: adj. 无法弥补的，不可赎罪的
inexpiable.note:
He committed an inexpiable crime against his own country. 他对自己的国家犯下了不可饶恕的罪行。

Some breaches of trust are considered inexpiable in a close friendship. 在密切的友谊中，某些背叛被认为是无法弥补的。

infatuate.meaning: v. 使迷恋，使冲昏头脑
infatuate.note:
Do not let a fleeting crush infatuate your better judgment. 不要让短暂的心动冲昏了你清醒的判断力。

He was completely infatuated with the glamour of city life. 他完全被大都市的魅力迷住了。

infatuated.note:
She was so infatuated with the actor that she bought every magazine he was in. 她对那个演员如此痴迷，以至于买下了他出现的所有杂志。

He made many foolish choices while infatuated with her. 在对她神魂颠倒期间，他做出许多愚蠢的选择。

infernal.meaning: adj. 地狱的，可恶的，极讨厌的
infernal.note:
The heat in the boiler room felt truly infernal. 锅炉房里的热气真像地狱般煎熬。

I wish that infernal noise from the next apartment would stop. 我真希望隔壁公寓那讨厌的噪声能停下来。

infliction.note:
The cruel ruler took pleasure in the infliction of pain. 这个残暴的统治者以施加痛苦为乐。

Citizens protested against the infliction of heavy new taxes. 公民们抗议强征沉重的新税。

informer.note:
The police caught the gang leader with the help of an anonymous informer. 警方在匿名密探的帮助下抓获了帮派头目。

An informer leaked the secret plans to the rival company. 一个告密者向竞争对手公司泄露了机密计划。

ingress.note:
A heavy iron gate controlled the ingress to the estate. 一扇沉重的铁门控制着进入庄园的通道。

Special filters prevent dust ingress into the sensitive camera lens. 特殊的滤网可防止灰尘进入敏感的相机镜头。

insane.meaning: adj. 疯狂的，精神失常的
insane.note:
Driving at that speed on a wet road is completely insane. 在湿滑的路面上以那种速度开车简直是疯了。

He was declared legally insane and sent to a medical facility. 他被宣判为法律意义上的精神失常并被送往医疗机构。

insanity.note:
Working seventy hours a week without a break is pure insanity. 每周工作七十小时且不休息纯粹是疯狂。

His defense attorney pleaded temporary insanity during the trial. 他的辩护律师在庭审中以短暂性精神错乱进行辩护。

inscription.note:
There was a faint Latin inscription carved into the old stone monument. 古老的石碑上刻着一行模糊的拉丁文铭文。

She found a romantic inscription inside the cover of the antique book. 她在那本古董书的封皮内侧发现了一段浪漫的题词。

insolate.note:
The herbs are traditionally insolated on bamboo trays to dry. 这些草药传统上被放在竹盘上在阳光下曝晒以晾干。

Researchers insolated the panel to test its resistance to solar radiation. 研究人员将面板置于阳光下曝晒以测试其抗太阳辐射能力。

insouciance.meaning: n. 漫不经心，无忧无虑，漠不关心
insouciance.note:
He faced the looming financial crisis with astonishing insouciance. 他以令人惊奇的漠不关心态度面对迫在眉睫的金融危机。

Her youthful insouciance charmed everyone at the gathering. 她青春期的无忧无虑迷住了聚会上的每一个人。

installment.meaning: n. 分期付款，（连载的）部分
installment.note:
We bought the new car and agreed to pay for it in monthly installments. 我们买下了这辆新车，并同意按月分期付款。

Fans eagerly waited for the next installment of the popular mystery novel. 书迷们焦急地等待着这本受欢迎的悬疑小说的下一期连载。

insuperable.meaning: adj. 不可克服的，难以逾越的
insuperable.note:
Language barriers once seemed like an insuperable obstacle to their communication. 语言障碍曾经看起来是他们交流中不可逾越的障碍。

With hard work, they managed to overcome seemingly insuperable difficulties. 凭借努力工作，他们设法克服了看似不可克服的困难。

interdisciplinary.note:
Environmental science is a major that requires an interdisciplinary approach. 环境科学是一门需要跨学科方法的专业。

The research team published an interdisciplinary study combining physics and biology. 该研究团队发表了一项结合物理学与生物学的跨学科研究。

interlace.note:
The basket was made of thin bamboo strips tightly interlaced together. 这个篮子是用紧密交织在一起的细竹条制成的。

The novel skillfully interlaces themes of love and political betrayal. 这部小说巧妙地将爱情与政治背叛的主题交织在一起。

interlocutor.note:
The diplomat listened carefully to his counterpart and chief interlocutor. 这位外交官认真听取了对方及其首席对话者的意见。

She looked across the table at her attentive interlocutor. 她看着桌对面全神贯注的对话者。

interlope.meaning: v. 干涉，闯入，私营贩运
interlope.note:
He tended to interlope in matters that did not concern him at all. 他倾向于干涉那些完全与他无关的事情。

Unlicensed merchants tried to interlope in the heavily regulated trade route. 无证商贩试图闯入这个受严格监管的贸易路线。

interloper.note:
The stray cat felt like an interloper in the house full of dogs. 这只流浪猫在满是狗的屋子里觉得自己像个闯入者。

She regarded the new business partner as an unwelcome interloper. 她把这位新商业伙伴视为不受欢迎的闯入者。

interstice.note:
Wildflowers managed to grow in the interstices of the ancient stone wall. 野花设法在古老石墙的缝隙中生长。

Sunlight streamed through the interstices of the dense forest canopy. 阳光透过茂密森林树冠的间隙洒下来。

interweave.note:
The author loves to interweave personal anecdotes with historical facts. 作者喜欢将个人轶事与历史事实交织在一起。

Colorful threads are interweaved to form a traditional tribal pattern. 五颜六色的线交织在一起，形成传统的部落图案。

intestate.meaning: adj. 未留遗嘱的；n. 未留遗嘱者
intestate.note:
He sadly passed away intestate, leaving his family to sort out the legal mess. 他不幸未留遗嘱就去世了，留下家人去收拾法律烂摊子。

The property of someone who dies intestate is distributed according to state law. 没留遗嘱去世的人的财产根据州法律进行分配。

intestine.meaning: n. 肠；adj. 国内的，内部的
intestine.note:
Food is digested and nutrients are absorbed primarily in the small intestine. 食物主要在小肠中被消化和吸收营养。

The country was weakened by years of bloody intestine conflicts. 这个国家因多年的血腥内乱而变得虚弱。

intumescence.note:
The physician noted a slight intumescence on the patient's forearm. 医师注意到患者的前臂上有轻微的肿大。

Heating causes the material to undergo an intumescence process. 加热会导致该材料经历膨胀隆起的过程。

investiture.meaning: n. 授职仪式，就职仪式，授权
investiture.note:
The queen presided over the grand investiture ceremony at the palace. 女王在宫殿里主持了盛大的授职仪式。

During his investiture, the new president swore to protect the constitution. 在就职典礼上，新总统宣誓保护宪法。

invigilate.note:
Professors took turns to invigilate the final chemistry examination. 教授们轮流监考期末化学考试。

She was asked to invigilate a room full of two hundred students. 她被要求监考一个坐着两百名学生的房间。

invoice.meaning: n. 发票，清单；v. 给…开发票
invoice.note:
Please send the official invoice to our accounting department by Friday. 请在周五前将正式发票发送至我们的财务部门。

We will invoice you as soon as the goods are shipped out. 货物一经发出，我们将立即向您开发票。

iridescence.meaning: n. 彩虹色，乳白光，灿烂的光辉
iridescence.note:
The soap bubble displayed a mesmerizing iridescence under the sunlight. 肥皂泡在阳光下呈现出迷人的彩虹色光泽。

She admired the subtle iridescence of the peacock feather. 她赞叹孔雀羽毛微妙的幻彩光泽。

irradiate.note:
The morning sun began to irradiate the mountain peaks. 早晨的太阳开始照亮山峰。

Food can be safely preserved using methods that irradiate the product. 可以使用对产品进行辐照的方法来安全地保存食物。

iterate.note:
Let me reiterate the main points of our strategy for clarity. 为了清楚起见，让我重申一下我们策略的主要几点。

The software allows engineers to iterate the design process rapidly. 该软件允许工程师快速重复设计过程。

jamboree.meaning: n. 快乐的集会，大型聚会
jamboree.note:
Thousands of scouts gathered from around the world for the summer jamboree. 数千名童子军从世界各地聚集在一起参加夏季大集会。

The annual music festival turned into a massive weekend jamboree. 每年一度的音乐节变成了一个大型的周末狂欢聚会。

jape.meaning: n. 玩笑，戏谑；v. 开玩笑，嘲弄
jape.note:
His harmless japes always brought a smile to his friends' faces. 他无害的玩笑总能逗得朋友们哈哈大笑。

The students loved to jape with the strict librarian. 学生们喜欢跟严肃的图书管理员开玩笑。

jesting.meaning: adj. 开玩笑的，戏谑的；n. 玩笑
jesting.note:
Despite his jesting tone, he was actually quite serious about the proposal. 尽管他语气带有玩笑成分，但他对这个提议其实相当认真。

Enough of your jesting; we need to talk business now. 别再开玩笑了，我们现在得谈正事。

jitters.note:
She took a deep breath to calm her pre-match jitters before going on stage. 她深吸了一口气，在上台前平复赛前的紧张情绪。

Financial markets suffered from jitters amid news of rising inflation. 在通胀上升的消息影响下，金融市场陷入了恐慌不安中。

jolly.meaning: adj. 快乐的，高兴的；adv. 非常，十分
jolly.note:
The innkeeper was a jolly man who welcomed every traveler warmly. 店主是个快乐的人，热情欢迎每一位旅客。

We had a jolly good time camping by the lake last weekend. 上周末我们在湖边露营过得非常愉快。

jubilant.meaning: adj. 欢腾的，喜气洋洋的
jubilant.note:
Fans flooded the streets in a jubilant celebration after the football victory. 足球比赛胜利后，球迷们涌上街头进行欢欣鼓舞的庆祝。

Jubilant cheers echoed through the stadium as the winner crossed the finish line. 随着获胜者冲过终点线，欢腾的呐喊声在体育场内回荡。

juncture.meaning: n. 关头，紧要关头，连接点
juncture.note:
At this critical juncture, we cannot afford to make any mistakes. 在这个关键关头，我们承担不起任何犯错的后果。

The pipes meet at a specific juncture beneath the kitchen sink. 水管在厨房水槽下方的特定连接点汇合。

jurisprudence.meaning: n. 法学，法律体系，法律学说
jurisprudence.note:
He spent decades studying the philosophy of comparative jurisprudence. 他花了几十年时间研究比较法学哲学。

Medical jurisprudence is a crucial subject for forensic investigators. 法医学对于法医调查员来说是一个至关重要的学科。

kaleidoscopic.meaning: adj. 千变万化的，万花筒般的
kaleidoscopic.note:
The city offers a kaleidoscopic mix of cultures, sights, and sounds. 这座城市提供了文化、风景和声音的千变万化的融合。

Autumn painted the forest in a kaleidoscopic array of fiery colors. 秋天将森林染成了色彩斑斓、变化多端的火热色调。

knoll.note:
They sat on a grassy knoll overlooking the quiet valley. 他们坐在俯瞰安静山谷的长满青草的小山丘上。

A single wind-swept tree stood atop the barren knoll. 荒凉的小山丘顶上伫立着一棵饱受风吹雨打的孤树。

laceration.note:
The paramedic treated a deep laceration on the cyclist's arm. 医疗急救人员处理了骑自行车者手臂上的一处深裂伤。

Sharp glass fragments caused severe laceration injuries to his hands. 锋利的玻璃碎片导致他的手部受到严重的撕裂伤。

lackey.note:
The corrupt official was surrounded by obedient lackeys. 这名腐败的官员周围环绕着服服帖帖的随从。

He refused to act as a political lackey for the ruling party. 他拒绝充当执政党的政治走狗。

laggard.meaning: n. 落后者，迟钝者；adj. 迟缓的，落后的
laggard.note:
The company cannot afford to remain a laggard in digital technology. 这家公司承担不起在数字技术方面继续落后的代价。

She urged the laggard students to keep up with the rest of the class. 她敦促落后的学生跟上全班其他同学的进度。

lamentable.meaning: adj. 令人惋惜的，悲惨的，糟糕的
lamentable.note:
The historical building was left in a lamentable state of disrepair. 这座历史建筑陷入了年久失修的悲惨状态。

His performance in the match was nothing short of lamentable. 他在比赛中的表现简直糟糕透顶。

lapidary.meaning: adj. 宝石刻工的，简练优雅的；n. 宝石匠
lapidary.note:
She inherited a collection of rare gems from a master lapidary. 她从一位宝石切割大师那里继承了一批珍贵的宝石。

The speech was praised for its lapidary style and precision. 这篇演讲因其简练优雅的风格和精确性而受到赞扬。

latch.meaning: n. 门闩，插销；v. 锁上，扣上
latch.note:
She turned the handle and lifted the latch to open the old wooden door. 她转动把手，提起门闩打开了那扇旧木门。

Make sure to latch the window securely before you leave. 离开前务必把窗户紧紧闩上。

layman.note:
The scientist explained complex quantum physics in terms a layman could understand. 这位科学家用外行人也能理解的词汇解释了复杂的量子物理学。

To a layman, legal contracts often look confusing and full of jargon. 对外行人来说，法律合同通常看起来令人困惑且充满行话。

layover.meaning: n. 短暂停留，中途停留
layover.note:
We had a six-hour layover in Singapore on our way to Sydney. 在去悉尼的路上，我们在新加坡进行了六个小时的中途停留。

She decided to explore the city during her afternoon flight layover. 她决定在下午航班转机停留期间探索这座城市。

leash.meaning: n. 皮带，牵狗绳；v. 束缚，用绳栓住
leash.note:
Always keep your dog on a leash while walking in public parks. 在公共公园散步时，一定要用牵狗绳拴住你的狗。

He tried to leash his anger during the heated discussion. 在激烈的讨论中，他试图克制自己的怒火。

leeward.meaning: adj. 背风的；adv. 在背风处
leeward.note:
The sailors moored the boat on the leeward side of the island. 水手们把船停泊在岛屿的背风侧。

They sailed leeward to escape the fierce headwind. 他们向背风处航行以躲避猛烈的逆风。

leeway.meaning: n. 自由度，余地，活动空间
leeway.note:
The manager gave her team plenty of leeway in completing the project. 经理在完成项目方面给予了她的团队充足的自由度。

We have very little financial leeway if costs exceed the budget. 如果成本超出预算，我们的财务余地将非常小。

legible.note:
Please write your answers in clear, legible handwriting. 请用清晰易读的字迹写下你的答案。

Most of the ancient manuscript was still remarkably legible. 这份古代手稿的大部分内容仍然非常清晰可读。

lesion.note:
The MRI scan revealed a small lesion in the brain tissue. 磁共振扫描显示脑组织中有一处小病变。

Exposure to strong chemicals can cause skin lesions. 接触强化学物质会导致皮肤损伤。

lexical.note:
The dictionary provides definitions, pronunciations, and lexical origins. 这本词典提供了定义、发音和词汇来源。

Translating idioms requires looking past mere lexical equivalents. 翻译习语需要超越单纯的词汇对等。

libelous.note:
The newspaper was sued for publishing libelous statements about the mayor. 这家报纸因发表针对市长的诽谤性言论而被起诉。

He threatened legal action over the libelous accusations online. 他对网上的诽谤性指控威胁采取法律行动。

libido.note:
Stress and lack of sleep can significantly lower a person's libido. 压力和缺乏睡眠会显著降低一个人的性欲。

Psychologists view the libido as a core driving force in human behavior. 心理学家将力比多视为人类行为的核心驱动力。

licit.note:
Trading shares on the open market is a completely licit business activity. 在公开市场上交易股票是一种完全合法的商业活动。

They sought licit sources of income after closing their old venture. 他们在关闭旧风险投资后寻找正当的收入来源。

ligature.meaning: n. 结扎线，绷带，连字号
ligature.note:
The surgeon used a surgical ligature to stop the bleeding. 外科医生使用手术结扎线来止血。

The letters 'fi' are often printed as a single ligature in traditional typography. 在传统排版中，字母“fi”通常作为一个连字印刷。

limbo.meaning: n. 中间状态，悬而未决的境地，地狱边缘
limbo.note:
After losing their funding, the research project was left in limbo. 在失去资金后，该研究项目陷入了悬而未决的境地。

Applicants often stay in career limbo while waiting for interview results. 求职者在等待面试结果时通常处于职业迷茫期。

lineal.note:
He claimed to be a lineal descendant of the medieval king. 他声称自己是那位中世纪国王的直系后裔。

Ancestry tests can trace your lineal heritage back through generations. 祖源测试可以追溯你几代人的直系血统。

lineaments.meaning: n. 面部特征，轮廓，特色
lineaments.note:
She inherited the delicate facial lineaments of her mother. 她继承了母亲精致的面部轮廓。

He studied the distinct lineaments of the landscape painting. 他研究了这幅风景画鲜明的轮廓特点。

lingual.note:
Phonetics studies the production of various lingual sounds. 语音学研究各种舌音的发音。

Early childhood is a critical period for lingual development. 早期童年是语言发展的关键时期。

littoral.meaning: adj. 沿海的，滨海的；n. 沿海地区
littoral.note:
Various marine species thrive in the shallow littoral waters. 各种海洋生物在浅海沿岸水域繁衍生息。

Development projects have altered the fragile ecology of the littoral zone. 开发项目改变了沿海地带脆弱的生态环境。

livid.meaning: adj. 勃然大怒的，青灰色的
livid.note:
The boss was livid when he discovered the financial mistake. 当老板发现这个财务错误时，他气得脸色铁青。

His arm was covered in livid bruises after the accident. 事故发生后，他的手臂上布满了青紫色的瘀伤。

loam.note:
Rich loam provides the ideal soil condition for growing tomatoes. 肥沃的壤土为种植西红柿提供了理想的土壤条件。

Gardeners mixed compost into the heavy clay to create a lighter loam. 园丁将堆肥拌入重粘土中，以创造更疏松的壤土。

locust.note:
A massive swarm of locusts descended on the crops, destroying the harvest. 一大群蝗虫降临到庄稼地里，摧毁了收成。

White locust flowers bloomed brightly in the spring breeze. 白色的刺槐花在春风中灿烂盛开。

locution.meaning: n. 惯用语，习语，言语风格
locution.note:
The phrase is an archaic locution rarely used in modern English. 这个短语是现代英语中很少使用的古老惯用语。

His speech was peppered with regional locutions and dialects. 他的演讲中充斥着地方习语和方言。

loft.meaning: n. 阁楼，顶楼；v. 击高球
loft.note:
They converted the dusty attic into a bright, modern studio loft. 他们把尘土飞扬的阁楼改造成了一个明亮现代的单间公寓。

He managed to loft the golf ball neatly over the sand trap. 他设法把高尔夫球巧妙地击过沙坑高高飞起。

logjam.meaning: n. 僵局，阻塞，原木堵塞
logjam.note:
Parliament finally broke the legislative logjam after weeks of debate. 议会经过数周的辩论，终于打破了立法僵局。

Traffic was halted due to a major logjam on the highway bridge. 由于高速公路桥上发生严重交通阻塞，交通停滞了。

loiter.note:
Signs around the station warn passengers not to loiter after dark. 车站周围的标语警告乘客天黑后不要逗留闲逛。

Suspicious teenagers were seen loitering near the school gates. 有可疑的青少年被看到在校门附近徘徊。

lore.meaning: n. 传说，传统知识，学问
lore.note:
According to local folklore, a hidden treasure is buried beneath the hill. 根据当地传说，一座宝藏被埋在小山底下。

He is an expert in ancient maritime lore and navigation history. 他是古代航海传说和航海历史的专家。

lout.meaning: n. 粗鲁笨拙的人，乡下人
lout.note:
He behaved like an ill-mannered lout at the formal dinner party. 他在正式晚宴上表现得像个无礼的粗人。

Security guards escorted the unruly lout out of the building. 保安护送那个不守规矩的粗鲁男子离开了大楼。

lowbred.meaning: adj. 教养不好的，粗俗的
lowbred.note:
His lowbred remarks offended many guests at the banquet. 他粗俗的言论冒犯了宴会上的许多宾客。

She looked down upon his lowbred manners and rough speech. 她看不起他教养不佳的举止和粗鲁的谈吐。

lubricious.meaning: adj. 滑溜的，好色的，淫荡的
lubricious.note:
The politician was notorious for his lubricious behavior and scandals. 这位政客因其好色的行为和丑闻而臭名昭著。

He flashed a lubricious smile that made her feel uneasy. 他露出一个让人感到不安的淫邪微笑。

lucre.meaning: n. 钱财，金钱（常含贬义）
lucre.note:
He abandoned his artistic integrity in pursuit of filthy lucre. 为了追求肮脏的钱财，他放弃了艺术操守。

Many scandals are motivated solely by a lust for ill-gotten lucre. 许多丑闻完全是由对不义之财的贪婪所驱动的。

lucubrate.meaning: v. 刻苦钻研，深夜苦读
lucubrate.note:
The scholar spent countless nights in his study to lucubrate on philosophy. 学者在书房里度过了无数个夜晚，刻苦钻研哲学。

His latest book is the result of years of quiet lucubration. 他最近的书是多年安静苦读研究的成果。

lure.meaning: v. 诱惑，引诱；n. 诱饵，魅力
lure.note:
Advertisements use free gifts to lure customers into the store. 广告利用免费礼品来诱惑顾客进店。

The high salary proved to be a powerful lure for young graduates. 高薪被证明对年轻毕业生有着强大的诱惑力。

luscious.meaning: adj. 甘美可口的，诱人的
luscious.note:
The dessert table was loaded with luscious chocolate cakes and fruit tarts. 甜点桌上摆满了甘美诱人的巧克力蛋糕和水果塔。

She enjoyed the luscious scent of blooming roses in the garden. 她享受着花园里盛开的玫瑰那迷人的芬芳。

lusty.meaning: adj. 精力充沛的，健壮的，宏亮的
lusty.note:
The newborn baby let out a healthy and lusty cry. 新生儿发出了健康而宏亮的啼哭声。

Despite his old age, he maintained a remarkably lusty constitution. 尽管年事已高，他依然保持着极为健壮的体魄。

lynch.meaning: v. 私刑处死，暴民审判
lynch.note:
The historical novel describes how an innocent man was almost lynched by a mob. 这部历史小说描述了一个无辜的人险些被暴民私刑处死的情景。

Local communities fought hard against the injustice of racial lynching. 当地社区坚决反对种族私刑的不公义行为。

mackintosh.note:
He buttoned up his heavy mackintosh before stepping out into the pouring rain. 他在冒着倾盆大雨出门前扣紧了厚重的防水雨衣。

She hung her wet mackintosh on the rack by the front door. 她把湿漉漉的防水雨衣挂在前门旁的架子上。

maculate.meaning: adj. 有斑点的，有污点的；v. 弄污
maculate.note:
The rare bird species features maculate feathers of brown and white. 这种珍稀鸟类具有棕白相间的斑点羽毛。

Careless mistakes will maculate an otherwise perfect report. 粗心的错误会玷污一份原本完美的报告。

maestro.note:
The renowned maestro raised his baton and the orchestra began to play. 这位著名的大师举起指挥棒，管弦乐队开始演奏。

He is considered a culinary maestro in the world of French pastry. 他被认为是法式甜点界的烹饪大师。

magniloquent.meaning: adj. 夸大其词的，宏大高傲的
magniloquent.note:
His magniloquent speech failed to impress the practical businessmen. 他夸大其词的演讲未能给务实的商人们留下深刻印象。

She disliked politicians who hid simple truths behind magniloquent words. 她不喜欢那些把简单真相藏在浮夸言辞背后的政客。

maim.note:
Landmines left behind in the fields continue to kill and maim innocent civilians. 遗留在田野里的地雷继续杀害和致残无辜平民。

The violent accident could easily have killed or maimed him. 那场激烈的事故差一点就让他丧命或终身残疾。

makeshift.meaning: adj. 临时凑合的，代用的；n. 权宜之计
makeshift.note:
They built a makeshift shelter using branches and plastic tarps. 他们用树枝和塑料防水布搭建了一个临时避难所。

Using a book as a doorstop was just a makeshift solution. 用书来挡门只是一种权宜之计。

malediction.note:
The witch muttered a dark malediction against the kingdom. 女巫低声念出了针对王国的恶毒诅咒。

He left the room under his breath with muttered maledictions. 他嘴里嘟囔着诅咒，气冲冲地离开了房间。

malefactor.note:
The police launched a manhunt to capture the dangerous malefactor. 警方展开搜捕行动以抓捕这个危险的罪犯。

Society must protect itself from habitual malefactors. 社会必须保护自己免受惯犯的侵害。

maleficent.meaning: adj. 行恶的，有害的，犯罪的
maleficent.note:
Fairy tales often feature a maleficent witch plotting against the royal family. 童话故事中经常出现密谋反对皇室的邪恶女巫。

Environmental laws aim to curb the maleficent effects of industrial waste. 环境法规旨在遏制工业废物有害的影响。

malice.note:
She bore no malice toward the person who had criticized her work. 她对批评她工作的那个人毫无恶意。

The prosecution had to prove that the crime was committed with malice. 检方必须证明这起犯罪是怀着恶意实施的。

malignant.meaning: adj. 恶性的，有害的，恶毒的
malignant.note:
Biopsy results confirmed that the tumor was malignant. 活检结果证实该肿瘤是恶性的。

A malignant rumor began to spread quickly through the office. 一条恶意的谣言开始在办公室里快速传播。

mallet.note:
The carpenter used a wooden mallet to tap the chisel firmly. 木匠用木槌紧紧敲击凿子。

Players swung their mallets to hit the wooden ball across the lawn. 球员们挥舞着木槌将木球击过草坪。

malodor.note:
A strong malodor emanated from the blocked drainage pipe. 堵塞的排水管里散发出浓烈的恶臭。

They tried to mask the malodor using air fresheners. 他们试图用空气清新剂掩盖恶臭。

manacle.meaning: n. 手铐，脚镣；v. 戴手铐，束缚
manacle.note:
The suspect was led into the courtroom with heavy iron manacles. 嫌疑人戴着沉重的铁手铐被带进法庭。

Bureaucratic rules can manacle creativity and innovation. 官僚主义规则会束缚创造力和创新精神。

maneuver.meaning: n. 策略，演习；v. 巧妙操作，调动
maneuver.note:
It requires great skill to maneuver a large truck into a tight parking space. 把一辆大卡车停进狭窄的车位需要高超的技巧。

The political maneuver was designed to gain support from undecided voters. 这一政治策略旨在获得未决选民的支持。

mangy.meaning: adj. 患疥癣的，破烂的，肮脏的
mangy.note:
A thin, mangy dog wandered around the alley looking for scraps. 一只瘦弱、患病的狗在小巷里徘徊寻找残羹剩饭。

He wore a mangy old coat that had seen better days. 他穿着一件破烂不堪、饱经风霜的旧外套。

maraud.meaning: v. 掠夺，袭击，四处劫掠
maraud.note:
Bandits used to maraud across the remote mountain passes. 匪徒过去常常在偏远的山隘间四处劫掠。

Wild wolves began to maraud the sheep farms at night. 野狼开始在夜间袭击并掠夺养羊场。

mariner.note:
Experienced mariners knew how to read the stars for navigation. 有经验的水手知道如何通过观察星星来进行导航。

The old ballad tells the tale of an unlucky ancient mariner. 这首古老的民谣讲述了一个不幸的老水手的故事。

marrow.note:
Bone marrow transplants can save the lives of leukemia patients. 骨髓移植可以拯救白血病患者的生命。

The bone-chilling cold went straight through to his marrow. 刺骨的寒冷直透他的骨髓。

matador.note:
The crowd cheered as the matador entered the bullring with his cape. 当斗牛士拿着披风走进斗牛场时，人群欢呼起来。

He trained for years before earning the right to perform as a lead matador. 他训练了多年，才获得作为首席斗牛士表演的权利。

matriarchy.note:
Anthropologists studied the customs of a traditional matriarchy in the region. 人类学家研究了该地区传统母系社会的习俗。

In this ancient community, inheritance is traced through a matriarchy. 在这个古老的社区中，继承权是通过母系社会来追踪的。

matriculate.meaning: v. 录取入学，成为大学注册学生
matriculate.note:
She was thrilled to matriculate at her dream university in autumn. 她很高兴能在秋天考入她梦想的大学。

All incoming freshmen must matriculate before attending classes. 所有新入学的本科生在上课前都必须办理入学注册手续。

maxim.note:
His guiding maxim in business was to always put the customer first. 他在商业上的指导格言是永远把客户放在第一位。

Quality over quantity is a useful maxim to live by. 重质不重量是一条很有用的生活准则。

mayhem.note:
The sudden power outage caused absolute mayhem in the shopping mall. 突然的停电导致购物中心一片大乱。

He was charged with criminal mayhem after the violent street fight. 他因那场激烈的街头斗殴而被控刑事伤害罪。

medicate.note:
Doctors carefully medicate patients to manage chronic pain. 医生仔细给患者用药以控制慢性疼痛。

It is dangerous to medicate yourself without consulting a doctor. 不咨询医生就自行用药是危险的。

megalomania.note:
His growing political power fueled a dangerous sense of megalomania. 他不断增长的政治权力助长了一种危险的夸大狂心态。

The dictator suffered from extreme megalomania, believing he was invincible. 这位独裁者患有极端的夸大狂，认为自己是不可战胜的。

memento.note:
She kept a small seashell as a memento of their summer vacation. 她留着一小枚贝壳作为他们暑假度假的纪念品。

He bought an antique pocket watch as a memento of his retirement. 他买了一块古董怀表作为退休纪念物。

menial.meaning: adj. 卑微的，低贱的（指工作）；n. 仆人
menial.note:
He started his career doing menial tasks in the office kitchen. 他的职业生涯是从在办公室厨房做卑微的杂务开始的。

She felt that her talents were being wasted on menial chores. 她觉得自己的才华被浪费在卑微的家务杂活上了。

mermaid.note:
The fairy tale featured a magical mermaid living deep in the ocean. 这个童话故事讲述了一个生活在海洋深处的奇妙美人鱼。

A bronze statue of a mermaid sits on a rock by the harbor. 一座美人鱼的青铜雕像坐落在港口旁的一块岩石上。

mesmerism.meaning: n. 催眠术，催眠状态，迷人魅力
mesmerism.note:
Early psychologists experimented with mesmerism to treat hysteria. 早期的心理学家尝试用催眠术来治疗歇斯底里症。

The speaker held the audience under a spell of pure mesmerism. 演讲者以其纯粹的迷人魅力吸引住了听众。

mesmerize.meaning: v. 施催眠术，迷住，迷惑
mesmerize.note:
The children were completely mesmerized by the magic show. 孩子们完全被魔术表演迷住了。

She was mesmerized by the dancer's graceful movements. 她被舞者优美的动作深深吸引了。

metallurgy.note:
Advances in metallurgy made it possible to produce stronger steel. 冶金学的发展使得生产更强韧的钢材成为可能。

He studied metallurgy at the university to work in the manufacturing industry. 他在大学学习冶金学以便在制造业工作。

midget.meaning: n. 侏儒，极小之物；adj. 极小的
midget.note:
The model airplane was built to precise midget proportions. 这架模型飞机是按照精密的微型比例建造的。

He parked his midget car in the smallest available space. 他把自己的微型汽车停在了最小的可用车位里。

mien.note:
Despite the crisis, the leader maintained a calm and confident mien. 尽管面临危机，这位领导人依然保持着冷静自信的风度。

Her serious mien made it clear she was not joking. 她严肃的神态表明她并不是在开玩笑。

miraculous.meaning: adj. 奇迹般的，不可思议的
miraculous.note:
All passengers survived the plane crash in what was described as miraculous. 所有乘客都在这场被称为奇迹般的空难中幸存下来。

His health showed a miraculous recovery after the new treatment. 经过新疗法后，他的健康状况出现了奇迹般的恢复。

miscellany.note:
The antique shop contained a fascinating miscellany of old books and art. 这家古董店里藏有各种迷人的旧书和艺术品杂集。

Her desk drawer was filled with a miscellany of pens, notes, and clips. 她的书桌抽屉里塞满了各种笔、便签和夹子的混合物。

missive.meaning: n. 信件，公函（多指正式或长信）
missive.note:
He received a formal missive from the head office on Monday morning. 他在周一早上收到了一份总公司的正式公函。

She sealed the official missive with red wax. 她用红蜡封好了这份官方信函。

mistimed.meaning: adj. 时机不当的，选择不合时宜的
mistimed.note:
His joke was terribly mistimed and made everyone uncomfortable. 他的笑话开得极不是时候，让所有人都感到不舒服。

The announcement was seen as a poorly mistimed move by the company. 这一宣布被视为公司一个时机极不恰当的举动。

mistral.meaning: n. 密史脱拉风（吹拂法国南部及地中海的强冷寒风）
mistral.note:
A cold mistral blew through the vineyards, chilling the autumn air. 一阵寒冷的密史脱拉风吹过葡萄园，使秋天的空气变得阴冷。

Sailors secured their boats tightly ahead of the approaching mistral. 水手们在逼近的密史脱拉风到来之前把船只紧紧固定好。

molest.note:
Hikers were warned not to approach or molest the local wildlife. 徒步旅行者被警告不要靠近或骚扰当地的野生动物。

Parks should be safe places where children can play without being molested. 公园应该是安全的地方，孩子们可以在那里玩耍而不受骚扰。

monograph.note:
The professor published a comprehensive monograph on marine biology. 这位教授出版了一部关于海洋生物学的综合专著。

Researchers often cite this monograph for its detailed historical data. 研究人员经常引用这篇专著，因为其包含详细的历史数据。

monopolize.note:
The company tried to monopolize the market by buying out smaller rivals. 这家公司试图通过买断较小的竞争对手来垄断市场。

He tended to monopolize the conversation at every dinner party. 他在每一次晚宴上总是独占话语权。

monstrous.meaning: adj. 巨大的，丑恶的，骇人听闻的
monstrous.note:
The corrupt officials committed a monstrous crime against the citizens. 这些腐败官员对市民犯下了骇人听闻的罪行。

A monstrous wave crashed over the seawall during the storm. 暴风雨期间，一道巨大的巨浪冲垮了海堤。

moody.meaning: adj. 情绪化的，喜怒无常的，忧郁的
moody.note:
He can be quite moody, switching from happy to silent in minutes. 他可能非常情绪化，能在几分钟内从开心变得沉默寡言。

The artist captured the moody atmosphere of the stormy sea on canvas. 艺术家在画布上捕捉到了暴风雨大海忧郁的氛围。

moor.meaning: v. 停泊，系船；n. 荒野，荒地
moor.note:
The fishermen decided to moor their boats safely in the sheltered cove. 渔民们决定把船安全停泊在避风的海湾里。

Fog rolled across the open moor as evening approached. 随着傍晚临近，大雾在开阔的荒原上弥漫开来。

mope.meaning: v. 闷闷不乐，消沉，郁郁寡欢
mope.note:
There is no use sitting around the house and moping all day. 整天坐在家里闷闷不乐是毫无用处的。

After failing the exam, he spent the weekend moping in his room. 考试不及格后，他在房间里郁郁寡欢地度过了整个周末。

morass.note:
The heavy truck sank deep into the coastal morass. 沉重的卡车深深陷入了沿海的沼泽中。

He struggled to free his company from a bureaucratic morass. 他努力让他的公司摆脱官僚主义的泥潭。

moron.note:
Leaving the front door wide open while on vacation is a moron move. 度假时把大门敞开简直是白痴行为。

He felt like a complete moron after dropping his phone in the toilet. 把手机掉进马桶后，他觉得自己像个十足的笨蛋。

motile.meaning: adj. 能动的，自动的（生物学）
motile.note:
Under the microscope, scientists observed motile bacteria swimming around. 在显微镜下，科学家观察到能动的细菌游来游去。

Sperm cells must be highly motile to successfully fertilize an egg. 精子细胞必须具有高度的运动能力才能成功使卵子受精。

mottle.meaning: v. 斑驳，使有斑点；n. 斑点
mottle.note:
Sunlight filtered through the trees, creating a mottle pattern on the ground. 阳光透过树木过滤，在地面上形成了斑驳的图案。

The disease caused the plant leaves to mottle with yellow spots. 这种疾病导致植物叶子出现斑驳的黄斑。

mountebank.meaning: n. 江湖骗子，卖假药的人
mountebank.note:
The traveling merchant was exposed as a common mountebank selling fake cures. 这名巡回商人被揭露为兜售假药的普通江湖骗子。

Do not trust smooth-talking mountebanks promising overnight wealth. 不要相信承诺一夜暴富的花言巧语的江湖骗子。

muddle.meaning: v. 弄乱，搞砸；n. 混乱，糊涂状态
muddle.note:
His instructions were so unclear that they just muddled everyone further. 他的指示太不清晰了，反而把大家都搞糊涂了。

The accounts were in a complete muddle before the auditor arrived. 在审计师到达之前，账目陷入了一片混乱。

muddy.meaning: adj. 泥泞的，浑浊的；v. 使泥泞
muddy.note:
The dogs tracked muddy footprints all over the clean kitchen floor. 狗在干净的厨房地板上留下了泥泞的脚印。

Heavy rain began to muddy the unpaved construction site. 大雨开始使未铺砌的建筑工地变得泥泞不堪。

muggy.note:
The summer air was heavy and muggy before the afternoon thunderstorm. 午后雷雨来临之前，夏日的空气沉闷而闷热。

We felt sticky and uncomfortable in the muggy tropical climate. 在闷热的热带气候中，我们感到黏糊糊且非常不舒服。

mulct.meaning: v. 罚款，诈取；n. 罚金
mulct.note:
Corrupt officials sought to mulct wealthy merchants through unjust taxes. 腐败官员试图通过不公正的税收向富商诈取钱财。

The speeder was punished with a heavy financial mulct. 超速者受到了沉重经济罚款的惩罚。

multifarious.meaning: adj. 多种多样的，各种各样的
multifarious.note:
The company deals in a multifarious range of consumer electronics. 这家公司经营种类繁多的消费电子产品。

She was known for her multifarious interests, ranging from painting to coding. 她以兴趣广泛而闻名，从绘画到编程无所不包。

multitude.note:
A multitude of fans gathered outside the stadium to greet the band. 大量粉丝聚集在体育场外迎接乐队。

There are a multitude of reasons why this strategy needs to be updated. 有众多的理由说明这个策略需要更新。

muniments.meaning: n. 产权契据，证明文件
muniments.note:
The family kept their ancient land deeds and muniments in a secure vault. 这家人把他们的古代土地契约和产权证明文件放在一个安全的保险库里。

Lawyers examined the old muniments to verify property ownership. 律师检查了旧的产权契据以核实房产所有权。

musty.meaning: adj. 发霉的，有霉味的，陈旧的
musty.note:
The old basement smelled strongly of dampness and musty books. 老地下室里充满了潮湿和发霉书本的浓烈气味。

His ideas on management felt a bit musty and out of touch. 他关于管理的想法显得有些陈旧且脱节。

mutilate.note:
The ancient sculpture was badly mutilated during the war. 那尊古代雕塑在战争中遭到严重损毁。

Do not tear or mutilate official documents. 请勿撕毁或损坏正式文件。

mutinous.meaning: adj. 叛变的，反叛的，造反的
mutinous.note:
The captain struggled to control the mutinous crew on the ship. 船长艰难地控制着船上那些有叛变倾向的水手。

Mutinous whispers spread quickly among the dissatisfied workers. 造反的低语在不满的工人们中间迅速蔓延。

muzzy.meaning: adj. 头脑糊涂的，迷糊的，模糊的
muzzy.note:
He woke up with a muzzy head after sleeping for only three hours. 只睡了三个小时后，他醒来时感到脑子迷迷糊糊的。

Her memories of that terrifying night remained muzzy and unclear. 她对那个可怕夜晚的记忆依然模糊不清。

naivety.note:
Her youthful naivety made her trust strangers too easily. 她年轻的天真使她太容易信任陌生人。

He soon lost his financial naivety after getting scammed in the market. 在市场上被骗后，他很快失去了财务上的幼稚。

nasal.note:
He spoke with a distinct nasal twang that annoyed his listeners. 他说话带着明显的鼻音，这让听众感到烦恼。

Cold weather often causes nasal congestion and difficulty breathing. 寒冷的天气经常引起鼻塞和呼吸困难。

natation.note:
The school curriculum included mandatory classes in basic natation. 学校课程包括必修的基层游泳课。

She showed exceptional skill in artistic natation competitions. 她在花样游泳比赛中表现出非凡的技巧。

naysayer.meaning: n. 唱反调的人，否定者，悲观者
naysayer.note:
Do not let perennial naysayers discourage you from trying. 不要让习惯唱反调的人打击你尝试的积极性。

Despite the critics and naysayers, the project was a huge success. 尽管有批评家和唱反调的人，这个项目还是取得了巨大的成功。

necessitous.meaning: adj. 贫困的，极为穷困的
necessitous.note:
The charity organization provided food and shelter for necessitous families. 慈善机构为贫困家庭提供食物和住所。

Aid was quickly dispatched to support necessitous communities after the disaster. 灾难发生后，援助迅速被派遣以支持贫困社区。

necropolis.note:
Archaeologists uncovered an ancient necropolis dating back to the pharaohs. 考古学家发掘了一座可追溯至法老时期的大型古墓地。

The historical site features an extensive underground necropolis. 该历史遗址具有广泛的地下陵墓群。

nemesis.meaning: n. 报应，天罚，强大的对手
nemesis.note:
Mathematics proved to be his ultimate academic nemesis during high school. 数学被证明是他高中时期最大的学业克星。

The detective finally caught up with his lifelong criminal nemesis. 这位侦探终于抓住了他一生的犯罪死敌。

neonate.meaning: n. 新生儿（出生后四周内）
neonate.note:
Specialized nurses monitor the vital signs of every neonate in the ward. 专业护士监测病房里每个新生儿的生命体征。

Neonates require delicate and constant medical attention. 新生儿需要细致且持续的医疗护理。

nephritis.note:
The patient was hospitalized due to a severe case of acute nephritis. 该患者因严重的急性肾炎病例而住院治疗。

Symptoms of nephritis often include swelling and changes in urine. 肾炎的症状通常包括水肿和尿液变化。

nestle.meaning: v. 舒适地安顿，依偎，紧挨
nestle.note:
A small village nestled peacefully at the foot of the mountains. 一个小村庄宁静地坐落在山脚下。

The child began to nestle close to her mother for warmth and comfort. 孩子开始依偎在母亲身旁以取暖和寻求安慰。

nestling.note:
Strong winds blew a helpless nestling out of the high tree branch. 强风把一只无助的雏鸟从高高的树枝上吹落下来。

Parent birds worked constantly to feed their hungry nestlings. 亲鸟不停地工作以喂养它们饥饿的雏鸟。

nethermost.meaning: adj. 最底部的，最下层的
nethermost.note:
He searched the nethermost shelves of the archive for the old file. 他在档案馆的最底层书架上寻找那份旧档案。

Submarines can dive deep into the nethermost layers of the ocean. 潜艇可以深入到海洋的最下层。

neurosis.meaning: n. 神经官能症，神经症
neurosis.note:
Therapy helped her cope with deep-seated anxiety and neurosis. 心理治疗帮助她应对深层的焦虑和神经官能症。

Modern work pressures can trigger various forms of neurosis. 现代工作压力可能会引发各种形式的神经症。

niggard.meaning: n. 吝啬鬼；adj. 吝啬的
niggard.note:
The wealthy owner was known as a niggard who never tipped service staff. 这位富有的业主被称为一个从不给服务人员小费的吝啬鬼。

They offered a niggardly donation to the disaster relief fund. 他们向救灾基金提供了一笔吝啬的捐款。

niggling.meaning: adj. 琐碎的，令人烦恼的，微不足道的
niggling.note:
He was bothered by a niggling injury in his right knee. 他一直受到右膝一处隐痛微小伤势的困扰。

After resolving the major issues, they had a few niggling details left. 在解决主要问题后，他们还剩下一些琐碎的细节要处理。

nihilism.note:
Philosophical nihilism questions whether life has any objective meaning. 哲学虚无主义质疑生活是否具有任何客观意义。

Disillusionment with politics sometimes leads to youthful nihilism. 对政治的幻灭有时会导致青年时期的虚无主义。

nippers.meaning: n. 钳子，小夹钳，手铐（俚语）
nippers.note:
The mechanic used a pair of steel nippers to cut the wire. 机械师用一把钢钳剪断了铁丝。

Crabs use their sharp nippers to defend themselves against predators. 螃蟹用它们锋利的双螯来防御捕食者。

nipping.meaning: adj. 刺骨的，寒冷的，尖锐的
nipping.note:
A nipping autumn breeze made everyone pull their coats tighter. 刺骨的秋风让每个人都把大衣裹得更紧了。

She felt a nipping pain in her fingers from the cold. 她感到手指由于寒冷而产生一种刺痛感。

nonesuch.meaning: n. 无双的人，绝无仅有的人或物
nonesuch.note:
Considered a nonesuch in scholarship, she graduated at the top of her class. 被视为学术界绝无仅有的人才，她以优异成绩毕业。

The vintage car was a true nonesuch among automobile collectors. 这辆老爷车在汽车收藏家中是真正的绝无仅有之宝。

nonpareil.meaning: adj. 无与伦比的；n. 绝无仅有的人
nonpareil.note:
Her skills as a violinist were truly nonpareil in the orchestra. 她作为小提琴手的技艺在乐队里真的是无与伦比。

The chef was a nonpareil when it came to preparing French desserts. 在制作法式甜点方面，这位厨师是无与伦比的大师。

noose.note:
The rope was tied into a tight noose at the end. 绳子的末端被系成了一个紧密的套索。

He felt the political noose tightening around his career. 他感到政治套索正越收越紧，威胁着他的职业生涯。

notability.meaning: n. 名人，声望，值得注意
notability.note:
Several local notabilities attended the ribbon-cutting ceremony. 几位当地名流出席了剪彩仪式。

The discovery achieved international notability within weeks. 这项发现在几周内获得了国际声望。

nude.meaning: adj. 赤裸的，裸体的；n. 裸体像
nude.note:
The art class practiced drawing a classic human nude model. 美术课练习画经典的裸体人体模特。

Swimming nude in the lake at night was a risky adventure. 夜晚在湖里裸泳是一场危险的冒险。

numerology.note:
She consulted a practitioner of numerology to pick her wedding date. 她咨询了一位数字占卜师来挑选婚礼日期。

He was fascinated by the pseudo-science of ancient numerology. 他对古代数字占卜的伪科学很着迷。

numinous.meaning: adj. 神圣的，精神上的，超自然的
numinous.note:
Ancient temples often evoke a deeply numinous and peaceful feeling. 古老的寺庙通常会唤起一种深深的神圣和平静感。

She experienced a numinous presence while walking through the silent forest. 当她穿过寂静的森林时，她体验到了一种超自然的存在感。

numismatic.meaning: adj. 钱币学的，硬币收藏的
numismatic.note:
He attended a major numismatic convention to buy rare ancient coins. 他参加了一个大型钱币学大会以购买珍贵的古代硬币。

The museum houses a priceless numismatic collection. 该博物馆收藏了一批无价的钱币藏品。

nuptial.meaning: adj. 婚礼的，婚姻的；n. 婚礼
nuptial.note:
The happy couple sent out elegant nuptial invitations to their friends. 这对幸福的夫妇向朋友们发出了典雅的婚礼请柬。

Birds often display bright feathers during their annual nuptial season. 鸟类通常在一年一度的求偶繁殖季节展现鲜艳的羽毛。

nymph.meaning: n. 仙女，若虫（昆虫幼虫）
nymph.note:
Greek mythology tells stories of beautiful water nymphs living in rivers. 希腊神话讲述了居住在河流中的美丽水泽仙女的故事。

Insects undergo a stage as a nymph before becoming adults. 昆虫在变成成虫之前要经历若虫阶段。

oar.note:
He gripped the wooden oar tightly and pulled hard against the current. 他紧紧握住木桨，顶着水流用力划水。

One of the oars broke during the rough boat ride through the rapids. 在穿过急流的颠簸航行中，其中一支桨断了。

oatmeal.note:
She started her cold winter morning with a warm bowl of oatmeal. 她在一个寒冷的冬日早晨以一碗热腾腾的燕麦粥开始新的一天。

Mix the oatmeal with honey and fresh berries for a healthy breakfast. 将燕麦片与蜂蜜和新鲜浆果混合，作为健康的早餐。

obelisk.note:
A tall ancient stone obelisk stood proudly in the center of the plaza. 一座高大的古代石方尖碑骄傲地矗立在广场中央。

Tourists gathered around the Egyptian obelisk to take photographs. 游客们聚集在埃及方尖碑周围拍照。

oblation.note:
Ancient priests offered wine and food as an oblation to the gods. 古代祭司供奉酒和食物作为对神的祭献。

The ritual concluded with a symbolic oblation on the altar. 仪式在祭坛上的一次象征性祭献中结束。

observance.note:
Strict observance of safety regulations is mandatory for all workers. 所有工人必须严格遵守安全规章制度。

The national holiday involves the traditional observance of historical customs. 这个国家假日包含对历史习俗的传统庆祝活动。

obtrude.note:
He tried not to obtrude his personal opinions into the professional meeting. 他尽量不把自己的个人意见强加到专业会议中。

Unpleasant memories began to obtrude into her quiet thoughts. 不愉快的记忆开始闯入她平静的思绪中。

occidental.meaning: adj. 西方的，欧美的；n. 西方人
occidental.note:
The museum features an impressive collection of both oriental and occidental art. 该博物馆展出了令人印象深刻的东方和西方艺术收藏品。

He studied occidental philosophy during his years in university. 他在大学期间研究了西方哲学。

ocular.meaning: adj. 眼睛的，视觉的；n. 目镜
ocular.note:
Eyewitness accounts provided direct ocular evidence of the crime. 目击者的陈述为犯罪提供了直接的视觉证据。

The astronomer adjusted the telescope's ocular to get a clearer view. 天文学家调整了望远镜的目镜以获得更清晰的视野。

oddments.note:
The drawer was full of buttons, screws, and other small oddments. 抽屉里塞满了纽扣、螺丝和其他小型零碎物品。

She used leftover yarn and fabric oddments to sew a patchwork quilt. 她用剩余的纱线和零星布料缝制了一条拼布被子。

odoriferous.note:
The greenhouse was filled with various odoriferous tropical flowers. 温室里弥漫着各种芬芳的热带花卉。

Chemistry students handled several odoriferous compounds in the lab. 化学系学生在实验室里处理了几种有强烈气味的化合物。

oligarch.note:
A powerful media oligarch controlled several major television networks. 一个强大的媒体寡头控制了几家主要的电视网。

The country's economy was heavily influenced by a small group of wealthy oligarchs. 该国的经济受一小撮富裕寡头的严重影响。

omnivorous.meaning: adj. 杂食性的，兴趣广泛的
omnivorous.note:
Pigs and bears are well-known examples of omnivorous mammals. 猪和熊是众所周知的杂食性哺乳动物例子。

She is an omnivorous reader who enjoys everything from history to science fiction. 她是一个博览群书的读者，喜欢从历史到科幻小说的所有内容。

onslaught.meaning: n. 猛烈攻击，大举进攻
onslaught.note:
The castle defenders managed to hold off the enemy's fierce onslaught. 城堡守军设法抵挡住了敌人猛烈的攻击。

Retailers prepared themselves for the annual holiday shopping onslaught. 零售商们为一年一度的假日购物热潮做好了准备。

onus.note:
The onus is on the defendant to prove his innocence in court. 被告在法庭上有证明自己无罪的责任。

Parents bear the onus of providing a safe environment for their children. 父母肩负着为孩子提供安全环境的责任。

ooze.meaning: v. 渗出，分泌；n. 软泥，淤泥
ooze.note:
Thick sap began to ooze slowly from the cut bark of the pine tree. 粘稠的树液开始从松树割破的树皮中缓缓渗出。

The boots sank deep into the riverbed ooze. 靴子深深陷入了河床的软泥中。

opiate.meaning: n. 阿片类药物，麻醉剂；adj. 麻醉的
opiate.note:
Doctors use powerful opiates to manage severe postoperative pain. 医生使用强力阿片类药物来控制严重的术后疼痛。

Historical critics viewed complacency as a dangerous opiate for the masses. 批评家将自满视为对大众的一种危险麻醉剂。

optimization.note:
Engineers worked on database optimization to speed up query responses. 工程师致力于数据库优化以加快查询响应速度。

The website focused on search engine optimization to attract more visitors. 该网站专注于搜索引擎优化以吸引更多访问者。

opus.meaning: n. 作品，巨著（尤指音乐或文学）
opus.note:
The symphony is widely considered the composer's crowning opus. 这部交响乐被广泛认为是该作曲家登峰造极的代表作。

He spent ten years writing his philosophical opus. 他花了十年时间写他的哲学巨著。

oracular.meaning: adj. 神谕的，晦涩玄妙的
oracular.note:
The prophet spoke in oracular statements that left followers guessing. 先知用晦涩玄妙的神谕言论发言，让追随者们去猜测。

His advice was often delivered with an oracular and mysterious tone. 他的建议往往带有神谕般神秘的语气。

orchid.note:
She carefully watered the delicate white orchid blooming on her desk. 她小心翼翼地给办公桌上盛开的精致白兰花浇水。

Tropical rainforests are home to thousands of unique orchid species. 热带雨林是数千种独特兰花品种的家园。

orifice.note:
Water sprayed from a tiny metal orifice at the base of the fountain. 水从喷泉底部的微小金属孔中喷射出来。

Protective masks prevent dust from entering respiratory orifices. 防护口罩可阻止灰尘进入呼吸器官孔道。

orotund.meaning: adj. 洪亮的，华丽宏伟的（声音或文风）
orotund.note:
The actor delivered his dramatic lines in an orotund voice. 这位演员以洪亮的声音发表了他的戏剧台词。

His writing style was criticized for being overly orotund and pompous. 他的写作风格因过于浮夸宏大而受到批评。

otiose.meaning: adj. 多余的，无用的，闲散的
otiose.note:
Adding more rules to the system would be completely otiose. 给系统添加更多规则将完全是多余的。

He spent his retirement years living an otiose life in the countryside. 他在乡下过着闲散的退休生活。

outfox.meaning: v. 以智取胜，机智过人
outfox.note:
The clever detective managed to outfox the experienced criminal. 这位聪明的侦探设法智取了经验丰富的罪犯。

In the chess game, the young player tried to outfox the grandmaster. 在国际象棋比赛中，年轻选手试图智取特级大师。

overweening.meaning: adj. 自负的，傲慢的，过分的
overweening.note:
His overweening arrogance made him deeply unpopular among colleagues. 他过分自负的傲慢使他在同事中极不受欢迎。

She suffered due to her overweening ambition and refusal to listen. 她由于过度的野心和拒绝倾听而吃了苦头。

palaver.meaning: n. 废话，啰嗦的讨论；v. 闲聊
palaver.note:
Let us skip the unnecessary palaver and get straight to business. 让我们省去不必要的废话，直接切入正题。

They spent hours in idle palaver before signing the contract. 在签署合同之前，他们花了几个小时进行无聊的闲聊。

palings.note:
Several wooden palings were broken on the old garden fence. 旧花园栅栏上的几根木条断了。

He painted the white palings of the yard fence to freshen its look. 他给院子篱笆的白色木条刷上漆，使其焕然一新。

pamper.meaning: v. 纵容，精心照顾，娇惯
pamper.note:
She loves to pamper herself with a spa day after a hard week. 在辛苦工作了一周后，她喜欢用做水疗来好好犒劳自己。

Parents should be careful not to pamper their children too much. 父母应该注意不要过度娇惯孩子。

pane.note: A stray baseball shattered the glass pane of the front window. 一个飞来的棒球击碎了前窗的玻璃。,Raindrops trickled down the cold window pane during the storm. 暴风雨期间，雨滴顺着冰冷的窗玻璃缓缓流下。

panoramic.note: The hotel room offered a stunning panoramic view of the ocean. 酒店房间提供了令人惊叹的海洋全景。,From the mountain top, hikers enjoyed a panoramic view of the valley below. 从山顶上，徒步旅行者欣赏到了下方山谷的全景。

pantechnicon.meaning: n. 大型搬家货车，仓库
pantechnicon.note: A large pantechnicon backed up to the house to load furniture. 一辆大型搬家货车倒车停到房子旁来装运家具。,Household goods were packed into the pantechnicon for transport. 家用物品被装进搬家货车以便运输。

pantheon.note: Ancient Greeks built temples to honor gods in their pantheon. 古希腊人建造寺庙来供奉他们万神殿中的诸神。,He secured a permanent place in the pantheon of literary legends. 他在文学传奇的名人堂里稳占了一席之地。

parley.meaning: v. 谈判，会谈；n. 和谈
parley.note: The two warring armies agreed to hold a brief parley at dawn. 两支交战军队同意在黎明时分举行一次简短的和谈。,The commander requested a parley to discuss terms of surrender. 指挥官请求进行一次会谈以讨论投降条款。

parlous.meaning: adj. 危险的，可怕的，棘手的
parlous.note: The company's finances were in a parlous state after the market crash. 市场崩盘后，该公司的财务状况处于危险的境地。,Economists warned of the parlous condition of global trade. 经济学家警告全球贸易处于危险状况。

parochial.meaning: adj. 狭隘的，地方性的，教区的
parochial.note: His views on foreign policy were criticized as too parochial. 他关于外交政策的观点被批评为过于狭隘。,She attended a local parochial school during her elementary years. 她在小学时期就读于一所当地的教区学校。

parturition.note: Veterinarians monitored the mare closely as parturition approached. 随着分娩临近，兽医密切监测着母马的情况。,The physiological process of parturition can be complex and demanding. 分娩的生理过程可能复杂且具有挑战性。

pastor.note: The church pastor delivered an inspiring sermon on Sunday morning. 教堂牧师在周日上午发表了一篇鼓舞人心的布道。,He worked closely with the local community pastor to organize charity events. 他与当地社区牧师紧密合作以组织慈善活动。

pathetic.meaning: adj. 可怜的，令人同情的，悲哀的
pathetic.note: The stray puppy gave a pathetic whine when it started to rain. 开始下雨时，那只流浪小狗发出了一声可怜的呜咽。,His excuse for missing the deadline was frankly pathetic. 他错过截止日期的借口坦白讲实在太可悲了。

pathos.note: The film script was filled with deep emotional pathos and drama. 电影剧本充满了深厚的感情色彩与戏剧化的悲情。,The actor conveyed a powerful sense of pathos in his final scene. 这位演员在他最后的场景中传达了一种强烈的悲伤感。

pawn.meaning: n. 典当，兵（国际象棋）；v. 典当
pawn.note: He had to pawn his expensive watch to pay his rent on time. 他不得不典当他昂贵的手表来按时支付房租。,In chess, a pawn can be promoted if it reaches the opposite end. 在国际象棋中，如果兵走到棋盘的对端就可以升变。

peaky.meaning: adj. 面容憔悴的，病容的
peaky.note: The child looked a bit peaky after recovering from the flu. 孩子在流感康复后看起来面容有些憔悴。,You look rather peaky today; perhaps you should rest. 你今天看起来气色不太好，也许你应该休息一下。

peculate.note: The treasurer was accused of trying to peculate funds from the account. 财务主管被指控试图从账户中挪用公款。,Strict financial controls help prevent employees from attempting to peculate. 严格的财务控制有助于防止员工企图盗用公款。

pecuniary.meaning: adj. 金钱的，金钱方面的
pecuniary.note: She faced heavy pecuniary difficulties following the business failure. 商业失败后，她面临着沉重的金钱困难。,The judge had no direct pecuniary interest in the lawsuit. 法官在诉讼中没有直接的金钱利益。

peddle.meaning: v. 叫卖，兜售，散布（思想）
peddle.note: Street vendors walked around town to peddle handmade crafts. 小贩们在镇上四处走动兜售手工工艺品。,Some tabloids peddle sensational gossip just to sell newspapers. 一些小报兜售轰动性的八卦新闻只是为了卖报纸。

peek.meaning: v. 偷看，窥视；n. 偷看
peek.note: She took a quick peek through the curtains to see who was at the door. 她飞快地透过窗帘偷看了一下是谁在门外。,Children love to take a sneak peek at their wrapped birthday presents. 小孩子们喜欢偷看他们包好的生日礼物。

peep.meaning: v. 窥视，吱吱叫；n. 偷看，微弱声音
peep.note: Tiny baby chicks made a soft peep inside the incubator. 孵化器内的小雏鸡发出了柔和的吱吱声。,He could not resist a quick peep into the mysterious box. 他忍不住对那个神秘的盒子偷看了一眼。

peery.meaning: adj. 疑神疑鬼的，警惕的
peery.note: He gave a peery glance around the room before speaking. 他在发言前警惕地环视了房间一周。,Her peery behavior made everyone suspect she was hiding something. 她疑神疑鬼的行为让每个人都怀疑她隐瞒了什么。

pelt.meaning: v. 投掷，连续攻击；n. 毛皮
pelt.note: Children began to pelt each other with snowballs in the yard. 孩子们开始在院子里用雪球互相砸对方。,Heavy rain continued to pelt against the glass windows all night. 大雨整夜连续不断地打在玻璃窗上。

penetration.note: The new marketing campaign increased market penetration in Asia. 新的营销活动提高了在亚洲市场的渗透率。,The detective showed remarkable intellectual penetration in solving crimes. 这位侦探在破案中表现出非凡的智慧洞察力。

pensive.meaning: adj. 沉思的，心事重重的
pensive.note: She sat by the window in a pensive mood, watching the rain fall. 她以沉思的心情坐在窗边，看着雨水落下。,His pensive expression revealed how deeply worried he was. 他沉思的表情暴露了他有多么深切的担忧。

penumbra.meaning: n. 半影，边缘地带，模糊不清的地方
penumbra.note: During the eclipse, the moon passed through the earth's penumbra. 日食期间，月亮穿过了地球的半影。,Ethical dilemmas often lie in the legal penumbra between right and wrong. 伦理困境往往存在于对与错之间模糊的边缘地带。

peptic.note: Stress and poor diet can contribute to the development of peptic ulcers. 压力和不良饮食会导致胃溃疡的发展。,Medical researchers study various peptic disorders in the digestive system. 医学研究人员研究消化系统中的各种消化性疾病。

percolate.note: Rainwater began to percolate down through the layers of rock. 雨水开始透过岩石层向下渗透。,Fresh coffee needs time to percolate properly in the pot. 新鲜咖啡需要时间在壶里适当地过滤萃取。

perigee.meaning: n. 近地点（月球或卫星轨道）
perigee.note: The moon appears larger and brighter when it is at perigee. 当月球处于近地点时，它看起来更大更亮。,Scientists calculated the exact time the satellite would reach perigee. 科学家计算了卫星到达近地点的确切时间。

periphrastic.meaning: adj. 迂回的，冗长的，繁复的
periphrastic.note: His writing style was criticized for being too periphrastic and wordy. 他的写作风格因过于迂回和冗长而受到批评。,She avoided a direct answer by using periphrastic language. 她通过使用迂回的语言避开了直接回答。

persnickety.meaning: adj. 挑剔的，讲究的，爱挑毛病的
persnickety.note: The chef was notoriously persnickety about the quality of ingredients. 这位厨师对食材质量挑剔是出了名的。,She can be quite persnickety when it comes to choosing home decor. 在挑选家居装饰时，她可能会非常挑剔。

personage.note: Several important political personages attended the state banquet. 几位重要的政治要人出席了国宴。,The novel features a colorful cast of historical personages. 这部小说包含了一群丰富多彩的历史名流角色。

perverse.meaning: adj. 堕落的，反常的，固执己见的
perverse.note: He took a perverse pleasure in disagreeing with everything she said. 他以反对她所说的一切为一种反常的乐趣。,Her perverse refusal to accept help made things harder for everyone. 她固执己见地拒绝接受帮助，使所有人的事情都变得更加艰难。

pesky.note: He spent the evening trying to get rid of some pesky mosquitoes. 他花了一整个晚上试图赶走一些讨厌的蚊子。,That pesky computer keeps crashing whenever I save files. 每当我保存文件时，那台讨厌的电脑就一直崩溃。

pettish.meaning: adj. 易怒的，使小性子的，闹情绪的
pettish.note: She made a pettish remark when things did not go her way. 当事情不顺心时，她发了一句小脾气。,His pettish mood ruined the pleasant evening for everyone. 他闹情绪的心情毁了大家愉快的夜晚。

pharisaic.meaning: adj. 伪善的，假装虔诚的
pharisaic.note: Critics condemned the politician's pharisaic hypocrisy and lies. 批评家谴责了这位政客伪善的虚伪与谎言。,She disliked his pharisaic attitude toward moral rules. 她不喜欢他对待道德规则那假装虔诚的虚伪态度。

phial.note: The chemist carefully measured drops from a tiny glass phial. 化学家小心翼翼地从一个小玻璃瓶中量取滴数。,The healer extracted medicine from a sealed stone phial. 治疗师从一个密封的石头小瓶中提取药物。

philology.note: He dedicated his academic career to the study of comparative philology. 他将自己的学术生涯奉献给了比较文献学的研究。,Ancient philology helps scholars understand the evolution of text. 古代文献学帮助学者理解文本的演变。

phobia.note: Many people suffer from a severe phobia of enclosed spaces. 许多人患有对封闭空间的严重恐惧症。,Her phobia of spiders made it difficult for her to clean the basement. 她对蜘蛛的恐惧症使她很难清理地下室。

phony.meaning: adj. 假的，伪造的，虚伪的；n. 骗子
phony.note: The antique dealer tried to sell a phony painting to an unsuspecting buyer. 这位古董商试图向毫无戒心的买家出售一幅假画。,She could easily spot his phony smile and insincere compliments. 她一眼就能看出他那虚伪的笑容和不真诚的赞美。

piazza.note: Tourists gathered around the central fountain in the bustling Italian piazza. 游客们聚集在繁忙的意大利广场中央喷泉周围。,Cafes lined the sunny piazza, offering outdoor seating for visitors. 咖啡馆排在阳光灿烂的广场旁，为游客提供户外座位。

piebald.meaning: adj. 花斑的，黑白斑杂的
piebald.note: A strong piebald horse stood grazing quietly in the green pasture. 一匹强壮的花斑马在绿色的牧场上安静地吃草。,The farm dog had a striking piebald coat of black and white patches. 这只农场狗拥有引人注目的黑白相间花斑外衣。

piecemeal.note: The restoration of the historic car was done in a piecemeal fashion. 这辆历史名车的修复是以零碎的方式进行的。,Changes to the tax policy were implemented piecemeal over two years. 税收政策的变化在两年内分阶段逐步实施。

pilfer.note: An employee was caught trying to pilfer small office supplies. 一名员工被抓到试图偷窃小型办公用品。,Shoplifters often try to pilfer minor items from store shelves. 商店扒手经常试图从货架上偷窃微小的物品。

pillage.meaning: v. 掠夺，抢劫；n. 劫掠
pillage.note: Invading armies began to burn and pillage the coastal towns. 入侵军队开始烧毁和掠夺沿海城镇。,The historic city suffered extensive damage and pillage during the conflict. 这座历史名城在冲突期间遭受了广泛的破坏和劫掠。

pincers.note: The mechanic used a heavy metal tool like pincers to pull out the nail. 机械师使用像钳子一样的重金属工具拔出钉子。,Lobsters use their powerful pincers to catch and crush prey. 龙虾用它们强大的双螯来捕获和压碎猎物。

piscatorial.note: The coastal village has a long tradition of piscatorial heritage. 这个沿海村庄拥有悠久的渔业传统。,He spent his retirement enjoying peaceful piscatorial adventures by the lake. 他在湖边享受着平静的垂钓乐趣来度过退休生活。

pitiless.meaning: adj. 残酷的，无情的，冷酷的
pitiless.note: The desert sun beat down with pitiless intensity upon the travelers. 沙漠的烈日以残酷的强度炙烤着旅行者。,He showed a pitiless attitude toward his debtors. 他对债务人表现出冷酷无情的态度。

pivot.meaning: n. 枢轴，中心点；v. 旋转，转动
pivot.note: The entire business strategy began to pivot toward digital marketing. 整个商业策略开始转向数字营销。,The door swung open smoothly on its heavy metal pivot. 门在重金属枢轴上平稳地转动打开。

plank.note: Workers laid a heavy wooden plank across the ditch to cross safely. 工人们在沟渠上横放了一块厚木板以便安全通过。,Economic reform was a central plank of the party's election platform. 经济改革是该党选举纲领的核心要点。

plaza.note: Families enjoyed walking around the public plaza on a warm Sunday afternoon. 在一个温暖的周日下午，家人们喜欢在公共广场上散步。,A large shopping plaza opened downtown, attracting thousands of shoppers. 市中心开了一家大型购物广场，吸引了数千名购物者。

plebeian.meaning: adj. 平民的，粗俗的；n. 平民
plebeian.note: The aristocrat looked down upon plebeian tastes and customs. 这位贵族看不起平民的品味和习俗。,In ancient Rome, plebeians fought hard for equal political representation. 在古罗马，平民为争取平等的政治代表权进行了坚决斗争。

plenary.meaning: adj. 全体出席的，全权的
plenary.note: All delegates were required to attend the morning plenary session. 所有代表都被要求出席早上的全体会议。,The ambassador held plenary powers to negotiate the final treaty. 大小大使拥有全权来谈判最终的条约。

plentitude.note: The region is blessed with a plenitude of natural resources and wildlife. 该地区享有丰富的自然资源和野生动植物。,Autumn brought a plenitude of harvest fruits to the market. 秋天给市场带来了丰收的各种水果。

pleonastic.note: Using phrases like 'free gift' is considered pleonastic. 使用“免费赠品”之类的短语被认为是冗言赘述。,The editor removed pleonastic expressions to make the essay concise. 编辑删除了冗赘的表达，使文章简明扼要。

pliers.note: He used a pair of insulated pliers to cut the electrical wires. 他用一把绝缘钳子剪断了电线。,Keep a set of pliers in your toolbox for household repairs. 在工具箱里备一套钳子用于家庭维修。

plump.meaning: adj. 丰满的，胖乎乎的；v. 使饱满
plump.note: She bought some ripe, plump peaches from the farmers' market. 她从农贸市场买了一些成熟、饱满的桃子。,He fluffed and plumped the sofa pillows before guests arrived. 在客人到来之前，他把沙发枕头拍得鼓鼓的。

poach.meaning: v. 水煮，偷猎，挖走（人才）
poach.note: She prefers to poach eggs for a healthy breakfast. 她更喜欢水煮鸡蛋来做健康的早餐。,Rangers patrol the park to protect endangered animals from illegal poachers. 护林员在公园巡逻，以保护濒危动物免受非法偷猎者的侵害。

poltroon.note: He proved to be a complete poltroon when danger suddenly struck. 当危险突然降临时，他证明了自己是个彻头彻尾的懦夫。,The cowardly soldier was branded a poltroon by his peers. 这名胆怯的士兵被同伴打上了懦夫的烙印。

polyandry.note: Anthropologists studied the historical practices of polyandry in certain cultures. 人类学家研究了某些文化中历史上的一妻多夫习俗。,Polyandry was traditionally practiced in specific mountainous regions. 一妻多夫制传统上在特定的山区实行。

polyglot.meaning: adj. 通晓多种语言的；n. 通晓多国语言的人
polyglot.note: As a skilled polyglot, she easily communicated with international delegates. 作为一名精通多国语言的能手，她轻松地与国际代表进行交流。,The conference attracted a polyglot audience from across the globe. 会议吸引了来自全球各地的通晓多种语言的观众群体。

polymath.note: Leonardo da Vinci is celebrated as the ultimate historical polymath. 列奥纳多·达·芬奇被推崇为终极的历史博学者。,A true polymath, he excelled in art, science, and philosophy. 作为一个真正的通才，他在艺术、科学和哲学方面都很出色。

pony.note: The children took turns riding a gentle brown pony at the farm. 孩子们在农场轮流骑着一匹温顺的棕色小马。,A small pony stood happily grazing in the meadow next to the barn. 一匹小马在谷仓旁边的草地上开心地吃着草。

porcine.note: Caricatures often exaggerate his porcine facial features. 漫画经常夸张地表现他猪一般的面部特征。,Veterinarians specialize in treating porcine illnesses on livestock farms. 兽医专门治疗牧场上猪类的疾病。

portable.note: He packed a small portable radio for the camping trip. 他为露营旅行打包了一台小型便携式收音机。,Modern laptops are designed for maximum lightweight portability. 现代笔记本电脑旨在实现最大程度的轻便携带性。

portend.note: Dark storm clouds on the horizon portend a severe afternoon rain. 地平线上的乌云预示着下午将有一场大雨。,Ancient Romans believed celestial events could portend political changes. 古罗马人相信天象可以预示政治变迁。

positiveness.note: Her natural positiveness inspired everyone on the struggling team. 她天生的积极乐观鼓舞了陷入困境的团队中的每一个人。,He spoke with absolute positiveness regarding the project's success. 他对该项目的成功表现出了绝对的肯定。

postscript.note: She added a warm postscript at the end of her handwritten letter. 她在手写信件的末尾加了一段温馨的附言。,The author included a brief postscript explaining the book's background. 作者包含了一段简短的后记，解释了这本书的背景。

potboiler.meaning: n. 粗制滥造的文艺作品（为谋生而作）
potboiler.note: He wrote quick crime potboilers to pay his bills during hard times. 在艰难时期，他为了付账单而快速编写粗制滥造的犯罪小说。,Critics dismissed the novel as a commercial potboiler. 批评家将这部小说斥为一部商业劣作。

prance.meaning: v. 昂首阔步，欢腾跳跃
prance.note: The show horses began to prance proudly around the arena ring. 演出马匹开始在竞技场内骄傲地昂首阔步。,Children love to prance around the living room dressed in costumes. 小孩子们喜欢穿着戏服在起居室里欢快地蹦跳。

prefigure.note: His early architectural sketches prefigured his later modernist masterpieces. 他早期的建筑草图预示了他后来的现代主义杰作。,The dramatic opening scene tends to prefigure the dark ending. 戏剧性的开场场景往往预示着黑暗的结局。

prehensile.meaning: adj. 抓握的，有抓握功能的
prehensile.note: Monkeys use their prehensile tails to swing easily through trees. 猴子利用它们具有抓握功能的尾巴在树丛中轻松荡来荡去。,Some animals have prehensile limbs adapted for grasping food. 一种动物具有适应抓取食物的抓握肢体。

preponderant.meaning: adj. 占优势的，压倒性的，多数的
preponderant.note: There was a preponderant vote in favor of the new workplace policy. 赞成新工作场所政策的投票占了压倒性多数。,The preponderant evidence pointed toward the suspect's guilt. 占优势的证据指向嫌疑人的罪行。

prepossessing.meaning: adj. 有吸引力的，给人好感的
prepossessing.note: Although not strikingly handsome, he had a quiet, prepossessing charm. 尽管算不上英俊惊艳，但他有一种安静、讨人喜欢的魅力。,Her polite manners made a very prepossessing first impression. 她礼貌的举止给人留下了非常好的第一印象。

presentiment.note: She had a dark presentiment that something bad was going to happen. 她有一种不好的预感，觉得要发生坏事了。,A sudden sense of presentiment made him cancel his travel plans. 一种突如其来的预感让他取消了旅行计划。

presumable.note: The presumable cause of the fire was an electrical short circuit. 火灾的推测原因可能是电线短路。,His absence was due to his presumable illness. 他的缺席是因为他可能生病了。

pretence.note: He gained entry to the building under the pretence of being a repairman. 他以修理工的借口混进了大楼。,She dropped all pretence of politeness and spoke her mind. 她卸下了所有的礼貌伪装，直抒胸臆。

prevision.note: His extraordinary market prevision saved the company from huge losses. 他非凡的市场先见之明使公司免受巨额损失。,Strategic planning requires clear vision and careful prevision. 战略规划需要清晰的愿景和周密的预知准备。

prick.meaning: v. 刺，扎；n. 刺痛，刺孔
prick.note: Be careful not to prick your finger with the sewing needle. 小心不要被缝衣针扎到手指。,She felt a sudden prick of guilt for not helping her friend. 她因为没有帮助朋友而感到一阵内疚的刺痛。

prickle.meaning: n. 刺，芒刺；v. 感到刺痛
prickle.note: Rose stems are covered in sharp prickles to deter animals. 玫瑰茎上覆满尖锐的刺以防动物侵害。,Her skin began to prickle from the cold winter wind. 寒冷的冬风让她的皮肤开始感到刺痛。

prig.meaning: n. 自命清高的人，迂腐小人
prig.note: He acted like an annoying prig who lectured everyone on etiquette. 他表现得像个令人讨厌的迂腐之辈，对每个人都说教礼仪。,Nobody liked the moralizing prig at the dinner party. 晚餐会上没有人喜欢那个爱说教的清高小人。

prissy.meaning: adj. 过分拘泥的，矫揉造作的
prissy.note: She rejected the messy art project with a prissy wrinkle of her nose. 她皱起矫揉造作的鼻子，拒绝了那个杂乱的美术项目。,He found her prissy attitude toward simple fun rather annoying. 他发现她对待简单乐趣那过分拘泥的态度相当烦人。

procreate.note: All living species share a biological instinct to survive and procreate. 所有现存物种都具有生存和繁殖的生物本能。,Nature ensures that animals reproduce and procreate to maintain species. 大自然确保动物繁殖后代以维持物种。

procrustean.meaning: adj. 强求一致的，削足适履的
procrustean.note: The manager applied a procrustean approach to manage diverse teams. 经理采用了一种强求一致的方法来管理多元化的团队。,Critics opposed the procrustean rules that ignored individual differences. 批评家反对那些忽视个体差异的削足适履规则。

progenitor.note: He traced his family tree back to an early Scottish progenitor. 他将自己的家谱追溯到早期的苏格兰祖先。,This ancient computer is considered the progenitor of modern laptops. 这台古老计算机被认为是现代笔记本电脑的原型。

prognosticate.note: Economists tried to prognosticate future market trends using charts. 经济学家试图通过图表预测未来的市场趋势。,Ancient astrologers used the stars to prognosticate royal fortunes. 古代占星家利用星星来预测皇室的命运。

prorogue.note: The monarch decided to prorogue parliament ahead of the general election. 君主决定在大选前宣布议会休会。,Parliament was scheduled to prorogue at the end of the session. 议会计划在会议结束时休会。

proverbially.meaning: adv. 众所周知地，俗话说地
proverbially.note: The British weather is proverbially unpredictable and rainy. 英国的天气是出了名的变化无常且多雨。,Opportunity is proverbially said to knock only once. 俗话说得好，机会往往敲门只有一次。

psalm.note:
They gathered in the church to sing a traditional psalm. 他们聚集在教堂里唱传统的赞美诗。

The king composed a heartfelt psalm of gratitude to God. 国王创作了一首发自内心的感谢上帝的赞美诗。

puberty.note:
Most children experience rapid physical growth during puberty. 大多数孩子在青春期经历迅速的身体生长。

Puberty brings significant emotional and psychological changes. 青春期会带来显著的情感和心理变化。

puffery.note:
The advertisement relied on exaggerated puffery rather than facts. 这则广告依靠夸大的吹捧而不是事实。

Buyers should learn to distinguish between legal statements and mere puffery. 买家应学会区分法律声明和纯粹的吹捧。

pullulate.note:
Insects began to pullulate in the warm, damp basement. 昆虫开始在温暖潮湿的地下室里大量滋生。

Ideas seemed to pullulate in her creative mind during the project. 在项目进行期间，创意似乎在她富有创造力的头脑中不断涌现。

pulpit.note:
The minister stepped up to the pulpit to deliver the Sunday sermon. 牧师走上讲道台发表星期日布道。

He addressed the congregation with great passion from the pulpit. 他在讲道台上充满激情地向会众发表讲话。

pulsate.meaning: v. 搏动，有规律地跳动
pulsate.note:
The music began to pulsate through the floorboards of the club. 音乐开始在俱乐部的地板上有规律地搏动。

She could feel her heart pulsate rapidly with excitement. 她能感觉到自己的心脏因兴奋而急剧搏动。

pulsation.note:
The faint pulsation of the machine indicated it was still on. 机器微弱的搏动表明它仍然开着。

Doctors monitored the regular pulsation in his wrist. 医生监测着他手腕上有规律的脉搏跳动。

purblind.note:
His purblind vision made it difficult to read small print. 他弱视的视力使得阅读小字变得困难。

Management was criticized for its purblind approach to the crisis. 管理层因其对危机的迟钝态度而受到批评。

purport.meaning: v. 声称，标榜；n. 意图，旨趣
purport.note:
The document purports to be an authentic royal decree. 该文件声称是一份真实的皇家法令。

The general purport of his speech was clear to everyone. 他演讲的总体旨趣对每个人来说都很清楚。

putative.note:
He is the putative leader of the underground organization. 他是该地下组织被推定的领袖。

The scientist challenged the putative cause of the disease. 科学家对该疾病被推定的病因提出了质疑。

putrefy.note:
Unrefrigerated meat will quickly putrefy in the heat. 未冷藏的肉在炎热天气下会迅速腐败。

The untreated wound began to putrefy and emit an odor. 未经处理的伤口开始化脓并散发出气味。

putrid.note:
A putrid smell came from the neglected garbage bin. 被忽视的垃圾桶里散发出腐烂的恶臭。

The food had been left out for days and turned putrid. 食物被放在外面好几天，变得腐臭了。

pygmy.note:
They discovered a pygmy species of deer in the dense forest. 他们在密林中发现了一种矮小的鹿。

Compared to his massive ambitions, his achievements felt pygmy. 与他宏大的野心相比，他的成就显得微不足道。

pyromania.note:
The psychologist studied the clinical symptoms of pyromania. 心理学家研究了纵火狂的临床症状。

His destructive obsession with fire was diagnosed as pyromania. 他对火灾具有破坏性的痴迷被诊断为纵火狂。

quadrangle.note:
Students walked across the central quadrangle to reach the library. 学生们穿过中央方庭去图书馆。

The ancient college building features a spacious grassy quadrangle. 这座古老的大学建筑拥有一个宽敞的草地方庭。

quadruped.note:
Most mammals, like dogs and cats, belong to the quadruped family. 绝大多数哺乳动物，如狗和猫，都属于四足动物家族。

Evolution allowed early quadrupeds to adapt to terrestrial life. 进化使早期的四足动物得以适应陆地生活。

quagmire.note:
Their car sank deep into the muddy quagmire after the heavy rain. 大雨过后，他们的车深深陷进泥潭里。

The government found itself stuck in a political quagmire. 政府发现自己陷入了政治困境。

qualm.note:
She accepted the bribe without a single moral qualm. 她毫无道德内疚地接受了贿赂。

He had no qualms about expressing his honest opinion. 他对于表达自己诚实的观点没有任何疑虑。

queasy.note:
The rough boat ride made several passengers feel queasy. 颠簸的船行让几名乘客感到恶心。

Eating spoiled food left his stomach feeling rather queasy. 吃变质的食物让他的胃觉得很不舒服。

queer.meaning: adj. 奇怪的，古怪的；同性恋的
queer.note:
There was a queer noise coming from the engine room. 机舱里传出一种奇怪的声音。

The community center offers support programs for queer youth. 社区中心为酷儿青年提供支持项目。

query.meaning: n. 疑问，查询；v. 质疑
query.note:
Customer service representatives are trained to handle any query. 客户服务代表经过培训以处理任何疑问。

The journalist decided to query the official statistics. 记者决定对官方统计数据提出质疑。

quintessence.note:
His latest novel is the quintessence of modern romantic literature. 他最新的小说是现代浪漫文学的精华。

She is the quintessence of grace and elegance under pressure. 她在压力下是优雅与高贵的典范。

quip.meaning: n. 俏皮话，讽刺语；v. 说俏皮话
quip.note:
He made a witty quip that made everyone in the room laugh. 他说了一句妙语连珠的俏皮话，让房间里的每个人都笑了。

She was always ready to quip back when teased. 当被人取笑时，她总是准备好回以俏皮话。

racketeer.meaning: n. 敲诈勒索者，打着合法旗号诈骗的人
racketeer.note:
The police arrested several members of the local racketeer ring. 警察逮捕了当地敲诈勒索团伙的几名成员。

He was charged with extortion and operating as a racketeer. 他被指控敲诈勒索并作为诈骗犯运营。

raillery.note:
The dinner party was filled with friendly banter and light raillery. 晚宴上充满了友好的闲聊和轻松的打趣。

He took her gentle raillery with good humor and a smile. 他带着幽默和微笑接受了她善意的玩笑。

rapscallion.note:
The young rapscallion was always playing pranks on his neighbors. 那个年轻的无赖总是对邻居恶作剧。

Grandfather laughed and called him a mischievous little rapscallion. 爷爷笑着叫他一个淘气的小流氓。

rasp.meaning: n. 粗糙的声音，粗锉刀；v. 发出刺耳声音
rasp.note:
His voice had a harsh rasp from smoking too much. 因为抽烟太多，他的声音听起来很粗糙刺耳。

She used a metal rasp to smooth down the rough wooden edge. 她用金属粗锉刀把粗糙的木质边缘磨平。

ravish.meaning: v. 狂喜，使陶醉；掠夺，强暴
ravish.note:
The stunning landscape completely ravished the travelers. 迷人的风景彻底让游客们陶醉了。

Invading armies came to plunder and ravish the coastal towns. 入侵军队前来掠夺并蹂躏沿海城镇。

rebarbative.meaning: adj. 令人讨厌的，粗鲁的
rebarbative.note:
His rebarbative personality made it hard for him to keep friends. 他令人讨厌的性格使他很难维系朋友。

She was put off by his rebarbative comments during their first meeting. 初次见面时他那些粗鲁的言论让她感到反感。

recline.note:
She decided to recline on the sofa and read a novel. 她决定躺在沙发上看小说。

The airplane seats can recline for a more comfortable journey. 飞机座位可以放倒，以便享受更舒适的旅程。

reconnoiter.note:
The scout was sent ahead to reconnoiter the enemy position. 侦察员被派往前线侦察敌方阵地。

Before building the bridge, engineers went to reconnoiter the riverbanks. 在建造桥梁之前，工程师们去勘测了河岸。

reedy.meaning: adj. 长满芦苇的，声音微弱嘶哑的
reedy.note:
They walked along the reedy banks of the calm river. 他们沿着平静河流长满芦苇的岸边散步。

He spoke in a thin, reedy voice that barely carried across the room. 他用微弱嘶哑的声音说话，几乎传不到房间的那头。

regal.note:
She walked down the stairs with a calm and regal grace. 她以平静而威严的优雅姿态走下楼梯。

The palace was decorated with a distinctly regal splendor. 宫殿装饰着独特的帝王般辉煌。

regent.note:
The queen mother ruled as regent while the prince was a minor. 在王子未成年期间，太后作为摄政者统治国家。

The board of regents approved the new university budget. 大学董事会批准了新的大学预算。

regiment.meaning: n. 团，军团；v. 严密编组，严格管束
regiment.note:
The infantry regiment was ordered to advance at dawn. 步兵团奉命在黎明时分前进。

He disliked a lifestyle that tended to regiment his daily routine. 他不喜欢那种倾向于严格管束他日常生活的的生活方式。

reincarnate.meaning: v. 使化身，使转世；adj. 再世的
reincarnate.note:
Believers think the soul can reincarnate in another physical form. 信徒们认为灵魂可以在另一种物理形态中转世。

Some writers feel like the reincarnate spirit of past romantic poets. 一些作家觉得自己就像过去浪漫主义诗人的转世精神。

rejoin.meaning: v. 重返，再次加入；回答，反驳
rejoin.note:
After a brief break, the players will rejoin the match. 休息短暂后，队员们将重新加入比赛。

'Not necessarily,' she was quick to rejoin. “不见得，”她很快反驳道。

rejoinder.note:
His sharp rejoinder left his opponent momentarily speechless. 他尖锐的反驳让他的对手一时语塞。

She had a clever rejoinder ready for every critical remark. 她为每一句批评的话都准备好了聪明的回答。

remission.meaning: n. 缓和，减免，（疾病的）缓解
remission.note:
The doctor announced that the patient's cancer was in remission. 医生宣布病人的癌症处于缓解期。

The court granted a partial remission of his heavy fine. 法院批准对他高额罚款予以部分减免。

remit.meaning: v. 汇款，宽恕，减轻；n. 职责范围
remit.note:
Please remit payment for the invoice within thirty days. 请在三十天内存入发票的汇款。

Investigating financial crime falls outside our official remit. 调查金融犯罪超出了我们的官方职责范围。

remittance.note:
Workers abroad send regular remittances home to their families. 在外务工人员定期向家里的亲属寄送汇款。

We acknowledge receipt of your remittance of five hundred dollars. 我们确认已收到您五百美元的汇款。

remittent.meaning: adj. 间歇性的，时轻时重的
remittent.note:
The patient suffered from a severe form of remittent fever. 病人患有一种严重的间歇性发热。

Remittent symptoms often complicate the process of accurate diagnosis. 时轻时重的症状往往使准确诊断的过程变得复杂。

remonstrance.note:
Their angry remonstrance was ignored by the board of directors. 他们愤怒的抗议被董事会无视了。

He offered a gentle remonstrance against her reckless spending. 他对她鲁莽的消费提出了温和的告诫。

remonstrate.note:
Citizens gathered to remonstrate against the new tax policy. 公民们聚集在一起抗议新的税收政策。

She tried to remonstrate with him about his dangerous habits. 她试图就他危险的习惯对他进行规劝。

remunerate.note:
Freelancers expect companies to promptly remunerate them for their work. 自由职业者期望公司能及时为他们的工作支付报酬。

The contract specifies how the legal team will be remunerated. 合同明确了将如何向法律团队支付报酬。

renascent.meaning: adj. 复兴的，重新萌芽的
renascent.note:
The city witnessed a renascent interest in traditional arts. 这座城市见证了人们对传统艺术重新燃起的兴趣。

Economists pointed to a renascent manufacturing sector. 经济学家指出了一个正在复兴的制造业部门。

rendition.note:
Her emotional rendition of the classic song moved the audience. 她对这首经典歌曲充满情感的演绎打动了观众。

This text provides a more accurate English rendition of the poem. 这段文本提供了该诗更准确的英文翻译。

renunciate.meaning: v. 放弃，宣布断绝关系
renunciate.note:
He decided to renounce his claim to the family fortune. 他决定放弃对家族财产的继承权。

The leader was forced to renounce violence and seek peace. 该领导人被迫放弃暴力并寻求和平。

repent.note:
He lived to repent his reckless actions in his youth. 他在晚年时为自己年轻时的鲁莽行为感到后悔。

She showed a sincere desire to repent and change her ways. 她表现出真诚的悔改愿望并改变了作风。

reportage.meaning: n. 新闻报道，报告文学
reportage.note:
His book is a masterpiece of investigative war reportage. 他的书是调查性战地报道的杰作。

The quality of television reportage has declined in recent years. 近年来电视新闻报道的质量有所下降。

rescript.meaning: n. 最高法令，批示，重写
rescript.note:
The emperor issued an official rescript regarding the new laws. 皇帝就新法律发布了正式的最高法令。

Scholars analyzed the historical rescript found in the archives. 学者们分析了档案馆中发现的历史批示。

reshuffle.meaning: v. 改组，重新洗牌；n. 人事改组
reshuffle.note:
The prime minister announced a major cabinet reshuffle. 首相宣布了一次内阁大改组。

Management decided to reshuffle the team structure to improve efficiency. 管理层决定改组团队结构以提高效率。

restorative.meaning: adj. 恢复健康的；n. 滋补品
restorative.note:
She believes in the restorative power of a good night's sleep. 她相信优质睡眠具有恢复体力的神奇力量。

The doctor prescribed a herbal restorative for her fatigue. 医生给她开了一种针对疲劳的草本滋补品。

resurge.note:
Economic confidence began to resurge after the crisis. 危机过后，经济信心开始复苏。

Old fashions often resurge decades after they fade away. 旧时尚往往在消失几十年后再度崛起。

retention.note:
Good employee retention is crucial for the company's long-term success. 良好的员工保留率对公司的长期成功至关重要。

Visual aids can significantly improve student memory retention. 视觉辅助工具可以显著提高学生的记忆保持力。

retentive.meaning: adj. 记性好的，有保持力的
retentive.note:
He has a remarkably retentive memory for historical dates. 他对历史日期的记忆力好得出奇。

Clay soil is highly retentive of moisture during dry seasons. 粘土土壤在干旱季节具有很高的水分保持能力。

reticulation.note:
The leaf displayed a complex and delicate natural reticulation. 这片叶子呈现出复杂而精致的天然网纹。

Biologists studied the reticulation of veins on the insect's wings. 生物学家研究了昆虫翅膀上脉络的网状系统。

retrenchment.note:
The university announced a period of severe financial retrenchment. 该大学宣布了一段严格的财政紧缩时期。

Corporate retrenchment often leads to temporary job losses. 企业削减开支往往会导致暂时的失业。

retroactive.meaning: adj. 有追溯力的，溯及既往的
retroactive.note:
The tax law changes will have a retroactive effect on last year. 税法变更有对去年的追溯力。

Workers demanded retroactive pay for the overtime hours worked. 工人们要求支付加班工时的追溯工资。

reversion.note:
The property is subject to a reversion to the original owner. 该房产需归还给原业主。

Doctors warned against a sudden reversion to unhealthy eating habits. 医生警告不要突然恢复不健康的饮食习惯。

revulsion.note:
She felt a deep sense of revulsion at the sight of cruelty. 看到残忍的场面，她感到一阵深深的厌恶。

Public revulsion forced the politician to resign from office. 公众的强烈憎恶迫使该政治家辞职。

rhapsody.note:
The pianist played a brilliant rhapsody by a famous composer. 钢琴家演奏了一位著名作曲家的一首精彩狂想曲。

His speech was a continuous rhapsody on the joys of rural life. 他的演讲是一曲关于乡村生活快乐的狂热赞歌。

riffle.meaning: v. 翻阅，快速翻动；n. 涟漪
riffle.note:
He began to riffle through the pages of the telephone directory. 他开始快速翻阅电话簿的页面。

A light breeze caused a small riffle across the surface of the pond. 微风在池塘表面激起了一层微小的涟漪。

riffraff.meaning: n. 乌合之众，下层社会的人
riffraff.note:
The snobbish aristocrats looked down on the local riffraff. 势利的贵族看不起当地的乌合之众。

He wanted to keep the club exclusive and free from riffraff. 他希望保持俱乐部的专属高档，免受下层流民的影响。

rigmarole.meaning: n. 冗长繁琐的手续，废话
rigmarole.note:
I hate going through the bureaucratic rigmarole to get a permit. 我讨厌为了拿到许可证而经历繁琐的官僚手续。

He spent an hour explaining a confusing rigmarole of instructions. 他花了一个小时解释一堆令人困惑且冗长的指令。

rinse.meaning: v. 冲洗，漂洗；n. 冲洗
rinse.note:
Make sure to rinse the vegetables thoroughly before cooking. 烹饪前务必彻底冲洗蔬菜。

Give your hair a final rinse with cold water to add shine. 用冷水对头发进行最后一次漂洗以增加光泽。

rip.meaning: v. 撕破，扯开；n. 裂口
rip.note:
He managed to rip open the package with his bare hands. 他设法用双手撕开了包裹。

There is a nasty rip in the fabric of your winter jacket. 你冬衣的面料上有一个讨厌的裂口。

roister.note:
Sailors on shore leave would gather to drink and roister. 上岸休假的船员们会聚在一起饮酒狂欢。

The noisy crowd continued to roister late into the night. 喧闹的人群一直狂欢到深夜。

rollicking.note:
The movie is a rollicking adventure full of humor and action. 这部电影是一场充满幽默和动作的欢乐冒险。

They sang a rollicking sea shanty around the campfire. 他们在营火周围唱了一首闹腾的海员号子。

rosy.meaning: adj. 玫瑰色的，美好的，乐观的
rosy.note:
She has a rosy complexion after walking in the cold wind. 在冷风中散步后，她有着红润的肤色。

The future of the new tech industry looks very rosy. 新科技产业的未来看起来非常乐观。

rote.meaning: n. 死记硬背，机械程序
rote.note:
Learning vocabulary by rote can be boring but effective. 通过死记硬背来学习词汇可能会很枯燥但很有效。

He memorized the speech by rote without understanding the context. 他在不理解上下文的情况下死记硬背下了这篇演讲。

rotund.note:
The cheerful innkeeper had a jolly and rotund figure. 愉快的旅店老板身材圆胖、慈眉善目。

He spoke in a deep, rotund voice that commanded attention. 他用洪亮深沉的声音说话，吸引了所有人的注意。

roundabout.meaning: adj. 绕道的，迂回的；n. 环岛
roundabout.note:
We had to take a roundabout route because of the blocked road. 因为道路封闭，我们不得不走一条迂回的路线。

Drive straight through the next traffic circle and roundabout. 直接开过下一个交通环岛。

rout.meaning: v. 击溃，惨败；n. 溃败
rout.note:
The home team suffered a complete rout in the championship game. 主队在冠军赛中遭遇了彻底的惨败。

Our army managed to rout the enemy forces in a surprise attack. 我军在一次突袭中成功击溃了敌军。

rowdy.note:
The police were called to calm down a rowdy group of teenagers. 警察被叫去平息一群吵闹的青少年。

Rowdy behavior will not be tolerated inside the concert hall. 音乐厅内不允许出现粗暴吵闹的行为。

rubble.note:
Rescue workers searched through the rubble for survivors. 救援人员在瓦砾堆中搜寻幸存者。

Old buildings were reduced to a pile of dusty rubble. 老建筑变成了一堆布满灰尘的碎石。

ruck.meaning: n. 普通大众，混乱的堆；v. 起皱
ruck.note:
He managed to stand out from the ruck of ordinary candidates. 他设法从一大群普通候选人中脱颖而出。

The rug tends to ruck up if you push heavy furniture over it. 如果你把重家具推到地毯上，它往往会起皱。

rucksack.note:
He packed a change of clothes and water in his rucksack. 他在背包里装了一套换洗衣物和水。

Hikers carried heavy rucksacks on their journey through the mountains. 徒步旅行者在穿越群山的旅程中背着沉重的背包。

ruddy.note:
The farmer had a ruddy complexion from working outdoors. 由于长期在户外工作，这位农民有着一张红润的脸庞。

His ruddy cheeks showed that he had spent hours in the cold wind. 他红润的双颊表明他在寒风中待了几个小时。

rumble.meaning: v. 隆隆作响；n. 隆隆声
rumble.note:
We could hear the distant rumble of thunder in the mountains. 我们能听到山中远处雷声的隆隆作响。

His stomach began to rumble with hunger before lunchtime. 午饭时间快到时，他的肚子开始饿得咕咕叫。

ruminate.note:
He sat by the window to ruminate on his future career options. 他坐在窗前沉思未来的职业选择。

There is no need to ruminate too long over past mistakes. 没有必要对过去的错误进行过长时间的反复思考。

rustler.note:
Sheriffs tracked the cattle rustler across the dusty plains. 治安官沿着尘土飞扬的平原追踪偷牛贼。

Farmers formed a posse to catch the notorious horse rustlers. 农场主们组建了一支搜捕队去抓捕臭名昭著的偷马贼。

saccharine.meaning: adj. 过分甜美的，发腻的
saccharine.note:
She disliked the movie for its saccharine and unrealistic romance. 她不喜欢这部电影那过分甜美且不切实际的浪漫。

His saccharine smile failed to hide his insincere intentions. 他发腻的微笑掩盖不了他虚伪的意图。

sacrament.note:
Baptism is considered an important sacrament in many Christian churches. 洗礼在许多基督教会中被视为一项重要的圣礼。

They took a solemn sacrament before entering the holy order. 他们在加入圣职前进行了庄严的圣礼仪式。

sadistic.note:
The villain in the novel took a sadistic pleasure in causing pain. 小说中的反派从制造痛苦中获得了一种残虐的快乐。

She escaped from the sadistic control of her abusive partner. 她逃离了虐待狂伴侣的残暴控制。

saga.meaning: n. 英雄传奇，长篇小说
saga.note:
The book tells the epic saga of a family settling in the American West. 这本书讲述了一个家庭在美洲西部定居的史诗传奇。

Finally, the legal saga came to an end after five years. 终于，这场漫长的法律纠缠在五年后画上了句号。

saliferous.note:
Geologists drilled into the saliferous rock layers deep underground. 地质学家钻探了地下深处含盐的岩层。

The region is known for its rich deposits of saliferous springs. 该地区以其丰富的含盐泉水沉积物而闻名。

sanatorium.note:
He was sent to a mountain sanatorium to recover from tuberculosis. 他被送到山区的疗养院去治疗结核病康复。

The quiet sanatorium provided a peaceful environment for resting patients. 安静的疗养院为休养的病人提供了一个平和的环境。

sangfroid.note:
She maintained remarkable sangfroid during the crisis. 在危机期间，她保持了极大的沉着冷静。

His cool sangfroid under pressure saved the mission from failure. 他在压力下冷静的表现挽救了任务免于失败。

sardonic.meaning: adj. 讽刺的，冷嘲热讽的
sardonic.note:
He gave a sardonic smile when told about the foolish plan. 听到这个愚蠢的计划时，他露出了冷嘲热讽的微笑。

Her sardonic wit often intimidated people who met her for the first time. 她讽刺的机智常常让初次见她的人感到畏惧。

satanic.note:
The old ruins were rumored to be used for secret satanic rituals. 有传言称，那些古老的废墟曾被用于秘密的撒旦仪式。

He laughed with a dark, satanic amusement. 他带着阴暗、魔鬼般的趣味笑了。

sated.note:
Feeling fully sated after the heavy meal, he declined dessert. 在吃完丰盛的一餐感到十分饱足后，他谢绝了甜点。

She grew sated with luxury and sought a simpler way of life. 她对奢华的生活感到厌腻，并寻求一种更简单的生活方式。

scab.meaning: n. 疮痂，结痂；罢工期间的工贼
scab.note:
A hard scab formed over the healing knee wound. 正在愈合的膝盖伤口上结了一层硬痂。

Strikers shouted angrily at workers who crossed the picket line as a scab. 罢工者愤怒地对那些作为工贼穿过纠察线的工人喊叫。

scabrous.meaning: adj. 粗糙的，下流的，粗鲁的
scabrous.note:
The snake's skin had a scabrous texture to the touch. 触摸时，蛇的皮肤有一种粗糙的质感。

He entertained his friends with scabrous stories from his youth. 他用自己年轻时下流的故事来取悦他的朋友。

scads.note:
She inherited scads of money from a distant relative. 她从一个远房亲戚那里继承了大量的金钱。

There are scads of things to do before we leave for vacation. 在我们去度假之前，有大量的事情要做。

scald.meaning: v. 烫伤，沸水烫；n. 烫伤
scald.note:
Be careful not to scald your fingers with the boiling water. 小心不要被沸水烫伤了手指。

She suffered a minor steam scald on her arm while cooking. 她在做饭时手臂受了轻微的蒸汽烫伤。

scamper.note:
The little dog began to scamper across the green lawn. 小狗开始在绿色的草坪上欢快地奔跑。

Children love to watch squirrels scamper up the oak trees. 孩子们喜欢看松鼠蹦蹦跳跳地爬上橡树。
