scan.meaning: v. 扫描，粗略浏览；n. 扫描
scan.note:
Please scan the document and send it to my email address. 请扫描这份文件并将其发送到我的邮箱地址。

She took a quick scan of the headlines before reading the articles. 在阅读文章之前，她快速浏览了一下标题。

scar.meaning: n. 伤疤，瘢痕；v. 留下伤痕
scar.note:
A small scar on his chin reminded him of a childhood accident. 他下巴上的一个小伤疤让他想起了童年的一次事故。

The traumatic event left a deep emotional scar on her mind. 那次痛苦的经历在她的心头留下了深深的情感伤痕。

scare.meaning: v. 惊吓，使害怕；n. 惊恐
scare.note:
The sudden loud noise in the dark did scare the children. 黑暗中突然的巨响确实吓到了孩子们。

That close call with the car gave her a serious scare. 那次与汽车险些相撞的经历让她受到了严重的惊吓。

scarp.note:
The fortress was built atop a steep rocky scarp. 这座堡垒建在一个陡峭的岩石陡坡顶上。

Geologists measured the height of the fault scarp. 地质学家测量了断层陡坡的高度。

scathe.note:
Critics did not hesitate to scathe the director's new film. 批评家们毫不犹豫地严厉批评了导演的新电影。

Miraculously, he escaped the explosion without a single scathe. 奇迹般的是，他在爆炸中安然无恙，没有受到丝毫损害。

scintillate.note:
The distant stars began to scintillate in the clear night sky. 遥远的星星在晴朗的夜空中开始闪烁。

Her witty conversation made her scintillate at every social gathering. 她机智的谈话使她在每次社交聚会上都大放异彩。

scission.note:
The political party suffered a major ideological scission. 这个政党经历了一次重大的意识形态分裂。

Surgeons performed a delicate scission to remove the tissue. 外科医生进行了精细的切断手术以切除组织。

scorching.note:
We tried to stay indoors during the scorching afternoon hours. 我们尽量在酷热的午后时分待在室内。

The striker scored a scorching goal from outside the penalty area. 这名前锋在禁区外打入了一记精彩的远射（炽热的进球）。

scour.meaning: v. 擦洗，细查，四处搜寻
scour.note:
She had to scour the dirty pots and pans after dinner. 晚餐后她不得不把脏锅碗瓢盆用力擦洗干净。

Detectives began to scour the neighborhood for clues. 侦探们开始在社区里四处搜寻线索。

scramble.meaning: v. 攀爬，争夺；n. 混乱，争夺
scramble.note:
Hikers had to scramble up the steep and rocky hillside. 徒步旅行者不得不艰难地攀登陡峭的岩石山坡。

There was a mad scramble for tickets as soon as they went on sale. 门票一开售，人们便疯狂地争夺起来。

screed.meaning: n. 冗长的文章或抱怨
screed.note:
He sent a long, angry screed to the local newspaper editor. 他向当地报纸编辑发送了一封冗长而愤怒的抱怨文章。

No one wanted to read through his political screed. 也没有人想读完他那篇冗长的政治长文。

scud.meaning: v. 疾飞，掠过；n. 疾飞的云
scud.note:
Dark clouds began to scud across the windy sky. 乌云开始在多风的天空中疾速掠过。

A low scud of mist blew in from the cold sea. 一团低矮的疾飞雾气从寒冷的海面上吹了过来。

scutter.note:
Crabs scuttered across the sandy beach as we approached. 当我们走近时，螃蟹在沙滩上慌乱地急跑开来。

Little insects began to scutter away under the damp log. 小昆虫开始在潮湿的圆木下慌忙逃窜。

scuttle.meaning: v. 破坏，弄沉（船）；n. 煤斗
scuttle.note:
The captain ordered the crew to scuttle the ship to prevent capture. 船长下令船员凿沉船只以防被俘。

Unexpected budget cuts threatened to scuttle the entire project. 意料之外的预算削减威胁要彻底毁掉整个项目。

seafaring.note:
The coastal town has a long and proud seafaring tradition. 这个沿海小镇有着悠久而令人自豪的航海传统。

Old sailors shared stories of their seafaring adventures. 老水手们分享了他们航海冒险的故事。

seclude.note:
He decided to seclude himself in a mountain cabin to write. 他决定把自己隔离在山间小屋里写作。

They found a quiet, secluded beach away from the crowds. 他们找到了一处远离人群的安静、隐蔽的海滩。

sect.note:
A small religious sect established a commune in the valley. 一个小型宗教教派在山谷中建立了一个公社。

Tensions between rival sects threatened the peace of the region. 敌对教派之间的紧张局势威胁到了该地区的和平。

sedition.meaning: n. 煽动叛乱，妨害公务
sedition.note:
The dissident was arrested and charged with criminal sedition. 这名持不同政见者被捕并被指控犯有煽动叛乱罪。

The newspaper was banned for publishing materials deemed sedition. 这家报纸因出版被视为煽动叛乱的材料而被禁。

seditious.meaning: adj. 煽动性的，反政府的
seditious.note:
He distributed leaflets containing seditious propaganda. 他散发了包含煽动性宣传品的传单。

The government cracked down on anyone spreading seditious ideas. 政府打击了任何传播反政府思想的人。

self.note:
Reading helps you discover more about your inner self. 阅读有助于你更多地了解你的内心自我。

She looked at her reflection in the mirror and smiled at herself. 她看着镜子里的倒影，对自己笑了笑。

senile.meaning: adj. 高龄的，衰老的，老迈昏聩的
senile.note:
In his final years, he showed signs of becoming increasingly senile. 在他生命的最后几年里，他表现出越来越衰老的迹象。

Medical care has improved the quality of life for senile patients. 医疗护理改善了老年痴呆患者的生活质量。

sensitize.meaning: v. 使敏感，使具感光性
sensitize.note:
The campaign aims to sensitize the public to environmental issues. 这场运动旨在提高公众对环境问题的敏感度。

Certain chemicals can sensitize the skin to sunlight. 某些化学物质会使皮肤对阳光变得敏感。

sensual.meaning: adj. 感官的，肉欲的，纵欲的
sensual.note:
She enjoyed the sensual pleasures of good food and fine wine. 她享受着美食和美酒带来的感官快乐。

The painting celebrates the rich, sensual beauty of the human body. 这幅画颂扬了人体丰富、感性的美。

sententious.meaning: adj. 说教的，好为人师的
sententious.note:
His sententious remarks annoyed everyone at the dinner table. 他好为人师的说教言论惹恼了餐桌上的每个人。

She grew tired of her boss's pompous and sententious lectures. 她厌倦了老板那些浮夸而说教的训诫。

sentry.note:
A lonely sentry stood guard outside the iron gate. 一个孤独的哨兵铁门外站岗。

The guards changed shift and relieved the exhausted sentry. 卫兵换班，替换了疲惫的哨兵。

sequacious.note:
Politicians often rely on a sequacious crowd of loyal followers. 政治家们往往依赖一群盲从的忠实追随者。

His sequacious obedience prevented him from thinking independently. 他盲从的顺从使他无法独立思考。

sequela.note:
Chronic fatigue can be a common sequela of the viral infection. 慢性疲劳可能是该病毒感染的常见后遗症。

Doctors closely monitored the patient for any neurological sequelae. 医生密切监测病人的任何神经系统后遗症。

sequestrate.note:
The judge decided to sequester the jury for the duration of the trial. 法官决定在审判期间将陪审团隔离。

The government has the power to sequestrate assets linked to crime. 政府有权扣押与犯罪相关的资产。

serenade.meaning: n. 小夜曲；v. 向...唱小夜曲
serenade.note:
He stood under her window with a guitar to play a romantic serenade. 他拿着一把吉他站在她窗下弹奏浪漫的小夜曲。

The musician began to serenade the guests during dinner. 音乐家开始在晚宴期间为客人们唱小夜曲。

serendipity.meaning: n. 意外发现珍奇事物的能力，机缘巧合
serendipity.note:
Finding the rare book in the dusty shop was pure serendipity. 在那家陈旧的店铺里找到这本珍贵的书纯属机缘巧合。

Science is often advanced through a combination of planning and serendipity. 科学往往通过计划与机遇的结合而向前发展。

serfdom.note:
The historical reform officially abolished serfdom across the country. 这场历史性改革正式在全国范围内废除了农奴制。

Peasants lived in deep poverty under the harsh system of serfdom. 农民在严酷的农奴制下过着深重的贫困生活。

sermonize.note:
He loves to sermonize his friends about healthy eating habits. 他喜欢向朋友们就健康的饮食习惯进行说教。

Instead of lecturing, try to listen rather than sermonize. 与其训诫，不如多听少说教。

serpentine.note:
The car drove slowly along the serpentine mountain road. 汽车沿着蜿蜒的山路缓缓行驶。

A serpentine river wound its way through the green valley. 一条曲折的河流在绿色山谷中蜿蜒流过。

shabby.meaning: adj. 破旧的，寒酸的，不公正的
shabby.note:
He wore a shabby coat that had seen better days. 他穿着一件饱经风霜的破旧大衣。

Treating loyal employees like that was a very shabby trick. 那样对待忠诚的员工真是一个极其不公正的把戏。

shanty.note:
Poor families lived in crowded shanty towns on the city edge. 贫困家庭住在城市边缘拥挤的棚户区里。

They built a small wooden shanty to shelter from the storm. 他们建造了一个简陋的小木棚来躲避风暴。

shawl.note:
She wrapped a warm woolen shawl around her shoulders. 她在肩膀上裹了一条温暖的羊毛披肩。

The old lady knitted a delicate lace shawl for her granddaughter. 老妇人为孙女织了一条精致的蕾丝披肩。

sheaf.meaning: n. 一捆，一束（纸或麦子等）
sheaf.note:
The lawyer handed a thick sheaf of documents to the judge. 律师递给法官厚厚的一束文件。

Workers gathered the harvested wheat into a neat sheaf. 工人们把收割的小麦聚集成整齐的一捆。

sheen.note:
Her dark hair had a healthy and beautiful sheen to it. 她黑色的头发散发着健康美丽的光泽。

The polished wooden floor retained a bright sheen. 打过蜡的木地板保持着明亮的光彩。

shibboleth.meaning: n. 陈旧观念，口号，习语
shibboleth.note:
Economic independence has become an outdated political shibboleth. 经济独立已经成了一个过时的政治口号。

Modern experts questioned the old shibboleth about corporate loyalty. 现代专家对关于企业忠诚度的陈旧观念提出了质疑。

shimmer.meaning: v. 闪烁，微光闪烁；n. 微光
shimmer.note:
The hot desert sand began to shimmer in the afternoon sun. 炎热的沙漠沙子在午后阳光下开始闪烁微光。

Moonlight created a silver shimmer across the surface of the lake. 月光在湖面上泛起了一层银色的微光。

shipwright.note:
The master shipwright inspected the wooden hull of the vessel. 造船大师检查了船只的木制船体。

He worked for decades as a skilled shipwright in the naval yard. 他在海军造船厂当了几十年的熟练造船工。

showy.meaning: adj. 艳丽的，俗艳的，引人注目的
showy.note:
She wore a showy dress covered in sequins to the party. 她穿着一件布满亮片的艳丽裙子去参加派对。

He preferred simple elegance over showy displays of wealth. 他比起炫耀财富的俗艳展示，更喜欢朴素的优雅。

shred.meaning: v. 切碎，撕碎；n. 碎片
shred.note:
Please shred all confidential documents before throwing them away. 扔掉所有机密文件前请将其全部碎掉。

There was not a shred of evidence to support his wild claims. 没有任何一丝证据来支持他荒谬的说法。

shuttle.meaning: n. 穿梭班机，航天飞机；v. 穿梭往返
shuttle.note:
A frequent bus shuttle runs between the airport and the hotel. 机场和酒店之间有频繁运行的穿梭巴士。

He has to shuttle between New York and London every week. 他每周都必须在纽约和伦敦之间穿梭往返。

sidesplitting.meaning: adj. 让人笑破肚皮的，极其滑稽的
sidesplitting.note:
The comedians performed a sidesplitting sketch on television. 喜剧演员在电视上表演了一个让人笑破肚皮的小品。

We spent the evening laughing at his sidesplitting jokes. 我们整个晚上都在听他那些极其滑稽的笑话并大笑不止。

sidle.note:
He tried to sidle up to the director without being noticed. 他试图在不被注意的情况下悄悄走到导演身边。

She decided to sidle past the angry crowd to reach the exit. 她决定侧身从愤怒的人群旁边挤过以到达出口。

signatory.note:
All signatory nations agreed to reduce carbon emissions. 所有签字国都同意减少碳排放。

He is one of the original signatories of the peace treaty. 他是和平条约的最初签署人之一。

signature.note:
Please provide your signature at the bottom of the page. 请在页面底部提供您的签名。

The painting bore the distinct signature of the famous artist. 这幅画带有这位著名艺术家独特的署名。

simian.meaning: adj. 猿类的，类人猿的；n. 猿类
simian.note:
Primatologists study the complex social behavior of various simians. 灵长类动物学家研究各种猿类的复杂社会行为。

The actor wore a costume with exaggerated simian features. 演员穿了一套带有夸张猿类特征的服装。

simile.note:
The phrase 'brave as a lion' is a classic example of a simile. “像狮子一样勇敢”这句话是明喻的经典例子。

Poets often use a simile to create vivid imagery in their writing. 诗人经常使用明喻在他们的写作中创造生动的意象。

sinister.note:
A cold wind blew through the old house with a sinister feel. 寒风吹过古老的房子，带有某种不祥的感觉。

She sensed something sinister behind his polite smile. 她在他礼貌的微笑背后察觉到了一些阴险的意图。

sizzler.meaning: n. 酷热的日子，精彩的事物
sizzler.note:
Yesterday was a true sizzler, with temperatures soaring over 40 degrees. 昨天真是一个酷热难耐的日子，气温飙升至40度以上。

The new action movie turned out to be a major box-office sizzler. 这部新的动作电影结果成了一部大卖的票房热门作品。

skein.meaning: n. 一束（线），一团（混乱的事物）
skein.note:
She bought several skeins of colorful yarn for knitting. 她买了几束色彩斑斓的毛线用于编织。

Detectives had to unravel a complex skein of lies. 侦探们不得不解开一团复杂的谎言。

skittish.meaning: adj. 易惊恐的，神经质的，善变的
skittish.note:
The horse was skittish and startled easily at loud noises. 这匹马很易受惊，对巨大的声音很容易吓到。

Investors remained skittish amid the economic uncertainty. 在经济不确定性中，投资者依然表现得神经质且善变。

skullduggery.meaning: n. 欺诈，见不得人的勾当
skullduggery.note:
There was a suspicion of political skullduggery behind the scandal. 丑闻背后隐约存在着政治欺诈的嫌疑。

The manager was fired for financial skullduggery and fraud. 这名经理因财务欺诈和舞弊而被解雇。

skunk.note:
We smelled a skunk near the garbage cans in the backyard. 我们在后院垃圾桶附近闻到了一只臭鼬的味道。

He called the man who cheated him out of his money a skunk. 他把那个骗走他钱的人骂作是一个卑鄙小人。

skyrocket.note:
Real estate prices in the city continue to skyrocket. 这座城市的房地产价格继续猛涨。

Demand for the new product caused sales to skyrocket overnight. 对新产品的需求导致销售额在一夜之间飙升。

slapdash.note:
The teacher criticized him for his slapdash approach to homework. 老师批评他对待家庭作业的态度太草率了。

A slapdash repair job resulted in the pipe leaking again. 马虎的修补工作导致水管再次漏水。

slaver.meaning: v. 流口水，巴结；n. 口水
slaver.note:
The hungry dog began to slaver at the sight of meat. 饥饿的狗看到肉开始流口水。

He watched the expensive cars with a greedy slaver. 他贪婪地看着那些昂贵的跑车，口水直流。

slay.note:
In the legend, the knight set out to slay the dragon. 在传说中，骑士出发去斩杀恶龙。

The tragic hero vowed to avenge his father's unjust slay. 这位悲剧英雄发誓要为他父亲不公正的遇害复仇。

sleazy.meaning: adj. 肮脏的，低级庸俗的
sleazy.note:
He lived in a sleazy motel on the outskirts of town. 他住在镇郊一家肮脏的小汽车旅馆里。

The politician's career was ruined by a sleazy financial scandal. 这位政治家的政治生涯被一桩低级庸俗的财务丑闻毁掉了。

sledgehammer.meaning: n. 大锤，重锤；adj. 粗暴强硬的
sledgehammer.note:
Workers used a heavy sledgehammer to break down the wall. 工人们用一把重锤砸碎了墙壁。

The government's approach to the problem was a bit like a sledgehammer. 政府解决问题的方法未免有些过于粗暴强硬。

sleight.note:
The magician performed the trick with incredible sleight of hand. 魔术师以难以置信的敏捷手法表演了这个把戏。

It was pure sleight of words that convinced them to sign. 纯粹是文字游戏般的诡计说服了他们签字。

sling.meaning: v. 投掷，吊起；n. 吊带
sling.note:
He had to wear his arm in a sling after breaking his collarbone. 锁骨骨折后，他不得不把手臂挂在吊带里。

She decided to sling her backpack over her shoulder and walk. 她决定把背包往肩上一甩便出发了。

slit.meaning: v. 切开，割开；n. 狭长的裂缝
slit.note:
He used a sharp knife to slit open the cardboard box. 他用一把锋利的刀割开了纸箱。

Light shone through a narrow slit in the heavy curtains. 光线透过厚重窗帘上一条狭窄的裂缝照射进来。

slobber.meaning: v. 流口水，胡言乱语；n. 口水
slobber.note:
The happy puppy began to slobber all over my face. 快乐的小狗开始在我脸上到处流口水。

He started to slobbering nonsense after drinking too much wine. 喝了太多酒后，他开始胡言乱语。

sloven.meaning: n. 邋遢的人，不拘小节的人
sloven.note:
His roommates often complained that he was a hopeless sloven. 他的室友经常抱怨他是一个无可救药的邋遢鬼。

He looked like a sloven with his unwashed hair and rumpled clothes. 他头发没洗、衣服褶皱，看起来像个邋遢的人。

slue.note:
The car began to slue around on the icy patch of road. 汽车在结冰的路面上开始打滑扭转方向。

He tried to slue the heavy table toward the corner. 他试图把笨重的桌子朝角落方向转动。

slump.meaning: v. 暴跌，塌陷；n. 萧条，衰退
slump.note:
Property values suffered a sharp slump during the recession. 在经济衰退期间，房地产价值遭遇了暴跌。

Exhausted from work, he slumped heavily into the armchair. 由于工作过度劳累，他重重地瘫坐在单人沙发上。

smirch.meaning: v. 玷污，弄脏；n. 污点
smirch.note:
He refused to let false rumors smirch his good reputation. 他拒绝让虚假的谣言玷污他良好的声誉。

There was a dark smirch of ink on the pristine white page. 洁白如新的纸页上有一块黑色的墨渍。

snappish.meaning: adj. 脾气暴躁的，厉声厉色的
snappish.note:
She was tired and gave a snappish reply to his question. 她很累，对他的问题给出了一个厉声厉色的回答。

The manager's snappish mood made everyone uneasy in the office. 经理暴躁的情绪让办公室里的每个人都感到不安。

snappy.meaning: adj. 敏捷的，时髦的，简明扼要的
snappy.note:
The presentation needs a snappy title to grab attention. 演讲需要一个简明扼要、吸引眼球的标题。

He dressed in a snappy suit for the important interview. 他为这次重要的面试穿了一套时髦的西装。

snicker.note:
A few students began to snicker at the back of the classroom. 几个学生开始在教室后面窃笑。

He tried to hide a snicker when the speaker made a mistake. 当发言者犯错时，他试图掩饰住一声窃笑。

snob.meaning: n. 势利眼，自命不凡的人
snob.note:
He is such a wine snob that he only drinks expensive vintages. 他是个不折不扣的红酒势利眼，只喝昂贵的陈酿。

She dismissed the local art gallery as a place for snobs. 她把当地的美术馆贬低为势利眼去的地方。

sociable.note:
He is a very sociable person who enjoys meeting new people. 他是一个非常合群的人，喜欢结识新朋友。

Cats are generally less sociable than dogs in a home environment. 在家庭环境中，猫通常比狗更不合群。

somnolent.note:
The warm afternoon sun created a somnolent atmosphere. 温暖的午后阳光营造了一种昏昏欲睡的氛围。

The heavy meal induced a quiet, somnolent feeling in him. 丰盛的一餐让他产生了一种安静的、想睡的感觉。

sonorous.meaning: adj. 洪亮的，雄厚共鸣的
sonorous.note:
The actor read the classical poem in a rich, sonorous voice. 这位演员用浓厚而洪亮的声音朗诵了这首古典诗歌。

A sonorous bell chimed from the old church tower. 古老的教堂钟楼里传出了一声雄厚共鸣的钟声。

souse.meaning: v. 浸透，使湿透；n. 酒鬼
souse.note:
Heavy rain began to souse the campers and their gear. 大雨开始把露营者和他们的装备淋得湿透。

He spent his evenings drinking like a hopeless local souse. 他把晚上的时间都花在像个无可救药的当地酒鬼一样喝酒上。

spangle.meaning: v. 闪烁，点缀；n. 亮片
spangle.note:
Stars began to spangle the dark night sky like tiny diamonds. 星星开始像微小的钻石一样点缀着漆黑的夜空。

Her stage costume was covered with sparkling gold spangles. 她的舞台服装上布满了闪闪发光的金色亮片。

spasmodic.note:
The patient suffered from spasmodic muscle contractions. 病人患有痉挛性的肌肉收缩。

Progress on the project was slow due to spasmodic funding. 由于资金呈间歇性到位，该项目的进展很慢。

speleology.note:
He dedicated his life to the scientific study of speleology. 他把一生奉献给了洞穴学的科学研究。

Speleology combines elements of geology, biology, and adventure. 洞穴学结合了地质学、生物学和探险的元素。

splashy.meaning: adj. 华而不实的，引人注目的
splashy.note:
The company launched a splashy marketing campaign for the new phone. 公司为这款新手机展开了一场引人注目的营销宣传活动。

She preferred a quiet wedding over a splashy celebrity event. 她比起华而不实的明星婚礼，更喜欢安静的婚礼。

spool.meaning: n. 线轴，卷轴；v. 卷在线轴上
spool.note:
She needed a spool of black thread to fix the torn seam. 她需要一卷黑线来修补撕裂的接缝。

The old film projector began to spool the celluloid strip. 老式电影机开始卷起纤维胶片。

spoor.note:
The hunters followed the fresh spoor of the deer through the woods. 猎人们沿着树林里鹿的新鲜足迹追踪。

Tracking animals by their spoor requires patience and skill. 根据足迹追踪动物需要耐心和技巧。

spout.meaning: n. 壶嘴，喷口；v. 喷出，滔滔不绝地说
spout.note:
Water began to spout from the broken pipe in the street. 水从街上破裂的水管中喷涌而出。

He stood on the street corner to spout his political theories. 他站在街角滔滔不绝地宣讲他的政治理论。

sprawl.meaning: v. 四肢摊开坐或躺，蔓延；n. 蔓延
sprawl.note:
He liked to sprawl comfortably on the large living room sofa. 他喜欢舒适地四肢摊开躺在宽敞的客厅沙发上。

The city continued to expand in an uncontrolled urban sprawl. 这座城市继续以失控的城市蔓延方式扩张。

sprint.meaning: n. 短跑，冲刺；v. 冲刺
sprint.note:
The athletes prepared at the starting line for the 100-meter sprint. 运动员们在起跑线上为100米短跑做准备。

Seeing the bus approaching, she began to sprint across the street. 看到公交车开过来，她开始冲刺过马路。

spunk.note:
I admire her spunk for standing up to the harsh manager. 我佩服她敢于顶撞严厉经理的勇气。

He showed a lot of spunk during the difficult competition. 在激烈的比赛中，他表现出了十足的胆量。

spurn.note:
She chose to spurn the offer rather than compromise her values. 她选择拒绝这个提议，也不愿违背自己的价值观。

His friendly overtures were coldly spurned by his colleagues. 他友好的示好遭到了同事们冷酷的拒绝。

squeamish.meaning: adj. 易恶心的，神经质的，讲究的
squeamish.note:
He is too squeamish to watch a surgery documentary. 他胆子太小（容易恶心），不敢看外科手术纪录片。

She is not squeamish about getting her hands dirty in the garden. 她在花园里弄脏双手时一点也不觉得难受或娇气。

stab.meaning: v. 刺，戳；n. 刺伤，尝试
stab.note:
He felt a sharp stab of pain in his knee after the fall. 摔倒后，他感到膝盖一阵尖锐的刺痛。

She decided to take a stab at learning a new musical instrument. 她决定尝试学习一种新的乐器。

stagy.meaning: adj. 做作的，演戏般不自然的
stagy.note:
His emotional speech felt a little overdone and stagy. 他情绪激动的演讲让人觉得有点过头且做作。

Critics disliked the play for its artificial and stagy dialogue. 批评家不喜欢这部戏，因为它虚假且做作的对话。

standstill.note:
Traffic came to a complete standstill after the heavy accident. 严重事故发生后，交通完全陷入了停滞。

Negotiations between the two parties reached a total standstill. 双方之间的谈判陷入了完全的僵局。

stash.meaning: v. 藏匿，存放；n. 藏匿物
stash.note:
He decided to stash his savings in a secure drawer. 他决定把积蓄藏在一个安全的抽屉里。

Police found a hidden stash of stolen goods in the basement. 警察在地下室里发现了一批藏匿的赃物。

steeple.note:
The tall church steeple could be seen from miles away. 从数英里外就能看到高高的教堂尖塔。

Lightning struck the old stone steeple during the storm. 暴风雨期间，闪电击中了古老的石制尖塔。

stoop.meaning: v. 弯腰，俯身；n. 门廊前台阶
stoop.note:
He had to stoop to get through the low doorway. 他不得不弯腰才能穿过低矮的门口。

She sat on the front stoop and waited for the mail carrier. 她坐在正门台阶上等待送信员。

stouthearted.meaning: adj. 勇敢的，坚强坚定的
stouthearted.note:
Only stouthearted explorers could survive the harsh polar expedition. 只有勇敢坚定的探险家才能在严酷的极地探险中生存下来。

She showed a stouthearted resilience in the face of disaster. 在灾难面前，她表现出了坚强不屈的韧性。

straggle.meaning: v. 迷路，零乱分布，掉队
straggle.note:
A few tired hikers began to straggle behind the main group. 几个疲惫的徒步旅行者开始落在主队伍的后面掉队。

Wildflowers continued to straggle along the edge of the path. 野花沿着小路边缘零乱地生长着。

strangulation.note:
The forensic report confirmed that the cause of death was strangulation. 法医报告确认死因是机械性窒息（勒死）。

Economists warned against the financial strangulation of small businesses. 经济学家警告不要对小型企业进行资金上的扼杀。

studio.meaning: n. 工作室，演播室，单间公寓
studio.note:
The artist spent all day painting inside her bright studio. 这位艺术家一整天都在她明亮的工作室里画画。

He lives in a cozy downtown studio apartment. 他住在市中心一间舒适的单间公寓里。

stun.note:
The news of the sudden company closure did stun the staff. 公司突然倒闭的消息确实让员工们震惊了。

The heavy blow to the head was enough to stun him momentarily. 头部受到的重击足以让他短暂晕厥。

stupefy.note:
The complex maze of rules was enough to stupefy anyone. 错综复杂的规则网足以把任何人弄得头昏脑胀。

She stood as if stupefy by the incredible turn of events. 她站在那里，仿佛被这不可思议的局势转变惊呆了。

stupendous.meaning: adj. 惊人的，巨大的，了不起的
stupendous.note:
The team achieved a stupendous victory in the finals. 团队在决赛中取得了一场了不起的胜利。

They stood in awe before the stupendous scale of the grand canyon. 他们在宏大峡谷的巨大规模面前肃然起敬。

sublimate.note:
He managed to sublimate his aggression into intense physical exercise. 他设法将自己的攻击性转化为强烈的体育锻炼。

In chemistry, heat can cause solid ice to sublimate into gas. 在化学中，热量可以使固态冰直接升华成气体。

subscribe.note:
Many readers subscribe to the digital version of the magazine. 许多读者订阅了该杂志的数字版本。

I do not subscribe to the belief that success comes easily. 我不赞同成功来得容易这种观点。

subsist.note:
During the harsh winter, they had to subsist on limited rations. 在严冬期间，他们不得不靠有限的口粮维持生计。

Wildlife in the desert manages to subsist under harsh conditions. 沙漠中的野生动物在严酷的条件下设法存活下来。

substratum.note:
Engineers tested the geological substratum before building the bridge. 工程师在建造桥梁之前测试了地质基底层。

Beneath the surface politeness lay a dark substratum of anger. 表面上的礼貌之下隐藏着一层阴暗的愤怒。

subvention.note:
The cultural project relied heavily on government subvention. 这个文化项目严重依赖政府的补助金。

The theater received a financial subvention to stage the play. 剧院获得了一笔财政津贴来上演这部戏剧。

sully.note:
He vowed never to sully his family name with dishonest behavior. 他发誓绝不以不诚实的行径玷污家族名誉。

Scandals can quickly sully the reputation of a public figure. 丑闻可以迅速败坏公众人物的声誉。

superannuated.meaning: adj. 老旧的，退休的，淘汰的
superannuated.note:
The factory replaced its superannuated machinery with modern tools. 工厂用现代工具替换了老旧的机械设备。

He felt like a superannuated worker in the fast-paced tech industry. 在快节奏的科技行业中，他觉得自己像个过时的淘汰工人。

superlative.meaning: adj. 至高无上的，极佳的；n. 最高级
superlative.note:
The chef prepared a superlative meal for the distinguished guests. 主厨为尊贵的客人们准备了一顿极佳的饭菜。

Grammar tests often check knowledge of the superlative form of adjectives. 语法测试经常考查形容词最高级形式的知识。

superstition.note:
Breaking a mirror is an old superstition associated with bad luck. 打碎镜子是一个与厄运相关的古老迷信。

Education helps replace fear and superstition with reason. 教育有助于用理性取代恐惧和迷信。

swank.meaning: adj. 华丽的，炫耀的；v. 炫耀
swank.note:
They stayed at a swank hotel in the heart of the city. 他们住在市中心一家华丽的豪华酒店里。

He loved to swank about his expensive new sports car. 他喜欢炫耀他那辆昂贵的新跑车。

swarthy.note:
The sailor had a weathered face and a swarthy complexion. 这名水手有着饱经风霜的脸庞和黝黑的肤色。

A tall, swarthy man approached them at the harbor gate. 一个身材高大、皮肤黝黑的男人在港口大门走近他们。

swear.note:
He had to swear to tell the truth in the courtroom. 他必须在法庭上发誓说实话。

Children should be taught not to swear in public places. 应该教育小孩子们不要在公共场所说脏话。

tarry.note:
Do not tarry too long, or we will miss the last train. 不要逗留太久，否则我们会赶不上末班车。

She chose not to tarry in the chilly evening air. 她选择不在寒冷的晚风中过多耽搁。

tattered.note:
He found an old, tattered book hidden in the attic. 他在阁楼里发现了一本破旧不堪的老书。

The flag fluttered in the wind despite being worn and tattered. 尽管破旧不堪，旗帜仍在风中飘扬。

tautological.meaning: adj. 同义语重复的，累赘的
tautological.note:
The phrase 'free gift' is often criticized as being tautological. “免费赠品”这个词组常被批评为同义语重复。

His essay was filled with tautological expressions that weakened the argument. 他的文章充满了同义重复的表达，削弱了论点。

teem.note:
The tropical rainforests teem with diverse animal species. 热带雨林里充满了各种各样的动物物种。

Streets began to teem with commuters rushing home. 街道上开始挤满急于赶路回家的通勤者。

teetotal.note:
He is a teetotal person who never touches any alcohol. 他是一个绝对戒酒的人，从不沾任何酒精饮料。

The club promotes a healthy, teetotal lifestyle for its members. 该俱乐部为其成员倡导健康、绝对戒酒的生活方式。

tendinous.note:
The injury affected the tendinous structure of his ankle. 这一受伤影响了他脚踝的腱部结构。

Surgeons repaired the torn tendinous tissue in his hand. 外科医生修复了他手中撕裂的肌腱组织。

tensile.meaning: adj. 张力的，拉力的，可延展的
tensile.note:
Steel cables are known for their high tensile strength. 钢缆以其高抗拉强度而闻名。

Engineers tested the tensile properties of the new alloy. 工程师测试了这种新合金的拉伸性能。

thespian.meaning: adj. 戏剧的，演戏的；n. 演员
thespian.note:
The local dramatic club welcomed aspiring young thespians. 当地戏剧俱乐部欢迎有抱负的年轻演员加入。

She pursued a thespian career against her parents' wishes. 她不顾父母的意愿，追求演艺事业。

thorny.note:
They faced a thorny problem regarding contract negotiations. 他们面临着一个关于合同谈判的棘手问题。

Be careful not to touch the thorny branches of the rose bush. 小心不要碰到玫瑰丛多刺的枝条。

thrall.meaning: n. 奴役，受支配地位；v. 使受奴役
thrall.note:
He was held in the complete thrall of his digital devices. 他完全受控于他的电子设备（处于奴役状态）。

She remained in thrall to her fear of public speaking. 她依然受制于对公开演讲的恐惧。

thrash.meaning: v. 痛打，彻底击败，挣扎
thrash.note:
The visiting team managed to thrash their opponents in the game. 客队在比赛中设法彻底击败了他们的对手。

He threshed around in bed, unable to fall asleep from fever. 他在床上辗转反侧、痛苦挣扎，因发烧无法入睡。

thresh.note:
Farmers used to thresh grain by hand in the old days. 过去农人们常常用手为谷物脱粒。

Machines have made it easier to harvest and thresh wheat. 机器使收割和脱粒小麦变得容易多了。

thrifty.note:
Being thrifty helped her save enough money to buy a house. 节俭帮助她存够了买房子的钱。

Her thrifty habits enabled the family to weather hard times. 她节俭的习惯使这个家庭能够度过艰难时期。

throes.meaning: n. 剧痛，阵痛，挣扎状态
throes.note:
The nation was in the throes of a massive economic transition. 这个国家正处于一场巨大经济转型的阵痛之中。

She was in the final throes of completing her doctoral thesis. 她正处于完成博士论文的最后拼搏冲刺阶段。

timeworn.meaning: adj. 陈旧的，饱经岁月沧桑的
timeworn.note:
They read messages carved on timeworn stone monuments. 他们阅读了刻在饱经岁月沧桑的石碑上的留言。

The speaker repeated a timeworn cliché about hard work. 演讲者重复了一句关于努力工作的陈词滥调。

tinge.meaning: v. 给...着色，微染；n. 气息，微量
tinge.note:
Her speech carried a faint tinge of regret and nostalgia. 她的演讲带有淡淡的遗憾和怀旧气息。

The setting sun began to tinge the clouds with gold and red. 落日开始给云朵染上一抹金色和红色。

topsy.note:
The sudden reorganization turned the department topsy-turvy. 突然的重组把这个部门弄得一团糟。

Everything grew topsy after the news broke out. 消息传出后，一切都变得颠倒混乱了。

torpedo.meaning: n. 鱼雷；v. 破坏，彻底破坏
torpedo.note:
The submarine fired a torpedo at the approaching enemy vessel. 潜水艇向逼近的敌舰发射了一枚鱼雷。

The unexpected scandal managed to torpedo his political career. 意想不到的丑闻彻底毁掉了他的政治生涯。

torrid.meaning: adj. 酷热的，热烈的，激情的
torrid.note:
They spent their summer vacation under the torrid desert sun. 他们在酷热的沙漠阳光下度过了暑假。

The novel describes a torrid romance set in wartime Europe. 这部小说描述了一段以战时欧洲为背景的热烈浪漫史。

torso.meaning: n. 躯干，人体躯干雕像
torso.note:
Swimming is a great exercise that strengthens your upper torso. 游泳是一项能增强你上半身躯干力量的极佳运动。

Archaeologists uncovered an ancient marble torso in the ruins. 考古学家在废墟中发掘出了一尊古代大理石躯干雕像。

torture.meaning: n. 折磨，酷刑；v. 拷打，折磨
torture.note:
Prisoners of war were subjected to cruel physical torture. 战俘们遭受了残酷的肉体酷刑。

Waiting for exam results can feel like pure mental torture. 等待考试成绩的感觉就像纯粹的精神折磨。

touching.meaning: adj. 动人的，令人感伤的
touching.note:
The film ended with a deeply touching scene between father and son. 电影在父子之间一个深深感人的场景中结束。

She wrote a touching letter of gratitude to her teachers. 她给老师写了一封感人的感谢信。

touchstone.meaning: n. 试金石；标准，检验标准
touchstone.note:
The essay is a touchstone for modern literary criticism. 这篇散文是现代文学批评的试金石。

His latest movie served as a touchstone for his growth as a director. 他最近的电影成了检验他作为导演成长历程的标准。

tousle.note:
She playfully tousled her son's hair. 她顽皮地弄乱了她儿子的头发。

The wind tousled his clothes and hair as he walked outside. 当他在外面走时，风把他的衣服和头发吹乱了。

traduce.note:
He was accused of trying to traduce his political rivals. 他被指控试图诽谤他的政治对手。

She felt deeply hurt when someone attempted to traduce her reputation. 当有人试图诋毁她的名誉时，她感到深深的伤害。

trammel.meaning: n. 拘束，束缚；v. 束缚，限制
trammel.note:
She wanted to break free from the trammels of traditional society. 她渴望摆脱传统社会的束缚。

He felt trammelled by the strict rules of the organization. 他感到自己受到该组织严格规则的束缚。

tramp.meaning: n. 流浪汉；沉重的脚步声；v. 跋涉，重步走
tramp.note:
We heard the heavy tramp of soldiers marching outside. 我们听到外面士兵行军的沉重脚步声。

They decided to tramp across the hills for the weekend. 他们决定周末跋涉穿过山丘。

transfuse.note:
The patient needed to be transfused with blood immediately. 这名病人需要立即输血。

The manager tried to transfuse new energy into the failing team. 经理试图为表现不佳的团队注入新的活力。

treachery.meaning: n. 背叛，背信弃义；变节
treachery.note:
He was executed for treason and treachery against the crown. 他因叛国和对王室的背叛而被处决。

She could never forgive the treachery of her former friend. 她永远无法原谅她前友人的背叛。

treasurer.note:
She was elected as the club treasurer for the upcoming year. 她被选为新一年的俱乐部财务主管。

The treasurer is responsible for managing the organization's budget. 财务主管负责管理该组织的预算。

trek.meaning: n. 艰难的跋涉；v. 艰苦跋涉，远足
trek.note:
They went on a long trek across the Himalayan mountains. 他们踏上了横跨喜马拉雅山脉的漫长跋涉。

We had to trek through deep mud to reach the campsite. 我们不得不踩着深深的泥泞艰难地走到营地。

tremulous.meaning: adj. 颤抖的，发抖的；胆怯的
tremulous.note:
She spoke in a tremulous voice, showing her nervousness. 她用颤抖的声音说话，表现出她的紧张。

He gave a tremulous smile before taking the stage. 他在登台前露出了一个怯生生的微笑。

trench.meaning: n. 沟渠，战壕；v. 挖沟
trench.note:
The soldiers took cover in the trench during the bombardment. 士兵们在轰炸期间在战壕里寻找掩护。

Workers began to trench the field to install the drainage pipes. 工人们开始在地里挖沟以安装排水管。

tresses.meaning: n. 长发，发辫（通常指女性的长发）
tresses.note:
Her dark tresses fell gracefully over her shoulders. 她黑色的长发优雅地垂在肩头。

She brushed her long tresses before going to bed. 她在睡觉前梳理了她长长的头发。

tribulation.meaning: n. 磨难，苦难，艰难困苦
tribulation.note:
They endured many tribulations together before achieving success. 他们在取得成功之前一起经历了许多磨难。

Life is full of unexpected tribulations and triumphs. 生活充满了意想不到的苦难与胜利。

tributary.meaning: n. 支流；adj. 支流的，进贡的
tributary.note:
The Missouri River is a major tributary of the Mississippi. 密苏里河是密西西比河的一条主要支流。

Small tributary streams flowed down into the main valley. 小支流顺流而下汇入主山谷。

trickery.note:
He won the contract through sheer trickery and deceit. 他通过纯粹的诡计和欺骗赢得了合同。

She suspected that political trickery was involved in the decision. 她怀疑这项决定中涉及政治花招。

trident.meaning: n. 三叉戟（海神等所执的武器）
trident.note:
In mythology, Neptune is usually depicted holding a trident. 在神话中，涅普顿通常被描绘成手持三叉戟的样子。

The emblem features a golden trident set against a blue background. 该徽章以蓝色背景上的金色三叉戟为特色。

trivia.note:
She loves answering pop culture trivia questions. 她喜欢回答流行文化冷知识的问题。

Let's not waste time arguing over such trivia. 我们不要浪费时间争论这些琐事了。

truant.meaning: n. 逃学者，旷课者；adj. 逃学的，旷课的
truant.note:
The boy was caught playing truant from school again. 这男孩又被抓到逃学了。

He spent his truant afternoon wandering around the city park. 他把旷课的下午时光用来在城市公园里闲逛。

truism.meaning: n. 自明之理，老生常谈，陈词滥调
truism.note:
It is a truism that prevention is better than cure. 预防胜于治疗，这是一个不言而喻的道理。

His speech was filled with tired truisms about hard work. 他的演讲充斥着关于努力工作的陈词滥调。

trumpery.meaning: n.华而不实的东西，假货；adj.华而不实的，无价值的
trumpery.note:
The antique shop was full of cheap trumpery. 这家古董店里到处都是廉价而华而不实的假货。

He dismissed the elaborate promises as mere trumpery. 他把那些详尽的承诺斥为无聊的废话。

tumid.meaning: adj. 肿胀的，肿大的；（文风等）浮夸的
tumid.note:
The injury left his ankle tumid and bruised. 这次受伤导致他的脚踝肿胀且有淤青。

Critics disliked the author's tumid and overly ornate style. 评论家不喜欢这位作家浮夸且过度华丽的文风。

tutelage.note:
The young artist blossomed under the tutelage of a master. 这位年轻艺术家在大师的指导下蓬勃发展。

The developing nation was placed under international tutelage. 这个发展中国家被置于国际托管之下。

twaddle.meaning: n. 胡言乱语，废话；v. 讲废话
twaddle.note:
I refuse to listen to such political twaddle. 我拒绝听这种政治废话。

He sat in the pub twaddling away about his past glories. 他坐在酒吧里滔滔不绝地胡扯着他过去的辉煌。

tycoon.meaning: n. 大亨，巨头（尤指商业或工业领域的）
tycoon.note:
The media tycoon owns several newspapers and television stations. 这位媒体大亨拥有几家报纸和电视台。

He rose from a humble background to become a shipping tycoon. 他出身卑微，后来成为了一位航运巨头。

typhoon.note:
A powerful typhoon struck the southern coast of the country. 一场强烈的台风袭击了该国南部海岸。

All flights were canceled because the typhoon was approaching. 由于台风逼近，所有航班都被取消了。

ulcerate.note:
The chronic skin condition began to ulcerate. 这种慢性的皮肤状况开始溃烂。

If left untreated, the stomach lining can ulcerate. 如果不加以治疗，胃黏膜可能会形成溃疡。

ulterior.meaning: adj. 别有用心的，隐秘的，不可告人的
ulterior.note:
She suspected that his kind offer had an ulterior motive. 她怀疑他那份好意的背后有着不可告人的动机。

He had no ulterior purposes; he simply wanted to help. 他没有什么别有用心的目的，他只是想帮忙。

ultramundane.meaning: adj. 超尘脱俗的，超然世外的，精神世界的
ultramundane.note:
She sought an ultramundane peace away from city life. 她寻求一种远离城市生活的超然世外的平静。

The philosopher focused on ultramundane matters rather than daily chores. 这位哲学家专注于超越世俗的事物，而不是日常杂务。

unbidden.meaning: adj. 未受邀的，未经请求的，自发地
unbidden.note:
Tears came unbidden to her eyes when she heard the news. 当她听到这个消息时，眼泪夺眶而出。

Memories of her childhood arose unbidden in her mind. 她童年的记忆不由自主地浮现在脑海中。

unbridled.meaning: adj. 放纵的，无拘束的，失控的
unbridled.note:
The crowd showed unbridled joy when their team won the championship. 当他们的球队赢得冠军时，人群表现出无拘无束的喜悦。

Unbridled ambition can sometimes lead to ruin. 无节制的野心有时会导致毁灭。

uncooperative.meaning: adj. 不合作的，不配合的
uncooperative.note:
The suspect remained uncooperative throughout the police interrogation. 嫌疑人在整个警方审讯过程中一直不予配合。

She found it difficult to work with an uncooperative colleague. 她发现与一个不合作的同事共事很难。

undisputable.meaning: adj. 无可争辩的，毋庸置疑的
undisputable.note:
The scientist presented undisputable evidence to support her theory. 这位科学家提出了毋庸置疑的证据来支持她的理论。

It is an undisputable fact that the climate is changing. 气候正在变化，这是一个无可争辩的事实。

undulate.meaning: v. 起伏，波浪般起伏；adj. 波动状的
undulate.note:
The wheat fields undulate gently in the summer breeze. 麦田在夏日的微风中轻轻起伏。

The landscape consists of rolling hills that undulate for miles. 绵延数英里的起伏丘陵构成了这片风景。

unexceptional.meaning: adj. 平凡的，毫无特异之处的
unexceptional.note:
His performance in the exam was entirely unexceptional. 他在考试中的表现平平，毫无出彩之处。

It is an unexceptional house in a quiet suburban neighborhood. 这是位于安静郊区的一栋平凡无奇的房子。

unilateral.note:
The country made a unilateral decision to withdraw its troops. 该国做出了单方面撤军的决定。

Unilateral actions often strain international relations. 单边行动往往会紧张国际关系。

unison.meaning: n. 齐声，异口同声；和谐，一致
unison.note:
The children answered the teacher in unison. 孩子们异口同声地回答了老师。

If we work in unison, we can achieve our goals much faster. 如果我们齐心协力，就能更快地实现目标。

upfront.meaning: adj. 坦诚的，直率的；预付的
upfront.note:
She was completely upfront about her past mistakes. 她对过去的错误十分坦诚。

The company requires a 50 percent payment upfront. 公司要求预付百分之五十的款项。

upstart.meaning: n. 暴发户，突然得势的人；adj. 暴发户的
upstart.note:
The established companies looked down on the new upstart firm. 老牌公司看不起这家新崛起的新兴企业。

He was dismissed by critics as an arrogant upstart. 他被评论家贬为傲慢的暴发户。

upsurge.note:
There has been an unexpected upsurge in property prices recently. 最近房价出现了意料之外的暴涨。

The movie caused an upsurge of interest in classical music. 这部电影引起了人们对古典音乐高涨的兴趣。

uptight.meaning: adj. 焦虑的，紧张不安的；拘谨的
uptight.note:
There's no need to get so uptight about a minor mistake. 没必要为一个小小的小错误而如此紧张。

He seemed a bit uptight and unapproachable at first. 他一开始显得有点拘谨且难以接近。

ursine.note:
His heavy, plodding walk had a distinctly ursine quality. 他沉重、缓慢的步态具有明显的熊的特质。

The zoologist studied the ursine population in the forest. 这位动物学家研究了森林里的熊类种群。

uxorious.meaning: adj. 过于听从妻子的，怕老婆的
uxorious.note:
He was criticized in courtly circles for being overly uxorious. 他在宫廷圈子里因过于听从妻子而受到批评。

His uxorious devotion to his wife was well known among friends. 他对妻子百依百顺的温情在朋友间是出了名的。

vagabond.meaning: n. 流浪者，四处漂泊的人；adj. 流浪的
vagabond.note:
He spent his youth living a vagabond life across Europe. 他年轻时在欧洲过着四海为家的流浪生活。

The vagabond wandered from town to town without a fixed home. 这个流浪汉在各个城镇间漂泊，没有固定的家。

valetudinarian.meaning: n. 过度担心健康的人，体弱多病的人；adj. 多病的
valetudinarian.note:
He lived the life of a valetudinarian, constantly worried about catching a cold. 他过着多疑病弱的生活，总是担心感冒。

Her valetudinarian habits meant she rarely left the house. 她多疑体弱的习惯意味着她很少出门。

valor.meaning: n. 勇气，英勇（尤指在战场上）
valor.note:
The soldier was awarded a medal for extraordinary valor. 这名士兵因非凡的勇气被授予勋章。

Stories of their valor in battle were passed down for generations. 他们在战斗中英勇作战的故事代代相传。

vampire.note:
Legend says that vampires cannot survive in direct sunlight. 传说吸血鬼无法在阳光直射下生存。

He dressed up as a classic vampire for the Halloween party. 他为万圣节派对打扮成经典的吸血鬼形象。

vanguard.meaning: n. 先锋，前锋，领导地位
vanguard.note:
The university is in the vanguard of scientific research. 这所大学处于科学研究的前沿。

Troops marched at the vanguard of the advancing army. 部队在前进军队的最前沿行进。

vegetate.meaning: v. 过单调乏味的生活，无所事事；（植物）生长
vegetate.note:
He spent his vacation just vegetating in front of the television. 他的假期就是在电视机前无所事事地度过的。

After retiring, he felt like he was just vegetating. 退休后，他觉得自己只是在混日子。

ventral.note:
The fish has distinctive markings on its ventral side. 这条鱼的腹侧有独特的斑纹。

Ventral fins help the creature steer through the water. 腹鳍帮助这种生物在水中游动转向。

verge.meaning: n. 边，边缘；v. 濒临，接近
verge.note:
The company was on the verge of bankruptcy. 这家公司濒临破产边缘。

Her remarks verged on being offensive. 她的言论近乎冒犯。

vermin.meaning: n. 害虫，寄生虫；（喻）败类
vermin.note:
The old house was infested with rats and other vermin. 这栋老房子里到处都是老鼠和其他害虫。

He considered dishonest politicians to be social vermin. 他认为不诚实的政客是社会的败类。

vernal.note:
The vernal equinox marks the beginning of spring. 春分标志着春天的开始。

Flowers blossomed in the warm vernal sunshine. 花儿在温暖的春日阳光下盛开。

versemonger.note:
The critic dismissed the book as the work of a mere versemonger. 评论家认为这本书不过是一个平庸诗人的作品。

He fancied himself a great poet, but others viewed him as a versemonger. 他自以为是个伟大的诗人，但别人却把他看作一个蹩脚的写诗匠。

vesture.note:
The priests wore sacred vestures during the ceremony. 牧师们在仪式上穿著神圣的法衣。

The hills were covered in a green vesture of spring foliage. 群山披上了一层春日绿叶的翠绿外衣。

viand.meaning: n. 食品，食物（多用复数 viands）
viand.note:
The table was laden with rich viands and fine wines. 桌上摆满了丰盛的食物和美酒。

Guests enjoyed the various savory viands served at the feast. 客人们享用了宴会上提供的各种美味佳肴。

vicissitude.meaning: n. 变迁，兴衰，荣枯交替
vicissitude.note:
They managed to survive all the vicissitudes of fortune. 他们成功经受住了命运的一切沉浮变迁。

The historical town has seen many vicissitudes over the centuries. 这座历史悠久的小镇几个世纪以来经历了许多沧桑。

villainous.meaning: adj. 恶毒的，邪恶的，极坏的
villainous.note:
He played the role of a villainous character in the movie. 他在电影中扮演了一个邪恶的角色。

A villainous plot was uncovered by the police. 警方破获了一个恶毒的阴谋。

vim.note:
She is full of vim and vigor despite her advanced age. 尽管年事已高，她依然充满活力和干劲。

He tackled the job with great vim and enthusiasm. 他以极大的精气劲和热情投入到工作中。

vindication.meaning: n. 证明无罪，辩护，证实
vindication.note:
The court's verdict was a total vindication of his innocence. 法院的判决完全证明了他的清白。

Her successful experiment provided full vindication for her theory. 她成功的实验为她的理论提供了充分的证实。

vinegared.meaning: adj. 加醋的；酸溜溜的，刻薄的
vinegared.note:
The salad was served with a lightly vinegared dressing. 这道沙拉配有清淡的酸醋调味汁。

He replied with vinegared wit that silenced the room. 他用尖酸刻薄的机智回答，让全场鸦雀无声。

virago.note:
She was feared in the neighborhood as a notorious virago. 她因是个名副其实的泼妇而在邻里间令人畏惧。

In the comedy, she played a sharp-tongued virago. 在这部喜剧中，她扮演了一个尖酸刻薄的泼妇。

virile.meaning: adj. 男子气概的，有雄性活力的，强健的
virile.note:
The painting portrayed a virile warrior ready for battle. 这幅画描绘了一位准备战斗的充满男性气概的战士。

The band delivered a virile performance that thrilled the crowd. 乐队奉献了一场震撼全场的充满活力的表演。

visage.note:
A smile slowly spread across his stern visage. 他的严厉面容上慢慢绽放出了笑容。

The ancient castle retains its grim visage through the centuries. 这座古老的城堡几个世纪以来一直保持着严峻的外观。

visceral.meaning: adj. 内脏的；发自内心的，本能的
visceral.note:
The movie evokes a powerful visceral reaction from the audience. 这部电影唤起了观众强烈的本能反应。

She felt a visceral fear when she heard the sudden noise. 当听到突如其来的声音时，她感到一种发自内心的恐惧。

vitreous.note:
The sculpture had a smooth, vitreous surface. 这座雕塑有一个光滑的玻璃质表面。

The doctor examined the vitreous humor of the patient's eye. 医生检查了病人眼球的玻璃体。

vulpine.meaning: adj. 狐狸的；狡猾的，虚伪的
vulpine.note:
He gave a vulpine smile that inspired little trust. 他露出了一个狐狸般狡猾的微笑，让人很难信任。

The detective noted the suspect's sharp, vulpine features. 侦探注意到了嫌疑人敏锐、如狐狸般狡猾的特征。

wade.meaning: v. 蹚水，涉水；艰难地前进
wade.note:
They had to wade across the shallow river to reach the other side. 他们不得不蹚过浅浅的河流到达对岸。

It took hours to wade through the paperwork on his desk. 花了好几个小时才艰难地处理完他桌上的文件。

wail.meaning: n. 哭号，悲叹；v. 痛哭，哀号
wail.note:
We heard the wail of a police siren in the distance. 我们听到远处警车警报器的哀鸣。

The baby began to wail when his toy was taken away. 当玩具被拿走时，婴儿开始大哭起来。

wallop.meaning: v. 重击，猛打；n. 重击，猛烈的影响
wallop.note:
He gave the ball a solid wallop that sent it flying. 他狠狠地击了那球一下，使它飞了出去。

The economic crisis delivered a hard wallop to small businesses. 经济危机给小企业沉重的一击。

wallow.meaning: v. 打滚，沉溺于；n. 打滚坑
wallow.note:
Pigs love to wallow in the cool mud on hot days. 猪喜欢在炎热的天气里在凉爽的泥地里打滚。

There is no point in wallowing in self-pity after a failure. 失败后沉溺于自怜是没有意义的。

wangle.meaning: v. 巧取，通过手腕或诡计弄到
wangle.note:
He managed to wangle an invitation to the exclusive party. 他设法弄到了一张去那个独家派对的邀请函。

She wangled a day off work by talking to the manager. 她通过和经理交谈，巧妙地请到了一天假。

wanton.meaning: adj. 无故的，恶意的；放荡的，荒淫的
wanton.note:
The vandalism was an act of wanton destruction. 这种故意破坏行为纯属无端肆意的破坏。

He regretted his wanton lifestyle of his youth. 他后悔自己年轻时放荡不羁的生活方式。

warble.meaning: v.（鸟）鸣唱，用颤声唱；n. 鸟鸣声
warble.note:
Small birds began to warble in the trees at dawn. 清晨，小鸟开始在树枝上婉转鸣唱。

She could hear the sweet warble of nightingales in the garden. 她能听到花园里夜莺甜美的歌声。

waspish.meaning: adj. 尖刻的，易怒的，脾气坏的
waspish.note:
He made a waspish remark that offended several guests. 他发表了一句尖刻的言论，冒犯了几位客.

Her waspish temper made it difficult to work with her. 她易怒暴躁的脾气让人很难与她合作。

waylay.meaning: v. 埋伏截击，拦路搭讪
waylay.note:
Reporters waylaid the actor as he left the theater. 当演员离开剧院时，记者们拦住了他。

He was waylaid on his way home by an old friend. 他在回家的路上被一个老朋友拦住了。

weird.meaning: adj. 怪异的，古怪的，离奇的
weird.note:
I had a very weird dream last night about flying. 我昨晚做一个关于飞翔的非常怪异的梦。

There was a weird noise coming from the basement. 地下室里传出一种奇怪的声音。

welsh.meaning: v. 赖债，背信（通常与 on 连用）；n. 威尔士人
welsh.note:
He promised to pay me back but ended up welshing on the deal. 他承诺会还我钱，结果却在交易上反悔赖账。

You shouldn't trust someone who frequently welshes on promises. 你不应该信任一个经常违背承诺的人。

whelm.note:
The massive wave threatened to whelming the small boat. 这巨浪威胁要将这艘小船吞没。

He was whelmed by a sudden surge of grief. 他被突如其来的悲伤情绪所淹没。

whelp.meaning: n. 幼兽（狗、狼、狮等）；小家伙（蔑称）
whelp.note:
The mother dog kept a close eye on her newborn whelps. 母狗密切注视着它刚出生的幼崽。

Don't talk back to me, you insolent young whelp. 别顶嘴，你这无礼的小崽子。

whit.meaning: n. 一点儿，微量（多用于否定句）
whit.note:
He didn't care a whit about what people thought of him. 他对别人怎么看他一点也不在乎。

Her opinion hasn't changed a whit since our last talk. 自从我们上次谈话以来，她的看法一点也没有改变。

wig.note:
The actor wore a blonde wig for his role in the play. 这位演员在剧中为了角色戴了一顶金色的假发。

British judges traditionally wear white wigs in court. 英国法官传统上在法庭上戴白色假发。

wiggle.meaning: v. 摆动，扭动；n. 扭动
wiggle.note:
The puppy began to wiggle its tail in excitement. 小狗兴奋地开始摆动尾巴。

Can you wiggle your toes without moving your feet? 你能在不动脚的情况下扭动脚趾吗？

windfall.meaning: n. 意外之财，被风吹落的果实
windfall.note:
They used their unexpected financial windfall to pay off debts. 他们用这笔意外之财来偿还债务。

We gathered the windfall apples from the ground under the tree. 我们收集了树下地上的落果苹果。

winkle.meaning: n. 滨螺；v. 仔细搜寻，把…挖出（out）
winkle.note:
We spent the afternoon gathering winkles along the rocky shore. 我们在岩石海岸边度过了收集滨螺的下午。

It was hard to winkle the truth out of him. 从他嘴里套出真相真是不容易。

wiretap.meaning: n. 电话窃听；v. 窃听电话
wiretap.note:
The police obtained a warrant to place a wiretap on his phone. 警方获得了对其电话进行窃听的搜查令。

Investigators discovered that their phones had been wiretapped. 调查人员发现他们的电话被窃听了。

witch.note:
In fairy tales, the wicked witch lives deep in the dark forest. 在童话故事里，邪恶的女巫住在黑暗森林的深处。

Children dressed up as ghosts and witches for Halloween. 孩子们为了万圣节打扮成鬼魂和女巫。

wizardry.meaning: n. 巫术，魔法；极高超的技巧
wizardry.note:
The story is filled with ancient magic and wizardry. 这个故事充满了古老的魔法与巫术。

His mastery of computer programming is pure technological wizardry. 他对计算机编程的掌握纯粹是高超的技术魔力。

wizen.meaning: v.（使）变干瘪，枯萎；adj. 乾瘪的
wizen.note:
The apples had begun to wizen in the autumn sun. 苹果在秋日的阳光下开始变得干瘪。

An old man with a wizened face sat on the porch. 一个面容干瘪的老人坐在走廊上。

wont.meaning: adj. 习惯于的；n. 习惯，惯常的做法
wont.note:
As is his wont, he arrived early for the meeting. 照例，他开会来得很早。

He was wont to take a long walk every evening. 他习惯每天晚上散步很长时间。

woodcut.note:
The book was illustrated with fine 19th-century woodcuts. 这本书配有精美的19世纪木版画插图。

He created a stunning woodcut of a landscape. 他创作了一幅令人惊叹的风景木刻画。

wraith.meaning: n. 幽灵，幻影，形影单只的人
wraith.note:
A pale figure moved through the fog like a wraith. 一个苍白的身影像幽灵般穿过雾气。

She looked like a mere wraith after her long illness. 经历长期疾病后，她看起来瘦得像个幽灵。

wrangle.meaning: n. 争吵，争辩；v. 争论，口角
wrangle.note:
The two politicians engaged in a bitter legal wrangle. 这两名政治家陷入了一场激烈的法律争端中。

They spent hours wrangling over the division of property. 他们花了几个小时争论财产的分割问题。

wreak.meaning: v. 造成（破坏等），发泄（怒气等）
wreak.note:
The storm wreaked havoc across the coastal region. 这场暴风雨给沿海地区造成了严重破坏。

He wanted to wreak vengeance on those who betrayed him. 他想向那些背叛他的人发泄复仇。

wreathe.meaning: v. 盘绕，缠绕，使成环状
wreathe.note:
Smoke wreathed around the chimney in the cold air. 寒冷的空气中，烟雾环绕着烟囱。

Her hair was wreathed with fresh flowers for the festival. 节日里，她的头发上缠绕着鲜花。

wreckage.note:
Investigators searched the wreckage of the plane for clues. 调查人员在飞机残骸中搜寻线索。

Pieces of wreckage washed up on the remote beach. 残骸的碎片被冲上了偏远的沙滩。

yeoman.meaning: n. 自耕农；海军军需官；英勇的人
yeoman.note:
Historically, English yeomen formed the backbone of the archer ranks. 历史上，英国自耕农构成了弓箭手队伍的中坚力量。

He did yeoman service during the crisis, working tirelessly. 他在危机期间立下了汗马功劳，不知疲倦地工作。

zesty.meaning: adj. 滋味浓郁的，开胃的；生气勃勃的
zesty.note:
The dish is seasoned with a zesty lemon sauce. 这道菜调有浓郁开胃的柠檬酱汁。

She brought a zesty energy to the new team project. 她为新的团队项目带来了生气勃勃的活力。

annex.meaning: v. 吞并，兼并；n. 附件，附属建筑
annex.note:
The country threatened to annex neighboring territories. 该国威胁要吞并邻近领土。

Classes are held in the newly built school annex. 课程在新建立的学校附属建筑里上。

barbarian.meaning: n. 野蛮人，粗鲁无礼的人；adj. 野蛮的
barbarian.note:
Ancient Romans referred to outsiders as barbarians. 古罗马人把外族人称为野蛮人。

His manners at the dinner table were downright barbarian. 他在餐桌上的举止简直野蛮粗鲁。

barcode.note:
The cashier scanned the barcode on the back of the book. 收银员扫描了书本背面的条形码。

Every product in the store has a unique barcode. 店里的每件商品都有一个独特的条形码。

bewitching.meaning: adj. 迷人的，妖娆的，有魔力的
bewitching.note:
She cast a bewitching spell over the audience with her voice. 她用歌声对观众施下了迷人的魔力。

The garden looked bewitching in the moonlight. 在月光下，花园显得格外迷人。

bumpkinly.meaning: adj. 乡巴佬气的，粗俗笨拙的
bumpkinly.note:
He tried to hide his bumpkinly background in high society. 他试图在上流社会掩饰自己乡巴佬气的背景。

Her awkward, bumpkinly manners amused the city guests. 她笨拙、土气的举止逗乐了城里来的客人们。

cell.meaning: n. 细胞；单间牢房；电池
cell.note:
All living organisms are made up of tiny cells. 所有生物都是由微小的细胞构成的。

The prisoner spent ten years locked in a damp cell. 这名犯人在潮湿的牢房里被关了十年。

chaperone.meaning: n. 监护人，伴护；v. 陪伴，伴护
chaperone.note:
Teachers volunteered to chaperone the school field trip. 老师们自愿担任学校郊游的伴护。

She needed a chaperone when she attended the high school dance. 她去参加高中舞会时需要一个伴护。

dab.meaning: v. 轻触，轻拍；n. 小量，一点点
dab.note:
She dabbed her eyes with a tissue to dry her tears. 她用纸巾轻轻擦拭眼睛以擦干眼泪。

Add just a dab of butter to the frying pan. 在平底锅里加一点点黄油即可。

dashing.meaning: adj. 帅气的，潇洒的；标致的
dashing.note:
He looked very dashing in his formal black tuxedo. 他穿著正式的黑色燕尾服，看起来十分帅气潇洒。

The hero of the novel is a dashing young adventurer. 小说的主角是一个风度翩翩的年轻冒险家。

dike.note:
The strong dike protected the village from the rising floodwaters. 坚固的堤坝保护了村庄免受上涨洪水的侵害。

Workers repaired the broken dike before the heavy rain started. 工人们在大雨开始前修复了破损的堤坝。

employ.note:
The factory plans to employ fifty more workers next month. 这家工厂计划下个月再雇佣五十名工人。

You should employ effective study strategies to pass the exam. 你应该采用有效的学习策略来通过考试。

epistolary.note:
The novel is written in an epistolary style using letters and diaries. 这部小说采用书信和日记的书信体风格写成。

She has a rich collection of epistolary literature from the 18th century. 她收藏了大量18世纪的书信文学作品。

evildoer.note:
Superheroes in comics always fight against evildoers. 漫画里的超级英雄总是与作恶者战斗。

Justice will eventually catch up with every evildoer. 正义终究会追上每一个作恶者。

fair.meaning: adj. 公平的，公正的；n. 集市，交易会
fair.note:
The judge ensured that both sides received a fair trial. 法官确保双方都得到了公正的审判。

We went to the annual agricultural fair in town. 我们去了镇上的年度农业集市。

fetching.meaning: adj. 迷人的，动人的，美丽的
fetching.note:
She wore a fetching blue dress to the evening gala. 她在晚会上穿了一条迷人的蓝色礼服裙。

Her fetching smile won over everyone in the room. 她迷人的微笑赢得了房间里所有人的好感。

fibrous.meaning: adj. 纤维状的，含纤维的
fibrous.note:
Celery has a tough, fibrous texture that takes time to chew. 芹菜质地坚韧且富含纤维，需要时间咀嚼。

The plant has fibrous roots that anchor it deeply in the soil. 这种植物拥有纤维状的根系，能深深扎根于土壤中。

foreordain.note:
He felt that his future career as a doctor was foreordained. 他觉得他未来作为医生的职业是命中注定的。

Their victory in the match seemed foreordained from the start. 他们在比赛中的胜利从一开始就似乎是注定的。

gag.meaning: n. 塞口物，笑话；v. 塞住嘴，作呕
gag.note:
The kidnappers tied his hands and put a gag in his mouth. 绑匪绑了他的手，并把他的嘴塞住。

The comedian told a funny gag that made the audience laugh. 这位喜剧演员讲了一个逗得观众大笑的笑话。

granulate.note:
Sugar is processed and granulated before being packaged. 糖在包装前经过加工并制成颗粒状。

The ointment helps the skin wound to granulate and heal. 这种药膏有助于皮肤伤口结粒并愈合。

leverage.meaning: n. 杠杆作用，影响力；v. 充分利用
leverage.note:
They used their financial leverage to negotiate a better deal. 他们利用其财务影响力谈判争取到了更好的交易。

The company plans to leverage its brand name to enter new markets. 公司计划利用其品牌知名度进入新市场。

madcap.meaning: adj. 鲁莽的，疯狂的，爱闹的；n. 狂热的人
madcap.note:
They embarked on a madcap adventure across Europe. 他们开始了横跨欧洲的疯狂冒险。

Her madcap schemes always lead to unexpected amusement. 她那些疯狂的计划总能带来意想不到的乐趣。

marbled.meaning: adj. 有大理石花纹的，具云石斑纹的
marbled.note:
The high-end steak was beautifully marbled with fat. 这块高端牛排带有漂亮的大理石脂肪纹路。

The book cover featured a classic marbled paper design. 书籍封面采用经典的大理石纹纸设计。

mastermind.meaning: n. 策划者，幕后主使；v. 精心策划
mastermind.note:
He was identified as the mastermind behind the bank robbery. 他被确认为银行抢劫案的幕后主谋。

She helped mastermind the company's successful expansion strategy. 她协助精心策划了公司成功的扩张战略。

observant.meaning: adj. 善于观察的，机警的；严格遵守的
observant.note:
The observant reader will notice clues hidden in the text. 善于观察的读者会注意到文本中隐藏的线索。

He is very observant of local traditions and customs. 他对当地的传统和习俗非常严格遵守。

pat.meaning: v./n. 轻拍，抚摸；adj. 现成的，陈腐的
pat.note:
She gave her dog a gentle pat on the head. 她轻轻拍了拍狗的头部。

His explanation sounded too pat to be completely true. 他的解释听起来太现成了，不完全真实。

photorespiration.meaning: n. 光呼吸（植物学名词）
photorespiration.note:
Photorespiration reduces the overall efficiency of photosynthesis in some plants. 光呼吸降低了某些植物光合作用的总体效率。

Scientists are researching ways to minimize photorespiration in crops. 科学家们正在研究如何将农作物的光呼吸降到最低。

privy.meaning: adj. 知情的，秘密的；n. 厕所
privy.note:
Few people were privy to the confidential business plans. 极少数人知晓这些机密的商业计划。

She was not privy to the discussion between the managers. 她没有参与经理们之间的私下讨论。

proscenium.meaning: n. 舞台前部，前台拱门
proscenium.note:
The actors gathered behind the proscenium before the curtain rose. 演员们在帷幕拉开前聚集在舞台前部后面。

Classic theaters often feature an ornate proscenium arch. 经典剧院通常设有华丽的前台拱门。

radical.meaning: adj. 激进的，根本的；n. 激进分子
radical.note:
The committee proposed radical changes to the tax system. 委员会对税收制度提出了根本性的改革。

He has always held radical views on social welfare. 他对社会福利一直持激进观点。

rascal.note:
The little rascal hid my car keys as a joke. 这个小调皮把我的车钥匙藏起来开玩笑。

Don't trust him; he is an absolute rascal. 别信任他，他绝对是个无赖。

scrimp.note:
They had to scrimp and save for years to buy a house. 他们为了买房省吃俭用多年。

She refused to scrimp on quality when buying ingredients. 她买食材时拒绝在质量上省钱。

slink.note:
The cat slinked quietly across the living room floor. 猫悄悄地溜过起居室的地板。

He tried to slink out of the room before anyone noticed. 他试图在没人注意之前溜出房间。

spoilsport.note:
Don't be a spoilsport; stay a little longer at the party. 别扫兴，在派对上再多待一会儿吧。

He ruined the fun for everyone and was called a spoilsport. 他毁了大家的乐趣，被叫作扫兴鬼。

steward.meaning: n. 乘务员，管家，管理人员
steward.note:
The airline steward served drinks to the passengers. 航空公司乘务员为乘客提供饮料。

He acted as a good steward of the family's estate. 他担任了家族产业的优秀管理人。

traipse.meaning: v. 疲惫地走，溜达，闲逛
traipse.note:
We spent hours traipsing around the department stores. 我们花了好几个小时在百货公司里逛来逛去。

I don't feel like traipsing through the mud today. 我今天不想在泥地里到处乱走。

tureen.note:
The hot soup was served from a silver tureen. 热汤是从一个银制的大汤碗里盛出来的。

She placed the heavy soup tureen in the center of the table. 她把沉重的大汤碗放在桌子正中央。

untrammeled.meaning: adj. 不受拘束的，自由自在的
untrammeled.note:
She longed for an untrammeled life in the countryside. 她向往乡村里自由自在的生活。

The artist's imagination remained untrammeled by rules. 这位艺术家的想象力不受规则的约束。

verisimilitude.note:
The novel's historical details added a sense of verisimilitude. 小说中的历史细节增添了一种逼真的感觉。

The film strives for verisimilitude in its special effects. 这部电影在其特效中力求逼真。

willy.meaning: adj. 诡计多端的，狡猾的（多用于 willy-nilly 身不由己）
willy.note:
They were dragged willy-nilly into the bitter family dispute. 他们身不由己地被卷入激烈的家族纠纷中。

The schedule changes willy-nilly depending on the weather. 时间表根据天气情况随心所欲地变化着。

winning.meaning: adj. 获胜的，迷人的，讨人喜欢的
winning.note:
She flashed a winning smile that charmed everyone. 她露出了迷人的微笑，迷倒了所有人。

The team scored the winning goal in the final minute. 球队在最后一分钟攻入了制胜一球。

wrest.note:
They managed to wrest control of the company from the rivals. 他们设法从竞争对手手中夺取了公司的控制权。

He tried to wrest the weapon away from the attacker. 他试图将袭击者的武器夺下来。

animadvert.note:
The critic animadverted sharply upon the author's new novel. 评论家对这位作家的长篇新作进行了严厉的批评。

She hesitated to animadvert on choices made by her colleagues. 她对同事们的选择犹豫着不去横加指责。

arrant.meaning: adj. 彻底的，十足的（用于贬义）
arrant.note:
His claims about winning the lottery werearrant nonsense. 他关于中彩票的言论纯属无稽之谈。

She dismissed the rumors as arrant falsehoods. 她把这些谣言斥为彻头彻尾的虚假谎言。

assoil.note:
The priest offered to assoil him of his past sins. 牧师主动提出赦免他过去的罪孽。

He sought a formal pardon to assoil his damaged reputation. 他寻求正式的赦免以恢复受损的名誉。

befoul.note:
Industrial waste began to befoul the clean river water. 工业废料开始污染干净的河水。

He refused to befoul the memory of his former mentor. 他拒绝玷污他前导师的名声。

besot.meaning: v. 使迷恋，使昏迷，使糊涂
besot.note:
He was completely besotted with her beauty and charm. 他完全被她的美貌和魅力迷住了。

Too much alcohol can besot the mind and dull reflexes. 过量的酒精会使头脑昏沉、反应迟钝。

blather.meaning: v. 胡说八道；n. 废话，胡言乱语
blather.note:
I got tired of listening to him blather on about politics. 我听腻了他喋喋不休地谈论政治废话。

She ignored his drunken blather and walked away. 她无视他酒后吐出的胡话，径直走开了。

bleary.meaning: adj.（眼睛）模糊不清的，昏花的
bleary.note:
He rubbed his bleary eyes after pulling an all-nighter. 通宵熬夜后，他揉了揉昏花模糊的眼睛。

She woke up with a bleary head and a sore throat. 她醒来时头脑昏沉，嗓子疼。

bonny.meaning: adj. 漂亮可爱的，健康的
bonny.note:
They welcomed a bonny baby girl into the family. 他们迎来了家里一个健康可爱的小女婴。

She looked bonny in her new traditional Scottish dress. 她穿著崭新的传统苏格兰服装，看起来很漂亮。

bouncing.meaning: adj. 健康活泼的，精力充沛的
bouncing.note:
The proud parents showed off their bouncing baby boy. 骄傲的父母展示了他们健康活泼的小男孩。

She walked in with a bouncing step and a bright smile. 她迈着轻快有力的步伐走进来，带着灿烂的笑容。

buffet.meaning: v. 连续猛击，打击；n. 自助餐
buffet.note:
The small boat was buffeted by high winds and huge waves. 小船遭到大风和巨浪的不断冲击。

Guests lined up to enjoy the rich variety at the hotel buffet. 客人们排队享用酒店丰富多样的自助餐。

bulldoze.meaning: v. 用推土机推平；强迫，威逼
bulldoze.note:
Workers used heavy machinery to bulldoze the old buildings. 工人们使用重型机械推平了这些老建筑。

He tried to bulldoze the committee into accepting his proposal. 他试图威逼委员会接受他的提议。

bullish.meaning: adj. 乐观的，看涨的（金融用语）
bullish.note:
Investors remain bullish about the future of tech stocks. 投资者对科技股的未来保持乐观态度。

The CEO gave a bullish forecast for the company's annual revenue. 首席执行官对公司的年营收给出了看涨的预测。

bullyrag.note:
The supervisor liked to bullyrag his junior employees. 主管喜欢大声斥责和恐吓他的初级员工。

She refused to let anyone bullyrag her during the meeting. 她拒绝让任何人会议期间对她恶言相向。

canorous.meaning: adj. 悦耳的，洪亮 melodious 的
canorous.note:
The singer's canorous voice filled the grand concert hall. 歌手悦耳动听的歌声回荡在宏伟的音乐厅里。

We listened to the canorous tones of the cello. 我们聆听着大提琴悠扬悦耳的音调。

chaffing.note:
His chaffing remarks kept the atmosphere light and friendly. 他开玩笑的话语让气氛保持轻松友好。

They exchanged good-natured, chaffing comments before the match. 比赛前他们互相开了善意的玩笑。

champ.meaning: v. 嚼（草料等），急于（做某事）；n. 冠军
champ.note:
The horses champed restlessly at their bits in the stalls. 马儿在马厩里不安地嚼着嚼铁。

He is the reigning world champ in heavyweight boxing. 他是现任重量级拳击世界冠军。

cheeky.meaning: adj. 厚颜无耻的，俏皮的，放肆的
cheeky.note:
The boy gave a cheeky grin when caught stealing cookies. 被抓到偷曲奇时，这男孩露出了一个俏皮的笑。

She made a cheeky comment that made her friends laugh. 她发表了一条俏皮的评论，逗得朋友们哈哈大笑。

chipper.meaning: adj. 爽朗的，兴高采烈的，活泼的
chipper.note:
She was remarkably chipper despite waking up very early. 尽管起得很早，她依然精神焕发、兴高采烈。

He greeted everyone with a chipper voice in the morning. 他早上用爽朗轻快的声音向每个人打招呼。

chubby.note:
The baby had adorable chubby cheeks. 婴儿有着圆乎乎、胖嘟嘟的可爱面颊。

He smiled, showing his chubby hands holding a toy. 他微笑着，露出他胖乎乎的手拿着玩具。

chuck.meaning: v. 扔，抛；抚摸（下巴）；解雇
chuck.note:
He chucked his old clothes into the washing machine. 他把旧衣服扔进了洗衣机。

She chucked her job to travel around the world. 她辞去了工作去环游世界。

clamber.note:
The children clambered over the large rocks on the beach. 孩子们在海滩上的大石头上爬上爬下。

He clambered up the steep hill with some difficulty. 他有些艰难地爬上了陡峭的小山。

clammy.note:
Her hands felt cold and clammy from nervousness. 由于紧张，她的双手感到冰冷黏湿。

The cave had a dark and clammy atmosphere. 这个洞穴有一种阴暗而潮湿黏糊的氛围。

con.meaning: v. 诈骗，哄骗；n. 骗局，缺点（pros and cons 中的 con）
con.note:
The criminal used a clever scheme to con elderly people. 这名罪犯用了一个聪明的计谋来诈骗老年人。

We need to weigh all the pros and cons of this decision. 我们需要权衡这项决定的所有利弊。

countrified.meaning: adj. 乡下风味的，具有乡土气息的
countrified.note:
The restaurant has a cozy, countrified decor. 这家餐厅拥有温馨的乡村风格装饰。

Her style of dressing is simple and somewhat countrified. 她的穿衣风格简单且带有几分乡土气息。

crackpot.meaning: adj. 荒唐的，怪异的；n. 怪人，狂想者
crackpot.note:
He presented a crackpot theory about time travel. 他提出了一个关于时间旅行的荒诞理论。

Neighbors dismissed him as a harmless local crackpot. 邻居们把他当成一个无害的本地怪人。

crib.meaning: n. 婴儿床；v. 抄袭，剽窃
crib.note:
The baby slept soundly in his wooden crib. 婴儿在他的木质婴儿床里睡得很香。

He was caught trying to crib answers from his classmate. 他被抓到试图抄袭同学的答案。

crimp.note:
She used a curling iron to crimp her hair for the party. 她用卷发棒把头发弄卷去参加派对。

The bad weather put a crimp in our outdoor plans. 恶劣的天气阻碍了我们的户外计划。

cull.meaning: v. 挑选，剔除，挑出；n. 剔除
cull.note:
The publisher culled the best poems for the anthology. 出版社为诗集挑选出了最好的诗篇。

Wildlife officials authorized a deer cull to control the population. 野生动物官员批准了一项鹿群扑杀计划以控制数量。

dash.meaning: v. 猛冲，疾走；n. 短跑，少量
dash.note:
He had to dash to catch the last train home. 他不得不冲去赶回家的末班车。

Add a dash of salt to improve the flavor of the soup. 加一点点盐来改善汤的风味。

desist.note:
The court ordered the company to desist from polluting the river. 法院命令该公司停止污染河流。

They were asked to desist making noise late at night. 他们被要求在深夜停止制造噪音。

dicker.note:
He spent an hour dickering with the merchant over the price. 他花了一个小时与商人讨价还价。

There is no point dickering over such a small amount of money. 为这么一小笔钱讨价还价是没有意义的。

dillydally.meaning: v. 磨蹭，虚度光阴，犹豫不决
dillydally.note:
Don't dillydally or we will miss the beginning of the movie. 别磨蹭，否则我们会错过电影开场。

She tends to dillydally when she should be packing. 她本该打包行李时却总喜欢磨蹭。

dither.meaning: v. 慌乱，犹豫不决；n. 慌乱状态
dither.note:
There is no need to get into a dither over a simple test. 没必要为一次简单的测试而惊慌失措。

She dithered for days before making a final decision. 她犹豫了好几天才做出最终决定。

divers.meaning: adj. 各种各样的，好几个的（文语）
divers.note:
The traveler shared stories from his divers adventures. 这位旅行者分享了他各种冒险经历的故事。

She has discussed this matter with divers colleagues. 她已经与好几位同事讨论过这件事。

dowse.meaning: v. 用占卜杖寻找（水源等）；熄灭（同 dout）
dowse.note:
He used a willow branch to dowse for underground water. 他用柳树枝来探寻地下水源。

Make sure you dowse the campfire before leaving the site. 离开营地前务必把营火熄灭。

draggy.meaning: adj. 沉闷的，拖沓的，无精打采的
draggy.note:
The second half of the movie felt a bit draggy and slow. 电影的下半部分让人感觉有些拖沓缓慢。

I am feeling a bit draggy today after working long hours. 长时间工作后，我今天感觉有点无精打采。

drawn.meaning: adj. 憔悴的，疲惫的；动词 draw 的过去分词
drawn.note:
His face looked pale and drawn after the exhausting ordeal. 经历这番筋疲力尽的磨难后，他的脸看起来苍白而憔悴。

The curtains were drawn tightly against the morning light. 窗帘拉得紧紧的，挡住了清晨的光线。

drip.meaning: v. 滴落；n. 水滴，点滴
drip.note:
Water began to drip from the leaky roof into a bucket. 水从漏雨的屋顶一滴滴落入水桶中。

She heard the slow drip of the faucet in the kitchen. 她听到了厨房里水龙头缓慢的滴水声。

drool.meaning: v. 流口水，胡言乱语；n. 口水
drool.note:
The hungry dog began to drool at the sight of the meat. 看到肉时，这只饥饿的狗开始流口水。

He drooled with excitement when he saw his new car. 看到他的新车时，他兴奋得语无伦次。

drub.meaning: v. 痛打，完胜，严厉批评
drub.note:
Our team was heavily drubbed in the championship final. 我们队在冠军决赛中被狠狠击败了。

The local press drubbed the mayor for his poor leadership. 当地媒体因市长糟糕的领导能力而对他进行了严厉批评。

edgy.meaning: adj. 烦躁的，紧张的；前卫的
edgy.note:
He has been feeling a bit edgy all day due to stress. 由于压力，他一整天都感觉有点烦躁不安。

The movie has an edgy style that appeals to younger viewers. 这部电影拥有吸引年轻观众的前卫风格。

elysian.note:
They spent an elysian afternoon relaxing by the quiet lake. 他们在宁静的湖边度过了一个天堂般惬意的下午。

The poem describes an elysian realm of peace and beauty. 这首诗描绘了一个充满和平与美丽的极乐世界。

encomiastic.note:
The biography was filled with encomiastic praise for the leader. 这部传记充斥着对这位领导人的赞美之词。

She delivered an encomiastic speech at the retirement ceremony. 她在退休仪式上发表了一篇赞颂的演讲。

epideictic.meaning: adj. 夸耀的，炫耀的，演说辞令的
epideictic.note:
Ancient rhetoricians often practiced epideictic speaking. 古代修辞学家经常练习炫耀性的演说。

The essay serves as an example of classical epideictic literature. 这篇文章是古典炫耀性文学的一个例子。

fancied.meaning: adj. 想象中的，虚构的；动词 fancy 的过去式
fancied.note:
His worries were mostly based on fancied dangers. 他的担忧大多基于想象中的危险。

She fancied herself as an expert in modern art. 她自认为是现代艺术专家。

fatidic.meaning: adj. 有预言能力的，预示未来的
fatidic.note:
The mystic made a fatidic prediction about the kingdom's future. 这位神秘主义者对王国的未来做出了预言性的预测。

People listened closely to her fatidic words. 人们仔细倾听她那些预示未来的话语。

finagle.meaning: v. 欺骗，用手腕获取，骗取
finagle.note:
He managed to finagle free tickets for the concert. 他设法弄到了音乐会的免费门票。

She finagled her way into a better position at work. 她通过耍手腕在工作中谋得了一个更好的职位。

flatulent.meaning: adj. 产气的，腹胀的；（言辞）浮夸空洞的
flatulent.note:
Certain foods can make you feel bloated and flatulent. 某些食物会让你感到腹胀和排气。

The speech was dismissed as flatulent and meaningless. 这篇演讲被斥为空洞浮夸、毫无意义。

flighty.meaning: adj. 轻浮的，反复无常的，易冲动的
flighty.note:
She was known for her flighty and unpredictable behavior. 她以行为轻浮、反复无常而闻名。

Don't rely on his flighty promises; he changes his mind constantly. 别指望他那反复无常的承诺，他总是改变主意。

flimflam.meaning: n. 骗局，胡言乱语；v. 诈骗
flimflam.note:
The investor fell victim to a clever financial flimflam. 这名投资者成了一场精明金融骗局的受害者。

He tried to sell us some flimflam about a get-rich-quick scheme. 他试图向我们推销一些关于快速致富骗局的鬼话。

flossy.meaning: adj. 丝绒般的；华而不实的，时髦的
flossy.note:
The dog had a soft, flossy white coat. 这只狗有一件柔软如丝绒般的白色外衣。

She preferred a simple lifestyle over flossy city luxury. 她比起华而不实的都市奢华，更喜欢简单的生活方式。

flummox.meaning: v. 使困惑，使不知所措
flummox.note:
The difficult math question completely flummoxed the students. 这道艰难的数学题把学生们彻底难住了。

He looked flummoxed when asked about the sudden change of plans. 当被问及计划突然改变时，他显得不知所措。

folksy.meaning: adj. 亲切的，平易近人的，具民间风味的
folksy.note:
The politician adopted a folksy tone to connect with voters. 这位政治家采用了亲切平易近人的语调来拉近与选民的距离。

The cafe is decorated in a warm, folksy style. 这家咖啡馆采用温馨的民间风格进行装饰。

freestanding.meaning: adj. 独立式的，自由立柱的
freestanding.note:
The kitchen island is a freestanding unit that can be moved. 厨房中岛是一个可以移动的独立式单元。

We need a freestanding bookshelf for the corner of the room. 我们需要一个放在房间角落的独立式书架。

frumpy.meaning: adj. 老气横秋的，不时髦的
frumpy.note:
She thought her old winter coat looked a bit frumpy. 她觉得她那件旧冬衣看起来有点老气。

She decided to update her wardrobe and ditch her frumpy clothes. 她决定更新衣柜，扔掉那些不时髦的衣服。

fuddle.meaning: v. 使迷糊，灌醉；n. 混乱状态
fuddle.note:
Too much wine can fuddle the brain. 过多的葡萄酒会使人头脑迷糊。

He woke up with his thoughts in a complete fuddle. 他醒来时，思绪陷入了一片混乱之中。

funky.meaning: adj. 时髦的，另类的；有霉味的
funky.note:
He wore a funky jacket with bright patterns to the party. 他穿了一件带有明亮图案的时髦夹克去参加派对。

There was a funky smell coming from the old refrigerator. 那台老旧冰箱里散发出一种霉味。

gabby.meaning: adj. 话多的，喋喋不休的
gabby.note:
She was in a gabby mood and talked throughout the trip. 她当时话很多，一路上都在滔滔不绝。

The gabby passenger wouldn't stop chatting on the bus. 这个话多的乘客在公车上说个不停。

gawky.note:
He was a gawky teenager who often tripped over his feet. 他曾经是个笨拙的少年，经常被自己的脚绊倒。

She looked back with a smile at her gawky school days. 她微笑着回首自己笨拙的学生时代。

goof.meaning: v. 混日子，犯傻；n. 傻瓜，错误
goof.note:
He spent the whole afternoon goofing off instead of studying. 他整个下午都在偷懒混日子，没有学习。

That was a silly goof on my part; I apologize. 那是我犯的一个愚蠢错误，我道歉。

gracile.note:
The dancer had a gracile and agile physique. 这名舞者有着纤细而敏捷的体格。

Evolutionary biologists study the gracile features of early humans. 进化生物学家研究早期人类纤细的身体特征。

gravitate.meaning: v. 被吸引到，受引力作用向…移动
gravitate.note:
Young people tend to gravitate toward the city center for nightlife. 年轻人往往倾向于被吸引到市中心过夜生活。

Objects gravitate toward each other due to gravitational pull. 物体由于引力作用而相互吸引。

hanker.meaning: v. 渴望，向往（常与 after/for 连用）
hanker.note:
After living in the city, he began to hanker for country life. 在城市居住后，他开始渴望乡村生活。

She hankered after a simpler and more peaceful existence. 她渴望一种更简单、更宁静的存在。

hazy.meaning: adj. 烟雾迷蒙的，模糊不清的
hazy.note:
The distant mountains were hidden behind a hazy morning mist. 远处的山峦被早晨朦胧的薄雾遮挡住了。

My memory of that childhood event is still rather hazy. 我对那个童年事件的记忆仍然相当模糊。

heady.meaning: adj. 令人陶醉的，刺激的；任性的
heady.note:
They enjoyed the heady success of their first business venture. 他们享受着初次创业带来令人陶醉的成功。

The wine had a heady aroma that filled the room. 这款酒散发出一股充满刺激陶醉感的香气。

huffish.meaning: adj. 生气的，生闷气的，盛气凌人的
huffish.note:
He became huffish when his ideas were rejected. 当他的想法被拒绝时，他显得有些生闷气。

She left the room in a huffish mood after the argument. 争吵过后，她带着生气的表情离开了房间。

huffy.note:
There is no need to get huffy just over a minor joke. 没必要仅仅因为一个小玩笑就生气发火。

She gave a huffy reply and turned away. 她没好气地回了一句，然后转过身去。

hunker.meaning: v. 蹲下，蹲伏（常与 down 连用）
hunker.note:
He hunkered down behind the wall to avoid the wind. 他在墙后蹲下身子以避风。

We hunkered down to study hard for the final exams. 我们蹲下来（比喻聚精会神）努力准备期末考试。

hurtle.meaning: v. 呼啸而过，猛烈疾飞
hurtle.note:
The runaway car hurtled down the steep hill. 失控的汽车呼啸着冲下陡峭的山坡。

Comets hurtle through space at incredible speeds. 彗星以不可思议的速度在太空中疾飞。

interlard.meaning: v. 点缀，夹杂（言语或文章中）
interlard.note:
He tended to interlard his speech with foreign phrases. 他倾向于在演讲中夹杂一些外国短语。

The author interlarded the serious essay with humorous anecdotes. 作者在这篇严肃的文章中点缀了幽默的轶事。

jab.note:
She gave him a playful jab in the ribs with her elbow. 她用手肘顽皮地戳了他的肋骨一下。

He went to the clinic to get his annual flu jab. 他去诊所打年度流感疫苗。

josh.meaning: v. 开玩笑，戏弄；n. 玩笑
josh.note:
Don't take him seriously; he is just joshing you. 别当真，他只是在跟你开玩笑。

They spent the evening laughing and joshing each other. 他们整个晚上都在欢笑并互相开玩笑。

jostle.note:
Shoppers jostled each other in the crowded holiday market. 购物者在拥挤的节日市场里互相推挤。

He was jostled by the crowd as he tried to exit the train. 当他试图下车时，他在人群中被推挤了一下。

jounce.meaning: v. 颠簸，颠动；n. 颠簸
jounce.note:
The old truck jounced along the bumpy dirt road. 这辆旧卡车在颠簸的泥路上上下颠簸着前进。

Every jounce of the carriage made her back hurt. 马车的每一次颠簸都让她的背部疼痛。

jumpy.meaning: adj. 神经质的，紧张不安的
jumpy.note:
The loud thunder made the dog feel nervous and jumpy. 巨大的雷声让狗感到紧张不安。

She has been jumpy ever since watching the horror movie. 自从看了恐怖电影以来，她一直神经质的。

lard.meaning: n. 猪油；v. 涂猪油于，点缀
lard.note:
The recipe calls for a cup of lard to make the pastry flaky. 这道食谱需要一杯猪油来使糕点酥脆。

He larded his lecture with numerous complex historical quotes. 他的讲座点缀了大量的复杂历史名言。

leach.meaning: v. 过滤，沥滤，（化学物质等）流失
leach.note:
Heavy rain can leach essential nutrients from the soil. 大雨会从土壤中冲走必需的营养成分。

Toxic chemicals began to leach out from the waste site. 有毒化学物质开始从废物场渗滤出来。

lymphatic.meaning: adj. 淋巴的；迟钝 sluggish 的
lymphatic.note:
The doctor examined the swollen lymphatic glands in his neck. 医生检查了他颈部肿大的淋巴腺。

He appeared somewhat lymphatic and lacked energy today. 他今天显得有些迟钝缺乏活力。

matte.meaning: adj. 亚光的，无光泽的；n. 哑光漆
matte.note:
She preferred a matte finish for her bedroom walls. 她更喜欢为卧室墙壁选择哑光漆面。

This lipstick has a long-lasting matte texture. 这款唇膏具有持久的哑光质感。

maunder.meaning: v. 闲逛；胡乱唠叨，喋喋不休
maunder.note:
He spent the afternoon maundering through the city streets. 他整个下午都在城市街道上漫无目的地闲逛。

Stop maundering and get straight to the point. 别再唠叨了，直接说重点吧。

mealy.meaning: adj. 面粉状的，粉质的；苍白的
mealy.note:
The old apple had a soft, mealy texture. 这个老苹果有一种柔软、粉质的口感。

He had a mealy complexion that showed poor health. 他的面色苍白，显示出健康状况不佳。

muck.meaning: n. 粪肥，污泥；v. 施肥，弄脏
muck.note:
The farmer spread muck over the fields to enrich the soil. 农民把粪肥撒在地里以改良土壤。

Clean your muddy boots before tracking muck into the house. 在把污泥带进屋子之前，先清理你的泥靴子。

mull.meaning: v. 仔细考虑，深思（常与 over 连用）
mull.note:
Give me a few days to mull over your job offer. 给我几天时间仔细考虑一下你的工作Offer。

He mulled the problem in his head throughout the evening. 他整个晚上都在脑海里反复琢磨这个问题。

munch.meaning: v. 津津有味地咀嚼，咔嚓咔嚓地吃
munch.note:
The rabbit sat in the garden munching on a carrot. 兔子坐在花园里津津有味地嚼着胡萝卜。

She munched on some popcorn while watching the film. 她一边看电影一边嚼着爆米花。

musky.note:
He wore a strong, musky cologne to the interview. 他喷了一种浓郁的麝香味古龙水去面试。

The old room had a heavy, musky scent. 这间老房间里有一种浓重、带麝香味的气味。

nifty.meaning: adj. 俏皮的，灵巧的，极好的
nifty.note:
She showed me a nifty trick to open jars easily. 她向我展示了一个轻松开罐头的小妙招。

That is a nifty little gadget for the kitchen. 那是厨房里一个非常灵巧的小工具。

nippy.meaning: adj. 寒冷的，刺骨的；敏捷的
nippy.note:
The morning air was quite nippy, so I wore a jacket. 早晨的空气相当刺骨，所以我穿了一件夹克。

He has a nippy style of playing table tennis. 他打乒乓球的风格非常敏捷灵动。

obsessive.meaning: adj. 强迫性的，着魔的，执着的
obsessive.note:
He has an obsessive need for perfection in his work. 他对工作有着强迫性的完美需求。

Her obsessive focus helped her achieve academic success. 她那执着的专注帮助她取得了学业上的成功。

oleaginous.meaning: adj. 油腻的；（言谈）虚情假意的，满口奉承的
oleaginous.note:
The salesman spoke in an oleaginous manner that felt insincere. 那个推销员满口奉承，说话油腔滑调，让人感觉很不真诚。

The food was a bit too oleaginous for her taste. 这食物对她的口味来说油腻了点。

ornery.meaning: adj. 脾气坏的，好争吵的，固执的
ornery.note:
The old mule was famously ornery and hard to handle. 这头老骡子出了名的脾气暴躁、难以驾驭。

He woke up in an ornery mood and complained all day. 他醒来时脾气很坏，抱怨了一整天。

pavid.note:
He cast a pavid glance around the dark, empty room. 他环顾了一下漆黑空旷的房间，目光中透着畏缩。

She was too pavid to speak up in front of the crowd. 她太胆小了，不敢在人群面前大声说话。

peachy.meaning: adj. 美好的，愉快的，极佳的
peachy.note:
Everything is looking peachy for our vacation plans. 我们的度假计划一切看起来都很好。

She wore a lovely peachy dress to the garden party. 她穿了一条可爱的桃红色连衣裙去参加花园派对。

peckish.note:
I am feeling a bit peckish; let's grab a quick snack. 我觉得有点饿了，我们去吃点小吃吧。

If you feel peckish before dinner, have an apple. 如果你在晚饭前觉得有点饿，吃个苹果吧。

pelagic.meaning: adj. 远洋的，海洋深处的
pelagic.note:
Whales and dolphins are typical pelagic creatures. 鲸鱼和海豚是典型的远洋海洋生物。

Scientists study pelagic fish species in the open ocean. 科学家们研究公海中的远洋鱼类物种。

pendulous.meaning: adj. 下垂的，悬挂摇晃的
pendulous.note:
The tree branches were pendulous under the heavy fruit. 树枝在沉甸甸的水果压迫下向下垂着。

He had pendulous earlobes that caught attention. 他有着引人注目的下垂耳垂。

perk.meaning: n. 津贴，额外好处；v. 振作，昂扬
perk.note:
Free lunch and health insurance are great job perks. 免费午餐和医疗保险是很棒的工作福利。

She perked up immediately when she heard the good news. 听到这个好消息，她立刻振作起来了。

picayunish.meaning: adj. 琐碎的，无聊的，小气计较的
picayunish.note:
He wasted hours arguing over picayunish details of the budget. 他花了几个小时争论预算中那些琐碎的细节。

It is foolish to lose friends over such picayunish matters. 为了这种琐碎的小事失去朋友是愚蠢的。

piteous.note:
The stray dog gave a piteous whine when it saw food. 流浪狗看到食物时发出了可怜的呜咽声。

She looked at the ruined house with a piteous expression. 她用悲惨的表情看着那栋被毁的房子。

prong.note:
He used a fork with four metal prongs to eat dinner. 他用一把带四个金属叉齿的叉子吃晚饭。

The plug had one bent prong that wouldn't fit into the socket. 插头有一个弯曲的插脚，插不进插座里。

pudgy.note:
The toddler reached out with pudgy hands to grab the toy. 学步的幼儿伸出胖乎乎的小手去抓玩具。

He wrote with a short pencil using his pudgy fingers. 他用粗短的手指握着一根短铅笔写字。

pushy.meaning: adj. 鲁莽进取的，盛气凌人的，纠缠不休的
pushy.note:
She disliked pushy salespeople who wouldn't take no for an answer. 她不喜欢那些不接受拒绝、纠缠不休的推销员。

He can be a bit pushy when trying to promote his ideas. 当试图推销自己的想法时，他可能会显得有点强势。

putter.meaning: v. 闲荡，做些琐碎事；n. 推杆（高尔夫）
putter.note:
He spent his Sunday morning puttering around the garden. 他把周日早晨的时间花在花园里做些修剪杂务上。

She used a putter to sink the ball into the final hole. 她用推杆把球推进了最后一个洞。

quasi.note:
The organization operates as a quasi-independent agency. 该组织作为类似独立的机构运作。

They held a quasi-official meeting to discuss the treaty. 他们举行了一场准官方会议来讨论该条约。

quicksilver.meaning: n. 水银，汞；adj. 变幻莫测的
quicksilver.note:
Her moods were like quicksilver, shifting from joy to tears. 她的情绪就像水银一样变幻莫测，从喜悦转为泪水。

Historical records mention quicksilver used in ancient mirrors. 历史记载提到古代镜子中曾使用水银。

quondam.note:
He met with his quondam colleagues at the annual reunion. 他在年度聚会上遇到了他从前的同事。

The castle belongs to a quondam noble family. 这座城堡属于一个以前的贵族家庭。

ramp.meaning: n. 斜坡，无障碍通道；v. 敲诈（ramp up 加剧）
ramp.note:
Wheelchair users can access the building via a concrete ramp. 轮椅使用者可以通过混凝土斜坡进入大楼。

The company decided to ramp up production for the holidays. 公司决定在假期前提高产量。

raptorial.meaning: adj. 食肉的，猛禽类的（如鹰、隼等）
raptorial.note:
Eagles and hawks belong to raptorial bird families. 鹰和隼属于猛禽类鸟类家族。

The biologist studied the raptorial instincts of owls. 这位生物学家研究了猫头鹰的食肉捕猎本能。

ravening.meaning: adj. 掠夺成性的，贪婪凶猛的
ravening.note:
The wolves prowled the snowy woods like ravening beasts. 狼群像凶猛贪婪的野兽一样在雪林中徘徊。

He felt like a ravening wolf after skipping lunch. 省去午饭后，他觉得自己像一头饥饿的野兽。

recusant.meaning: adj. 拒绝服从的，抗命的；n. 不顺从者
recusant.note:
The government imposed fines on religious recusants. 政府对拒绝服从宗教法令的人处以罚款。

His recusant attitude toward the new regulations caused trouble. 他对新规持抗命不从的态度，这引起了麻烦。

retch.meaning: v. 作呕，干呕；n. 干呕
retch.note:
The foul smell made him retch and turn away. 难闻的气味让他作呕并转过头去。

She woke up feeling sick and began to retch. 她醒来时感到恶心并开始干呕。

ritzy.meaning: adj. 豪华的，讲究排场的
ritzy.note:
They stayed at a ritzy hotel in the heart of downtown. 他们住在市中心的一家豪华酒店。

She wore a glamorous dress to the ritzy charity ball. 她穿著一件迷人的礼服去参加豪华的慈善舞会。

sag.meaning: v. 下垂，松弛，下跌；n. 下陷
sag.note:
The old mattress began to sag in the middle. 这张旧床垫中间开始往下陷。

Stock prices experienced a slight sag during the morning trading. 上午交易期间股价经历了一小波下跌。

sally.meaning: n. 突围，俏皮话；v. 出发，出击
sally.note:
The soldiers prepared for a daring sally at dawn. 士兵们准备在黎明时分进行一次大胆的突围。

With umbrellas in hand, we sallied forth into the rain. 我们手里拿着伞，冒雨出发了。

satiny.meaning: adj. 缎子般的，光滑细腻的
satiny.note:
Her skin had a smooth, satiny texture. 她的皮肤有一种光滑细腻如缎子的质感。

The interior of the box was lined with satiny fabric. 盒子的内部衬有缎面般的光滑织物。

saucy.meaning: adj. 调皮的，无礼的，俏皮的
saucy.note:
The little girl gave a saucy reply to her mother. 小女孩对妈妈做出了一个调皮的回应。

She wore a saucy red hat that caught everyone's attention. 她戴了一顶俏皮的红帽子，吸引了所有人的目光。

scamp.meaning: n. 淘气鬼，恶作剧的人；v. 草率完成
scamp.note:
The little scamp hid behind the sofa to scare his sister. 这个小顽皮躲在沙发后面想吓唬他姐姐。

He shouldn't scamp his duties just to leave early. 他不应该为了早退而草率敷衍工作。

scraggly.meaning: adj. 骨瘦如柴的，不整洁的，参差不齐的
scraggly.note:
A stray dog with scraggly fur wandered down the street. 一只毛发凌乱的流浪狗在街上游荡。

He had a scraggly beard that needed trimming. 他留着一丛需要修剪的凌乱胡须。

scruffy.meaning: adj. 肮脏的，不修边幅的
scruffy.note:
He showed up to the meeting in scruffy jeans and a t-shirt. 他穿著破旧不整洁的牛仔裤和T恤出现在会议上。

The stray cat looked scruffy but friendly. 这只流浪猫看起来蓬头垢面但很友好。

shamble.meaning: v. 蹒跚，拖着脚步走；n. 蹒跚步态
shamble.note:
The tired hiker shambled toward the mountain cabin. 疲惫的徒步旅行者蹒跚着走向山间小屋。

He got up from the sofa and shambled into the kitchen. 他从沙发上站起来，拖着脚步走进了厨房。

shilly.meaning: adj. 优柔寡断的（常用于 shilly-shally 犹豫不决）
shilly.note:
Stop shilly-shallying and make a choice right now. 别再犹豫不决了，马上做出选择吧。

His shilly habits frustrated his business partners. 他优柔寡断的习惯让他的商业伙伴感到沮丧。

simonize.meaning: v. 给（汽车等）上蜡打光
simonize.note:
He spent his Saturday morning washing and simonizing his car. 他花周六早晨的时间清洗并给汽车打蜡。

The vintage car was carefully simonized for the exhibition. 这辆老式老爷车为了展览被仔细打过蜡。

slog.meaning: v. 苦干，艰难跋涉；n. 苦差事
slog.note:
Studying for the bar exam was a long and difficult slog. 准备律师资格考试是一段漫长而艰辛的苦差事。

They slogged through the thick mud for miles. 他们在厚厚的泥地里艰难跋涉了数英里。

slosh.note:
Water sloshed around in the bucket as he carried it. 他提着水桶时，水在桶里晃荡着溅了出来。

Children loved to slosh through the puddles after the rain. 雨后孩子们喜欢蹚着水坑玩耍溅起水花。

smut.meaning: n. 污迹，煤烟；下流话，色情内容
smut.note:
There was a black smut of soot on his cheek. 他的脸颊上有一小块黑色的煤烟污迹。

Parents complained about the smut in the late-night magazine. 家长们抱怨深夜杂志里出现的色情低俗内容。

snipe.meaning: v. 放冷枪，恶意抨击；n. 鹬（鸟）
snipe.note:
Political opponents continued to snipe at each other online. 政治对手继续在网上互相恶意抨击。

A hidden sniper took aim from a high window. 一个隐藏的狙击手从高处的窗户瞄准。

snivel.meaning: v. 抽鼻子哭，鼻涕眼泪一起流，哭诉
snivel.note:
The child began to snivel when he dropped his ice cream. 孩子冰淇淋掉了时开始抽鼻子哭泣。

Stop sniveling and face your problems like an adult. 别抽鼻子哭了，像个成年人一样面对你的问题。

snooze.note:
He likes to take a short snooze after eating lunch. 他喜欢午饭后小睡一会儿。

The cat curled up on the sofa and fell into a deep snooze. 猫在沙发上蜷缩起来，进入了深沉的打盹中。

soigne.meaning: adj. 极具时髦感的，打扮精致的
soigne.note:
She always appeared soigné and elegant at social events. 她在社交场合总是显得非常精致优雅。

The hotel catered to a soigné and wealthy clientele. 这家酒店迎合了那些追求精致的富裕客户群体。

spatter.meaning: v. 泼洒，飞溅；n. 溅泼声
spatter.note:
Grease began to spatter from the frying pan onto the stove. 油从平底锅里飞溅到炉灶上。

A light spatter of rain signaled the start of the storm. 一阵细微的雨点飞溅预示着风暴的开始。

spew.note:
The active volcano began to spew ash and lava into the sky. 这座活火山开始向空中喷发火山灰和熔岩。

Factory pipes spewed toxic waste into the atmosphere. 工厂管道向大气中喷射有毒废物。

sportive.meaning: adj. 嬉戏的，玩耍的，开玩笑的
sportive.note:
The puppies had a sportive interaction in the yard. 小狗们在院子里进行了嬉戏玩耍。

His sportive remarks showed that he wasn't taking it seriously. 他爱开玩笑的言论表明他并没有把这当真。

squab.meaning: n. 刚孵出的雏鸽；adj. 短粗肥胖的
squab.note:
The menu featured roasted squab served with wild berries. 菜单上特色菜是配有野莓的烤雏鸽。

He sat on a squab sofa in the corner of the lounge. 他坐在休息室角落的一张短粗沙发上。

squirt.meaning: v. 喷射，挤出；n. 喷射，小家伙
squirt.note:
She squirted a little lemon juice over the fish. 她在鱼肉上挤了一点柠檬汁。

Water squirted from the broken hose across the yard. 水从院子里破损的软管里喷射出来。

stampede.meaning: n. 惊跑，群兽狂奔；v. 使惊跑
stampede.note:
A loud noise caused a sudden stampede of the cattle herd. 巨大的噪音导致牛群突然惊慌狂奔。

Frightened horses began to stampede across the open plain. 受惊的马匹开始在开阔的平原上狂奔。

stately.meaning: adj. 庄严的，宏伟的，高贵的
stately.note:
The queen made a stately entrance into the great hall. 女王庄严地步入了大厅。

They lived in a stately home surrounded by large gardens. 他们住在由大花园环绕的宏伟宅邸里。

sticky.meaning: adj. 粘的，湿热的，棘手的
sticky.note:
Her fingers were sticky after eating the sweet mango. 吃完甜芒果后她的手指黏糊糊的。

We found ourselves in a sticky situation with our boss. 我们发现自己和老板陷入了一个棘手的境地。

straiten.meaning: v. 使窘迫，使陷入困境；使狭窄
straiten.note:
Economic depression straitened the family's finances. 经济萧条让这个家庭的财务陷入了困境。

Their straitened circumstances forced them to move to a smaller flat. 他们拮据的境况迫使他们搬到一个更小的公寓里。

stricken.meaning: adj. 受灾的，患病的，深受打击的
stricken.note:
The poverty-stricken area received emergency food supplies. 这个灾区收到了紧急食品物资援助。

She looked stricken when she heard the tragic news. 听到这个悲惨消息时，她看起来深受打击。

swathe.meaning: n. 狭长的一带，长条；v. 包裹，缠绕
swathe.note:
Large swathes of forest were destroyed by the wildfire. 大片大片的森林被森林大火毁坏了。

The infant was swathed in soft warm blankets. 婴儿被柔软温暖的毯子包裹着。

swig.note:
He took a long swig of cold water from the bottle. 他从瓶子里大口痛饮了冷水。

Thirsty after the hike, she swigged down the juice. 徒步旅行后口渴难耐，她一口气喝光了果汁。
