swoop.meaning: v./n. 俯冲，猛扑，突然袭击
swoop.note:
The hawk watched its prey before making a swift swoop down. 老鹰观察着猎物，随后迅速俯冲下来。

Police made a sudden swoop on the illegal warehouse. 警方对非法仓库进行了突然袭捕。

tatter.meaning: n. 碎布，破衣（多用复数 tatters）；v. 使破烂
tatter.note:
His old coat was worn into tatters after years of use. 经过多年的使用，他的旧外套已经磨损成碎布了。

The strong winds tattered the old flag hanging outside. 强风把挂在室外的旧旗帜吹破了。

tattle.meaning: v. 泄露秘密，告状，闲聊
tattle.note:
The child promised not to tattle on his brother. 孩子答应不向别人告他兄弟的状。

Her suspicious behavior started to tattle on her secrets. 她可疑的行为开始无意间泄露了她的秘密。

thump.meaning: v./n. 重击，扑通扑通地跳
thump.note:
His heart began to thump with fear in the dark room. 在黑暗的房间里，他的心脏因恐惧开始扑通扑通地跳。

Someone gave a loud thump on the front door. 有人在前门重重地敲了一下。

tony.meaning: adj. 高雅的，时髦的，豪华的
tony.note:
They dined at a tony restaurant in downtown Manhattan. 他们在曼哈顿市中心的一家高级豪华餐厅用餐。

She moved to a tony neighborhood near the park. 她搬去了公园附近一个高档的时髦街区。

trounce.note:
Our basketball team trounced their opponents in the match. 我们的篮球队在比赛中完胜了对手。

The government was trounced in the recent general election. 政府在最近的大选中遭到惨败。

tumble.note:
She took a nasty tumble down the wooden stairs. 她从木楼梯上狠狠地摔了下来。

Stock prices tumbled following the unexpected economic news. 经济消息出乎意料之后，股票价格出现暴跌。

tweak.note:
He made a few final tweaks to his software presentation. 他对软件演示做了一些最后的微调。

She playfully gave her brother's nose a gentle tweak. 她顽皮地轻轻捏了一下她弟弟的鼻子。

unbosom.meaning: v. 吐露心事，倾诉隐情
unbosom.note:
He felt relieved after unbosoming his secrets to his best friend. 把秘密向最好朋友倾诉后，他感到如释重负。

She decided to unbosom her worries to her mother. 她决定向母亲倾诉自己的担忧。

velvety.note:
The red rose petals had a soft, velvety texture. 红玫瑰花瓣有着柔软、丝绒般的质感。

He enjoyed the rich and velvety taste of the dark chocolate. 他享受着黑巧克力浓郁丝滑的口感。

verboten.meaning: adj. 禁止的，严禁的（源自德语）
verboten.note:
Entering the private construction site is strictly verboten. 进入私人建筑工地是严格禁止的。

Such behavior was considered completely verboten by school rules. 这种行为被学校规章视为完全禁止的。

versant.meaning: adj. 精通的，熟悉的；山坡
versant.note:
He is well versant in modern computer programming languages. 他对现代计算机编程语言非常精通。

The steep mountain versant was covered with dense pine trees. 陡峭的山坡上覆盖着密密麻麻的松树。

vest.meaning: n. 背心，防护背心；v. 授予，赋予（权力等）
vest.note:
The security guard wore a protective bulletproof vest. 保安穿著一件防护防弹背心。

Authority is vested in the board of directors by law. 权力依法赋予董事会。

wacky.meaning: adj. 古怪的，荒诞的，滑稽的
wacky.note:
She came up with a wacky idea for the party theme. 她为派对主题想出了一个古怪荒诞的点子。

The comedy is filled with wacky characters and funny jokes. 这部喜剧充满了古怪的角色和有趣的笑话。

wend.meaning: v. 前往，行进（多用于 wend one's way）
wend.note:
They wended their way slowly home through the dark streets. 他们在黑暗的街道中缓缓地踏上回家路。

Travelers wended their path across the snowy mountain pass. 旅客们踏着足迹穿过白雪皑皑的山隘。

wheeze.meaning: v./n. 喘鸣，发出呼哧呼哧的喘息声
wheeze.note:
The dust in the old room made him cough and wheeze. 老房间里的灰尘让他咳嗽并发出喘鸣声。

He had a bad cold that left him with a persistent wheeze. 他得了重感冒，留下了持续的喘息声。

whimper.note:
The injured puppy began to whimper softly in the dark. 受伤的小狗在黑暗中开始轻声呜咽。

She tried to hide her tears and stopped her whimpering. 她试图忍住眼泪，停止了抽泣。

wigwag.meaning: v./n. 摇晃，摆动，旗语信号
wigwag.note:
The signalman used flags to wigwag instructions across the field. 信号员在场地上用旗语打出指令。

His playful hand gestures seemed like a constant wigwag. 他顽皮的手势看起来像个不停摆动的信号。

wile.meaning: n. 诡计，花招；v. 诱惑，消磨（时间）
wile.note:

wispy.meaning: adj. 纤细的，缕状的，脆弱的
wispy.note:

He had a wispy beard that made him look older. 他留着一丛稀疏的胡须，让他看起来更老了。

wroth.meaning: adj. 愤怒的，发怒的（文体）
wroth.note:
The king was wroth when he heard of the betrayal. 当听到背叛的消息时，国王勃然大怒。

She felt wroth at the unfair treatment she received. 她对遭受的不公平待遇感到十分愤怒。

yank.note:
He yanked the door open to see who was outside. 他猛地拉开门，看看外面是谁。

yen.meaning: n. 日元；强烈渴望，热望

yowl.note:

yummy.note:
Mom baked a chocolate cake that tasted absolutely yummy. 妈妈烤了一个巧克力蛋糕，尝起来极其美味。

zany.meaning: adj. 滑稽的，荒诞离奇的

zoom.meaning: v. 疾行，急升，放大缩小

able.note:

about.note:

above.note:

across.note:

bed.note:

amaze.note:
His incredible magic tricks continue to amaze everyone. 他令人难以置信的魔术技巧继续让每个人大为惊叹。

The beauty of the sunset will never fail to amaze me. 日落的美景总能让我叹为观止。

america.note:
He moved to North America to start a new business. 他搬到了北美去开启新的事业。

They visited several major cities in America last year. 去年他们造访了美国的几个主要城市。

american.meaning: adj. 美国的；美洲的 n. 美国人
american.note:
She loves classic American literature and cinema history. 她喜欢经典的美国文学和电影史。

An American tourist asked me for directions in the street. 一位美国游客在街上向我问路。

and.note:
He ordered coffee and a piece of chocolate cake. 他点了一杯咖啡和一块巧克力蛋糕。

She opened her notebook and began to write carefully. 她打开笔记本，开始仔细地书写。

angel.note:
The young boy was dressed up as a white angel. 那个小男孩扮成了一个白色的天使。

Thank you for helping me, you are an absolute angel. 谢谢你帮助我，你真是个大好人。

any.note:
Do you have any questions about today's lesson? 关于今天的课程你有什么问题吗？

You can choose any book you like from the shelf. 你可以从书架上挑选任何你喜欢的书。

anyhow.meaning: adv. 无论如何；随随便便地
anyhow.note:
It is raining, but we will go to the park anyhow. 天在下雨，但无论如何我们都会去公园。

He threw his clothes anyhow into the wooden closet. 他把衣服随随便便地塞进了木衣柜里。

anyone.note:
Is there anyone in the office who can answer this? 办公室里有人能回答这个问题吗？

Anyone can learn to code if they practice regularly. 只要定期练习，任何人都能学会写代码。

anything.note:
I didn't eat anything for breakfast this morning. 我今天早上早餐什么都没吃。

Is there anything urgent I can help you with now? 现在有什么急事是我可以帮你的吗？

anywhere.note:
I couldn't find my missing car keys anywhere. 我在任何地方都找不到我掉落的车钥匙。

You can sit anywhere you like in the audience. 你可以在观众席中坐在你喜欢的任何位置。

apology.note:
He offered a sincere apology for arriving so late. 他为迟到这么久提供了诚挚的道歉。

I received a written apology from the company management. 我收到了公司管理层寄来的书面致歉信。

arab.meaning: n. 阿拉伯人 adj. 阿拉伯的
arab.note:
Hospitality is an important part of Arab culture. 款待客人是阿拉伯文化的一个重要组成部分。

He has spent many years living among Arab communities. 他在阿拉伯人社区生活了很多年。

area.note:
This neighborhood is a peaceful residential area. 这个社区是一个宁静的居民区。

She is a recognized expert in the area of finance. 她是金融领域的知名专家。

arm.meaning: n. 手臂 v. 武装
arm.note:
He broke his left arm while playing football. 他踢足球时摔断了左手臂。

The guard was trained to arm himself quickly in danger. 该警卫受过训练，能在危险中迅速武装自己。

army.note:
He served two years as a soldier in the army. 他在军队里当了两年兵。

An army of volunteers cleaned up the local beach. 大群志愿者清理了当地的海滩。

around.note:
They sat around the warm campfire to sing songs. 他们围坐在温暖的篝火旁唱歌。

The flight will arrive at around three in the afternoon. 航班将在下午三点左右到达。

arrow.note:
Follow the red arrow signs to find the exit. 顺着红色的箭头记号寻找出口。

The hunter shot an arrow directly at the wooden target. 猎人将一支箭直接射向木目标。

article.note:
She wrote an inspiring article on healthy living. 她写了一篇关于健康生活的鼓舞人心的文章。

Personal articles should be kept in your locker. 个人物品应妥善存放在你的储物柜里。

as.meaning: prep. 作为 conj. 当……时；因为；像……一样
as.note:
She works hard as a junior software engineer. 她作为一名初级软件工程师努力工作。

As the sun set, the sky turned a deep pink. 当太阳落下时，天空变成了深粉色。

asia.note:
Tokyo and Singapore are major financial hubs in Asia. 东京和新加坡是亚洲的主要金融中心。

They traveled across several countries in Asia. 他们造访了亚洲的几个国家。

asian.meaning: adj. 亚洲的 n. 亚洲人
asian.note:
Many people enjoy traditional Asian food options. 很多人喜欢传统的亚洲美食选项。

She is learning about Asian history and philosophy. 她正在学习亚洲历史与哲学。

asleep.note:
The tired baby fell asleep quickly in the crib. 疲惫的婴儿在婴儿床里很快睡着了。

He was so exhausted that he fell asleep on the bus. 他太累了，以至于在公交车上睡着了。

at.note:
Let's meet at the main entrance of the station. 我们在车站主入口碰头吧。

The daily morning meeting starts promptly at nine. 每天早上的会议在九点准时开始。

attend.note:
All team members are expected to attend the meeting. 所有团队成员都应出席该会议。

She attended a top university to study law. 她在一所顶尖大学就读学习法律。

attract.note:
The warm beach attracts thousands of tourists every summer. 这片温暖的海滩每年夏天吸引成千上万的游客。

Bright colors are used to attract the attention of buyers. 靓丽的颜色被用来吸引买家的注意。

australia.note:
Australia is famous for its unique wildlife like kangaroos. 澳大利亚以袋鼠等独特野生动物闻名。

My cousin moved to Australia to study medicine. 我表弟搬到了澳大利亚去学医。

australian.meaning: adj. 澳大利亚的 n. 澳大利亚人
australian.note:
We enjoyed watching an Australian rules football game. 我们喜欢观看一场澳式橄榄球比赛。

She met an Australian writer at the international conference. 她在国际会议上遇到了一位澳大利亚作家。

awake.meaning: adj. 醒着的 v. 唤醒
awake.note:
Noise from the street kept me awake all night. 街上的噪音让我整晚都保持醒着。

She lay awake thinking about the upcoming interview. 她躺在床上醒着，思考着即将来临的面试。

badly.note:
He was badly injured in a skiing accident yesterday. 他昨天在滑雪事故中严重受伤。

The team played badly and lost the championship game. 该队表现糟糕，输掉了锦标赛。

bake.note:
My grandmother loves to bake fresh bread on weekends. 我祖母喜欢在周末烘焙新鲜的面包。

She is learning how to bake chocolate chip cookies. 她正在学习如何烘烤巧克力豆饼干。

balloon.note:
They decorated the room with colorful party balloons. 他们用绚丽的聚会气球装饰了房间。

The red hot-air balloon floated gently in the sky. 红色的热气球在天空里轻轻漂浮。

bamboo.note:
Giant pandas feed primarily on fresh bamboo leaves. 大熊猫主要以新鲜的竹叶为食。

The garden features a decorative fence made of bamboo. 这个花园有一个用竹子制作的装饰性篱笆。

band.note:
The rock band performed live to a massive audience. 这支摇滚乐队给海量观众带来了现场表演。

She tied her long hair back with a rubber band. 她用橡皮筋把长发扎在脑后。

bang.meaning: n. 重击声；猛击 v. 猛敲
bang.note:
The door closed with a sudden loud bang. 门突然发出一声巨响关上了。

He accidentally banged his knee against the wooden table. 他不小心把膝盖猛撞在木桌上。

base.meaning: n. 基础；基地 v. 以……为基础
base.note:
The company established its main operational base here. 该公司在此建立了其主要运营基地。

They base their opinions on hard facts and research. 他们把自己的观点建立在铁事实和研究之上。

basket.note:
She filled the picnic basket with sandwiches and fruit. 她在野餐篮里装满了三明治和水果。

Please throw the scrap paper into the waste basket. 请把废纸扔进废纸篮里。

bath.note:
I like to take a warm relaxing bath after work. 我喜欢在下班后洗个温暖舒适的热水澡。

Fill the tub with hot water for a soothing bath. 往浴缸里倒满热水来洗个舒缓的澡。

be.note:
I want to be a helpful engineer when I grow up. 我长大后想成为一名有用的工程师。

Try to be quiet while the baby is sleeping peacefully. 婴儿平静入睡时，尽量保持安静。

beat.meaning: v. 打败；敲打；心跳 n. 拍子
beat.note:
Our school basketball team managed to beat the rivals. 我们学校篮球队成功打败了对手。

Listen to the steady beat of the heart monitor. 聆听心电监护仪稳健的节拍声。

beef.note:
We ordered roast beef and vegetables for dinner. 我们晚餐点了烤牛肉和蔬菜。

This spicy beef noodle soup is very popular here. 这款香辣牛肉面在这儿非常受欢迎。

beg.note:
I beg your pardon for interrupting your presentation. 原谅我打断了你的演示。

The children would beg their parents for extra dessert. 孩子们会恳求父母给额外的甜点。

beginning.note:
The story was engaging right from the very beginning. 这个故事从一开始就引人入胜。

This is just the beginning of a long journey. 这仅仅是一段漫长旅程的开端。

bell.note:
The school bell rang to signal the end of class. 学校的铃声响了，标志着下课。

He rang the front door bell to announce his arrival. 他按响了前门的门铃以告知他的到来。

beside.note:
She sat beside her best friend during the lecture. 在讲座期间，她坐在她最好的朋友旁边。

There is a small nightstand beside the king-size bed. 床旁边有一个小夜宵桌。

besides.meaning: prep. 除……之外 adv. 此外
besides.note:
Besides English, she speaks Spanish and French fluently. 除了英语，她还能流利地说西班牙语和法语。

I don't want to go out; besides, it is freezing cold. 我不想出门；此外，天气冷得要命。

biology.note:
She is deeply interested in plant biology and ecology. 她对植物生物学和生态学深感兴趣。

We have a biology lab class scheduled for Tuesday. 我们安排在周二有一堂生物实验课。

birth.note:
They celebrated the birth of their first daughter. 他们庆祝了他们第一个女儿的诞生。

Please state your full name and date of birth. 请说明您的全名和出生日期。

bit.note:
I feel a bit tired after the long road trip. 长途驾车旅行后，我感觉有点累。

Could you move a little bit to the left, please? 请问你能往左移动一点点吗？

blackboard.note:
The teacher wrote the new key words on the blackboard. 老师把新的关键词写在了黑板上。

Please wipe the blackboard clean after the lesson ends. 课程结束后请把黑板擦干净。

blank.meaning: adj. 空白的 n. 空白处
blank.note:
Please leave the bottom line blank for signature. 请将底下一行留空以便签名。

My mind went completely blank during the difficult oral test. 在困难的口试中，我的大脑一片空白。

blind.note:
Guide dogs help blind people navigate the city safely. 导盲犬帮助失明人士在城市中安全前行。

Love shouldn't make you blind to serious faults. 爱不应该让你对严重的缺点盲目视而不见。

blouse.note:
She wore a silk white blouse to the job interview. 她穿了一件丝绸白衬衫去参加求职面试。

This floral blouse matches your blue skirt nicely. 这件印花女式衬衫和你的蓝裙子搭配得很好。

blow.meaning: v. 吹；吹动 n. 打击
blow.note:
A cool gentle breeze began to blow from the sea. 一阵凉爽的微风开始从海上吹来。

Make a wish and blow out the candles on the cake. 许个愿，然后吹灭蛋糕上的蜡烛吧。

boating.note:
We went boating on the quiet mountain lake yesterday. 我们昨天在安静的高山湖泊上划船。

Boating is a popular weekend activity here in summer. 划船是这里夏天很受欢迎的周末活动。

bookmark.meaning: n. 书签 v. 添加书签
bookmark.note:
She placed a handmade bookmark inside her novel. 她在她的小说里放了一张手作书签。

Don't forget to bookmark this useful language website. 别忘了将这个有用的语言网站添加到书签。

bookshop.note:
I bought this travel guide at a local bookshop. 我在当地一家书店买到了这本旅行指南。

The cozy bookshop sells both new and used novels. 这家舒适的书店既卖新小说也卖二手小说。

bookstore.note:
We met outside the campus bookstore after lectures. 听完讲座后，我们在校园书店门外碰面。

This bookstore has a wide collection of art books. 这家书店藏有大量丰富的艺术类图书。

borrow.note:
Can I borrow your black pen for a minute, please? 我能借用一下你的黑色钢笔吗？

Students can borrow up to five books from the library. 学生最多可以从图书馆借五本书。

both.note:
Both of my brothers are studying computer science. 我的两个兄弟都在学习计算机科学。

She likes both tea and coffee in the morning. 她在早晨既喜欢喝茶也喜欢喝咖啡。

bowl.note:
He ate a big bowl of warm soup for lunch. 他午饭吃了一大碗热汤。

Please pour the cereal into a clean ceramic bowl. 请把谷物倒入干净的陶瓷碗里。

brain.note:
Exercise increases blood flow to the human brain. 运动能增加流向人体大脑的血液。

Use your brain to work out this logic puzzle. 动动脑筋把这道逻辑谜题解答出来。

breathe.note:
It was great to step outside and breathe fresh air. 走到室外呼吸新鲜空气感觉真是太棒了。

Deep yoga exercises help you learn to breathe properly. 深度的瑜伽练习能帮助你学会如何正确呼吸。

britain.note:
Great Britain consists of England, Scotland, and Wales. 大不列颠由英格兰、苏格兰和威尔士组成。

They toured historical castles across Britain last summer. 去年夏天他们游览了英国各地的历史城堡。

british.meaning: adj. 英国的 n. 英国人
british.note:
Drinking afternoon tea is a famous British tradition. 喝下午茶是一项著名的英国传统。

She met several British students during the exchange. 在交流活动中她结识了几位英国学生。

broadcast.note:
The radio station will broadcast the match live. 广播电台将现场直播这场比赛。

The news broadcast provided updates on the storm. 新闻广播提供了风暴的最新动态。

broken.note:
He tried to fix the broken window with tape. 他试图用胶带修补破损的窗户。

She spoke in broken English but made herself clear. 她用破破碎碎的英语表达，但说得蛮清楚。

broom.note:
She picked up a broom to sweep the kitchen floor. 她拿起一把扫帚清扫厨房地板。

Store the broom and dustpan in the cleaning closet. 把扫帚和簸箕存放在清洁柜里。

brotherhood.note:
They formed a strong bond of lifelong brotherhood. 他们建立了深厚而终生的兄弟情谊。

The event promotes peace and international brotherhood. 该活动旨在促进和平与国际手足情谊。

brush.meaning: n. 刷子；画笔 v. 刷
brush.note:
You should brush your teeth at least twice daily. 你每天应该至少刷两次牙。

The artist cleaned her paint brush with warm water. 画家用水清洗了她的画笔。

burn.meaning: v. 燃烧；烧伤 n. 灼伤
burn.note:
Wood was burning brightly in the cozy fireplace. 木柴在舒适的火炉里旺盛地燃烧着。

Be careful not to burn your hands on the hot oven. 注意不要在烫手的大烤箱上烫伤手。

bury.note:
Pirates used to bury their gold treasure on islands. 过去海盗习惯将金银宝藏埋在岛屿上。

The heavy snow blanketed and buried the entire garden. 大雪覆盖并掩埋了整个花园。

businessman.note:
He is a successful businessman managing tech firms. 他是一位管理多家科技公司的成功商人。

The businessman traveled overseas for an urgent meeting. 这位商人因紧急会议飞往海外。

but.meaning: conj. 但是 prep. 除了
but.note:
She tried hard, but she could not complete it. 她付出了很大努力，但未能完成它。

Everyone attended the meeting but John, who was sick. 除了生病的约翰外，大家都出席了会议。

button.note:
Press the green button to start the machine up. 按下绿色按钮来启动这台机器。

She sewed a loose red button back onto her shirt. 她把一颗松动的红纽扣重新缝回她的衬衫上。

by.note:
They decided to travel to the coastal city by train. 他们决定乘火车前往沿海城市。

He stood by the window watching the rain fall. 他站在窗边看着雨滴飘落。

bye.note:
Bye! See you tomorrow morning at the station. 再见！明天早上车站见。

She waved bye to her friends as the car drove off. 当汽车驶离时，她向朋友们挥手道别。

caf.note:
Let's meet at the corner caf for breakfast. 我们在拐角的小餐馆碰面吃早餐吧。

The caf serves fresh pastries and warm coffee. 这家小餐馆供应新鲜的糕点和热咖啡。

cage.note:
The bright parrot chirped inside its large wooden cage. 明亮的鹦鹉在它的木大笼子里唧唧喳喳唤叫。

Never keep wild animals trapped inside a small cage. 决不要把野生动物关在狭小的笼子里。

canada.note:
Canada is famous for maple syrup and natural beauty. 加拿大以枫糖浆和自然美景闻名。

We spent two weeks vacationing in Canada last fall. 去年秋天我们在加拿大度过了两周假期。

canadian.meaning: adj. 加拿大的 n. 加拿大人
canadian.note:
He loves drinking authentic Canadian maple syrup. 他喜欢喝地道的加拿大枫糖浆。

She met a friendly Canadian student at the museum. 她在博物馆遇到了一位友善的加拿大学生。

cancer.note:
Early detection is key in treating skin cancer. 早期发现是治疗皮肤癌的关键。

Scientists are working hard to find a cure for cancer. 科学家们正在努力寻找攻克癌症的疗法。

candle.note:
She lit a scented candle to make the room smell nice. 她点燃了一支香薰蜡烛使房间气味芬芳。

Blow out the birthday candle and make a secret wish. 吹灭生日蜡烛，许下一个秘密心愿。

candy.note:
Children love eating sweet fruit-flavored candy. 孩子们喜欢吃甘甜的水果味糖果。

Do not eat too much candy before going to sleep. 睡觉前不要吃太多糖果。

cannon.note:
An ancient iron cannon was displayed at the castle. 城堡里展出了一门古老的铁制大炮。

The ship was equipped with powerful heavy cannons. 这艘船装备了威力强大的重型加农炮。

canoe.meaning: n. 独木舟 v. 划独木舟
canoe.note:
They paddled their wooden canoe down the calm stream. 他们划着木独木舟沿着平静的小溪顺流而下。

Learning to maneuver a canoe takes balance and skill. 学习操纵独木舟需要平衡感和技巧。

cap.note:
He wore a baseball cap to protect his eyes from sun. 他戴了一顶棒球帽防晒遮阳。

Make sure to screw the bottle cap back on tightly. 务必把瓶盖重新拧紧。

capital.meaning: n. 首都；资金；大写字母
capital.note:
Paris is the breathtaking capital city of France. 巴黎是法国令人叹为观止的首都。

You must start every sentence with a capital letter. 你必须用大写字母开始每一个句子。

caption.meaning: n. 说明文字；字幕 v. 加上说明
caption.note:
Read the short caption underneath the news photo. 阅读新闻照片下方简短的说明文字。

She added an inspiring caption to her online post. 她为自己的网络帖子加上了鼓舞人心的文案。

care.meaning: v. 关心；在乎 n. 照顾；小心
care.note:
Parents take great care of their newborn babies. 父母对他们的新生婴儿照顾得无微不至。

I really care about the environment and green energy. 我真的很在乎环境与绿色能源。

careless.note:
A careless mistake caused the system to crash. 一个粗心的错误导致了系统崩溃。

Don't be careless when handling fragile glass items. 处理易碎的玻璃制品时切勿粗心大意。

cause.meaning: v. 引起；导致 n. 原因；事业
cause.note:
Heavy fog caused major travel delays at the airport. 浓雾导致机场出现了严重的出行延误。

What was the exact cause of the electrical fire? 这起电气火灾的确切原因是什么？

cd.note:
He bought a vintage music CD at the second-hand shop. 他在二手店买了一张复古音乐光盘。

Put the audio CD into the car player to listen. 把这张语音光盘放进车载播放器里听吧。

ceiling.note:
A grand crystal chandelier hung from the high ceiling. 一顶华丽的水晶吊灯挂在高高的天花板上。

disturb.note:
Please do not disturb me while I am working quietly. 在我安静工作时请不要打扰我。

Loud noises outside disturb her sleep during the night. 室外巨大的噪音在夜间干扰了她的睡眠。

dive.note:
He loves to dive deep into the clear blue ocean. 他喜欢深潜入清澈湛蓝的海洋中。

The eagle made a swift dive down to catch its prey. 鹰快速俯冲下去捕捉猎物。

divide.note:
Divide the apple pie evenly into six equal slices. 把这个苹果派均匀地分成六等份。

If you divide ten by two, you get five. 如果你用十除以二，就会得到五。

do.note:
What do you plan to do over the long weekend? 你打算在长周末做点什么？

Do your best to complete the assignment on time. 尽你最大的努力按时完成这份任务。

doll.note:
The little girl squeezed her favorite porcelain doll tight. 小女孩紧紧抱住她最喜欢的瓷玩偶。

She collects vintage handcrafted dolls from all over Europe. 她从欧洲各地收集复古的手工洋娃娃。

double.meaning: adj. 双重的；两倍的 v. 加倍
double.note:
We booked a comfortable double room at the seaside hotel. 我们在海滨酒店预订了一间舒适的双人房。

The company hopes to double its annual revenue next year. 公司希望明年能将其年收入翻倍。

down.meaning: adv./prep. 向下；沿着 adj. 情绪低落的
down.note:
Tears began to run down her warm cheeks quietly. 泪水开始静静地顺着她温暖的脸颊流下。

He felt a bit down after losing the tennis match. 输掉网球比赛后他感到有点情绪低落。

download.note:
You can download the mobile application for free online. 你可以在线免费下载这款移动应用程序。

The download finished in just a few short seconds. 下载在短短几秒钟内就完成了。

downstairs.note:
He ran downstairs to answer the loud ringing doorbell. 他跑下楼去开响个不停的门铃。

The kitchen is located in the downstairs area of the house. 厨房位于这栋房子的楼下区域。

downtown.note:
They love eating out at fancy downtown restaurants. 他们喜欢在繁华的市中心餐厅用餐。

It takes twenty minutes by metro to reach downtown. 乘坐地铁到达市中心需要二十分钟。

dozen.note:
She bought a dozen fresh eggs from the local farm. 她从当地农场买了一打新鲜鸡蛋。

There were over a dozen people waiting in the line. 有十几个人排队等候着。

drag.note:
He had to drag the heavy suitcase along the gravel path. 他不得不沿着碎石路拖着沉重的行李箱。

Click and drag the icon to move it across the desktop. 点击并拖动图标将其跨桌面移动。

dragon.note:
The mythical dragon breathed fire in the fairytale story. 这条神话中的龙在童话故事里吐出火焰。

They performed a traditional dragon dance for the festival. 他们为这个节日表演了传统的舞龙。

drawer.note:
He kept the important papers safely in his desk drawer. 他把重要的文件安全地存放在书桌抽屉里。

Pull out the top drawer to find your spare keys. 拉开最上面的抽屉找你的备用钥匙。

drawing.note:
She won first place in the school drawing competition. 她在学校绘画比赛中获得了第一名。

He showed me a detailed pencil drawing of a bird. 他给我看了一张用铅笔画的细致小鸟图画。

dream.meaning: n. 梦想；梦 v. 做梦；梦想
dream.note:
Her lifelong dream is to become a world-famous doctor. 她毕生的梦想是成为一名世界闻名的医生。

I had a strange dream about flying through the clouds. 我做了一个关于在云端飞行的奇怪梦境。

dress.meaning: n. 连衣裙；服装 v. 穿衣
dress.note:
She selected a elegant blue dress for the evening party. 她为晚会挑选了一件优雅的蓝色连衣裙。

Please dress appropriately for the formal business dinner. 请为正式的商务晚宴穿戴得体。

drink.note:
It is important to drink plenty of water every day. 每天喝充足的水是很重要的。

Can I get you a cold drink while you wait inside? 你在里面等待时，需要我给你拿杯冷饮吗？

drop.meaning: v. 掉下；落下；降低 n. 水滴
drop.note:
Be careful not to drop that fragile porcelain teacup. 小心不要掉落那个易碎的瓷茶杯。

Heavy rain drops began falling onto the window pane. 大颗的雨滴开始落在窗户玻璃上。

drought.note:
The severe drought destroyed crops across the agricultural region. 严重的干旱摧毁了整个农业区的作物。

Water restrictions were put in place during the long drought. 在漫长的旱灾期间实施了用水限制。

drunk.note:
Driving while drunk is extremely dangerous and illegal. 酒后驾车极其危险且违法。

He got drunk at the celebration party after two glasses. 在庆祝聚会上喝了两杯后他就醉了。

dry.meaning: adj. 干燥的；干旱的 v. 使干燥
dry.note:
The hot midday sun will quickly dry the wet clothes. 中午炽热的太阳会迅速晾干湿衣服。

This desert region is known for its extremely dry climate. 这个沙漠地区以其极度干燥的气候而闻名。

dumpling.note:
My family makes delicious pork dumplings on Spring Festival. 我家在春节会包美味的猪肉饺子。

She ordered a basket of steamed vegetable dumplings. 她点了一笼蒸蔬菜饺子。

during.note:
Please remain quiet during the entire theatrical performance. 观演期间请保持安静。

Many birds migrate south during the cold winter months. 许多鸟类在寒冷的冬季月份向南迁徙。

dusk.note:
The street lights turn on automatically around dusk. 路灯在黄昏前后会自动开启。

They arrived at the quiet mountain cabin at dusk. 他们在黄昏时分到达了安静的山间小屋。

dust.meaning: n. 灰尘；尘土 v. 拂去灰尘
dust.note:
A thick layer of dust covered the old wooden furniture. 厚厚的一层灰尘覆盖了旧木家具。

Please dust the bookshelves before placing the new volumes. 放新书之前请先把书架上的灰尘擦掉。

dustbin.note:
Please toss the empty plastic bottle into the dustbin. 请把空塑料瓶扔进垃圾桶里。

The municipal dustbin was emptied early this morning. 市政垃圾桶今天一大早清空了。

duty.meaning: n. 责任；义务；值班；关税
duty.note:
It is our civic duty to protect the environment. 保护环境是我们的公民责任。

The nurse will be on duty at the clinic all night. 这名护士将整晚在诊所值班。

ear.note:
She whispered a secret softly into her mother's ear. 她在她母亲耳边轻声说了个秘密。

He has a sharp ear for catching music subtle nuances. 他在捕捉音乐细微差别方面有敏锐的听力。

early.note:
Getting up early in the morning gives you more energy. 早晨早起能给你带来更多的活力。

They caught an early flight to avoid heavy traffic. 他们赶了早班飞机以避开拥堵的交通。

earth.note:
The planet Earth orbits around the bright sun. 地球围绕明亮的太阳旋转。

Farmers rich black earth is ideal for growing vegetables. 农民肥沃的黑土非常适合种植蔬菜。

earthquake.note:
The powerful earthquake shook building foundations. 强烈的地震震撼了建筑物的地基。

Rescue teams worked tirelessly after the massive earthquake. 大地震发生后救援队伍不眠不休地工作。

east.meaning: n. 东方 adj. 东方的 adv. 向东
east.note:
The sun always rises in the east every morning. 太阳每天早晨总是从东方升起。

They traveled east towards the scenic coastal region. 他们向东前往风景优美的沿海地区。

easy.note:
Solving this basic math puzzle is very easy. 解开这道基础数学谜题非常容易。

Take it easy and rest after a long tiring day. 在疲惫漫长的一天后放轻松好好休息。

eat.note:
It is essential to eat a healthy balanced breakfast. 吃一顿健康平衡的早餐至关重要。

We love to eat fresh seafood at oceanfront places. 我们喜欢在海滨餐厅吃新鲜的海鲜。

edge.meaning: n. 边缘；刀刃 v. 缓缓移动
edge.note:
Don't place that fragile cup near the table edge. 不要把那个易碎的杯子放在桌子边缘附近。

The sharp edge of the metal kitchen knife cut him. 金属菜刀锋利的刀刃割伤了他。

education.note:
Higher education plays a vital role in personal growth. 高等教育在个人成长中起着至关重要的作用。

The charity works to promote equal education for girls. 该慈善机构致力于促进女童的平等教育。

egg.note:
She fried two fresh eggs for her morning breakfast. 她早上炸了两个新鲜鸡蛋当早餐。

The bird carefully guarded the eggs in its warm nest. 鸟儿在温暖的窝里细心地守护着蛋。

egypt.note:
Egypt is famous worldwide for its ancient pyramids. 埃及因其古老的金字塔而享誉世界。

The Nile river flows gracefully right through Egypt. 尼罗河婀娜地流经整个埃及。

egyptian.meaning: adj. 埃及的 n. 埃及人
egyptian.note:
We visited the museum section housing Egyptian antiquities. 我们参观了存放埃及文物的博物馆展区。

She studies ancient Egyptian hieroglyphics at university. 她在大学里学习古埃及象形文字。

eight.note:
There are eight students seated around the round table. 有八名学生围坐在圆桌旁。

The work day usually starts at eight in the morning. 工作日通常在早上八点开始。

eighteen.note:
She celebrated her eighteen birthday with close friends. 她和至亲好友一起庆祝了她的十八岁生日。

You must be eighteen years old to vote in elections. 你必须年满十八岁才能在选举中投票。

eighth.meaning: num. 第八 n. 八分之一
eighth.note:
Today marks the eighth anniversary of our business founding. 今天是我们企业成立的第八周年纪念日。

He finished in eighth position in the marathons. 他在马拉松比赛中取得了第八名的成绩。

eighty.note:
My grandfather will celebrate his eighty birthday next week. 我祖父下周将庆祝他的八十岁大寿。

The car was driving at eighty kilometers per hour. 汽车正以每小时八十公里的速度行驶。

either.meaning: det./pron. 任何一个 conj. 要么……（用于either...or）
either.note:
You can choose either option; both are completely fine. 你可以选择任何一个选项，两者都完全可以。

Either you come with us now, or you stay home. 要么你现在跟我们走，要么你留在家里。

elder.meaning: adj. 年长的 n. 长者；长辈
elder.note:
Her elder brother works as a senior software developer. 她的年长哥哥担任高级软件开发员。

Younger generations should respect the wisdom of elders. 年轻一代应该尊重长者的智慧。

electricity.note:
Solar panels generate clean electricity from sunlight. 太阳能电池板利用阳光产生清洁电能。

The thunderstorm caused a sudden loss of electricity power. 雷暴造成了突然的停电。

elevator.note:
Take the elevator straight up to the top floor office. 乘电梯直接上去顶楼办公室。

The high-speed elevator glides smoothly between floors. 这台高速电梯在楼层间平稳滑行。

eleven.note:
There are eleven players on each soccer team. 每个足球队有十一名球员。

The train to the capital leaves at eleven o'clock. 开往首都的火车在十一点开动。

else.note:
Is there anything else I can help you with today? 今天还有什么其他我可以帮你的吗？

If he is not here, somebody else must know. 如果他不在里，必然有其他人知道。

e.meaning: n. 英语字母表的第5个字母；电子（前缀）
e.note:
'E' is the most frequently used letter in English. 'E'是英语中最常用的字母。

E-commerce has transformed global retail businesses. 电子商务改变了全球零售业务。

empty.meaning: adj. 空的 v. 倒空
empty.note:
The milk bottle in the fridge was completely empty. 冰箱里的牛奶瓶完全空了。

Please empty the trash bin into the large outdoor container. 请把垃圾桶倒空至室外大集装箱里。

encourage.note:
Teachers should encourage students to ask creative questions. 教师应该鼓励学生提出富有创意的问题。

Her family always encourages her to pursue her dreams. 她的家人总是激励她去追求她的梦想。

end.meaning: n. 结束；末端 v. 结束
end.note:
We stayed until the very end of the concert. 我们一直待到音乐会彻底结束。

Their long journey will end at the ocean shoreline. 他们的漫长旅程将在海洋海岸线结束。

enemy.note:
Soldiers defended the ancient city wall from the enemy. 士兵们防守古代城墙抵御敌人。

Pollution is a dangerous enemy to human health. 污染是人类健康的大敌。

engineer.meaning: n. 工程师 v. 设计；建造
engineer.note:
She works as a civil engineer designing bridges. 她作为一名土木工程师从事桥梁设计工作。

Engineers spent years developing this safe electric car. 工程师们花了数年时间开发出这款安全电动车。

england.note:
London is the capital and largest city of England. 伦敦是英格兰的首都兼最大城市。

They toured old countryside villages across England. 他们游览了英格兰各地的古老乡村小镇。

english.meaning: adj. 英国的；英语的 n. 英语
english.note:
Learning to speak English fluently opens global doors. 学会流利地讲英语能打开走向全球的大门。

She loves classic English tea and scone afternoon routines. 她喜欢经典的英式下午茶与司康饼日常。

enjoy.note:
I really enjoy spending relaxing weekends with family. 我真的非常喜欢与家人一起度过放松的周末。

They enjoy listening to classical music in the evening. 他们喜欢在晚上听古典音乐。

enjoyable.meaning: adj. 令人愉快的；有趣的
enjoyable.note:
We had a very enjoyable picnic in the sunny park. 我们在阳光明媚的公园里进行了一场非常愉快的野餐。

Reading novels is an enjoyable way to relax your mind. 阅读小说是放松身心的愉快方式。

enough.note:
Make sure you drink enough water throughout the day. 确保你一整天都喝了足够的水。

He was brave enough to stand up and speak out. 他足够勇敢，能够站出来发声。

enter.meaning: v. 进入；输入；报名参加
enter.note:
Knock on the door before you enter the private room. 在你进入私密房间前请先敲门。

Please enter your user password to log into system. 请输入你的用户密码以登录系统。

entrance.note:
Meet me right outside the main library entrance. 在图书馆主入口正门外与我碰头。

The grand entrance of the museum is paved with marble. 博物馆的雄伟入口是用大理石铺成的。

envelope.note:
She sealed the handwritten letter inside a white envelope. 她把手写信密封在一个白信封里。

Don't forget to put a postage stamp on the envelope. 别忘了在信封上贴上邮票。

envy.note:
Many people envy her successful creative career. 很多人羡慕她成功的创意事业。

Her stunning home garden was the envy of all neighbors. 她那令人惊叹的家庭花园成为了所有邻居羡慕的对象。

equal.meaning: adj. 平等的；相等的 v. 等于
equal.note:
Everyone should have equal rights and fair opportunities. 每个人都应该享有平等的权利和公平的机会。

Two plus two is equal to four in mathematics. 在数学中二加二等于四。

equip.note:
The school aims to equip classrooms with smart boards. 学校旨在为教室配备智能黑板。

You must equip yourself with warm clothing for winter. 你必须为冬天装备保暖的衣物。

equipment.note:
The gym facility offers modern sports training equipment. 该健身设施提供现代化的体育训练设备。

Engineers brought specialized heavy equipment to the site. 工程师们带了专业重型设备来到工地。

eraser.note:
Use a soft rubber eraser to remove pencil marks. 用软橡皮擦去铅笔痕迹。

She lost her pink eraser during the drawing class. 她在绘画课上弄丢了她的粉色橡皮擦。

error.note:
A computer system error prevented the report from saving. 计算机系统错误导致报告无法保存。

Correct any spelling error before printing the document. 在打印文档之前纠正所有拼写错误。

escape.note:
The prisoners tried to escape over the high wall. 囚犯们试图翻过高墙逃跑。

Reading fantasy books is a great escape from daily stress. 阅读奇幻书籍是摆脱日常压力的大好避风港。

especially.note:
I love fresh organic fruits, especially sweet strawberries. 我喜欢新鲜有机水果，尤其是甜甜的草莓。

The park is beautiful, especially during early autumn. 这个公园非常美丽，尤其是在初秋时节。

essay.note:
Students were asked to write a five-page history essay. 学生们被要求写一篇五页的历史文章。

Her prize-winning essay was published in the journal. 她获奖的随笔发表在该期刊上。

eve.note:
Families gather together to dine on Christmas Eve. 各大家庭在圣诞前夕聚在一起用餐。

On the eve of the historic battle, soldiers rested. 在这场历史性战役的前夜，士兵们进行了休息。

even.meaning: adv. 甚至 adj. 平坦的；偶数的
even.note:
He didn't even say goodbye before leaving room. 他离开房间前甚至连再见都没说。

Two, four, and six are basic even numbers in math. 在数学中，二、四、六是基础偶数。

evening.note:
We enjoyed a quiet relaxing evening at home together. 我们一起在家度过了一个宁静放松的晚上。

The cool evening air was scented with blooming flowers. 凉爽的晚间空气中弥漫着花朵的芬芳。

event.note:
The annual sports event draws participants nationwide. 一度一届的体育赛事吸引了全国各地的参赛者。

Graduation is a major momentous event in a student's life. 毕业是学生生涯中的一个重大关键事件。

ever.note:
Have you ever visited the magnificent Great Wall? 你曾经游览过雄伟的长城吗？

This is the best homemade cake I have ever tasted. 这是我吃过的最美味的手工蛋糕。

every.note:
Every single student must hand in their homework today. 每一个学生今天都必须提交他们的作业。

The shuttle bus runs every fifteen minutes to airport. 机场穿梭巴士每隔十五分钟运行一班。

everybody.note:
Everybody was standing and cheering for the winning team. 每个人都站起来为获胜的团队欢呼。

Is everybody ready to start the interactive meeting? 所有人准备好开始这场互动会议了吗？

everyday.note:
Stress is an unavoidable part of modern everyday life. 压力是现代日常生活不可避免的一部分。

Wear comfortable everyday clothes for the school field trip. 参加学校郊游请穿舒适的日常衣服。

everyone.note:
Everyone in the classroom listened attentively to speaker. 教室里的每个人都聚精会神地听演讲者演讲。

Good health is a common desire for everyone on earth. 良好的健康是地球上每个人的共同心愿。

everything.note:
Everything went according to our original project plan. 一切都按照我们原先的项目计划进行。

She packed everything she needed into her red backpack. 她把她需要的一切都装进了她的红背包里。

everywhere.note:
Beautiful colorful flowers were blooming everywhere in spring. 春天里到处绽放着美丽彩色的花朵。

I looked everywhere for my keys but found nothing. 我到处寻找我的钥匙，但什么也没找到。

exact.note:
Can you give me the exact time of arrival? 你能告诉我准确的到达时间吗？

The scientist recorded the exact location of the species. 科学家记录了该物种的确切位置。

exactly.meaning: adv. 精确地；确切地；正是
exactly.note:
The train arrived at the station at exactly noon. 火车在正午时分精确地到达了车站。

That is exactly what I was trying to tell you. 那正是我一直试图告诉你的事。

exam.note:
She studied late into night for her math exam. 为了数学考试，她复习到了深夜。

Students waited nervously outside for their final exam results. 学生们在外面紧张地等待期末考试结果。

examine.note:
The doctor will examine your throat to check infection. 医生将检查你的喉咙以查看是否有感染。

Inspectors carefully examine all product safety details. 检查员仔细审查所有产品安全细节。

example.note:
Can you provide a clear example of this grammar rule? 你能提供一个关于这条语法规则的清晰例子吗？

Her dedication sets a inspiring example for young students. 她的奉献精神为年轻学生树立了鼓舞人心的榜样。

excellent.note:
She received an excellent grade on her chemistry project. 她在化学项目上获得了优异的成绩。

The restaurant is renowned for its excellent service. 这家餐厅因其卓越的服务而闻名。

except.meaning: prep. 除……之外 conj. 只是
except.note:
The store is open daily except on official holidays. 商店除法定节假日外每天营业。

Everyone was invited to party except for John. 除了约翰，大家都接到了去聚会的邀请。

excite.note:
The news of the upcoming trip will excite children. 即将来临的旅行消息会让孩子们大为兴奋。

The interactive science display excited their natural curiosity. 这个互动科学展览激发了他们天然的好奇心。

excuse.meaning: v. 原谅 n. 借口；理由
excuse.note:
Excuse me, could you tell me how to get there? 打扰一下，你能告诉我怎么去那里吗？

He offered a flimsy excuse for missing the staff meeting. 他为缺席员工会议提供了一个蹩脚的借口。

exercise.meaning: n. 运动；练习 v. 锻炼
exercise.note:
Regular physical exercise is important for cardiac health. 定期的体育运动对心脏健康非常重要。

Complete the grammar exercise at the end of chapter. 完成本章结尾的语法练习。

exhibition.note:
We visited an impressive modern photography art exhibition. 我们参观了一个令人印象深刻的现代摄影艺术展。

The museum hosts a new temporary historical exhibition. 博物馆举办了一场新的临时历史展览。

exist.note:
Do you believe that intelligent alien life can exist? 你相信智性外星生命可能存在吗？

Many unique wild species only exist in remote forests. 许多独特的野生物种仅存在于偏远的森林中。

expect.note:
We expect the new train to arrive on schedule. 我们预料这列新火车会按时到达。

Teachers expect students to complete all assigned homework. 教师们要求学生完成所有布置的作业。

experience.meaning: n. 经验；经历 v. 体验；经历
experience.note:
She has ten years of practical experience in teaching. 她在教学方面拥有十年的实践经验。

Traveling abroad allows you to experience fascinating diverse cultures. 国外旅行让你能体验迷人的多元文化。

experiment.meaning: n. 实验 v. 进行实验
experiment.note:
The scientific team conducted a lab experiment on plants. 科研团队在植物上进行了一项实验室实验。

Chefs like to experiment with new exotic cooking flavors. 厨师们喜欢用新的异域烹饪风味做实验尝试。

expert.meaning: n. 专家 adj. 熟练的；专家的
expert.note:
She is a leading medical expert on infectious diseases. 她是一位传染病领域的首席医学专家。

Seek expert professional advice before making big financial investments. 在做出重大财务投资前，请寻求专家的专业建议。

explain.note:
Could you please explain this complex physics formula again? 能请你再解释一下这个复杂的物理公式吗？

He tried to explain the valid reason for his delay. 他试图说明他迟到的正当理由。

express.meaning: v. 表达 adj. 特快；明确的 n. 快件
express.note:
Music is a powerful medium to express deep emotions. 音乐是表达深层情感的强大媒介。

They took the high-speed express train to the capital. 他们乘坐高速特快列车前往首都。

eye.meaning: n. 眼睛；眼光 v. 注视
eye.note:
She closed her fatigue eyes and fell fast asleep. 她闭上疲惫的眼睛，很快入睡了。

He has a sharp eye for identifying rare artwork. 他在识别稀有艺术品方面有着敏锐的眼光。

fact.note:
State only the plain fact without adding personal bias. 仅陈述客观事实，不要增加个人偏见。

In fact, he was the first person to arrive. 事实上，他是第一个到场的人。

factory.note:
The shoe factory employs hundreds of local assembly workers. 这家鞋厂雇佣了数百名当地的装配工人。

They built a new automated factory on city outskirts. 他们在城市郊区建造了一座新的自动化工厂。

fail.meaning: v. 失败；未做到；不及格
fail.note:
He worked hard because he did not want to fail. 他努力工作，因为他不想失败。

If you fail to submit on time, points will drop. 如果你未能按时提交，分数将会下降。

fame.note:
The young actor achieved international fame overnight after movie. 这位年轻演员在电影上映后一夜之间赢得了国际声誉。

Fame and wealth do not always bring true happiness. 名声和财富并不总是带来真正的幸福。

famous.note:
Italy is famous around the world for rich cuisine. 意大利因其丰富的美食而享誉世界。

She met a famous author at book signing event. 她在签名售书活动上遇到了一位著名的作家。

far.note:
How far is your new home from the central station? 你的新家离中心车站有多远？

We walked as far as the edge of the riverbank. 我们一直走到河岸边缘那么远。

farm.meaning: n. 农场 v. 务农
farm.note:
They own a beautiful organic dairy farm in country. 他们在乡村拥有一个美丽的有机构乳农场。

His family has farmed this fertile land for generations. 他的家族在这片肥沃的土地上耕作了数代。

farmer.note:
The local farmer wakes up early to feed livestock. 当地的农民很早起床喂养家畜。

Farmers harvest crisp red apples in late golden autumn. 农民们在金秋时节收获脆红苹果。

farming.note:
Modern sustainable farming methods conserve precious soil quality. 现代可持续农业方法能保护珍贵的土壤质量。

Farming remains the main source of income in rural village. 耕作仍是该乡村地区的主要收入来源。

farmland.note:
Acres of rich green farmland stretch along the river. 数英亩肥沃的绿色农田沿着河流延伸。

The expansion of city destroyed fertile agricultural farmland. 城市的扩张摧毁了肥沃的农业农田。

farther.meaning: adv./adj. 更远地；更远（far的比较级）
farther.note:
We cannot walk any farther without taking a rest. 不休息一下的话，我们再也走不了更远了。

The house is located on the farther side of lake. 这栋房子位于湖的更远那一侧。

farthest.meaning: adv./adj. 最远地；最远（far的最高级）
farthest.note:
Pluto is one of the farthest planets in solar system. 冥王星是太阳系中最遥远的行星之一。

He threw the baseball the farthest during the school contest. 他在学校比赛中把棒球扔得最远。

fast.meaning: adj. 快速的 adv. 快速地 v. 禁食
fast.note:
He drives a fast car on the highway. 他在公路上开着一辆快车。

The clock on the wall is five minutes fast. 墙上的钟快了五分钟。

fasten.note:
Please fasten your seat belt during takeoff and landing. 起飞和降落期间请系好安全带。

Fasten the notice to the board with a pushpin. 用图钉把通知固定在公告栏上。

fat.meaning: adj. 肥胖的 n. 脂肪
fat.note:
Eating too many sweets can make you fat. 吃太多甜食会让你发胖。

This milk contains only one percent fat. 这种牛奶仅含百分之一的脂肪。

favour.meaning: n. 恩惠；偏袒 v. 赞同；偏爱
favour.note:
Could you do me a quick favour and open the door? 你能帮我个小忙把门打开吗？

Most members voted in favour of the new proposal. 大多数成员投票赞成这项新提议。

favourite.meaning: adj. 最喜欢的 n. 最喜欢的人或物
favourite.note:
Blue is my favourite color for summer clothes. 蓝色是我夏天衣服最喜欢的颜色。

This historic park is a favorite among local residents. 这个历史悠久的公园是当地居民的最爱。

fax.meaning: n. 传真 v. 发传真
fax.note:
Please send the signed agreement to us by fax. 请通过传真把签订好的协议发给我们。

I will fax the financial documents to your office immediately. 我会立即把财务文件传真给你的办公室。

fear.meaning: n. 害怕；恐惧 v. 害怕；担心
fear.note:
She tried to overcome her fear of public speaking. 她努力克服对公众演讲的恐惧。

Doctors fear that the dangerous virus may spread rapidly. 医生们担心这种危险的病毒可能会迅速传播。

feather.note:
The soft pillow is filled with natural goose feather. 这个柔软的枕头里装满了天然鹅毛。

Birds use their colorful feather to attract mates. 鸟类使用它们绚丽的羽毛来吸引配偶。

february.note:
February is the shortest month of the entire calendar year. 二月是整个日历年里最短的月份。

They plan to host their wedding in early February. 他们计划在二月初举行婚礼。

federal.meaning: adj. 联邦的；中央政府的
federal.note:
The case is currently under federal investigation by agents. 该案目前正由特工进行联邦调查。

Federal laws apply to every single state in the country. 联邦法律适用于该国每一个州。

fee.note:
The university raised its annual tuition fee this term. 这所大学本学期提高了每年的学费。

There is no additional entry fee for museum members. 博物馆会员无需支付额外的入场费。

feed.meaning: v. 喂养；提供 n. 饲料
feed.note:
Don't forget to feed the cat before you leave for work. 你出门上班前别忘了喂猫。

Farmer stores animal feed inside the wooden barn. 农民把动物饲料储存在木制农舍里。

feel.meaning: v. 感觉；觉得；触摸 n. 触感
feel.note:
I feel very tired after walking all day around town. 在城镇走了一整天后我感到非常疲惫。

Feel the soft texture of this silk scarf. 感受一下这条丝巾柔软的质地。

feeling.note:
She had a strange feeling that someone was watching her. 她有一种奇怪的感觉，觉得有人在看着她。

He expressed his deep feeling of gratitude in the speech. 他在演讲中表达了他深深的感激之情。

fetch.note:
Go and fetch a bucket of clean water from the well. 去井里打一桶干净的水来。

The rare painting is expected to fetch a high price. 这幅罕见的画作预计能售得高价。

fever.note:
The child had a high fever and stayed in bed. 这孩子发高烧躺在床上。

World Cup fever swept across the entire nation. 世界杯狂热席卷了整个国家。

few.meaning: adj./pron. 很少的；几乎没有的（与a连用表示少数）
few.note:
Very few people attended the outdoor concert due to rain. 由于下雨，极少有人参加这场户外音乐会。

I have a few questions regarding the new company policy. 关于公司的新政策，我有几个问题。

fifteen.note:
The meeting will begin in exactly fifteen minutes. 会议将在十五分钟后准时开始。

She has lived in this coastal city for fifteen years. 她在这座沿海城市生活了十五年。

fifth.meaning: num. 第五 n. 五分之一
fifth.note:
This is our fifth visit to the national park this year. 这是我们今年第五次游览该国家公园。

About one fifth of the total area is covered by water. 大约五分之一的总面积被水覆盖。

fifty.note:
My uncle will celebrate his fifty birthday next month. 我叔叔下个月将庆祝他的五十岁生日。

The box contains fifty individual packets of tea. 这个盒子里装有五十个独立包装的茶叶袋。

fight.note:
The two dogs began to fight over a bone in the yard. 两只狗在院子里开始为了骨头打架。

They had a fierce fight about money yesterday. 昨天他们为钱发生了剧烈的争吵。

fill.note:
Please fill the glass with cold mineral water. 请用冷矿泉水倒满杯子。

The smell of fresh coffee began to fill the kitchen. 新鲜咖啡的香味开始飘满厨房。

film.meaning: n. 电影；胶片 v. 拍摄
film.note:
We went to the theater to watch a classic documentary film. 我们去影院看了一部经典的纪录片。

They plan to film the new TV series in Italy. 他们计划在意大利拍摄这部新电视剧。

find.meaning: v. 找到；发现；觉得 n. 发现物
find.note:
I can't find my house keys anywhere in my bag. 我在包里到处都找不到我家钥匙。

Did you find the lesson easy to understand? 你觉得这堂课容易理解吗？

fine.meaning: adj. 好的；纤细的 n./v. 罚款
fine.note:
The weather today is sunny and fine for a stroll. 今天天气晴朗，非常适合散步。

He had to pay a steep fine for speeding on highway. 他因在公路上超速驾驶而不得不缴纳巨额罚款。

finger.note:
He cut his index finger while chopping vegetables. 他切菜时割伤了食指。

She pointed her finger at the map on the wall. 她用手指指向墙上的地图。

finish.meaning: v. 完成；结束 n. 结尾；饰面
finish.note:
You must finish your assignment before watching TV. 你看电视前必须完成你的作业。

The marathon runners were racing towards the finish line. 马拉松选手们正冲向终点线。

fire.meaning: n. 火；火灾 v. 开火；解雇
fire.note:
Campers gathered around the bright warm fire to sing. 营员们聚集在明亮温暖的篝火旁唱歌。

The manager had to fire the employee for misconduct. 经理因失职不得不解雇该员工。

fireplace.note:
They sat by the cozy fireplace to keep warm. 他们坐在舒适的壁炉旁取暖。

Logs were burning brightly inside the stone fireplace. 木柴在石砌壁炉里旺盛地燃烧着。

first.meaning: ord./adj./adv. 第一；首先 n. 开始
first.note:
This is the very first time I have tried sushi. 这是我第一次品尝寿司。

First, wash your hands thoroughly before eating food. 首先，进食前要彻底洗手。

fish.meaning: n. 鱼；鱼肉 v. 钓鱼；捕鱼
fish.note:
Colorful exotic fish were swimming around the coral reef. 彩色异域鱼类在珊瑚礁周围游动。

They decided to fish along the quiet riverbank. 他们决定沿着宁静的河岸钓鱼。

fisherman.note:
The old fisherman cast his net into the sea. 那位老渔民把网撒入海中。

Local fishermen sell their fresh catch at the harbor market. 当地渔民在港口市场出售新鲜捕获的水产。

fit.meaning: v. 适合；安装 adj. 健康的；合适的
fit.note:
These shoes don't fit me; they are too small. 这双鞋不适合我，太小了。

He exercises daily to stay physically active and fit. 他每天锻炼以保持体魄强健和健康。

five.note:
The cat gave birth to five healthy tiny kittens. 猫咪产下了五只健康的小猫。

Our office working day ends at five in afternoon. 我们的办公室工作日于下午五点结束。

fix.meaning: v. 修理；固定；安排 n. 困境；解决方法
fix.note:
Can you help me fix my broken computer keyboard? 你能帮我修理损坏的电脑键盘吗？

Fix the wooden frame firmly to the plaster wall. 把木框架牢牢固定在石膏墙上。

flag.meaning: n. 旗帜 v. 标记；衰退
flag.note:
The national flag was flying high on top of building. 国旗在建筑物顶部高高飘扬。

His energy began to flag after running ten miles. 跑了十英里后，他的精力开始衰退。

flight.note:
Our direct flight to Paris leaves early tomorrow morning. 我们飞往巴黎的直飞航班明天清晨起飞。

The bird took flight as soon as it saw the cat. 鸟儿一看到猫就飞走了。

flood.meaning: n. 洪水 v. 淹没；大量涌入
flood.note:
Heavy summer rains caused a disastrous flood in town. 夏天的大雨在城镇引发了灾难性的洪水。

Water began to flood the basement during the storm. 暴风雨期间水开始淹没地下室。

floor.note:
She dropped her phone onto the hard wooden floor. 她把手机掉到了坚硬的木地板上。

Our office is located on the third floor of building. 我们的办公室位于这栋建筑的三楼。

flower.meaning: n. 花；花朵 v. 开花
flower.note:
He brought a colorful bouquet of fresh flower home. 他带了一束鲜艳的新鲜花朵回家。

Cherry trees flower in early spring every year. 樱花树每年早春开花。

focus.meaning: v. 集中；聚焦 n. 焦点；重点
focus.note:
Try to focus on your studies instead of playing games. 尽量专注于你的学习，而不是玩游戏。

The main focus of the meeting was sales expansion. 会议的主要焦点是销售扩张。

fog.meaning: n. 雾 v. 笼罩在雾中；使模糊
fog.note:
Thick morning fog covered the mountain highway. 浓浓的晨雾笼罩着山区公路。

Steam from the warm bath caused the mirror to fog. 来自温水浴的蒸气使镜子变模糊了。

foggy.note:
Drivers slowed down on the foggy mountain road. 司机们在有雾的山路上放慢了速度。

I have only a foggy memory of that childhood trip. 我对那次童年旅行只有模糊的记忆。

follow.note:
The little ducklings follow their mother everywhere. 小鸭子们到处跟着它们的妈妈。

Please follow the safety instructions listed in manual. 请遵循手册中列出的安全说明。

following.meaning: adj. 接着的 prep. 在……之后 n. 追随者
following.note:
They left early the following morning for vacation. 接下来的那天清晨他们出发去度假了。

Following the lecture, attendees asked several questions. 讲座之后，与会人员提出了几个问题。

fond.meaning: adj. 喜爱的；深情的（常用于be fond of）
fond.note:
She is very fond of classical piano music. 她非常喜爱古典钢琴音乐。

He recalled fond memories of his happy childhood. 他回想起了对自己快乐童年的深情回忆。

food.note:
Fresh organic food is good for maintaining overall health. 新鲜有机食物有利于维持整体健康。

They donated supplies of canned food to charity. 他们向慈善机构捐赠了罐装食品物资。

fool.meaning: n. 傻瓜；愚人 v. 愚弄；欺骗
fool.note:
Don't be a fool; think carefully before deciding. 别当傻瓜，在决定前仔细思考。

You cannot fool me with that obvious fake trick. 你用那个明显的假把戏欺骗不了我。

foolish.note:
It was foolish to walk alone in dark at night. 夜间独自在黑暗中行走是愚蠢的。

He felt foolish after making a simple basic math mistake. 在犯了一个基础的简单数学错误后他觉得很傻。

foot.note:
His left foot was injured during soccer practice. 在足球练习中他的左脚受伤了。

The village is situated at the foot of mountain. 这个村庄坐落于山脚下。

for.meaning: prep. 为了；给；关于 conj. 因为
for.note:
This surprise present is meant specifically for you. 这个惊喜礼物是专门给你的。

We walked together in silence for two whole hours. 我们一起安静地走了整整两个小时。

foreign.note:
Learning a foreign language requires daily practice. 学习一门外语需要每天练习。

She loves watching foreign films with local subtitles. 她喜欢看带本地字幕的外语电影。

forest.note:
They went hiking in the deep green pine forest. 他们去深绿色的松树森林里徒步。

Wild animals thrive inside the protected nature forest. 野生动物在受保护的自然森林中繁衍生息。

forever.note:
True friendship can last forever despite distance. 真正的友谊尽管相隔遥远也能长久持续。

It seemed to take forever to reach our destination. 到达我们的目的地似乎花了漫长无比的时间。

forget.note:
Don't forget to lock the front door when leaving. 出门时不要忘记锁上前门。

I will never forget the kindness she showed me. 我永远不会忘记她对我展现的善意。

forgetful.note:
My grandfather is getting increasingly forgetful with age. 我祖父随着年龄增长变得越来越健忘。

He is so forgetful that he always leaves keys. 他太健忘了，总是把钥匙落下。

fork.meaning: n. 餐叉；岔路 v. 分叉
fork.note:
Set the table with a metal knife and fork. 用金属餐刀和餐叉摆好餐桌。

Turn left when you reach the fork in the road. 当你到达路的岔路口时请向左转。

form.meaning: n. 表格；形式；形状 v. 形成；组建
form.note:
Please complete and sign this official application form. 请填写并签署这份正式的申请表格。

Ice began to form on the surface of pond. 池塘表面开始形成冰层。

forty.note:
The speed limit on this suburban road is forty. 这条郊区道路上的限速是四十。

There are forty students registered in this class. 这个班级登记了四十名学生。

found.meaning: v. 建立；创立（另为find的过去式/过去分词）
found.note:
They plan to found a new charitable trust organisation. 他们计划创立一个新的慈善信托组织。

The historical university was founded in the eighteenth century. 这所历史悠久的大学创立于十八世纪。

four.note:
A square shape has four equal straight sides. 正方形形状有四条相等的直边。

They have four children living at home together. 他们有四个孩子一起生活在家里。

fourteen.note:
The young teenager turned fourteen years old today. 这个年轻少年今天满十四岁了。

The vacation package lasts for fourteen full days. 这套度假套餐持续整整十四天。

fourth.meaning: num. 第四 n. 四分之一
fourth.note:
July the fourth is a major holiday in US. 七月四日在美国是个重大节日。

He finished fourth place in the regional swimming race. 他在区域游泳比赛中取得了第四名。

france.note:
Paris is the iconic capital city of France. 巴黎是法国标志性的首都城市。

They spent two weeks traveling in southern France. 他们花了两周时间在法国南部旅行。

free.meaning: adj. 免费的；自由的；空闲的 v. 释放
free.note:
Admission to the city public museum is completely free. 进城市公共博物馆参观是完全免费的。

Are you free to attend the workshop tomorrow afternoon? 明天下午你有空参加研讨会吗？

freeze.note:
Water will freeze when temperature drops below zero. 当温度降至零下时水会结冰。

Freeze the remaining soup in a sealed container. 把剩下的汤装进密封容器里冻结保存。

french.meaning: adj. 法国的；法语的 n. 法语
french.note:
She speaks fluent French and basic standard German. 她说流利的法语和基础的标准德语。

We love eating delicious French bread and cheese. 我们喜欢吃美味的法国面包和奶酪。

frenchman.note:

She spoke from bottom of her warm loving heart. 她从自己温暖慈爱的心灵深处发声。

heat.meaning: n. 热量；高温 v. 加热
heat.note:
Protect yourself from intense midday summer heat outside. 在户外保护自己免受中午漫长酷热的伤害。

Heat the leftovers in microwave for two quick minutes. 在微波炉里把剩菜加热两分钟。

heaven.note:
Believers hope to enter eternal peace in heaven. 信徒们希望在天堂获得永恒的安宁。

Lying on beach in sunshine feels absolute heaven. 躺在阳光明媚的海滩上感觉完全是天堂般的享受。

heavy.meaning: adj. 沉重的；繁重的；剧烈的
heavy.note:
He struggled to lift the heavy wooden furniture box. 他费劲地搬起沉重的木制家具箱。

Expect heavy rain and thunder throughout entire afternoon. 预计整个下午都会有大雨和雷电。

heavily.note:
It was raining heavily when we left building. 我们离开大楼时正下着大雨。

The company relies heavily on modern digital tech tools. 该公司在很大程度上依赖现代数字技术工具。

hello.meaning: int. 你好 n. 问候
hello.note:
Say hello to your parents for me when returning. 回去时替我向你的父母问好。

He greeted her with a warm wave and hello. 他用温暖的挥手和问候向她打招呼。

help.note:
Can you help me carry these groceries up stairs? 你能帮我把这些杂货搬上楼吗？

Thank you very much for your kind support help. 非常感谢你善意的支持与帮助。

helpful.meaning: adj. 有帮助的；乐于助人的
helpful.note:
The library clerk was extremely polite and helpful. 图书馆店员极其有礼貌且乐于助人。

She gave me some really helpful practical advice today. 她今天给了我一些非常有用的实践建议。

hen.note:
The brown hen laid a fresh warm egg morning. 这只棕色母鸡早上产下了一枚新鲜温暖的蛋。

Farmer raised chickens and hens in backyard coop. 农民在后院鸡舍养鸡和母鸡。

her.meaning: pron. 她（宾格）；她的（物主代词）
her.note:
I gave her the classic novel as present. 我把这部经典小说作为礼物给了她。

Her car is parked outside near entrance gate. 她的车停在入口大门附近的外面。

here.note:
Please come here and look at this painting. 请来到这里看这幅画。

I have been waiting here for thirty long minutes. 我在这里已经等了长长三十分钟了。

hero.note:
The brave firefighter became a celebrated local hero. 这名勇敢的消防员成为了备受赞誉的地方英雄。

He plays the courageous hero in new movie. 他在这部新电影中扮演勇敢的男主角。

hers.meaning: pron. 她的（名词性物主代词）
hers.note:
This red shiny sports bicycle is actually hers. 这辆红闪闪的运动自行车实际上是她的。

Your jacket is blue, but hers is dark black. 你的夹克是蓝色的，但她的则是深黑色的。

herself.note:
She taught herself how to code computer programs. 她自学了如何编写计算机程序。

She looked at herself in long dressing mirror. 她看着长衣镜中的自己。

hey.meaning: int. 嘿；喂（打招呼或引起注意）
hey.note:
Hey! Wait for me before crossing street! 嘿！过马路前等等我！

Hey, have you seen my lost keys anywhere? 喂，你有在什么地方看到我遗失的钥匙吗？

hi.note:
Hi! It is wonderful to see you again today. 嗨！今天能再次见到你太棒了。

Say hi to your family when you return home. 当你回到家时向你的家人问声嗨。

hide.meaning: v. 隐藏；藏匿 n. 兽皮
hide.note:
The playful dog loves to hide its bone buried. 这只爱玩闹的狗喜欢把它的骨头埋起来藏匿。

You cannot hide the truth from public forever. 你不能永远向公众隐藏真相。

high.meaning: adj. 高的；高级的 adv. 在高处
high.note:
Mount Everest is the highest mountain peak world. 珠穆朗玛峰是世界上最高的山峰。

The bird flew high up into clear sky. 鸟儿高高地飞入清澈的天空。

highway.note:
Traffic on coastal highway moves smoothly today afternoon. 今天下午沿海公路上的交通流动顺畅。

They took national highway direct to state capital. 他们沿着国家公路直达州首府。

hill.note:
They hiked up steep grassy hill to view town. 他们爬上陡峭的草丘以鸟瞰城镇。

A tiny historic church stands atop green hill. 一座微型历史教堂耸立于绿丘之巅。

him.note:
I saw him walking dog in city park. 我看到他在城市公园里遛狗。

Please send him the updated document by email. 请通过电子邮件向他发送更新后的文档。

himself.note:
He fixed the broken wooden chair all by himself. 他完全靠他自己修好了破损的木椅。

He bought himself a handsome watch for birthday. 他在生日时给他自己买了一块英气的手表。

his.note:
His new bicycle is parked outside front gate. 他的新自行车停在前门外。

That blue notebook on desk is actually his. 桌上的那个蓝笔记本实际上是他的。

hit.meaning: v. 打击；碰撞 n. 击打；轰动一时的人或物
hit.note:
He hit the baseball hard over high fence. 他把棒球猛烈击打翻过了高墙。

The news song became an instant global hit. 这首新歌瞬间成为了轰动全球的热门曲目。

hobby.note:
Her favorite leisure hobby is painting landscape scenes. 她最喜欢的业余爱好是画风景画。

Collecting rare coins can become a lifelong hobby. 收集稀有硬币可以成为毕生的业余爱好。

hold.meaning: v. 握住；举行；容纳 n. 握住
hold.note:
Hold the handrail tight while walking downstairs. 走下楼梯时紧紧握住扶手。

The venue can hold up to five hundred guests. 该场地最多可容纳五百位客人。

hole.note:
The rabbit ran fast into its dark underground hole. 兔子快速跑进了它黑暗的地底洞穴。

There is a small hole in my wool sock. 我的羊毛袜子上有个小洞。

holiday.meaning: n. 节日；假期 v. 度假
holiday.note:
They spent summer holiday relaxing on beach island. 他们在海滩岛屿上度过了暑假。

Tomorrow is a national public holiday across country. 明天是全国性的公共法定假日。

home.meaning: n. 家；住宅 adv. 在家；回家 adj. 家庭的
home.note:
After long work trip, it feels good to return home. 长途出差后，回到家里感觉真好。

She stays at home to care for young children. 她留在家里照顾幼小的孩子们。

hometown.note:
He returned to his rural hometown after ten years. 十年后他回到了他偏远农村的家乡。

My hometown is famous for beautiful historical rivers. 我的家乡因美丽的历史河流而闻名。

homework.note:
Complete your math homework before going out play. 在出门玩之前完成你的数学家庭作业。

The teacher assigned reading homework for weekend break. 老师为周末假期布置了阅读家庭作业。

honest.note:
He gave an honest answer to difficult question. 他给出了一个针对难题的诚实回答。

She is a very honest person who never lies. 她是一个从不说谎的极其诚实的人。

hope.note:
I hope you have a safe smooth trip home. 我希望你回家路途平安顺遂。

Never lose hope even in difficult challenging situations. 即使在困难挑剔的逆境中也绝不要失去希望。

hopeless.meaning: adj. 绝望的；无能为力的
hopeless.note:
The situation seemed completely hopeless after storm hit. 暴风雨袭击后形势似乎彻底陷入绝望。

I am hopeless at cooking complex gourmet meals. 在烹饪复杂的美味大餐方面我简直无能为力。

hospital.note:
The ambulance rushed injured patient to hospital. 救护车将受伤病人急送往医院。

She works as a dedicated nurse at children hospital. 她在一家儿童医院当一名奉献的护士。

hot.meaning: adj. 炎热的；滚烫的；辣的
hot.note:
Drink a cup of hot tea on cold morning. 在寒冷的早晨喝一杯滚烫的热茶。

The midday summer weather was exceptionally hot today. 今天夏天的中午天气异常炎热。

hotel.note:
We booked a oceanfront room at luxury hotel. 我们在一家奢华酒店预订了一间面向大海的房间。

The hotel offers complimentary hot breakfast to guests. 酒店向住客提供免费的热早餐。

hour.note:
The movie lasts for two and half hours total. 这部电影总共持续了两个半小时。

We agreed to meet at six hour sharp outside. 我们商定于六点钟整在外面碰头。

housewife.note:
She is a busy dedicated housewife raising three kids. 她是一个忙碌照顾三个孩子的称职家庭主妇。

The housewife manages daily household budget carefully. 这名家庭主妇细心地管理着日常家庭预算。

housework.note:
They share the daily housework like cleaning washing. 他们分担日常家务劳动如打扫洗涤。

Doing housework consumes a lot of physical energy. 做家务消耗大量的体力。

how.meaning: adv. 如何；怎样；多少（用于问程度）
how.note:
How do you solve this mathematical equation easily? 你是如何轻松解开这个数学方程式的？

How old are you, and where do you study? 你多大年纪，又在哪里学习呢？

however.meaning: adv. 然而；但是 conj. 无论如何
however.note:
He worked very hard; however, he failed exam. 他非常努力工作；然而，他考试不及格。

However you decide to approach it, take care. 无论你决定如何处理它，都要小心。

hug.note:
She gave her old friend a warm tight hug. 她给了她的老朋友一个温暖紧密的拥抱。

The mother loves to hug her baby before sleep. 这位母亲喜欢在睡前拥抱她的宝宝。

huge.note:
A huge crowd gathered to watch stadium game. 庞大的动人群众聚集观看体育场比赛。

They made a huge discovery in cancer research. 他们在癌症研究方面取得了巨大的发现。

human.meaning: adj. 人类的 n. 人
human.note:
Heart is a vital organ in human body. 心脏是人体中至关重要的器官。

Humans need clean water and air to survive well. 人类需要干净的水和空气来良好生存。

hundred.note:
Over one hundred guests attended the wedding reception. 一百多位宾客参加了婚礼招待会。

This ancient tree is over three hundred years old. 这棵古树有着三百多年的历史。

hunger.meaning: n. 饥饿；渴望 v. 渴望
hunger.note:
Millions of children suffer from world hunger daily. 每天有数百万儿童承受世界饥饿之苦。

He had an intense hunger for acquiring scientific knowledge. 他对获取科学知识有着强烈的渴望。

hungry.note:
I feel so hungry after running five miles. 在跑了五英里之后我感到非常饥饿。

The stray dog looked hungry and thin on street. 那只流浪狗在街上看起来既饥饿又瘦弱。

hurry.meaning: v. 赶快；匆忙 n. 匆忙
hurry.note:
Hurry up, or we will miss morning train! 快点，否则我们要错过早班火车了！

He left home in a great hurry this morning. 他今天早上非常匆忙地离开了家。

hurt.meaning: v. 伤害；使疼痛 adj. 受伤的
hurt.note:
Be careful not to hurt yourself on glass. 小心不要被玻璃伤害到自己。

My left knee begins to hurt after running. 跑步后我的左膝盖开始感到疼痛。

husband.note:
She and her husband have been married for decade. 她和她的丈夫已经结婚十年了。

Her husband cooked a romantic candlelight dinner tonight. 她的丈夫今晚做了一顿浪漫的烛光晚餐。

ice.note:
Put a few ice cubes into fruit juice. 在果汁里放几个冰块。

The road surface is covered with dangerous black ice. 道路表面覆盖着危险的暗冰。

idea.note:
That sounds like a brilliant and creative idea. 那听起来像是个绝妙而富有创意的主意。

I have no idea where my lost keys are. 我完全不知道我的失物钥匙在哪里。

idiom.note:
'Piece of cake' is a common English idiom. 'Piece of cake'（小菜一碟）是一个常见的英语习语。

Learning local idioms helps you understand natural conversation. 学习本地习语有助于你理解自然交谈。

if.note:
If it rains tomorrow, we will stay inside. 如果明天下雨，我们将留在室内。

I wonder if she will join our meeting. 我想知道她是否会参加我们的会议。

ill.meaning: adj. 有病的；坏的 adv. 不利地
ill.note:
He stayed home from work because he felt ill. 因为感觉生病了，他留在家里没去上班。

She was taken ill suddenly during school concert. 她在学校音乐会期间突然生病了。

illness.note:
He missed two weeks of school due to illness. 由于疾病，他缺了两周课。

Proper rest helps your body recover from severe illness. 适当的休息有助于你的身体从严重疾病中康复。

imagine.note:
Can you imagine living on a distant planet? 你能想象生活在遥远的星球上吗？

I imagine he will arrive before evening darkness. 我猜想他会在傍晚黑天前到达。

immediately.note:
Please respond to this urgent email message immediately. 请立即回复这条紧急电子邮件消息。

The police officer arrived on the scene immediately. 警官立即赶到了现场。

important.note:
Getting enough sleep is very important for health. 获得充足的睡眠对健康非常重要。

He has an important job interview tomorrow morning. 他明天早晨有一场重要的求职面试。

impossible.note:
Nothing is impossible if you work hard enough. 如果你足够努力，没有什么是不可能的。

It is impossible to finish this project in one day. 在一天内完成这个项目是不可能的。

in.meaning: prep. 在……里面；在……期间 adv. 在内
in.note:
The keys are inside the box in my room. 钥匙在我房间里的盒子里。

We love to go skiing in the cold winter. 我们喜欢在寒冷的冬天去滑雪。

inch.meaning: n. 英寸 v. 缓慢移动
inch.note:
One inch is equal to two point five centimeters. 一英寸等于二点五厘米。

The traffic began to inch forward very slowly. 交通车辆开始非常缓慢地向前挪动。

include.note:
The total price includes breakfast and free WiFi. 总价包括早餐和免费无线网络。

Does the tour package include accommodation and flights? 这套旅游套餐包括住宿和航班吗？

increase.note:
The company plans to increase product sales nationwide. 公司计划在全国范围内增加产品销售额。

There was a sharp increase in online orders. 在线订单出现了大幅增长。

indeed.meaning: adv. 确实；真正地 int. 真的（表达惊讶等）
indeed.note:
Thank you very much; it was very kind indeed. 非常感谢你；这确实太善意了。

A friend in need is a friend indeed. 患难见真情（患难之友才是真朋友）。

india.note:
New Delhi is the official capital city of India. 新德里是印度的官方首都城市。

India has a rich and ancient cultural history. 印度有着丰富而古老的文化历史。

indian.meaning: adj. 印度的 n. 印度人
indian.note:
We love eating spicy delicious Indian curry dishes. 我们喜欢吃辛辣美味的印度咖喱菜肴。

An Indian diplomat visited the global international summit. 一位印度外交官访问了全球国际峰会。

information.note:
For more detailed information, check our official website. 如需更多详细信息，请查看我们的官方网站。

The tourist center provides helpful travel information daily. 游客中心每天提供有用的旅游资料。

ink.note:
The fountain pen is completely out of black ink. 这支自来水笔彻底没有黑墨水了。

Print documents using dark permanent printer ink. 使用深色永久打印机油墨打印文档。

insect.note:
An ant is a tiny six-legged common insect. 蚂蚁是一种微小的六条腿常见昆虫。

Many plants rely on insects for natural pollination. 许多植物依靠昆虫进行自然授粉。

inside.meaning: prep./adv. 在……里面 n. 内部 adj. 里面的
inside.note:
It is raining hard outside, so let's stay inside. 外面下着大雨，所以我们留在里面吧。

Keep the fresh food stored inside the cold fridge. 把新鲜食物保存在冰凉的冰箱内部。

instruction.note:
Read the step-by-step instruction manual before assembly. 在组装前请阅读逐步说明书。

Follow teacher's instruction carefully during the chemistry lab. 在化学实验室期间要仔细遵循老师的指导。

interest.meaning: n. 兴趣；利息；利益 v. 使感兴趣
interest.note:
He shows a keen deep interest in space history. 他对太空历史展现出浓厚的兴趣。

Money deposited in the bank earns annual interest. 存入银行的钱赚取年利息。

interesting.meaning: adj. 有趣的；引人入胜的
interesting.note:
She told an interesting story about her travel adventures. 她讲了一个关于她旅行冒险的有趣故事。

This history book contains many interesting facts. 这本历史书包含许多有趣的细致事实。

international.note:
The city airport handles regular international long-haul flights. 该城市机场处理定期国际长途航班。

They signed an important international climate change treaty. 他们签署了一份重要的国际气候变化条约。

internet.note:
You can search for useful information on the internet. 你可以在互联网上搜索有用的信息。

Our house has a high-speed fiber internet connection. 我们家拥有高速光纤互联网连接。

into.meaning: prep. 进入……里面；成，为；深入
into.note:
Walk into the living room and sit on sofa. 走进客厅并坐在沙发上。

She translated the foreign manuscript into plain English. 她把这本外文手稿翻译成了通俗英文。

introduce.note:
Allow me to introduce my new work colleague John. 允许我介绍我的新工作同事约翰。

The firm plans to introduce modern technology tools. 公司计划引进现代技术工具。

invention.note:
The invention of printing press changed global education. 印刷机的发明改变了全球教育。

This smart gadget is a truly useful invention. 这个智能小工具是一个真正有用的发明。

inventor.note:
Thomas Edison was a famous American prolific inventor. 托马斯·爱迪生是一位著名的美国高产发明家。

The young inventor created a portable water filter. 这位年轻的发明家创造了一种便携式水过滤器。

invite.meaning: v. 邀请；招致 n. 邀请
invite.note:
They plan to invite all friends to wedding. 他们计划邀请所有朋友参加婚礼。

Don't leave doors open to invite theft danger. 不要敞开大门以招致盗窃危险。

is.meaning: v. 是（be动词第三人称单数现在时）
is.note:
She is a talented pianist playing classical music. 她是一位演奏古典音乐的天才钢琴家。

The weather today is sunny and extremely pleasant outside. 今天外面的天气晴朗且非常宜人。

island.note:
They sailed around the small tropical blue island. 他们绕着这个热带的蓝色小岛航行。

The island is famous for pristine white sand beaches. 该岛因纯净的白沙滩而闻名。

it.meaning: pron. 它；这（用于指代非人事物或作形式主语）
it.note:
I bought a new book and read it all night. 我买了一本新书并读了整整一夜。

It is raining heavily outside right now. 现在外面正下着大雨。

its.note:
The dog wags its fluffy tail when happy. 狗在高兴时会摇晃它蓬松的尾巴。

The company announced its new expansion plans today. 公司今天宣布了其新的扩张计划。

itself.note:
The smart door locks itself automatically after ten seconds. 这个智能门在十秒后会自动锁上它自己。

The issue will eventually resolve itself over long time. 该问题随着漫长时间推移最终会自我化解。

japan.note:
Tokyo is the bustling capital city of Japan. 东京是日本熙熙攘攘的首都城市。

They plan to visit Japan during cherry blossom season. 他们计划在樱花季期间游览日本。

japanese.meaning: adj. 日本的；日语的 n. 日语；日本人
japanese.note:
We love eating fresh Japanese sushi for lunch. 我们喜欢午餐吃新鲜的日本寿司。

She is learning to speak and write Japanese fluently. 她正在学习流利地讲和写日语。

jeep.note:
They drove a sturdy green jeep across desert dunes. 他们开着一辆坚固的绿色吉普车穿越沙漠丘陵。

The mountain tour requires a four-wheel drive jeep. 这一山区游览需要一辆四轮驱动的吉普车。

job.note:
He applied for a new full-time software developer job. 他申请了一份新的全职软件开发员工作。

You did an excellent job organizing the team event. 你在组织这次团队活动中做得非常出色。

join.note:
Would you like to join us for dinner tonight? 你今晚想加入我们一起吃晚餐吗？

This narrow bridge joins two historic riverside towns. 这座狭窄的桥连接了两个历史悠久的滨河小镇。

joke.meaning: n. 笑话；玩笑 v. 开玩笑
joke.note:
He told a funny joke that made everyone laugh out. 他讲了一个搞笑的笑话，让大家都笑了出来。

Don't take it seriously; I was only joking. 别当真，我只是在开玩笑。

journalist.note:
The brave journalist reported news straight from front lines. 这位勇敢的记者直接从前线报道新闻。

She works as a senior political journalist for newspaper. 她担任一家报纸的高级政治记者。

joy.meaning: n. 喜悦；快乐；令人高兴的人或事
joy.note:
Tears of joy filled her eyes upon hearing news. 听到这个消息时，喜悦的泪水充满了她的双眼。

Gardening brings great joy to her daily retirement life. 从事园艺给她日常的退休生活带来了巨大的快乐。

juice.note:
Pour a glass of fresh orange juice for breakfast. 倒一杯新鲜橙汁当早餐。

She likes drinking iced lemon juice on hot days. 她喜欢在炎热的天气里喝冰柠檬汁。

july.note:
July is usually the hottest summer month in hemisphere. 七月通常是该半球最热的夏季月份。

Our annual company retreat will take place in July. 我们一年一度的公司合宿将于七月举行。

jump.note:
The energetic cat can jump up onto high fence. 这只精力充沛的猫能跳上高墙。

There was a sudden jump in oil market prices. 石油市场价格出现了突然暴涨。

june.note:
School summer vacation officially starts in late June. 学校的暑假在六月下旬正式开始。

They got married on a warm sunny day in June. 他们在六月一个温暖晴朗的日子里结婚了。

jungle.note:
Wild tigers hunt in the dense tropical green jungle. 野生老虎在浓密的热带绿色丛林中猎食。

They trekked through hazardous jungle terrain for three days. 他们穿过危险的丛林地形徒步了三天。

junior.meaning: adj. 资历较浅的；年少的 n. 晚辈；三年级生
junior.note:
He works as a junior developer at technology company. 他在一家科技公司担任初级开发人员。

She is two years junior to her elder brother. 她比她的哥哥小两岁。

just.meaning: adv. 恰好；只是；刚才 adj. 公正的
just.note:
Wait for me; I have just finished my work. 等等我，我刚好完成了我的工作。

That is just what I was looking for today. 那正是我今天一直在寻找的东西。

keep.note:
Keep your bedroom clean and organized every single day. 每天保持你的卧室干净整洁。

Please keep walking until you reach the blue station. 请继续步行，直到你到达蓝色的车站。

key.meaning: n. 钥匙；关键；按键 adj. 关键的
key.note:
She unlocked the front door using a small key. 她用一把小钥匙锁开了前门。

Hard work is the key element to achieving success. 努力工作是取得成功关键要素。

keyboard.note:
Type your full name on the computer wireless keyboard. 在计算机无线键盘上打出你的全名。

He learns to play musical tunes on piano keyboard. 他学习在钢琴键盘上弹奏音乐曲调。

kick.note:
Kick the soccer ball hard towards the net goal. 把足球猛烈踢向球网目标。

He gave the locked heavy wooden door a kick. 他踢了锁着的沉重木门一脚。

kid.meaning: n. 小孩 v. 戏弄；开玩笑
kid.note:
The kids are playing safely in the park playground. 孩子们正在公园游乐场里安全地玩耍。

Don't be mad; I am only trying to kid. 别生气，我只是在开玩笑。

kill.meaning: v. 杀死；毁灭；消磨（时间）
kill.note:
Frost can kill delicate summer plants during cold nights. 霜冻会在寒烈的夜晚杀死娇嫩的夏日植物。

We played cards to kill time while waiting train. 我们在等火车时打牌来消磨时间。

kilo.note:
She bought one kilo of fresh ripe sweet apples. 她买了一公斤新鲜成熟的甜苹果。

The parcel weighs approximately two kilo in total package. 包裹总计重约两公斤。

kilogram.note:
One kilogram equals one thousand metric grams exactly. 一千克精确地等于一千公克。

He lost five kilogram of weight through proper exercise. 他通过适当的运动减轻了五公斤体重。

kilometre.note:
The hotel is just one kilometre from train station. 酒店距离火车站仅有一公里。

They ran a five-kilometre marathon race for charity. 他们为了慈善跑了一场五公里的马拉松赛跑。

kind.meaning: adj. 善良的；友好的 n. 种类
kind.note:
Thank you for being so kind and helpful today. 谢谢你今天如此善良且乐于助人。

What kind of music do you enjoy listening to? 你喜欢听哪种类型的音乐？

king.note:
The king ruled the ancient empire with absolute wisdom. 国王以绝对的智慧统治着这个古老的帝国。

The lion is known as the king of jungle. 狮子被称为丛林之王。

kingdom.note:
The story tells of a magical kingdom far away. 这个故事讲述了一个遥远的神奇王国。

Fungi represent an independent taxonomic kingdom of nature. 真菌代表自然界中一个独立的分类学界。

kiss.note:
She gave her sweet baby a gentle loving kiss. 她给了她可爱的小宝宝一个温柔慈爱的吻。

They kiss each other goodbye before leaving for work. 他们在出门上班前互相亲吻道别。

kitchen.note:
The aroma of baking bread filled the entire kitchen. 烤面包的香味飘满了整个厨房。

She was busy preparing dinner inside the clean kitchen. 她正忙着在干净的厨房里准备晚餐。

kite.note:
Children love to fly a colorful kite in park. 孩子们喜欢在公园里放彩色的风筝。

The red kite soared high up in windy sky. 红风筝在有风的天空中高高翱翔。

knee.note:
He injured his left knee during the soccer match. 他在足球比赛中弄伤了左膝盖。

The toddler sat comfortably on her father's knee. 这个幼童舒适地坐在她父亲的膝盖上。

knife.meaning: n. 切菜刀；餐刀 v. 割；刺
knife.note:
Use a sharp stainless steel knife to slice vegetables. 用一把锋利的不锈钢切菜刀来切蔬菜。

Set the table with a metal knife and fork. 用金属餐刀和餐叉摆好餐桌。

knock.note:
Please knock on the front door before entering room. 在进入房间之前请敲前门。

I heard a loud knock on my office window. 我听到我的办公室窗户上传来一阵响烈的敲击声。

know.note:
Do you know the answer to this difficult math question? 你知道这个难数学题的答案吗？

I have known her since we were primary kids. 自从我们还是小学生起，我就认识她了。

korean.meaning: adj. 韩国的；朝鲜的 n. 韩国人；韩语
korean.note:
We enjoy eating authentic spicy Korean food for dinner. 我们喜欢吃地道辛辣的韩国美食当晚餐。

She is currently studying to speak Korean language fluently. 她目前正在学习流利地讲韩语。

ladder.note:
He climbed up tall aluminum ladder to fix roof. 他爬上高大的铝制梯子去修屋顶。

Education is a proven ladder for social career advancement. 教育是社会职业提升被证实的阶梯。

lady.note:
A polite elderly lady offered her seat on bus. 一位有礼貌的年长女士在公交车上让出了她的座位。

Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to our annual music concert. 女士们，先生们，欢迎来到我们一年一度的音乐会。

lake.note:
They rented a small wooden boat on calm lake. 他们在平静的湖面上租了一只小木船。

The beautiful clear lake is surrounded by snow mountains. 美丽清澈的湖泊被雪山环绕着。

lamp.note:
Turn on the reading desk lamp to study late. 打开阅读台灯供深夜学习。

A cozy vintage floor lamp illuminated the living room. 一盏舒适的复古落地灯照亮了客厅。

land.meaning: n. 陆地；土地 v. 降落；着陆
land.note:
After weeks at ocean sea, sailors finally saw land. 在公海上度过数周后，水手们终于看到了陆地。

The airplane landed safely at International Airport on time. 飞机准时安全降落于国际机场。

language.note:
English is a widely spoken global international language. 英语是一门被广泛使用的全球国际语言。

Body language often conveys internal emotions without words. 肢体语言往往能在无需言语的情况下传达内心情感。

lap.meaning: n. 大腿部；一圈 v. 舔食；重叠
lap.note:
The cute child sat on her mother's lap. 这个可爱的孩子坐在她母亲的大腿部上。

The runner completed the final lap of the track. 跑步选手完成了田径跑道的最后一圈。

large.note:
They live in a large house with big garden. 他们住在一间带大花园的大房子里。

A large group of people gathered outside building entrance. 一大群人聚集在大楼入口外。

last.meaning: adj./adv. 最后的；最近的 v. 持续 n. 最后
last.note:
We caught the very last bus home tonight. 我们赶上了今晚回家最后一班公交车。

The stormy weather will last for three whole days. 暴风雨天气将持续整整三天。

late.note:
Hurry up or you will be late for school! 快点，否则你上学会迟到的！

They worked late into the night to finish project. 他们工作到深夜以完成项目。

lately.note:
Have you seen any good movies lately in cinema? 你最近在电影院看过什么好电影吗？

She has been feeling very tired lately at work. 她最近在工作中一直感到非常疲惫。

later.meaning: adv. 后来；稍后 adj. 随后的
later.note:
I will call you back later this afternoon. 我今天下午晚些时候会给你回电话。

See you later! Have a wonderful pleasant weekend break! 稍后见！祝你度过一个美好愉快的周末假期！

laugh.meaning: v. 笑；发笑 n. 笑声
laugh.note:
His funny jokes made everyone laugh out loud. 他的搞笑笑话让大家都大声笑了出来。

They had a good warm laugh over old memories. 他们对着旧日回忆愉快地大笑了一场。

law.note:
Citizens must respect and obey the national law. 公民必须尊重并遵守国家法律。

She is studying international environmental law at university. 她正在大学学习国际环境法。

lay.meaning: v. 放置；铺设；产卵（另为lie的过去式）
lay.note:
Please lay the clean tablecloth on dining table. 请把干净的桌布铺在餐桌上。

The brown hen will lay a fresh egg daily. 这只棕色母鸡每天都会产下枚新鲜蛋。

lazy.note:
Don't be lazy; get up and do exercise! 别懒惰；起来做运动！

We spent a lazy afternoon relaxing on beach. 我们在海滩上度过了一个懒散的下午。

lead.meaning: v. 领导；引导；通向 n. 领导；铅(/led/)
lead.note:
She will lead the team project to success. 她将领导团队项目走向成功。

This narrow path will lead you to lake. 这条狭窄的路径将指引你通向湖泊。

leader.note:
A good leader listens to team members carefully. 一名优秀的领导者会仔细倾听团队成员的意见。

She was elected as class leader by students. 她被学生们选举为班级首领。

leaf.meaning: n. 树叶；页 v. 翻页
leaf.note:
A golden maple leaf fell slowly from tree. 一片金黄色的枫树叶从树上缓缓落下。

Leaf through the catalog to find product code. 翻阅目录找到产品代码。

least.meaning: det./pron./adv. 最少的；最小的（little的最高级）
least.note:
That was the least expensive option on menu. 那是菜单上最便宜的选项。

At least we tried our best to solve problem. 至少我们尽了最大的努力去解决问题。

leather.meaning: n. 皮革 adj. 皮革制的
leather.note:
He wore a stylish black leather jacket today. 他今天穿了一件时尚的黑色皮衣夹克。

These handmade shoes are crafted from pure leather. 这些手工鞋是由纯皮革精制而成的。

leave.meaning: v. 离开；留下；遗忘 n. 准假
leave.note:
We must leave for airport in ten minutes. 我们必须在十分钟后出发前往机场。

Don't leave your personal belongings unattended here. 不要把你的个人物品遗留在无人看管的地方。

left.meaning: adj. 左边的 adv. 向左 n. 左边（另为leave的过去式）
left.note:
Turn left at the next traffic light intersection. 在下一个交通信号灯十字路口向左转。

He writes with his left hand with ease. 他能轻松地用左手书写。

leg.note:
He broke his right leg in skiing accident. 他在一次滑雪事故中摔断了右腿。

One leg of the wooden table is loose. 木桌的一条腿松动了。

lend.note:
Could you lend me your dictionary for hour? 你能把你的字典借给我一个小时吗？

Banks lend money to buyers for purchasing house. 银行借钱给购房者用于购买房屋。

less.meaning: det./pron./adv. 较少的；较小程度的（little的比较级）
less.note:
Eat less sugar to maintain better physical health. 少吃糖以维持更好的身体健康。

It is less cold outside today than yesterday. 今天外面不像昨天那么冷。

lesson.note:
The English lesson begins at nine sharp morning. 英语课在早晨九点整开始。

Failure can serve as a valuable life lesson. 失败可以作为一个宝贵的人生教训。

let.note:
Let me help you carry heavy grocery bags. 让我帮你搬沉重的杂货袋。

They have a room to let in house. 他们在房子里有一间房间出租。

letter.note:
She received a heartfelt handwritten letter from friend. 她收到了一封来自朋友真挚的手写信件。

'A' is the very first letter of English alphabet. 'A'是英语字母表的第一个字母。

license.meaning: n. 执照；许可证 v. 批准；许可
license.note:
You must present your valid driver's license here. 你必须在这里出示你有效的驾驶执照。

The authority licensed the firm to operate business. 官方批准该公司开展业务。

lie.meaning: v. 躺；说谎 n. 谎言
lie.note:
Don't lie on the grass when it is wet. 草地湿的时候不要躺在上面。

It is wrong to lie to your parents. 对父母说谎是不对的。

life.note:
She moved to the city to start a new life. 她搬到了这个城市开始新的生活。

Doctors saved the patient's life. 医生们挽救了这位患者的生命。

lifetime.note:
This travel experience is a once in a lifetime opportunity. 这次旅行经历是一生一次难得的机会。

He dedicated his lifetime to scientific research. 他将一生都奉献给了科学研究。

lift.meaning: v. 举起；抬起 n. 电梯；搭便车
lift.note:
The box is too heavy for me to lift. 这个箱子太重了，我举不起来。

We took the lift to the tenth floor. 我们乘电梯到了十楼。

light.meaning: n. 光；灯 a. 轻的；明亮的 v. 点燃
light.note:
Please turn off the light before leaving the room. 离开房间前请关灯。

This bag is very light and easy to carry. 这个包很轻，容易携带。

The morning sun makes the room light and warm. 早晨的阳光使房间明亮而温暖。

like.meaning: v. 喜欢 prep. 像……一样
like.note:
I like reading books in my spare time. 我喜欢在空闲时间读书。

He looks like his father. 他看起来像他父亲。

line.meaning: n. 线；排；队伍 v. 排队
line.note:
Draw a straight line on the paper. 在纸上画一条直线。

Please stand in line to buy the tickets. 请排队买票。

lip.note:
She put on some red lipstick on her lips. 她在嘴唇上涂了一些红口红。

He bit his lower lip when he was nervous. 他紧张时咬着下唇。

list.meaning: n. 清单；列表 v. 列出
list.note:
Make a list of things you need to buy. 列一份你需要买的东西的清单。

Please list all your achievements in the resume. 请在简历中列出你的所有成就。

listen.note:
Listen carefully to what the teacher is saying. 仔细听老师在说什么。

You should listen to advice from experts. 你应该听从专家的建议。

litter.meaning: n. 垃圾；废弃物 v. 乱扔垃圾
litter.note:
Please put your litter in the bin. 请把你的垃圾丢进垃圾桶。

Do not litter on the public beach. 不要在公共海滩上乱扔垃圾。

little.meaning: a. 小的；少许的 adv. 几乎没有
little.note:
A little boy was playing with a toy car. 一个小男孩正在玩玩具汽车。

I have little time to finish this project. 我几乎没有时间来完成这个项目。

live.meaning: v. 居住；生活 a. 活的；现场直播的
live.note:
They live in a quiet neighborhood. 他们住在一段安静的社区。

We watched the live broadcast of the football match. 我们看了这场足球比赛的现场直播。

lively.meaning: a. 活泼的；充满生气的
lively.note:
She is a very lively girl who loves sports. 她是一个非常活泼且热爱运动的女孩。

The city center has a lively atmosphere at night. 市中心夜间充满了生机勃勃的气氛。

living.meaning: n. 生活；谋生手段 a. 活着的
living.note:
He earns his living by working as a designer. 他靠做设计师谋生。

All living things need water and air. 所有的生物都需要水和空气。

lock.note:
Remember to lock the door when you go out. 出门时记得锁门。

She put the key into the lock and turned it. 她把钥匙插进锁里转动了一下。

london.note:
London is one of the most famous cities in the world. 伦敦是世界上最著名的城市之一。

They spent three days sightseeing in London. 他们在伦敦游览了三天。

lonely.note:
He felt very lonely when he first moved here. 他刚搬到这里时感到很孤独。

They lived in a lonely house in the mountains. 他们住在山里一座偏僻的房子里。

long.meaning: a. 长的；长期的 adv. 长期地 v. 渴望
long.note:
It is a long distance from here to the station. 从这里到车站有一段很长的距离。

She longed to return to her hometown. 她渴望回到她的家乡。

look.meaning: v. 看；看起来 n. 外表；看
look.note:
Look at the colorful flowers in the garden. 看看花园里五彩缤纷的花朵。

You look very tired after the long journey. 长途旅行后你看起来很累。

lot.note:
There are a lot of books on the table. 桌子上有许多书。

They bought a small lot to build their home. 他们买了一块小场地来盖房子。

loud.note:
There was a loud noise outside the window. 窗外传来一声响亮的噪音。

His voice was loud enough for everyone to hear. 他的声音足够大，所有人都能听到。

loudly.note:
Don't speak loudly in the reading room. 在阅览室里不要大声说话。

The audience clapped loudly after the performance. 演出结束后观众大声鼓掌。

loudspeaker.note:
An announcement was made over the loudspeaker. 扩音器里播放了一则广播通知。

The music played from the loudspeaker filled the hall. 从扬声器播放出来的音乐响彻大厅。

love.meaning: v. 爱；喜欢 n. 爱；热爱
love.note:
Parents love their children unconditionally. 父母无条件地爱他们的孩子。

She expressed her deep love for music. 她表达了对音乐的深切热爱。

lovely.meaning: a. 可爱的；令人愉快的
lovely.note:
What a lovely day to go for a picnic! 今天真是去野餐的好天气！

They have a lovely little dog. 他们有一只可爱的小狗。

low.meaning: a. 低的；低价的 adv. 低地
low.note:
The wall is too low to keep out animals. 这面墙太低了，挡不住动物。

The sun was low in the sky. 太阳在天空中的位置很低。

luck.note:
I wish you good luck with your exam! 祝你考试好运！

It was pure luck that we found the lost key. 我们能找到丢失的钥匙纯属运气。

lucky.meaning: a. 幸运的；带来好运的
lucky.note:
You are lucky to have such supportive friends. 你有这样支持你的朋友真的很幸运。

Seven is considered a lucky number by many. 很多人认为七是一个幸运数字。

lunch.meaning: n. 午餐 v. 吃午饭
lunch.note:
What do you usually eat for lunch? 你午餐通常吃什么？

They had lunch together at a local café. 他们在当地的一家咖啡馆一起吃了午饭。

madam.note:
May I help you, madam? 我能为您服务吗，女士？

Dear Madam, I am writing to inquire about the position. 尊敬的女士，我写信是为了咨询该职位的情况。

magazine.note:
He reads a sports magazine every week. 他每周读一本体育杂志。

Her article was published in a fashion magazine. 她的文章发表在了一本时尚杂志上。

magic.meaning: n. 魔法；魔术 a. 有魔力的
magic.note:
The magician performed amazing magic on stage. 魔术师在舞台上表演了惊人的魔术。

Do you believe in magic? 你相信魔法吗？

mail.meaning: n. 邮政；邮件 v. 邮寄
mail.note:
I get a lot of mail every morning. 我每天早晨都会收到很多邮件。

Please mail this parcel to my home address. 请把这个包裹邮寄到我的家庭地址。

main.note:
What is the main reason for your decision? 你做决定的主要原因是什么？

Traffic was heavy on the main road. 主干道上的交通很拥堵。

make.meaning: v. 制造；做；使得 n. 品牌
make.note:
She taught me how to make a paper plane. 她教我怎么做纸飞机。

The comedy film made everyone laugh. 这部喜剧电影让每个人都笑了。

man.meaning: n. 男人；人类 v. 操纵；配备人员
man.note:
A tall man was standing at the entrance. 一个高大的男人站在入口处。

Firefighters were needed to man the stations. 需要消防员在各个站点值守。

manage.meaning: v. 管理；经营；设法做到
manage.note:
She knows how to manage her time effectively. 她知道如何有效地管理自己的时间。

How did you manage to complete it so fast? 你是怎么做到这么快完成它的？

manager.note:
He spoke to the hotel manager about the issue. 他向酒店经理反映了这个问题。

She is a capable project manager. 她是一位有能力的项目经理。

many.meaning: det./pron. 许多的；许多人或物
many.note:
How many languages can you speak? 你能说多少种语言？

Many of the students passed the final test. 许多学生通过了期末考试。

map.meaning: n. 地图 v. 绘制地图
map.note:
Let's check the map to find our way. 我们查查地图来找路吧。

Scientists are working to map the ocean floor. 科学家们正在努力绘制海底地图。

march.meaning: v. 行进；游行 n. 游行；三月(March)
march.note:
Soldiers march together in perfect rhythm. 士兵们以整齐的节奏一起行进。

Thousands joined the peaceful protest march. 数千人参加了和平抗议游行。

mark.meaning: n. 痕迹；分数 v. 做标记；给……打分
mark.note:
