He left a muddy mark on the clean carpet. 他在干净的地毯上留下了泥印。

The teacher spent the evening marking papers. 老师整个晚上都在批改试卷。

marry.note:
They plan to marry early next year. 他们计划明年年初结婚。

He wanted to marry the girl he loved. 他想嫁/娶他心爱的那个女孩。

mathematics.note:
Mathematics is an essential subject in school. 数学是学校里一门重要的学科。

She excels at solving complex mathematics problems. 她擅长解决复杂的数学难题。

matter.meaning: n. 事情；物质 v. 有关系；要紧
matter.note:
What is the matter with your computer? 你的电脑怎么了？

It doesn't matter if you make a mistake. 犯错也没关系。

may.meaning: modal v. 可以；也许 n. 五月(May)
may.note:
May I use your mobile phone for a second? 我可以用一下你的手机吗？

It may rain later this afternoon. 今天下午晚些时候可能会下雨。

maybe.note:
Maybe we can try a different method tomorrow. 也许我们明天可以尝试一种不同的方法。

Will she come? Maybe, I'm not entirely sure. 她会来吗？也许吧，我不太确定。

me.note:
Can you hear me clearly? 你能清楚地听到我说话吗？

Give me a piece of paper, please. 请给我一张纸。

meal.note:
Breakfast is the most important meal of the day. 早餐是一天中最重要的一餐。

We enjoyed a delicious hot meal at the inn. 我们在客栈享用了一顿美味的热饭。

mean.meaning: v. 意思是；意图 a. 吝啬的；刻薄的
mean.note:
What does this foreign word mean? 这个外国单词是什么意思？

Don't be mean to your younger brother. 不要对你弟弟那么刻薄。

meaning.note:
Look up the meaning of the phrase in a dictionary. 在字典里查查这个短语的意思。

Helping others gives meaning to his life. 帮助他人赋予了他的生活意义。

means.note:
Subway is an efficient means of transportation. 地铁是一种高效的交通方式。

He has the financial means to support his business. 他有经济实力来支持他的业务。

meat.note:
Some people choose not to eat meat. 有些人选择不吃肉。

Make sure the meat is thoroughly cooked. 确保肉彻底煮熟。

meet.meaning: v. 遇见；满足 n. 集会
meet.note:
Nice to meet you for the first time. 很高兴第一次见到你。

We need to meet the customer's needs. 我们需要满足客户的需求。

meeting.note:
The manager called an emergency meeting. 经理召集了一次紧急会议。

I have an important business meeting tomorrow. 我明天有一个重要的商务会议。

melon.note:
Fresh melon is very refreshing in summer. 新鲜的甜瓜在夏天非常解渴。

She sliced a sweet melon for dessert. 她切了一个甜瓜做甜点。

member.note:
He became a member of the chess club. 他成为了棋艺俱乐部的一员。

Each team member worked hard to win. 每一位团队成员都努力工作以争取胜利。

memory.note:
She has a very good memory for names. 她对名字有很好的记忆力。

The trip to Paris left me with wonderful memories. 巴黎之行给我留下了美好的回忆。

mend.note:
He knows how to mend torn clothes. 他知道怎么缝补破损的衣服。

Can you mend the broken wooden chair? 你能修好那把破损的木椅吗？

mention.note:
Did he mention when he would return? 他有没有提及他什么时候回来？

Don't mention this matter to anyone else. 不要向其他任何人提及这件事。

menu.note:
Could we have the menu, please? 请给我们拿一下菜单好吗？

Select an option from the main menu on screen. 从屏幕上的主菜单中选择一个选项。

message.meaning: n. 消息；信息 v. 发信息
message.note:
I left a voice message on your phone. 我在你的手机上留了一条语音留言。

She messaged me that she arrived safely. 她给我发信息说她已经安全到达。

metre.note:
The tower is over one hundred metres tall. 这座塔有一百多米高。

Fabric is sold by the metre in this store. 这家商店按米出售布料。

mid.note:
They expect to finish the work by mid-July. 他们预计在七月中旬完成工作。

He had a career change in his mid-thirties. 他在三十多岁中期进行了职业转型。

middle.note:
There is a table in the middle of the room. 房间中央放着一张桌子。

She sits in the middle row during class. 上课时她坐在中间那一排。

midnight.note:
The concert didn't finish until midnight. 音乐会直到午夜才结束。

He usually works late into the midnight hours. 他经常工作到半夜。

might.meaning: modal v. 可能；也许 n. 力量
might.note:
Take an umbrella, as it might rain. 带把伞吧，因为可能会下雨。

He pulled the rope with all his might. 他用尽全力拉那根绳子。

mild.note:
We enjoyed the mild weather during spring. 我们喜欢春天温暖宜人的天气。

He showed mild symptoms of a winter cold. 他表现出轻微的感冒症状。

mile.note:
Our house is about two miles from the beach. 我们的房子离海滩大约两英里。

He runs three miles every morning. 他每天早晨跑三英里。

mind.meaning: n. 头脑；介意 v. 介意；照看
mind.note:
Keep your mind focused on the goal. 保持注意力集中在目标上。

Do you mind if I open the window? 你介意我打开窗户吗？

mine.meaning: pron. 我的 n. 矿山 v. 采矿
mine.note:
This jacket isn't yours; it's mine. 这件夹克不是你的，是我的。

They work deep underground in a coal mine. 他们在地下深处的煤矿里工作。

minibus.note:
The hotel provides a free minibus to the airport. 酒店提供前往机场的免费小型巴士。

Our group rented a minibus for the trip. 我们小组租了一辆面包车去旅行。

minus.meaning: prep. 减去 a. 负的 n. 减号
minus.note:
Five minus two equals three. 5减2等于3。

The temperature fell to minus five degrees. 温度降到了零下五度。

mirror.meaning: n. 镜子 v. 反射；反映
mirror.note:
She looked at herself in the bathroom mirror. 她看着卫生间镜子里的自己。

The water was smooth, mirroring the clear sky. 水面平静，倒映着晴朗的天空。

miss.meaning: v. 错过；想念 n. 小姐(Miss)
miss.note:
Hurry up, or you will miss the early bus. 快点，否则你会错过早班车的。

I miss my family very much when away. 在外地时我非常想念我的家人。

mist.meaning: n. 薄雾 v. 蒙上薄雾
mist.note:
The mountain tops were hidden in thick mist. 山顶隐藏在浓浓的薄雾中。

The car windows began to mist up inside. 车窗内部开始蒙上一层水汽。

mistake.meaning: n. 错误 v. 误会
mistake.note:
Everyone makes a mistake now and then. 每个人偶尔都会犯错。

Don't mistake his kindness for weakness. 不要把他的善良误认为是软弱。

mobile.meaning: a. 可移动的 n. 手机
mobile.note:
He answered the urgent call on his mobile. 他用手机接听了那个紧急电话。

Medical teams were highly mobile in the area. 医疗队在该地区具有高度的流动性。

model.meaning: n. 模型；模特；型号 v. 做模特
model.note:
He built a model airplane out of wood. 他用木头做了一个飞机模型。

She works as a fashion model in Milan. 她在米兰担任时装模特。

modern.note:
The city is famous for its modern architecture. 这座城市以其现代建筑而闻名。

Computers play a big role in modern life. 计算机在现代生活中发挥着巨大作用。

mom.note:
My mom bakes delicious cookies on weekends. 我妈妈周末会烤美味的曲奇饼干。

Call your mom to let her know you're safe. 给你妈妈打个电话，让她知道你很安全。

moment.note:
Wait a moment, I'll be right back. 等一下，我马上回来。

It was one of the happiest moments of my life. 那是我一生中最幸福的时刻之一。

mommy.note:
The little child ran into her mommy's arms. 那小孩子跑进了她妈咪的怀里。

Mommy, can I have a sweet before dinner? 妈咪，我晚饭前能吃块糖吗？

money.note:
He saved enough money to buy a new bicycle. 他存了足够的钱来买一辆新自行车。

Time is money, so use it wisely. 时间就是金钱，所以要明智地利用它。

monitor.meaning: n. 显示器；班长 v. 监控
monitor.note:
He purchased a high-resolution computer monitor. 他买了一台高分辨率的电脑显示器。

Nurses closely monitor the patient's condition. 护士们密切监控着病人的状况。

month.note:
February is the shortest month of the year. 二月是一年中最短的月份。

We are going on holiday next month. 我们下个月要去休假。

monument.note:
A impressive monument was built in the square. 广场上建造了一座令人印象深刻的纪念碑。

The ancient temple is a historical monument. 这座古老的寺庙是一处历史遗迹。

moon.note:
The full moon shone brightly in the night sky. 满月在夜空中皎洁发光。

Astronauts walked on the surface of the moon. 宇航员曾漫步在月球表面。

mooncake.note:
We eat delicious mooncakes during Mid-Autumn Festival. 我们在中秋节吃美味的月饼。

She baked traditional lotus seed paste mooncakes. 她烤制了传统的莲蓉月饼。

more.meaning: a./adv. 更多的；更 n. 更多
more.note:
Would you like some more hot tea? 你想再要一点热茶吗？

This puzzle is more difficult than the last one. 这个谜题比上一个更难。

most.meaning: a./adv. 最多的；最 n. 大多数
most.note:
She scored the most points in the match. 她在比赛中得分最多。

Most people prefer working from home today. 如今大多数人更喜欢居家办公。

motorbike.note:
He rides his motorbike to work every morning. 他每天早晨骑摩托车去上班。

Always wear a helmet when riding a motorbike. 骑摩托车时一定要戴头盔。

motorcycle.note:
A modern motorcycle consumes less fuel. 一辆现代摩托车消耗的燃料更少。

He parked his black motorcycle by the curb. 他把黑色摩托车停在路边。

mountain.note:
They decided to climb the high mountain tomorrow. 他们决定明天去爬那座高山。

The snow capped mountain looked breathtaking. 积雪覆盖的山峰显得非常壮观。

mouth.note:
Open your mouth wide and say 'ah'. 张大你的嘴说“啊”。

The river enters the sea at its mouth. 这条河流在河口处入海。

move.meaning: v. 移动；搬家；感动 n. 移动
move.note:
Don't move while I take your photograph. 在我为你拍照时请不要动。

Our family is going to move to Shanghai next month. 我们一家人计划下个月搬去上海。

movement.note:
Regular exercise improves your physical movement. 定期的锻炼可以改善你的身体运动性能。

She observed the gentle movement of the leaves. 她观察着树叶轻微的摆动。

movie.note:
Let's go to the cinema to watch a movie. 我们去电影院看场电影吧。

Action movies are very popular among teenagers. 动作电影在青少年中很受欢迎。

mr.note:
Mr. Smith is our English language teacher. 史密斯先生是我们的英语老师。

Good morning, Mr. Brown! 早上好，布朗先生！

mrs.note:
Mrs. Green bakes great apple pies. 格林太太烘焙的苹果派非常好吃。

We sent a invitation to Mr. and Mrs. Davis. 我们给戴维斯夫妇发了一份邀请函。

ms.note:
Ms. Taylor manages the marketing department. 泰勒女士管理着市场部门。

Please deliver this package to Ms. Lee. 请把这个包裹送给李女士。

much.meaning: det./adv. 许多；非常 n. 许多
much.note:
Thank you very much for your kind help. 非常感谢您的热情帮助。

There is not much water left in the bottle. 瓶子里没有剩多少水了。

multiply.note:
If you multiply four by five, you get twenty. 如果你用4乘以5，就会得到20。

Rabbits multiply quickly in wild environments. 兔子在野外环境中繁殖快速/成倍增加。

murder.note:
The detective is investigating a mysterious murder. 侦探正在调查一起神秘的谋杀案。

It is a grave crime to murder someone. 谋杀他人是严重的犯罪行为。

music.note:
She enjoys listening to classical music at night. 她喜欢在晚上听古典音乐。

Music can express emotions that words cannot. 音乐能够表达语言所无法表达的情感。

must.meaning: modal v. 必须；一定 n. 必须做的事
must.note:
You must finish your homework before playing games. 你玩游戏之前必须完成作业。

He must be exhausted after working all day. 他工作了一整天，一定非常疲惫。

mutton.note:
We ordered a stew made with tender mutton. 我们点了一份用嫩羊肉炖的菜。

Mutton is a popular meat choice in winter. 羊肉是冬天很受欢迎的肉类选择。

my.note:
This is my favorite book of all time. 这是我一直以来最喜欢的一本书。

Where did I leave my keys? 我把我的钥匙放在哪里了？

myself.note:
I can complete the painting task by myself. 我可以自己独立完成绘画任务。

I bought myself a gift for my birthday. 我在生日时给自己买了一份礼物。

name.meaning: n. 名字；名称 v. 命名
name.note:
What is your full name, please? 请问你的全名是什么？

They decided to name their puppy Lucky. 他们决定给他们的小狗取名为 Lucky。

narrow.meaning: a. 狭窄的；变窄 v. 变窄
narrow.note:
The car drove down a narrow country lane. 汽车驶过一条狭窄的乡村小巷。

The river narrows significantly at this point. 河流在这一点上明显变窄了。

nation.note:
The president addressed the entire nation on TV. 总统在电视上发表了面向全国的讲话。

Our nation is rich in cultural heritage. 我们的国家拥有丰富的文化遗产。

national.note:
Today is a national holiday in our country. 今天是我们国家的法定节假日。

The team won the national football championship. 这支队伍赢得了全国足球锦标赛冠军。

natural.note:
Fruit juice contains natural sugars. 果汁含有天然糖分。

She is a natural leader in group discussions. 在小组讨论中，她是个天生的领导者。

near.meaning: prep./a. 靠近；近的 adv. 在附近
near.note:
Is there a post office near here? 这附近有邮局吗？

The deadline for the assignment is drawing near. 任务的截止日期临近了。

nearby.meaning: a. 附近的 adv. 在附近
nearby.note:
We ate lunch at a nearby Italian restaurant. 我们在附近的一家意大利餐厅吃了午饭。

My grandparents live nearby, so I visit often. 我祖父母住在附近，所以我经常去看他们。

nearly.note:
It is nearly time for our meeting to start. 我们的会议差不多到时间开始了。

I have nearly completed the entire project. 我几乎完成了整个项目。

neat.note:
Her handwriting is always very neat and clear. 她的字迹总是非常整洁清晰。

Please keep your study desk neat and tidy. 请保持你的书桌整洁有序。

neck.note:
He wore a warm wool scarf around his neck. 他脖子上围着一条温暖的毛围巾。

The shirt had a loose, comfortable neck. 这件衬衫有个宽松舒适的领口。

necklace.note:
She wore a gold necklace for the party. 她戴了一条金项链去参加派对。

The pearl necklace was passed down through generations. 这条珍珠项链一代代传了下来。

necktie.note:
He wore a formal suit and a silk necktie. 他穿了一套正式西装，系着一条丝绸领带。

Do I need to wear a necktie to the event? 我参加这个活动需要系领带吗？

need.meaning: v./n. 需要；必要 modal v. 需要
need.note:
I need to buy some fresh vegetables today. 我今天需要买一些新鲜蔬菜。

There is no need to worry about the exam. 没有必要为考试担心。

needle.meaning: n. 针；缝衣针 v. 缝纫
needle.note:
She threaded the needle to sew the button on. 她给针穿线，准备把纽扣缝上。

The nurse inserted the sharp needle gently. 护士轻柔地插入了尖锐的针头。

neighbour.note:
Our next-door neighbour helped water our plants. 我们的隔壁邻居帮忙浇了花。

Be a good neighbour and keep the noise down. 做个好邻居，把声音关小一点。

neighbourhood.note:
We live in a friendly and safe neighbourhood. 我们住在一段友好安全的社区里。

There are several nice parks in this neighbourhood. 这个社区里有几个不错的公园。

neither.meaning: det./pron. 两者都不 adv. 也不
neither.note:
Neither of the two books is interesting. 这两本书都不有趣。

If you don't go, neither will I. 如果你不去，我也不去。

nervous.note:
I always feel nervous before giving a speech. 我在做演讲前总是感到紧张。

She gave a nervous laugh during the interview. 面试时她紧张地笑了一下。

nest.meaning: n. 鸟巢；巢穴 v. 筑巢
nest.note:
The bird built a small nest in the tree. 那只鸟在树上筑了一个小巢。

We found a nest of mice in the garage. 我们在车库里发现了一窝老鼠。

network.meaning: n. 网络；网状物 v. 建立联系
network.note:
The computer network is down for maintenance. 计算机网络正在关机维护。

Conferences are great places to network with peers. 会议是与同行建立联系的好地方。

never.note:
I have never been to Paris before. 我以前从来没有去过巴黎。

Never give up on your dreams, no matter what. 无论如何，决不要放弃你的梦想。

new.note:
He bought a new car last weekend. 他上周末买了一辆新车。

Welcome to our school, new students! 欢迎来到我们学校，新同学们！

news.note:
Have you heard the good news about her? 你听到关于她的那个好消息了吗？

I watch the evening news every day at six. 我每天六点看晚间新闻。

newspaper.note:
My father reads the local newspaper every morning. 我父亲每天早晨读当地的报纸。

He wrapped the fragile glass in old newspaper. 他用旧报纸包裹着易碎的玻璃。

next.meaning: a. 下一个的 adv. 接下来 n. 下一个
next.note:
What is the next topic on our agenda? 我们议程上的下一个议题是什么？

We will visit the museum next week. 我们下周去参观博物馆。

nice.meaning: a. 良好的；令人愉快的；友好的
nice.note:
Have a nice weekend with your family! 和家人过个愉快的周末吧！

She is very nice and always willing to help. 她人非常好，总是愿意帮忙。

niece.note:
My niece gave me a lovely drawing for Christmas. 我侄女送了我一张可爱的圣诞画作。

She loves spending time playing with her niece. 她喜欢花时间和外甥女一起玩。

night.note:
Good night, sleep tight and sweet dreams. 晚安，睡个好觉，做个好梦。

The city looks completely different at night. 这座城市在晚上看起来完全不一样。

nine.note:
There are nine players on a baseball team. 棒球队有九名队员。

The meeting is scheduled to start at nine o'clock. 会议定于九点开始。

nineteen.note:
She was only nineteen when she started her company. 她创办公司时只有十九岁。

There are nineteen students in our class. 我们班有十九名学生。

ninety.note:
My grandfather lived to be ninety years old. 我祖父活到了九十岁。

The speed limit on this highway is ninety kilometers. 这条公路上的限速是九十公里。

ninth.note:
Today is the ninth day of September. 今天是九月的第九天。

Her office is located on the ninth floor. 她的办公室位于九楼。

no.meaning: adv. 不 det. 没有 n. 否定的回答
no.note:
No, I haven't seen your glasses. 不，我没看到你的眼镜。

There is no water left in the jug. 壶里没有水了。

nobody.meaning: pron. 没有人 n. 小人物
nobody.note:
Nobody answered when I knocked on the door. 我敲门时没有人应答。

Don't treat him like he's a nobody. 不要把他当成无名小卒来对待。

nod.meaning: v./n. 点头（表示同意或招呼）
nod.note:
She gave a gentle nod to agree with me. 她微微点头表示同意我的看法。

He smiled and offered a friendly nod. 他笑着打了个友好的点头招呼。

noise.note:
The loud noise woke me up in midnight. 巨大的噪音在半夜把我吵醒了。

Try not to make any noise during test. 考试期间尽量不要发出任何声音。

noisily.note:
The children played noisily in the playground. 孩子们在游乐场里吵闹地玩耍。

The engine began to hum noisily. 发动机开始嘈杂地发出轰鸣声。

noisy.note:
It is hard to study in a noisy environment. 在喧闹的环境中很难学习。

The noisy crowd cheered for their favorite team. 喧闹的人群为他们喜爱的队伍欢呼。

none.meaning: pron. 没有一个；全无 adv. 一点也不
none.note:
None of the information was helpful for us. 这些信息中没有一条对我们有用。

We looked for apples, but there were none left. 我们找苹果，但一个都没剩。

noodle.note:
He ordered a bowl of beef noodle soup. 他点了一碗牛肉面。

Instant noodles are convenient when you are busy. 忙碌时方便面非常方便。

noon.note:
The hot sun reached its peak at noon. 酷热的太阳在正午达到了最高点。

We agreed to meet outside the mall at noon. 我们约定正午在商场外见面。

nor.note:
He neither smokes nor drinks alcohol. 他既不抽烟也不喝酒。

I can't swim, nor do I intend to learn. 我不会游泳，也没打算去学。

normal.meaning: a. 正常的；标准的 n. 常态
normal.note:
It is completely normal to feel nervous before a test. 考试前感觉紧张完全是正常的。

Life slowly returned to normal after the crisis. 危机过后生活慢慢恢复了常态。

north.meaning: n. 北方 a. 北方的 adv. 向北
north.note:
The birds fly north when spring comes. 春天到来时鸟儿飞往北方。

Beijing is located in the north of China. 北京位于中国北方。

northeast.meaning: n. 东北 a. 东北的 adv. 向东北
northeast.note:
A cold wind came from the northeast. 冷风从东北方向吹来。

The town lies in the northeast part of the province. 这个小镇位于该省的东北部。

northern.meaning: a. 北方的；来自北方的
northern.note:
They live in the northern hemisphere of the earth. 他们住在地球的北半球。

Northern winters are usually very cold and snowy. 北方的冬天通常非常寒冷且多雪。

northwest.meaning: n. 西北 a. 西北的 adv. 向西北
northwest.note:
The storm is moving towards the northwest. 暴风雨正向西北方向移动。

They traveled to the northwest region of the country. 他们前往该国西北地区旅行。

nose.meaning: n. 鼻子；突出部分 v. 嗅
nose.note:
She wiped her running nose with a tissue. 她用纸巾擦了擦流淌的鼻涕。

The dog stuck its nose out of the window. 狗把鼻子伸出了窗外。

not.note:
I am not feeling very well today. 我今天感觉不太舒服。

It was not as difficult as I expected. 这没有我预期的那么难。

note.meaning: n. 笔记；便条；钞票 v. 注意；记录
note.note:
Leave a brief note on the kitchen counter. 在厨房台上留个简短的便条。

Please note that the office will close early. 请注意，办公室将提前关门。

notebook.meaning: n. 笔记本；笔记本电脑
notebook.note:
Write down the important key points in your notebook. 在你的笔记本上记下重要要点。

He opened his portable notebook to start working. 他打开便携式笔记本电脑开始工作。

nothing.meaning: pron. 没什么；无事 n. 零；微不足道的事
nothing.note:
There is nothing left in the fridge to eat. 冰箱里没有剩下任何可吃的了。

She said nothing and just walked away quietly. 她什么也没说，只是安静地走开了。

notice.meaning: n. 通知；注意 v. 注意到
notice.note:
Did you notice the strange sign on the wall? 你注意到墙上那个奇怪的标志了吗？

The company posted an official notice on the board. 公司在公告栏上张贴了一则官方通知。

now.meaning: adv. 现在；此刻 conj. 既然
now.note:
Where are you living right now? 你现在住在哪里？

Now that you are here, we can begin. 既然你来了，我们就可以开始了。

nowhere.meaning: adv. 无处；到处都没有 n. 极远无名的地方
nowhere.note:
There was nowhere to hide from the heavy rain. 没有任何地方可以躲避这场大雨。

This road leads to nowhere in particular. 这条路通向一个无名偏僻的地方。

number.meaning: n. 数字；数量 v. 编号
number.note:
Write your phone number on this paper. 在这张纸上写下你的电话号码。

A large number of people attended the concert. 大量的人参加了音乐会。

object.meaning: n. 物体；目标 v. 反对
object.note:
What is that flying object in the dark sky? 暗空中那个飞行的物体是什么？

Many local residents object to the new plan. 许多当地居民反对这项新计划。

ocean.note:
The Pacific Ocean is the largest ocean on Earth. 太平洋是地球上最大的海洋。

They enjoyed swimming in the warm ocean water. 他们喜欢在温暖的海洋水里游泳。

o.meaning: int. 哦（表示惊讶、赞叹） n. 字母O
o.note:
O, what a beautiful view from the hill! 哦，山上俯瞰的风景真美呀！

The word 'blood' contains two O's. 单词 blood 包含两个字母 O。

october.note:
Halloween is celebrated on the last day of October. 万圣节在十月的最后一天庆祝。

The leaves turn yellow and red in October. 树叶在十月份变黄变红。

of.note:
He is a close friend of my older brother. 他是我哥哥的一位密切朋友。

She drank a full glass of cold milk. 她喝了一整杯冷牛奶。

off.meaning: adv. 离开；关掉 prep. 从……离开
off.note:
Please turn off the lights when leaving. 离开时请把灯关掉。

He fell off his bicycle on his way home. 他在回家的路上从自行车上摔了下来。

offer.meaning: v. 提供；提出 n. 出价；提议
offer.note:
They offered me a job at the new firm. 他们在一家新公司给我提供了一份工作。

Thank you for your generous offer of help. 感谢您慷慨地提出帮忙。

office.note:
She works in a quiet office near downtown. 她在靠近市中心的一间安静办公室工作。

He has been in public office for five years. 他已经担任公职五年了。

often.note:
How often do you go to the gym weekly? 你每周去健身房的频率是多少？

I often read books before going to bed. 我经常在睡觉前看书。

oh.meaning: int. 哦；哈（表示惊奇、痛楚等）
oh.note:
Oh, I completely forgot to bring my key! 哦，我完全忘了带钥匙！

Oh! What a wonderful surprise performance! 哦！多么精彩的惊喜演出！

oil.meaning: n. 石油；食用油 v. 给……加油
oil.note:
Add a spoonful of olive oil to the salad. 在沙拉里加一勺橄榄油。

The price of crude oil went up yesterday. 昨天原油的价格上涨了。

ok.meaning: a./adv. 好；同意 int. 行
ok.note:
Is it OK if I sit here by you? 我坐在你旁边可以吗？

Everything is going to be OK, don't worry. 一切都会好起来的，别担心。

old.meaning: a. 年老的；古老的；旧的
old.note:
My grandfather is eighty years old now. 我的祖父现在八十岁了。

He drives an old car built twenty years ago. 他开着一辆二十年前造的旧车。

olympic.meaning: a. 奥林匹克的 n. 奥林匹克运动会
olympic.note:
He won a gold medal at the Olympic Games. 他在奥运会上赢得了一枚金牌。

The city was chosen to host Olympic events. 这座城市被选为承办奥运赛事的地点。

on.meaning: prep. 在……上面；在……时刻 adv. 继续
on.note:
Put the plate on the dining table. 把盘子放在餐桌上。

We will have an exam on Monday morning. 我们将在星期一上午举行考试。

once.meaning: adv. 一次；曾经 conj. 一旦
once.note:
I have only visited Japan once so far. 到目前为止我只去过日本一次。

Once you make a promise, keep it strictly. 一旦你做出承诺，就要严格遵守。

one.meaning: num. 一 pron. 一个人或物 a. 某一个
one.note:
One of my friends is a doctor. 我的一个朋友是医生。

Which shirt do you want? The blue one. 你想要哪件衬衫？蓝色的那件。

oneself.note:
It is important to believe in oneself. 相信自己是非常重要的。

Cooking for oneself can be fun and healthy. 给自己做饭可以是有趣且健康的。

only.meaning: adv. 仅仅；只有 a. 唯一的
only.note:
I only have five dollars left in cash. 我手里只剩五美元现金了。

She is the only child in her family. 她是家里唯一的孩子。

onto.note:
The cat jumped onto the kitchen counter. 猫跳到了厨房台上。

Step onto the platform carefully when boarding. 上车时请小心踏上站台。

open.meaning: v. 打开 a. 开放的；开着的
open.note:
Please open the window for fresh air. 请打开窗户透透新鲜空气。

The bank is open from nine to five. 银行的营业时间是从九点到五点。

opera.note:
They went to the theater to see an opera. 他们去剧院看了一场歌剧。

She trained for years to be an opera singer. 她训练了多年以成为一名歌剧演员。

operate.note:
Do you know how to operate this machine? 你知道如何操作这台机器吗？

Surgeons will operate on the patient tomorrow. 外科医生将于明天为患者进行手术。

or.note:
Would you prefer tea or coffee? 你更喜欢喝茶还是咖啡？

Hurry up, or you will be late. 快点，否则你要迟到了。

orange.meaning: n. 橙子；橙色 a. 橙色的
orange.note:
She peeled a sweet orange for her snack. 她剥了一个甜橙子当作零食。

The wall was painted a warm orange color. 这面墙被刷成了温暖的橙色。

order.meaning: n. 订单；顺序；命令 v. 订购；点菜；命令
order.note:
Are you ready to order your meal now? 您现在准备好点餐了吗？

Please place the books in alphabetical order. 请按字母顺序摆放这些书籍。

other.meaning: a. 其他的 pron. 另外的人或物
other.note:
Some people like tea, while other people like coffee. 有些人喜欢茶，而其他人喜欢咖啡。

I have one shoe, but where is the other? 我有一只鞋，但另一只在哪里？

our.note:
Welcome to our house for dinner! 欢迎来到我们家吃晚餐！

Our teacher gave us a project to work on. 我们的老师给我们布置了一个要完成的课题。

ours.meaning: pron. 我们的（名词性物主代词）
ours.note:
Their car is red, but ours is blue. 他们的车是红色的，而我们的是蓝色的。

This garden is ours, so we can plant flowers. 这个花园是我们的，所以我们可以种花。

ourselves.note:
We enjoyed ourselves at the beach party. 我们在海滩派对上玩得很尽兴。

We need to solve this problem by ourselves. 我们需要靠我们自己来解决这个问题。

out.meaning: adv. 在外面；出去 a. 外面的
out.note:
The kids ran out to play in the yard. 孩子们跑出去在院子里玩。

The lights went out during the big storm. 大暴风雨期间灯熄灭了。

outdoors.meaning: adv. 在户外 n. 户外
outdoors.note:
It's a sunny day, so let's play outdoors. 今天天气晴朗，我们去户外玩吧。

They love spending time in the great outdoors. 他们热衷于在大自然户外度过时光。

outside.meaning: prep./adv. 在……外面 a. 外面的 n. 外部
outside.note:
Wait outside the room until called. 在房间外面等待，直到叫到你。

The outside of the building was painted white. 这栋建筑的外墙被刷成了白色。

over.meaning: prep. 在……上方；越过 adv. 结束；翻转
over.note:
A bright bird flew over the house. 一只明亮的鸟飞过了房子。

The game is over, and our team won. 比赛结束了，我们队赢了。

overcoat.note:
Put on your heavy overcoat; it's freezing. 穿上你的厚大衣，外面冷极了。

He hung his black overcoat behind the door. 他把黑色大衣挂在了门后。

own.meaning: a./pron. 自己的 v. 拥有
own.note:
I saw the accident with my own eyes. 我亲眼看到了那起事故。

They own a nice small cottage near the sea. 他们在海边拥有一栋漂亮的精致小别墅。

owner.note:
The proud owner showed us his new house. 骄傲的主人向我们展示了他的新房子。

Who is the legal owner of this red sports car? 谁是这辆红色跑车的合法所有者？

the.note:
The sun is shining in the sky. 太阳在天空中发光。

Please open the door for me. 请为我把门打开。

pack.meaning: v. 打包；挤满 n. 包裹；一群
pack.note:
Remember to pack your suitcase tonight. 记得今晚把你的行李箱打包好。

A pack of wild wolves hunted in the snow. 一群野狼在雪地里捕食。

packet.note:
He bought a packet of potato chips. 他买了一包薯片。

Open the sugar packet and pour it into tea. 打开糖包倒入茶中。

page.meaning: n. 页；页面 v. 翻页
page.note:
Turn to page forty of your textbook. 翻到课本的第40页。

She bookmarked the web page for reference. 她将该网页存入书签以备参考。

pain.meaning: n. 痛苦；疼痛 v. 使痛苦
pain.note:
He felt a sharp pain in his knee after running. 跑步后他感觉膝盖剧痛。

It gave her great pain to say goodbye. 告别让她感到非常痛苦。

painful.note:
His injured arm is still very painful. 他受伤的手臂依然很痛。

It was a painful memory that he wanted to forget. 那是一段他想忘却的痛苦回忆。

paint.meaning: v. 油漆；绘画 n. 油漆；颜料
paint.note:
They plan to paint the fence white. 他们计划把篱笆刷成白色。

Dip your brush into the watercolor paint. 把你的画笔蘸上水彩颜料。

painter.note:
The painter completed a portrait of the queen. 画家完成了女王的一幅肖像画。

We hired a painter to redecorate the living room. 我们雇了一位油漆工重新装修客厅。

painting.note:
The oil painting hangs above the fireplace. 这幅油画挂在壁炉上方。

She takes night classes to study painting. 她上夜校来学习绘画艺术。

pair.meaning: n. 一双；一对 v. 成对
pair.note:
I need to buy a new pair of shoes. 我需要买一双新鞋。

The teacher paired the students for the dialogue. 老师将学生们结成对子练习对话。

palace.note:
The royal family lives in a grand palace. 皇室成员居住在宏伟的宫殿里。

Tourists love visiting the old royal palace. 游客们喜欢参观这座古老的皇宫。

pale.meaning: a. 苍白的；暗淡的 v. 显得逊色
pale.note:
Her face turned pale when she heard the news. 听到这个消息时，她的脸色变得苍白。

The pale moonlight shone through the curtains. 暗淡的月光穿过窗帘照了进来。

pan.note:
Heat some oil in a frying pan first. 先在平底煎锅里加热一些油。

She washed the heavy iron pan thoroughly. 她把那只沉重的铁锅彻底洗干净了。

paper.meaning: n. 纸；报纸；论文 v. 贴壁纸
paper.note:
Write your name on a blank sheet of paper. 在空白纸上写下你的名字。

He submitted a research paper to the journal. 他向期刊提交了一篇研究论文。

pardon.meaning: int. 原谅；请再说一遍 n./v. 赦免；原谅
pardon.note:
Pardon? Could you repeat that sentence please? 什么/请原谅？你能重复一下那个句子吗？

The president granted a full pardon to him. 总统给予了他全赦。

parent.meaning: n. 父亲；母亲；双亲之一
parent.note:
Every parent wants the best for their child. 每一位父母都希望把最好的给孩子。

Her parents came to attend the graduation. 她的双亲出席参加了毕业典礼。

park.meaning: n. 公园 v. 停放车辆
park.note:
Children are playing joyfully in the park. 孩子们正在公园里快乐地玩耍。

You cannot park your car on this busy street. 你不能把车停在这条繁忙的街道上。

parking.note:
Is there any free parking space nearby? 这附近有免费的停车位吗？

Finding parking downtown is very difficult. 在市中心找地方停车非常困难。

part.meaning: n. 部分；零件；角色 v. 分开
part.note:
Eating healthy food is part of a good life. 吃健康的食物是美好生活的一部分。

He played an important part in the movie. 他在这部电影里扮演了一个重要的角色。

party.note:
We are holding a birthday party tonight. 我们今晚要举办一场生日派对。

He joined the local political party last year. 他去年加入了当地的政党。

passage.note:
Read the following passage and answer questions. 阅读以下段落并回答问题。

A narrow dark passage led into the basement. 一条狭窄黑暗的通道通往地下室。

passport.note:
Don't forget to take your valid passport with you. 别忘了随身携带你有效的护照。

She showed her passport to the border officer. 她向边检官员出示了护照。

past.meaning: a. 过去的 prep. 越过 n. 过去
past.note:
In the past, people traveled mostly on foot. 过去，人们出行大多靠步行。

Walk past the bank and turn left. 步行越过银行，然后向左转。

path.note:
Follow the stone path through the quiet woods. 沿着石头小路穿过这片宁静的树林。

Education is a key path to success. 教育是走向成功的一条关键途径。

pause.note:
He made a brief pause before continuing. 他在继续之前短暂地停顿了一下。

Press the pause button to stop the video. 按暂停键停止播放视频。

pay.meaning: v. 支付；付出 n. 工资
pay.note:
How would you like to pay for the meal? 您想怎么支付餐费？

Workers are demanding better pay and conditions. 工人们正在要求更好的工资和条件。

p.note:
'Peter' starts with a capital letter P. “Peter”以大写字母 P 开头。

Mind your P's and Q's when attending formal dinner. 出席正式晚宴时注意言行举止/措辞。

pea.note:
She added fresh green peas to the fried rice. 她在炒饭里加了新鲜的绿豌豆。

They grow sweet peas in their garden. 他们在花园里种植甜豌豆。

peace.note:
The two countries signed a peace treaty. 这两个国家签署了和平条约。

I love the peace and quiet of the countryside. 我喜欢乡村的宁静与和平。

pear.note:
She bit into a juicy, sweet yellow pear. 她咬了一口多汁甜美黄梨。

We picked ripe pears directly from the orchard. 我们直接从果园里摘下了成熟的梨。

pen.meaning: n. 钢笔；笔 v. 写作
pen.note:
Can I borrow a blue pen to sign this? 我能借一支蓝色钢笔来签这个吗？

He penned a thoughtful letter to his friend. 他给他的朋友写了一封深情厚谊的信。

penny.note:
Every single penny counts when saving up. 在攒钱时每一便士都算数。

He doesn't have a penny left in his bank. 他的银行账户里一分钱不剩了。

people.meaning: n. 人们；人民 v. 居住于
people.note:
There were many people waiting at the bus stop. 公交车站有很多等候的人们。

The government serves the interest of the people. 政府服务于人民的利益。

pepper.meaning: n. 胡椒；辣椒 v. 洒上胡椒
pepper.note:
Add salt and black pepper to taste. 加入盐和黑胡椒调味。

She chopped some red bell peppers for soup. 她切了一些红铃椒做汤。

performance.note:
The actors gave a brilliant live performance. 演员们做了一场精彩的现场表演。

His work performance has improved recently. 最近他的工作绩效有所提高。

person.note:
Each person must show a valid identification card. 每一个人都必须出示有效的身份证件。

She is a kind and thoughtful person. 她是一个善良又体贴的人。

personal.note:
This is my personal opinion on the matter. 这是我对这件事的个人意见。

Please keep your personal belongings safe here. 请在这里保管好你的个人物品。

pet.meaning: n. 宠物 a. 宠爱的 v. 抚摸
pet.note:
Do you have any pet at your home? 你家里养有任何宠物吗？

She stopped to pet the friendly cat. 她停下来抚摸那只友好的猫。

phone.meaning: n. 电话；手机 v. 打电话
phone.note:
My phone rang while I was taking a shower. 我洗澡时手机响了。

I will phone you back as soon as possible. 我会尽快给你打电话回复。

photo.meaning: n. 照片 v. 拍照
photo.note:
Can you take a quick photo of us together? 你能帮我们一起快速拍张照片吗？

I framed a photo of my family on the desk. 我在桌上摆了一框我家人的照片。

photograph.meaning: n. 照片 v. 拍摄照片
photograph.note:
An old black-and-white photograph hung there. 那里挂着一张老旧的黑白照片。

He loves to photograph wild animals in forests. 他热爱在森林里拍摄野生动物。

phrase.meaning: n. 短语；词组 v. 措词
phrase.note:
Look up the meaning of the key phrase. 查找这个核心短语的意思。

He phrased his response very carefully. 他非常谨慎地措辞了他的回答。

physicist.note:
Albert Einstein is a world-famous physicist. 阿尔伯特·爱因斯坦是一位闻名世界的物理学家。

The physicist explained the law of gravity. 物理学家解释了万有引力定律。

physics.note:
Physics is my favorite science subject in school. 物理学是我在学校里最喜欢的理科学科。

Laws of physics govern the movement of planets. 物理法则支配着行星的运动。

pick.meaning: v. 挑选；采摘 n. 选择；采摘
pick.note:
You can pick whichever cake you prefer. 你可以挑选你喜欢的任何蛋糕。

We went to the farm to pick fresh apples. 我们去农场采摘新鲜的苹果。

picnic.meaning: n. 野餐 v. 去野餐
picnic.note:
We had a relaxing weekend picnic by the lake. 我们在湖边度过了放松的周末野餐。

They decided to picnic in the sunny park. 他们决定在阳光明媚的公园里野餐。

picture.meaning: n. 图画；照片；电影 v. 构想
picture.note:
Draw a picture of your house and garden. 画一张你的房子和花园的图画。

I can't picture him as a teacher. 我无法构想他当老师的样子。

pie.note:
My grandmother bakes the best apple pie. 我祖母烤的苹果派是棒的。

Would you like a slice of hot chicken pie? 你要切一片热鸡肉馅饼吗？

piece.note:
Can I have a piece of paper, please? 请给我一张纸好吗？

He ate a big piece of birthday cake. 他吃了一大块生日蛋糕。

pile.meaning: n. 堆；大量 v. 堆积
pile.note:
A big pile of laundry was on the chair. 一大堆洗涤衣物放在椅子上。

Leaves piled up quickly in the backyard. 树叶在后院里迅速堆积起来。

pill.note:
Take one pill three times a day after meals. 饭后一天吃一片药丸。

She swallowed the bitter pill with water. 她用水吞下了这颗苦药片。

ping.meaning: n. 乒的一声 v. 发乒声；发消息
ping.note:
The microwave made a ping when ready. 微波炉好时发出“乒”的一声。

Ping me when you arrive at the station. 你到达车站时给我发个消息。

pink.meaning: a. 粉红色的 n. 粉红色
pink.note:
She wore a pretty pink dress to party. 她穿了一件漂亮的粉红色连衣裙去派对。

Pink is her absolute favorite color. 粉红色是她最喜欢的颜色。

pity.meaning: n. 遗憾；同情 v. 同情
pity.note:
It is a pity that you missed the concert. 你错过了演唱会真是个遗憾。

I pity anyone who has to work in cold. 我同情必须在寒冷中工作的任何人。

place.meaning: n. 地方；位置 v. 放置
place.note:
This is a quiet place to read books. 这是一个读书的安静地方。

Please place the vase in the middle table. 请把花瓶放置在桌子中央。

plan.meaning: n. 计划；方案 v. 计划；打算
plan.note:
What is your plan for the upcoming weekend? 你对即将到来的周末有什么计划？

We plan to visit our grandparents soon. 我们打算近期去看望我们的祖父母。

plane.note:
The plane landed safely on time at five. 飞机在五点钟准时安全降落。

We flew on a large commercial plane. 我们搭乘了一架大型商业飞机。

planet.note:
Earth is the third planet from the Sun. 地球是离太阳第三近的行星。

We must protect our home planet for future. 我们必须为未来保护我们的地球家园。

plant.meaning: n. 植物；工厂 v. 种植
plant.note:
Water the house plant once a week. 每周给这株室内植物浇一次水。

They plan to plant new trees along road. 他们计划沿着道路种植新树木。

plastic.meaning: n. 塑料 a. 塑料制的；可塑的
plastic.note:
Try to reduce using single-use plastic bags. 尽量减少使用一次性塑料袋。

The toys are made of durable plastic. 这些玩具是由耐用塑料制成的。

plate.note:
He piled food onto his dinner plate. 他把食物堆在他的晚餐盘子里。

She broke a ceramic plate by accident. 她不小心打碎了一个陶瓷盘子。

play.meaning: v. 玩；演奏；做运动 n. 剧本；游戏
play.note:
Children love to play in the backyard. 孩子们喜欢在后院里玩耍。

We bought tickets to watch Shakespeare's play. 我们买了票看莎士比亚的剧本戏剧。

playground.note:
The kids are running on the school playground. 孩子们正在学校操场上奔跑。

The park added new swings to the playground. 公园在游乐场增加了新的秋千。

please.meaning: int. 请 v. 使高兴；使满意
please.note:
Please open the door for me. 请帮我开一下门。

He did everything he could to please her. 他做了所能做的一切来使她高兴。

pleased.note:
I am very pleased with the test results. 我对考试成绩感到非常满意。

She was pleased to receive your letter. 收到你的信她感到很高兴。

pleasure.note:
It is a pleasure to work with you. 与你共事是一件令人快乐的事。

Reading brings him great personal pleasure. 阅读给他带来巨大的个人乐趣。

plenty.meaning: pron./n. 丰富；大量 adv. 足够
plenty.note:
Don't hurry, we have plenty of time. 别着急，我们有充裕的时间。

There is plenty of food for everyone. 这里有供大家享用的丰盛食物。

plus.meaning: prep. 加；加上 a. 正的 n. 加号；优势
plus.note:
Two plus two equals four. 二加二等于四。

Having good computer skills is a real plus. 拥有良好的计算机技能是一个真正的优势。

pocket.meaning: n. 口袋；口袋大小的 v. 放入口袋
pocket.note:
He put his hands into his coat pocket. 他把双手伸进大衣口袋里。

I always carry a small pocket dictionary. 我总是随身携带一本小巧的袖珍字典。

police.meaning: n. 警察；警方 v. 维持治安
police.note:
Call the police immediately in emergency. 紧急情况下请立即报警/呼叫警方。

The police are investigating the theft incident. 警方正在调查这起盗窃事件。

policeman.note:
A friendly policeman gave us clear directions. 一位友好的男警察给了我们清晰的指引。

His uncle works as a traffic policeman. 他叔叔是一名交通警员。

polite.note:
It is polite to say thank you for help. 得到帮助时说谢谢是有礼貌的。

He is always polite to customers and staff. 他对待客户和员工总是非常有礼貌。

politics.note:
He is very interested in international politics. 他对国际政治非常感兴趣。

They discussed politics over dinner last night. 昨晚他们在晚餐时讨论了政治。

pollute.note:
Factories must not pollute nearby rivers. 工厂决不能污染附近的河流。

Exhaust fumes continue to pollute city air. 尾气排放继续污染着城市的空气。

pool.meaning: n. 水池；游泳池；台球 v. 集中资源
pool.note:
Children love swimming in the outdoor pool. 孩子们喜欢在户外游泳池里游泳。

They decided to pool their resources together. 他们决定将各自的资源集中起来。

poor.meaning: a. 贫穷的；可怜的；差的
poor.note:
The charity organization helps poor families. 该慈善机构帮助贫困家庭。

He has very poor eyesight without glasses. 不戴眼镜他的视力非常差。

pop.meaning: n. 流行音乐；发出扑通声 v. 突然出现
pop.note:
She loves listening to energetic pop music. 她喜欢听充满活力的流行音乐。

An idea popped into my head suddenly. 一个想法突然涌上了我的心头。

litterbug.note:
The park was covered in trash because of those litterbugs who never use the bins. 公园里到处都是垃圾，因为那些从不使用垃圾桶的乱扔垃圾者。

She scolded the litterbug for dropping cigarette butts on the pavement. 她责骂那个乱扔垃圾的人在人行道上丢烟蒂。

population.note:
The city has a population of over two million people. 这个城市拥有超过两百万的人口。

Part of the local population opposed the new road. 部分当地居民反对修建这条新路。

pork.note:
We had roast pork for dinner yesterday. 我们昨天晚餐吃了烤猪肉。

Do you prefer pork or beef? 你更喜欢猪肉还是牛肉？

porridge.note:
He usually eats a bowl of warm porridge for breakfast. 他早餐通常吃一碗热燕麦粥。

She cooked some rice porridge for the sick child. 她给生病的孩子煮了一些白米粥。

port.meaning: n. 港口；左舷；端口 v. 移转
port.note:
The ship arrived safely in the port. 船只平安抵港。

Connect the cable to the USB port on your computer. 将电缆连接到电脑的USB接口上。

possible.note:
Please call me as soon as possible. 请尽快给我打电话。

It is possible that it will rain this afternoon. 今天下午可能会下雨。

post.meaning: n. 邮件；柱子；岗位 v. 邮寄；张贴；发布
post.note:
I need to send this letter by post. 我需要通过邮政寄出这封信。

She got a new post at the university. 她在大学里获得了一个新职位。

Don't forget to post the updates on the website. 别忘了在网站上发布更新。

postage.note:
How much is the postage for this package? 这个包裹的邮费是多少？

Postage is included in the total price. 邮费已包含在总价中。

postbox.note:
He dropped the letter into the red postbox. 他把信投进了红色的邮筒里。

Is there a postbox near the station? 车站附近有邮箱吗？

postcard.note:
She sent me a beautiful postcard from Paris. 她从巴黎给我寄了一张美丽的明信片。

I like collecting postcards from different places. 我喜欢收集来自不同地方的明信片。

postcode.note:
Don't forget to write the postcode on the envelope. 别忘了在信封上写邮政编码。

Please tell me your street address and postcode. 请告诉我你的街道地址和邮编。

postman.note:
The postman delivers the mail early every morning. 邮递员每天一大早送邮件。

Our postman is always very polite and friendly. 我们的邮递员总是非常礼貌和友好。

potential.meaning: adj. 潜在的 n. 潜力；电位
potential.note:
The project has great potential for success. 这个项目有巨大的成功潜力。

We must consider all potential risks before deciding. 我们决定前必须考虑所有潜在的风险。

pour.note:
Please pour some tea for our guests. 请给客人倒些茶。

It began to pour with rain as soon as we stepped outside. 我们一走到室外，就下起了倾盆大雨。

prefer.note:
I prefer tea to coffee in the morning. 早晨我更喜欢喝茶而不是咖啡。

He would prefer to stay at home tonight. 他今晚宁愿呆在家里。

prepare.note:
Students are preparing for their final exams. 学生们正在准备期末考试。

She prepared a delicious dinner for the family. 她为家人准备了一顿美味的晚餐。

present.meaning: n. 礼物；现在 adj. 出席的；目前的 v. 赠送；展示
present.note:
He gave me a wonderful birthday present. 他给了我一份棒极了的生日礼物。

All members were present at the meeting. 所有成员都出席了会议。

She will present her research results tomorrow. 她明天将展示她的研究成果。

press.meaning: v. 按，压；催促 n. 报刊；新闻界；按压
press.note:
Press the button to start the machine. 按这个按钮启动机器。

The news was reported widely in the national press. 这则新闻在全国媒体上被广泛报道。

pretty.meaning: adv. 相当，很 adj. 漂亮的
pretty.note:
The garden looks pretty good in spring. 这个花园在春天看起来相当不错。

She wore a very pretty dress to the party. 她穿着一件非常漂亮的连衣裙去参加派对。

price.meaning: n. 价格；代价 v. 给……定价
price.note:
What is the price of this pair of shoes? 这双鞋的价格是多少？

They had to pay a heavy price for their mistake. 他们不得不为自己的错误付出沉重的代价。

pride.meaning: n. 自豪；自尊心 v. 以……自豪
pride.note:
She takes great pride in her daughter's achievements. 她为女儿的成就感到非常自豪。

His pride was hurt by the criticism. 他的自尊心受到了批评的伤害。

print.meaning: v. 印刷；打印 n. 印刷品；字样；印痕
print.note:
Can you print three copies of this document? 你能打印三份这份文件吗？

The article is available in print and online. 这篇文章有纸质版和电子版。

prize.meaning: n. 奖品，奖金 v. 珍视
prize.note:
He won first prize in the national drawing competition. 他获得了全国绘画比赛的一等奖。

Freedom is prized above all else. 自由高于一切，备受珍视。

probably.note:
It will probably rain later this afternoon. 今天下午晚些时候大概会下雨。

She is probably the best candidate for the job. 她很可能是这份工作最佳的人选。

problem.note:
Can you help me solve this math problem? 你能帮我解决这道数学题吗？

Lack of sleep can cause serious health problems. 缺乏睡眠会导致严重的健康问题。

produce.meaning: v. 生产；制造；引起 n. 农产品
produce.note:
The factory produces thousands of cars every month. 这家工厂每月生产数千辆汽车。

Fresh organic produce is sold at the local market. 当地市场出售新鲜的有机农产品。

professor.note:
Professor Smith gave an interesting lecture yesterday. 史密斯教授昨天做了一场有趣的讲座。

She was promoted to full professor last year. 她去年晋升为正教授。

programme.meaning: n. 节目；计划；程序 v. 规划；编程序
programme.note:
My favorite news programme starts at seven o'clock. 我最喜欢的新闻节目在七点开始。

The school launched a new training programme. 学校启动了一项新的培训计划。

progress.meaning: n. 进步；进展 v. 前进；进步
progress.note:
She has made great progress in her English studies. 她的英语学习取得了巨大进步。

Work on the new bridge is progressing slowly. 新大桥的建设进展缓慢。

promise.meaning: v. 承诺；有……前景 n. 许诺；希望
promise.note:
He promised to help me with my homework. 他答应帮我做作业。

Always keep your promise to others. 始终对他人守信。

proper.meaning: adj. 适当的；正确的；特有的
proper.note:
Make sure you wear proper clothes for the interview. 确保你穿着得体的衣服去参加面试。

It is essential to use the proper tools for the job. 使用合适的工具来做这项工作至关重要。

protect.note:
Sunglasses protect your eyes from the sun. 太阳镜能保护你的眼睛免受阳光伤害。

Laws were passed to protect rare wild animals. 法律已经出台以保护珍稀野生动物。

proud.note:
His parents are very proud of his success. 他的父母为他的成功感到非常自豪。

She felt proud to be part of the winning team. 她为能成为获胜团队的一员感到自豪。

provide.note:
The hotel provides free Wi-Fi for all guests. 这家酒店为所有客人提供免费无线网络。

They will provide meals and accommodation. 他们将提供膳食和住宿。

province.note:
Hubei is a famous province in Central China. 湖北是中国中部的一个著名省份。

Computing is outside his province of expertise. 计算机不在他的专业领域之内。

public.meaning: adj. 公共的；公开的 n. 公众
public.note:
The museum is open to the general public. 该博物馆向普通公众开放。

We should encourage more people to use public transport. 我们应该鼓励更多人使用公共交通。

pull.meaning: v. 拉，拔，拖 n. 拉力；影响力
pull.note:
Don't push the door, you need to pull it. 别推门，你得拉开它。

He managed to pull the heavy box across the room. 他设法把那个重箱子拉过了房间。

pupil.note:
The teacher enjoys working with young primary pupils. 这位老师喜欢和小学低年级学生在一起。

Her eyes diluted and her pupils became larger in the dark. 在黑暗中她的瞳孔变大了。

purple.meaning: adj. 紫色的 n. 紫色
purple.note:
She bought a purple sweater for the winter. 她买了一件紫色的毛衣过冬。

Mix red and blue paint to get purple. 将红色和蓝色颜料混合以得到紫色。

purse.meaning: n. 女用钱包；手提包 v. 噘嘴
purse.note:
She reached into her bag and pulled out her purse. 她把手伸进包里，拿出了钱包。

She pursed her lips in disapproval. 她噘起嘴表示不同意。

push.meaning: v. 推；督促 n. 推力；挺进
push.note:
Push the green button to call the elevator. 按绿色按钮叫电梯。

Parents shouldn't push their children too hard. 父母不应该给孩子施加太大的压力。

put.note:
Please put your books back on the shelf. 请把你的书放回书架上。

He doesn't know how to put his feelings into words. 他不知道如何用语言表达自己的感受。

pyramid.note:
The ancient pyramids of Egypt attract millions of tourists. 古埃及金字塔吸引着数百万游客。

The food pyramid guides us toward a balanced diet. 膳食金字塔指导我们进行平衡膳食。

quarter.meaning: n. 四分之一；一刻钟；季度
quarter.note:
It is a quarter past eight right now. 现在是八点一刻。

Sales increased sharply in the first quarter. 第一季度的销售额大幅增长。

queen.note:
The Queen gave a speech on national television. 女王在全国电视上发表了演讲。

The queen bee is the largest bee in the hive. 蜂后是蜂巢中最大的蜜蜂。

question.meaning: n. 问题；疑问 v. 询问；质疑
question.note:
Feel free to ask a question if you don't understand. 如果你不明白，尽管提问。

The police began to question the suspect. 警察开始审问嫌疑人。

queue.meaning: n. 队列，长队 v. 排队
queue.note:
There was a long queue outside the cinema. 电影院外面排起了长队。

We had to queue for an hour to get the tickets. 我们不得不排队一个小时才买到票。

quick.note:
Let's take a quick look at the report. 让我们快速看一下这份报告。

He gave a quick response to my email. 他快速回复了我的电子邮件。

quiet.meaning: adj. 安静的；宁静的 n. 安静
quiet.note:
Please be quiet in the library reading room. 在图书馆阅览室请保持安静。

They led a quiet life in a small village. 他们在一个小村庄里过着宁静的生活。

quilt.meaning: n. 被子，棉被 v. 缝制被子
quilt.note:
My grandmother made a warm quilt for me. 我祖母给我做了一条温暖的被子。

Cover yourself with a extra quilt if you feel cold. 如果你觉得冷，就再盖一条被子。

quit.note:
He decided to quit smoking for his health. 为了健康，他决定戒烟。

She quit her job to start her own business. 她辞职去创业了。

quite.note:
The weather today is quite warm for winter. 就冬天而言，今天的天气相当暖和。

I am not quite sure what he means. 我不太确定他是什么意思。

quiz.meaning: n. 测验；小考 v. 考查；盘问
quiz.note:
We have a short pop quiz in math class today. 我们今天数学课有个小测验。

The journalist quizzed the minister about the new policy. 记者就新政策盘问了部长。

race.meaning: n. 赛跑，比赛；种族 v. 竞赛；疾走
race.note:
He won the 100-meter race easily. 他轻松赢得了百米赛跑。

People of many different races live in this country. 许多不同种族的人生活在这个国家。

My heart began to race with excitement. 我的心因兴奋而快速跳动。

radio.meaning: n. 无线电广播；收音机 v. 用无线电发送
radio.note:
I usually listen to the radio while driving to work. 我开车上班时通常听收音机。

The captain radiod for help immediately. 船长立刻用无线电求救。

railway.note:
They are building a new railway line connecting the two cities. 他们正在修建一条连接这两座城市的铁路线。

We walked along the abandoned railway track. 我们沿着废弃的铁轨行走。

rain.meaning: n. 雨，雨水 v. 下雨
rain.note:
It looks like rain, so take an umbrella. 看起来要下雨了，带上伞吧。

It rained continuously for three whole days. 雨整整下了三天。

raincoat.note:
Put on your raincoat before going out into the storm. 在走进暴风雨之前穿上你的雨衣。

She bought a bright yellow raincoat. 她买了一件亮黄色的雨衣。

rainy.note:
I love staying indoors reading on a rainy day. 我喜欢在下雨天呆在室内看书。

The rainy season usually starts in June here. 这里的雨季通常在六月开始。

raise.meaning: v. 举起；筹集；养育；提高 n. 加薪
raise.note:
Please raise your hand if you know the answer. 如果你知道答案，请举手。

They held a charity event to raise money for homeless people. 他们举行慈善活动为无家可归者筹集资金。

rather.meaning: adv. 相当；宁可；更确切地说
rather.note:
It is rather cold outside, so wear a heavy coat. 外面相当冷，所以穿件厚大衣吧。

I would rather stay home than go to the party. 我宁愿呆在家里也不愿去参加派对。

reach.meaning: v. 到达；伸出；够到 n. 范围
reach.note:
We hope to reach London before sunset. 我们希望在日落前到达伦敦。

Keep these medicines out of the reach of children. 把这些药品放在儿童够不到的地方。

read.note:
She likes to read storybooks before bed. 她喜欢在睡前读故事书。

The thermometer reads 30 degrees Celsius. 温度计显示摄氏30度。

ready.note:
Dinner is ready, come to the table! 晚餐准备好了，快来桌前吧！

Are you ready for your presentation tomorrow? 你为明天的演讲准备好了吗？

real.note:
Is that a real leather jacket or synthetic? 那是一件真皮外套还是合成革的？

Tell me the real reason why you are upset. 告诉我你难过的真正原因。

realise.note:
I didn't realise how late it had become. 我没意识到居然这么晚了。

She finally realised her dream of becoming a doctor. 她终于实现了成为医生的梦想。

really.note:
I am really sorry for keeping you waiting so long. 让你等这么久我真的很抱歉。

Do you really think this idea will work? 你真的认为这个主意行得通吗？

reason.meaning: n. 原因；理性 v. 推理；说服
reason.note:
What was the main reason for your decision? 你做出这个决定的主要原因是什么？

Human beings have the ability to reason. 人类具有推理的能力。

receive.note:
Did you receive my email this morning? 你今天早晨收到我的电子邮件了吗？

The hospital received many new patients today. 医院今天接待了许多新病人。

recent.note:
Have you read any good books in recent months? 你最近几个月读过什么好书吗？

Recent reports indicate a stable economic recovery. 最近的报告表明经济呈稳定复苏态势。

red.meaning: adj. 红色的 n. 红色
red.note:
Stop the car when the traffic light is red. 交通信号灯变红时停车。

She bought a beautiful red rose at the flower shop. 她在花店买了一朵漂亮的红玫瑰。

refuse.meaning: v. 拒绝 n. 垃圾；废弃物
refuse.note:
He offered to pay, but she refused to accept it. 他主动提出付款，但她拒绝接受。

Disposal of household refuse is managed by the council. 家用垃圾的处理由市政会管理。

regret.meaning: v. 遗憾，后悔 n. 痛惜；遗憾
regret.note:
I regret not studying harder for the final exam. 我后悔没有为期末考试更努力地学习。

It is with deep regret that we announce his departure. 我们怀着深切的遗憾宣布他的离职。

regulation.note:
Safety regulations must be followed at all times in the lab. 在实验室里必须时刻遵守安全规则。

The government announced new environmental regulations. 政府公布了新的环境保护规定。

relax.note:
Listening to classical music helps me relax after work. 下班后听古典音乐有助于我放松。

Rules were relaxed to encourage more business investment. 规则被放宽以鼓励更多商业投资。

relay.meaning: n. 接力赛；中继设备 v. 转播；接替
relay.note:
Our team won the gold medal in the 4x100m relay. 我们的团队获得了4x100米接力赛的金牌。

Satellites relay television signals around the world. 卫星在世界各地转播电视信号。

remain.meaning: v. 依然是；留下；剩余 n. 残余，遗迹
remain.note:
Please remain seated until the plane has stopped completely. 在飞机完全停稳之前请保持就座。

Only a few old houses remain from the last century. 上个世纪留下的旧房子所剩无几。

remember.note:
I can't remember where I left my car keys. 我不记得把车钥匙放在哪里了。

Please remember me to your family. 请代我向你的家人问好。

rent.meaning: n. 租金 v. 出租；租用
rent.note:
How much rent do you pay for your flat every month? 你每个月付多少公寓租金？

They decided to rent a car for their road trip. 他们决定为公路旅行租一辆车。

repair.meaning: v. 修理；补救 n. 修理；修理工作
repair.note:
It will take two days to repair your broken watch. 修理你坏了的手表需要两天时间。

The house is in urgent need of repair. 这座房子急需维修。

repeat.meaning: v. 重复；重说 n. 重复；重播
repeat.note:
Could you please repeat your question? 能请您重复一下问题吗？

I watched a repeat of last night's talk show. 我看了昨晚脱口秀的重播。

reply.meaning: v. 回复；答复 n. 回复；回答
reply.note:
She didn't reply to my text message all day. 她一整天都没有回复我的短信。

I am writing in reply to your letter received yesterday. 我写信回复您昨天收到的来信。

report.meaning: v. 报道；报告；汇报 n. 报告；新闻报道
report.note:
The teacher asked us to write a report on the field trip. 老师让我们写一份关于野外考察的报告。

Journalists reported live from the scene of the earthquake. 记者们从地震现场发回了现场报道。

research.meaning: n. 研究，调查 v. 调查；研究
research.note:
Scientists are conducting research into medical treatments. 科学家们正在开展针对医疗方法的科学研究。

She researched the historical background before writing her book. 她在写作前调查了历史背景。

rest.meaning: n. 休息；剩余部分 v. 休息；倚靠
rest.note:
You should take a rest after working so hard. 辛苦工作之后你应该休息一下。

I will keep a few apples and give the rest to my friends. 我会留几个苹果，剩下的分给朋友。

restaurant.note:
They reserved a table at a famous French restaurant. 他们在一家著名的法国餐厅预订了座位。

Let's eat out at a nearby restaurant tonight. 我们今晚去附近的餐厅吃吧。

result.meaning: n. 结果；成绩 v. 产生；导致
result.note:
The exam results will be posted on the board tomorrow. 考试成绩将于明天公布在公告栏上。

The accident resulted in serious traffic delays. 事故导致了交通严重延误。

return.meaning: v. 返回；归还 n. 返回；回报；退货
return.note:
He promised to return home before dinner time. 他承诺在晚餐前赶回家。

Please return the library books within two weeks. 请在两周内归还图书馆图书。

review.meaning: n. 复习；审查；影评 v. 复习；审查；评论
review.note:
Students should review their notes before every test. 学生们每次测试前都应该复习笔记。

The movie received positive reviews from critics. 这部电影获得了影评人的正面好评。

rice.note:
Rice is a staple food for millions of people worldwide. 米饭是全球数亿人的主食。

Would you like fried rice or steamed rice with your chicken? 你的鸡肉要搭配炒饭还是蒸米饭？

rich.meaning: adj. 富裕的；丰富的；浓郁的
rich.note:
He became a rich business executive through hard work. 他通过努力工作成为了一位富有的企业高管。

This soil is very rich in minerals. 这片土壤矿物质含量非常丰富。

ride.meaning: v. 骑；乘车 n. 骑行；搭车；游乐设施
ride.note:
She learned how to ride a bicycle when she was six. 她六岁时学会了骑自行车。

Can you give me a ride to the railway station? 你能顺路载我去火车站吗？

right.meaning: adj. 正确的；右边的 n. 权利；右边 adv. 正好；直接地
right.note:
Turn right at the next traffic light. 在下一个红绿灯处右转。

Everyone has the right to free speech. 每个人都有言论自由的权利。

Is your calculation right or wrong? 你的计算是对还是错？

ring.meaning: n. 戒指；环形物；铃声 v. 按铃；打电话；围住
ring.note:
He bought a golden diamond ring for his wife. 他给妻子买了一枚金钻石戒指。

I will give you a ring as soon as I land. 我一落地就给你打电话。

rise.meaning: v. 上升；升起；起床 n. 增加；上升
rise.note:
The sun rises in the east and sets in the west. 太阳从东方升起，从西方落下。

There has been a sharp rise in fuel prices recently. 近来油价急剧上涨。

river.note:
They decided to walk along the river bank. 他们决定沿着河岸散步。

The Amazon River flows through South America. 亚马逊河流经南美洲。

road.note:
Look both ways before crossing the busy road. 穿越繁忙的马路前要向两边看。

The road was closed due to heavy snowfall. 由于大雪，道路被封锁了。

rob.note:
Two masked men tried to rob the local bank. 两个戴面具的人试图抢劫当地银行。

The noise robbed me of a good night's sleep. 噪音剥夺了我一夜好眠。

robot.note:
Industrial robots are widely used in car factories. 工业机器人在汽车工厂中被广泛使用。

He built a simple robot that can clean the floor. 他制作了一个能打扫地板的简单机器人。

rock.meaning: n. 岩石；摇滚乐 v. 摇晃
rock.note:
The boat hit a sharp rock and began to sink. 船撞上了尖锐的岩石并开始下沉。

My brother loves listening to heavy metal rock music. 我哥哥喜欢听重金属摇滚乐。

room.note:
She spent the afternoon cleaning her bedroom. 她花了一下午清理自己的卧室。

Is there enough room for another suitcase in the trunk? 后备箱里还有足够的空间放另一个行李箱吗？

rose.note:
He planted red and white roses in the garden. 他在花园里种了红色和白色的玫瑰。

The fresh rose gave off a sweet smell. 新鲜的玫瑰散发出甜美的香味。

rough.meaning: adj. 粗糙的；艰难的；大致的
rough.note:
The hands of the old fisherman felt very rough. 老渔夫的手感觉非常粗糙。

Can you give me a rough estimate of the total cost? 你能给我一个总费用的粗略估计吗？

row.meaning: n. 一排；争吵 v. 划船；争吵
row.note:
We had seats in the front row of the theatre. 我们的座位在剧场的前排。

They rented a wooden boat to row across the lake. 他们租了一条木船划过湖面。

rubber.note:
Car tires are made of durable synthetic rubber. 汽车轮胎是由耐用的合成橡胶制成的。

Can I borrow your pencil and rubber, please? 请问我可以借用你的铅笔和橡皮吗？

rude.note:
It is rude to interrupt people when they are speaking. 在别人说话时打断是不礼貌的。

He gave a rude answer to the customer's query. 他对顾客的询问给出了粗鲁的回答。

rule.meaning: n. 规则；统治 v. 统治；裁决
rule.note:
You must obey the safety rules in the school lab. 你必须遵守学校实验室的安全规则。

The King ruled the country with justice and wisdom. 国王以公正和智慧统治这个国家。

ruler.note:
Use a straight ruler to draw a straight line. 用直尺画一条直线。

The powerful ruler united the divided kingdoms. 这位强大的统治者统一了分裂的各个王国。

run.meaning: v. 跑；经营；运转 n. 跑步；趟
run.note:
He runs five miles in the park every morning. 他每天早晨在公园里跑五英里。

She has been running her family business for ten years. 她经营家族企业已有十年之久。

runner.note:
More than ten thousand runners participated in the marathon. 一万多名跑步者参加了马拉松赛。

She was a fast runner in her school track team. 她曾是学校田径队的一名短跑好手。

rush.meaning: v. 冲，奔；仓促行事 n. 冲；热潮；忙碌
rush.note:
We had to rush to catch the last train home. 我们不得不飞奔去赶回家的末班车。

Avoid travelling during the morning rush hour if possible. 如果可能的话，避免在早高峰期间出行。

russian.meaning: adj. 俄罗斯的；俄语的 n. 俄语；俄罗斯人
russian.note:
She can speak fluent Russian and German. 她说一口流利的俄语和德语。

We enjoyed traditional Russian dumplings at the cultural festival. 我们在文化节上品尝了传统俄罗斯饺子。

safe.meaning: adj. 安全的；平安的 n. 保险柜
safe.note:
Keep your important personal documents in a safe place. 将你的重要个人文件保存在安全的地方。

Put your jewelry into the hotel room safe. 把你的珠宝放入酒店房间的保险柜里。

safety.note:
Always wear your seatbelt for your own safety. 为了你自己的安全，请时刻系好安全带。

The building inspectors checked the structural safety of the bridge. 房屋检查员检查了这座桥的结构安全性。

sail.meaning: v. 航行；扬帆起航 n. 帆；航程
sail.note:
The ship will sail for New York tomorrow morning. 这艘船将于明天早晨开往纽约。

The wind blew hard into the white canvas sail. 强风吹进了白色的帆布帆里。

salad.note:
I ordered a fresh green salad with olive oil. 我点了一份带橄榄油的新鲜绿色沙拉。

She loves eating fruit salad in the summer. 她喜欢在夏天吃水果沙拉。

sale.meaning: n. 出售；特卖，打折销售；销售额
sale.note:
This beautiful house is currently up for sale. 这栋漂亮的房子目前正在出售。

I bought these winter coats on sale at half price. 我在打折促销时以半价买下了这些冬大衣。

salesgirl.note:
The helpful salesgirl showed me different shoe sizes. 那位热心的女店员给我展示了不同的鞋码。

She works as a salesgirl in a clothing boutique. 她在一家服装精品店担任女售货员。

salesman.note:
The car salesman explained all the features of the new model. 汽车销售员介绍了这款新车型的所有功能。

He has been working as a door-to-door salesman for years. 他多年来一直担任上门推销员。

saleswoman.meaning: n. 女售货员，女推销员
saleswoman.note:
The saleswoman recommended a reliable brand of laptop. 那位女推销员推荐了一个可靠的笔记本电脑品牌。

She is one of the top-performing saleswomen in the store. 她是这家店内业绩最优秀的女售货员之一。

salt.meaning: n. 食盐；盐类 v. 盐渍
salt.note:
Pass me the salt and pepper, please. 请把盐和胡椒粉递给我。

Don't add too much salt to the soup. 汤里不要放太多的盐。

same.meaning: adj. 相同的 pron. 同样的事物
same.note:
We both graduated from the same university. 我们俩毕业于同一所大学。

Thanks for your help, happy to do the same for you. 谢谢你的帮忙，乐意为你做同样的事。

sand.meaning: n. 沙；沙滩 v. 用砂纸打磨
sand.note:
Children were building sandcastles on the soft beach sand. 孩子们在柔软的沙滩沙子上堆建沙堡。

You should sand the wooden surface smooth before painting. 在涂漆前你应该把木头表面打磨光滑。

satellite.note:
The weather forecast relies heavily on satellite imaging. 天气预报在很大程度上依赖卫星成像。

The moon is the natural satellite of the Earth. 月球是地球的天然卫星。

satisfaction.note:
Customer satisfaction is our highest business priority. 客户满意度是我们的最高业务重点。

She found deep satisfaction in helping underprivileged children. 她在帮助贫困儿童中找到了深刻的满足感。

satisfy.note:
The meal was enough to satisfy my hunger. 这顿饭足够满足我的饥饿感。

The products failed to satisfy international safety standards. 这些产品未能符合国际安全标准。

save.meaning: v. 拯救；储蓄；节省；保存 prep. 除……之外
save.note:
The brave firefighter saved three children from the burning house. 勇敢的消防员从着火的房子里救出了三个孩子。

I am trying to save money to buy a new car. 我正在努力存钱买一辆新车。

Don't forget to save your file before closing the window. 别忘了在关闭窗口前保存你的文件。

say.meaning: v. 说；讲；陈述 n. 发言权
say.note:
What did you say to the manager just now? 你刚才对经理说了什么？

Citizens should have a say in local environmental policy. 公民应该在当地环境政策上有发言权。

scenery.meaning: n. 风景，景色；舞台背景
scenery.note:
They stopped to admire the breathtaking mountain scenery. 他们停下来欣赏令人惊叹的高山风景。

The island is famous for its beautiful natural scenery. 这座岛屿以其美丽的自然风光而闻名。

schoolbag.note:
The student packed his textbooks into his schoolbag. 这名学生把课本装进了书包。

Her heavy schoolbag caused her shoulder pain. 她沉重的书包导致她肩膀酸痛。

schoolmate.note:
I ran into an old high schoolmate at the supermarket. 我在超市偶然碰到了一个高中老同学。

They have been close schoolmates since elementary school. 自小学以来，他们一直是亲密的同学。

scientific.note:
There is clear scientific evidence supporting climate change. 有明确的科学证据支持气候变化说法。

They used rigorous scientific methods to conduct the survey. 他们使用严谨的科学方法开展了这项调查。

scientist.note:
Scientists are developing new vaccines for the disease. 科学家们正在研发针对该疾病的新疫苗。

Albert Einstein is one of the most famous scientists in history. 爱尔兰·爱因斯坦是历史上一位非常著名的科学家。

scissors.note:
Use a pair of sharp scissors to cut the paper. 用一把锋利的剪刀剪纸。

Keep these sharp scissors out of young children's hands. 请将这些锋利的剪刀放在幼儿拿不到的地方。

screen.meaning: n. 屏幕；屏风 v. 掩蔽；筛选
screen.note:
Staring at the computer screen all day hurts your eyes. 一整天盯着电脑屏幕伤害眼睛。

All job applicants will be screened thoroughly. 所有求职者都将被彻底筛选。

sea.note:
They love swimming in the sea during summer vacations. 夏天假期里他们喜欢在海里游泳。

The ship sailed into the open sea at dawn. 船只在黎明时分驶入辽阔的大海。

seagull.note:
A flock of seagulls flew over the sandy beach. 一群海鸥飞过了沙滩。

The hungry seagull snatched a fish from the water. 饥饿的海鸥从水里叼起了一条鱼。

search.meaning: v. 搜索；搜查 n. 搜寻；寻找
search.note:
Police are searching the forest for the missing child. 警察正在森林里搜寻失踪的孩子。

I did an online search to find the best restaurant. 我进行了线上搜索以找到最好的餐厅。

seat.meaning: n. 座位；席位 v. 使就座
seat.note:
Is this seat taken or is it free? 这个座位有人坐吗，还是空的？

The waiter seated the guests at a window table. 服务员安排客人坐在靠窗的桌子旁。

second.meaning: num./adj. 第二的 n. 秒；二等品 v. 赞成
second.note:
He won the second place prize in the running contest. 他在长跑比赛中获得了第二名。

Wait just a second, I will be right back. 等一下，我马上回来。

secondhand.meaning: adj. 二手的，用过的；间接的
secondhand.note:
She bought a secondhand bicycle to save money. 她买了一辆二手自行车以省钱。

I received the information from secondhand sources. 我是从间接来源获得这个信息的。

see.meaning: v. 看见；领会；参观；拜访
