Camels store fat in their humps. 骆驼在驼峰里储存脂肪。

story.note:
Grandma told me an interesting bedtime story. 奶奶给我讲了一个有趣的睡前故事。

The building has ten stories. 这栋建筑有十层楼。

strange.note:
I heard a strange noise last night. 我昨晚听到了一种奇怪的声音。

He is a complete stranger to me. 他对我是个完完全生的陌生人。

street.note:
Children are playing football on the street. 孩子们正在街上踢足球。

My house is on the main street. 我的房子在主街上。

strict.note:
Our math teacher is very strict with us. 我们的数学老师对我们要求非常严格。

There are strict rules in the library. 图书馆里有严格的规章制度。

strike.meaning: v. 打击；罢工；n. 罢工
strike.note:
Lightning struck the tall tree. 闪电击中了那棵大树。

Workers went on strike for better pay. 工人们为争取更好的薪酬而罢工。

strong.note:
He is strong enough to lift the heavy box. 他足够强壮，能搬动这个重箱子。

There is a strong wind blowing outside. 外面刮着强风。

student.note:
She is a hard-working student. 她是一个努力学习的学生。

All the students are in the classroom. 所有的学生都在教室里。

study.meaning: v. 学习；研究；n. 书房
study.note:
He likes to study English every day. 他喜欢每天学习英语。

My father is reading a book in his study. 我父亲正在他的书房里看书。

stupid.note:
It was stupid of me to make such a mistake. 我犯这种错误真是太蠢了。

Do not make stupid decisions. 不要做出愚蠢的决定。

subject.note:
What is your favorite school subject? 你最喜欢的学校科目是什么？

We changed the subject of our conversation. 我们改变了谈话的主题。

succeed.note:
If you work hard, you will succeed. 如果你努力工作，你就会成功。

She succeeded in passing the exam. 她成功通过了考试。

success.note:
Hard work is the key to success. 努力工作是成功的关键。

The party was a huge success. 派对取得了巨大的成功。

successful.note:
He is a successful businessman. 他是一个成功的商人。

The project was very successful. 这个项目非常成功。

such.note:
I have never seen such a beautiful flower. 我从未见过如此美丽的花。

Such a decision requires careful thought. 这样的决定需要深思熟虑。

sudden.note:
There was a sudden change in the weather. 天气突然发生了变化。

His sudden departure surprised everyone. 他突然的离开让每个人都很惊讶。

sugar.note:
I like to put sugar in my tea. 我喜欢在茶里放糖。

Too much sugar is bad for your teeth. 糖吃太多对牙齿不好。

suggest.note:
I suggest that we leave early tomorrow. 我建议我们明天早点出发。

Can you suggest a good restaurant? 你能推荐一家好的餐馆吗？

suggestion.note:
Thank you for your valuable suggestion. 谢谢你宝贵的建议。

I am open to any good suggestions. 我乐意接受任何好的建议。

summer.note:
We usually go to the beach in summer. 我们通常在夏天去海滩。

Summer is the hottest season of the year. 夏天是一年中最热的季节。

sun.note:
The sun rises in the east. 太阳从东方升起。

We sat out in the sun to get warm. 我们坐在阳光下取暖。

sunglasses.note:
She wore sunglasses to protect her eyes from the glare. 她戴着太阳镜以保护眼睛免受强光照射。

I forgot to bring my sunglasses today. 我今天忘记带太阳镜了。

sunlight.note:
Plants need sunlight to grow. 植物需要阳光才能生长。

The room is filled with warm sunlight. 屋子里充满了温暖的阳光。

sunny.note:
It is a bright and sunny day today. 今天是一个晴朗的日子。

We had sunny weather during our holiday. 我们的假期里天气晴朗。

sunrise.note:
We woke up early to watch the sunrise. 我们起得很早去看日出。

The sunrise over the ocean was breathtaking. 海上的日出美得令人窒息。

sunset.note:
They took photos of the beautiful sunset. 他们拍下了美丽的日落照片。

We must return before sunset. 我们必须在日落前返回。

sunshine.note:
We enjoyed the warm sunshine on the beach. 我们在海滩上享受着温暖的阳光。

Her smile brings sunshine into my life. 她的微笑给我的生活带来了阳光。

super.note:
That movie was super! 那部电影太棒了！

We had a super time at the party. 我们在派对上玩得超级开心。

supermarket.note:
I need to buy some fruit at the supermarket. 我需要在超市买点水果。

The supermarket is very busy on weekends. 超市在周末非常忙碌。

supper.note:
What is for supper tonight? 今晚晚餐吃什么？

We had a light supper and went to bed. 我们吃了一顿清淡的晚餐就去睡觉了。

supply.note:
The school will supply books for all students. 学校将为所有学生提供书籍。

There is a shortage of water supply. 目前存在供水短缺的问题。

sure.note:
Are you sure about this plan? 你对这个计划有把握吗？

Sure, I can help you with your homework. 当然，我可以帮你的作业。

surf.note:
He loves to surf in the ocean. 他喜欢在海里冲浪。

I like to surf the internet in the evening. 我喜欢在晚上上网浏览信息。

surprise.note:
We planned a birthday surprise for her. 我们为她策划了一个生日惊喜。

The news surprised everyone in the room. 这个消息让屋里的每个人都感到吃惊。

sweater.note:
It is cold, so put on a sweater. 天气冷，穿上一件毛衣吧。

She knitted a wool sweater for her son. 她为儿子织了一件羊毛毛衣。

sweep.note:
Please sweep the floor of the living room. 请把客厅的地板打扫一下。

He swept the fallen leaves away. 他把落叶扫走了。

sweet.note:
This apple is very sweet and juicy. 这个苹果非常甜且多汁。

What a sweet little baby! 多么可爱的小宝贝啊！

swim.note:
Can you swim across the river? 你能游过这条河吗？

We go to the pool to swim on weekends. 我们周末去游泳池游泳。

swing.note:
The children are playing on the swings. 孩子们正在玩秋千。

She swung her handbag back and forth. 她来回晃动着手提包。

tail.note:
The dog wagged its tail happily. 狗高兴地摇着尾巴。

Some monkeys have very long tails. 有些猴子的尾巴非常长。

tailor.note:
The tailor made a new suit for him. 裁缝为他做了一套新西装。

We can tailor the plan to fit your needs. 我们可以定制计划以满足您的需求。

take.note:
Please take your umbrella with you. 请把你的雨伞带上。

It takes two hours to get there. 到那里需要花两个小时。

tale.note:
She told us an ancient fairy tale. 她给我们讲了一个古老的童话故事。

His life story reads like a adventure tale. 他的生平读起来像是一部冒险传奇。

talk.note:
They like to talk about movies. 他们喜欢谈论电影。

We had a long talk last night. 我们昨晚进行了长谈。

tall.note:
He is the tallest boy in our class. 他是我们班最高的男孩。

There are many tall trees in the park. 公园里有许多高大的树木。

tape.note:
Use adhesive tape to fix the box. 用胶带把箱子固定好。

Listen to the English listening tape. 听英语听力磁带。

task.note:
We must finish this task before Friday. 我们必须在周五前完成这项任务。

Cleaning the house is a big task. 打扫房子是一项重大的任务。

taste.note:
Taste this soup and tell me how it is. 尝尝这汤，告诉我味道怎么样。

I prefer the sweet taste of honey. 我更喜欢蜂蜜的甜味。

taxi.note:
We took a taxi to the airport. 我们坐出租车去了机场。

It is hard to catch a taxi in the rain. 下雨天很难拦到出租车。

tea.note:
Would you like a cup of green tea? 你想来一杯绿茶吗？

Chinese people love drinking tea. 中国人喜欢喝茶。

teach.note:
She teaches us English at school. 她在学校教我们英语。

My father taught me how to ride a bike. 我父亲教我如何骑自行车。

teacher.note:
Mr. Smith is our history teacher. 史密斯先生是我们的历史老师。

She wants to be a primary school teacher. 她想成为一名小学教师。

teamwork.note:
Success requires good teamwork and communication. 成功需要良好的团队合作与沟通。

Football is a game that values teamwork. 足球是一项重视团队合作的运动。

teapot.note:
She poured hot water into the teapot. 她把热水倒进茶壶里。

This old teapot is made of porcelain. 这个旧茶壶是瓷制的。

tear.note:
She had tears in her eyes when she heard the news. 听到这个消息时她眼里含着泪水。

Do not tear the pages of the book. 不要撕毁书本的页数。

technology.note:
Modern technology makes our lives easier. 现代科技使我们的生活更轻松。

He is studying information technology. 他正在学习信息技术。

teenager.note:
Many teenagers like pop music. 许多青少年喜欢流行音乐。

She has two teenagers at home. 她家里有两个青少年孩子。

telegram.note:
He sent an urgent telegram to his family. 他给家人发了一封紧急电报。

Telegrams were widely used in the past. 电报在过去曾被广泛使用。

telegraph.note:
They communicated by telegraph in the 19th century. 他们在19世纪通过电报进行交流。

He telegraphed the news to the headquarters. 他把消息电报发回了总部。

telephone.note:
You can answer the telephone if it rings. 如果电话响了你可以去接。

I will telephone you tomorrow evening. 我明天晚上给你打电话。

television.note:
My grandparents like watching television in the evening. 我的祖父母喜欢在晚上看电视。

We bought a new color television. 我们买了一台新的彩色电视机。

tell.note:
Can you tell me the way to the station? 你能告诉我去车站的路吗？

She always tells the truth. 她总是说实话。

ten.note:
There are ten players on the field. 场上有十名球员。

He has ten fingers and ten toes. 他有十个手指和十个脚趾。

tent.note:
We pitched a tent in the forest. 我们在森林里搭起了一个帐篷。

They slept in a tent during the camping trip. 他们在露营旅行中睡在帐篷里。

term.note:
The school term ends next month. 学校学期下个月结束。

This scientific term is difficult to understand. 这个科学术语很难理解。

terrible.note:
We had terrible weather during the trip. 我们在旅行中遇到了糟糕的天气。

I made a terrible mistake in the exam. 我在考试中犯了一个可怕的错误。

terrify.note:
Thunder and lightning terrify the little dog. 雷电把小狗吓坏了。

Heights terrify him. 高度让他感到恐惧。

test.meaning: n. 测试；考试；v. 检测
test.note:
We have a math test tomorrow morning. 我们明天早晨有一场数学测试。

The mechanic will test the car engine. 机械师将检测汽车发动机。

text.meaning: n. 文本；正文；v. 发短信
text.note:
Please read the text on page ten. 请阅读第十页的正文。

He texted me the good news. 他发短信把这个好消息告诉我了。

textbook.note:
Open your textbooks to chapter five. 把教科书翻到第五章。

This textbook is very helpful for learning English. 这本教科书对学习英语很有帮助。

than.note:
He is taller than his brother. 他比他的兄弟高。

More than fifty people attended the lecture. 五十多个人听了讲座。

thank.note:
I want to thank you for your help. 我想感谢你的帮助。

Thank you very much. 非常感谢你。

thankful.note:
I am thankful for all your support. 我对你所有的支持心存感激。

She felt thankful to escape safely. 她为安全逃脱感到感激。

that.meaning: pron. 那；那个；conj. 引导从句
that.note:
That is my favorite bicycle. 那是我最喜欢的自行车。

I know that he is an honest man. 我知道他是个诚实的人。

their.meaning: pron. 他们的；她们的；它们的
their.note:
Their children are playing in the garden. 他们的孩子正在花园里玩耍。

We visited their new house yesterday. 我们昨天参观了他们的新房子。

theirs.note:
This big house is theirs. 这座大房子是他们的。

Their car is red, and ours is blue. 他们的车是红色的，而我们的是蓝色的。

them.meaning: pron. 他们；它们；它们（they的宾格）
them.note:
I saw them playing soccer in the park yesterday afternoon. 我昨天下午看到他们在公园里踢足球。

If you find any errors in these reports, please correct them immediately. 如果你在这些报告中发现任何错误，请立即纠正它们。

themselves.meaning: pron. 他们自己；它们自己（反身代词）
themselves.note:
The children built a small wooden house in the backyard all by themselves. 孩子们完全靠自己 在后院建了一座小木屋。

They found themselves in a very difficult situation after losing the key project. 在失去那个关键项目后，他们发现自己陷入了非常困难的境地。

then.meaning: adv. 当时；那时；然后；那么
then.note:
We lived in a small coastal town back then before moving to the capital. 那时在搬到首都之前，我们住在一座沿海小镇上。

First finish your homework, and then you can go out to play with your friends. 先完成你的作业，然后你就可以出去和朋友们玩了。

If the weather is bad tomorrow, then we will have to cancel our outdoor picnic. 如果明天天气不好，那么我们不得不取消户外野餐。

there.meaning: adv. 在那里；往那里; n. 那里
there.note:
She parked her red car over there next to the ancient oak tree. 她把她的红色汽车停在了那边那棵古老的橡树旁。

There are several important issues we need to discuss in today's meeting. 在今天的会议上，有几个我们需要讨论的重要问题。

these.note:
These apples were freshly picked from our organic orchard this morning. 这些苹果是今天早上刚从我们的有机果园里采摘的。

Among all the proposed options, these seem to be the most practical for us. 在所有提出的选项中，这些对我们来说似乎是最实用的。

they.note:
They are planning to launch a new eco-friendly product line next month. 他们计划下个月推出一系列新的环保产品线。

Although the tasks were challenging, they managed to complete everything on time. 尽管任务很有挑战性，但她们还是设法按时完成了一切。

thick.note:
He wore a thick wool jacket to protect himself against the freezing winter cold. 他穿了一件厚羊毛夹克以御寒。

The mountain path was barely visible because of the thick morning fog. 由于早晨浓雾弥漫，山路几乎看不清楚。

thief.note:
The police managed to catch the sneaky thief within twenty-four hours after the crime. 警方在案发后24小时内设法抓獲了那名狡猾的小偷。

Security cameras recorded the thief taking a valuable painting from the gallery. 监控摄像头拍下了小偷从画廊拿走一幅昂贵画作的过程。

thin.note:
She sliced the homemade bread into thin pieces for making toasted sandwiches. 她把自制面包切成薄片用来制作烤三明治。

The air gets very thin as you climb higher up the high mountain peak. 当你向高耸的山峰攀登得更高时，空气会变得非常稀薄。

thing.note:
The most important thing right now is to stay calm under pressure. 目前最重要的事情是在压力下保持冷静。

Could you help me carry these heavy things upstairs to the storage room? 你能帮我把这些重物搬上楼到储藏室吗？

think.note:
I need some quiet time to think about your business proposal carefully. 我需要一些安静的时间来仔细思考你的商业提议。

Do you think it will rain later this afternoon based on the dark clouds? 根据这些乌云，你认为今天下午晚些时候会下雨吗？

third.meaning: num./adj. 第三; n. 三分之一
third.note:
This is the third time he has visited Paris for international business trips. 这是他第三次因国际商务旅行访问巴黎。

About one third of the overall company budget was spent on market research. 公司总预算的大约三分之一花在了市场调研上。

thirst.meaning: n. 口渴；渴望; v. 渴望
thirst.note:
After running the full marathon, he drank a large bottle of water to quench his thirst. 在跑完马拉松后，他喝了一大瓶水来解渴。

The young scientist has an unquenchable thirst for knowledge about quantum physics. 这位年轻的科学家对量子物理学的知识有着难以遏制的渴望。

thirsty.note:
If you feel thirsty after the workout, please help yourself to some fresh juice. 如果你在锻炼后感到口渴，请随意喝些新鲜果汁。

The dry soil in the garden seemed thirsty for a heavy rainfall. 花园里干燥的土壤似乎渴望一场大雨。

thirteen.note:
Her daughter will turn thirteen years old next month and enter junior high school. 她的女儿下个月就要满十三岁，上初中了。

There are thirteen players selected to represent the city in the basketball match. 有十三名球员被选出代表该城市参加篮球比赛。

thirty.note:
The upcoming presentation will take approximately thirty minutes to complete. 即将开始的演示大约需要三十分钟才能完成。

My mother worked in this local public library for nearly thirty years. 我母亲在这家当地公共图书馆工作了将近三十年。

this.note:
This new mobile application is designed to help users track daily health habits. 这款新的移动应用程序旨在帮助用户追踪日常健康习惯。

I have never seen such a beautiful sunset in this coastal city before. 我以前在这座沿海城市从未见过如此美丽的落日。

those.note:
Those old books on the top shelf belong to my grandfather's collection. 顶层架子上的那些旧书属于我祖父的藏书。

For those who arrive early at the venue, free coffee will be provided. 对于那些早早到达场地的人，将提供免费咖啡。

though.meaning: conj. 虽然；尽管; adv. 可是；然而
though.note:
Though he worked hard all night, he could not finish the complex assignment. 虽然他整晚都在努力工作，但他未能完成那项复杂的任务。

The task was extremely difficult. He decided to give it a try, though. 任务非常艰难。然而，他还是决定试一试。

thought.meaning: n. 思想；想法；思考; v. 想（think的过去式和过去分词）
thought.note:
After careful thought, she decided to accept the job offer in Singapore. 经过仔细思考，她决定接受新加坡的工作邀约。

I initially thought the exam would be easy, but it turned out quite tough. 我最初以为考试会很简单，但结果却相当难。

three.note:
Our business team consists of three senior managers and two software developers. 我们的商务团队由三位高级经理和两位软件开发人员组成。

She has lived in three different countries over the past six years. 在过去六年里，她在三个不同的国家生活过。

through.meaning: prep. 穿过；通过；凭借; adv. 穿过；从头到尾
through.note:
The fast train travelled through several long tunnels in the mountains. 这列高速列车穿过了大山中的几条长隧道。

They achieved great progress in research through relentless practice and dedication. 他们通过不懈的练习和奉献在研究中取得了重大进展。

throw.meaning: v. 扔；投；掷; n. 投掷
throw.note:
Don't throw trash on the street; always put it into the recycling bin. 不要把垃圾扔在街上；一定要放进回收桶里。

The famous pitcher made a powerful throw that secured the final win for the team. 这位著名的投手做出了关键的一投，为球队奠定了最终的胜利。

thus.meaning: adv. 因此；从而；以此方式
thus.note:
He studied extremely hard for months; thus, he achieved the highest test score. 他几个月来极其努力地学习；因此，他取得了最高测试分。

The new machinery operates faster, thus reducing overall manufacturing production time. 新机械运转速度更快，从而缩短了整体制造生产时间。

tick.meaning: n. 滴答声；钩号; v. 发滴答声；打钩
tick.note:
The slow tick of the wall clock was the only sound in the peaceful room. 墙上挂钟缓慢的滴答声是这间安静房间里唯一的声响。

Please tick the appropriate box on the application form to select your choice. 请在申请表上的适当方框内打钩以做出你的选择。

ticket.meaning: n. 票；车票；入场券；罚单
ticket.note:
I bought an admission ticket for the upcoming modern art exhibition online. 我在线购买了一张即将举办的现代艺术展览的门票。

The police officer gave the driver a speeding ticket for breaking the road limit. 警察因司机违反道路限速规定而向其开出了一张超速罚单。

tidy.meaning: adj. 整洁的；整齐的; v. 整理；收拾
tidy.note:
She always keeps her study desk neat and tidy for better concentration. 她总是把书桌保持得干净整洁以更好地集中注意力。

Please tidy your room before your grandparents arrive this evening. 请在你祖父母今晚到达之前把你的房间整理干净。

till.meaning: prep./conj. 直到…为止 (等于 until)
till.note:
The library will remain open till late at night during the final exam week. 在期末考试周期间，图书馆将一直开放到深夜。

We waited under the store roof till the heavy summer rain finally stopped. 我们一直在店面屋檐下等待，直到夏日的大雨终于停止。

time.meaning: n. 时间；次数；时期; v. 安排时间；为…计时
time.note:
What time does the international flight to London depart this evening? 今天晚上前往伦敦的国际航班几点起飞？

He has read that classic novel three times because he likes the story so much. 这本经典小说他读过三次，因为他太喜欢这个故事了。

The coach timed the runners as they completed their four-hundred-meter laps. 当跑步者完成四百米圈数时，教练为他们进行了计时。

tire.meaning: v. 疲劳；厌倦; n. 轮胎 (美式英语等于tyre)
tire.note:
Walking up the steep stairs for hours will quickly tire anyone out. 沿着陡峭的楼梯走上几个小时会让任何人迅速感到疲惫。

He had to replace the flat front tire on his bicycle after hitting a sharp nail. 在碰到一颗尖锐的钉子后，他不得不更换自行车上瘪掉的前轮胎。

tired.meaning: adj. 疲倦的；累的；厌烦的
tired.note:
She felt extremely tired after working long overtime hours at the office. 在办公室长时间加班后，她感到非常疲倦。

Many citizens are getting tired of hearing the same empty promises from politicians. 许多市民对于听政治家们重复同样的空洞承诺感到厌烦。

to.meaning: prep. 向；到；往；对于; (动词不定式符号)
to.note:
We decided to walk to the central train station together after lunch. 午饭后我们决定一起步行前往中央火车站。

It is important to maintain a healthy balance between work and life. 在工作和生活之间保持健康的平衡是非常重要的。

today.note:
Today is the official deadline for submitting your research applications. 今天是提交研究申请的官方截止日期。

Young people today use smart technology for communication more than ever before. 如今的年轻人比以往任何时候都更多地使用智能技术进行沟通。

together.note:
Let's work together to complete this complex project ahead of schedule. 让我们共同努力，提前完成这个复杂的项目。

Put the two separate pieces together to form a stable wooden structure. 把这两个独立的部分拼在一起，以形成一个稳定的木制结构。

toilet.note:
Excuse me, could you please tell me where the nearest public toilet is? 打扰一下，请问最近的公共洗手间在哪里？

Make sure to flush the toilet after use and wash your hands thoroughly. 使用后请务必冲洗马桶并彻底洗手。

tokyo.note:
Tokyo is one of the most populous and vibrant modern cities in the world. 东京是世界上人口最多且最具活力的现代城市之一。

They flew directly to Tokyo to attend an international technology conference. 他们直接飞往东京参加一个国际技术会议。

tomb.note:
Archaeologists discovered an ancient royal tomb filled with gold treasures. 考古学家发现了一座装满黄金珍宝的古老皇家陵墓。

Visitors stood quietly in respect around the solemn tomb of the soldier. 参观者们肃立在士兵庄严的陵墓周围表示敬意。

ton.note:
The heavy industrial truck can carry over ten tons of raw materials. 这辆重型工业卡车可以运载超过十吨的原料。

I have a ton of work to finish before I can enjoy the weekend. 在我享受周末之前，我有大量的工作需要完成。

tonight.note:
Are you free to have dinner with us at the new Italian restaurant tonight? 你今晚有空和我们一起去新的意大利餐厅吃晚餐吗？

Tonight will be a clear night, perfect for observing distant stars. 今晚夜空晴朗，非常适合观测遥远的星星。

too.note:
Nice to meet you; I am very happy to join the research project, too. 很高兴认识你；我也很高兴能加入这个研究项目。

This coffee is way too hot for me to drink right now without burning. 这咖啡太热了，我俩现在喝会烫到。

tool.note:
A hammer is an essential hand tool for any basic home repair work. 锤子是任何基础家居维修工作必备的手工工具。

The internet has become a vital learning tool for students worldwide. 互联网已成为全球学生至关重要的学习工具。

tooth.note:
The dentist checked every single tooth during my annual dental checkup. 在我的年度牙科检查中，牙医检查了我每一颗牙齿。

He broke a front tooth while playing contact sports without protective gear. 他在没有佩戴防护装备进行接触性运动时弄断了一颗门牙。

toothache.note:
He could not sleep last night because of a severe and painful toothache. 昨晚因为严重的牙痛，他根本无法入睡。

You should schedule a dentist appointment immediately if you get a toothache. 如果你牙痛，你应该立即预约牙医。

toothbrush.note:
Dentists recommend that you replace your plastic toothbrush every three months. 牙医建议你每三个月更换一次塑料牙刷。

Don't forget to pack your electronic toothbrush when preparing your travel bag. 准备旅行包时，不要忘记带上你的电子牙刷。

toothpaste.note:
Squeeze a small pea-sized amount of toothpaste onto the bristles. 将少量豌豆大小的牙膏挤到刷毛上。

This brand of mint toothpaste helps to keep your breath fresh for long. 这款薄荷牙膏有助于长期保持口气的清新。

top.meaning: n. 顶部；顶端；上衣; adj. 顶部的；最高的
top.note:
They finally reached the top of the snowy mountain after hours of climbing. 经过数小时的攀登，他们终于到达了雪山的顶峰。

She ranked among the top students in the national mathematics competition. 她在全国数学竞赛中跻身于优秀学生的前列。

total.meaning: adj. 总计的；完全的; n. 总数; v. 合计
total.note:
The total cost of repairing the damaged car was far higher than expected. 维修损坏汽车的总费用远高于预期。

The sales figures for this single quarter total over two million dollars. 仅这一个季度的销售额总计就超过二百万美元。

touch.meaning: v. 触摸；接触；感动; n. 触觉；联系
touch.note:
Please do not touch the delicate museum exhibits without authorization. 未经授权，请勿触摸馆内精致的展品。

Her speech about overcoming difficulties touched the hearts of the audience. 她关于克服困难的演讲触动了现场观众的心灵。

Please keep in touch with me while you are studying abroad. 当你在国外留学期间，请与我保持联系。

tourism.note:
International tourism plays a crucial role in boosting the local economy. 国际旅游业在推动当地经济方面发挥着至关重要的作用。

The city council invested heavily to promote historical tourism in the area. 市议会投入巨资在该地区推广历史文化旅游。

tourist.note:
Thousands of foreign tourists visit the famous historic castle every summer. 每年夏天，数以万计的外国游客参观这座著名的历史古堡。

He works as a professional local tour guide helping tourists navigate the city. 他担任专业当地导游，帮助游客在城市中游览。

toward.meaning: prep. 向；朝向；对于 (也可拼作 towards)
toward.note:
The young herd of cattle moved slowly toward the river to drink water. 那群年轻的牛群缓慢地朝河边走去喝水。

Her practical contribution toward the group project was highly praised. 她对小组项目做出的实质贡献受到了高度赞扬。

tower.note:
The famous clock tower stands majestically in the center of the town square. 这座著名的钟楼庄严地屹立在城镇广场中心。

We climbed to the top of the observation tower to get a panoramic view. 我们爬上了观光塔的顶端，以俯瞰全景。

town.note:
He grew up in a quiet farming town before moving to a metropolis. 在搬到大都市之前，他在一个安静的农业城镇长大。

There are several excellent restaurants located in the historical part of town. 镇上的历史旧城区有几家优秀的餐厅。

toy.note:
The little child spent hours building houses with his colorful wooden toy bricks. 这个小孩花了几个小时用彩色的木制玩具积木盖房子。

Don't leave your plastic toys scattered all over the living room floor. 不要把你的塑料玩具散落得到处都是在客厅地板上。

tractor.note:
The hardworking farmer drove his heavy tractor across the wheat field. 勤劳的农夫驾驶着他的重型拖拉机穿过小麦田。

Modern tractors are often equipped with advanced satellite GPS navigation systems. 现代拖拉机通常配备有先进的卫星定位导航系统。

trade.meaning: n. 贸易；交易；行业; v. 进行交易；交换
trade.note:
International trade between the two strong nations has grown rapidly. 两大国之间的国际贸易增长迅速。

The kids decided to trade their extra collectible cards during recess. 孩子们决定在课间休息时交换他们多余的收集卡片。

tradition.note:
It is a long-standing family tradition to gather together on New Year's Eve. 年三十晚上聚在一起是一个悠久的家庭传统。

The festival preserves the ancient cultural traditions of the indigenous people. 这个节日保留了当地原住民古老的文化传统。

traditional.note:
She wore a colorful traditional costume during the ethnic dance performance. 在民族舞蹈表演中，她穿了一件色彩鲜艳的传统服装。

The restaurant is famous for serving traditional local food using secret recipes. 这家餐厅因利用秘方烹制传统的当地美食而闻名。

traffic.note:
The heavy morning traffic caused him to be late for an important job interview. 早晨拥挤的交通导致他在一场重要的求职面试中迟到。

Traffic lights were installed at the busy street intersection to improve safety. 繁忙的街口安装了交通信号灯以提高安全性。

train.meaning: n. 火车; v. 训练；培养
train.note:
The high-speed passenger train arrives at the central platform at eight sharp. 高速客运列车在八点整准时到达中央站台。

Athletes must train hard every morning to prepare for the national championship. 运动员必须每天早上努力训练，为全国锦标赛做准备。

trainer.meaning: n. 教练；培训师；运动鞋
trainer.note:
He hired a certified personal fitness trainer to help him lose weight safely. 他聘请了一位受过认证的私人健身教练来帮助他安全减肥。

She put on a comfortable pair of white trainers before going out for a run. 她在出去跑步前穿上了一双舒适的白色运动鞋。

translate.note:
Can you help me translate this official French document into plain English? 你能帮我把这份官方法语文件翻译成通俗易懂的英语吗？

Good practical ideas will not translate into success unless you execute them. 优秀的实用想法如果不付诸实践，就不会转化为成功。

trap.meaning: n. 陷阱；圈套; v. 诱捕；使困住
trap.note:
The experienced hunter set a small trap in the deep woods to catch rabbits. 经验丰富的猎人在深林里设下了一个小陷阱来抓兔子。

Several commuters were trapped inside the elevator during the power outage. 在停电期间，几位通勤者被困在了电梯里。

travel.meaning: v./n. 旅行；游历；长途客运
travel.note:
They love to travel to different exotic countries during their annual vacations. 他们喜欢在每年假期前往不同的异域国家旅行。

Air travel has become significantly faster and more accessible in recent decades. 在最近几十年里，航空旅行变得明显更快且更容易使用。

traveler.meaning: n. 旅行者；游客 (英式拼写作 traveller)
traveler.note:
The weary traveler searched for a comfortable hotel to stay for the night. 疲惫的旅行者寻找一家舒适的酒店过夜。

Experienced travelers always pack light to make moving around easier. 有经验的旅行者总是轻装简行，以便使出行更加轻松。

treat.meaning: v. 款待；对待；治疗; n. 款待；乐事
treat.note:
The doctor knows exactly how to treat patients suffering from rare skin conditions. 这位医生确切地知道如何治疗患有罕见皮肤病的患者。

My generous uncle offered to treat the whole family to a fine dinner tonight. 我慷慨的大叔提出今晚请全家吃一顿丰盛的晚餐。

tree.note:
They sat under the shade of a large green oak tree to read their books. 他们坐在大绿橡树的树荫下看书。

Every spring, the cherry blossom tree in our front garden produces pink flowers. 每年春天，我们前院花园里的樱花树都会开出粉红色的花朵。

trip.meaning: n. 旅行；绊倒; v. 绊倒
trip.note:
We took a fantastic weekend road trip to the scenic countryside mountains. 我们进行了一场棒极了的周末乡村山区自驾游。

Be careful not to trip over the loose carpet on the wooden floor. 小心不要被木地板上松动的地毯绊倒。

trouble.meaning: n. 麻烦；故障；烦恼; v. 麻烦；使烦恼
trouble.note:
If you experience any technical trouble with the system, call IT support. 如果你的系统遇到任何技术故障，请联系IT支持部门。

I am very sorry to trouble you during your busy weekend rest time. 非常抱歉在您繁忙的周末休息时间打扰您。

trousers.note:
He wore a formal black suit jacket with matching suit trousers to the meeting. 他穿了一件正式的黑色西装上衣，配有配套的西裤去参加会议。

These cotton trousers are comfortable enough to wear during long casual flights. 这些棉质长裤足够舒适，适合在漫长的休闲飞行中穿着。

truck.note:
A huge delivery truck unloaded heavy boxes outside the warehouse entrance. 一辆巨大的送货卡车在仓库门口卸下了重箱子。

He works as a professional long-distance truck driver delivering goods. 他的职业是一名运送货物的长途卡车司机。

true.meaning: adj. 真实的；正确的；忠实的
true.note:
The emotional movie is based on a true heroic story from World War II. 这部感人的电影是根据二战期间的一个真实英雄故事改编的。

A true friend will support you when you face difficult challenges in life. 当你在生活中面对艰难的挑战时，真正的朋友会支持你。

truth.note:
The honest witness swore under oath to tell nothing but the absolute truth. 诚实的证人宣誓只说绝对的真相。

It took many years of deep research to discover the scientific truth behind it. 花了多年的深入研究才发现了其背后的科学真理。

try.meaning: v. 尝试；试图；努力; n. 尝试
try.note:
You should always try your best regardless of how difficult the exam is. 无论考试有多难，你都应该时刻尽力而为。

If the initial attempt fails, give it another try after making adjustment. 如果最初的尝试失败了，做出调整后再试一次。

t.note:
The letter 'T' is the twentieth letter in the modern English alphabet. 字母'T'是现代英语字母表中的第二十个字母。

Make sure to cross the letter t when writing words clearly by hand. 用手清晰地书写单词时，确保在字母t上划横线。

turn.meaning: v. 旋转；转向；变成; n. 转弯；轮流
turn.note:
Turn left at the next street intersection to find the public hospital. 在下一个街口左转就能找到公立医院。

Now it is your turn to roll the game dice and move your piece forward. 现在轮到你掷游戏骰子并将你的棋子向前移动了。

tv.meaning: n. 电视；电视机 (等于 television)
tv.note:
The family gathered together in the comfortable room to watch live sports on TV. 全家人聚集在舒适的房间里在电视上看体育直播。

He prefers reading books online rather than spending hours watching TV shows. 他更喜欢在线看书，而不是花几个小时看电视节目。

twelfth.meaning: num./adj. 第十二; n. 十二分之一
twelfth.note:
December is the twelfth and final month of the year in the solar calendar. 十二月是阳历一年中的第十二个月也是最后一个月。

Today is her twelfth birthday party, and all her classmates are invited. 今天是她的十二岁生日派对，她所有的同学都被邀请了。

twentieth.meaning: num./adj. 第二十; n. 二十分之一
twentieth.note:
They celebrated their twentieth marriage anniversary with a romantic trip. 他们通过一次浪漫的旅行庆祝了他们的第二十个结婚纪念日。

He finished in twentieth position among one hundred runner participants. 在一百名跑步参与者中，他获得了第二十名。

twenty.note:
There are twenty students attending the advanced computer coding class. 有二十名学生正在参加高级计算机编程课程。

She has lived in this historic residential building for over twenty years. 她在这栋历史悠久的住宅楼里生活了二十多年。

twice.note:
I have visited that modern science museum twice with my middle school classmates. 我和初中同学一起去参观过那家现代科学博物馆两次。

This broad new road is twice as wide as the old dusty countryside path. 这条宽阔的新路是那条破旧尘土飞扬的乡村小道的两倍宽。

twin.meaning: n. 双胞胎之一; adj. 孪生的；双重的
twin.note:
She gave birth to healthy twin boys early yesterday morning at the hospital. 她昨天清晨在医院生下了一对健康的双胞胎男孩。

The hotel offers comfortable twin rooms with two separate single beds. 这家酒店提供带两张独立单人床的舒适双人房。

two.note:
I bought two fresh cups of black coffee from the local coffee shop. 我从当地咖啡馆买了两杯新鲜的黑咖啡。

The important match was extended by two extra minutes of injury time. 这场重要的比赛延长了额外的两分钟伤停补时。

type.meaning: n. 类型；种类; v. 打字
type.note:
What type of classical background music do you prefer listening to while studying? 在学习时你更喜欢听哪种类型的古典背景音乐？

She can type very fast without looking at the mechanical keyboard keys. 她可以打字非常快，而不用看机械键盘键。

typical.note:
Rainy weather is very typical for this coastal area during early spring. 在初春时期，阴雨天气是这个沿海地区非常典型的现象。

This is a typical example of modern minimalist architecture in big cities. 这是大城市中现代极简主义建筑的一个典型例子。

u.note:
'U' is the twenty-first letter of the English alphabet. 'U'是英语字母表中的第二十一个字母。

The river makes a broad U-turn around the base of the high mountain. 这条河流绕着高山的底部拐了一个巨大的U形弯。

uncle.meaning: n. 叔叔；伯伯；舅舅；姑父
uncle.note:
My uncle works as an experienced pilot for an international airline company. 我舅舅在一家国际航空公司担任有经验的飞行员。

We visited our uncle's organic farm in the countryside during the holiday. 假期里，我们参观了我叔叔在乡村的有机农场。

under.meaning: prep. 在…下面；在…领导下; adv. 在下面
under.note:
The sleepy cat is resting peacefully under the big wooden dining table. 那只困倦的猫正安详地躺在大木餐桌下面休息。

Children under twelve years old must be accompanied by a responsible adult. 十二岁以下的儿童必须由有责任心的成年人陪同。

underground.meaning: adj. 地下的; n. 地铁; adv. 在地下
underground.note:
They built a huge underground parking lot beneath the central square. 他们在中央广场下方建了一个巨大的地下停车场。

Taking the London Underground is often the fastest way to travel across town. 乘坐伦敦地铁通常是在城里穿行的最快方式。

understand.note:
I cannot fully understand the complex math concept without extra examples. 没有额外的例子，我无法完全理解这个复杂的数学概念。

Do you understand the safety instructions given by the flight supervisor? 你听懂乘务主管给出的安全说明了吗？

understanding.meaning: n. 理解；谅解; adj. 善解人意的
understanding.note:
Mutual respect and clear communication are basic to a deep relationship understanding. 相互尊重和清晰沟通是深刻关系理解的基础。

Thank you for being so patient and understanding while I dealt with the problem. 感谢在我处理问题时你如此有耐心且善解人意。

unfair.meaning: adj. 不公平的；不公正的
unfair.note:
It is completely unfair to blame him for an accident he did not cause. 将他并未造成的事故归咎于他是完全不公平的。

Many workers complained about the unfair distribution of company workloads. 许多工人抱怨公司工作量分配不公。

unit.note:
The meter is a standard global unit used for measuring physical distance. 米是用于测量物理距离的标准全球单位。

Each learning unit in this English textbook focuses on practical vocabulary. 本英语教科书中的每个学习单元都侧重于实用词汇。

universe.note:
Astronomers use space telescopes to study distant galaxies in the universe. 天文学家使用空间望远镜研究宇宙中遥远的星系。

There are billions of stars and planets scattered across the vast universe. 广袤的宇宙中散落着数十亿的恒星和行星。

university.note:
She plans to study computer engineering at a top prestigious university. 她计划在一家顶尖知名大学学习计算机工程。

The university library offers extensive digital resources for student research. 该大学图书馆为学生研究提供广泛的数字资源。

unknown.meaning: adj. 未知的；不知名的; n. 未知的事物
unknown.note:
The painter was completely unknown to the public before winning the award. 在获奖之前，这位画家对公众来说完全是不知名的。

They set out on a journey into the unknown regions of the deep forest. 他们踏上了前往深林未知区域的旅程。

unless.note:
We will have our outdoor picnic tomorrow unless it starts to rain heavily. 除非开始下大雨，否则我们明天将举行户外野餐。

You won't pass the final qualification exam unless you practice regularly. 除非你定期练习，否则你不会通过最终的资格考试。

unlike.note:
Unlike her elder brother who loves sports, she prefers reading books indoors. 与她喜欢运动的大哥不同，她更喜欢在室内看书。

Unlike traditional cars, electric vehicles do not produce direct exhaust emissions. 与传统汽车不同，电动汽车不产生直接尾气排放。

until.note:
Please stay in your classroom seats until the exam bell rings. 在考试铃声响起之前，请留在教室座位上。

He worked non-stop until he completed the complex research report. 他不停地工作，直到完成了那份复杂的研究报告。

unusual.note:
It is very unusual to have snow in this warm coastal region in spring. 在初春时期，这个温暖的沿海地区下雪是非常不寻常的。

She has a very unusual artistic style that attracts many young art collectors. 她有一种非常独特的艺术风格，吸引了许多年轻的艺术收藏家。

up.meaning: adv. 向上；起来; prep. 沿着…往上
up.note:
He looked up at the blue sky and saw a flock of migrating birds. 他抬头看着蓝天，看到了一群迁徙的鸟类。

Prices of organic fresh vegetables have gone up significantly this month. 这个月有机新鲜蔬菜的价格大幅上涨。

upon.meaning: prep. 在…之上；在…后立即 (等于 on)
upon.note:
Upon arriving at the international airport, he immediately called his family. 一到达国际机场，他立即给家人打了电话。

Once upon a time, there lived a wise old man in a small village. 从前，在小村庄里住着一位智慧的老人。

upstairs.meaning: adv. 在楼上；往楼上; adj. 楼上的; n. 楼上
upstairs.note:
She carried the laundry basket upstairs to the main master bedroom. 她把洗衣篮搬上楼到主卧室。

The children are playing noise games in their upstairs bedroom right now. 孩子们现在正在他们楼上的卧室里玩闹吵闹的游戏。

use.meaning: v. 使用；利用; n. 使用；用途
use.note:
Can I use your mobile phone charger to charge my battery for a moment? 我可以使用你的手机充电器给我的电池充一会儿电吗？

This modern software tool has many practical uses in graphic design projects. 这款现代软件工具在图形设计项目中有很多实用的用途。

used.meaning: adj. 使用过的；二手的不新鲜的; (used to) 过去常常
used.note:
He bought a reliability-checked used car at a much lower price. 他以低得多的价格买了一辆经过可靠性检查的二手车。

I used to live near the beach when I was attending elementary school. 我在上小学时曾经住在海滩附近。

useful.note:
The instructor gave us some very useful practical advice on public speaking. 导师给我们提供了一些关于公开演讲的非常有用的实用建议。

A pocket knife is a useful tool to bring along during camping trips. 折叠口袋刀是野营旅行中随身携带的有用工具。

useless.note:
An umbrella is completely useless against such strong gale winds. 在如此强劲的大风面前，雨伞完全是无用的。

Don't waste your precious time reading useless marketing advertisements. 不要浪费你宝贵的时间阅读无用的营销广告。

user.note:
The new website interface is designed to provide a better user experience. 新的网站界面旨在提供更好的用户体验。

Each registered user must create a strong password for account safety. 每个注册用户必须创建一个强密码以保障账户安全。

usual.note:
He arrived at the morning meeting at his usual time of eight o'clock. 他在通常的八点钟到达早会现场。

As usual, she ordered a hot latte and a blueberry muffin for breakfast. 像往常一样，她点了一杯热拿铁和一个蓝莓玛芬作为早餐。

usually.note:
I usually take a quick half-hour walk in the park after dinner. 我通常在晚餐后在公园里快步散步半小时。

Public buses in this metropolitan city are usually on time according to schedule. 这个大都市的公共汽车通常按照时间表准时到达。

vcd.meaning: n. 影音光盘 (Video Compact Disc)
vcd.note:
He found an old VCD containing family vacation videos in the attic. 他在阁楼里找到了一张存有家庭度假视频的老旧VCD光盘。

VCD technology was widely popular before DVD and streaming services emerged. 在DVD和流媒体服务出现之前，VCD技术非常流行。

vegetable.note:
Eating fresh green vegetables every day is beneficial for overall health. 每天吃新鲜的绿色蔬菜对整体健康有益。

She planted carrots and tomatoes in her backyard vegetable garden. 她在后院蔬菜园里种植了胡萝卜和番茄。

very.meaning: adv. 非常；很; adj. 恰好的；正是的
very.note:
Thank you very much for your kind help during our sudden emergency. 非常感谢你在我们发生突发紧急情况时给予的热心帮助。

At that very moment, the power went out completely in the whole building. 恰在那个时刻，整栋楼彻底停电了。

victim.note:
The charity foundation provides food and emergency shelter for disaster victims. 慈善基金会为灾难受害者提供食物和紧急避难所。

He fell victim to an online financial scam due to a lack of awareness. 由于缺乏意识，他成为了在线金融诈骗的受害者。

video.meaning: n. 视频；录像; v. 录制视频
video.note:
She recorded a short promotional video to introduce her modern online course. 她录制了一段简短的宣传视频来介绍她的现代在线课程。

We watched an educational video about marine wildlife protection in class. 我们在课堂上观看了一段关于海洋野生动物保护的教育视频。

villager.note:
Friendly local villagers welcomed the lost mountain hikers with warm tea. 友好的当地村民用热茶欢迎了迷山的小路徒步者。

The news spread quickly among every villager in the rural community. 消息在乡村社区的每个村民之间迅速传开了。

violin.note:
She has been practicing playing the classical violin since age seven. 自七岁起，她就一直在练习演奏古典小提琴。

The wooden violin produced a rich and expressive melody during the concert. 在音乐会上，那把木制小提琴演奏出丰富且富有表现力的旋律。

visit.note:
We plan to visit our grandparents in the countryside during autumn. 我们计划在秋天去乡村拜访我们的祖父母。

His long-awaited visit to the ancient city was a memorable experience. 他期盼已久的古城之行是一次难忘的经历。

visitor.meaning: n. 参观者；访问者；来客
visitor.note:
All museum visitors are requested to show their tickets at the entry gate. 要求所有博物馆参观者在入口大门处出示门票。

The company welcomed several international visitors to inspect the factory. 公司欢迎了几位国际来客参观检查工厂。

voice.meaning: n. 声音；嗓音；发言权; v. 表达；说出
voice.note:
She has a beautiful singing voice that captured everyone's attention. 她有着迷人的歌唱嗓音，吸引了所有人的注意力。

Employees were encouraged to voice their suggestions during the general meeting. 鼓励员工在大会期间表达他们的建议。

wake.note:
I usually wake up early at six o'clock without relying on an alarm. 我通常早晨六点钟醒来，不需要依靠闹钟。

Please don't make loud noises that might wake the sleeping baby. 请不要发出可能唤醒沉睡婴儿的大声吵闹。

walk.note:
They decided to walk home instead of taking the crowded public bus. 他们决定走路回家，而不是乘坐拥挤的公共汽车。

Let's go for a relaxing walk along the sandy beach this evening. 今晚让我们沿着沙滩散散步放松一下吧。

wallet.note:
He realized he had left his leather wallet on the restaurant table. 他意识到自己把皮革钱包遗留在了餐厅桌子上。

My wallet contains my identity card, driving license, and cash. 我的钱包里装有我的身份证、驾驶执照和现金。

want.meaning: v. 想要；需要; n. 需要；缺乏
want.note:
Do you want to join our study group for the upcoming history exam? 你想要加入我们的学习小组备考即将到来的历史考试吗？

The poor family suffered from extreme hunger and basic material want. 这个贫困的家庭遭受着极度的饥饿和基本物资的匮乏。

war.note:
The country suffered great economic loss during the long devastating war. 该国在漫长而具毁灭性的战争中遭受了巨大的经济损失。

Diplomats worked around the clock to prevent a destructive global war. 外交官们昼夜不停地工作以防止一场破坏性的全球战争。

warm.meaning: adj. 温暖的；热情的; v. (使)变暖
warm.note:
Spring brings warm weather and blooming flowers after a cold winter. 在寒烈的冬天过后，春天带来了温暖的天气和盛开的花朵。

The host extended a very warm welcome to all the newly arrived guests. 主人对所有新到来的客人表示了非常热烈的欢迎。

Sit close to the fireplace to warm your cold hands after being outside. 外出回来后坐近火炉，取暖冻僵的手。

warning.note:
The weather station issued a flood warning due to heavy rainfall. 由于强降雨，气象站发布了洪水警报。

He ignored the clear safety warning sign and entered the hazardous area. 他无视明确的安全警告标志，进入了危险区域。

washroom.note:
Where is the nearest clean washroom located on this building floor? 这个建筑楼层最近的干净洗手间在哪里？

He went to the washroom to wash his sticky hands before lunch. 午饭前他去洗手间洗了洗黏糊糊的手。

waste.meaning: v. 浪费; n. 浪费；废弃物; adj. 废弃的
waste.note:
Do not waste your valuable time playing senseless computer games. 不要把宝贵的时间浪费在玩无意义的电脑游戏上。

The local factory must process chemical waste safely to protect nature. 当地工厂必须安全处理化学废弃物以保护自然环境。

watch.meaning: v. 观看；注视；看守; n. 手表；监视
watch.note:
They love to watch live theatrical plays at the historic downtown theater. 他们喜欢在市中心的历史剧院观看现场戏剧表演。

My grandfather gave me a beautiful classic mechanical wristwatch as a gift. 祖父送给我一块漂亮的经典机械手表作为礼物。

water.meaning: n. 水; v. 浇水；供水
water.note:
Drinking enough clean water every day is essential for good body health. 每天饮用足够的干净水对身体健康至关重要。

Remember to water the potted green plants on the balcony every two days. 记得每两天给阳台上的盆栽绿植浇水一次。

wave.meaning: v. 挥手；摇动; n. 波浪；挥手
wave.note:
She waved goodbye enthusiastically to her friends as the bus drove away. 随着公交车驶离，她热情地挥手向朋友们告别。

Surfers gather at the ocean beach to catch the giant ocean waves. 冲浪爱好者聚集在大洋海滩上捕捉巨大的海浪。

way.meaning: n. 道路；路线；方法；方向
way.note:
Could you please show me the fastest way to get to the airport? 你能告诉我去机场最快怎么走吗？

Everyone has a unique way of dealing with personal stress and anxiety. 每个人都有自己独特的方式来应对个人压力与焦虑。

we.note:
We are going to organize a outdoor charity marathon next Saturday. 我们计划下周六组织一场户外慈善马拉松。

Together we can overcome any challenges that stand in our collective way. 只要团结一致，我们就能克服阻碍我们前进的任何挑战。

weak.meaning: adj. 虚弱的；微弱的；薄弱的
weak.note:
He felt very weak after recovering from a serious viral flu infection. 在从严重的病毒性感冒中康复后，他感到身体非常虚弱。

This argument is far too weak to convince the board of Directors. 这个论点太薄弱了，无法说服董事会。

wear.meaning: v. 穿；戴；磨损; n. 穿戴；服装
wear.note:
You should wear a heavy coat today because the outdoor temperature is low. 你今天应该穿一件厚大衣，因为户外温度很低。

This boutique store specializes in high-quality formal business wear for women. 这家精品店专门经营高质量的女式正式商务服装。

weather.note:
The warm sunny weather made our outdoor picnic very enjoyable. 温暖晴朗的天气使我们的户外野餐变得非常愉快。

Always check the local daily weather forecast before planning long hikes. 在计划长途徒步旅行之前，务必查看当地的每日天气预报。

wednesday.note:
Our weekly team progress meeting is held every Wednesday morning at nine. 我们的每周团队进度会议在每周三上午九点举行。

Next Wednesday is an official public holiday, so schools will be closed. 下周三是法定公共假期，所以学校将放假。

week.note:
He will travel to France for business next week to sign contracts. 他下周将去法国出差签署合同。

There are seven days in a week, starting from Monday to Sunday. 一周有七天，从星期一到星期日。

weekday.meaning: n. 工作日 (周一至周五的任一天)
weekday.note:
The public museum is usually less crowded on a normal weekday morning. 在普通工作日的早晨，公共博物馆通常没那么拥挤。

He commutes by train to work every single weekday without exception. 毫无例外，他每个工作日都乘火车通勤上班。

weekend.note:
What do you usually plan to do with your family during the weekend? 周末期间你通常计划和家人一起做什么？

They spent a relaxing weekend at a cozy cabin near the blue lake. 他们在蓝色湖泊附近的一座舒适小屋里度过了轻松的周末。

weigh.note:
The airport staff will weigh your luggage before allowing you to board. 机场工作人员会在允许你登机前称量你的行李重量。

You must carefully weigh the advantages and disadvantages before deciding. 在做出决定之前，你必须仔细权衡利弊。

weight.note:
He has been exercising regularly to manage his body weight effectively. 他一直在定期锻炼以有效地管理自己的体重。

The heavy wooden table could not bear the extra weight of the equipment. 这张重木桌无法承受设备带来的额外重量。

welcome.meaning: v./n. 欢迎; adj. 受欢迎的; int. 欢迎
welcome.note:
We extend a sincere welcome to all delegates attending this global forum. 我们向参加本次全球论坛的所有代表表示诚挚的欢迎。

You are always welcome to stay at our house whenever you visit London. 无论何时你访问伦敦，都随时欢迎住在我们家。

well.meaning: adv. 很好地; adj. 健康的; n. 水井; int. 呃
well.note:
She plays the piano exceptionally well after years of dedication. 经过多年的专注投入，她钢琴弹得相当好。

I didn't feel very well yesterday morning, so I stayed home to rest. 我昨天早上感觉身体不太舒服，所以留在家休息。

The villagers drew fresh drinking water from an ancient deep well. 村民们从一口古老深井中抽取新鲜的饮用水。

west.meaning: n./adj. 西方(的)；西部(的); adv. 向西
west.note:
The bright sun sets in the west every evening over the distant ocean. 璀璨的太阳每天傍晚在遥远的大洋西边落下。

They drove west along the highway for hours to reach the coastal city. 他们沿着公路向西行驶了数小时，到达了那座沿海城市。

western.meaning: adj. 西方的；西部的; n. 西方电影/小说
western.note:
Many western countries share common historical and cultural roots. 许多西方国家有着共同的历史与文化渊源。

He enjoys watching classic western movies about cowboys and wild horses. 他喜欢看关于牛仔和野马的经典西方电影。

westerner.note:
As a Westerner living in Tokyo, he found the culture fascinating. 作为一名生活在东京的西方人，他觉得这里的文化非常迷人。

Many Westerners come to travel and study ancient Asian history here. 许多西方人来到这里旅游并学习古代亚洲历史。

westwards.meaning: adv. 向西 (也可拼作 westward)
westwards.note:
The flock of wild birds flew westwards as the winter cold approached. 随着冬日寒冷的临近，那群野生鸟类向西飞去。

They continued their journey westwards across the vast open desert plain. 他们继续跨越辽阔开放的沙漠平原向西前进。

wet.meaning: adj. 湿的；潮湿的; v. 弄湿
wet.note:
Don't sit on that wooden bench because the fresh paint is still wet. 不要坐在那条木椅上，因为新漆还是湿的。

His clothes got completely wet after getting caught in the sudden downpour. 在陷入突如其来的倾盆大雨后，他的衣服全湿透了。

what.note:
What is the primary reason for your sudden decision to change jobs? 你突然决定换工作的主要原因是什么？

What a wonderful musical performance we enjoyed at the theater tonight! 我们今晚在剧院享受了一场多么棒的音乐表演啊！

whatever.meaning: pron./adj. 无论什么；任何事物
whatever.note:
You can choose whatever food items you like from the menu buffet. 你可以从自助餐菜单中挑选任何你喜欢的食物。

Whatever happens during the competition, we should remain calm and focused. 无论在比赛期间发生什么，我们都应该保持冷静和专注。

wheat.note:
The golden fields of ripe wheat were ready for autumn harvesting. 成熟小麦的金黄田野已经准备好进行秋收了。

Whole wheat bread is generally considered healthier than refined white bread. 全麦面包通常被认为比精制白面包更健康。

wheel.meaning: n. 车轮；轮子; v. 推动；旋转
wheel.note:
One of the bicycle wheels came off after hitting a bump on the road. 自行车的其中一个轮子在碰到路上的颠簸后脱落了。

The nurse gently wheeled the injured patient into the examination room. 护士轻轻地推着推车把受伤的病人送进检查室。

when.note:
When does the international conference officially begin tomorrow morning? 明天早上国际会议什么时候正式开始？

Please remember to turn off all lights when you leave the study room. 当你离开书房时，请记得关掉所有的灯。

whenever.note:
You are free to call me for help whenever you encounter difficulties. 每当遇到困难时，你都可以随时打电话给我寻求帮助。

Whenever he visits Paris, he makes sure to stop by that cozy cafe. 无论何时他访问巴黎，他都一定要顺道光顾那家舒适的咖啡馆。

where.meaning: adv./conj. 在哪里；往哪里; n. 地点
where.note:
Where is the main entrance to the underground train station located? 地铁站的主入口位于哪里？

This is the peaceful seaside town where I spent my primary childhood. 这就是我度过童年时光的那座宁静的海滨小镇。

wherever.meaning: conj./adv. 无论在哪里；无论去哪里
wherever.note:
I will support your career decisions wherever you choose to live. 无论你选择住在哪里，我都会支持你的职业决定。

Friendly local people welcomed us warmly wherever we went on the island. 无论我们在岛上去哪里，友好的当地人都热烈地欢迎我们。

which.note:
Which of these two design options do you think is more suitable? 你认为这两个设计选项中哪一个更合适？

She bought the book which was strongly recommended by her English teacher. 她买了她英语老师强烈推荐的那本书。

whichever.meaning: pron./adj. 无论哪个；无论哪些
whichever.note:
You can pick whichever seat is available in the seminar room. 你可以选择讲座放映室里任何空着的座位。

Whichever road you choose to take, make sure to drive very carefully. 无论你选择走哪条路，都务必非常小心地驾驶。

while.meaning: conj. 当…的时候；虽然；而; n. 一会儿
while.note:
She listened to soft relaxing music while studying for her exams. 她在备考学习的同时听着舒缓放松的音乐。

While I understand your point of view, I still disagree with the plan. 虽然我理解你的观点，但我仍然不同意这个计划。

Let's sit down and rest here together for a little while. 让我们一起在这里坐下来休息一小会儿吧。

white.meaning: adj. 白色的；白种人的; n. 白色；蛋白
white.note:
She wore a elegant white dress for her formal wedding ceremony. 她穿了一件优雅的白色礼服参加正式的婚礼仪式。

Separate the egg white from the yellow yolk carefully in a bowl. 在碗里仔细地将蛋白与黄色蛋黄分开。

who.note:
Who is responsible for organizing the annual international conference? 谁负责组织这场年度国际会议？

He is a famous doctor who has dedicated his life to medical research. 他是一位将一生奉献给医学研究的著名医生。

whole.meaning: adj. 全部的；整体的; n. 整体；全部
whole.note:
The whole family went on a long vacation trip across Europe. 全家一起踏上了横跨欧洲的长途度假旅行。

When taken as a whole, the plan seems extremely feasible and realistic. 作为一个整体来看，这个计划似乎极其可行且切合实际。

whom.note:
To whom should I address this formal business application letter? 我应该把这封正式的求职申请信寄给谁？

The candidate whom we interviewed yesterday afternoon proved very capable. 我们昨天下午面试的那位候选人被证明非常有能力。

whose.note:
Whose black leather jacket is this left on the meeting room chair? 这件遗留在会议室椅子上的黑色皮革夹克是谁的？

I met a talented writer whose new fantasy book recently won an award. 我遇到了一位有才华的作家，他的新奇幻书最近获得了奖项。

why.meaning: adv. 为什么; n. 原因；理由
why.note:
Why did you choose to study mechanical engineering at university? 你为什么选择在大学学习机械工程？

That is the exact financial reason why we decided to sell the office. 那正是我们决定出售办公室的真正财务原因。

wide.meaning: adj. 宽阔的；广泛的; adv. 充分地
wide.note:
The heavy truck drove down a wide avenue lined with palm trees. 这辆重型卡车驶过一条排列着棕榈树的宽阔大街。

The university offers a wide range of academic courses for students. 该大学为学生提供广泛的学术课程选择。

wife.note:
He bought a beautiful golden ring for his beloved wife on her birthday. 他在他妻子的生日那天给她买了一枚漂亮的金戒指。

His wife works as a senior software designer for a technology company. 他的妻子在一家科技公司担任高级软件设计师。

will.meaning: aux. 将；会; n. 意志；遗嘱
will.note:
Our engineering team will launch the updated software system next Monday. 我们的工程团队将于下周一推出更新后的软件系统。

She displayed strong personal will and courage to overcome her illness. 她展现出坚强的个人意志和勇气来克服疾病。

The elderly lawyer helped the family read their late grandfather's legal will. 年老的律师帮助家人阅读了他们已故祖父的合法遗嘱。

win.meaning: v. 赢得；获胜; n. 胜利
win.note:
Our sports team hopes to win the national championship final tomorrow. 我们的体育队希望能在明天的全国锦标赛决赛中获胜。

It was a crucial win that guaranteed their place in the next round. 这是一场关键的胜利，保证了他们晋级下一轮。

wind.meaning: n. 风; v. /waɪnd/ 缠绕；弯曲；给…上发条
wind.note:
A strong cool wind blew across the open ocean fields in autumn. 秋天里，一股强劲的凉风吹过开阔的大洋田野。

You need to wind up the spring clock every night so it keeps time. 你需要每天晚上给这座弹簧钟上发条，这样它才能保持走时准确。

window.note:
Please open the room window to let in some fresh morning air. 请打开房间的窗户，让一些新鲜的晨气进来。

She looked out of the plane window to see the fluffy clouds below. 她向飞机窗外看去，看到了下方蓬松的云朵。

windy.note:
It was so windy today that my light umbrella blew inside out. 今天风太大，以至于我轻巧的雨伞都被吹得翻了过去。

They flew kites together on the windy hilltop during the weekend. 周末期间，他们一起在多风的山顶上放风筝。

wine.note:
They ordered a bottle of fine red wine to celebrate their success. 他们点了一瓶优质红葡萄酒来庆祝他们的成功。

This region in France is internationally famous for producing organic wine. 法国的这个地区因生产有机葡萄酒而闻名国际。

winner.note:
The proud winner of the marathon received a bright gold medal. 马拉松大赛骄傲的胜利者获得了一枚璀璨的金牌。

Judges will announce the final competition winner at the end of the ceremony. 评委将在典礼结束时宣布最终的比赛赢家。

winter.note:
Heavy white snow covers the scenic mountain peaks throughout the winter. 整个冬天，厚重的白雪覆盖着风景如画的山峰。

Many birds fly south to warmer regions to spend the cold winter. 许多鸟类飞往南方更温暖的地区过冬。

wish.note:
I wish you the very best of luck with your new business venture. 我祝愿你在新的商业创业中一切顺利。

She blew out all the candles on the cake and made a silent wish. 她吹灭了蛋糕上的所有蜡烛，许下了一个心愿。

with.meaning: prep. 和…一起；用；随着；关于
with.note:
He went to the cinema with his close university friends yesterday. 他昨天和他的大学亲密朋友一起去了电影院。

She sliced the sweet red apple into pieces with a sharp knife. 她用一把锋利的刀把甜甜的红苹果切成碎片。

without.note:
It is difficult to solve complex math problems without a calculator. 没有计算器，很难解决复杂的数学问题。

He left the house quickly without taking his warm winter coat. 他没拿他温暖的冬衣就迅速离开了房子。

woman.meaning: n. 妇女；成年女子 (复数 women)
woman.note:
A kind elderly woman offered her seat to the pregnant passenger. 一位善良的老年妇女把她的座位让给了怀孕的乘客。

She is a successful business woman running her own marketing firm. 她是一位成功的商务女性，经营着自己的营销公司。

wonderful.note:
We had a truly wonderful holiday spending time by the ocean. 我们在海边度过了一个真正精彩的假期。

Thank you for inviting us to such a wonderful classical concert. 谢谢你邀请我们参加如此精彩的古典音乐会。

wood.meaning: n. 木材；木头；树林 (复数 woods)
wood.note:
The comfortable rustic furniture is made entirely of solid natural wood. 这套舒适的乡村风格家具完全由实木天然木头制成。

They went for an exploratory walk in the peaceful woods near town. 他们去镇附近宁静的树林里散步探索。

wool.note:
My mother knitted a warm winter scarf using pure sheep wool. 我母亲用纯羊毛编织了一条温暖的冬日围巾。

Natural wool is a great sustainable material for making winter coats. 天然羊毛是制作冬衣的一种极佳的可持续材料。

woolen.meaning: adj. 羊毛制的；毛纺的 (英式拼写作 woollen)
woolen.note:
She wore a cozy woolen sweater to stay warm in the chilly weather. 她穿了一件舒适的羊毛衫以在寒冷的天气里保持温暖。

These high-quality woolen socks are perfect for long mountain hikes. 这些高质量的羊毛袜子非常适合长途登山徒步。

word.meaning: n. 单词；话语；承诺; v. 措辞
word.note:
Look up the exact meaning of this unfamiliar English word in the dictionary. 在字典里查查这个不熟悉的英语单词的确切意思。

Give me your word that you will keep this secret completely safe. 向我承诺你会完全保守这个秘密。

work.meaning: v. 工作；运转；起作用; n. 工作；作品
work.note:
She has to work extra hours tonight to complete the urgent design. 她今晚不得不加班工作以完成这项紧急的设计。

This classic painting is considered a masterwork of nineteenth-century art. 这幅经典画作被认定为十九世纪艺术的杰作。

worker.note:
The construction worker wore a protective hard hat on the site. 建筑工人在工地现场佩戴了保护性安全帽。

Every dedicated healthcare worker was praised for their courage. 每一位敬业的医护工作者都因其勇气受到了赞扬。

workplace.note:
Maintaining safety standards is crucial in every modern industrial workplace. 在每个现代工业工作场所中保持安全标准是至关重要的。

Company management works hard to foster an inclusive office workplace. 公司管理层努力培养一个包容的办公职场环境。

works.meaning: n. 工厂；著作；工程 (复数名词或单复同形)
works.note:
The city council inspected the new sewage treatment works project. 市议会检查了新的污水处理工程项目。

He has studied the complete literary works of Shakespeare in detail. 他详细研究了莎士比亚的全套文学著作。

world.note:
She dreams of traveling around the whole world to experience cultures. 她梦想着周游全世界以体验不同的文化。

The internet has drastically changed how information moves across the world. 互联网彻底改变了信息在世界各地传播的方式。

worried.note:
Her parents were very worried when she didn't return home on time. 当她没有按时回家时，她的父母非常担心。

He looked worried about the prospective results of his medical exam. 他看起来对自己的医学检查预期结果感到发愁。

worry.meaning: v. 担心；使烦恼; n. 担忧；烦恼
worry.note:
Don't worry about making mistakes when learning a new language. 学习一门新语言时不要担心犯错。

Financial instability is a major source of worry for many families. 财务不稳定是许多家庭担忧的主要来源。

worse.meaning: adj./adv. 更坏的(地)；更差的(地) (bad的比较级)
worse.note:
The storm conditions grew worse as night fell over the coastal area. 随着夜幕降临沿海地区，暴风雨状况变得更糟糕了。

He performed worse than expected in the running trial due to injury. 由于受伤，他在跑步选拔赛中的表现比预期的更差。

worst.meaning: adj./adv. 最坏的(地)；最差的(地) (bad的最高级)
worst.note:
This is by far the worst heavy traffic jam I have ever experienced. 这是迄今为止我经历过的最严重交通拥堵。

Even in the worst situations, she always tries to maintain optimism. 即使在最坏的情况下，她也总是试图保持乐观。

worth.meaning: prep. 值得；值…钱; n. 价值
worth.note:
This historic museum artifact is estimated to be worth millions of dollars. 这件历史博物馆文物估计价值数百万元。

The historical exhibition is definitely worth visiting with your family. 这个历史展览绝对值得带着你的家人一起去参观。

would.meaning: aux. 将；愿意 (will的过去式)；(表虚拟或委婉语气)
would.note:
He said that he would call me as soon as he reached the airport. 他说过他一到达机场就会给我打电话。

Would you mind closing the window because it is getting a bit cold? 你介意把窗户关上吗，因为天气变得有点冷了？

wound.meaning: n. 伤口；创伤; v. 使受伤
wound.note:
The doctor cleaned the open wound carefully to prevent bacterial infection. 医生仔细清洗了敞开的伤口以防止细菌感染。

The deep emotional wound caused by the betrayal took years to heal. 背叛造成的深层情感创伤花了数年时间才平复。

wounded.meaning: adj. 受伤的; n. 伤员
wounded.note:
Paramedics treated the wounded passengers right at the accident scene. 急救人员在事故现场立即救治了受伤的乘客。

The team worked heroically to evacuate all the wounded soldiers. 团队英勇工作，撤离了所有受伤的士兵。

write.note:
Please write your full name clearly at the top of the answer sheet. 请在答题卡的顶部清楚地写下你的全名。

She aspires to write an inspiring novel about historical adventures. 她渴望写一本关于历史冒险的鼓舞人心的小说。

wrong.meaning: adj. 错误的；不道德的; adv. 错误地; n. 坏事
wrong.note:
I dialed the wrong telephone number by mistake earlier this morning. 今天早上我不小心拨错了电话号码。

There is something wrong with the car engine; it makes strange noises. 汽车发动机出了些故障；它发出奇怪的噪音。

year.note:
They are planning to buy a new house in the suburb early next year. 他们计划在明年年初在郊区买一套新房子。

She spent a whole academic year studying abroad at an Italian college. 她在一所意大利大学度过了整整一个学年的留学生涯。

yellow.meaning: adj. 黄色的; n. 黄色
yellow.note:
She wore a bright yellow raincoat while walking under the rain. 她在雨中步行时穿了一件鲜黄色的雨衣。

The autumn leaves turned a beautiful shade of yellow and golden brown. 秋天的树叶变成了漂亮的黄色和金褐色。

yes.note:
Yes, I would be delighted to attend your birthday party tomorrow night. 是的，我很乐意参加你明天晚上的生日派对。

When asked if he agreed with the proposal, he nodded and said yes. 当被问及是否同意该提议时，他点头说是的。

yesterday.note:
I received an official confirmation letter from the university yesterday. 我昨天收到了来自该大学的官方确认信。

Yesterday was one of the hottest days of this summer season. 昨天是这个夏季中最热的天气之一。

yet.meaning: adv. 还；已经; conj. 然而；可是
yet.note:
The delivery package has not arrived at our office location yet. 快递包裹还没有送达我们的办公室地点。

He is soft-spoken, yet he commands strong authority in meetings. 他说话温和，然而他在会议上却拥有强大的权威。

you.note:
Can you please pass me the salt shaker from across the table? 你能把桌子对面的盐罐递给我吗？

I hope that you all have a fantastic and safe weekend vacation. 我希望你们所有人都能度过一个精彩且安全的周末假期。

young.meaning: adj. 年轻的；幼小的; n. 幼崽
young.note:
Many young professionals move to major metropolitan cities for opportunities. 许多年轻的专业人士搬到主要的大都市寻求机会。

The mother bird diligently feeds her vulnerable young in the high nest. 鸟妈妈在很高的大巢里勤劳地喂养她脆弱的幼崽。

your.note:
Don't forget to take your official identity card before leaving home. 离开家之前不要忘记带上你的官方身份证。

What is your personal opinion regarding the new educational policies? 关于这项新的教育政策，你个人的意见是什么？

yours.meaning: pron. 你的(东西)；你们的(东西)
yours.note:
Is this red umbrella left on the office chair yours or mine? 这把遗留在办公室椅子上的红雨伞是你的还是我的？

Their strategic plan was successful, and we hope yours will be too. 他们的战略计划成功了，我们希望你们的计划也会成功。

yourself.note:
You should give yourself more credit for completing the tough project. 完成这个艰巨的项目，你更应该为你自己感到自豪。

Make sure to take good care of yourself during this busy exam period. 在这个繁忙的考试期间，务必照顾好你自己。

yourselves.meaning: pron. 你们自己 (复数反身代词)
yourselves.note:
Please help yourselves to any food and drinks available at the party. 请大家在派对上随意享用任何食物和饮料。

You all should be immensely proud of yourselves for making this happen. 你们所有人能促成这件事，都应该为你们自己感到无比自豪。

zoo.note:
Parents took their enthusiastic children to visit the city zoo today. 父母们今天带着热情的孩子们去参观了城市动物园。

The local zoo works hard to protect endangered species through breeding. 当地动物园努力通过繁殖来保护濒危物种。
